title: Wove
description: A cozy platforming adventure where you explore various worlds as a small doll-like traveler, solving puzzles and unlocking outfits. Play solo, or share the journey with others along the way.

title: DuoZuplixo
description: DuoZuplixo is a 2D platforming collect-a-thon with some RPG elements. You'll be taking control of two characters, Dr. Zuplow & Nora. You'll be able to switch between these two on the fly, and will need to make use of both of their abilities to collect all the Zuplonium Orbs and proceed through the areas. Alongside the Zuplonium Orbs you'll also find other secrets hidden throughout, such as Health & Attack Upgrades & tokens that allow you to access 3D bonus levels.​

title: Pushed a 'Bot!
description: 100% restoration of the touch of the arcade! This "Ji" allows you to bring the entire coin pusher arcade home.

title: Empronix Game
description:
The villain from the Bluky and Phen series now has his own game! He's just a head in this one so don't get your hopes up.

Speed through levels with a new moveset! Increase your gear to get even faster! Each level has new mechanics, as well as an increase in size! New "masking" mechanic where you can transform into enemies! Try out even more movesets! Escape sequences! We sure need more of that in this genre.

title: Curse the Cursor
description: An idle game with two opposite modes. --Parker Mode: Do not move your cursor!-- --Nonstop Mode: Move your cursor!-- Customize your game with skins, effects, and backgrounds.

title: Ultimate Drummer
description: Ultimate Drummer is an action-platformer where you play as a lone drummer on a sacred quest to restore harmony to a fractured world. Use a fully playable step-sequencer drum kit to reshape reality, awaken lost musicians, and bring music back to life.

title: Core Hustlers
description: Core Hustlers is a single-player sci-fi extraction shooter where every run is unique. Infiltrate derelict stations, hack data cores, outthink ruthless AI, and survive shifting, deadly environments.

title: Entropic Fracture
description: Entropic Fracture is a speed and combat-focused platformer in which you play as Doctor Chaos, a green doctor hellbent on destroying his brother's plans for total world annihilation.

title: Step Away
description: Step Away makes your time off-screen feel more rewarding. While you’re away, going for a walk, cleaning up or grocery shopping, the little wanderer gathers steps. When you return, you might find he’s earned a new hat for his journey.

title: Essential Power
description: Essential Power is a short visual novel. The main character's mundane routine is turned upside down when he meets Mia, a talented designer.

title: Baku Maru
description: A fast-paced 3D unique action platformer where you'll be rolling and munching all your nightmares away.

title: Drug Business
description: Drug Business is a single player simulation game. Plunge headlong into the gangland and experience the thrill of knowing that you're beyond the law. Develop your business: grow and sell your goods, improve your possession.

title: Village of the Ages
description: If a giant tornado ended it all, can you rebuild? Guide villagers from the Early Ages to Middle Ages and beyond in this cute chaos village simulator. No progress bars, no tech trees. Paradise or inferno - you decide.

title: We, Junk Artists
description: A "collage-and-guess" multiplayer game for up to 6 players. Enjoy collaging ordinary items into outside-the-box "masterpieces," guess each other's creations, and unleash your wild imagination around the campfire. Here, everyone is an artist!

title: Job Fit For a Devil
description: An adventure game with crafting and transformations about a devil in the service of Peter the Great. Play as a little imp - trick, lie, steal and cheat in order to get your way and move up the ladder!

title: Heroes of Magic & Cards
description: Build the perfect deck, draw the perfect hand, and strike down your enemies with pairs and straights. Heroes of Magic & Cards is a roguelike deckbuilder with a poker twist, sending you and your fifty-two into a mystical fantasy world of monsters and magecraft!

title: Flow Skate
description: Introducing Flow Skate, a fast-paced 3D platformer with gameplay inspired by Sonic R and Kirby Air Ride, with a sharp cel-shaded aesthetic.

title: Trench Lord: Eastern Front
description: The enemy has invaded the territory, the motherland needs you, soldier! Gather your troops and defeat all enemies!

title: Clione's Bomb-Bomb Sweeper
description: A spin-off from the asymmetric party action game "Goonya Monster," with character designs by Terada Tera! Break through the oncoming blocks and advance! This is a fresh, exhilarating puzzle action game that fuses bomb puzzles with unique "Goonya Monster" action!

title: Fork of the Crimson Soul
description: Fork of the Crimson Soul is a stylish character action game featuring food characters in absurd and badass life or death battles. You take control of Furter, a hot-headed fork wielding hotdog who slashes his way through heaps of enemies he's fairly quick and has a wide range of moves.

title: In the Midst of a Neverending Season
description: "Don't you want to experience a love like that some day?" As dreary days roll by, who should appear before Tokiha Sai but Emiya Hanabi, his childhood friend and first love, who he had alienated long ago. That is the start of a day that seems like a dream.

title: LLMxQuiz
description: A quiz battle adventure where AI asks and judges! Use skill cards to change the tide and defeat the stone guardian with your knowledge. Each match takes around 15 minutes—fun, casual, and great for all ages!

title: Tamago
description: Step into a delicate, sketchbook-like world and carry fragile eggs safely back home. Precision and careful control are key in this action-packed challenge.

title: Heroic Songs: The Remix!
description: Travel through fantasy worlds and build an idol sanctuary! An idol × city-building simulation game where you create your very own fan sanctuary alongside adorable idols to restore the lost connections between worlds!

title: Yooca: Next Horizon
description: A multiplayer life-sim RPG where you build character traits like Net Worth, Influence, Authority, and Strength, master real-world skills, craft items, complete quests, and shape your story in a vibrant, evolving metaverse filled with challenges, friends, and opportunities.

title: Little Re-collector
description: Join Annie and Tristan, the Re-collector, in the collapsing tower “Worseth” to retrieve treasures. Will you keep exploring, or make your escape? Make the best choices if you want to bring back more treasures!

title: Flipping Frogs 64
description: Flipping Frogs is a fast-paced platformer built around one mechanic: a grappling-hook tongue. Whether you’re snagging flies, launching across gaps, or chaining together perfect swings, the tongue is your main tool for movement, combat, and speed.

title: Neffy: Moonlight Labyrinth X
description: Neffy -Moonlight Labyrinth X- is an action puzzle game where you team up with the young shrine maiden Neffy to solve riddles and overcome traps in a fantasy maze.Originally developed for VR, the game has been carefully optimized for consoles—now more accessible than ever!

title: NeverAwake Flashback
description: The side story to the nightmare shooter NeverAwake is here! Why is this young girl being tormented by nightmares once again? Dive into a roguelite reimagination of the original with all-new features!

title: Mana Land
description: Mana Land brings multiplayer thrills into a single-player RPG with thousands of AI-powered players online. They think, feel, and have unique personalities. Explore stories, trade, make friends or team up for dungeons, quests, and PvP. It's a world where AIs have souls, and stories are shared.

title: Loafing Town
description: A relaxing and humorous idle god simulator that stays at the bottom of your screen or on a second monitor while you do other things. With physics-based dragging interactions, it feels just like playing with desk toys.

title: Soul Redemption
description: "Soul Redemption" is a card-based role-playing game. In a decaying kingdom, play as a merciful priest and guide the lost sheep back to the light.

title: Riyou
description: Riyou is an RPG about nostalgia, childhood adventure, and close friends. Explore both your fondest memories and your darkest fears.

title: Agreeee
description: Can you 'play' this game!? To play the thrilling action game, you must agree to all 12 terms and conditions.

title: Fluffy Kitchen Saga
description: A restaurant simulation game located at the bottom of your computer screen, where both staff and customers are fluffy little animals! They’ll keep you company while you work/study. Let’s run a restaurant full of fluffiness!

title: Honu
description: Honu is a first-person puzzle game set in a story-rich, stylized world filled with magitech and charming characters. Developed by H-BRS DevTeam—a German hobbyist game development team supported by Hochschule Bonn-Rhein-Sieg.

title: Card Cultivation
description: Card Cultivation is a card management game that visualizes the process of cultivating immortality through cards. In the game, you will play as a cultivation practitioner: cultivate techniques, explore treasures, and craft weapons, Throughout re-cultivation, you will recover memory.

title: Holy Intentions
description: Holy Intentions is a fast-paced FPS set on a divine scale. You are a crusader, chosen to punish the wicked. Armed with a dragon and devastating holy powers, tear apart an evil cult that controls the entire world.

title: Spark! Photon Blast
description: "SPARK! -PHOTON BLAST-" is a sports action game where players face off in a futuristic stadium, rendered with stunningly beautiful photorealistic graphics. Your goal is to score by launching a sphere into your opponent's goal. Enjoy the heart-pounding, high-octane action where every second counts!

title: In Harness
description: IN HARNESS is an online co-op 3D jumping game for 1–10 players. With simple move and jump controls, pets team up to clear tough stages and reunite with a girl in heaven, bringing the warm “Helper’s High” of saving friends.

title: Cozy Forest
description: Restore a sleepy forest with adorable animals. Explore, craft, and decorate a cottage-core haven at your own rhythm—no timers, no hassle. Progress continues while you’re away!

title: The Dowsing
description: You have entered a sealed gold mine, dreaming of a fortune. All you can rely on is your dowsing rod. Is it gold that lies beyond your reaction, or is it......?

title: Over the Radio
description: Local co-op game about flying a plane. One player is the pilot, the other the navigator. The pilot has no map. The navigator guides the pilot using only words. Work together to reach your goal in a remixable national park map.

title: Zozo and the Lost Dreams
description: Help Zozo find his way home in this cartoon-inspired Metroidvania platformer. Pillow-fight sentient pastries, train under an octopus master, and brave a cybernetic jungle as you explore the vibrant landscapes of Zozo's dreams.

title: Trick Eight
description: On a remote village shrouded in bloody tradition, a centuries-old ritual endures. You are a detective with unique skills, yet branded as a traitor. Will you surrender your limbs to ascend like an immortal? Or risk everything at the edge of science and plunge into the abyss of truth?

title: Oedo Developer
description: “Oedo Developer” is a city builder featuring Ieyasu Tokugawa's Edo. Story and free play modes are available, the first offering a history based city building experience, and the second allowing you to freely develop the lands. Plan, build, distribute, and learn as you make the Edo of your dreams!

title: Captain Corgi: Planetary Problem Solver
description: Mr Wolf is up to no good and Lil Red might be in trouble! It's up to Captain Corgi to investigate and figure out what's really going on.

title: Surface Labyrinth Kurumabu
description: Neo-2D Action Puzzle Game !

title: I Saw a Flying Saucer
description: An interactive fiction about a man who lost his wife and goes in search of a UFO that shouldn't exist.

title: Crude Oil
description: Escape your captors as a puddle of petroleum on the run from Big Oil. Collect more oil to grow big and juicy. Bounce and slide. Operate heavy machinery. Flush polluters down the drain.

title: Underground Nomads
description: You're the commander of a drilling train, leading a clan of dwarves through the underground depths toward the planetary core. Manage the crew, complete expeditions, gather resources, upgrade equipment, and make tough choices to reach the abandoned city and return your people to their home.

title: Chrono Impact
description: Portal meets Superhot - A revolutionary FPS puzzle with time manipulation Wield two time-control guns, red and blue, to rewrite the laws of physics. Master deceleration and acceleration to solve seemingly impossible puzzles.

title: Eternal One
description: Eternal ONE is a visual novel game of futuristic fantasy genre, learning about secret of the city while resolving various request of Lucio City.

title: Cat's Wars
description: Cat's Wars is a turn-based cooperative third-person tactical game. Choose one of the sides, the Kotnaz or the Koterists, and prove who the real cat is.

title: Sonic.exe: Dark Souls Remake
description:
While on vacation, Sonic The Hedgehog, making a discovery on Angel Island, calls his friend Miles “Tails” Prower so they could investigate it together, not realizing that he has gotten himself possessed.

The self proclaimed demon, Exezar, using Sonic’s body, goes on a mission alongside his only demon friend, Oxiel, to revive the physical body of himself and his ally, Avares… but, do the both of them have the same goal in mind?

Waking up from the commotion caused by Exezar on Angel Island, Knuckles The Echidna rushes to the rescue of the Master Emerald.

His badniks have made the same discovery as Sonic, and with Metal Sonic sent away to collect the Chaos Emeralds, Dr. Ivo “Eggman” Robotnik, travels to Angel Island to confirm his badniks’ discovery with his own eyes, only to find himself tangling with the Heroes on the way and, later, Exezar's companion, Oxiel.

title: Be Lost
description: BE LOST is a third-person horror adventure where you control three characters trapped in a mysterious world. Explore schools, caves, forests, and ruins, face dangerous enemies, and uncover dark secrets while fighting to survive.

title: Compensated Girl
description: “Compensated Girl” is a deck-building roguelike card battle adventure game.It aims to defeat monsters in card battles and try to escape from a nightmare world.However, the deck you use is the girl herself.Using cards affects the girl directly, changing elements like the UI, story, and more.

title: Clinch Legends
description: Where do the secret paths of human destinies lead? Intertwined, they create bizarre patterns of events. Choose your path in Action RPG in the spirit of your favourite representatives of the genre.

title: Chukgwi
description: A slightly special incomplete shaman with a voice that drives out evil, crosses fate and confronts the past.A PC•VR Voice-contolled Korean Folk Horror Experience.

title: Short Short Fictions
description: A short short mix tape of one story that connects three shorter stories. On the NewWave, a magical game console that is retro but new, enjoy DON'T SAY YES, TO:NORTH, and a secret tale nobody yet knows. Welcome to a slightly fantastical and nostalgic world of painful, toilful, and beautiful stories!

title: Semo
description: Move the SEMO horizontally and jump to hit the circle and make it reach the target point!

title: The Window 8: Millennium
description: Hey player, It's the day before the Millennium. Follow me, I will give you a unique psychological horror experience. This isn’t just a game—it’s a doorway. Trust me, and I will lead you to see the god.‍

title: Sonic.exe: Dark Souls
description:
Sonic.exe : Dark Souls
is a game based on sonic.exe creepypasta
The story is told in a kinda different way, My way

title: Negotiation Love
description: 'It's a hundred years early to go out with me!' One day after school, I was treated coldly by her for never confessing! She tried to leave, but without giving up, I approached her to negotiate. Will I be able to become Hogetsu's lover beyond the tremendous time of 100 years...?

title: Selve
description: Play melodies to colossal spirits in this first person musical adventure. Decipher their poems, perform the songs they demand, and earn sacred melody cards. Explore the tension between your own voice and the expectations of your tribe.

title: Re.dive Wonderland
description: Re.dive Wonderland is a mystery × romance visual novel where a girl wakes up in a strange RPG world with no memories. Make choices, connect with companions, and solve puzzles to uncover the truth. Includes 4 story routes and multiple endings.

title: Abyss Saga
description: In the heart of the continent lies the deep pit called Abyss, rumor says there is boundless knowledge and immeasurable wealth. As a traveler who has stumbled into Abyss, you will build a team with diverse companions to navigate the Abyss, explore its deepest layers, and unearth the ultimate truth...

title: Mount Lomyst
description: Mount Lomyst is a 2D action game about climbing to the summit of Mount Lomyst, using a grappling hook and wall climbing — without jumping.

title: Otter Yakuza
description: Otter Yakuza is an anime-style action-puzzle game set in a modern Yokohama-inspired city.Lead Zuka, the young Otter Boss, as he rebuilds his fallen clan, clashes with punk Gekkos, and restores honor crate by crate.The river always remembers.

title: Episode
description: On his way to the city, Jonas is forced to stop when his car breaks down amid a fierce storm. Stranded, he seeks refuge in Nachtheim — a seemingly quiet town hiding dark secrets. As the line between reality and the supernatural begins to blur, Jonas must navigate and uncover the truth.

title: Beyblade X Evobattle
description: Three EVOLUTIONS have been unleashed in the "BEYBLADE ACTION" game that faithfully recreates the BEYBLADE X series (distributed by TOMY Company, Ltd.) that is popular among fans of all ages! Witness the power of EVOBATTLE, EVOSTORY, and EVOCUSTOMIZE!

title: The Screen
description: Thank you for joining the ███ program. To start out, we would like to ask a few simple questions.

title: Momo Bunny: Cash Me or Crash Me!!
description: The legendary mercenary MOMO Bunny was enjoying retirement until a Colonel suddenly appeared: ‍ "Help! My team's been captured!" "Sure... but let me livestream it!" And thus begins a rescue mission with a twist - every saved teammate becomes a Super Chat donor!

title: Aum the Game
description: AUM: The Game is an arena-based combat experience with deep RPG elements and unmatched customization. Master 5 fighting styles, harness elemental powers, and wield divine blessings to forge your destiny in a myth-inspired universe. Craft your unique avatar and conquer the arena!

title: Rainbow Legends
description: A territory-control roguelike deck builder where the side with more tiles at round’s end deals damage. Seize ground, place structures, shield your core, and unlock builds with card shapes, factions, and relics

title: Pigeon Hunter
description: Pigeon Hunter is classic hidden object game. Find the pigeons and other items in a series of beautiful hand drawn environments. Complete each scene and traverse though a dream like home.

title: The Last Zone
description: The ultimate survival challenge begins now! In The Last Zone, the battle for humanity’s last stronghold reaches its climax. No longer a test – this is the real war. Armed with powerful weapons, tactical tools, and your will to survive, you must stand your ground against relentless waves of mutated enemies. Every decision, every shot, every second matters.

title: Maple and Aluna
description: Fight together as Maple and Aluna in this action-adventure roguelike. Slaughter foes, capture altars, and augment yourself with powerful mystics to survive the eternal winter.

title: Spray N' Pray
description: Spray N' Pray is a fast-paced boomer shooter where you play as Justinian, a priest armed with dual revolvers. Dash, run, and jump through a demon-infested cathedral, vanquishing hellspawn and fallen angels to earn your righteous place in heaven.

title: Axol's Quest
description: Axol's Quest is a short, turn-based fantasy RPG about a young axolotl on an epic quest to save the Land of Xochimilco from a dastardly demon king! Brotherly bonds, team attacks, and plenty of barrel puzzles await you in this endearing adventure...

title: Detective Agency: Murder at the Manor
description: The owner of the Golden Rose Manor died mysteriously in the secret room. Everyone in the manor has an alibi, but their speech is full of loopholes... You will go to the crime scene, search for clues, analyze the suspect's statement, make reasonable inferences, reveal the truth of the case!

title: Steel Torrent
description: In the game, players can choose either the French camp or the Soviet camp, and destroy the enemy's buildings to win. Players can build different weapons and arms, each faction has different buildings, and a reasonable combination of arms can make it easier for you to win.

title: Ruinscape
description: Dive into the mysteries of an abandoned castle, explore its ruins, and uncover treasures that reveal stories of the past. Serene medieval music sets the tone for a timeless journey through the ages.

title: Color Clash
description: Think your eyesight is sharp? Most can't reach 20 points. Find the different colored square in a 10x10 grid. Start with 5 seconds. Correct +1 sec, wrong -1 sec. Color differences get extremely subtle. Mouse-only, windowed mode, perfect for quick breaks. Helps train color vision.

title: Wall World Complete
description:
Explore the mysterious Wall World on your giant robospider: mine for valuable resources, upgrade your equipment to fight off hordes of monsters, and discover exotic biomes in-between attacks. Will you be able to survive and learn the secrets of the Wall World?

Includes base game, its original soundtrack and story DLC.

title: Ecopunk
description: Ecopunk is a survival and colony management simulation game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Balance survival, resource management, and hope as you guide your colony through the ruins of civilization.

title: Fantasy Waifu Collector
description: Fantasy Waifu Collector is an exciting game about collecting "Waifu" in order to build an army to build a town and restore the world from decay! Players will recruit many different characters as they explore a fascinating world filled with monsters. Defeat the Demon King to win, right?

title: Echoes of Red
description: Echoes of Red is a fast-paced roguelite shooter where you can carry tons of weapons at once, face endless enemies ever stronger and build your perfect custom loadout. Obliterate tens of thousands of enemies who dared to challenge you and make them regret standing against you.

title: Amaginu Kanojo: Side A
description: A rainy summer love story in the Japanese countryside.

title: Amaginu Kanojo: Side B
description: The second and final part of Amaginu Kanojo, with an alternative route.

title: Sex Any Cost but Free
description: As a student you will have to chase them - dates. Win their favor with eloquence, jokes and life stories. The main thing to remember is that you are a pauper.

title: Kirby: Soft & Wet
description:
Welcome to Kirby ~ Soft & Wet! This is a game where you catch as many fish as you can!
Simply throw your bobber and click the right keys!
You can also come back in other times of day to get unique catches!
Can you collect them all and fill your Fishbook?

title: Planet S: A New Horizon
description: A new Horizon is a singleplayer campaign centered around the rumored discovery of a seemingly impossible planet, codenamed Planet S. The story is told from the perspective of Hazel Renex, an ambitious young Commander with a strong determination to uncover the truth herself. However, she is not the only one who wants to reach Planet S first.

title: Tree of Sacrifice
description: Tree of Sacrifice is a role-playing game in the Dota tower climbing genre. You will be selected to become an archer/mage/warrior in the giant tree to adventure, constantly update equipment and skills to defeat all enemies that stand in your way, climb to the top of the canopy to save the island.

title: Fairies vs Bugs
description: When the bugs come to the fairy's village. The winter is coming...

title: Dark Continent
description: A fast-paced action MMORPG where every strike is aimed and every dodge matters. Take on epic bosses, experience responsive real-time combat, and enjoy full control—no tab-targeting, no auto-play, and no Pay2Win.

title: Tom Dahl
description: In the small, burnt out Northern Ontario town that was once Montgomery Hills, there is a prisoner. You are in charge. Keep yourself awake long enough to see the light of day. Uncover the truth about one of Canada's biggest tragedies. The prisoner has a name and his name is Tom Dahl.

title: VHS Bodycam: The Torture Machine
description:
The following transcript is not authorized for distribution:

The Oakwood Institute of Science reported the captivity of 26 students and faculty who all entered a building on campus, but have not come out on the morning of April 9th, 2002.

Police were notified at 6:42pm on the same day and promptly surrounded the building which held the missing students. Whether this is an active hostage situation or a gas leak is unknown.

A Swat team is on standby along with a chemist equipped with a remote controlled rover to analyze air toxicity.

We are still awaiting an update from the police chief about the fate of the missing students and faculty.

[This transcript was written on April 9th, 2002 at approximately 8:30pm]

title: I'm on Observation Duty 8
description:
As an employee of a mysterious organization, your job is to monitor live surveillance camera footage and report other-worldly anomalies using your sharp eyes and good memory.

Monitor surveillance cameras across six unique levels, each with their own unnerving "anomalies"—supernatural occurrences ranging from subtle environmental shifts to grotesque otherworldly intruders. Report anomalies to "fix" them and survive the night. If you can.

I'm on Observation Duty is the original viral franchise that ignited a trend in spot-the-difference horror games that are now loved by players worldwide.

title: Sonic Riders Plus
description:
"Sonic Riders Plus" is a mod of the original Sonic Riders for the Gamecube that focuses on enhancing the competitive potential of the game while still remaining true to the game's nature.
Changing, Adding and Removing multiple aspects of the game like Characters, Gears, Stage elements, Visuals and a lot more.

title: Manaftory
description: Collect resources, build machines, and automate everything. Explore magical lands, face hostile creatures, and turn their loot into part of your factory system. This is your Manaftory — a magical factory powered by mana.

title: Lustful Professor
description: Lustful Professor is an adult-only visual novel. In this game, you are in the role of a university professor who lives an ordinary life. But one day a student comes up to him and asks for help. After that, his life changed dramatically...

title: Gummy Bear Idle: No Job, Just Jelly
description: From promising officer to Gummy Bear Containment & Management extraordinaire! Dive into this hilarious idle game where your mission is deceptively simple: supervise a ridiculously lazy gummy bear. This "pacifist" needs to produce Star Dust, the magical fuel keeping the entire base afloat. Fail, and it's canned fish for everyone!

title: Hidden Realm of the Enchantress
description: Hidden Realm of the Enchantress is a turn-based strategic dungeon crawler RPG with deckbuilding elements where you battle and conquer a variety of fierce and alluring monster girls! Uncover the mysteries lurking within the dungeons and discover the cause of the strange incidents!

title: I Wanna Fuck My Busty Boss
description: Experience the thrill of forbidden office romance in I Wanna Fuck My Busty Boss, a captivating visual novel where workplace drama meets intense desire. Step into the shoes of Daigo Manabe, a young professional whose life takes an unexpected turn when he develops an undeniable attraction to his alluring boss, Arisa Shinoda.

title: Help! My New Roommate Is a Hung Goth Futanari Ghost!
description: Dive into a hilarious and heartwarming paranormal romance in "HELP! My New Roommate is a Hung Goth Futanari Ghost!" This engaging visual novel combines romantic comedy with a dash of horror and a whole lot of supernatural spice. Prepare for a sexy and spooky adventure unlike any other!

title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - Chronicles: Alexander the Great
description: Embark on Alexander the Great’s epic journey in this narrative-driven campaign featuring three new civilizations, customizable armies, and fresh storytelling.

title: MechaJourney
description: This is a placement game. Due to the invasion of EB and D&D, humans learn and research new technologies, which enable them to manufacture and transform mechas; It can also cultivate pilots and develop cities. Finally eliminate all invading enemies

title: The Grindstone
description: Create a party of four and begin your open world adventure. Slay monsters, complete quests and find magical treasure.

title: Geometry Breakers
description: An arcade shoot 'em up retro-style game starring Captain Spike while destroying anti-matter geometric figures chimeras and their evil organization lead by General Complox.

title: Greeny the Blox
description: Speed on through the adventurous world of Greeny the Blox! The fast-platforming cube with a burst of energy!

title: MrToilet
description: MrToilet is a demonic toilet monster who has possessed your toilet, craft the right poo, then feed it into his mouth using your ass!

title: Guild of Monsters
description: Guild of Monsters is a lane-based tower defense game inspired by the Plants vs. Zombies series, and similar titles. Play as Cassidy, an estranged princess who ran away from her deadbeat father, and a ragtag group of monsters who have been beaten down by the human kingdom. Make elaborate plans, fight against armies of soldiers, and enact vengeance on the vicious King. Recruit unique and crazy monsters to battle against equally crazy enemies. With the help of in-level upgrades and the mystical Power Cards, you can make your monster squad even stronger than you can ever imagine.

title: Hyperboard Extreme
description: Hyperboard Extreme revives PS2-era arcade-style racing with cool girls, crazy powerups, and intense, speedy action.

title: Soap Slide
description: Soap Slide is a chaotic and fun party game set in a pastel world where soaps race and slide. Play solo or co-op with friends and dive into slippery chaos across mini-games like golf, football, and more!

title: Go-Kart Racing 2
description: Test your skills out in Career Mode and race for the championship against your rivals. Race on seven different go-kart tracks and earn your spot at the top of the leaderboards.

title: Aeropunx
description: Forget gravity, ignore the limits, and prepare for a tournament where flow is your only law and style is your greatest weapon. Choose your side and fight against the system!

title: Jenny
description: Smash demons, salarymen and the bureaucratic system in this chaotic hat-and-bat twin-stick shooter.

title: Sàngshī Wéichéng: Límíng
description: Prepare for the apocalypse in Sàngshī Wéichéng: Límíng, a thrilling blend of American comic style, strategic gameplay, and collectible card battling. Build your ultimate team from a diverse roster of heroes and villains, mastering their unique abilities to overcome challenging encounters and save the world from impending doom. Immerse yourself in a vibrant post-apocalyptic setting where every decision matters.

title: Vispo: Video Spot the Difference
description: Spot Differences in videos. Simples. A new twist on the old favourite.

title: The Rise of the Hero
description: The game world is in chaos, and only by reuniting every piece of the crystal can balance and peace be restored.

title: Fēngkuáng Pào Pào Bǔyú
description:
The ultimate fishing game makes its grand debut!
Experience classic fishing gameplay with screen-filling bosses and massive 100,000x multipliers, where coins burst nonstop for endless excitement.

title: Huáijiù Bǎn Sānguózhì Idle RPG
description: Embark on an epic journey through the Three Kingdoms period in Huáijiù Bǎn Sānguózhì Idle RPG, a classic strategy RPG reimagined for the modern gamer! Experience the thrill of leading legendary heroes, mastering powerful skills, and collecting mythical treasures in this engaging idle game. This nostalgic title blends the charm of retro games with the convenience of idle gameplay, allowing you to progress even when you're not actively playing.

title: Diànwán Bǔyú
description: Experience the ultimate underwater adventure with Diàn Wán Bǔ Yú! Immerse yourself in a vibrant ocean filled with exotic fish and exciting challenges. This captivating fishing game combines classic arcade elements with innovative gameplay for an unforgettable experience.

title: Jinx
description: Jinx is a 3D action platformer inspired by Sonic Adventure, NiGHTs Into Dreams, and Super Mario Sunshine.

title: Kick-Bell
description: Kick-Bell is a 4-player, 3D-action arcade styled game where you must defeat every enemy to proceed to the next stage!

title: Kira-Kira Catgirl Rampage
description:
Kira-Kira Catgirl Rampage is a difficult exploration-based platformer where pretty much every background object is destructible!

Taiki has had enough of those meddling rats.
Take control of Taiki, and her drunken fairy friend Ivy, as you rip and tear through various buildings, plots of land, whatever needs "cleaning!"

title: Luna Anomaly
description: A restless spirit twists the town around you. Luna Anomaly is a psychological horror game where only those who spot the anomalies can escape.

title: Untitled Sonic Fangame
description: Untitled Sonic Fangame is a game inspired by Eggman Hates Furries as well as Sonic Boom (the rom hack) and Super Meat Boy

title: Lloyd the Monkey 3 Expansion: The Warrior Once Called Prince
description: Told over the course of five stages, the campaign details Grecian prince Octavius's efforts in protecting his younger sister and his kingdom from Scholz's initial efforts for conquest, culminating in the explosive battle teased in Lloyd the Monkey 2's cold open.

title: Lo-Friction
description: Lo-Friction is a speedrunning platformer about being in the zone, finding new ways to gain speed and getting better and better times.

title: Paloo Spiral
description: Classic run n' gun gameplay mixed with fast paced melee combat! Rack up your combo to unleash even more powerful attacks!

title: Bob Don't Sleep!
description: You are Bob, when you wake up, your memory is gone, and the room is pitch dark. Using your quirky yet surprisingly useful big head, embark on an adventure. Find four batteries to light up four lamps and uncover the hidden truth. Puzzles, traps, and mysteries await. Don't sleep now, Bob!

title: Quadratic Puzzle 1
description:
"Quadratic puzzle 1" is a beautiful girl puzzle game developed by "Rabbit studio". The biggest feature of the game is that all the spliced pieces are irregular in shape, just like the puzzles sold in the toy store.

The gameplay is mainly jigsaw puzzles, and you can pass the level by moving all the animation image fragments to their original positions.

title: Solar Dreamer Nikko
description: BOOST YOUR DREAMS ! Play as Nikko, a young squirrel girl on a journey through visions of her future ! Explore levels at brisk speed using you BOOST! and collect every sun in this retro-styled adventure paying hommage to the greatest late-90's classics !

title: Raybeem
description: Live in your music with Raybeem. Load in your favorite tunes and watch them shape the world around you in Virtual Reality. Find your vibe by selecting a theme that fits the pace of your mood and music. If only every reality was as sublime as Raybeem.

title: Fake God
description: This single-player roguelike 2D game,Set in a vast continent within a Cultivation Realm, the game begins with the player controlling a Revived Patriarch - the first awakened elder of a dormant sect. Players assume this role to fulfill the mission of Developing the Sect.

title: Alpha Runner 2
description: Alpha Runner 2 is a challenging endless platform game with different game modes, Make your way through different obstacles and mini games that get more difficult the further you get. Show off to your friends by getting the highest score on the leaderboard.

title: Megaman X: Omega Blaster - Definitive Edition
description: This version of the game is the latest and most current, released at SAGE 2024. It comes with more Bosses, new stages, new music and better gameplay for both X and Zero.

title: Megaman X Omega Blaster - Ultimate Edition
description: This is the game's latest update, now featuring four selectable characters: X, Zero, and two X Armors called Moolight Armor and Jotun Armon. It also features four different endings, new bosses, stages, and music. This is definitely the final version of Omega Blaster!

title: Mari0: Alesan99's Entities
description:
Alesan99's Entities adds many entities to Mari0! From Enemies to power ups you'll never run out of entities to make levels now!

It even has bonus features like online multiplayer, custom characters, custom enemies/powerups, animated tiles, infinite levels and music, vertical scrolling, tile properties, and more!

title: Meeri Bliss
description: A pixel platformer featuring Meeri and her friends!

title: Wonders of the Deep
description: Wonders of the Deep is a third-person underwater exploration adventure with puzzles, marine wildlife, and diving mechanics in a mysterious world.

title: Super Pump
description: Super Pump is a one-button runner game about an old man chasing his dog. Test your timing, focus and anticipation skills as you toggle oncoming hazards to survive. Short but sweet - this game is easy to learn but hard to master.

title: Chinese Mythology: Journey to the West
description: This is a casual lawn mowing game with Journey to the West as the backstory and rogue elements. Grow by killing monsters, gaining upgrade options, challenging bosses, fighting your way out, and unlocking more levels, characters, and magic weapons!

title: Maxim
description: MAXIM, is a concept game where the idea of a machine future come to life.Through the trenches of The Great War witness the inception of your demise.And the coming of a new age.

title: Metal Surge
description: Metal Surge is a 2d platformer shooter with multi-phase boss fights and multiple upgrades that change how you play and are required for beating its challenges.

title: MHZ
description: MHZ is a multiplayer action real time strategy game (action RTS) greatly inspired by the early original pioneers of the genre. Instead of controlling an omniscient being who gives orders to units on the ground, you yourself play as one. Playing as a carrier aircraft, you must manage the construction, placement and support of your units directly on the ground. With your aircraft's pulse cannon, you have a direct impact on the battlefield. Your goal is simple: capture as much territory as you can and destroy your opponent's base.​

title: Milk Quest: Repasteurized
description: Explore the depths of the Void to reclaim your milk! Milk Quest: Repasteurized is a reimagining of the original Milk Quest. Join Fezhead and a variety of friends and foes alike as you try to get home after a milk run gone bad! Use your abilities and whatever junk you pick up along the way to platform through and escape the confusing land of the Void.

title: Raw Concrete
description:
"It's just a simple job. I go, take out the creature, and make a ton of money.

That guy runs an offshore oil rig, obviously loaded, and I need that cash."

title: Something Left
description:
After years of isolation caused by a haunting past, a reclusive girl receives an unexpected message—her mother appears in a dream and urges her to seek out the ex-boyfriend she left behind long ago.

Driven by curiosity, unresolved feelings, and a flicker of hope, she sets out from her remote home into the vast city, facing unfamiliar streets, fading memories, and the weight of her own emotions.

Will she find closure... or uncover something she never expected?

title: Planescape: The Shaper of Dreams
description:
Planescape: The Shaper of Dreams is a German six chapter fan-made campaign for Neverwinter Nights 2.

In the first chapter we get to know our heroine, her story and the horrible nightmares she has to deal with. In fact, when the player meets her for the first time, she isn't a heroine yet. Therefore, a major part of this chapter is about her everyday life as a lady of the manor near the small city of Holst. The player will help her to find out about her hidden powers and to become a true heroine on her long way to the Abyss. At the end of chapter one - when she has passed her first tests - she will embark on her journey.

As we go along, several companions will join her in the chapters to come. The party will have to survive many adventures on their way which will lead them to Sigil and finally to the Abyss.

title: Wonderful Purgatory
description:
Have you ever wondered what the beautiful world where angels and other creatures live looks like?

Do you think that up there, in the heavens, everything is colorful and peaceful?

You're right — but you might be mistaken...

Dive into this seemingly sweet world, filled with bright colors, psychedelic motifs, and crazy music.

title: AnimalFruitTart
description:
Simple controls—just jump! Play with one button in this physics-based, intuitive action game!
Bounce and roll through a candy world in the grand adventure of the “Animal Fruits”!

title: Racing: Storm Chase
description: This is a car racing as the core of the game, driving different cars, experience unlimited driving fun. Challenge the thrilling track, but also with friends to play two, experience the thrilling chase game!

title: Prism: Master Tape
description: This is a dystopian soft sci-fi game. One day, you and your family received a flyer from the community to watch a movie for free. Your family has already set off, and you arrived later - but you find out that they are not there. After that, you discover the untold secrets of the medium of "video".

title: Capybara Achievement Clicker
description: Capybara Achievement Clicker is a simple incremental and idle game. It features over a hundred easy-to-acquire achievements and a Capybara to click on.

title: By Bait or By Bullet
description: By Bait or By Bullet is a bombastic 2D fishing rogue-lite adventure with both story-rich top-down exploration and action-packed platforming combat, made with Unity and available on Windows and through WebGL!

title: Delta Squared
description: Delta Squared is an abstract Shoot'em up game made in retro 8-bit style in modern times. Has 4 stages, 2 game campaign modes and a local coop mode. Also has unlockable color palettes.

title: Idle Cultivation
description: Idle towards Immortality! Ascend the cultivation stages to become immortal. Battle experts, monsters and mythological beasts. Draw talismans, craft powerful equipment and powerful pills to assist you in combat.

title: Sheep vs Tiger
description: A timid sheep must outsmart fierce tigers in this turn-based puzzle game. Push crates to trap tigers and escape. Each move matters—plan wisely or face defeat! Can you survive the jungle

title: Pirates of Justice
description: Pirates of Justice is a strategic puzzle game where players help pirates destroy corrupt Marine buildings by placing objects to guide a bomb ball to its target. Use your wits to bring down the Marine's stronghold and rise through the pirate ranks.

title: Kill Ralph
description: "Lies, treachery, and a bounty worth dying for. You’re no warrior, just a cunning hunter—will your wits be enough to catch Ralph Devour?"

title: Project S.U.N.D.I.A.L
description: Online PvPvE extraction shooter with hardcore survival mechanics. Explore the wastelands of France, the dark forests of Eastern Europe, and Norway's infamous Hollow Plague Fjord — and beyond. Face off against rival players, ruthless raiders, and the terrifying Hollows.

title: Souls of White Star
description: Souls of White Star is a sci-fi turn-based card wargame Roguelike strategy game. The different design of [double-sided technology moving cards] and [bandwidth draw cost] will test your judgment and decision more!

title: Erased
description: "Erased" is an action-packed psychological whirlwind in a post-apocalyptic sci-fi world. Explore an open-world with fast combat, rail grinding, parkour, pets, and graffiti. Embrace hip hop, Afro-beats, and K-pop while following a dream based lore in single player mode or face others in online PVP.

title: Run From the Hunt
description: An Horror Clicker Game, where you have to click to run from the hunt.

title: Apex Armor Swap Trainer
description: The 100% accurate representation of the Armor Swap system from Apex Legends. Use your real game Mouse Sensitivity and Field of View parameters and choose your training mode. Now you're ready to become the best Armor Swapper in the world.

title: Living In Infinity
description: Living In Infinity is a puzzle adventure focused on switching between parallel realities and using various items to solve mysteries. Play as Lin Meizhen, a 17-year-old high school student who eats a suspicious mushroom at home—only to find her familiar surroundings beginning to twist and distort.

title: Rainbound
description: Follow Puddles, a brave little swallow, in this atmospheric 2D platformer. In a world soon perished by extreme weather conditions you'll have to avoid dangerous obstacles and navigate the terrain in your search of a safe haven.

title: Kubby Big Adventure
description: Kubby is a serious red cube who goes on a dangerous adventure to get his stolen artifacts back — gloves and boots that give him superpowers!

title: A Sun-Kissed Fantasy
description: A Sun-Kissed Fantasy is a short RPG featuring Harold on a tropical adventure.

title: PuppetShow: Her Cruel Collection - Collector's Edition
Heartbeat in Thailand
description: Freshly graduated, you head to Bangkok’s Chinatown to find your uncle—only to lose contact. Seeking a steady job, you’re mistaken for a gang boss and thrown into chaos. Along the way, you meet a sweet cousin, cold widow, mysterious performer, quirky ghost, and even... someone unexpected.

title: Sofia the Witch: Curse of the Monster Moon
description:
You play as Sofia, a plucky little witch that will do whatever she can to save her friends from their terrible curse.

Using your two spells, Transmogrification and Bubble Bounce, explore levels, discover secrets, and save your friends.

title: Ruled by Rule
description: Dive into the depraved world of Ruled by Rule, an engaging RPG where the stakes are high and the consequences are… stimulating. This isn't your typical hero's journey; here, villains hold the power, and the Public Order Princesses are at their mercy. Prepare for intense combat, strategic decision-making, and a unique erotic specialization that sets this game apart.

title: Project Z: The beginning of the end - Chapter I
description: Tower & Defense game, with Topdown view set in a post-apocalyptic world of zombies.

title: Project Athenia
description: Project Athenia is a multiplayer first-person shooter in which you can play against your friends in several game modes on many different maps.

title: Luna Has Gone
description: Luna Has Gone is an RPG inspired by PS1-era pre-rendered backgrounds, delivering a unique visual style for an RPG Maker game. The gameplay features turn-based battles with limited resources. You play as Misha, the daughter of a world-class corporation, whose goal is to find her missing friend, Luna.

title: Pretty Girl Cube
description: Dive into Pretty Girl Cube, a captivating match-two puzzle game where strategic thinking meets irresistible rewards! Your objective is simple: clear each level by flipping pairs of blocks to reveal matching images. Earn valuable gold coins with every successful match and level completion.

title: Girlfriend Simulator
description:
You wake up with a pounding headache in a room that looks like your own, but doesn't feel quite right. By your bedside is a cute girl who introduces herself as Nagi, your adorable, doting girlfriend. Nagi informs you that you're very sick, but don't worry: she's going to do her very best to take care of you!

That would be all well and good, but...

If Nagi really is your girlfriend, why can't you remember her?

title: Midsummer
description: Dive into the enchanting world of Midsummer, an engaging independent decryption game where you solve intricate puzzles to unlock stunning artwork. Explore each level carefully, searching for hidden prompts that will guide you on your quest. This isn't just about beautiful pictures; it's about brain-teasing fun!

title: Megane Breaker
description:
This is Megane Breaker! In this world, glasses are windows to the soul. They filter the way you see the world, protecting you and your innermost feelings, but they also keep you at a distance...

You are an apprentice Breaker, and today is your first day on the job. Help your customer take off the glasses he's hiding behind by breaking down his Megane Barrier!

title: Succubus Spell
description: An ancient spellbook promised the power to summon a demon. The enchantress followed the arcane instructions meticulously, but the creature that emerged was far from subservient! Prepare for a dark fantasy visual novel where control is an illusion and desire is the ultimate weapon. Can she bind the succubus, or will her aching body and immortal soul become the demoness's playthings?

title: Urban Legends: The Dry Body
description: After the mysterious death of his parents, Marcos leaves alone in a raid to find answers about the curse that runs in his blood ... But this will not be an easy task, some adventurers tried to explore the forest previously and none of them returned alive to tell the story.

title: Whispers in the Bitter Frost
description: A Cold Horror RPG about fragmented memories.

title: Challenge from the Black Cat
description: Old-fashioned block crumbling with a cat motif. Simple controls allow a wide range of players from small children to adults! It also comes with an ending! The volume has been increased to play up to a total of 10 stages! Can you win the challenge from the black cat?

title: Reconnecting
description: WARNING 18+: After more than two decades apart, you reunite with the daughter of your old friend and establish a relationship, though your new relationship causes more problems in your life than you anticipate.

title: Voltage Box
description: Voltage Box is a challenging puzzle game where players must overcome obstacles to activate a set number of switches in each level. For those who love a challenge, try activating all the switches and collecting all stars in each level to achieve a perfect score.

title: Our Last Conversation
description: Our Last Conversation is an RPG Maker Horror 2D side-scrolling game. The main character has two friends who have gone to an abandoned school. And this place isn't safe enough to let us think about that it has many things that don't like that we are alive.

title: The Hentai Memory
description: Remember the same symbols, gradually opening the full picture.

title: Beaver TD
description: A tower defense game with roguelite elements, where you build wooden rafts, summon beaver warriors, and strategically control enemy paths to lead them into traps. Gather resources, upgrade your base, unlock powerful skills, and adapt to chaotic enemy waves to survive as long as possible!

title: PuppetShow: The Curse of Ophelia - Collector's Edition
Color by Number: Monster Heroes
description: Color by Number: Monster Heroes is an addictive anti-stress pixel art game. Choose from a variety of fun pixel images and follow the numbers to bring them to life. Color by Number has never been this easy!

title: PuppetShow: Faith in the Future - Collector's Edition
Delvin: Origins
description: A horror turn-based RPG in hell.

title: Hentai Bae Sunny
description: A simple match-2 puzzle game where you unlock images of “happy” memories between you and your sweet lover, Sunny.

title: Eternal Ex Machina: Hawz Krarace
description: The legend said at the Hawz Krarace ruin have legendary weapon and the chosen one can pull it out!! You and your party member take the task and find them and become millenarians in no time!! But... Something... Not right...

title: Island of Death: Demons and Despair
description: When they decided to spend their honeymoon on a wonderful island retreat, Natalie and John could not imagine the terrible experiments that would be conducted on them. Right when the couple arrived at the island, demons broke out and attacked the island’s inhabitants and infected everyone with a mysterious disease. Fortunately, Natalie managed to avoid infection. Help Natalie find a way to cure John in Island of Death: Demons and Despair.

title: Zelda's Adventure Remastered
description:
This is a remaster of Zelda's Adventure, originally for the Philips CD-i, developed using GameMaker Studio 2.

Includes a Classic Mode, which plays roughly the same as the original, and a Remastered Mode, which includes various QoL changes as well as restored cut content!

Other features of this remaster include but are not limited to:
Smooth 60fps gameplay, subtitles for cutscenes and ingame dialogue, rebindable controls, better looped ambience sound/music, stereo panned sound effects and localization options (currently only English and Dutch are available).

As of the current demo it should be possible currently to beat the first dungeon, the Shrine of Earth.

title: City Gangs War in Miami
description: Join City Gangs Miami in 30 action well packed missions in his never-ending quest to defeat The BigBoss. City Gangs Miami is a third person shooter where you have to eliminate all opponents, use grenades, rifles, rocket launchers, tanks, helicopter to defeat the enemy.

title: Island Treasure Chase
description: We explore the pirate island searching for treasures and trying to escape from skeletons.

title: Brainrot Battle Simulator
description: Create unique battles and find out who is the best Italian Brainrot character! Choose your fighters and dive into chaotic fights-1v1, 5v3 or total chaos!

title: Crimson Echoes
description: Crimson Echoes is a horror themed puzzle-adventure game. By solving various riddles and avoiding deadly traps, help Aria and her companions find her Uncle.

title: Bell Bot
description: Play as a food delivery robot wheeling and dealing tasty treats to students across a vibrant college campus! Dodge angry pedestrians by navigating interconnected pathways, outmaneuver reckless drivers while locating waypoints on your map, and complete orders to create happy customers.

title: Shadow Spell Saga: The Winds of Fate
description: A tactical RPG set in an original fantasy world. Driven by story, characters, and nostalgic strategy gameplay. 26 chapters, 40+ playable characters, and dozens of secrets to discover.

title: Poker Loafer
description: A Blackjack game that amuses you in working hours. Its game interface will remain fully transparent unless hovered by mouse. No full-screen, no BGM. Win high scores, and don’t get caught. Good luck.

title: Blackjack Simple
description: A single player simple blackjack game with standard rules. The player plays against a computer (dealer). The game contains customizable card themes as well as unlocks and rewards such as color changes to the tables and menus. Standard blackjack rules, and can be played with 1-10 decks at a time.

title: Milenay
description: A small 2D platformer developed in GBStudio for the Gameboy Color, featuring external music with CD quality and Chiptune style.

title: World of Motors
description: The World of Motors. game designed to suit your requirements. The new challenge makes you collect money to buy new cars and unlock new levels.

title: Gang of Frogs
description: Sail through the galaxy as a fearless outlaw frog. Plunder loot, upgrade weapons, eat flies and fight through hordes of monstrous bugs in an intense 1-4 player co-op shooter.

title: Mr. Golden Revenge Machine
description: The game is a reference to Puyo Puyo games, inspired by Dr. Robotnik's Mean Bean Machine/Dr. Fetus' Mean Meat Machine, it's mostly Tetris.

title: Undersea: Waves and Adventures
description: You are the captain of a submarine of a small Ukrainian island state, with a big baggage of dreams and a lot of problems. Sink enemy ships, explore mysterious abandoned bases, steal secret documents. Drink tea and don't forget to have fun. Your team is already waiting for you. To the Battle!

title: Numeric Demon Cat
description: This is a HARD numerical strategy game. During EA no more than 5% of players unlocked 5-star achievements.

title: Blind Man's Sun
description: A short visual novel with graphics inspired by “milk-like” horror and a storyline straight out of 2000s comics. You play as a blind man who made a deal with a strange ghost. For those who don’t like pixels, an alternative visual style is also available.

title: DescTop
description: DescTop is a cozy typing game where you can type at your own pace, in your own speed, how ever you like. You can type the target word given to you or you can type your essay in the ingame notepad; whatever you type you will be rewarded for it.

title: Reverse Escape Room: Archaeologists Sanctum
description: Short and sweet first person puzzler about archaeology, rivals, and robots.

title: Snowflake Master
description: Create your own unique paper snowflake. Make up or repeat ready-made patterns that will take your skills to the next level. Let your imagination run wild!

title: Skat 3D Premium
description: Realistic 3D Skat simulation with singleplayer, multiplayer and tutorial. With configurable AI strength and many adjustable rule and game variants you can start exciting Skat tournaments - or just play for fun!

title: Armor Stride
description: Sir Stepsalot is trapped in the Cursed Forest! Luckily, he has his trusty sword and bomb pouch to fend off dangerous monsters. He will have to travel deeper into the forest fighting monsters and avoiding traps. Our knight can't stay in place for too long though. There's a dark curse chasing him!

title: Item Collector: Pirates
description: Item Collector - Pirates - Play through a huge amount of different levels with increasing difficulty and alternative exciting game modes. Bring you brain to the limit and find all the matching pairs!

title: Miracle Journey: 3D Find Differences
description: Leave 2D behind and explore 3D worlds, from pyramids to towns.Finding differences is a breeze! Look beyond the obvious, like a peddler's glance in a market or fireworks' shape at festivals. Players love it: "Old games were dull. This 3D one is like a new world, full of surprises!"

title: Grimace's Birthday
description:
Grimace is having a party! And YOU are invited!
Something feels off at the party. After coming to this realization, you must escape from his domain while being hunted.

title: Christmas Slots: Casino Game
description: Step into a world of festive cheer and excitement with Christmas Slots, the ultimate casino game that combines the thrill of spinning reels with the joyous spirit of the holiday season. Get ready for a merry gambling experience filled with colorful symbols, jingle bells, and the chance to win big.

title: Attenzione Pickpocket!
description: You're a pickpocket, being hunted but refusing to get a regular job. Don't get caught with the loot.

title: Asteroid Forward
description: Asteroid Forward is a spin-off video game from the Asteroid series for PC and mobile devices. Battle your way through space in this side-scrolling action RPG!

title: Sad Virus Space
description: 4th part of walking simulation game series. Sad virus mission is again collect beer bottles in space themed map

title: CyberCook
description: A cyberpunk PS1-style cooking game, serve up more than just food. Slice through enemies, decide their fates, and uncover dark secrets hidden within your dystopian kitchen.

title: The Moment of Memory
description: Help Wendy regain her lost memories. This is a short work about home and love.

title: Sokoku
description: A block-pushing game where you not only push blocks, you are one. Plan your movements so that the right number ends up on top, while you interact with other cubes and mechanics. Can you roll your way to the solution?

title: Mirror Atelier
description: Mirror Atelier is an story-rich, relaxing, sliding puzzle game where artwork and stories come together. Solve fragmented artworks, piece by piece, to unlock delightful narrative snippets. Challenge your perception and immerse yourself in this tranquil adventure.

title: Cute Warrior Girl
description: The 16-year-old warrior's name is Fiora. This game is an adventure story about a young female warrior set in a medieval world.

title: Power the Future
description: Power the Future is a strategy game that allows you to take control of Germany, the USA, China, India, Australia, Japan or the UK and guide them into the future. You will work to satisfy each nation's power needs and growth by developing technology and harnessing power from around the world.

title: Xiǎoguàiwù Bìxū Sǐ
description:
Little Monsters Must Die" is a casual idle game that combines pinball mechanics, strategy card gameplay, and RPG elements!
You will recruit a legion of knights, defeat evil bosses, and explore mysterious worlds.
Precise aiming and strategic positioning are the keys to victory.

Enjoy generous rewards, fair gameplay, and build a powerful army that belongs to you.
Join this world full of adventure and glory now!

title: FlushFall
description: Welcome to FlushFall, a toilet Battle Royale!

title: Luna and the Sea
description: A hand-drawn-style point-and-click adventure set in 17th-century Amsterdam. Play as Luna, a young girl surviving on the streets, solving puzzles, and embarking on a journey to find her father. A touching story about kindness, resilience, and the sea.

title: Onirical
description: Aid Wimsy and its critters into the Oniric space to purify each world from the darkness!

title: Living Legends: Frozen Destiny Collector's Edition
description: Can you stop an evil Ice Queen before it’s too late?

title: Richest Thief
description: You sprint down a dusty road, diamonds clutched in your hand, fleeing thugs. You run through crumbling buildings, past ghosts of the past. Reaching the end of the road, you watch the thieves disappear into the darkness. The diamonds remain, a promise of freedom.

title: Crafter's Hollow
description: Forge gear, run a shop, and send mercenaries into danger so you don’t have to. A cozy-but-clever crafting sim where business booms, heroes bicker, and dungeons provide all the “supply chain” problems you’ll ever need.

title: Kovoclak
description: KOVOCLAK is a hand-drawn 2D platformer set in a strange, poetic, and musical universe. Created by Lingouf, an electronic music producer and artist. No weapons here — only a watering can, an umbrella… and a boombox. You just have to find the right frequency !

title: HereticOS Mr. Lab
description: Thanks to the breakthrough of HereticOS network basic technology, HereticOS Mr Lab The war simulator can realize the real-time online interaction of the largest 65000 online players on same server and screen .

title: The Royal Rebel Casino
description: Clara Kassedy, a private investigator receives an important assignment from her boss that requires her to travel to the Royal Rebel Casino. Throughout her journey, she will interact with characters and be forced to test her luck on popular casino games like blackjack, poker, and roulette.

title: Homam: An Inventor's Fist
description: Experience a unique 2D pixel art platformer where satisfying pounding mechanics meet brain-teasing puzzles. Step into Homam’s shoes, a skilled hero with a powerful fist, and help the legendary inventor Al-Jazari on a time-traveling quest. Solve puzzles, and conquer challenges with agility and wit

title: S.R.A
description: S.R.A Project is a challenging roguelike bullet hell wave survival game. Face cosmic creatures, improve through skill and perseverance, and master a world that rewards learning and adaptation.

title: Compass of Destiny: Survivors
description: Prepared using the assets of the Compass of Destiny: Istanbul game, the Survivors mode is a special game mode that heavily includes action and survival elements.

title: Interquel
description:
The traitor of the Immortals, Ye Jiming, in a desperate attempt to escape pursuit, used the legendary Yeming Relic, said to have the power to shatter the barriers between three thousand worlds.

When Ye Jiming awakens again, he finds himself surrounded not only by a completely unfamiliar otherworldly landscape, but also by strangely familiar faces, seemingly bound to him by fate...

title: Alien Abduction Experience
description: This is a deep immersion VR short play. Refer to the personal experience of many alien abductors in history, which will bring you unprecedented visual impact, and experience the experience of alien abduction.You need to open the game or bring a VR device to immerse yourself

title: Alex's Tunnel
description: Get ready for impossible challenges and push your skills to the limit. The pacing of the obstacle avoidance game is very tight. The goal of the game is to score as many points as possible. .

title: Immortal Family
description: The player plays the role of a family patriarch, establishes a family, and then occupies a small island for cultivation in a sea area, leading the family to gradually grow and develop. In the process of growth, you can capture other islands for cultivation, explore the deep sea, search for treasures in secret places, etc.

title: Lily's Dream: Adventures of Dinosaurs
description: This is an independent game of adventure, exploration and puzzle solving. The game tells that the little girl Lily came to the Dinosaur Island through a dream and found that she had become a loving mother dragon mother, embarking on an adventure to find her three babies.

title: Hentai Celestia
description: Hentai Celestia is an erotic hentai puzzle game that transports you to majestic celestial halls, where a divine paladin with amethyst eyes and a glowing halo gazes at you through the winds of the cosmos…

title: Gretel and Winslow's Mansion
description: It's a story-based escape puzzle game. Gretel headed to Madame Winslow's Mansion on an errand by her parents. Following her parents' note, Gretel will stay at Madame Winslow's Mansion for three days to help her with her work. Help Gretel solve the mystery of the villa and escape safely.

title: Ice Orange Pudding
description: "Ice Orange Pudding" is a game that is falsely biased towards Qinglily and is based on the plot, interspersed with some small games and puzzle-solving games. The game mainly tells about herself. In the future, a certain girl may be alone in order to invent a robot as her sister. Leah

title: Phase Nexus
description: Phase Nexus is an upcoming fast-paced 2D action-platformer starring speedster Cyanser and teleporter Raviel (once again not playable yet). Think of a fever fusion between Sonic (without the loops), Viewitful Joe, Sparkster/Rocket Knight and Luminous Avenger iX/White Steel X. In terms of mechanics and movement from those games, they blend well surprisingly.

title: Earthquake: Margarita School
description: A horror game set in a school, in which you will be a police officer who will have to investigate an earthquake. You will have to complete puzzles and face the paranormal events that occur. You have to be careful, the school covers a fairly dark past that you will be able to discover.

title: Phyllis, The Receptionist of The Guild
description: You will play a receptionist of the guild to help the adventurers on their quests. Keep it be busy by investing on the shops and scouting the new adventurers, while play the quiet adventurer Mark at the same time!

title: Prison Boss: Prohibition - Stitchin' Rich
description:
Get Rich or Die Stitchin'

Welcome to The Public Place, a charming new district where the mayor’s statue watches over the city like he owns it… because he does. For now.

Set up shop under the fountain’s shadow and meet the Egg White Collars: a new faction of civil servants with threadbare suits, broken dreams, and very questionable taste. They may not be powerful, but they sure are picky.

Use new tools like felting needles and embroidery hoops to stitch, felt, and embroider your way through brand-new recipes. Work with leather, wool, linen and dye to craft everything from cozy sweaters to lumpy teddy bears, leather vests to slightly lopsided hats. It’s clumsy, it’s crafty, it’s chaos.

Become the boss of New Yolk’s least fashionable workforce one crooked stitch at a time.

title: Korridor
description: Fight off hordes of demons in this unforgiving shoot-them-up! A diabolic mix of the gates runner genre with survivor-like elements. Many foes and secrets await you in the catacombs...

title: Pew-casso
description: Choose your loadout, choose your art brushes, and blast your way to a masterpiece! Pew-casso is a top-down action-roguelite shooter where you defeat enemies to level up and create a piece of art. The longer you last, the more complex your unique piece of art will become.

title: Winemaker Simulator
description: Step into the Medieval Mediterranean and live the life of a vintner. From tending your vineyard to harvesting, winemaking, and trading, every decision shapes your craft. Will you create the most exquisite and valuable wine?

title: Potato Game. Trilogy
description: It's the Screaming Potato Head against other-worldly creatures in the loudest adventure ever conceived!

title: Enemy Territory Terrorists Takedown
description: Venture deep into enemy territory and become an ambassador of justice! Enemy Territory Terrorists Takedown is an immersive FPS experience that puts you in the shoes of a brave soldier tasked with saving civilians from brutal terrorists.

title: Riley The Roadrunner
description: A speed demon who loves nothing more than to race. One morning, he and his partner in crime, Ollie the Armadillo, have a rude awakening when an Unidentified Flying Object plows through their tree. Next thing they know, weird alien tech is spreading all over their canyon home. Will Riley be fast enough to stop this other worldly menace?

title: Idle Taoist Mage Warrior
description: Are you familiar with the three major professions of warrior, mage, and Taoist. Simple placement gameplay.

title: King of Meat: Deluxe Edition
description:
The King of Meat Deluxe Edition includes:

Exclusive Emerson Shard Set:
- Emerson Shard Legendary Costume
- Emerson Shard Legendary Sword & Board Weapon Skin
- Emerson Shard Legendary Hammer Weapon Skin
- Emerson Shard Legendary Arcane Knuckles Weapon Skin
- Emerson Shard Legendary Banner Foreground

- Tapeboard Betsy Robot Dance Emote
