title: Call to Arms: Panzer Elite - Deluxe Edition
description: Step into the battlefields of 1944 with a new set of missions and iconic German camouflage. The Deluxe Edition expands your experience with three missions and three exclusive tank skins.

title: Three Kingdoms Mushouden: Digital Deluxe Edition
description: The Three Kingdoms Mushouden Digital Deluxe Edition includes 4 original character skins, 2 weapons, 1 horse, and 1 additional map BGM track.

title: RPGMP: Retrieving the Ruby
description: RPGMP: Retrieving the Ruby is an RPG Maker VX game with ACTUAL RPG mechanics, some cool dialogue and a retrievable ruby!

title: Hunter: Space Pirates
description: Dive into the enthralling story of Hunter, a young man whose dreams of joining the Navy are shattered by an unexpected twist of fate. As he navigates the complexities of his daily life, Hunter finds himself on an unexpected path filled with mystery, personal growth, and discovery.

title: From Dusk To Dawn
description: Construct your symbol combination to generate more defense value until it completely resists the attack of zombies.

title: Hearthstorm
description: General, prepare your army for victorious battles. Select the card and make your first move!

title: Programming Simulator
description: In the game, you are a game developer who writes game code according to the tasks assigned by the company. You need to drag and drop nodes and connect them to build a complete behavioral logic!

title: Slashbang
description:
Slashbang aims to be the fastest paced FPS around. Inspired by the likes of Jet Set Radio and Sonic Adventure, there's a distinct 50/50 split between movement and combat.

There's lots of movement abilities and lots of tech, including dodging, drifting, and the ability to run up walls. Props are also fully destructible and can be sliced to pieces with Flynn's claws, as well are enemies! There's also a focus on story - the full game will be akin to a mix of Scott Pilgrim and Metal Gear.

title: Slice Night 3: Slicer of the 7 Dreams
description: Slice Night 3 is a graceful yet challenging melee platformer about the beauty of dreams and processing of repressed emotion; a power fantasy with some truth sprinkled in.

title: Alice and The Reformatory for Witches
description: Very strange things have been happening to Alice since her childhood. But that isn’t a reason to imprison her in a reformatory for witches. Or is it? Exactly this is what happened to her just now! Help her escape and discover the power of her magical abilities...

title: Slug Fling
description: Slug Fling is an action platformer inspired by the retro classics of the run-and-gun genre with modern enhancements. Help Team STAR to victory by carrying Slug across the solar system, and stop the threat to the Astropod!

title: Super Freaks 1: Ultimate Edition Turbo
description: Super Freaks 1: Ultimate Edition is back, and turbocharged! Build up crazy speeds with the new sprinting feature, and perform death defying time trials in turbo mode!

title: Taima Miko
description: After an earthquake, monsters from folklore roam a quiet island just off the coast of modern Japan. But the legendary exorcist maiden Miko has returned from the past to battle them! Take control of Miko and restore peace to the island!

title: White Bridge
description: White Bridge is a blend of role playing game and classic JRPG. It offers an immersive world for the players to explore and interact with. Choose the way you will deal with people and change the outcome of how they treat you.

title: Trailblader
description: Trailblader is a turn-based strategy game that features loop-based combat, integrating 4X strategy and hero development. The game tells the story of a hero who, having lost their homeland, leads the people to migrate to the wilderness to rebuild their home.

title: Castle Dark
description: Brand Warcford must track down the evil force plaguing the land in this single player ACTION RPG.

title: Camilla
description: Pac-Man-type running simulation Camilla is the story of a girl who confronts fear. Check the number of acquired goods for clearance for each stage and acquire all the goods and move on to the next stage. You can clear all the stages consisting of three stages and check the final ending.

title: Invention 8
description: Invasion 8 is a continuation of a small indie shooter about the adventures of a group of cyborgs in the world of post-apocalypse and monsters.

title: Super Crash
description: How much damage can you create? Drive fast and wreck as many cars as possible before time runs out. Carefully plan your wreck to maximize chaos and destruction. Get a high damage score to win a gold medal on every level.

title: The Escape: Team Battle Arena
description: 5:5 team fight. The team that escapes first will grab the victory.

title: Master Knight
description: Player controls Master Knight in this 3rd person rpg adventure. His mission is to kill Werewolf and collect skulls in different areas

title: Glitch Core
description: A tactical FPS Rogue Lite where you take on the role of a rogue AI (Pun intended). Honing your skills in relentless combat simulations, until you uncover the unsettling truth of your existence....

title: Casino Roulette: Roulettist
description: Test your luck! Play casino roulette with stunning, realistic 3D graphics! Feel the risk as you dive into the casino atmosphere and hit the big time!

title: Jump You+
description:
As a lost one, you tirelessly jump towards the top!
To return to your owner!

title: I Am Quadrober!
description: Are you ready to take on the challenge and become the best quadrober? Join us and prove that you are a true master of quadrobbing!

title: Rays
description: RAYS - the plot unveils complex emotions and psychological conflicts, forcing you to make choices that will determine the fate of the main character and the surrounding world.

title: The Bladeingtons Camping Adventure
description: Happy 3rd Anniversary to the first time "The Bladeingtons" was ever uttered on twitter dot com (June 13th, 2020). Here is a special game celebrating this anniversary about a fun camping trip.

title: Junji Ito Maniac: An Infinite Gaol
description: Junji Ito Maniac: An Infinite Gaol is a first-person survival horror game inspired by Junji Ito's psychological horror and eerie aesthetics. This work centers on the twisted potential of human nature and fear of the unknown, taking you on a journey of survival where memory and mystery intertwine.

title: Personal Best
description: Personal Best is a Momentum Platformer. The player must navigate through the various paths that make up each level on their way to the Stopwatch at the end. However, they have a limited amount of time to progress, and when that timer runs out, their score (gained via collecting Charms throughout the level, as well as just making their way to the end) are tallied up and converted into EXP and Points. They're then sent to the Upgrade Menu where those points can be used to purchase upgrades, allowing the player to better navigate and further progress in the level.

title: Lordling of Hearts
description: Lordling of hearts is an erotic fantasy text-RPG, made to have a "deeply interwoven mechanics, an endearing cast, and a cozy comedy plot!"

title: 9-Bit Armies: Going Rogue!
description: In this exciting Roguelite take on Real-Time Strategy, collect and upgrade your personal army of units as you battle across randomized world maps and defeat the final boss to unlock persistent rewards!

title: Smart-Attack!
description:
Smart-Attack is a wacky brain-teaser bullet hell.
Help Jack the donkey survive a deranged, rejected educational game!
You'll need your smarts and your reflexes for this one.

title: Re:Burn The Bonfire of Taiwan
description: A classic Asian drama series is reborn in anime style, and you’re the director with power to guide the clash between rival families! Re:Burn The Bonfire of Taiwan puts you in control of the narrative, allowing you to guide the beloved characters to endings from the original show.

title: Archive Fever
description: Archive Fever is a downloadable, meditative digital photo album where you can curate photographs and shape your own archive of personal and collective history. Be mindful — the way you choose to archive impacts your history and memory.

title: Blightseed
description: A space roguelike, where you fight waves and decipher the language of your enemies. Take breaks between fast action sequences, to translate the attacks and buffs you collected. The more you understand the easier it will be to find the winning synergies to defeat your foes.

title: Snoutbreakers
description: Do you have what it takes to become the champion of the Snoutbreakers, an underground fighting circuit? Fight your way through gauntlets of furry fighters armed with their fists, weapons, and more as you try to beat down everyone in your path.

title: Milkteeth
description: A short game about drinking tea, meeting tooth fairies, and navigating the haze between memory and dreams.

title: Stadium Shift
description: Stadium Shift is an indie game inspired by Mr. Needlemouse and a Deranged Italian Chef where you stand between the fate of the world itself by doing smooth, fun and chainable moves all the way to the end of stages.

title: Street Rider
description: Street Rider is a hectic endless runner taking place on a never ending road trip. Weave through cars, tire spikes, and many other obstacles to see how far you can get!

title: Sufferix Six: Attack of X
description: Stop a robotic uprising at the hands of a 14-year-old mad scientist!

title: Symbiote
description: A high-speed action platformer where combat intertwines with movement. Swing off your enemies or slam them into the ground!

title: Sungka
description: A relaxing digital adaptation of the traditional Filipino mancala game, Sungka challenges players to strategize, plan their moves, and outsmart their opponents while collecting shells in this timeless classic.

title: Winter's Wrath
description: In this challenging tower defense game, place and upgrade your towers to fend off relentless waves of foes. With limited resources, every decision matters. The frost is unforgiving—so must be your defense.

title: Telegeddon
description: Telegeddon is a TV-trashing, genre-busting action RPG with a battle system made up of microgames - think "Paper Mario meets WarioWare," but with an original touch and its own sense of identity.

title: Fly Me To The Moon
description: Press left and right, move your earth, and fly you to the moon

title: The Boy and his Story
description: A fast-action platformer inspired by the Sonic Rush trilogy with decently animated pixel art and music inspired by many artists.

title: The DeviantArt Grind
description: Congratulations! You got yourself a shrew to raise! Now's your chance to become an ARTIST! Feed your shrew, draw him, and put him on DeviantArt!

title: Thunder Edge
description: A high-voltage action platformer set in the distant future of 1989, where the supervillain group New Age Pantheon threatens the world. Strike like lightning, and become the hero that will shock the world!

title: Beetle Barrage
description: Destroy all of the insects in your way! As you shoot, you recoil backward from your weapons as a mechanical beetle.

title: Trunkey's Amazing Odyssey
description:
Trunkey's Amazing Odyssey is an unorthodox 3D physics platformer about stealing shiny objects while dealing with dangerous monsters!

Experience the privilege of living through the compound eyes of Trunkey, a weak, unintelligent, and easily distracted critter as he endeavors to steal shiny objects. He knows how to run, jump, slide, and throw things. Go nuts!

Featuring unique point-and-click styled mouse controls for precisely throwing objects, the gameplay focuses on your ability to bring as many objects back to the extraction point as possible while facing hostile wildlife at every turn!

title: Aishi & Reimu
description: Aishi & Reimu is a 2D Sonic-inspired Touhou fan game inspired by the likes of Sonic CD and Sonic 3 & Knuckles. It is a similar formula to "Super Marisa Land" and "MegaMari - Marisa no Yabou", but instead of, let's say Mario or Mega Man, it's Sonic instead.

title: Project Chromata
description: Generate primary colors and unlock complex mixers to build an intricate production chain. Use your creations to generate Light and restore a vast, explorable Star Chart, unlocking powerful, permanent bonuses with each constellation. Evolve your engine with sophisticated automation to manage production and upgrades, allowing you to focus on cosmic restoration. Uncover the secrets of the void through fragmented lore entries tied to your progress.

title: Pokémon Otherside
description:
Pokémon Otherside is an independent fangame RPG that offers a brand-new adventure in a completely original universe.
It introduces an original region, over 150 new Fakemon, new forms such as Mega Evolutions, as well as new types like Tech.
With its focus on story and player choices, unique abilities and talents, and an innovative Pokémon management system, Pokémon Otherside provides a rich experience inspired by classic RPGs.

title: Die or Die
description: Roll the dice and choose how you will die. Die or Die is a top-down shooter roguelite where you run, shoot and dodge enemies to get dice with which to disable threats or unlock abilities. Roll. Die. Repeat.

title: After Long Night
description: Welcome to the real apocalypse. After Long Night is a sandbox survival RTS where you take on a world completely overrun by the undead. Scavenge a ruined city, build your shelter, and lead a survivor army in the face of overwhelming zombie hordes. Will you fortify your defenses—or strike first? The choice is yours.

title: Operation Caucasus
description: Operation Caucasus is an action packed, first person shooter game.

title: Gramm
description: Beat each level as you run away from the dogs in this parody horror game, Gramm!

title: Twins of the Sun
description: A colorful co-op adventure where you take on enemies with power-ups and clever tricks. Travel through diverse lands to rescue your sister in a story anyone can enjoy.

title: [Herror] Gas Station Case
description:
[HERROR] is a series of short horror episodes where everyday work routines collide with paranormal threats. Each episode is a unique standalone story lasting 1.5–2 hours.

Dan Cooper, a 25-year-old night shift gas station worker in Ohio, recently laid off from a uranium plant, is trying to put his life back together. But everything changes when his friend Michael discovers a mysterious case by the lake. Soon, people begin to vanish in the surrounding woods, and the cozy gas station turns into a deadly trap.

title: Scientist Creature
description: Try to escape from Dr. Henry Hoismer’s mansion while being chased by a monster we believe is called 'Prototype C – 23.' You'll have to hide, search for keys, solve a maze, and find codes in order to escape.

title: Cheat Death
description: Play dice poker with the grim reaper in a dark strategic roguelite. Build powerful poker hands from cursed dice, stack upgrades, rig the odds, sabotage Death, and survive deadly mini-games with your life on the line.

title: Rabolut: Escape From Hell
description: A 2D pixel art game where you escape crises born in a toxic workplace. With semi-randomized maps and an increasing variety of traps as you progress, players must master movement techniques and carefully plan the use of limited resources to survive. Perfect for fans of Celeste and Getting Over It.

title: Miasma 2: Freedom Uprising
description: Turn-based planning and realtime battles, with a choice-driven story, all set in a dystopian future

title: Holo ADV: SakuraSingularity.exe
description: Sakura Miko and the Hololive members are suddenly warped into an alternate future timeline. In this 3D adventure game, Miko must reunite with her friends and uncover the truth of this strange world to find her way back home.

title: Immortality Factory
description: Build and automate your factory to unlock new machinery and recipes in this pixel-art automation idle game.

title: Sushi Delivery
description: “SUSHI DELIVERY” is a loop-based psychological horror game where you must deliver sushi without dropping it. Avoid nightly anomalies and complete all seven days of delivery.

title: Fadin's Vacation
description: The is a remake of a game already released on Steam, and the final version will be available as a free update for all current owners.

title: Super Turbo Racing
description: Super Turbo Racing is your drag racing game. The main goal of the game is to defeat all rivals, earn money in-game and become the ultimate car collector, own every luxury car in the game.

title: Angry Cubes
description: "Angry Cubes" is an exciting puzzle game that will challenge your skills and creativity. In this singleplayer game, each level presents increasing levels of difficulty as you progress through the game.

title: Myrkwood: Offshoot
description: Myrkwood: Offshoot is a top-down survival defense game that you can play with friends! Defend the Gem as you fight through waves of enemies!

title: Algoremind
description: Craft a living AI in this sci-fi pixel art Action RPG. Explore dangerous biomes, fulfill life sim needs, survive against the odds, and gather resources to evolve your creation. Your choices shape its consciousness and unlock one of many endings based on the path you choose.

title: Gunman Drift
description: The driving and shooting game. Gunman Drift is an incredible and satisfying drifting TPS where you drive, shoot, get shot at and get rewarded for it all in the meantime. Keep climbing the ranks until you become the Ultimate Gunman!

title: Coin Blitz
description: Coin Blitz is a casual coin-push arcade cabinet experience, with a pachinko-style backboard element. Build up layers of coins and try to get specialized effects in the best locations to dump coins into your bank. Stack your prizes over time for more powerful effects and level up your coins! Which prizes will you choose, and how quickly will you accumulate riches? Focus on a few powerful effects or dabble in a little bit of everything, the choice is yours.

title: Bom-eul Buleuneun Seolnyeo: Yuna Seupin-opeu
description: I received a love confession from a doctor I met in a peaceful countryside village I came down to find peace in.

title: Winterlight: Where Silence Says It All
description: As Elias returns to the coastal town that once sheltered him, he’s pulled into a slow winter of connection, memory and quiet decisions. Take the role of this young man and guide the choices he makes, surrounded by the warmth of townspeople young and old, often holding conversations in a bookstore over shared coffee.

title: Survival Classic
description: Try to survive the harsh realities of the cold Siberian countryside. Live long and always remember, man is man's enemy. You can trust no one but it is almost impossible to survive on your own. Choose your path and go to finish. Firefights, transport, crafting and survival.

title: Bumpkin & Sprout
description: Embark on an unforgettable co-op 3D platformer adventure in "Bumpkin & Sprout," where action, humor, and environmental awareness unite! Join these two whimsical mushrooms on a mission to save not only themselves but also Nature herself from the clutches of the nefarious Pollution Spirit.

title: Many Minigames
description: Singleplayer Wario Ware-like minigame collection with a challenge mode and global leaderboard.

title: Choyo Girl Lilina 2
description: Choyo Girl Lilina 2 is an RPG game about the training journey of a 16-year-old magical girl. Embark on an adventure through various villages, hunt monsters, and purchase better items from shops.

title: Sector Clear: Hryaken Destroy
description: Sector Clear: Hryaken Destroy - Endless Tactical Sweeping of Enemy Swine Forces in an Action-Packed Match-3 Game!

title: Re: Lord - Tales of Adventure
description: Card-based strategic roguelike with a mix of deck-building, auto-battler and territory management. Choose between +300 unique cards to create a deck that matches your playstyle, and lead your forces across the whole continent in an adventure that will unveil the truth behind this world.

title: Cute Warrior Girl 2
description: Cute Warrior Girl Fiora takes on the orcs raiding the rural villages! This is a JRPG-style comedy game where you freely explore castles, forests, and villages, talk to people, read signposts, and track down the orcs’ hideouts to defeat them.

title: Archaeology: Frozen Space
description: A game of the genre find the hidden object.

title: Binary Game
description: This is a simple luck-based game where players generate a random 30-digit binary number. The goal is to win by having all digits be either 0s or 1s. With extremely low odds of success, the game offers a fun challenge and a sense of achievement when winning.

title: Archaeology: Frozen Pirates
description: A game of the genre find the hidden object.

title: Anime: Match the Memory
description: Finding pairs might sound easy, but this game will definitely challenge your brain! Train your memory, concentration, accuracy, attention, the speed of thinking and logic skills and much more. This game is a great way to exercise your memory and keep your brain fit!

title: Italian Brainrot TCG
description: Italian Brainrot TCG is the chaotic card collector game you never asked for. Earn points passively, buy cursed booster packs, and unlock bizarre Italian brainrot characters and descend into card collecting madness

title: Jigsaw Puzzle: Anime Girls
description: Do puzzles in a new puzzle way! Advanced puzzle layout and involving gameplay will help you to relax after a hard-working day. The player can choose to play with 20, 30, or 42 pieces.

title: Emoji Merge: Puzzle Matching
description: Welcome to Emoji Merge, a vibrant and addictive puzzle-matching game that will immerse you in a world of colorful emojis and exciting challenges. Get ready to combine and merge emojis to create new and captivating expressions!

Discover uniquely named creatures across rarity tiers, unlock backgrounds and egg skins, complete collections, and trade in extras for missing pets. No combat, no pressure — just pure collecting bliss.

title: SimpleMovie
description: Simple Movie is a simulation, crafting and sand box game. The goal is to create a short film. The player is the film's writer, producer and director. The game creates a video with fixed background music and subtitles.

title: Stage Break Idle
description: Stage Break Idle is a relaxing incremental game where you defeat enemies at each stage. As you progress, you'll discover meaningful upgrades and unlock engaging new features. Unlock powerful companions to aid you in battle, and continue advancing until you conquer the final stage.

title: The Hurt in Secret
description: “The Hurt in Secret” is a visual novel game adapted from true events. Players play a role as practice teacher to experience teachers' life. They will involve in a troublesome case. In the story, the chosen dialogue will affect directly to the ending.

title: Operation Save Anna
description: There's a virus outbreak at a medieval military base. There are a lot of mutated zombies out there. The base doctor has developed a vaccine that works well against this mutated virus, and your job is to protect it from the zombies. Are you ready?

title: Investigation Stories: Gunsound
description: The peace of the town is shattered by a gunshot, and behind this spate of bloodshed is --?

title: Furrifighters: Prequel I
description: Furry 2D fighting game "FURRIFIGHTERS: PREQUEL I" ! Explore the storyline on the arcade mode, or have a good fight with your friend on VS mode!

title: RC SIM 2022
description: Play around in this semi-open world environment with different vehicles and maps!

title: Twist Logic
description: Hundreds of Levels Await Your Exploration

title: Adventures with Alan Parkour 3D
description: The goal of the game is to reach the portal that will take you to the next level. To do this, you need to jump on the blocks without falling into the lava.

title: Ruarua.ru
description: Ruarua.ru is a long-term farming project that always accompanies you... It is a simple farming game that can be played anytime and anywhere when you have free time.

title: Clutter 18: Joe's Ultimate Challenge - Collector's Edition
description: Are you ready for Joe's Ultimate Challenge? Take on new block puzzles and split takes among over 1800 puzzles that promise to keep you playing for days and days. Randomly generated levels mean endless replayability!

title: Leaks In Space
description: Build your own spaceship. Protect ship's core, manage Hull & Pressure to survive. Fight pirates. Explore themed sectors of the Syntar System. Uncover the mysterious of the Syntarian Empire!
