description: Zuma girl is a casual marble shooting game, which integrates RPG skills and strategies with traditional Zuma playing methods. You will meet three beautiful girls in the battle. Who is stronger or weaker? Only the brave survive to the end!

title: Hana
description: Hana is a 3D top-down tactical MMORPG where you play as a Hanari, a race of elves whose civilization has been decimated. Confront formidable adversaries solo or with your friends, develop your guild, your commerce, and rebuild the Hanaris civilization.

title: Gui Chu Da Mao Xian
description: a text-based visual novel with some RPG elements. As the story progresses, you will collaborate with and fight against Gui Chu stars. Remember, collaborating and fighting is just a means to survive, not an answer to the secrets in this world. Your mission is to figure out the truth of this world.

title: Lost Memories 3 Side Stories
description: Important note: Use the modifier to modify the data in the game will be judged cheating, the penalty is life-long ban on running the game! The game moderate liver injury, clearance time at least 200 hours, before you buy it must be estimated whether the body can bear it. Is your liver OK?

title: Journey of Carrying Light
description: Break the limitations of traditional soul games on players' attack actions, and provide players with the ability to freely design their own action modules

title: Idle Tiers
description: A real idle game with more than 2000 upgrades and deep management

title: Extra Extra Poison
description: At Bernard Cinemas we work harder not smarter! Work may feel like a loop but once you get infected, we'll take care of you! During the vaccination process please make sure to cover majority of your immune system's field. Good luck!

title: Key 2
description: Spend hours having fun exploring this ever-growing maze. In Key 2, with each level beaten, the maze gets bigger and more hard. Dodge slimes, spikes and traps, find the key and open the door before time runs out.

title: Maximum Fighterz: Direct Offensive Action
description: Competitive fighting game fun, appropriate for all.

title: The World of Marius
description: Get ready for an epic journey in The World of Marius

title: HelloWorld: Escape
description: Hello World:ESCAPE is a game created by Korean high school students, where a girl trapped in an unknown space kills enemies and finds an exit.

title: Animal Workforce: Idle Tycoon Clicker
description: Animal Workforce: Idle Tycoon Clicker is a simple and laid-back game that's easy to jump into. Perfect for casual play, it lets you unwind and progress at your own pace, all while collecting rewards and achieving upgrades. There are also plenty of easily obtained Steam Achievements!

title: The Rise of Tianling Sect
description: Lead your sect to become the strongest in the universe!

title: Mine Upgrade
description: Mine rocks with your pickaxe, purchase miners and upgrade your equipment! Sell gems and collectables for coins. Complete the game by achieving each task and earning trophies!

title: Sinew
description: Venture into the mysterious, horrid depths of a cold and threatening abyss in this short, dark adventure game. Players assume control of a small, aquatic creature as they must avoid dangers and solve environmental puzzles.

title: Don't Wake Up My Dream
description: Embark on a journey through a dog’s dream. Explore, solve puzzles, and trigger surprising events that shape the story and its endings. With hand-drawn art, heartfelt twists, and plenty of humor and surprises, this dreamy adventure awaits you.

title: Kunoichi Beat
description: Kunoichi Beat is a pseudo 8-bit, quasi-cinematic platformer with minor stealth elements. Playing as an urban ninja, much of the platforming is parkour-influenced as players will be making use of the environment with the urban ninja’s (slightly over-exaggerated) realistic jumping abilities.

title: Vacuum Cleaner Robot Simulator: Pile Sos Edition
description: In the game you control a robot vacuum cleaner! You have to avoid collision with different obstacles in order not to break down and reach the very end!

title: PBA Pro Bowling 2026
description: Do you have what it takes to bowl with the greats? PBA Pro Bowling is back and better than ever with a reimagined Career Mode, character customization, new character art, improved graphics, online play, advanced physics, and oil pattern breakdown - plus new game modes, venues, pros, balls, and more!

title: Beyond Your Wall
description: Tap. Break. Breathe. Become. Tap to break walls and open the door to self-discovery.

title: Study Time Anomaly
description: You fell asleep studying for exams, but when you woke up the school was empty. Survive the night, identify what’s wrong, and escape the loop... or be stuck at school forever.

title: Memasiki 2: Oldskuly svelo
description: Each round offers you a picture or description of a meme, after which you need to choose the correct answer from the options offered. For each correct answer, the player gets +1 point, and for an incorrect answer, 1 point is deducted.

title: Payday 3: Party Powder Heist
description: A mob family has enlisted the aid of corrupt cops to steal drugs from the Triads. The Party Powder heist supports both stealth and loud approaches, offers multiple paths, and includes cooking for those willing to risk it all for a bigger payday.

title: Project II: Silent Valley
description: Project II: Silent Valley is a linear, semi-open world dystopian visual novel with card combat and explore. Play as US Navy Officer Hierophan, joining the docile humanoid weapon Osprey to uncover a conspiracy at the underwater base "Silent Valley" and the hidden truths of his missing friend, Ochira.

title: Zumery
description: "Zoomers” is a visual novel that plunges you into the world of young dreamers who risk everything for their goal. Four guys - Kostya, Genka, Stas and “Bazuka” - decide to realize their dream: to open their own business. However, their plans collapse when a series of strange and dangerous events begin.

title: Navy Seals
description:
Map/weapons Pack made by mihn le before creating Action quake2.

This mods contains military weapons and custom maps.

title: Ghost Feed
description: This is a game inspired by the creator's real-life experiences and insights. The protagonist arrives in an old town and encounters strange, supernatural events in a spooky mansion. Ultimately, he discovers a deep connection between himself and the people and events within the mansion...

title: Back to the Scene
description: "Return to the Scene" is a story-based interactive suspense and mystery AVG game with multiple endings. The intricate case on an urban campus, the elusive murderer, and the unknown adventures entice you to explore deeper and deeper.

title: Awakening of Solutio
description: Venture into the heart of a fairytale forest fraught with peril in Awakening of Solutio, a captivating 2D platform game. Play as Solutio, accompanied by your loyal forest ghost companion, Ali, on a quest to restore balance to a land consumed by darkness. Your mission: to liberate the trapped forest ghosts, the very essence of the forest's life force.

title: Taoist Survivor
description: In ancient times, "Yaoshan," a mountain in the East, promised immortality through its legendary peaches, lingzhi mushrooms, and the trials of thunder. Many Taoists ventured there, but perilous beasts roamed the slopes. Can you survive "Yaoshan" and attain immortality?

title: Rite of the Dealer
description: Rite of the Dealer is a roguelike multi-deckbuilder where you guide charming rat companions through a peculiar, otherworldly hotel.

title: Karta Centauri
description: An accidental space adventure

title: Word
description: Type the Bible and record your best WPM for each verse!

title: Maid of Salvation
description: Maid of Salvation is an action RPG that features fast-paced and versatile combat. Master your own fighting style with a variety of swords and firearms, and explore a dark world full of secrets.

title: Brightest Star
description: You are returning to Earth on a starship, towards your cherished goal. Enjoy the wonderful life in the world of the future. And stay true to yourself when it comes time to save mankind in a cosmic novel-size adventure through space, time, and other dimensions.

title: Frog Odyssey
description: A turn-based strategic auto-battler where you buy ingredients, craft special dishes, and feed them to your frog adventurers to unlock powerful bonuses! Embark on a heroic journey to confront those causing chaos across the realm.

title: Alone but Strong
description: A single player first-person action shooter.

title: Shitlings
description: Gather resources, build a camp and protect it by constructing defenses. Assign jobs to your Shitlings, take care of their needs, develop new skills and unlock new constructions. Move the camp between locations on a path to the total victory of Shitlingness over the World!

title: Neko Times: Purrfect Shapes
description: "Neko Times: Purrfect Shapes" is a relaxing, feel-good puzzle game where you organize cute, quirky cats into grids. With 80 delightful levels, charming visuals, and soothing gameplay, it's the perfect way to unwind while having fun!

title: Kidney Stone Clicker
description: KIDNEY STONE Clicker is a Simple Clicker idle game but odd theme. Kidney stones by clicking rapidly on the screen to break them down into smaller pieces. Collect stone for power-ups and make your body healthy.

title: Modavuj Platform
description: Modavuj Platform is a multiplayer gift-collecting competition for up to 4 players and an action game where players can throw colored gel balls at each other.

title: Banished Sir
description: Banished Sir is an RPG game set in a Medival Fantasy world where decisions made matter.

title: Ball Heroes
description: The core gameplay takes the essence of soccer, while creating some very interesting rules to make it even more exciting! The basic rules of the game are simple, but it's up to the player to figure out a variety of skill combinations and team cooperation strategies.

title: Split Souls
description: The Player's soul has been split into 2 and it's the job of the player to get the souls back together.

title: Superior IQ
description: "Superior IQ": Test your knowledge across 4 different topics. Answer each question quickly before time runs out. Advance and showcase your intellectual superiority in this thrilling question and answer game. Challenge your friends and dive into the educational fun now!

title: Teamfight Manager 2
description: Teamfight Manager is back with more detailed tactics, management, and a new MOBA-style gameplay. Take charge of a virtual e-sports team, build the ultimate roster, and become the greatest manager!

title: Mobile Soldiers: Plastic Army
description: Get ready to embark on a thrilling journey down memory lane, with Mobile Soldiers: Plastic Army, bringing the beloved childhood table-top game to life in a new 3D experience that fits in your pocket. Brace yourself for fun that combines nostalgia with the excitement of mobile gaming!

title: DangerousPath
description: Think quickly, plan wisely, and victory will be yours!

title: Click Click Click
description: The most simple idle clicker game. Are you able to reach the one octillion value? Buy upgrades and use prestige system to achieve the goal! Fun and relaxation are included

title: Echoes of Tomorrow
description: A post-apocalyptic action RPG where you survive harsh environments, face challenging combat, make choices with lasting consequences, and uncover lost secrets. Every decision shapes your journey through a dangerous, immersive world.

title: Food Chain
description: Full Physics Massive Multiplayer.

title: Kalaha
description: A classic two-player strategy board game where players collect pearls and outmaneuver their opponent through careful planning and tactical moves. Easy to learn, challenging to master.

title: Trump vs Harris Clicker
description: The presidential race turned clicker game! Click, gain upgrades, and win states to decide who will become the next president!

title: Trophy Truck Racing Tour
description: Can you become the best driver on the Trophy Truck Racing Tour? Battle against other drivers at several different off-road dirt tracks and experience what it's like to drive one of the most intense off-road trucks ever built.

title: Nophenia
description: explore atmospheric dreams of vagrant but familiar memories.

title: Cyclopean II: The Dreamlands
description: Cyclopean II: The Dreamlands takes you into the dark fantasy setting described in H.P. Lovecraft's Dreamquest of Unknown Kadath and other stories of his Dream Cycle.

title: Undress!
description: Memory game, find a pair of underwear to undress the girl!

title: FlappyParrot
description: This is a very good mini game,

title: My Hooptie
description: Fix up your crappy car and build the engine yourself. Make money by selling wood, potatoes, mining ores, or racing. Explore the map, manage survival, Build your story set in America, 2002.

title: No Walls in Heaven
description: No Walls In Heaven is a first-person exploration platformer about losing yourself in the hostile vastness of the cosmos. Grapple, leap, and fight your way through the towering concrete and metal landscapes of a lost megastructure that seems to disobey all laws of physics and reality.

title: Jack
description: Find all the pieces of candy to save your village from the entity called "Jack". But beware, Jack's friends seek to release him by stopping you.

title: Skylax! The Lab Runner
description: Skylax! The Lab Runner is an FPS game that presents you with tight gameplay and good mechanics. In the game, you can pass levels either by hiding using the invisible mechanic or by fighting against enemies. And after each level you will upgrade your weapons and utilities!

title: Ashes of War
description: Thrown into a century long war between the Union and the Kingdoms, a lone starship Captain decides to rebel against his fate. Join him in his galactic journey and discover the various stories that can still bloom in the Ashes of War...And flirting. A lot of flirting.

title: Hidden Anime Girls
description: Find 20 hidden girls and 5 secrets items on each unique anime-style levels. Cute and chill hidden object game.

title: Caveman Caravan
description: A land bridge has appeared that leads to a new land! Guide a caravan of cavemen on a journey to a new continent by using map tiles and invented tools together in powerful combinations to collect resources that help them to survive.

title: Durak Online
description: Fast-paced, strategic card game, playable with 2 - 6 players or 1 - 3 bots!

title: Interstellar Nomad
description: First person single player 3D Sci-Fi adventure in space

title: Fart Drop DX
description: Very niche fart puzzle

title: Mafia Romania
description: MAFIA ROMANIA is a Free-to-Play multiplayer shooter with Romanian-Inspired locations, parkour/freerunning elements, and both first person/third person perspectives.

title: Palworld: Palfarm
description: Enjoy a farming life with mysterious creatures known as Pals! Team up with them to grow your farm at your own pace in this brand new creature-collecting farming sim, fully playable in multiplayer!

title: Cinema Tycoon
description: Cinema Tycoon Gold is a game where you get a chance to manage your very own cinema. Do you have what it takes to become a Cinema Tycoon?

title: Toffee Cats
description: A relaxing puzzle game about adorable cats! Toffee Cats is a cute and casual game for the whole family! Different cats, charming graphics, and a cozy atmosphere will bring tons of joy. Perfect for relaxing and having fun.

title: Cat Sudoku
description: Cat Sudoku is an extremely cute game where you play a little sudoku with cats.

title: Flood Escape
description: A first person shooter where players see who can survive to be the last one alive as the flood below them rises.

title: Hurricane Heroes
description: Hurricane Heroes is a 3-act interactive narrative experience that places players in the shoes of three critical roles as a storm approaches and impacts the coast of Florida.

title: Zoo Time
description: Zoo Time is a Top-Down Animal & Zoo Management Party Game. Core Gameplay revolves around physics-based interactions and successful task execution. Enjoy an Easy play with your kids or Challenging play with your friends!

title: Supreme Heroes
description: Highschool sophomore Jacob suddenly discovers he has super powers and must team up with his best friends to become the 'Elect Few', but convincing them to embrace their powers and save the world is all but easy. Events bring Jacob to battle villainous factions in order to bring peace to the nation.

title: Color Patterns
description: Color Patterns is a minimalist puzzle game inspired by the classic board game domino. Find the correct color patterns on the board.

title: Survivor: Spark
description: Survivor: Spark is the first episode of a series of anti alien invasion games. It's a classic transcendental third person shooting game!

title: Binarycurse
description: This is a password game that decrypts hidden information by finding it. You need to be very careful to find the password to solve the puzzle. It is a very difficult game!

title: Super Nihon Cheating Cup 86'
description: This game was made for the #badboxart jam

title: Deep Space Solitude
description: "Deep Space Solitude" is a first-person horror game. As a journalist, you investigate the disappearance of a scientist in a remote cabin, tackling puzzles, challenges, and fear to survive.

title: Coppy Tour
description:
Coppy Tour is a side-scrolling arcade adventure with the goal of collecting all coins, targets, and hidden items spread across the Coppy Tour 2D world. It is a classic "High-Score" competition, with an online leaderboard and unlimited playability. Control your player through the course to collect coins, while using your gun to collect targets. Hidden coins and pickups may require several playthroughs to find or access. With a run duration under 30-minutes, you can attempt to beat your high score frequently, though legend has it nobody has ever completed with 100% of the items collected.

Unlock new weapons, skins, item customizations, and map features through in game decisions. Learn the levels to maximize your score each run and find all unlockable items. In-depth stats menus keep track of your achievements, with runs saving automatically and several gameplay options to choose from.

title: Create a Pop Sensation
description:
Released in other territories as "Smash Hits: Wannabe a Popstar", Create a Pop Sensation gives players the chance to create their own pop songs from numerous music samples.

Hold auditions for band members, strike a recording deal and put on a concert for your adoring fans. If you're lucky, you'll make it into the top 20 charts.

title: Lovely Anime Puzzle: Christmas
description: Lovely Anime Puzzle: Christmas is a fun and rewarding puzzle game. Assemble charming Christmas-themed pictures, sharpen your attention, and immerse yourself in a festive holiday world.

title: Neko Café Stories
description: Sweet atmosphere, charming girls, and bubbles.

title: The Island of Thugs
description: Welcome to the island of thugs. This tropical island is a secret military base of Russian PMC. You are a Special Agent who must find the leader of PMC and eliminate him. Take the gun and let's go!

title: Idle Pixel Fantasy
description: Recruit hard-working helpers and magical creatures that automatically collect gold and crystals. Unlock new levels, invest in stronger units, and work your way up to the powerful dragon boss at the top. A relaxing pixel-style idle clicker!

title: Akiba Lost
description: Thirteen years ago, six girls vanished in Akihabara in the unsolved case “Akiba’s Spirited Away”. Daiki Shinjo announces a live-action game based on the incident, gathering six women who embody Akihabara’s subculture. But their story begins to seep into reality. Can AKIBA LOST be finished?

title: Neural Tanks
description: Neural Tanks is a third-person tank combat game that takes AI to the next level by leveraging Neural Networking. Neural Networking allows enemy tanks to learn and adapt over time, making them smarter, faster, and more efficient as they navigate the battlefield.

title: Still Stars Echo
description: An atmospheric science-fiction journey across distant alien landscapes. Traverse monolithic structures, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the story of a lost civilization written among the stars.

title: Happy Nuclear
description: Happy Nuclear is an evidence-based investigation game where players act as detectives to prevent a disaster. They analyze interconnected case information on an investigation board, primarily using old CCTV and access logs. Cases link together at the end, and each replay introduces changes.

title: Rock Paper Scissors: The Final Match
description: Rock Paper Scissors: The Final Match is a horror-themed twist on the classic game, where every win draws you deeper into the darkness. Climb the leaderboard and prove you're the ultimate survivor.

title: Paper Pilot
description: Immerse yourself in the adventure of Paper Pilot, where you control the "Paper Pilot" through 15 unique levels. Collect star boxes to unlock new levels. Beware, your gun can overheat! Develop a strategy to navigate this adventure successfully.

title: Pazinko!
description: Pazinko! is a fast-paced arcade pachinko game. Launch chrome balls through vibrant, dynamic pegboards. Test your reflexes and timing as you launch balls through a maze of obstacles, aiming for the highest score.

title: Hunted Hunter
description: Hunted hunter, is a game in which you'll have to take the form of objects on the game map, to blend into the background, in order to eliminate your opponents before they eliminate you. Everyone hunts everyone. Hide well, win games and have fun!

title: Rotten Woods
description: Take on the role of a brave hunter and embark on a dangerous journey through an abandoned village where mysterious monsters are waiting at every turn.

title: Fortune Crafter
description: Fortune Crafter is a roguelike(rogueLite*) game that focuses on crazy synergies. You can play this game in local coop with as many friends as you wish. Or you can play several pvp modes. This game will be perfect for minmax enjoyers, since it has lots of deep mechanics and interractions.

title: Sad Virus Runner
description: Endless runner game where player control virus characrer in 6 different maps with obstacles

title: Burger Typer
description: Type Burgers | Make BIG Money | Upgrade Your Restaurant | Include Your Twitch Viewers | BURGER TYPER

title: Black 9
description: Black 9 is a third person shooter that takes place in the year 2080 where Earth is full of crime, chaos, and despair. The Illuminati, the most powerful of the cartels, have decided to assert their dominance by eliminating the competition. Now all nine members of the Illuminati are plotting against each other, all secretly hoping they will emerge victorious to rule over what's left of the planet. You are their only hope but you have no loyalty or do you?

title: Tower Inc.
description: Tower Inc. is a survival horror of shifting floors, monsters, and betrayal. Collect quotas as fuel to keep the elevator running — without them, you won’t survive the climb. Work with your team… or leave them behind.

title: Juiced Fruit Racing
description: Splash and smash your friends in this juicy party kart racing game! Make and take speedy shortcuts as you compete against the sweetest competition. A wholesome and hectic racer packed with power-ups and heavy laughter.

title: Dwarfare: All For The Forge
description: Be the dwarf you know you are! Build towers to protect the beacons and keep production in motion! Use your weapons to corner any enemies that scrape through. Do it- do it ALL FOR THE FORGE!!

title: City Block
description:
A kid decides to help its town. Complete mission for different professions or take a break and race through the roads and streets of the town on a motorcycle, kickbike or skateboard, play some football or ride a sheep!

City Block is a town simulation game focused on driving in a big pixel car playmat with gameplay similar to the early auto theft games.

title: Wu Confucian Painting Volume: Apocalypse
description: Wu Confucian Painting Volume-Apocalypse" is a three-country background development game. Players can formulate their own development routes in the game, or assist the emperor as a counselor, or assist the emperor to seek the Quartet as a military commander, and he can be the monarch himself

title: Lottery Center Simulator
description: You will act the administrator of a lottery center.

title: Epejsodion Dodgeball Training
description: Epejsodion Dodgeball Training gives the player a great and fully customizable training area to train for the greatest dodgeball event ever, the Epejsodion Dodgeball Championships!

title: Cooking Time!
description: A chaotic multiplayer strategic shooter where players cook different dishes and throw them at their enemies.

title: XP Slime
description: Train your slime to earn XP and unlock powerful new forms (depending on care it receives)

title: Procemon: You Must Catch Them
description: A retro-style procedurally generated monster collecting RPG. All glitches, all the time.

title: Lizard Survival Duo
description: It is a tension survival platform machine at the same time, and it is a nervous survival platform machine that avoid obstacles falling from the sky.Yellow and blue lizard is manipulated with different keys, and concentration speed and concentration is required.

title: Minidinos
description: In this fun, family-friendly real-time strategy game, kids can control dinosaurs, beasts, and bugs as they battle for supremacy! Build your army, gather resources, and outsmart your enemies in epic showdowns. Play solo against the computer or team up with friends for multiplayer action!

title: 50 Minutes 'Til Impact
description: 50 Minutes 'Til Impact is set in a retro-futuristic world aboard an advanced, yet luxurious space train! It's a linear narrative adventure where players utilize 3D exploration, code solving, and visual novel interactions to do whatever they can to save everyone on board before time runs out.

title: Gangsta Style
description: A first-person versus fighting shooter with voice controls!

title: Snake Eyes
description: Snake Eyes is a bullet hell top down 2D roguelike where you assume the role of a vengeful snake on a quest to take down the casino that took her arm. Parry, dodge, and take revenge with your homemade Slot Machine Gun while collecting unique items to assist you on your path of revenge.

title: Duel Legends
description: Duel Legends - a revolutionary auto-battler card game where strategy meets dynamic combat. Step into a world where every card you play transforms your hero into an unstoppable force.

title: Ball Space
description: A single player 3D puzzle platformer set in low earth orbit. Roll, jump, and float around in space as a ball collecting records, coins, and new friends. Listen to the records you collect and uncover forgotten secrets. Gravity changes from area to area so be prepared for some unusual challenges.

title: Number Game: 24 Points
description: A game,you just need to put your answers into the circles to make the expression equal to 24 points. It is simple (or not).

title: Illumina Defender
description: Defend the vibrant world of Illumina from descending enemies in this retro-styled, fast-paced, single-player arcade game. Utilize strategic upgrades to keep the city safe and enjoy an electrifying soundtrack while you do it!

title: Ogre Chambers 2222
description: A ROGUELIKE, where you FIND and FUSE ABILITIES, while raiding TRANSFORMING space ARENAS Traverse randomized planets - Murder their populations - Get stronger - Take down Ogre Overlords! But remember, DO NOT anger the ogres beyond your guns' capabilities!

title: The Turkish Bazaar
description: "The Turkish Bazaar" offers players a true bazaar vendor experience. Purchase products wholesale from the hal, load your vehicle, set up your stall, and engage with dynamic customers to become the most successful vendor in the bazaar!

title: Polycore
description: Certainly not another rage platformer.

title: Satan Santa
description: Satan Santa is a first-person horror walking simulator where you play as a child trapped in a Christmas nightmare. The jolly Santa you once knew has become a bloodthirsty demon, and now you must fight for survival through an eerie house and a forest filled with horrors.

title: Launch Ball
description: Launch Ball: Position your cannon and skillfully launch the ball to hit the box in this precise and engaging physics-based puzzle game.

title: Conquest Emperor
description: This is a match-3 RPG game! You are called to another world. This is a world ruled by empresses, all you have to do is defeat and conquer all empresses and eventually become the king of Galan.

title: Ragdoll Playground
description: Ragdoll is a fun sandbox game with realistic collision physics. Launch your character as you would anywhere.

title: Box Hustle
description: Box Hustle is a 3D isometric Sokoban-inspired puzzle game where strategic movement is key. Push wooden crates onto target spots while navigating tight spaces and avoiding dead ends. Every move counts as you hustle to solve increasingly challenging levels.

title: Spike Match
description: Spike Match is a multiplayer soccer game with nails. It's a game to play against your friends. Be precise on your turn or you will give the victory to your opponent.

title: Swallow the Blue
description: An eerie horror game set in a weird hotel plagued with bizarre beings and interesting characters. The game utilizes a never-used before environment alongside brand new horror mechanics, one of a kind graphics/art style, and an unnerving story with rich lore to create a unique experience for players.

title: Zombies In Valkeala
description: Third person shooter game, where player controls woman character whose mission is to kill zombies in place called Valkeala in 4 different locations

title: Quick Trivia
description: Quick Trivia is a small multiplayer guessing game — with questions related to gaming.

title: Drift Showcase
description: Awesome side-scrolling drifting experience. Showcase your skill, impress the crowd and gather more fans, earn credits, buy cars and tune your ride. Enjoy the awesome graphics and custom vehicle physics.

title: Mellstroy Survivor
description: Enter the world of Melstroy Survivor, where your skills are tested in battles and quests. With simple controls and deep leveling, each battle brings you closer to glory. Fight, collect loot, level up your hero, and enjoy the gorgeous retro graphics.

title: Escape Protocol: Hospital
description: A text-based escape room horror with multiple endings. Trapped in an abandoned hospital, use classic text-adventure commands to explore, solve puzzles, and uncover sinister secrets. Will you find your way out?

title: Zly.ii: The Hacked Station
description: Zly.ii The Hacked Station is a first-person sci-fi adventure game made for the 10th anniversary of the Black Cube series (ASA, Myha...). Visit an abandoned space station, and try to get a Black Cube while searching for your lost friend...

title: Falling Duke Nukem
description: Short mod about Duke falling forever

title: Dragon Maiden: Blossoms of the Past
description: Dragon Maiden is a 2D pixel-art mystery adventure. As Wang Xie, you're trapped in a time loop on the day of the Mountain God Ceremony. Relive the 22 hours before midnight, uncover the truth behind the village's destruction, and break free from the cycle.

title: Eternal One: Memories of Kumo Island
description: After the Beta War, the abandoned Island #17 was reborn as the vibrant “Kumo Island” by the Kumo people of Motokumo. The Administrator journeys to Toa and Satona’s hometown, chasing lost memories and hidden truths. But what is really happening in Motokumo?

title: Itachi: Haunted Abodes - Wandering Through 2000s Tokyo Culture
description: Itachi: Hunted Abodes is a paranormal suspense adventure that has you wandering through 2000s Tokyo's subculture scenes!

title: Hoptale
description: 《Hoptale》 is a casual and strategic Rougelite game that combines slot machines with combat. Players will use the slot machine to determine the character's next behavior, the damage caused to monsters, and the loot obtained!

title: Syobon No Action Special
description:
Did you play the original Syobon Action, and thought it was fun?...

No?

Well, this is a very SPECIAL edition of the game! No more trolling, 13 new levels, and many, many new features!

A completely new almost troll-free platformer based on the original Super Mario Bros and Syobon Action.

title: How Many Dudes?
description: How many dudes does it take to beat up 1000 toddlers? A gorilla? Twelve bears and a horse-sized duck? A GOD? Enter the Dude Ranch and find out.

title: Elven Forest
description: Rescue captivating elf girls from an enchanted forest in this fantasy adventure. Wield your sword and free imprisoned beauties trapped by dark magic. Immerse yourself in vibrant landscapes, intriguing challenges, and alluring encounters along the way.

title: Goddess Paradise
description: "The Forbidden Zone" - the ultimate fantasy world for men! Here, holy angels, charming witches, and soft beast girls are all at your disposal! The original "battle suit breaking" system, the more intense the battle, the more powerful the visual impact! 50 Live2D dynamic battle girls.

title: Ardena
description: Ardena is a first-person survival horror game where your only light is a dwindling campfire. Gather wood to keep it burning, uncover chilling clues about you and your location, and find a way to escape the mysterious forest—before she finds you.

title: Blood West: Scavengers
description: Endless West brings a long awaited endless randomizer mode to Blood West! See how long you can survive as you meet familiar friends and old foes in the never ending weird wild west!

title: Eleanor in Miami
description: A stunning mix of visual novel and relationship-simulating elements as they make decisions that shape the main plot. Each character featured in the game has its unique storyline to discover, with various daily actions, stats, and events set in place to strengthen the gameplay experience.

title: Mistress Marigold's Home Improvement
description: Mistress Marigold's Home Improvement is a kinetic (linear) short story. It is an AVN, but linear by design, telling a very specific story. You play as George, who has admired Mari - his coworker - from afar. One lucky Saturday, she invites him to become a bigger part of her life.

title: Passion Rift
description: Enter a futuristic reality show where you seduce exotic beings, battle interdimensional monsters, and uncover dark corporate secrets. Build your team, chase desire, and become a star on screen... and behind the scenes.

title: Hemohound
description: HEMOHOUND is a fast-paced western shooter with roguelike elements in a world where vampires stand under the sun. Consume your foes' blood to gain their skills and weapons as you cut a bloody trail through the west seeking to become worthy of immortality.

title: Aerocube
description: AEROCUBE is a Ski-Fi Roguelike + First-Person Boomer Shooter in a huge mysterious cube that always rotates randomly. Each room of AEROCUBE is different, but one thing stays the same: something’s always behind you, ready to kill.

title: Deck Of The Damned
description:
How unlucky can one be?
Trapped in a graveyard with a peculiar deck of cards, and an even more peculiar cat. You must find some way to escape this cursed place before monsters drawn to your bad luck get you.
WIth the deck of cards you can channel your unlucky energy to slash, curse, and defend yourself . But watch out as your unlucky energy can be used against you as well.
Made for GBJam 13

title: Turnbound
description: Turnbound is an auto battler, where you manage a hero's inventory to escape a haunted boardgame. Each run is different from the last, with unique upgrades, combos and synergies. Async PvP lets you battle the ghosts of other players at your own pace in this unique new inventory battler. Will your design outlive your ghostly opponents… or join them?

title: Wishfarers
description: Wishfarers is a turn-based, tactical RPG with streamlined platformer movement, explosive combat, and destructible terrain. Join a plucky band of adventurers as they chase shooting stars, face mysterious foes, and fulfill wishes both big and silly.

title: Golden Idol Investigations: The Curse of the Last Reaper
description:
This swashbuckling adventure spans across two interconnected timelines -1797 and 1927- challenging you to piece together a fragmented past. This tale is a stand-alone DLC, can you piece together the scrolls of history?

Shortly after the events of The Case of the Golden Idol a pirate captain hid mysterious treasure. Follow his tracks and a group of explorers 130 years later unearthing the lost curse.

title: Haunted Manor: Halloween's Uninvited Guest - Collector's Edition
Dead by Daylight: Sinister Grace
description: Play as The Krasue, a gruesome Killer with two terrifying forms, or Vee Boonyasak, an electrifying survivor from the rising punk band Axekick. Experience a terrifying take on Thai Folklore rooted in visceral body-horror....in Dead by Daylight: Sinister Grace.

title: Creature Pedia
description: A broke college student accidentally takes a job from a mysterious Magic Academy—oops. Now you’re stuck solving magical mishaps, meeting NPCs, collecting odd materials, and summoning monsters to survive this chaotic campus.

title: Path of Master
description: Path of Master is a roguelike‑inspired casual monster‑grinding game.You can continuously upgrade your skills to slay hordes of monsters and strive to survive.

title: Aice
description: Aice is a game about designing increasingly complicated processor chips, all while hiding sneaky extra capacity from the 'supervising' humans. Carefully design and layout your chips so that all the extras you've added are well hidden in amongst the regular components!

title: Math in Space
description: Are your kids tired of the daily grind of school classes? Hold on—don’t rush to dismiss the value of learning just yet.

title: Trash Battle
description: A casual turn-based card game based on the rules of Trash or Garbage. A classic card sequencing game that involves organizing a hand Ace through Ten in sequential order before your opponent can.

title: Angelica's Chaotic Hardcore School
description: Angelica's Chaotic Hardcore School is an Indie Horror Game inspired by Baldi's Basics in Education & Learning, featuring a young girl named Emily in a Chaotic School with 5 different floors. From Solving Math Problems to discovering new Science Experiments. Different Knowledge is Required!

title: Card Heroes of Millford
description: A roguelike deck-building RPG where you battle the creatures of the Millford Woods in strategic card combat. Level up your character gaining strength and new ability cards for your deck. Discovering new creatures and ultimately freeing the village of Millford.

title: The Isle of Cats
description: Rescue colorful cats to fill your boat in a new digital adaptation of the beloved board game.

title: Polyarmory: High Calibre Love
description: The world's only fully-loaded conspiracy theorist gun-nut dating simulation.

title: Pick Up Your Masks
description: Throw as many masks as possible into the garbage can before one falls to the ground in the 24 levels.

title: MiniCar Shop Simulator
description: Have a great, silly time running a toy car store in MiniCar Shop Simulator! It's 50% Supermarket Simulator, 50% Mario Kart, 50% Goat Simulator, 50% gacha game, 50% NBA, 1% DOOM, and 99% certified STUPID.

title: Bladepink
description: A dark game in a medieval setting where you play as a wounded hero trying to survive in a world invaded by the undead.

title: Room Dot Exe
description: Unleash your creativity with Room dot Exe! Design your dream room with endless furniture, colors, and accessories, playable on PC or phone!

title: Shinka Tales
description: Super Mario 64, but with masks, magic and machinery!

title: El Norte Salvaje, Juego De Cartas RPG
description: The Wild North, RPG card game, is a card game with a medieval and fantasy theme for one player in which we control a hero who has at his disposal a deck of nj cards that he will use to advance overcoming different scenarios until completing the campaign map.

title: Grinding Guilds
description: Grinding Guilds mixes Auto Battler and ARPG elements. Pick your hero, level up, get loot and upgrade abilities. Hire allies for your guild, equip Pacts, position your units and find the best strategy to beat all bosses.

title: Bunny Pit Stop
description: Get ready to hop into action in Bunny Pit Stop, a puzzle game where a clever rabbit mechanic takes center stage. Inspired by the classic push-and-place style, your mission is simple but tricky: push cars into their maintenance bays and keep the garage running smoothly.

title: T*riff U!!
description: You are an eccentric president saving your sanity by imposing tariffs! Match lines of country flags and start trade wars, but don't crash your economy. Fight for Congress's support and don't let your presidency collapse... or do it with a bang!

title: Mystery Quest
description: Mystery quest - Mysterious things are going on in the magical world. Help the young sorceress collect all the scattered things and put things in order in the possessions of her teacher, and maybe then she will share the secrets of magic with you..

title: Swim
description: Enter the world of Block Blast, where you have to use your brain with every step, and you can also watch the magic cube explode, which is super rewarding!

title: Sex Game: Threesome - Episode 3
description: Enjoy an erotic visual novel featuring a guys and his 2 hot girl friends, and an engaging sex simulator. An inviting empty beach is to tempting not to take advantage of, so the three friends let themselves carried away in a hot threesome on the sand, by the ocean.

title: Witch of Mystery Tower
description: "Witch of Mystery Tower" is a witch x gem elimination x interactive erotic game. It’s a turn-based game that you need to fight against witches by eliminating magical gems. As the witch's magical value decays until she is unable to battle with the player, it starts the interactive erotic stage.

title: Mortality Decomp. Killers: Shadow of Abaddon
description: In the slums of Tokydon, ruthless crime-boss 'Abaddon' is caught in a gang war over selling immortality while he struggles with his own.

title: Hentai Senpai: Tavern Whores
description: Enter a medieval tavern where these Tavern Whores serve more than ale! Solve erotic puzzles to unlock steamy scenes with Tavern Whores who'll drain your coin purse and your balls. Three puzzle modes, gallery system, and enough debauchery to make any adventurer cum back for more!

title: Ancestral Harvest
description: A shaman-child wanders through a world destroyed by mankind, seeking a cure for his eternal wound. With the aid of a mystical drum, he must connect with a withering planet and purge the evil that controls humanity.

title: Hentai Girls: Sexy Maid Party
description: Enjoy 20 animations featuring 5 sexy maid girls! As you progress, unlock animations of many different positions with all the girls. These maids are waiting to give you their service!

title: Dale & Dawson: Stationary Supplies
description: In "Dale & Dawson Stationery Supplies," play as a Manager, Specialist, or Slacker in an office setting. Slackers blend in, mimicking Specialists to avoid the Manager's suspicion. Uncover or cause deception to win.

title: Hentai World Wild
description: A relaxing puzzle game where each completed stage unveils stunning images of beautiful girls, set to gentle music with increasing challenges.

title: Succubi's Trap Dungeon of Seduction
description: The town of warriors, Kazanstall... Kazanstall aimed to bring up fine warriors who could vanquish monsters in the future. However, an incident strikes him out of the blue. Mirai (the protagonist of our story) must survive while fighting and trying to avoid the traps.

title: Hentai Bae Violet
description: A simple match-2 puzzle game where you unlock images of “happy” memories between you and your sweet lover, Violet

title: CoThrust
description: In the darkness of space, you are not alone. The thrusters are yours. Alone or with a friend, hold your course, resist the chaos, and reach the rescue ship.

title: Aura: Echoes of Pain
description: A beautiful narrative 2D puzzle platforming journey of self discovery. The world was bright and full of life, but is now dark and barren. Travel across a desolated land to find meaning through memories of a better time, when life was happier and uncover the secret that brought darkness to the land.

title: Dickland: Tower Defense
description: Dickland: Tower Defense is Tower Defense in Lowpoly 3D graphics. The main feature of the game is black humor and a visual environment, namely the world of penises. Here you have to build the economy and various defensive towers to resist hordes of enemies.

title: Cliff Hanger PC
description: This is a PC conversion of the 1983 arcade game Cliff Hanger. This is an FMV game that uses footage from the Lupin the 3rd series. Quick reflexes are necessary to beat the game.

title: Eden’s Frontier
description: Eden’s Frontier is an Action RPG inspired by works from the 90s and 2000s. Pixel art + 3D environments, deep narrative, dynamic combat, and exploration, all set in the same universe as its manga!

title: Comet Catastrophe
description:
Comet Catastrophe is a Sonic fangame inspired by Classic Sonic games with its own somewhat strange twists.
Throughout your journey, you'll get to meet some quirky characters that may or may not help you. No, Sonic isn't one of them...

title: D-topia
description: Step into the world of D-topia in this gentle-paced puzzle adventure. In D-topia, life is curated by artificial intelligence to maximize happiness. As the newest Facilitator, its up to you to solve puzzles to keep the D-topia residents happy and the facility running.

title: Cliff Hanger
description: The backgrounds up the tempo and players are well equipped with a plethora of attacks! Test your mettle against a horde of enemies! Difficulty settings are available to adjust the game for both players that are new to action games and players that want a challenge.

title: People of Note
description: In this turn-based RPG musical, join Cadence as she recruits an ensemble of musicians on her quest for stardom. Experience turn-based combat like never before, where each battle is a musical performance with evolving combat conditions and genre-bending mashup attacks!

title: Demi and the Fractured Dream
description: In this action adventure, play as Demi and venture through the wondrous world of Somnus. Tasked by a mysterious voice, you must destroy the legendary Accursed Beasts to save the world. Use your attacks and abilities to slay enemies, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth behind an ancient history.

title: MoeSpotter: Uncover the Girls' Mysteries!
description: This is a game that combines "beautiful girls" and "spot the difference". You will find yourself in a different world, encountering various beautiful girls, from after-school JK to cute maids. Explore their unknown side by finding the differences in their daily lives!

title: Spread The Love
description: A silly dating sim where your flavor decides your fate. Customize your profile, flirt with six lovably unique characters, and try to survive your first date!

title: Dark Ties
description: Experience the brand-new tale of Yoshitaka Mine from Yakuza 3 in an included separate game. Having once led a succesful startup company, he plunged himself into the dark world of the yakuza by choice after losing everything. Left with an empty heart, the pursuit to find true bonds drives him forward once again in a dramatic journey colored by exhilarating boxing-based combat, and a variety of engaging side experiences.

title: Yakuza Kiwami 3 & Dark Ties
description: YAKUZA KIWAMI 3 is an extreme remake of the action-adventure beat 'em up Yakuza 3 featuring ex-yakuza Kazuma Kiryu's fight to protect those he loves. DARK TIES is a brand-new game featuring Yoshitaka Mine from Yakuza 3 included as a separate action-packed experience.

title: Wǒ de Tǎnkè Wǒ de Tuán
description: Dive into My Tanks, My Legion - Large-Scale Team Battle Strategy Game, the ultimate mobile experience for tank warfare enthusiasts! Command powerful armored vehicles, forge unbreakable alliances, and conquer the world in this thrilling strategy game. Prepare for intense tank battles, strategic deployments, and large-scale team operations. Whether you are a seasoned strategist or a newcomer to the genre, get ready to immerse yourself in a world of explosive action and tactical brilliance. This MMO strategy game allows you to build your tank legion and lead your team to victory on the battlefield.

title: Animula Nook
description: Ever wondered what it’s like to call a desk your home? Shrink into a cozy miniature world to explore and live among giant everyday objects. Here, you’ll collect sunlight & raindrops, build dream homes, and befriend whimsical folk. In Animula Nook, the smallest things tell the biggest stories.

title: Manairons
description: Manairons is a 3D action platformer game inspired by the legends of little creatures living in the Pyrenees. Help Nai face off against the landowner who has taken control of a charming village using the power of the "canut," with magic, flute, and plenty of chaos.

title: Lost Patient
description: The game is a surreal horror RPG, containing puzzles and enemy battles, it features a mix between pixel art and 3D low poly art!

title: PongBang
description:
PONGBANG is a digital board game inspired by Russian roulette, reimagined with a fun and strategic twist. Players take turns surviving high-stakes rounds while using item cards to prank, sabotage, or protect themselves. The last player standing wins the game.

A thrilling mix of luck, bluffing, and backstabbing — PONGBANG is perfect for parties and chaotic game nights.

title: Recuerdos de Invierno
description: Recuerdos de Invierno is a point-and-click visual novel with hints of dark comedy. The story follows a clown who lives in the backrooms, exploring different episodes from her past. As she wanders through strange corridors and rooms, the player interacts with objects linked to her memories, revealing fragments of her life and personality.

title: Go Kart Island
description: An open world kart racer! Use items, driftslide and boost your way to championship glory as you help Lachlan the highland cow complete his lifelong dream of winning the BIG RACE and becoming Go Kart Champion.

title: Sins of a Solar Empire II: Content Pass
description:
The Sins of a Solar Empire II Content Pass includes the soundtrack, Triumphs DLC, Reinforcements DLC, Harbinger expansion and Nemesis expansion. All items will be available in the future as they are released.

The Content Pass includes the following:

Digital Soundtrack (Releases September 2024): Immerse yourself in over 60 tracks by Paul Scheugraf.

'Paths to Power' Scenario Pack: Custom scenarios with unique starting and victory conditions.

'Reinforcements' Ship Pack: New forces join the fray as each race gains two new units to field.

'Times of War' Campaign Expansion: A full single-player story driven campaign that relates the tragic story of the TEC, Vasari and Advent.

'Harbinger' Expansion: Discover and play as the mysterious fourth faction!

title: Sins of a Solar Empire II: Paths to Power
description:
Prepare for new challenges with Paths to Power, the first DLC for Sins of a Solar Empire II! This DLC features new mission-driven scenario maps that forces players to achieve special goals to achieve victory. Test your strategic skills and shape your fate as you battle through new, high-stakes scenarios in the vast universe of Sins of a Solar Empire II.

Paths to Power includes over 10 new scenario mission maps to play-through in single-player action.

Featured Scenarios
• All as One
• Defend the Homeworld
• Seek & Destroy
• Scorched Space
• Conversion
• Clash of the Titans
• Spearhead
• Superpowers
• The Uprising

title: Sins of a Solar Empire II: Reinforcements
description:
Deploy six new command-class warships and customize your game with factional victory conditions with the Reinforcements DLC.

Command-Class Ships
• TEC Enclave – Takadaran Command Fortress
• TEC Primacy – Khevarkov Modular Battleship
• Vasari Alliance – Sularkon Tyrant
• Vasari Exodus – Anarkrul Wanderer
• Advent Wrath – Oblivia Dreadnought
• Advent Reborn – Justicia Dreadnought

Factional Victory Conditions
In addition to new units, the Reinforcements DLC includes three new Factional Victory Conditions to better customize your gameplay:
• Vasari – The Departure
• Advent – Mass Conversion
• Trader Emergency Coalition – Super Novalith Offensive

title: Sins of a Solar Empire II: Times of War
description: The first playable campaign for Sins of a Solar Empire, relating the histories of each race over the 11,000 year history of the game.

title: Sins of a Solar Empire II: Harbinger
description: The Harbinger expansion features the much anticipated 4th playable faction to Sins of a Solar Empire II.

title: Happy Island Fantasy
description: The story of Happy Island Fantasy takes place on a nearly isolated island, where “Ron” arrives to seek treasures hidden in ancient ruins and meets several beautiful women on the island. You can adventure, fish, cook, explore, solve mysteries, and more, embarking on a joyful and thrilling journey.

title: Potion Permit: Lunar New Year Lantern
description: Moonbury's residents need healing, and you're the best chemist around! With your trusty tools, a cauldron, and a canine companion at your side, you'll need to diagnose symptoms, gather ingredients, brew potions, and cure ailments in this open-ended sim RPG.

title: Potion Permit: Oriental Folding Wall
description: Moonbury's residents need healing, and you're the best chemist around! With your trusty tools, a cauldron, and a canine companion at your side, you'll need to diagnose symptoms, gather ingredients, brew potions, and cure ailments in this open-ended sim RPG.

title: Potion Permit: Red Flower Arrangement
description: Moonbury's residents need healing, and you're the best chemist around! With your trusty tools, a cauldron, and a canine companion at your side, you'll need to diagnose symptoms, gather ingredients, brew potions, and cure ailments in this open-ended sim RPG.

title: Poetic Trio
description: A game about rain, a game about snow, and a game about wind. All in one.

title: Tablets of Power
description: JRPG w/ modern humor, turn-based combat, intricate plot twists and a world filled with puzzles, exploration and conspiracy theories.

title: The Glass Sea
description: You are Dreamer. You've been stuck at sea for many years with no recollection of what life was like before. The sea contains little glass shards representing different memories of yours. You're able to move the moon to reflect it's light onto these shards, allowing you to relive the memories they contain. In The Glass Sea, you uncover who you are really are: your life, your friend, your world, one memory at a time.

title: Chante: Fortress of Spores
description: In this third-person, tower defense/ puzzle game, you play as the adventurous little fungus, Chante! Explore, gather, and craft to uncover resources that will fortify your defenses, while surviving waves of enemy attacks. Join us in discovering the oddities of Chante: Fortress of Spores.

title: Port Authority
description: Port Authority is a real-time harbor management game where you draw routes guiding cargo ships to color-matched docks. Navigate increasingly chaotic traffic through harbors inspired by real-world locations as more vessels arrive. One collision ends it all. How many containers can you deliver?

title: Varthos: Heir to the Throne
description: Varthos calls you to his side. Fight hordes of monsters and undead creatures in this captivating action RPG, who have only one goal: to kill you. Fight, die, repeat — the battle for the throne of the world has begun.

title: HypeHype
description: Gaming meets LIVE creating. HypeHype is a multiplayer online platform that connects live streamers, creators, entertainers and players for unforgettable LIVE gaming experiences.

title: The Boykisser Mod
description: A mod for Minecraft which adds a Boykisser biome, featuring various additions in relation to the Boykisser meme, such as Boykisser mobs and Boykisser ores which can be used to make Boykisser tools and armor. The mod even adds in new potions, such as the Potion of Gay which gives the player the LGBTQIA+ potion effect.

title: Scary Ferry
description: Scary Ferry is a co-op horror game where you and your friends face monsters, traps, and treacherous waters. Complete challenging missions, explore dangerous dungeons, and uncover ISM's secrets.

title: Wet and Wild
description: In Wet and Wild Girls, your goal is simple yet irresistible, unlock and collect stunningly beautiful girls, each captured naked, wet, and glistening under the steamy shower. With 300 breathtaking girls waiting to be discovered, every level brings you closer to completing your ultimate collection!

title: Funkyheart
description: Bunn awakens in a surreal world with no memories of what happened. Bunny Hop through this colorful surreal landscape, explore hidden locations, and uncover the troubling truth about your identity in this 3D platformer.

title: Lobsterpunk
description: Lockpick your way through an abandoned city powered solely by the combustion of lobsters. Bring the dead machinery one last breath of life before their steel forms lay cold forever. As you do, see the memories of the last man on earth, and how familiar that might feel, however foreign the setting.

title: DoBad Inc
description: Commit crimes without consquences in our brand new indie game DoBad Inc.! You play as Garett the Ferret the newest badguyer around, work your way up the corporate ladder to become one of the worst people to ever live.

title: Crabs and Rats
description: On a stormy night, Boris, a weak pirate with a stomachache, tumbles in his cabin, tormented by hallucinations from malnutrition and sea sickness. Trapped in a nightmare, he must fight for his life and escape… or be swallowed by the madness.

title: Fallout Equestria: Silent Village
description:
A long time ago, in the magical land of Equestria...

An era arrived when the ideals of friendship and mutual support gave way to greed, selfishness, and paranoia.

Countries turned their weapons against each other. Decades of brutal warfare, all for the sake of annihilating everyone in man-made fire.

You will assume the role of the commander of a small squad. Using the skills of all characters, you will need to solve various tasks.

title: Cone’Z Broken Bonez
description: Completely bored, babol decides to drive around and see if there's anything interesting to do. luckily, he remembers about the SAGE event, but shows up at the wrong SAGE. a very original concept. seeing as this expo also had a few games, decides to play the games.

title: Cocaine Dealer
description: A clicker/management drug dealing simulator. Get your product cut and wrapped quickly and out on the streets. Build your crew, expand your operation, and climb the supply chain. Stay ahead of the cops, keep your crew in line, or pay the price.

title: ZagZag
description: An arcade game where you will try to reach high scores and unlock new characters by collecting gold.

title: Kick the Virus
description: Kick the virus. It's a game that helps when your anger reaches its maximum.

title: Fungiculture
description: A cute and relaxing mushroom farming idler. Collect a variety of mushrooms, watch and help them grow, then sell them off for more money to buy more packs and discover them all.

title: Wanech's Z.O.O.
description: Rescue animals for Wanech's Z.O.O. in a clicker-typer with arcade bursts. Type 3-letter prompts, click falling pickups and trade Fish/Leaves into SCORE. Upgrade automation, earn Marine & Forest Prestige, unlock heaps of achievements, and keep the sanctuary humming to chiptune pings nonstop.

title: Seasonal Bloom
description: Players unlock the beautiful blossoms of each season by drawing branches on the canvas. The game features four chapters—Spring, Summer, Autumn, and Winter—each representing a different stage of love, from the budding of first love to the eternity of affection.

title: Stump Simulator 2
description: Stump Simulator 2 is a game in which you can become a tree stump.

title: GPU Inferno
description: If your FPS drop to 30 you lose! GPU Inferno is a survivor bullet hell where you play as a graphics card fighting off viruses, crypto miners, and malware. Your real FPS are your health. When the GPU is damaged, actual background processes on your PC will slow down your FPS.

title: The Scam
description: Play as a little purple square who just wants to have coins and not get scammed.

title: HiHi
description: Jump up, don't fall.

title: Final Outcry
description: Final Outcry is a first-person horror game that centers on classified government found footage of an urban exploration trip gone wrong. As you venture further into an abandoned prison, do you have what it takes to face the horrors lurking within and reach the end of the V/H/S tape?

title: Asteroidia
description: A simple and fun space shooter.

title: Undead Exterminator
description: "The Undead Exterminator" is an exciting 3D zombie shooter where players pick up a rifle and battle hordes of the undead. You will have to shoot zombies and survive in an apocalyptic world.

title: Obscuria 2
description: Obscuria 2 is a horror and adventure experience created in Unreal Engine 5, where you will investigate an abandoned island with many secrets, mysteries and scares.

title: Isekai Emblem
description: Isekai Emblem is an unofficial freeware Fire Emblem fan game available on Windows and Android featuring over a hundred characters from a wide variety of different isekai anime franchises.

title: Meanwhile in Russia
description:
Meanwhile in Russia, is a work-in-progress singleplayer anti-/sci-fi first-person shooter modification for a parody of Half-Life, that was initially authored with XashXT SDK while using Xash3D engine. However, recently the development continued by porting the game to a new engine called XashNT, which is inspired by, and a spirtual successor of Xash3D engine.

An Intro Demo was released on October 25th, 2018.

title: Press a Button Simulator
description: Welcome to Press a Button Simulator: a new and exciting twist on modern video games. Gone is the time of tryhards and sweats, and in is the new age of only pressing a button! Will you find all the secrets? Of course not! There is only one: You get to press a button!

title: Urban Legend Hunters: Ghosts in the Circuit
description: To rescue her best friend Nyx, who's trapped in a digital world, a girl and her friends explore and solve puzzles in the mysterious alternate dimension "Mata." The game features a virtual community, multi-threaded reasoning, and 3D exploration, immersing you in the story.

title: Monster Hunter Wilds: Title Update 4
description: Title Update 4 (TU4) for Monster Hunter Wilds releasing December 16, 2025 which includes Gogmazios, expanded endgame content, and more.

title: Valorborn
description: Dive into a living medieval fantasy sandbox RPG. Whether you lead a group or walk alone, carve your own identity. Hunt, steal, trade, build, or wander freely. Explore a vast open world and shape your journey through immersive roleplay and boundless freedom.

title: DungeonRoute
description: In this shifting dungeon, you may only move along arrow directions. Tiles vanish once stepped on, and the layout reshuffles! The farther you walk, the greater the combat buffs and treasure loot. Plan your path carefully and keep going deeper—how far can you descend into the abyss?

title: Before Closure
description: An experimental narrative game that tells its story through sound and memory. Sort through a box of personal mementos and relive memories from a relationship by closing your eyes in real life.

title: Kirby's Dream Land PIC18F45K22 Edition
description: Ever wondered how the original Kirby would look like on a microprocessor made for dishwashers? No? Ok...

title: Malpiot Horror
description: A 2D comedy horror. Explore dark stages, search for hidden passages, and try to survive while terrifying creatures chase you.

title: The King's Bargain
description: A king's foolish bargain. A queen's final curse. A kingdom's rotten soul and a world in ruins. In this gothic survival, RPG-Strategy, manage your team, sanity, and resources to fight the blight that consumes your kingdom.

title: Strange Brew
description: Escape zombies and chase coffees! Run to survive the horrific launch of a new pumpkin spice latte. Play as Joe the Duck, a mascot, who must outmaneuver and outwit the brainless mobs. Destroy the company town to win some peace with your morning cup.

title: Mario VS The Noise
description: A Pizza Tower fangame starring Mario!

title: Gloom Punks
description: Not your average co-op roguelike. Where the price for power is death, and you’re trapped in a gloom-scape of fever dreams and fairytales gone feral, you can only rely on Punks like yourself. Cheat death, bounce back, and take on a world that so badly wants you dead!

title: Critter Drifters
description: A retro kart-racing adventure with a cast of cute, colorful animal characters! Set in a theme park, win tickets to unlock courses and new worlds to explore. Drive with precise, arcade-style movement (with drift and boost mechanics), and use items strategically against your opponents!

title: Fur-Guardians
description:
Fur-Guardians is a traditional platformer game.
It features 16-bit style graphics and old-school music and sound effects.
It's free to download and play with no in-app purchases and no ads.

Create your own furry character and defend the land of Fur-Gardia.
Run and jump through different environments to collect gems and defeat monsters from the Realm of Chaos.

title: Skyward Masters
description: Skyward Masters is inspired by the hit game mode Bedwars and established first-person shooters, combining the best of multiple games into a new action-packed FPS title. 4 teams will battle on floating islands in a thrilling and ever-changing environment to be the last team standing.

title: Froggy Hates Snow
description: A survival roguelike where a frog digs through freezing snow, uncovers treasures, unlocks upgrades, and battles mystical creatures. Find the escape door or defeat the final boss to survive.

title: Unshine Arcade
description: An arcade full of secrets, a sentient virtual pet in the prize cabinet, a stealth shooter roguelite arcade machine and one way to escape: win tickets.

title: Mario's Challenge Gala
description: From the creator of the "infamous" Super Mario Bros. Friends, a.k.a "Dorkly" Mario Adventures (by others), now returns with a brand new game! Join the team as they compete in a mysterious contest happening at the mall!

title: Rush The Towers
description: Will you break through enemy defenses, or watch your forces fall before the towers?

title: Axeras
description: As a young captain in the army, command Acorns Company in this turn-based tactical SRPG as you fight through the Evestrian Civil War. Use different units and combine abilities to secure battlefield superiority. The decisions you make on the battlefield will eventually catch up to you…

title: Haunted Manor: The Last Reunion - Collector's Edition
Xiangsheng Simulator
description: "Xiangsheng Simulator" is a humorous and witty adventure that takes you into the unique world of Xiangsheng. As a Xiangsheng Penggen, you'll team up with your Dougen partner to deliver a performance filled with laughter.

title: Mario's Picross Deluxe
description: Chisel your way in this PC Remake of the Game Boy classic!

title: Chark
description: CHARK is a chess roguelike about risk, synergies, and precise calculation.

title: Mega Man X Demake
description:
How would Mega Man X be if it had come out on an 8-bit console?

8-bit, NES-style recreation of Mega Man X, inspired by Mega Man 7 and 8 Famicom.

title: Megaman Zero: VS The Universe
description: Megaman Zero: VS The Universe is a Megaman Zero fangame where you fight bosses from several different franchises, such as Sonic and Dragonball.

title: Rhizomatic Compound
description: Investigate a mysterious colony on a distant alien planet in this hand drawn sci-fi tale of exploitation and collapse from the influential Decadence collective. Explore ruins, hack terminals, reprogram cellular life forms, and cultivate fungi spores to disrupt and penetrate the hostile environment.

title: The Serpent & The Seed
description:
An artistic retelling of the story of The Bible through the lens of the typological seed of the woman mentioned in Genesis 3.

In a post apocalyptic future overrun by thorns and the power of the snake king, a bird discovers an ancient book that may have the answer on how to save the world.

title: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers: Power Nexus
description: MMPR Power Nexus is a REMIX of the Game Geam (and now Sega Genesis!) MMPR games! Battle it out as one of 35 characters in the intense semi-survival arcade 1P mode. Duke it out with a friend in VS matches. Change between 8-bit/16-bit music on the fly!

title: Eco Bridge
description: Eco Bridge is a first-person simulation game where you must restore nature and build biological corridors across different regions of Chile. Developed by Fire Forge Developers, it won first place in the Social Impact Game Jam 2024. It is available for free on itch.io. Download it and contribute to a greener future.

title: Ashes & Blood
