title: Duelmasters
description: Battle your friends in fast-paced 1v1 arena brawler style duels. Choose from axe, sword, or spear, each with its own strengths, and fight through intense rounds. Outplay your opponent, become champion of the arena, and earn the title of Duelmaster!

title: Assassin of Goblin
description: Play as warrior and try to beat green goblin in 9 different levels and find captured skulls in this medieval rpg adventure

title: Knights of Messiah If: Castle in an Alternate Dimension
description: Enjoy traveling around the beautiful world of Knights of Messiah as the leader of a party of adventurers! When Alicia and Maya are captured by the evil prince of Windsor, Ritz, you and your friends must explore dungeons in search of the Gemstones that'll allow you to access his castle!

title: Stonerill
description: Stonerill is an addictive game where you have to drill down through the ground endlessly, collecting resources and upgrading your drill. You need to be careful and attentive to avoid buried bombs and set a record for drilling depth.

title: Fallen Lean
description: Ruthless open-world action RPG with dynamic, skill-based combat. Slay colossal bosses, survive deadly traps, loot and craft gear, and wield supernatural powers. Build your skill tree, unlock combos, and shape a branching story—rise as a hero or descend into chaos.

title: Arcane Duel
description: Arcane Duel is a RTS game. There are many skills you can choose in this game. In each game you can choose four skills and one auto attack style. Using these skill to defeat your enemy!! This game is using mouse to control the movement of the character and use QWER key to cast the skill.

title: Wandering Hunter
description: A SRPG which brings classic pixel graphics and innovative game mechanics. Play as Ack, a young hunter who experiences the days before the disaster. Hunt a variety of prey in a variety of environments, as well as daily market transactions, until a terrible turn of events occurs......

title: Unique Identy
description: Unique Identy is a roguelite action platformer inspired by the metroidvania style. You earn points by continuously killing incoming enemies and try to survive. There are no save points; kill, die, learn, and repeat. The points you earn are permanent, but the enemies become increasingly tougher.

title: Cactus Simulator Remake
description:
Cactus Simulator Remake is a meditative desert experience where you become a cactus and simply inhabit the landscape. Take in the beauty of your surroundings while performing calm, cactus-like actions and watching the world shift with dynamic day and night.
With a new engine, improved optimization, and stylized desert visuals, the game includes two mods—arcade and realistic—plus music and additional localizations to support multiple audiences.

title: Case 42: The Redwood Files
description: A Narrative Horror Adventure game where you play as a Detective and unravel the bizarre mysteries of a seemingly Ordinary Hilly Town.

title: BombMaze
description: Blast through mazes in this modern take on classic bomb placing gameplay. Strategically place bombs, outsmart AI opponents, and collect power-ups in thrilling single-player action!

title: Elara and the Machine
description: Elara and the Machine is a first-person parkour game where your goal is not only to escape, but to hunt down your pursuers. Travel through the anti-utopian world and enjoy the strategic and maneuvering challenges of going from fleeing to hunting through subtle movement and stomping.

title: Sokoteddy
description: Sokoteddy is a sokoban game. In this game you have to help a cute bear pass the levels. Such a game is relaxing.

title: War Battle Royale Battlegrounds
description: War Battle Royale Battlegrounds takes place in a cubic world! Compete against opponents on a map created to play this type of game(battle royale)Duration of the game less than 10 minutes Choose one of five characters and start the battle against opponents on the island

title: Bottle Collector Run
description: "Bottle Collector Run" is a dynamic and addictive endless runner game where the player has to control a character continuously running forward. The goal of the game is to run as far as possible, collecting bottles along the way and avoiding various obstacles.

title: Hardbass Clicker
description: Collect Semechki to make your Babushka proud. And while you collect them you can enjoy some nice Hardbass.

title: Empty Throne
description: Empty Throne is a dark fairytale puzzle game. Compose the Snow Queen's tale in music. Truth twists through alley whispers and forest echoes. The throne lies empty. The mirror speaks. Who writes the ending—you, or the lie?

title: Slime Order
description: Players just decide the order of the slimes! A puzzle game that is easy to play.

title: Fog Racing Circuit
description: Get ready to push your limits in the most challenging racing championship yet!

title: Ellentis
description: Strategic card game set in a fantasy world. Create powerful combinations by combining elements and card levels in a unique circle system. Simple to learn, but full of depth - every decision matters. Master the mechanics, take risks and achieve the highest scores!

title: Mining And Achievements
description: Mining and getting Steam achievements, this is a casual idle game. Players travel to a world where mining is king. As long as you mine day and night, you can dominate the world; unlock powerful weapons and creatures, and let them join your mining army!

title: Street Boss
description: Become the boss of the streets. Take down anyone who stand against you.

title: Holy Fire Meow Meow: Special Forces
description: "Holy Fire Meow Meow: Special Forces" is a top-down shooting game featuring cats as the main characters. You will play as Elusa, a special forces soldier from the feline tribe, infiltrating enemy territory to defeat the forces and rescue your trapped comrades!

title: Scary Granny
description: **"It Seems That We Will Never Leave Here!"**

title: The Line of Defense
description: Prepare for an epic battle to defend your mystical swamplands from the invasion of three ruthless kings!

title: When The Rumors Become Real
description: Matt, a 14-year-old student, is forced to visit a ghost house for having "hide and seek with oneself" challenge . He invites his friend Esther to visit together and pretends to do the challenge. However something wrong happened during the challenge.

title: Assassin of Monsters
description: Third person rpg game where player warrior need kill 7 different bosses in 7 different levels. So be a hero and fight against several different big enemies

title: Save Your Soul
description: A dark 2D precision platformer. Every move is a risk. Every level is torture. Survive in a dying world where mistakes mean death and mastery is the only way out. Control a ghost lost among traps and silence in a world that no longer waits for anyone.

title: It Takes Many
description: You've got a Tindermatch! Sadly she lives very far away so you decide to fly to her and take your friends with you! Plays like Super Mario, but you only have a limited amount of restarts. Play with up to 7 people. Reach the End to win the game

title: Little Fish Seek to Live On
description: A platform jumping game

title: The Forest Keeper
description: Survive in the merciless wastelands of a post-apocalyptic world where every day is a struggle for food, water and ammo. Fight mutants and survive as long as possible in this merciless slaughter.

title: City Hunter
description:
Released on March 2, 1990 as the only official home-console game of its kind, this legendary title returns 35 years later—now launching worldwide simultaneously with all the excitement of its original debut.

This game is more than just a remake—it’s a fusion of nostalgia and newness. With multi-language localization, both long-time fans and new players can enjoy the experience without a language barrier.

Relive the excitement and emotional moments once more.

title: Make Merits in Another World
description: You are forced to become the savior of the world, and go to another world to kill the devil! But at the beginning of your reincarnation in this other world, you turned out to be just a piece of grass...

title: Bombardiro Crocodilo Mission
description: In this fun and frenetic shooter, you'll play as Bombardiro Crocodilo, who's trying to save Ballerina Capuchina from Tralalero Tralala's shoed fins. Embark on an action-packed journey with tons of shooting, different weapons, and skins from the Brainrot universe!

title: Destroy the Demon Army
description: A casual idle clicker about raising an army to defeat the demon forces.

title: Super Momos Crushers
description: Super Momos Crushers is a platform fighting game inspired by Super Smash Bros, featuring characters from various internet memes.

title: Frenzy Freak Fantasy
description: Frenzy Freak Fantasy is a bonkers strategy romp where you unleash fart-propelled T-Rexes, AK-47-toting toilet goblins, and crotch-cannon weirdos. Command wacko units, sling absurd attacks, and rule gut-busting battles in this nutty simulator.

title: Sonic Astral Generations
description: Sonic Astral Generations is a fangame that seeks to give the opportunity to new levels that were absent in the 3 versions of Sonic Generation, with brand new Friends to save.

title: Blood for the Throne
description: Blood for the Throne is a tactical war strategy game with auto-battler combat and RPG progression. Command your general and army across a medieval world, equipping troops, managing resources, and battling rivals, monsters, and kingdoms to claim the throne.

title: Chronal Chain
description: "TIME CONTROL" bullet hell action. Overcome impossible odds by slowing, stopping and rewinding time!

title: Tapes of Entities
description: Tapes of Entities is a first-person psychological survival horror game. Roam between realities of fear, madness & machinery. Solve puzzles, explore an atmospheric world, survive horrifying entities.

title: 5125m
description: A contemplative pixel-art platformer where you climb a mountain with two independent grappling hooks, blending precision, mastery, and exploration, while uncovering the mystery behind your ascent. 5125m. Don’t worry, you don’t have to pronounce it. Just climb it.

title: Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines 2 - The Flower & the Flame
description:
Her art skirts the boundaries of life, of undeath, of Blood, and of the social mores of Kindred society. But she still burns for that glorious moment of transcendence, when her mastery will shape a work that echoes through eternity.

For this, she will become a legend. However, every masterpiece needs a canvas, and there is much work to be done.

Experience Ysabella's dark artistic journey as she seeks to create her magnum opus in this Story Pack.

Contains new playable story content, combat mechanics, and Phyre outfit.

title: Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines 2 - Loose Cannon
description:
The Kindred of Seattle call him Prince Campbell's attack dog. What happens when the leash that holds him finally snaps?

Experience Seattle's underworld through Sheriff Benny's brutal perspective in this Story Pack.
Contains new playable story content, combat mechanics, and Phyre outfit.

title: Noctuary: New Journey
description: Noctuary DLC: "New Journey" Featuring 6 stories, 17 sections, and 3 playable characters. All mysteries and adventures await you to unravel!

title: Khnum Fire
description: Get ready to embark on an exhilarating journey through a vibrant world filled with adventure and fantasy. The game features two distinct combat systems—Magic and Swordplay—allowing you to choose your fighting style or even combine them for a truly epic experience! But that’s not all; you’ll encounter a variety of puzzles that will challenge your wits and traps that will test your reflexes.

title: Sonic Breaking Point
description: A 2D single-player focused fighting game inspired by Flash animations such as Super Mario Bros. Z.

title: Sonic Daybreak
description: Explore all-new, original levels with the help of Sonic's core physics-based gameplay, with moves such as the Trick, Spindash, Dropdash, Rail Surge, Wall-Run, and so much more!

title: Sonic Definitive
description:
This is a 2D Sonic fangame based on the Boost formula, using the Modern Sonic Worlds engine, created in Click Team Fusion .
A platformer with exciting additions: quick-time events and animated in-level cinematics to immerse you in this adventure.

title: Joey The Duck
description:
Joey The Duck is a linear, open level type platformer game.

Join Joey as he explores different locations within one large, diverse level.

Don't be fooled by his cuteness - Joey is a materialistic, money-driven duck who embarks on a risky journey through the Forbidden Lands in search of a treasure that may not even exist.

There's no main menu, no world map, no hub world - Joey keeps moving forward without pause to get his feathers on that so-called mythical treasure.

The game features minimalist pixel-art style, with the option to switch between light and dark modes, as well as effects like CRT TV simulation and Black and White mode. These effects can even be combined for an extra retro vibe.

Collect coins, jump on enemies, interact with the environment, and get that legendary treasure!

Key Features:

One big level, zero interruptions - no main menu, no world map, just go!

Light Mode and Dark Mode - switch the style anytime!

Optional effects - play with CRT TV or Black and White effects, or even combine them!

Minimalist pixel art - cute and colorful!

Play as Joey - He's greedy, he's cute and he's cool!

title: Sonic Escape
description: An expressive 2D Sonic Game inspired by the Sonic Advance Trilogy and Sonic Rush.

title: Eastwynne
description: Play as either Ester or Sye as they navigate college and life in Eastwynne. A city filled to the brim with magic, high society life, the best of the best businesses, and real estate. Maybe not the best people, but you got everything else.

title: Little Nightmares III: Ferryman Costumes Set
description: Get the Ferryman Costumes Set, exclusive to the Expansion Pass and suited for both characters Low and Alone - a mysterious figure familiar to all children in The Nowhere…

title: Little Nightmares III: Dark Six Costumes Set
description:
Get the Dark Six Costumes Set suited for both characters Low and Alone - a twisted reflection of the girl who escaped The Maw.

Many questions remain about the identity of Dark Six. Is she an alternate reflection of Six, a haunted, corrupted reflection? Is she the same person, but darker, shaped by her fears and the horrors she’s witnessed? Or is she something completely different?

Her silhouette remains unchanged, but something is different… The yellow is gone.

What’s left is a cold echo - quiet, watching, waiting.

Wearing this costume is more than a disguise.

It’s a question: What happens when you stop running… and become what you feared?

title: Little Nightmares III: Secrets of The Spiral - Expansion Pass
description:
Includes:
Little Nightmares III: Ferryman Costumes Set
Little Nightmares III: The Backstage
Little Nightmares III: The Shores

Delve deeper into the eerie lands of The Spiral.

title: The Adventures of Little Wurfel
description: Dive into the world of Little Wurfel — the mighty little cube! Get hypnotized and relax as you watch his astonishing journey through infinity, or take on the thrilling challenge of "Swords & Sharks", where your skills in precision, dodging, and balancing will be put to the ultimate test!

title: The Solitary Existence of a Little Universe
description: In this dark interactive novel you will play as a lost soul wandering a forsaken desert, accompanied by a mysterious girl. Explore ancient ruins and face obscure choices. Your decisions will shape their journey—often in ways you’ll never fully understand. Will you find peace, or something else?

title: Little Pilot
description: This is a 2D casual game suitable for all age groups, with an overall low difficulty. In the game, players will take on the role of a little butterfly, avoiding collisions with other butterflies while enjoying the beautiful scenery along the journey.

title: Sonic Forces Untold: Darkest of Days
description: Three years have passed since Sonic vanished. Eggman rules the world, and the Resistance is on the brink of collapse.

title: Sonic Minus
description: The game takes place on Eastshore island, Eggman discovered that the center of the island holds a ton of Negative Energy so he wants to use that to make the Chaos Emeralds into Negative Emeralds.

title: Sonic Mystic Land
description: Sonic The Hedgehog comes back to a new exciting and somewhat strange adventure in Sonic Mystic Land! What will he find on this foreign land that he finds himself on?

title: B-Line
description: B-Line is a short knowledge-based walking simulator game. Explore different worlds and discover how to get out of the station.

title: Interrogator 2
description: You work as a detective specialized in the art of interrogation. You're given cases to solve and people to interrogate, together with your loyal partner, Charles. Interaction with other entities is based on written or spoken words.

title: Sonic of the Ring Tutorials Room
description:
This game is about virtual training game which you can explore with Running and Fighting segments like Sonic Unleashed.
Sonic of the Ring will return to the era of 2006 to 2010 because this game tells the story of a blue ring that can awaken past memories.

title: Sonic Can Go Only Up
description:
This is a 2D Sonic platformer, where your goal indeed is to go up. The game is one single huge level for you to clear, with areas of said level split into different zones. Rings are sparce (you can hold only a single ring), there are no checkpoints, and you will most likely fall down a good few times. Oh, but don't worry, the game autosaves.

If you're familiar with Getting Over It, Jump King, Only Up, Get to Work, all those sorta games, you know what to expect. If not; expect to get frustrated and annoyed.

title: One in the Back
description: An escape-room styled series of puzzles await in the car that seems to contain neither rhyme nor reason. See if you can solve the mysteries of the photographs, and figure out what it means to be the One in the Back.

title: Fights in Tight Spaces: K9 Division
description: A new canine face joins Section XI, just in time to go into action against some of the worst the criminal underworld has to offer. This expansion adds a versatile and highly agile canine companion, as well as new enemies, enhancements, and events.

title: Bedtime Stories 2
description: Bedtime Stories 2 is a fully voiced adult visual novel where your choices shape Cindy’s journey. Explore love, power, and intrigue across five episodes, featuring rich sound effects and dynamic storytelling in both SFW and NSFW moments.

title: Heartdust
description:
HEARTDUST is a horror online PvP/Co-op hero shooter with up to 4 players set inside a cursed retro videogame.

Your childhood friend texted you after realizing that the servers for HEARTDUST, a game you both used to play as children, have misteriously reopened 15 years after their closure. You decide to play together one more time, but something ghastly is awaiting inside.

title: Doki Boki International Hentai Language School
description: Welcome to Doki Boki International Hentai Language School, an exclusive adult institution offering a unique blend of language learning and romantic visual novel gameplay. Prepare to immerse yourself in a captivating world where language lessons meet heart-racing interactions with a diverse cast of beautiful and passionate teachers. This is more than just studying; it's a journey of self-discovery, emotional connection, and unforgettable experiences.

title: Vacation in Paradise
description: Sun, fun, and beautiful girls - what’s not to love? Dive into a world of over 140 stunning images, three captivating love interests, and multiple endings depending on your choices!

title: Sonic Paradigm
description: The Ultimate 2D Sonic Adventure!

title: Rollo Boi
description: Rollo Boi is a thrilling controller-based physics puzzle platformer where you take on the role of an adventurous rolling ball. Your mission? Collect coins, unlock powerful abilities, and conquer vibrant worlds filled with challenges!

title: Cosplay Fever!!
description: Enjoy a cosplay session with an anime college girl who likes cosplaying with her school uniforms! Enjoy 11 scenes in this casual game where you can unlock new positions and outfits!

title: Athena Code
description: Athena, one of the best security agents in the world will face the most difficult challenge in her career; to defeat the evil forces of the rebel group “Phantom Claw” who tries to ruin the technological society in which she lives.

title: In'ernus
description: In'ernus is a hit and shoot game that focuses on boss battles. Inspired by the animation of the Siames song "THE WOLF"

title: Fragile Peace
description: In Fragile Peace, you are the European Union and are confronted with multiple political dilemmas that appear at certain intervals. These 'Events' can be resolved one way or another - but each decision has a consequence.

title: TurboMania Fog Racers
description: Ram your opponents, drift through corners, and avoid obstacles in your way in these dynamic fog races. Remember TURBO, your secret weapon. Show others who's boss in a world of tough racing where the slightest mistake means you lose.

title: Case No.1: Rose Academy
description: Rose Academy is a detective visual novel about a young special agent sent to an elite girls' school to investigate the mysterious death of one of its top students. As you uncover the dark secrets hidden behind the academy’s flawless facade, you'll be drawn into a world of intrigue, temptation, and romance.

title: Sonic Quickshot
description: A 2D Sonic fan game with an emphasis on quick and focused level design.

title: The Hole Keeper
description: God has chosen you not for strength, but for obedience. Do not question. Do not turn away. Walk. Feed. Repeat.

title: Pose Crush: Waifu Edition
description: Fast-paced pose-matching game. Test your reflexes in provocative and charming visual challenges.

title: Runaway Cheater
description: You just got caught by the husband of the girl you were cheating with! Run away, cheater!!

title: Tiny Metal 2
description: The TINY METAL series reaches its full potential in this land, sea, and air tactical battle simulation game! Produce your favorite units, capture territory, and fight for victory. 100+ Campaign and Skirmish mode maps. 15+ commanders. Report for duty, soldier!

title: Hentai Store
description: Hentai Store - Cozy and hot shop near home.

title: Monster Ops 5
description: NSFW Gay Visual Novel Dating Sim! Black Ops soldiers Wraith and Tide know they must count on each other to survive. Will their bond as battle-brothers evolve into something more? Monster Ops: Military Special Forces Hunting Rogue Monsters!

title: Secret Crush: Unrequited Love
description: My second spring in high school. Surrounded by my dreamy upperclassman, that classmate I'm interested in, and my childhood friend who's a year younger than me. She's been in the search for a boyfriend who would look at her, and only her. The protagonist Chika decides to confess her feelings to……

title: Cube Hits Corner
description: A nostalgic, casual distraction inspired by The Office’s DVD logo scene. Track high scores while subtly influencing the bouncing image's direction. Perfect for meetings or class. Customize the visual by swapping in your own image or gif for a personal touch. Desktop can still be used while playing.

title: Psychic Ward: Kill The Seven King Dragon
description: Join the world as an agent of the Psychic Ward. Explore the strange surreal world and capture the immense world restructuring power of the Seven King Dragon.

title: Azazel Gamble
description: Join Azazel's lethal gambling arena—a high-stakes showdown of life or death. at a 4-player table with allies or adversaries, where cunning strategies and skills determine survival. Hunting demon or being hunted? Team up or solo.Hey guys !Are you ready to embrace the chaos of a blood-soaked gamble?

title: Maid For My Master
description: A cute romance story between a young man and a maid who just so happens to be a robot. Is love enough to overcome the differences between man and machine?

title: Fishman
description: Fishman is a relaxing fishing game that supports multiple people online. Colorful lantern fish, silly turtles, graceful mermaids and dancing devils call you in the deep ocean. After adding friends in the game, friends can send each other gifts of gold coins to enhance their feelings.

title: The Fiancée Has Never Known First Love
description:
The "Partner System": upon turning 16, the government assigns you a fiancé.
At the start of the new semester, your perfect arranged partner will transfer into your school!
Experience love for the first time and make your relationship with these girls, who have never known romance, a success!

title: Bikini Brickout
description: Old-school golden age arcade gameplay, featuring 700 photos of beautiful swimsuit models

title: Advent Arena
description: A PvP card-game/tower-defense hybrid.

title: Come To Play
description:
A game made for gbjam 8. How would a modern horror game would be if it was made in 1992 for the gameboy? This is a short scary experience that answers that question.

Instructions:
Use WASD or Arrows to move and collect 6 dolls.

title: Super Mario Buys Bread
description: Mario wants to buy bread, but there isn't any! And now he's on a rampage against the bread thieves!!!

title: Sonic After the Sequel DX
description: Sonic After the Sequel DX is an enhanced re-release of Sonic After the Sequel developed by LakeFeperd that ports the Game from Multimedia Fusion Developer 2 to Clickteam Fusion 2.5, Tweaks the Game's Physics, Adds the Drop Dash from Sonic Mania, Hardware Render Support, and a third act to Dream Dance Zone. It also features a title screen that was redrawn from scratch as Lakefeperd had learned more about pixel art from his indie game project Spark the Electric Jester.

title: Duckstroma
description: Meet Aura, she's a delivery duck and about to have a life changing day on the job. A client has requested 8 disks be delivered to them, but this won't be an easy task. Using Aura's skills navigate the hostile environment by bouncing on weak foes, even lay an egg to reach higher spots.

title: Super Mario Star Scramble Jam
description:
Super Mario Star Scramble Jam is an unofficial remastered collection of all four games in the Super Mario Star Scramble series.
Not only does it improve the visuals and run at 60 FPS, but it also adds content and improves the gameplay for the ultimate classic experience.

title: They Watch
description: A horror game where you confront otherworldly entities as you do everything in your power to escape the strange mazes you wake up in.

title: Wakatsuya Mura no Tatari
description: A screenwriter, Terashima Tsukasa, and a criminal psychologist, Hayami Yusei, head to Wakatsuya Village, a village rich in nature. What tragic incident occurred there?

title: Sonic Seasons
description: Stop Eggman's Control over the seasons on Eastside Island in Sonic Seasons!

title: Mortal Kombat 1: Definitive Edition
description: New to Mortal Kombat 1? Get started with the Definitive Edition for the most extensive Mortal Kombat 1 Experience!

title: Athamuff
description:
ATHAMUFF is a game where player moves around to see and interact with different objects in an area. With a mouse and a keyboard, the player will be able to experience an interactive journey with multiple events happen during the game. RACING through several levels, the player gradually uncovers more of a lively world with deeper meanings awaiting in the adventure ahead.

The game also features numerous fully original soundtracks from the recent hit album "Mix Isa Wip" published by the well-known artist "MinoruGLS". The album consists of many tracks with various interesting genres such as experimental, instrumental, conceptual and even minimal. These will surely provide a COLORFUL music aspect to any single gaming playthrough.

title: Fracctal TCG
description: Fracctal TCG distills the thrill of monster collecting into a one-versus-one card game built for quick, tactical showdowns.

title: Petrick
description: This is a FE-like game. To defend against human forces, you will assemble monster girls. Training them, get powerful equipments and skills... In short, it features a wealth of character development elements. Every decision players make will influence the outcome of the entire game!

title: Flee the Fallen
description: Flee the Fallen is a thrilling 2D zombie survival game where you fight relentless undead, switch between powerful weapons, and battle through intense encounters. Every moment tests your reflexes, strategy, and will to survive.

title: Rip Current
description: Rip Current is a horror game set in a cryptic research facility where genetic experiments, in a bid to strengthen aquatic ecosystems, have spiraled out of control. Navigate flooded corridors, uncover the fate of the scientists, and survive the prehistoric apex predators stalking the depths.

title: Snake: Secret Treasure
description:
Snake: Secret Treasure reimagines the classic snake game as a modern puzzle-adventure experience.
Across 120 challenging levels, your logic, reflexes, and strategy will be pushed to the limit as you search for hidden treasures.

Features:
120-Level Campaign – Divided into 8 themed worlds (Desert, Ice, Fire, and more).

Progressive Challenges – Each section introduces new mechanics: a fire-breathing snake, Sokoban-style box pushing, invisible tail segments, speed changes, and more.

Treasure Hunt – Collect every gold piece without dying and reach the exit gate.

Classic Meets Modern – Nostalgia of the original snake combined with fresh puzzle and challenge mechanics.

title: Collector: 10 Lives Challenge
description:
Only 10 lives. 90 handcrafted levels. One brutal challenge.

Collector: 10 Lives Challenge is a distilled arcade-puzzle experience built entirely around mastery and survival. You start with just 10 lives — and that’s all you’ll ever get. Lose them all, and it’s back to the very beginning. No extra continues. No shortcuts. Just pure challenge.

Your goal is simple: guide a small crystal orb along intricate paths and collect every gold piece in each level. The moment all gold is collected, the level ends. But one wrong click, one mistimed jump, and you’re out. With every mistake, your precious pool of lives shrinks. Can you survive all 90 levels in a single run?

title: The Evelyn Game
description: Evelyn`s Game is a third-person psychological horror where memories can be as dangerous as monsters.

title: Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts: Merciless Marksman
description: Strike hard and fast with the Merciless Marksman DLC Weapon Pack, featuring four lethal firearms for the ultimate in high-precision warfare. No self-respecting assassin should be without it... assuming they want to last more than five minutes.

title: Party Madness
description: Party Madness is a 2-4 player online party game. Compete with your friends in wacky mini-games, collect points, and claim victory!

title: Skullgirls: Season 1 Pass
description:
The first ever Skullgirls Season Pass! Discover 4 brand new characters (including stages, palettes, and Story Mode) and the Skullgirls Soundtrack all bundled together at a discounted price!

The Season 1 Pass includes:
- DLC: Annie of the Stars
- DLC: Umbrella
- DLC: Black Dahlia
- DLC: Marie
- Season Pass Exclusive Palette Pack
- DLC: Skullgirls Original Soundtrack

title: Ramona
description: Ramona is a first-person psychological horror set in the 1970s. Use a camera to reveal the invisible, follow Ramona’s rules, and explore rooms filled with puzzles and disturbing memories in a house haunted by secrets and remorse.

title: Ramona: Play With Me
description: Demo-prequel of Ramona – Play With Me: a 1970s psychological horror. Experience a self-contained story, discover key mechanics and feel the tension—without any spoilers for the full game.

title: The Battle of Polytopia: Forgotten
description: The Battle of Polytopia race of The Forgotten can befriend swampy fauna, build structures on the water, create giant squids, ride crocodiles, tame toads and swim effortlessly in their marshy terrain.

title: The Battle of Polytopia: Solaris
description: Burn the Square with the Solaris! Led by the diabolical, extradimensional Ralmi, the Solaris are here to both defeat their icy foes, the Gaami. Using the powers of lava, fire, and steam, the Solaris are the biggest challenge the Polytopians have faced, yet!

title: RimWorld: P-Music
description: A popular music mod for RimWorld, which adds a set of 56 additional fanmade music tracks to the game.

title: Skinfreak
description: The city’s most disturbing serial killer is at large and has his sights set on Belle. Can she escape this maniac’s fleshy, rotting clutches? Or will she lose her skin to this sicko’s collection?

title: Mongol 2
description: Call me Mongol! Some time ago, I ventured into Agrippa's perilous realm to claim the false god's life. Armed with an arsenal of weird weapons given onto me by Mithrithnogg, the prophet of worms, I uncovered a dark truth that shook the very foundation of reality!

title: Skullbreaker
description: Skullbreaker is an Arkanoid game where you have to help the skeleton return to the tower and regain its rightful place at the top

title: Layer Cake

description: Lunchbreak Tactics is a strategic auto-battler card game set in a chaotic supermarket backstore. Draft cards, min-max your squad, build ridiculous synergies, then battle players asynchronously. Play your way to climb the ranks with quick runs, no timer, limitless combos, and endless replay.

title: Apex Ascent
description: Apex Ascent is a fast-paced climbing platformer where danger lurks on every wall. Dodge deadly boxing gloves that punch out from the surfaces, leap over spinning obstacles, and time your moves to avoid searing lasers. Reach the top or fall trying.

title: Toadled: Eating Frenzy
description: Grow from a tiny tadpole to cosmic menace in Toadled: Eating Frenzy, the frantic single-stick roguelike. Test your reflexes and make smart choices as you upgrade through hundreds of new mutation combos, fight bosses, and become the universe!

title: Da Tutu
description: "Da Tutu" is a minimalist leisure game, waving a stick to let the rabbit take off.

title: Spell Trigger
description: Unleash modern spell-craft in this third-person multiplayer shooter RPG. Wield the Spell Trigger, a weapon that fuses arcane power with firearms, and confront an otherworldly force behind a mysterious wave of slumber and mortality threatening humanity.

title: Solid Flight
description: You are a licensed pilot and contract employee at Goldal Town Airport. You earn money delivering mail to remote homesteads in a mountainous area. You can rent a plane and fly wherever you want, explore the area and hunt animals. You can buy all the planes, and when you have saved enough money you can buy a stunt plane.

title: Liquid Cat
description: Embrace two forms in this unique puzzle-platformer! As a solid cat, leap and run through treacherous platforming challenges. Then, dive into a pipe and transform into a liquid cat! Rotate the pipes to solve intricate puzzles and create a safe path to the exit. With 40 progressively difficult levels, Liquid Cat offers a refreshing blend of fast-paced action and brain-bending logic.

title: Terminator: Arena
description: Battle against bots, Friends as the T-800 Terminator series in Terminator: Arnea. this Series attempts to please the fans of the Terminator series with multiple mods including Singleplayer, Co-Op and also Deathmatch focused gameplay mods that changes the weapon set to the classic terminator weapons you recognize form the classic movies.

title: Fry You Fool
description: Stack food pieces to escape the boiling oil, and go as high as you can!

title: Sin Slayers: Meat & Greed
description: A chill idle-mining sim that lives on your desktop. Dig rocks, collect gems, buy upgrades, feed your greed, and uncover shiny surprises while you do other things.

title: Lightkeeper's Curse
description: Lightkeeper’s Curse is an adventure horror puzzle game that immerses you in the dark mysteries of a ruined keep cursed by shadow.Navigate the keep to restore the light and escape what lurks in the dark

title: Myst: The Age of Rime
description:
The Age of Rime introduces players to the snowy, mountainous seascape that Atrus and his family would visit in years past, before the events of Myst and Riven upended their lives. Sweeping vistas, beautiful ice structures, and fantastical natural phenomena await new visitors.

This breathtaking new Age also houses a detailed laboratory space where bold experiments were made, delving into the mysterious nature of Linking Books themselves. This new version of Rime includes all-new narrative beats, new lore, and new sights to behold.

title: Game Saloon Simulator
description: Step into the world of fun and become the boss of your own game saloon! In this game, you’ll serve customers, enjoy interactive games, and get a taste of the relaxing and enjoyable experience that awaits you.

title: Luxman Moonlit Market
description: A strategic spatial set-collection roguelike featuring Balatro-inspired power-up management. Under the flamboyant Uncle Luxman, build the ultimate Moonlit Market while using exotic charms to trigger game-changing combos and adapting to the crowd’s ever-changing trends!

title: Specters of the Deep
description: Climb out of your tomb to avenge your own death in this haunted fantasy epic! Defy dragons, duel the dead, and face the nightmare at the bottom of the sea! It's an interactive epic fantasy novel, without graphics or sound effects, fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.

title: Autobahn Police Simulator 3: Police Motorcycle
description: Leave the windshield behind and feel the rush of the wind as you dive into high-speed pursuits or keep traffic under control with the brand new police motorcycle!

title: Autobahn Police Simulator 3: Speed Trap
description: Choose tactical positions along the Autobahn, monitor traffic discreetly, and gather solid evidence of speeding violations with the new speed trap!

title: Reckless Ruckus
description: A free to play card-based strategy RPG with PvE and PvP game modes.

title: Shadow Album
description: Shadow Album is a captivating narrative adventure game where you delve into the fragmented memories of Nira, piecing together her past through a collection of enigmatic photographs. Explore beautifully crafted environments, solve intricate puzzles, and unravel a compelling story filled with mystery and emotional depth. Experience a unique photographic memory mechanic as you reconstruct Nira's history, one photo at a time.

title: Kimi no Shinzou to Cosmos wo Miru
description:
In this story, three troubled high school girls. The tale then shifts to his past, where he meets his destined partner, only to face her congenital heart disease. It’s a story of how each path leads to its own form of happiness.

With love from the heart, anytime.

At any time, people can live on.

A visual novel with about 2 hours of playtime.

title: Terrafarmers Inc.
description: Tame wild planets, create environments friendly to humans. Fight for survival, farm the land, craft items, build, automate — Terrafarm.

title: Blood Crucible
description: A no-turns deck builder roguelike game. Time your ability and combo enemies while you frantically play cards. Explore hexes to power up with stats, xp-gaining-cards, and artifacts. Get bloody through this stylized crucible.

title: Harbinger: Legacy Edition
description: Harbinger is a nightmarish action-horror adventure through the ruins of a mid-western American city ravaged by a cultic terrorist organization. In a world dominated by an advanced form of bio-terror, the only thing you can trust is the weapon by your side...

description: A Go RPG where you can naturally learn Go while having fun! ♪ The legendary staff "Honin Rod" sealed away the Demon King. But the seal broke due to the staff's deterioration. The resurrected Demon King brought forth monsters called "Gomono," throwing the kingdom into chaos.

title: Deal With Nyarlathotep
description: Naia's Contract is a survival game with elements of Texas Hold'em and mowing. You play as a gambler who has signed a soul pact with an ancient god in a Cthulhu setting. Using poker as a medium, you harness the power of the ancient god to defeat waves of enemies. Each card corresponds to a unique skill, and combining Texas Hold'em cards grants powerful powers. Ultimately, you must rely on your own wits and strength to escape from your confinement!

title: The Orb of Darkness
description: The Orb of Darkness summons you! Join our little Goth friend as he explores the many different worlds of the dark universe as he tries to find his way back home!

title: Boom and Rum
description: "Boom and Rum" is an exciting action-puzzle game with elements of arcade 3D, where players immerse themselves in the world of complex mazes. Your task is to find the exit, overcoming obstacles and using explosives to destroy walls and enemies standing in your way.

description: Silvatale is a high quality mod of Undertale. It replaces many songs and SFX with SiIvaGunner rips, amongst over small changes.

description: Nova's Cube! A Bullet Hell Game!

description: Pyramid Clicker is a real adventure! Upgrade your perks, buy artifacts that grant incredible bonuses, and experience the power of prestige. This game offers vast opportunities for progression that will keep you hooked for hours on end.

description: Prepare to journey through treacherous levels filled with countless dangers!

Every level can be finished without collecting anything, but the more stuff you grab, the better grade you get at the end of each level. Unlock more levels and stuff by getting higher grades on previous levels.

Snack-sized space puzzle action with the Finnish Space Force. Handmade wackiness.

No payments, no ads, no data collection, just old-school fun in space - just the way our lives used to be.

description: CUMBOY IN SPACE 2 is a sequel visual novel in which you will play a male character. It is a space drama in an alternate history, where you will have hot sex with beautiful women and decide the fate of the galaxy.

description: RPG Stories 3D World Builder VTT lets you create any indoor or outdoor environment, then either export your maps to other VTTs or invite friends to play your tabletop RPG sessions online in 3D. It fully supports all three major TTRPG eras—Fantasy, Modern, and Sci-Fi.

title: Spartacus Blood Arena
description:
Spartacus Blood Arena is a historically authentic gladiator video game,
developed in collaboration with leading archaeologists and world-class reenactors to deliver unmatched realism.

Focused on accuracy and immersion, the game will feature a unique, skill-based combat system built in Unreal Engine for both PC and console players.
Currently in a pre-alpha stage, the game already includes local (PvP/AI) and online multiplayer, with a story mode planned for the next stage of development. At this point, our main focus has been on building the core combat system, along with a selection of environments and characters.

description: The Bar Souls is a retro pixel souls-like set in a mysterious digital world. Face ruthless bosses, solve puzzles that test mind and heart, and let perseverance unveil hidden secrets on your path to the end.

description: The Tribe is the first DLC for Drop Duchy, introducing a brand new playable faction inspired by mystical druids and ancient monuments. Explore a different approach to the game that invites you to rethink your strategies across every mode, with a focus on smart tile placement, exploration mechanic and combos synergies.

description: Tales' Epic Gang is a 2D Sonic the Hedgehog Fan Game with cartoony graphics and wacky characters.

description: Fight through cute enemies and tough bosses alike using your diverse arsenal of weapons and your ability to stop time! Get revenge on those Lunarians as you uncover their secret bases through 10 beautiful levels in this fully 3D FPS game based on the Touhou Project!

description: In 1995, humanity's last hope—Project Retrograde—collapsed as the underground world was shattered by the ancient parasite L.U.C.A. Play as a bounty hunter symbiotic with parasite, using its dangerous power to save the world, even if it consumes you.

description: Survive a gripping psychological thriller in this visual novel. Make critical decisions, face a disturbed captor, and experience multiple chilling endings.

Magpies have stolen all of the coins from the pot of gold, destroying the rainbow and removing the colors of all the flowers in the world. Help Kultapossu and Leo Leijona save enough money to refill the pot of gold and restore the rainbow.

A game developed and released in a marketing campaign for the Finnish bank Postipankki's children's saving club Kultapossukerho.

description: CYBRID: Survivor - is a single-player shooter with survival elements. Use your entire arsenal, fight hordes of robots, mine resources and unlock powerful upgrades as you clean up the streets at night. You are alone, against everyone!

description: Save the world with maths! An educational game where you act as a judge on olympics, solve egyptian riddles and craft keys into locks in an aztec tomb all while learning about geometry, fractions, unit conversions and other mathematical concepts.

title: Task Time
description: Task Time is a Gameshow inspired competitive party game where 8 friends dive headfirst into 6 rounds of unpredictable tasks and physics-fuelled chaos, to finish top of the leaderboard. From (some of) the people who worked on Gang Beasts and Fall Guys, this is your new favourite friendslop.

description: An episodic release of Rewrite side-stories which was released with DVD and Blu-ray Disc volumes for the anime.

title: S.E.M.I.: Side Effects May Include...
description: S.E.M.I. is a cooperative online game about escaping from a special clinic. Here you and up to 3 of your feeble-minded loyal friends in the role of patients fight with the staff and other patients and find yourself in unexpected situations. Teamwork is essential, as randomized events and experimental drugs will lead your party into unpredictable mayhem. Pop pills with your friends as you cooperate to gain your freedom.

description: Can you escape? Explore ever-changing dungeons, face dangerous enemies, and challenge a powerful boss. With each floor, the trials grow harder, and the foes become stronger. Test your skills and prove that you are the one who can triumph and earn your freedom!

description:
You awaken in a mysterious luxury bar, the Golden Jack, alongside nine strangers, and are forced to play a game by The Owner. Each player represents one of the game's rules. You can disobey your own rule, and that rule will disappear if you die. Only three players can survive...unless you find another way.

Beyond R: Rule Ripper is a visual novel with some light gameplay elements, inspired by series such as Zero Escape, Danganronpa, and Ace Attorney, as well as anime like Death Parade and Kaiji. Mixing suspense, drama, and mystery, with a seasoning of comedy.

To survive, they must put trust each in each other and lean on the hope for eventual rescue.

description:
FodFru is a 3D platformer video game developed by Néo Foderé de Frutos under the brand NSTUDIOS GAMES, a division of FODSOFT.

In this game, you step into the shoes of the fodfrus, a spherical-shaped alien species that can change color at will. This species is building an amusement park inspired by planet Earth. The problem is that several parts are missing from the main attraction’s mechanism, so your fodfru is one of the chosen ones tasked with finding the remaining pieces to complete the final ride and open the park.

title: Dance with the Moon
description: A boy who hates the night meets a vampire girl who loves it. As they steal blood packs and help those in need under the cover of darkness, the two gradually fall in love. A multi-ending visual novel that gently illuminates the lives of those lost in the night and offers comfort to the lonely.

description: Trapped in a dense cornfield, you must navigate hidden landmarks, avoid noise traps and outsmart a relentless stalker that hunts by sound. Stay quiet, read the signs and escape before it reaches you.

title: Monster City: A Monster College Story
description: Set in the same universe as Monster College, this spin-off features a young vampire struggling with family problems, curses and atypical powers. Join him as he attends college and meets sexy new girls, each with their own peculiarities.

description: Shards of the Banished is a dark fantasy action-RPG set in a cursed medieval world. A fallen king, a cursed queen, and a power-hungry usurper have plunged the land into ruin. As the exiled heir, you must rise, face powerful foes, and reclaim what is rightfully yours.

description: A deckbuilding roguelite game where you must save Perdita's cat from the horrors of The House of Hamelin! Navigate the ever-changing, twisted hallways and become strong enough to defeat the gruesome creatures that lurk within... if you can.

title: One Pass
description: "One Pass": A Stress-Reliever,a New Leisure Favorite!Control adorable little characters,collect gold coins, and navigate through fantasy levels.But don't underestimate the challenges, as each level hides the author's "little pranks" full of traps and humorous moments.Are you ready? Let's get started

title: Potatogeddon
description: Take on the role of a potato and become a hero! Explore generated levels, develop skills, fight against enemies. Play solo or gather a team. The potato revolution is waiting for you! Take up the challenge in Potatogeddon and prove that the potato is king!

title: MoonDrop Chronicles
description:
A cozy space adventure with tiny, powerful friends!

Crash-landed and alone, space pirate Callisto must find her missing crew. With the help of her loyal Moonies, you’ll fight enemies, explore strange worlds, and uncover secrets across the stars.

title: GPMoto Challenge
description:
GPMoto Challenge is a game developed and published by LOSEDEAD, with its release date for PC on June 17, 2022.
The game is described as a pulse-pounding, arcade-style racer that features a simulation feel, allowing players to drive powerful cars on famous tracks from around the world, with options for day and night-time races, varying weather conditions, and unique car handling.
It supports various game modes including single-player, online multiplayer, co-op, PvP, and local multiplayer, and includes full controller support.
The game is available on PC and has been featured on platforms like Steam, although it is currently not listed on Steam's storefront.

title: Crash Bandicoot Mayhem
description: A since-delisted Crash Bandicoot fangame by Mrmediamanx. It has additions and changes not seen in other Crash games like a keyboard-and-mouse control scheme, a continuous bound move and a "floor is lava" combo system for defeating enemies and breaking boxes.

title: HandleIt
description: As a newcomer to the gaming industry, I present you with the game I made to kill time while you waiting anything or anyone. The game was created as a car simulator. In subsequent updates, new cars will also be added open world, physics will get a new character similar to real life

title: Black Cat Brawl
description: Have you ever wanted to prove to your friends that you truly are better at gambling than them? Here's your chance! Black Cat Brawl has you going up against 7 of your friends in a team-based slamfest!

title: Anarko Zmeu
description: A fast paced arcade maze chasing game inspired by the 90s media portrayal of hackers and their culture. Download files, evade enemies, collect power-ups, launch rootkits, worms, and forkbombs and unleash total chaos.

title: A Difficult Game About Climbing: Chapter 2
description: A free update for A Difficult Game About Climbing including an entirely new map similar in size to the main game. It contains 9 new areas with new kinds of surfaces and obstacles.

title: Speedrunner
description: The title says it all, SPEEDRUNNER. Run, fast, until you reach the finish line. Gain 3 stars on the levels and open chests for rewards. From which you can customize your player. Keep your head tilted and your finger down because when you end up slacking, you will lose time...

title: VataZombie
description: Vata zombies have announced the beginning of a "special military operation" on your territory. Their claims were absurd and pointless, they want to take away your home and your quiet life. Your task is to repel the waves of Vata Zombies and protect your freedom!

title: AstroDrop
description: A 2D platformer about an astronaut who drops from space all the way back to Earth.

title: Forest Mansion Incident
description: An ordinary evening after routine cleaning turns into a nightmare... Will you be able to get out of the mansion, unravel all its secrets and defeat the voracious entity that lives in this unfortunate place without losing the remnants of humanity?

title: Desktop Kitten Girl
description: Wanna make your desktop more interesting? Here comes the cute little witch! She will keep your company all the time on the desktop! And you can add different events to the little witch's routine! Every event has abundant collection elements. The game supports the steam workshop!

title: Block Sky Rise
description: Welcome to Block Sky Rise – a relaxing yet engaging game where you’ll build towers while considering physics and gravity! Simple mechanics, an exciting process, and a variety of game modes for those who want to unwind and enjoy construction.

title: Absolute Tennis Manager
description: The most complete Tennis management game!

title: Legend Of The Platforms
description: Please read about the update! From the creator of "Diamond Board" gives you "Legend Of The Platforms". Draw cards to move and navigate the Heavens, Earth, and Underworld platforms to win the game. Each platform has different laws of navigation and different features.

title: Taskbar Looters
description: Taskbar Looters is a simple idle game where animal looters collect treasures on your desktop while you focus on other tasks.

title: Miscrits: World of Creatures
description: After years of absence, Miscrits is back and better than ever! Return to the world of Miscria and capture hundreds of iconic Miscrits. Train your Miscrits to their strongest forms and put a stop to the Magicites, who threaten to eliminate all Miscrit life from the world!

title: Pussy Cum with Me
description: Pussy Cum with me is a collection of short adult visual novels. Spend an unforgettable summer holidays, date with hot girls, and follow your passion.

title: Q-Up
description: Sick of long queues, unfair matchups, and arbitrary reflex tests? Try Q-Up, the coin flipping eSport. It's one part clicker, one part multiplayer strategy game, one part demented capitalism simulator, and 100% completely random.

title: Alexia Zero
description: High-Speed 2D Hack-and-Slash Game
Real-time, role-based dungeon crawler where you control four characters at once in action RPG combat.

description: Classic tank battles reborn with online play, powerups, emojis & map editor!

description: The powerful baron and the Holy Inquisition, magical races and hordes of undead — all are eager to find ancient artifacts and gain power over the world. Bloody battles and destructive sorcery, ambition and intrigue will lead you to unravel the mystery of the world of Sarcus!

title: Exorcist: Oldest Tongue
description: Speak the demon’s true name to win. Let your sins be known, and you’ll die. Master the synergy of countless sacred verses and wait for fate to turn in your favor. A fast-paced, compact game of judgment and luck—where every choice is a gamble.

title: To Be Altered
description: Uncover the mystery of the Ghoul's Grove, hidden in the Australian outback and filled with strange and mutilated scare actors. To Be Altered is a multiple-ending visual novel where your choices matter, even the most minuscule decisions will decide the fates of Darcy and others.

title: Flesh Farm
description: Flesh Farm is a third-person shooter inspired by 90s horror classics. Battle through a cult-run farm to find your missing wife and son. Hack with an axe, shred with a chainsaw and blast enemies with a shotgun. Solve puzzles, collect body parts, and uncover dark hidden secrets in the compound.

description: Turn-based Dungeon Crawler Rogue-like with strategic combat. Navigate through a randomly generated labyrinth and encounter a variety of enemies and events. Build your party with different skills and equipments to defeat strong enemies and to conquer the dungeon.

description: «Mistbound» is a nonlinear visual novel in the psychological romance genre. Loneliness can be too loud. And salvation can be too quiet!

title: Ricochet Raven
description: Make your way through levels against enemies by only parrying their attacks! upgrade your deflection abilities by acquiring upgrade feathers and create chaotic combos in Ricochet Raven!

description: You are a monster merchant. Catch cute monsters, sell them, take pills. This is your job, if you don't do it, someone else will, and you don't want that. This is a psychological horror game about catching cute creatures.

description: Fight for your life in the endless halls of a primordial stronghold to escape an endless cycle. You and up to 7 of your friends can coordinate, strategize and conqueror the dungeon together, or you can face the horrors alone.

title: X-YZE
description: Bump combat action with a mysterious short story.

title: This Is Love
description: Guide a small character through platforming and puzzle levels that explore the emotions of a toxic relationship. Uncover harrowing real quotes shared by those who endured it as you flee an antagonist determined to keep you captive while searching for freedom.

title: Season 31
description:
A short narrative game experimenting with the management sim genre.
April 2131. In the abandoned countryside, rally cars are racing endlessly to entertain the public far in the capital. Recruit, film, manage to make the races go as smoothly and spectacularly as possible. Everything should go well, as long as you keep it under control…

title: Dark Tales: Edgar Allan Poe's Lenore - Collector's Edition
Dark Tales: Edgar Allan Poe's Morella - Collector's Edition
Grendel's Revenge
description: A MUX online RPG where the players take the role of monsters hunting down human invaders to their lands. Notable for the extensive dungeon complexes that players in guilds could create, the PvPvE tierlist of transforming monster types for solo players, and the storyteller system developed by publisher Skotos Online.

title: Dark Tales: Edgar Allan Poe's The Pit and the Pendulum - Collector's Edition
RE0: VTuber Life

title: Dark Tales: Edgar Allan Poe's The Oval Portrait - Collector's Edition
Thugging
description: THUGGING is a 3rd Person Shoot 'em up set in a dystopian city fueled by drugs and gambling. Inspired by classic 3D retro games it tries to capture this unique oldschool ambient in a semi open world setting. Steal money, kill thugs and get away in your car!

title: Rusty Winter
description: Rusty Winter is a sidescrolling adventure game inspired by hardboiled detective stories and urban legends. Meet a diverse cast, chase down leads that blur the boundaries between reality and the paranormal, and explore a cold, once-glorious industrial town in search of your missing loved one.

title: Pyrosynchist
description: Ride and fly off ramps on your motorcycle in this arcade-style infinite runner. Demons take over the earth, you must fight to delay the inevitable! Brave the pandemonium as you chuck explosives and set off shockwaves. Ride tandem with a comrade for chaotic co-op.

title: Mobile Murder Mystery
description: Follow the story of the Unseen Narrator, whose repetitive life falls apart when their co-worker decides to quit on a whim.

title: Kyvos
description: A dice roguelike. Build your own dice face by face, combine special effects, and fight enemy cards with unique abilities in fast-paced runs full of luck, strategy, and tension.

title: Drowning Song of the Stagnant Sea
description: A dark fairy tale set in the deep sea. The fated encounter between a sea monster and a human forever changes their lives in this yuri visual novel.

title: Re:D Cherish!: Eternity Blood

title: Re:D Cherish! SS: Rouge's One Operation

title: Earth Must Die
description: These moronic Terranoids think they can just roll in here and take over my beautiful Tyrythian kingdom? The kingdom that I built from the ground up with my bare hands, and only sort of inherited from my dear, sweet, extremely dead father? This is complete bullsh*t, and I'm going to make them dead.

title: Rain World: Slugcat's Lifecycle Edition
description: The story of the slugcats, packaged together in this Complete bundle of the base game of Rain World and its two expansions, Rain World: Downpour and Rain World: The Watcher!

title: House Flipper 2: Pets
description: House Flipper 2 is getting rowdy! With dozens of pets to choose from, you can now adopt your new best friend. Let them accompany you during the pet-centered jobs or relax by petting them with your friends in the Co-op!

title: Blood: Refreshed Supply
description: Things are about to get… bloody! Soak up 42 pulse-pounding levels dripping with Lovecraftian atmosphere as you battle your way through armies of sycophantic cultists, zombies, gargoyles, hell hounds, and other insatiable horrors, in your quest to defeat the loathsome Tchernobog.

title: Forest: The Call For Help

description: Unlog is a fast-paced 2D platformer about a sleepy goblin trying to escape a mysterious dream factory. Dash, wall jump and avoid the traps to get as fast as you can ! Believe us, you'll need it.

description: BrokenLore: DON'T LIE is psychological horror spin-off of DON’T WATCH, where lies, medication and fragile bonds blur the line between reality and nightmare.

description: Two hot and destructive warrior women obliterate all of their opponents but find themselves left with too much pent up energy and frustration. And one has a weapon that needs tending to! Will her fighting companion be able to oil her sexy spear, lubricate her lusty tool?

description: Node Math is a simple, idle-factory game about combining numbers with math operators, unlocking new stuff, and making money go brrr!

The Scorching Land: A New World Born from Ancient Egypt

An exorcist that doubts the existence of ghost might sound contradictory but to Alicia Wilkershire, this is the right way to get closer to the truth. A client's mother claims to be haunted but after sensing something nefarious behind it, Alicia rushed to investigate.

description: Cargo, Commuters, and Chaos! Lay tracks, schedule trains, and optimize routes to transport passengers and cargo across the map. Balance fuel costs, adapt to your environment, and demands in this ever-evolving train-based puzzle.

description: Chimera Circuit is a pixel-art tactical racing simulator where you splice hybrid creatures from over 100 species, train stats, shop for items, bet on outcomes, and deploy stamina-based skills during grid-based races. Forge optimal builds across 10 Clades with 200 traits to conquer the career!

description: GLASS x CANNON is a risky top down shooter roguelike. You are always very low health so you'll have to dodge and use blood to survive. Collect items and get stronger to defeat a powers, crossing into our world.

description: Precision platformer set in a gothic minimalist shadow world. Cut down a path, defy gravity, and unleash your inner strength to find your way out.

description: Invade the primitive planet of Earth, setting up a profitable business, abducting its inhabitants, and ultimately conquering the planet.

description: Ayano loves Takumi, and Takumi loves Ayano, a classic story of unrequited love... until it's not! They finally confess their love to each other, and they couldn't be happier for it. Unfortunately, relationships are not allowed. Can their love survive in secret?

description: Hunt eldritch horrors in the cursed lands of Transylvania. Stalk your prey with blades and bullets, craft your ideal loadout, and conduct unnatural rituals in this gothic shooter.

description: Curse Words is a roguelike FPS about swearing! Use your real voice to unleash powerful abilities based on your favorite swear words. Slay hordes of enemies, level up, and unlock new words and upgrades to create insane builds!

description:
A collection of three stories:

2. Ultra-happy wife 「超・おさな妻」
3. Strongest woman wife in history 「史上最強のおしかけ女房」

description: Ronza is a tense survival game where you sit at a PC, uncover dark secrets, play games and listen for dangers creeping near. Strange characters stalk you, each with their own way to counter. Stay alert, react fast, and survive the night while the computer pulls you deeper.

title: Arctic Drive
description: Explore and survive in the Arctic, where your car is the only thing keeping you alive. Arctic Drive is a 1–4 player co-op survival sim set in a procedurally generated winter wilderness. Find supplies, repair your rig, and haul it all onwards with only one hope left: there must be safety out there.

Do you remember your worst nightmare?

Every night, he wakes up drenched in sweat, trapped in the same nightmare over and over again. But what is it that's haunting him – and how, or who, can set him free?

When it comes to fall flavors, sanma is a must!

Yakuza Kiwami 3 is an extreme remake of the action-adventure beat 'em up Yakuza 3 featuring ex-yakuza Kazuma Kiryu's fight to protect those he loves.

Deluxe Edition Contents:
- Legendary Outfit Pack
