description: Test your focus and patience in a colorful matching game! Find and pair identical images as difficulty increases. Relaxing yet challenging, casual yet addictive—easy to pick up, but hard to put down.

title: Convent Chronicles: Revelation
description: A visual novel that combines religious themes from Catholicism with anime inspired drama and visuals.

title: Slut Nurses
description: Slut Nurses is an erotic game in the genre of "Arkanoid", in which you will have to break the cubes and gradually discover really beautiful and hot images.

title: Hentai Casual Swap 3
description: Relax and enjoy a stylish tile-swap puzzle game where solving each level unlocks beautifully drawn, sensual anime-style illustrations. With 40 exclusive images, an immersive soundtrack, and a dedicated gallery, Hentai Casual Swap 3 offers the perfect blend of casual gameplay and tasteful erotic art.

title: Poo Poo War
description: This is a combat shooting game, but it also has AI monsters. You can also create your own host to pass the level alone. The way to win is to defeat the enemy and reach the designated location.

title: Athos'Code
description: Discover a lively manuscript that will tell you the story of Athos as you embody him in his most epic battles. Athos' Code is a story-driven sword fighting game that takes you to the heart of the quarrels of the French province in the XVIIth century.

title: Dream Trials
description: Somehow, someway you achieved a complete balance between life and death. The universe has taken notice and now you must undergo the Dream Trials.

title: Sariel's Day Out
description: You are a silly angel boy who is just so sick and tired of working day in and day out! So you decide to slack off a little bit. Absolutely nothing can go wrong! It's just a little break, right? Right?

title: Object Factory
description: Turn the simplest shapes into something extraordinary.

title: Sweet Story Neko
description:
Two forest cats live in the deep forest. The singing of birds, the sound of wind and water, became their home. You can be a part of their romantic friendship, so join them.

Sweet Story Neko is a puzzle game in which you must collect all pairs of pictures to reproduce the image.

title: Lilialette's Hustle: Getting My Hands Dirty to Save My Guild
description: Lilialette loves life as a guild receptionist, but between the upcoming guild merger and budget cuts, she might be getting fired soon! Help Lilialette get into gear and take on quests to turn her F-Rank guild into a bustling hub for adventurers... and save her dream job, of course!

title: Beasts of Mystery
description: Have you ever wondered what it would be like to see Mothman fight the Flatwoods Monster? Well now you can find out in Beasts of Mystery, the cryptid fighting game with hand drawn animation and approachable gameplay inspired by the greatest of fighting games’ past and present.

title: Harold Rabbit 2: The Case of the Pastry Pirate
description: A fully hand-drawn adventure game about the rabbit detective Harold and his sidekick, the bumblebee Maud. Join Harold and Maud on a new and exciting case, the case of the pastry pirate!

title: Unknown Hero
description: Brace yourself for an intense bullet hell experience! Fight your way through challenging levels, defeat bosses, upgrade your weapon and get the highest score!

title: Wand Mart
description: Welcome to Wand Mart — an absolutely ordinary magic store where everything is fine. n̶o̶ ̶o̶n̶e̶ ̶d̶i̶s̶a̶p̶p̶e̶a̶r̶s̶ ̶i̶n̶ ̶t̶h̶e̶ ̶b̶a̶s̶e̶m̶e̶n̶t̶ . A cooperative game for 4 players: build, trade, and, if possible, don't die. Just like in real life

title: Cyte
description: Blaze your path as CYTE, a being created to guard the flow of time, as you dash and slam your way through a mysterious enemy’s mechanical army in this first person 3d action game. Fight through a unique science fiction world in the perfect blend of intense combat and lightning-fast movement.

title: Mermeows - Chill Cat Mermaids
description:
Welcome to Mermeows: Chill Cat Mermaids!
Ever dreamed of a world where cats and mermaids become one? In Mermeows: Chill Cat Mermaids, hatch magical cores to reveal adorable Mermeows—each with its own quirky personality and charm. Watch these enchanting cat-mermaids drift gracefully through beautifully hand-drawn lakes in a serene, idle clicker adventure.

title: Pickle Panic
description: Steer the jar with your pickles inside. Roll through trap-filled courses! A 1–4 player physics-based co-op chaos: clear obstacles without shattering the jar, return to checkpoints, and try wild tactics with friends. Easy to learn, hard to master.

title: Cryptic Tales: Crossroads
description: Jon’s dreams were filled with music and a love life he once had. Now they’ve curdled into nightmares, weaving between memories and unknown realms. Set in the '90s, this immersive first-person psychological walking simulator follows Jon as he realizes… something is stalking him.

title: Of Grit & Graves
description: A roguelite turn-based tactical RPG inspired by classic tabletop dungeon crawlers, where strategic thinking meets the thrill of the dice. Command your party in tense tactical grid combat across seven perilous realms to destroy the prismatic dragon and end the curse.

title: Brass & Bramble
description: Brass & Bramble is a narrative deck-builder set in a steampunk Victorian age where myth and empire collide. As Avalon’s Envoy, battle the brass-forged Empire, uncover forgotten roots of myth, and journey from Ireland to Egypt, Japan, and beyond in story-driven expeditions.

title: Knight's Errand
description: Gather your army. Defeat other players' avatars. Claim the champion's title. Knight's Errand is a concentrated dose of tactical nostalgia, designed for quick and intense sessions. Pure tactics, no filler.

title: Inquisitor Shepherd
description: Become Shepherd, an inquisitor sent to a suspicious village. Unveil the secrets of a world filled with fear, and make an inevitable choice. In this visual novel mystery, your decisions change the world. Can you survive the desperate horror?

title: Iron Shadow: Survival Protocol
description: Iron Shadow: Survival Protocol fuses side-scrolling platformer action with survivor-style combat. In a future city ruled by an AI legion, you are the last ghost soldier. Dodge, jump, and carve your path through endless swarms of enemies to survive.

title: Morra 3D
description: MORRA 3D is a classic boomer shooter about battling restless creatures with high-caliber guns and an ever changing storm inside of you.

title: Wetter
description: Step into the paws of Luna and explore a rain-soaked archipelago. Uncover pieces of your forgotten past and decide which memories will shape who you become.

title: Minor Deity
description: Command the elements to create the landscapes of your imagination in this gridless interactive sandbox. Control dynamic weather and allow vegetation and animals to flourish. Lay out towns for growing populations, establish resource outposts, and encourage trade via road, river and sea routes.

title: The Kingdom of God
description: The Kingdom of God: Creation is an independent game integrating territory management, resource management, strategic chess and exploration. As a new God, players develop their own country in the dangerous universe and eventually become the king of the new generation of gods.

title: Archaeology: Egypt
description: A game of the genre find the hidden object.

title: How Much Items: Vehicles
description: Game genre find hidden objects.

title: The Stones
description: Welcome to The Stones! CLICK ON A STONE, GET A STONE. Try your luck and unlock unique skins. Collect, customize, and build the ultimate collection as you play.

title: Farming Mushroom
description: Let's dig for mushrooms! The time has come to fulfill our dreams. Everyone has wanted to dig for mushrooms at least once. Enjoy the thrill of digging for mushrooms in nature. Find mushrooms and grow them with the animals.

title: The Prince Fights the Dragon
description: This is an adventure game. You can use moves, spells and weapons. This game will bring you happiness.

title: RockStars!
description: "RockStars!" is a third-person action adventure game set in an alien planet with a 70's retro psychedelic style. When Aero's rocket minivan crash lands on a hostile alien planet, they must use the abilities of different instruments to find their band members and escape.

title: Limb
description: Speak into the microphone to see, but be careful, for he can hear you...

title: Project: Ether
description: Project: Ether is a magical sci-fi stealth game about trans witches fighting robots. Stop Time, Be a Witch, Save the World.

title: Project Hangman
description: Enjoy the classical game of Hangman with friends.

title: Ruiga Pirates: First Survivors
description: Defeat legions of pirates and marine beasts to emerge victorious! Ruiga Pirates: First Survivors is an adventure with survival elements. Customize your ship, brace yourself for a bullets from myriad foes! Navigate the perilous waters of a ghost-infested realm and Play for Free now!

title: Terpenie
description: In the gloomy atmosphere of post-Soviet everyday life, routine tasks like cleaning, cooking, and exploring your own room hide something much darker. Survive and uncover the truth before the maniac comes for you.

title: A Most Important Night
description: An experimental conversation simulator - Can you survive the night and leave some good impressions on important strangers?

title: Solitaire Battle Online
description: "Solitaire" and "Spider" are created in intense competitions. Compete not with a deck, but with players from all over the world. Your goal is not just to collect solitaire, but to do it more faster and more efficiently than everyone else.

title: Cheapskate
description: cheapskate is a passion project to make a highly accessible skate toy for the action sports gaming community. The ultimate goal is to provide offline singleplayer, serverless / account-free multiplayer, easy mod support, Steam Deck compatibility, and one low price forever.

title: Find My Love
description: Find lovely couples in this memory game with romantic vibes.

title: Spy Alliance
description: This is a two-player online interactive video game perfect for friends or couples. Single-player sessions last 30-40 minutes. Through the challenges, you can work together or tease each other. Your choices together will determine the story's trajectory, creating your own unique adventure.

title: Lordbound
description:
The land of Druadach, a dense new region larger than Solstheim, filled with quests, dungeons, events and activities, for you to enjoy.
About 60+ hours worth of content through main questlines and side content.

Over 40 quests, found through our many new settlements and exploring the world.

Over 50 new dungeons, featuring the most epic spaces you've ever explored!

The biggest main quest you've ever played in Skyrim, with choices and consequences that change the state of the valley.
Join Lord Haelan on a quest to uncover the truth behind his family’s past.
Assist the Imperial Legion in reclaiming the trade route to Jehanna.
Support the Orcs of Garshakur, as they defend their new home against the Legion.

Loot that you’ll want to carry over to your future adventures. New weapons, armor, spells, and surprising consumables.

Fully-voiced NPCs and an original soundtrack!

title: Sunken Dreams
description: An atmospheric puzzle and exploration game from a solo developer. Explore an island ruin, and delve into the darkness with a cinematic camera system and realtime player decay.

title: In The Middle Of
description: In the Middle Of is a narrative adventure of mystery and fantasy. Isolated in a cabin next to an ancient forest, Shafer will discover that the world is not as banal and logical as he believes and he will be surrounded by enigmatic characters, creatures and extraordinary events.

title: Mutant Alley
description: Mutant Alley is a 2D and VR first person fantasy sex simulation and a complete remake of the original Mutant Alley: Do the Dinosaur.

title: I Crossed Over Into the World of Magic
description: A modern girl is suddenly transported to the world of magic. At the same time she possessed the ancient magic. Use this magic to repel the dangerous uncle. Come and save her.

title: Milfy Cases: Damsels in Distress
description: Milfy Cases is a choice-driven adult visual novel filled with the best parts of a modern day adventure. Take the initiative in this urban fantasy to romance gorgeous women, collect lore, and solve the central mystery with dating, love, and sex along the way.

title: Zerion 12
description: A sci-fi tower defense game. Create futuristic towers of various types to destroy hordes of aliens that come in waves. Build up resources to create more towers, repair, upgrade etc. Earn rewards for accomplishing certain tasks.

title: Bane and Valor
description: Bane and Valor is a hero-based top-down action-RPG that offers tons of build variety to let you play the way YOU want. Find your favorite hero, craft the perfect build, solve quests and defeat mighty bosses in this medievil fantasy world.

title: Fortress Fury
description:
Fortress Fury is a multiplayer tower defense game with minimalistic gameplay and roguelite elements.

The monsters are here, and there's no place to run or hide.

Defeat the enemies!

All you can do is survive as long as you can until other towers are fallen.

Gather gold to buy upgrades and win other players.

Key Features

Dynamic Builds: With over 16 different weapons to choose from throughout a run, no two attempts will ever be the same

Rank System: Compete your skills with other players in session and overall

Diverse Cast & Tower Arsenal: Experiment with builds across a wide cast of unlockable towers and upgradable weapons

Pick Up And Play: Approachable 10-20 minute runs built with quick play sessions in mind

title: The Battle of Polytopia: Quetzali
description: The Quetzali tribe worship the Bird Gods of the red soil and live in harmony with the natural symmetry of their cubistic jungles. They are commonly seen riding giant flightless birds. The Quetzali starts the game with Strategy tech.

title: The Battle of Polytopia: Khondor
description: The ancient sacred order of Khondor Honor Guards has appeared! Hailing from the time of Mubehasi the Undefeated, the Khondor have put on their masks, mounted their Sphelix, and set out to reform the Oumaji out of nomadism and back into a more civilized age.

title: Main Sequence
description: Main Sequence is a first-person space-sim factory builder where you design spaceships, build space stations, and automate everything. Start with a single ship and grow to become an interstellar industrial empire as you leave your mark on the galaxy.

title: The Battle of Polytopia: Iqaruz
description: The Quetzali may worship the birds, but members of the Iqaruz have taken their devotion a step further by trying to transform themselves into actual birds, with wings and all. Some are even attempting to fly, so they can meet the Bird Gods in the sky, but it rarely ends well.

title: The Battle of Polytopia: Yădakk
description: The Yădakk started out as a nomadic tribe in the beautiful harsh Khalee plains. Now they are the traders of the Square, connecting their empire with impressive trade routes. The Yădakk starts the game with the Road tech.

title: The Battle of Polytopia: Luxidoor
description:
The Luxidoor love expensive things; jewels, rare spices and garments. That is also why they are the most expensive tribe in Polytopia!
The Luxidoor citizens lead very comfortable lives, draped in the finest purple silk. The Luxidoor starts the game with a huge capital.

title: Nitro Turtles
description: Nitro Turtles is a racing game about super fast turtles! Reach insane speeds with awesome shell-attached gadgets, compete in crazy races with friends, and sprint across the finish line to claim ultimate turtle victory! To be the fastest turtle around, you'll need to master shell gadget usage, learn every shortcut imaginable, and maybe even consider using performance-enhancing seaweed!

title: Ryan Ward's Lunch-Out!!
description: Inspired by the true-life events of my good friend Ryan. My first game ever; I am not a programmer and taught myself what I could of PICO-8, making this whole thing up as I went along, so I'm sure the code is very inefficient and a mess, sorry! It's a simple game and is mostly a lifetime of inside jokes, but to the general public: I hope you enjoy it anyway!

title: Printfarm Simulator
description: Start with your first 3D printer and grow your printing farm step by step. Manage your printers, organize materials, and fulfill orders while finding the best way to run your business smoothly.

title: The Battle of Polytopia: To-Lï
description: The To-Lï rigorously train their bodies and minds in their sturdy Binba forests. They've been summoned from their temples and gyms to aid the Ai-Mo in the war, as few can match their sheer strength and discipline.

title: The Battle of Polytopia: Aumux
description: The gilded Aumux Mercenaries have been serving as the personal army of the Luxidoorian Emperor for many years, as there's no one else who can match their exorbitant demands for gold and precious gems!

title: The Battle of Polytopia: Cultists
description: Vengir of the fanatical Burzgor Cult will perform the visceral Thdkrkr Ritual, shrugging off their mortal flesh and gaining power directly from the God of Blood, themself. Their zealous display of devotion isn't taken as seriously as they'd like by the other tribes, however.

title: The Battle of Polytopia: Ürkaz
description: The Ürkaz from the Khalee Highlands are known as a gruff and unfriendly group that controls the Yădakk's criminal underground. Smuggling, racketeering, and other shady dealings are all steps to their goal of economic domination of the Square!

title: The False Alice: Retold Tale

title: Super Lunch-Out 2 Turbo
description: Following the events of 2016's genre-defining "Ryan Ward's Lunch-Out!!", this sequel doubles down on the "Nutritional Food Action" formula in a competition against a mysterious new challenger! Play against a friend in/solve minor disputes with this 2-player game from joseph3000!

title: Lunch-Out 3: Waste Disposal 20XX
description: Help Old Ryan travel back to the past in this challenging puzzle game!

title: Trickshotterz
description: SCORE IN THE TOP OF THE CUP. Pick abilities, grab wild powerups, and pull off absurd trickshots that hit harder the crazier they are. Play with up to 4 players locally, online, or hop into public matchmaking.

title: Primary Exit
description: A puzzle game about finding a way out and escape from the office at midnight.

title: Bait & Tackle
description: Catch exotic fish and fight comical sea-monsters as you chase after The One That Got Away in this fishing-centric boss rush!

title: Hyper City Parkour
description: A platformer with parkour elements

title: The Greys: Human Abductions
description: In The Greys: Human Abductions, you discover top-secret documents and unsettling alien evidence. As you explore, encounter strange noises, bizarre events, and the chilling possibility of abduction. Will you uncover the truth or become the next victim?

title: Mr. Hopp's Playhouse: The Toybox
description: When Emmie brings home a toy rabbit she found in the woods, her mother, Kaiya, starts experiencing strange happenings inside their home as everything becomes a fight for survival.

title: My Little Coffee Shop
description: Open the doors of your own coffee shop and immerse yourself in the world of fragrant coffee! In My Little Coffee Shop, you will have to: prepare different types of coffee and desserts; serve customers and fulfill their orders; decorate and improve the interior of your coffee shop; expand your business and discover new opportunities. Create the most cozy place in the city where everyone will find their favorite drink.

title: Your Personality Test
description: Take Your Personality Test, where you'll be entertained with a diverse range of questions, all with the company of me, Myrddin! -

title: Pizza for Creeps
description:
"Pizza for Creeps" is a horror-comedy that mixes body horror with romance and working-simulator elements.

You can date almost everyone, you can choose to be nice, rude or creepy (who's the real creep?), and you might also learn a thing or two about pizza making.

title: Crush Depth
description: CRUSH DEPTH is first-person sci-fi horror game set at the bottom of the ocean. A salvage operation that would set you up for life goes sideways when you realize you're not alone down there. You'll solve puzzles and run from danger as you uncover the mysterious fate of Eclipse Station.

title: PointWorks
description: In the world of PointWorks, you play as a biped robot named 'Robot 27', your only goal is to navigate through a series of 7 obstacles, and complete this parkour test in a grey, neon and geometric dimension called 'The Grid'.

title: Blasteroids
description: Blast your way through waves of space debris in order to reach what is waiting for you on the other side. Find your fighting style with multiple unlockable ships in this fast paced space adventure!

title: Curtains The Clown
description: Curtains The Clown is a compact 2D adventure with multiple possible outcomes. Use simple platforming mechanics like wall jumps and double jumping to guide Curtains through a treacherous world in search of a way to continue (or end) his journey. Hidden away in seemingly unreachable places are 6 items that hold the keys to various exits. Find and bring an item to its corresponding NPC/world object to discover what fate will become of our clown friend.

title: Raven Tea
description: Raven Tear is a stylized co-op adventure (4 players) in a small open world with horror elements. Evil has gripped the small town of "Raven Tear", you - brave hunters, must take your faithful dog and your excellent car, turn up the radio to go on a journey through the locations and drive them all back to the underworld. Grow vegetables, catch fish, earn money for equipment and arrange a safari for monsters!

title: Wintertale
description: A short visual novel made as New Year greeting card from the developers, featuring characters from Everlasting Summer.

title: Zwei Trigger
description:
Set in a rapidly developing city plagued by an abnormally high number of disappearances, this mystery visual novel follows two intertwined tales of resolve and tragedy. Kurusu Yuuma searches desperately for his missing sister-figure, Akizuki Kaname, only to be drawn into a web of unexplained vanishings. Meanwhile, Takanashi Shin’ya delves into the same enigma in hopes of saving Akesaka Touka, a girl afflicted by a mysterious illness linked to the supernatural.

Written by Kazuki Fumi, the story features a dual protagonist system, weaving together two perspectives that gradually uncover the dark secrets lurking beneath the city’s surface.

title: Orbiteers
description: Design efficient space stations across the solar system in this minimalist puzzle-builder. Solve unique challenges with help from your assistant L.U.N.A., optimize your builds, maximize your score, and lead humanity’s journey beyond Earth!

title: Scritchy Scratchy
description: Scritchy Scratchy is a satisfying scratch card incremental game. Buy tons of scratch-off's, buy an auto scratcher to do all the hard work and win jackpots! Will you risk it all for the big reward or play it safe?

title: RoadCraft: Rebuild Expansion
description: Explore two new maps, Contamination and Washout, in Rebuild Expansion for RoadCraft. Mitigate chemical disasters, navigate flooded swamps, and deploy six unique vehicles. Requires the base game RoadCraft to run.

title: Alaskan Road Truckers: Mother Truckers DLC
description: Show off your badass style with a brand new character as well as upgrading your truck's look, letting every other driver know they need to get out of your way when they see you coming. Conquer the Alaskan frontier with unique cosmetics for your truck!

title: Da Capo Innocent Finale
description:
Alternative setting to Da Capo staging Kotori Shirakawa as the main heroine, with a completely rewritten scenario.

The scene takes place after the graduation ceremony. After being crowned at the school beauty contest, Kotori confesses to Jun'ichi, or rather, she intends to. At that time, something happens to Nemu...

description: Sequel to Lithia's route from Shuffle 2.

title: Mutants vs. the Chosen
