The future has brought destruction to some places on Earth. Some people are suffering from poverty, disease and visible genetic mutations.

Although the mutations are typically small, they are often used as a pretext to attack the Mutants by the Chosen. The gunmen steal, destroy and kill. This time, they have chosen a small village in the shadow of the ruined city, where Riam lives with his father and sister. Maybe it's time to stand up to the Chosen. Do it - in this point and click adventure game.

title: Shuffle! Love Rainbow
description: Shuffle's fandisc, with 3 after-stories.

title: Akatsuki Yureru Koi Akari SS: Momiji to One Room - Toaru Natsu no Ichinichi
description:
One day during the summer holidays, while all the other dorm residents headed back to their family's homes, the members of the Takamura class were enjoying the remainder of their holiday to the max at the academy.
During this time, Momiji realises that there just happens to be a day where everyone else is out of the dorm apart from her. Thinking that she could have Iori all to herself, without having to worry about the gazes of the others, she barged into Iori's room.

There's just over 24 hours left!
Momiji's many delusions finally explode!
And so their sweet lovey-dovey flirty-flirty day begins.

title: Mutants vs. the Chosen Part 2
description:
“Mutants vs The Chosen: Traitor” is a point-and-click adventure game, where you help Riam, the main hero, defend mutants against the Chosen ones.

Hand-painted graphics, a strange atmosphere of the future world, puzzles in which you have to use your brain, and the story – these are the main ingredients of this adventure game.

title: The Starfighter
description: A big, immersive, realistic, Full HD and real-time 3D combat flight arcade game. You are a space alien and fly two-seater Griffin Starfighter. You must wipe out evil King Nimrod's buildings, spaceships, rocket launcher equipped armored buggies, drones, etc. and restore peace to the universe.

title: Suzaku Shijuusou: "Saikyou" no Katana Hime
description:
The game is set in the 5th sea-top special district, the Sumiyoshi Academic Centre.
Things seem somewhat strange today at Murakumo Academy, the only place you can learn Jindou.
The uniforms that were once unified are now all over the place, but the students don't seem find it strange at all.
It seems that a boundary has been set up all throughout the Sumiyoshi Academic Centre.

title: United City
description: A simple casual game that can be completed with just a click of a mouse, revisiting the past from a sci-fi perspective and experiencing a different life scene in domestic towns in the 1990s, with a cinematic reading experience.

title: Akatsuki Yureru Koi Akari SS: Asahi to One Room - Toaru Natsu no Ichinichi
description:
One day during the summer holidays, while all the other dorm residents headed back to their family's homes, the members of the Takamura class were enjoying the remainder of their holiday to the max at the academy.
Asahi has completely become a commuting wife with how she regularly heads to Iori's room without worrying about those around her. However, she's seeming a bit overworked after the Enbu-sai. Deciding that things can't go on like this, Iori makes a certain suggestion to her on a day where the other members of the Takamura class aren't around.

"Today is your day completely off, Asahi!
I'll obey anything you tell me to do!"

Asahi's lust finally explodes!
And so their sweet lovey-dovey flirty-flirty day begins.

title: Anthèse
description: In Anthèse, an Action Light RPG, you explore a ruined world alongside your faithful companion. On a mission on a flying island, Emöke must eliminate a particularly dangerous predator that threatens a village under his protection.

title: Shion to One Room: Kizuna Kirameku Koi Iroha SS
description: After graduating, Touki moved from Acadamy Island to the mainland and now lives alone. Shion often comes over when the weekend rolls around and they spend sweet lovey-dovey time flirting as lovers. Their second anniversary is fast approaching-- this year they want to celebrate it with just the two of them. With this anniversary just around the corner, they decide to surprise one another...

title: SnackTimeActionGame
description: [Snackable hero experience!]Zombies in the city, a western street corner, a samurai battle... Snack time action game is a 2D action game where you can easily enjoy feeling like a hero or a monster in various situations! 7 types of situations + α&20+ playable characters! The combination is up to you!

title: Tsubaki to One Room: Kizuna Kirameku Koi Iroha SS
description:
Tsubaki had been participating in the Jindou pro leagues, but after a certain match, kitsune ears popped up on her head once again. Unable to go out or train as a result, she must stay at home for a while.
She's gotten hold of time all alone with Touki for the first time in a long while. As chances like this don't come around all too often, the two of them decide to enjoy flirting, acting all lovey-dovey and doing things they can't normally do, as lovers living together!

title: Secret Sealing Travel
description: Secret Sealing Travel is a casual game created by Touhou Project. Interact with the two girls from the Secret Sealed Club on your desktop, experience stat development, and explore, work, and shop on a vast map of near-future Kyoto. Enjoy every day with the Secret Sealed Club!

title: Zentore: Muscle Your Brain
description: A fitness game that combines brain training with muscle training.

title: Nightwatch at the Hopkins' Cliffside
description: Tense first-person anomaly-detection horror game. Investigate anomalies, wield an ancient artifact, and uncover the secrets of the cliffside. Will you survive until dawn, or will the anomalies consume you?

title: D.C. II To You: Da Capo II To You - Side Episodes
description:
A collection of 4 short side stories.
The first one tells about the events of a decade ago, when Yoshiyuki was adopted by Asakura family.
From the second story we'll learn how Yoshiyuki became friends with Wataru and Suginami, and how the Setsugekka trio was formed.
The third story is about a close friendship of Miki and Mahiru, when she was still alive.
The fourth story is an alternate reality, which tells how in one rainy day Sakurai picked up a broken "μ", who was thrown out by heartless owner, and how strongly he became attached to her.

title: Fear Tapes: Scrap Yard
description:
Out in the backwoods, you discover someone has left a small, neatly packed case of VHS tapes at your cabin doorstep. It is labeled, "Promotional Materials."

Why not put a tape in the VHS player?

title: Mogu Valley
description: A small game for writing leisure, by writing a word to obtain a piece of ink field and different ink gas, through the gathering spirit can temporarily improve the speed of obtaining Mogu Valley

title: Argonauts Agency: Gorgon Medusa
description: Argonauts Agency: Gorgon Medusa: A journey to gather resources, fight petrification, and save your friends and all of Greece!

title: Pro Basketball Manager 2026
description: Lead your club to greatness in Pro Basketball Manager 2026! The Basketball Champions League arrives with 53 licensed teams, putting you in charge of every decision as you aim to dominate both domestic and continental basketball.

title: Die Drei ???: Ruf Der Trolle
description: Trolls in Rocky Beach? A teenager has disappeared and his sister suspects a kidnapping by a real troll. Who is the strange-looking man that not only little Elenya has seen? Investigate with Justus, Peter and Bob in a "trollish" case!

title: Magic Click
description: Jagshemash! You like sexy time? I like sexy time too! I show you something. Here is magic click. You use this click, girls show shes vazheen and dance for you. Click-click-click! Very nice, very nice! You click often - the line of romance explosion go up! Wawaweewa! You buy this clicker, you get 10 animated girls with big plastic chests and shave down below in sexy poses. Click-click-click! Elf girl, nun girl, slave-raccoon girl, honey rabbit girl and many others are await to meeting you!! Greatest achievement of all of the glorious Kazakhstani's game dev! You can play this game even if your brother bit your hands off - you need no hands to play! Make girl happy, give her money or give her nice ring and she will take her cloth for you, you don’t press nothing! Chenquieh. High five! Great success!

title: Yandere Goth BDSM 7
description: Experience a Sunday with Kuromisa, your 261cm tall, giant, goth, dominatrix girlfriend who's slowly getting more and more obsessed with you, the same way you're getting more and more obsessed with her.

title: Wicked Subway
description: They were just two best friends on a mostly empty train. The night train, the last one of the night that usually took all the lonely women home after the clubs had closed. What sort of trouble could this futa lesbian couple find in such a public setting?

title: Beauty and the Thug
description: A poignant romance with straight or pure lesbian romantic options. 13 fetishes to learn. Over 27,000 images and 3,200 animations!

title: Stay in the Moment
description: Stay at This Moment is a short visual novel with a single storyline. It tells the story of the mutual change and reconciliation between Bai Xiaoxi and Lv Xiaowen, a teacher and student, triggered by a collection of poems.

title: The Dead Daughter
description: A single-player psychological horror visual novel. Simply click through the main storyline, presented in text and images. It's short but captivating.

title: Lunar Mirror
description: "Lunar Mirror" It is a horror suspense decryption game with the theme of Cthulhu in the research institute. Nishimura Qiren's girlfriend mysteriously disappeared on campus. As the investigation deepened, strange events happened one after another

title: Stardom
description: "Star Dream," released by Gloria Entertainment on January 15, 1995, is a simulation game and the first in the "Star Dream" series. In the game, players assume the role of Zhou Yingtong's high school classmate, managing an agency. The goal is to win three major awards within two years, as mandated by the chairman.

title: Stardom 2
description: Players take on the role of a female artist and also serve as her own manager. Over three years, develop her acting career based on her own business model and embark on the journey to becoming a superstar.

title: Stardom 3
description: Stardom 3 combines simulation, development, adventure and puzzle. Players play the role of an agent, facing difficulties such as the artist being poached, the father suffering a heart attack, and the company being in debt of tens of millions and about to go bankrupt. They must discover and cultivate potential stars of tomorrow to turn the tide. As an agent, players must not only arrange the schedule for the star, act as a nanny and follow the artist to the announcement, but also work hard.

title: The Sea-Demon
description: A team of detectives was invited by the owner of Octopus Island to solve a six-year-old mystery involving a siren. They were given 24 hours to complete their investigation and submit their own answers. In the end, seven completely different solutions emerged...

title: Hellcrackers
description: Hellcrackers is a survivors-like you can play solo or with up to 8 friends locally. Fight waves of monsters, and buy upgrades from the coins you collect! If you are a few coins short you can always accept curses for some extra cash!

title: Finding Chuchu
description: Ari’s side-scrolling shooting adventure to find the cat ChuChu! Use over 20 spells with simple controls for strategic gameplay. Create and share maps with the Map Maker, or conquer maps made by other players!

title: Earthling's Undertaking
description: "Tian Di Gui Xu" is a Cultivation RPG and strategy game based on ancient Chinese mythology. Players assume the role of the leader of a declining sect, journeying through the mysterious world of Taichu, managing their sect and training disciples, seeking immortals and cultivating the truth to improve their cultivation. They explore the reasons behind the tilt of the heavens in Taichu, uncover the hidden conspiracies of the immortals, break free from the constraints of fate, and compose their own myths and legends.

title: Project 0.1
description: Project 0.1 is a fast-paced, roguelike action game inspired by Vampire Survivors. With 15 unique skills to unlock and evolve, you must experiment with different builds to survive relentless enemy waves. How long can you survive the chaos?

title: In The Liminality
description: A psychological-cosmic horror experience, unique in story, art, and heart. Bear witness to a tale of girl's love, rage, hurt, and healing. Only you can bring it an end. Only you can bring World Revolution.

title: Mirklurk: Every Step Matters
description: You've been exiled to The Mirk - an unforgiving swampland where every step could be your last. You must constantly make choices: what paths to take, which tree to shelter under, what beasts to engage or avoid, what items to bring into the darkness of dungeons, and what treasures to leave behind.

title: Train Hero
description: Train Hero is a retro-themed action-puzzle game where you conduct trains, switch tracks and use your brain to avoid collisions and make sure that all trains arrive at their stations on time.

title: In The Well
description: Escape the well and find out who you really are... Lost in the snowy lands, find the answers to your questions

title: Py-oneers
description: Journey through a digital world where Python powers your progress. Solve coding puzzles, dodge obstacles, and reveal secrets in this educational platformer. Each level unlocks new skills and challenges—can you conquer the code and reach mastery?

title: MetaStrike
description:
MetaStrike is a first-person game, multiplayer team-playing be inspired by two blockbuster titles CSGO and COD.
So you will feel very familiar,easy to participating in MTS but that is not all, you will have countless other interesting experiences from many different game modes..

title: EasyTetris
description: Very simple casual elimination game, on the basis of Tetris, the setting is more simplified, there is no upper limit of points, no time regulation, simple and easy to operate.

title: BeachHead Rogue
description: BH Rogue is the next exciting iteration of the BeachHead brand. It blends the action FPS of the original BeachHead game with new Rogue-lite elements.

title: Go
description: Classic Weiqi, Igo, Baduk, Discover Go Like Never Before! Welcome to a world where strategy and skill meet in the ancient game of Go, now available at your fingertips.

title: Metal Head Warfare
description: Metal Head Warfare is one of the best fast-paced shooting games in 4K and 120 FPS, modern and with wonderful graphics, where players collect super powers and become increasingly powerful to defeat chaos and evil in a world on the brink of the abyss.

title: Seed Adventure
description: The MOST DIFFICULT Game Ever Made. A 3D platformer where you play as a seed traveling through 6 environments to save its village.

title: God of Gamblers
description: Participate in the God of Gamblers Tournament to compete for the Ring of God of Gamblers, date casino beauties, and whether you can gain intimacy is up to you.

title: Sid Meier's Civilization V: Enlightenment Era
description: The Enlightenment Era, The Century of Lights, The Age of Reason. Those are but a few names people have dubbed the Eighteenth Century, one hundred years that pushed the world into the direction of scientific and social progress. A mod for Civilization V that fleshes out the midgame with a new era featuring new technologies, units, and more.

title: Belot
description:
Belot is a single level short adventure for Doom 2, set in the shell of an old monastery.
Tested in Nugget Doom at MBF21 compatibility, with some extra features for Nugget Doom players (custom HUD, custom UI sounds). Designed to be played without mouselook, jumping, or crouching.

title: Mech Builder 3D
description: Become a master modeler in Mech Builder 3D. Experience the relaxing process of assembling, customizing, posing and displaying all the 61 model kits with complete freedom without ever losing a piece.

title: Nova IV
description: Nova IV is a 33-map MBF21 compatible megawad designed by newer or intermediate Doom mappers, built over the span of 16 months by some of the most talented fresh faces in the community.

title: PVZ Fusion
description: Plants vs. Zombies Fusion is a fan-made game based on the original Plants vs. Zombies and developed on the Unity engine by LanPiaoPiaoFly that begin on May 8th 2024.

title: Tellyport
description:
Play as Sally, the granddaughter of a brilliant and eccentric inventor, who invited you to explore her 70s lab, filled with unique inventions.

Solve puzzles by crossing TV screens that alter your gravity, size, or both. Observation, manipulation, and thinking are key to progressing!

title: Breath of Life
description: Breath of Life - a dark third-person action RPG. You are an Incarnation, born from the Void to tread where the dead cannot rest. Each portal is a step toward the artifact "Breath of Life" and a step deeper into the abyss.

title: Sid Meier's Civilization V: Future Worlds
description: "For tomorrow belongs to the people who prepare for it today." This mod extends the Information Era of Civilization V by adding near-future technologies, improvements, buildings, and units, which continue onward into a new, endgame Future Era.

title: Honto ni Atta! Noroi no Choujou Genshou Chousa-sha
No More Furries
description: Hordes of Werewolves siege the world and you alone must find out how to stop it. Fight in a Singleplayer Round-based Shooter as you fight off waves of enemies. Only the strongest can survive the longest in this action packed game.

title: SteelMechBattle
description: Steel Mech Battle is a 3D robot action game designed exclusively for solo and offline play. Team up with AI allies and take on 4-on-4 battles as you progress through each stage. Defeat enemies to earn points and unlock stronger weapons, experiencing stage-clear style action with every victory.

title: Domain of Hallucination
description: Domain of Hallucination is a Bullet Heaven game with Bullet Hell elements. During your hallucination, you can build your own map and choose your own challenges. Drink the potion, enter the Domain of Hallucination, and survive!

title: Prism of You
description: Experiment with emotions in this emergent sandbox simulation by identifying, engaging, and expressing dynamic creatures known as Emoes -- all while trying to maintain balance and uncover the secrets of this mysterious alien world.

title: Forgive for Ever
description: In this war-torn age, people can only place their hopes in the gods. As a divine messenger, you must help the believers fulfill their wishes! For loved ones, for freedom, for faith—how far can human willpower go?

title: Quiete
description: A hardcore open-world survival action RPG set during the Eon of the Forbidden Chant, when a great calamity rendered the spoken word unusable. Explore, fight, loot, and survive. Conquer, if you can.

title: RadioWave: Black Signal
description: This isn't the RadioWave you remember... discover the lore and even more origins behind the story of RadioWave in this thrilling prequel chapter and find out how Tim Spencer started his rampage.

title: Between Worlds
description: MAT is a young boy trapped in a school he barely recognises. Help him in the search for answers, shifting between worlds, uncovering new challenges, creatures, and abilities in each of them. Explore a narrative platformer inspired by the metroidvania genre, made by friends for friends.

title: Divine's Howl
description: In Divine's Howl, you will embody a divine avatar, leading your followers to expand your power across a shattered world.

title: Netbreak
description: Boot a hacker's OS and breach the world's most secure networks. Scan, exploit real-world CVEs, crack credentials and social-engineer your targets — all from a living terminal. Stay a ghost or get traced. 100+ commands, 100+ missions, 5 endings. You're not playing a hacker. You ARE the operator.

title: Jeffy's Infinite Irida
description: Jeffy's Infinite Irida is a mod centered around horror-themed SML content.

title: Guns of Salvation
description: A dark Metroidvania where failure is eternal… and redemption is earned in blood.

title: The Floor Above
description: A claustrophobic anomaly-horror game where you can only turn, blink, and decide: is it real or not? Survive five endings and uncover Mike’s story.

title: Trophy Phishing
description:
Cruise around the cyber sea and fish for over 200,000 models from the Discmaster archive!

Preserve the ones you like on a pedestal on the deck of your boat, release the ones you don't care for.

Marvel at all this stuff - people made it! Where are they now? Who were they? Did they have a good time making all these models, or was it a miserable endeavor?

title: Techmino
description: Welcome to Techmino, a block-stacking game by 26F Studio! Immerse yourself in more than 100 modes of this modern yet familiar game, with a variety of difficulties so everyone can have a great time! Hang out and challenge your friends and players around the world in the multiplayer modes, and discover some hidden easter eggs all over the game!

title: Skigill
description: Fight! Collect! Explore! Experiment! Survive! Master the Skigill, a large skill tree spanning the entire battleground, to power your character and survive waves of enemies. Unlock upgrades, weapons, and characters in a meta sigil after each game, and maybe you'll see the end!

title: Benefitship: The Hallowed Wiener
description: In this sequel to Benefitship, the story of Amy and Chloe continues as an old friend of Amy's comes back into her life, sparking plenty of sexual tension.

title: Knightoban
description: Knightoban is a fantasy-themed puzzle game where a brave knight ventures into a dungeon filled with deadly traps and ancient secrets. Your goal is to clear the path and collect all the treasures to complete each level. By pushing blocks, sealing acid holes, and unlocking gates, you’ll create a safe route for the knight to reach every treasure.

title: Terminal Descent
description: Terminal Descent is a terminal-based mining incremental game. Upgrade drills, automate operations, smelt metals, and descend deeper. ASCII graphics with active/idle hybrid gameplay in your terminal.

title: Dead Space Collection
description: A bundle of the original Dead Space trilogy.

title: Soulfused
description: Soulfused is a modern take on the classic text adventures from the early days of computer gaming. Dive into a dystopian future ruled by an empire focused on conquest and control. Take on the role of a newly converted Soulfused; a part human/part robot soldier in service to the Empire.

title: Parasocial Climbing
description:
A climbing game where twitch chat can directly modify the level by placing or destroying blocks.

Chatters can place blocks at exact coordinates by typing

title: Franchise Hockey Manager 12
description: Franchise Hockey Manager returns for the 2025-26 season with plenty of new additions to the deepest, most authentic hockey strategy gaming experience you can find. Choose from teams around the globe and select a team to guide to glory, including a chance at the ultimate prize, the Stanley Cup.

title: Nutty Nemesis: Nile's Downfall
description: Shooter about a squirrel fighting a corporation that destroyed his home

title: IRL: Italian Ritual Live
description: A streamer, a live IRL in a forest searching for a creature from Italian folklore... what could possibly go wrong?

title: Zenless Zone Zero: Update 2.3 - Memories of Dreams Bygone
description:
Version 2.3 of Zenless Zone Zero, which includes:
• New Characters: Lucia, Yidhari and Komano Manato
• New Main Story Quest: Memories of Dreams Bygone
• New events
• ...and more!

title: Deltarune: Plugged Dream
description:
After completing the Mantle minigames in the S-Rank room, Susie shows up and pulls you out of them, leaving you with... A LOT of questions.
But… what if things didn’t go quite the same?

What if something was... weirder?

That's where the idea is coming from:

Now, after completing these minigames, Ramb comes in to ask you some questions of games and how fun they were. But after that, he tells that there are lots, lots of unfinished Mantle prototypes exist on discarded cartridges, but, as Ramb knows, none will boot on the console. With jealousy that Kris won't be able play the games, Ramb decides to tell a backup plan, and...

Well, something surely happens!

title: Mang Ojek: Driving Test
description: Ojek Online Simulation Game

title: Robo's Sandbox
description: Robo's Sandbox by RoboArray lets you play as Carl in a dynamic, evolving world. Meet quirky characters like Bob, Jeff, and Carl’s Cat, explore new locations with each update, and interact with objects, tools, and a money system. Seasonal events and decorations keep the sandbox fresh and immersive.

title: Mashup Bros. Super Marionette Brawl
description:
Get ready for the ultimate online brawl in "Mashup Bros."!
Use weapons and jumps to defeat rivals and snatch their coins! Various characters, diverse weapons, and items. Join unpredictable real-time online battles!

title: 2Person
description:
2Person is a 3D co-op and versus platformer played from a second-person perspective, designed with Twitch streaming and speedrunning in mind.
You play as a robot exploring space with friends — all while seeing the game through your teammate’s point of view.

Experience the unique perspective in single-player mode, which simulates second-person gameplay, or team up in 2–4 player co-op and 2v2 competitive modes.

title: Creator's Fall
description: Creator’s Fall is a pixel roguelike with various classes, where you can choose between different paths. The goal is to reach and defeat the final boss at the end of the path. Levels are dynamically generated and feature different biomes. You can choose an upgrade after each level up.

title: Purelove Monologue: Xiaoxiao
description: A sweet encounter between a nerdy artist and a beautiful programmer.

title: Interim Crossroads
description: A visual novel with choices and consequences, set in a purgatory dimension where we must complete certain tasks before we are deemed worthy to move on. Build trust and romance, confront the past, and choose the future.

title: Your Butt
description:
This is a 2048-style game. Use the arrow keys or WASD to slide the pictures, combine two identical pictures into a more advanced picture to get points, and try to get a higher score before filling the entire board!

There are also different styles of patterns to use in the game, each with different background music.

title: Zen Simulator
description: Unwind with this meditation game, guided by the calming sound of the wooden fish. Clear your mind, relieve stress, boost focus, and improve sleep—all in just a few minutes of peaceful gameplay.

title: Hatred and Blood
description: Baptized in Dismay is a psychological horror RPG set in a dystopian 1980s. Nations have turned to isolation and walls to prevent another war. But a curse, or sickness, spreads... consuming people from within and erasing their humanity. Will you endure… or be Baptized in Dismay?

title: Falarma: Open World
description: FALARMA - An open-world adventure where you explore, complete missions, and enjoy every moment of the journey!

title: Don’t Make Her Open Her Eyes!
description: A black-white-red visual novel in the horror genre.

title: It's John's House
description: Anomaly-Spotting Horror inside a cursed manor ruled by the twisted lawyer Dr. John Ravenwood, his voice following your every step and decision. Time loops, shifting horrors, and cruel games await. Spot anomalies. Sign his contract… and no, you don’t get another lawyer.

title: Dark Compass
description: In narrowing tunnels, rolling dice, and the ticking of fate, you measure each breath, each prayer, and your dwindling will to survive.

title: Starlight Blade
description: An adventure-packed slasher where you play as the heir to a legendary blade, crushing armies of faded stars and battling the very creators of the universe.

title: Born for the Light: Wavelength Radiant Collapse
description: Endless world. Endless sky. Endless light. Will the shadows be cast upon all Children dwelling on the Treetops? Regardless, I spread my prosthetic wings, taking a leap of faith.

title: Viking Ventures
description: In Viking Ventures, you awaken in a Viking hall suspended between life and death. There are no battles to fight—only conversations to unravel, keys to discover, and doors that may not lead where you expect. Explore shifting rooms, meet a cryptic bartender, and follow the pull of a quiet destiny in this short, atmospheric narrative adventure.

title: Cummon
description: Catch and evolve over 186 unique CumMon! Turn based combat meets bodily fluids. Can you raise the ultimate team of cum spewing, shit slinging and piss blasting monsters?

title: Pro Soccer Online 2
description: Pro Soccer Online is back and better than ever. Featuring a newer game engine, and built from the ground up, Pro Soccer Online 2 is a bigger and better version of the 1st one. It offers the same smooth, input based, physics driven gameplay, with lots of additional features and QOL improvements.

title: Chronicle of Scarlet
description: Chronicle of Scarlet is a WWA-like role-playing game (RPG) created by Charge Piggy Studio and the Touhou Project. In the game, you play Flandre Scarlet, the second daughter of the True Red bloodline. In this fantasy world, you activate your talents, build equipment, defeat enemies, and make your own decisions as the story progresses.

title: Sculpture
description: A first-person psychological horror that unfolds around Andy, who has just moved into a new trailer park one summer day. Try talking to the seemingly friendly residents.

title: Space Blast
description: You are Zam, the king of Mars. One day, riots take place on the planet and it's up to you to travel the solar system and uncover a massive conspiracy perpetrated by a supernatural being named Fat Cat.

title: Armaphract
description: Take command of a tank company to strike enemies in destructive urban warfare across a shattered megacity. Outmatched and outgunned, ambush and outflank the intelligent military and mercenary forces to succeed on an expedition to the edge of the city.

title: Kaminari
description: Explore a fantasy feudal Japan, teeming with authentic Yokai creatures. Build your own character, choosing a race, class, and combat abilities. Learn the way of the sword, master the elements through magical talismans, or become a master marksman in Kaminari.

title: Queen’s Guard
description: An action RPG where you protect a princess of a fallen kingdom. Experience gripping swordplay with powerful, heavy strikes, and share a turbulent life on the run with the princess. When an age of chaos and destruction begins, protect the princess of destiny—no matter what!

title: Skerda Armor
description: Skerda Armor is a bizarre soulslike set in a distant grotesque world of concrete jungles and strange rural lands.

title: C4: Classical Caliber Combat Contest
description: The Arena Shooter Party Game with Item Boxes, Minigame rounds, loads of Weapons and Modifiers, and a card-based Party Mode! Classic action meets stage hazards, comeback mechanics and comic style in this retro multiplayer FPS with modern twists.

title: Descend With Caution
description: A silly platformer about exploring the depths of a mountain.

title: Vox Populi: Australia 2025
description: Play as an existing or fully customisable political figure, and campaign for many alternative Australian elections! In "Vox Populi: Australia 2025", you and the characters around you must promote your ideas and your popularity throughout the country to claim victory!

title: Shiren the Wanderer: The Tower of Fortune and the Dice of Fate
description:
Adventure with Shiren the Wanderer and his sidekick Koppa, the talking ferret, through a world filled with cunning monsters, deadly traps and countless treasure.
This version of Shiren the Wanderer: The Tower of Fortune and the Dice of Fate is based on the Vita “+” edition but adds three new dungeons (Bladeless Wasteland, Cloister of Certain Doom, and Garden of Destiny), a Music Collection feature, offers expanded language support, and provides a worldwide rescue system.

title: Grand Poker Casino
description: Play poker like a champion!

title: Five S'hIft Masters
description: A fast paced adventuring game featuring challenging combat and satisfying combos.Master knockback attacks to juggle and outmaneuver your enemies in dynamic battles.

title: Middenmoon
description: That's no moon. It's a giant ball of garbage. Build a factory to excavate, wash, sort, classify and disassemble the detritus of ages past.

title: Odiumfloreo
description: A body horror, physics-based sit-n-survive. Prevent abstract threats from twisting your body. Endure nightmares and a reality gone mad. Dive into the kanvas.

title: Merry Bunny Garden
description:
Tipsy-walking Action Game
A spin-off of the "Bunny Garden" that charmed gentlemen across the world, is available now as an action game!
Control "woozy" cast members who can't walk properly and return home avoiding dangers that await!
Your mission is to safely escort these "woozy" cast members home!

title: Zoo Life Simulator
description:
Build and manage your dream zoo from the ground up!
In Zoo Life Simulator, you can play solo or with up to 4 friends in co-op mode take care of animals, expand habitats, manage staff, and keep your visitors happy in this realistic management and simulation experience.

Start small with simple animals and grow your park step by step as you unlock new biomes and exotic species. Feed, clean, and care for your animals while balancing your zoo’s economy and visitor satisfaction. Whether you’re expanding enclosures, rescuing runaway rabbits, or designing the perfect visitor area, Zoo Life Simulator offers a fun and creative sandbox for all animal lovers.

title: Kellan Graves: Fallen
description: A dark sci-fi FPS survival horror. Trapped underground after a fall, Kellan Graves faces the abyss – armed with nothing but a pistol and sheer will to survive.

title: Melody Xmas
description: Melody Christmas is a 2D Arcade game featuring Projekt Melody. Help Melody collect all the gifts before Malady steals all the presents for herself!

title: Who's Hungry?
description:
After a robot invasion that wiped out most humans from existence, a
human calls to DELIVERYCIOUS, one of the few food delivering services left.
You, a Delibot from the same company, must venture to another planet to deliver your
food. Explore a kilometric building where all kinds of bots will try to steal your food!

title: Greek Kitchen Frenzy: Dionysus
description: Craft dishes in Ancient Greece to appease gods and save humanity!

title: Stream Basketball
description: Vossel's Stream Basketball: A live Twitch video broadcasting game that helps engage viewers and grow your channel! Compete in a physics-based game, shoot hoops, and climb the leaderboard for ultimate viewer retention and excitement!

title: Clicker Time
description: Clicker Time is a simple and fun clicker game on Steam, where you earn points and unlock Steam achievements by simply tapping the screen!

title: DragonRoad
description: This is an open world game on 3D, Also a mission centered survival battle game. It includes role-playing, tactical strategy, experience upgrade.It has Dozens scenes and combat tasks, allowing players to complete tasks and receive rewards. It support multi people cooperation on network.

title: Ocean Keeper Co-op
description: Dive into the Ocean Keeper — a cooperative roguelike where four survival miners defend their Mech Spider, fight with endless hordes of monsters, and dig for resources. Team up with your friends, upgrade between waves, and survive the deep caves, full of treasures… if you can.

title: Floss
description: A fast-paced top-down shooter without any excess. Built on aggressive movement, precise controls, and real challenge. Designed for players who love to learn, adapt, and master mechanics.

title: Forsen's Vacation
description: You are a popular Swedish streamer "Forsen". You went on vacation, but something gone wrong and you wake up on the island. Your paddles are stolen so you have to find them to escape the island. Fight chatters from your twitch chat in order to find them and escape the island.

title: Chaos Squad
description: Chaos Squad is a turn-based tactics game with Cthulhu, rouge-lite and survival elements. Build your squad with 10 unique heroes. Embark on 12 levels in a snowy mountain, grassland and more. Defeat monsters, collect treasures and eventually unveil the truth behind the disaster of ruptured continent.

title: Ooble Gardens
description: Ooble Gardens is a cozy game where you, an Ooble gardener care for little Oobles, shaping their dream fairy garden. Merge and combine their offerings to discover a variety of cozy furniture for you to decorate the garden with!

title: Swords and Souls Neverseen
description: From SoulGame Studio, creators of the wildly popular Swords & Souls, comes an all new, even bigger standalone adventure to an island far across the sea. In Swords & Souls: Neverseen you find yourself shipwrecked and caught up in a struggle between a dangerous witch and some decidedly kooky townsfolk. To stop the witch, you'll need to train, fight, train, and fight some more in this addictive single-player combat-focused game that rewards player skill and juicy progression.

title: Blackwood
description: By day, you run a DVD store in 2012 New York. By night, you’re a ruthless assassin. BLACKWOOD is a cinematic third-person shooter with grounded melee combat, brutal takedowns, responsive gunplay, and a double life to manage.

title: Battle Zombie
description: This is a large-scale shooting game with real military battlefields and modern military equipment. Different shooting gameplay challenges your limits!

title: Fastro Dude 2
description: You are a space traveler who finds himself on a mysterious, unexplored planet after the crash of his spaceship

title: S.A.F.E
description: S.A.F.E is a co-op survival horror game where you and your friends must go into procedurally generated castles and dungeons to find junk to throw in the grinder. The game includes many different maps and tons of monsters to keep you and your friends on your heels.

title: Dropcore
description: Dropcore is a 2D online arena game where players use knockback, not damage, to eliminate opponents. Master gravity, dodge bullets, and blast rivals off the stage in chaotic maps. Choose your class, grab a weapon, and outplay your friends in fast-paced physics brawls.

title: A Lenda de Niterói
description: Embark on Arariboia’s journey during the 16th-century struggle for Guanabara Bay. Explore lush forests, face Tupinambás and French forces, and uncover ancestral echoes that still resonate today, in an action-adventure with exploration and metroidvania-inspired elements.

title: Victoria Kopernik: Mother
description: Victoria Kopernik, an occult influencer, uncovers the dark history of a haunted mansion in a short horror point-and-click adventure video game.

title: Len Burns Down a School
description: The Vocaloid Len Kagamine decides to commit arson.

title: Chronosurge: Echoes of the Void
description: Chronosurge Echoes of the Void is an intense roguelite survival game where you forge insane builds to resist infinite hordes of anomalies in a collapsing universe. Master the Chronosurge, adapt your strategy, and test your reflexes to survive the Void and etch your name onto the cosmic leaderboards.

title: The Baby is Here
description: When everything looked like a tragedy he noticed that everything was broken from the beginning with his son. Help Joseph to complete the masterpiece the boy left unfinished on this Survival Horror Game.

title: The Roach Hotel
description: The Roach Hotel is a first person analog horror game that drags you into its halls, where every shadow hides a question and every corner dares you to keep following its path.

title: 8AM: The Office
description: "8AM: The Office" is a suspense game set in a deserted office at night. Observe workers through security cameras and decide if their odd behaviors stem from fatigue or something sinister, aiming to survive until 8:00 a.m.

title: Curupira the Forest Guardian
description: Join Curupira, the legendary guardian of the forest, and heroes inspired by Brazilian folklore to protect nature! ★ Dodge, crouch, and jump to avoid obstacles! ★ Defend the Forest from Threats! ★ Unlock new characters and abilities! ★ Characters inspired by Brazilian Folklore!

title: Scared of Zombies
description: Survive in the city with endless zombies rushing in!

title: Progress Bar Deluxe
description: Loading, loading, loading… when will it ever be ready? Will you finally see the bar reach 100%? In Progress Bar Deluxe, your mission is simple — fill the ultimate progress bar to 100%! Click, upgrade, and wait as you chase that sweet moment of completion.

title: Cold Verdict 3
description: The third and final part of the 'Cold Verdict' trilogy. Claire has spent two years tracking down the elusive masked man who puts people through psychological games. Now she has to get through another of his ordeals if she wants to bring him to justice. Make choices and decide the final outcome!

title: Island of 16 Sisters
description: What mystery is hidden on the island with sixteen beautiful girls? One day Robert wakes up on a cold pavement in the middle of a small town on an unknown island. Soon he finds out he's not alone. There are 16 beautiful girls and a mysterious Father living on the island. What's the secret behind all of this?

title: Interplay's Learn to Program Basic
description: Learn to Program BASIC is an edutainment software title released for the PC and Macintosh by Interplay.

title: Island of 16 Sisters Part 2
description: The second part of the adventure game Island of 16 sisters takes you to new and unexpected parts of the island. Meet more beautiful girls and solve more interesting puzzles. Will you help Robert escape the island this time?

title: Tyr
description: Tyr is a tank shooter where strategy beats twitch reflexes. Pilot heavy-armored vehicles with unique capabilities and upgrade them as you battle for victory with your team.

title: One Giant Hole
description: One Giant Hole is a multiplayer voxel-mining game where players collectively dig an enormous hole through online collaboration. Players contribute to the excavation either alone or with others, communicating through a social media-style chat system, while working together to discover what lies at the bottom of their shared excavation project.

title: Drifter Star: Evolution
description: From a stardust speck to a galaxy-devouring titan. In this unique cosmic evolution game, experience the full life cycle from asteroid to galaxy. Each consumption brings growth; each evolution requires choice. The universe's ultimate secrets await your discovery.

title: Lo and Behold
description: Lo and Behold is a cozy-tinged action roguelike where you play as Lo, heir to an owl lineage. Descend shifting dungeons, transmute souls into powers, forge living weapons, and keep your village alive as you face the Vulture King.

title: Rohan II
description: In a mythic world, players choose from multiple races and classes, join guilds, battle in large-scale PvP, claim territory through boss wars, and explore dungeons and fields. The game also features a unified account system and a free economy allowing open trades and market transactions.

title: I am Machine
description: Fight through a machine-ruled world in this isometric rogue-lite adventure. As Erik, a man-turned-robot, outsmart waves of enemies and adapt to ever-changing levels. Change the world before it changes you in this relentless quest for vengeance.

title: Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition - The Canary & The Trader
description: Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition’s first DLC, The Canary & The Trader, expands the base game with two additional CPU lords, each with their own distinctive playstyles, as well as an original nine mission Sands of Time trail to truly test the bounds of your strategic skills.

title: Assassin’s Creed Mirage: Valley of Memory
description:
A free major update introducing the new region of AlUla and featuring a new story arc for Basim. Players can explore the landscapes of deserts and oases as they uncover family secrets and face a ruthless gang threatening the valley’s peace.

The update also includes many gameplay improvements and changes for the whole game, including smoother parkour and mobility improvements, replayable missions and challenges, customizable experience with new difficulty levels, skills and tools customization and expanded features and fixes.

title: Ruindrift
description: Ruindrift is a fast-paced RPG built around short, intense battles and tight skill-based combat. Choose your class, craft your build, and be relentless as you fight your way through colorful hand-drawn worlds in ruin.

title: GT Racing 1980
description: Take a journey back to the 80's and race some of the greatest cars ever made, in a retro arcade style racing experience. Race against some of the most iconic racers, build rivalries and unlock special rewards.

title: Okiro
description: Okiro is a post-apocalyptic 3D adventure puzzle game where players embody Lulu, a plant sprite, exploring toxic fog-covered ruins. Solve intricate puzzles, navigate hidden paths, and collect energy stones to activate seeds that restore ecological balance through the power of plant growth.

title: Assault Commander Rearmed
description: Assault Commander Rearmed is a turn-based military strategy game played on a hexagonal map.

title: Jezzball Classic Deluxe Edition
description: In JezzBall, your goal is to contain bouncing Jezz atoms by building walls. Complete levels by converting over 75% of the chamber into walls, adding a new atom each time. Left-click to deploy walls and right-click for direction.

title: Hydropawnics
description: Take this shoot to the moon! Help this space cat on their mission to the stars by fixing generators, dodging lasers, and keeping the last plant alive in Hydropawnics!

title: FlyingChicken
description: Two-dimensional (2D) graphics: simple and colorful. Easy to play: control with just one tap, but be careful, every move is recorded! Challenges are fun: levels full of exciting thrills and increasing challenges. Global Competition: Compete and challenge your choices for the highest points!

title: Xerminus
description: Survive randomized waves of enemies in top down arena combat. No upgrades or roguelite elements. No survivors.

title: Sarah's Great Adventure
description: In the world of dreams, be a hero who saves the world!

title: Brickade
description: A skill-based journey through the world of the brick-breaking arcade genre. Master precise angle shots, get slimed, dodge falling barrels, crack open safes, or drop a precision airstrike on a swarm of flying bomb-bats blocking a laser switch... all while smashing every brick in sight.

title: Halloween Trouble 6: Pumpkin Rampage
description: Halloween Trouble 6: Pumpkin Rampage is a spooky Match-3 puzzle that follows the adventures of the witch, Ronida. When a magical battle with a wizard goes awry, it causes the magic creatures of the swamp to run amok, threatening the peaceful town of Jamberton!

title: Sifu's Quest
description: Be a young sword man to explore and save the world. A turn-based WuXia RPG game with strategic combat system.

title: Urban Shadows Racing Tokyo
description: Urban Shadows Racing Tokyo - intense races on the neon-lit streets of Tokyo. Compete against other racers, upgrade your cars, and prove you're the best on the track.

title: TD3D
description: In Tower Defense 3D, the enemy may walk on the wall, and you can also build the tower on the wall, so you have to consider No longer just a plane, but the entire space.

title: DJLand
description: Exquisite Art Style - More exquisite and comfortable than arcade graphics, perfect upgrade for gaming experience!

title: RoundZ
description: A round-based zombie shooter in VR and on PC. Battle zombies, upgrade weapons, face tough rounds and play with your friends. Join forces and immerse in the world of RoundZ to see if you can survive the apocalypse.

title: IAH: Internet War
description: "IAH: INTERNET WAR" - a roguelike Turn-Based RTS hybrid survival game. Battle through the internet’s depths and survive as long as possible.

title: Anti-TuringTest
description: Fiction style DBG strategy game: During the game you will walk among the gigantic artificial city, bloody battlefield, ancient ruins. They are full of danger, waiting to be challenged. Only by getting stronger you can understand the ultimate purpose of this trial.

title: Honey Trap Amnesia
description: In this game, you play as the protagonist and make your way through the story in visual novel format. Sit back, relax, and enjoy the adventure!

title: USD Clicker
description: The most simple clicker game with endless USD cash

title: Europa One
description: Explore the ice-encrusted ocean of Jupiter's moon Europa.

title: Learn Spanish! Easy Vocabulary
description: Learn over 200 Spanish words with authentic native pronunciation, mini-games and total immersion in Spanish.

title: Lingua Franca
description: Lingua Franca is a puzzle game all about taking pictures. Help a young girl capture an alien by finding the materials she needs to make her trap, photographing the world to get others to help her, and maybe even helping them along the way.

title: University Life Visual Novel
description: Welcome to University Life! Set in the vibrant town of Falls Ville, you're about to embark on an incredible journey filled with new experiences and opportunities.

title: Cardboard Battle Tanks: Desk Division
description: Battle your friends in thrilling, top-down, cardboard tank-on-tank combat! Annihilate your friends with sick bank-shots, dominate the battlefield with a tank loadout tailored to your playstyle, and unlock new parts to expand your arsenal! With Steam Workshop support, theres so many maps to play!

title: Reincarnation: Hero of the Gun
description: Text Idle Game

title: Indulgentia
description: Strategic block puzzle with NSFW AI unlockables. Combine block pieces drawn from your deck to solve stages and unlock explicit AI-generated artwork. Clear goals to reveal seductive characters, mature scenes, and hidden desires.

title: The Lustful Touch
description: The Lustful Touch is an 18+ visual novel in which massage becomes more than just a service, but a revelation. Hidden desires, subtle emotions, and touches that can break down the boundaries between care and temptation. One meeting. One session. Everything can change.

title: Highway Warriors Remastered
description: You've arrived to the highway racing scene from watching drift comps and partaking in them with an old, slightly modified entry-level sports car, what do you do? Maybe you need to have some lessons of speed, or teach the others about cornering?

title: Zelensky vs Poroshenko: The Destiny of Ukraine
This Is Why We Don't Play Golf
description: Golfing, but up a bizarre mountain where every 'I got it!' is a lie. A chaotic co-op physics platformer where falling is half the fun... probably.

title: Starship Scarwolf
description: Starship Scarwolf is a 2D top-down omnidirectional shooter. As I'm a fan of vector scan games, I aimed to create an expression using only wireframe rendering. However, I couldn't achieve this with just dots and lines, so I also used fill and circle drawing functions.

title: Bert: The Game
description: Happy and normal game about Bert to laugh :)

title: New Yankee: Pirate Trap
description: Just when King Arthur's heroes thought they'd earned a break, the Gremlin pulled a mysterious chest from the sea. Captain Ghost, the chest’s owner, casts Camelot’s heroes to an uninhabited island, where they must compete for their freedom!

title: Horse Tales: Emerald Valley Ranch - Unicorn Tack Set
description:
Add a touch of fantasy to your stable!

Discover 3 magnificent unicorn tack sets for your horses.

title: Horse Tales: Emerald Valley Ranch - The Rainbow Tack Set
description: Discover 3 magnificent rainbow harnesses for your horses.

title: Arena of Gods
description: Arena of Gods is a fast-paced free-to-play PVP card game with rich strategies. Integrating four major myths, the game has hundreds of deities for players to choose from. Flexibly use public cards and build decks to fight, opening up thousands of strategic possibilities!

title: Grow Empire: Rome
description: Hey Caesar! Defend your fortress and build your roman empire

title: Upworm
description: Upworm is a physics challenge platformer. Guide your worm up the sculptures. Can you reach the top?

title: IcoNick Duster: Planets Defender
description: Nick Duster, better known as "IcoNick", a war veteran of the intergalactic congregation, who has been brought back to defend the planets from hostile alliances. Control your turret, with high firepower. 3 game modes: Contracts, Asteroids and Invasion. Full of action. Hundreds of galaxies awaits. Go!

title: Grind Rush
description: Join an intense off-road race where 16 vehicles collide! Compete with buggies and monster trucks through forests and canyons. Destroy courses and rival cars to reach the top!

title: Red Circuit Rebellion
description: Fast, aggressive, mech shooter with fully destructible environments, swarming adaptive enemies, and arcade-fast action. Upgrade your mech and fight through escalating chaos again and again.

title: Streamlands: Defense
description: A low-poly Tower Defense game inspired by World War I and II, in an original universe.

title: Tinker Toy Theatre
description: Brave performers from across the lands have gathered at the Tinker Toy Theater! Battle across the magical stage with all kinds of wind-up soldiers, put on a good show for the audience, and win the heart of the Princess!

title: Silver Moon
description:
Our protagonist grows up in Geo, a facility that gives special education for gifted children. He rejects life as an elite and instead lives a normal college life.

Suddenly, he's confronted with a woman called V.A. who informs him about his abnormal physical condition and declares he has 15 days left to live.

The four girls surrounding him, the secret of "Geo", and the intentions of the mysterious V.A... How will he survive the remaining 15 days of his life?

title: King of Rats: Enter the But Hole
description: I am not fully confident that this game won't give you brain damage so exercise caution.

title: Rainy Blue: 6 Gatsu no Ame
description: The protagonist and his childhood friend, Ao, both aspired to become artists, but her life was tragically cut short by a car accident. While the protagonist was despairing from the loss of his friend, a small doll that Ao had once given him came to life. The doll, named Aoi, encourages him not to give up on his life and his dreams of art.

title: Spookshow
description: Spookshow is a retro horror game where you play solo or with friends as the unlucky stars of a 1990's midnight TV Show. Create your episode by selecting your map, monster, and character, then fight to survive each terrifying tale — or step into the monster’s shoes and make the show a scream.

title: Graviton Flux
description: Graviton Flux is a fun action-packed puzzle game. Differently colored particles are constantly being attracted towards the center. Rotate the center to match similarly-colored particles to make them explode and prevent them from reaching the outer ring. Try to reach the rank of Grandmaster!

title: Purrfect Stall
description: Purrfect Stall! Is a game A cosy 3D management game where you serving ice cream and tanghulu to customers and fight off your boss Capymayor at the end of each day. With each day the game gets quicker and boss gets more intense. As you try and keep on top of managing the store.

title: Exanimora
description: A hack-and-slash adventure with Soulslike intensity. Battle through a cursed world of corrupted horrors as one of the gifted undead, where death is only a setback and survival demands skill, grit, and relentless will.

title: Planet Coaster 2: Bonus Ride Collection
description:
The Planet Coaster 2: Bonus Ride Collection contains three thrilling rides designed to give your guests an extra boost of fun:

FD Vision – Powered Rotating Ride: A classic rotating ride of the much-adored omnimover variety, the FD Vision never truly stops! This powered ride consists of a chain of vehicles operating on a fixed speed track that must be boarded and disembarked on the move via its accompanying conveyor belt.

The Cube: Bear witness to the tumbling terror of geometry that is the Cube! Your guests will twist, spin and squeal with glee amidst the rides numerous rotating squares.

Outamax – Water Coaster: This tall and speedy water-based coaster uses a unique double life elevator to propel your guests from one massive splash to the next.

title: Heat 'n Hit: The Blacksmith Simulator
description: You are a blacksmith in a medieval fantasy world. Take over your missing grandfather's workshop, forge legendary weapons, and rise from apprentice to legend. Explore distant cities, gather rare materials, and uncover the mystery behind your grandfather's disappearance.

title: Bedtime Stories
description: Bedtime Stories is a wholesome 2D platformer with fun, forgiving combat where you play as the imaginary heroes in Cantonese and Indonesian fairytales. Face creatures inspired by Traditional Puppet Theatre, only to realise that the allies you form along the way are much more powerful.

title: Bleakmoor House
description: Bleakmoor House is a psychological horror game where you navigate a shifting maze of dark rooms, solve puzzles, and uncover the mansion's secrets. Face terrifying encounters and unravel the twisted history to survive the deadly traps within.

title: Stadium
description: Welcome to Stadium. The Original Game Changer. Pick your Sport, Lead your City, Win a Championship, Build a Dynasty, Leave a Legacy. You play the games, you make the calls. Bring your cards to life. Stadium is a brand new strategy game system unlike anything you've played before.

title: Unit Zero: Operation Black Veil
description: Unit Zero is a first-person multiplayer shooter with realistic bodycam-style graphics made in Unreal Engine 5. Includes competitive and cooperative zombie modes. Investigate what went wrong in the secret operation that unleashed the nightmare.

title: Red Spider: Vengeance Remastered
description: Fully voiced, with over 530 CGs, and an estimated total playtime of 7-8 hours (approx. 1 hour per route). Homages to classic Hong Kong films and characters based on real-life famous actors immerse you in a deep, cinematic drama. The "Cyclopedia" included in the game provides detailed explanations of which scenes reference which films, and which characters are inspired by which actors.

title: Triangle Defense
description: An atmospheric tower defense game with intentionally imbalanced mechanics. Deploy defenses and skills to stop enemies. Through multi-tiered levels, learn from failures to adapt strategies and secure victory.

title: Maguntsche: Chapter Two
description: The job was simple: Unifying encrypted data and company records. In the quiet town of Macungie, Pennsylvania, the sprawling warehouse is a monument to a forgotten prosperity and a mysterious downfall. Will you withstand these otherworldly influences as you connect the past and present?

title: Prince of Darkness Jr.
description: It's 'Vamps vs Lamps' in this box-pushing, shadow-casting, mind-bending puzzle game. Push blocks, open doors, smash windows, and discover secrets -- but whatever you do, don't touch the light!

title: Carteado
description: Defeat monsters and climb the floors! Carteado is a casual top-down roguelite where you use your cards to defeat enemies while building your deck and unlocking new cards!

title: ShipCrafter
description: ShipCrafter is a naval sandbox simulation game. Build you ship, unlock new components and defeat increasingly powerful foes in the campaign !

title: Desktop Defender
description: An idle auto-battler that sits in the corner of your screen while you do other things.

title: Soul Demon Hunters
description: Soul Demon Hunters is a 2D side-scrolling action game with pixel graphics, where you resolve supernatural phenomena across the world through combat.

title: Chess With Idiots
description: Shape the turn order in a speed-based tactical roguelike. Adapt to shifting battlefields, overcome unique bosses, and unlock powerful new abilities as you guide a band of idiots through four perilous and distinct regions!

title: Ethernia
description: 2D pixel art MMORPG with real-time combat, gathering, crafting, and immersive storytelling. Evolve your class, fight monsters, and discover if you're the Heir of Ethernia.

title: Cumming of Age
description: A young man prepares for his "Coming of Age" ceremony by getting blessings of the ancient Greek goddesses. A rich lewd visual novel over 125.000 words about Greek mythology.

title: Kkokko Industry
description: Kkokko Industry is a relaxing idle game where you manage a chicken farm. The game runs on one side of your monitor, allowing you to enjoy it comfortably while working on other tasks.

title: Heroic Hop: A New Adventure Begins
description: Jump, dodge, and fight through challenging retro-style 2D platforming with deadly traps, moving platforms, and epic bosses. Featuring tight controls, a dynamic life system, and a free demo, Heroic Hop is a thrilling test of skill and resilience. Add it to your wishlist now!

title: The Dream Globe
description: Idler game inside an antique dream globe, build the small home and help the mini dream world grow

title: Slingbox
description: Slingbox is a minimalist, physics-based 2D platformer where precision and momentum are everything. Master your dash and rope mechanics to swing, launch and race through clean abstract levels. Beat the clock, earn medals and chase perfection.

title: Peganomics
description: A roguelike pachinko about building outrageous synergies with pegs, balls, and buckets. Chase massive scores, discover chaotic combos, and break the economy of pegs in your quest for the ultimate run.

title: Chains on Sand
description: Enter the blood-soaked arenas of Chains on Sand, a brutal turn-based roguelike where every strike counts. Build a unique gladiator, survive tactical grid-based combat, and rise through fame, death, and legacy — or die forgotten beneath the sand.

title: Vribyss Refuge: Metamorphosis
description: Vribyss Refuge Metamorphosis is a small fantasy RPG about a refugee seeking out others who've also been displaced because of religious persecution.

title: Soilborn: Ant Empire
description: Ever wondered what it’s like to rule an empire beneath your feet? Build it. Command it. Survive.

title: Soul Gather
description: "Soul Gather is an intense Challenging indie horror game where survival is key. collect 10 souls in each chilling level while evading relentless pursuers, including demons, ghosts, vampires, clowns, spiders, minotaur's, and more. Can you escape their grasp and gather all 10 of the Souls Per level ?

title: Iblis3: Phenomena
description: IBLIS 3: PHENOMENA is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore a mysterious house in a slow-paced, atmospheric environment with terrifyingly realistic settings that keep you constantly on edge and experience a truly horrifying journey.

title: Abyssal Drift
description: Explore abyssal mazes as a jellyfish in a retro 1-bit puzzle — find the key, unlock the door, and dive ever deeper.

title: Path of the Zenith Master
description: Path of the Zenith Master is an action-adventure game. Once a disciple of a reclusive mountain clan, you are chosen to forge your own path to mastery when your clan faces imminent peril. Through trials of fire and steel, transform into the unyielding pillar that safeguards your ancestral stronghold.

title: Hidden Nature
description: Each level offers a new way to discover the hidden dark side of your peers. Will your friendship stay intact or become corrupted like so many others?

title: Galaxy Defense War
description: 'Galaxy Defense War' is a roguelike tower defense game where you need to select suitable galactic principles from randomly dropped heroes and equipment to form a combat-ready team to resist alien invaders.

title: Sinister Remains
description: In the shadow of a curse that has endured for decades, explore a town haunted by twisted truths and terrifying events. As you search for the remnants of the past, you’ll uncover the darkness around you and within yourself.

title: Banana Loco
description: A thrilling tile-based treasure hunt where players uncover banana prizes while dodging traps and explosive surprises. Are you ready to go bananas?

title: Egglets: The Long 10 Days
description: A 10-day crisis management simulation. As Eggon’s administrator, you follow absurd orders, manage chaos, and seek truth between news and rumors. Obey commands – or choose humanity? The fate of the Egglets rest in your hands.

title: Tui Shou: Sokoban
description: "Tui Shou: Sokoban" is a 2D Sokoban-style puzzle game. You need to push boxes marked with different attributes while following rock-paper-scissors rules to move them to designated spots. Be careful! Some incorrect moves will cause boxes to disappear! Let the challenge begin!

title: BeatBucs
description: Hop on a rhythm pirate adventure! Dodge enemies and face off against epic bosses, each moving to their own original track. From dancing crabs to Penguin DJs, navigate a dangerous pirate world. Can you survive the beat?

title: Escape: Mall
description: Wake up in a closed mall and you are alone.. or maybe not? With no way out but going down, you must descend using elevator through each floor.

title: Right & Left Column Battle
description: Right & Left Column Battle is a turn-based roguelike strategy game. Its round loop (position reset, recruit units, choose columns, unit combat) hides randomness and rich decisions—200+ unique units, with countless build combinations to explore

title: The Useless Wizard
description: An alcoholic wizard with no spells, only rocks, must save his village from depraved monster hordes. Tactical action, chaotic weapon combos, and dark humor collide in this unique twist on the Vampire Survivors formula!

title: Baking Bad
description: A chaotic co-op, rouge like, quota game, where you and your friends are constantly on the run, cooking, looting, and shooting whatever you can to survive.

title: Cats vs. Rats
description: A chaotic roguelite bullet hell where you play as a cute turret-wielding cat blasting through waves of villainous rats. Choose your turret, grab powerful loot, level up, and build devastating combos to survive escalating swarms

title: Spinochet
description: Take aim and splatter tomatoes in this artsy, arcade-style target game!

title: Lust Storm
description: Lust Storm is an adult visual novel that begins with two girlfriends going on a camping trip but they lose their way in an unexpected storm. You play as a college student, studying for your exams at your family's forest house, and you end up inviting two girls seeking shelter from a sudden storm.

title: Soy Supremacy
description: Run a vegan cafe by day, sell illegal meat & fast food by night! Romance rebellious girls while dodging the law in the world of Soy Supremacy, romantic and sweet visual novel. Can you make profit, make your girls happy and stay out of jail?

title: Gnaw
description: Something’s rotten in New Dino City, and it’s up to you to solve the mystery in GNAW. In this Metroidvania, explore a pre-apocalyptic saurian civilization hurtling toward self-annihilation. Meet strange characters, fight off twisted critters, and rescue your beloved city from extinction.

title: Foxo
description: Foxo is a cozy online hangout: play minigames, go fishing, decorate/ expand your room and express yourself with tons of customization options, all with one crucial twist... everyone is a fox!

title: Duck Norris Tales
description: Duck Norris Tales is a run and gun action game heavily focused on boss battles. Play as a brave duck saving the world from an alien invasion. Make friends, discover secrets, wield face melting weapons and most of all shoot first and ask questions later.

title: Overdawn
description: Overdawn is a 2.5D, bullet time shooter set in a dystopian city of Andrean. As a blood-thirst merc, hunt down your enemies and defy against your destiny. Now—lock in. Slow time and find your flow state. Punch a hole in your enemy’s head—because it’s you or them.

title: TapMazing
description: An addictive game where you guide Po-G, a quirky slime hero, through a vibrant and challenging environment. Inspired by scientific experiments, this game offers a unique blend of fun and strategy. Explore a lab full of surprises, where every tap unveils a new discovery!

title: Tank Zero
description: Tank Zero is an action-packed game with tanks where players build their own unique tank from various parts, such as the hull, chassis, cannon, engine, and armor. Each time, players can create different combinations of characteristics and appearances for their tank.

title: Chessemble
description: Customize your board with a host of new pieces. Start with an aggressive forward assault, Or perhaps a defensive fortress designed to weather the storm. Will you outwit, outmanoeuvre, or out-explode your way to victory?

title: Diablo IV: Season of Infernal Chaos
description: Shift the veil between Sanctuary and Hell in the all-new, chaos-fueled Infernal Hordes and their relentless Chaos Waves. Unleash deadly Chaos Perks and hunt down game-changing Chaos Armor to forge devastating, meta-defying builds.

title: Happy Bones: Welcome Home
description: After receiving a frantic message from her father, Laura heads out to her parents house located inside a cult compound to search for the truth, in this complete remake of the classic horror themed JRPG!

title: Death Note: Confrontation
description: A digital port of the board game "Death Note: Confrontation" for Tabletop Simulator.

title: Pondemonium
description: A puzzle-platformer where three ducks (Chuck, Mac, and Peggy) combine their unique abilities to recover eggs, cleanse poisoned ponds and outsmart traps across handcrafted levels.

title: Rendagor
description: A top down 2d pixel art sci-fi shooter. Destroy threats, solve small puzzles, kill bosses in each level to advance to the next. Upgrade your drone with the power-ups and weapons you find around the levels to become increasingly lethal.

title: Touhou Chronicles: Tales of the Two Immortals
description:
An epic chronicle beyond the borders of Gensokyo — a dazzling festival on a new stage!
With the destruction of Gensokyo as its central theme, the immortal Hourai dwellers rise to brilliance in a brand-new world, embarking on an eternal journey to find their long-lost companions!

All main characters from the official Touhou series — along with some “forgotten” faces from the past — make a return, ready to shine once more in this new realm!

What kind of adventures await the girls from Gensokyo beyond the fantasy world they once knew?
What new bonds will guide their futures in this unfamiliar land?

With over 20 playable characters, each featuring unique skills and personalities, you can form the ultimate dream team — one that’s perfectly tailored to your playstyle!

Awaken hidden potential!
Even the same character can evolve in countless ways, creating endless build possibilities and strategies.

Coordinate with your allies through the support combat system, and face off against fierce, tactical foes who will push your team to the limit!

A massive story with over 1 million words, 10 different endings, and deep character arcs that will reveal untold emotional journeys in this unfamiliar world.

Side stories are packed with detail and warmth, shedding new light on the inner worlds of the characters you thought you knew.

With New Game+ and progression carryover, every playthrough makes you stronger.
Whether you aim for the “Level 1 Challenge Run” or “Ultimate Swordmaster Route,” the game offers endless fun and replayability.

Difficulty settings are friendly and flexible — newcomers and veterans alike can enjoy the full experience. Even on easy mode, you’ll get a satisfying, complete ending.

A variety of mini-games, rich and meaningful side quests, and clever puzzles will constantly challenge your curiosity and passion!

Love collecting? The achievement and title system is made for you.
You can also link save data and character cards with your friends for co-op-style shared progress and support battles!

Earn high scores through title achievements — your total score becomes a badge of honor!

A grand conspiracy lies hidden in the threads of fate...
Only your unwavering determination can break Gensokyo free from the cycle of destruction!

All the fun — you’ll only understand once you try.
The longer you play, the deeper the experience becomes. Even after 100+ hours, you’ll still be discovering new rewards.

So come on — step into the fantasy chronicle’s time-space!
In this game world, discover the true charm of RPGs. This experience is one you deserve.

title: Sunset Game Shop Shayou
description: Manage your dream game shop through gaming history starting from 1985. From the Famicom boom to digital distribution—can you survive this management simulation through Japan's biggest gaming shifts?

title: Kinetic
description: A first-person platform game with smooth and responsive movements designed for speedrunning. In Kinetic you will jump, surf and bounce through 50 levels, switch dimensions with portals and challenge yourself on the online leaderboards!

title: Hands of the Sovereign
description: It's time to duel on Fardea Island! Encounter a colourful cast of rivals! Challenge your host: Lord Blackthorn! Assemble your own personal deck, and do battle upon a grid-based battlefield.

title: Reseed
description: Reseed is a puzzle platformer about planning. Record your path through a safe level, then watch it execute through the same level, now filled with traps. Will the seed survive?

title: Match! The 12 CZ Wars
description: Match! The 12 CZ Wars is a roguelike strategy game blending match-3 and buff-building. Partner with 12 Zodiac Maidens to repel ancient primordial beasts. Navigate random events, battles, and upgrades. Carefully choose paths, manage resources, and empower your Maidens to secure victory.

title: Bae Bash! The Chaos Collection
description:
As Bae’s 4th anniversary approached, the Brats sprang into action to make a game worthy of the celebration. But with so many wild and brilliant ideas, they couldn’t choose just one—so they mashed them all together! The chaotic mix of genres and styles created a game so powerful, it pulled Bae in herself! Now trapped inside, she must navigate the madness. What kinds of games await her, and can she find a way out?

The atmosphere is charming and relaxing, with sound design tied to each painting action, creating a cozy and artistic experience.

title: Hula Hula Wee
description: Tropical puzzles, fruity explosions! In Hula Hula Wee, every level is a refreshing mix of logic and fun. Push coconuts across colorful maps, smash them into pineapple towers, and watch as they burst together into delicious Piña Coladas. The rules are simple, but the challenge keeps growing. Slide coconuts carefully, plan your moves, undo mistakes infinitely, and use bonfires to burn obstacles out of the way. To complete a stage, you’ll need to destroy every pineapple tower and outsmart each tricky layout. The adventure spans 30 puzzles across three vibrant settings. Start on CoCo Island, where the basics are introduced with lighthearted challenges. Then head to Hula Beach, where new twists like craters force coconuts to stop mid-path. Finally, climb the Fire Tower, the toughest destination, where bonfires add a fiery layer of strategy to your quest. With its tropical theme, playful mechanics, and clever progression, Hula Hula Wee is the perfect puzzle getaway for anyone who loves a mix of brains and beach vibes.

title: Slide Viking
description: Sharpen your axes and get ready to slide into adventure! In Slide Viking, every move matters as you glide across the grid, smash crates, and collect the treasure chests hidden throughout the kingdom. What starts as a simple journey quickly becomes a true test of logic and planning. You play as a bold viking whose mission is clear: gather every chest of gold the land has to offer. With continuous sliding movement, you’ll need to think several steps ahead, undo mistakes infinitely, and break obstacles that stand in your way. The puzzles grow trickier with each level, mixing clever layouts and satisfying “aha!” moments. The game features 30 handcrafted puzzles across two unique settings. Begin in the Village, a humble place of wood and earth where your skills are forged. Then, prove your worth inside the Castle, the richest and most fortified place in the realm, with stone walls and floors that raise the challenge. Whether you’re after a casual puzzle to relax with or a series of smart challenges to conquer, Slide Viking delivers a journey full of brains, treasure, and plenty of sliding fun.

title: Dice with the Devil
description: Dice with the Devil is a party-based, dice-chucking, deck-building roguelike. Assemble your crew of adventurers, Defeat the DEVIL!

title: Dead Iron
description: Dead Iron is a Western-themed, wave-based horde survival FPS. Fend off endless packs of werewolves. Earn blood money from every kill. Unlock haunted parts of the town as you fight your way uphill toward the final boss waiting in the church under the full moon.

title: C::Reactris
description: A mashup of Minecraft and Tetris, with Tetris style gameplay; Tetrominoes have been replaced by Minecraft's blocks, that interact with eachother in a similar way that they did in Minecraft, the goals and gameplay style are still the same as in Tetris.

title: ¡Tienes 24 Horas!
description: Spanish Game-Jam entry where you control a gravity-less white figure who shoots lasers at enemies to clear stages. Enemies cannot harm the player, but some can shoot projectiles which will push the player back. The goal is to complete the game under a strict time limit.

title: Midnight Escape
description: A weekend getaway turns into a desperate fight for survival. In Midnight Escape, team up with 3 friends to explore a terrifying villa while hunted by a relentless creature. You must find clues, solve intricate puzzles, and find one of the multiple escape routes before the night claims you all.

title: Fit and Fry: Mise En Place
