description: Fit and Fry: Mise en Place is a casual puzzle game set in a restaurant, where every challenge takes place inside a frying pan. The goal is to perfectly organize the ingredients on the board, fulfilling customer orders and progressing through 40 levels that mix strategy and fun.

title: Pond Guardian
description: Pond Guardian is a vertically scrolling shoot'em up feauturing dodging, shooting, and a parry/deflect system.

title: Carnedge
description: Carnedge is a dark fantasy RPG where you drag the Eternal Flame across a dying world. Build deadly decks, summon weird allies, and fight through twisted dungeons full of enemies that hate your guts and watch chaos unfold!

title: Warlocks Maze
description: A Warlock has unleashed chaos upon the World of Eld! Lead a band of heroes into his shifting labyrinth in this brutal turn-based dungeon crawler. Outsmart deadly foes, conquer traps, and adapt to ever-changing challenges. Will you emerge victorious or be lost to the maze forever?

title: Mǐ Mǔ Mǐ Mǔ Hā
description:
“Mǐ Mǔ Mǐ Mǔ Hā” is a life simulation game with a forward-thinking spirit.
In a dream world where loneliness is forbidden, you can pilot your steam-powered flying house to visit friends, or explore themed floating islands alongside your adorable companion, the Mimu. On your very own island, cute Mimus will help you farm, gather, and fish. Enjoy limitless island customization—decorate, build, and share to earn likes and compliments! Host lively parties with friends and experience a wonderfully relaxing, joy-filled life beyond imagination.

title: Wèilái Zhànshì
description: Featuring detailed visuals and rich animations, this game offers 8-directional jumping and shooting, a wide variety of primary firearms, powerful arcing grenades, and devastating special weapons—giving rise to an all-around, Rambo-style protagonist. Enjoy an arsenal packed with diverse, exhilarating weapons that will leave players craving for more!

title: These Four Walls
description:
"A locked door.
It never opens."

These Four Walls is a short game where... nothing happens.

title: Fènnù de Sūnzi Men
description: Paying tribute to the classic Chinese animated series Calabash Brothers, Fènnù de Sūnzi Men is an FPS game where players take on the role of Grandpa, fighting alongside the Calabash Brothers to defend against waves of attacking demons.

title: Grassland Cleaning Worker
description: Mobile and Shooting Players only need to move to play this game. Multiple ability choices Obtain different constructions through upgrades and item drops. Extra limited time capability By picking up limited time ability items, temporary ability bonuses can be obtained.

title: Àoshì Xuè Mó
description:
Amid the vast galaxy of legendary games, a new star rises — Ao Shi Xue Mo!
Blazing onto the stage with thunderous power, it brings unprecedented passion and generous rewards to all legend lovers. Step into a fair, exhilarating, and action-packed new world where classic glory is reborn and your fighting spirit ignites once more!

title: Wàng Wénài Shēng Yì
description:
“This is a moderator simulator game.”
You play as an ordinary content reviewer at a fictional streaming platform, tasked with monitoring live chat messages for sensitive words.
If you spot one — hit the spacebar fast and take it down!
Miss one or make a wrong call, and your performance score will drop.
As for promotions and raises… well, there’s always a chance!

title: Yì Shìjiè Wùyǔ
description:
“Yì Shìjiè Wùyǔ” is a fantasy adventure RPG with character growth and development elements.
In the game, players take on the role of brave warriors who hunt and defeat powerful Origin Beasts to obtain Origin Elements. By crafting mighty Origin Weapons and Origin Gear from these elements, you can enhance your combat power and grow ever stronger on your journey.

title: Fire at Campsite
description: Protect the campsite in this Single-Tower-Defense game where you play as a campfire against the local wildlife! With many abilities and characters at your disposal, try new builds, synergies, and combos to make those animals run away with fear!

title: Office Party
description: Take your escapades into the Office and other new locations in this long awaited sequel to House Party! You've made it through the interview process and you're starting a new job. Make a good impression and get promoted. Make the wrong choices and get demoted. Work your way up the corporate ladder in this hysterical, story-rich 3D adventure game with a lot of new surprises and upgrades from the traditional House Party game play.

title: Mavis Beacon Teaches Typing 2020
description: Maximize your productivity with Mavis Beacon Teaches Typing 2020! The most comprehensive typing instruction system now includes learning tools and an updated user interface to guarantee typing improvements in just 2 weeks!

title: Arcane Rivals
description: Arcane Rivals is a combo‑driven, voice‑interactive PvP fighter. Weave hand signs, then speak the spell into your mic to unleash anime‑inspired techniques. Chain, counter, and outplay in fast duels where precision, timing, and clear calls decide the winner.

title: Broken Sword: The Smoking Mirror - Reforged
description: The award winning adventure returns with 4K visuals and remastered audio. A mysterious escapade of intrigue and deceit, in which journalist Nico Collard and her adventuring companion George Stobbart must overcome powerful forces from fulfilling their evil ambitions

title: Star Conflict: Amber. Weapon of victory
description: This pack includes: Unique weapon “Amber A15”Active module “Drop” active defence, Unique shield modifier “Defence systems configurator”, Unique CPU modifier “Chance” computing adapter, 60 monocrystals. A set of resources with 50 ores each: (Vanadium + Silicon + Graphite + Osmium) + 50 Crystal shards, Pattern “Kittens uprising”, Animated decor “K9”Uniq

title: Darkspy
description: Darkspy is a hardcore first-person stealth shooter with tactical mission planning, reactive AI, and rogue-lite structure. Infiltrate enemy strongholds, choose your loadout and insertion point, and shape the world through your decisions.

title: 101 Cats in Vietnam
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Vietnam landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: 101 Dogs Hidden in Berlin
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in Berlin in the hand-crafted landscape. Earn tons of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: 101 Cats in Moscow
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Moscow landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: Coroconnect
description: "COROCONNECT" is a multiplayer-only action game where teamwork is key. Players use various gimmicks to tackle different stages. Synchronized cooperation is essential for success! Team up with friends or online players to clear all the stages!

title: Tamamoji
description: A little clicker game where you take care of a Tamamoji, an emoji with a changing mood. Click to accumulate points and keep your emoji alive as long as possible!

title: We Are Square
description: WARNING: This game will destroy friendships. In We Are Square you and up to seven friends must work together to control one square and platform yourselves to the goal.

title: Hymble Ventures
description: A cute, quirky level-based adventure where you relive the classic era of collectathon platformers with a modern twist. Explore whimsical worlds, meet charming characters and unlock new abilities as you progress through a diverse set of puzzles, obstacles and denizens.

title: Alruna: End of History
description: Alruna; now in wide-screen! A different kind of Metroidvania, a tour-de-force of game design, with world-class temples and dungeons. Dead men yearn for Heaven, but Elysium remains out of their grasp.

title: Tin Lord
description: Tin Lord is a hybrid of RTS and Tower Defense in a post-apocalyptic world where you control robots that rebuild technology and fight monsters in a destroyed world.

title: Hunter: The Reckoning - A Time of Monsters
description: Topple the vampires from the streets below! Will you unite the homeless, the gangs, and the secret hunter societies to defy vampiric rule? An interactive novel set in the World of Darkness extended universe.

title: Mouseward
description: 3D retro styled collectathon meets souls-like. Play as a tiny mouse warrior solving the mysteries of the fallen stars,

title: Historic Helix
description: Collect map pieces, find ancient artifacts, or chase cosmic mysteries with on-the-fly upgrades, lore-packed exploration, and music that evolves as you play. Uncover, the Historic Helix, in this procedurally generated, progressive, epic adventure through time and space.

title: PC Cursed 98
description: An eerie compilation of 21+X spine-tingling indie horror games concealed within a mysterious demo disc from the fictitious depths of our sinister gaming magazine. Dive into the macabre with this unique itch.io collection, where terror lurks in every pixel. Unearth hidden nightmares as you navigate the ghastly landscapes of indie horror.

title: Escape the Cradle
description: Escape the Cradle is an Incremental RPG with cute pixel art about a foxgirl trying to clear out the dungeon she was born in so she can leave with her mother and explore the outside world. She's animated with Live2d and you restore her hp between runs with headpats!

title: Mazestalker: The Veil of Silenos
description:
In Mazestalker, players take on the role of Yve Allard, a treasure hunter who stumbles upon the long-isolated kingdom of Ebuzond. A world full of genuine mysteries, in stark contrast to the staged adventures of her homeland. What begins as a search for forgotten enigmas soon develops into a journey shaped by the intrigues of gods, archaeological puzzles, and the witty bottled god Wotton, whom she accidentally picks up along the way.

The game is designed as a homage to the japanese 16-bit era of action RPGs and features:

A relaxed yet gripping combat system at its core
A colorful, handcrafted overworld in the style of classic 2D Zelda games
An expansive labyrinth with Metroidvania-like exploration
Challenging dungeon levels that drive the story forward

title: Recycling Center Simulator: E-Waste DLC
description: This DLC adds a new e-waste recycling chain, letting you turn discarded electronics into products like solar panels, batteries, and other electronics. It also adds two new maps-the Solar Plant and Electronics Junkyard-where you can collect materials for your recycling center.

title: Car Dealer Simulator: Up 2 You DLC
description: With the Up 2 You DLC, Car Dealer Simulator lets you fully customize your dealership, cars, and brand. Design interiors, tune cars, attract new clients with new Photo Mode, and even race your own ride in illegal street races.

title: Aquarist: American Fish DLC
description: Enrich your aquariums with 25 unique species from South, Central, and North America. From mysterious inhabitants of dark caves, to colorful defenders of tropical reefs, to predators from the ocean depths and crystalline rivers. Each has its own unique colors, shapes, and behaviors that will bring your underwater kingdom to life.

title: House Builder: Egyptian DLC
description: Discover the secrets of ancient Egypt in the new DLC for House Builder! Build the peasant's house, the wealthy merchant's mansion, and the monumental temple of the gods. From simple mud huts to stone wonders, each project will transport you to a world of sand, the Nile, and eternity.

title: Non-violent Hero
description: A pixel RPG where you play as a handsome, non-violent Hero on a mission to help the King rescue his daughter, who has been kidnapped by the Demon King!

title: An Unplayable Game?!
description: a game about accessibility settings that's just a *bit* too hard for you to play effectively. 10-15 minutes in length with 30+ minutes of developer commentary!

title: Walls and Tower Party
description: A digital collection of Board games to play with friends and family both locally and online. Walls & Tower is the first original game of this collection. Race with up to 6 with your friends, block there way and eliminate them one by one. Makes parties more excited! Demo available now!

title: HyperBlade 2050: Dystopian Sports Manager
description: HyperBlade 2050 is a futuristic text-based sports management simulation set on a dystopian Earth. Experience the excitement of professional sports management, whilst being drawn into the rich lore of society in an alternative future of the 2050s.

title: Light'Em Up
description: Once bitten by an undead, you embark on a dark hunt. Use mirrors to reflect the sunlight into the undead's lairs. Level by level, the story of a missing loved one unfolds.

title: DWD: Drunk Wizard Dungeoneer
description: Play as Tipsy, a high-functioning potion-loving wizard on a wild quest in the shifting dungeon. Balance your buzz—one too many and your magic fails, too few and chaos reigns. You will need wit, courage, and a strong liver to master your spells and prove you are more than a barstool legend.

title: Pirate Den
description: Recruit your crew and sail for glory! In Pirate Den, a transparent idle pirate roguelike, climb the ranks to become the Pirate King while surviving dangerous missions and keeping your crew in line.

title: Bubble
description:
Bubble is an easy and fun to play arcade puzzle game where you have to shot colored bubbles to complete levels. 
 
If three or more bubbles of the same color are next to each if you shot any one of them they will burst and the bubbles above drop down. 
 
Bubbles contains more than thirty handcrafted levels, four power up's and lots of different balls, some with special effects that will help you to complete levels quicker. 
 
At the end of every level you will receive 50 bonus coins, that can be used to unlock Power up's, and help you to complete the harder levels in the game.

title: Processor Dev Tycoon
description: Build your own processor empire! Design custom chips, compete with rivals, and dominate the tech industry!

title: Boomer Grandma
description: This is a boomer shooter where you shoot, dodge, and defeat demons! Play as the "Boomer Grandma" and fire heavy guns to turn Hell into a sea of blood.

title: Astro Delivery
description: Uncover hidden routes to deliver the package in perfect time in this 2D precision platformer.

title: Misty Onsen
description: A first-person psychological horror set in a remote Japanese mountain onsen. As the new caretaker, survive by following the memo: wear visible clothes, stay on the path, don’t turn when called, no women here, flee if you smell something. Obey—or never escape!

title: Doom Dawn
description: Doom Dawn is a fast-paced post apocalyptic zombie shooting game where players need to use randomly dropped super weapons and magic to eliminate insane zombies and survive within a specified time frame to win the final victory!

title: GluMe
description: “GluMe” is a cute Sokoban-style puzzle game. Team up with your slime friends to collect all the spectacular gems.

title: Hypno Halo
description: Hypno Halo is a minimalist score attack game.

title: Scarf Ace
description: Swing, zip, run and jump through over 50 hand-crafted levels in this momentum based 2D platformer. From the mind and keyboard of solo developer Louis

title: Dwarf Brew Master
description: In arcade simulator of beer brewing you will deal with the wishes of elves who have never tried beer! Brew from the ingredients, understand what elves need, remember who is who to reach the goal! Accustom all the elves to beer!

title: Lazy Lord: War on the Desktop
description: You're the Laziest Evil Lord ever—too lazy to fight, yet destined to rule the world. Send minions (automatically), upgrade them with gold and treasures, and conquer 1,000 areas without leaving the throne. Evil has never been this effortless.

title: Stranded in the Abyss
description: Stranded in the abyss is a shoot-em-up in a unique sci-fi sci-environment where you command a massive squad of ships in an endless war Against an evil rebellion. Shoot command and bomb your way through hundreds of enemy fighters, capital ships, and skirmishes.

title: Divine Tactics
description: Lead your team of divine allies to victory in this roguelike autobattler. Position your units, unleash their unique powers, and outsmart rivals in this asynchronous multiplayer competition.

title: Depth of Mind
description: In this turn-based strategy game, you must assemble the strongest team of mental operatives to overcome mental illnesses inside a person.

title: No Way Back: Dark Horizon
description: A first-person survival game with horror elements. You wake up on an island with your young son and no memory of how you got there. He gets hungry, he gets scared, you can tell him to wait or follow, and if he dies the game is over. By day you explore, gather, hunt, cook and build shelter; when night falls the island stops being safe.

title: Noneworld
description: NONEWORLD is a cute RPG set in a dying world. You are a Princess from another world, accompanied by an omnipresent Cheshire Cat. Only YOU and your fruity colored allies can LIGHT THE WORLD and return home safely.

title: Yuna and the Spirit Forest
description: A 2D pixel-art metroidvania where you fight using elemental spirits instead of basic attacks. Explore, collect, and solve puzzles in a magical forest.

title: Byteworld
description: Welcome to BYTEWORLD, the ultimate VR experience that aims to bring streamers and viewers together like never before!

title: Sombie
description: Sombie offers action packed PvP, and PvE in an always online MMO. loot, kill, die, repeat. Explore an endless randomly generated world with your friends. Offering a unique spin on the Zombie survival genre, built from the ground up.

title: Reng Azure Requiem
description: Face the soul guardians in your quest for the 7 master keys in this pixel art Action RPG. Evolve your abilities and rely on the help of your protector raven to explore and fulfill this purpose in the grim world of Tartarius.

title: Call of Duty Frontlines
description:
3 times Winner as the Best COD mod in the World. It is simply the biggest and most complete FPS game ever made in the history of gaming, there is nothing out there that comes close to the diversity of Frontlines. To give you an idea, if you were to add up all the Call of Duty titles ever released into a single game, it wouldn’t even reach 30% of the vast features of Frontlines.

These features include hundreds of new innovative ideas not only limited to gameplay, but also to server management, such as 52 different basic game types and a smart server capable of performing live actions in real time, as a real admin was there at all times.

title: Jump Frog
description: A determined frog leaps ever higher, risking its life in a perilous climb where every slip could send it tumbling back to the start. driven by the call to find the perfect mate. Will this frog have what it takes?

title: Be My Horde
description: Be My Horde is a roguelite survivor where your minions fight for you. Become a formidable necromancer and turn your enemies into a resource! Raise fallen foes, build massive undead hordes, enhance your skills with devoured souls, and conquer the world – you’re the villain in this story.

title: Necrologium
description: Seven corrupted souls died in one fateful night. Discover their sins and unravel the mystery that surrounds their mortal shells.

title: Digging Together
description: Start digging with your grandpa’s map! In this stylized co-op digging game (up to 4 players), dig, upgrade, and reach the treasure together. Work as a team or compete! Fun, chaos, and rivalry await deep underground.

title: Shattered Dreams: Redemption
description: Shattered Dreams: Redemption is a choice-driven visual novel where you play as a former basketball prodigy whose dreams were shattered. The game emphasizes its immersive narrative, where you will face moral and difficult choices that will shape your story.

title: The Reflex Lab
description: You've been kidnapped by an evil (and extremely rude) alien. To escape, you’ll have to complete a series of reflex, skill and patience based trials in his poorly constructed laboratory. Will you survive the alien’s twisted tests and escape? Or will you end up like his last batch of “lab rats”?

title: Chronicles of Childhood
description: A story-rich, platform, side-scroller in the coming of age genre. Travel around the Fantasy World of "Chronicles of Childhood", with your slingshot at hand. Fight and avoid imaginative creations, to finish all the levels and discover what does it really mean to grow up.

title: Sorrow: Rise of Divinity
description: An open-world action survival game combining fast-paced battle royale, competitive deathmatches, trophy hunting, and intense missions—where strategy and skill determine your fate.

title: Installation 19
description: Alex Carter, part of The Abducted UFO group, acts on a tip about nighttime sightings. Unknowingly, he wanders into a top-secret military base, triggering a suspenseful journey.

title: Cube Dungeon
description: Trapped in the mysterious Cube Dungeon, you must fight, loot, and survive through dark halls and deadly enemies. This action RPG blends old-school handcrafted style with unique progression systems and hardcore mechanics. Can you escape?

title: Perfore the Perforien Request
description: Carolanne Marin, Princess of Prodo, is invited to Berlo, the capital of Birini and the great capital of Perfore, to see the Perforian in person for a request.

title: Arena of Suffering
description: A classic RPG of strategic turn-based combat, dangerous dungeon crawls, and total party customization. Build the best heroes in the land — and by the end, you won’t just face the final boss. You’ll be the final boss.

title: Ma-suru Joshou
description: This is a story-driven RPG that combines turn-based combat with simple mathematical puzzles and a visual novel-style story progression. Beginning with this prologue, it is being developed as a series.

title: Damn Gravity!
description: Parkour, bounce, & flail your way sky-high because the only way is up! There is no saving. There is no loading. There is only gravity. Collect your parachute. You only get one. Your eyes will lie & your depth perception will betray you! Can you reach the top of this hardcore vertical 3D platformer?

title: Astrolite
description: Astrolite is an arcade-styled bullet heaven in a race against time. Conquer each planet before the forces of the galaxy overpower you. The Galaxy stands united. The World Guardians prepare a final stand against their greatest enemy... that enemy... is you.

title: Zhàn Qí Dàlù
description:
“Zhàn Qí Dàlù” is a 2D turn-based tactical strategy RPG with simple controls and rich gameplay.
You play as a commander who recruits units, captures cities, and engages in battles of wits against beasts and mages.
The game features over 30 types of units and summons, each serving a unique strategic purpose.
Terrain mechanics play a key role—different terrains affect unit attributes and combat performance. Smart use of terrain can even determine the outcome of an entire battle.
Includes 11 story campaign stages and 8 free maps for endless tactical fun.

title: Língjiè Yì Wén Lù
description: "Língjiè Yì Wén Lù" is a Japanese-style story background, combined with a fresh and beautiful art style, and supplemented by a variety of special systems, showing players a wonderful Japanese magical two-dimensional world.

title: Tabletop Fantasy War
description: Tabletop Fantasy War is a turn-based strategy game where you create and customize your unit groups, deploy them on the battlefield, and command them with strategic actions. Your units are all you have. Every decision matters. Lead them wisely and defeat your opponents!

title: Slime Tales
description: Embark on a pixel-art roguelite adventure as a brave little slime exploring a mysterious dungeon beneath a sorcerer’s castle. Battle deadly foes, uncover ancient secrets, and power up with loot and upgrades—solo or with friends!

title: Metal Undergrowth
description: A small atmospheric game set in a strange, overgrown superstructure. It's inhabited by peculiar hybrid creatures that you can collect to buy upgrades and repair your transport capsule — your only way to escape (or not).

title: Filtration
description: Jump, bounce, blast, and fly through 12 pocket dimensions in order to harvest the precious power sources within. With robotic foes and tricky puzzles in your way, it's gonna take a lot more than Ion Cells to get through this!

title: Visions & Voices
description: Wanderer and Telia bicker their way through a woebegone fishing village, gradually unravelling the mystery of its residents' disappearance. Rummage through the remains of Montfort, recruit survivors, fend off cosmic forces, and ultimately meet your fate -- whether you're ready or not.

title: The Anubis Treasure
description: Embark on an epic adventure in The Treasure of Anubis, a minimalist 2D platformer.

title: The Cute the Baldy and the Fluffy
description: A small old-school FPS set during old wild west featuring 2D pixelated graphics in a 3D environment, metroidvania style exploration and some action RPG elements.

title: Pandora no Yume
description:
The story starts on a summer holiday training camp for members of the arts club. As they are exploring the basement of the European-styled school building, they find a nursing robot called Suu, albeit non functional due to a used-up battery. After being brought back to life by the main character, Hirano Yuito, the robot, of female appearance, recognizes him as her new master.

On the final day, the protagonist prepares to leave after spending an enjoyable week. An earthquake occurs, but he dismisses it as a casual event.
However, before Yuito knows what's happening, all of them are warped back to a week earlier, memories altogether.

As the pattern keeps looping, Suu seems to remember faint traces of the week period, and uncannily starts depicting traits of humanity.

title: You Are the Bomb: A Game About Rolling Bombs
description: Collect coins, gems and gun powder, uncover secrets, and conquer epic bosses across time-based levels. Test your skills by mastering the rolling mechanics in this action-packed 3D platformer! Face dynamic environments, harness powerful abilities, and race to save the magical world of Boomerland!

title: Shatterland
description: Shatterland is a co-op zombie survival game with base-building and exploration. Loot resources, craft weapons, build with friends, and fight through a devastated world filled with the undead, hostile survivors, and military secrets.

title: Unattached: City of Shadows
description: Freshly-graduated detective James Arnold is sent on a mission to investigate the death of the mayor of New Eastbrook, a little-known city where corruption is tradition. Investigate crime scenes, interrogate suspects, and fight criminals in a city where every choice pulls you deeper into the shadows.

title: Itrp: Vacuum Bless
description: You are hanging on a spaceship amidst the endless vacuum. You've got to options: either perish there, or collect yourself and find the fabled rescue shuttle.

title: Holy Justice: Galaxy Outcast
description: A cosmic bullet-hell roguelike. Holy Justice is an exhilarating arcade shooter where you upgrade your ship with Core Enhancers, create unexpected combinations, discover unique devices at critical moments, and unleash outrageously powerful builds.

title: Fangs to Fields
description: A relaxing idle game you can play anywhere on your desktop screen. Grow and harvest dozens of different crops while working, surfing the internet, or even when you're AFK.

title: Junkyard Fury 3
description: The anomaly vehicles are back and more aggressive than ever. Each area now features unique experiments and goals. Choose your approach—pick your starting items, vehicles, upgrades, and mods. One experiment won't cut it anymore. Time to get to work.

title: Abulia
description: Abulia is an Type-write battle RPG and Visual Novel adventure based on the mind of a special girl that is trying to find herself in the world and struggling to understand our complex world.

title: A Spaceship Accident
description: A choice-driven narrative game with RPG mechanics, filled with cosmic wonders and horror. Forge your own path across more than 50 unique endings. Barter, upgrade your character, fight, and explore alien worlds, overcoming every obstacle to find your way back to Earth… and to your daughter.

title: Breath Bound
description: Breath Bound is a 2D co-op puzzle adventure where two divers share one oxygen tank and have to keep each other alive by scrounging air and navigating the treacherous obstacles of the sea. Every stretch of the journey back to the surface is a small test of coordination, timing and teamwork.

title: Drift Gang
description: Drift with up to 8 friends in a fun and physics-based cart game! Drift, bump, and overtake on competitive tracks or just relax and drive on chill maps. Whether you're here to win or to have fun, Crazy Cart offers a smooth and exciting driving experience!

title: Space Hood
description: Defend your outpost in this tower defense with a raiding twist. Battle the ruthless Nova Roma Corporation as you build, loot, and survive relentless assaults.

title: Doomriderz
description: Drive through zombie hordes. Upgrade your vehicle to drive faster and longer. Drive everywhere to survive and reach the destination. Also, don't forget to drive safe!

title: The Baumman Box
description:
Your dead son can be resurrected with the power of the mysterious forest, yes. But the forest would rather add your body to its rotting collection.

Explore a dark entombed forest and collect mushrooms to successfully perform a ritual, and know that the forest is ready to stop you. Uncover the mystery of the confined woods as you avoid death in an attempt to save the life of a child. Find the truth of why you are here through the game's multiple endings.

title: Interstellar Espionage Inc.
description: Manage an interstellar spy business in this strategy game with lunchbreak length runs. Explore a random universe, expand your espionage network, exploit weaknesses in corporate information security, and exterminate companies by strategic sale of their information to the competition.

title: Blade Tempest
description: Blade Tempestis a 3D action Roguelike — tear through the cycle in an eternal storm, and carve your endless saga of slaughter with raging blades!

title: Fraud Camp: Survival Escape
description: “Fraud Park: Survival Escape” is a stealth-survival adventure. Trapped in a guarded compound of patrols and cameras, you must search for tools, keycards, and intel to escape. Every noise risks exposure—distract, evade, or fight back. Choices lead to escape, rescue, or exposing the park.

title: Sisyphus Is a Bug
description: As punishment for dirtying Olympus's marble halls, Sisyphus, the dung beetle, must push his ball of dung up and down Mount Olympus every day, for the rest of his life. That is, unless he can complete the seemingly impossible task of reaching Olympus before the sun sets

title: Built by Force
description: Merge Titanfall-style gunplay with Satisfactory base-building and Minecraft exploration in a living, randomized world. Transform at will, master a single-resource economy, and join with up to 11 friends to face adaptive AI enemies.

title: Okinawa Journal
description: A point-and-click mystery game set during the summer of 2000 in the mysterious landscapes of Okinawa. You play as Kami, a guardian angel tasked with guiding Haruki, a struggling journalist, as he delves into the baffling disappearance of a beloved actress.

title: Koshchei the Immortal
description: Help Koshchei the Immortal reclaim his power in an old-school action RPG. No fluff. Kill – Level Up – Grow Stronger – Repeat.

title: Pet Oddities: Desktop Shelter
description: Here's a chill casual collection sim game! In another dimensional world, you'll use an old book to keep collecting all sorts of cute, weird, funny creatures in different styles. Your aim? Track down the oldest one and become the ultimate collection master! And yeah, this game will keep updating！

title: Inspiral: Echoes of Gravity
description: Start as an asteroid, grow by absorbing other celestial bodies to become a planet, a star, and ultimately a black hole. Experience realistic gravity and orbital physics in an ever-evolving sandbox universe.

title: Neuter Master
description: A lighthearted roguelite breeding game where you match animals on a customizable grid, earn gold with slot-machine-style combos, and balance breeding, sterilizing, and upgrades to keep your herd thriving year after year.

title: Conquer Lands
description: The king has died without an heir. Lords are battling for the throne. Build your own unique deck of cards and units, battle against challenging lords and and be the king!

title: Towers Heritage
description: Defend yourself to victory, design your own towers and play offline or online in this tribute to the Tower defense genre

title: Weeks Till Winter
description: In a dark study with a Book of Worlds and a handful of wooden buildings, you are cursed to build until you've unlocked the secrets of your mysterious past. This is a score-based strategy game using city-builder mechanics.

title: The Awakened Avenger
description: The Awakened Avenger is a top-down shooter light rogue-lite game. Players take on the role of a zombie who has been harmed by biochemical experiments but retains self-awareness. Survive by choosing different equipment and props, and defeat the ultimate villain.

title: Next Run
description: Fantasy strategy RPG with roguelike elements. A game about choice: every mechanic is an alternative to another. Fight or bribe, craft or trade, build or cast. Find your own path and reach victory.

title: Trial of Ariah
description: A tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Strategically use runes on a mystical grid to cast spells and battle enemies. Escape through three distinct realms - fiery, terrestrial, and celestial - as you navigate branching paths that change with every playthrough in your quest to reach Ariah.

title: Work Life Balance
description: “Are you truly happy?” — A near-future dystopian RPG of corporate satire. In a world where work is everything, 【Work Life Balance】 may be the key to happiness—or a crafted illusion. Join the mysterious “Work Life Balance Fellowship” and uncover the truth.

title: Biida-Bash
description: Experience the thrill of a marbles tabletop game with physics-bending powers! Dive into this turn-based multiplayer action, challenging friends, family, or strangers across different mini-games with unique challenges. It's all about calculated moves and chaotic fun!

title: Fantasy Forest
description: Welcome to the wonderful realm of “Fantasy Forest”. Here, you’ll encounter a world as clear and dreamlike as a Hayao Miyazaki anime! This is a healing game that combines creature collection, relaxed idle gameplay, and scene decoration.

title: Hopward
description:
Hopward is a precision platformer where you play as a determined little frog climbing toward the sky. Charge your jumps, dive through the air, and test your patience as every leap brings you closer to the top or all the way back to the bottom. Explore vibrant worlds from rainy ponds to wizard towers, floating gardens, and mystical skies.
No checkpoints. No shortcuts. Just you, your timing, and the fall.

title: Timeless Solitaire Collection
description: An anthology of seven classic solitaire games - each re-imagined with striking art styles, playful twists, and flexible rules for endless replay.

title: Brand! New! Friends!
description: Four washed-up performers become unlikely friends and attempt to take on the idol industry in this silly little Vocaloid fanfiction game.

title: Epi-Derick
description: You run the only pharmacy in a rural town. Each face at the counter is the same, each ailment slightly different. Provide Care - Follow Our Rules - Stay Safe.

title: Revenge On Gold Diggers
description: The first-ever FMV game about emotional fraud, brought to life by Chinese director Hu Yaohui and a team of film industry veterans. In this entirely fictional story, step into the role of a hunter of hearts and infiltrate a shadowy organization deep in emotional deceit. In this immersive, third-person cinematic experience, every choice matters as you navigate a treacherous web of lies, seduction, and manipulation. The game features 472 minutes of cinematic footage, over 200 choices, and 38 possible endings. You can also explore the Love Dossier with over 140,000 words, and interact with others on the Wall of Memories, which already contains more than 4,000 player comments.

title: Huggy & Friends
description: Huggy & Friends is an upcoming Poppy Playtime-themed DLC for Minecraft: Bedrock Edition.

title: Sweet Driver
description: Sweet Driver - A simple and beautiful jigsaw puzzle game with drivers as the theme. It features the daily life of five pretty and cute girls at work, accompanied by relaxing music. After completing the level, you can enjoy the girls' photos in the gallery.

title: Prisoner Breaker
description: A gay adult game. The warden of a max security prison was violated by 3 inmates. The player needs to figure out which 3 of 20 prisoners were the offenders. The core-game is a detective puzzle, use your logic to figure out the criminals through the information you have gathered in mini-games.

title: Hentai Evangeline
description: Hentai Evangeline — erotic puzzle game where a seductive nun awaits your devotion. Solve 30 puzzles, unlock sinful rewards, and reveal her forbidden ritual of passion

title: Fucked by the Princesses of the Realm
description: You live in Drosk, a dusty land... and where you don't throw any. One day, a crazy old man tells you that beyond the Red Valley there is a kingdom where only beautiful and hot women live. Without hesitation, you head straight for the steamy tale you've just been told, and you find out it's real.

title: Space Treasure Hunters
description:
After the Third Galactic war, many worlds were left in ruins. In these ruins remained treasures of inestimable value. Hundreds of treasure hunters are crisscrossing the Galaxy. One of them is David Fox - and it seems that he finally got lucky...

Discover clues that the famous treasure hunter left in the Space restaurant. Go to the place where the greatest treasure of all time is hidden and get it for yourself!

title: Thief's Adventure
description: A real-time tactical stealth game set in a gritty medieval fantasy world. Sneak, loot, and ambush your enemies. Being spotted means death.

title: Space Treasure Hunters part 2
description:
After the Third Galactic War, many worlds were left in ruins. There are treasures of great value hidden in those ruins. Hundreds of treasure hunters are flying through the Galaxy searching for them. One of them is David Fox. This time he managed something incredible...

Follow the footsteps of scientists who discovered the precious T-gems, which are full of energy. Find out where their Hyperspace ship is and head to the place where the greatest cosmic treasure of all time is hidden.

title: Lateral Thinking Together
description: Crack the Mystery Together! "Lateral Thinking Together" is a cooperative and competitive online multiplayer game that challenges your knowledge and deductive reasoning to uncover the truth. Solve incomprehensible stories with creative thinking and flashes of insight!

title: Gridle
description: Gridle is an incremental idle RPG where you’ll manage a powerful party to take down waves of enemies! Strategically upgrade, heal, reassign, and level up your party members to conquer the world!

title: FOF: Fear Of Failure
description: FOF (Fear of Failure) is a physics-based precision platformer where every shot counts. Use the powerful recoil of your shotgun to propel yourself through challenging environments, overcoming obstacles with skill and strategy. one wrong move, and you’ll experience spectacular failure.

title: Airport Baggage Simulator
description: Inspect and sort baggage at the airport! Check suitcases for illegal contents, weight, and destination. Build your own fully automated baggage handling and optimize your terminal's efficiency for maximum profit!

title: Starvania: Tales Of The Past
description: The land of Starvania is under attack by a demon god. It's only way of survival is to summon a warrior from the future to help it fight the demon god. Will it work? Or is Starvania doomed?

title: Atrium Mortis
description: Trapped in an endless Roman corridor, you must observe carefully, solve eerie puzzles, and survive horrors in this roguelite puzzle-adventure.

title: Price of Obsession
description: Price of Obsession is a choice-driven narrative game featuring multiple endings, where your decisions determine who lives, who dies, and who you might fall in love with.

title: David: Rise of the Shepherd
description: An epic biblical action-adventure RPG set in ancient Israel. Control David in third-person combat, slay beasts and giants, explore vast deserts and villages, complete quests, and face cinematic boss battles in a story of faith, courage, and destiny.

title: Scope Out
description: Take the shot — or be taken out. A 1v1 Top Down online sniper duel where matches are fought in best-of-3 rounds. Win three rounds to claim victory. Every bullet, every breath, and every move matters.

title: Slime Changer
description: A slime with no memory of who—or what—it is. Absorb others, wield their powers, and embark on a journey to save the world and discover your true identity. Experience fast-paced, stylish action in a brutal yet beautiful dystopia where magic and machines collide.

title: Throne Alone
description: Not your average toilet-sim: Throne Alone is a cursed physics platformer where gravity hates you, progress is pain, and a blue floating face roasts your every moment.

title: Desktop Colony
description: A cosy incremental semi-idle space colony management game that sits on your desktop while you do other things. Mine asteroids, build ships, expand the colony, research technology, uncover mysteries and explore the universe.

title: Little Witch's Carnival
description: This is a light ROGUE game that combines weapon evolution and action shooting, with diverse builds and duels. Play as a young witch visiting school's club carnival. Defeat the overly enthusiastic members of various clubs and survive their crazy talent shows and fanatical recruitment efforts!

title: TBH: Task Bar Hero
description: The taskbar is now the stage for our heroes! Support their small but epic adventures. Earn chests through their journeys and unlock powerful gear to strengthen your heroes!

title: Firefighting Simulator: Ignite - Rosenbauer HEROS Titan DLC
description: The Rosenbauer HEROS Titan DLC includes the high-performance firefighting helmet HEROS Titan, designed and manufactured by Rosenbauer.

title: Firefighting Simulator: Ignite - Summer Camp DLC
description:
Oh, sweet summer! It's a perfect time for exploration and adventure at Woodchuck summer camp, near our beloved Oakridge City. Since 1921, the camp has been welcoming children and teenagers from the area, and is among some of their fondest memories. Unfortunately, there are reports of a fire at Camp Woodchuck, and the Oakridge City FD is on high alert. Come join the crew in the Summer Camp DLC and save a city landmark and beloved institution of the greater Oakridge area.

The Summer Camp DLC includes:

A new environment
2x new missions

title: Professional Ship Simulator
description: Take the helm in this realistic, large-scale maritime simulation. Command your fleet from agile rescue vessels to massive LNG tankers and perform precise maneuvers in challenging conditions. Navigate a living open world where weather, traffic, and every wave shape your career

title: Letter Hunter
description: Letter Hunter is a fast-paced, addictive multiplayer observation game where every second counts ! It's up to you to spot and write down as many words as possible beginning with the letter chosen. Challenge your friends now !

title: Transport Legion
description: A unique roguelike card-based tower defense game. Strategically place cards, manage resource transport, balance production with combat, and craft distinctive decks to claim victory.

title: Waste Sorting
description: Waste Sorting is a single-player puzzle game, inspired by the classic pipe games from the 80s and 90s. Click the pipes to turn or switch them and create a way from start to finish.

title: Turning the Tide
description: Welcome to January 1941. Allied forces have just repelled an invasion force in the Battle of Britain but their forces are severely depleted. Plans have been made to halt the Nazi war machine and Turn The Tide towards an all out victory. YOU have been hand-picked to carry out those plans. God Speed.

title: King's Subsidy
description: King's Subsidy is a turn-based economic strategy game with rogue-lite mechanics. Use the unique skills of the most influential merchants in the world and develop their potential. Plan. Develop. Yield. Trade. Protect. Each run has different challenges and opportunities.

title: A Planet of Mine Mastermine Edition
description: A Planet of Mine Mastermine Edition is a cozy 4X game with mass strategy! Choose your winning gang, mastermine resources, and build your base and tools to boost your technology and conquer space! Unless your neighbors don’t see it that way… Trade, peace or clash: your planet, your choice!

title: Void Drift
description: Void Drift is a survival roguelike space shooter where you explore unque battlefields, evolve powerful weapons face relentless enemy swarms and take on bosses, adapt your strategy, and survive the chaos of the void!

title: Deep Loop
description: Find your way to master the seven deadly sins in a constantly looping world that will force you to experience different realities.

title: Restaurant Scramble
description: Run your own diner, patisserie, seafood store, and more in this fast-paced incremental game! Keep your customers happy by updating your menu and upgrading a variety of skills.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: KDCA Airport
description: Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport (IATA: DCA, ICAO: KDCA, FAA LID: DCA) is a busy airport close to Washington, D.C. named after Ronald Reagan, who was the 40th President of the United States. This airport is the closest one to the nation's capital with some very unique features.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: YSSY Airport
description: [YSSY] - Sydney Airport by FlyTampa, developed by FeelThere for Tower - realistic modeling with over 100 custom modelled buildings including Terminal interiors, New Gate 10, Kilo Ramp and Shopping Terminal and much more! Take control over Sydney airport and sky!

title: Tower! Simulator 3: EDDV Airport
description: The ninth largest airport in Germany, EDDV is available for Tower Simulator 3, developed by FeelThere and SoFly. Hannover Airport [IATA: HAJ, ICAO: EDDV] is the international airport of Hanover in Germany, with 3 interconnected terminals beautifully modeled.

title: Freelancers: Rogue Skies
description: FREELANCERS: ROGUE SKIES An open-world single-player space combat roguelite where you pilot customizable starfighters, engage in tactical dogfights, and explore dynamic star systems across a galaxy shaped by war and opportunity.

title: Keep Gambling
description: KEEP GAMBLING is a hostile friendslop gamble-em-up featuring LOTTO TICKET, SLOTS, CASE OPENING, and SUBSTANCE ABUSE simulations. Beat your friends and be the first to repay your debt.

title: Misty's Idle Fishing
description: Misty's Idle Fishing is a relaxing idle fishing game that sits on your desktop! Help Misty upgrade her equipment, customise her boat, and discover new islands, so she can catch and research all sorts of fish while you are busy with other things!

title: One Nation Under the Old Gods
description: A Rogue-lite Deckbuilder set in early 1800s United States. Play as members of a secret organization that investigates occult activity in an effort to stop various cults from summoning Eldritch Gods. Acquire cards to create combos and synergies to defeat your enemies in turn-based combat!

title: ICBM: Escalation - Endless October
description:
What if communism lasted forever?

In this gripping alternate history DLC for ICBM: Escalation, the Soviet Union emerges from the Second World War stronger, smarter, and far more ruthless. The politburo has tightened its grip, forged a stable superstate, and is ready to reshape the world, by diplomacy, domination, or devastating nuclear fire.

Set in 1950, just five years after the end of the Great Patriotic War, Endless October plunges players into a world where the Cold War burns hotter and longer. The USSR detonated its first nuclear bomb only four years after the U.S. and now, Korea becomes the first major flashpoint in a decades-long global struggle.

Take command of the Soviet Union and lead it through a sprawling campaign that spans the 20th century and beyond. Forge alliances, provoke conflicts, and rain destruction on capitalist enemies as you aim to raise the Red Banner over every continent.

Long live the revolution. Endless October has begun.

title: Potat
description: Potat is a quirky, physics-based 3D adventure where you play as a sentient potato trying to escape a house before you get cooked alive. Roll, flip, and flop your way through a bizarre home filled with deadly traps, chaotic layouts, and unexpected obstacles.

title: Subtracto
description: "Click, hold, drag, subtract to zero in this fast-paced, number-crunching game!"

title: Salted
description: You are bacon. No matter how many times you fall, keep climbing. Drag your mouse to adjust power and send bacon flying. That's all you need to do. It's a climbing game influenced by Getting Over It.

title: The Mountain
description: Slow paced puzzle game

title: Kubikon 3D: Arctic DLC
description: Get ready for an arctic challenge! In this expansion, you'll find a new icy environment, unique mechanics, and a whole set of new levels full of frosty puzzles!

title: Through Hell and Back
description: Through Hell and Back is a timeline based roguelike deckbuilding game. Place your spells on the Timeline to outsmart your enemies. Choose your power ups carefully, trade spells and upgrade the Timeline to unleash devastating combos.

title: Nova Survivors
description: A sci-fi survivor game focused on fast-paced combat and deep meta-progression. This is no walk in the park. You'll land on a hostile alien planet and face relentless waves of monsters. The only way to survive this hell is to fight, upgrade, and permanently strengthen yourself!

title: Dungeon Danger Traps 2
description: Dungeon Danger Traps 2 is a free hardcore platformer with multiplayer, where every move matters. Dodge deadly traps, find the shortest route to the finish line, and compete for the best time!

title: Papao: The Legend of the Bogeyman
description: PAPAO: The Legend of the Bogeyman is a horror game with mascots. Face mystical figures in dark settings, solve mysteries, and use toys as weapons to tackle challenges as you guide a child through an intense, puzzle-filled storyline

title: Rotem
description: Rotem is a unique and challenging tile puzzle game featuring three distinct puzzle modes: Tile Rotator, Tile Swapper, and Rotem Puzzle. With 240 themed images, 20 ambient music tracks, and a variety of difficulty levels, test your logic and problem-solving skills.

title: Nightmarena
description: Nightmarena is a 2D rogue lite turn based fighting game. Carefully analyze enemy attack pattern to figure out the best time and direction to dodge and then fight back with your own skills. After every arena attempt, improve your character and keep fighting until you conquer all the floors.

title: Ms Vampire Love to Date With Me
description: 《Ms Vampire Love to Date with Me》 is a multi-ending ADV that depicts the player and Irene (a vampire) living together during summer vacation.

title: Kubikon 3D: Pirates DLC
description: Ahoy, adventurers! This expansion takes you to an all-new Caribbean environment to face unique mechanics and tackle a whole new set of levels across treacherous waters!

title: Kubikon 3D: Cyberpunk DLC
description: Welcome to the neon jungle! In the Cyberpunk DLC, you'll enter a brand-new glowing environment, face unique mechanics, and tackle a whole set of new levels full of futuristic challenges!

title: Kubikon 3D: Warehouse DLC
description: Overcome unexpected obstacles in the hectic outdoor warehouse. This expansion brings a brand new environment, new mechanics and, of course, a whole new set of levels full of logistical challenges!

title: A'Jatt
description:
Rione Luzzatti. Naples.

In recent years, some children have mysteriously disappeared in that very neighborhood—vanishing right before their mothers’ eyes, without anyone noticing a thing. Your mother has asked you to take care of the house for a day. In the house there is also a cat, unusually large and with strange behaviors. Will you simply do what you’ve been asked, or will you try to uncover what’s really going on?

title: My Hotel Simulator
description: Build and manage your own hotel, from a small property to a luxury resort. Design rooms, maintain cleanliness, develop amenities, and offer guests unforgettable experiences at your hotel!

title: Plinbo
description: Take your chance, build your fate, and earn money! Every choice is a new strategy, every run a unique challenge. The thrill of roguelike meets the sweet chaos of plinko.

title: Eien no Miyako
description:
Hero is a college student who attends university in Tokyo. He lost father at young age and now lives with mother, father-in-law and sister-in-law Mariko.

A strange letter arrived from Mariko's pen friend Keiko who spends summer vacation on a "September Island (Ku Tsutou)".
"Strange events have been happening, please come quickly. I'm scared".
Hero used to visit this island together with his deceased father and together with Mariko they set off to help Keiko.
Keiko was supposed to work as maid in a western mansion, but only three mansion owner daughters are found there.

title: Seikishi Melty Lovers
description: In Ederant, the greatest honour regardless of gender is becoming a knight. Till enrolled in the knight-training school Equites and must find a partner for the knight examination. He met the smart but naive Sefi, the motivated cool beauty Frey, the mysterious gun-toting Lil, and the foreign giant sword-wielding Canon. His pure admiration of knights would soon change into a greater wish due to these girls with the same aspirations.

title: Genshin Impact: An Elegy for Faded Moonlight
description:
Version "Luna II" of Genshin Impact, also known as "Song of the Welkin Moon: Reprise". This update includes:
• New characters: Nefer and Miliastra Wonderland's Manekin
• New main story quest: "An Elegy for Faded Moonlight"
• New main event: Ruins Exploration - Fieldwise Center
• New QoL, and more!

Additionally, this update also adds Miliastra Wonderland, a new gameplay mode centered around user-generated content.

title: Starbrew Station
description: Manage a bustling space station café in this sci-fi idle game! Hire quirky alien baristas, automate your coffee empire across 5 unique decks, and survive chaotic Rush Hour events for massive rewards. Prestige to unlock powerful, permanent upgrades.

title: Wuthering Waves: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
description:
Version 2.7 of Wuthering Waves, including:
• New characters: Galbrena and Qiuyuan
• New story quests
• New echoes, events and more!

title: BlastMorph: Pinball
description: A free pinball game for both Windows and Xbox. You start with one board with four more to unlock by doing various objectives. Also features over 10 ball multiball and plenty of minigames per board.

title: Dorotea
description:
Dorotea is a researcher specializing in the history of her hometown of Conversano, near Bari, in Italy

An important event is just days away. Her job involves cataloging and archiving books and artifacts dating back to the 17th century, stored in a room that hasn't been opened in decades.

But the past never stops watching her...

The game is a horror top-down adventure for the Game Boy and Game Boy Color

title: A Brat's Journey: A Rose Playing Game
description: A narrative-driven RPG where you play as rosedoodle, a teal-haired catsprout, and embark on a journey across Stardust Valley. Visit various locations and interact with many of the Vchiban friends and family. Try and gather all the collectables, some which require gacha luck, fishing skill, and a sharp eye for details. Game lovingly made by rosedoodle's community for her 10th year anniversary.

title: Memology: Goyda
description: Take the annual meme exam and prove you're an expert!

title: Would You Still Love Me if I Was a Worm?
description: You’re on a mission to get revenage on your ex-girlfriend and her family and her family’s friends and basically just all the birds on earth… how dare they be a bird. The nerve.

title: Devil's Menu
description: This fast-food restaurant in the underworld needs your management! Upgrade the diner, serve monsters, fulfill orders, and collect their treasures. They might even get you a real-world treat!

title: Cosmic Scramble
description: A grid-based arcade shooter where enemies only move when you do. You have about a second before they break free of the time freeze and scramble your ship's controls again and again. Best of luck. You'll need it.

title: Gatekeeper of the Yin Dynasty
description: Gatekeeper of the Yin Dynasty is an independent game with a fantasy fairy tale theme, and the core gameplay focuses on "identifying fakes and identifying monsters". Every decision you make is not only about the safety of the people in the city, but also about the profound impact on the entire city

title: Solnest
description:
Solnest is a relaxing cat-finding adventure set in peaceful, sunlit, solarpunk-themed rooms. Explore all cozy levels to discover hidden cats in a beautifully drawn world.
500+ hidden cats to find across detailed scenes. 11 cozy rooms to explore, each bursting with solarpunk personality.

title: Blast Bebop
description: Blast Bebop is an easy-to-pick-up action-incremental game, combining dodging, shooting, collecting, and upgrades, set to retro pixel visuals and psychedelic music for a short, relaxing combat experience.

title: Ripperdoc Simulator
description: In Ripperdoc Simulator, you are the surgeon of the shadows. In the front, you run a dingy electronics shop in a crime-ridden district. In the back, you perform illegal implantations on desperate clients seeking power, beauty, or survival — no matter the cost.

title: Coding With Doc
description: Alternate between stationary horror and top-down stealth in this game where time is always against you. At night, complete tasks on your PC while keeping various AIs docile. In the day, look for clues, study patrol routes, and learn to run and hide as you plot your escape. The clock is ticking.

title: Semperfly
description: semperfly is an FPV drone simulator built to train the next generation of drone pilots. Experience the adrenaline of high-speed first-person flight as you race through the skies with full control and realistic physics.

title: Breezy Bakes Simulator
description: Run your own seaside Italian bakery, craft pizzas and breads, and enjoy, fun with up to 4 players online!

title: Homeshift
description: Guide a young boy through fears and dark caverns, in hopes of reaching a happy home. Homeshift sees you platforming in diverse environments, utilising your wits and tools to overcome challenges in creative ways.

title: I Will Never Fall for My Tsundere Classmate, so I Will Just Date a Background Character Instead!
description: A short parody visual novel about romance with a tsundere girl... Or not?

title: Night Shift Customer
description: A night shift at a minimarket turns into a nightmare. Serve customers, tidy the store, and watch for oddities - one of them isn’t human anymore.

title: Quarked up Omnibus: Clean - Fix - Escape
description: Quarked Up Omnibus is a 2D space exploration adventure game where you can walk around planets, and seamlessly fly to numerous other planets. Clean, Fix, and Exterminate your way through a day-by-day story, and plot your escape.

title: Overgrown Cleaner
description: What a mess! It looks like no one has taken care of this place for centuries! In this satisfying simulator, you can relax by cutting, cleaning, mowing, and chopping through overgrown, weed-infested areas—without worrying about back pain!

title: SoulTrigger
description: An urban fantasy turn-based RPG where you analyze monsters' patterns and weaknesses to progress through battles.

title: Gunzzle: Warp Master
description: Coming Soon Gunzzle! Beat the clock evading the floor with your teleportation gun ! Jump over and through abysses, fire, acide and many other deadly threats to get through the portal. Gunzzle Is Endless Hours Of Competitive Fun! Try the Free Demo!

title: Jack's 510 Racing
description: Jack's 510 Racing is an open world arcade driver set on nine connecting islands. Earn points by racing on the streets, surviving UFOs and police, or causing mayhem in death races inspired by the cult classic movie. Use points to upgrade, customize, and buy new cars.

title: Stellar Rhythm
description: Stellar Rhythm is a fast-paced, trippy, vibrant, music-driven 2D space shooter where every shot, enemy movement, and setting syncs to the beat. Running silky-smooth at 120fps, it’s a solo creation from Azido 88 - award-winning DJ and music producer - delivering an audiovisual rush like no other.

title: Jane Austen Simulator: Pride and Prejudice
description: Improve your word-guessing skills with this unique twist on Hangman! Guess sentences from Jane Austen’s Pride and Prejudice. Unlock audio clips and images with no way to lose! Immerse yourself in the greatest love story ever written. Who is “a single man of large fortune”? D_r_y

title: Stellar Archipelago
description: Stellar Archipelago is a third-person base builder with a space western flair. Gather resources, build colonies on miniature planets, and grow your population to prove habitability. Unlock the warp junction and open your frontier system to future settlers.

title: Just Grow
description: Step into Cooper’s shoes and battle childhood nightmares in an abandoned orphanage. Explore procedurally generated levels, dynamic melee combat, and hand-drawn art. Collect essence, grow stronger, and uncover hidden secrets!

title: Wrong
description: A paranoid schizophrenic searches for his girlfriend’s killer in a decaying city.

title: Emergent-Z
description: Experience the outbreak in Emergent-Z, a pre-apocalyptic third-person survival game. Build your base, master your skills, and fight to survive as a human—or command chaos as a zombie horde leader. Your choices will shape the fate of the world.

title: Stall
description: ball type game :)

title: HaneHolo!
description: A jump-action game where you control Hololive members and aim for the goal!! With simple controls, just keep climbing higher and higher! Play the entire story for free in the free version!

title: Grit & Grind
description: Grit & Grind is a retro arcade style RPG where you strive to make a difference amid a fast-paced world. Fight the Mob, shop at the grocery, chop trees or mine rocks, complete freedom! Navigate complex challenges, or build connections, and redefine what it means to thrive with purpose and impact.

title: RogueVirus
description: Grid-based action roguelike where you face chaotic encounters against computer viruses. Build and upgrade your antivirus using a vast array of commands and add-ons in order to survive.

title: Magiculon's Tower
description: Welcome to Magiculon’s Tower, a brutal hand-drawn puzzle platformer where every step upward is a test of wit, reflex, and patience. Inspired by the unforgiving design of “foddian” games, a single mistake can send you tumbling back down the tower, but every climb brings mastery, discovery, and the sweet taste of progress.

title: Beaux-Arts
description: Beaux-Arts is a surreal horror-adventure game about being held prisoner by the residents of a countryside estate. Trapped in an arbitrary and nightmarish system of justice, you must explore the grounds and try to convince the family and staff to let you out alive.

title: Nonogos
description: No no-go's in Nonogos, a nonogram solving game! Choose from a wide selection of nonograms to solve, with no restriction on puzzle grid size!

title: AddicDead
description: Survive waves of zombies with various heroes, unlocking increasingly powerful weapons in a post-apocalyptic world with escalating difficulty. Gain experience and complete challenges in this third-person bullet hell.

title: Silence of Elven Mage Rin
description: A puzzle game featuring a beautiful elven sorceress.

title: Void Hazard
description: Trapped in a zero-gravity space station twisted by a corrupted AI, you must survive a labyrinth of shifting corridors and relentless obstacles. Scavenge for resources, upgrade your suit, and fight your way through terrifying threats.

title: Team Dehdehbon
description: Team Dehdehbon is an action game filled to the brim with tight platforming, awesome combos and satisfying movement! Well, if you're good, anyway...

title: Cosmic Composer
description: Casual puzzle game on a cosmic scale. Build stars, planets and other cosmic objects. Evolve your cosmos using abilities of the stars from stellar winds to supernova.

title: Cage Me Not
description: Cage Me Not is a 3D brawler beat'em up where boundaries are meant to be broken! Use your unique ability to phase through everything and make objects traversable, unleashing thrilling combat and creative strategies in every battle.

title: Time Snatcher Handy
description: The universe's greatest cat burglar? The ultimate phantom thief across dimensions? Nah... Time Snatcher Handy, that's me! A time-stop bullet-hell action roguelike starring "Handy" the stylish cat burglar! Stop the time to dodge bullets, gather items to get stronger, and escape the Time Museum!

title: Kats Trigger
description: "Kats Trigger" is a story-driven action game that tells the tale of an otter who lost his family and a stray cat who lost her home.

title: Magic World
description: Master magic with a unique gesture system! In Magic World, you wield a magic wand and combine mouse movements with key presses to cast powerful spells. Simple spells for beginners, complex ones for true masters! Are you ready to become the strongest mage?

title: PseudoSanity
description: Fight multiple monsters at once while uncovering the mysteries of your missing father. Solve puzzles and find more weapons, but most importantly, try not to fall insane.

title: Bones
description: Bones is a FPS Horror game .You're an agent being sent to an island to find an independent scientist team. They told you it's an abandoned island but that is not the case. There is something on the loose. - The game is made on Unreal Engine 5

title: Under a Desert Sun: Seekers of the Cursed Vessel
description: Under a Desert Sun: Seekers of the Cursed Vessel, is a single-player and co-op action RPG set in WWII-era Egypt. Battle soldiers and undead hordes, explore ancient tombs, and uncover a dark curse. Play solo or with friends in local co-op, with new heroes and content coming in Early Access.

title: Zombies & Bullets
description: Zombies & Bullets is a 3D top-down action shooter game where you must help the soldier Jacob face armies of zombies in varied scenarios full of challenges. Prove your skills and reflexes and become the warrior of the zombie apocalypse!

title: Eseal: Reject, Reclaim, Redeem
description: In ESEAL: Reject, Reclaim, Redeem join an elite team sent into a compromised facility to erase a catastrophic mistake. Battle nightmarish horrors, follow ruthless orders and uncover dark secrets. Will you obey your superiors or defy them? Survival and morality collide in this tense co-op FPS.

title: Luminaya
description: Prepare for an enchanting journey as you dive into the mystical realm of Luminaya. You are braving a mysterious forest teeming with terryfing shadows. Use magical runes strategically to create enchanted orbs of light to drive away the shadows. Be vigilant and escape the ominous darkness!

title: Super Chillers: The Chat Room
description: Travel back to the 90s in this campy point-and-click horror adventure inspired by classic YA horror books like Fear Street and Point Horror.

title: Cthulhu Mysteries: Veins of Arkham
description: Cthulu Mysteries: The Veins of Arkham is Lovecraftian narrative mystery, where staying sane is the greatest challenge. Interview the witnesses, gather clues and draw conclusions to solve the most unusual case. Will you be able to handle the truth?

title: Air&Hook
description: You and your friend are test subjects (?) in a super lab run by a mysterious robot! With an air gun and a grappling hook, cooperate to overcome its obstacle courses. Use each characters unique abilities to tackle challenges and enjoy a fun, chaotic co-op platformer in a cute and casual world!

title: Deepstone Rift
description: Fight big battles in the mines, get to mining and collecting gold and minerals. build and upgrade your towers, power up with treasure chests. Defend your base from looting goblins! using variety of weapons and tower, from RPG, ak47, canons towers, to sawblade towers and more!

title: Rogue Pirates
description: Rogue Pirates is a swashbuckling roguelike turn-based RPG about captaining your crew of pirates through hostile seas. Recruit daring pirates to join your crew and lead them into peril and plunder. Battle sea monsters, other pirates and civilization itself all for the quest of becoming a legend.

title: Amazeing Racer
description: Race through ever-changing urban mazes in AMazeing Racer! Master the art of navigation while customize your vehicles, go from a struggling driver to racing legend as you assemble the mythical Golden Engine. Every run is different, every corner a challenge, and every drift brings you closer to glory.

title: Dr. Kyanta
description: A puzzle game spinoff of Ultra Fight Da! Kyanta 2. As Dr. Kyanta or Masako, move around the grid to break colored blocks across the board, or go head-to-head against another player or the CPU, and be the first to obtain 5 stars to claim victory.

title: Useless Timmy
description: Useless Timmy is a platform game where you have to complete each level as quickly as possible. There are several islands, each with their own unique mechanics. Have fun :)

title: Module
description: An anti-platformer game about controlling the entire level. You'll need fast reactions and clever thinking to navigate through the infinite combinations of blocks in this physics-based experience.

title: Ghosts of Trastevere
description:
In this brief journey through memories and legends, walking through the quiet alleys of Trastevere and the shadows of Piazza Trilussa, a man recalls what his grandfather told him about the ghosts of Rome.

From the haunting of Beatrice Cenci to the mysterious monk of San Pietro in Vincoli, each step crosses the fine line between reality and myth, between life and the eternal echo of the city.

A short walking simulator about the hidden soul of Rome, where beauty and mystery merge into an immersive and contemplative experience.

title: Project Luminext
description:
Project Luminext is block-stacking puzzle game where main goal is to build squares from same-colored blocks, which soon gets erased by music engaged timeline. More squares you build, more score you'll get!

Includes a Skin Editor, allowing you to design and share your own skins, as well as a "Synthesia Mode" that lets you play the game to music saved on your device.

title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Complete Edition: 10th Anniversary Edition
description:
The anniversary release of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt. Bundle contains
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Game of the Year Edition for PC or The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Complete Edition for PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X together with anniversary steelbook and lenticular card.

title: Walkabout Mini Golf: Forgotten Fairyland
description: Just off a lonely highway lie the crumbling remains of Fairyland Amusement Park. Once full of childhood joy, it now sits in eerie decay—yet something stirs within. Hop the fence to discover what’s at play! But don’t linger too long and ride at your own risk…

title: The Merchant's Eden
description: In The Merchant's Eden, you build a town around a thriving market. Defend your citizens and traveling merchants against raiding bandits. A minimalist game blending cozy city-building and intense tower-defense as you grow and protect your town.

title: Bradyon Veda
description:
It’s been three years since the end of the tragic Great War. In the midst of the central city of Moloch in defeated Japan appeared a man, Naoto, bearing the rusted badge of Nephilim.

Nephilim was the 10-man experimental elite special corps who possessed the powers of the gods and annihilated tens of thousands of enemy units. The immense powers which they held scared not only their enemies, but also themselves. Realizing this, their leader Komoe disbanded the group. In order to carry on her intentions, Naoto stood up to seal those powers which should not remain in this world.

What lies ahead in the future? Will it be sovereignty, harmony, or destruction?

title: Rules of Engagement: The Grey State
description: A new gold rush has begun. In this Tactical RPG Shooter, you are a Strider, an elite operative sent into the Grey State to retrieve priceless artifacts. Craft your own build, survive nightmarish creatures and rival squads, and get paid. This isn't about saving the world. It's just business.

title: The Cuniculus of Paradise
description: Dive into The Cuniculus of Paradise and experience humanity's epic battle against Gigantic Beasts! As the pilot of a large humanoid weapons called an Exo, Customize your gear, conquer missions, and explore the Abyssal Labyrinth.

title: Parkitect Dinos and Dynasties
description:
Welcome to Parkitect: Dinos & Dynasties!

Complement your park with two new themes from prehistory to antiquity. This content DLC introduces two new themes, full of exotic and classical decorative objects to expand your park into new areas, along with some exciting new attractions.

title: Bad Dream: Afterlife
description: You're back, but the entire dream is empty. All residents have evacuated, and the reason is you. The walls are covered with a number of hurtful messages, but the most common one is - "You can keep the whole city to yourself, but DON'T FOLLOW US, YOU MONSTER!"

title: Driving in Tehran
description: Driving in Tehran is a 2006 driving game made by Iranian video game company Samie Rayan Pardaz (SRP) for the Iranian traffic police, with the purpose of promoting safe driving in Tehran.

title: The Boo-chelor
description: Will you find your souldate this Halloween on the no.1 spooky dating show?

title: Spookie Dookie
description: Spookie Dookie is a horror bathroom simulator where a simple pit stop goes wrong. Explore a decaying gas station restroom, uncover hidden tapes, survive encounters with what lurks within, and unlock multiple endings. Sometimes… holding it is the smarter choice.

title: My Peephole: Hotel Harborview
description: One room. One hole. One judgement. Watch the guests through your peephole, inspect their documents, dial the telephone, and judge who's normal and who's not. Do your job properly to avoid the demon's punishment.

title: Red Land
description: Escape a post-apocalyptic Earth colonized by a highly-intelligent alien species. Fight alien bosses, nitro-mutants, unlock classes, and explore dangerous biomes in a vast open world. Red Land is a rogue-lite, high risk, high reward game. Will you escape... or not?

title: I'm on Sorority Duty
description: You've just started a surveillance job at the local paranormal security corp, and now you're on Sorority Duty! A horror parody, spot-the-difference game about a haunting at Kappa Kappa Tease.

title: Gancho Bond
description:
Collect the golden chalice in a cave in the desert.

You only have your trusted grappling hook to reach high places and use it to kill enemies and move the elements to combine them to create new elements.

title: Grieving: Berduka
description: Mourning Ritual for a Haunted Boarding Room. Uncover the mystery behind the ghost through exploration, puzzles, and a psychological horror narrative.

title: Couch Detective
description: Couch Detective is a text-based deduction game hosted by AI. Ask questions to uncover bizarre yet logical truths. You can also feed the AI your ideas to generate new puzzles and share them with friends.

title: Serene Estates: Last Guy
description: A third-person adventure game set in a sprawling dystopian housing facility. Explore its atmospheric corridors, uncover a mysterious story, and enjoy visuals that harken back to the iconic 2000s era.

title: Touhou Drunken Rebellion
description: Touhou Drunken Rebellion is a classic top-down danmaku shooting roguelike game. Set in the world of Touhou Project, players take on the role of various lesser youkai living in Gensokyo and set out on a journey of rebellion against the powerful figures who rule over it.

title: 7 Servant's Blade
description:
7 Servant's Blade is a doujin arcade vertical shooting game starring Saber, one of the main characters of Fate/Zero and main heroines of Fate/stay night anime series. The game feature TATE mode, the ability to rotate the game's display by ninety degrees while the player's monitor rests on its left side, for full-screen arcade size.

Players will be equipped with two shot types: straight and wide along with Counter Nouble Phantasm, a powerful celestial sword fueled through a conversion of Mana into photoelectric energy. There are five levels and two game modes; Normal Mode with default difficulty setting, and Ranker Mode with higher difficulties and reserved for advanced player.

title: Off the Text
description: Full-Keyboard Rhythm Game focused on mastering your entire keyboard. Inspired by 1970s-80s cinema, visuals are crafted with VHS aesthetics and montage techniques. Play every key at your own tempo with forgiving timing, but conquer brutal levels demanding simultaneous control of 40+ keys. Try it now!

title: Desktop Town
description: Desktop Town is a relaxing idle city builder that runs directly on your desktop. Build and decorate your own tiny town, or watch your little citizens go about their day, while doing your usual tasks on the PC.

title: Ten Trials of Babel 2: Tower and Aurora
description: Otome × Death Game × Story-Driven Multi-Ending Puzzle Battle RPG Game

title: Hand Meat Walker
