description: A fast-paced, strategy driven retro FPS in which you fight alongside a robot companion. Explore chunky, old school style maps and battle bizarre creatures together. Bring demise with your well-rounded arsenal and powerful ally.

title: Lucky Break: Dating in New York
description: A Slice-of-Life Dating Sim with AI Full-Motion Videos, set in modern New York.

title: Revenge of the Gamer
description: Demo version is available! This is a modern gaming company, and you are an unhappy player who came to leave your feedback. Grab your sword and go to the destruction of inept programmers, game designers and other developers. Revenge of the Gamer is a game about a modern gaming company.

title: Lead & Blood
description: A fast-paced arena shoot 'em up arcade. Face endless hordes in a dark forest, shoot everything that moves, dodge projectiles, deflect fireballs, and slice cultists. Choose your character, master your weapons, and chase the highest score!

title: Epos Survivors
description: An ancient evil rises! Greek heroes return to battle it. Craft dash effects, collect autocast skills, and unlock synergies. Fight solo or co-op in a campaign with diverse objectives. Crush hordes of enemies your way!

title: Witch Play House
description: Witch Play House is an unconventional fantasy collection-adventure game that seamlessly blends exhilarating monster-slaying action with a deep collection system. The game features a unique "aesthetic of feet" theme, creating a mysterious world brimming with whimsical imagination.

title: No Fox Season
description: One rainy day you come home from the store and find a wounded fox on the road. In spite of your strict parents who forbid you to have pets, you decide to take her in.

title: I Want to Run Away From My Goth Mommy... or Do I?
description: You dashed into the first apartment you could find, trying to escape the sudden downpour—and here's the result: a slamming door, an unfamiliar interior, and… her.

title: Dodgibi
description: Dodgibi is a roguelite where everything wants to get you. Dodge enemies attacks, collect feathers, discover new maps, fight bosses and unlock all characters with their unique abilities! Playable up to 4 players!

title: Off Road Stars
description: Race tiny trucks around the circuit. Take control of one of up to 8 off-road racing cars and compete in a race track looking down from an isometric perspective.

title: Libertine
description: Face off a series of diverse characters in stressful card game duels, wagering both chips and the fingers off your hand. Can you win big?

title: Mr. Hoob!
description: "Mr. Hoob!" is a colorful remaster of a FICTIONAL 2006 3D-platformer where you play as an energetic and always smiling platform-hopping character who shoots golden rings from his eyes at blue and green aliens! BEWARE; This game gets darker as it progresses...

title: Wood & Flesh Chapter 2
description: A new story in the Tales from Candleforth universe. Continue the story of Wood and Flesh: A Candleforth Short Story in this new chapter, in a point & click puzzle adventure with hand-drawn 2D graphics and an unsettling cozy horror setting.

title: Idle Empires
description: Idle Empires is an incremental strategy game where you build and expand a thriving empire, one hex at a time. Place buildings, gather resources, and upgrade your empire automatically over time. Whether you’re actively playing or letting progress tick while idle, your empire is always growing.

title: Kin:d Barabin's Expedition
description: Join the Bean-shaped Explorer on a mysterious adventure! Journey through different villages, make new friends, and solve extraordinary mysteries together. A tale of friendship and growth, KIN:D Barabin's Expedition.

title: Get the Guy
description: A mysterious interface connects you to a troubled girl from an Eastern fantasy realm. Receive her words and visions instantly. Guide her choices through conscious labyrinths as your fates intertwine.

title: Shuffles 'n Scuffles
description: Enter a papercraft world in this single-player, deck-building, card-battling, roguelike strategy game. Use your wits to battle your way through waves of enemies, while rewriting the very definitions of the cards you hold.

title: Shadow of the Yokai
description: Unleash carnage in 'Shadow of the Yokai'! Hack through hordes of blood-thirsty beasts in procedurally-generated levels. Utilize an assortment of weapons and abilities, leaving a trail of blood-soaked bodies in your wake. Will you slay the Daimyo, or will the Yokai's curse live on?!

title: Cats & Cakes: The Card Game
description: Cats & Cakes: The Card Game is a cozy card-stacking bakery sim where you bake pastries, serve eccentric feline customers, and manage the chaos of your shop in real time. Build fame, decorate your bakery shop!

title: AIgent
description: 1982 style gameplay in a 1982 alternate timeline. Speedrunning 2D hand-drawn pixel art platformer where you need to destroy the satellite on each level by shooting, headshooting or knifing the enemies and collecting their elevator access codes.

title: The Doppel
description: The Doppel is a single player 2D action game.The player controls the protagonist, a failed novelist, and tries to recover his lost precious feelings while running away from the 'doppel' that pursues him in the dream world.

title: Ghost Ripper
description: In Ghost Ripper, you play as Heather, a night-shift waitress abducted and held captive in an abandoned asylum by the infamous and sadistic serial killer known as the Ghost Ripper. Hide, survive, and uncover his dark past as you search for a way out.

title: Who Summoned It?
description: Unravel the Knotgud disaster in this point and click deduction mystery. Explore the town of Knotgud, interrogate townsfolk, and use magical items. Use your discoveries to piece events together in your scroll of truth and find out, Who Summoned It?

title: Minute Man
description: Minute Man is a 2D beat 'em up platformer game where you can freeze time as you're fighting enemies to secure an advantage. Fight through various waves of enemies and defeat bosses in several levels, keeping time frozen as you chain combos against your enemies!

title: Nekomimi Destruction
description: The main character is an extraordinary transfer student! A 3D action game in which a martial arts schoolgirl goes on a rampage at school! Anyway, beat them all up!

title: Rolling Core
description: Rolling Core is a 2D platformer set inside a colossal, ancient factory coming back to life. Play as a small machine part breaking free, navigating shifting machinery, evading hostile robots, and unlocking new abilities to escape the factory’s ever-changing depths.

title: Paper Traces Whisper
description: A hidden-object & puzzle scrapbooking game where you play as a voiceless girl piecing together fragments of her journey. At its heart is a unique scrapbook system—in which certain collected items becomes a decorative sticker to bind your personal memory album.

title: Malignant Survivors II
description: Enter a world consumed by nightmares, ancient ruins, forbidden magic, and mountains of loot. Battle relentless enemy hordes, grow stronger with every run, and uncover the dark secrets of a forgotten land.

title: TheVillage: Possession
description: A cursed village serves as the setting for this single-player psychological horror adventure. As you are drawn into a demonic scheme, solve spooky puzzles, evade deadly spirits, and discover sinister secrets. first in the series TheVillage Chronicles.

title: In Their Shoes
description: From the first day of spring, to the last day of winter, wear seven shoes of seven characters and live their most intimate moments. Explore their thoughts, choose their steps and shape their paths in a mumblecore narrative game where the most extraordinary setting is ordinary life itself.

title: Where the Forest Ends
description: Where the forest end is a story-driven, top-down horror shooter set in a zombie-infested post-apocalypse. Visceral, grounded, and realistic. A fresh take on a classic genre.

title: File Tricks
description: "File Tricks" is a visual novel with puzzle solve. It is not only a test of logical thinking and observation, but also a reasoning feast full of suspense and reversal. You need to investigate the crime scene, collect evidence, confront the people involved and finally solve the case.

title: Anchor's Lament
description: Is a multiplayer roguelike strategy game, where you as your own captain travel the thousands seas to find glory! On your way you gather a crew of exotic animals and creatures that will help you fight other captain's that stand in your way. In this world, all life is sentient.

title: 5P1N
description: Another game about shooting invaders from outer space.

title: Locked Together
description: The first of its kind on Steam. A retro-style Touhou Project fangame with a modern feeling. Beat some sense into the great library in love!

title: Mouldog
description: Travel between planets, gather their resources, upgrade your arsenal, fight bosses and save the galaxy in this 2d action roguelite. Up to 4 players online.

title: Killer Eyelashes
description: The apocalypse is here… and its beat for the gods! How likely was your debut as a drag artist to be overshadowed by a zombie apocalypse? Meet quirky characters, solve puzzles, and catfight with your rivals in this fresh narrative adventure.

title: Night in Delirium
description: A series of murders puts a town in Chile on alert, and the police are unable to identify the perpetrator and his strange messages. Meanwhile, Nicolas, the young owner of Bar Delirio, suspects that the culprit is hiding among his frequent customers.

title: Joth Fading
description: Joth Fading is a souls-like, story based RPG. Save humanity by completing your quests. Master the three combat styles that will help you best demons and gods alike. Traverse the world to find optional mysteries about the land. Beware! Any enemy can kill you with a well-placed blow. Stay alert.

title: EmDePloy
description: A unique Auto-Battle-puzzle game.Subvert enemies to recruit troops, finely search for enemies through micro manipulation and positioning, use tactics such as kiting, focus fire, counters, and synergies to win more with less, eventually approach the limit of the level.

title: Cosmos Milk Tea
description: In Cosmos Milk Tea, you serve drinks and talk freely with AI-powered characters who have memory and personality. Run your café by day and uncover the truth through deep conversations aboard a mysterious space station at night.

title: Wind Tunnel Simulator
description: Wind Tunnel Simulator is a creative physics sandbox game that combines intuitive 3D sculpting with realistic aerodynamic simulation. Design and test your own experimental shapes using clay-like modeling tools, then watch them come alive in a state-of-the-art virtual wind tunnel.

title: Beki, Do You Copy?
description: A first-person space roguelike that dares you to press every button (even the ones you shouldn’t). Your signal is fading… Do you copy?

title: UrbexCam
description: UrbexCAM is a first-person horror exploration game where you and your friends break into eerie, abandoned locations whether it’s a crumbling house, a shut-down mall, or a forgotten factory to dig up the dark secrets behind why they were left behind. Each place has its own disturbing story, and it’s up to you to piece together the truth. But you’ll need to be careful this isn’t just some casual walking in the dark simulator. Try to stay silent and out of sight, because these places are rigged with hidden security cameras, motion sensors, traps, and alarms. One wrong move could alert the cops or something even worse.

title: Dead Beyond
description: Dead Beyond is an action packed survival game where you are trapped in a house full of zombies and challenging traps to overcome.

title: Sahir: Shiv of Memories
description: Sahir: Shiv of Memories is a classic story-driven JRPG blended with survival mechanics. Gather your party, choose who you trust amidst the mysterious events unfolding on the island, and fight to survive.

title: Critical Ops: Dead Zone
description: Critical Ops - Dead Zone is a multiplayer isometric combat game in which players must kill enemies to complete certain objectives.

title: Bist Squad
description: Bist squad is a short, tactical dungeon crawler where you hatch strange eggs, evolve your creatures, and face off in auto-resolved battles. No tutorials. No hand-holding. Just discovery. Learn the mechanics by playing and experimenting.

title: Try to Catch Me!
description: Try To Catch Me is a multiplayer game where you and friends play as kids trying to escape from school. Hide, run, and complete diverse tasks to escape while causing mayhem and destruction. The teacher’s job is to stop the chaos, but this won't be so easy!

title: Surangama
description: Unravel the truth and secrets which bind Tse Li Li to her forgotten past. Battle through hordes of relentless malformed souls and solve intricate puzzles in this Survival Horror X Character Action mashup set in a neon soaked Diyu, the Chinese-Buddhist vision of Hell, inspired by Kowloon Walled City.

title: Your Love Ai
description: Your Love Ai is a game where you develop a relationship with an android robot named Ai, and your dialogue choices influence the ending. Will you be able to touch Ai's heart?

title: Homeless Life Simulator
description: You’ve lost everything. Live as a homeless survivor on the streets. Fight to stay alive, rebuild your life, and see if you can climb from the streets to become the richest in the city.

title: Football Academy Manager
description: Run your own football academy. Scout and discover young talents, evaluate their potential, manage their development through training, and negotiate transfers with clubs to grow your prestige and influence.

title: Ashes Remember Us
description: Ashes Remember Us is a horde-based roguelike with tower-defense elements. Protect your fire, build deadly traps, customize your weapons, and face endless mutant hordes and vicious bosses. Every run is different – how long can you survive?

title: ClassBoom
description: This is a physics-based casual sandbox game, where there are no limits to your creativity. Mess around with liquids, explore the space, build machines, or just explode everything you can see.

title: Cursed Presence
description: Cursed Presence is a first-person psychological horror, paranormal, and survival horror story where grief opens the door to the supernatural. Explore, solve puzzles, and escape from ghostly entities, guided only by a bell that detects evil and defending yourself with limited resources.

title: The House Remembers
description: After your grandfather’s death, you return to his old house. But something's still there. Something that watches. Something that remembers. Face the haunting truth in this atmospheric psychological horror experience.

title: Whispers Among the Poppies
description: A hand-drawn narrative journey through the eyes of a child who lives through war and possesses the gift of communicating with the spirit world

title: Protogen Inc.
description: Huh, you've never heard of Protogen Inc.? That's strange, because everyone knows it's the best space station in the entire universe, with everything you could ever need!

title: Shinebringers
description: You are the final spark of hope. Team up with your friends, wield magic, and survive a world swallowed by darkness — together.

title: Ai & the Demon & the Curse of Lust
description: As the rumors about a brand new, revolutionary (and absolutely NOT cursed) website DemonComm start to spread, students belonging to the local school's Paranormal Research Club seem to take interest in it.

title: Super Mario 3D All-Stars Deluxe
description: A PC version of Super Mario 3D All-Stars that features further optimizations, 2 games not seen in the original collection, and a few more enhancements including; mod support, enhanced textures, and support for any everyday controller!

title: In Loving, Oblivion
description:
I have always been in love with my best friend, that won't change even after he lays his eyes on you.

Right?

title: Cookie's Trails
description: Cookie’s Trails is a cozy tactical puzzle set in a post-apocalyptic world with a sweet twist. The player guides a friendly hamster survivor through zombie-filled trails, collecting baseball bats and medical kits to safely reach the camp.

title: Monster Saga
description:
Ovest, is under attack by wild monsters. Become a monster trainer and freeing Ovest from Prof Mad Dog Lunatic.
Features 24 Monster to collect and train , 20 Main Mission , 12 Side Mission , and many more features.

title: Dominus Automa
description: Dominus Automa is an idle multiplayer RPG meant for busy adults who still love online gaming but don't have endless hours to play anymore. Shape your hero's decision-making process, define their strategy with the combat matrix system, and let them progress 24/7 - even when you're offline.

title: Qiánfú zhī Chìtú
description: Qianfu: Chi Tu is a spy-themed game set in Shanghai during the resistance against Japanese aggression. You play as an underground party lurking in the Japanese intelligence agency, carrying out a series of activities such as assassination and stealing secrets. How far can you go as an undercover agent? "No one engaged in intelligence work has a good end", can you break this assertion?

title: Vanquish The Eternal
description: Vanquish The Eternal is an arcade inspired, skill based action game with meta progression. As All Hallows' Eve descends, the King of the Damned rises to claim your soul. You have one chance to defeat evil itself.

title: Pokémon: The Evil Inside
description: Pokémon have carried humanity’s burdens for generations. When they revolt, a single man must stand between their vengeance and face them to save the human race... You are in control of that Man... Can you kill 'em all?

title: Iluminatus Bizarre Ascent
description: Jump and survive! Help Iluminatus escape a bizarre world full of mutant viruses, creepy llamas, aliens, and powerful bosses! Unlock abilities, climb puzzling levels, or test your skills in endless mode.

title: Horde of Viscount
description:
Step into a land infested by the massive Horde of Viscount

Traverse through both classic-vania stages and regions with exploration where you use subweapons for your advanced movement. Be wary, you only have a limited amount of these subweapons. Instead, you must plan your actions wisely. Use the Dash Knife to attack your enemies from far away? -or perhaps use it to flee?

title: Apollo Sonata
description: At night, the campus is full of urban legends—bloody toilets, garbled blackboards, a path to the underworld, and a piano playing on the rooftop. Play as Miu, Juniper, and MOMO across three playthroughs to uncover the supernatural mysteries. Can their friendship reveal the truth?

title: Plane Balance
description: Plane Balance: Smugglers or Saints? – A cozy puzzle-sim where you stack Tetris-like cargo, choose legal or shady deliveries, dodge customs and police, and earn money to build your dream lake house with your otter companion.

title: Calling Depths
description: A short horror game where you pilot a submarine to collect samples on the crushing depths of the ocean.

title: Bonfire Simulator
description: Light, manage, and enjoy realistic campfires as you experience changing weather and unexpected events in this relaxing simulation game

title: Aivx Push
description: Get addicted to AIVX PUSH, a mind-bending arcade puzzle game with a challenging new mechanic! Lock in, and zone out, to pulsing music and mesmerizing procedural visuals which react and evolve in real time.

title: Stickman Fury
description: Stickman Fury: Flashy fights, crazy combos, and bosses in pure comic mayhem!

title: Alchemist's Alcove
description: Alchemist's Alcove is an Open World Traditional Roguelike where you craft unique spells and tools using the remains of your fallen enemies. Fight, Craft, Discover, and Die as you trudge forth through ancient lands and warring factions!

title: A Slice of Lunch
description: Slice, rotate and pack your meal into your lunchbox in A Slice of Lunch! Find the best way to fit foods of different shapes, sizes, and cuisines into uniquely shaped lunchboxes. Be wary of how many slices you have so no food is left behind!

title: Squad Arcade
description: Squad Arcade is a roguelike deckbuilder with a fast-paced arcade twist, where robots collect ancient heroes and myths to fight in tactical card battles. Every run challenges you to build powerful decks, form unique squads, and master unpredictable challenges.

title: My Name Is...
description: Survival horror about sanity balancing affecting gameplay in a steampunk world of phobias, full of dangerous entities, anomalies and randomly generated puzzles.

title: Burgle Supply Company
description: A co-op horror comedy game for you and your friends about burglarizing a nightmarish neighborhood full of mutated pets. No one said this would be easy, but maybe you can make it out of there with a sweet wood paneled video cassette recorder.

title: Christmas Soul
description: Santa and his helpers have been kidnapped! Mysterious aliens are plotting to destroy the holidays. Fortunately, all is not lost. Take on the role of a brave Snowman – the last defender of Christmas in a dynamic 2D platformer with arcade combat. Bring back the magic of Christmas!

title: The Hero Is Too Powerful so Let's Pleeeease Settle This Peacefully!
description: How strong is too strong? Find out from the hero's victims in this adventure RPG as you talk things out (or destroy everything) on your way to save the hero's childhood friend!

title: The Endless Backgate
description: The ENDLESS BACKGATE is a survival horror game where you face anomalous phenomena unfolding behind three doors. You begin your job as a 'Field Maintenance Supervisor' for our company. Identify the patterns of various phenomena, respond accordingly, and remove all missing posters.

title: Don't Jump
description: A co-op survival game for 1–6 players. Enter corrupted timelines as time janitors, scavenging resources, solving objectives, and surviving collapse. Every jump is different.

title: Will of Destiny
description: Roguelike deckbuilder with a unique SPIN! As a guardian spirit, you use the magical wheel and cast spells to help human souls to overcome life's obstacles. Forge your custom wheel (deck) and unleash the ultimate combos to fulfill their destinies!

title: The Awakener: Battle Tendency
description: The Awakener: Battle Tendency is a hack-and-slash survivor game that blends Eastern fantasy with Western high fantasy. You will control “Awakeners” from different eras and regions to fight against demonic echoes and twisted fate, striving to rewrite a destiny once doomed to fail.

title: The Archivist
description: A psychological horror experience set in the Backrooms. Explore a failed government facility, hack corrupted systems, and descend into a story where memory and reality collapse.

title: Striking Wine
description: "Striking Wine" is a tower defense game. Unexplored maps, unstable climates, and strange enemies may overwhelm unprepared defense. But, by exploring the world, combining different resources, and encountering fantastic events, we can resist attacks and escape... or choose to more deeply explore.

title: Katagiri-san is Very Cold
description: You wake up in a dimly lit room, with your classmate Katagiri-san in front of you. Why are you here? Who could've done it? Why is she here? Maybe there is a way to get out of this place... Try to find your way out in this short escape room RPG with hints of horror, comedy, and a bit of spice!

title: Katagiri-san is Relying on Me
description:
You wake up in a dimly lit room, with your classmate Katagiri-san in front of you. Why are you here? Who could've done it? Why is she here...? Wait a minute... I think you've been here once before. Everything looks the same, yet something seems off...

Try to find out what brought you back to this place in this short escape room RPG with hints of horror, comedy, and a bunch of sweets lying around!

title: Unshaken
description: Try on the role of a former detective who has become the best contract killer. Complete the tasks by destroying everyone who gets in your way in a challenging adventure! Genres: 2D platformer, action, arcade, adventure. Visual style: Cyberpunk, pixel art.

title: Dinus Cross World
description: Experience the journey through beautiful pixel-art graphics, a hauntingly quiet atmosphere, and environments inspired by real Indonesian architecture. Discover Kedirya City as a reimagined reflection of a real-world town, and encounter spirits inspired by Indonesian folklore.

title: The Song of Invermere
description: A town stuck in endless darkness has gone mad. At the center of it all: a nun taking confessions during the end of days.

title: Fragments of Dread: Fale Haven
description: Fragments of Dread is an episodic psychological horror series. Each episode tells a self-contained story of dread, fear, and survival.

title: Caverna
description: Caverna is the digital adaptation of the board game of the same name created by Uwe Rosenberg developed by "Lookout Games". It can be played with 1-7 players.

title: Coasterama
description: Coasterama is a short puzzle game about helping tiny guys ride the rollercoaster of their dreams. Build each rollercoaster piece by piece while meeting every tiny guys' requirements, all while figuring out how to complete the rollercoaster.

title: HyperDissonance
description: HyperDissonance is a mind-bending first-person psychological horror game set in a cyberpunk city where Faith, a young hacker falls into a rabbit hole of memory-altering Bio-Chip technology while trying to uncover the truth behind her father's disappearance.

title: Brother, Get the Oats
description: Convince an AI powered, stubborn pig to part with his precious oats. You’ve got ten minutes, good luck!

title: Eon's Insomnium
description: A dark Metroidvania where memory and madness intertwine. Explore surreal biomes, face grotesque bosses born of trauma, and recover fragments of a forgotten identity in a world that twists with your sanity.

title: Resurface.exe
description: Resurface.exe is a short pixel-art narrative set at a spring in Northeastern Italy. As the protagonist, you return to a place heavy with memory and remorse; from the water, a voice rises that seems to know you better than you’d like.

title: Game Company Simulator: Back to 2000
description: “Game Company Simulator: Back to 2000” is a game development company to establish a management game. Employ employees, balance pressure and output, develop new game types, produce highly praised games, release and earn.

title: Deep Sheol
description: In a dystopian future, Agent Seth investigates a corporate geological facility where a biological gas turned people into bloodthirsty monsters. Fight through enemy hordes, uncover a dark corporate conspiracy, and face Lovecraftian nightmares in this tense retro FPS with survival horror!

title: Lola Maria
description: Lola Maria is a first-person psychological horror game where everyday tasks take a disturbing turn. Living with your grandmother, you uncover unsettling secrets as the line between family, memory, and the supernatural begins to blur.

title: Condemned to Clean
description: You are a cleaner not by choice, but by necessity. A single-player eco-activist simulator that aims to bring life back to an old beach in a provincial town. Explore abandoned embankments and courtyards, collect rubbish, sort resources, and uncover the history of this forgotten place.

title: Maze Adventure
description: level-based puzzle game. Mechanic/sprinter enter time portal, caught by savages, escape. Levels need map move, clues, signals. Sneak; rescue/steal/assassinate + escape. Tighter defenses later, test strategy.

title: 12 Months to Launch
description: A lighthearted resource-management game of running an indie game studio! Play as a first-time indie game producer, making critical decisions for your team's future while balancing quality against viral appeal. Will you become a laughingstock among players, or a shining star in the industry?

title: Vector Seven
description: Retro arcade shooter inspired by classic 80's games Fast-paced side-scrolling shoot 'em up with looping battlefields, relentless enemy waves, tactical shields, power-ups and hyperspace jumps

title: War Beans
description: Wage war against massive hordes of orcs, undead and demons in this survival roguelite. Upgrade and combine epic weapons and talents. Enlist an army to fight alongside you. Embrace the chaos of the battlefield!

title: Willow's Paper House
description: A mystery adventure puzzle game about a girl searching for her brother in an arcane hospital full of monsters and patients who have lost their memories.

title: Elixir of Moonglow
description: Ella & Umbra — Ella wakes in a strange world with no memory, just a wolf by her side. Uncover and explore a cozy story-rich adventure as an apprentice alchemist through hand-drawn biomes. Gather ingredients, solve thoughtful puzzles as Ella accepts a world of chaos, wonder, and forgotten alchemy.

title: Hopzi
description: Hopzi is a colorful and fun 4-player multiplayer platform game where cute aliens race through crazy obstacle parkours. Be the fastest, leave your opponents behind, and prove that you are the true Hopzi Champion!

title: Hrror
description: Work is humanity’s greatest fear.

title: Die By Die
description: Die By Die is a rogue-lite text adventure game with lite rpg elements where every run is a new story. The dice of fate decide the setting and plot points for each run, but your actions and your dice rolls will tell the story.

title: Eldritch Archives
description: You step into the shoes of a paranormal investigator who receives a strange letter that is accompanied by a cursed page. Ever since, nightmares of twisted worlds and awful creatures have plagued your sleep. Investigating the client’s home may be the only way to uncover the truth… or fall victim to the sinister forces within.

title: Nine Lifes Nine Deaths
description: It's an Itchio released Vampire Survivors-like arcade game.

title: Tiny Space Pirate
description: Tiny Space Pirate is a cozy top-down space adventure where you explore a handcrafted galaxy, upgrade your ship, and help quirky space locals. Complete light quests, play relaxing mini-games, and discover tiny stories across the stars.

title: Another Day of My Life
description: In the game, the little girl has the strangest day of her life. It starts in a quite peaceful morning and ends up in a really weird night. Her mom is missing, and her dad is acting crazy... What happens this day seems all mixed up and strange, but it's actually meant to be.

title: Trash Takeout
description: You're a truck who needs to push falling trash into trash collectors to earn the highest score possible.

title: Flesh Reactor
description: A sci-fi survival horror top-down shooter. Explore a decaying research facility, scavenge scarce resources, and survive against grotesque abominations.

title: Dictation
description: Dictation is a word-building based roguelike, with plenty of perks to experiment with and create combos to reach the top of the scoreboard.

title: Arbeiter
description: Arbeiter is a survival-management game about working-class life. Work to survive, balance hunger, stress, fatigue and wages, organize fellow workers, manage unions, and spread your ideology. Or go your own way.

title: Rick Henderson: Eternal Arena
description: Rick Henderson is back! Join the endless arena battle, upgrade your ship, upgrade your guns, upgrade your drones. Fight, upgrade, die, repeat.

title: Traveler Arena
description: A lightly action-oriented Roguelike adventure game, set in a fictional gladiator world. Players will扮演 gladiators, battling through a three-layer arena, experiencing rich randomness and replayability.

title: Deep Space Diesel
description: Welcome to your new career as a gas station attendant in the deepest, darkest corner of space! Serve adorable ships, count your cash, and expand your diesel empire. It's a simple, satisfying job. Just... ignore the whispers in the vents. Everything is fine. Probably.

title: R.I.P.: Reincarnation Insurance Program
description: In this virus-ravaged, post-apocalyptic world, you will wield the power of infinite resurrection to delve into perilous ruins, gather legendary gear, and draw strength from the gods—growing stronger through endless cycles, until you become a true savior legend.

title: Stellifier: The Comeback
description: Stellifier: The Comeback - an otome TYPING game inspired by older idols, sequel to the original Stellifier An idol drama game about an older group making a comeback from retirement, featuring a GxB/BxB/non-binary romance!

title: Legion: Arcane Origins
description: This is a top-down action-rpg where you're an anime character surviving and thriving in a randomly generated maze full of monsters, items and other cool stuff. As you crawl deeper into this dungeon, you will unlock more characters, spells, items, dungeon floors and other cool things.

title: Monsters & Magics: Digital Card Game
description: Battle against your friends online or computer controlled enemies in this digital card game. Play with the unique Summoning mechanic while the Action point system keep turns short and impactful. Unlock new cards by playing to build decks with varied strategies.

title: Angel Love Online 2
description: MMORPG / A story in which the player becomes an angel and fights for God

title: Unsealed Pact
description: A dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder. Build your deck, wield forbidden powers, and face relentless enemies — where every choice seals your fate.

title: Secret Lab Cleaner
description: A janitor's first day in a secret facility turns deadly. Clean anomalous messes, evade immortal entities, and survive under AI ANNA's chilling protocol.

title: Heaven’s Gate
description: Heaven's Gate is a story-driven overhaul of Fallout: New Vegas that reimagines the Mojave as a mythic, spiritually charged wasteland shaped by the Glow. Explore a reworked world with altered landscapes and haunting atmospheres while uncovering new lore about twisted urban legends and the Courier's dark reign. Every major character features around 3000 fully voiced lines, and branching dialogues explore themes of faith, rebellion, and redemption with philosophical depth. Encounter new enemies, allies, and factions born from the Glow's influence as you navigate a darker, more meaningful New Vegas experience that integrates the base game and all DLC content.

title: Inc.
description: A stylish pixel-art platformer with a thumping chip-tune sound track. Perfect for quick and short bites of run and jump gaming action. Taking you back to the retro days in a modern way.

title: White Whisper
description: An unknown signal. A silent ship. Only traces of the crew and empty corridors remain on the Sentinel. As Elara Wynn, you investigate what happened—and why the last transmission was a desperate distress call from the depths of space...

title: Ryne-Arca
description: Ryne-Arca is an atmospheric action RPG where you explore a vast world shaped by time and its shifting moods. Where a young girl, longing to escape the real world, finds herself lost within the depths of her own mind. This is her story—a quiet journey through an inner landscape shaped by emotion, memory, and mystery.

title: Shelf by Shelf
description: Work in a warm, cozy bookstore, sort books by genre, and brighten your shelves! Shelf by Shelf invites you into a peaceful world with satisfying organizing mechanics. Help local readers find the perfect books, make them happy, grow your earnings, and expand your shop!

title: Sweet Nibbles
description: Fight possessed souls, solve deadly puzzles, and master movement abilities like wall running to infiltrate a sinister factory built to control everyone. Survive the sweet world of Mr. Shrine’s candy empire in this action-horror adventure. Uncover dark secrets, meet mysterious characters, and gods.

title: Liar-for-hire
description: Follow the new worker of the disinformation agency day by day. Decide how to oppose news and people through the use of fake scandals and redirections. Ensure a win for your employers - or find some conscience after all.

title: Grannies on Wheels
description: Battle it out in chaotic single screen party game where Monster Truck driving Grannies fight for jam and survival! Smash, crash, and outwit your rivals in dynamic arenas, packed with physics, mini-games, and laugh-out-loud chaos.

title: Side Eye High
description: Investigate student deaths inside a 1997 American high school. Inspect everything, collect evidence, and piece together what happened in a grounded point-and-click detective mystery.

title: Kawaii Clicker Reborn
description: Ultimate cute clicker is back and even cuter than ever! Fill up the gauge to enter “Fever Mode” and get lots of hearts! Let's click to see cute animations of cute characters!

title: 99 Days
description: Survive 99 days in a cursed forest covered in toxic mist. Keep your campfire alive, craft essential gear, and expand your safe zone before the mist takes over.

title: 100% Clean Inc.
description: 100% Clean Inc. is a top-down Roguelite shooting game. Follow the new intern as he explores the cleaning company building, where things seem to be going wrong.

title: Timeless Artifact: Mechanubis
description: A sci-fi action-adventure in which you take control of a robotic Anubis with two shields. Explore the pyramid, go through challenging trials and uncover secrets in this experimental journey.

title: Familiar Findings
description: Summon and study witches’ familiars in this charming creature collection game. Gather dragons, spirits and more in your quest to complete your magical grimoire. Watch them enchant your screen without intruding while you work, study or relax. With over 100 variations there’s a favourite for everyone!

title: Wind Chill
description: Working as a Search & Rescue officer, you must keep yourself sane and log objects you find in the woods, all while facing off against twisted creatures. With a flashlight as your only pair of eyes, you have until 6AM to find your subjects. Good luck, and remember, DO NOT GO NEAR THE STAIRS.

title: Insanitorium: Don’t Be Afraid
description: Trapped in a psychiatric hospital, you must escape demons lurking in the shadows.Explore Insanitorium only with your flashlight and scarce batteries, defend yourself with a machete and a dart gun, and face the strange patients. Remember, do not listen to the mannequins that whisper inside your head.

title: Slime Town
description: "Slime Town" is a fantasy world that can stay on your desktop! It allows you to leisurely collect resources and nurture companions during breaks from work or study! Here, you'll build a home with adorable slime companions, explore hidden realms, and create your unique adventure.

title: Voidwatch
description: Voidwatch is a silky-smooth space shooter roguelike. Hop from planet to planet, facing off against the Cult of the Void as you fight to free the galaxy from their clutches. Collect new weapons and powerful modifications to improve your Voidhawk Infiltrator starship & lay waste to your foes!

title: Tenvader
description: Tetris meets Space Invaders – Build your ship block by block while blasting alien swarms. Upgrade weapons, face evolving bosses, and survive the chaos across endless loops.

title: Meow Palace: Forbidden City
description: Step into the role of a clever stray, paws padding into the grand and mysterious Forbidden City. With palace cats as your guides, you'll pick up skills, gather treasures, complete quests, and uncover the secrets hidden in its halls.

title: Tornado: Caballo Del Zorro
description: A whimsical 2D action-platformer where you dash, leap, and kick through handcrafted worlds as Zorro's daring horse, blending fast-paced platforming with stealth and cinematic flair.

title: Parnitha: Patient 66
description:
A haunted house, whispers from the past, and a truth you were never meant to uncover. Psychological horror inspired by real places in Greece.
After an unexplained murder, you are asked to enter the house of a man who killed his wife and daughter. A simple favor to retrieve a document… turns into a nightmare.
The house shifts, doors seal shut, and voices whisper in the dark. Each room reveals memories that aren’t your own. Notes, symbols, and disturbing apparitions uncover the story of Patient 66 — a man who survived horrific experiments, but was never the same again.
Will you escape, or descend deeper into madness?

title: Atomic Age
description: Criminal case in the cabaret stage Atomic Age, a comedic, retro-futuristic 2D point & click adventure in the shape of the 50th and 60th years

title: Blazing War World
description: 3D Apocalypse Level-Based Action Game. Players navigate radiation-ruined areas, using walking, jumping, shooting, exclusive ultimate skills to fight mutated zombies, wasteland thugs, agile creatures, elites. Core goals: defeat bosses or finish tasks to advance, with classic level challenges.

title: Relentless Dark
description: I'm just a dude who got bored and wanted to make a fun but scary coop zombie game. If I can do it you can too! It's always been my dream to develop and release a game one day - even if it sells just one copy  Thanks again for all of the amazing feedback so far! Can't wait to play this with you all

title: Deathplane
description: Deathplane is a 2D puzzle-platformer game about moving the actual deathplane below the level up and down to kill enemies and find solutions and secrets.

title: Odyssey Times: A Quest for Adventure
description: Embark on a story-driven adventure where dynamic combat and leveling meet the charm of a SNES-era JRPG.

title: R.E.A.P.E.R. Corp.
description: A co-op horror about scavenging a post-apocalyptic earth and eating your friends.

title: Secrets of Suburbia
description: Investigate a disappearance in a quiet American suburb in 1997—or ignore it entirely. Spend the night browsing the internet, playing video games, and chatting with your friends in this first-person mystery-horror experience.

title: Sortlandia
description: An isometric action puzzle game, where you sort precious gems and relics, in colorful factory levels. Control spinners, springs, and teleports, avoid hazards, fill containers, and maximize your score.

title: Obfuscation
description: Obfuscation is a first-person indie horror game set entirely within a mysterious house. You don’t know how you got here - or why. Explore the house as reality slowly begins to fall apart, and uncover the truth.

title: Murmurs of Fear: A Whisper of Loneliness
description: Murmurs of Fear is an episodic psychological horror about those left alone with the unexplainable. Each episode tells a self-contained story of fear, isolation, and the struggle to stay sane when the world around you begins to fracture.

title: Blitloop
description: A fast-paced, side-scrolling retro shooter where you play as “Blit" on a mission to rescue orb pods. Blast enemy swarms and face off against bosses in this bullet-hell shoot 'em up. Earn power-ups and get ready for fluid arcade action in a stylish world with an 80s synthwave soundtrack.

title: Cosmotiles
description: Embark on a relaxing cosmic expedition. Use your strategic skills to terraform barren planets into vibrant worlds — one block at a time.

title: Chicken Craft
description: Chicken Craft is a management game where you hatch cute chicken monsters on a fantasy science farm. Discover unique breeds, unlock various mutations, brew potions and create your very own chickens!

title: Tyrone vs. Cops 2
description: Awaken the latent power of your melanin and kill cops in this thought-provoking game on police brutality in America.

title: The Skeletons Are Fighting
description: A traditional, ground-based 2.5D fighting game (with skeletons) that takes a lot of inspiration from anime/hyper fighters. A nice balance between eccentric mechanics and slower, footsies-based neutral.

title: Fractals
description: Fractals is a two-player co-op puzzle platformer where players complete puzzles and challenges using innovative mechanics. Work together to solve physics-based puzzles and go through platforming challenges.

title: Dig Island
description: Dig Island is a 4-player co-op digging game. As you dig deeper, discover new resources, upgrade your equipment, and work with your friends to repair the plane and escape the island.

title: Rogue Runner
description: Rogue Runner is a high-speed running, rogue-like, third-person shooter, action, and parkour game. You must run to break the cycle. As you run, you'll discover different possibilities. Run, Kill, Die, Try new skills, and Repeat to break the cycle!

title: Fantasy Idle Dungeon
description: In Fantasy Idle Dungeon, hatch and capture rare Jenin, awaken their legendary skills and talents, and experience the joy of leveling up, evolving, and fusing them. Freely customize your gear, assemble an unbeatable adventure team, and claim glorious victories with effortless idle gameplay!

title: Malón
description: From the plains in the Pampas to the most hostile places in the untamed Patagonia: Manage your own frontier outpost, build new structures, train soldiers, and survive relentless attacks from the enemy.

title: The Path Home
description: "The Path Home" is a 2D pixel-art puzzle game where you explore a strange world with a girl. Use panels to "flip" black and white tiles and reshape the puzzle world. The girl always searches for the "shortest path to the goal," but avoiding fake goals and reuniting her with the crow is up to you.

title: Home Before Winter
description: Single Player coming soon! -- Mobilize your troops and start your journey towards world domination. Get into the trenches and shoot incoming soldiers in this WW1 inspired shoot'em up, turn based, strategy game.

title: Roulette Heist
description: Step into the shadows of a luxurious nightclub casino, don your mask, and join 4 to 6 players in a deadly multiplayer game of wits and chance. Bullets are your only companions in this life-or-death showdown.

title: Hero and a Wicked Man
description: Hero and A Wicked Man is a game about Hero, who goes on an adventure to stop the evil Dr. Wicked. The core mechanics are shooting and platforming. Adventuring through each level and collecting more ammo gives the player an incentive to explore.

title: Sled Together
description: Compete on crazy tracks, race on turbo sleds, collect boosters and... launch your penguin into flight! The winner is the one who best combines speed, precision and aerodynamics

title: The Depths of Duskraven Manor
description: Follow the exploits of five fugitives as they fight their way through the horrors that lurk under Duskraven Manor. With the promises of a clean slate, wealth and freedom from the pasts that haunt them, they fight through unimaginable terror while uncovering a reality-shattering mystery.

title: Don't Freeze: A Winter Card Survival
description: Don't Freeze is a winter card survival game set in a winter wasteland. Explore, gather resources, craft, hunt, die, repeat. Something sinister lurks in the cold darkness. Will you make it out in time?

title: HaoWei 1
description: HaoWei 1 is a female-oriented 3D visual novel otome game. that blends sweet romance with murder mystery. While experiencing a dazzling love story, you must also solve a homicide case and uncover the real culprit!

title: Meteorite Fall
description: Let's use existence and freedom as stakes, block everything, and explore the ancient legends of the Fallen Star Village, digging out the truth buried in the long river of history.

title: CongWei
description: CongWei is a sweet romantic visual novel otome game. After a lightning strike, your body turns into a power bank, and the power company CEO, CongWei, needs your body to recharge to survive—so you must marry immediately...1000+ stunning 3D scenes，Full voiced，Main storyline，Mini-games

title: Love Surge!
description: Love Surge! is a comedy dating sim where you can romance human versions of your appliances, merging visual novel text with card game mechanics. As you rack up point combos, you will simulate deeper conversations. Who will you choose?

title: The Stalked 3
description: A late-night thrill turns into a nightmare. Olivia sneaks into Creepwood Wonderland Carnival with her boyfriend, expecting a fun night alone in the park. But something feels off. Distant footsteps. Faint whispers. Someone else is here… Watching.

title: AnimaCircus
description: Join the troupe of an circus exclusively for cats. Pick your visuals and show your talent as a feline artist.

title: City of Spells
description: AI-powered detective game set in New York City! Solve mysteries with magical spells and mess around with silly chatbots along the way!

title: Zombie Chef
description: Grind zombie limbs for ingredients and get missing supplies from the store. Every recipe demands precision; even a small mistake can be costly. Reinforce your doors and set traps. As the Blood Moon approaches, be ready to survive the night.

title: Mind Split
description: A top-down puzzle game where you discover the harmony of opposites. Control Light and Shadow with a single mind as they move in opposite directions—use strategic moves to bring them together. Balance each step, challenge your mind in every level!

title: Sealed In
description: Explore this haunted mansion as a detective, discover chilling secrets with your UV flashlight and fight to stay sane before the mannequins gets you.

title: Office 5
description: Protect your family. Protect your coworkers. Verify today. Office 5 is an analog indie horror experience where the player can never be certain who is human or who is unverified.

title: Rubble Eats the World
description: A high energy, physics driven shooter where everything can be destroyed and consumed. Fight angry bots to gain size and abilities. Grow from a tiny pebble to a mountain of a force and you just might EAT THE WORLD! Then build and share your own worlds with the sandbox level editor!

title: Restless Rites
description: Tend to a cursed chapel at the edge of town, or be swallowed by what sleeps beneath it. Clean, survive, and unravel a rotting mystery in this surreal horror game of routine, decay, and sacrifice.

title: Plan B
description: From a desperate runner to a ruthless kingpin — smuggle drugs, weapons, and secrets through a corrupt city. Outsmart police, sabotage rivals, and build your empire with warehouses, vehicles, and loyal crew. Every delivery is a risk; every decision shapes your rise to power.

title: Raidbound
description: Raidbound is a Viking-themed auto-battler with a worker placement style system. Recruit warriors, forge gear, sacrifice for power, and raid rival clans. Choose your path, build your warband, and earn glory across a mythic map of tactical choices.

title: Prsi
description: A short detective-card-adventure set in a dirty Czech pub. Play cards, get wasted and embark on a journey of self-reflection.

title: The Depths of My Guilt
description: Explore the deepest depths of the ocean as you survey the environment by recording audio and taking pictures. Collect fuel found on the mountains in these depths. Be carful though, you are not the only intelligent creature down here.

title: Our Dreadling
description: Step into the world of our little pink dreadling on its mission to uncover the enigmatic Monono. Our Dreadling is a minimalist platformer with Metroidvania-inspired exploration, delivering a unique blend of humor, storytelling, and surreal environments.

title: Electronics Store Simulator
description: Open your own electronics store and grow it from a small shop into a modern technology hub. Manage deliveries, prices, and store equipment, take care of customers, expand the product range, and become a master in the world of electronics retail!

title: Bishoujo Tennis
description: This is an affordable and fun casual tennis game featuring anime-style pretty girls. The gameplay is very simple—just slide the screen with the mouse. There are over ten pretty girls to choose from, allowing players to freely select both their own character and their opponent's.

title: Bat-Rush
description: Bat-Rush is a casual but challenging game.Complete levels , unlock characters or see how far you can get on the endless mode! Fly your bat through caves, castles and more. Collect all the stars and try your luck on the hard mode available for each level. Don't be fooled by the cute graphics though , completing all the levels will be much harder than you think!

title: MonsterGirl 3: Wukong
description: "Monster Girl 3: Wukong" is an interactive narrative game that combines strategic battles with branching storylines. Collect various mystic elixirs for trading, and unlock enchanting demoness characters to keep as desktop companions.

title: Motel Nightmares
description: Trapped in an eerie, forgotten motel, you must uncover dark secrets and escape the nightmares that haunt every room. Motel Nightmares is a first-person psychological horror experience filled with mystery, tension, and atmospheric dread.

title: Mobile Phone Shop Simulator
description: Build and manage your own mobile phone shop! Buy, sell and expand your business in this detailed simulation game. Balance profits, manage your team, and become the best shop in town.

title: Fortified Space
description: Seize control of enemy planets in this nostalgic space sim and tower defense game made in the style of classic Flash games. Start by dominating orbital space in starship combat with railguns, defense turrets, and shields. Once clear, land on the surface to build a base and destroy waves of enemies.

title: Gunflare Epoch
description: "Gunflare Epoch" is a roguelike top-down shooter. Earth has fallen. As rebel rangers—humanity's last hope—plunge into randomized dungeons, arm yourself,and survive endless hordes. Uncover the rebellion's truth in a storm of bullets and scrap.

title: Megastore Simulator
description: Megastore Simulator is a first-person management & tycoon game. Start small and grow into a massive two-floor megastore with forklifts, pallet jacks, and staff. Unlock and run Bakery, Clothing, Electronics, Sports, Music, Toy & Grocery departments. (Formerly Urban Supermarket Simulator)

title: I Would Love to Wish You Good Morning
description: Congratulations! You've been selected for reassignment to The Isola - a remote facility supporting vital intelligence operations at WE Inc. Your profile suggests an ideal fit for this unique position. WE looks forward to your cooperation. Best!

title: Motorbike Shop Simulator 2025
description: Build your own motorbike shop! Buy, repair, customize, and sell bikes. Sell gear, attend shows, and expand your business. Manage your dream workshop in Motorbike Shop Simulator 2025!

title: FPV Kamikaze Drone Simulator
description: An intense FPV drone warfare simulator with online multiplayer and co-op modes. Take control of modern kamikaze drones in a high-adrenaline combat experience where precision, speed, and tactics decide your success. Play solo or team up with friends to destroy enemy tanks, vehicles, and bases.

title: The Last Tape: Before the Mine
description: In this first chapter of the saga, relive an old tape recorded over 35 years ago, revealing one of Lurmont Corporation’s darkest secrets. Explore the Alhambra mines, uncover the truth behind the events, and survive the constant threat of B-96. What was once recorded now hunts you.

title: Kitty Rush
description: Kitty Rush is a 2D single-player puzzle platformer where you play as a vet student trapped in an animal clinic invaded by alien forces. Solve puzzles, collect kittens, dodge danger, and fight for your final grade… and their fluffy lives!

title: Out on the Water
description: Out On The Water is a short, meditative journey through memory and grief that tells the story of an inattentive father and his last chance to connect with his children. Set adrift in quiet waters that represent each child, catch strange memory fish to uncover the past and face regrets.

title: Impact Trial: Hyperchaos
description: Face endless waves and survive the chaos! Impact Trial: Hyperchaos is a casual spaceship bullet hell with adaptive difficulty, where your reflexes and decisions make the difference against hundreds of relentless enemies. Push your limits and climb the global leaderboards.

title: Moose Diver
description: You’re a moose on a diving adventure. Swim into the ocean and vacuum coins from the seabed. Sell the coins and earn money to upgrade and buy new gear. Swim deeper and find treasure chests to collect power boosting artefacts, but don’t forget to keep an eye on your oxygen level.

title: Recall News
description: Explore haunted zones with friends in this co-op horror! Grab cursed decor, sell it fast, and escape before the house eats someone (again).

title: Depths of Insanity 3
description: A Cartoony 3D Adventure played in 3rd/1st Person! Explore a wide variety of places. Meet cool characters. Gather to build. And full of Action! Follow a weird story of an Alien Slug trying to survive Planet Earth! It's all about the FUN, WEIRD & COZY things in life!

title: Not Raised by Wolves
description:
Not Raised by Wolves is a third-person shooter starring La Coyota, an anthropomorphic gunslinger. Dash, aim, and shoot with your revolver while your robotic sidekick hacks enemies to stun them and expose weak points in your fight to rescue the colony’s pups.

**A student team project designed to deliver a ~10 minute experience.

title: Fields of Mine
description: Fields of Mine is a roguelike puzzle where classic Minesweeper turns into an unpredictable adventure. Each level changes the rules, challenging your logic, focus, and adaptability.

title: The Fantastic Adventures of Mr. Don and Friends
description: This game is not driven by attribute enhancements or utilitarianism. Bring your friends along to protect Mr. Don and experience once again the pure and simple fun of multiplayer cooperative challenge levels. The game has implemented an online lobby. Recommended for 3 players.

title: Internal Incident
description: Internal Incident – a top-down survival horror extraction shooter. Explore the hidden corners of a vast facility in search of resources while fighting off terrifying creatures lurking in the dark. Unveil the secrets of the abandoned complex and do everything you can to make it out alive.

title: Blackjack Wars
description: A fast-paced, dynamic, and extraordinary blackjack experience set on dark-themed tables, blended with epic hero battles! With fate decided by coin tosses, four-round short matches, special abilities and diverse table combinations, prepare for breathless battles where wit and luck collide.

title: Solo Chess
description: The chess roguelike deckbuilder. Solo Chess is a cozy strategy game where you play chess-themed cards on a 3×3 grid, trigger piece effects, and earn points through clever combos. Build your deck with pets and food to conquer waves of unique battles.

title: PonPonTown
description: A pachinko-style idle game that stays on the side of your screen while you are doing other things. Unlock and collect more marble creatures to earn coins, continually upgrade your village and pachinko tables to accelerate growth. Build the beloved Village!

title: Purrplate
description: In this sunlit feline paradise, become the owner of a one-of-a-kind restaurant designed with your dream "Purr Plate"! Team up with over 100+ quirky cat staffers--from paw-kneading bakers to servers tumbling adorably over their own tails--to create your purrfect woodland café!

title: Cyber Evolution
description: Cyber Evolution is a fast paced, third-person multiplayer shooter where every round is a chance to evolve, adapt, and outplay your opponents. Dive into a neon-soaked cyber arena where physics-based projectiles, skill-based combat, and ever-evolving upgrades create endless variety.

title: Lightrix
description: Lightrix is a sleek, minimalist puzzle game about blending colored lights to correctly light up a glowing matrix of targets. Solve handcrafted levels or unwind with endless relaxing puzzles. Stylish, satisfying, and perfectly meditative.

title: Perk Up
description: Perk Up! is a multiplayer deck-building fighting game where every defeat makes you stronger. Each time you fall, you gain new powers, evolving into an unstoppable force. Keep fighting, adapt, and outlast everyone to become the last one standing!

title: Samurai's Odyssey
description: Japan, 17th century. A samurai is not merely a warrior; it is a path of blazing honor, duty, and death. You are a samurai who has faced all of this. Go forth to meet your destiny.

title: Taptron 1999
description: Taptron 1999 is a short roguelite clicker where you must prevent Y2K using the power of a mouse click.

title: Guild of Hunters
description: A mysterious miasma spreads across the world, turning local wildlife into terrifying monsters. Guild of Hunters is a turn-based RPG where you recruit new members for your guild, negotiate item prices, and embark on adventures across various regions of a medieval world.

title: Squarepinski
description: A cozy jigsaw game with a twist; every piece is the same shape, but not the same size! A low-pressure experience with chill piano music and gorgeous hand-drawn line art.

title: Fuggedaboutit Farm
description: Think you know farming sims? Fuggedaboutit. Your brother is in debt to a crime family and now missing; you're the insurance policy. Gather materials, grow crops and partake in piggery to make as much money as possible. You have 30 days; will you ship enough or end up sleeping with the parsnips?

title: Little Betty: Gold Rush
description: Help brave Betty to collect the stolen gold! In this fast-paced 2D pixel art retro single screen platformer, you'll race through 60 challenging levels full of traps, obstacles and surprises.

title: Starlight Mining Company
description: Build and defend your base to mine starlight crystals in this roguelike co-op tower defense! Carve paths, build defenses, and upgrade your operation as 1-4 players battling escalating waves of hostile threats across a procedurally generated galaxy.

title: Killing Tragedy Samsara
description: A.D.2046 Spring, Hecate, the great novelist, was invited to La Stella Domani Detective Competition, and unexpectedly forced to play a murder game among gifted and criminal teens. With the power of time loop, could she crack those perfect crimes?

title: System Clues
description: Play as a secret agent of a mysterious organization and complete complex plot investigation tasks through network infiltration, social engineering, and digital investigation. Is it justice or sin?

title: Remnant Frontier: Survival
description: The Remnants of humanity send an augmented human to a seemingly uninhabited alien frontier. From sticks and stones, build the tools required to complete the Quantum Gate Terminus and save the world. A relaxed yet deep and engaging Rogue-lite Card Based Adventure; Combine, Explore, Learn & Build.

title: Fishing Mega-Game
description: Fishing Mega-Game takes the joy of a fishing mini-game and crafts it into a larger creature collecting experience. Roam the land for new fishing spots and deploy your favorite fish in search for new playable fish!

title: Gunfight Arena
description: Fast-paced top-down PvP shooter where powerful weapons spawn across the map. Grab them fast, outgun your enemies—and beware: death or the ticking clock will send you back to your default gun. Outplay, survive, and claim your spot at the top. Don't waste a second.

title: Typing Tales
description: Typing Tales is a typing survivors like. Slay enemies to unlock new abilities and upgrade existing ones. Progress to uncover new game modes, maps, characters and abilities. Can you discover all secrets and get all achievements?

title: Touhou Three Noisy Fairies' Adventure: Take It Easy
Gingerbread Holiday
description: Learn to love a broken Holiday through romance. Build a gingerbread house as you form your new home.

title: FalseGod's Gambit
description: "FalseGod's Gambit" is a Roquelike deck-building game (DBG) infused with our unique ideas, set against a backdrop of Norsemytholoay, Plavers will step into the boots of veteran soldier Rod, embarking on his final mission before retirement!

title: Node RPG
description: In Node RPG, take control of a humble cursor embarking on a grand quest! Select from unique classes, overcome tough zones, and enjoy the feeling of always getting stronger in this minimalist RPG incremental adventure.

title: Rest Area Simulator
description: Take over the gas station and convenience store at a roadside rest area and expand by purchasing new businesses. Manage a living world shaped by dynamic economy and random events. Upgrade your facilities, satisfy your customers, and play solo or with friends.

title: Avril
description: Welcome to my first project! Step into a haunted apartment complex where nothing is as it seems. What begins as a search for your missing sister quickly spirals into a nightmare of jumpscares, puzzles, and a descent a place where unspeakable dark rituals were performed.

title: Balaball
description: "Balaball" is a rouge-like game based on physical collision and deck building. Experience the pleasure of getting high scores in chaotic collisions. Find the new combination in different situations, trigger crazy chains and high scores.

title: The Underdog
description: A top-down soulslike action game. Play as a medieval mercenary, use 4 weapon types (sword & shield, two-handed sword, mace, spear) to tackle BOSS warrant levels, explore diverse scenes, strengthen through failure, and unlock surprises.

title: Dark Grid
description: You wake up with only a luminous tower beside you, its warm light enveloping you. Besides, looking around, there is only endless darkness. Survival, exploration, utilizing all resources around to survive, searching for the reasons why the world is plunged into darkness.

title: Dockside Dreams: Fish & Cook Simulator
description: Dockside Dreams – Multiplayer Fish & Cook Simulator Catch seafood with your fishing rod, cook it, and serve it in your restaurant. Customize your venue, build the best restaurant in town. Serve fresh flavors and expand your business together with friends in CO-OP mode.

title: 7 Days Devil
description: Players will play as the Devil King, with a cycle of seven days, learning skills, searching for treasures, interfering with heroes, setting traps, and surviving under the continuous attacks of heroes.

title: Woofy Run
description: Woofy Run is a multiplayer dog racing game where speed, strategy, and sabotage come together. Set traps, avoid obstacles, and race to be one of the top 10 fastest players on every map! Select your favourite dog and join the race!

title: Untitled Car Game
description: Explode your friends in this rogue-lite deckbuilding racer! Acquire fun upgrades and create powerful synergies to dominate the arena!

title: Crabs Must Die!
description: You've crash-landed on a forgotten planet and must survive in a hostile open world filled with mutated crabs and other enemies. Armed with weapons, a beat-up bike, and a few skills, you'll explore, fight, scavenge, and level up. A compact open-world shooter with light RPG and survival elements.

title: Vampire Awakening: Elven Sword Chronicles Survival
description: Blademaster Lyla went missing while investigating the forest anomaly. You ventured into the forest in search of Laila. You'll experience a small story through chapter after chapter of levels. Defeat countless enemies in each chapter!

title: Yakimochi Stream
description: Yakimochi Stream is a school comedy adventure game released by Madosoft.

title: Shalguy
description:
Searching for a way home. It must be out there somewhere.

Based on a collection of dreams I had over the years.

title: Peropero Candy: You no Shou
description: The protagonist is an average guy. One day in the street I meet up a agent who introduces me into a H shop (Image Club). I'm unwilling because it may be coarse, but he confidently says to me that there's a pretty girl in the shop, so I change my mind and get in. Yes! A beautiful and nice girl named Candy welcomes me. From now on the story's simple. We talk familiarly for a while and take a H situation-play. From time to time I meet up a girl in the street who resembles Candy in appearance but she says she doesn't know me. Who is she?

title: Tainted Ground
description: A first-person psychological horror game where you wake up in a remote cabin. Survive paranormal events, explore the forest to find sacred tools to defend yourself from the dark secrets hidden within, and escape the cursed woods before they consume you.

title: Ultra Vertigo
description: Run, Climb, Fall and Retry - A fair platformer about running and jumping through a huge minimalistic tower made from the tears of our playtesters. Nothing is unfair, keep trying and you will succeed.

title: Campsite Hustle
description: Build your own outdoor store and campground in the heart of Red Shore Valley. Set up your shelves, manage your stock, expand your campsite, and take care of every guest. From humble beginnings to a thriving business all in the middle of nature!

title: Kamikaze Strike: FPV Drone
description: Fly a kamikaze drone through fast-paced FPV missions. Dodge bullets, sneak past jammers and radars, and crash into tanks, troops, and enemy bases. Discover diffferent drones and face tougher challenges in every level.

title: Beauties and the Stranded
description: You wake up in a bunker, surrounded by five stunning women. But something doesnt add up. Their beauty feels out of place in this desolate ruin. Their strength and cryptic clues make you question everything. Will you capture them, trust them, or love them? The choice is yours!

title: Maid Mech
description: In 2060, nanoweapons leaked from an Antarctic ancient ruin transformed Earth lifeforms into deadly bioweapons. As human forces retreat, you—a top frontline commander—are tasked with leading experimental 3rd-gen mech units to defend the most critical zone until civilians evacuate to near-Earth orbit.

title: Bean There, Swung That
description: Swing, race, and grapple your way to glory. Bean There Swung That is a high-speed grappling-hook platformer built for speedrunners. Master momentum, speed and accuracy to perfect your runs. Race through 90 themed levels versus friends, or your own times.

title: Your Second Wife
description: Think you've had your fill of virtual waifu? It's Okay, step into the world of Your Other Waifu... She's developed a passion for dress-up and is waiting for you to join her in some delightful little games!

title: Mumu's Soup Adventure Samsara
description: The recipe is soup, the ingredient is your heart! An escape room styled adventure game set in the town basked in twilight, uncovering the stories from lost souls. Will Mumu reach the path of enlightenment? Or perhaps...

title: Stockwave Online
description: STOCKWAVE ONLINE is a high-octane, player-vs-player fighting game about beating the stocks out of your colleagues. You'll find that trading isn't safe in the modern day, as the employees of big-stonk would rip anyone apart over any liquidated penny they can find.

title: Coincidences?
description: After a sudden rent hike, you move into a suspiciously cheap house deep in the woods. The price is absurdly low and there’s work nearby—it seems like a stroke of luck. But you soon realize something is seriously wrong with the place...

title: Mowit: Grass Cutting Simulator
description: Mowing lawns has never been this much fun! Relax with your friends in online co-op, upgrade your equipment, shape beautiful gardens, and enjoy the experience. Join the fun with 1-4 player co-op!

title: The Long March: 20000 Miles of Journey
description: A story of a little girl joining the Red Army and finishing the Long March, while discovering her true faith.

title: HellBit
description: HellBit is a fast-paced roguelike where every run dives deeper into a chaotic underworld. Procedural levels, permadeath, and punishing enemies combine for compact but brutal sessions. Survive, adapt, and see how far you can descend.

title: Hover Rancher
description: Pilot your hovercraft across a wild, untamed world in Hover Rancher—a point-and-click adventure packed with action minigames like aerial dogfights and snowboarding! Explore, collect, and deploy troops as you build your ranching empire from the skies.

title: Brawlborn
description: A fast paced bullethell boxing roguelike that combines fast paced movement with beat em' up mechanics. Discover a wide range of enemies and weapons inside a dungeon full of secrets. Master the art of boxing and become strong enough to reclaim your title as the greatest boxer in the world.

title: 5 Nights at Timokha 5: Island
description: A naughty guy showed a pie and ruined a vacation on a paradise beach!

title: Ravenwood 46
description: A 2D psychological point-and-click horror game where you explore disturbing environments and uncover hidden truths through narrative-driven gameplay.

title: Circle of Bosses
description: Circle of Bosses is a realtime tactics game that provides the complex mechanics of MMO-like Bosses but on a singleplayer experience. Tactical combat with a top-down view where the player assumes the role of a guild leader that can give instructions to AI characters.

title: Fishing Tales: Neko's Journey
description: A relaxing idle fishing game focused on companionship, featuring 26 fishing spots and over 200 fish species. Easy to enjoy without much effort. You can place the game anywhere on your screen while studying or working, without it intruding on your tasks.

title: Unseen Land: Into the Mist
description: For centuries, Veridia thrived. Now, an otherworldly invader tears rifts, unleashing maddened beasts. In the chaos, you awaken—once a humble farmer and hunter. Take up the sword, wield your power, and save Veridia.

title: Loot & Ledger
description: Run your own medieval store! Stock shelves with groceries and legendary loot, set prices, serve customers, and expand your shop. Fund adventurers to explore dangerous lands and return with valuable chests full of swords, shields, and rare items and all without leaving the counter.

title: No More Work for Ito
description: Trapped in a cursed office overnight, you must uncover a hidden password before morning... while reality distorts, blood seeps through the walls, and something watches you. Explore branching paths, face strange encounters, and survive this psychological horror visual novel.

title: Fidget Widget
description: Fidget Widget is a collection of mini games that chill on your desktop, ready to play anytime you’ve got a few minutes to spare.

title: Evac Bay 09
description: You're trapped in the seemingly endless corridors of a space station, desperately searching for the evacuation bay 09. But the station is not as empty as it seems; you must observe for subtle, unsettling occurrences and log them if you want to move forward. Can you break the loop and escape?

title: Why Me
description: 3D 3rd Person Perma-Death Climbing/Running/Swimming Game with progressive difficulty. Some Traps are unfairly tedious. Set a Record Time or Record Death Count. The Question is "Can you beat the game ?"

title: Phantom Fools
description: Phantom Fools is a co-op third-person action roguelike for 1-4 players as poltergeist ghosts. Possess objects and use their powers, find magic books and random upgrade cards, climb procedurally generated castle tiers, and escape the dungeon!

title: Asteroid Boom Cosmic Courier
description: You’re no hero—you’re a subcontractor. Drop the bomb, dodge the blast, and hope the paperwork clears. 4-player physics chaos in a space platformer with no safety net.

title: Seedrun
description: Cultivate a secluded cave in this short & minimalist farming game. Gather resources, get upgrades through a big skill tree and grow living plants that help you fulfill tasks!

title: Turbo Carnage
description: Turbo Carnage is a fast‑paced arena survival game. Smash through clowns with deadly vehicles, fire high‑powered weapons, and call airstrikes. Play solo or join friends in online co‑op against endless, escalating waves.

title: Aixin: Goddess' Love
description: A short visual novel about a warrior with a dark past and a radiant goddess who are confronted with a shocking challenge that will change their lives forever, forcing them to reconsider their views on such a complex and contradictory feeling as love.

title: Coaster Crash Course
description: Roller coaster design puzzle meets physics sandbox. In a series of increasingly challenging levels your task is to get creative and build all kinds of crazy coasters. Don't get too crazy, though, or physics will turn your coaster into a rocket.

title: Bite Night: Dine or Die
description: Bite Night: Dine or Die is a First-Person horror thriller where you play as a diner worker trying to solve the murders of your customers along side your best friend Vamp.

title: The Cubes
description: The Cubes is a colorful puzzle adventure where you control four unique cubes to solve spatial challenges. Switch between the cubes, activate buttons, overcome spikes, collect coins and solve puzzles in a relaxing yet brain-teasing experience.

title: Platform Anomaly
description: Platform Anomaly is a co-op horror game where you and your friends hunt for anomalies — or hide them yourself and watch the search unfold. Scary and fun at the same time!

title: Tiny Hell
description: A 2D pixel roguelike where a tiny hero tries to escape from a hotel. Choose a class, explore rooms, collect items, craft powerful weapons, and defeat enemies in turn-based battles. Each run is unique and full of surprises.

title: Tome
description: Tome is an Action RPG with deep character building. Find and craft powerful items. Equip your Tome with a unique combination of gems to forge novel skills to defeat hordes of monsters.

title: Pizza Syndicate
description: Run your pizza empire in this quirky retro tycoon! Manage restaurants, hire staff, craft menus, and outsmart rivals. Dive into the underground syndicate—rob banks, hire hitmen, sabotage competitors, and use any scheme to dominate the city with humor and strategy! WISHLIST NOW!

title: Ruina
description: Match radiant gems, empower scrolls, and wield enchanted tools in this rogue-lite match-3 game. Customize your bag, purchase relics and charms, and choose boons to shape each run. Every match is a step toward mastery!

title: Totally Tuberz
description: Get ready for TOTALLY TUBERZ - A Super Sweet Sledding Simulator! Grab your tube and conquer the mountain solo or with friends. Race for the fastest time or shred with epic style in this totally tubular snow-sledding thrill ride!

title: Monster Looter
