description: Kill monsters. Get loot. Get stronger. Then what? Kill BIGGER monsters. Get EVEN MORE loot. Upgrade. Upgrade again. Keep looting. Keep growing. How powerful will you be? Become the best monster looter in the world!

title: Wanted Shadows: Unchained
description: A survivors-like game where you defeat creatures of the night trying to take over the underworld. Vanquish the invasion, perfect your build, and become purgatory's master.

title: Virtuoso GP Race: On
description: An homage to early 3D racers: true ’90s handling with bespoke physics, checkpoints with EXTEND TIME, instant restarts, ghosts, and global leaderboards. Demo: Sakura Coast & Dunas de Giza.

title: Bumper Brawlers
description: A fun, fast-paced, cartoon styled vehicle brawler.

title: Typing Break
description: If you can type, you can fire a gun.

title: How Should I Keep a House Squeaky Clean, With a Filthy Little Neighbour Ghost?
description: “How should I keep a house squeaky clean, with a filthy little neighbour ghost?” - is a short story about a robotic cat maid trying to clean an apartment where a dirty ghost has taken up vengeance.

title: Make the Empire Great Again
description: A simulation + turn-based auto-battle game. The "Dusk Apocalypse" nears; the empire teeters! Your people need food, work, maybe some thrilling fun. But monsters seize Your lands, plunder Your fields & mines! Fight, reclaim lost! Build, forge grandest! Fear not the "Dusk", for a new "Sun" has risen!

title: Spongiorno: Schwammfred Moving Company
description: The most realistic moving-stuff-with-bubbles simulator in the world. Bubble your way through handcrafted underwater fishtank levels and load stuff onto your truck in this skill checking puzzle platformer. Experience an unique bubble physics gameplay!

title: Raccoon Valley Tycoon
description: Raccoon Valley is a cozy incremental game about restoring a forgotten raccoon village to its former glory. Dig for resources, collect everything in sight, and watch your little town come back to life.

title: Slimeward
description: Slimeward is an idle game where players build and upgrade a village, recruit heroes, and defeat Monster 'Slime' that fell in front of the house one day,

title: Casanova Simulator
description: A romance simulation game where you play as a charismatic young man, experiencing the thrill and excitement of building romantic relationships with a variety of girls. Every choice you make shapes unique stories and emotional connections, creating a truly immersive romance adventure.

title: 1492: Colonization of the New World
description: Chart your nation's rise in 1492 Colonization of the New World, a turn-based strategy game where you explore, settle, trade, and lead your colonies to independence amid rival empires and native alliances during the Age of Discovery.

title: Drop: Save the Forest
description: In Drop: Save the Forest, use the power of water to solve environmental puzzles, extinguish wildfires, and save biomes inspired by the Dolomites. ️ Combine elements like wind, fire, and plants in a lively pixel art adventure.

title: Vindilis
description: Save the island of Vindilis and defeat the Omniscient! A short, epic adventure that will pit you against powerful enemies in a hand-drawn, hand-animated universe. A short-form indie game vengeance, creation, and completing a quest.

title: Pixel Shinobi
description: Become the Green Ninja. Step into the role of a swift, deadly warrior on a mission to cut down monsters, defeat powerful bosses, and uncover the darkness consuming the land.

title: Throw Anything: Zombie Invaders
description: Stack it, smash it, and throw everything you can! Survive wacky zombie waves, clear chaotic chapters, and enjoy nonstop laughter in this physics-based action defense game.

title: Grass Toucher
description: Do you have what it takes? Are you brave enough to touch the mysterious green organism known as "grass"? Grass Toucher is a clicker game where you touch grass, buy buildings, and unlock special upgrades. Experience the thrill of touching grass without ever stepping outside.

title: Teach My Little Sister How to Drive
description: Teach My Little Sister How to Drive is a chaotic simulation game where you have to teach your sister who's driving on deadly roads. Trapped in the passenger seat, the only thing you can do is to give proper directions to your sister through your voice.

title: Combotronica
description: Discover hidden patterns. Build spectacular chains packed with combos. Collect powerful Amulets. Watch scores skyrocket in this brilliantly satisfying roguelike deck-builder where you balance logic and luck your way!

title: The Spiriting Away of Saooni Village
description: After Mako and Akane arrive at the village, the villagers gaze at them with eerie eyes. Will the two of them be able to leave this place safely?

title: Dungeon Brawl
description: Dungeon Brawl is a casual-yet-intense online co-op roguelike action game! Choose from dozens of anime-style heroes, freely combine hundreds of skills and relics, and team up with your friends to carve through hordes of enemies. Build your own fighting style and dive into the blood-soaked chaos!

title: Even20: The Interference of Parallels
description: Two souls are drawn into a mysterious otherworld—and torn apart. In a realm filled with danger and restless spirits, each searches for the other while uncovering hidden truths. A suspenseful multi-ending adventure where every choice shapes their fate.

title: DFP: Disappear From Polizia
description: The checkpoint-themed roguelike. Smuggle weird stuff, troll the cops, and save your sweet granny.

title: Duty Free Shop Simulator
description: Run your own airport duty free shop, manage stocks, catch smugglers, sell & grow!

title: Monster Gals: Voyage
description: Awaken in a terrifying world where monsters are real, find a way back home while forging bonds with five captivating monster gals: a playful gecko, a mischievous demon, a popular pumpkin, a elegant carnivorous plant and a gentle moth. Shape friendships and romances in this light-hearted adventure!

title: Tojibo
description: Team up with a friend in this two-player co-op adventure! Help the robots T0J1 and J1B0 climb to the top by solving puzzles and coordinating with your partner!

title: Funkels
description: Battle, recruit, and play as over 45 bizarre contenders in the chaotic race to become Funkel Lord.

title: Malleus Maleficarum
description: A Metroidvania inspired by the mechanics and style of classic games in the genre. Help Mirabel find different ways to explore a haunted mansion and hunt terrifying witches while gaining new weapons and discovering more about the macabre experiments carried out by demonic beings.

title: Radiant Click
description: Defeat waves of enemies to grow stronger in this arena shooter. Overcome each boss granting you more upgrade paths to make your character your own. Multiple classes to choose from, plenty of upgrade paths and many hordes to cut through.

title: Lucky Shelter
description: Welcome to the brutal wasteland!​​ Survival here is a deadly slot machine - spin to build combos and fend off hordes. Every pull could save you... or doom you.

title: Drive Me Broke
description: Build your dream car! The cops are always on your back, so stay on good terms with them... Also, be prepared to do any job that requires money.

title: Handy Helper
description: The old system is about to vanish! All your tool friends are trapped beneath colorful blocks. As a brave little hand, it's your time to shine—launch tiles, clear blocks, rescue your friends, and escape! But before you go, there's still one special thing to find…

title: Duality Shift
description: Duality Shift is a Singleplayer FPS Time-Attack Platformer with a unique reality-switching mechanic - Run, Jump, Switch, Shoot and perform parkour moves on your way to the highest position on the leaderboard. Can you beat your friends' score and uncover the truth of the world you inhabit?

title: Blackwood Division
description: Fight supernatural creatures with your forces in this fast paced Roguelike RTS game!

title: Ware's Laboratory
description: Anti-piracy measures are now active. Your game has turned into a nightmare. Crawl through corrupted levels, read notes from a malicious developer, and face the nature of evil itself.

title: Faust Duel
description: FAUST DUEL is a Blackjack-driven roguelike deck-builder. Play as Dr. Faust, who lost his wager and now joins Hell’s games. Within a limited number of rounds, earn enough chips to buy back your soul from its master.

title: Coins Only!
description: Become an exploited worker in a chaotic world full of quirky customers, magical objects, absurd rules — and a pitiful paycheck.

title: Pray or Die: Tactical Defense
description: PRAY OR DIE is a game that combines the genres of survivor-like, tower defense, MOBA, and action roguelite. Players must build defense towers on the island, equip their sailboat with weapons, and pray to Guardian Spirits for powerful blessings to protect the island from invaders and corruption.

title: Chihuahua Controller
description: Help the Chihuahua reach the flag with the Chihuahua Controller! Controlling the Chihuahua will become increasingly difficult! How many flags can you collect?

title: Happy Pinball
description: A pinball machine simulation game. Pull the lever to launch the ball, and you will receive a reward if it falls into the red light hole. During the game, there is a chance to obtain dolls, which can be collected in one's own album or sold on the market to other players.

title: I'm Not a Robot!
description: "I'm Not a Robot" is an atmospheric horror with old-school 3D and dark humor, telling the story of quickly making $300 in a shady alley. Sounds safe, right? Grab an easy payday or uncover all the secrets of the dark cult that has taken over your small town.

title: DreamHero
description: DreamHero is an overhead action-adventure game focusing on hero capture and diverse combat. Players can turn defeated enemies into controllable heroes, experiencing single-player stories, Roguelike, 1V1, 5V5, 20-player battle royales, and cooperative dungeons, blending strategy and operational fun.

title: Gridfall
description: Gridfall is a fantasy deckbuilder where synergy on the grid is key. Feed, train and grow your army on this turn-based conquest!

title: Kitty Claw
description: Play as a heroic claw machine arm in this quirky puzzle-adventure! Team up with a brave plushie, escape the arcade, and take on towering bosses. Grab, fling, and smash your way through a colorful world in a cozy, chaotic quest to save the world—one claw at a time.

title: Ultra Damage
description: Ultra Damage is a hand-drawn Boomer Shooter packed with humor and action, featuring hand-crafted visuals and a story blending gritty detective work with absurd comedy. Each level is a wild ride. Unravel the mystery, find hidden clues, and deal ultra damage to save humanity!

title: Winterreach Emporium
description: Run your own fantasy ski shop in the frosty peaks of Winterreach. Stock magical gear, serve a variety of races, hire and manage staff, research upgrades, and adapt to festivals, shortages, and the shifting demands of a living, lore-rich world.

title: Your Weight
description: Your Weight is a simulation game that turns weight loss into a series of decision-based scenarios. Players manage their character's journey through weight loss by making lifestyle choices, with game mechanics centered around health and fitness decisions that affect the character's progress toward their goal.

title: Darko
description: Immerse yourself in Darko, a short psychological horror game where the scars of the past come to life. Explore the house, avoid hallucinations, and find your pills before it’s too late.

title: Park It at All Costs!
description: Test your driving skills in this fun and challenging car parking game. Navigate tight spaces, dodge obstacles, and master realistic controls across varied lots, city streets, and multi-level garages to park perfectly and earn top scores.

title: Battle On! Hero Academy
description: Welcome to Battle On! Hero Academy! In this desktop idle game, you are the dean. Recruit heroes and plan their careers from swordsmen to paladins. Your heroes battle and grow. Reap the rewards, then lead your upgraded team against epic bosses. Enjoy deep strategy and satisfying idle progression!

title: Desserted
description: Hello, Friend, welcome to Desserted. Together we'll answer the Universe's most important question: "What's for dinner?" 6-player co-op survival adventure; Eat, stealth, fight, sacrifice; Explore lost planets within time limits; Survive. Get stronger. Explore worlds

title: Ravy Davy: Attack on Ambiguity
description: Play as a washed-up rockstar Ravy Davy battling aliens, biker gangs, satanic cults and whackjobs in the desert town of Ambiguity—ruled by villain Margaret Doom, a chain-smoking OAP on a mobility scooter.

title: Bloodville
description: BLOODVILLE is a retro FPS game where you play as Cane, a retired hitman dragged back into killing - and slowly losing his mind.

title: Smash Out Colony
description: Smash Out Colony launches you into roguelite breakout styled chaos. Time your hammer swings, launch projectiles, crush enemy hordes, and adapt fast with game altering tools and physics driven mayhem. Swing fast. Smash waves. Survive the chaos. You got this.

title: ProtoBlue Tower
description: Reborn as a defense tower, you must now protect a foreign village. Use roguelite mechanics in a mix of tower defense and survivor gameplay to defeat your enemies with powerful upgrades.

title: The Valley Beyond
description: Beyond The Valley is an exploration puzzle game with no quest markers or enemy, only curiosity guides your steps. Find your way through gorgeous landscapes and activate all the artworks. But something went wrong in the park, and to leave, you will have to uncover its secret.

title: 3000m to Whatever’s up There
description: Jump. There must be something up there.

title: GrowBud
description: Farm cannabis on your desktop! Grow and master 30+ strains alongside your daily workflow as a discreet sidebar. Customise your grow houses to suit your style; fulfil orders, unlock new strains and equipment, and progress from hands-on care to full automation🪴

title: Space Dash
description: In Space Dash, every move is an explosion. Click to dash into swarms of rock enemies, unleash devastating area damage, and spend gold to unlock upgrades, gravity pulls, turrets, and missiles for nonstop action

title: Crush the Rebellion!
description: The galactic empire is under siege from the rebel scum in all directions! Fight through endless waves of rebel ships using all of the weapons and resources at your disposal as you execute your sole orders: to Crush The Rebellion!

title: Pomelo & Friends: Sevilla
description: Pomelo and his friends have hidden away in sunny Seville! Explore five iconic hand-drawn locations and find 101 different dogs in this colorful hidden object game.

title: Sphereverse
description: Sphereverse is a fast-paced 3D platformer where you roll through action-packed worlds, dodge deadly traps, collect orbs, and face powerful bosses. With permadeath mode, unlockable skins, intense challenges, and tons of levels, skill is everything.

title: Hand-me-downs
description: A roguelike deck builder where you are your own worst enemy. Manage your deck as your opponents use your old hands against you. Use powerful trinkets to take full control of the table.

title: Armada Pet Wars
description: Armada Pet Wars is a 4X-lite asynchronous turn based space-themed strategy game... with pets. Design Starships, make or break alliances, setup your fleets for victory in this strategic, space-themed, auto-battler.

title: Push Through Hell
description: Survival roguelite, where endless waves of monsters and enemies try to stop you from completing your objective. Choose your character, find upgrades and defeat bosses. Will you be able to move The Core all the way to the end, or will you die trying?

title: The Shadow Cosmos
description: A 3D metroidvania with retro aesthetic. As master peacock, delve into a mysterious, dream-like world with non-linear exploration and progression, stylish and challenging fights with a powerful halberd, tricky parkour and puzzles. Collect shadows, unleash darkness.

title: Tiny: The Last Wayfinder
description: A wholesome adventure through an oversized world. Explore freely, solve puzzles, and unlock new paths using magic, tools, and traversal abilities in this calm, atmospheric world filled with secrets, story, and gentle creatures.

title: Don't Feed the Cat
description: You’re stuck in a time loop from 10 PM to 6 AM inside a dark apartment. Survive the nights, uncover the truth, and whatever you do… don’t feed the cat.

title: Glisynth
description: Glisynth is a rhythm game that uses two types of notes. The Q row on the keyboard is used for yellow notes, while the A row is used for white notes.

title: MechShell
description: Defend the Overgrown Realms as S.H.E.L.L., a weaponized snail! Customize your shell, unlock wild abilities, and team up with friends in chaotic multiplayer mayhem across lush, trap-filled biomes. Every battle is a fast-paced, action-packed adventure!

title: Decision Point
description: Plans meet friction in Decision Point, a wargame where you issue NATO-standard orders, observe AI execution in real time, and adapt as the battlefield evolves. At key Decision Points, the action pauses—giving you time to reassess, redirect your forces, and outmanoeuvre the enemy.

title: Gun of Fate: The Silver Gun of Ylia
description: A shooting adventure RPG game, where you play as a gunslinger in Westland. The main combat system of the game is gun shooting. You can complete quest and side missions, unlock items and equipment, and also play fishing and horse racing mini games.

title: MilkTea Time
description: "Milk Tea Time" is simulation business game that includes all the elements of production, deployment and construction. You need to make each cup of milk tea. Research new flavors to win customer praise. Build and decorate your milk tea shop by hand. Create your own beautiful milk tea shop!

title: Divine Sin
description: A deck-building roguelike with innovative card mechanics, blending strategy with unpredictability. In a decaying dark fantasy world, you are a resurrected Apostle—sworn to hunt the gods.

title: Crimson Oath
description: Long may the sun shine! Prepare to suffer! Souls-like combat adventure in a unique world. Learn to fight... then fight to realize your belief.A warrior gradually grows and uncovers the ultimate truth of world change.

title: Letsss Play
description: A blogger investigates disappearances at a mall built on the ashes of a circus. Posing as a night guard, he must uncover the truth behind the tragic fire and learn whose restless souls now haunt the halls. Gather clues and survive before the past consumes you.

title: HellBorn
description: Enter a realm of terror in this 4-player co-op horror. Explore a 50-room manor and sinister dungeon haunted by a demon baby. Experience physics-driven chaos and eerie rituals as secrets unfold in every shadow.

title: Bayaya
description: A relaxing fairy-tale life sim and story-rich adventure in a colorful wooden-toy world.

title: Clan Fantasy Adventures
description: Clan fantasy adventures is a turn-based 2D RPG. Play Marco, a young boy who wants to become a swordsman, through various adventures that will plunge him into the heart of a major conflict.

title: Deep Down Below
description: Deep Down Below is a dungeon-crawling strategy roguelike where you choose your class and fight your way home, leveling up your character and looting items along the way to progress deeper and deeper!

title: Stardust Escape
description: Survive 15 minutes of neon space chaos in this fast-paced top-down arcade shooter with a twist of Asteroids. Blast through swarms of geometric enemies, complete quirky quests, and upgrade your ship with absurd weapons in a Jetsons-style galaxy brimming with danger, glow, and humor.

title: Abyss Deck: Deckbuilding Roguelike
description: A deckbuilding auto-battler roguelike.Build your team, shape your deck, and survive through random events and shifting rules.Every outcome depends on your decisions before battle.

title: Joyful Masks
description: Step into the subconscious mind of a brilliant professor, where memories twist, logic bends, and hidden truths await discovery through intricate puzzles

title: Uncle Lee’s Cookbook: Five Recipes for Disaster
description: Uncle Lee has done it again. It’s up to you to pick up the pieces. Join rebellious teen Ines as she deals with the fallout of her uncle Lee’s experiments/inventions/cooking, in a modern point & click adventure in five self-contained episodes.

title: Kitty Can Cook
description: Kitty has big plans this time! Help Kitty deliver meals while managing space and time. Chop, mix, and toss food fast, with 8 recipes to master and challenge! Pressure Cooker mode turns up the heat with unlockable costumes! Give the demo a try today!

title: Lone City
description: Lone City is a first-person open-world survival shooter. The world is gone—only you, a dog, and a sleek car remain. No missions, no hope. Just ruins, silence, and a flicker of life refusing to die.

title: Sticky Date
description: An anti-dating simulator that subverts the genre and provides catharsis through relatable, raw and satirical dates. You play as an underpaid dumpling cook who, in order to make ends meet, gets recruited by a sketchy dating app agent. Now you need to crash dates in order to earn a living wage!

title: Deckanism: Singularity Island
description: A roguelike deckbuilder meets auto-battler where every fight is a puzzle. Build mechanisms, counter enemies and unleash your perfect combo!

title: Guilds of Greybrook
description: Guilds of Greybrook is a roguelike management simulator where you don't play the hero, you pay the heroes! Operate the choppy waters of business ownership, hire adventurers, take contracts, and choose sides in the dangerous power struggles of the frontier.

title: Gazar
description: GAZAR is an intense vertical arcade space shooter where you fight against an alien fleet destroying the galaxy. Battle through Story Mode or test your skills in Infinity Mode with 5 difficulty levels and leaderboards. GAZAR delivers non-stop action, stunning visual effects, and dynamic combat.

title: Reborn: The Evil Being
description: This is an open-world action-adventure game where you explore a stunning and vibrant fantasy world full of magic, mystery, and hidden danger. Play in either third-person or first-person as you battle monsters, uncover secrets, and grow stronger in your quest to find the truth behind your arrival.

title: Hired Stars
description: HIRED STARS is an isometric single player RTS game in an open, randomly generated sandbox universe. You take control of a small mercenary force. Plunder trade routes, attack pirates, fight the Empire or follow the story. Conquer or buy new ships and equipment. Recruit new captains and level them.

title: Galactic Space Guard
description: Galactic Space Guard is a turn-based tactics game. Lead your squad of elite soldiers against feral alien beasts and defend humanity’s space stations. Upgrade your squad, prepare for battle, and restore peace to the galaxy!

title: Stellar Raiders
description: Stellar Raiders is a turn-based tactics roguelike where you lead a crew of space pirates, raid enemy ships, and grab as much loot as you can before making your escape.

title: Big Beautiful Women: Giantess Dating Action
description: If you like big girls, this is the game for you. Play as a college student trying to find love in a city full of giant ladies. 5 lovely ladies to woo, 5 stats to manage, and 10 endings to reach. Can you fall in love before you graduate?

title: DualVerse86
description: A 2D retro speedrunner where every second counts. Switch between worlds, dodge traps, beat the clock.

title: Autumn's Dungeoneering
description: You're the expendable summoned pet. Your AI adventurer calls the shots while you try to keep them alive. You respawn when you die, they don't. Classic RPG mechanics with a completely flipped power dynamic.

title: Tales of Justice Academy: Winds Arise
description: You can play as a young martial artist entering Justice Academy. Train through various courses, customize your build with different weapons, skills, and inner techniques. Explore the jianghu, bond with companions, and shape your fate across branching stories and three romanceable heroines.

title: Messy Hearts
description: Messy Hearts is a pixel-art visual novel about a complicated coworker friendship. Through journal-style narration, Florence unpacks romance, trauma, and some messy boundaries in a deeply personal story of mental health and heartbreak. No choices; this is a linear narrative.

title: RaceWorms
description: Dig your way through this competitive multiplayer racing game with up to 6 players! RaceWorms can be played online, locally (max. 4 players) or both. Burrow through dynamic maps, leap from the ground to gain a burst of speed, and use items to hinder your opponents.

title: Dragon Survival
description: Stranded on a mysterious island with a baby dragon, survive and grow stronger. Gather resources, build your base, and overcome trials left behind by ancient explorers. An open-world survival RPG blending exploration, crafting, combat, and dragon growth.

title: Dungeon Forge
description: You are a blacksmith, not a hero. Create weapons with countless unique combinations, exploit monsters’ weaknesses, and supply heroes with what will determine their fate.

title: Recoup
description: Bring back mankind. Bring down factions. Explore the new world by solving light grid puzzles. Interact with lots of unique citizens such as a cashier and a shopkeeper. Recruit and bargain through combat-like dialogues. Modify your abilities as you experience the story through comic cutscenes.

title: To Crown or to Destroy
description: Fight horrible creatures. Devour other fairytales' hearts. Set the Princess free from her cage...and rewrite her fate! To Crown or to Destroy is a narrative RPG inspired by dark fairy tales, and tragic love stories.

title: SOS: Save Our Ship
description: SOS is a 4-player online co-op horror-action game. Operate your ship, explore dangerous islands, loot valuable treasures, and escape deadly enemies to repay your soul’s debt. Strategy and teamwork are key to survival!

title: Cuzuco
description: Challenge yourself and demonstrate your precise high-speed hand control to help our little armadillo get back home as fast as possible in this fair but unforgiving platformer game.

title: Eagle Legacy: Zero
description: Explore a cursed realm locked in mist and blood. Solve ancient puzzles, cast forbidden spells, and survive the Witch’s trial in this dark third-person adventure set at the edge of myth and memory.

title: Pelican Empyrean
description: Food is love! In this fantastical roguelike card game share the magic of abundance by cooking delicious meals for all who come to Pelican's kitchen.

title: Racer Overdrive
description: This game tells the story of your rise from obscure rookie to racing star. A global championship, hosted by a mysterious tech company, is your chance to establish yourself in the world of racing. Experience extreme drifting and nitro acceleration on iconic tracks around the world. Experience a refreshing driving system, multi-mode racing, and a rich main and side storyline. As the race progresses, participate in various events and become famous. Ultimately, uncover the championship's conspiracy from the mysterious host company and face off against an out-of-control super artificial intelligence!

title: Samurai Heroes
description: This is a highly flexible command RPG set in Japan's Warring States period. There are over 85 playable factions and over 300 generals! All items have random titles and qualities! Enjoy collecting generals and items, and freely forming your troops!

title: Catch & Defense
description: Catch & Defense is a unique mix of tower defense and monster collection. Build your team, defend your base, and use powerful creatures in a strategic game where every decision counts. Capture monsters, unleash them in battle, and combine their abilities to create unstoppable synergies.

title: The Unplace
description: “The Unplace: Escaping The Cursed Place by Facing Different Trials” is a first-person game where you must escape a cursed place by completing a series of trials.

title: Referee Life Simulator 2026
description: A realistic referee simulator! Show cards, use VAR, control matches, and rise through your referee career!

title: Paint on Paint TD
description: A tower defence that blend the chaos of bullet hell with the strategy of a tower defence. Yours tower damages enemies — but also you — forcing constant awareness and balance. No two runs play the same, with random upgrade paths and map layouts that demand fresh strategies each time.

title: Forgotten: Whispers From Ashes
description: A curse lurks in the fog in this psychological and investigative horror game. Use a strange lantern to uncover the truth and solve the mystery of Centreville and its ghostly inhabitants. Will you break the curse… before it drives you insane?

title: Starship Dice
description: Starship Dice​​ is a strategy game with dice at its core, inspired by Mahjong. Players use dice to command fleets in battle. Different point values and dice combinations form scoring hands. But don't worry, you can still battle even without forming a complete hand.

title: Saga of Yurina
description: A 2D action platformer of graceful duels and perfect parries under the falling sakura.

title: The Sage's Spirit: Shining Flame
description: A Japanese-inspired Western fantasy visual novel with a female-centric narrative, set in a unique world. Play commoner mage Nolan: follow your mentor to Sabelien, forge bonds, face power struggles. Choose to avoid chaos or carve your path—your choices will shape Aorleton and the Mage Guild’s fate.

title: Photophobia
description: Explore the abandoned city of Kriladam as you hide from the streetlights, as the city's electrical network itself is bent on killing you. Search the abandoned houses for a way to the network's mainframe as you slowly uncover the truth of the tragedy that struck the city years ago, with people turning up missing or dead every single day. Solve puzzles caused by the disrepair of the city and dodge the light as you try to destroy the machine. (from Itch.io)

title: Synth Laser
description: Synth Laser is a dynamic laser maze rhythm game. Get ready to dodge and weave around the deadly and stunning laser show, built upon the outrun and synthwave music.

title: RebreatheR
description: Underwater, you're alone. Or almost alone. You're a diver doing routine work: cleaning the seabed, collecting waste, fixing pipes. But deep down there's always something wrong. Explore, repair, survive — and try not to lose your mind.

title: Synergy Strike
description: Arcade game where you play as triangles that dash strike enemies. Enter the flow state to climb global leaderboards while earning massive combos. Up to 4 friends can join in synergy with couch co-op team mode. Unlock prizes using your precision, poise, and persistence as 2D colorful combat ignites.

title: How Many Secrets Under Ceiling
description: The first light novel-style immersive detective game's here! A dentist dead in a double-locked room seems like a suicide, but unexplained contradictions connect different truths. Each investigation and puzzles are up to you. But wait, what's wrong with this suspicious "assistant" following?!

title: Bad Heroes
description: Save the world and romance misfit heroes in the first-ever dating sim and beat-em-up! When a crime wave grips Gloom City, you and your ragtag band of heroes-for-hire uncover shocking truths about the A-list supers at the top. Fight crime, punch mimes, and kiss six superheroes with supernatural abs!

title: Holes
description: In this horror game, mysterious hands drag the hero underground, and the player's task is to get out to the surface to return to your usual work. All the action of the game takes place in dark and stuffy tunnels, in the absence of light.

title: Slingshot Pilot
description: Master fast paced gravity manuevers in this arcade space game.

title: Butterfly X
description: A free cute puzzle game from the Butterfly series of games. You can choose any level to pass through. The caterpillar can't jump on its own! It can fly from place to place bouncing off various game objects in its path. It also moves around the level on pipes. Use logic and have fun!

title: Kindred: High Tide
description: In this mystery horror visual novel, help lead a loyal crew across deadly waters. Encounter beasts, explore forgotten seas, but most importantly: don't let this become your final voyage. A deeper mystery looms, and the sea is not your only enemy. Choose a side; don't look back.

title: Earth Space Defenders
description: Earth Space Defenders is a starship twin-stick real-time shooter action game. Experience story of menacing green smoke that plagues whole universe. Supports steam multiplayer and party play with multiple controllers.

title: SubZero
description: A frozen apocalypse. Three unique survivors join you. Lead them through the icy wasteland! Zombie whispers, blizzards blur morality... Hope or doom? The fateful die burns in your grip.

title: ZK1L4
description: Survive relentless hordes in ZK1L4, a fast-paced bullet heaven! Choose unique characters, unleash powerful weapons, and master deadly skills. Play solo or team up in couch co-op to take on the chaos. Will you escape the swarm or become one with it?

title: Dead Frequency
description: A mysterious frequency is being transmitted from the Radio Tower. You the Technician, must repair the tower, and uncover what happened to the previous engineer.

title: Simulator RKM
description: Immerse yourself in the rigors of working at the RKM. Join the ranks of the supervisory staff and experience the responsibility (and absurdity) of content filtering.

title: Echoes in the Storm
description: Investigate a series of brutal crimes in a remote Arctic town in this psychological horror experience steeped in oppressive atmosphere. Step into the shoes of Detective James Northland and face the terrifying beast threatening to shatter your sanity in this chilling tale of mystery.

title: Poly Frenzy
description: Poly Frenzy is a fast-paced roguelike shooter: 5 classes with perks and progression, 10 maps, Classic & Survival modes. Loot pistols, rifles, shotguns, flamethrowers and grenades, upgrade your stats, and fight solo or in coop for leaderboard glory!

title: Halftime Adventures
description: Topdown survival mechanics mixed with roguelike adventure in a tiny open world with environment destruction. Cast spells, loot relics, buy elements to create the strongest build. Slay thousand of enemies, bosses and prevent Ragnarok.

title: Ballshit
description: The first live-action visual novel with an anime flair! Gamer 'Eggy' turns into a girl. Join bro Monkey and his gf to uncover why the school belle hides a tough guy soul. Seek a cure or embrace your new life. Your choice drives this adventure!

title: Super-B
description: Super-B is a free-to-play multiplayer game with AAA 3D graphics, where players become toy characters in a brick-built world. It features 12+ game modes at launch, offering fast-paced action and social interaction.

title: Twins & Dreams
description: Control two characters at once in this fun puzzle game! Guide them to the "WAKE" button together, avoid sneaky ghosts, and solve tricky puzzles that get harder with every level!

title: The Warrens
description: An atmospheric first-person horror immersive sim where you use an array of unusual items to escape a murderous cult of rabbit-headed men from a nightmare world.

title: Twisted Toys
description: Pack toys. Ship orders. Finish the shift. And repeat. Twisted Toy is a psychological horror game where your nightly routine reveals you’re not alone.

title: From the Dark
description: A tense, procedurally generated dungeon crawler where your only advantage is the dark. Face relentless enemies and find a way to reclaim the light that was stolen.

title: Pencil Stories
description: Explore Tsukinoma village after midnight and share the peace and solitude with Letty whilst everyone is asleep. Unravel secrets of lost letters in this unique, hand-drawn world - no rush, just calm discovery.

title: Nova Rally
description: Nova Rally: a chaotic party racer for up to 24 players. Assemble your dream team of drivers, outwit rivals, and chase victory via stats-based strategy and dynamic action! Play locally or online!

title: Whiskers Wizards & Wands
description:
Whiskers Wizards and Wands is a whimsical and cozy adventure game. Take on the role of a Wizard Cat who interacts with the world around them via a customizable wand. Fight enemies, find secret treasures, design spell combinations, to repair a world that has been broken and scrambled.

The game has a beautiful orchestral score, and is completely hand-drawn. Every image was drawn with markers on paper before being placed into the game.

title: Woolly
description: Raise a flock of colourful sheep in this slow-paced idler. Look after your sheep, gather their fleeces and complete your collection.

title: Middle Management
description: Middle Management is a satirical office building and management game. Design an office. Hire the right talent. Spread your tentacles. Keep your rebellious workers productive. Delve into brains to design the perfect employees. DON'T YOU DARE cross your boss or his INFLUENTIAL clients.

title: Aliya: Timelink
description: The player connects to a girl in distress in space thousands of years later? How will they resolve the crisis and discover the truth? Through the mechanism of real-time synchronization, the game breaks through the dimensional wall and creates an immersive dialogue across time and space.

title: No Food?
description: On a rainy day, you find and bring home an abandoned kitten. Now, you're responsible for this precious life. Provide the best environment and food, building a deep bond. Your love and care will determine the cat's growth and its final moments.

title: Empous
description: You are the leader of an empire, which you must manage by building different zones (residential, industrial, commercial) and setting government policies. If your populace reaches the maximum level of happiness, you win.

title: Hemobloom
description: A psychological horror game where you explore a twisted realm of nightmares, confront grotesque monsters and piece together the mystery of the Hemobloom.

title: Bily'Sine
description: The story of a young boy transported to the mysterious world of Bily'Sine by a magical pearl. To return home, he must explore unknown lands, face magicians in bullet-hell magic duels and make choices that will influence his adventure and the fate of the world. Each decision reveals new secrets and mysteries to unravel.

title: Saven
description: You’re Carl, a maintenance worker spending seven nights in a remote lodge. Fix what’s broken, explore its dark corners, and face the feeling that you’re not alone.. while pretending nothing is wrong.

title: Daimon Comics: Herofrenia
description:
Daimon Comics: Herofrenia follows Marco, a boy who dares to enter the former children's asylum of Aguscello, a place shrouded in mystery and legend for decades.
What begins as a game of courage quickly turns into a descent into horror, as Marco discovers that the line between reality and madness is thinner than he imagined.
His only goal: find the exit before being lost forever in the silence of the asylum.

title: My Tiny Garden
description: My Tiny Garden is a cozy idle game that runs at the bottom of your screen. Plant cute plants, water, fertilize, and prune them. Earn coins to unlock new pots, plants, and stands. Decorate your desktop and relax while working, studying, or browsing.

title: Beer Manufacture Simulator
description: Brew your own beer from scratch! Take on the role of a brewmaster, learn brewing techniques, create unique recipes, and grow your craft brewery into a full-scale factory. Expand your brewery from mashing and fermenting to bottling and selling - every decision shapes your beer empire

title: Coffee Bar Simulator
description: Open your own café and create a place brimming with aroma and flavor. Serve coffee, pastries, and desserts, expand your bar, decorate the interior, and serve your guests in a way that keeps them coming back for more!

title: Silktrails: Cats in the Grove 2
description: Silktrails: Cats in the Grove 2 is a cozy, hand-drawn adventure where you explore 11 peaceful levels and find over 1,000 hidden cats. Set in the charming world of Silkgrove, it's perfect for anyone who loves relaxing games and cute cats.

title: Pictective
description: Think you're good at spotting images and solving captchas? Join Doma, a curious little cat who's just started training to become a detective! Help Doma take on picture-matching challenges to prove your skills!

title: Face Interrogation
description: Become the detective. Try and outsmart the killer by picking the right way forward. It's up to you to figure out clues, takes notes, then use your Command Computer to unlock and confirm core behaviors in the subject. Once you understand him, you may solve the case. Or you might just end the world.

title: iRacing Arcade
description: Race across global licensed series and build your own racing team to secure your motorsport legacy in this third person arcade racer.

title: Catsuhi and Eva
description:
Natsuhi wakes up with cat ears. Eva's here to help.

This is a non-profit fan work based on the visual novel series ‘Umineko no naku koro ni’. It has no association with 07th Expansion or Ryukishi07.

title: Tiara
description:
Tiara is an exploration-focused narrative game where you play through a number of days (and dream through a number of nights) to uncover the story of Tiara's life.

The game takes place over an eventful month after Tiara has decided not to pursue the life her father wants from her any longer.

As you play through the days you'll encounter strange situations and surreal dreams with many mysteries to work out. Each day involves exploring a number of environments, interacting with characters, and working out game mechanics. These explorations will help you understand what occurred during this month of Tiara's life.

title: Mistpaw Ravine
description: The witches are gone. Only their cats remain. Make a new home for them in this feline city-builder. Keep your cats fed and happy, clean their litter box, and endure the toxic mist of a world ravaged by magic.

title: Aegis Protocol
description:
Halloween was supposed to be simple.

Halloween is off to a rough start. The plan was simple: get ready, grab your friend, and hit the party. But when the mayor turns up dead in a back alley, "simple" is officially off the table. Meet Sunny Summers. She's got a moody attitude, a wardrobe that's 99% black, and zero interest in being a hero — or anything positive really. She takes out her mood swings on her AI companion Cogs, a lovable penguin robot. They are, without a doubt, the worst duo to ever be tasked with solving a murder. But sometimes, you don't get to choose your adventure.

title: Tabletop Tavern
description:
Total War meets Slay the Spire in a new RTS rougelike.

Dive into Tabletop Tavern, a real-time strategy roguelike where every battle is a roll of the dice—and every victory is earned. Command your mercenaries on a chaotic tabletop battlefield, recruit a wild roster of warriors, and forge your legacy against relentless goblin hordes. With infinite builds, brutal choices, and endless replayability, this is RTS chaos for roguelike fanatics.

title: The House Dreams Along With Them
description:
A first person horror puzzle adventure with an emphasis on interactivity. Solve cryptic puzzles with logic and careful observation while dreaming in different rooms of a mysterious house in the woods. Completing a dream-puzzle makes the dream real in the house.

The game is inspired by Myst, Blue Prince, The Witness, The House of Leaves, Twin Peaks Season 3, liminal space games such as Pools and Limscape, anomaly horror games such as The Exit 8 and Cabin Factory as well the metafictional rabbit holes of games such as Fez, Braid, Tunic, and Animal Well.

title: Nearly Impossible Odds
description: Nearly Impossible Odds is an idle game where you increase the chances of unlikely events happening at the same time!

title: Spellatro
description: A roguelike word game that combines Balatro with Scrabble. Power up letters and use 100+ passive abilities to defeat bosses and rack up high scores!

title: Protect Gloobi
description: Protect Gloobi is an arcade-style, Souls-like FPS with a weird and offbeat vibe, where you split your focus between shredding your foes to pieces and replenishing your ammo by playing the game on your phone, during your challenging battles across the galaxy!

title: Meeting Places
description: A minimalist city builder all about creating places for neighbours of different tribes to meet.

title: Powwow Bound: A Menominee Homecoming
description: Experience the story of a Menominee family reconnecting with their tribal culture and language through the lens of the Menominee Annual Contest Powwow.

title: Fishing Corner
description: A cozy idle fishing game that lives at the bottom of your screen. Catch hundreds of fish, discover charming locations, and unravel their secrets while you work or relax. Your joyful fishing escape is just a click away.

title: Max Manos 2
description: Max Manos is back with a destructive incremental adventure. Climb a 202-floor tower swarming with monsters. Destroy enemies, unlock powerful abilities, and upgrade into an unstoppable hand of destruction. Reach the top and face the ultimate challenge.

title: Ecto Mercenary Program
description: Ecto Mercenary Program is a sci-fi looter shooter where you and your friends form a mercenary group to forge a path for yourselves. Rise from a destitute crew fighting raiders for scraps to a feared force on the station. Survival is not guaranteed.

title: BoobyRogue: Tumor Takedown
description: BoobyRogue: Tumor Takedown is a fast-paced 2D roguelike where you choose your hero and fight through waves of enemies in a symbolic battle against breast cancer. Collect weapons and items, create unique builds, and survive until the final Tumor.

title: Wild Explorer
description: Wild Explorer takes you on an immersive journey deep into the wild. Capture stunning photos of wildlife, explore ancient monuments, and uncover hidden secrets. Use your torch to navigate the darkness and complete your exploration book with every discovery. Are you ready for the adventure?

title: Cosmonade
description: Cosmonade is a real-time competitive PvP game — pilot a ship and destroy everything! Designed for players who enjoy gameplay that’s both simple and demanding... Face off against other players in matches where skill, team coordination, and reflexes make all the difference.

title: Breakout Season
description: Breakout Season is a ball-bouncing arcade roguelike. Aim carefully and harness the chaos to your advantage. Build game-breaking synergies, and destroy everything you can before the season ends!

title: Ghostly Acres
description: Ghostly Acres is an idle hotel management game that lets you play at your own pace. Build, collect, upgrade, and grow an old house into a thriving inn for ghostly travelers.

title: Cosmic Destroyer
description: The horizontal SHMUP with a grappling hook. Join a ragtag crew and fight against a Cosmic Destroyer from another galaxy. Dive into a high-intensity shooter with twisting stages, branching paths, brutal enemies. Choose your ship, grab powerful weapons and upgrades - it's time to strike back!

title: The Office Rooms
description: A short exploration game blending liminal spaces and corporate dystopia. Explore an abandoned anomaly control facility and uncover its past and purpose!

title: Physics World: Evolution
description: Push the limits of what’s possible with physics in Physics World: Evolution!

title: Moonvile
description: Moonvile is an asymmetric PvP game that you can play with your friends, for 2 to 12 players. Become a Hunter and hunt your friends, or become a Mage and work together to open the portals and escape from this dark realm.

title: Trimjob
description: Trim weeds in a golfly manner! Aim, click and trim across 4 different gardens each with 18 levels inside. Can you get a TRIM-IN-ONE in all 72 levels? Chill out and enjoy the fully handcrafted original soundtrack and retro sound effects.

title: Ministry of Stoic
description: A short, chill game about managing a ramen stall-front to distribute contraband 'cute-ware' to the masses in rebellion against a nation-wide strict anti-aesthetic policy.

title: Ks Tank War
description: 3D tank first-person shooting, you can also switch perspectives. Language Supports English, Japanese and Chinese. A mouse and keyboard are required to control. A single-player PC game with 9 levels. Non-network game.

title: RePulse-X
description: Defend Earth against alien asteroid attacks in this arcade shooter and experience the evolution of the genre in a gripping visual and auditory adventure.

title: There's No Differences: Monsters
description: Ready to test your detective skills? Find the differences between two similar monster-themed scenes!

title: Kegan
description: Kegan is a dark fantasy action RPG where you play as a dual-blade warrior on a quest for vengeance. Uncover ancient secrets, battle corrupted enemies, and shape the fate of a shattered world in this story-driven adventure.

title: Work Sucks, Let’s Play Dou Dizhu!
description: Work Sucks, Let’s Play Dou Dizhu! The world's smallest card table, hidden in your taskbar Turn your taskbar into an invisible card table! Play 5+classic card games at a height of centimeters！

title: Jet Gunner: Refueled
description: Jet Gunner is reloaded, remade and refueled for a new explosive 8-bit adventure. Relive the past glory days where VHS was king, phones didn't have screens and you'd have to blow into a cartridge to get your gaming fix.

title: Packing Life
description: A cozy and satisfying puzzle-simulation game where you step into the role of a warehouse worker with a knack for perfectly organizing and packing orders. With charming visuals, relaxing gameplay, and a lighthearted story, experience the joy of transforming everyday tasks into a fulfilling adventure.

title: Face of Fear: The Forester
description: Face of Fear: The Forester is a psychological horror where you become a new forest ranger. A couple of months of silence, a house in the middle of a dense forest and not a soul around, what could go wrong?

title: Doki Doki: Majima Helps the Literature Club!
description:
Enter a world where Goro Majima from the hit video game Yakuza series has to help the girls out on a substory.
What silly activities await Majima and the Literature club?

title: TryAngle: Shapes Warfare
description: TryAngle: Shapes Warfare is a fast-paced, addictive shoot 'em up with a twist...You can't shoot! Easy to pick up, hard to put down, dodge, survive, and chase high scores in this addictive, old-school action game!

title: Desktown
description: A minimalist city-builder that sits on the bottom of your screen! Gather resources, set timers, and decorate your town while you do other activities.

title: Srush
description: 2D Roguelike Pull-Action Game. Simply pull and fire slimes with your mouse! Attack by slamming slimes into enemies! Grow your slimes, build your strategy, and defeat invading enemies to protect your nest!

title: The DvD Idle Game
description: Remember the old bouncing DvD screensaver? Well now its an idle game, Bounce DvD's all over the screen and increase your profits, and a lot of 2000's technology will come up as shops

title: Tales of Demagost: Exodus
description: Your village got burned down, now resettle in a safe place, rebuild and train to take your revange. ToD is pretty casual story driven RPG that combines linear and open world parts.

title: Red Panda: The Quiet Path
description: A peaceful third-person adventure where you play as a red panda. Climb trees, roll into a ball, swim, knock down objects, and even fly with a balloon! No combat, no rush — just the forest, atmosphere, and full immersion in nature.

title: Bounce Up!
description: A physics-based platformer where you guide a bouncing robot through challenging levels using precise jumps. Master 480 stages across 8 worlds, each beatable in just 4 jumps. Features mini-golf physics, 3 difficulty modes, online leaderboards, and level editor.

title: Yggdra Refrain
description: *Genre girl collectible turn RPG *High-quality cel-animation with over 50 beautiful girls that will make you feel the charm of beautiful girls *A variety of mechanics and fun to capture content for turn-based RPGs *Sub-stories that allow you to feel the hidden charm of alliances and characters

title: Rabbit's Hop
description: Guide clever rabbits into one hole using smart hops and limited moves. Plan each jump carefully — squirrels, logs, and lily pads add fun twists! Use obstacles wisely to solve unique puzzles that blend logic, timing, and strategy.

title: Oreflux
description: Oreflux is a fast mining roguelite where you have to battle with time to fullfill your daily mission. Upgrade your gear, create synergies with dozens of unique items and become a millionaire!

title: Dungeon Sucker
description: Dungeon Sucker is a 2D roguelite shooter. For the upcoming dungeon inspection, the Demon left for her summer vacation and entrusted the cleaning to an agency. Armed with the “Mighty Vacuum,” you can absorb anything that stands in your way. Clean up the chaotic dungeon—if you can!

title: Bread Adventure
description: Experience a adventure in a seamless world of food, where you play as a brave bread. Freely explore interconnected regions, uncover hidden secrets, collect items to enhance your abilities, tackle challenging stages, and defeat formidable foes.

title: Chess 2048
description: Chess 2048 – Classic chess moves meet fresh puzzle-strategy twists: watch the board reshape, adapt on the fly, and master piece combos. Then escape poison gas, jump between water tiles, use portals, and pull off clever tricks.

title: Phil in the Mirror
description: The mirror calls to you. Down the endless corridor, aged walls and flickering lights cross paths. As your footsteps echo with every step, why do you find yourself frozen before the mirror? Then again, maybe it's not a mirror at all.

title: Execute
description: Kill everyone in the world with a guillotine… on a cursed Win98 desktop.

title: Tile Tempest
description: Precision meets chaos in this fast-paced, physics-driven tile matcher. Memorize colors and shapes, adapt to shifting modifiers, and stay sharp under pressure. In this storm, your memory is your greatest weapon.

title: Take7
description: Remove numbers by selecting squares of numbers where their sum equals seven. Avoid blocking yourself by carefully choosing what part of the grid to clear. Think carefully, compete against friends in the daily challenge, finish the harder gem levels or go as far as you can in endless mode.

title: Idlewood Outpost
description: An idle desktop pet game where pixel RPG heroes patrol the bottom of your screen, collect loot, and level up while you work.

title: Pogo Panic
description: Pogo Panic is a difficult, Parkour Adventure. Bounce on a pogo stick, ignite a fleeting jetpack, and vault through space. One slip-jump takes you back to the start—no checkpoints. Fail, rebound, and master the sky one desperate hop at a time.

title: Hangtime!
description: Hangtime! is a high-stakes volleyball roguelite where every rally hits like a boss fight. Chain explosive abilities, shut down evolving teams, and spike your way to the top — or lose it all in one play.

title: Mate'Morphosis
description: Mate Morphosis is a pixel art, chess-inspired puzzle game built around the concept of becoming the piece you capture. Outsmart each board, adapt to evolving mechanics, and hunt down the rival king across every stage.

title: Koloboke: Sickness Simulator
description: This is a difficult game that takes the best from Dark Souls - the rolls Combined with a first-person camera, it turns into a truly butt-blasting mix

title: Accelerator Operator
description: Build a chain reaction and watch it break apart for Profit! Accelerator Operator is cash chasing roguelike where you harness the power of the atom. Play through 4 Gamemodes with difficulty built to provide challenge to those of any skill level.

title: Incredicer
description: Incredicer is an incremental dice game where you roll dice, earn money, upgrade and buy helper hands to automate and increase your income.

title: RocketShip Go Up
description: Navigate treacherous caverns in RocketShip Go Up, a physics-based 3D game. Master your thrusters to deliver packages, dodge beams, turrets, and falling debris—or speedrun for the fastest flight. Precision is your lifeline.

title: Casino Tycoon: Sin & Win
description: Rise from a broke gambler to a casino kingpin in this high-stakes sim blending management, gambling, and adult content. Win big, indulge in luxury, go bankrupt, or start a gang war—every choice writes your destiny. In this city, you either rule the tables… or end up in a ditch.

title: Quarantine Zombies
description: Inspect survivors in Chicago's Quarantine Zone to spot the infected before they turn. No base-building - just tense inspections and gunfights! You've got 30 days until the army arrives. Hold out, fix your car, and fight your way through Chicago to the main checkpoint to save your little brother.

title: Pegasis Odyssey
description: In the far reaches of space, an odyssey begins. Explore hostile biomes, face powerful enemies, and gather vital resources in a retro shoot ’em up. Reset to evolve and grow stronger. The odyssey of Pegasis is endless, how far will you go?

title: Find Kittens 6: After Us
description: Explore the continuation of this mysterious robotic world of another civilization, finding cute cats and paint black - white locations with colored paints.

title: Everest: Real Climbing Simulator
description: Climbing Mount Everest is a lifelong dream for many — but also the world’s most dangerous and costly challenge. Now, with this world's first life-size 1:1 replica of Everest game, you can live that dream without risking your life or breaking the bank!

title: Somewhere, a Cat Sleeps
description: Between the veil of night and dawn, a cat once loved still wanders on. A meditative walking simulator about cats, patience, love, and loss.

title: Space Sim Tycoon
description: Space Sim Tycoon – A sandbox transportation tycoon game where you can explore forbidden planets, gather resources, craft goods, and establish routes to manage your space empire.

title: Critters Breakout
description: Critters’ Breakout is a chaotic 4v2 fun 3D chase game where you can play as the cute and cuddly Critters or hunt them as the ferocious Kollectors! The Critters must scavenge supplies, outwit the enemy, and escape to freedom. The Kollectors track, trap, and fight to STOP THE BREAKOUT! Wishlist Today!

title: Echo Maze
description: An innovative audio-based puzzle, Echo Maze. Sight is useless. Your only guide is the sound around you. In total darkness, pinpoint your location by the sounds of scattered gimmicks and evade deadly traps. Is every sound a hint, or an invitation to death? A 3D audio survival.

title: Chief Miner
description: Chief Miner is a space mining simulation / incremental adventure about blowing up space rocks, becoming overpowered, and uncovering a universal mystery

title: Night Shift at the Gym
description: Your first night shift at an empty gym becomes a descent into madness. Clean the equipment, mop the floors, and discover what lurks in the weight room after midnight.

title: Fling Friends
description: Fling Friends is a chaotic co-op physics platformer where one fling yeets everyone! Solve color-based puzzles, climb together (or fall together), and laugh your way through a vibrant Arabian-inspired world.

title: The Legend of Kairo
description: You’re the last fire master, fighting an evil army who threaten to bring back an ancient being from hell.

title: Arrowburst
description: Arrowburst is a calm, relaxing, short incremental game about bursting squares and upgrading your arrow.

title: Nitroglycerine!
description: A challenging arcade simulator of transporting dangerous cargo on heavy trucks along a complex and unpredictable route.

title: Minsgon Simulator
description: Minsgon Simulator is a Market & Collectible simulation where you can hatch Minsgons from mysterious eggs, manage your store, develop your collection and compete in the Olympics with your Minsgons. Organize your shelves, sell to your customers, train your Minsgons and play your way to the top!

title: Galaxy for Dummies
description: A chaotic roguelike auto-battler set in a ridiculous sci-fi universe. Assemble bizarre alien teams, exploit crazy synergies, and fight your way through the galaxy with humor and strategy.

title: Dworf's Forbidden Gold
description: Help the Dworfs obtain all the Forbidden Gold to Build a Rocket Ship to Outer Space! Click the Rock, Obtain Resources, Build a Village, Gain More Dworfs!

title: Maktala: Slime Lootfest
description: An incremental adventure where every battle unlocks new ways to slay hordes of monsters, collect powerful loot, master skills, and uncover tons of content.

title: Click to CIV
description: Smash ancient rocks, collect civilization badges, and grow your hometown into a thriving hub of progress. This simple yet addictive incremental game with active clicking guides humanity from caves to the stars.

title: Fish3: First Catch
description: FISH³: FIRST CATCH is a high-octane, surreal speed-fishing adventure where your boat is powered by fish! Engage in time-attack stages, dual-rod fishing, and underwater spear-fishing in a dreamlike world teeming with bizarre aquatic creatures.

title: Allmage
description: Allmage is a multiplayer role-playing game actively under development. It features classic pixel-art style games, open world exploration, multiplayer dungeons, and extensive character customization!

title: Scoop it! Crane Game
description: The fan-favourite arcade classic—The Crane Game—returns, powered up! Packed with more content and fresh new controls! Become a Crane Master!

title: Udon! Road to Mastery
description:
Firm noodles! Dashi! Tempura!
Fill udon orders as quickly as possible and follow the road to mastery!

title: Little Nightmares: Enhanced Edition - Complete Edition
description:
The Complete Edition includes the Enhanced Editions of:
- Little Nightmares
- Little Nightmares - Secrets of The Maw Expansion Pass

(Re)-Discover the dark whimsical tale of Little Nightmares, now enhanced in stunning 4K and 60 FPS.

Little Nightmares Enhanced Edition lets you choose between Quality or Performance Mode to favor either the visuals or the framerate depending on your preferences. With the Enhanced Edition, enjoy 60 FPS, higher resolution, and improved visual effects. Additional helpers have been added to deliver an overall smoother experience.

title: Hentai Sayo
description: Hentai Sayo is an erotic hentai puzzle game that takes you into a mysterious hospital ward, where a seductive pink-haired nurse with gentle eyes and a hidden passion is waiting for your care…

title: Lust & Magic
description: Rule your own forbidden academy of magic. Restore the castle, seduce students, and experience explicit sexual adventures.

title: The Faith of Sin
description: One night, you wake up and realize you're no longer in the real world. As you explore your home, you'll uncover clues and piece together hazy fragments of your past. And when you finally remember everything you've done — you'll understand what the 'faith of sin' truly means.

title: Project: Knossos
description: Project: KNOSSOS let´s you and up to 7 friends fight through 4 different gamemodes in levels inspired by real ancient greek temple layouts. Blindly hack away at your frenemies or band together to fight the strongest players. Coop is very optional though because only one can win.

title: Flashpoint Campaigns: Cold War
description: Master grand tactical combat as a Cold War force commander in this data-rich simulation. Plan and issue orders in asynchronous WEGO turns, leveraging real-world maps and complex features like Electronic Warfare and Air Assaults to outthink your enemy.

title: Reader Rabbit Personalized Preschool
description: On June 28, 1999, a personalized version of Reader Rabbit Preschool was released, which added the use of A.D.A.P.T. Learning Technology and the Personalized Learning Center as a second disc. This version is based on Version 2.0, featuring the carnival. In 2000, another version was released, featuring the Treehouse Launcher and the Learning Creations program.

title: Overwatch 2: Season 19 - Haunted Masquerade
description: Unmask Your Power. Haunt the Competition. Season 19 creeps in... ambitious and cloaked in mystery! The Haunted Masquerade event introduces a spooktacular mode where mystical masks grant buffs, twisting every battle into a spectral spectacle. Plus, something wicked this way returns as Junkenstein's Revenge and Wrath of the Bride are back for frightful co-op fights. Then Stadium transforms under the eerie moonlight, unveiling new Heroes, a cursed map, fresh features, and match-defining Gadgets forged in shadow. Across the season, the festive spirit of Halloween stretches wide as Mythic cosmetics rise from the crypt, and a treasure trove of twisted tricks & treats awaits those brave enough to claim them. Welcome to the Haunted Masquerade, ENTER IF YOU DARE!

title: Muv-Luv Girls Garden
description:
Muv-Luv Girls’ Garden is a free-to-play gacha / auto-battle RPG (role-playing game) developed by KMS and published by Exnoa, for PC (via DMM) and Android in Japan.

It is positioned as a new, approachable spin on the Muv-Luv franchise: not strictly a sequel or remake, but something that adds a different flavor (school life + battle + gacha) to attract both newcomers and existing fans.

title: Fred's Idle Garden
description:
Fred's Idle Garden is an idle farming simulator which sits on your desktop while you do other things.

Grow & harvest crops
Grow various crops and watch the coins roll in! Use your shiny earnings to unlock even more crops, upgrade your characters abilities and buy some nice decorations for your garden. Expand your garden and farm more crops.

Run your own little cozy shop
Once you have grown and harvested your crops, you’ll also need a place to sell them! Manage your shop, making sure it's stocked with the crops your customers crave. Keep them happy, and watch your little business thrive!

Decorate your garden
Decorate your garden with plants and trees to create your own cozy little place.

Fully automated
Fred's Idle Garden is a great game for farming multitaskers! Your character does all the hard farm work while you do your own thing. You can place the game wherever you want on your screen, zoom in and out, and it'll quietly do its thing without getting in your way. When you feel like it get back and add new things to your garden or upgrade your character.

title: Kupiec
description: Travel and trade game. Buy low, sell high, bandits on the road, people to talk to in the taverns (including white haired mercenary Geralt), paying toll.

title: The House of Toys
description: The House of Toys is a horror game in which the player ventures into an old mansion filled with seemingly harmless toys. His mission is to explore each room, searching for clues to discover which of the toys is cursed. To free the soul trapped in this toy, the player must solve intricate puzzles.

title: Mart Mayhem
description: Be a convenience-store clerk in a first-of-its-kind chat game—and kick out AI Karens. There are no preset choices. Say what you couldn’t in real life and enjoy how the AI responds differently each time. A stress-relief game where your what-ifs come to life!

title: The Vow: Vampire's Curse
description: A dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder fused with turn-based tactics. Build your deck, master deadly synergies, and survive seven cursed nights to rescue your fiancée from the vampire’s grasp.

title: Gachanimals
description: A cozy gacha shop simulator set in a world of adorable, collectible-loving dogs. Run your very own gachapon store in an animal-filled town. Decorate your shelves, restock your capsule machines, and watch as curious customers wander in to see what surprises await inside each toy capsule.

title: Melted Valor
description: The Green Forces battle the ruthless Tan menace in a war across the neighborhood. Command toy soldiers, fight bugs turned into chemical weapons, and defend your home in this all-out fight for survival.

title: Survival: Caged
description:
Natsuhi calls Eva while she's at work. Eva sends to have her brought to her.

This is a non-profit fan work based on the visual novel series ‘Umineko no naku koro ni’. It has no association with 07th Expansion or Ryukishi07.

title: Hacked: The Streamer
description: You are blackmailed in Hacked: The Streamer. Investigate clues, make impactful decisions, and shape your story to uncover the culprit is in this thrilling interactive movie. The fate of PinkyPie, a fan-favorite streamer, is in your hands.

title: Destiny 2: Year of Prophecy
description: The Destiny 2: Year of Prophecy Edition includes two expansions: The Edge of Fate and Renegades. Experience new adventures, new weapons and armor to collect, a new raid and dungeon, four Rewards Passes, and much more.

title: Destiny 2: Year of Prophecy Ultimate Edition
description: The Destiny 2: Year of Prophecy Ultimate Edition includes two expansions: The Edge of Fate and Renegades. Experience new adventures, new weapons and armor to collect, a new raid and dungeon, four Rewards Passes, and much more.

title: Little Nightmares: Enhanced Edition - The Depths
description:
Others lead the escape, but The Kid drops down into the Depths of the Maw.

Little does he know that this murky place is home to the Granny - abandoned to decay and rage she will let no-one go. He must struggle on if he wants to survive, leap from floating debris to avoid being pulled into the treacherous waters, and find a way to create a path through the depths.

The Enhanced Edition offers higher resolution, improved visual effects, and is optimized for higher framerates. Additional helpers have been added to deliver an overall smoother experience.

Save data is not compatible with the original 2017 game: Little Nightmares.

title: Little Nightmares: Enhanced Edition - The Hideaway
description:
The Runaway Kid wakes up in the engine area of the Maw, a dark and grimy place populated by Nomes. Only by finding and rescuing these curious creatures can The Kid make his way out of the Maw; but where are all these Nomes coming from? What secrets are buried in their nest?

The Enhanced Edition offers higher resolution, improved visual effects, and is optimized for higher framerates. Additional helpers have been added to deliver an overall smoother experience.

Save data is not compatible with the original 2017 game: Little Nightmares.

title: Little Nightmares: Enhanced Edition - The Residence
description:
The Runaway Kid is not out of trouble yet as he enters the Lady's private residence. Escaping the shadow enemies summoned by the Lady and solving deadly puzzles will be the only way to survive this luxurious house of dread. Armed only with his flashlight The Kid will have to repel the nightmarish illusions and dodge the traps set in the twisted library. As he walks to meet his fate, The Kid will shed light on the darkest secrets of the Maw…

The Enhanced Edition offers higher resolution, improved visual effects, and is optimized for higher framerates. Additional helpers have been added to deliver an overall smoother experience.

Save data is not compatible with the original 2017 game: Little Nightmares.

title: Dragon Age: The Veilguard - Rook's Weapons Appearance Offer
description: Rise as Rook in Dragon Age: The Veilguard. This offer includes Rook’s Weapon Appearance Set for all players who own the game.

title: Little Nightmares: Enhanced Edition - Secrets of The Maw Expansion Pass
description:
Can't get enough of Little Nightmares?

Unveil all the secrets of the Maw in a parallel escape story where you play as the Runaway Kid, another prisoner looking for a way out of this place of misfortune. On his journey, The Kid will explore the Depths, the Hideaway and the Residence, offering a different perspective on Six’s adventures as well as new challenges to overcome.

The Enhanced Edition offers higher resolution, improved visual effects, and is optimized for higher framerates. Additional helpers have been added to deliver an overall smoother experience.

Save data is not compatible with the original 2017 game: Little Nightmares.

title: Landlord Quest
description: 2BR, 1BA, NO PETS!!!

title: Don't Play Breakout Deluxe
description: A little stroll with a ball that you only control horizontally, while it keeps going up and down, inverting itself each time you touch a floor or a ceiling. Just a comfy, short game, with nice ambiance.

title: Exile Protocol
description: Exile Protocol is a heart-pounding sci-fi first-person shooter that thrusts you and your friends into the depths of procedurally generated bunkers teeming with nightmarish creatures. In this brutal world, survival is the only goal, and every decision could mean the difference between life and permanent death.

title: Plaguetrix
description: An fmv experiment. Walk down an alley which is a real video recorded in the north east of England avoiding the plague. Time moves when you walk forward but freezes when you move sideways. Anticipate the movement of the plague to avoid infection.

title: Naishitai: The parts I'm missing.
description: A short experience where you accompany Nai in her normal Sunday routine of watching TV and eating ramen.

title: Copacetic
description: Manage resources and module connections to stay alive and harvest planets of sentient life. Take control of a brain stuffed into a box full of hate as you travel across the universe exterminating all sentient biological life. Space is limited, the only enemy is yourself.

title: Asantria
description: An intriguing top-down game with a cartoonish pixel art style! Move around the map in all directions while viewing your character from above! Use various types of magic to shoot and fight monsters! Also use different outfits that will give you additional advantages in the game world!

title: League of Foes
description: League of Foes is a split-screen Multiplayer Local Battle Arena (MLBA) where players strategically push lanes, battle minions, and fight to destroy the enemy's base.

title: Aexxos
description: Command 25 ship variants with 20+ upgrades in a living, multiplayer galaxy. Explore, trade, mine, and fight epic real-time battles. Forge alliances or betray rivals—your choices shape the universe. Dive into stunning space combat now!

title: Super Blowfish Castle
description: Physics are your best frenemy in this cozy chaotic puzzle-solving platformer where you guide a small blowfish back to its castle just by pressing one button.

title: Nice City
description: Welcome to Nice City. This is a beautifully crafted, emotionally rich third-person open-world shooter. The people here are simple and honest, the place is endowed with fine spirits – if you encounter any strange characters, they might have traveled from "Return to Campus".

title: Dogpile
description: Dogpile is a roguelike deck builder about merging cute dogs into bigger dogs. Play dogs, get money, customize your dogs with special Traits, refine your deck, PLAY MORE DOGS! DOGS!

title: CarCam
description: CarCam throws you into childhood chaos as a remote-controlled car! Race, capture zones, play car-powered billiard, or just roam free - all in a giant living room world. Play solo or with friends. Wishlist now and relive the fun!

title: Abyss Born
description: Abyss Born is a single-player dark action RPG with survival and dungeon crawler elements. Fight various monsters, explore dangerous dungeons, trade with allies and complete quests to find a friend and face evil.

title: Ink Link
description: Ink Link is a sleek world of action in 2.5D! Outsmart enemies, piece together platforms, and upgrade your skills to take on powerful bosses. Discover hidden paths as darkness creeps in and your ally-turned-enemy, Ink, tests your skills—and your will to survive.

title: Dimensional Gates
description: Truly ambitious Indie RPG with innovative modern concepts and original storylines. Normal mode has random encounters and boss fights. Story mode has no random encounters and boss fights play themself out. Can you stop the Shetman from destroying the strings and the very fabric of our Universe?

title: Null Train
description: Battle through an endless, ever-changing sci-fi train in this gritty 2D roguelike. Each car is a new challenge—fight enemies, discover items from unique realities, and defy gravity. Die and start over, unlocking new gear and skills to push further every time. Welcome aboard the NULL Train.

title: Helrift
description: Enter a gritty MMORPG where rival factions clash in brutal PvP. Defend your city, conquer enemies, and build your legacy. Forge alliances, master skills, and shape the realm’s destiny.

title: MeowPower! Yachiyo
description: A casual side-scrolling beat em up where you play as a catgirl and join forces with cats to defeat enemies.

title: Thargelia
description: Separated by disaster. Connected by choices.In Thargelia, a narrative adventure multiplayer game for two players, your decisions shape more than just your own fate. Cooperate, sabotage, or survive at any cost. How far are you willing to go to save your own life?

title: Delicious Winter Edition
description: Christmas themed version of the original Delicious game. The game is the same, serve all customers within the time limit, but with a winter theme.

title: The Oversight Bureau
description: The Oversight Bureau is a voice-driven narrative adventure game. You are candidate 404, trapped inside C.U.T.E. - a rehabilitation program designed to make you a more “appropriate” member of society. As time ticks away and days blur, escape is the only way to keep your sanity and your voice, 404.

title: BunkerZ
description: Stylized WWI trenches meet explosive co-op mayhem. Hold the bunker as a Rifleman, Medic, Engineer, or Machine Gunner. Fight back with era specific WWI weapons, shovels, and flamethrowers, then launch undead sky-high with grenades and explosives. Solo or multiplayer survival at its most chaotic.

title: Protocol Paradox
