description: Protocol Paradox is a fast-paced roguelike shooter blending twin-stick combat, anomaly-based weapons and branching lore. Survive procedural sectors, customize builds with weapons and passives, face concept-driven bosses, and replay for new revelations.

title: Island of Hearts
description: After a rough breakup, you do what any reasonable person would: run away to a remote tropical island full of beautiful strangers. There, you’ll meet six captivating women, each with her own charm, secrets, and questionable taste in men. Your choices decide who you love, lose, or accidentally ghost.

title: Motion Wulin
description: "Motion Wulin" is a fast-paced martial arts action game where you play as a time-traveling warrior fixing broken timelines.

title: Forest Time
description: Forest Time is a tactical game with a cozy experience. Enjoy various puzzles in a charming, vibrant world with peaceful yet challenging tasks.

title: Slot or Not
description: Deck-building turn-based slot machine battling adventure. Fight evil fruits aside your battle buddy slot machine to save your village. Spin your destiny and grab the precious loot in a fast paced colorful adventure.

title: Nebula Cleanup Crew
description: Nebula Cleanup Crew is a short top down action roguelite shooter with a focus on hot and cold weaponry. Rescue your crew members as you blast enemies and bosses away with super heated and chilled weapons — freeze foes, overheat them and unleash powerful supertemp special attacks!

title: Memoriedit
description: An adventure exploring two distinct types of information: conversation and memory. A district two stations away from the city, a night district who exude a atmosphere of alluring “Just listen to their desires, then do whatever you like.” —Told ya?

title: Echoes of the Hive
description: Team up with friends in this 2D fantasy sandbox adventure! Explore mysterious worlds, craft powerful gear, battle monsters, and delve deep underground to uncover secrets and challenge epic bosses.

title: Supernatural Visual Novel: The Fourteenth Guzai Vol. 1 & 2
description: Middle school girls face final exams and a deadly supernatural game. An urban legend of a “nonexistent telephone pole.” The “Eight Sisters,” silver assassin, and mysterious “RULERS.” A supernatural suspense of survival and conspiracy. Ongoing story continuing to unfold.

title: Iceburg
description: An adventure-based, third-person co-op/single-player shooter. Destroy enemies with a variety of modern and futuristic weapons, and solve puzzles in between action-packed levels. Destroy zombies, robots, explore the locations of a secret underground base to solve the main mystery of Antarctica

title: Evolve or Die
description: Evolve or Die is the co-op multiplayer version of Arrow a Row. Team up with your friends, choose upgrades, and fight waves of different Kuns—only together can you defeat Lao Da.

title: BioMenace Remastered
description: The classic 2D action platformer BioMenace returns with enhanced graphics and refined gameplay. Fight your way through a city ravaged by dangerous mutants, rescue hostages, find secrets and rack up points. Locate the secret lab behind this attack and prevent Dr. Mangle from taking over the world!

title: Alisha's Sexual Fear
description: Alisha's Sexual Fear is a casual board game in which you have to help Alisha conquer her fears and have fun with her! ^_^

title: Overcat
description: OVERCAT is a 1v1 twin-stick fighting game, where competitive and casual players can finally have a fair fight!

title: Beat of Rebellion
description: Be the voice out of the choir! Beat of Rebellion is an isometric rhythm-based Hack & Slash. Follow the Beat, create your own Melodies and unleash devastating combos to fight against a totalitarian regime in a cyberpunk city.

title: Shoulder-Mounted Space Program
description: Explore the vast reaches of space inside a realistic gravity simulation with only your trusty rocket launcher by your side. Battle scores of local robotic inhabitants that want to push you out and stake your claim at the edge of the galaxy.

title: Checkmate in the Wild West: Chess Adventure
description: Saddle up for a Wild West chess puzzle adventure! Will you become an outlaw or a deputy? Your choices matter. Test your wits, cross paths with bandits, sheriffs, helpers, and hustlers. Solve puzzles, challenge characters, buy powerups, and determine your destiny.

title: Perfect Liar
description:
a modern juke-em-up / a speedrunner's purgatory / a bite-sized dose of cortisol

collect map tiles to chart your path through the liar's maze while simultaneously dodging your way through a web of increasingly menacing angelic foes; think on your feet and make your own luck from the draw to score record times, or plow ahead cautiously taking down each stage as it comes. collect powerups, study patterns of movement, die endlessly—and come back each time ready for more. test your wits with a unique 'dodging only' mechanic through a stark hand-drawn world, overcoming 18 grueling untruths to nerve-wracking electronic blast beats.

title: Arcane Plunder
description: Explore enchanted dungeons shrouded in magical fog. Reveal hidden paths, uncover treasures, and telekinetically loot artifacts from the shadows. Upgrade your magic, extend your reach and dive deeper into the unknown in this bite sized idle clicker adventure.

title: Omertà: Mafia Novel
description: Noir visual novel set in 1950s New York. Infiltrate a prison, build a smuggling network, and shape fates through tough choices across branching paths.

title: Letherfall
description: Letherfall is a first-person horror video game with Lovecraftian elements: the player must make their way through monstrous entities and intricate puzzles while exploring the abandoned village of Letherfall. Some nightmares don’t fade. They’re just waiting for you to open the wrong door.

title: Deepfried in Deepspace
description: Take orders from alien customers & make some food! First you gotta get the ingredients, & they seem to be a bit more sentient than they are on earth. Once you have your order, go to the back & find the ingredients stored in coolers and beat the crap out of them! Be careful, the food fights back.

title: My Car My Life
description: Build the car of your dreams to compete in intense drag races, featuring detailed mechanics, advanced customization, and realistic physics. Tune every part of the engine, control the revs with precision, and win through reaction and skill.

title: Kali's Legion
description: An open-world adventure RPG. Trade, hunt, fight, plunder, ravage settlements and cities, descend into the dungeons of long-destroyed civilizations, level up your character, assemble a squad, join factions, don't let the disaster happen again, stop the legion!

title: Keypress Mania
description: Stretch your fingers and get ready for all kinds of typing that await you. Whether you're typing casually, typing for challenges, typing for rankings, typing competitively, or simply typing for practice — Keypress Mania offers it all. Press your keys and join the typing craze!

title: Liminal Waters
description: Explore, Listen and Observe. LIMINAL WATERS is a liminal space exploration game. Discover a large facility with diverse rooms and themes and be enchanted by the radiant beauty of Unreal Engine 5.6. Relaxation, anxiety, confusion or familiarity? The mysterious Poolrooms are waiting for you.

title: The Condition
description: You move into an old house for three months, and everything seems peaceful… until you notice the door you must never open. From the very first day, unexplained noises, fleeting shadows, and objects that move on their own begin to haunt you. The line between reality and paranoia blurs as you explore the house, and every unexpected sound heightens the tension. In The Condition, your choices and curiosity confront a mystery that defies logic and tests your sanity. Some rules are meant never to be broken… will you dare to discover what lies behind the door?

title: Evil of Fate
description: Evil Of Fate is a horror-thriller game. Features first- and third-person weapon mechanics Experience this fascinating and frightening atmosphere with up to 4 friends. Fight in a universe where a witch has imprisoned people.

title: Ark of Isolation
description: Once humanity's last hope, the space vessel 'PramaArk' now drifts aimlessly, light-years away from Earth. It's up to you to set things right, and uncover the secrets buried deep within the ship. The one left behind, and the one who had to say goodbye... Which one will you relate to more?

title: Spoofs Playland
description: Play, paint, fish, collect and decorate! Spoofs Playland is a relaxing, family-friendly collection of point-and-click minigames where you collect decorations and bond with the adorable Spoofs. Earn rewards, complete quests, buy new backgrounds and hundreds of items, and make your ideal room!

title: HDOS
description: A free-to-use third party client for Old School RuneScape that is restoring HD for the game Old School Runescape.

title: Swordmancy
description:
Swordmancy is a survivor game where the player controls a Swordmancer, warriors capables of controlling living weapon.

You defeat enemies, get the experience and choose one out of three random upgrade as you level up. Once you get an upgrade to level 8, you can evolve the weapon to get an even more powerful version.

As you defeat bosses, complete events and evolve weapons, you will unlock more characters, weapons and upgrades. You can try every single one of them and unlock more and more elements in your collection!

title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 - Season 6
description: The Haunting returns with a vengeance in Season 06, bringing new Halloween-themed map variants and chilling LTMs across all three modes. Fight as and against iconic slashers and zombies and unlock a hearty helping of spooky rewards scattered throughout in-game events and the new seasonal Battle Pass.

title: A Kobold Story : Trenchcoat Adventurer
description:
Trenchcoat Adventurer is a dungeon-crawling roleplaying game with a whimsical heart and a beautiful, hand-drawn CrayonVision aesthetic.

Three Kobolds find themselves drawn to the allure of Adventuring after overhearing how successful adventurers get to eat the best food and have the shiniest shiny things. Cunningly disguised in a trenchcoat, this towered trio find their way though an ever-deepening dungeon in the hunt for shinies and tasties!

Unbeknownst to them, the "beginner dungeon" that they wandered into breaks through into a much deeper, darker place full of real peril... with the training wheels off and the worst equipment they could find, can our Trenchcoated heroes go from wannabes to true heroic adventurers?

title: Dead by Headshot
description: A first-person survival shooter with apocalyptic simulation elements, focused on precision and headshot mechanics. Every shadow hides a deadly threat. Survive the night, manage your ammo, and fight off ever-increasing waves. Do you have what it takes to resist?

title: A Simple Life with My Unobtrusive Sister
description: A fully animated and voiced sister life-sim with roguelite runs. Find a cure for Mio’s illness. Share meals and quiet nights at home, then enter the Abyss each day to fight, loot, and push deeper to protect your simple life together.

title: Riruri Tachibana: Reincarnated
description: Haruka, who streams as the popular virtual streamer Riruri Tachibana. After a streaming accident, her everyday life quietly begins to crumble. What awaits her is a new stage—or an endless nightmare. A short first-person horror story themed around “reincarnation.”

title: Dicey Bizniz
description: A strategic dice roguelike where you build powerful combinations by locking and rerolling dice to beat escalating score targets. Collect game-changing relics, cast tactical spells, and master probability through 11 challenging antes.

title: RV There Yet?
description: A co-op adventure about driving your Recreational Vehicle home.

title: Sweet Easter
description: Sweet Easter - A simple and beautiful puzzle game with Easter theme, where five cute resurrected bunny girls work, accompanied by relaxing music, and after completing the level you can enjoy the girls' photos in the gallery.

title: Conductor: Eternal Service
description: Conductor: Eternal Service is an atmospheric horror simulator of a Russian train conductor. Perform routine duties, sell goods, and keep the carriage in order… until passengers begin to show signs of demonic possession.

title: Adventures of Astronaut Max
description: Join astronaut Max in thrilling space adventures with turn-based battles and real-time exploration. Battle mutants, monsters & more. Upgrade skills, uncover mysteries.

title: Suzerain: Expanded Edition
description: Suzerain Expanded Edition includes political drama game Suzerain and the Kingdom of Rizia DLC.

title: Isonzo: First Wave Edition
description: The Isonzo First Wave Edition includes a huge array of visual customization options: 140 items from four DLCs: ‘Elite Units', ‘Veteran Units', ‘Reserve Units', and ‘Alpine Units'.

title: Vale's Echo
description:
2D cozy horror adventure that blends dark comedy, psychological storytelling, and surreal art.

In Vale’s Echo, death isn’t the end — it’s your last chance. Players take on the role of Vale, a sarcastic and troubled soul who wakes up on a mysterious train to nowhere. No pulse. No past. No clue. Her only company? Echo — a floating skull full of secrets, charm, and just the right amount of mischief.

As Vale and Echo journey through the underworld to confront Death and uncover Vale’s past, players will meet a bizarre and unforgettable cast of characters — from chatty fish-human hybrids to leech merchants and morally dubious spirits. Each encounter challenges not just Vale’s choices, but also the player’s empathy, humor, and sense of right and wrong.

Gameplay in Vale’s Echo revolves around dialogue choices, unsettling puzzles, and branching narratives that shape Vale’s relationships, memories, and ultimate fate.

Beneath its eerie charm lies a deeply emotional story connecting the surreal with the human — all wrapped in cinematic visuals, melancholic music, and darkly witty writing.

title: Isonzo: Movember Handlebar
description: Support the Movember movement in-game! Unlock the extravagant ‘Handlebar’ moustache to adorn the upper lip of soldiers of every faction. Proceeds are donated to the Movember Foundation charity.

title: Coven of Crones
description: Coven of Crones is an official Creation, a DLC-sized mod, for The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim that introduces a completely new island, a dark storyline, and custom assets.

title: Story of Alicia
description:
Story of Alicia is a fan-made revival project based on 말과 나의 이야기, 앨리샤 (Story of My Horse and Me, Alicia), the horse racing and ranch management game developed by Ntreev Soft. Created as a private server, Story of Alicia seeks to faithfully recreate and expand upon the experience of the original title, which was discontinued in 2014.

The project is built around community-driven development, with a focus on consistent updates, gameplay improvements, and player feedback. While still in active development, Story of Alicia will be fully free-to-play upon release, allowing both returning fans and new players to experience the world of Alicia once again.

Story of Alicia is an independent, non-commercial project and is not affiliated with Ntreev Soft.

title: Lord of Mysteries
description: Lord of Mysteries is an upcoming RPG game based on web novel Lord of Mysteries officially licensed by Cuttlefish That Loves Diving.

title: Cluck to the Top!
description: You are a rooster and your girl's been birdnapped. Get up there and save her!

title: Bottom-up Beatdown: Hostile Takeover
description: Bottom-Up Beatdown: Hostile Takeover is an intense 2D character action game set in a world dominated by corporations led by monsters! The only way out is up! Become a star solo or share the spotlight with friends in co-op mode!

title: The Curse of Tethria
description: Explore dungeons, avoid traps, fight monsters and progress through a hand-crafted world. Defeat your enemies with action combat using your sword and shield, the tools you find and items from the environment. Can you overcome these challenges to end the curse and restore the world from evil?

title: Heaven Does Not Respond
description: Heaven Does Not Respond is a psychological and analog horror simulation game set in an alternate 2005 timeline. Play as intelligence agent, exploring a retro computer interface to decrypt hidden files, watch mysterious videos, and uncover dark secrets behind a young man’s sudden death.

title: Gaia Maker
description: Gaia Maker is a planet-wide simulation game of terraforming, based on real physics and geology. As the planet's overseer, wield advanced technologies to reshape barren planets into life-filled worlds. Foster animal life, cultivate civilizations, or destroy them. Their fate is in your hands.

title: The 2024 Secret Santa Collab
description: This is The 2024 Secret Santa Collab! This was a collaboration project hosted by Goose, BossSauce and Kazt. Featuring 61 maps made over the course of four months, with 3 lobbies that were developed over the course of 7 months.

title: Ribbit Ranch
description: Ribbit Ranch is a cozy and relaxing idle game. Collect frogs and raise them in real time, then sell them to earn a profit! Customize your habitats by filling it with decorations, rare frog species and ultra-rare special frogs!

title: Kody's Purgatory
description: Kody's Purgatory is an RPG maker game developed by KODYDEV.

title: Winter Hunting
description: Winter Hunting is a Roguelite match-3 game. Matching tile to hunt beasts, gather firewood and grow stronger. Survive for 60 days to win the game!

title: Gallery Collab 2024
description: 2024 Gallery Collab contains over 20 maps, and an amazing lobby. Covering all the difficulties, from Beginner to Grandmaster! And we also included several new mechanics for the players to discover!

title: Kody's Purgatory: Kenshi
description: Kody's Purgatory: Kenshi is a spinoff of Kody's Purgatory (Game), released on July 20th, 2025, taking place a few months after the original. In the Barbosa village, the new elder Benson delivers the news that Anthony Barbosa, the former elder, was killed by a Kody Beatz Jr. Kenshi, a young warrior fighter who is enthralled in the Barbosa fighting style, decides to take it upon himself to avenge Anthony, locate and kill Kody Beatz. Kenshi goes on a thrilling adventure, meeting friends, foes and beings beyond his comprehension. As it seems he has the perfect opportunity to avenge Anthony, he asks upon himself "is it worth it?".

title: The Chosen Ones
description:
Twelve peaceful years have passed since The Great War ended. The war that lasted centuries but no man could recall the reason of. The age of despair, bloodshed, loss and grief is now past. The new age brought the opportunity for human kingdoms to rise, as humanity has broken free from the grip of the dragons.

This story focuses on Kingdom of Balgaron and three famous Dragon Slayers: Phodom, Fradz and Galeoth. Each of them starts their journey in different places, but they will eventually meet eachother and join forces along the path. Together, the three are forced to go a conflict beyond their imaginations.

Lead them into an epic world, guided by a strong storyline that covers hate, love, war and peace.

title: Chameleon: DYH - Season Finale
description:
Chameleon - DYH: Season Finale brings all gamers' choices to a conclusion.
Exploring multiple endings
affected by strategy, emotional level, and skills.
Pushing forward all characters through their biggest challenges yet.

title: The Detectorist Guild
description: Explore a quintessential British village collecting artefacts and studying local history. Solve a dark mystery that draws in you and your family. Complete quests for villagers who have a habit of losing their treasured possessions. Donate, trade and sell your ‘finds’ to build impressive collections.

title: Curse of the Forsaken
description:
After securing the Forsaken's hold in Lordaeron, the Banshee Queen Sylvanas Windrunner began preparing for war against her most hated enemy, the Lich King. Her plans were delayed as the Forsaken found themselves under attack by the Scarlet Crusade, a religious human faction dedicated to the eradication of the undead.

Undeath, loss and pain had turned the Forsaken mistrustful of the living; their destiny would be their own to seize. But as enemies lay in wait in every corner, Sylvanas Windrunner began to wonder if the Forsaken would ever be able to succeed on their own.

title: Aquaville
description: An idle desktop aquarium game where you buy, feed, and breed fish to discover new species with unique rarities and tiers. Decorate cozy tanks and customize your desk with cute items. Earn money just by caring for your fish, even while you work or relax!

title: The High Tower
description: The High Tower is a third-person, action-adventure game set in a post-apocalyptic world. After a global catastrophe, humanity builds a sky-piercing megastructure in search of hope. As the chosen one of the Church, you must ascend the tower, uncover hidden truths.

title: Retro Racing 2
description: From the developer of Amiga classics Nitro and A.T.R. Retro Racing 2 is a frenetic top-down arcade racer with power-ups and wild tracks. Pure retro-speed! Race solo or in split-screen multiplayer, and relive classic retro racing with a modern twist!

title: My Cozy Aquarium
description: Dive into a cozy underwater world where caring for fish and decorating aquariums becomes your most relaxing adventure.

title: Deadzone: Rogue - Apophis
description: Enjoy a new forging system for weapon progression, 8 Missions, the powerful Radiation element, new enemies, environments, bosses, and more as part of the free "Apophis" Zone 4 Expansion!

title: Metro Rivals: New York
description: Reputation is paramount; strategy is key, and all-out speed can make or break everything. Welcome to Metro Rivals—a genre-defying subway simcade game where you battle Track Titans in solo play or clash with friends in fierce PvP.

title: Aim To Capture
description: Aim to Capture is a stylish horror visual novel where you take on the role of a spy diving into the memories of others to find dirt on a sinister biocorporation.

title: Last Breath
description: Last Breath is a tense side-scrolling shooter in a fungal-ravaged world, where humanity has become “Spore Zombies.” As the older sister Guan Jin, fight through the ruins to find your lost sibling. Scavenge, adapt, survive. But what awaits: redemption or a deeper nightmare?

title: Rust Rides
description: Roads that remember time. Cars with soul. Travel through Ukrainian steppes and villages — survive, race, trade, create. In the world of Rust Rides, there is no script — only you, the road, and a choice that changes everything.

title: Flarebound
description: A tactical roguelike where you throw flares to briefly pierce the darkness, draw a path in pitch black, and race dripping lava following you through the volcanic tunnels. Plan fast, dig deep, and descend to the safe place before the lava swallows everything.

title: Tiger Casino & Slot Game
description: "Tiger game" is a very fun small fresh beauty leisure entertainment chess and card mobile game. The game is simple, easy to play, fast-paced, and suitable for young and old. "Tiger game" introduces the current technology and supports one click login, which saves a long time for players to register.

title: Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising - Additional Character: Galleon
description:
Set Contents:
• Playable Character: Galleon
• Premium Avatar: Galleon
• Badge: Galleon
• Weapon Cutout: Gaia Scepter
• Figure Studio poses and expressions 1–6 for Galleon

title: Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising - Additional Character: Wilnas
description: Contents: Playable character (Wilnas), premium avatar (Wilnas), badge (Wilnas), weapon cutout (Red King Crab), and Figure Studio poses 1-6 and expressions 1-7 for Wilnas.

title: Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising - Additional Character: Meg
description: Set Contents: Playable character (Meg), premium avatar (Meg), badge (Meg), weapon cutout (Survival Blade EX), Figure Studio poses and expressions 1-6 for Meg and Figure Studio poses and expressions 1-3 for Mari.

title: BL Werewolf:Doki-Doki Summer vacation
description: A werewolf game based on BL manga! Split into the straight camp and the lewd camp and protect your chastity!

title: Fishbait
description: Fishbait is a chaotic card game where you play as fish that needs to avoid getting caught by the fisherman. It has online multiplayer and can be played with up to 4 people in a round. With its Russian roulette–style mechanics, only the last fish alive wins.

title: Toontown Rewritten: Clear Coasts
description: Clear Coasts is a beach vacation neighborhood that is currently hidden under the cloud on the map of Toontown in the Shticker Book. According to the brochure, its theme is inspired by the Italian Riviera where Toons can relax, explore, and socialize to get away from the Cogs and enjoy the playfulness of a beach trip. On August 28, 2023, Flippy formally announced that the playground was under construction.

title: Lone Pine
description: Lone Pine is a single-player, 2D adventure set in the fictional Lone Pine National Park. You play as Izzie, who has come to Lone Pine to try to photograph some of its mysterious, undiscovered 'cryptids'.

title: Resurviv.biz: Battle Royale
description: A remake of Surviv.io with a unique twist and fresh gameplay elements. https://resurviv.biz

title: There Are People In Your Walls
description: Psychological horror game about fear and anxiety, there are people in your walls.

title: Warrior Maiden Lecia and the Lost Fortress
description: A fresh graduate of the military academy, Lecia has just joined the ranks and received her first posting. She is to head to Kreist Fortress, a remote outpost far from the capital Central. However, what awaits her is the Lost Fortress fallen into disrepute at the hands of her new commander.

title: For God's Sake, Help Him!
description: FOR GOD'S SAKE, HELP HIM! is a tiny, surreal first-person art "game" about what it's like. your goal is singular and simple: try to help him, however you can... if you can. that's a tall order considering you're both in a blank void and he's being crushed over and over.

title: Treasure Drop
description: Don’t let your treasure leave the dome. Merge it together, and create the biggest fortune!

title: AshBall
description: Outrun the lava. Trust your teammate. One ball, one chance — pass or perish in AshBall's minimalist, deadly arenas. Climb the leaderboard together and prove you're the ultimate duo.

title: Night Drone
description: "Night Drone" is a game about using drones in modern warfare. To achieve your goals, you will have to control various types of drones (reconnaissance drone, kamikaze FPV drone, drop drone, surveillance drone, FPV drone and others).

title: Farming Life Simulator
description: Plant seeds, grow crops, chop trees, go to fishing, and trade goods in a fully interactive farming simulator. Build relationships, expand your fields, manage resources, and experience daily life in a living village.

title: Rage Fishing
description: Help Mr. Wormy rescue his beloved by tackling fast-paced and absurd microgames in this chaotic, frenetic and addictive arcade fishing game.

title: Mitla
description: A challenging 2D platformer inspired by Mesoamerican mythology, where you control a frog to overcome deadly traps and explore a labyrinth filled with secrets and danger.

title: Sink and Score
description: Uncover hidden warships, reach the score limit with limited shots, and reshape your tactics using powerful cards. A solo strategy game blending grid-based discovery with deep deck-building.

title: My Lovely Flower
description: A PS1-style horror game where you run a flower shop, grow blooms, and craft bouquets for mysterious customers. Uncover secrets buried in soil as tension slowly takes root.

title: Halls of Nyarlathotep
description: Explore the shifting labyrinths of the Dreamlands in this Lovecraftian roguelite FPS, where every shot, step, and secret chips away at your sanity as you face eldritch horrors and ancient Outer Gods.

title: Angelo
description: A charming and brutal baroque story.

title: Pond
description: Build. Customize. Relax. Create your own peaceful fish pond and watch it come alive, piece by piece. Shape the terrain and decorate your pond the way you like. Place fish and see them swim around in their new home. No stress—just a soothing world where you can enjoy the beauty of nature.

title: Deckout
description: Deckout is a fast, competitive card game for 2–4 players. Secretly pick your cards, reveal in order, play by a random round rule, and survive the hammer—each hit costs a heart. Quick rounds, big laughs, sharp decisions.

title: Celephaïs Dead Cities
description: Multiplayer survival game in a long dead world.Explore the sunken horrors in your sea vessel while carefully choosing where to anchor and explore the wasteland on foot... NO NPC, All encountered survivors are other players. No leveling, no grinding, just PVP, PVE, with looter and survival elements.

title: Dreiframe
description: Dive into the decaying machine world of DREIFRAME, a pixel-art metroidvania packed with challenge. As a Frame, a sword-wielding robot, fight brutal enemies, exploit their weaknesses, unlock powerful but risky abilities, and uncover the land’s story through exploration and combat.

title: Mind Lure
description: A Lovecraftian deck-building roguelike. Collect eerie cards and twisted creatures. Strengthen your deck while battling sanity loss in waters haunted by unspeakable entities.

title: Suika Puffworks
description: Relax to the comfy and cozy atmosphere and master the games Physics to strategically match items until you make a nuclear ball without running out of space in ​this new hit action puzzle game! How many nuclear balls can you merge?

title: Red Passport: Ticket to Russia
description: Embark on a thrilling journey across Russia! From a cozy apartment to the airport, fly to a new city, and ride a train to Vladivostok. Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover secrets along the way!

title: Funky Monkey: Time to Slack Off!
description: Every click is a sacrifice to fate! Keep working, keep slacking off, and smash that keyboard for the monkey’s hats, clothes, wigs, and all sorts of wild accessories! Dress it up, hang out with it, and create the coolest desktop look — all for the monkey!

title: Rush Roulette
description: A village trapped in fear and snow. Leap and climb across rooftops to avoid danger. When the curse shifts, choose a powerful ability card to turn the tide. Avoid the monster and collect three relics to escape in this intense asymmetric multiplayer battle.

title: Chicken Defense
description: Plant, harvest, and defend your farm! Build turrets, gather resources, and fight off waves of enemies. And most important defend your CHICKEN!

title: Mr Investigator
description: The Time Bureau sent us another unfortunate case to crack. Do what you do best - Use your detective skills, explore the written memories and restore the victim's diary.

title: Fly Over! 100KM! Mountains!
description: This is an easy-to-learn yet incredibly challenging endless flight game. Control your little plane through the ever-changing sky, nimbly avoiding obstacles and desperately trying to escape the ever-approaching tornado behind you. Every advance is a test of skill and perseverance.

title: Lost in the Woods
description: 'One last try' Violet is determined to save her broken marriage - at any cost!Wandering through a dark forest in search of lost mementos, she finds the world around her shifting with every step.

title: Window Aquarista
description: Create your dream aquariums while you do other things in this relaxing idle game that sits on the bottom of your screen. Unlock new fish and watch them thrive with your help. All at your own pace.

title: Galactic Deck Clash
description: A deck-building roguelike set in a sci-fi galaxy. Collect a huge variety of cards, command different factions, and explore endless combinations. Uniquely, you can modify card effects and enhance yourself with equipment, runes, and items to overcome powerful enemies repeatedly.

title: Chick Game
description: Chick Game is a boomer shooter, survival game where you care for the flock, get upgrades and craft defenses during the day to defend the coop from waves of predators as a powerful, shotgun-wielding rooster at night. Survive all 7 nights in Normal mode or see how long you can survive in Chaos mode.

title: Cam4Z: Bodycam Zombie Elevator Survivor
description: Step inside. The elevator’s waiting. Survive, or don’t. Who cares?

title: Mycopsychosys: Project Jupiter
description: Explore, investigate, and survive this new infection. Collect clues, meet and interact with people, and bond with the main cast. Solve the mysteries like a true detective and follow the non-linear narrative. Are you ready to face this new deadly infection?

title: Mystery Island: Enigmatic Painting
description: After a difficult journey, Ada officially became a detective. This disappearance commission seemed extraordinary. During the exploration of the ancient castle, it seemed that a series of strange events also surfaced...

title: The Beast Is yet to Come
description: Unleash your inner beast in The Beast Is Yet To Come — a chaotic 3D action roguelike where you play as a brutal Troll crushing enemy hordes across multiple battlegrounds. Build devastating "punch hell" combos and fight through the storm.

title: Stigma: The Salem Legacy
description: Stigma is a truly small indie game. It is a psychological detective horror focused on atmosphere and mystery. Uncover the haunting narrative of an old house and its forgotten past.

title: Jìngjiè 2: Qiánkūn Yī Zhì
description: Jìngjiè 2: Qiánkūn Yī Zhì is an independent, single-player rogue-like RPG. Its 1v1 turn-based dice-rolling combat is innovative and unique, with victory determined by a point-based competition and every roll of the dice full of uncertainty. The game offers a vast array of skills and artifacts, allowing for a flexible build style. Whether you're a "Gambler" relying on extreme strategy or a "Noble Phantasm" relying on divine weapons, you'll find a way to victory. The perfect blend of randomness and deep strategy makes every challenge unique. Embark on an adventure, warriors! Use wit and luck to defeat the demons and win your own victory!

title: GreySky&StarNavigator
description: GreySky&StarNavigator is a text-based adventure game. In the game, you will learn about the story of a young girl trapped in a one-day world. You will follow her perspective to experience the joyous daily life of her alien companions, and eventually find a way to escape from this world.

title: Zhúlù Hàn Mò
description: Zhúlù Hàn Mò invites you to the exciting and transformative Three Kingdoms era at the end of the Eastern Han Dynasty, where you can embark on a journey to dominate the world and unify the Central Plains with unprecedented freedom, depth and historical authenticity.

title: Pet Street Story
description: Jinyu, also known as Xiaoli, worked on Pet Street to repay her owner's debt as a way of expressing gratitude for the owner's life-saving kindness. During this time, she made various friends and experienced unusual events. As she matured, Jinyu decided to revive the increasingly depressed Pet Street.

title: Lóng Shén de Xīnniáng Wàizhuàn: Yù Líng Qǐ Tán
description: A Japanese-style fantasy x fairy-tale narrative adventure ADV, telling the story of an unnamed god and a wandering miko…

title: The Rainy Night
description: On a rainy night, it's all up to you whether to show love or be cruel.

title: Shū Liàn yǔ Jūn: Xiānzǐ Xiàn
description: A vibrant, white-haired beauty, but her true identity is actually a timid, short-haired, glasses-wearing girl?! I'm still dating her! A 200% sweet college romance! Dates, hand-holding, hugs, kisses, and marriage after graduation!

title: Yāo Dāo Zhuàn
description: Yōko-Densetsu is a narrative - rich text game with tabletop role - playing simulations. In the stormy Middle Earth, northern demons and power - hungry eunuchs run wild. Your choices shape the story. Meet like - minded people on your journey and forge your unique path.

title: Běncǎo Shàn Shí Lù
description: This is a casual healing game that blends herbal cultivation, recipe preparation, and garden construction. After an unexpected fire, you are expelled from your master's school and wandered to the south of the Yangtze River. Through cooking healthy food, planting herbs, and decorating your garden, you heal the diners' bodies and minds, experience the artistic conception of Chinese gardens, gradually uncover the stories behind lost recipes, and realize the true meaning of the world through flavor and human kindness.

title: Xiān Lǚ Yì Wén Lù
description: "Xiān Lǚ Yì Wén Lù" is a story-based role-playing game. Players assume the role of an ordinary person who is accidentally spotted by an immortal and embarks on a journey to immortality, gradually cultivating and becoming immortal. During this journey, you will encounter various strange and bizarre events, which you can participate in or observe from the sidelines.

title: Zhōng Yān Yǔ Lóng Tóngxíng
description: "Zhōng Yān Yǔ Lóng Tóngxíng" is a story with almost no plot. There are no grand adventures, no miracles, and no intertwined destinies. Just the same days, repeated between dawn and dusk. Eating together, talking, remaining silent, occasionally arguing, and occasionally laughing so hard over trivial matters. Life is like warm water, almost transparently ordinary, yet so real that it makes you want to escape. You always feel that if this continues, the world will never change. But somewhere in your heart, a gentle reminder is that this won't last much longer. Not because of what has happened, but because nothing will happen. She won't tell you the reason, and you won't ask.

title: Kareshi no Mawari ni itara Iya na Onna Tomodachi wo Kobushi de Wakaraseru Game
Shìjiè Zhīwài de Yúrén Chuán
description: This is a visual novel, in reality we create different worlds that belong only to you for various reasons, and they will gradually fade away with your memories. Please enjoy this time traveling in different worlds with the girls, and then return to where you are meant to exist - your life.

title: Bù Shàngàn Bù Liànài
description: Life is full of regrets, a belief firmly held by Li Hao, a self-proclaimed small-town test-taker. After graduating from an unknown science and engineering university, faced with the employment dilemma common among liberal arts graduates, he opted for a stalling career in logistics. Then, waking from a daydream, he heard a piece of news...

title: Dà Mèng Chūnqiū
description: An interactive AVG with a time-travelling male protagonist in an ancient style, with multiple endings and multiple branches, and a journey of bondage in which you and six close friends join hands to dominate the world in a parallel world.

title: Táng Chuánqí: Shàng Yuáncháng Gān Xíng
description: A three-thousand-mile journey of exile, a mystery of untold evil, when strange legends are decoded into reports of social pathology, when the joy of wuxia revenge collides with the ironclad fortress of power, from bandits slaughtering villages to the powerful committing cannibalism, who is not a lamb to be slaughtered in troubled times? This game focuses on the historical backdrop of the An-Shi Rebellion during the Tang Dynasty, and every choice the player makes will mark their character's fate.

title: Yìnéng Chóngzǔ
description: "Yìnéng Chóngzǔ" is a turn-based rogue-like game. Do you envy the boss's abilities? Great! In this game, you can completely plunder the enemy's abilities, skills, and even minions! Build your own abilities through looting while simultaneously destroying the enemy's abilities. Can you find the best strategy? As you progress, the strength of both you and your enemies will rapidly increase. Come experience the stat boost brought by perfect combos!

title: Jìn Shì Shū
description: As an orphaned courtesan turned rich man's sister, you enter the palace game. Entangle with six soulmates where romance is deadly—and every choice reshapes the dynasty. Pierce three deadlocks (throne, martial world, fate) with your heart. Write your legend in ashes amid bloodshed.

title: Yāo Xiān Dòngfǔ
description: A diablo-like ARPG.

title: Tóng Dāo Yín Jiàn
description: During the Xining period of the Northern Song Dynasty, a treacherous prime minister wreaked havoc on the imperial court. He engaged in militarism without regard for the rich and the poor. Using his position as a court official, he obstructed the lending practices of landlords, favoring the common people over the gentry. Undeterred by the will of Heaven, he attempted to divert the Yellow River, a move that would etch his name in history. Fearing this move would destroy the lifeblood of the Song Dynasty, the underworld rallied around a general, a knight-errant, an assassin, and a thief, known as the "Four Swordsmen," to bring down the treacherous prime minister Wang Anshi.

title: Lǐ Èr Nián Yǒng Chuǎng Héhuān Zōng
description: A text adventure game in first-person perspective, with the protagonist being male. You need to uncover the truth by having conversations with various cute girls. Trigger different events through options and finally choose the ending that suits you.

title: Yáo Àn Dēng Hǎi
description: A human girl, born into a prestigious family of sorcerers but lacking in talent, forges a contract with the city's most powerful cat demon. Until a certain deadline, the Lantern Festival, she strives to become an exceptional sorcerer, though the cat demon seems to be unaware of her aspirations.

title: The Three Kingdoms: Rebirth
description: You, an ordinary youth, accidentally travel to a parallel Three Kingdoms era. By fate, you encounter famous historical generals and beauties. Faced with emotional and historical choices, will you retire in the mountains with a beauty, or lead generals into battle?

title: Yāoliàn Xīyóu
description: You, an ordinary college student, are unexpectedly reincarnated into another world, becoming the new "Golden Body" chosen by Jin Chanzi. Characters from "Journey to the West" suddenly reappear before you in the guise of women. To return to your original world, you must complete the mission entrusted to you by "Tathagata Buddha." Renew your bonds with various demons, undo the mistakes of the previous Golden Body, "Tang Sanzang," and retrace your journey westward, reshaping order and causality...

title: Jǐn Nǐ Yī Rén
description: I was known as the "problem girl," and she was the center of the class. Two seemingly unconnected lines, however, collided through a series of coincidences, shattering my bleak life. I wanted to monopolize her gaze, to be the only one by her side. Starting with that encounter in the hills behind the school, the pure longing in my heart gradually began to distort.

title: To the Finale.
description: What is music to you? In my eyes, music is a key, a key that can unlock the heart. People always compromise with so many things, locking their emotions, their hearts. Music is the key to that lock. It can unlock the shackles. Sadness, anger, joy, whatever emotion, whatever words, can be woven into a song. With this key, we, and everyone else... at least until the end, can temporarily remove those heavy shackles...

title: Shényóu Kèběn
description: This interactive puzzle book is for all children and those who are young at heart! You'll be transported back to your childhood school desk and immerse yourself in Chinese, math, and English textbooks. Use your brain, click your mouse, solve puzzles, and have fun! The book also includes fun illustrations and stories, so come and try it out, young and old!

title: Tàn Dǎo Hǎiguītāng
description: The most mind-bending single-player situation puzzle! A highly trained, intelligent host allows for completely free questioning, each potentially revealing the hidden truth. Layers of mystery and twists and turns loom, leaving you feeling tense and oppressive every second. An anti-stuck system ensures smooth gameplay, ensuring a stress-free experience.

title: Sè Sè Fādǒu
description: A horror puzzle exploration game After breaking the lipstick, your wife began to beat you up Explore the house, collect props, avoid the wife who is in a strange state, and finally escape from this white nightmare

title: SandTable War: Three Kingdoms
description: "SandTable War: Three Kingdoms" is a strategic simulation game set during the Three Kingdoms period. Here you can play as various factions from Three Kingdoms history to conquer cities and lands, unify the realm. With abundant historical officers and scenarios, come restore the Han Dynasty!

title: Jìyì de Zhǔrén
description: Focusing on story and exploration, the game unfolds a unique system and world-view within a traditional RPG framework. Combat is semi-real-time, eliminating the need for complex and meticulous control. Overwhelming victories offer significant rewards, complemented by a highly flexible equipment enhancement and crafting system. To ensure seamless gameplay, players can monitor their progress and adjust the difficulty of battles. Are you ready to face the secrets of the world?

title: We Escape Together
description: While enjoying a peaceful evening, we suddenly find ourselves in an unknown place, forced to play a mysterious game. Should we play along with their rules? Can we truly reclaim our old lives—or are we trapped in this game forever?

title: Bloodplague Lockdown
description: In this third person action adventure inspired by classic survival horror games, you will play the role of an FBI agent and travel to a secret research base that has been sealed off for many years to investigate the source of the virus.

title: Night of the Duat
description: Uncover ancient secrets in this exploration horror adventure. Join a team of archaeologists as they explore a cursed Egyptian tomb, solve intricate puzzles, and unveil a buried mystery that was never meant to be found.

title: Bloodthirsty Sword
description: Bloodthirsty Sword is a top-down fantasy action-adventure game where you will fight non-stop in order to survive, thus embarking on an adventure full of excitement and thrills

title: Pyro
description: An exciting 2D action platformer where you control crazy pyrotechnics, face frantic challenges, and create epic explosions while testing your skills and reflexes at every level.

title: Tiny Legends
description: Get ready for an epic adventure to defend your kingdom from goblins and their dark spirits! Build towers, command your troops, and adapt your strategy through storms, snow, and night battles. Upgrade your forces and strike back into goblin lands to uncover their secret and take your revenge!

title: Bob Saves the Princess
description: Bob Saves the Princess is a Roguelite about controlling the roguelite elements themselves. Control rooms, items, aid in battles and summon creatures to help Bob reach the end alive.

title: Drawn to Drift
description: A competitive space racing game. Drift on player built tracks for the best times and claim your rank on the global leaderboards.

title: Parking Tycoon 2: Business Simulator
description: Return to the world of parking business! In Parking Tycoon 2: Business Simulator, you're not only building your empire - you're defending it. With a new combat system, skill upgrades, and security guards, your parking lot becomes a fortress!

title: Bug Bunny: Discontroll
description: Trapped in a nightmarish abandoned school, you must control a haunted doll through an unfamiliar system and escape from a terrifying clown in this survival horror adventure.

title: TwinGrip
description: TwinGrip is a twin-stick physics-based puzzle-platformer video-game. That's a lot of hyphens. Control each leg of your vessel individually with a controller, or both at the same time with the mouse! Master this unique control scheme and find your way home!

title: Workplace Hazard
description: Are you an old CRT monitor with a penchant for picking up boxes? Do you long for the days when you could place those boxes in an exit portal and engage your jetpacks early because you're impatient? If you answered yes to any of these questions, you're really weird! But try Workplace Hazard anyway!

title: Nocturnal Throne
description: Collect 100s of items, level up your character and obliterate anything that crosses your path. There are no limits in this endless rogue-lite. Mix and match weapons, items and characters to create the perfect build.

title: Maidnight
description: A Dreamcast-inspired visual novel about cute maids, minimum wage and losing your sense of self.

title: Twilight Protocol
description: Twilight Protocol is an atmospheric detective horror about an employee who becomes trapped in a corporate mystery. Explore the city, gather clues, talk to locals and colleagues, and uncover the truth hidden beneath the surface.

title: Idle Geometry Defense
description: Defend against endless waves of deadly red cubes in this futuristic idle tower defense game. Upgrade your towers, deploy mini-towers, speed up time, and rotate the battlefield in full 360°. Infinite levels. Infinite upgrades. No mercy.

title: Idle Pizza Business
description: Idle Pizza Business is a casual idle sim where you automate pizza production, upgrade gear and staff, and grow your empire across multiple locations.

title: Copperfell
description: Journey to Copperfell, a magical land teeming with charming villages, dangerous monsters, and an abundance of natural resources for you to make use of.

title: Excellent
description: excellent is a puzzle game based on data analysis, where data is stored into blocks. Arrange the data, create new blocks and ranges, and discover how the function blocks work and interact with the data in order to solve the puzzles.

title: Griddle
description: Step into your inherited meatball shop, where every order hides a secret and every customer brings a shadow from the past. Balance cooking with uncovering dark mysteries in this tense and atmospheric horror experience.

title: Wild Tower
description: "Wild Tower" is a Three Kingdoms-themed top-down combat game with Souls-like and light Rogue elements. Enter the tower to explore the unknown, face challenges, and experience combat.

title: Zodiac Requiem
description: "Zodiac Requiem" is a top-down shooter RPG based on the Chinese zodiac. You play as Lin Xiaoman, a mysterious girl who embarks on a perilous journey through thorns and trials to uncover the truth about her origins.

title: Hero's Ignition
description: Inspired by the iconic 80s classic H.E.R.O., wield your weapons and propeller-powered device as you navigate perilous underground depths. Retro charm meets modern innovation in an adventure reimagined for today’s explorers!

title: Light and Sneak
description: You will play as a player, holding a flashlight, exploring the dark and seemingly labyrinthine areas. As you observe and utilize the patterns of the maze's materials and inhabitants, you will become more adept at uncovering its secrets. Play hide-and-seek, wander around, don't get caught. That's it.

title: Supply Chain Expansion
description: Expand your supply chain by flipping tiles.

title: Mora: Mining for Freedom
description: You’re trapped in a mine, forced to repay the debt left behind by your late grandfather. Dig, explore, build, and earn your way out — one rock at a time.

title: Chernobots
description: Chernobots is a retro 3D roguelite, allowing endless exploration of the horrific and procedurally generated Chernobyl Exclusion Zone. Search for highly radioactive targets via remote controlled robots to get the job done or pay the price. Are you up for the gig?

title: My Eerie Lair
description: A dark cozy ‘Romantasy’ furnishing game where a vampire kidnaps his beloved and tries to win her heart by turning his eerie castle into their dream home.

title: Halloween Girls
description: Halloween girls are poised for your arrival to dive into the spooky fun together

title: HeadHunters
description: HeadHunters is a chaotic couch/online party game where you don’t pick a character… you are the head. Attach to different bodies to gain new weapons and abilities, and adapt on the fly. Improvise. Adapt. Overcome. Up to 4 players. Fully cross-platform. Don’t lose your head.

title: Another Day to Die
description: Top-down co-op survival shooter for 1-4 players. Battle zombie hordes, complete dangerous missions, and scavenge gear in infected zones. Upgrade your survivor and fight to live.

title: Baby Kings
description: Escape a dangerous dungeon with your friends as royal babies. Solve puzzles, dodge traps and laugh through chaotic co-op action for 2–8 players!

title: Animal Hearts: A Card Quest
description: Animal Hearts: A Card Quest is a charming and relaxing solo card game designed to help you chill and relax with pastel colors and pleasant music.

title: Clicker Climber: Pachinko
description: Prepare for a brutally difficult incremental game that requires fast clicking and build optimization. Click the balls to make them split and get paid when you reach the top. Miss too much and it’s game over.

title: The Faked
description: Create chaos in a sandbox full of absurd physics, join the wild action, and discover online fun with your friends!

title: Dice Team
description: This is a turn-based strategy adventure game. You need to form a crack 5-hero squad, collect mysterious props, build powerful hero abilities, defeat powerful monsters, and uncover the secrets of this world.

title: Think and Choice
description: You are a traveler, stepping into a door, traveling to different worlds, leading your team to explore and adventure, and facing challenges.

title: Sunbreak War
description: Sunbreak War is a light Rogue strategy game that focuses on construction and defense. Players need to build territories, recruit soldiers and survive enemy attacks.

title: Tooned Out Duo Dippin
description: Welcome To Tooned Out Duo Dippin!!! This game is a body of work that has been painfully derived from years of suffering/studying Become A Monster Player! In this All Out Fantasy Arcade Racing heart pumping new franchise. Let your jaw drop as you duo dip through Pure Imagination and Hard work.

title: Codename: Twilight
description: The treacherous world of Cyber Neon and Data Mist, with the core gameplay of puzzle solving, deduction and parkour. Single-player or multi-player play as a time and space hacker, collect the subtle evidence scattered everywhere, to reveal the unknown shocking truth.

title: Marcella Moon: The Phantom of Harvest Grove
description: A prankster is loose at the Harvest Grove autumn festival. Find the culprit before things get out of hand.

title: Gumball in Trick-or-Treat Land
description: A nostalgic JRPG love letter to the Game Boy Color era! Gumball in Trick-or-Treat Land is a lighthearted adventure with challenging turn-based combat. Explore a mysterious world, take on tough opponents, and save the day in a game designed to charm all ages!

title: Robicon
description: Robicon is a tactical tower defense game with roguelite elements. Place and merge your towers, experiment with different builds, and crush endless waves of robotic enemies. Adapt, upgrade, and survive.

title: Game Giant
description: Become the biggest game publisher! Find developers, negotiate contract and market the games. Grow your company and design your offices.

title: Lone Survivors
description: Cut through hundreds of monsters and survive against all odds in this fantasy survivors-like top-down action game! Level up, unlock abilities, and defeat bosses with a wide arsenal of weapons and magic.

title: Momento Pole
description: Swing, launch, and carve a deadly trail through swarms in this momentum-fueled roguelite. Master movement-based combat, combine skills, and craft talisman builds for endlessly unique runs.

title: Ego League
description: A competitive, skill-based football game where you control a single player. Master precise movement, dribbling, and shooting mechanics, and compete in fast-paced, online multiplayer team matches. Build your ego by equipping powerful, customizable abilities that define your unique playstyle.

title: Mayor's Secretary Escape Game
description: Your first day at the Town Hall won’t be as peaceful as you think. Solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and escape — in VR or on PC, solo or with up to 4 players.

title: Splash: Paintball
description: SPLASH-Paintball delivers an authentic FPS paintball experience with licensed gear from real brands, true-to-life ballistics, and detailed tournament and scenario maps. Play Speedball, Capture the Flag, or Arcade, solo or online with friends. Regular updates from community feedback keep it fresh.

title: Invisible Room
description: Invisible Room is an audio-based puzzle game where players rely on sound and clues to uncover hidden truths. Without visuals, the game challenges your auditory perception and logical reasoning, using both audio cues and physical props to solve puzzles.

title: Double-Sided Aces
description: This is a BL Dating Sim featuring multiple male protagonists. Six unique love interests, all fully voice-acted! Make choices at every step to uncover their hidden double lives. Zaize Yang, works at a tech company and gets caught up in a web of gangs and betrayal. What choices will he make?

title: Go Forward Survivors
description: "Go Forward Survivors" is a light ROGUE game that combines tower climbing and barrage shooting gameplay. By strengthening the attack model, the character becomes stronger and stronger, defeating hordes of enemies and liberating your homeland.

title: Beihai 2010
description: An emotional point-and-click adventure about youth, love, and growing up. Explore Namo's memories and uncover a touching story of friendship and first love in the city of Beihai.

title: Defense & Making
description: Defense & Making is a tile-based strategy game. Become a Demon Lord design enemy paths using randomly drawn tiles and cards place traps and monsters and experience a unique dungeon defense that changes every time you play.

title: Sunny Blooms Garden Center
description: Create your dream garden center! Design, decorate and stock it with stunning plants to wow customers and earn top ratings. Manage staff, suppliers, and finances to stay ahead of the competition. Take control of stock management, interact with cash registers and experience the day-to-day operations.

title: Arkee Malarkey
description: Throw a bunch of quirky animals onto the Ark and merge them into bigger animals in Classic and Score Attack modes! Or put your animal throwing skills to the test in the Arkee Trials, featuring various levels and unlockables to collect!

title: Monkey Testing
description: As the Head Warden, maintain order in the laboratory prison! Manage experiments on test subject monkeys, enforce the scientists' commands, and uphold security. Will you turn a blind eye to unethical experiments, or will you protect the test subjects and spark a rebellion? The choice is yours!

title: Infected Escaped
description: A co-op PvE survival game where you team up with other survivors to scavenge resources, fight infected enemies, uncover the map, and reach the final extraction point.

title: Magic Regrowth
description: Magic Regrowth is a relaxing incremental game where you restore the magic of floating islands by planting magical trees, bushes, and flowers. Transform forgotten landscapes into vibrant sanctuaries at your own pace, and immerse yourself in a serene and enchanting world.

title: Mech Shop
description: MESH SHOP is a game that combines puzzle-solving and inventory management. Assemble powerful Mecha Bots, complete orders at top speed, and make sure no customer leaves without their order. With the coins you earn, upgrade your shop and equip your room.

title: SpookY2K
description: You wake up on a cold bathroom floor, only to discover that you somehow time travelled to a Halloween party in 1999! As you try to make sense of your situation and get closer to the other guests, will your clueless involvement let the party take a deadly turn?

title: Super Beast World
description: Three silly girls get into equally silly situations.

title: Keep
description: Keep is a WW2-themed strategy shooter where you place flak turrets to defend your fortress, then jump into first-person mode to shoot down enemy planes. Switch between tactical planning and direct combat in a fast-paced blend of strategy and action

title: RGB Athletes
description: RGB Athletes is a team-based MOBA. Play as athletes in this sport and fight in a stadium. Train in a Zombie mode by surviving as many waves as possible!

title: Proton & Electron
description: Play as Dr. Proton and Electron in a world of Electromagnetism, where two must collaborate to solve puzzles and restore their broken world.

title: Vaca Bullet
description: In "Vaca Bullet," you play as a cowboy in the Wild West defending your cows from bandits' bullets. The game is a tribute to classic Western movies, filled with shootouts and chases, brought to life through beautiful pixel art, giving it a raw and unique essence like a true western.

title: Tower of Jank
description: Create game-breaking card combos to survive relentless hordes. Tower of Jank is a chaotic top-down action roguelite card-battler where you build overpowered decks, collect relics, and fight through ever-harder stages. You can stop time to plan your moves or let your cards play automatically.

title: Train Reaction
description: Train Reaction is a satisfying puzzle game about automating efficient train networks. Create the logic that powers signals and junctions in order to deliver cargo and avoid crashes. Optimize your solutions for efficiency and climb the global leader boards!

title: Clownout
description: CLOWNOUT – Smash or dash in the ultimate clown vs. human showdown! Run, hide, eat candy, build rafts, or die hilariously in 60 seconds. Up to 6 players battle on 10 wild maps using traps, teleportation, disguises, and broomstick flight. Chaos, comedy, and total madness await!

title: Abyss Stares at You
description: Trapped in an underwater base at the bottom of the Mariana Trench, you uncover a chilling truth: previous expeditions never returned. Solve the mystery, survive the abyss, and escape before it claims you too. A sci-fi horror where the depths hold more than just darkness.

title: Trash Card Adventure
description: TCA is a punk deck bulding game with a twisted story, hand drawn with a ball pen. Collect cards and fight against demonic forces, childhood bullies and capitalism! It's an adventure with trash cards and social commentary.

title: The Funnel
description: Assemble gear boxes, meet your crew, escape the factory. Experience the unique underground steampunk world of The Funnel, where you may help or betray any of the people you meet. But be careful, the Funnel is watching...

title: Loded Depths
description: Take on the role of an adventurous archaeologist who stumbles upon clues leading to a mythical underground civilization believed to hold immense knowledge and power.

title: Jiggly Strike
description: A fun, fast-paced, cartoon style arcade volleyball game with snappy controls. Play unique characters on diverse courts in matches against AI or your friends.

title: Red Dawn
description: RED DAWN is an SRPG game with cute graphics! Take command of Baker squad and fight back against Tiesov's invasion! The Winning or Losing of Carimae School is depends to you.

title: Dang Darn Island
description: Dang Darn Island is a 1-4 player co-op roguelike adventure. Explore the procedurally generated island, delve deep into the temple, smash pots, dodge traps, and see if you can escape with the Gold Idol!

title: Choices & Chances
description: In Choices and Chances, every move counts. Inspired by the old table-top classics with a splash of strategy mixed with luck and hard-to-predict outcomes all in one game. Roll the dice - choose your path, build a career, make careful investments, work your way to the top, or just wing it.

title: The PipeTuber's Guide to the Solar System
description: The PipeTuber's Guide to the Solar System is a Rogue-Lite Strategy Resource Management game. Players will build “Pipelines” to gather 4 kinds of resources in order to fulfill recurring survival challenges and explore the game world.

title: Insight Room
description: Insight Room is a top-down adventure game focused on symbolic narrative, exploration, and emotional puzzles. You play as Josh, a child lost in a dreamlike space filled with distorted memories and forgotten feelings.

title: Timber Panic
description: You had trees. The world didn’t. Now you’re rich. Cut wood, upgrade stuff, and build your timber empire.

title: Toilet Boom
description: Explore the bunker with monsters and find the coolest weapons! Action Roguelike

title: Teddy Roller 2
description: Teddy is ready for another super-charged adventure. The bear will roll, jump, and leap through perilous maps on his trusted ball of yarn. Expect the unexpected while traversing over 90 unique stages. Fantastical and strange creatures stand in Teddy`s way as he sojourns to Teddy village.

title: Pair Panic
description: Form your team, grab the objects, match them, and outscore your rivals! Pair Panic delivers fast-paced, competitive multiplayer matching chaos, while also letting you test your skills against the clock in single-player mode.

title: Buzz Wars
description: Buzz Wars is a wasp and bee themed strategy and fighting game with multiple playable units, various paths to win and multiple maps. Face off against other players in the multiplayer mode, or compete with AI opponents. Find your strategy - are you more a builder, a fighter or both?

title: Anyone in the House？
description: You are trapped in a strange resort, and every night you need to turn on the lights and check the entire room to ensure there is no danger before going to sleep. Once something goes wrong, the long night will loop endlessly.

title: Sunny Shores
description: Sunny Shores is software for casual and retired gamers who have prematurely reached unc-status in their careers. It features cozy lo-fi fishing mechanics, block-building and an open-world sandbox. Play with friends or play with yourself.

title: A Ghost Journey
description: In a quiet forest, a little ghost witnesses the prince’s assassination and begins a journey to the castle, carrying a heavy promise. What awaits it on the way? A Ghost Journey is a 2D stealth platformer where you engage in thrilling chases or move through the shadows with quiet stealth.

title: Winter Mercenary
description: Select your weapons, kill enemies and reach the objective in the given time.

title: Kingdom of Hope
description: Rise from nine years of tyranny to rebuild a scarred medieval land. As a celebrated hero, you’re granted a farmstead by the new King. Forge a fresh life of growth, craft, and community.

title: Buzzopolis: Hive Incremental
description: An incremental roguelite colony sim about bees, mutations, and controlled chaos. Experiment with management, crafting, research, and upgrades. When mutations spiral out of control — collapse the hive, keep progress, and start fresh. Every run unlocks new strategies and a buzz of unpredictable fun.

title: Trust Me
description: In a post-apocalyptic quarantine zone, repair your vehicle, scavenge loot, and fight to survive. With the help of your independent-minded third arm, battle mutants, upgrade your ride, and seek the path to freedom.

title: Not the End
description: Not The End is a story-driven horror drama in first-person view. Fight zombies with your sword and keep your family alive using the resources you collect. A story that will push your psychological limits awaits you.

title: Where Are You?
description: Where Are You? is a story-driven 2D adventure about curiosity, loss, and the search for truth — and about the question of whether values can survive when truth is forgotten.

title: Residuum
description: RESIDUUM is a first-person psychological horror game set in a decaying research facility. With only a dwindling flashlight and faulty heartbeat sensor, manage power, seek answers, and escape what hides in the dark.

title: Shave & Stuff: Dreads
description: Master the art of styling with the Dreadmaker tool, crafting thick, thin, or curly dreadlocks for head and beard. Shape, grow, trim, and reposition locks, then customize them with vibrant colors, adjustable lengths, and over 15 unique rings and beads!

title: Modulea
description: Defend Modulea! Dodge bullet hell, combine modules, and fight off waves of enemies with your custom-built space battleship in this roguelike action shooter!

title: Rogue Cell
description: Rogue Cell is an arcade-styled game about absorbing cells, avoiding hazards, collecting DNA, and upgrading on a path to become the biggest and toughest microscopic organism in the primordial soup.

title: Profana
description: Profana is a Metroidvania centered around exploration and combat. Kill demons on a holy war while making sick looking combos!

title: The Still
description: Daniel has become homeless! He now travels to a strange land seeking accolades and new beginnings. Join him and his companion Shana on this voyage by creating your own character & picking from a list of races/classes tailored to your preference.

title: The Life Together Online
description: Live, socialize, create! The Life Together Online is a unique online life simulator where every character is a real player. Work, make friends, customize your home, attend parties and travel. Complete freedom - choose your path and become part of a living world!

title: Payasos & Balazos
description: A 2D action platformer focused on bosses and comedy. Join Chiclón and his bubblegum gun on a colorful adventure to rebuild a circus and defeat the fearsome Magnum Risum on the chaotic Laughter Island.

title: Am I The Asshole?
description: Step into the role of a judge, solve the pettiest online drama packed with quirky characters and offbeat humor. A satirical take on internet culture.

title: NeoHack
description: "NeoHack" features a unique hacking-themed elimination gameplay—take down major security systems!

title: Glen-moril
description: GLENMORIL is a mod for The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim and its Special Edition, featuring a new questline divided into four acts, along with new weapons, armors, and unique creatures. It also includes a witch hunter quest, enhancing the gameplay experience with additional content.

title: Decay of Worlds
description: A tactical fantasy defense game with RPG elements: Deploy powerful units, wield magic, and lead a band of heroes through dark missions filled with meaningful choices.

title: Bearskull 2
description: A vast open world, ruthless Vikings, powerful bosses, and an epic co-op mode – rise to the challenge!

title: Unslaad
description: Unslaad is a quest mod for Skyrim that features a story-driven adventure involving a half-dragon character. It includes unique quests, creatures, and items, with a mix of lighthearted and darker themes throughout the gameplay.

title: Brass Rain
description: Fight iconic battles of World War II in Brass Rain. Choose your side and take part in crew-based combats as infantry, tank crews, bomber gunners, or naval teams. Support your Brothers and shape the course of history.

title: Street Fight Club Simulator
description: Start with a fight club. You run the bets, grow the weed, control the girls. Weapons, turf, money, loyalty—it all flows through you. Each night, your empire grows. In this city, there are no rules. Only power. And you’re here to take it.

title: Once Before Us
description: A cooperative, narrative puzzle adventure for two players. Explore a mysterious world, solve interconnected challenges, and communicate to progress. Once Before Us is a game about thinking, perception, and discovery through exploration and problem-solving.

title: Confront
description: Trapped in an abandoned building, your grip on reality fades. Confront is a first-person psychological horror game filled with paranoia, hallucinations, and the struggle to stay sane.

title: It Reaches
description: It Reaches is a first person horror game, captured through the lens of a police officer’s body cam. Trapped inside the facilities of an abandoned hospital, find a way to escape the horrors lurking underground. Uncover a dark mystery left behind and don't get caught! They will reach for you…

title: Rock Clicker
description: Rock Clicker is a clicker game where you have to click on a rock to get minerals. Every so often, rocks or other minerals will fall into your inventory. You can exchange these for different items on our website to customize your profile and complete your collection.

title: House Ghost
description: In this slow-burn BL visual novel, build trust and uncover the past of a gentle spirit. Make choices that shape your bond with him, explore his memories, and discover if love can truly cross the boundary between life and death. Romance. Mystery. And a ghost who might just steal your heart.

title: Trinity Building Editor
description: Building simulator game. Play with landscape, build the foundation, change the size of all building parts, combine pieces for a unique design, stack, rotate and scale. Choose and change materials and textures. Finish it by putting down plants. Complete tasks and increase your architect level!

title: Poppy Playtime: Chapter 5 - Broken Things
description:
Face off against the deadly puppetmaster behind the horrifying events of Playtime Co.

In the latest terrifying chapter of the Poppy Playtime saga, you are propelled further into the gruesome depths of the factory, with Playtime’s security system Huggy Wuggy in hot pursuit.

Abandoned by your only allies, your fight for survival gets all the more challenging as you race further into the abyss that is His domain.

Here, shadows whisper, and the puppet master who lords over this realm pulls the strings of madness. Can you stand against evil and finally put an end to this nightmare? Every bloody move forward will test your resolve as you uncover secrets years in the making.

title: Mahjong Riichi Multiplayer
description: Japanese mahjong, also known as Riichi mahjong, is a 4 player tabletop game based on the chinese original mahjong. Compete against individuals from all over the world in the online multiplayer mode. Build sequences and tripplets within your hand and complete your hand faster than your opponents!

title: FNAFB: Desk Fan's Particularly Unusual Journey - Refreshed Edition
Vaxinator
description: Defend the body in vaXinator, a fast-paced action roguelike! As the last white blood cell, unleash powerful abilities and antibodies to fight off waves of infections. Test your reflexes in this microscopic battle for survival. How long can you hold the line?

title: Ashen Vow
description: You are a knight sworn to God’s word, wielding only a sword against the darkness. But not all believers walk in good faith. The Black Maw has sunk its claws into the misguided, twisting their devotion into madness. Explore a once familiar castle now warped by evil, and cut down the corrupted horde

title: Quase Rosa
description: Quase Rosa is a 2D precision platformer with elements of randomness. With each attempt to beat a level, a different possible skill.

title: Mercie and the Fairies
description: Start with a broken phone... and follow Mercie, a lazy witch, as she juggles fairies, weird upgrades and a cauldron that turns anything into everything! Brew all kinds of stuff and embrace the cozy chaos in this offbeat incremental idle game

title: Mask City: Chapter Zero
description: MASK CITY: CHAPTER ZERO is a detective visual novel that lets you be a superhero, investigating a string of murders. Talk to witnesses, meet allies and fight bad guys. It’s a small-town story with big city spice written by bestselling author Aaron Crash

title: Astroops
description: AsTroops is a roguelike card-based space combat game. Build your fleet, choose cards with machine gun, rocket, and electric weapons, and fight real-time battles to break the alien blockade.

title: Farm Defence
description: Idle-farming game with automation. The game will sit at the bottom of your screen allowing you to work on other tasks. Grow crops, produce fuel, activate turrets to defend your FARM.

title: Little Aquarium
description: Little Aquarium is a relaxing idle game where you grow your own underwater world. Collect rare fish, discover vibrant color variants, and decorate your dream tank!

title: Universe Slime
description: UNIVERSE SLIME is a destruction action game where everything is destructible. Control the UNIVERSE SLIME, destroy towns and cities, swallow everything, and become a new star to replace the sun and save the solar system.

title: Sheltered From the Storm
description: A calm, atmospheric experience where you rest in shelters—cars, camps, houses, and an underground banker—while rain falls and danger lingers outside. No combat, no survival meters—just immersive weather, ambient soundscapes, and quiet reflection.

title: Improvised Tactics
description: Improvised Tactics is a single player RTS game that involves a focus on individual soldiers on a battlefield. You can command units on where to go or even play as the units to achieve your goals. Improvised Tactics offers several game modes for you to play!

title: Summoner's Pieces
description: A fusion of puzzle, deck-building, and auto-battle. Connect all the tabs to summon units and spells sealed within the pieces!

title: Pet Desktop Adventure
description: Pet Desktop Adventure is a desktop tower defend game. Defeat waves of enemies, get mysterious eggs and collect different pet animals. While you do your own things, adding a little fun to your desktop!

title: Diceeee
description: A Yacht-roguelike fusion!Roll waves of dice to form classic Yacht hands and unleash explosive synergies that skyrocket your score.Spend coins each stage to upgrade your deck, chase the top spot, and feel the thrill of soaring numbers—play now!

title: FishingCard
description: A pixel-art roguelike fusing fishing and deck-building. Build a powerful pond and earn gold through a 'buy, catch, sell' cycle. You must balance card strategy and economics to pay rising rent and survive this unique adventure.

title: Crystallium
description: Crystallium is a furry-themed rhythm game where you build a team of warriors to fight monsters. Vanquish corruption from the dungeons and unearth the ancient mystery that has faded from everyone's memory.

title: Professor Simulator
description: Professor Simulator is an idle management game where players build their academic career from novice lecturer to established researcher. Players manage their university lab by recruiting students, assembling research teams, publishing papers, and completing projects.
