Success leads to promotions, lab expansions, and new equipment purchases as they climb the academic ladder.

title: My Housetopia
description: "My Housetopia" is a relaxing sticker-based game where you can decorate everything from cozy rooms to grand villas. Enjoy endless mode, free creation, and community mods. No time limits—just pure creative fun, anytime, anywhere. Design your dream home without pressure!

title: Don't Burst My Balloon
description: Gather your friends for frenetic balloon-popping battles! Play as chickens in vibrant arenas, float with balloons, unleash magical tricks, and outlast your rivals in hilarious party matches for up to four players.

title: Beguile
description: A completely command-based online PvP party game!! Successfully confess and you win! Fail and you lose! Enjoy a thrilling psychological battle as each person's feelings intersect!

title: Contact Protocol
description:
Contact Protocol is a starship job simulator taking place in a gritty, cassette-future. Humanity has spread throughout the solar system and started extracting its natural resources.

You play as the security officer aboard PALE HORSE - a Galileo Corporation vessel carrying miners set for Ganymede, Jupiter's biggest moon. It’s your job to assess the intentions of approaching ships, decide their fate, and keep your crew alive. The company is watching.

title: Loser Named Hana
description: Loser Named Hana is a friendship-building visual novel. You respond to an ad advertising $100 a week to be the lonely college student, Hana, friend.

title: The Planet Crafter: Toxicity
description: The "Toxicity" DLC takes you to a unknown planet heavily corrupted by past industrial activity. You must restore its majesty using new tools and machinery. Alone or with friends, explore this wasteland, uncover its secrets, and help it revive!

title: Bound in a Nutshell in Infinite Space
description: Explore a claustrophobic space station floating above the Earth, fix critical systems in the vacuum of space as they begin to fail, and discover the truth about what happened to the mysterious sole survivor of a disaster from another station. A first-person space horror mystery story.

title: Motorcycle Ride: Infinity
description: Cruise on an endless highway with light traffic and no turns. Motorcycle Ride: Infinity is all about freedom, flow, and the joy of riding—without stress or objectives.

title: Citrus Summer
description: 以都市职场生活为背景的百合视觉小说， 作为在大城市游戏行业996的独身社畜， 想要改变却无能为力的吴依， 偶然间得到了一次改变命运的机会……

title: Crusaders Quest: Merge Chess
description: Welcome to Crusaders Quest: Merge Chess, where easy-to-learn puzzles fuse with deep, strategic gameplay! Collect captivating Heroes visualized in charming pixel art, build your ultimate deck, and embark on a grand adventure. With the divine blessing of the Goddess, Let their story begin!

title: Trials Survivors
description: Fight through endless hordes in trials bestowed by constellation patrons. Upgrade skills, collect relics, and craft broken builds in true roguelite fashion! Rediscover the fantasy behind the words hack and slash and bullet heaven. Will you survive the densest monster Survivor-like ever created?

title: Wukong 2088
description: Wukong 2088 is a survival rogue-like game where you play as the secret weapon of Sun Wukong in futuristic Journey to the West. You will resist the invasion of the Cyber TianGong, face endless waves of enemies and bosses, defeat them, and strengthen yourself to fight against the powerful Mega-Corp.

title: The Radio Tower
description: A short horror game were you are sent to fix a radio tower at the edge of an evacuation zone to restore a city’s communications.

title: Type Drivers
description: In Type Drivers, the speed of your car is the speed of your typing. Race against rivals or challenge yourself in solo runs where every word counts. The faster and more accurate you type, the faster your car tears down the track.

title: Mouse Practice for Kids
description: This game helps kids develop mouse skills by clicking on fun, colorful fruits that appear on the screen, making learning both engaging and enjoyable.

title: Revolgear Zero
description: Shizuku and Akane...two pilots bound by rivalry and friendship battle to save their world from malevolent cosmic forces! A classic arcade style shmup with deeply satisfying fast paced combat, wide variety of load-out combos, and even local co-op!

title: Blood Moon Massacre
description: Build a fortress, set traps, and blast your way through hordes of bloodthirsty creatures. Blood Moon Massacre is a fast-paced horde shooter featuring customizable builds and chaotic monster-slaying mayhem. Can you survive the night?

title: A Game of D.I.C.E.
description: A tense gambling duel in an elegant Art Deco world where luck and strategy decide who survives. Roll five dice and build winning hands inspired by poker. Use Gambits to reroll, sabotage your opponent and turn your fate. Win rounds and outlast your rival. Only one leaves the dinner table.

title: Squidly's Revenge
description: A fast-paced underwater roguelike where a squishy squid with divine powers steals enemy weapons to take revenge on Lord Azure and his Abyssal Cult. Chaos, crustaceans, and cartoon violence await!

title: LenscraftCube
description: LenscraftCube is a 2D platform puzzle game where players take on the role of a cube that must navigate through levels while being constrained by the boundaries of other camera cubes.

title: Furniture Restoration Simulator: Garage Edition
description: Step into your own garage workshop and breathe new life into forgotten furniture. In this immersive first-person simulation, sand away decades of wear, apply vibrant paints, and polish each piece to a showroom finish—one satisfying restoration at a time.

title: Lawn Care Simulator
description: Take Back the Yard in Lawn Care Simulator! Grab your mower and bring unruly lawns under control. From overgrown backyards to massive estates, cut through the chaos one blade at a time. Satisfyingly slice, edge, and clean your way to perfectly manicured greens — all in a day's mow.

title: Parking Simulator
description: The parking situation in vehicle simulator will require you to show top driving skills in steering, acceleration and obstacle avoidance to get those vehicles parked in parking places. As the parking lot driver, you will drive the awesome automobile around corners, obstacles, and parking lot borders with speed and accuracy. Learn how to navigate in realistic parking environment. Steer the vehicle meticulously and catch the bridge in time to lift your car onto the next story. Use the varying gears and shifts to wiggle into the parking spot. Avoid crashing into barriers and other cars! This is quite the challenge. Follow the checkpoints to find your way ad become parking master!

title: Man Simulator 2025
description: Escape contemporary manhood as you gamble, vape, and consume your way to the light. Discover unique paths to unravel the secrets that lie within the simulation.

title: Cut the Grass: Farm Defense Survival
description: Cutting grass is just the beginning. Explore, gather loot, upgrade your farm and survive night attacks. Fight monsters, defend your base, and last as long as you can in this day-night survival loop!

title: WeedEx: Drug Express Delivery
description: Start as a street dealer and rise to criminal power — produce and distribute various illegal substances across the dark streets of Hyland Point. Expand your empire by purchasing property, growing your business, acquiring new cars, and building a powerful underground network.

title: Turbocide
description: A Simple third-person, arena shooter playing as robotic beings called Reavers Each kill Grants you More Power.

title: Ocean of Vengeance
description: Ocean of Vengeance is a 2D pirate adventure where you sail across oceans, explore unique islands, and battle enemy ships in turn-based combat. Discover mini-games, recruit crew, earn loot, and upgrade your ship as you uncover the secrets of the high seas.

title: Ludominar
description: Ludominar is a third-person single-player shooter focused on boss fights. Inspired by liminal spaces, the game delivers intense and challenging battles.

title: Fechtbucher
description: Fechtbucher - Uber-Realistic Medieval game, with Melee Combat based on Physics. Participate in tournaments, or explore the dungeons to uncover a dark story. Master guards and strikes inspired by HEMA, straight out of medieval guidebooks.

title: This Game Exists Now
description: You play as a cube battling heaps of enemies and bosses in order to get your game back from and evil organization called the P.I.A(Pineapple Intelligence Agency) You will be assisted by a wonderfully charming narrator, a strange shop keeper, and MORE! Do you have what it takes to Exist Now? OR NOT!?

title: SlapCats
description: A party game that supports up to 4 players playing on the same screen. You will control cats in a paper world and win by defeating other players. Proficient use of different skills will make your little cat claws more effective!

title: Funny Bones
description: A fast-paced Halloween themed typing game where you can test your speed and spelling skills in a crazy summoning madness.

title: The Veil of Death
description: A psychological horror game inspired by the myths and legends of Mexican folklore, set in the Juárez Hospital in Mexico City in 2007. Explore, solve puzzles, fight entities from beyond and reconstruct the truth behind a forgotten tragedy.

title: Cigarettes for Shion
description:
A drabble about missing someone who's only legacy was leaving you with an addiction. A visual novel so short that its entire script fits in a single screenshot.
Downloading it will take longer than finishing it. 100 words and not a single more.

title: Urban Paranoia
description: Locked into a deadly lease, you and up to 3 friends must scavenge the sewers, face cryptids and stalkers, and fight to keep your sanity… all to pay the rent.

title: Scribble Bots
description: Draw your robot, play as your drawing! Face your friends in Scribble Bots, a 2D, physics based sandbox party game. Will your robot be a functional masterpiece, or an inoperable abomination?

title: In Banjiha
description: It is a first-person horror game. Escape the damp, dark semi-basement. Overcome your fear and find a way out.

title: Up Cards
description: UP CARDS is a light roguelike card game. In this exciting journey, you need to control the card situation, play the best combinations, stack additional effects to turn the tide, choose your permanent rewards, and reach new heights through different strategic builds.

title: Toy Zombies
description: Escape the abandoned mall by hiding from the creatures, learn their behaviors and explore the place to find the way out.

title: Mech and Tech 1
description: Conquer. Build. Survive. A tactical strategy game on procedural hex grids - intense, deep. Plan every move: establish your base, secure supply lines, and unleash suppression fire against all who stand in your way. Research new technologies - improve your units. Play solo, co-op, or PvP.

title: Cherry Dies in 5 Minutes
description: A short, timed visual novel about a zombie girl living the last few minutes of her life.

title: Hanasu: Girls Kiss At The End Of The World
description: HANASU ～Girls Kiss At The End Of The World～ is a short kinetic novel about finding small joys even in the most dire of situations.

title: MuTris
description: If Tetris had a baby with Bomberman and fed it sugar. Slide, stack, and mutate blocks in real time with bombs, lightning, and rainbow blocks shaking up every level.

title: Stellar Nemesis
description: A high-definition arcade shooter blending old-school action with modern polish. Battle across the Solar System, upgrade your weapons, and unlock tougher challenges in Nemesis Mode - all set to a hypnotic, retro-electro soundtrack.

title: Lead to Gold
description: ​​Lead To Gold​​ is a tech-themed solitaire game collection. Rearrange cards on your playing field to complete a series of challenging missions.

title: Texas Twist Poker 3 Bandit's Run
description: A poker-infused tile-puzzler with the strategic depth of a roguelike deck-builder. Hunt notorious Bandits and break their curse by combining Jokers and upgrades to create the 10 best poker hands in a 52-card deck. Shop wisely between rounds to build a formidable deck and winning strategy.

title: Rogue AI: Idle Domination
description: A Rogue A.I. simulator that sits at the bottom of your screen. Take over the world while taking care of other tasks!

title: Fantasy Franchise
description: Own and manage your own football team! Set your lineup, train your players, hire coaches, and improve your stadium to create a franchise that can go all the way!

title: Screen Greens
description: A casual 2D golf simulator in a transparent window on your screen. Get the ball in the hole with as few strokes as possible, unlock new balls, skins, and effects, and enjoy randomly generated levels!

title: Pizza Restaurant Together
description: Pizza Restaurant Together is a restaurant management game where up to four players cooperatively run a pizzeria. Players work together to prepare pizzas, serve customers, and manage the business by upgrading furniture and decorations to improve their restaurant's reputation. The game allows both solo and multiplayer operation of the establishment.

title: Defectant
description: Defectant is a modular action-RPG where you build your fighter from any parts you find, even from enemies. Survive the Pit’s brutal arena, forge alliances, climb the ranks, or find another way to escape.

title: Flappy Witch
description: Help Flappy Witch save her beloved cat in this short, magical adventure!

title: Battle of the Abyss
description: This is a auto battler game combined with slot machines. Players can collect different weapons, gradually upgrade their abilities, and challenge different levels until they achieve ultimate victory.

title: Bresh
description: BRESH is a tactical FPS with teleportation between two universes. Think on two levels. Hide and outsmart. Customize your gear and appearance.

title: Pure Shinty
description: Camanachd - Game of the Gaels comes to your home in this sports simulation indie game. Play against your friends as real teams from across Scotland!

title: Triple Swap Tower
description: Triple Swap Tower is a frantic roguelite which puts you in control of three different heroes. Swap fast between them as you fell waves of enemies, then power them up! How will you build your party?

title: Wuli Sandbox
description: In this physics-based particle sandbox, everything is in flux: water, steam, ice, magma, acid... Blast it. Wreck it. Build it!

title: Faint Echo
description: Faint Echo is a psychological horror visual novel with point-and-click elements. A young man named Denys moves into a cheap apartment, but soon faces disturbing paranormal events. Explore the dark building, uncover its secrets, and try to survive.

title: True Abstraction: Forbidden
description: Awakening was only the beginning. RDS is real… consuming anyone who ventures too close.

title: Attorney Investigations Online
description:
Have you dreamed of navigating around the game world, like in Ace Attorney Investigations: Miles Edgeworth, while still playing online?
Well, your dream's come true, because we bring you: Attorney Investigations Online!

title: Bush Dog
description: Fight the timer to herd the sheep on unique maps with each round adding more sheep.

title: Picronix
description: Relax and engage your mind with these relaxing logic puzzles. Train your brain and find your inner peace.

title: The Three Moons
description: Survive a hostile alien world shaped by three mysterious moons. As a lone robotic unit, gather resources, rebuild your systems, adapt to extreme conditions, and uncover what happened before your arrival.

title: Showdown! Mahjong Tutorial Included
description: A Mahjong roguelike deckbuilder where you create powerful synergies between Mahjong hands and performance-based sponsorships to execute combos that make numbers go up. The game also features a step-by-step tutorial to help you learn how to play Mahjong.

title: Wolf With Inn
description: Wolf With Inn is a cozy fantasy tavern simulator. Become a werewolf, discover new recipes, cook hearty meals, and grow your inn! Welcome noble white knights and adventurers—and send them into the clutches of the forest "monsters."

title: Switchboard
description: 1952, Empire Grand. Inhabit the frantic life of a telephone exchange operator in this thrilling voice-acted historical puzzle game. Connect calls, consult the directories and listen closely to earn your family a better life. When agents of war and rebellion begin to call your name, will you answer?

title: Rebound Hell
description: A minimalist top-down action game where every shot bounces, changes color, and can turn against you. Managing ricochets is your only chance to survive.

title: Cyclia Journey
description: This title, CYCLIA JOURNEY, is a 2D puzzle action game set in a geometric world where everything is governed by the “The Law of Replication & Re-creation”

title: Computer Virus
description: Computer Virus is an experimental puzzle game with no fixed answers. Bounce the virus using springs, adjust their angles, and guide it all the way to the computer. How far can your hacking skills take you?

title: Chronicles of Albian 3: The Vanishing Village - Collector's Edition
description: High in the mountains of Albian, something very strange has happened.

title: The Site: Night Shift
description: At night, you're alone in a half-finished building. Your task is simple: patrol the floors, check the rooms, and watch for any signs of intrusion. But as the nights pass, you begin to realize you're not alone.

title: Treasure Drop: Algae Valley DLC
description: Merge coins and fill the Algae Valley with treasure!

title: Treasure Drop: Coral Reef DLC
description: Merge coins and fill the Coral Reef with treasure!

title: Treasure Drop: Deep Trench DLC
description: Merge coins and fill the Deep Trench with treasure!

title: Treasure Drop: Open Sea DLC
description: Merge coins and fill the Open Sea with treasure!

title: Skull Port
description: A strategic digital board game adaptation. Roll the dice, manipulate the roll outcomes, and place Influence tokens to outmaneuver opponents.

title: Re: Promise - Promise of Linaria
description: I thought it was just the same old routine as always... You, having forgotten everything except your name, encounter four fateful men. The days spent recovering your memories gradually turn into a sweet and bittersweet love—

title: ScanIt!
description: You take on the role of a clerk working at a store, tasked with scanning items for each customer. The game introduces a unique gameplay mechanic that focuses on item manipulation, adding a layer of challenge and engagement and introducing a fresh twist to the simulation genre.

title: I Sell Lemonade
description: This is not just a business sim. It’s a story about small things that change you. And the summer that made you stronger.

title: Dungeon Dreams Wanderers
description: Travel, form bonds, explore a vast world filled with multiple-outcome quests, with your custom created protagonist in an adventure that blends old school JRPG, life simulation and role playing.

title: Little Island
description: Plunge into a vibrant underwater world as a heroic mermaid—battle whimsical sea creatures, clean up ocean pollution, and team up with your crab companion in a charming roguelite adventure.

title: Adventarum
description: Adventarum is a fantasy idle battler where you fight monsters, earn loot, and rise through the Adventurer’s Guild. Upgrade skills, craft gear, and unlock epic quests as you grow from lone adventurer to guild master.

title: Cool Cool Water
description: A desert survival game, set in southern New Mexico.

title: Mega Monkey Brawl
description: Mega Monkey Brawl is a chaotic, team-based action game where hurling your friends is just part of the strategy. Battle alongside your clan of wild animals as you toss items, enemies, and teammates to snatch up precious fruit and claim victory. Only the most cunning fighters will come out on top.

title: Meat Man
description: Blast through hordes of skeletons in this action-roguelike shoot em up where random upgrades will decide your playthrough. Choose a bullet type to start with and add improvements to your gun and body as you fight through increasingly difficult waves of skeletons on your way to hell.

title: Cat vs. Slime
description: The cats can stack on top of each other like human ring performers, easily reaching the flying slime in the air. As the battle progresses, you can randomly unlock new cats, enhance the cat house, and the mild roguelike elements bring new surprises to each game.

title: WhoIs
description: A 4-8 player PvP game of deception and paranoia. You have a role, a target, and one mission: eliminate them and escape. Use powerful abilities at the risk of revealing your identity. In this ever-changing arena, hunt or be hunted.

title: Hotel Keeper
description: Start with an empty building and run your hotel: attract guests, clean rooms, gain windfalls or return lost items, while keeping an eye out for suspicious characters, gradually realizing your dream of a star-rated hotel.

title: My Dream Garage
description: Design and customize your dream garage, showcase your car collection, and create a unique space that reflects your style!

title: Ethics Empire
description: Become the richest business owner in this strategy-based simulator, choose your playstyle trying to balance ethics and profits in this chaotic low poly world. Will you keep your ethical businesses thriving or will you let it all crumble down for a quick buck?

title: Fractured Red
description: A science fiction visual novel. Deep beneath the surface of Mars lies a secret that will change everything. Six researchers. One rift. No one will return the same.

title: Clones Conquer Worlds
description: A tactical deckbuilder where you shape and command customizable clone squads. Equip them with weapons, armor, and light or dark powers. Mix their traits and tactical positioning to create deadly synergies — and conquer alien worlds!

title: Get Your Free Christmas Tree
description:
City-17 is in for a long, cold Winter...

The anarchy that followed the death of the Consul by Santa Claus' hands has resulted in the hunting for 3 Christmas artifacts, the forming of several citizen factions, and your quest to retrieve MacGuffins in the possession of charismatic idiots. Create allies. Create corpses. All in your path to salvation. Who will you amend with and who will you betray?

Will you learn that your actions have consequences? Solve puzzles, ask around, make friends and outwit your enemies in uniquely designed scenarios from the depths of City 17 and beyond.

The Power of God only belongs to the strongest... Or so they say. Find out the truth in your own path and collect the Christmas artifacts across an epic journey spanning mine carts, trains, roads, and festive snow-covered terrain stained in blood and bullets.

One Man Army Studios presents Get Your Free Christmas Tree, a modification for the leaked Half-Life 2 beta engine. In development for a year, GYFCT offers a unique experience detached from the common notions of Half-Life lore to bring the spirit of Christmas to the dark and gritty world of City 17.

title: A.S.İ: Başlangiç
description: Imagine being torn from your world and dragged into an unknown realm. A.S.İ : BAŞLANGIÇ is a single-player action RPG that draws players in with its dark atmosphere. In this world of life and death, only your sword and your will can guide you.

title: Midnight Files
description: The camera doesn’t lie, but the truth isn’t always obvious. Photograph traces, gather evidence, link clues on the board, search police databases for key info, and identify the culprit and the next attack site. Each case is a standalone mystery waiting to be solved.

title: Wizard's Oblation
description: Wizard's Oblation is a co-op horror for 1–4 wizards. Step through a portal and hunt for artifacts that hold unique spells.

title: Platform 0
description: You’re trapped in a forgotten metro system, haunted by a ghost train that reacts to your every move. Explore dark tunnels, avoid deadly traps, and stay quiet — your survival depends on it. A first-person horror experience where silence is your only weapon.

title: Raised From Hell
description: Raised from Hell is a first-person psychological horror game! Explore the mysteries of your grandfather's mansion by searching for clues, solving puzzles, and noticing strange occurrences… An adventure awaits you, and maybe someone has been raised from hell…

title: Coconut Simulator 2
description: Coconut Simulator 2 is a game in which you can become a coconut.

title: Welcome to Bodyland
description: A theme park where every ride teaches something new about the human body. Take an adventure through the body! There's never been an amusement park quite like this before. Join Ricki, your tour guide, and her hilarious parrot companion, Hiccup, on an adventure through the Bodyland Theme Park. Fast-paced rides and challenging activities encourage kids to explore the park on their own and learn about the human body at the same time. For children aged 5-11 years.

title: EDM Ballistics
description: As Missile Division Commander in WWIII, complete high-risk missions to save your unit. Dodge defenses, strike to the beat, and manage weapons and budgets to survive an entertainment-driven war.

title: Modo Modo
description: A 2D/3D hybrid rogue-lite card game. Top demon realm streamers Momo & Dodo face a mysterious network crash that drives all demons mad! After receiving "Dr. M's" salvation card deck, they battle via live-streams to save fans. Uncover the realm's truth through animated story chapters & multi-endings.

title: Midnight Study
description: Midnight Study is a roguelike deck-building horror game where four high school girls fight to reclaim a school overrun by vengeful spirits. Play as Haneul, an archery ace descended from shamans, and battle ghosts from Korean school ghost stories and folklore to escape the endless night.

title: Midnight Saturn
description: A grizzled private eye in a sci-fi adventure takes a murder case no one else will touch. He’s seen it all before, but nothing’s prepared him for a conspiracy that leads off-world. Something big is about to happen. Whatever it is... it goes live at midnight.

title: Jupiter Jackpot Casino
description: Play, win, enjoy! JUPITER JACKPOT CASINO is a casual, single-player casino sim RPG. Explore 5 different game lounges! Play games to unlock trophies and new areas! Teleport to different locations with your handy TelePod! Catch a view of Jupiter from the many viewing ports and lounges. and MORE!

title: Pursuit
description: You are an illegal courier in a city where speed is survival and the law never sleeps. Deliver forbidden cargo, outsmart police, and master the streets. Every ride is a challenge— one mistake could cost everything.

title: Set Adrift
description: Set Adrift is a single-player fantasy exploration game where you sail between strange islands, talk to odd creatures, uncover lost secrets, and cast your line in search of the unknown.

title: Profit or Peril
description: A co-op extraction horror game. Dive into shifting spaces, solve puzzles under pressure, grab valuables, and escape together. No quotas—progress by bringing loot home and unlock tougher levels with what you earn.

title: Time and Space Legacy
description: Time and Space Legacy is a top-view puzzle game where you design and build your own space stations. Manage scarce resources, lay out buildings accordingly, and use advanced time-traveling technologies to save the future of humankind !

title: Super Flying Vroom Vroom
description: Drive, boost, take off, and navigate spectacular aerial challenges!

title: Master of Jewelry
description: Master Of Jewelry is a unique open-world jewelry simulation game with survival elements. Explore Diamond City, take your first order, and repair a gold chain in your workshop.

title: The Kindling
description: A short, poetic puzzle experience. Guide a fading soul through strange places, where every object you burn keeps the shadows away. What seems simple may turn into a trial. Choose carefully… and don’t let the light fade.

title: The Arena
description: Fight for Glory in the arena! Face challenging enemies, deal with random events, and entertain the crowd on your path to becoming the ultimate arena champion!

title: Rocrasher
description: PUSH and SMASH!!! Savor the ultimate thrill of crushing everything in your way! Crushing the little figures along the road will increase the boulder's size and weight, granting it greater acceleration and diving force!

title: Order Up!
description: Run your own chaotic burger restaurant! Cook, assemble, serve, and manage your way to success—while handling picky customers, power outages, and inventory disasters in this immersive restaurant sim.

title: Spellcasters Chronicles
description: CAST. FLY. FIGHT. COOPERATE. In intense 3V3 action-strategy battles, summon hundreds of creatures, cast devastating spells, and call upon the might of Titans to rise as the most powerful member of the community of Spellcasters – and shape the fate of the world. Together.

title: Healer's Yell
description:
"I can’t fight, but with this power, I can protect everyone"

A minigame of healing and supporting the other party members in an automatic battle.
There is no story to this game.

title: The Panspermia
description:
The year is 2132. The resources on Earth have become depleted, and mankind sought out new settlements and advanced on to other planets. At that time, a meteorite from space has been detected carrying unicellular organisms with similar DNA structures as those found on Earth. This discovery is thought to contain the key to unlocking the mystery behind the origin of life on Earth, so an investigation has been launched. As a result, an unknown planet has been discovered in our Solar System: Harmonia. An American research team from Mars Base is set out to embark for Harmonia in order to survey it.

Soon the truths behind mankind, life, and the universe will be revealed.

title: Neighborhood Video
description: Crack the case of the missing video store employee in this 3D point and click mystery game by solving escape room puzzles, combing the computer database, and scouring shelves as an undercover detective posing as a cashier during your first weekend at the suspiciously understaffed Neighborhood Video.

title: ForgeRun
description: ForgeRun is a co-op arena survival roguelike where you battle endless hordes, collect anvils, and forge random upgrades mid-fight to become the ultimate blacksmith hero.

title: Senpie
description:
Help Granny run a successful bakeshop in this exciting puzzle matching adventure!

Granny is an excellent baker, but she needs your help to defeat the yokai and complete her customers' orders on time. Swap baking trays to collect falling ingredients and make pies - but watch out for bad apple spirits!

title: Another's Memories
description: Another's Memories is a first-person psychological horror video game located in Argentina. Explore a sinister country house, solve puzzles, and survive ruthless enemies in an immersive experience where every shadow hides a disturbing story.

title: The Man Who Walked
description: The Man Who Walked invites you to solve relaxing puzzles by switching between two worlds: in 2D you rearrange the environment, in 3D you explore it. Only by combining both perspectives will you uncover the end of the story.

title: Get Them To Safety
description: You play as a father trying to guide his children to safety through a terrifying, creature-infested world. You can command them to follow you or stay hidden, but every choice could mean life or death.

title: We Are Gum
description: A puzzle game about goofy alien bubble gum trying to find their way home. They move together because they're aliens. They stick to things because they're bubble gum. They're silly and goofy because they're alien bubble gum! Don't question the science.

title: Drawquarium
description: Draw your own fish and unlock new ways to decorate your aquarium. If you feed them well, they will gain a metallic shimmer as they age. Will you be the one to raise a golden fish in this relaxing sandbox experience?

title: Groupel
description: A strategic roguelike inspired by casinos: combine jokers, manipulate luck, and challenge the house in a completely reimagined roulette experience.

title: Field of Enemies
description: "Field of Enemies" is a casual top-down action roguelike! Survive endless waves of monsters, upgrade super abilities and fight for a place on the leaderboard. Crazy co-op for up to 4 players, unique "voice" sound effects and dynamic gameplay. Your path to a record starts here!

title: Catfighter, In the Lands of Sinners
description: A fantasy Souls-like and CUTE~ top-down action game. Step into the despised Lands of Sinners as Mickesh, where lovely cats enjoy fast-paced battles, family friendly interactions, and the most adorable ?sUfF3r1nG? imaginable!

title: Three Kingdom: Zhang Jiao Revival
description: Three Kingdom - Zhang Jue Revival is a real time RPG roguelite. Battle alone or recruit up to 10 comrade to fight along side in real time combat. Specialize in 1 class or learn all 6, wide range of equipment to create your own build. Powerful yet simple statistic system to spice up game play.

title: ChloroLink
description: In ChloroLink, a cute and cozy management game, guide Lux the plant of life as she spreads her rootweave to connect charming plants. Use each plant’s growth pattern to explore, reinforce the links between plants, overcome gentle challenges, and help Lux bloom the world back to life!

title: Summer Adventurers: Mediterranean
description: Relax and explore the Mediterranean in a charming hidden-object adventure. Find cleverly hidden items, solve mini-puzzles, and uncover bonus sublevels filled with secrets!

title: Goblinna's Garden
description: Quick to start, learn, and play tower defence! Use 7 unique towers to squash waves of 10 unique enemy types. Dynamically change the maze by raising and lowering dirt to block off parts of the path. Enjoy endless replayability with map customizers to allow for a personalized tower defence experience!

title: Voidblade Shadows of The Realm
description: A Halloween-themed platform adventure, where you wield the Voidblade to face dark creatures, explore mystical settings, and free trapped souls in a cursed realm.

title: A Tale of Shadows Fragments
description: Unravel lost memories in A Tale of Shadows, a psychological thriller where secrets lurk in a haunted estate. Solve puzzles, evade sinister forces, and uncover the truth behind your past.

title: Shadow of Winter
description: A narrative-driven survival horror set in the frozen wilderness of 1985. Descend into an abandoned Soviet bunker, uncover its dark secrets, and fight to survive the terrors lurking within.

title: Figures of Shadows
description: A text-based horror game focused on atmosphere and user choices, it's highly story-based and builds atmosphere by allowing a player to make choices that determine whether they make it out alive or not.

title: Cult of Shadows
description: Uncover the secrets of Bel Noa. Fight hordes of cultists and the Myhos they summon. Defeat fearsome beasts, upgrade your character, acquire and enchant weapons. Die and return stronger to face the Cult of Shadows.

title: Cat and Shadow and Death's Four Friends
description: Cat and Shadow and Death's Four Friends is a two-player platformer game. It consists of 4 chapters and 16 levels. Players need to take on the roles of Cat and Shadow respectively, use various skills and in-map mechanics to cooperate in collecting items, and reach the end together.

title: Shadow Monarchs Rise
description: Shadow Monarch’s Rise is a 2D action RPG with fast, skill-based combat, quests, hidden treasures, epic bosses, and character progression. Future updates will include cloud saves and accessibility features.

title: Zupay: Shadows of Independence
description: They messed with your homeland. A violent demon saved you from death and now pushes you to get revenge. In this Hack and Slash, explore a revolutionary land, merge with the environment, and consume your enemies' fear to unleash the Zupay.

title: Shadows of Thornkeep
description: A dark fantasy, grid-based dungeon crawler where every step hides peril. Loot, adapt, and survive in turn-based battles as you lead lost souls through cursed halls in this rogue-lite descent into madness.

title: Torch of Shadows
description: Torch of Shadows is a fast-paced roguelite where Light and Dark clash endlessly. Defend the temple, counter enemies with opposing powers, and preserve the fragile balance before the void consumes all.

title: GhosTrick-The Sacred War of Light vs. Shadow
description: Short Description A strategic board game where angels and demons clash through hidden identities and mind games. Three intertwined win conditions create a new story and challenge with every match.

title: Tiny Shadows Interwoven Hearts
description: Programmer Lin Mo is tired of his monotonous life. One day, he meets a mysterious girl at a café who hides many secrets. As lies and true feelings intertwine, can this chance encounter save him from his numb existence? A visual novel filled with "love and hope".

title: Nocturne Maze: Shadows in the Hedge
description: Defeat as many ghoulish enemies and go for the high score!

title: Project: Another Use - Graftage
description: GRAFTAGE is a solarpunk hacking game where a bug has turned an office building into a cage. As you hack the corrupted machines through puzzles within their allotted runtimes, you bring the trapped denizens of the office building one step closer to freedom with each win you make against the virus.

title: Escatpade
description: Escatpade, a combination of escapade and cat, is an exciting adventure filled with danger and felines meant as a form of escape. Very suiting when it comes to junior high school student Ico. She was just spending another day during her summer vacation when she suddenly hears the "meow" of a kitty cat. This leads to an experience Ico soon won't forget, as she finds herself trapped by an evil scientist named Wapumi.

title: Baratin: The Video Game
description:
After the card game, discover the video game !

"Baratin : The video game" puts the community center from Quéven as well as its workers under the spotlight with humor in this crazy visual novel !

Try to beat haelori in a drinking game, escape from an hellish version of the Baratin and even survive in the woods !

Discover 20 endings with 10 differents characters in this unusual story !

title: Fire Entrance
description: You're a team of rescue robots in a world on fire!! Your tools: A high-pressure water hose and a trusty fire axe. Your mission: Don't be the reason your team fails!

title: Tangoo & Ullashong
description: Tangoo & Ullashong is a 2D action/platformer originally released in Korea for Windows/PC in the early 2000s. It was developed by Korean teams (listed variously as OK Interactive / SeoulMovie / Wemade/Joymax partners) and published in Korea by Joymax.

title: Starbrew Station: Auto-Maintenance Droid Unit
description: The Auto-Maintenance Droid is a new Patron-role unit available for the Engineering Deck (Deck 2). This unit is a premium side-grade offering slightly better income efficiency and is intended for players who wish to optimize their station. The Droid produces 22 Coffee/s and acts as a higher-tier alternative to the free units on this deck.

title: Starbrew Station: Symbiotic Sprout Unit
description: Introduce a new passive income unit, the Symbiotic Sprout, to your station. This Patron is available on the Hydroponics Deck (Deck 3). It provides a solid mid-tier choice, adding variety to your unit strategy. The Sprout produces 150 Coffee/s.

title: Starbrew Station: Station Mascot 'Pip' Unit
description: Unlock Pip, a new Patron-role unit who provides passive income on the Ground Floor (Deck 1). Pip is a balanced intermediate unit that offers a smoother income progression in the early game. Pip's production is 1.5 Coffee/s.

title: Starbrew Station: The Galactic Tycoon Unit
description: The Galactic Tycoon is an aspirational Patron unit for the VIP Deck (Deck 5), designed for dedicated late-game players. This unit offers a powerful new income source, producing 40,000 Coffee/s, surpassing the standard free units on this deck. It provides an extra goal for those who wish to accelerate their prestige runs and offers another way to support the solo developer.

title: Word Quest
description: Are you ready to wield words as weapons and conquer the quest?

title: Drone-Locked
description: In this First Person Shooter, take on a dangerous mission in infiltration and battling Autonomous Drones. Will you uncover the conspiracy?

title: Territorial Conquest
description: Lead your nation in Territorial Conquest through the Middle Ages, WWII, and Modern Era. Expand borders, build armies, trade, sabotage enemies, make political decisions, and conquer the world in immersive real-time strategy.

title: Five Nights at F**kboys: Ennard's Valiant Expedition
description:
Ennard embarks on a one-of-a-kind expedition...

Welcome to EVE, an original spin-off of the infamous Sister Location FNAFB game by Sivelos

Featuring perhaps over an hour or two of gameplay (idk for sure though tbh could be less), it has more than enough to satiate you fnafb gamers.

Originally developed by Ashy202 & AxelLino126

Ennard must embark on a quest to root out the true cause of all the events that transpire. Will Ennard and his new allies be able to identify and solve the world's crisis? Or will he turn another leaf and embrace the chaos?

title: Battleship Blitz
description: A modern take on the classic Battleship game - now in 3D! Place your wooden fleet, take aim, and sink enemy ships in singleplayer or PvP multiplayer. Simple, nostalgic, and addictive.

title: Assetto Corsa Rally
description: Assetto Corsa Rally is a high-fidelity rally sim built for precision and challenge. With 3D laser-scanned stages and cars, professional co-driver support, and dynamic conditions, it delivers a demanding, immersive experience where every second behind the wheel counts.

title: Rare Rabbits: Snuggle Haven
description:
Rare Rabbits is an adorable, turn-based simulation game where you can already breed more than 6,000,000 unique rabbits and manage your very own rabbit farm.
Each rabbit’s appearance and traits are determined by scientifically accurate genetics and inheritance principles, down to the smallest allele!

title: Realm Architect
description: An easy to use, immersive worldbuilding VTT that saves you time. Build worlds and play TTRPG's at your pace!

title: Fawn the Florist
description: Fawn the Florist is a cozy idle game that sits at the bottom of your screen, creating a peaceful companion for you as you work, study, or relax.

title: Burger, No Please!
description: BURGER, NO PLEASE! — a trashy co-op for up to 4 players where you work in fast food and get ingredients in absurd ways: fish from toilets, cola from rusty taps, cheese from rats. Cook, sabotage, and laugh until you cry!

title: DuoBellum de Marionnette
description: Even after their master's death, the dolls continue to engage in dueling dramas in secret. An old mansion deep in the forest. If the secret power hidden there is obtained, the curtain will rise on an even more fierce duel...

title: Cubic Annihilation
description: Command cubic armies in a classic explosive RTS but with a twist. Inspired by games like C&CG, SC2, & Total Annihilation. Build your loadout, deploy across land, sea, and air, and outwit your rivals in fast-paced tactical warfare.

title: Wrecking Wave
description: Wrecking Wave is an explosive action game with physics-based destruction focused on Challenge and Speedrun. Unleash a wave of chaos and smash cities, chase high scores and stop a mad scientist from polluting your ocean with toxic waste.

title: Ground Water: Episode of Dhanra
description: A platformer about squeezing and a quest to forge freedom. Follow Roshi's venture through the conflicts of Dhanra Village as a part of his journey to find a cure for the curse on his home. Navigate through winding paths and tactile environments that help express Roshi's potent squeeze and vessels.

title: Golden Freddy's Debauchery Simulator 1986
description: A sequel to Golden Freddy's Debauchery Simulator taking place after the events of Five Nights at F***boy's 3

title: Crazy Pipes 3D
description: In this fast-paced 3D puzzle game, connect pipes before time runs out, while avoiding obstacles and dynamites. Boost your score by using more pipes. Advance in the Normal mode with growing challenges or play randomly generated puzzles in the timer-less Endless mode.

title: Undead Sentence
description: Trapped in a decaying prison overrun by the undead, you must fight, scavenge, and survive. Undead Sentence is a retro-style survival horror FPS with brutal combat, atmospheric levels, and zero forgiveness.

title: Guild of Slayers
description: Survivors-like in full 3D with ragdoll physics. Enemies throw themselves at you as projectiles, crash into allies, and damage each other. Bodies fly. Chaos reigns. Survive waves of undead in the most satisfying horde-slaughter you've ever seen.

title: Mandate of Heaven
description: You will take on the role of the Second Prince of Xuan, heir of the Southern Regime. With foreign invaders entrenched in the north and a complacent court content to linger in the south, you face a defining choice:The choice… is yours!

title: Apes Warfare
description: Lead your ape army to victory in APES WARFARE, a modern turn-based strategy game. Command diverse units, outsmart your enemies, and conquer dynamic battlefields. Test your tactics in the solo campaign or challenge players worldwide in thrilling online multiplayer battles.

title: Cubuleto
description: Step into the world of Cubuleto, an isometric grid puzzle game where your goal is simple: find the path from start to finish. Easy to learn but challenging to master, each puzzle tests your logic and creativity. Can you find the way through?

title: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney – Presumption of Guilt
description:
Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney – Presumption of Guilt is a fangame based on the Ace Attorney series.

It serves as an interquel between the second and third mainline entries in the series — Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney – Justice for All and Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney – Trials and and Tribulations. Six cases are currently planned for the game.

title: The Last Worlds: Crossed Souls
description: 3D Action Open World RPG set on the alien planet Ness-444. Explore this world on the brink of ruin with your inseparable companion Lupio. Fight or tame countless nessky, fantastic creatures now blinded by darkness. Survive to learn the truth of this world and find out where other like you have gone.

title: Through the Nest
description: Through the Nest is a fast-paced sci-fi roguelite shooter set in deadly alien hives. Start with two classes, unlock more with chips, and survive each run by choosing upgrades along the way.

title: Snack Attack
description: Jump into traffic as your favorite animal and compete for dropped food! Dodge speeding cars, mash buttons to devour snacks hungry-hippos style, and fight to keep your stash. Find new friends hidden in each map. Fast-paced local multiplayer with simple controls that anyone can pick up and enjoy.

title: Epoch Cycle
description: Apocalypse is Not the End, It's Your Beginning. Become the supreme leader of a civilization in an apocalyptic world. Every collapse fuels the rise of a new era—your choices will forge a legacy across four monumental epochs.

title: Infected Love: The Fatal Experiment
description: Infected Love: The Fatal Experiment is not just a survival game — it’s a fusion of horror, romance, and unforgettable choices. Are you ready to confess your love… when the world is falling apart?

title: 101 Dogs Hidden in Shanghai
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in Shanghai in the hand-crafted landscape. Earn tons of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: EmberStride
description: The Dark Lord has awakened and attacked the kingdom. The King has sent you to defeat the evil enemy and free your people!

title: Li Shui
description: This is a modern 2D pixel style casual decryption game with very simple game controls. Players can collect props, use them in reasonable situations, and unlock the plot Every time the plot is unlocked, there may be some changes in the game's scenes, and players can explore the plot again

title: Xeno Strikers Hyper Squadron
description: A roguelike top-down shoot-em-up! Defeat waves of enemies and level up your ship and arsenal as you move from world to world! Challenge yourself with 12 different difficulties, from a breeze in the park to tough as nails!

title: Polybomber
description: Drop bombs. Survive. Extract. Upgrade. Repeat. Polybomber is a fast-paced arcade game packed with increasingly chaotic polygon battles.

title: Swords & Slippers
description: A darkly comedic Character Action Hack and Slash with deckbuilding and dating-sim elements, set in a twisted fairytale world. Lead your royal rebellion, build your squad, and confront wicked stepmothers in a world where happily ever after isn’t easy.

title: Shadow Mansion 2
description: A terrifying secret buried in your family’s shadow awaits... Decaying walls, whisper-filled dark rooms — are you ready to confront the curse of the past? A short, gripping, and immersive horror experience is calling you.

title: White Noise: Ghost Signal
description: You are the new caretaker of a polar station. The assignment came unexpectedly, but you accepted it without hesitation. A lonely outpost in the middle of an endless frozen wasteland — a place where you must simply survive, follow the instructions… and keep your mind from breaking.

title: Magic Maho: Dream Runner
description: Magic Maho: Dream Runner, a cute endless-style runner game about platforming and fighting monsters. Play as Maho, a magical girl stuck in an endless dream where she runs atop rooftops and is chased by monsters. Collect and use her magical staff to feed and defeat the monsters with pokies.

title: What Was Home
description: What Was Home is a story-driven first-person psychological horror game rooted in urban exploration. Wander through decayed halls and forgotten rooms, uncover fragments of the past, and piece together the hidden stories of those who once lived here — including the secrets your parents tried to keep from you.

title: Teddy Horses
description: Buy, breed, and race horses in charming Teddy Bear-run farms. Train and pair horses to create champions with better stats, compete in thrilling races, win big rewards, and expand your ranch into the ultimate horse-breeding empire.

title: Bunny Forest
description: Calm and cute pixel game about bunnies. Hop around, search for carrots, plant flowers, trade and explore the forest.

title: Only Animals
description: Venture into an endless world of shifting biomes and living ecosystems. Capture and transform into 100+ animals to explore, fight, and survive. Brave nights, battle colossal bosses, collect mystical hats, and team with up to 9 friends in a wilderness that never stops growing!

title: Tangled Slug
description: Turn-based puzzle about stretchy slugs that eat mushrooms. Eat all the mushrooms to clear a level, eat them within the allotted number of turns to get 3 stars!

title: Mary Jane
description: Start as a small producer, produce and distribute. Fight rival gangs and become the baron of two cities.

title: Jamp
description: Jamp is a fast paced jump timing platformer. Solve the jumps and complete timed challenges to unlock sweet customizations and bragging rights.

title: Paper Department
description: Paper Department is a psychological horror game in which you are a night-shift clerk working at a sinister paper company, who must approve or reject never-ending stacks of documents—while pursued by horrific visions, nightmare memories, and a mind that cannot be trusted.

title: Train Cargo: Nightshift
description: Unload trains, sort and package shipments, and keep the yard efficient. In Train Cargo Simulator, your performance keeps the company running and that's exactly how it should be.

title: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds - "Blue Star" Extreme Gear
description: Take control of the skies with the "Blue Star" Extreme Gear, inspired by Sonic's Extreme Gear in Sonic Riders.

title: Cute Mold
description: Cute Mold is a mold growth and evolution simulation. The mold gets energy for the void space around it, so the mold that has more voids will get more energy. Molds cannot interact or damage each other, evolutionary selection goes only by competing for space.

title: Ramshackle
description: Ramshackle is a multiplayer sandbox game where you design a combat vehicle, or "Vessel", out of destructible parts and armor, and put it to the test against other player-driven and AI Vessels. Share designs with other players on your server or license it out to the AI and encounter it in battle!

title: Slay the King
description: Lead a tribe of warriors to defeat a corrupt king and reclaim your land

title: Merlin Survivors
description: Camelot is under threat! Merlin Survivors is a game where rogue-like action meets fast-paced survival challenges. Take control of legendary characters like Merlin, Arthur, Lancelot, and Morgana, and fight against relentless waves of enemies. Master each character.

title: Mot's 8-Ball Pool
description:
A little pool simulation inspired by 3D pool on the C64 and Amiga.
Shoot a round of pool against a friend, or one of the 7 different CPU characters.

title: One More Gem
description: "One more gem" is a love letter for all the classic retro games similar to Supaplex or Rocks'n'Diamonds. Featuring more game elements, modern graphics and 130 levels packed with thrilling monsters and mind bending puzzles. If you want one more gem, the game also features a level editor.

title: Ptolem's Singing Catacombs
description: Ptolem's Singing Catacombs is an audio-based role-playing game styled after old-school dungeon crawlers.

title: Negotiations Have Failed!
description: Fight off the Aetheryx invasion in brutal, turn-based card battles across civilization's ruins. Choose your targets wisely as dice rolls and the luck of the draw determine attack damage. Master three unique classes, endure waves of enemies, and prepare to invade and destroy the Aetheryx Lair!

title: Twilight's Folclore
description:
Arima, the son of a doctor, lived in the capital of a nation that had been founded a few decades ago and which had undergone remarkable development. When his father succumbed suddenly to illness, he was left without any family. Fortunately, he was taken in by the noble Otobe family to work as the attendant for their lone daughter Supika, who had a frail constitution.

They were moved away from the main residence to a villa with a few other servants to escape from the scheming that swirled around the family and to spend their days happily. However, the calmness only lasts when the sun shines; When night falls, you could hear the sound of her life ticking away. Why was he chosen to be her attendant?

"Well, there’s no way around it, right? You’re the only one that I can eat."

title: Tekken 8: Armor King
description:
The heel wrestler Armor King is joining the fight!

Revenge beckons Armor King to take down his archenemy - the man who killed his brother.

Enter King, who is determined to end his bloodthirsty vengeance and challenge the dark wrestler. Armor King breaks the seal on a forbidden move which his brother had passed onto him in secret.

"I'll tear down the champion by any means necessary. It's all fair in my world. This... is the life of evil. And I live it to the fullest!"

title: Unquiet Grey
description:
Unquiet Grey is a visual novel about love and grief.

You wake up by the side of the road, alone and freezing. A stranger’s jacket covers you.

You don’t recognise it. You don’t recognise the man it belongs to either, staring out from the ID card you find in the pocket.

So why is there a picture of him and you on his phone screen?

title: Tekken 8: Miary Zo
description: Miary Zo embodies the vessel of the Silver Fighting God, a divine presence rooted in Madagascan legend. Her unique combat style draws from Morengy, a traditional Madagascan martial art, alongside other African influences and animal-inspired movements learned from the creatures she grew up observing. Accompanied by Vanilla and Cacao, two ring-tailed lemurs said to be messengers of the Silver Fighting God, Miary Zo channels joyful and lighthearted energy, treating every rival as a “battle friend forever.”

title: Tekken 8: Pac-Pixels
description:
Celebrate Pac-Man's 45th anniversary with the new stage Pac-Pixels!

Enjoy a blast from the past with upbeat, 8-bit style background music and Pac-Man-inspired visuals. Utilize Floor Breaks and Floor Blasts to turn up the heat in battle!

title: Suspecto
description: Dive into chaos with your friends! Slip into disguise as the killer and pick off your targets, or play the agent and hunt down the fakes hiding in the crowd. In this blend of strategy, stealth, and absurd humor… one fart sound can blow every plan to pieces.

title: PhaigeX: Confiners
description: Welcome aboard, Confiner! As PhaigeX Megacorp’s newest specialist, you’re tasked with curbing the AI incursion into hyperspace sectors. Choose your ship, upgrade your modules, accept commissions, and deploy adaptive strategems to fend off the relentless AI invasion.

title: Packonomy
description: Packonomy is a fun business simulation set in the nostalgic 90s atmosphere, where you start your entrepreneurial journey right from your own room. Buy products, manage your inventory, gain advantages through mini-games, unlock new products, and grow your business by keeping your customers happy!

title: Echo 91
description: A video blogger explores an abandoned Soviet school to film content — but the deeper he goes, the more disturbing the truth becomes. Discover secrets, solve puzzles, and try to escape a place that doesn’t want to let you go.

title: Cropia
description: Build and manage every aspect of your farm in Cropia. Cultivate crops, care for animals, fish, mine resources, and explore diverse environments, all while supporting and expanding the growth of the local community. Hire the town citizen to help you work effectively and efficiently.

title: Push Push
description: Push Push is a cute and relaxing idle balloon game! Pump balloons, unlock adorable cats, and discover quirky pumping gadgets and fun item combos. Perfect for quick breaks and stress relief.

title: Ants March TD
description: The survival of humanity rests in your hands. The ants have grown stronger, smarter, and more relentless. Build your defenses, upgrade your towers, and call upon the power of the legendary Lemon Totem. Will you rise as the last defender against the endless march?

title: The Erased Student
description: First-person horror game set in an abandoned Soviet-era school. You play as a Russian father whose son vanished years ago. Explore the decaying building, read forgotten letters, follow clues, and uncover a dark and disturbing truth.

title: Day In
description: Today is your day off! What will you do with this time? One of your numerous chores you've been neglecting, or will you find something else to do?

title: Secret of Fantasy
description: A card-driven idle roguelite where sci-fi crashes into fantasy. Two aliens, a curse, a relentless time loop. Set priorities, automate your run and be reborn stronger until you break the curse. Uncover the Secret of Fantasy.

title: Cyber Shard Clicker
description: Cyber Shard Clicker is a short cyberpunk incremental game. Break down geometric shapes representing hostile cyber attacks against Vault Inc., gather data shards, upgrade your hacking skills, and unlock permanent boosts in the vast skill tree to push your cyber assault even further!

title: Last Front
description: Modern armies, unique commanders, tactical battles. In Last Front, each faction offers its own style of war and exclusive units. Build your base, lead your army, and prove your superiority on the battlefield.

title: Rewind 99
description: The year is 1999. You're the last remaining video rental store. From humble VHS clerk to rental racketeer - run your video store and explore Reshoot Springs, building an underground empire. Expand with upgrades, side hustles, store membership, and more. Whatever it takes to survive.

title: Luminous Storia
description: A simple and easy-to-play sword world. A small adventure of a boy who defeats monsters one after another with good music "Luminous Storia"

title: TTT Classic
description: TTT Classic is a Half-Life Mod. A demake of the popular Garry's Mod gamemode, Trouble in Terrorist Town (TTT), faithfully recreated for the original Half-Life.

title: Docking Bay
description:
"DOCKING BAY" a mangement horror game where you as an inspector are placed into an outbreak of an infection in space.

Inspector, your crew is scheduled to return to the ship. It is now time to make a choice. Will you let your crew back on the ship or terminate them at a moment’s notice in order to preserve your own life?

title: DeviloutionX
description: DevilutionX is a port of Diablo and Hellfire that strives to make it simple to run the game while providing engine improvements, bugfixes, and some optional quality of life features.

title: TypeCaster
description: A once-shameless thief, cursed with a slow, agonizing death, must now embark on a perilous journey to the top of the legendary Tower of Trials. This 2.5D action RPG challenges you to master lightning-fast reflexes and precise typing to battle hordes of fearsome monsters guarding each floor. Harness powerful spells, uncover treasures, and push yourself to the limits in your battle against the unknowns. Will you rise to the challenge and break the curse, or will you become another victim?

title: Neuromira: First Death
description: "Can you reach Level 0?" Trapped in an endless loop, you must descend through a decaying, shifting building. Reality distorts, NPCs glitch, and something is watching. Find anomalies and escape before the system corrects you. A cyber-horror survival mystery awaits.

title: Warframe: The Vallis Undermind
description: Safeguard the Deepmines from Corpus defilement. Protect this thriving subterranean ecosystem by completing Bounties given to you by an enigmatic, mushroom-infested Solaris known as Nightcap.

title: Touhou Dystopian
description: Touhou Project's Brand New Action Roguelite Fan Game! Strange incidents erupt in the Animal Realm and Primate Spirit Garden. Embark on an unknown journey, uncover the truth behind the anomalies, and break through this 'Touhou Dystopian'!

title: Kinetic Neo Ornate Bout
description: Play two games at the same time—each with one stick of your controller. Score points, gain abilities, and don't forget to push the snails towards your opponent! They are the third and final dread in this extra hard multitasking challenge. K.N.O.B. will melt your brain! Play local with friends.

title: Spooky Dating Sim
description: You show up at a hot halloween party looking for a date. Unfortunately a bunch of rude guys start hitting on you and you need to get rid of them so you can talk to your crush.

title: A.I: Mnemosyne
description: A visual game based on the short story "A.I. - Memory Goddess" explores love and the meaning of existence. The story begins with the daily life of an ordinary person (me) and his celebrity girlfriend, Muni. Humanity's technological research in all aspects has reached its peak, but excessive development and research have also sown the seeds of crisis...

title: Initiating Station Plus
description: Next station, towards the future with you. The original 2016 visual novel 《高捷少女IS》is now on steam! In addition to all the original content and fully voiced (Chinese) dialogue, four whole new chapters and CGs are ready for you to explore.

title: A Night With Gigsjaw VR
description: A VR Survival Horror game set in a decrepit out of commission restaurant. Survey the cameras and your surroundings, conserve and recharge your power, and whatever you do... Do NOT let them in your room.

title: T-Crisis 4 110% A.I. Turbo Remix Tetris
description: Gameboy Tetris In Color With Multiple Players & Incredible Music!

title: Thine Rogueth
description:
The tales of Dirk McSteel are legend. True, he wasn't much of a fighter, but boy could he run! And run he did, collecting five Treasures of Complacency in the Temple of Forgotten Spine Monsters, or so it is told. Such a brave adventurer was he, risking life and limb at every turn, 'til that dreadful dungeon devoured him whole, never to be seen again.

But what if I told you he was still alive?

And if one acted fast, they might be able to save him...

And there's something more. For some curious reason, saving him is worth more than all twelve treasures combined.

Now wilt Thine Rogueth?!

title: Human Spiderweb
description:
The radiation shielding on the colony cracked; all the colonists have developing life-threatening tumors!
In an emergency procedure, the colony's surgeon removed their cancerous limbs and organs, and stitched them together to share vital organs until an organ printer can be made.

Unfortunately, space pirates have just invaded! All the colonists need to escape however they can.

title: Forlorn Screams of Agony Echoing Forevermore
description: A horror game where you scream to see.

title: Platswarmers
description: Integrate with your twitch channel and watch your viewers compete to see who can get to the end in the shortest number of moves. Create your own levels and share them with others.

title: Such a guy
description:
Such A Guy is a first-person narrative game that blends live-action interactive storytelling with light management gameplay. You play as Zane Zheng, a young man who leaves his city job in search of meaning and, together with two close friends, renovates a lakeside guesthouse by the sea. Featuring cinematic-grade filming, real actors, and on-location shooting, the game offers a deeply immersive experience. It combines branching narratives, relationship development, and exploration to create a lifelike yet open-ended interactive journey.

With nearly 1,000 minutes of 4K HD footage at its core, the game incorporates a relationship system and branching events. Players face hundreds of decision points, each influencing the characters' fates and the progression of the story. Over 20 different endings are available, along with side mini-games, hidden surprises, memorable scenes, and an achievement system to encourage exploration and replayability.

title: Endoparasitic Jam Version
description: Infected, partially devoured, survive. Prevent the parasite from going deeper into your body, as you escape the depths of your lab.

title: Neural Rot
description:
You're the last surviving from your unit.

A terrible affliction lies in these depths, and it's gotten to you, too.

Can you stave off your rot long enough to find a cure?

title: Celestial Clockwork
description: You have been assigned by King Gregura to create a calendar for the newly discovered world of Alyna.

title: The Lurking Fear
description: A minimalistic survival horror game where you fight or run from monsters using stealth to hunt you.

title: Belts of Iron
description:
Belts of Iron is an open world, third-person, factory building game. As a solo developer your support and feedback is crucial to the continued development of the game.
Explore vast procedurally generated worlds where every playthrough offers something new. Venture off in search of rich resource deposits, uncover unique landscapes, and share your favorite world seeds with friends. But beware, exploration comes at a cost, native hostile creatures roam the planet so you'll need to be prepared!

Build sprawling factories that stretch across the terrain, connected with miles of conveyor belts. Merge and split belts of items to optimize production lines and keep your factory running at peak efficiency. From simple smelters to complex oil refineries, every machine pushes your automation further as you expand your industrial empire!

title: Camelot 10000CE
description: Camelot 10000CE is a dark fantasy action game where you play a crippled cyborg and have to type commands to move and attack.

title: Cyan Heart
description: A horror exploration puzzle adventure where you relive events through a selfie viewpoint. Alone, with only voice communication from comrades as support, she simply keeps the camera rolling. Witness the record she wished to leave behind.

title: Kaos Kards
description: Do you like strategy? Do you enjoy throwing bread at people? Well then this game is for you! Take on five unique opponents in a fast-paced strategy card game where every turn is a mind game. Build your deck, manage your hand, and time your plays to gain the upper hand. Use Action Cards to attack, heal, or defend. Boost your odds with Dice Cards, or shake things up with unpredictable Kaos Cards that affect everyone on the field.

title: Jupiter's Orbit
description: A branching narrative, visual novel dating sim where you play asteroid dT. There are 4 loves, astrological secrets, and multiple endings based on your choices. Eject mass to change your orbit and meet different planets, but lose too much and you risk breaking apart.

title: Allgo: The Prime Reset
description: ALLGO: The Prime Reset is an FPS/TPS roguelite where you fight through wave-based combat, earn upgrades, and face deadly bosses. Swap between first- and third-person views, manage your loadout, and survive the reset. 🚨Demo coming soon!🚨 Wishlist Now!

title: MX Bodycam Bikes Racing
description: Race across treacherous off-road tracks filled with sharp turns, daring jumps, and harsh terrain. Feel every bump, slide, and burst of speed in this first-person motorcycle racing experience built for pure adrenaline.

title: Pasture Palette
description: Pasture Palette is a living art piece where your field becomes the canvas. Shape colors by painting objects, growing flowers, and raising sheep in vibrant hues, as loyal dogs help turn wool into goods and discover the palette hidden in your pasture.

title: Island Deck
description: "Island Deck" is a turn-based strategy game combined with island construction. Build your island with the cards in your hand, gather resources, and complete various tasks assigned by the king.

title: Infinite Einstein Tiles2
description: Infinite Einstein Tiles2 is a casual puzzle game themed around another mysterious tile discovered by David Smith. When you have solved all the puzzles, you may understand the relationship between the two tiles.

title: Zombie Protocol
description: Zombie Protocol is a hardcore isometric survival sim. Stay alive while caring for your baby—feed, protect, and keep quiet, because zombies react to every sound. Craft gear, drive when you must, and explore procedurally generated cities where every run is unique.

title: Purified
description:
PURIFIED is a single-player, third-person shooter with high octane action and neo-retro style, currently in development for the PS Vita and PC.
Inspired by the games and comics of the 90s and early 00s, it aims to be both a love letter to, and commentary on, the era of giant shoulder armor and over-the-top action.

title: Individual Investor Tycoon II
description: Start with nothing and work your way up — sell stocks over the phone, seize market opportunities, invest in properties, and build your fortune through smart decisions and well-timed moves.

title: Brio World: Railway
description: Build your dream railway using BRIOs classic wooden-style parts. Lay tracks, place stations and figures, create unique train sets, and explore a charming world filled with fun missions to complete.

title: Insomnia: Chapter One
description: 2012. The Arctic research station "Persei" loses contact with the outside world. You are Ethan Miller, a technician sent to the facility to fix the issues. But something here has clearly gone out of control.

title: Perilous Light
description: Perilous Light is a Lovecraftian-style 2D puzzle-platformer. The game’s core mechanics revolve around a unique player-light interaction, challenging players to solve environmental puzzles while evading deadly light.

title: X-Gravity
description: Defy physics with insane skateboarding combos across a reality-breaking open-world cityscape in X-GRAVITY! Rack up views, blaze through missions with a crew of freaky aliens, and carve your path with a fully customizable skater.

title: Twinkle’s Galactic Tour
description: Travel the galaxy and bash enemies to the beat in this 90's anime styled, low-poly, musical platforming adventure! Jump from planet-to-planet, collect 'em all in classic platforming-style zones, and meet the locals in big, open city hubs full of activities, side-quests, and mysteries.

title: New Eyes Cycle
description: A ten minute mystery.

title: Leonidov
description: Leonidov is a full Source Engine recreation of Ivan Leonidov's entry in the 1934 contest to design buildings for the People's Commissariat of Heavy Industry. It is structured like a virtual exhibit, giving players a tour of Ivan Leonidov's proposal.

title: Crash Bandicoot N.Finite
description: Crash Bandicoot N.Finite is a 2.5D side-scroller game that takes the shape and characteristics of the original ps1 games, with also dynamics from games such as Spyro and Jak and Daxter.

title: Weird Comic Art: The Athletic & Museum
description: A Follow up to Koumei Satou's mod, Weird Comic Art, made for the original Quake. Weird Comic Art: The Athletic & Museum is a showcase of various artistic setpieces utilizing the capabilties of the Quake II engine.

title: Joymaker
description: A story-driven indie psychological horror game

title: Clinical Marshmallows
description: Battle for patient lives in this hospital-themed card battler! Roll dice to heal or harm as hospical staff clash in chaotic wards. Rogue-like progression meets deck-building strategy in this darkly humorous take on healthcare chaos

title: The Definitive Subsistence Update
description:
MGS2 received a Substance version that added new content to play.
MGS3 received a Subsistence version that changed how the game was played.
MGSV deserves an update of the same caliber.
Definitive Subsistence adds new content and new meaningful gameplay mechanics that'll make you feel like you're playing MGSV for the first time

title: Far Fresnel
description: FAR FRESNEL is an exploration game where you descend into the abyss of a distant planet aboard an ancient elevator system. As you venture deeper into this forsaken world, you'll uncover the secrets of the previous expeditions.

title: Lyrvane Park
description: Lyrvane Park is a first-person meta-horror puzzle adventure. Use the Radar of Emotions to harvest children's emotions, power up the train, and unlock the path forward. Beyond the Staff Only signs, the park’s darkest secrets await

title: As Long As You're Here
description: A first-person emotional family drama seen through the eyes of a woman with Alzheimer's disease. When Annie is forced to move from her long-time home, her children try to cope with reversed caretaking roles. As they clash over how to care for her, Annie's life slowly unravels, and memories of her long-dead brother start bleeding into the present.

title: Virus Brain
description: Explore a surreal, abandoned Japanese city, collect credit cards from corpses and solve Kanji puzzles to get back your lost memories.

title: Saint of Chains
description:
Psychological single-player first-person horror. Explore dark environments, fight with melee and guns, and solve puzzles in this retro 2000s-inspired nightmare where the truth is more terrifying than the monsters.

Retro Horror - Reborn: A love letter to Silent Hill 3, Lost in Vivo, Condemned: Criminal Origins, and Cry of Fear.

Built in the haunting visual style of the PS2 / Xbox360 era — when every shadow felt alive, and every step sounded like a confession.

title: Jackpot Crash Course
description: In a game show starring only criminals, you must gamble against rival players to prove yourself worthy of being pardoned for your wrong deeds— But is the show really about proving your innocence? Jackpot Crash Course is a death game visual novel about crime, luck and spectacle.

title: Fun Home
description: You are a little boy trapped in a house with an axe wielding maniac clown. Can you figure out the mysteries of the house and escape with your life?

title: Geometry Dash: 1.9 Update
description: The 1.9 update for geometry dash was at the time of the release, the biggest and more influential update to the game. It included the brand new wave gamemode, the ability to use songs uploaded to newgrounds, two new main levels (Blast Processing and Theory Of Everything 2), new blocks, icons, among other things.

title: Reverse 1999: A Long Long Way
description:
Version 3.0 of Reverse: 1999, which includes:
• New characters: Sentinel and Charon
• New Garments for Semmelweis, Flutterpage, J, and Ms. Radio
• New main story chapter: A Long Long Way
• New Anecdote for Tennant
• …and more!

title: Geometry Dash: 2.0 Update
description: The 2.0 update for Geometry Dash was the biggest update to the game at the time. Including two new levels, Geometrical Dominator and Deadlocked, it also introduces the robot gamemode, move and opacity triggers, user coins, social features such as player profiles, and many other changes.

title: Geometry Dash: 2.1 Update
description: The Geometry Dash 2.1 brought a new official level: fingerdash, along many other additions to the game, such as the spider gamemode, daily levels, quests, gauntlets, new icons, different demon ratings, among many other new adduitions

title: Geometry Dash: 2.2 Update
description: The 2.2 update was notorious for falling into developement hell, taking close to 7 years to actually release. When it finally released, the update included a new level, "dash", a new gamemode, the swing, the platformer mode, new orbs such as the teleport orb, many new triggers such as camera control, among many other features.

title: Launderley
description: A horror and exploration adventure that tells the story of Blanche, who was found alone in the gardens of Launderley, in front of a pile of twenty-nine corpses.

title: Dragon Quest X: Jikuu no Mayoigo-tachi Online
description: Dragon Quest X: Jikuu no Mayoigotachi Online is the seventh major expansion for Dragon Quest X, known as Version 8. It adds a new story, characters, and content as part of the ongoing Dragon Quest X experience, but requires prior access to earlier Dragon Quest X Online content (or the All-In-One version covering versions 1–7) to play.

title: Quadratic Puzzle 2
