description: Quadratic puzzle 2 is a very interesting puzzle game. Compared with the first one, it has more functions. It can restore images with one click, allowing you to browse pictures faster!

title: Blazing Maidens
description: In this pixel action shooting game inspired by the classic gameplay of Vampire Survivors.

title: Ascend From Nine Mountains
description: Craft mythical treasures. Perfect your stance. Shatter your limits. Ascend from Nine Mountains is a cultivation RPG where deep crafting, tactical combat, and meaningful relationships intertwine. Your choices carve the way from mortal obscurity to legend.

title: BioShock 2: Kill 'em Kindly
description: Kill 'em Kindly is a game mode for BioShock 2 Multiplayer released as a Downloadable Content on May 11th, 2010, alongsides the Rapture Metro Pack and the Zigo & Blanche DLC. In this game mode, the players can only use golf clubs to strike enemies with melee attacks. This mode is free to download on the Xbox Live, and the PlayStation Network. It was also free to download on the Games for Windows Live online platform for PC until its closure, but is now included on the regular game on Steam.

title: Beer Machine
description: Your father needs a beer, and it's your job to get it. He doesn't care what it takes, so do what you must. Be quick though - it's not so safe in the dark.

title: Pyromaniac
description:
Play as Nikolas, a 20-year-old guy who found himself lost in a completely abandoned city... or so he thought it was at first.
Explore the city, defend yourself from monsters, and find answers to what is really going on.

title: Cockroach!
description: A cockroach crawling around on your computer desktop — and it even bursts with goo when clicked!

title: Shifting Chambers
description: Shifting Chambers is a first-person horror exploration puzzle game set inside a manor where the room layout shifts when the bell rings. You must explore a constantly changing layout, solve cryptic puzzles, and avoid the enigmatic guardians who brought you here — and won’t let you leave.

title: Drowning Ashes
description: The Ashes ignite once more, and the floodwaters rise to drown an accursed kingdom. Explore the ruins of the Capital, recruit wild monsters, and find a way to end the ruinous Cycle in this turn-based monster collector from the makers of Guile & Glory: Firstborn.

title: Rebounce
description: You’re not just playing a game, you’re babysitting a basketball with abandonment issues. It just wants to bounce back to its family, but gravity, wreckage, and your questionable skills stand in the way. Every slip hurts it and tests your patience. But hey, love is worth it, right?

title: Five Nights at F***boy's: Golden Edition
Addition Subtraction Multiplication Division Magician
description: You are a wizard from another world, using Math to create your own magic, entering different spaces, facing a constant stream of enemies, plundering various treasures to fill your vault. Of course, you have to live to take away these spoils.

title: Autumn Rail
description: A survival horror visual novel. When her train terminates at the strange and sinister Sylvan Station, Tera finds herself entangled in a neverending night of darkness.

title: Five Nights at F***boy's: Golden Edition 2
Five Nights at F***boy's: Dancing All Night
description:
Welcome to the wonderful world of FNaFb: Dancing All Night.

Ever wondered what would happen if the creator of the (s)hit fan games Golden Freddy's Debauchery Simulator and FNaFB SFME decided to make a fan made Five Nights at F---boy's 4 and not take it seriously in the slightest? Five Nights at F---boy's 4: Dancing All Night is the answer to your weirdly specific question!

title: Chip by Chip
description: Piece your memories back together in a cozy platforming adventure about finding home where you least expect it; chip by chip.

title: Shitamichi Chinsou Club
description:
Race through two courses inspired by real-world locations.
Master the unique handling characteristics of each of the four cars, and push for the fastest time on twisting, winding roads!
Compete against other players’ records and climb the local leaderboard.

title: Mutual Harrow
description: Guide Mina and Rex through a dark and intense psychological visual novel of trauma, love, and insecurity. Traverse Section 56's dangers, confront the past, and shape their fate through decisions that lead to four unique endings.

title: Stocks: Main Force Simulator
description: This is a game simulating large capital operations by major players in the stock market. Leverage announcements, market sentiment, and sector hotspots to buy/sell stocks for profit. Will you act as a market maker harvesting retail investors or a hero helping them escape losses?

title: Hide Zone
description: Hide Zone is a multiplayer game where one player becomes the hunter and the others turn into props. Find them all before time runs out or hide so well that no one ever finds you!

title: Habitat Toxica
description: In Habitat Toxica, a mysterious virus mutates animals into hostile creatures, pushing them toward extinction. As one of the few chimpanzees who gained intelligence from the infection, you must fight for survival and save the remaining wildlife.

title: Psycho Partisans: Officer Nirvana
description: Dive into Psycho Partisan, the gripping episodic adventure horror series! Survive the brutal grip of an East European dictatorship, blending eerie Slavic mythology with true tales of Belarusian heroes battling for freedom. Each episode unleashes heart-pounding terror and resilience.

title: Polandball: The Black Apocalypse
description: This game blends Polandball's dark humor with psychological horror and survival combat. Scavenge limited resources (food, medicine, weapons, parts) to stay alive, fend off monsters with diverse arsenals. Every second of survival is a hard-won luxury – survive until you unveil the truth.

title: Isekai Training
description: Abandon your past life; this one hinges on training and survival. In a world of magic and monsters, spark fire, raise a timber keep—Observe, Prepare, Adapt, Restrain—carve through wilds, dungeons.

title: Street Life Simulator
description: Lose everything to debt, start from the streets, and survive by begging, selling, and upgrading your shelter.

title: Pumpkin Simulator
description: Pumpkin Simulator is a game in which you can become a pumpkin.

title: Ski Jumping World Cup
description: Take flight in Ski Jumping World Cup - a true ski jumping adventure that takes you to legendary hills across the globe. From snowy peaks in Scandinavia to wind-swept arenas in Japan and record-breaking runs in the USA, every leap demands focus, precision, and nerves of steel.

title: Typing Fireworks
description: Typing Fireworks is a casual game where your fingers run across the keyboard to set off fireworks! You can only move to adjacent keys, escape the danger zone before the fuse burns out, and look up to enjoy the dazzling display when the fireworks bloom!

title: Where Is Mommy
description: A retro horror game about spotting anomalies in looping environments and surviving the cycle.

title: Scrap Bulwark Guide
description: "Scrap Bulwark Guide" is a tower defense game blending exploration and RPG mechanics. As a survivor in a post-apocalyptic city, you must recruit others, scavenge building materials from ruins, build street barricades, and fend off nightly zombie hordes to ultimately lead your group to safety.

title: Sepan and the Seven Flasks
description: Help Sepan to find his way in the darkness. Explore, beat minigames, survive and find the Seven Flasks.

title: Brownie's Adventure: The Final Resolution
description: A traditional yet wildly unique 1990s-style Point & Click adventure. Journey through a realm of rich fantasy—and, er... the midlands—as you fumble your way toward saving both worlds from almost-certain doom! Make choices, solve puzzles and enjoy a hilarious final chapter to the Brownie universe!

title: Wilva
description: Wilba is a side-scrolling action platformer game influenced by classic action RPG games.

title: DreamEcho
description: Dream Echo is an RogueLite ARPG game where players can explore the world of Dreams and acquire various Concepts to engage in nearly completely free-form combination battles. Additionally, you can gather Memories upon waking, allowing you to bring some Concepts into your next dream adventure...

title: Arinoa: Conquest
description: Arinoa: Conquest is a real time grand strategy game with a focus on hero units, and combines elements of strategy, resource management, and light RPG mechanics. Gather resources, build your army, and conquer your enemies within the harsh world of Arinoa.

title: Letter From Heart Antique Shop
description: A story about a girl who finds herself in a mysterious antique store where letters with screaming human hearts appear.

title: Ashbound Expanse
description: This is a fast-paced first-person and third-person shooter that blends roguelike elements, offering easy-to-learn mechanics, satisfying controls, and intense gunplay. Combined with highly immersive visuals, it delivers a thrilling and exhilarating shooting experience.

title: Schwarzesmarken: Kouketsu no Monshou
description:
First part of Schwarzesmarken visual novel, covering the events of Volume 1 to Volume 3 of the Light Novel.

The story follows the East German Army's 666th TSF Squadron in its battles and political conflicts during the BETA's westward push in 1983.

The East German Army 666th TSF Squadron "Schwarzesmarken" (Black Marks) are a special-forces unit tasked with assaulting BETA forces through unconventional tactics; specifically, they target Laser and Heavy Laser class BETA to deny the BETA the advantage of ranged firepower. Their orders are given the topmost priority, such that it is common practice for the 666th to ignore allied distress calls that will result in deviation from their original mission, even if only for a short moment.

title: Runic Tower
description: Stand as the last guardian of the god-bound Runic Tower in a groundbreaking 3rd-person roguelike tower defense experience. Command evolving powers, confront relentless invading factions, and utilize strategic planning to overcome your foes!

title: Kinap
description: A pixel art action roguelite where you defeat enemies to transform into them, gaining their abilities in fast-paced, strategic, and intense combat.

title: PooPig
description: Shoot, dodge, and chase your acorns in this absurd, cartoon-style Bullethell filled with humor and visual gags.

title: Tower Tactics II
description: The fusion of deck-building roguelike and tower defense returns, bigger than ever! Build your deck with powerful new cards, unlock unique trinkets, and deploy enhanced towers to overcome relentless waves of enemies and new strategic challenges.

title: Gladiators of Roma Revixit
description: Gladiators of Roma Revixit is a unique, story-driven roguelike, set in world in which, after the nuclear fallout, a new Rome and thus a new colosseum rises from the radioactive-ashes. Rise the ranks, enjoy the celebrity of being a Gladiator, and make decisions that impact the story.

title: Project Obscure
description: Solve the physics-based puzzles in a steampunk atmosphere "Enlighten" dark mysteries of an old facility. Delve into a unique experience and KEEP YOUR LIGHT ON.

title: Spider Hotel
description: Run, hide, survive in SPIDER HOTEL—an asymmetrical 1v4 chase. Hunt as the wall-crawling Spider or cooperate as the Insects to rescue allies and escape. Traps & abilities decide who gets cocooned.

title: Spooky Monster
description: The story is about a young woman who has been forcibly taken by a demon to another world, crawling with various monsters: zombies, ghosts, vampires, fairies. Now she must coexist with them until she can return home.

title: Medetashi Medetashi
description: Play the role of an ordinary main character in the story—a nameless cat. He journeys through the pages of the book in search of the heroine's secret.

title: Type Ride
description: "Type Ride" is a typing-based tower defense game where you summon units by typing. In a world overrun by ink lifeforms, the protagonist—once known as the "Type Rider" for her high-speed typing skills while riding a motorcycle—decides to ride her beloved bike once again to resolve the chaos.

title: One With the Unicycleverse
description: A precision platformer where you maneuver and weave your unicycle through hundreds of dastardly obstacles across dozens of levels and side modes. Upon mastering the controls; the game becomes a meditative experience and you will discover what it means to be ‘One with the Unicycleverse.’

title: Black Mesa: Route to Evacuation - Part 1
description: Route to Evacuation is a story based singleplayer mod. You'll get to take the role of Howard Nevill, a scientist who works in the analytical laboratories at Sector C. A distinguished individual with a scientific degree will go through the horrors of the Black Mesa Incident in a desperate attempt to survive. As you are a regular scientist, this will be harder than usual.

title: Schwarzesmarken: Junkyousha-tachi
description:
Second part of Schwarzesmarken visual novel, covering the events from Volume 4 and completes the story of Schwarzesmarken with three routes:

Our Hands: Katia Waldheim
Last Desires: Irisdina Bernhard
Lost Heaven: Lise Hohenstein

The story follows the East German Army's 666th TSF Squadron in its battles and political conflicts during the BETA's westward push in 1983.

After success in operation neptune 666th TSF Squadron is widely recognized as heroes of East Germany. And while this status guarantees some measure of inviolability to its members there are still many adversities waiting for ours heroes - from continuing BETA westward offesnive to threat of civil war and apprehension by Stasi.

Player's choices are more imactful than in previous installment as each of the ending is vastly different than the others.

title: Gaya: The Mystery
description: A Korean-style Soulslike RPG set in the ancient Gaya era. A mysterious adventure of a warrior’s desperate journey to save the kingdom!

title: Soulscape 2: Fragments of the Present
description: Soulscape 2 is a Turn-based RPG set in the dystopian near future. Featuring an isometric exploration, party-based combat, and a branching dialogue that is shaped by your choices in the game.

title: Operation Purge
description: Operation Purge is a story-driven sci-fi survival game set on Titan, Saturn’s mysterious moon. Explore the terrain, manage limited resources, and uncover the secrets hidden beneath the surface. Will you survive long enough to find the truth?

title: Secret of Havendor
description: Survive the shadows of your past. Forge your path in a world where blood and targets are currency. Will you cling to your humanity or become the monster they see?

title: GrappleBurger
description: GrappleBurger is a high-management cooking game where multitasking is the only way to get your orders out. Master the chaos of the kitchen as you fry, blend, grill, and craft your way up the leaderboards! Do you have what it takes to be a top chef?

title: Zombie Typing
description: Zombie Typing is a tense survival game where every action: moving, looting, reloading, and fighting off the undead, relies on your typing skills. Type fast and stay sharp, because one wrong key could mean the difference between survival and being devoured!

title: Cairn: Stone Towers
description: Build balance, one stone at a time. Stack stones into tranquil cairns in this meditative physics-based puzzle game. Explore serene landscapes, master gravity and patience, and create harmony through careful placement. No timers. No stress. Just you and the stones.

title: B-Ricky High School
description: Meet Ricky in this exciting arcade game mixing flipper, brick smashing and fight. Get ready for the challenges of Arcade or Story mode and for the tough ones, settle the score in the double 2-player mode.

title: RabbitHole Island: Turn-based Vtuber Battles
description: Turn-based battles against powerful vtubers. Free to Play!

title: Wonder Warp
description: An Alien Threat Has Emerged in the City of Cynosure! Run and gun through a series of mazes to defeat the monsters.

title: The Demon's Apple: Otome Game
description: The Demon's Apple is a Dark Fantasy otome game with mature content. Pomme, a herbalist as to make an alliance with a bloodthirsty demon she saved to survive in a world hostile to both. Play as Pomme who has to learn to live under the same roof as the demon who wants her blood and more.

title: Someone's Inside Me
description: Your teacher Ms. Morbid has trapped you and your classmates on a deadly multiplayer field trip inside a human body! With proximity chat, two teams must scavenge, sabotage, and outwit each other to see who escapes first.

title: Down Forward
description: A fast-paced roguelike FPS where you survive shifting liminal nightmares and VHS-era horrors.

title: Influencer Simulator 25
description: Step into the shoes of an ambitious influencer, clicking and buying your way to fame. Bribe followers, become stronger with upgrades and buy a wide range of consumables to dominate all of the hashtags of the internet space!

title: Innerwhy
description: You just dissociated from reality. Unfortunately, the imaginary world you've landed in is as disturbed as your mental state. Gather your courage and confront your darkest thoughts in this 8-bit psychological horror RPG.

title: Dice x Deck
description: Based on backgammon, players gain buffs that amplify the effects of the squares. Deck-building roguelike-like play experience.

title: Human Planet
description: 500,000 years ago in the Stone Age, explore uncharted lands in search of a settlement. Survive hunger and predators armed with only crude weapons and your wits.

title: Genesis Relic: Idle Sandbox Simulator
description: A sandbox idle management sim: pick the preset worlds “Three-Kingdoms Conquest” “The Golden Lotus” or “Famine Legend” then build and govern your own realm. The in-game editor lets you customize development rules, characters and plots, export your world, or load and share creations with others.

title: Cairns
description: Balance. Patience. Perfection. Cairns is the quintessential Stone Stacking game. Experience diverse and atmospheric environments, and master the art of building the freestanding stone towers know as Cairns.

title: Tiny Bakery
description: Run a tiny bakery for sweet-toothed slime customers! Adapt to changing weather, seasons, and festivals as cravings shift. Unlock new recipes, welcome new guests, and prepare each night for the day ahead.

title: Hunkfrat
description: Hunkfrat is a fast-paced first-person shooter where you try to get your almighty frat beverages in the most sarcastic and entertaining way.

title: Nonetbeat
description: NonetBeat is a TPS action game starring three charming heroines. Each with unique combat styles, they obliterate hordes of monsters with magic! Sandbox stages let you destroy terrain for dynamic battles. Collect magic and unleash dazzling combos in thrilling hack-and-slash action!

title: Chain Shotgun
description: Chain Shotgun is a fast paced movement shooter where your only weapon is the multi-barrelled CHAIN SHOTGUN. Two barrels are way too few! With an up-to-infinite amount of barrels, it can shoot anything from sniper rounds, rockets, slime - LEGS? Why not even load it with yourself?

title: Merp in Merpworld
description: Merp in Merpworld evokes the feeling of classic Gamegirl Color platformers, but includes modern niceties such as widescreen support, high refresh rate support, and a hi-def, heart-pumping soundtrack.

title: Devil's Terminal
description: Troubled teen simulator. Build a deck of dice and roll against fear.

title: GU Fighters
description: GU Fighters is an action roguelike where you unlock and upgrade new abilities after every round of combat. Play with up to 4 players locally or online to create your own unique build and be the first to win, or go solo/co-op to traverse varying environments and defeat hordes of enemies.

title: Case Files: Internal Affairs
description: Case Files: Internal Affairs is the third installment in the Case Files series, a choice-driven detective adventure in which players investigate the deaths of two police officers and uncover the truth behind a mysterious case through evidence gathering, questioning suspects, and critical decision-making.

title: Cats With Standards
description: Horror Visual Novel where Cats claw through filth for bones and whisper lies to mirrors. Find the Hidden-Objects. Obey, smile, repeat—until the lines between rule and ruin blur, and you’re left meowing into the void.

title: Recurrence
description: "Something is broken... and it keeps repeating."A classic survival horror set in a cyberpunk world corrupted by a strange signal. Solve puzzles, face terrifying creatures, and try to escape a nightmare that seems endless

title: Skewer Squad
description: Become the ULTIMATE Grill Master! Pick your favorite foods and seasonings to build your Skewer Squad. Drag, shoot, and bounce to keep those sneaky critters away from your precious grill!

title: Ignition 2000: Origins
description: Immerse yourself in the world of street racing, go on an adventure on those 2000s summer nights. Take care of your ride, upgrade it, customize it! Unlock and explore cars never seen before, discover new roads, take up new challenges! Or just go on a relaxing night run, it's up to you!

title: Airport Police Simulator
description: Airport Police Simulator offers players the opportunity to take on the task of maintaining security at a busy airport. As a police officer, your goal is to detect banned substances, catch criminals and ensure that every passenger travels safely.

title: Fishing for Numbers
description: Fishing for Numbers is a vibrant first-person educational adventure where you step into the shoes of an aspiring Mathemagician on a quest to join the prestigious Arcane Anglers Guild. Master increasingly harder equations and catch magical fish to prove your worth and earn your place among the elite!

title: Hedgehog's Dilemma
description: A story of love, connections, and separation, a story about philosophy and science. Marharyta and Mykhailo try to figure out their relationships - and cannot help but fall in love over and over again.

title: V2 Cucumber Scam
description: A darkly humorous adventure + colony builder (with Farming). Crash-land on V2, home to the mysterious “Cucumbers”. Build a colony, explore anomalies, hack devices and uncover the truth - all in hand-drawn 2D pixel art.

title: The Game for Free
description: This game is [FREE] of charge.

title: Paper Wars
description: Paper Wars is a single-player flight action game where you pilot powerful paper airplanes. Face off against an army of red paper planes, along with land and sea threats. Unlock and upgrade your fleet to dominate the skies!

title: Basketboy's Adventure
description: Explore, collect, and fight in Basketboy's Adventure! Uncover stories and hidden secrets across the vibrant, hand-drawn semi-open world of Gugu City. Master dozens of skills and talents, bond with powerful pets, and gear up for an epic battle!

title: Drunkard Simulator
description: Drink. Stumble. Cause chaos. Drunkard Simulator lets you turn your neighborhood into a boozy playground of impulsive stunts and slapstick mayhem.

title: Operator Unknown
description: IReCorp gave you access to memory. But whose memory is it — and where is the exit from someone else's dream?

title: Headspace
description: A NSFW Adventure-RPG where you either subdue or seduce the various denizens of your imagination, all while trying to remember who you are. Can you escape the confines of your Headspace?

title: Melodic Mage
description: A rhythm-based action shooter where you play as a mage, casting spells and dodging to the beat. Battle through dynamic levels, defeat challenging bosses, and unleash the magic of music!

title: Lokko
description: Lokko is a bouncy, action-packed 3D platformer where YOU create the adventure! In Lokko, players race to deliver hot pizzas around the globe while battling the sinister Goobol fast-food corporation.

title: Charoite Into the Deep
description: This is an action RPG in which Charois, a little witch, goes underground with her golem. Using skills such as “dowsing” and items found in the game, players can safely reach the deepest part of the basement by avoiding traps and threats from powerful enemies.

title: Steel Defence
description: Every battle is a test. Every choice is a step towards victory. Combine skills, experiment with tactics and find your own style that will turn you into a nightmare for your enemies!

title: Bomberrage
description: Bomberrage has no classic rules - it's a fast and exciting game where you fight strong opponents or friends in explosive multiplayer battles!

title: Tete's Atelier: Patches
description: Tete received a patch customization machine from her grandmother and now transforms each piece of clothing into something special! Unleash your creativity, create unique pieces, and sell them in your in-game store.

title: Lone Bird in the Tree
description: “Lone Bird in the Tree” is an ADV with male and female versions of each of the four characters. The story alternates between the “future” of the main character, who is deeply traumatized by the grief of his/her best friend, and the “story leading up to the loss of his/her best friend”.

title: From the Top
description: Fusing Battling tops and Roguelike Deckbuilding together to create an unlimited source of battling tops fun! Collect new tops, combine them together, pair 'em up with synergistic relic and go on a short adventure, From the Top!

title: Monitor State
description: You are an operator in a dystopia world, watch and punish citizens. Experience a deep narrative with moral dilemmas. Obey, resist or find another path.

title: Resort Island Simulator
description: A world filled with tricksters, pirates, zealots, and treasures. An ocean full of danger and prize. Face dilemmas and encounters. Manage a resort in this wild world and build a thriving business. An Explorer, a Survivor a Resorter or a Trader? Forge your own path to wealth. Make Resort Prosper!

title: Ice River
description: Ice River is a point-and-click story-driven adventure game set in late 1990s in northeastern China. Players will immerge into Jiangping, which inspired by Shenyang and Changchun, gradually uncover the truth behind the disappearance of Dun’s mother.

title: ReSoul: Jack
description:
ReSoul:Jack is a turn-based blackjack roguelike.
Draw from nine facedown cards, using only their relative size hints to guide your choices.
Combine items creatively and survive each tribute requirement on your path toward rebirth.

title: Foxy Trouble
description: An uninvited fox spirit girl suddenly appears, determined to absorb the purest life essence—by having a romance that's both sultry and thrilling! And so begins a heart-pounding, sweat-inducing cohabitation life! This is a short romance visual novel guaranteed to make you smile!

title: Isekai Revitalizer
description: Explore the world of Miliene and watch as Gonzo’s saga unfolds in this story-driven visual novel! Meet the dynamic cast and experience a whole new world with Gonzo’s second chance at life. How will he take his 98 years of experience on earth and change this world? It’s up to you to find out!

title: Jam's Adjustable Mirrors
description: Harness sunlight and guide light beams by strategically placing and rotating various types of mirrors- all to power an elaborate jam-making operation!

title: Rogue Melee
description: Rogue Melee is an action Roguelike where you fight your way through a randomly generated dungeon. As you descend deeper, every floor has a unique theme, cast of enemies, bosses and treasure to find. Additionally, you will also acquire stronger weapons and items that empower you on your journey.

title: E9uations
description: You are the equal sign(=). Rearrange the numbers and operators to form equation and solve the puzzle.

title: With Me: Aquatic Time
description: With Me: Aquatic Time! is a gamified focus tool where you raise fish and design your aquarium. With soothing music, flowing water, and gently swimming fish, it creates a relaxing space to boost focus. Discover, breed, and nurture fish while personalizing your tranquil aquatic world.

title: Don`t Peek
description: Don’t Peek is a cooperative psychological horror in a cyberpunk style, blending elements of survival and escape. Experience the atmosphere of fear and uncertainty, make critical choices, and control the fate of your friends — will you save them or leave them to perish in this nightmare?

title: Ticking Together
description: Ticking Together is a 1-4 player co-op platformer set in a high-stakes cyberpunk world. Carry a bomb through deadly obstacle courses, reset its timer with a hand scan every 15 seconds, and work together to prevent a catastrophic city-wide explosion.

title: Mushroom Clicker
description: An Idle Incremental Clicker game with cosy magical vibes. You are the newest Mushroom Wizard Initiate Cast spells, harvest mushrooms and level up to become more powerful! Hire little creatures ️ to help you harvest and unlock different types of shrooms and skills!

title: One Halloween Night
description:
- One Halloween Night is a realistic home-invasion horror experience created using the Unity Engine. This is definitely my best project yet, and I appreciate every download!

-You take the position of a teenage boy, who is left home alone on Halloween night. Your parents had to unexpectedly leave the house for the night, with you left to manage trick-or-treaters. What should have been a simple, smooth, and relaxing night, quickly turns into a terrifying Nightmare.

- Full gameplay takes about 25 minutes.

title: EmPipe
description: Puzzle game that has you lay down pipes to channel water from a start to finish point

title: Samago
description: Can you be the greatest frog today? SAMAGO is an endless 2D Platformer with 24-hour twist! Each level is up for 24-hours to compete in against other players!

title: A Man's Work
description: "A Man's Work" is a short, story-driven psychological horror. During a cold, snowy winter, Nikolay Sokolov, a rising Russian horror film actor, returns to his late father’s apartment to sort through his belongings and memories.

title: Frost and Glory
description: Snowfall City is hosting a legendary snowblaster tournament, and you’re set to compete! Enter a light, wintery open-world RPG with a cheerful atmosphere, level-up talents through snow-slinging trials, recruit companions, outplay tricky rivals, and rise from rookie to seasonal champion!

title: Shellstorm: The Great War
description: SHELLSTORM unleashes satisfying tactical combat that redefines the RTS genre with destructible terrains, physics-driven interactions, and complex AI. Command infantry, artillery, tanks, and aircraft to overcome impossible odds on difficult missions, or play PvP battles and climb the leaderboards.

title: Fool's Cup
description: Fool’s Cup is an online multiplayer party game set in a medieval world. Compete in colorful, chaotic mini-games to prove your skills and outwit rivals. Fun, rivalry, and laughter collide—but only one can claim the crown as the kingdom’s ultimate jester!

title: Knights & Towers
description: Create strategies, evolve and defende the castle!

title: Panoptyca: Idle RPG Manager
description: Discover a new style of RPG management gameplay. Experience the fun of an idle RPG that blends an innovative four-view battle system with a deep hero-growth mechanic.

title: My Cold Girlfriend
description: What's It Like to Have a Girlfriend with a Hidden Side? A romantic comedy visual novel set in a modern campus, where a dare leads to an unexpected relationship with a cold beautyand a sweet, chaotic cohabitation begins.

title: Ayrton Idle
description: A chill Auto-Battler Idler RPG inspired by classic Flash games. Battle, mine, fish, and upgrade gear—all while multitasking. Made to keep you busy while you’re busy.

title: Who Do Voodoo
description: A social deduction game where crafted cards become spells. Protect allies, sabotage rivals, or prank everyone in a magical fight for survival.

title: DeAnima
description: DeAnima is a brutal yet rewarding dungeon crawler steeped in classic roguelike tradition. Set in a sprawling, medieval dungeon, you embody a lone wanderer seeking the fabled Crown of Nivek.

title: Living With a Little Fox Girl
description: Care for a local shrine and befriend Mao, the fox girl who lives there. In this light-hearted simulation game, you’ll have 30 days to balance your time between your tasks and building a relationship with Mao. Use your time wisely, and who knows? Maybe she'll let you stay longer.

title: Desktop Purrfect
description: Your purr-fect desktop companion is here! Get adorable cats that chill at the bottom of your screen, keeping you company while you work, study, play, or relax. Collect toys & furniture to build them a cozy home. Pet, feed, play, or simply enjoy their presence.

title: Tiny Paws
description: Your hand-drawn desktop pet digs while you work. Care on breaks. No timers, just cozy idle. Paw to paw, pixel to pixel, helping real animals.

title: Feed My Mech
description: Your mech is all that stands between you and what writhes below. FEED MY MECH is a short horror experience—venture into a dead underground colony and recover lost tech. But something is spreading through the machines… and it’s looking for a way inside your mech.

title: It’s Quiz Time: Guinness World Records Edition
description: The iconic GUINNESS WORLD RECORDS meets It's Quiz Time for the ultimate multiplayer party game. Flex your knowledge on official, mind-blowing records, conquer unique rounds with photo and video questions, and battle your friends locally and online all using your phone as a controller!

title: The Myth of a Godslayer
description: Follow Klain's mythical adventures in this top-down Action-RPG mixing combat, exploration, puzzles and platforming. Travel through the New World, explore forgotten dungeons, confront terrible foes and... become a Godslayer!

title: Dangerous Mountain Together
description: Team up in this chaotic 2-4 player co-op RC car adventure! Navigate dangerous mountain roads while tethered together, pulling each other back from disaster. Climb steep hills, survive wild weather, and reach the top without tumbling into the abyss!

title: Paw Pop Fish
description: Watching a kitty chase fish on a tablet, I thought: what if I could be that carefree—just tapping fish and forgetting worries? So we made this lighthearted game! Choose from 14 paws or design your own, explore 10 scenes, switch day & weather, and climb leaderboards with friends worldwide.

title: Danmo Three Kingdoms: Battle of Wits
description: A Three Kingdoms-themed tactical chess game with light strategy and easy controls. Step into the era as a strategist, use over 200 historical figures—each with unique traits and counters—to form teams, revisit key battles, and shape outcomes with your tactics.

title: Grave Whisperers
description: Grave Whisperers is a co-op horror game set in a cursed pet cemetery. Stay silent or the creatures will hear you. Scream once and you're dead. Gather clues, solve twisted cases with friends, and survive the nightmare that listens to every sound.

title: Pocket Gecko
description: A cute gecko lives on your screen! Capture bugs, keep them for special bonuses or sell them to buy upgrades and customize your gecko. Watch it wiggle while you work or play!

title: Alley Cats Idle
description: Adopt, collect, and relax with a growing gang of streetwise cats in this cozy idle game. Who will wander into your alley next?

title: There's No Differences: Cake
description: Ready to test your detective skills? Find the differences between two similar sweet scenes!

title: Arrow Spire: Tower Defense
description: A tower defense roguelite where each defeat makes you stronger. Spend gold on temporary boosts, invest gems in permanent upgrades, and push your tower higher each run.

title: Cyberpunk Store Simulator
description: Cyberpunk Store Simulator puts you in charge of a neon lit shop in a dystopian city. Manage stock, serve customers, sell cybernetic implants, and explore the streets. Build, customize, and grow your store into a futuristic empire.

title: There's No Differences: Dragons
description: Ready to test your detective skills? Find the differences between two similar dragon-themed scenes!

title: Beauty Store Simulator
description: Run your own beauty store in Beauty Store Simulator! Manage a variety of cosmetics, fashion items, jewelry, and more. Design your store, keep customers happy, and build a successful beauty empire. Can you become the ultimate beauty mogul?

title: Tales of Terrarum
description: 《Tales of Terrarum》is a management adventure sim game. On the new land of Terrarum, you will inherit a territory as a descendant of the Francz family, and become the town mayor to settle the craftsmen and adventurers who come to the town. You'll live in and expand the town together.

title: Cosmos Point
description: Control a squad of fighters in turn-based battles. The game pays great attention to the details of equipment - weapons, backpacks, a lot of grenades and other devices. More resources taken out of the mission - more improvements at the base. There are no useless items, there is a small backpack.

title: Wasteland Shop Simulator
description: A post-apocalyptic shop management game where you build, customize, and expand your store. Hire staff, explore the wasteland for loot, deal with messy customers and thieves, and grow your retail empire in a chaotic world gone mad.

title: Royal Lord
description: In "Kingdom Monarch", you are a monarch and can build the kingdom of your dreams! You need to build city walls, assign jobs to villagers, recruit soldiers, repel hordes of monsters at night, and expand your village during the day.

title: Basement 66
description: The dice roguelike. You’ve been locked in Basement 66 with the Demon. Roll the death dice. Destroy cursed cards. Remember, only one of you can leave this hell alive. Will you survive? Good luck…

title: Indian Mechanic Simulator
description: Fix punctures, repair engines, wash, paint, and restore scooters, cars, and more in Indian Mechanic Simulator. Experience authentic street-side repairs and become the most trusted mechanic in town!

title: Sinking Eternity
description: Sinking Eternity is a single-player underwater exploration RPG. Survive extreme depths, hide from dangerous sea creatures, and uncover the secrets of a civilization lost for millennia.

title: Rustmire
description: In this side-view pixel-art world, you captain a landship—survive by combat and scavenging, and grow your modular vessel into your own city. Among roaming cities and underground enclaves, records and wreckage hint at why people live this way… or how you become wreckage.

title: Bamorota Defense
description: Defend the sealstones in a fantasy world! Place towers and cast spells to stop endless waves of monsters in this casual tower defense game.

title: Bouncemasters 2: Pengu Throw
description: Bouncemasters 2: Pengu Throw is a sequel to the 300-million-downloads fun arcade hit and a successor of the legendary Yetisports! Grab your bat, line up the perfect swing and bounce your way around Levels Map. Chase glory while branching biomes packed with hazards, boosters and memes!

title: Find Your Way Home: Last Flight
description: Build your colony in the zombie apocalypse, gather resources, and defend against raids. Send your team to loot houses for supplies, advance through research, struggle to survive, and try to build your plane to return home.

title: Find All: Halloween
description: “Trick or treat? ” Test your bravery by exploring a spooky mansion inhabited by ghosts, finding different items, and coloring a black and white picture with colorful inks.

title: Shika-Q
description: SHIKA-Q is an online, real-time puzzle battle on a 10×10 board, where players link blocks to attack and defend. Original vocal tracks drive the action, creating an immersive experience that makes music a core part of gameplay.

title: Hotdog: The Videogame
description: Solo or with friends, manage multiple hot dog stands in a dynamic and realistic business simulator. Sell fast food, customize it with unique toppings, upgrade your equipment and buy your dreamed restaurant. Serve demanding customers against the clock to achieve efficient greatness.

title: Window Garden
description: Manage your garden on your desktop and experience its ups and downs. Watch the weather change, plants grow, and enjoy the beautiful music! This game has been specially designed to avoid interfering with your normal work.

title: Neon Strike
description: Quick reflexes, color swaps, and instant retries! Neon Strike is an easy to control action-puzzler set in a vibrant neon world. Easy to play, tough to master.

title: Mork Folio
description: Mork Folio is a third party companion APP for the Award winning Mork Bork TTRPG game.

title: Noise Canceler
description: APods — AI-powered earbuds that read your emotions and generate music. Drawn to these songs, five ordinary people find themselves moved to action.

title: Stringate
description: Stringate is a level-based puzzle game with portals and other complex mechanics.

title: Astro Nova
description: Astro Nova is a short incremental roguelike about surviving swarms in space, combining modules into powerful builds, and ascending beyond the stars.

title: Ghost with a Gun
description: Escape to Fort Lockwood - a stylish and secure location with strong defenses and an emphasis on safety. Bring your own firearms or borrow ours to practice your marksmanship in your very own indoor gun range.

title: A Home Is Safe
description: A Home Is Safe is a 3D survival horror game where a retro firmware update is your only hope of stopping T.O.M, home security robot turned killer. Split your focus between a tense computer interface and nerve-wracking first-person survival, rebuilding T.O.M.'s psyche as you evade the imposing threat.

title: Rondoku
description: Fill elegant diagrams with the correct numbers using three simple rules. Rondoku invites you to think, take your time, and enjoy beautifully hand-crafted challenges.

title: Prototype is !Lisa
description: Lisa recovers from an accident for her next mission: enter the mainframe complex and connect the Megalocal Recognition system to the main control room. A simple mission.

title: Gvalt
description: Collect words, find powerful combinations of boosters, and achieve the highest score! In this dynamic word game, you will find dozens of artifacts, unusual upgrades, and colorful characters who are ready to raise a ruckus!

title: Rabbit Samurai
description: In Rabbit Samurai, you’ll join a colorful 2D deck-building adventure. Each fight is tougher and funnier than the last.

title: Alpine Skater
description: Alpine Skater takes mountain skating to the next level with tracks that span every kind of terrain the highlands can offer. From icy slopes and snow-dusted ridges to rugged rocky paths and many more.

title: Dragonsbane Sword Brawdia High!
description: This is the enhanced edition of the short, puzzle-like SRPG 「滅竜剣ブラウディア」, originally released as a free game in 2025. It now includes additional content and full English support. Enjoy the small but heartfelt adventures of Sphie, Lyon, and two new adventurers joining the story.

title: Sex Game: Gay Affair - Episode 3
description: A simple SEX SIMULATION game with VISUAL NOVEL elements, featuring HD GRAPHICS and juicy ANIMATIONS. In this episode, they spend a warm summer afternoon on the sandy beach, tanning in the sun. They take advantage of being alone on the beach and engage in sex.

title: Hentai Bae Pinky
description: A simple match-2 puzzle game where you unlock images of “happy” memories between you and your sweet lover, Pinky

title: Shirou Day Online
description: Fangame of the Fate/stay night licence to celebrate the Shirou Day. This is an online multiplayer game where everyone plays as Shirou. You explore the city, find its secrets and unlock achievements.

title: Job Hunting
description: Job Hunting is a PS1-style horror comedy where a living job application stalks you through liminal space office ruins and corporate hellscapes. Parkour, grapple, and survive unemployment itself. Run from the job that wants to hire you...permanently. Find your resume pieces, AND GET TO SHREDDING!

title: Lines of Battle
description:
Lines of Battle is a multi-era tactical strategy game that puts you in command of armies inspired by the Napoleonic Wars and World War II.

Plan your deployments, issue orders, and outmaneuver your opponent in battles where positioning, timing, and decision-making determine the outcome. Built around the fantasy of being a true battlefield commander.

title: Hedge Fund Manager Simulator MMO
description: A multiplayer stock investing simulator, where players run their own Hedge Funds. Everyone begins with a million dollars. Players can invest in other players' funds, and have other players as investors in their fund. Stock prices follow the real market, and are updated once per day.

title: Luta: Luminoria Tactics
description:
Luminoria Tactics is a 3D turn-based strategy and collectible card game that delivers fast-paced, cinematic battles. Summon powerful 3D heroes into visually striking arenas and command them with tactical decisions, no “End Turn” button, just seamless, continuous strategy.

Players can level up heroes, upgrade items, and cast dynamic spells to outplay opponents in short, action-packed matches. Every decision shapes the flow of battle, combining collectible card depth with real-time tension.

Designed for both mobile and desktop, Luminoria Tactics redefines tactical card combat with 3D heroes, evolving arenas, and endlessly replayable strategic gameplay.

title: Immortal Farmer: System’s Mandate
description: Welcome to Immortal Farmer: System’s Mandate, a paradise blending adventure, cultivation, and rural life. In this apocalyptic world overrun by demons, you are transmigrated into a refugee and stumble upon a mysterious village—Taoyuan Village, protected by cultivators.

title: Tulip Season
description: Tulip Season is an incremental farming sim built from small, satisfying routines. Beauty has a number, and you make it go up. Unlock new tulips and field upgrades, breed new colours, and help out when the neighbours come by.

title: The Driver Syndicate
description: The Driver Syndicate is an open-world driving action game inspired by the classic Driver series.

title: Pine Creek
description: A weekend getaway to Pine Creek in '86 turns into a nightmare when your wife vanishes as strange lights appear in the sky. Solve puzzles, hide from the grays, save Sarah and survive the night in this first-person stealth survival horror. The truth is darker than you think.

title: The Sushi Restaurant
description: Prepare sushi in this cozy horror game and unlock new recipes every day. But something is making the atmosphere grow creepier. Can you figure out what?

title: Lugal: Bronze Age Survival Game
description: A survival craft game with RTS elements. Build a base, become the leader of a tribe → village → city → state. Conquer neighboring settlements and become king.

title: Sherok's Case: Recollection
description: "Scientific evidence, eyewitness testimony, and objective facts—when these align, the truth emerges. As my grandfather Holmes used to say: Whatever remains, however improbable, must be the truth."

title: Molitva
description: Molitva – a brutal, nonlinear visual novel about sins committed and the final chance for redemption. Are you worthy of forgiveness?

title: Ogrewatch
description: Shoot Ogres and race to upgrade your base and equipment before getting overrun. Discover ancient secrets to unlock more powerful weapons and find the key to your survival.

title: Mini Golf Gold
description: Mini Golf Gold is a video game published in 2002 on Windows by Electrotank, Inc.. It's a sports game, set in a mini golf theme.

title: Not Survivors
description: Not Survivors is a top-down survival Roguelike game. Choose from diverse adventurers, skillfully combine item and weapon effects to fend off hordes of monsters, survive, and secure victory.

title: Corner Cards
description: Corner Cards is a relaxing corner-window idle card-collecting game where you open booster packs, complete card sets, and upgrade your booth to attract more customers and fans alike!

title: Potting Paradise
description:
Live out your gardening dreams in this micro-greenhouse vegetable-clicker game.

Potting Paradise is your personal 'lil greenhouse. that fits perfectly snuggly on your desktop or web-browser. Watch the plants grow and throw the pots around till they align perfectly in they way you want them. This is your space to do whatever you want with, handcraft the perfect little digital garden till your heart's content!

title: Swords and Sandals III Redux
description: A legend returns! The beloved classic Swords and Sandals 3 is back, re-forged in glory! Step back into the Gladiae Ultratus once more and prepare to take on the greatest gladiators in all Brandor. It's the hardest, most metal gladiator game ever made.

title: The False God's Fold
description: A turn-based card strategy game. You are a Card-Seeker, wandering ruined lands and forgotten realms, collecting forbidden cards—shattered relics of fallen gods. Wield their power to battle twisted creatures and ancient guardians. Each card is a weapon. Each play, a gamble.

title: Super Shape Shooter
description: hilarious fun, simple, fast-paced free-for-all deathmatch game with tons of unlockable hats! Super Shape Shooter is an online 2D Mutliplayer Shooter platformer. Choose from three different classes and play in five different maps against your friends and have some gun n jump fun in hilarious epic matches. Features: 2D Online Multiplayer Shooter Play against bots or humans 6 different maps 3 different characters Tons of cosmetic hats to make ur shape unique

title: Love Too Easily 2: Summer Pocha
description: Real-life dating simulation game "Love Too Easily 2: Summer Pocha." You lose everything in a hit-and-run accident while delivering food. To make matters worse, you're scammed by the only friend you ever trusted! You start running a Pocha (food truck) and encounter five beautiful girls....

title: Black Border II
description: Black Border 2: Night Shift is an intense border patrol simulator where you inspect documents and use special tools to detect forgeries and stop smugglers after dark.

title: Cafe Crew Simulator
description: Craft coffee masterpieces, grow your dream café, and sabotage the competition in style! Coffee's hot, competition's hotter!

title: Ropeat
description: Ropeat is a fun top-down shooter in which 2-10 players use their robots’ repeat-mechanic to win: Each player gets copies that repeat exactly what they did a few seconds ago. Plan carefully ahead or just dive into the chaos and win against your friends!

title: Sherpa's Caravan
description: Explore a cozy open world as a sherpa driver in your van! Deliver cargo, cook food, craft gear, and explore mountains, lakes, and hidden trails. Sail in boats and kayaks, dive underwater. Meet old friends and upgrade your van! A camping atmosphere and next-gen graphics.

title: The Pact
description: The Pact is a first-person, story-driven psychological horror game where you unravel your family's dark legacy across generations. Face unsettling trials, uncover truths meant to stay forgotten, and witness the horrors that follow your bloodline through the centuries.

title: Warp Marked
description: Warp Marked is an incremental space exploration game. Explore a mysterious uncharted dimension, navigate around its dangers, learn its secrets, and return stronger with every launch!

title: Creature Menace: The Ultimate Nightmare
description: Battle against hordes of violent creatures in this 2D arcade-shooter. Utilize your vast arsenal of weapons to survive across the 8 maps, level up using the unique class and perk system, beat your previous high scores as you become stronger. Endure the peril alone, or with up to 3 other friends.

title: Illumination of Mansion
description: Step into a haunted mansion where every move counts! Illumination of Mansion horror-puzzle game mixes Minesweeper mechanics with a horror genre atmosphere. Solve puzzles, uncover dangers, and survive through to rooms - if you can.

title: Cursed Frontier
description: A 2D platformer shooter with a somber linoleum-inspired art style, where you’ll face funeral creatures in a haunting Wild West setting.

title: Motorcycle for Sale Simulator
description: Buy, fix, customize, and sell motorcycles. Start with old bikes, restore every part, test ride, and grow your own dealership. Take risks, make smart deals, and become the best in town!

title: MusicRunner
description: Welcome to MusicRunner, a new type of rhythm and action game!

title: Running Fable Petite Party
description: Running Fable Petite Party throws you and your friends into 16 fast-paced, friendship-testing mini-games across 3 tabletop arenas. Outsmart, outplay, and out laugh each other in this ultimate party showdown for 1–4 players!

title: Vegemancer
description: Feed a mysterious mole your hard grown vegetables in this fast-paced incremental farming clicker/idle. Use tools, automation and chaotic spells to truly master the vegetable and unravel reality altogether.

title: Coin Shark
description: Coin Shark is a coin flipping roguelike deck builder all about beating randomness and creating powerful synergies!

title: Plantverk: Perfectly Plantastic Plant Simulator
description: Create your perfect little Greenhouse with fantastic plants, fun decorations and more in this cozy idle game! Throw your harvests around and cause havoc, and then use the vacuum to clean up your mess (for profit of course). Use your well-earned money to buy decorations, unlock new plants and pots.

title: Mirage: Lost in the Liminal
description: Mirage is an immersive psychological horror game inspired by the Backrooms. Trapped after a failed tech experiment, you explore a distorted world where hallways repeat, walls lie, and reality crumbles. Survive, understand... or be lost forever.

title: Abyss Lord
description: What awaits the young man in the future? A long and happy life next to loved ones? Losses and suffering leading to an inglorious death? The throne of the enemy of humanity? A harem of all sorts of races, from pretty goblins to graceful vampires? The one and only love until death?

title: Null Transit
description: Null Transit is a high-stakes action-platformer. Command the captain and crew of a failing ship, master a unique dash-attack combat system, and fight to survive the unforgiving depths of deep space.

title: Behind the Hydra's Eyes
description: Welcome to Forward Green, Dave, we hope you're excited. Project Lagoon Breeze is a great opportunity to make connections, oversee construction, and manage community relations on an international scale. This role requires resilience, but we know you're up for it. Are you ready to make a difference?

title: Zjawa: Bloodstained Soul
description: "Fear not Brother, tonight we are without sin. In Crusade all is forgiven." It is 13th century, and seeds of heresy sprout in the west. By the grace of Pope, all who take up arms against this evil shall have eternal salvation. Or so you were told.

title: The Black Bahr
description: The Black Bahr is a sandbox colony simulation RPG blending ocean exploration, crew management, and dynamic faction politics. Freely chart your course as a pirate, merchant, or honorable captain, shaping your destiny across the open seas.

title: Gunblade Ranger
description: Gunblade Ranger is a post-apocalyptic Roguelike top-down shooter. You will use guns and blades to hunt monsters in randomly generated radiation zones, collect mutant abilities, break into the source of the radiation, and face the final challenge.

title: Project Sara
description: A man who has lost his wife and seeks to escape loneliness and grief begins working as a firewatch in a forest. He meets a girl named Sarah and encounters strange occurrences while uncovering deep family secrets. He learns that not every voice is human and not every farewell signifies an end.

title: The Last Delivery Man on Earth
description: A lonely and challenging experience with realistic driving physics. Pickup packages, deliver them and escape the death zone to finish the job.

title: Alien Cartographer
description: Alien Cartographer is a Minesweeper-like logic deduction puzzle game, where the player has to identify various buildings on a hexagonal grid using environmental hints and the strict rules of their architecture.

title: Dungeon Trail
description: A role playing game where you gamble with human lives. Roll dice, change fate.

title: Consonance
description: Engage your mind with Consonance, a puzzle game featuring procedurally-generated, animated, minimalist scenes. Rearrange the pieces to reveal each unique scene, and challenge yourself with puzzles containing up to 100 pieces.

title: Diapause
description: DIAPAUSE is a haunting sit-and-survive style indie horror game. Stuck within a cabin with only your wits and a spotty flashlight, defend your life against vicious monsters during the night, and solve mysterious puzzles while wandering the halls of your deteriorating mind during the day.

title: Purplearc
description: PURPLEARC is a platformer where you control the main character, Baty, and explore a world of night.

title: Pass Tiger Cage
description: A Roguelike game. You will play a general in the game who leads his troops to guard the historical gate. Choose from a variety of combat skills, upgrade your equipment and recruit troops to assist in the battle.

title: Paint by Words
description: The game is a fun and educational combination of Hangman and Crossword, plus some PbN vibe :) Fill in the missing letters in the crossword puzzles to unveil distinct regions of one big pixel art. Use your brain power to convert boring grayscales into colorful pixel art fellows!

title: Polaria
description: Polarium is a relaxing idle game set in the serene world of Antarctica. Discover peaceful marine life, learn about polar ecosystems, and find comfort in nature. Inspired by real research, the game blends healing gameplay with subtle messages on climate and biodiversity.

title: Parking Garage Simulator
description: Build a parking business from scratch! Welcome cars as a valet, collect payments, expand your garage, and ensure security. Welcome to Parking Simulator with realistic mechanics and the chaos of city life!

title: Pizzaïolo-Ninja
description: Pizzaïolo-Ninja is a 'Die & Retry' platformer with 100 levels, a global speedrun leaderboard, a Streamer Mode to play with your Twitch chat.

title: FriendOS
description: FriendOS is a singleplayer/online bullet-hell RPG set within a virus-infected computer. Customize your Friend and team up with others to fish, socialize, and explore the depths of a dying operating system.

title: G-Mode Archives+: Stella Deus - The Spirit of Darkness
description: Face the trials and fight through! Team up with unique companions! This is our story — a journey of uncertainty, but we keep moving forward.

title: Windwoven
description: You inherit forest edge land. Daily, till soil with your hoe grow radishes, rear chicks, bond with oddball neighbors. Spring seeds yield summer gardens; autumn's firelit pumpkins reveal woodland mysteries. Nighttime under trees, fireflies dance like starlit constellations, this is your idyllic life.

title: Meluo and the Eyes of Hollow
description: A small walk 'n talk journey with little to no puzzling. Follow Meluo through his descent into disarray.

title: Meet Me at the Apple Garden
description:
Welcome to the Apple Church!

A remote Sisterhood where each day begins the same: wake, attend the Morning Ceremony, and serve each other. Selaphiel, a devout nun, has lived by this pattern for many years.

Until her small slice of Paradise is disturbed when she receives a letter from her dear friend, Celestine.

title: Childish Life Prologue
description: This game tells the story of a girl with a special fate who meets a cat and a mysterious talking body in a different world, and the body and cat help the girl return to the real world. Players need to control the girl to pass through each level. Due to her special fate, the girl has special skills in a different world, which can help players better avoid monsters and traps.

title: Yorvik's Game
description: An atmospheric tabletop game with elements of deckbuilding and a narrative puzzle to solve

title: QiuQiu Town
description: You have come to this new world, where you will start a new life, have many options, run the farm, scale up, and become a great agriculturist. Or run a store and become a business mogul. Or ordinary life every day, if you were given the chance to do it again, what would you choose?

title: Agro Racing
description: With stylized low-poly 3D visuals and a tight third-person camera, Agro Racing combines combat-racing with a roguelike experience, where each race is more chaotic than the last. Upgrade your tractor with absurd tools, destroy your opponents, and claim the title of Cattle Baron!

title: Dungeon of Erotic Master Reboot
description: In a certain kingdom, there are three female warriors who are quite popular in their adventuring partyーhowever, they have their vices… Buried in debt and with their reputations on the line, will our heroines be able to take advantage of the chance of a lifetime and save the lost adventurer king?!

title: My Little Spider
description: Adopt a cute pet spider that lives anywhere on your desktop! Team up to discover unique bugs, decorate their web, and unlock adorable spider hats as you work or relax.

title: Seasons Turning
description: A farming/life sim focused on exploration and immersion. There's no stamina bar and no broken tools. Aside from the genre's norms, it has four puzzle-filled dungeons, secret locations, irrigation, gene splicing, mafia kittens, and one rusty, well-loved bicycle. Save whenever. Play at your own speed.

title: Spirit Vendor
description: I built Spirit Vendor as a solo indie dev, and I'm excited to share it with you! In this charming world, you decide how your day unfolds—run your shop, tend your fields, and care for your animals. Explore a lively village, meet unique characters, build friendships, and perhaps even find true love.

title: Mandate Order
description: Mandate Order is a strategy game set in the Warring States period. Starting from barren lands, build strongholds integrating production, defense and military functions. Manage resources and the people's will, expand your territory, counter threats, and ultimately rise to prominence amidst the chaos.

title: Dāo Qūqū
description: Play as your dao-style hero and fight against others! The battle frees your hands, allows you to focus on strategy build. With the card pool building gameplay, random draws gain strategic depth! Skill backpack requires your superb management ability! You have only one goal: to become the Solo King!

title: Jiànxí Sǐshén
description: "Jiànxí Sǐshén" is a text-based interactive otome romance game. Players will become a newly appointed Death God and rescue a programmer on the verge of collapse. Every response will change the course of his life.

title: Crimson Horror
description: Crimson Horror is an 8 map MBF21 compatible mapset for Doom 2, featuring extensive use of DEHACKED to add multiple custom weapons and enemies.

title: Physical Train: Chamland National Railway
description: Drive an exciting train using physics simulation and complete missions to develop Chamland!

title: Suīyáng: Shī Yǔ Huǒ
description: On the Lantern Festival night of the eleventh year of the Tianbao reign of the Tang Dynasty, the wandering young man Han Chengye encountered a mysterious noblewoman in the prosperous city of Chang'an. Three years later, the An-Shi Rebellion broke out. Where would fate throw these two unlikely couples? Players will experience a series of events in the lives of multiple protagonists and be thrust into the most brutal defense of a city in ancient Chinese history. Defend it, save it, or flee? The choice is yours.

title: Jiǔměizǐ zhī Sǐ: Zhāohé Shàonǚ Xuèsè Gàobái
description: In 1988, on the eve of the bursting of Japan's bubble economy, he transformed himself into a detective who was wrongly accused of a crime. He investigated the strange suicide case of Qingmei, which led to the secret of a 20-year-long serial murder case. He shuttled through the streets of Showa, which were filled with cigarettes, alcohol and neon lights. Amidst the choices between human hearts and life and death, he searched for clues and found the truth of the bloody case.

title: Loop My Crank
description: A ridiculous clicker where cranking handles becomes a cult. Upgrade your cranks, recruit spinners, and embrace the infinite loop. Always spin. Never stop.

title: SpelBrawl
description: SpelBrawl is a roguelite word game with challenging and rewarding gameplay. Play solo to unlock spells, intervals, and unique characters to extend words. Battle others online and test your luck to become the ultimate SpelBrawler!

title: Pixel Survivors: Defense
description: Pixel Survivors: Defense is a pixel roguelike defense game where you fight off endless waves of monsters. Collect skills, upgrade your heroes, combine items, and survive as long as you can!

title: Omega Protocol
description: "Choose, boost, survive!" Rogue-lite Co-op Action!! 3 rookies vs mutants with ONE shared power-up. Survive together by passing boost between teammates! Sniper needs precision? Give it! Tank under attack? Switch instantly! Steal power from allies or sacrifice yourself. Teamwork meets betrayal.

title: Hexachess
description: Chess on hexagonal field with local play, online multiplayer & against AI. Based on Glinski's chess variant.

title: Rolla
description: Play as the monster from the movie series that never existed, ROLLA. ROLL. EAT. REPEAT. Fast paced arcade game with chunky old school 3d graphics: eat people, destroy whole cities and battle with cops, army and government agents! Uncover the secrets of what ROLLA is and where it is from.

title: Apocalypse Meow
description: The fur flies in a post-human wasteland where cats have to claw their way through a world overrun by crazy human factions. Equip yourself with weapons to battle through chaotic missions and uncover the secrets behind humanity's downfall. It's a world where cats don't just survive but they dominate.

title: Reality Rivals: The First Season
description: Reality Rivals is the reality show you can play. Compete in challenges, form alliances, and survive the vote in this social strategy game. Every choice shapes the drama. Will you avoid Exile, and beat your Rivals?

title: Timber Trail
description: What began as a peaceful hike turns into a horror story. Trapped in a stranger’s home, you must escape before this nightmare consumes you. When things take an unexpected turn, you seize the chance to end this dreaded legend.

title: Hold Your Breadth DX
description: Play as a squishy slime trough this spooky, 80´s inspired, puzzle / adventure, and remember to Hold Your Breadth.

title: Merror
description: Trapped in an endless loop of mirrored rooms, restore broken symmetry by solving puzzles and confronting your fears. An atmospheric psychological horror puzzle game where reality and reflections merge into one.

title: Tame-a-goat-chi
description: Tame-a-goat-chi is a cozy world of goats that live alongside your daily routine, gently unfolding at the bottom of your screen.

title: Cat Carried Butterfly
description: The story unfolds in Republican-era Shanghai. Lüpíng, a girl raised in an orphanage, receives a letter from the headmaster guiding her back to her childhood home. In the long-forgotten courtyard, amid a maze of fading traditions and new ideas, she uncovers her past and long-buried eerie secrets.

title: Eternal Voyager
description: Eternal Voyager is a classic action RPG set in a universe overrun by monsters, spiders, robots, and freaks. Take on the role of a living weapon unleashed to stop the source of a catastrophic event that threatens to destroy all worlds.

title: Shitty Game
description: Armed with a weaponized plunger and a bathroom full of mutant turds, it’s your job to shoot, flush, and survive the chaos. Add SHITTY GAME to your wishlist — before the stink spreads.

title: Fleet Tycoon
description: Turn a single ship into a maritime empire through clever upgrades and strategic planning. Combine upgrades in surprising ways to create a profit engine that breaks the game! Every addictive 3-minute cycle reveals new profit optimizations!

title: Stress Relief
description: Stress Relief is an idler game, which comes with a reliable companion, the Slime! Are you bored? Are you stressed because of work? Come and destroy your desktop with the tools included! Play, earn Pixel Points and get drops every 25 minutes!

title: Pixel Pegz
description: A vibrant arcade game inspired by pachinko and coin droppers. Launch balls, hit pegs to fill your energy bar, unlock new characters by collecting cards, and create combos in colorful pixel art levels with custom level editing and endless replayability.

title: The Shadow of Ayutthaya
description: Betrayed all his life, Gabin seeks truth alongside Kaewsai in this brutal Souls-like Action-RPG. Wield shadows as weapons, master ancient Thai combat, and survive the fall of Ayutthaya. An authentic Thai experience by two passionate developers.

title: This Ain’t Even Poker, Ya Joker
description: A unique incremental idle clicker where you flip cards to earn money, grow your hand, buy new decks, unlock powerful upgrades, discover new cards, and more. Can you defeat the Jester and escape the carnival?

title: Fail Fail Succeed
description:
Fail Fail Succeed is a compact logic-driven puzzle platformer about turning failure into progress, inspired by the developer's struggles with cycles of manic highs and depressive lows.

You're an anonymous individual trapped inside a dream-like dimension. From somewhere a dog has appeared. She wants to guide you forward. But the path forward is full of deadly traps… and your one real ability? To fail.

Fortunately for you, there are mysterious orbs that let you leave a fragment of yourself behind. What remains will become barriers against hazards or platforms paving your way forward.

Fail and fail again, until you succeed! Persistence and clever thinking is the only way out of this place.

title: 404 Beat Crash
description: 《404 Beat Crash》 is a rhythm-driven roguelike action game that blends strategic buildcrafting, character progression, and high-speed combat — delivering a thrilling experience where every beat hits with impact.

title: Pulupu
description: It a move pieces puzzle game

title: Don´t Hang Up
description: A tense single-player horror game where your phone is your only tool. Take unsettling calls, uncover hidden clues, and survive the unknown. Every call could be your last.

title: Cardopolis
description: Cardopolis is card based city-builder, where you take on the role of Cardopolis' Mayor. Build up your city card by card, law by law, sector by sector and avoid meeting your investors' ire by reaching your goals in time!

title: Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising - Indigo Witch Beatrix
description: Contents: Unlocks the Indigo Witch costume for Beatrix for use in battle and the Figure Studio.

title: Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii - Ichiban Pirate Crew Set
description:
Add-on for Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii that adds the Hero of Yokohama, Ichiban Kasuga and his pet crawfish Nancy to your pirate crew.

The Ichiban Pirate Crew Set contains:
- Ichiban Kasuga crewmate
- Nancy supporter

title: Sen no Hatou, Tsukisome no Kouki: Hana Akari
description: This is the fandisc for Sen no Hatou, Tsukisome no Kouki. featuring after stories for all heroines. Also includes new stories for side-characters Isuzu, Chihaya, Himi no Mikoto and Sekka.

title: Hunter and Tavern
description: Hunt in the mountains during the day, manage a tavern at night, or unlock a farm to become a landlord. Form bonds with uniquely-characterized companions. Explore the mysterious Moonlit Mountain - its misty veil, elusive creatures, mystical beasts, and even the feline folk of the Cat Demon Tribe.

title: Craft. Sell. Goblin. Repeat.
description: Build and manage your own goblin shop! Craft unique weapons and negotiate their prices! Send out explorers in to gather resources and become the richest merchant in the kingdom!

title: Supermarket Cola Dash Classic
description: A 2D endless runner style game featuring Camer the Dragon.

title: Supermarket Cola Dash Deluxe!
description: A 3D endless runner style game utilising sprites featuring Camer the Dragon and Lily the Dragon.

title: Interstellar Dragon: Into the depths... of space!
description: Camer the Dragon is in a UFO in the depths of space, when suddenly a massive wave of Asteroids/Meteoroids show up! Avoid them for as long as you can!

title: Pakku Pony
description: Pakku Pony is a 2D virtual pet simulator where you raise your own pony! It’s a chill point-and-click game where you take care of your little garden, cook delicious dishes and relax with fun minigames. Oh, and don’t forget to look stylish with cosmetics and customization options!

title: Primal Dinosaur Shooter: Dino Killer
description: Primal Dinosaur Shooter: Dino Killer throws you into an era where dinosaurs once again rule the land. In a hostile environment, you are the last hope to restore balance. Armed with modern weapons and unshakable determination, you face a relentless battle against prehistoric creatures that hunt without mercy. Every step could be your last, and survival depends solely on you.

title: What is Older?
description: What is Older? is a fun, brain-teasing game where you choose which historical event, invention, or milestone happened first. From fire to smartphones, test your sense of time and chase the ultimate high score!

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: A Lightful Love
description:
Version 8.5 of Honkai Impact 3rd, which includes
• New Part 2 Story Chapter X: Reunited Under the Light of Faith
• New S Rank Valkyrie: Hi♪ Love Elf♥ (Elysia)
• New Featured Event: With You! Youthful Dreams
• ...and more!

title: Deltarune Paraphrase: Steamton Edition
description: Deltarune: PARAPHRASE is an alternate universe, where the world and the characters inhabiting it get new looks and stories based on already existing ones, but with less influence from the original while keeping their personalities true to the canon.

title: Rasetsu 2
description: Fully 3D sequel to Rasetsu.

title: Cryo
description: CRYO is a multiplayer co-op survival horror. You have been deployed by your company to various locations around the Antarctic due to communication issues. What awaits you in these dark, remote regions is far more sinister than a technical fault.s

title: The Deep Library
description: A first-person exploration horror roguelite. Explore the depths of a seemingly endless library in search of rare books, but beware of the terrifying entities that protect it!

title: Silent Hunt
description: Play as a police officer sent to a remote island in British Columbia. Investigate disappearances on Mist Island. Explore the island on foot or by car. Hide, fight and survive the threat that lurks in the forest. Protect the local population and put an end to the vicious dinosaurs !

title: SunderBound
description: SunderBound is a co-op top-down shooter with roguelite progression, set in a crumbling mega-tower. Survive floor by floor with a partner you trust, or an AI companion if you’re climbing solo. Every room’s a test. Every upgrade’s earned. And the only way out is up.

title: Little Crossroads
description: Escape the rush of your other life in this multiplayer Cozy RPG. Advance in a deep progression of skills like Fishing, Mining, and Bug Catching. Unlock cute and cool cosmetics to customize your character. Experience the "cozy chaos" of random events. All solo or with friends. Welcome home!

title: Pawsome Resort
description: Pawsome Resort is a cozy life sim with Co-op gameplay where you run an animal hotel in a charming pixel-art village. Design your resort, care for cute animals, grow crops, craft things, complete quests, and bond with villagers. With farming and RPG elements, it's a perfect cozy escape.

title: Vyun, Kosmeya, and the Witch's Curse
description: A linear visual novel that tells us about the adventures of a budding writer, Kosmeya, who needs to take his manuscript to a competition in the capital, the path to which passes through a creepy forest.

title: Jumpscare to Live
description: The game features the player taking the role of a ghost who tasks themselves with alerting the person who lives in the home they haunt with making them aware of a person outside who appears threatening. The ghost can't communicate well with the person living in their home, however, so they wind up making a mess of things and have to scare the person around the home to safety away from the threat outside at the windows.

title: Lost Wiki: Kozlovka
description: Explore a wikipedia-like database and solve a small town mystery in Eastern Europe. Step into the shoes of a journalist in the 90s as you sprawl through articles and uncover the secrets that have been laid in front of you.

title: Swarm Me
description: A minimalist horde survival arena where you can’t shoot back. You’re hunted by an endless swarm of drones - kite the horde, bait them into deadly traps, upgrade your defenses, and survive as long as you can. Every minute the swarm grows denser, faster, and deadlier.

title: Dehydration
description:
Dehydration adds thirst to Minecraft: just like food, you'll need to stay hydrated to survive and thrive.

For an easier start, use the bonus chest on world generation.

title: EnvironmentZ
description:
EnvironmentZ adds harsh environment behaviors to Minecraft so keep cool in hot and warm in cold biomes.

If the temperature gets to 0°C (32F) the player starts to freezing if not protected against the cold.

If the temperature is too hot, make sure to wear no armor or protect yourself in another way against the heat.

So for the beginning, warm up at a cozy fire place or keep calm!

title: NutritionZ
description: NutritionZ adds a nutrition system to enhance the gameplay.

title: Spelunkery
description:
Have you ever noticed how repetitive mining can be? There's only so much variation you can find before it all starts to blend together. However, with Spelunkery your woes are no more!

Spelunkery has three main goals:
To tweak material progression to enhance the experience of mining.
To populate the underground with new landmarks, points of interest, and variations on ore generation to strengthen the variety of caves.
To provide novel and useful tools to create exciting experiences when mining or exploring.
