title: Days Without Incident
description:
It has been ___ days without incident. Working off no more than an old newspaper clipping, your investigation has brought you to an old metalworks factory, abandoned after a series of mysterious deaths. The people of Ebenflow live in the shadow of this awful tragedy; they may want to forget, but you've come to find the truth of what happened to the factory and its workers. Why did they get sick? Why doesn't anyone drink the water? And what’s been growing in the quiet?

Days Without Incident is a short, never-before-seen horror experience from We Create Stuff. This lost prototype from 2017 reveals the creative roots of indie horror smash hit In Sound Mind, illustrating the studio’s growth from their Half-Life 2 modding projects of the late 2000s and early 2010s.

title: The Tooth Fae
description: A nightmarish dental simulator where you sneak into townsfolks' homes to steal their teeth. An expanded version of the Ludum Dare 58 game of the same name, made by a solo developer.

title: Maze It Out
description: Relax, and engage your brain by solving maze based puzzles!

title: RoadCraft: Aramatsu Bowhead 30T
description: Get the Aramatsu Bowhead 30T, a powerful tracked heavy dump truck, with a 360-degree rotating base, equipped with a large dumpster and caterpillar tracks and capable of pouring up to 30 tons of sand and serving as a sand refiller for other trucks.

title: RoadCraft: Rebuild Edition
description:
Get the Rebuild Edition of RoadCraft and receive the following content:
• The base game
• The Rebuild Expansion, which includes 2 maps filled with new contracts, activities, and utility vehicles
• The Invictus Type A, a powerful and unique scout vehicle, available at launch

RoadCraft – Rebuild Edition is a realistic construction and logistics simulation game where you manage a disaster recovery company tasked with rebuilding regions devastated by natural disasters. Players clear debris, repair infrastructure, and rebuild roads and bridges using over 40 vehicles, from bulldozers to cranes.

title: RoadCraft: Invictus Type A Scout
description: The Invictus Type A Scout is a rugged search and rescue truck with a military-inspired design, a powerful engine, and a stable base. Built for rough terrain, it delivers reliability and control, making it ideal for overcoming extreme in-game challenges.

title: Virago: Herstory 2
description: Willow returns in a psychological detective game where nothing is as it seems. As fear grips the town, she must face twisted truths, confront her past, and uncover dark secrets. A slow burning story of suspicion, silence, and survival.

title: W.I.M.S.
description: A first person precision platformer where you try to escape a kitchen as a little alien.

title: Virago World
description: Virago World is a cozy life sim with a dark twist. Grow and sell flowers, work at a shop, and decorate your home. Have your best friend Ollie the loyal bear who always protects you. But at night, survive stalkers hiding in the shadows.

title: Prisoner of the Ephemeral Kingdom
description: Fourteen from across the world are abruptly abducted to an isolated structure dubbed "Ephemera Manor". They are strangers, but now forced to partake in an ancient and eerie ritual—"the Feather-Burning Rite". A bloodstained drama spanning millennia has silently unfolded...

title: Kiddie Train
description: Kiddie Train is a horror game where you work the midnight maintenance shift at an indoor kiddie train ride. Stay alert to signs of danger and make it to payday!

title: The Day of Salvation
description: "The Day of Salvation" is a horror game in which players must escape from giant humanoid creatures by hiding in the fog and discovering their true identities.

title: Train Station Simulator: Together in Japan
description: Reopen and restore a Japanese rural Train Station. Repair, upgrade, and bring it back to life. Uncover the station's hidden stories and team up with friends or solo.

title: The End Protocol
description: In the fog-shrouded ruins, you will explore, gather, forge, and fight—within this dark Roguelike strategy game, cast the Dice of Fate, forge the ultimate relic, and face countless unspeakable foes. Every choice can turn the tide of battle, as you carve your own story through endless cycles of fate.

title: Fitforce2
description: Blast calories in a sci-fi arcade of over 1,000 stages! Play action, puzzle, and reflex-based mini-games powered by your real-life moves. Master 12 workout exercises, track your progress, and turn fitness into an arcade experience— just with your smartphone camera.

title: The Black Pool: Arena Survivors
description: Survive an onslaught of alien robots in this fast and intense action roguelike. Rapidly evolve your build by leveraging a huge pool of abilities, augments, and upgrades. There are millions of possibilities. Are you and your friends up to the challenge?

title: Starshield
description: While your ship battles enemies on autopilot, your mission is to keep upgrading it with strategic cards. In this experience that values brains over reflexes, the right upgrades are the key to victory!

title: Mindscorn
description: A psychological survival horror where you play as a disgraced journalist investigating the Royal Veil Hotel, where multiple people have gone missing. Desperate for one last chance to reclaim your life, you must uncover its secrets and confront your past.

title: Midnight Mazesoba
description: Midnight Mazesoba is an atmospheric horror-cooking sim where you run a cozy ramen stall, serving warm bowls of mazesoba amid creeping shadows. Upgrade your shop, get to know your customers, and uncover the fate of the other late-night food carts.

title: Brave Splat
description: Minimalist real time strategy game in a medieval setting. Mine copper, build structures, train units and defend your kingdom. Fight off invaders. Simple game play.

title: Doghouse 3
description: A short Casual Adventure game that takes place in your backyard. Pick up items, think through problems, and give your beloved pet the best home he deserves.. as soon as you can.

title: Five Mysterious Murders
description: Five teenagers went to a small Louisiana town to make a movie about a famous serial killer. What could go wrong?

title: Willow’s Descent: Into the Under
description: Experience the beautiful, hand-drawn world of the Arretai in this atmospheric precision platformer. Dive deeper into the Under and overcome unique platforming challenges in search of your missing sister.

title: Bow Hunter
description: A prehistoric pixel art top-down survival-hunting roguelike with a first person shooting mechanic, where you attempt to survive in a chain of islands, to gather resources for yourself and your family, and hunt for rare trophies.

title: Aurora Heights
description: Aurora Heights is a precision platformer and climbing game sprinkled with metroidvania. Help Hoshi, a fallen star, ascend back to the heavens. Unlock new abilities, collect keys, discover secrets, and explore mysterious landscapes where other stars have failed.

title: Snow Plowing Simulator: Ski Resort
description: Clear snowy slopes and resort roads with powerful plows in this DLC for Snow Plowing Simulator. Keep ski runs safe, resorts accessible, and winter holidays running smoothly.

title: Simulo
description: A 2D physics sandbox game where you can build and share creations. Features include a simple and intuitive interface, electricity, and modding.

title: Barfbot
description: Square off against evil rhombi in this level-based microvania bullet-filled platformer. Find secrets passageways, unlock new weapons, dodge waves of enemies all in search of your beloved pet bot. Jump, barf, die, repeat.

title: Polterparty
description: Spooky McGee invites you to the Polterparty! Polterparty is a 4 player online co-op horror game with minigames. A haunted mansion filled with deadly entities awaits, and it’s up to you and your friends to survive the night by outsmarting supernatural.

title: Bharat Police
description: Lead a police force in noir India. Manage officers, respond to emergencies, and upgrade your team. Navigate crime, corruption, and deep-rooted social tensions. Every decision has consequences.

title: Dyskairos
description: Dyskairos is an FPS with roguelike and metroidvania elements. Explore a mysterious tower while also fighting the tower itself.

title: Count Meowcula's Barbershop
description: You're Count Meowcula, a vampire cat that opened a barbershop. Wash and cut hairs, also clean your establishment and try not to bite your clients in this creepy cute game with minigames and chaotic controls. Manage your instincts and your reputation. Who said that beauty does not require sacrifices?

title: Fracturefront
description: Fracturefront is a fantasy third-person 3D action roguelike. Centered on random equipment, it delivers a variable and strategically deep combat experience. Players take on the role of a warrior who travels through rifts to stop enemies from seizing the energy core.

title: Eurekas
description: Eurekas is a real-time strategy colony sim where settlers battle a hostile, mystical island. Build, survive, use magic, and appease your gods—or risk losing everything to the wild forces that resist your claim.

title: Farmare: Ultimate Animal Survive
description: A survival roguelite RPG where you fight endless waves of enemies, gather upgrades on the fly, and grow your farm base stronger with every run.

title: Rampage
description: Want to be the first to experience all the new features and help us make the server perfect? We will be happy to invite the most interested players to test the new game build from our team.

title: Double Dragon Dodgeball
description: As the wielders of the Sosetsuken stand against evil, the curtain rises on a new legend of dodge ball...

title: Scarred Steel
description: A brutal medieval roguelite where every scar tells your story. Permanent injuries, hard choices, and bloody duels shape your path in a dying world.

title: To the Sunset
description: Yuto, a lethargic shut-in, steps out into the outside world through the “action button,” which becomes active when pressed. A 3D adventure game that lets you look into Youto's daily life while making full use of the action buttons.

title: Rush N Crash
description: Get ready for chaos with different modes that pull you into the action! Rush N Crash throws you into a world where humans and zombies clash in epic races. Hit the gas, and fight for victory!

title: Rogue Inferno
description: Rogue Inferno is a grid-based roguelike deckbuilder where every move counts. Choose your hero, build your deck, master tactical movement and powerful combos, and adapt your strategy to save your loyal dog!

title: Backrooms Stories
description: Read five horror stories set in the Backrooms. Experience existential horror and terrifying encounters while making choices that will alter your fate. Will you escape or be lost forever?

title: Succubus Memories
description: An exhilarating idle loot-based 3D infinite flow game where you adventure with beautiful waifus !

title: Big Band Survivors
description: Build your band, unlock powerful relics, and slay hordes in sync with the beat. Big Band Survivors is a rhythm-based roguelite that combines the visceral gameplay of the Survivors-like genre with musically interwoven game mechanics.

title: The Eldritch Ascent
description: "The Eldritch Ascent" Is a new grimdark fantasy narrative driven turn based game. Explore and battle your way up the twisted spire as the Eldritch, a wretched lost soul brought back from the depths by a mysterious demon.

title: Dictator Simulator: Gradnar
description: Become the Dictator of Gradnar! Rule the nation, choose between democracy and tyranny, wage wars with a unique card-based mechanic, and expand your empire. A political dystopia packed with satire and humor!

title: Solo Tactics
description: Solo Tactics is a 1 V 1 MOBA where you'll need to rapidly switch between three champions. Play as the defender or attacker in a thrilling showdown-play for free !

title: Fourth Time Around
description: Henry is an elderly man with regrets. Over the course of his life, he has killed three times. He is about to kill again.

title: Beast Survivor
description: In the jungle of the weak being preyed upon by the strong, only by continuously devouring the weak and strengthening oneself can one survive.

title: Teddy Knight
description: Step into the paws of an unlikely hero and journey through the toy chest! In Teddy Knight, a physics-based action roguelite, you play as Teddy, a brave stuffed knight on a mission to save the toy world from evil. Engage in fast-paced combat with unique “bounce” mechanics in a dark toy universe.

title: Tiny Isle
description: Tiny Isle is a cozy idle sim where you care for a magical island. Grow whimsical crops, collect sparkling crystals, and unlock fantastical new plants. Discover hidden secretsgiant fish, strange weather, island expansion, and charming residentsall at your own relaxing pace.

title: Watcher From the Void
description: You’re a night-shift nurse called to help a deaf patient after an accident. But as you explore his house, strange things happen. In Watcher from the Void, you must collect key pieces to escape while avoiding a deadly presence. Use stealth and distractions to survive the night In this horror game.

title: Herbal Haven
description: In this life-sim, you are sent by the adventurer’s guild to run a local infirmary. Explore diverse biomes to gather ingredients, nurture your herbs and concoct remedies to aid your guild. Build relationships with your neighbors and engage in community events.

title: Endless Vine
description: Crash-landed in an endless jungle, you must rescue survivors, build a steam-powered colony, and construct an escape vehicle before the wilderness claims you. Endless Vine is a steampunk survival colony builder where every decision shapes your fight for survival.

title: LightQb
description: Dash and survive in a grid-like world filled with colored light cubes, lasers, and portals, each with unique mechanics. Play, die, and repeat to master the fastest path to the finish. Time is not on your side.

title: Behind the Smile
description: Behind The Smile is a psychological horror. After a lifetime with your mom, who left her parents as a teen, you're sent to spend time with grandparents you've never met in their remote house. Use voice interaction to speak directly to them and uncover hidden truths as they respond in real-time

title: Madman's Dice
description: An RPG Maker Horror game with a focus on exploration and puzzles where the player completes stories to win a prize from a Game Master.

title: Maid of Venia
description: Embark on an action RPG adventure as the Maid of Venia, tasked with defending your homeland and uncovering the truth about the enigmatic Belt. Level up, wield powerful weapons, and unlock new abilities as you battle goblins, and the formidable Witch of the Wasteland.

title: PreStrafe
description: PreStrafe is a fast paced, high skill ceiling, competitive movement parkour game with expansive and unforeseen meta where players compete for the best times on official and community levels. Play solo, with friends, or a public lobby.

title: Vaulted Valor
description: You are in a post-apocalyptic underground vault where every decision carries weight. As you embark on quests and unravel a deep, twisting story, your actions will permanently alter the lives of your fellow inhabitants.

title: War and Politics
description: A strategy simulation that combines elements of war and politics. Take on the role of President (or Prime Minister) and govern the nation, managing government, policy, military, diplomacy, taxes. Win elections and achieve victory in war. Turn your beliefs into reality.

title: Standing Together
description: The world has fallen by zombies. As a part of the association, you are dispatched to the places where zombies are concentrated and stabilize these areas. Fill your backpack with the full of items, and eliminate zombies with the bullet hell.

title: Sleepover: Rewake
description: Sleepover: reWake is a Gay Adult/Yaoi Visual Novel featuring the story of Kano and Aki, two best friends who have drifted apart over the years. Help Kano navigate the two’s changed relationship, and create a special bond with Aki to last forever. One night is all it takes!

title: ParryMaster
description: A minimalist 2D, one-button game with individual levels and an upgrade tree about parrying enemies at the right time.

title: Falaz
description: Falaz is a 2 map MBF 21 compatible WAD for Doom 2 designed by Matt Eldrydge, with a focus on atmosphere and exploration, and survival horror inspired level design.

title: Prospice
description: Prospice blends tense driving and atmospheric horror as you haul cursed cargo across a haunted island, where the terrain hungers and every road bears the scars of the past.

title: Eulogy for Nonno
description:
It's always difficult to deliver flowers for a bereavement.

But it's even more difficult when the grieving family mistakes you for their long-lost cousin and won't let you leave "your" grandfather's wake.

title: Roman Rumble
description: WRESTLING MEETS ANCIENT GLORY! Unleash chaos in the Roman Colosseum as the crowd roars with every WHAM and SLAM!

title: Infinite Mansion
description: A Lovecraftian roguelike where every run is a new mystery. Choose your investigator, explore a procedurally generated mansion, solve evolving story puzzles, and survive tactical combat against otherworldly horrors... or become part of the madness.

title: Knock on the Occult Door
description: Bind spirits. Weigh their pain. Each client arrives by appointment haunted, broken, or dangerous. In this gothic occult visual novel, you use protective accessories, read signs, and choose bindings that alter fate. Some seek redemption. Others hide darker truths. Your rituals may awaken the dead.

title: Castle and Cursor
description: Do you like Tower Defense and also clicking the cursor? Then defend your castle with itself and with your cursor. Each castle has its own unique upgrades. Complete stages unlock different castles and upgrade your cursor skills.

title: Squared Straight
description: These puzzles look like Rubik's cubes, but the stickers slide around instead of the normal twist movement, which changes how you approach the solves. 🤔 Plus, the puzzles can be all different dimensions, and you can create and save mosaic designs in them! ️

title: Myth Guardians
description: A strategic defense game where legendary gods become towers to repel the advancing demon hordes. Place, upgrade, and merge towers to create synergies, and use tactical placement and skills to hold the line.

title: Kofoin: Swarm Defense
description: Kofoin is a real-time Tower Defense game where you command your swarm of bees, expand your territory, use powerful flowers to upgrade your defenses, and harness the power of Basque divinities to survive hordes of enemies

title: Primal Echo
description: Escape from an alien megastructure that harbors an ancient ecosystem. Climb, fight and bite your way through a retro-inspired metroidvania that fuses survival with 3D action-platformers.

title: My Retro World
description: Build the retro world of your dreams: from chill vaporwave vibes to neon retrowave skylines, from 90s suburbs to futuristic cityscapes, all in the most nostalgic sandbox...

title: Nemunai
description:
Retro survival horror inspired by Japanese folklore.
Explore a cursed village, uncover its dark truth, and face deformed creatures in direct 2D fighting-style combat.

title: Auto WWII Equips
description: A World War II equipment-themed auto battler game. Build your squad and battle against asynchronous opponents. Contains Steam Workshop, allowing you to modify game rules and create custom units.

title: 101 Cats in Seoul
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Seoul landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: The Backrooms: Rescue Expedition
description: The Backrooms: Rescue Expedition is a realistic first-person horror game up to 4 players. You and your team are tasked with saving the lives of the missing expedition unit, Echo-7 North. Ruthless entities and the madness of infinite halls create an atmosphere of relentless terror.

title: Untold Chronicles: The Harvest
description: In this field, what is harvested doesn’t sprout from the earth. Something hides among the cornfields, watching all the time. Explore and dare to see what the earth itself tries to conceal… because this time, you are part of the harvest.

title: Samurai Conqueror
description: Conquer Japanese History! A “Historical Timeline Strategy” fought on the grand timeline of Japan

title: Endless Shift
description: Endless Shift is a 1-4 player co-op horror exploration game. Trapped in a office building, you and your friends must work together to solve puzzles, evade monstrous entities, and escape before it's too late.

title: Eastern Era
description: To escape from pursuit, as the leader of your sect, guide your disciples to rise again! Engage in farming and hunting, train in martial arts, and forge weapons and armor. Build your sect's base and fortifications from the ground up to survive in this perilous, ambition-filled martial world!

title: Fireball
description: Are you ready for a breathtaking adventure in a fantastical world with "Gümüş Kafa"? A unique gaming experience awaits you with an immersive story, adrenaline-filled courses,challenging enemies, and epic bosses. Explore the fantastic world of the Fireball and uncover its mysteries with "Gümüş Kafa"!

title: Doki Doki Theo Club
description: A once in a lifetime experience with Theo. Explore a world full for ripening with the one and only Theo. Theo is all that matters. Theo is love, Theo is life.

title: Backrooms Anomaly
description: Explore a looping corridor filled with anomalies. Walk through the fluorescent-lit backrooms environment, examine your surroundings, and spot subtle changes in reality.

title: Repeater
description: REPEATER is a one-hit to kill, online arena shooter where the arenas repeat infinitely. Forward is backward. Up is down. You have been here before.

title: Wrath and Retribution
description: WRATH AND RETRIBUTION is a fast-paced space combat roguelike where you battle massive warships, collect powerful loot, and unleash devastating abilities. Pilot your groundbreaking ship alongside your onboard companion as you fight the relentless Remnants!

title: Freetown Forest
description: Come visit scenic Freetown Forest, home of the famous Profile Rock and Wampanoag reservation! And for you spooky thrill seekers come take our ghost tour and maybe feel a creepy dark presence that lurk in these dark woods. Do not feed the deer. -Massachusetts Office of Travel and Tourism.

title: Cosmo's Industry
description: Cosmo's Industry is a point-and-click, inventory-management adventure where you run an old, run-down shop that was abandoned by its previous owner. With the facilities damaged or lost entirely, it's your job and pleasure to recover as much as you can while satisfying the needs of your customers.

title: Doctor Gallagher's Residence
description: A retro-style point-and-click adventure. Step into the peculiar Gallagher Mansion to uncover its darkest secrets.

title: Heist Haven
description: Heist Haven is a 1 to 4-player co-op online shooter set in the open-world criminal paradise of Haven. Assemble your crew, select your gear and customise your character: the next big score is waiting!

title: Obelus Manor
description: Lose your mind in an ever-changing labyrinth full of spirits and paranormal forces. Uncover the secrets of an abandoned manor in this hand-drawn first person dungeon crawler.

title: Shan Hai: Mythic Origins
description: SHANHAI: Myth Origins is a MOBA-style action roguelike inspired by the Shanhaijing. Enter a mythic realm, forge divine weapons, wield the Five Elements, collect artifacts, bind spirits and capture beasts. Play solo or in up to 4-player co-op.

title: Let's Just Farm
description: You receive a mysterious letter saying that you have won a sweepstakes you didn't enter. The prize... a free parcel of land in the middle of nowhere. A farm. Thinking this could be a fresh start, you sell all of your belongings and hit the road saying to yourself "Let's Just Farm!"

title: Code of Corruption
description: open-world survival-horror, scenic exploration, puzzle solving, first-person, dark fantasy

title: Boat Together
description: Hop on kayaks and boats for a fun adventure with up to 8 friends! Work together to paddle through cool waters, overcome obstacles and bosses, and reach new islands. If the legend is true, a hidden treasure awaits on the final island. Can you make it without sinking?

title: Vibe City Islands Architect
description: The mayor has given you a budget; people need housing, jobs, parks. The city needs a tourism boost, now! It's actually a chill game.. 10 gangs, each with their own radio station. Build for the city, or for your favourite gang.......... You are the architect.

title: Tale of Android After the Apocalypse
description: Niluas, an android who suddenly activated 276 years after the extinction of humanity. With her AI, Naive, she seeks lost memories, her activation's mystery, and humanity's extinction's cause. Facing enigmatic foes and hostile androids, she quests for truth about her existence and the desolate world.

title: Yokai Goddess
description: Yokai Goddess is a mix of bullet hell and adventure, inspired by classic arcade shoot 'em ups and RPG Maker horror games. You'll have to break through relentless enemy attacks while uncovering the secrets of the Seven School Mysteries.

title: Dead Ringer
description:
It begins with a phone plugged into a faulty socket and an electric malfunction, it ends with seven dead and one missing...

Detective Maxwell is called to investigate what seems to be, by all accounts, an impossible murder. In all of his years, he has never seen a crime this gruesome perpetrated in such a puzzling way. All he has are the testimonies of three known survivors — socialite and lobbyist Meredith Eloise, her stoic butler Richard Torres, and the one surviving guest, Alexander Florence. There's also the matter of the missing person, Felix McCain, Meredith's good-for-nothing and embittered employee... He must solve the case under a deadline; if he cannot catch the culprit by dawn, the place will be swarming with reporters, ruining his client's dear reputation. And Meredith values her good name more than her own life.

What's already an impossible crime gets dialed up when Maxwell finds an unexplainable oddity: a telephone that did not belong to any of the people at the party. Perhaps it was waiting for its next owner...

title: Bob's Island
description: Fight your way across the island in this open world survival crafting game! Explore, craft, and mine in order to defeat the cursed monstrosities that inhabit the land, uncovering ancient secrets as you face off against strange creatures and challenging bosses!

title: Hebeloma
description: Explore the forest. Check for new plants and add pages to your guidebook.

title: Crawling Angels
description: Smash and thrash the mysterious Forever Chicken, a living ragdoll central to a frightful midnight carnival. Your Uncle Tontine assures "you can leave as soon as you desire" but despite their efforts no child has ever gone home... Will you be the first?

title: Mead & Glory
description: Jump, dash, throw, and smash through enemies in this action-packed 2.5D roguelite platformer! Loot up, amp up, and climb up to the top for mead and for glory!

title: Knights in a Different Spacetime
description: A Knight with a gun. Something's happened to time. Deadly robots invading. A twin-stick, action, top down shooter, with in depth gun customization, special abilities, and classic swords. Shoot your way through linear levels and secrets, and develop the ultimate guns and futuristic weapons.

title: News Company Simulator
description: Become a journalist in a dynamic newsroom where every call is a new lead. Investigate news, capture breaking stories with your camera, and expand your newspaper business in a living, breathing city. Will you chase sensational headlines or uphold journalistic integrity?

title: Door to Somewhere
description: You are Winnie, a reclusive alchemist living on the edge of a dying forest. Years ago, your mentor/older sister vanished, leaving behind cryptic clues and unfinished projects. Now, a letter from her has arrived. The door in the woods beckons, unknown horrors are here and someone must stop them.

title: XenoHaven
description: In XenoHaven, gather resources to build shelters, enslave alien beasts to work for you, and run restaurants and shops. Delve into dark underground dungeons, defeat swarming insectoids and mighty bosses, and craft powerful gear to conquer the alien world.

title: Yandere Maid: Love-Crazed Maid
description: You and the maid begin your life together. However, as the story progresses, the maid becomes more and more “yandere”. Can you escape from the “Yandere” maid and get to the truth about her? This is a slightly horror game about a cute maid.

title: Gap Year
description: Gap Year is a story-focused point & click adventure played through comic book panels that reconfigure as you explore Vera Novak’s one-bedroom apartment. Vera is a bright young scientist, but the arrival of an unexpected guest and a strange fixation with a cosmonaut may derail her academic pursuits.

title: Rosie
description: Rosie is a Choose Your Own Adventure Horror experience that takes place inside a series of pop up books.

title: Rng Arena: Fate Fight
description: Select skills, build your hero, fight other in arena and become Champion

title: Wild Roots
description: Wild Roots is a thrilling farm and cooking adventure! Grow crops, raise animals, and battle critters trying to steal your hard-earned goods. Harvest, cook up mouthwatering dishes, sell for cash, and expand your farm by clearing land. Defend, cook, and conquer—your farm’s fate is in your hands!

title: Graveyard Simulator
description: Graveyard Simulator is a simulation game focused on strategy, design, and moral choices as you transform an abandoned cemetery into a prestigious memorial site. Take on daily graveyard tasks and delve deep into humanity’s relationship with death.

title: Your Time Has Come
description: They traded everything for fame, money and power. You are the collector: build your deck, play cards, manipulate the environment and eliminate the humans. Make their time come.

title: Undead Tread
description: Mow down hordes of zombies in a high-speed vehicular roguelike! Tear through the undead with front-mounted guns, upgrade your car, and battle through procedurally generated highways, cities, and rural roads. Will you reach the cure, or become just another wreck in the apocalypse?

title: The Voynich Project
description: A choice-driven romance visual novel where every decision shapes your relationships and the story. Meet unique characters, explore multiple routes, and unlock different endings. Featuring high-quality anime-style art, an immersive soundtrack, and deep storytelling. Your journey begins now!

title: Arrow World
description: Guide the ever-moving cardboard "Hakoby" to the goal! Use infinitely placeable conveyor belts to create diverse solutions. A fresh puzzle experience that responds to Hakoby in real-time!

title: Cultivation Magic World
description: "Cultivation Magic World" is a single-player RPG blending treasure hunting, cultivation, and idle play. With various classes and physiques, you can tame spirit beasts, collect gear, and advance your realm. Log in to battle automatically and enjoy the fun of growth and collection.

title: Little Lights Remains TD
description: Protect the spark of Light in a world of looming shadows. Explore, build towers, and solve puzzles to unveil ancient secrets. Every glimmer matters in meticulously crafted, luminous realms, where Darkness lurks with fearsome foes. You are the Guardian—save the universe.

title: Cat Snap
description: Cat Snap is a cozy puzzle game where you guide a playful cat and capture delightful photos!

title: Z Evil Road
description: ★ Z-Evil Road is Advanced Tower Defense game with many mechanics, find a perfect strategy for every challenge and become master of defending base !

title: Tailor Simulator
description: Build your workshop and turn it into a fashion business. Interact with your customers and design unique collections to sell in your store. Upgrade your workshop until you rule the fashion industry.

title: Backrooms: Missing Persons
description: Many have vanished without a trace, swallowed by the endless halls of the Backrooms. Now it’s your turn to step inside. Wander through unsettling liminal spaces, guided only by the constant hum of fluorescent lights. Are you the next to disappear?

title: Ride Up
description: The steepest climb between mind and body: Ride UP. Grab your bike and ascend through a world woven with delusions. Physics-based riding, brutal tracks, and a past that refuses to be remembered await you.

title: Taste of the Sea
description: A Visual Novel dating sim about a hungry student going through a tough time until the seafood changes everything.

title: Scurry
description: Lead an army of rogue squirrels as you wreak havoc on the local golf course. Eat trash, spread disease, summon lightning, and control the minds of your enemies. Become the apex species.

title: A Superplanet Called KG
description: A Superplanet Called KG is an anthology game created by KG, containing 5 shorter I Wanna Be The Guy adventure games in the "needle" genre (very tight platforming with little focus on traps or boss fights), each with a unique set of mechanics and their own visual style and story.

title: The Flipbook
description: This game reads you. You are not alone in this Arena-Shooter-Roguelite. Even the shop is watching you. It adapts. It evolves. Build bonkers synergies and survive 20 waves of hand-painted horror in the Flipbook of a failed artist. Build your arsenal of memories to unravel his tragic past.

title: Enchanted Stories: Pawisoned Kingdom - Collector's Edition
description: Uncover secrets in Castelia! Find hidden objects, solve puzzles & stop a royal conspiracy in this enchanting feline adventure.

title: Muhe Space
description: A space strategy game. By freely editing the attributes of eight warships, engage in free combat and obtain unlimited resources to strengthen the warships. Featuring innovative combat modes, mutually restrained weapon types, and highly strategic.

title: I Have a Sect in the Mountains
description: "I Have a Sect in the Mountains" is a cultivation-themed idle simulation game. Players can choose to become a construction enthusiast, a fashion expert, or even a grand master who trains disciples to conquer the world.

title: Food Processing Simulator
description: Build and manage your own food processing factory. Automate production with machines, expand your facility, and keep inventory under control as you grow from a small workshop into a large-scale production empire.

title: Gods Deify War
description: A mythological action 3D level-clearing game based on Investiture of the Gods. Players control Fengshen heroes to traverse Shang-Zhou battlefields, use exclusive skills to fight monsters and bosses, collect resources to upgrade abilities, and unlock divine powers to continue the Fengshen legend.

title: Paper Xian
description: Paper Xian is a xianxia roguelike survival game featuring unique paper-cut art. Defend against 20 monster waves with auto-attacks, upgrade skills between rounds, and join sects for special boosts. Enjoy fast 30-min runs with local co-op support!

title: Idle Harem Dungeon
description: Upon hearing your dreams of making her yours one day, the beautiful and sadistic goddess Era comes to you with a proposal: survive and seduce her seven chosen warriors, and she will consider making your dreams a reality. Will you succeed or die, over and over again, trying?

title: Growmon Island
description: Growmon Island is a CREATURE-COLLECTION idle sandbox that lives on your desktop. Hatch eggs, care for each creature’s needs, TRAIN and EVOLVE them through Child, Teen and Adult stages. Customize island with decorations and facilities — sell or keep adults for passive bonuses.

title: Game of Dice
description: Roll the dice, rule your fate! Thrilling real-time board battles!

title: Grass Life Sim 2
description: Don't touch grass. Become grass!

title: KillCam Blablublas Battle Royale
description: You’re thrown into the chaos of urban warfare, where every corner hides danger and every mistake is fatal. With a body camera perspective, no HUD, and no second chances, survival depends on your reflexes, precision, and courage.

title: Sparky Rush: Purrils in Pawsville!
description: Sparky Rush is a lost media 3D Platformer PS1 game with elements of Psychological Horror where its developer descends into complete sorrow and madness. Play as Sparky and discover all the morbid secrets left by its creator before his sudden disappearance.

title: Detective Bloodphobia
description: Detective Bloodphobia is a black-and-white noir visual novel with point-and-click investigations and deduction gameplay.

title: Zombocalypse Now!
description: The Zombocalypse is upon us. Build up and defend your settlement from the Zombie hordes until help arrives.

title: Lac Viet Journey
description: Explore Vietnam’s rich flavors and culture as you soar with a little Lạc bird, typing dish names, unlocking upgrades, and journeying across the country.

title: Victoriam
description: GOLD, GLORY, GUTS! An auto battler roguelike where you construct your army from the finest soldiers and tear through your enemies in a never-ending war

title: Friendship Dungeon: Party Puzzler
description: Friendship Dungeon: Party Puzzler is a dungeon crawler where puzzles meet chaos! Grab your friends (up to 4-player co-op) and dive into a roguelite dungeon where every room is a unique tile-swapping puzzle packed with traps, monsters, and treasures. Will your friendships survive the dungeon?

title: Grim Pastures: Outlaws
description: Grim Pastures: Outlaws is a multiplayer social deduction game for up to 12 players. Innocents work to fulfill the farm’s orders, while killers secretly sabotage the process. In a voting situation, one player is sent to the gallows. In a farm where trust doesn’t exist, who will you believe?

title: Hexadel
description: A unique and stylish neon drenched layered tower defence puzzle game. Minimalist chill tunes, and loads of possibilities to build the Citadel (Hexadel) of your dreams. Take it easy while outsmarting the ghost in the machine ⬡⬡⬡

title: Why's It Getting Darker?!
description: Descend into the abyss in this first-person deep-sea horror. Photograph hostile creatures, balance oxygen, and survive unpredictable ambushes—all while guided by a darkly sarcastic AI.

title: The Ice Cream Shop
description: You run a late-night ice cream shop, but your illness makes reality twist. Serve customers who may not be what they seem, and try to separate your mind’s visions from the horrors at your door.

title: 10 Feet Under
description: A psychological horror walking simulator set in an endless flooded pool. Explore liminal corridors, notice subtle anomalies, and endure the growing tension as you search for an escape.

title: Nightmare Pick
description: Nightmare Pick is a simple mining combat game where you upgrade your equipment with ores to defeat monsters blocking your path and find a way to escape the nightmare.

title: Nocturnal Sun
description: Nocturnal Sun is an open-world RPG set in the mysterious and lush environment of Cozamal. You've been tasked with exploring the region and documenting available resources within the Codex provided. Cultivate the land, fish, hunt, and harvest natural resources to discover the riches of Cozamal.

title: Cat Merge
description: CatMerge is an arcade game where you grow adorable cats by merging them. It’s easy to learn but delightful to master. With its cute visuals, relaxing atmosphere, and cats full of surprises, it offers a cozy experience at every moment. Perfect for fun, peaceful, and heartwarming times!

title: The Last Portrait
description: Dark legends surround the abandoned mansion Ashwood Manor: Once, an art collector lived here, and his most valuable piece is said to still be hidden in the villa. Break into the house, solve the puzzles of Ashwood Manor, steal the cursed painting – and escape. Are you brave enough?

title: Deadland Outlaws
description: Deadland Outlaws is a merciless Western-style co-op and PVP shooter based on the book of the same name. Try to survive as an outlaw in this deadly environment. Play with your friends in co-op or tower defense mode against hordes of zombies and other nightmares.

title: Hoppin: Into the Woods
description: In Hoppin: Into the Woods, master precise dashes to navigate challenging puzzles and collect carrots. Place objects strategically, find creative routes, time your actions perfectly, and interact with curious forest creatures to solve each unique level.

title: Jester Party
description: Jester Party is a 2–6 player co-op card game. Players play their cards silently and intuitively, without following a turn order.

title: Overkill Squad
description: Join the Overkill Squad: oversized guns, absurd relic builds, brutal bosses and solving problems the only way they know how: by making them ten times worse with explosions!

title: Ronin Awakening
description: Ronin Awakening promises players a visually stunning and emotionally charged experience, as they guide Takashi through a breathtaking world steeped in Japanese folklore, facing formidable enemies and forging alliances with divine entities in a quest for redemption and survival.

title: Haunted: Village
description: In a forsaken Anatolian village steeped in impenetrable darkness, slip into a first-person view to trace the roots of a traumatic curse. Shatter the jinn ritual chain, navigate whisper-haunted corridors, and uncover the sinister secret that lurks in the shadows.

title: Tunestrike
description: TUNESTRIKE is a first-person rhythmic shooter where every shot and every enemy spawn is synchronized with the music. Arm yourself, follow the beat, and wipe out waves of robots in action-packed enclosed arenas.

title: Clover Party
description: This is an adventure game set in a fantasy world without the concept of time.

title: Fortiori
description: Fortiori is a high-stakes number multiplication roguelike where your only opponent is your own rising score. Survive rule-bending bosses and devastating curses by mastering your deck and harnessing powerful buffs.

title: Stacked!
description: A pleasant evening to relax - but not here. Get dressed, fix your hair, and strike a winning pose. Try building a tower out of your small figurines alone, or gather up to 4 players. A lucky figurine can lead to victory - or defeat.

title: Echoes of Light
description: A lone spark in a world consumed by darkness. Revive forgotten heroes, harness their power, and forge endless combinations of upgrades as you push back hordes of enemies in this atmospheric action roguelike.

title: Foes of Legacy: Survivors
description: Spring arrives in Avalon. Fensy sets out to claim her inheritance, battling relentless foes in a fast-paced 2D top-down roguelike. Quick reflexes, powerful weapons, and survival are key—fight, grow stronger, and defend your legacy in Avalon's unique world!

title: Palm Simulator 2
description: Palm Simulator 2 is a game in which you can become a palm tree.

title: Loot of Idle
description: Loot of Idle is an idle item stacking game filled with boss battles and a pixel chill atmosphere, where you fight against endless enemies and constantly improve by collecting items.

title: Age of Damnation
description: Age of Damnation — a fantasy medieval strategy with a top-down view. By day, you explore the forest and build your settlement. By night, you defend against waves of monsters born from damnation mist. Gather resources, develop your settlement, research technologies, build defenses, destroy monsters.

title: Cascade Falls
description: A story-driven visual novel about healing, heartbreak, and second chances. Build relationships, face your past, and shape your future in a town where every choice leaves a mark. Romance, drama, and emotional chaos await in Cascade Falls.

title: Veilborn
description:
Veilborn is a single-player 2D action roguelite set in a dark fantasy world.

Players explore hostile regions, battle dangerous creatures and powerful bosses, and develop their heroes across successive expeditions.

The game features multiple playable heroes, character progression, equipment preparation and a camp that serves as a base between expeditions.

Players can explore two distinct regions: the mysterious Lands of the Veil and the volcanic Crown of the Furnace, home to the Colossus of the Last Forge.

Death is part of the experience, with each fallen hero contributing to an ongoing legacy.

Veilborn was developed by BLACKSHADOW using the Godot engine and was released as a free-to-play PC game on October 14, 2026.

title: Fartcore
description: A dumb, loud third-person descent challenge with precision moves, emergency micro-boosts, instant restarts and ragdoll wipeouts. On-screen timer, respawn counter, Steam leaderboards, and Shot Mode for meme-worthy fails.

title: Liar Masks
description: Two masks guard your escape—one always lies, one sometimes lies. Question both, spot anomalies as clues, and identify the absolute liar to choose the correct door to Escape.

title: Find Your Friends
description: Master the art of deception to outwit friends & foes in this social deduction party game for 2-8 players that blends stealth, strategy, and deceit. Play online or locally through a variety of mini-games while using cunning and misdirection to locate your friends while staying hidden.

title: Echo of the DarkZone
description: A first-person shooter fantasy horror game focused on fast-paced action and fun, with an oppressive atmosphere and exploration

title: The Last Witness
description: Micheal Jillien, a Vietnamese medical graduate, accepts a job interview in the suburbs. But behind it lies a deadly plot. Can you help her survive and escape the trap?

title: Slot Heroes: Reels of Fate
description: A fantasy RPG where slot reels decide your strategy. With 243 paylines, spin the reels to unleash your heroes’ skills. Trust in luck or control the board — journey with allies and carve out your destiny!

title: Hijong Park's Defender Patrol
description: Hijong Park's Defender Patrol is a small, low-poly helicopter combat flight simulator featuring simple but fully interactable cockpit system, playable in both the monitor and Virtual-reality.

title: DriveWave
description: Every keystroke powers your car across endless neon highways, from glowing deserts to midnight forests. Collect, customize, and embark on a driving journey, all while boosting your productivity.

title: Vinnie’s Tomb: Chapter One - The Road to Vinnie’s Tomb
description: Vinnie’s Tomb: Chapter One – The Road to Vinnie’s Tomb is a surreal point-and-click adventure game released in 1997 by Reldni Productions. Players guide Vinnie, a hapless clown-like character, on a bizarre quest to locate his ancestor’s tomb, hidden somewhere within an abandoned electronics store. Mixing absurd humor, hand-drawn art, and deliberately offbeat puzzles, the game delivers a very much self-aware parody of 1990s adventure tropes. Originally distributed as a free PC title, it has since become a cult curiosity among collectors of obscure shareware and indie releases.

title: Miko-san no Miracle Board
description:
Miko-san no Miracle Board is a 3D Platformer/Snowboarding video game developed by PowerWinds and released in 2002 for Microsoft Windows.

It's a spinoff to the Tondemo Houki series of games.

title: Simple Arena Robots
description: Simple Arena Robots is a one of a kind multiplayer fighting game. It combines RPG customization features with thrilling tactical real-time combat. It redefines the genre by allowing players to fully customize their modular suits with various weapons and stats upgrades.

title: Sugar Ghouls
description:
Another year, another Halloween night Ghostkid is spending frantically searching for the best candy the neighborhood can offer. But this time around, he's finding himself empty-handed! Though his luck may not have run out yet...

Rumors are spreading fast of one particular house having the biggest, tastiest, and rarest full-size candy bar any kid has ever seen- the fabled Ghoul Bar! Unlucky for Ghostkid, the house is in another dimension... and guarded by droves of sniveling sugar snatchers who want the candy for themselves! Enter the haunted 3D realm of... the Sugar Ghouls!

title: Skellet
description:
Skellet wakes up alone, in a cruel mansion.

Explore the deep dark, see if you can wake from this nightmare.

title: Goodbye Page
description:
Page visits the house of her absent father, who has completely disappeared out of the blue. The landlord mentions that, oddly enough, his belongings were left in packaged boxes, but he himself could not be found.

However, her arrival at the house suggests that there is something even stranger about her father’s disappearance than she had expected. What could her father have been hiding? And how will all of this affect Page?

title: Late Metro Drive
description: You just ended your night shift, now you need to get home by the metro...

title: Lonely Guardian
description: Lonely Guardian is a relaxing and accessible 2D platformer where you play as a Foo Dog, a mythical creature from East Asian culture. Your sacred mission is simple: collect the Mystic Pearl, rescue a lost pup, and reach the temple gate in each level.

title: Runix: Pinball Roguelike
description: A roguelike 3D pinball game where you build your ball deck to hit and slay monsters with incredible combos and climb to the top of the leaderboard. Discover powerful artifacts that create incredible synergies and increase your mage powers to restore "The Pinball Order"

title: Hong Kong 2097
description: Hong Kong 2097 is the official sequel to Hong Kong 97, codeveloped by Kanipro and Happy Soft. Throw morality out the window and decimate an entire country in this twin stick shooter from hell.

title: V.I.P Client
description: V.I.P Client is a single player horror game. You are trapped inside of a casino, your only way out is to play the twisted games of chance where the stake is your life. Luck and skill will be required in order to survive

title: Goat Simulator 3: Baadlands: Furry Road
description: Play as Baallistic Pilgor, the antihero and survivor of the apocalypse. Roam around the Baadlands on your motorcycle, butt heads with bizarre rival factions, establish your town and harass its citizens, and try to figure out what’s behind the mysterious vault.

title: For the King: Deluxe Edition
description:
For The King is a turn based roguelike, RPG that can be played solo or cooperatively online and features strategic adventuring, turn based combat, and persistent choices. Players must survive cunning enemies and creatures, wicked weather and brutal traps in their quest to solve the mysterious death of the king and bring order to the land.

This bundle also includes the Lost Civilization Adventure Pack expansion.

title: Cruise Control
description: It's time to set sail! Manage a cruise liner fleet, build entertainment and relaxation facilities, and tend to your guests needs at every turn. Work fast to solve problems, earn rewards, and ensure smooth sailing! Are you ready to turn on Cruise Control?

title: Alteratio
description: Immerse yourself in this first-person horror game filled with psychological scares, intricate puzzles, and gripping mysteries. With an atmospheric design that keeps you on edge, the game blends exploration, story-driven moments, and unexpected jump scares to keep players engaged. As the terror intensifies, you must not only confront the creature chasing you, but also your own deepest fears. In this harrowing journey of self-discovery, every decision will be crucial to your survival.

title: Cult of the Dragon
description: Cult of the Dragon takes place in a fantasy world that is currently experiencing peace. But the imprisonment of the player character is just the beginning of a change, as evil begins to creep from the shadows of the realm, and into the light. The player has the choice of 10 different characters from 10 different classes. The classes are Hero, Warrior, Mage, Priest, Paladin, Thief, Archer, Warlock, Monk, and Samurai. Each class has it's own unique set of weapons, along with special skills and magical spells. This means each class will play different, and each time playing is a new experience. You can play as a Witch or Wizard. Or you can play as a Samurai. The choice is yours.

title: Lily's Lil Barn Yard!
description: The old Lily Flash Games are being recompiled for modern systems! In Lily's Lil Barn Yard, help Summer restore her family farm! Clean the farm, and deliver the goods! Now with 3D minigames and all new Less Looping Technology! Help Lily become the best farmer she can be!

title: Farming & Defense: Farmfence
description: Supermarket Simulator meets Farming Simulator—with zombies. Build your store, grow crops, and survive nightly undead attacks in this fast-paced farming defence game. Harvest, sell, and fight to keep your business and farm alive.

title: Crime Scene Clean: Paranormal
description: Crime Scene Clean is about Sector 7 hides the supernatural from the world. You’re their cleaner—erasing cursed symbols, demonic traces, and forbidden rituals. No fame, no questions. Just silence, speed and survival. Clean haunted scenes, contain threats, and bury the truth before it spreads.

title: Dynasty Protocol
description: Command your space fleet, mine asteroids, and conquer colonies in this immersive real-time strategy game. Build powerful space stations, upgrade your ships through combat experience, and manage vital resources as you expand your dynasty across a star system.

title: Lost Sanity: Cthulhu
description:
Lost Sanity: Cthulhu is a horror and exploration game where each chapter is a new story.

A group of teenagers get together to tell horror stories, and each story is represented as a chapter of "Lost Sanity."
Starting with the tale of "Cthulhu," a cosmic entity that lies dormant in their city submerged in the sea, occultists gather with the goal of awakening the entity.

You play as Megan Claire, a former reporter, who wakes up in a prison-like place. Your goal is to understand what is happening there and escape as quickly as possible!

title: Dear Poe
description:
You have received a mysterious email! After the death of an underworld citizen caused by a strange letter, Poe and Arthur are called in to investigate the case and prevent further tragedies. But what appears to be a simple crime soon reveals something much bigger, involving wandering demons and a much more complex dark plot.

Dear Poe is a spin-off of Dark Light, set 6 months before the main events of the game.

title: Bellochia: Love Powered by Gears
description: Find your first love in the kingdom of Bellochia, use your skills to talk with our 4 main protagonists, invite them to dates and live a school life in a day-by-day gameplay.

title: Robot-LE
description: A point-and-click adventure game based on a story where humanity is about to die soon, because of the sun exploding and taking everything with it. Humanities attempt to save their species, working with the most talented scientists in the world to build a sophisticated AI robot to enter space, find habitual planets, and then return with data to prove the existence of another exoplanet. So, they come up with Robot-LE.

title: B.O.D.E.
description: From the creators of Devil's Drizzle, B.O.D.E. is a pixel art metroidvania lite shooter with a satanic theme (and a healthy dose of blasphemy). Use your shotgun to move around and annihilate everything in your path. Destroy hell in search of revenge!

title: The Never Ending Flower Shop
description: The Never Ending Flower Shop is a game focused on exploration, you will fight your way through the lost Floricultura Consuelo, a place that once thrived in the ownership of your mother, now forgotten, exactly as she left it.

title: Futurama: Hit & Run
description:
Good news, everyone!

This mod transforms the suburbs of Springfield into the futuristic cityscapes of New New York, along with new missions and areas to explore.

title: Lembre-se em Cedida
description: Emerge in the lives of three different inhabitants of a small town as they are caught between self discovery, destruction and rebirth of themselves and where they step on.

title: Dig Out
description: With a dark and minimalist aesthetic, the title blends action and elements of "puzzle combat," pitting the protagonist, an abstract representation of human emotion, against enemies that personify their own inner "demons."

title: Talentos Indie ZNT
description: A bundle featuring all games of Talentos Indie ZNT, from ZNT Productions.

title: Miller's Fantasy: Party - Deluxe Update
description: An upcoming major update to Miller's Fantasy: Party, which revamps the gameplay, visuals and a new storyline.

title: Protocol: Umbra
description: Protocol: Umbra is an unsettling, observation-driven psychological horror game inspired by I’m on Observation Duty and FNaF, built in Python with Pygame-CE and powered by my own UI framework, Tessella.

title: Toada Brava
description: You’ve got busted! Save your mom and escape from Santacrúz Dungeon alongside a ragtag team of heroes in this hand-drawn JRPG.

title: Small Claims
description: Step into the shoes of an employee at North River, one of today's largest artificial intelligence startups, in this narrative choice-based game. But be careful: your choices can have small consequences.

title: Lofi Mahjong
description: Dive into a calm, cozy world with Lofi Mahjong. Enjoy classic Mahjong Solitaire enhanced by a lofi soundscape for maximum focus and minimum stress.

title: New Folder
description: You log on to a computer having no clue of what lies within. Explore its files, solve puzzles to recover missing pieces, and decipher passwords to enter otherwise prohibited folders. As you delve deeper into its content, you’ll find that there is a greater mystery to be solved.

title: Night of the Ritual
description: After a party at a TV presenter home, Sara finds herself trapped in an unknown place. Furthermore, her life is in constant danger, due to a killer stalking her. Survive and investigate on this short horror game.

title: Coloring Pixels: Halloween 7
description:
This Halloween-themed book unlocks 20 additional levels for Coloring Pixels! Halloween is back for round 7 of pixel art, even more spooktacular than before!

Dive into this annual-themed book...if you dare!

title: Benjumpin Hopkins
description: A challenging high-stakes physics based precision platformer. You take a role of Benji The Frog, who likes to jump, has a goal to climb up to the top of this infamous magical well, where a princess might be waiting. A single missed jump can lead to a long fall back down, but Benji never gives up.

title: Pone
description: A co-op survival horror game where you and your closest friends must work together to survive in an upside down world crawling with the infected.

title: Miller's Fantasy: Party
description: Visit the city's most famous park and uncover dark secrets as you fight to survive. Find items and tools to escape locations, make choices to discover different perspectives, and decide your fate.

title: My Furry Dragon
description: Oh no, the kingdom is preparing for war, and the princess has been captured by the Terrifying Dragon. Now you must travel through the Dreadful Forest to find the princess and fight the evil dragon. But what if the Dragon is not evil at all?..

title: The Birthday Boys
description: An absurd co-op dungeon crawler where the only thing more dangerous than the enemies is your own party.

title: Your Friend Wiggles
description: In this terrifying walking simulator, you will meet those virtual pets you once forgot in a drawer, and who now seek revenge, in an atmosphere full of mystery and secrets waiting to be uncovered.

title: Alice at the End of Her Life
description: A mysterious disease plagues a world where death shouldn't exist. Fight the nightmares tormenting Wonderland in this 2D turn based RPG inspired by the work of Lewis Carroll. Live forever, dear Alice.

title: Hypnosync
description: RHYTHM x HYPNOSIS. You are forced into being the manager of the brand new music game arcade, HYPNOSYNC! With your newfound hypnosis ability, hypnotize customers to the beat and turn them into your very own mindless employees!

title: Inky's Sleep
description: A haunting yet enchanting 2D horror-adventure with surreal touches, led by an endearing little cat Inky. Explore dark dreams, unravel uncanny puzzles, and evade otherworldly creatures.

title: Holy Night
description: Holy Night is a bloodthirsty action-adventure metroidvania set in a haunted space cruise traveling to Mars. Explore, rescue, and survive, upgrading your unique combat skills and weapons. Kill hordes of vampires and monsters that stand between you and your family to celebrate Christmas on time.

title: High Stakes: Hot Nights
description: The protagonist, a loser in life, challenges the last gamble to win [money and women] in exchange for a lifetime of coal mine slavery.Babel only deals with one game, the 'JANKEN' game, the world's fairest and most perfect balance!

title: SecreD: Foot Art
description: Solve sliding puzzle. Relax with anime-girls. Try to pass puzzles. SecreD is a sliding puzzle game. Moves are limited. You must finish the level before you run out of moves. But it still a relaxing game.

title: Her Last Piece
description: A choice-based dark gothic romance Visual Novel... Trapped alone in her castle, can you survive a dark yandere queen's schemes? Or will you fall for her charms? Remember... She lies.

title: Dungeon Holdem
description: Dungeon Holdem is the poker dungeon crawler deckbuilder. Forge your path as a warrior or wizard, unlocking powerful abilities to boost your hands. Master combos, stack hands, upgrade your deck, and slay monsters in this epic poker RPG.

title: Nightholme
description: Team up or strike out alone to hunt an eldritch Gloomfiend in a city crawling with horrors. Channel corruption and transform into a monstrous Grimspawn for devastating bursts of power. But beware. Madness is patient, and you look delicious. Survive the run. Take the prize. No one leaves unchanged.

title: Izumo 2
description:
Yagi Takeru is a student who goes to Izumo Academy. He has no family but he spends his days with his friends like Yamato Takeshi who is his bestfriend aswell as his rival in kendo, Shiratori Kotono and her sister, Asuka.

One day, an abrupt earthquake changed the school completely. The teachers and the students disappeared and the school was infested with monsters. Takeru managed to escape from the school, but he found all his friends and even his town were gone. Then suddently people wearing odd uniforms appeared.

title: Timeater
description: Timeater is a 2D pixel art scrolling game with roguelike elements and a narrative focused on bending the time of the game to our will with a bilinear progression that will be spiced up with some gameplay/narrative secrets inherent in time itself.

title: Meteor World Actor: Gaslight Bullet
description: The third and final part of the Meteor World Actor series.

title: Blightveil
description: Blightveil is an Action-MOBA with WASD movement and non-targeting combat. Enter a brutal world where the genre takes a fresh twist. Battle in arenas where two teams of four clash for one goal: destroy the enemy relic and become champions.

title: Habitat: Race to Mars
description: The corporate space race begins! An Adventure/Survival/Farming game where you need to manage resources while exploring the planet and interacting with ancient alien artifacts in order to change the climate, survive the seasonal elements, evade enemies and stack up on Doge to conquer a new world.

title: Blackout Tonight
description: A side-scrolling puzzle adventure where a power outage hits an apartment building during a stormy night. Play as an amateur detective, visit diverse residents, uncover secrets, solve puzzles, and restore power before midnight... Stop rummaging through those useless trash cans!

title: Crimson Devotion
description: Crimson Devotion is a short visual novel created for the Stained Red; A Yandere Game Jam.

title: Paper.Void
description:
Navigate an infinite monochrome dimension where many mysteries are yet to be discovered. You are merely a paper plane, flying through space as you collect VOID Cubes which further distort the world around you...

The VOID may be infinite, but as you progress further, it becomes increasingly challenging to navigate as you leave behind a permanent deadly trail of light. Your sense of scale, gravity, and depth do not exist here.

When reality reaches its END, can you survive your own self-made labyrinth? Or will your journey lead to an inevitable PAPER CUT...

title: Heartstop Tour
description: Heartstop Tour is a free-to-play visual novel developed by Comfort Kuma Studios, originally submitted to Otome Jam 2025 and later expanded with additional content.

title: Frankenstein's Monster
description: Compete to build the perfect monster. Then unleash it to hunt your rival scientists. - In roguelite single-player, or social hangout multiplayer.

title: Bluey's Quest for the Gold Pen
description: Join Bluey on a fun-filled quest for the Gold Pen in an original story by Bluey creator, Joe Brumm. A joyful experience for the whole family.

title: Axe Me Why
description: Survive 15-minute runs with 3D movement & uneven terrain in the Spirit Realm. Fight, forage & adapt while defending your village’s fading spirit. The stories of your people unfolding with your actions, new religions, good neighbors, spirit-tech punks & serial killers all rely on you to see tomorrow.

title: Home Paige
description: Home Paige is a momentum-based 3D platformer set inside a 90s Operating System. You play as Paige, a silly, optimistic girl from your computer!

title: Lawn Mowing Simulator 2
description: Head to the USA and grow your own business with a realistic and relaxing lawn mowing experience! With brand new grass tech and reworked systems based on player feedback to the original, plus licensed equipment from around the world.

title: Butler Guillotine
description: Flesh filled puppets in a mishapen hotel. No windows, no exterior. Follow different characters' intertiwining paths and unearth forgotten events from a time long gone. Bring the ceremony to a halt.

title: Unconventional Fantasy
description: This game combines the gameplay of text adventure and card battles. You will play as an office worker who travels to another world, selecting cards to build your own deck. Random choice events provide you with various effects. Will you save everything, destroy everything, or do nothing at all?

title: God Help Us All
description: God Help Us All is a fixed-camera survival horror game that merges the suffocating dread of classic horror with the brutal grit of the Wild West.

title: Dingir OS
description: Congratulations, you've found Dingir OS — an operating system that lets you glimpse into the darkest corners of the internet. Browse forbidden websites, investigate lethal files, and immerse yourself in the world of digital legends. (We are not responsible for anything that may happen to you.)

title: Your Forever Friend
description: Your Forever Friend is the solution to never feeling alone again! Play video games, listen to music together, reminisce about buried memories... And there's absolutely nothing wrong with it. NOTHING ! <3

title: The Nobody Woods: Lucy
description: The Nobody Woods: Lucy is an adventure game set in Nobody Woods, a place on the border between life and death. Escape from those who want to take Lucy's life, explore the forest, solve puzzles, and meet new friends.

title: The Hambagu Shop
description: The Hambagu Shop is a cozy horror narrative simulator where you work in a Japanese Hamburg Steak Shop. Cook Hamburg, serve customers, and upgrade your shop for more menu items.

title: Crathos Deep
description: Descend down the arctic depths in Crathos Deep, a cosmic horror narrative adventure. Explore the vast abyss with your submarine and utilize your expeditionary drone to reach the dark corners of the ocean. Investigate a lost research institute to unravel the unsettling mystery of its downfall.

title: Ancible Online
description: A 2D MMORPG set in the world of Veridia where players craft, fight, trade, and explore alongside other players.

title: Paranormal Activity: Threshold
description: Pierce the veil Play multiple timelines, communicate with entities, end the nightmare.

title: Fallout 4: Anniversary Edition
description: The base game, six official add-ons, and over 150 pieces of Creation Club content get bundled together in one neat package in celebration of Fallout 4’s 10th anniversary.

title: Skinwalker: First Blood
description: Skinwalker is a hack n’ slash action platformer where you swear allegiance to a formidable beast to save your daughter from a terminal illness. Shapeshift into the creature’s monstrous form and wield untamed wrath in exchange for its freedom and the promise of a cure.

title: Ham Ham Hamsters
description: A hamster pet and breeding simulation game for PC

title: Fallout 76: Burning Springs
description: A new region of the map is opening for those with enough grit to cross Point Pleasant bridge. It's time for you to travel westward towards Burning Springs. Taking place in rural Ohio, this is our largest map expansion to Fallout 76 yet!

title: Dumb Ways to Party
description: The worlds dumbest party game is here! Play as your favorite Bean, and go head-to-head with up to three other players to become the Dumbest of the Dumb. Will you use skill, sabotage or sheer dumb luck to win?

title: Cultivation Story: Infinite Sword Realm
description: Cultivation Story: Infinite Sword Realm is an action-packed roguelike deckbuilder rooted in Cultivation and Chinese mythology, where every action costs you lifespan. Enter the realm of Swords, balance power and mortality as you climb the path to immortality.

title: A Week at Polar's Buffet
description:
You are the brand new nightguard of Polar's Artic Frenzy Buffet. After the previous one retired from the position. You will spend your whole first week in this nearly run down place, make sure nothing gets in, and nothing gets out.

Though, the animatronic mascots' programming is starting to get a bit faulty, if you get hurt, will it be by the errors in the code, or the ghosts of the hidden past?

This game has a 2.5D artstyle, with 3d environments and 2d characters. The building is 3D Modelled, the props are 3D and 2D, and the characters are 2D.

title: Project Tal
description: An open-world action Korean mythology RPG. Players will explore a detailed and in-depth world across a single-player adventure inspired by ancient folklore that reimagines Korea’s traditional Tal masks. Engage with an array of threats from massive monsters to formidable swordsmen, making use of enemy weak points, counterattacks, unique abilities, and more.

title: Kuiper Roulette
description: Kuiper Roulette is a strategic turn-based card game with fun and cute space themes ranging from cool card designs to silly space animations. Your objective is to be last one standing, using items, boosting items, stealing items, and trading items with the diverse mechanics given to you.

title: Racoon Escape 2: Warehouse Storage
description: A Chubby Raccoon named Popo is trapped in a warehouse storage. Help Popo escape from the warehouse.

title: Post Apocalypse Microbe Lab
description: Leave the game on and watch Lyse work in a post-apocalyptic world on the corner of your desktop. Her job is to collect microbe samples; your job is to lend a hand when you can.

title: Pay at the Pump
description: A lonely night shift at a remote gas station turns into a nightmare. Strange customers arrive, unease grows, and the line between reality and hallucination begins to blur.

title: Brainshell
description:
Did you ever wonder what it would be like to become an Intercontinental Ballistic Missile?

BRAINSHELL is a psychological horror experience focusing on immersion, storytelling and audiovisual torment.

title: Arthur's Kindergarten
description: Arthur's Kindergarten is the perfect combination of learning, fun, and helpful features. With 15 different educational activities, Arthur's Kindergarten teaches a full year's worth of kindergarten skills and entertains your child with limitless fun and learning!

title: Deadlivery Night
description: Deadlivery Night mixes a frenetic arcade gameplay with survival horror elements. Explore the city of Santa Monica while completing deliveries, escape the killer, meet colorful characters and unravel the truth in a world of conspiracies!

title: Gensou Yumegokochi Illusion: Dreamlike
description: Free the Yōkai captured by the Supreme Leader!

title: Expeditions: A MudRunner Game - Season 4: Amber Dusk
description: Complete your off-road journey in the Tatras, and help unveil the wilds' last great mysteries. Traverse idyllic valleys transformed by recent floods, venture deep underground, and discover remnants of ages past - from majestic basalt columns to ancient ziggurats.

title: Hunter x Hunter: Nen x Impact - Additional Character 2 Phinks
description: This add-on unlocks the playable character "Phinks."

title: Hunter x Hunter: Nen x Impact - Additional Character 3 Shizuku
description: This add-on unlocks the playable character "Shizuku."

title: Hunter x Hunter: Nen x Impact - Additional Character 4 Zeno
description: This add-on unlocks the playable character "Zeno."

title: Shinobi: Art of Vengeance - Sega Villains Stage
description: Battle legendary SEGA Villains; Majima, the mad dog of Shimano; Dr. Eggman, the evil genius from the Sonic the Hedgehog series; and Death Adder, the ruthless giant from Golden Axe. Explore 5 new stages, unleash 3 new ninpos, plus new music tracks, new skins, and a new Boss Rush mode.

title: Super Robot Wars Y: DLC 1 - Contract from the Darkness
description:
Super Robot Wars Y features a number of units and pilots from a variety of robot anime, and the first DLC introduces three exciting crossover titles:

- Galaxy Cyclone Braiger
- The Big O
- Fuuto PI: The Portrait of Kamen Rider Skull

Players will gain access to new area missions and additional playable units inspired by these series, expanding the strategic depth and fan-favorite roster of the game.

title: Super Robot Wars Y: DLC 2 - Awakening of a Soul
description:
DLC 2 includes the following content:
• 5 Playable Units*
- Kotetsu Jeeg
- Getter Noir 1
- Getter Noir G
- Da-Garn X
- Great Da-Garn GX

title: Vagrus: The Riven Realms - At the Heart of Ruin
description: Vagruss region expansion, At the Heart of Ruin, adds a dense area fraught with conflict and rich with opportunities. Brave the forsaken paths of this broken realm to be challenged not only by new foes and villains, but also by the very nature one must traverse the mountainous terrain.

title: Daemon x Machina: Titanic Scion - Into the Abyss
description: Expand your adventure with never-before-seen bosses, a new map area, and new equipment!

title: Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero - Super Limit-Breaking Neo
description:
Super Limit-Breaking Neo has come to Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero
Adding new Playable Characters, new Customization, new Stages, and Solo Mode!
Experience the Super Limit-Breaking battle!

Adding about 30 characters including those joining the Budokai Tenkaichi series for the first time such as Super 17, Bardock, Super Saiyan, and Champa and Vegeta (GT)!

title: Dragon Quest VII Reimagined: Jam-Packed Swag Bag
description:
A set of items that can be used in DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined.

An assortment of items to assist your adventure!
Set forth on your journey with these helpful items!

[Contents]
・Slime Sword x1
・Slime Boomerang x1
・Slime Stick x1
・Metal Slime Heart (Grants experience boost) x1
・Gold Golem Heart (Grants gold boost) x1
・Medicinal Herb x9
・Single Phial x3
・Seed of Strength x1
・Seed of Resilience x1
・Seed of Life x1

title: Little Nightmares III: The Backstage
description: Low and Alone are torn apart. To find his friend, Low ventures into The Backstage. There lies The Puppeteer hunting the living canvas for her next masterpiece. With her Torch Hat, Dime is the only one who can guide Low through these depths.

title: Little Nightmares III: Klonoa Costumes Set
description: Bring nostalgia and darkness together with these costumes. A tribute to the beloved classic, reimagined with a creepy twist for your journey through the Spiral.

title: Little Nightmares III: Nomes Costumes Set
description: Transform your character with this eerie yet endearing look inspired by the mysterious Nomes of the Little Nightmares universe.

title: Little Nightmares III: The Shores
description: Low and Alone, reunited, traveled through the mirror. Without Dime, it's once again just the two of them. The filthy stones, the fishy smell, the damp wind, there is no doubt they have reached The Shores. The overwhelming fog is regularly pierced by the lighthouse beacon. From up there, they will find their way. Low’s map says so. It must be true.

title: Dragon Quest VII Reimagined: Luminary's Livery
description:
Dress up as the characters from DRAGON QUEST XI: Echoes of an Elusive Age with this costume set!
Put these outfits on from time to time for a nice change of pace!

[Contents]
・Luminary's Livery (Appearance changing costume for your Hero)
・Spiky Sidekick's Costume (Appearance changing costume for Kiefer)
・Red Sisterly Smock (Appearance changing costume for Maribel)
・Green Sisterly Smock (Appearance change costume for Maribel)
・Fully Fabulous Finery (Appearance change costume for Ruff)
・Warrior Princess Wardrobe (Appearance change costume for Aishe)
・Auld Rogue's Outfit (Appearance change costume for Sir Mervyn)

title: Dragon Quest VII Reimagined: The Road of Regal Wretches
description:
Challenge legendary demon kings from the DRAGON QUEST series’ Erdrick Trilogy in the Battle Arena! Defeat them to earn valuable rewards, including “Erdrick’s Sword”!

[Monsters you can fight in The Road of Regal Wretches]
・The Original Demon
・Master of Destruction
・The Lord of Darkness

title: Yakuza Kiwami 3 & Dark Ties: Legendary Lads & Gals Set
description:
This pack contains extra members for the Ryukyu Gal Gang.

This pack includes:
Legendary Lads set
- Daigo Dojima
- Goro Majima
- Taiga Saejima
- Ono Michio

Legendary Gals set
- Kaoru Sayama
- Saeko Mukoda
- Seonhee
- Chitose Fujinomiya

title: Drunkonauts
