description: Drunkonauts is a chaotic multiplayer party game with hilarious physics-based combat, crazy weapons and JETPACKS! Battle friends in local or online matches, use unpredictable movement and wacky attacks to send opponents flying, stay on the map, avoid dangerous hazards and claim victory!

title: Cat and Isle of Stars
description: Cat and Isle of Stars is a cozy sim adventure on a mysterious cat-inhabited island. Run a cat café, enjoy island life, and bond with locals, as whispers of an ancient mystery and an outsider threat reveal secrets from the island’s past.

title: Tiny Terrors
description: Tiny Terrors is a casual 2D action game with a top-down view where you control a tiny ghost and collect candy. On Halloween night, a lonely ghost child encounters a mysterious jack-o'-lantern bucket... A short story presented entirely in hand-drawn animation. Two endings.

title: Sunset Moon
description: You've just arrived on the island of Sunset Moon, tasked with looking after your sick grandpa and his farm. Will you be able to stay on track and fulfill your responsibilities, or will the temptations of this Mini Open World Game pull you in other directions?

title: Blossoming Ruins
description: Reclaim your land in this cozy idle kingdom simulator that quietly grows at the bottom of your screen as you go about your day. With 'The Great War' behind you, lead your villagers into an era of peace and prosperity, cultivating crops and rebuilding from the ruins.

title: Refate: Echoes of Desire
description: Wake up with amnesia in Tokyo, caught between the Yakuza and police. Romance 8 unique beauties: cop, ninja, boss, izakaya owner, heiress, college girl, teacher, model. Uncover your true identity—host, agent, assassin, or crime lord? Shape your destiny and find true love.

title: The Night Crawler
description:
The Night Crawler is a tiny cozy game where you’ll discover the enchanting world of nocturnal insects! Grab your torchlight and embark on a delightful journey to create a new home for tiny, fascinating creatures.

Relax by collecting, caring for your creatures, follow quests to earn rewards, upgrade your gears and adjust the gameplay for a tailor experience. But keep your eyes open as you never know what mysterious species you might stumble upon...

title: Witch's Brew: Love and Lattes
description: Will you spill the tea about the secret, cozy magical cafe on your college campus? Brew potions and romance on coffee dates with your new friends! A text-based novel of magic and romance, with hundreds of choices and without graphics or sound effects.

title: God Forsaken
description: The God - Forsaken Land is a roguelike survival adventure game that combines the features of Diablo. In this abandoned land of despair, you fend off endless monsters, light a fire in the darkness, and search for that faint glimmer of hope.

title: Path of Exile: Keepers of the Flame
description: In Path of Exile: Keepers of the Flame you will continue the story of Breach, an iconic league from Path of Exile's past, and assist a mysterious monastic order in defending Wraeclast from the Breachlords.

title: Disguiser
description: This is a game about disguise. Players are split into two teams—Red and Blue—and must blend into groups of NPCs. To stay hidden, everyone has to act like the NPCs while trying to figure out who the enemy players are and take them out.

title: Open Robot
description: Third-person shooter action adventure about robots. Explore, drive cars, talk to other characters and fight your enemies to survive and complete the quest-driven story mode, or fight your way through the survivor mode!

title: Five More Minutes
description: Build your deck and strategize to defeat foes as you traverse videogame worlds. Choose between 3 unique starting genres, and combine them to create unstoppable combos! Five more minutes is a love letter to growing up with the emotional support of our best friend: videogames.

title: Duckoleon
description: Experience (mildly) accurate historical battles from the Napoleonic era, but from the perspective of DUCKS! Duckoleon is a multiplayer FPS with strategic elements. Exciting combat with units ranging from line infantry to cavalry and artillery, historical uniforms, cutie ducks and much more!

title: Assslash!
description: Everyone, "This isn't just a fight." Get ready for the spectacular sight of adorable cute girls pushing each other off vibrant, flashy 3D stages using their 'Ultimate Butt Push' techniques. Download now and show off your 'Ultimate ASSS Power!' (Don't forget to time your moves just right.)

title: Star Wars: The Old Republic - Enter the Fight
description: Begin your journey with this 30-day subscription bundle, including 1050 Cartel Coins and an exclusive S15 Scout mount! Rideable at level 1, this mount helps you to zoom around the galaxy as you choose your path from Origin Story to the Legacy of the Sith expansion.

title: Zaetherfall
description: Precision bullet-hell shmup with dual-element weapons, two tight-window shields, reactive in-mission dialogue and multi-phase bosses. Lead three rival aces united against the theocracy of Zael Aether.

title: Slumber Party
description: A 4 player co-op horror game about a Slumber Party, where you and three friends are pulled into shared nightmares, each one a new level to survive. Work together to complete objectives and make it through the night.

title: Irezumi Defenders
description: Irezumi Defenders is a tower defense game where you craft your units in a world inspired by Japanese mythology. Stack cards to craft buildings, gather resources, and build up your defenses to protect your kingdom from Yokai!

title: Monster Prom 3: Monster Roadtrip - Playable Character Jacqueline
description:
Ever feel like leaving your small town and seeing what’s out there? Then Jacqueline might be the Playable Character for you… as long as you don’t mind getting your hands dirty!

Jacqueline’s folksy farmer vibes will let you enjoy nature to its fullest as you go on a wild ride with Polly and Scott.

Play as Jacqueline in her journey far beyond the reaches of her small farm. This pumpkin is no bumpkin, and she’s ready to see the world!

Throw out your old Jack-o’-lantern and get ready to put petal to the metal with Jacqueline!

title: Death in the Manor
description: Death in the Manor is a casual isometric point and click murder mystery game. You have 1 hour to discover the killer and weapon before the police arrives. Every game is procedurally generated: rooms change place, suspects are never the same, and there are 22 potential murder weapons.

title: Dupery: A Game of Solo Deduction
description: A terrible syndicate has infiltrated society, explore cases, listen to what the citizens have to say, and use that information to route out the good from the evil in this roguelike 'clock-like' deduction game. Can you uncover the head of the syndicate? Or will you be duped like the rest?

title: Halo: Campaign Evolved
description: Halo: Campaign Evolved is a faithful yet modernized remake of Halo: Combat Evolved’s campaign. Experience the original story rebuilt with high-definition visuals, updated cinematics, and refined controls, plus three brand-new prequel missions featuring the Master Chief and Sgt. Johnson. A broader arsenal of weapons, vehicles, enemies, and gameplay-modifying “Skulls” – optional modifiers that change combat in fun and challenging ways – add fresh tactics and endless replayability.

title: YogLabs: Testing Initiative
description: A unique puzzle-adventure set in the secret YogLabs research facility. As a newly created clone, you’ll face a series of challenges while disaster threatens to consume the laboratory.

title: Once Upon a Katamari: Katamari Damacy Series Songs - Side B
description: This pack contains 34 additional BGM tracks and 8 costume pieces from previous Katamari series titles.

title: Once Upon a Katamari: Katamari Damacy Series Songs - Side A
description: This pack contains 26 additional BGM tracks and 18 costume pieces from previous Katamari series titles.

title: Vampire Hunter: Nightrise
description: You came to hunt a vampire. Instead, you're trapped in his sprawling Gothic castle. You must hold on to your dwindling faith and dismantle his defenses before Nightrise — or become his prey in this single, story-driven experience.

title: 8AM: The Warehouse
description: "8AM: The Warehouse" is a suspense game set in a massive distribution center late at night. Monitor security cameras as strange incidents occur among the remaining workers — and decide if it’s exhaustion, system error, or something lurking between the shelves until 8:00 a.m.

title: Bible Trivia: Alchemy
description: Combine the elements of Creation and reveal the stories of the Bible! In Bible Trivia – Alchemy, each new fusion unlocks biblical characters, objects, and events. Experience the joy of discovering the sacred world — one element at a time.

title: The Finals: The Chirurgeon Set
description: The Chirurgeon Set includes: 1 Legendary Outfit, 1 Epic Emote, 1 Legendary Weapon Skin, 1 Epic Charm, 2 400 Multibucks.

title: The Finals: The Apothecarion Set
description: The Apothecarion Set includes: 1 Legendary Outfit, 1 Epic Emote, 1 Legendary Weapon Skin, 1 Epic Charm, 2 400 Multibucks.

title: UvsU: You vs. You
description: Outsmart your past self in a battle of cause and effect. Explore an interconnected clay world, discover its hidden rules, and uncover the secrets it would rather keep buried.

title: Bushido Kensei: The Last Warrior
description: Busido Kensei The Last Warrior a Roguelike Action RPG. Hack & Slash with a Looting system.

title: Honkai: Star Rail - As Tomorrow Became Yesterday
description:
Version 3.7 of Honkai: Star Rail, which includes:
• New character: Cyrene
• New Trailblaze Mission: "As Tomorrow Became Yesterday"
• New areas: Great Tomb of the Nameless Titan and Ruins of Time
• New game mode: Currency Wars
• New events
• ...and more!

title: Uncharted Sectors
description: A grand strategy game built on a deep economic simulation and orchestrated by an intelligent AI storyteller. Ensure the survival of your domain at the edge of the galaxy: colonize worlds, manage populations, navigate politics, design custom goods, and master dynamic markets.

title: Lancer Tactics
description: The iconic Lancer TTRPG, adapted to digital. Craft your Lancer from over 500 unique abilities and make your mark on the fight for Union's utopia. Play story-driven narrative campaigns, get right to battle in Instant Action, or build your own combats and campaigns with built-in sandbox editor tools.

title: VortX
description:
VortX is a casual arcade style game featuring a black hole, a space ship and asteroids.

The gameplay is simple but challenging: Evade from the asteroids as long as you can while the singularity prevents you from actually escaping the scene. Collect and use your PowerUps wisely.

The game starts quite easy but it quickly gets harder over time. Can you survive more than 5 minutes?

title: Sex Game: Naughty Couple - Episode 5
description: A simple SEX SIMULATION game with VISUAL NOVEL elements, featuring HD GRAPHICS and juicy ANIMATIONS. Damien and Lora head for a relaxing day in the sauna. Things get hot as soon as they enter, and an empty sauna is too tempting not to have sex in it.

title: Sex Game: Threesome - Episode 4
description: Enjoy an erotic visual novel featuring a guys and his 2 hot girl friends, and an engaging sex simulator. A day out on the ocean on a yacht, and it's inviting privacy and luxury, quickly turns into some exciting sex.

title: Sex Game: Naughty Girls - Episode 5
description: Enjoy an erotic visual novel featuring two hot women and an engaging sex simulator. Juliette and Natalie go out shopping for some sexy lingerie. They start fooling around in the empty store, which eventually leads to sex.

title: Sex Game: Naughty Girls - Episode 6
description: Enjoy an erotic visual novel featuring two hot women and an engaging sex simulator. Juliette and Natalie go for their daily workout at the gym. The quiet and empty gym is too inviting and they give into the their temptations and have sex in front of the massive mirror on the wall.

title: Sex Game: Naughty Couple - Episode 6
description: A simple SEX SIMULATION game with VISUAL NOVEL elements, featuring HD GRAPHICS and juicy ANIMATIONS. Damien and Lora take a private jet to an exotic location. A long flight becomes more pleasant once the two of them start fooling around and decide to join the mile high club by engaging in sex.

title: One Night of Romance With My Waifu
description: "Deep in the stillness of the night, the wind drums against the bamboos. Who will pity my lonely figure, facing the empty bed?" Sir, this lonely beauty is eagerly awaiting you, her delicate body craving your comfort.

title: Field of Screams
description: Field of Screams is a first-person horror game where you respond to an assault at a haunted corn maze. Navigate the maze, hunt down suspects, and think before you shoot—hesitation could kill you, but firing too fast could cost innocent lives.

title: Battlefield 6 Season 1
description: Season 1 rolls out in three phases with new hardware, gadgets, maps, and monthly drops for Portal. Blackwell Fields spans besieged facilities and homesteads under a burning horizon, supporting all combat sizes with land and air. Eastwood turns a quiet villa and golf retreat into a frontline, with land vehicles and helicopters in play.

title: Lizard Brain
description: Lizard Brain is a game that challenges your memory and puzzle solving skills. Navigate a lethal maze by remembering the correct path before the deadly traps become invisible. As you progress, choose from a variety of challenges that increase the difficulty in chaotic or puzzling ways.

title: Waking Nightmares
description: Waking Nightmares is a top-down survival horror game where you're a detective, the last inhabitant of a ghost town, or at least, that's as far as you remember... Everyone is gone, and yet you can't seem to remember anyone... The case is open. Your objective: Find out what happened to everyone.

title: Dwarven Rampart
description: Dwarven Rampart is a Fantasy strategy game where you build your Dwarven town, raise massive armies, and choose your enemies to fight against. How long can you survive?

title: ESMO: Esports Manager Online
description: Watch every match play out live as you run a persistent esports club across a MOBA, a Tactical Shooter, and Car Soccer. Scout and develop players, work a live transfer market, and climb from Iron to Elite against real managers worldwide, with cross-play across PC, iOS, and Android.

title: Bewitching Sinners Royal Blood
description:
On your death bed, a handsome man with a fat ass whisked you away to a magical faraway land. The catch? Revive a dead God by masquerading as a vampire Duke/Duchess/Duchum about to get hitched for peace on the order of your tyrannical cousin.

Endure awkward sexual-tension with charming princes, sexy witches, and feet-obsessed mermaids, all while dodging your cousin's unpredictable mood swings!

title: You and I, at the End of That Summer
description: Having lost the meaning of life, Shionagi meets Ayana, who suffers from a certain illness. “Kidnap me from this boring everyday life.” He wishes to die. A girl promised death. A bittersweet summer kidnapping drama where they confront each other's “lives.”

title: Once Upon a Child - Full Stop
description: A cute and short visual novel about the power of words

title: Watamari Part2: A Fake Marriage?
description: This is a yuri game where you as an angel of love must help guide the heroines. Do your best, little angel (you) and take care of your mistress's wellbeing!

title: An Easter to Remember
description: You're trapped in your school during a lockdown and being hunted by a chainsaw-wielding maniac in an Easter Bunny suit. Get ready to experience an unforgettable Easter…

title: Ultimate Fishing Simulator 2: Delaware Bay
description: Delaware Bay is a coastal estuary between New Jersey and Delaware, home to a wide variety of saltwater fish. Anglers can catch flathead grey mullet, battle mid-sized fighters like striped bass and black drum, or take on ocean predators such as Atlantic blue marlin! A true saltwater challenge!

title: Euro Truck Simulator 2: Isle of Ireland
description: Get ready to explore the Emerald Isle - a land of stunning natural beauty, rich history, and vibrant culture. This map expansion takes you across Ireland and Northern Ireland, offering a diverse and immersive driving journey through rolling green landscapes, scenic coastal roads, and dynamic cities.

title: Blightfell
description: Choose your house, build a unique deck, and summon powerful minions to claim victory in Blightfell, a card-battler full of tight decision-making and strategic depth.

title: Tale of Exorcists
description: Lac Viet Adventures: Tales of Exorcist is a fictitious Vietnam world, during Ly Dynasty with the infestation of vicious demon monsters. Play as a skilled exorcist against chaotic evil to fight your way through the brutal world, and experience unforeseen entanglements of complex beings.

title: Divine Gambit
description: Defy the Gods and protect your Village in a 3rd person action and tower defense hybrid. Use the days to build your defenses and the nights to repel the Executors trying to lay waste to your Home. Endure the wrath of Gods solo or with friends in a unique mix of strategic planning and frantic action.

title: Welcome to the Game III
description: Navigate the internet's dark net, searching for pieces of a puzzle that once combined will clear your outstanding debt. Scan strange websites for info, hack into PCs while defending your own, and buy/sell goods & services, all while avoiding threats in this strategic, suspenseful horror game.

title: Isophoria
description: A narrative RPG set in a surreal cyberpunk world. Be a good neighbor or a sly opportunist. Play retro mini games to complete niche gigs. Hack your nervous system with dubious technology and navigate the strange side effects. Find your way through somehow, just don't get lost in the back alleys.

title: Oeuf
description: 3D physics-platformer where you are an egg! Roll, hop and slide your way back home.

title: Oblivium
description: Oblivium is a fast-paced, violent spellcasting action roguelike featuring elemental reactions where you battle through the nine circles of hell.

title: The Silent Cartographer: Evolved
description: A reimagining of the fourth level of Halo: Combat Evolved with a visual overhaul, a complete redesign of the layout & weapon sets, and expanded set pieces.

title: Discover The World
description: Sylvie enters yet another world in this turn-based RPG platformer. Collect items, fight battles, and destroy the tyrant.

title: Hallowed Legends: Samhain
description: Celtic folklore seems to be more truth than lore when the Samhain festival goers disappear! Find the missing people and save the day in this exciting Adventure game! Battle the gods of yore to restore the seasons and repair time in Hallowed Legends: Samhain. Depart on a fantastic adventure and learn the secrets behind an ancient Gaelic festival!

title: Feed The Flames
description: A shadowed forest looms, its hostile residents bound to an ancient evil that is rising again. You bear the heavy burden of an age-old ritual—to keep the demon at bay. Keep the sacred flame burning until dawn, or risk the fate of both yourself and the world.

title: Il Suo Volto Era Una Maschera Di Sangue
description:
Silent Hill but it's an italian giallo.

During the celebrations of an old folk festival a man is found dead inside the village’s church. All the inhabitants have something to hide.

Explore the mysterious town of Montechiuso, the background of paranormal phenomena and mysterious murders.

title: Hajimemashite Boku no Kanojo
description:
"Do you remember me?"

After coming home from work, I spotted a young woman sitting at my door.
I don't recall ever having known her.

title: Mrs. Estacion
description: Mrs. Estacion is a bullet hell shooter inspired by the Touhou Project series.

title: Diemi
description: Diemi is an adventure RPG made by Segawa. It has turn based battles, multiple endings and a good quantity of optional content.

title: X-1
description: X-1 is a short adventure game about pandemic fatigue, days that all run together in a studio apartment, and how to activate noclip in real life.

title: Kimi ni Shinzou wo Agetai
description:
When I was done and had lost all hope, an android girl, U, had come into my life.
"I do not understand how you feel. Because... I do not have a heart."
While talking to U and getting to know her, I've come to understand myself as well...

title: Boku dake ga Shitteiru
description:
After a long hospital stay, Akira was worried about a female college student, "Misaki", who was a fellow patient. It seems that she has promised to meet a man whom she became close to on SNS...

This visual novel is something of a fandisc for "Kimi no Nisemono ni Koi wo Suru", "Test Gaeshi", "Kimi ni Shinzou wo Agetai" and "Hajimemashite Boku no Kanojo" from the same developer, and as such it contains spoilers and bonus after stories for characters from those games.

title: Gorgon's Garden
description: Gorgon's Garden is a love letter to old forum culture and the generally more earnest and amateur tone of older creepypastas. It's a bit of horror, a bit of humor, all contained within a virtual desktop you can toy around with. Change your cursor, download weird images to set as your background, pick through bizarre forums with a colorful cast of characters, and explore an MMO that seems curiously devoid of any other players...

title: Sekai Seifuku Kanojo
description:
Yukito is waken up every morning by his cute childhood friend Yumeko. Normally one would feel blessed to be in such a situation, but she’s actually a mad scientist who wants to take over the world! She would even create a robot just for this purpose, scaring the heads of state around the world to surrender without a fight.

All he wished for is to live a peaceful life until graduation. Then he saw her at a press conference on TV declaring that she will be taking over the world before the end of the year. In the commotion that follows, another girl named Ako transfers into the school to stop her. Will Yumeko be stopped by New Year’s Eve or will his dream of a peaceful life vanish forever?

title: The Wapple Hous
description:
When Death grows weary of their whole soul capturing gig, they turn to Zoe, the next in line to take up the mantle as the grim reaper.

Zoe has quite a long way to go before they're even close to Death material, and current Death has grown rather impatient.

In an attempt to speed things along, Death sends Zoe out on their first solo run... Tasked with capturing and escorting a freshly deceased soul into the afterlife. Are they up to the task? Probably not...

title: World Wide Love!: Sekai Seifuku Kanojo Fandisc
description: This is the fandisc to Sekai Seifuku Kanojo. Contains after stories for all 5 original heroines and will include a route for Yoshiko who was a sub-character in the original game.

title: Snug
description: Snug is a cozy game about packing bags just the way you like. Stack, sort, and squeeze everyday objects into oddly shaped spaces with physics, jiggling, and the satisfaction of fitting things neatly into place.

title: Riruka ha Ikue ni Yoru wo Irodoru
description:
"I have other personalities," the girl said on the night they first met.

Her gaze was serious as she looked at Shiraishi Naoya - the self-proclaimed detective - who responded by lighting a cigarette with a skeptical expression. At first, he didn't believe her. How could multiple personalities truly exist within a single body?

There was the overly familiar and cheeky Nanase, with a penchant for overt physical intimacy.
The prudish but naive Senri, who gets easily flustered.
The calm and collected Kanna, who always keeps her composure.
And the one who Naoya met first - the pure and honest Riruka, who has a streak of shyness.

They met on a rainy night, and by a twist of fate, Naoya found himself bringing the "girls" home.

She is a girl who carries multiple souls within her, and each personality holds a wish of her own - desires so powerful that they gave birth to new selves.

When all of their wishes are finally fulfilled... what awaits at the end?

title: Seifuku Kanojo 2: Free DLC Act.1 - Yahiro Mio
description: The first free DLC out of four for Seifuku Kanojo 2, focused on Mio.

title: Sinisomnia
description: Sinisomnia is a psychological point-and-click horror game that traps you in a looping nightmare of uncertainty and dread. Scattered fragments, unsettling oddities, and the constant sense that something isn’t right await at every turn.

title: Vampolitics: Vassals of the Void
description: You have inherited a graveyard, Sovereign. Yet through logistics, diplomacy, and the art of war, the space-vampire age can rise again under your banner.

title: Bunny Garden 2
description: A brand new title in the Bunny Garden series, a romance adventure game where you can deepen your relationships with a unique cast of girls while visiting the gentleman’s sanctuary “Bunny Garden”. In addition to the return of familiar characters such as Kana, Rin, and Miuka, Erisa will newly join the cast. Furthermore, new characters are also planned to appear, promising an even more intimate experience than the previous title.

title: Hallowed Legends: Samhain - Collector's Edition
description:
This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won’t find in the standard version.

The Collector’s Edition includes:
- Bonus gameplay
- Integrated Strategy Guide
- Stunning soundtrack
- Concept art

title: Gabyouden
description:
Humanity advances into space, builds new civilizations and attracts attention of aliens.
Girl Eko suddenly speaks to girl Kinu and announces that aliens start to invade the planet, but to oppose them girls need to perform a synchronized special attack to target limited wavelength. Will life on the planet persist in the end?

title: Touhou Meisuishu: Resurrection of Heaven's Liquor
description: Touhou Meisuishu: Resurrection of Heaven's Liquor is a Touhou Project fangame.

title: Where the Roots grow
description: When a young woman moves out to the countryside to start anew on a farm, what she finds is not what she expected!

title: Upshift StrikeRacer
description: Upshift Strikeracer is an online combat racing game where players battle at high speeds using armed vehicles. Combining intense car racing with explosive weapon-based combat, the game features fast-paced action, customizable cars, and thrilling multiplayer modes where victory depends on both driving skill and firepower.

title: Moulder
description: Moulder is a fast-paced hack-and-slash game with a focus on boss fights. Master your weapons and command an army of loyal maggots to overwhelm prey much larger than you.

title: QLewds
description: QLewds is a 3 vs 3 online multiplayer clash in a large 2D arena. The game aims to bridge aspects of MOBAs, Metroidvanias, 2D Platformers, and Brawlers into a novel gaming experience.

title: Oath: There is a You That Remains
description: DLC expansion to vai5000's game oath, a companion to her 2025 album.

title: Emerald
description:
It's been so long since you've last been with her, seen her... Something inside of you eats at you. The world around you is bleak and dark, but the thought of meeting her once again keeps you going.

Follow the short linear story as you fight with your own mind, your fears and worries taken form, as you search for the part of yourself you've lost.

This short adventure serves as a companion piece to vai5000 and maji*'s 2025 track of the same name, emerald, and expands on the story of the song. It builds on vai5000's prior release of oath, acting as a smaller self contained experience in the same vein.

title: Zuìhòu de Xiūxiānzhě
description: A simple and playable placing game where you can hang up and place and wait for a reward.

title: Liú Yǐn
description: f you like the game that pursues the details to explore the way to play, the game with high degree of freedom in the open world, the game that goes out of one's own plot line at will.

title: Tales of Isenberg
description: Tales of Isenberg is a medieval fantasy-style, Hungarian-voiced 2D platformer that blends action and skill. The hero, Alrik, journeys to the frozen castle of Isenberg to face the forces of darkness. Dangerous foes and unexpected twists await you!

title: Lucha Align
description:
Get ready for the most exciting fight of your life in Lucha Align, the puzzle game where every piece is a luchador ready for action! Your mission is clear: fit the champions and completely fill the ring to claim victory in style.

With 40 levels full of action, each match brings new shapes, new challenges, and even more excitement. From the first training sessions to the ultimate battles, you’ll need strategy, quick thinking, and the spirit of a champion to master every grid and earn the special stars.

title: Science Skaters
description: Join Max, Jin, Lia and Zev in this fun adventure and skate around thanks to their customizable nano-skates, solve science puzzles adapted to different ages. Explore, learn and fight to save the future of humanity!

title: Huànxiǎng Xiū Zhēn
description: A text-based casual idle cultivation game.

title: Zhèn Xié
description:
“Zhen Xie” is a single-player Taoist-themed adventure game inspired by traditional Chinese folklore.
Players take on the role of a disciple of the Daoist sect, sent to a mysterious village to uncover the secrets of their own origins—only to become entangled in a grand conspiracy.

Explore ancient tombs, hunt for lost treasures, exorcise spirits, perform rituals, draw talismans, and refine corpses… an unprecedented clash between humans and ghosts unfolds, as sinister forces and restless souls intertwine in endless struggle.

A destiny bound for twenty years—yet one lifelong wish remains unfulfilled.

title: Xīn Suǒ Xiàngwǎng de Běijíxīng
description: A text adventure game that combines the elements of beauty, suspense and love. A visual novel game, the player takes the role of the main character in the story and uses options to advance the story to different endings.

title: Fēngshén Ràng Wǒ Lái
description: “Who decides the will of heaven? Why can’t one defy fate and walk against the heavens?”

title: Zhōngguó Shì Fùháo
description:
Developed by a two-person indie team, “Zhong Guo Shi Fu Hao” (Chinese Tycoon) is a 3D city-based simulation game centered around economics and modern life.
Experience a wide range of gameplay features including stock trading, car driving, shooting, city exploration, and the collection of money and story texts.

You can engage in real-time stock market fluctuations, buying and selling your way to sudden wealth; gather scattered banknotes around the city to trigger unique events and discover hidden narratives; or simply enjoy the sights of towns, beaches, and forests as you live the life of a modern tycoon.

title: Scorched Sun
description: Scorched Sun is a short experience that combines top down survival horror with turn based combat. As a new initiate, delve into the depths of a monastery of the Scorched Sun order and discover the secrets within.

title: Tactichord: Glam Strategy
description: A mashup of turn-based tactics and music games. Rock on turning foes into fans while making lyrical and audio choices during battle to create your own glam metal anthems. Experience a homage to 1990s ensemble dramedies, choosing when to embrace angst or empathy.

title: Seifuku Kanojo 2: Free DLC Act.2 - Momojiri Serika
description: The second free DLC out of four for Seifuku Kanojo 2, focused on Serika.

title: Seifuku Kanojo 2: Free DLC Act.3 - Tamayori Himari
description: The third free DLC out of four for Seifuku Kanojo 2, focused on Himari.

title: Seifuku Kanojo 2: Free DLC Act.4 - Konomi Yui
description: The fourth and final free DLC for Seifuku Kanojo 2, focused on Yui.

title: Defiant Ascent
description:
In this post-apocalyptic survival game, you wake up deep inside a bunker devastated by catastrophe. The rooms are shrouded in darkness, resources are scarce, and the horrors lurking behind every door won't give you a break.

Explore the bunker room by room in a procedurally generated world where every run is different. Scavenge supplies, find or craft improvised weapons, and face off against enemies in a turn-based combat system where every decision could mean the difference between life and death.

title: The Sims 4: Autumn Apparel Kit
description: Breathe in that crisp autumn air, watch the leaves change color, and reach for something warm from The Sims 4 Autumn Apparel Kit†. This collection features layered looks plus accessories, like scarves and a wide-brimmed hat that are perfect for strolling down chilly streets, as well as snuggly sweaters that’ll make the season feel extra cozy.

title: Anchor
description: Anchor is a large-scale underwater multiplayer survival game. Build your base, craft tools and weapons, explore, loot and prepare for battle. Every player is a potential threat in a persistent world where bases can be raided, alliances broken, and the ocean itself hunts you.

title: Rift Miner
description: Rift Miner is a 3D voxel roguelite: mine resources against the clock, escape through the portal, and invest your haul in permanent upgrades. Unlock Echo Cards for powerful synergies. Brave the high-risk Deeper Rifts for even greater rewards.

title: The Last Phoenix
description: The Last Phoenix is a roguelite inspired action platformer RPG where death fuels your power. You grow stronger with every death. Felix, a goblin who possesses a demonic power of reincarnation, must save his kind from eradication at the hands of a cult!

title: Forbidden Terror: Board Game
description: A psychological horror game where you take the role of Jonah, an 18 year old trying out a new board game, The Ouija Board, with his friend Emily. Little did they know, it was far from a simple board game.

title: Origens: Story Mode 2
description: A 3D third-person plot-focused adventure game, and the sequel to Origens: Story Mode.

title: 100 Chernobyl Cats
description: Find 100 hidden cats in hand-drawn Chernobyl and Pripyat scenes! Explore mysterious locations with atmospheric music. Spot them all if you can

title: Descent Of Lunaris
description: Investigate a signal emanating from deep within the moon and fight through a dark reflection of human nature. Are you being tested, or punished for the actions of humanity? Descent of Lunaris is a classic dungeon-crawling turn-based RPG inspired by Wizardry and Shin Megami Tensei.

title: Pih
description: Pih is a really simple game that you can play on PC or VR. Complete each level by collecting all the food , without being killed by the enemy pigs. The game has 64 levels and 4 bosses. Ragdoll physics, platforms and good music. No story, no loading screens, no cutscenes, just gameplay.

title: HowlKraul
description: A fast-paced pixel dungeon crawler focused on score chasing. Break furniture, slay enemies, and grab as many coins as you can in rooms that constantly change colors and foes. Play alone or with a friend and settle the score with end-of-run stats.

title: El 39
description: "El 39" is a horror game set in the Buenos Aires neighborhood of Constitución in the early hours of the morning.

title: The Secret Planet
description: The Secret Planet is a 2D adventure game styled after the classic games of the 90s. Your ship has crash-landed on an unknown planet. In order to survive, you'll need to explore and use your own skills and wits. After all- No one knows about this planet, and no one knows what awaits you on this journey.

title: Antonym Obscure
description: Antonym Obscure is a free indie boys-love visual novel, made for Yaoijam 2025.

title: Ashes of the Damned: The Forgotten Ward
description: Trapped in a looping asylum, stalked by something in the dark. Explore, uncover hidden truths, and survive in this first-person psychological horror.

title: Shrouded Depths
description: Stranded in the fog of the murky waters on an isolated ferry with nothing but your harpoon gun, you feel the overwhelming presence of something within the misty mangrove. Your vessel is stopped dead and it is up to you with the assistance of the Captain to get the boat back up and running again.

title: Releaseburg
description:
The purge is over. The nightmare begins.
Every bullet counts. Every mistake kills.
Welcome to Releaseburg.

title: How to Train Your Cock
description: A chill idle game that sits in your screen while you do other tasks. Watch your cock train and grow, decorate his island, and buy him some stylish hats. Is your cock the biggest among your friends? Now it can be!

title: Loulan: The Cursed Sand
description: Set in a historical fantasy theme against the backdrop of the ancient Silk Road in the Western China Regions, it tells the poignant love story of an exiled royal guard who returns to the ancient kingdom of Loulan in a turbulent era of warfare and seeks his beloved princess.

title: Dwarf Fortress: Siege Update
description:
New enemy weapons: Battering rams, trolls can now carry giant pickaxes and blocks for building

New enemy behaviours: Enemy behaviour is now classified into different roles (charge, hang back, ambush) and can path around dangerous areas. Engineers can build floors and stairs. Enemies can break through fortifications and raised bridges. They can also dig underground through natural walls. Goblins also bring more kinds of mounts and their demonic leader

New weapon: Bolt thrower. This is a siege engine with a fixed location but can be turned freely in any direction. It fires faster than a crossbow and the ammo bin can hold 100 bolts. Siege operator skill matters but unskilled operators can use it more effectively than they use hand-held weapons.

Reworked weapons: Ballistas and catapults are more effective

Changes to traps: Goblins can rescue caged allies. Water and magma traps will not be as effective as before, so you’ll have to try a variety of defensive tools instead of relying just on one, to properly protect your forts.

title: We Only Come Out at Night
description: A JRPG/Metroidvania hybrid that will have you traversing traps and puzzles with classic, turn-based combat. Learn new abilities to unlock new areas, and learn new spells to crush your enemies! Emotional, cute, and fun for all ages and all players, with a great soundtrack to boot!

title: Road to Karatl
description: On the road to the sacred shrine of Karatl, lost souls entrust you with their stories. In this contemplative Visual Novel, listen to their truths and perhaps, at the journey's end, you will discover your own.

title: Katana Hime
description: A short game about simple command-based Katana Slashes... and saving a cat.

title: Mourningwood Lodge 2: Hidden Voice
description: Mourningwood Lodge 2: Hidden Voice is a horror FMV mystery game. As the second installment in the "Mourningwood Lodge" series and a prequel to the original title, it introduces an entirely new storyline where players assume the role of a fresh character embarking on an intensely terrifying journey.

title: Underway Remastered
description: This remastering of moral-testing adventure/puzzle RPG "Underway" will give you chills in places you didn't know you could get them! With a deep and intriguing story to boot, you'll have a great time getting lost in the world and story!

title: Grenzgänger: Aus der DDR in den Westen
description: Grenzgänger is a serious game about three intertwined lives in the German Democratic Republic. Play as Assel, Michael and Hanna living under the constant surveillance of the state trying to fight back or flee into the West in this free point&click adventure. (currently only available in German)

title: Cherokee Numbers Maze
description:
This is a simple platformer game to assist with learning the Cherokee numbers.
You wander around in a maze and collect dice together that match the challenge given, then explode them.
After you have completed all the challenges for a level you move on to the next larger level with more numbers to learn.

title: Siam
description: You tried to quit your job but your company didn't let you. In order to motivate you to keep working, you were assigned a virtual assistant named SIAM.

title: Peripheral
description: A first-person psychological horror game where you must return seven books to their shelves in a deserted library while being hunted by statue-like entities that only move when unobserved. Survive using observation and strategy in this tense 20-30 minute experience.

title: Simogo Legacy Collection
description: From cute arcade novelties to innovative text-based thrillers and acclaimed fourth wall-breaking stories, Simogo Legacy Collection is an eclectic celebration of Simogo's past, featuring faithful renditions of seven games released on mobile platforms between 2010 and 2015.

title: Shutter Evidence
description: Shutter Evidence is an action-packed experience where you explore active crime scenes by flying a drone, photographing evidence to uncover secrets.

title: Blues Brothers 2025
description: Blues Brothers 2025 is a 23 map megawad by Ravendesk and General Roasterock that takes you on a calcium-rich journey down the deepest depths of a collapsing society and below. Explore a bustling Escher civilization that hides a world under its skin, discover the balance of this slice of life and reach the full potential of chaos and carnage therein.

title: Homunculus Meat
description: Horror games have a creepy atmosphere and sudden scares, so many people don't like them. Have you ever wanted to try a horror game but couldn't because you were too scared? This game is designed with maximum consideration for people who don't like horror games.

title: Dark History
description: This is a 2D action game with only boss rush. Choose from 36 playable characters and win the boss rush of 36 battles!

title: The Corgi Knight
description: The Corgi Knight is about a corgi who starts out as a simple apple-picker, in a simple corgi town. No one expects much greatness from this little corgi, but when danger strikes, he finds himself in the midst of an epic adventure to save not only his village, but much, much more.

title: Halloween: Trick or Treat 3 Collectors Edition
description: A family friendly Hidden Object Game for Halloween

title: Dami and Secret Library
description: A healing 3D adventure featuring color-absorb puzzles, emotional cutscenes, and exploration across 50 handcrafted levels. Join Dami on her journey through the Secret Library to reunite with her mother.

title: Wowo Island
description: A alpaca arrives at a place called Wowo Island and begins a leisurely and happy adventure. You can level up and there are many magical weapons and monsters on the island. Start your adventure now.

title: Psychopomp 2
description: The beautiful world of Psychopomp returns. Ascend into a brand new nightmare. A Dog told you the world will end in three days. Travel across strange landscapes, discover bizarre secrets, and meet unthinkable creatures. Something gnaws at your memory. Will you remember before it is too late?

title: The Vernyhorn
description: A third-person open-world RPG inspired by classic role-playing roots. Follow a man haunted by his past as he faces his inner demons in a world shaped by faith, fear, and survival — where every choice leaves a mark that time cannot erase.

title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as an Autonomous Robotic Vacuum Cleaner
description: A short humor/horror game where you play as an autonomous robotic vacuum cleaner trying to clean a haunted house.

title: Sex Game: BDSM - Episode 2
description: Immerse yourself in an erotic visual novel that explores the bond between a submissive and her Master, paired with an interactive sex simulator. Veronica and her master continue to explore deeper BDSM fantasies.

title: Darkwood II
description: Roam freely around the scorched deserts of a dying sea as you secure resources and explore the mysteries of Darkwood. But beware nightfall – seek shelter, shore up your defenses, and pray for the morning light as the horrors of the world hunt the ill-prepared.

title: Puppergeist
description:
Play as Claire, a witch who journeys into the mysterious Doggie Underworld with one simple goal: Finding her lost Pup!

As you travel through Doggie Underworld, you'll encounter countless souls, each with a story to tell. Share moments with them, play together, and listen to their heartfelt tales. Use your sense of rhythm to lift their spirits and ease their troubles, bringing you one beat closer to reuniting with your own lost Pup.

title: Ungodly
description: UnGodly is a dark fantasy RPG where visceral real-time combat meets collectible hero strategy. Build your roster, chain elemental powers through seamless team swapping, and forge bonds that unlock devastating synergies in a world on the edge of ruin.

title: Asvara
description: Asvara is a psychological horror game where the entity reacts to the way you play — how fast you move, how long you hesitate, and what you choose to interact with.

title: Hentai Night Club
description: Hentai Night Club - You have passed face control and beautiful women are waiting for you and want to dance.

title: Vampire Survivors: Ante Chamber
description: Prepare for a different kind of Stake as the Jokers run wild in Vampire Survivors: Ante Chamber.

title: Vampire Survivors: 1.14
description: A 5-part update for Vampire Survivors: Online Co-op mode, new stages Westwoods and Mazerella, new content for Ode of Castlevania DLC, new characters and weapons, Party Mode and the launch of new DLC Ante Chamber, a crossover with Balatro.

title: Yakuza 20th Anniversary Edition
description: The Yakuza 20th Anniversary Edition bundles three foundational entries in SEGA's crime drama series: Yakuza 0, a prequel set in 1980s Japan following the origin stories of Kiryu Kazuma and Majima Goro; Yakuza Kiwami, a modern remake of the original game where Kiryu investigates the theft of 10 billion yen in Tokyo's Kamurocho district; and Yakuza Kiwami 2, which continues Kiryu's saga as he mediates a brewing war between Tokyo and Osaka's criminal organizations. All three games feature beat-em-up combat, detailed city exploration, and various side activities within a narrative focused on honor, loyalty, and power in Japan's criminal underworld.

title: Yuuki Yuuna ha Yuusha de Aru A
description: Released with the Yuusha no Shou anime's Blu-ray box. Contains 10 short scenarios: 3 set post-Yuusha no Shou and 7 set around episode 1.

title: Bao Bao's Cozy Cleaning Services
description: Relax with Bao Bao in this cozy 2D pressure washing sim. Clean pastel environments, chill lo-fi beats, and no stress, just peaceful vibes. Play solo or with up to 3 friends. A peaceful pressure washing game for quiet minds and cozy days.

title: The Mine Room
description: A first person twist on the classic game of Minesweeper. It's dark, all you have is a torch and a burning desire to flag all those pesky mines without falling in the goo or getting blown up.

title: Balltopia
description: Balltopia is a roguelike marble racing simulator where your only objective is to make more money. Featuring dozens of unique levels and over 50 game-altering cards, the potential to win is almost limitless - but be careful! Place an errant bet, and you could lose it all.

title: A World of Keflings: The Curse of the Zombiesaurus
description: Put a horde of Spooklings to work gathering bones, brimstone and slug shampoo in this macabre night-time land! Horrifying creations await you as you build your creepy kingdom and work out how to deal with the largest, most horrifying creation of all... the Zombiesaurus!

title: Fights in Tight Spaces: Frights in Tight Spaces
description: A mysterious and lethal cult obsessed with summoning otherworldly beings and worshipping forgotten gods. They've taken up residence in a haunted manor house and kidnapped the Ambassador, there to sacrifice him and give living form to an unspeakable evil. There's no telling what horrors await.

title: Veilborne Sacrament
description: Veilborne Sacrament is an immersive psychological horror experience centered around atmosphere, puzzles, and emotional tension.

title: Allele: Origin
description:
A Dark Fantasy Romance VN Otome/BL
An ongoing plague has pushed humanity to the brink of extinction. Born from mankind's desperation to survive, monsters evolved.

title: Don't Sleep: Hard Mode
description: Try to survive, it's hard...

title: Esper X Guide
description:
Tactical Card RPG x Otome /BL VN x Social Sim

The world needs the spiritually gifted espers to fight off monsterous aberrations with their explosive powers.

Espers need guides to purify their spirits from corrosive effects of using their abilities and return them to a state of equilibrium.

Guides need... a steady payout while pressed by the weight of corporatism where people are graded and discarded like commodities.

Welcome to guideverse

title: Dungeon Tourists
description: Explore procedurally generated dungeons with up to 4 players. Take photos of the curiosities you come across. Throw stuff at them, unlock new floors, get rewards, and complete your collection!

title: Lightkeeper
description: Explore, gather, craft, and rebuild a community of island creatures. Sail, swim, climb, and fly across a mystical archipelago and uncover it’s forgotten secrets. Spread your light to outshine the oncoming darkness.

title: Decoration Disorder Disconnection 1
description: A fanmade visual novel adaptation of the first volume of the Decoration Disorder Disconnection novel series written by Kinoko Nasu.

title: NieR Replicant: Red and Black
description: A fanmade visual novel adapting the NieR Replicant: Red and Black short story featured within the pages of Grimoire NieR, telling the events that led up to the start of Route A from the perspective of Brother Nier.

title: Let Me Play!
description: After shouting "Let Me Play!" to the cast in a theatre, the fiction comes crashing down as everyone, including you, becomes aware they're only following a script. Will you let the play continue? Or will you write your own ending?

title: Draft Day Sports: Pro Basketball 26
description:
Build your basketball dynasty in Draft Day Sports: Pro Basketball 26, the deepest and most customizable pro basketball management simulation available. Step into the role of general manager as you draft, trade, and develop players while managing the salary cap and long-term team building.

This year’s version features a refreshed, modern UI for a smoother experience, a new player archetype system to help identify roles and playing styles, smarter AI that adapts and creates unique league storylines, and expanded game presentation updates that bring your vision to life on the court.

Customize your universe with powerful editing tools — create teams, players, logos, and even entire leagues to design the basketball world of your dreams. Whether you want to recreate today’s pro landscape, build your own fictional league, or relive historic eras, DDS: Pro Basketball 26 gives you the tools to do it.

With deep strategy, immersive presentation, and unlimited customization, no other basketball sim delivers a franchise experience like this.

title: Lime Stenched Dirt
description:
Lime Stenched Dirt is a short RPG Maker 2003 game.

In the game you control a girl called Lyza and have to reach a super computer, that is infected by a virus, to safe the Darkened Lands.

Make friends, battle ghosts and learn more about the history of this ruined world.

The game is about 2-3 hours long and features 3 party members and 2 endings.

title: An Exorcism
description: Enter a terrifying exorcism as a reverend, armed with holy tools and your wits. To save the possessed Erin, you must confront the demon in control of her, uncover the dark secret that binds it to this world, and perform an exorcism to banish it in this intense atmospheric horror game.

title: To The White Calm
description: An atmospheric fantasy indie visual novel

title: Alisa's Grimoire
description: Alisa comes across a Grimoire that seals the soul of a powerful sorcerer by chance. Through its power, Alisa becomes a sorcerer and learns that the academy is actually a laboratory for magical experiments. To save her loved ones, Alisa takes on a battle against sorcerers.

title: Touhou Fuumaroku: The Story of Eastern Wind
description: Touhou Fuumaroku: The Story of Eastern Wind is a fanmade remake of Touhou Fuumaroku: The Story of Eastern Wonderland. It features Windows era characters and PC-98 Mima, as well as an original extra stage and another extra stage based on the Yukkuri meme.

title: Phantasm Romance: Gensou Rouman Kikou
description: Phantasm Romance is a Touhou fangame made with Danmakufu.

title: Suwako no Danmaku Pyon-pyon Daisansaku
description: Suwako no Danmaku Pyonpyon Daisansaku is a Touhou fangame by UTG Software. It is set in an isometric perspective and bullets are fired in a 3d space, giving Suwako the ability to jump over them.

title: Super Postal
description: Made specifically for the Japanese market, this version of POSTAL features a complete Japanese dub and two extra levels: Akihabara and Dōtonbori (more commonly known as Tokyo and Osaka to English speakers).

title: Scarlet Meister
description: Scarlet Meister is a Touhou Project fangame by ハードカバーは鈍器. Unlike the Touhou Project main games, Scarlet Meister is a horizontally scrolling shooter.

title: InfiniSweeper
description:
InfiniSweeper is a minesweeper clone with a twist:

Infinite recursions.

A part of the game board could contain itself, and it also contains itself, which also contains itself, which also contains itself, which also...

title: Saving Princess of Mars
description: Saving Princess of Mars is an stylish action platformer featuring puzzles to solve and ton of enemies to eliminate.

title: Pete's World
description: Pete the Penguin woke up and found himself in a mysterious and dangerous world. Help him navigate this challenging world by avoiding obstacles like shooting projectiles, spawning rain clouds and more while gaining points by collecting flowers.

title: Hidden Cats in Spooky Village
description: Bring light to the darkness as you color each scene by finding over 1200 hidden objects across 12 levels in the Spooky Village! Discover heroic feline hunters of spooky creatures, collect special cards, unlock bonus levels, and explore haunting yet cozy locations filled with mystery and charm.

title: Battleplan
description:
Battleplan is a historical, WW2 real-time strategy game of unparalleled realism and simulation.
Fight across massive battlefields created from real-world geographic data.
Create your army by customizing your order of battle and chain of command.
Draw directly on the map to create elaborate plans.

title: Aim Trainer: With Cats
description: A simple aim training game with images of cute cats, developed in Unreal Engine 5. Support kitties and improve your accuracy.

title: Crimson Night
description: Crimson Night is a challenging turn-based combat game that blends unforgiving battles with world exploration and character progression/building. You'll learn through trial and error, die often, adapt your tactics, and keep pushing forward!

title: Fishing at the Lake Full of Cats
description: Fishing at the Lake Full of Cats is a puzzle solving, cat collecting, fishing game where you uncover the secrets of Silly Lake in a quest to fish up every last one of its pointy eared denizens.

title: Red Awe
description: A short horror game where you take photos of a volcanic planet in the deep space to reveal out the conspiracy theory about a scientist...

title: Under Heaven or Hell
description:
You wake up in Hell with no memory of how you got there, and no clear way out.

To return home, you will have to survive the brutal politics of this realm and forge alliances with two dangerous devils and an enigmatic angel, each with their own secrets, and temptations that may pull you closer.

Will you escape with your soul intact, or will your path become forever tied to those who linger within the flames?

Your choices will shape your fate, and perhaps, the fate of Hell itself.

title: Odd Mobs Zero: Arrange
description: Odd Mobs Zero: Arrange is a shoot 'em up by Gustav.

title: Lost in Random: The Eternal Die - Cursed Couture
description:
This isn't just fashion—it's a fright. Because if one is going to stalk the floors of Mare's dark games, one might as well look drop-dead fabulous. Includes two unique costume sets for Aleksandra and Fortune:
- The Vampyre Set
- The Phantom's Set

title: Dragon Song Tavern: Festival of the Returning Tides DLC
description: The Festival of the Returning Tides special DLC is now available for free!

title: Dragon Song Tavern: Pumpkin Masquerade DLC
description: Dragon Song Tavern: Pumpkin Masquerade! When candlelight flickers, the tavern transforms into a pumpkin party!

title: My Dream Setup: Sim Racing
description: Do you want to create your dream Sim Racing setup? With the Sim Racing DLC, it's finally possible! You can create any setup you want. Any size, any color combination, any budget - from casual desk racers to full professional rigs - it's all up to you.

title: Prize Fighter: Heavyweight Edition
description:
Originally developed by Digital Pictures, Prize Fighter returns!

Prize Fighter - Heavyweight Edition takes you closer than a ringside seat — it puts you right in the game. In this remastered Digital Pictures classic, you’re the one slugging it out with the best boxers in the world.

With your fists in view, you can throw any punch, anytime. A jab. A hook. An uppercut! Land a blow and watch your opponent reel.

When you take a punch, your vision rocks. You might even find yourself flat on your back, looking up into the faces of the referee and your trainer as you take the count. Or maybe you'll be up there accepting the heavyweight crown!

You’re fighting in the main event, attended by your trainer, cornerman and bucket boy. They guide you, help you, give advice. Also on hand: the referee, card girls, announcer, assorted hecklers, and four of the beefiest, brawniest, pug-ugly opponents you can imagine.

Prize Fighter is brooding, brutal, real! It has the impact of Martin Scorcese’s film Raging Bull. In fact, the bouts are staged by Ron Stein, the boxing guru who choreographed the fight scenes in Raging Bull and the Rocky films. Close-ups, point of view shots and handheld camera bring the intensity of the boxing scene right in your face!

Rebuilt from the ground up, Prize Fighter has been enhanced with 4K video along with numerous improvements and new features!

So pull on your gloves and get ready for tonight’s main event. You've got to beat three tough contenders to earn your shot at the champ.

title: Fear Effect 2: Retro Helix
description:
Return to 2048 Hong Kong in the groundbreaking prequel that defined style and mature storytelling for a generation.

Set two years before the events of Fear Effect, dive into a sprawling adventure that takes you from futuristic cityscapes to the lost tomb of China's first emperor, and discover the origins of mercenaries Hana Tsu-Vachel, Royce Glas, Deke Decourt, and the enigmatic Rain Qin, in a story that blends high-tech espionage with ancient Chinese mythology and the supernatural.

title: Earnest Evans Collection
description: Three classic action games return in the Earnest Evans Collection: Earnest Evans, El Viento, and Anett Returns! Can you put an end to Al Capone's evil plans and thwart the resurrection of the Dark Lord Hastur?

title: Little Samson
description: Leaping, smashing, scorching, and exploding its way into your collection! Little Samson—the rarest and most coveted game of the 8-bit era—arrives on modern systems for everyone to enjoy!

title: Sigma Star Saga DX
description:
The classic shooter/RPG is back and better than ever! Featuring a unique mix of side-scrolling shoot-'em-up space battles and top-down planetary exploration, Sigma Star Saga DX is an explosive genre mashup that lets you take control of Allied Earth Federation pilot Ian Recker and infiltrate the alien Krill Empire as a double agent in a last-ditch effort to save mankind.

With loyalties divided between humans and Krill, you must investigate six planets using an ever-expanding set of tools and abilities, and jump into the cockpit to engage enemy forces in intense shmup-style combat using more than 70 different Gun Data items. Gorgeous pixel-art graphics, epic boss battles, and a twist-filled story with multiple endings await.

The new DX version adds numerous refinements over the original 2005 release, including an improved map, decreased random encounter rate, rebalanced EXP system, enhanced dialogue, additional save points, assorted bug fixes and quality-of-life updates, and more.

title: Grave of Voices
description:
This is a first-person survival horror game focused on atmosphere, exploration, and tension. You’ll search for clues, solve environmental puzzles, and scavenge resources to survive. There is no signal and your phone is useless. Every step forward could reveal something vital or something hunting you.

Hide when you can. Fight when you must. Explore the catacombs in order to escape this messed up place. But the deeper you go the more your brain becomes messed up.

Will you escape… or end up as just another set of bones beneath the city?

title: Infinity Nikki: Encore Season
description:
The "Unleash Your Style: Super Styling Contest" has officially kicked off in Wishfield!
Step into the competition and showcase your one-of-a-kind style and boundless creativity on the grand stage!
With three groups vying for the championship, how many trials and challenges will you face on your way to the top?

As the candlestick lights the way to the past and old friends reunite, it's not sorrow we feel—but the warmth of shared memories.
Remember, every encounter is a miracle!

title: She's Still Alive
description: Hare tries to keep his sick wife, Bunny, alive. Wake Up.

title: The Lost Battalion
description: The Lost Battalion is a large-scale overhaul mod for Arma 3, built around immersive, handcrafted missions and realistic military simulation. The mod combines custom-made assets, detailed operations, and a structured unit system to deliver an authentic tactical experience. Developed and maintained by its own dedicated community, The Lost Battalion runs continuous story-driven campaigns and handcrafted missions that emphasize teamwork, realism, and dynamic combat scenarios.

title: School Night Seance
description: School Night Séance is a modern take on the point and click adventure genre. A pair of best friends; the impulsive Melony, and the practical Letty, find themselves separated in a haunted mansion after performing an ill-advised séance. The girls will need to work together to solve puzzles, uncover the mansion’s mysterious history, and finally, reunite and escape the house!

title: Dragon Quest I HD-2D Remake
description: A remake of the first Dragon Quest game in HD-2D, released as part of the Dragon Quest I & II HD-2D Remake bundle.

title: Dragon Quest II HD-2D Remake
description: A remake of the second Dragon Quest game in HD-2D, released as part of the Dragon Quest I & II HD-2D Remake bundle.

title: Deep Fog Signals
description: Stuck in an outpost deep in a sea of toxic fog, your crew has been decimated, you're cut off from the outside world, and oxygen is running out. Use limited bandwidth to coordinate unstable crewmates, conduct esoteric research that could change the world, and interpret strange signals from the deep.

title: Resident Evil Requiem: Deluxe Edition
description:
Resident Evil Requiem Deluxe Edition. Includes the full game and the Deluxe Kit. A must have for true survivors.

The Deluxe Kit contains the following content:
- Grace's Costume: Dimitrescu & Film Noir
- Leon's Costume: RE4, Apocalypse & Film Noir
- Screen Filter: Apocalypse & Film Noir
- Four weapon skins including S&S M232 Weapon Skin: Apocalypse
- Charms: Mr. Raccoon & DSO Emblem
- Audio Pack: Raccoon City Classic
- Files: Letters from 1998

Prepare to escape death in a heart-stopping experience that will chill you to your core.

title: Touhou Madarazakura
description: Touhou Madarazakura is a Touhou fangame with gameplay inspired by Ikaruga.

title: Shinyaku: Touhou Gensousatsu - Re.Phantasmagoria of Imagine Breaker
description: Shinyaku: Touhou Gensousatsu - Re.Phantasmagoria of Imagine Breaker is a Touhou fangame. It features a crossover with the A certain Magical Index series. This game is a remake of the creator's earlier work, Touhou Gensousatsu: Phantasmagoria of Imagine Breaker, which was released in 2012.

title: Maple Wars
description: Maple Wars is a comedy-packed adventure RPG where you play as a patriotic American maple syrup farmer down on his luck, downtrodden, and down to invade Canada. Embark on missions to fix up your farm, recruit fellow New Englanders, and sabotage the Maple Syrup Deep State. Make America Sticky Again!

title: The Florist
description: A classic survival horror experience, set in a town overgrown with deadly yet beautiful flowers.

title: Object Impermanence
description: A first person puzzle game where your vision defines reality, and only the things you can see exist. Learn and master the strange behaviours of objects outside your vision. Traverse the ancient structures of a world forgotten by the universe.

title: Farmer Fowl's Farmhouse
description: Step inside the abandoned Farmer Fowl's Farmhouse — once a cheerful children's attraction, now left to rot since it's sudden closure decades prior. You play as Eli, a salvage assessor sent to document and mark the building's remaining assets before demolition. You must mark items for salvage, take photos of rooms, and collect leftover documents. However something evil still lurks within the building, can you complete your job and get out of the building? Or become a part of its tragic history.

title: Mamon King
description: "Mamon King" is a monster-raising simulation where you aim to become the King. Battles feature simple turn-based command combat, yet each monster possesses unique skills. Combined with the SP required to activate these skills, this creates intense strategic gameplay that anyone can easily enjoy.

title: Snip Snap
description: Test your reaction speed and precision in this exciting game!

title: Sanguis et Gloria: Shadow of the Labyrinth
description: Step into the depths of Crete and face the legendary Minotaur in this action-packed indie adventure. Play as Nikandros, a Spartan warrior forged in battle, as you fight against the might of the ruler of the labyrinths, the great Minotaur.

title: 67: The 7 Pages
description: You're in a spooky forest and 7 pages have been scattered around, but the 67 kid has suddenly become evil and is hunting you down.

title: Automatachef
description:
Welcome to Automachef, a resource management puzzler where you design kitchens, program machinery and watch your genius come to life! It’s time to engineer tomorrow’s kitchen, today!

Plan. Position. Program: Design and build automated restaurants, then program them to run like well-oiled machines! Do you have a can-do attitude and the know-how to conquer the world of automated restaurants?

title: Don’t Eat the Cashier!
description:
Congratulations!

You’ve just landed a night shift at a gas station for minimum wage — spooky enough already. But your customers tonight aren’t exactly human.
Meet talkative monsters, flirt with an eldritch being, pet a werewolf, and try not to end up on the menu. Your choices shape relationships and endings — from romantic to nightmarish.

title: You Must Sleep
description:
You are John.
You have insomnia.
Monsters are attacking you.
But above all,
YOU
MUST
SLEEP

title: Chopping Hour
description: Chopping Hour is a tension-driven restaurant game where you rush to fulfill orders while evading enemies that hunt you. Buy supplies, stock shelves, cook, and deliver the right dishes as you survive the threats and push toward the ending.

title: It's Always Happy at Chubby's
description: Welcome to the night shift at Chubby’s, a 24/7 burger joint in the 90s. It's in the middle of nowhere, so you'll be mostly entirely alone. Just keep the store clean and occasionally serve the drive-thru counter. But whatever you do... always follow the rules.

title: Hilda Bewildered
description: From the creators of The Artifacts and Midnight Feast, Hilda Bewildered is an illustrated short story for deep-thinking adolescent readers and above.

title: Shadow City Mysteries: Case Files - Rise of the Rat King
description: Shadow City Mysteries: Case Files – Rise of the Rat King is a narrative game set in Shadow City’s underbelly. Assume the role of the Rat King, an underworld mastermind fighting for absolute power. Shape your legend by forging alliances, crushing rivals, and leaving a trail of consequences.

title: Yorunomori Bus Stop
description: A short walk while waiting for the bus. An exploration game where you encounter strange events.

title: Vendigo Corporation
description: Vendigo Corporation - is an atmospheric first-person psychological horror game. You must escape from the underground complex where experiments have gone out of control.

title: Folk Trails
description: In this game, you are a child exploring and taking pictures of an abandoned trail, accidentally capturing the attention of a long forgotten being, the Krampus. Use your camera's flash find your way through the dark night and to scare the monster away before it catches you!

title: Rookie Knight
description: Rookie Knight is a fast-paced 2D action-platformer where you step into the boots of a young knight on his very first adventure. Run, jump, wall slide, and strike down enemies as you explore vibrant biomes filled with danger and discovery

title: Road Tripped Live
description: A chaotic co-op road trip where you hit the road livestreaming to find the next breaking news. The crazier it gets, the more your stream blows up. How many viewers can you get while staying alive? Storms, UFOs, T-Rexes... You'll never guess what'll be next.

title: Grand Sands
description: You are Selka, a Drifter of the Sands. In a realm where the desert’s harsh beauty conceals relentless dangers, will you be claimed by the shifting sands—or wield the elements to master and conquer them?

title: Mars 2120: The More, the Merrier
description: In MARS 2120, a metroidvania on Mars, you're sent on a rescue mission after disaster strikes. Explore hostile environments, battle enemies, and master powers to face a threat beyond the red planet. With “The More, The Merrier” DLC, the challenge intensifies.

title: Top Racer Collection: Top Racer Customs
description: Get ready to experience the ultimate Top Racer, the classic arcade racing game from the 90s: nostalgia, speed, and now the freedom to customize your car's look and performance.

title: PaperPlane Minigames
description: Fly a paper plane through fun minigames to earn coins and unlock colors and unique hats. Complete quick challenges and give your plane its own style!

title: Street Racer Collection
description: Street Racer is one of the most insane and fun kart racers of the 90s. Run, fight, and win! Speed and brawls on crazy tracks! A classic that mixes racing and fighting, bringing back chaotic battles and irreverent humor for up to 4 players!

title: Neon Abyss 2: Archenemy Returns
description: All 34 bosses from the original Neon Abyss have returned! After skill optimizations, visual effects upgrades, and complete reworks of some manager bosses, they've fully evolved! Are you ready to face their wrath?

title: Daemon x Machina: Titanic Scion - Vehicle Set
description:
Travel in style with these new rides!

This DLC set includes:

Additional Vehicle - Cruiser Vehicle
Additional Vehicle - VH8-G2500
Additional Vehicle - Nightmare

title: 101 Cats in Jakarta
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Jakarta landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: Repossession: Mafia Debt
description: As a mafia-hired repo man, you break into debtors’ homes where people would rather blow up their own apartment than pay a single cent. Grab the loot, dodge traps, and escape before the place turns into a war zone—preferably with a crew of friends, as in this line of work chaos is business as usual.

title: Beyond Words
description: From the creators of GoldenEye & TimeSplitters comes Beyond Words, the genre-defining fusion of roguelike strategy and word-crafting. Build powerful combos, unlock upgrades, and master a challenge where victory is spelled one letter at a time.

title: The Living Shadows
description: The Living Shadows is a survival horror game where you have to take the role of a woman named Amelia and go through the world of the dead in order to save your sister and try to return to the real world.

title: Toad Slide
description: In Toad Slide, a Sokoban-inspired 2D pixel-art puzzle, you control a mystical toad who must move runic stone blocks and place them onto magic circles to restore balance to the swamp.

title: Sauce Factory Tycoon
description: Manage production, keep customers happy, and build a sauce empire.

title: Fortnite: Chapter 6 - Mini Season 2: The Simpsons
description: Drop from the Battle Bus into... Springfield? The 80-player Springfield Island features a fast-paced, back-to-basics Battle Royale experience straight from the minds behind The Simpsons. Giant donuts will fall from the sky and angry clones will roam the streets, but don’t worry, Homer Simpson is in charge.

title: Mittelland AD
description:
Achieve wealth and fame in the Principality of Mittelland! Found a dynasty, trade goods, prove your political skill, eliminate your rivals, and immortalize yourself in the history books!
The classic political and economic simulation starting from the year 1600 – now available again!

Mittelland AD is the revised version of the 1996 classic Die Fugger 2, which had to be pulled from shelves due to a legal dispute with the Fugger family.
The game features improved music, online multiplayer via Steam Remote Play Together and a full english translation including all texts and voiceovers.

title: Nexen
description: A first-person horror action game set inside a shifting neon maze where the player must collect orbs, complete objectives, and survive. In NEXEN, you navigate dark corridors while being hunted by a relentless entity that reacts to sound and movement. Each mode changes the rules—Classic focuses on survival and orb collection, while Task Mode adds objectives and hazards. Blending retro visuals, industrial sound design, and high-intensity chases, the game challenges players to stay calm, adapt, and escape before the maze consumes them.

title: Kings Origin
description: A roguelite dungeon-building tower defense. Build your domain on a tactical board, place rooms and units, and survive relentless waves to rise as the Dungeon Lord.

title: Plants Vs. Zombies: DLC Edition
description: Plants Vs. Zombies: DLC Edition is a mod for Plants Vs. Zombies that adds brand new adventure worlds, 20+ new mini-games, 20 puzzles, 12 challenges, and loads of other new stuff added to the beloved classic 2009 game.

title: Dally Doo You Can Too! Numbers
description: Dally Doo You Can Too! Numbers is an educational title for ages three to six that teaches children about counting skills, as well as matching, sorting, and observation skills. There are games and lessons, as well as a bonus I Spy game, for the targeted age group on the topic of pre-math skills. Dally Doo, a friendly dinosaur, will provide help to the player on any of the activities and games if needed. The game features narration to help the player for extra practice.

title: Mecha Ritz
description: Mecha Ritz is a vertically scrolling shoot 'em up. It encourages players to raise their rank as much as possible, giving them plenty of resources to survive the resulting rise in difficulty.

title: Pantsu: Atty's Collection
description: A casual anime game with mini-games to collect panties, which are used to rank up, unlock levels, and buy items to customize your own character. Lighthearted with funny descriptions.

title: Aerial Raider
description: Embark on an exhilarating journey in Aerial Raider, a nostalgic top-down arcade shooter that combines classic 1980s pixel art with high resolution backgrounds and high-quality modern audio. Step into the cockpit as Commander Kael Riven and take to the skies in a relentless battle against the Varkari, an alien race from a dying sun. Your mission: shoot down waves of foes, navigate through intense aerial dogfights, and uncover a compelling story that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

title: Sonic Forces: Sanic T-Shirt
description: Sometimes, you've gotta go fast. These exclusive "Sanic" T-shirts for your custom character features beautifully rendered art, and virtual threads organically grown on the snowing peaks of Mt. Fuji many years ago.

title: Dead Sight
description:
A short Horror game that tries to emulate mid 2000s dual screen handheld gaming.

In the game you hold the imaginary device sideways and have two screens right next to each other. The left one is the main one, while the right one is your peripheral vision, that shows you ghostly things hiding from your main view.

title: Plague Hunters
description:
In shadowed realms where plague winds howl and moan,
Plague Hunters calls, a rogue-like throne,
Turn-based tales in dark fantasy's grip,
Where survivors and hunters join your fateful trip.

Each run a riddle, randomized anew,
Levels rise like ghosts from the misty blue,
Gather your party 'midst the cursed decay,
In a world devoured by plague's grim sway.

With art like fairytales twisted and torn,
Beautiful darkness where nightmares are born,
Battle grotesque foes, bosses foul and vast,
Equip potent perks to endure the blast.

Shrines whisper secrets, a gamble profound,
Luck's fleeting kiss or a curse tightly bound—
Venture forth, hunter, in this plague-wrought dream,
Where victory's edge cuts on fortune's sharp gleam.

Directed by Luc Bernard.

title: Plants vs. Zombies: Ultimate
description: Plants Vs Zombies: Ultimate (formerly known as Integrated or Integrated Ultimate) is a fan-made Plants vs. Zombies mod project that is actively being developed and shared within the community. It's goal is to combine everything from all the different Plants vs Zombies 1 ports (including the Chinese exclusive levels, plants and campaigns), with extra and scrapped content, and even tools to allow community-made levels to be shared, into one complete package.

title: Vtuber Story
description:
In this world, every village has a unique VTuber as its chief.
All the rules are created and managed by the village chief.
With the combined efforts of the chief and the player villagers,
what kind of village will it ultimately become?

Step into “VTuber Story” and join the streamers in building villages full of personality!

title: Stellar Trader
