description: See the galaxy through the eyes of a trader. Hundreds of years after humanity took to the stars, you're free to buy, fight, explore, and build your way to power. Shape economies, form alliances, and influence the systems that control trade, tech, and politics.

title: Exe Tries to Save the Holidays
description: “Exe Tries to Save the Holidays” is an extra Friendship Test story that takes place a few months after the events of the game, where you help Exe make everyone happy during a power outage in the middle of the holidays.

title: Sniper Elite: Resistance - Striking Range
description: In the new Striking Range Campaign Mission, you must prevent a V1 rocket barrage from decimating the allied invasion fleet ahead of D-Day whilst attempting a covert rescue of the Resistance operative Carillon.

title: Atelier Resleriana: The Red Alchemist & The White Guardian - Seasons Pass
description: The Seasons Pass contains most of the game DLCs.

title: Kitty Cauldron
description: A relaxing linear level-based game. Exquisite hand-drawn cartoons transport you to a fairytale-like dream. An adorable little witch and her black cat companion set out together to search for ingredients in each world, ultimately cooking the most delicious dishes.

title: Exit Zone
description: Exit Zone is a multiplayer horror game with anomalies for 1–5 players, memorize every corridor, uncover anomalies, and make the right decisions—before Exit Zone traps you forever.

title: Thief's Riddles
description: In the game, you’ll experience: Various locations and missions Lots of puzzles and mysteries Diverse criminals, each with their own secrets and paranoia Engaging stealth gameplay A range of enemies: criminals, insane homeowners, guard dogs

title: All My Heart, Banjo
description: A click & point + mini-games adventure where you'll be able to partake in various activities and dialogue to discover our main character and his backstory.

title: Sweetoria Land
description: Sweetoria Land is a 3D low-poly platformer for kids 8-15. Jump, collect Candy Keys, solve puzzles, and explore a vibrant candy kingdom with a heartfelt story of growth, joy, and overcoming challenges!

title: Halls of Torment: The Boglands
description: The Boglands is a DLC for Halls of Torment set in a swamp-like region filled with spirits, insects, and animated plant creatures. It introduces new playable characters—the Crone, who uses plant-based attacks and debuffs, and the Alchemist, who employs customizable elemental mixtures. It also adds new mechanics and challenges focused on survival rather than timed progression.

title: Alcazar
description: Alcázar is a collection of six Halloween-themed, Boom-compatible maps by General Roasterock, Ravendesk, and Jizzwardo, inspired by the Wormwood series. The maps range in style from tight combat challenges to medium-sized slaughter, intended as a love letter to a delightfully eccentric series of WADs.

title: FNAF Online Multiplayer
description: An online multiplayer fangame of Five Nights at Freddy’s 1 where 3-5 players each occupy their own office and must collaborate via in-game voice chat to survive the night. One player can also assume the role of the Purple Guy, controlling animatronics to eliminate the others before 6AM. Currently in alpha, available for Windows via GameJolt and Itch.

title: SAI: Immediate Assistance Service
description: An RPG about work-life balance in a Latin American inspired cyberpunk world.

title: ProMods Europe
description: ProMods is a community project which expands the Euro Truck Simulator 2 experience greatly, adding and rebuilding 300+ cities and thousands of Kilometers of road to make a more realistic and varied European driving experience.

title: Going To Bed
description: It's bedtime and you need to wake up early tomorrow. Hey, what's that sound in your room?

title: Eldritch Horror: Digital Edition
description: Uncover ancient cults, battle horrific monsters and thwart the rise of unfathomable Ancient Ones in a 1920s-themed adventure. In this faithful adaptation of the classic board game, you must race against time to save humanity from ancient powers and dark secrets before all is lost.

title: Frostpunk 2: Fractured Utopias
description: The first Frostpunk 2 DLC expands Utopia Builder mode by adding structured Utopia Trees for each faction, powered by affinities. As factions’ trust grows you unlock faction-specific laws, buildings, and abilities that push their ideological goals. Completing a faction’s Utopia Tree enacts a single societal vision for the city and permanently resolves Tension, but pursuing utopia carries significant costs.

title: Flesh Made Fear: 1998 Theme
description: The 1998 Theme DLC outfits both main characters in retro-inspired uniforms that capture the gritty spirit of late-90s survival horror.

title: Liminal: The Forgotten Maze
description: Liminal The Forgotten Maze is a first-person psychological horror survival game. Elias is pulled into a space outside of reality. He awakens in a place that shouldn't exist—a network of endless, yellowed corridors lit by buzzing lights, where time and space seem to fold in on themselves.

title: Flesh Made Fear: Summer in Rotwood
description: The Lake Rotwood Getaway DLC introduces new swimsuit outfits for both main characters, adding a chilling summer twist to your survival.

title: Lost in the Backrooms: Day 100
description: Lost in the backrooms day 100 is a co-op horror game based on the concept of the backrooms with different levels and entities , a sanity system and unreal engine 5 graphics for the best immersive experience.

title: RIP Party
description: Throw a party at a maniac's mansion. RIP Party is a single player slasher horror game inspired by 80s & 90s horror movies where you and the NPCs are being hunted. Try and survive the micro sandbox experience.

title: Devestor
description: Across 10 haunted levels… You'll face Jumpscares, Puzzles, Parkour, Mini-Games, and a Roaming Monster that truly hates you. Your only hope lies in the notes left by some clueless idiot who came here just like you… and never made it back.

title: Corrupted Basement
description: Corrupted Basement is an atmospheric survival horror game. You are trapped in two different basements. Focused on RUNNING and HIDING. Find a way to open the exits and escape before it catches you.

title: Don't Look at Grandma
description: Grandma hasnt been the same since Grandpa passed. A night in her house spirals into a battle with the Devil. Recover family heirlooms and perform the ritual to save her soul. But whatever you do DONT LOOK AT GRANDMA.

title: Speakeasy Simulator
description: Manage your own speakeasy during the Prohibition. Produce illegal alcohol, customize your bar, satisfy demanding customers, and smuggle booze to the mafia, all while avoiding police patrols in this Prohibition-era simulator.

title: Job Hunter 202X
description: When you're laid off, it's sink or swim. An RPG about unemployment, job hunting, and depression.

title: We Gotta Go
description:
We Gotta Go is a first person co-op horror game where you and your friends have to reach the only bathroom in a haunted mansion before your bowels betray you.

The mansion won’t make it easy: its many passages are blocked, locked, hidden, and haunted... can your team survive all the way to the porcelain promised land?

title: Static Signal
description: Static Signal is an open world 'action' horror game. Venture through your old office building and even reality as a malicious entity plans to reshape the world into a nightmare, but you can stop it before it's too late. Will you waste your time away, or will you save everyone from extinction?

title: Sol and the Endless Orbit
description: A story-rich, not-quite-turn-based hybrid of RPG strategy and real-time platforming. Secure the future of the galaxy's vibrant settings and whimsical inhabitants... or uncover the secrets at the center of everything, and draw a different path.

title: Lanternwood
description: Build your ideal party, master skill combinations, and conquer battles in this fantasy PvE autobattler adventure.

title: Dream Distortion
description: Dream Distortion is a Yume Nikki-inspired game made in Godot 3.6.

title: Curse of The Lineage
description: Curse of the Lineage is an isometric puzzle roguelike where you navigate shifting grounds filled with lost souls, powerful charms and endless secrets. Unravel your bloodline’s dark past as you solve evolving puzzles and fight to break the family curse.

title: Goblin Goopmaxxing
description:
Goblin Goopmaxxing is a dark comedy sandbox story about brewing bizarre potions and experimenting on unfortunate goblin specimens.

Does the goblin look sad because you turned it into a disgusting abomination? Just drop it into the meat grinder!

Every item in Goblin Goopmaxxing can be brewed into a potion with a completely unique effect. Want to turn a goblin body-pillow into a potion? Go ahead! I don't know what it'll do, but it'll probably disfigure the goblin in horrifying ways!

A sausage potion that grows a third leg? A chair potion that turns the goblin into a chair goblin? A goblin baby potion that does another crazy thing that you'll just have to find out when you play Goblin Goopmaxxing?! The possibilities are endless...

Goblins don't have rights so you can do what you want with them! If you're feeling hungry why don't you throw a gnome into a woodchipper to turn him into a sausage? You can in Goblin Goopmaxxing!

Do as the collector says, you don't want to make him mad, do you?

title: Ressolve Steps
description: A simple 3D top-down puzzle game that requires precise movement and strategy.

title: Roxy Raccoon 3: Troubles in Time
description: Roxy Raccoon 3: Troubles In Time is 2.5D platformer for all ages and a throw back to collectathons of the past. Explore four uniquely themed worlds as you prevent the witches dastardly schemes, conquer endless minigames and save the future!

title: Push the square
description: A mysterious square has appeared in your house. It seems to do nothing but rotate clockwise, so you are gonna spend all your money making sure it does.

title: Misdecayed
description: An adventure RPG about life, death, rebirth, and robots.

title: GroundBreaker
description: GroundBreaker is a roguelite experience where you have to reach the end of the dark mine. Collect rocks, find & buy upgrades and defeat dangerous enemies, but be careful with oxygen!

title: Troll
description:
Become a brave troll warrior and save little humans from orcish tyranny in a fast paced brick wall destructing action game!

The quest will take you through six lands from green plains, across the mysterious swamps and desert, through snowy mountains and dark horror forest to the terrible wasteland, the home of orcs.

You will have to defeat many foes and face hideous and powerful creatures to finally fight the freedom for peaceful people from the Plains.

title: Horde: The Citadel
description:
Horde: The Citadel is a sequel to the fantasy real-time strategy game, Horde: The Northern Wind. Continuing the story of the land of Semirechye, The Citadel further explores the conflict between the Semireks and the invading nomads lead by their khan Teimur. In The Northern Wind, Semirek leaders have been able to drive Teimur's forces out of Lower Urgal, however the khan had been able to ally with hermit wizards and fortify his lands. The only path to his main citadel, Vorezh, lies through the Land of Shadows no man dares to tread, and the Semireks will need to secure an alliance with the dreaded dragons to pass safely into Teimur's domain.

The Citadel essentially uses the same engine as its predecessor, retaining all of the original game mechanics but also adds new content in the form of units, structures, items and terrain types. The game runs in higher resolution as The Northern Wind, but the sprites are not scaled up so a larger portion of the battlefield is visible. Gameplay remains mostly the same, with the player having to explore each of the nine maps in order to solve the main quest, find necessary items, defeat or negotiate with opponents. The maps are also larger, and each usually has two neutral Semirek settlements for the player to interact with, while in the previous game, only one settlement was initially present on most maps.

title: Pudding: Lyre Knight
description: "Let's defeat the demon lord together!" A thrilling action-adventure of destruction!

title: The Virus Game
description:
In this novel, we download a deleted game, after completing which people died.
After downloading the game, we meet one of the characters - the Virus, which feeds on the souls of people. Depending on your decisions you will either be friends with him or die :)

title: Stares Back
description: Looking for relief, signs point her towards a mysterious nebula. Now she needs a closer look

title: A Hollow Harvest
description:
First it went for the livestock, now it's after the villagers.

You find yourself in a quiet little village. After inheriting an old farm from a deceased brother, a family reaches out for your help to find out what's responsible-but the investigation isn't easy; someone locked everything up. Search a dead man's belongings and penetrate his secrets one lock at a time-but hurry, bodies are piling up by the day. Your decisions will affect the fate of who lives and who dies for different potential endings-as well as several death scenes along the way, if you aren't careful.

Features custom art, atmospheric storytelling and plenty of scares! (This is the fourth game in the NOT ALL THERE series, but you can play them in any order.)

title: Yum's Farm
description: Struggling to make ends meet, Yum E. Bacon's late father passes him a plot of land to live out the farming lifestyle he had always dreamed of. Purchase farms, harvest when ready, and defend your land from wild humans! Make profits and get the fastest time it takes to go from nothing to a millionaire.

title: Monster Parlor
description: Monster Parlor is a game in which you run a beauty parlor for monsters, where you have the privilege to make them into something a bit more charming! Strike up a conversation, convince them of your ways, and earn some charms of your own.

title: My Only
description:
You don't know why, but you return. Again and again, you come, hoping to rid yourself of the past. Still, it does nothing for you. To where is there acceptance in what's happened, or a justified means to an end?

For too long have you endured this suspension of heart.

The time has come to finally take control of your fate and do what you should've done so many years ago. Only then will you at last be free from the ghosts to haunt your past.

title: Kid Pilot
description: Kid Pilot is an educational flight simulator designed for elementary school children. It allows aspiring aviators to take to the skies across America. With help from friendly penguin Penwick, players can choose a scenario (midflight, take-off, or landing), difficulty level, time of day, location, and one of three planes to command. From big cities like New York and San Francisco to natural wonders like Crater Lake and the Grand Canyon, there are different places to explore, each accompanied by factoids and historical notes announced by Penwick in the air. Kid-friendly controls support joystick or keyboard play, with on-screen instruments like a compass and attitude indicator to assist navigation. Players can practice aerial maneuvers, weave through skyscrapers and mountain passes, and snap pictures for their scrap book, all while learning the basics of flight and the facts behind America's most famous places.

title: Sword Sage: Awakening
description: Sword Sage: Awakening is an action RPG rooted in Chinese myth and folklore. You play as San Niang, a novice disciple of the Yuangong Sect, about to confront the thousand-year inherited burden by the leaking of the forbidden celestial books, and the many ominous forces lurking in the shadows...

title: Feast of Fools
description: You have been invited to a mysterious dinner party. But alas, it seems you are to be the dinner! Flee, and you may yet survive!!

title: A Whisper of Fall: Jinyiwei
description: "A Whisper of Fall: Jinyiwei" is an ARPG set in the Ming Dynasty. Play as a Jinyiwei (Imperial Guard) with martial art, lightness skill and the unique deduction ability, across shifting timelines and sandbox levels to weave the destiny of yourself and the dynasty.

title: Lihiman
description: Lihiman is an anime-style story game about spending time with your family in the comfort of home. It is not about danger or fear but about the joy of simple moments that make life feel warm and safe. That is, until...

title: Beneath Europa
description: Explore the eerie depths of Europa to find extraterrestrial life.

title: Mawaru! Hacker Tantei
description: Become a righteous hacker detective who solves people's problems... and hack the requested PC by solving riddles! Analyze the PC by hacking! And... solve the source of your client's problems in the PC! This game is a puzzle solving adventure. You can hack by solving riddles.

title: Project Titan: The Redacted Files
description: Join Special Agent Detective Trevor Vanguard as he uncovers a world ending threat in the downtrodden mega city of Dynawatch. Explore, shoot and survive in this Action Adventure Sci-fi thriller and uncover the truth!

title: The Backrooms Deluxe 2
description: A new, immersive Backrooms game featuring many entities and many levels

title: Pieceful Gallery
description: A classic jigsaw game—each puzzle is a stunning work of art, replicating the operation and difficulty of traditional jigsaws. Come experience Cyber Puzzle now!

title: Delivery Dash: Battle Couriers
description: Step into the world of Delivery Dash Co., where every package counts and every second matters! With randomized delivery locations, hazards around every corner, and arcade-style bonuses, every run is a fresh adventure—whether you’re competing against rivals or shaping your own courier story.

title: Rocket League: Season 20
description: Head to the Boostfield Mall in Rocket League Season 20!

title: Candy Killers
description: Trick-or-treat with caution. Some candy will kill, and it’s up to you to figure out who’s handing it out.

title: Dual Fire Walled City
description: Dual Fire Walled City is a story-driven co-op game for two players. Featuring close friends who grew up together in the Kowloon Walled City, only to be pulled onto vastly different life paths by a twist of fate. Get ready to immerse yourself in a classic Hong Kong-style movie.

title: Draft Day Sports: Pro Football 26
description:
Step into the front office and take total control of your favorite football franchise in Draft Day Sports: Pro Football 26. This is the ultimate pro football simulation experience—designed for fans who want the depth, strategy, and freedom that other games overlook.

Build your dynasty from the ground up. Manage every detail of your team’s journey—from drafting the next superstar, negotiating key contracts, and scouting opponents, to setting weekly gameplans and making the tough calls on game day. Smart AI ensures every season feels fresh and competitive, while enhanced presentation brings your franchise to life like never before.

Enjoy expanded customization, refined player progression, and deeper in-game strategy options. Whether you’re a master roster-builder or a sideline strategist, you’ll find countless ways to put your mark on the league.

title: Angelface
description: ANGELFACE is a kinetic visual novel horror short story that follows a man chosen by God to guide an angel who has been displaced on earth back to heaven.

title: Manic Pixie Dreamgirls
description: Four students have a dark secret—they are mystic fae, who can enter people’s dreams and influence their feelings. What could possibly go wrong?

title: Radiophobia 3
description: Radiophobia is a comprehensive overhaul of Shadow of Chernobyl, focused on delivering an immersive gameplay experience with modernized graphics and a refined arsenal. It introduces a higher level of customization and numerous quality-of-life enhancements. Players can choose to follow the original storyline or dive into the many new quests. It's time to venture into the Zone once again...

title: Ben Shapiro: The Game
description: The Constitution is in trouble and Ben Shapiro needs your help. Protect the constitution from the floating heads of its enemies. Use your facts to stomp out their feelings in this game.

title: Secrets to Success: With Dr. Brain
description:
Good news!

Your company has enlisted you to try out the new VCR success booths to motivate you to be more productive!

Meet "Dr. Brain", a philosopher, entrepreneur & psychiatrist who will step you through a five-step program to being a go-getter!!

Don't, dilly dally, Lost One! Your key to a new life awaits!

title: OneRoom
description: You log in to a chatroom. Some of the members have just completed a game jam and want your opinion on their work. What could go wrong?

title: Kinophobia
description:
Explore a haunted movie studio. Learn the fates of the tormented souls bound to it. End a 50-year curse inscribed in blood and celluloid.

Kinophobia is a parser game about exorcising ghosts, becoming a rabid cinephile, and the terrible price of success.

title: Mari Lwyd
description:
You hear a knock at the door. The wind howls outside, carrying a strange and eerie melody.

Spending Christmas night alone, you assume it’s just some late-night carolers. But when you open the door, it’s not people you find—it’s something ancient and cold, staring at you with hollow eyes. The warmth vanishes, the air grows icy, and the haunting carol fills the silence.

They’ve come for something… and they won’t leave empty-handed.

title: Tungtung's Nightmare
description: You stay up late and feel sleepy. Instead of having sahur, you decide to go back to sleep, but...

title: I'm Struggling
description:
[I'm Struggling] Is a short atmospheric journey taking inspiration from a poem by Avalon complemented by the aesthetics of PS1-era graphics.

In the shadowed corners of a forgotten town, where dreams lie dormant and the weight of reality presses heavy, an echo of a poem unfolds.

This is not a game it's a reflection of the human spirit's resilience, a regret for lost dreams, and a quiet hope for a new beginning.

Will you find meaning in the shadows, will you find comfort in the ambiance or will it consume you ?

title: Streamer Screamer
description: You are Flincher, antagonist of the hit new horror game Flincher's Forest that every streamer's been playing. Find where the streamer is by watching his stream, and build up tension to create big scares and earn viewers!

title: The Walk
description:
The story of “The Walk” starts with Matt, who is traveling on a back road to get to a friend's house. After several hours of driving, his car breaks down after going through a tunnel. Matt finds himself in a town called “Nominal Town” and, with no towing options, decides to look for lodging. While walking through the dark streets, he meets a blind man who offers to stay in his house. Matt declines the offer, but the blind man warns him that the town is full of crazies and that at the end of the road there is only nothingness.

Matt continues on his way and stops at a store where the cashier is also surprised to see that Matt is looking for a house at the end of town, since, according to him, there is only empty field there. Despite the warnings, Matt continues on. On the way, he encounters an old woman on the road who reacts strangely...

title: Haunted Ice Cream
description: Haunted Ice Cream is a fast-paced time-management and rhythm simulation game where you play as a ghostly ice cream vendor serving spooky treats to restless spirits. Press the right keys in perfect timing to scoop and stack eerie flavors before your possession meter overflows, all wrapped in vibrant neon pixel art and ghostly charm.

title: A Very British Summer
description: A darkly comic life-sim where players manage a small-town doctor's daily life, solving puzzles to treat patients, navigating village activities, and choosing whether to follow the law or indulge in crime and chaos on the path to fortune.

title: Sunset Street Ninja
description: Sunset Street Ninja is a Action platformer/Fps beat em up, with semi nonlinear progression and with a hub world and retro style graphics.

title: Sunrise of the Time: End of Blue
description: Every step matters in “The Hunt,” the trial Gilens must face to become a soldier. A 2D action-adventure shaped by real-time combat, free exploration, and player-driven choices awaits you.

title: Boardfall
description: Progressively harder waves of enemies fall from the sky. Capture them to earn gold, and then purchase your own reinforcements to drop onto the board. 10 brand new chess pieces to master. How many waves can you survive?

title: The Defiant
description: The defiant Set during the Sino-Japanese War (1937-1945), the game is still in early development but promises to deliver action-packed shootouts, puzzle solving, and cinematic action. The game is dedicated to the memory of those who fought to liberate China, giving it a historical context and deep emotional meaning.

title: Axxx: Taught and Fucked
description: You want to help college girls improve their grades but your kinky mind and your curious cock, make what they are wishing for come true. Choose your actions wisely and teach them double lessons.

title: Crystal Maidens: Unleashed
description: A twisted wizard has corrupted the Maidens and their land. It’s up to you to summon your own harem of stunning waifus, fight back against the dark forces, and liberate them in this lewd RPG adventure. Let your desires get unleashed!

title: Furry Sexy Girls
description: Relaxing puzzle game for a good mood

title: Dying Night Sex with Zombi
description: Cum on girls, have fun and get ready for the shocking ending of the story ... A third-person PORN game set in the future at a research station full of sexy female employees. Explore space stations and read the sexual pleasures of girls from their science computers.

description: By moving and matching these colorful gems, reaching 3 or more to form a straight line to eliminate them, each successful elimination will bring gorgeous special effects and satisfying sound effects, as well as beautiful illustrations unlocked after completing the level

title: I Have Died
description: You have died, and only you can discover how it happened. Do not worry though, I am here to help you. Let us figure this out together. This mixed media artistic point and click adventure novel will not take you long to complete.

title: Memology
description: MEMOLOGY is a comprehensive test that shows how deeply you are immersed in the culture of memes.

title: Monster Girl Jungle
description: Adventure through a dangerous jungle, where monster girls await you. Will you resist when these seductive creatures make their move or will you surrender?

title: Lala Hentai 2
description: Cute puzzle game with hentai anime girls. Beautiful, erotic and juicy girls for every taste. Enjoy!

title: The Lewd Deal
description: The Lewd Deal is a short adult visual novel in which you will meet Ashley, a hot real estate agent. You can choose to be a single man and seduce her, or be married and dominate her with the help of your beautiful wife. Both routes have a similar initial premise but quite different fetishes/stories.

title: Cuckold Life Simulator
description: Cuckold Life Simulator is a story about paying enough attention to your other half or she will find someone else. An office slave named Slavik (Slavek) comes home early one day and catches his wife and her new fitness trainer having sex.

title: Sky Resort 2
description: Put yourself once more in the shoes of Sky's Resort manager, the kinkiest resort on Earth where everything and anything goes. Take care of your guests, their fetishes, and ensure they'll enjoy their stay!

title: Corpus Machina
description: What's that? An AI chatbot? I don't remember installing it...

title: Antonblast 64
description:
ANTONBLAST 64 is a fan game inspired by Summitsphere's ANTONBLAST - experience the familiar and chaotic Boiler City in a new dimension!

Also, be on the lookout for secrets - their locations mirror those of the original game, but contain new features to try out!

title: Sexuality with Girlfriends: Laler & Reese
description: In a world full of fantasy and romance, "Sexuality with girlfriends: Laler&Reese" will take you on a sweet journey exclusively for adults! The game is based on the simple and easy-to-use elimination game. Players need to complete various challenges by eliminating gems of the same color!

title: Floain Plus
description: "What's happiness?" No response. I knelt down to you ,praying for little comfort. Even if it's just a moment,I will capture it. This is My World:Third-Rate Romance Novels.But because it's me,it's fate,it's a childhood story written with my own hands. So,watch us:go far away,starting from that cliff—

title: Hentai Gymnast Scarlett
description: This is not just erotica. It’s an intimate encounter with visual art that reveals itself to you gradually — piece by piece.

title: Arcany
description: Arcany is a cozy persistent online world set in the mysterious Realm of Gravenmoor. Train skills, explore a magical land, craft powerful items, and uncover the story behind the forgotten cataclysme.

title: What the Stars Forgot
description: What The Stars Forgot is a retro-styled sci-fi horror management sim. As an advanced starship's cutting-edge AI, you have to guide a procedurally generated crew of hundreds as they embark on a dangerous mission to discover the source of an anomalous signal emanating from deep space.

title: Indomitable Spirit
description: The player will play the role of an anti-Japanese soldier. In the icy and snowy forest wilderness, relying on secret camps, villages and deep mountains, they will carry out a series of dangerous tasks and ultimately expose the conspiracy of the Kwantung Army.

title: Isle of Lament
description: Isle of Lament is a first-person mystery game set on a haunted island. Uncover its dark secrets as you explore eerie landscapes, solve intricate puzzles, and wield supernatural abilities to track and banish vengeful spirits. Can you break the curse before it claims you?

title: Astro Fighters 2
description: Astro Fighters 2 is a vertical scrolling bullet hell shooter designed to test your skills with non-stop arcade style action. Use a variety of special items, power up your chosen ship and compete for the high score across 4 difficulty modes to be the best fighter pilot in the game.

title: Brother Hai's Pho Restaurant
description: Brother Hai's Pho Restaurant is a story-driven horror game inspired by Vietnamese culture and real events, made with Godot Engine. The game offers glimpses into everyday Vietnamese life that you don't typically see in the media.

title: Arondight
description: Zanac-like Ultra High-Speed Scrolling 2D Shooter Humanity suffered a crushing defeat in the war against the sentient AI, RA6 the Great Sovereign, losing 70% of the global population. Now, you board the anti-AI fighter MSX-3 Arondight, and launch into the final battle against the Sovereign.

title: Ada
description: Ada is a cozy looking soulslike game. Help Ada embark on a journey to uncover what is happening to her. Explore the ever changing world she finds herself in. Meet new friends and foes as you reveal the truth that awaits.

title: 0X13
description: A fast-paced cyberpunk action RPG where you slash, leap, and parkour through a neon city, mastering stylish melee combat and upgrading your abilities to survive.

title: Background Bells
description: In Background Bells, you will return to the roots of classic survival horror games like Resident Evil and Silent Hill, with a unique style and a chilling sound design that will send shivers down your spine. Battle the monsters that will cross your path as you explore terrifying locations and solve twisted puzzles.

title: Karate Rogue
description: A stance-driven, turn-based combo roguelike—turn defense into offense and fight your way out of the abyss.

title: Lorsvale
description: Lorsvale is a open world fantasy rpg, where four factions battle for dominance. As a new arrival you can recruit allies, form alliances, and defeat foes as you shape the future of the Lorsvale.

title: Faeborne
description: Faeborne is a story-driven action-adventure indie game with fast-paced combat, precision platforming, and magical abilities. Explore a cinematic fantasy world, battle stone golems, solve puzzles, and uncover memories to bring your sister home.

title: ObeyE
description: In ObeyE, you will play the role of a [Fake] New-Order priest. Roguelike combat, build your fortifications while planting magical plants. Craft and shoot all the Enemy you see!

title: Void Red
description: An interactive card game that stirs memories and emotions. In silence, the cards speak, touching the depths of the heart. Philosophical space and tension quietly envelop the players.

title: Status Kakunin Tantei
description: Check the suspect's status and solve the mystery! A status-checking mystery ADV in which a rookie detective takes on difficult cases that take place in a fantasy world.

title: Tales of Eldoria
description: The sun is gone. In a world trapped in eternal moonlight, guide Liora and her companions through the Arcadia dungeons in a story driven JRPG about sacrifice and the bonds formed when the world is already broken.

title: Mochi Conquest
description: A roguelike JRPG dungeon crawler set in mythical Japan. Lead Mochi squads across 9 unique classes in dynamic turn-based combat with timeline tactics. Meet 300+ Kami, loot weapons, power up, and shape your strategy. Conquer 100 corrupted floors to uncover forgotten fates. A full JRPG - Every Run!

title: Santherya Uprising
description: Santherya Uprising is a deck-building game where tactics, timing, and upgrades play a crucial role. Cards cost fatigue instead of mana, the higher the cost, the later that character will play its next turn. Recruit heroes, build up their decks, and empower them with the magic of powerful orbs.

title: Pro Jank Footy
description: Pro Jank Footy is an over-the-top arcade comedy-sports game. Score goals to unleash game-changing power-ups, build a deck of absurd abilities, and tackle a season where no two matches are ever the same—solo or with your mates.

title: Heroes of Newerth Reborn
description:
Heroes of Newerth: Reborn is a modern reimagining of the beloved classic MOBA, rebuilt from the ground up to deliver the fastest, most fluid, and most intense gameplay experience in the genre. Designed for both veterans and new players alike, Reborn captures the heart and soul of the original Heroes of Newerth while enhancing every aspect. From visuals and performance to balance and accessibility.

Every hero has been reworked with updated models, refined animations, and rebalanced abilities to preserve their identity while elevating their impact on the battlefield. The iconic Newerth map returns with a fresh look, optimized pathing, and improved clarity for competitive play. Whether you're diving into fast-paced solo queue battles or coordinating with friends in ranked modes, the focus is on skill expression, teamwork, and lightning-fast decision-making. With smoother servers, enhanced visuals, and the same fierce edge that made HoN legendary, Heroes of Newerth: Reborn isn’t just a revival, it’s an evolution.

title: Final Fantasy XIV: Into the Mist
description: The Patch 7.4x series includes a number of new activities and updates for players to undertake, including new Main Scenario Quests, dungeon, trial, Arcadion raid series tier, Variant & Criterion Dungeon alongside additions to the Duty Support system, and updates to PvP, Gold Saucer, Occult Crescent, a new star for Cosmic Exploration and more.

title: Don't Scream Together
description: Don't Scream Together is an online co-op jumpscare horror simulator where you and friends walk through a pitch-black forest with camcorders in 1993. Use proximity chat and escape the forest. But if anyone screams or speaks too loudly, the game restarts or the screamer returns as the hunter!

title: Factoriant
description: Factoriant is a factory builder where you construct an underground ant factory. As a queen ant, dig tunnels, carry food, and hatch worker ants to automate your production. Defend your nest from threats like birds and humans, and build a subterranean ant colony.

title: Golden Retriever Simple Life
description: Share your days with an adorable real-life Golden Retriever. Feed, train, and play together as your bond grows stronger every day. Teach tricks, discover new walks locations, and keep your furry friend happy and healthy.

title: When Them Demons Cry
description: When Them Demons Cry is a single map MBF21 compatible Doom wad, created for the ENDOOM Mapping Contest 2025, themed after the When They Cry series of visual novels.

title: Gutter Night
description: It’s your first night shift at the bowling alley.

title: Father Figure
description: No mother. No father. Everything and everyone in your life slowly fades. The pain becomes too much. You can't take it anymore.

title: Espectro the Fighters Focus
description: Espectro - The Fighter's Focus is a beat 'em up action game with retro visuals and exuberant pixel art. Espectro and his allies, Sayuri and Iron Crusher, face hordes of enemies and powerful bosses in their quest for justice.

title: Ruin and Rebirth
description: Ruin and Rebirth is a fantasy open-world factory building game with creature taming and breeding. In this playable creation myth, bring life back to a surreal, shattered, post-divine apocalyptic world where the gods have died.

title: Delivery Mystery
description: You play as a delivery man in a really really normal city of Deskadia.

title: Pacific Drive: Whispers Edition
description:
The Whispers Edition of “Pacific Drive” includes the base game and its new expansion, “Whispers in the Woods”. Experience the rise of a terrifying new group of Anomaly obsessed fanatics on your journey through the Olympic Exclusion Zone.

Pacific Drive is a first-person driving survival game with your car as your only companion. Navigate a surreal reimagining of the Pacific Northwest, and face supernatural dangers as you venture into the Olympic Exclusion Zone. Each excursion into the wilderness brings unique and strange challenges as you restore and upgrade your car from an abandoned garage that acts as your home base. Gather precious resources and investigate what’s been left behind in the Zone; unravel a long-forgotten mystery while learning exactly what it takes to survive in this unpredictable, hostile environment.

Navigate a surreal reimagining of the Pacific Northwest, and face supernatural dangers as you venture into the Olympic Exclusion Zone. Each excursion into the wilderness brings unique and strange challenges as you restore and upgrade your car from an abandoned garage that acts as your home base. Gather precious resources and investigate what’s been left behind in the Zone; unravel a long-forgotten mystery while learning exactly what it takes to survive in this unpredictable, hostile environment.

title: For Old Time's Sake
description: For old times sake is a wholesome roleplaying game about a student historian investigating a forgery. scoot and jump to explore the big open world and speak with the locals to solve the mystery!

title: Drownload
description: You wake up alone in an underwater bunker with no memory of what happened. Guided by Ed, a friendly robot, you explore, solve puzzles, and uncover dark secrets. But when another AI, Ev, reaches out, you must decide who to trust — and what’s really true.

title: The Answer Is Behind You
description: You, a professional translator, are contacted by a researcher asking for assistance with a text written in a language never seen before. The offer is too tempting to refuse... but what secrets does this long-forgotten language hold?

title: Meat Gone Wrong
description: Grab your fire-axe and smash your way out of this fast-paced shooter, ultra-violent graphic-novel inspired underworld where raging mutants, marauding mechs and menacing monsters prowl the darkness ready to tear you limb from limb!

title: Gobble Fantasy 2003
description: Gobble through a surreal maze-chase adventure packed with oddball characters and playful JRPG elements. A love letter to the software RPG Maker 2003.

title: Moon Bride
description: This is a classic platformer with hand-drawn graphics and animations.

title: Nowhere Belonging
description: A 15 minute account of not belonging. No save points. No going back.

title: Flappy Coq
description: A fast, comedic 2D arcade flyer where you flap a stubborn rooster through deadly gaps, chase high scores, and purchase skins. Tight controls, snappy retries, global leaderboards, and escalating obstacles keep every run tense, hilarious, and endlessly re-playable.

title: SCAMP 2025
description: SCAMP 2025 brings you 12 brand new maps by 5 different mappers for Chasm: The Rift. Created by The Shadow Zone community, SCAMP includes additional textures, models, monsters, music and sounds in what is the first ever (probably) publicly released community mod for this game!

title: Clankers!
description: Clankers! is a short incremental robot killing game. Kill Clankers, gather money and spend it on weapons and upgrades to stop Clankers from stealing our jobs!

title: Demon Stick
description: You are a demon trapped in a stick. A challenging game about crossing different levels of hell, inspired by the paintings of Hieronymus Bosch. Simple controls, endless falls, and no mercy.

title: Sunday School
description: You are trapped in a Sunday School, plagued by eerie childlike hallucinations. Observe your surroundings carefully to spot anomalies, and descend deeper only when you're certain it's safe.

title: Uranium Gays
description: Very serious toxic yuri game for toxic yuri jam and videotome jam 2 "love".

title: Gallery of Shadows: Lycans Returns
description: Gallery of Shadows: Lycans Returns is a Hunting and Stealth game where you must hunt humans to instill fear and recover the lost Territories of the Werewolves or "Lycans".

title: U.S.Z.I.O.K.
description: Sometimes, you may wonder what your life would look like if you had made a different decision at some point in time. That's what Zenon - the main character - does every day. He's forced to receive treatment inside a weird machine called N.E.M.O., which is supposed to be helping him recover from his partial amnesia. The space complex, however, doesn't really seem to be what it pretends to be. While Zenon is growing more and more suspicious of the events happening around him, the other part of the story takes place in his memories, where he's reliving his high school life.

title: N.O.N.E.Z.
description: Years of traveling and wondering about what could have been if you did something different can be tiresome for a human. The main character of the third and last installment of the N.E.M.O. trilogy knows well how it feels. For decades, Zenon has been trying to reclaim his past life and finally get his happy ending. During the story, you can accompany him while he uses the N.E.M.O. machine to try and discover the source of his misfortune. Will he succeed in finding his final destination or will it fail like everything in his past? See for yourself in N.O.N.E.Z.!

title: Undead Night Crew
description: You work for Undead Cleaning Services. The job: rid the world of the undead. Jump in online with friends, build a crew of unique auto-attacking fighters, and stack wild synergies in a stunningly illustrated zombie apocalypse. Casual enough to pick up, deep enough to keep you coming back.

title: Crypt of the Necrodancer: Shovel Knight
description: Delve into the depths of the Crypt of the NecroDancer as the noble Shovel Knight! Use any shovel at hand to spring from enemy to enemy, unearth treasure, and dig shortcuts deeper into the dungeon. Bring every foe to justice... shovel justice!

title: Idle looter
description: Slay endless monsters for legendary loot. Master deep crafting and prestige systems to grow infinitely. Collect an army of companions and conquer the unknown. Do you have what it takes to become a hero?

title: Zemsky Sobor
description: Russia, emerging from the Time of Troubles, faces a new trial. Kirsha, a battle-hardened Cossack, is pulled into a whirlwind of events as factions fight for the throne. The Assembly of the Land promises order—but the path to it is paved with intrigue and betrayal. Experience an action-adventure set in 17th-century Russia, with brutal combat and the ominous mood of uncertain times.

title: Microbian
description: Adapt, evolve, and pass on your traits if your kind is to survive in the dark and oppressive world of Microbian.

title: Warno: Nemesis #4 - Capital Defence
description: Safeguard the capital with two special defensive formations in Nemesis - Capital Defence featuring a host of new units, vehicles, and weapons. The mixed British Home Defence Region London takes to the fight with the elite Moscow-based 2-ya Tamanskaya Gvardeyskaya Motostrelkovaya Diviziya.

title: Virtual Ties Isekaijoucho Träumerei
description: Our protagonist, Kirishima Yu, returns from Tokyo to the island where he once lived and reunites with his childhood friend, Minase Seikai. Seikai, who had been on the verge of giving up on her dream of becoming an idol, looks somewhat gloomy. Wanting to make her smile again, Yu proposes that she debut as a virtual idol named "Isekaijoucho" based on an illustration he drew himself.

title: Life 2047 Escape Simulator
description: Life 2047: Escape Simulator is an atmospheric puzzle game set in a cyberpunk dystopia. The line is your path to freedom. Hack the system, evade surveillance, uncover hidden truths, and escape the loop where every day repeats. Are you a glitch — or salvation?

title: Skibidi Mahrt Kart: TrackMahrnia
description:
A competitive racing game featuring new and familiar sites from the Skibidi Mahr Universe!
Try beating the gold times in Time Trial, test your endurance in Marathon Mode or release some steam whilst exploring the free roam and all its mysteries...

title: ProMods Canada
description: ProMods Canada is a mod created by the team behind ProMods Europe, adding the Canadian province of British Columbia to the map.

title: Silly Survivors
description: Silly Survivors - a casual, pared-down roguelike where you play as an adorable but fiercely determined furry fox, armed with… a flashlight! Your mission is simple: survive waves of suspiciously silly ghosts who keep trying to get close (and pull some kind of silly stuff). Light is your main weapon.

title: Red Alert 2: Apocalypse Rising
description:
Red Alert 2: Apocalypse Rising is a standalone modification of Command & Conquer: Renegade.

The game is set in the vibrant universe of Red Alert 2 and offers an exciting new way to experience a unique ground-level perspective as an Allied G.I. or Soviet Conscript.

As the Allied Forces or the Soviet Union, battle to destroy each other’s bases using a vast array of exotic weapons and vehicles as seen in Command & Conquer: Red Alert 2.

title: Silivri
description: Silivri City — an open-world co-op game blending absurdity and dark humor! Complete missions, launder money, jump in your car, explore the city, or betray your friend. Every corner is nonsense, every NPC has a story. Your only goal: deliver the laundry... and don’t lose your mind!

title: Castle Cairn
description: Castle Cairn is a first-person psychological horror game set in 18th-century Scotland. Explore a forgotten ruin, uncover ancient Scottish folklore, and solve time-shifting puzzles to survive a curse where memory and myth twist into something real.

title: Sid Meier's Civilization VII: Tides of Power Collection
description: Explore new possibilities for your personalized empire in Sid Meier's Civilization VII with the post-launch paid add-on content of the Tides of Power Collection!

title: Girl Werewolf Hamlet Saves Christmas
description: Guide Hamlet (now a Girl *and* a Werewolf) as she deals with a murder mystery, a usurped throne, and a cursed sledding competition. Her emotions are your stats, so.... emote wisely. Or impulsively. Or with shame. It’s her kingdom. Everyone else is just tolerated in it.

title: Tic Tac Rogue
description: Tic Tac Rogue is an indie roguelite where DnD dice rolls meet tactical tic-tac-toe combat. Choose a class, battle silly pixel-art goblins and orcs, earn gold, and unlock magic items that reshape your strategy. Roll a D20 to attack and claim the board - every square is a chance to strike or survive.

title: Idleant
description: Manage your ant colony to accumulate maximum resources in this super relaxing idle, drawn entirely by hand.

title: Abiotic Factor: Temple of Stone
description: Visit mystery-laden ruins in the Temple of Stone - a Home World, which is a base-building portal location and a home-away-from-home. This pack also contains the official GATE Botanist uniform, which you can wear as you wander the hedge garden and ponder ancient, time-worn enigmas.

title: Airflow: Seattle ARTCC
description: Seattle ARTCC (KZSE)

title: Brick Blast
description: Brick Blast is designed for users to create and upload their very own games, while also being able to play other users creations.

title: Hentai Lunara
description: Hentai Lunara — a body bathed in moonlight. Raindrops slide down her skin, and each puzzle brings you closer to forbidden pleasure.

title: Cure: A Hospital Simulator
description: Manage an ER during the apocalypse, solo or with friends online: diagnose patients, design and grow your hospital, and defend against the undead while treating the living. Integrate with Twitch chat for even more fun!

title: Castle Idler
description: castle idler is a short, relaxing incremental tower defense game with no waves. upgrade towers, collect coins, and unlock powerful prestige upgrades to defend your castle.

title: A Happy Place
description: 3D Platformer Collectathon Throwback

title: Star Wars Galaxies: Ancient Empire
description: A non-profit, fan-made, community-driven remaster of the classic MMORPG Star Wars Galaxies

title: Luckyest
description: A quick, incremental scratch-and-reveal game focused on compounding choices - set stakes, uncover outcomes, cash out or push for bigger multipliers, and funnel winnings into permanent upgrades that accelerate income and unlock new tools over time.

title: The Binding of Isaac: Revelations
description: The Binding of Isaac: Revelations is a three-part mod for the rogue-like videogame, Binding of Isaac: Rebirth and its subsequent DLCs. The mod adds a variety of content, such as new monsters, items, characters, and most notably, new custom floors.

title: Oz
description: Adventure game based on The Wizard of Oz, starring Japanese singer and actress Eriko Tamura.

title: Key Of The Magic
description: Fantasy typing game.

title: Frontier Brain
description: Strategy turn-based game. This giant-robot battle game involves customizing your own mechs and programming their AI subroutines before heading out to battle.

title: Dystopia RPG
description: Dystopia RPG is an 8 bit style fantasy RPG where You lost a duel to a government's shaman and ended up trapped and sealed in a Cell Phone application. Explore the Dungeons, Combat monsters, Collect and Trade Items, Glitch the game & break free.

title: Maya: Ek Pishachini
description: A story-rich Indian themed horror. Fully voiced in Hindi with English subtitles. Explore a haunted haveli, solve sinister puzzles, and fight to rescue your friends trapped there.

title: Lost Tales: Karai Vosa
description: Lost Tales: Karai Vosa is a horror anthology game with retro graphics, and the first installment of Lost Tales, a series of different dark stories collected in Paraguay.

title: Red Riddles
description: Red Riddles is a first-person co-op horror puzzle game for 1-4 players. Search haunted locations, read and solve riddles written on walls, dig up and rescue buried teammates, and avoid monsters that hunt you.

title: Out of Place: Origin
description: Out of Place: Origin is a survival game built on attention and observation. In a diner where reality quietly collapses, notice the anomalies, capture them on camera, and survive… Because sometimes, the thing watching you isn't a mistake.

title: Priest Simulator: Her Ghost
description:
Her Ghost is an add-on containing a quest that continues the events of Vampire Show. A little funny, even more a little pathetic, but one of a kind. That is, one of a kind in the same way as Heavy Duty and Vampire Show, which makes it one third of a kind.

You'll have a few stupid dialogues and cutscenes and three additional exorcisms. This time, the tooth fairy has caused trouble in San de Ville, and Cardinal Godspeed, known from Infernal Radiation, will come to Orlok's aid.

title: The Three Vegan Entrepreneurs
description: It's 5 Days before Christmas, Santa Claus is trying a new Vegan diet to lose weight! He finds a shift at bad vegan restaurant, he takes the job for employee discounts at the food bar, but he gets pursued by creepy Mascots of the night. Stay alive, or it's your funeral...

title: 7 Nights Later
description: A psychological horror experience set in a lonely video rental store. Serve customers, manage your business, and survive the eerie events that unfold after dark.

title: Pad Quad
description: Get ready to bounce into action with Pad Quad, a lightning-fast platformer where padel meets pure arcade fun! Control adorable pixel mascots inspired by QUAD Sports rackets and race across futuristic arenas packed with enemies, traps, and tricky jumps.

title: Warhammer Survivors
description: Thrust into a universe of relentless war, become the embodiment of bullet hell in Warhammer Survivors, a fast-paced roguelite survivors game. Play as characters from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer: Age of Sigmar universes, collect and evolve iconic weapons and destroy endless swarms of enemies.

title: Rallyween
description: Race the clock, smash skeletons, upgrade your car in a spooky modern take on the top-down racer! Featuring nitros, wings, jumps, pumpkins, ghosts, deadly sunlight and more I've forgotten about!

title: Sim Hospital
description: Sim Hospital is a simulation game where you build and manage your own hospital. You'll encounter all kinds of interesting patients and events. Improving the skills of your doctors and nurses is just as important!

title: Sim Hospital: Emergency Rescue
description: “Emergency Rescue” is the first free DLC for Sim Hospital, featuring stage-based gameplay.

title: Buggy League
description: Buggy League is a unique, retro, futuristic buggy-racing game. Races take place inside force fields on space stations and barren planets.

title: Mach-1
description: Mach-1 is a supersonic race across the galaxy! Realistic physics meets mach-speeds on futuristic death-defying race courses! Do you have what it takes to survive?

title: It Digs Up
description: Be a spiderbot, crawl around on walls and ceilings, dig and drill, make critters go splat, find the exit.

title: Dwarf Miner
description: DWARF MINER A 2D mining adventure where you play as a dwarf digging deep to recover an ancient scroll. Face enemies, upgrade your tools, and uncover hidden treasures. The game saves progress, but the journey gets tougher with each update. Can you survive the depths and uncover all secrets?

title: Evil Pongon Game
description: A fast-paced 2D platformer where you dash, wall-jump, and speedrun through levels while avoiding enemies that steal your riches. Shatter hourglasses to trigger countdown escapes from the wall-phasing ENPHOSO, and face bosses in Undertale-style bullet-hell battles.

title: Baldo's Discovery
description: You play as Baldo, a man with great intellect. You are looking for your old friend John. You discover some strange things in the castle. There is no way back now. Well, let's go find our old friend John.

title: An Unexpected Arrival
description: You are lost in a dark forest. Your sanity is fading rapidly. You have little time before your past catches up with you. You must seek refuge; anywhere but the undergrowth of the forest which has you trapped, alone.

title: Recurring Nightmares
description: One of Martin's many recurring nightmares during April, 1887.

title: To Give Is To Force
description: Awake in a nightmare and discover the deep plot left malleable to interpretations. Mythology, fetal suicide, and more are hinted at within this surreal landscape. Now raise the volume, turn down the lights, and prepare to enter the world of stagnant growths.

title: Black Forest Castle
description: You wake up in an uninviting room with the foreboding feeling that something is lingering outside... You recall a dark figure stalking you the night before... No, it must have been your mind playing games with you. You remember tightly closing and locking the door before resting. The key is no longer in the keyhole and the door appears unlocked. Who, or what, could have gotten through from the other side? Is something after you?

title: Oh Silent Night
description: You play as a young child who wakes up in the middle of the night during Christmas Eve at a noise, and goes out on a search to find Santa.

title: Grunt's Castle
description: You need the turn off the generator. Do it fast. What a great story.

title: Emma's Story
description: You are Emma, daughter of esteemed scientist, Dr. Robert Coleman. Ever since his discovery of the mythical Orb of Power, he has vanished, leaving you alone in the family estate. With strange things happening, you wonder what has happened to him. The story begins as you wake up in your room to find an ominous note from your lover. As you play, you will unravel Emma's Story.

title: Zombie Escape
description: After a zombie apocalypse, you gather food and try to survive while aiming to achieve the highest score.

title: Olaf's Demise
description: You play as Olaf and your house may be haunted so be careful.

title: Gary: Dark Secrets
description: You're Gary. You recently got invited to a party by your close friend Nicholas. The party is hosted by a man named Thomas, who you hardly know anything about except that he's one of Nicholas friends. Later at the party, you're having a blast! The party is great, but maybe a little to great since you passed out after having a little to much to drink. While your asleep, thanks to some terrible nightmares, you wake up in the middle of the night, and notice that something's not right...

title: Amnesia: Rain
description: I fear my life is in peril. Where I am or how I got here I have no recollection of, for my memory is fragmented and my mind scattered. I find it necessary to write down my thoughts for fear of losing them again. I don't know how many times I have drifted in and out of consciousness, or for how long I have been here. I see visions beyond this nightmare, visions of wood and carpet instead of stone and dirt... I hear rain.

title: The Halloween
description: A special for The House franchise. The player's goal is to venture through the scenario.

title: 100 Ramen Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all?

description: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all?
