title: 100 Tavern Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all?

title: Hyper Demon PvP
description: Hyper Demon PvP is a free online 1v1 FPS. Master simple but deep mechanics and defeat opponents in intense duels to climb the global leaderboard.

title: 100 Atelier Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️‍Can you find them all?

title: Dispersio 3
description: Dispersio 3 is a retro-styled action platformer. As you progress through the game, you will face different obstacles, such as wind, water or antigravity. There's even a hard mode for hardcore players.

title: Realtime Mining Simulator
description: Have you always wanted to mine crypto coins? With the Realtime Mining Simulator this is no problem! Simulate your success with the crypto currencies in the 3D real-time simulation.

title: Limp Knight
description: War is over! Limp back home collecting fantastical sticks, reading letters from your wife as you travel the lands one leg at a time. Meet a colorful cast of knights and uncover the kingdom’s conspiracy one limp at a time in this comedic narrative adventure.

title: The Salesman
description: In the Salesman, you play as a recently laid-off employee trying to survive the grind of job applications, debt, and dwindling hope. Trade your belongings for ad-supported replacements as you slowly sell away your life in this psychological horror game

title: Zeverland
description: Welcome to Zeverland. Common sense is your best weapon against the Zeds. After figuring out the "not dying" part, grab some friends to save the world. Find a cure, build a rocket, or a tower too high for Zeds to climb. Nothing's off limits. You're here at the very start of the apocalypse. Go wild!

title: Deorum
description: Descend into the forsaken dungeon and fight the horrors in the dark. Gather occult materials, craft nightmarish coins, and settle your debt to the cosmic powers. Obey the Divine Festival.

title: Leaf It Alone
description: Finally, it's that time of the year to clean up this leafy mess. It's been a while since the last time you've done it, so don't waste any second and derust your raking skills!

title: Void Future: Hacking Protocol
description: In Void Future: Hacking Protocol, you play as a hacker in a cyberpunk world ruled by corporations. Hack, solve puzzles, and uncover a global conspiracy. Hunted by a system that never sleeps, you’ll need to stay hidden, outsmart surveillance, and fight to survive.

title: Badass Brigade
description: Throw a dude at another dude! Badass Brigade is a light-hearted 2D action game where you shoot, punch, grab, and throw your foes. Take on missions where you can explore the world and uncover a wide variety of weapons and gear for new ways to fight.

title: Autumn Aurora 2
description:
Autumn Aurora 2 it's modification made by small group from Poland which brings the autumnal atmosphere to the Zone and totally overhauls the graphics, audio and gameplay of S.T.A.L.K.E.R. Shadow of Chernobyl.

The second version of the Autumn Aurora brings the autumnal atmosphere to the Zone and totally overhauls the graphics, sound and gameplay of S.T.A.L.K.E.R. - Shadow of Chernobyl. The mod is built on the newest Zone Reclamation Project's core, it contains official AtmosFear for ShoC which has never been released before. AtmosFear has been extensively redesigned to match the autumn style. It also holds an official new Absolute Nature for ShoC (never released as standalone as well) with new tree models from AN3 CoP and some new ones. It is the perfect opportunity for every S.T.A.L.K.E.R. fan to immerse again into Chernobyl universe in completely different style this time!

title: Motorfish
description: Motorfish is a game about a fish with a motor-powered tail and a thirst for some underwater action. The game has a scratchy, cartoonish art style and a unique gameplay loop focused around flicking and parrying.

title: Ratshot
description: RATSHOT is a slick, fast paced platformer where you use the recoil of your gun to launch yourself through levels. Race through grimy streets and sewers while trying to get the best times and ranks, or play at your own pace and admire the graffiti-covered walls of NYC.

title: Zzz
description: Three short dreams

title: Figure It Out: The Tantrum Simulator
description: Beat the clock, tame her wrath, save the day.

title: Dragon Quest HD-2D Erdrick Trilogy Collection
description: Three legendary adventures. One definitive bundle.

title: NBA 2K26: Slam Edition
description:
The SLAM Edition includes NBA 2K26 and additional bonus content:

- 35,000 VC
- Full Series 1 Team Selection
- Triple Threat Park Free Agent Pack
- 5x Series 1 Packs
- 2-Hour 2XP Coin
- 10x 6 Types of Skill Boosts (10 Games)
- 10x 3 Gatorade Boosts (10 Games)
- SLAM Cover Athletes Shirt

title: Inazuma Eleven: Victory Road - Deluxe Edition
description: The deluxe edition of the latest entry in the character collection and football simulation RPG series, "Inazuma Eleven!" With an original story featuring new main characters, over 4,500 players from across the series' history to collect and train, as well as exciting online tournaments, you can play the game your way!

title: Dragon Ball: Xenoverse 2 - Future Saga: Chapter 4
description: The fourth chapter in the future saga series depicts an unprecedented alteration of history! Includes new Playable Characters, a new Extra Mission, new Parallel Quests, Additional Moves, Costumes, and more!

title: SpongeBob SquarePants: Titans of the Tide - Plankton's Portal Challenge DLC
description: Add more challenges and brand-new eerie locations to Plankton's Portal! Test your sliding skills in Sandy's Racing Trials! Keep your cool in Squidward's Haunted House and survive extra-hard boss fights on Mr. Krabs' treasure hunt!

title: SpongeBob SquarePants: Titans of the Tide - Search for SquarePants DLC
MineDeeper
description: MineDeeper is Minesweeper but with layers. Experience the old classic in a fresh and trippy way. Uncover new layers below the field to boost your run: less 50/50's, infinite layers and increasing difficulty.

title: Kittengumi Short: Chapter 0
description: Discover this prequel chapter of Kittengumi, which tells the story of what happened before the Sakabato was stolen, as well as different versions of the story that you can discover thanks to your decisions!

title: 3D Train Studio V9
description:
3D Train Studio allows you to plan and design miniature worlds on your own PC in a simple and fun way.

Whether it's a model railroad with tracks from popular manufacturers or a realistic railroad simulation, 3D Train Studio unites all the tools you need, under a modern and intuitive user interface.

title: Error: Ai.lien
description: "ERROR:Ai.lien" is a bishoujo horror adventure where she watches, learns, and slowly invades your everyday life— ordinary routines twist bit by bit, until the AI’s love transforms into madness.

title: Yongjiang River
description: This is a casual puzzle game, where the position of each game image is random and can be repeated.At first, it may be very chaotic,Then gradually place the image in the corresponding position,The image gradually becomes complete,Come and give it a try!

title: Verdure
description: Shape nature your way in a surreal playground of infinite plants and trees. Tweak their recipes, prune or let them flourish, and save your best creations into an ever growing collection.

title: The Last Salvage Squad
description: Battle enemy forces reminiscent of alien weapons from retro sci-fi works in this single-player 2.5D FPS.

title: Within Lattice
description: Within Lattice is a 2D logic puzzle game where you swap chunks of tiles in a grid to reach the objective.

title: The Core
description: Step into a world of mystery and self-discovery with The Core, an immersive action-adventure game. As an autonomous AI core, you awaken alone in a long-forgotten facility, your memory lost. Embark on a thrilling journey to uncover your true identity and unravel the purpose behind your creation.

title: Ship v Maze
description: Fly. Crash. Repeat. Avoid the obstacles for as long as possible, then try to do better.

title: Trapaze
description: As the character ventures through the intricate maze, fueled by curiosity and determination, each level presents a new mystery. With each challenge conquered, the character's understanding of the maze deepens, offering glimpses into its purpose and the minds of its creators.

title: Synthwave Smashers
description: Synthwave Smashers is a retro-inspired throwback to the classic brick-breaking arcade games of the '70s and '80s.

title: Showdown Next Week!
description: Showdown Next Week! is a choice-based adventure puzzle game where you must find a way to protect your village from the Demon King within seven days. For one week, wander around the small village—chatting, persuading, trading, and discovering—to explore different ways to defend it!

title: A Christmas Carol VR
description: In a blend of old and new media, we invite you to join us for a classical Dickensian recital featuring bleeding-edge motion-capture and interactive broadcast technology. Enjoy this live, digital performance from the comfort of your own home as up close and personal as you like.

title: Locus Equation
description: You are an anthropod, a life form synthetically crafted by AI. Your objective is to save the ones who are stuck on an uninhabited planet. Persuade, charm, manipulate: use your ultimate power—freedom of choice—in sci-fi role playing hyper variative game LOCUS EQUATION.

title: Laser Tank
description: This is a puzzle game. You must get your tank to the flag in every level. Your tank can move in four directions and can fire a laser that is used to move objects. The amount of moves and shots it takes to complete a level are recorded in a high score list. The scores are then compared with the current "Global High Score" file. You can get a current copy of the Global High Score file on LaserTank web site. If you beat one of the scores by making less moves to finish the level, then send me an e-mail with your "LaserTank.hs" file attached. I will update the website with your score; however, you will have to prove your score by recording the level and sending me the playback file [.LPB file]. Also, don't forget to rate the unrated levels you solve. You can use the LaserTank Level's Evaluator tool to do it.

title: Terram Reduc Protocol
description: This 2.5d platformer blends the nostalgia of 90s shooters with modern gameplay mechanics and graphic design. Move using the keyboard, aim and fire with the mouse, kill everything that crawls of flies, get through mazes full of deadly traps, survive battles with robotic bosses and save the Earth.

title: Goat Mode: Activated
description: A hilarious, challenging, and seriously addictive platformer. Ready to become THE GOAT? Choose your torments and create an increasingly impossible experience. Enter the arena. Jump, fail, repeat.

title: Shadowverse: Worlds Beyond - Skybound Dragons
description:
In Skybound Dragons, Shadowverse: Worlds Beyond's fourth card set, diversify your tactics with 76 new cards, 8 different exchange tickets, and 2 additional fully animated cards.

Meet new allies from Cygames' Granblue Fantasy and employ their Skybound Art and Super Skybound Art abilities, which can be activated after a certain number of turns, or sooner if you evolve followers. Furthermore, Sandalphon, Primarch Successor joins the fray with a unique Invoke ability, which will summon him directly from your deck once its conditions are met.

Hesitate not, Skyfarer, even in the face of overwhelming malice.
We, the Wedges—the Six Dragons—shall preserve the balance of this realm.
"Fear not these vast skies."

title: If You’re a Man, Hold On for Half a Song
description: This is an action shooter with extremely simple controls.Its gameplay duration is short but concise, with no filler content at all.The levels seem simple yet hide subtle twists, and there are plenty of little surprises waiting for you to discover!Anyway, it’s free—you can’t go wrong with it.

title: Super Dimensional Creator
description: In the world of games, every wonder exists—but for the truly extraordinary, look no further than Super Dimensional Creator!magine this: pieces don't just move forward, backward, left, or right—they also move up and down, “flying” through the air and “jumping” across multi-level boards!

title: No One Leaves the Field
description: A first-person folk horror game set on a cursed farm where the wheat shifts each time you enter. Search for your car keys, uncover the family’s dark ritual, and beware—something ancient walks between the stalks.

title: Pyramid Quest 2
description:
Pyramid Quest 2 is an exploration and treasure-hunting game inspired by classic platform games. The goal is to find the three parts of an artefact and open the gate to the next level while collecting diamonds and coins.
In this adventure, the player finds himself in a pyramid in the jungle surrounded by dense vegetation.
Traps, obstacles, and enemies from old days make the quest very dangerous and challenging.3D graphics packed in a nice graphics style, great 2.5D levels and proven gameplay gives you hours of fun.

title: Ben 10 Destroy All Aliens
description: A 3D game based on Ben 10: Destroy All Aliens. It is a video game.

title: CRU
description: You are the only one fighting back - tear through everything in order to close out the city's portal. CRU is a single-player, heavily atmospheric FPS that takes place in a fictional planet invaded by otherworldly abominations.

title: Noise’s Halloween Bash
description: Play as The Noise in this one level fan-game, inspired by the Crash Bandicoot and Rayman franchises. Jump, slide, dash and bash through a 2.5D world while collecting pumpkins to save the Halloween festivities!

title: Stack-Erz
description: Stack-Erz is a semi randomly generated action RPG which includes swords,magic and a lot more skills. Gear up your mercenary bot with powerful accessories and equipment to defeat monsters, complete contracts, level up, solve puzzles and ultimately destroy bosses that stand in your way.

title: The Dreaded Hut
description: A mysterious flood swallows a small village in the Philippines. Wade through the ruined homes, drowned fields, and whispers in the fog to search for your lost sister. Be careful of the water, some things don’t drown… they wake up.

title: Retronaut
description: A rogue star pilot lost between galaxies—upgrade your ship, harness ancient artifacts, and survive relentless alien hordes in this cosmic action roguelite.

title: Approaching Infinity: Shipyards
description: Design your own custom starting ship with a point-based system and access to every weapon and device in the game. Tow 5-deck shipwrecks to get more points. Space stations will offer more ships for sale, and the asteroid base will have a brand new ship upgrade service: the Shipwright!

title: Beak the Hunter
description: Beak the hunter is a 2D monster hunting game that follows the adventures of the master hunter, Beak. Explore a new and exciting world, and prepare yourself for hard battles against powerful and wild beasts in this soulslike adventure that will test your abilities!

title: Sweetie Candy Maze: Yellow Lemon
description: Dive into a vibrant candy world! Collect delicious sweets and find your way through playful yellow lemon mazes in this sweet and colorful adventure.

title: Cheri's Dollhouse: Forgotten Memory
description:
You wake up in an old puppet theater—trapped, disoriented, and with no memory of how you got here.

Investigate the room, as every object holds a clue, every note a fragment of something lost. But be careful—some memories are meant to stay buried.

title: Epics of Noche, Brain Busted
description: Noche tests out Shaylin's brain scanner in this short, 2-hour platforming spin-off of the EON book series.

title: Kyojin-tachi Zero: Prologue
description: A sequel to Kyojin-tachi, following Watanabe as he conducts a secret investigation into Netsect, the remnants of a hacker group that opposed the internet regulation laws enacted across multiple countries.

title: Kyojin-tachi Zero Div1
description:
An experimental digital novel continuing the world introduced in Kyojin-tachi Zero: Prologue. The story follows a new group of characters not previously seen in the series and represents another step toward the conclusion of the wider Kyojin-tachi Zero narrative.

Set within a world fragmented across geographical, temporal, spatial and transcendent boundaries, the game explores consciousness and the unconscious, neurons, the arbitrariness of language and the separation between individuals inhabiting an incomprehensible reality. Its narrative attempts to capture and reflect the psychological worlds of creators, imagined beings and created beings.

title: Eight Strange Corridors
description: A looping space full of subtle anomalies. Can you spot them and find your way out?

title: Pokémon: Special Chapter
description: Pokémon: Special Chapter is an RPG Maker fan game. Follow Red's adventures after the events of the Pokémon Adventures: Red Chapter GBA rom hack, as well as new playable stories for Blue, Green, Gold, Pink, and Ash.

title: Mega Man: Starburst
description: A new adventure starring Mega Man!

title: Cozy Tiny Home
description: Welcome to Cozy Tiny Home, a warm and heart-melting decorating game where you can design the most adorable spaces imaginable - and fill them with sweet animal friends!

title: Freedom Planet Plus
description: Freedom Planet Plus is a mod that restores cut features and DLC content, notably the ability to play as Torque and Spade.

title: Decrepit
description: Decrepit is a first-person action game with souls-like combat where every death drags you back into the depths. Learn the dungeon, master the combat, and find your way out of the forsaken castle.

title: Rocket Rally
description: Simple controls. Fast runs. Top-down 2D rally game. Race short courses, beat target times, and go for the gold!

title: Ittzy Fearless
description: Ittzy Fearless is a difficult physics-based action game. Play as Ittzy the fire spirit and use your swift moves and devastating strikes to tackle chaotic waves of enemies, projectiles and explosions.

title: Emerald Blue
description:
This game is a Bullet hell Manic shooter, Meaning you will have to lead bullets and maintain firm in your position while killing enemies, But... The difference in this game is that you have to be aggressive with enemy formations.

Select between Power or Speed modes, and use your Pierce Lance to obliterate enemies and gather their Emerald stones to rack up your Emerald Chain. But if things get to hectic, use your Sword Slash if charged...

Rush through 4 score dense and challenging stages and bosses, going against whatever stands in the way of your mission...

title: Chess v Checkers
description: Chess v Checkers is a mashup of two popular games Chess and Checkers. Play as either side on the game board through three distinct game modes.

title: Kingdom Of Choices
description: Kingdom of Choices is a Rogue-Lite visual novel game with multiple outcomes. Players must make challenging decisions regarding politics, military, economics, health, religion, and the public as their characters evolve. Send them to rule your kingdom!

title: Cats in Paint
description: A group of little kittens has quietly hidden in the painting, waiting for you to discover them!

title: Agyaat
description: Agyaat is a first-person single-player horror game where you play as Acharya, drawn into the haunted depths of Ambika’s House to uncover a dark truth buried in Indian folklore. Explore, survive, and piece together the mansion’s twisted past — but beware, the house remembers every step you take.

title: Our Ordinary Home
description: A psychological thriller where you assemble fragmented memories and hidden clues to uncover the truth behind a disturbing incident.

description: Accessory: Spotted Cat Tail will be added.

title: Mitsume
description: Mitsume is a cooperative horror game for two players where each participant controls a fragment of the same fractured psyche. Players must work together to investigate anomalies within a mental realm as they attempt to break free from an endless cycle of negativity.

title: Military Escape
description: Escape from an abandoned military base in this horror survival game. Explore dark corridors, avoid terrifying dangers, and fight for your life as you uncover the secrets hidden within the ruins.

title: Coffee Fox Kim Samwol
description: A fantasy romance visual novel about Samwol, a nine-tailed fox who has lived for 3,000 years. Experience her story of love, destiny, and choices in the human world, set in a cozy café. Featuring full voice acting, stunning illustrations, and immersive storytelling.

title: DianQi
description: The protagonist played by the player was suddenly shouted by the name of recognizing his ancestors, and suddenly found that everything seemed to be as simple as imagined ...

title: 100% Orange Juice: Suguri & Hime Winter Costumes
description: Contains new skins with an all-new look for the popular duo from Suguri series: Suguri and Hime. The costumes are themed after the pair's appearance in Sora. If user does not have Suguri and Hime unlocked in 100% Orange Juice, DLC grants direct access to them.

title: Finding Cats
description: In the serene world of Finding Cats, embark on a relaxing journey. With soothing music, use your mouse to explore detailed scenes and spot hidden cats. Slow down and immerse yourself in this cozy, peaceful atmosphere.

title: ConnecTitty
description: Immerse yourself in a relaxing puzzle experience.Progress through 27 levels of increasing difficulty while enjoying calm, soothing music. This game contains suggestive and erotic imagery intended for adults only.

title: Boardfall Zero
description: Try Boardfall for free! Progressively harder waves of enemies fall from the sky. Capture them to earn gold, and then purchase your own reinforcements to drop onto the board.

title: Pot
description: Pot!: Random adventure game. Move/roll to avoid dangers, navigate levels. Start with a unique pot to break obstacles, defeat enemies. Choose routes, collect modules/Bo Coins for items, strengthen your pot and win!

title: Freefall '95
description: Fast paced, arcade-like, 90’s inspired action packed fun! Play as a passenger on board a doomed flight stuck in a twisted time loop in the year 1995. Explore a wild time-bending narrative while stacking up trick combos, collecting items, earning coins, upgrading abilities and dodging debris!

title: Holy Valkyrie Exs-Tia 3
description: From hit Japanese ending developer Lusterise! Monsters soon begin to emerge again. Marina Katsuragi transforms into ExS-TIA once again to defeat them.

title: Core Destroyer
description: Coredestroyer is a horror-action game where you run through dark corridors, hide from monsters, and destroy their cores before they catch you.

title: Be Missed and Remembered: The Letter from Mayoiga
description: The setting is 50 years ago, Showa 47. The protagonist, a high school student, is heading to his grandparents’ countryside home. A short trip taken during summer vacation, a yearly tradition. Spending time with his sister, peacefully interacting with the villagers, but…

title: Tz Mini Stg Collection
description: This book contains several of tamazusa's small-scale STG works, mainly game jam works.

title: Og Frog Fr
description: A platformer where you play as Ogie the Frog and must use your jump strength precisely. Either master your jumps to race to the finish line, or to help critters and collect gems along the way.

title: RoboFarm
description: Build, automate, and decorate your dream farm! Deploy robot workers, unlock powerful upgrades, and watch your crops thrive while you relax, raising profits to your satisfaction. Save and share your creations, tune in with the music, and experience the world of RoboFarm.

title: Torerowa
description: Explore dungeons in your spare time! Roguelike dungeon RPG with a party of up to 3 players to challenge dungeons!

title: The Haunted Spot
description: The Haunted Spot is a 2D Top-Down survival horror game based on the story of a paranormal enthusiast called Jack who arrived at a haunted hotel in order to experience the paranormal.

title: Qilich Izidan
description: Embark on an epic solo adventure in Qilich Izidan – The Sword’s Trail. Explore ancient castles, overcome puzzles and traps, and reclaim Amir Temur’s lost sword. Realistic parkour, dynamic sounds, and immersive challenges await—all crafted by a single dedicated Uzbek developer

title: Monster Cards: Plus License
description: A DLC that unlocks additional customization features to enhance your card creation freedom. Make your cards more free, more luxurious!

title: New Lands: The Shadow of Alvaria
description: Messages in bottles become a map leading to a great mystery!

title: Meg's Monster: Lost Memories
description: Delve deeper into the world of Meg's Monster through the eyes of five beloved characters and unearth harrowing secrets from the past in this short, episodic prequel DLC.

title: StarFox: Game&Watch
description: StarFox: Game&Watch aims to preserve and update the original LCD title released by Nelsonic Software and Nintendo from 1993! This version not only comes with the benefit of being able to be played on modern hardware but is also packed with many quality of life improvements; from achievements to a new balanced mode, you’re sure to sink many hours in this polished gem from the past!

title: Roughly Crafted
description: Roughly Crafted is a craftsman simulator where you slap together monster bits and odd materials into one-of-a-kind weapons. Run your own shop: experiment with designs, bargain with adventurers, and grow your collection of crafting parts. Remember: the right tool can save a hero’s quest!

title: Moaning Moron of the Mountain
description: Moaning Moron of the Mountain is an adventure thriller that puts you in the place of a college student who got a love letter and an invitation to the local mountain peak. But be warned, there is a mysterious man on the mountain harassing hikers. Sneak past him and meet your sweetheart!

title: Get In Get Out
description: Pixel-art judgment game about trust and paranoia. Interrogate arrivals, scan for symptoms, and make moral calls as a guard. Let them in, turn them away, or stop the threat. Randomized traits, scarce tools, authoritarian regime, multiple endings. Add to your wishlist!

title: Gobotix: Duo
description: Guide two tiny robots through clever 3D isometric puzzles; solo or in co-op. Every click adds a new note to the game’s looping beat, making each run sound unique. Free to play, with optional supporter DLCs that add nothing but love.

title: Stoneveil
description: A dark, competitive turn-based card game where you wield six elemental Stones to summon, scheme, and conquer in a world stripped of luck and ruled by strategy.

title: Alex Kidd and the Miracle Gems
description: We all know Sonic got reinvented for the Dreamcast era. Have you ever wondered what Alex Kidd might have been like if it had been reinvented for the Sonic era? Alex Kidd and the Miracle Gems explores this "what if" with a Genesis-styled Alex Kidd fangame with all the speed and action of Sonic. Alex Kidd and the Miracle Gems is a loose sequel to Alex Kidd in Miracle World and Alex Kidd: The Lost Stars, with other nods to the Alex Kidd series and classic SEGA throughout.

title: Maid Moving Boxes
description: An anime android maid and her work drone are meeting a quota at the warehouse! A simple yet engaging game about the monotonous, relaxing process of working as a mover. Short but challenging levels, multiplayer, and lots and lots of boxes await you!

title: Dig Baby Dig Company
description: An online co-op horror game with 1-4 players. Explore and dig through strange alien fields, face hostile creatures, and harvest energy matter... all to satisfy the cruel demands of your master.

title: Aquanore
description: A cozy idle aquarium game: collect, breed, and sell fish, shape your tank with decorations, grow your economy, and relax while your fish earn for you.

title: Orbital Frenzy
description: Orbital Frenzy is a blast from the past where players must survive waves of intergalactic foes in an arcade style shooter with a unique orbital movement mechanic. With a secret ending and hidden story elements we hope you can stand a chance against the intergalactic onslaught!

title: No Kings Tiny Defenders
description: Cozy roguelike tower defense where every run is unique. Build, adapt, and defend a world with no kings.

title: Gilroy's Grove
description: Step into the forest where your shovel is both your weapon and lifeline. Fight back against twisted forest creatures, claim their corrupted seeds, and bring them to your farm and grow your weapons. Restore the forest plant by plant, Will you break the curse, or will the forest claim you too?

title: Drug Empire
description: Drug Empire is a casual simulator game where you grow, synthesize and distribute products to build your underground empire. Manage production, inventory, and distribution network while unlocking new ways to expand your operation!

title: Crushing on the Clock
description: Your 9-to-5 is now a dating sim. Charm coworkers, then date them in a unique turn-based "rizz" combat system. Shop, workout, improve your job performance and yourself and you will find your way to love!

title: Bunnies & Ballgames!
description: Bunnies and squirrels play soccer! Navigate environmental hazards! Explore the critters' home to find powerups!

title: Ravenmoore Psychiatric Hospital
description: Explore an oppressive and terrifying environment where you play as a young man who infiltrates the old and abandoned Ravenmoore Psychiatric Hospital in search of the harsh reality hidden behind this place. Every sound can be a sign of danger... Don't let them find you, and especially not HER......

title: Dynamite Dashers
description: Throw bombs, upgrade your skills, and survive endless waves of enemies in this fast-paced roguelike action game. Build your explosive arsenal, discover powerful combos, and see how long you can stay alive!

title: Go Ape Ship!
description: Go Ape Ship! is a frantic co-op multiplayer game for one to eight players. Work with your crew of daring Astrochimps to master an expanding collection of tasks, respond to emergencies, unlock new rooms and upgrades for your spaceship, and safely reach the stars. Survive together. Or not at all.

title: I woke up in the house of a fat man: he's over 30 years old and loves beer and games
description: Escape your beer-fuelled future. After waking up in an unfamiliar place with a pounding headache, you realise that you have become a prisoner of Alfaskuf. Your future is a never-ending game of tanks and beer madness. To escape, you must challenge the master of this gloomy labyrinth.

title: Crimson Faith
description: Crimson Faith is a classic 90s survival horror experience.

title: Kishki
description: The action unfolds in a small town in Russia. You will have to plunge into the life of a not quite ordinary Russian student who recently moved into a dormitory. A story about friendship, hatred and something else awaits you.

title: Lexispell
description: Strategy meets physics, in this roguelike word game, where you combine spelling with cool upgrades to score high.

title: Horses of Hoofprint Bay
description: Horses of Hoofprint Bay is a lovingly hand-drawn 2D point and click barn buildup game. Take care of your horses, train them to build up their strength and confidence, and compete for prize money! Breed adorable foals, hire and manage staff, and build the stable of your dreams!

title: Begraved
description: A cosy & dark first-person co-op dungeon crawler where you loot cursed crypts, dodge traps, and flee from things that should not move. Escape with treasures snatched from the dead. Decorate your hideout, uncover buried secrets, and remember: the Taxman always comes for his due.

title: Side Hustle
description: Welcome to the Side Hustle program! You have 5 days to dispose of defective androids and earn the prestigious City of Light citizenship! Your freedom HAS a price, and it’s a great deal!

title: PiPu Party
description: PiPu Party is a chaotic party puzzle-platformer game with a shared 3-slot symbol backpack. Pick and put symbols to alter the level. Co-op or outsmart your friends.

title: Rakuen: Ai Kawarazu na Boku. no Baai
description: The player takes the role of a nameless protagonist that the script refers to as Boku (boku is a word one can use to refer to themselves in Japanese. It's less formal than watashi, but not to the point of words like ore). Boku is a ronin that moves to Tokyo in hopes of being able to study and prepare himself for the university entrance exams. His hobbies as an artist and the myriad of temptations of the big city have kind of caused him to waste his time away, playing games and watching anime instead of focusing on studying. His need for a job eventually landed him a job at MoonEarth, an eroge studio that at the time was needing a character designer. The studio's fate takes a turn for the worse when the scenario writer decides to entirely drop out just as the crew is producing their first title.

title: Bear Brigade: Ocean Attack!
description: A twist on the tower-defense genre, play as a bear tribe chief defending their home against the forces of the ocean as they attack you in anger and retaliation due to overfishing. Place towers, command minions, and defend the camp from the enemy.

title: Fright Train
description: Fight through a train overtaken by monsters and survive Antarctica’s cold as paranormal special agent Doug Barker in this chilling single-player third-person survival horror game.

title: Sanctum: Yogscave
description:
Coffee Stain Studios have teamed up with The Yogscast to bring their signature 'Joffo Cake' fuelled humour to Sanctum in the free DLC, Yogscave!

As the ruling elite in Elysion One, the brightsiders live a life of decadence but this luxury comes at a terrible cost to the less fortunate members of society, who toil in factories below the surface - securing minerals to craft weapons to defend against invaders. Simon and Lewis are two miners who have found themselves on the night-shift to end all night-shifts. After Simon's "amazing" idea to increase Joffo Cake storage by 46% by diverting power from the core's energy containment shielding, the night was off to a great start! Unfortunately this idea backfired as the reduced shielding attracted unwanted attention from some of the Yogscave's more sinister denizens. The invaders are different this time, they appear to be organised by some far more nefarious mind.

Experienced at dealing with the odd Barret Bat and Blessed Boar here and there, Simon and Lewis are still unable stop these invaders and require your help! Can you save the world? And more importantly can you save the Joffo Cakes?!

This DLC adds the 'Yogscave' map to your library of accessible content. With this DLC, you will be able to host games on this map and engage in both single and multi-player conflict.

title: MTT Sports
description:
This is a web-based Texas Hold'em poker game. Players can participate in free multi-table tournaments to get the platform's exclusive gaming currency—MTT TOKEN, which can be used to register for higher-level tournaments.
The game currently includes various formats such as No-Limit Texas Hold'em tournaments, Bounty Hunter tournaments, and Sit & Go (SNG) matches, while also providing access to real-time global player rankings.

title: The Kepler Experiment
description: The Kepler Experiment is a survival-horror first-person shooter, drawing inspiration from games like Half-Life, Amnesia and System Shock 2.

title: Chefware
description:
CHEFWARE is a game where you try to get hired as a chef through intense Warioware inspired micro-games.
Meet Magnus, the rough and tough head chef of one of the highest, most prestigious restaurants around. There's no other jobs hiring, so may as well give his place a shot, right?

title: Prophet Margin
description: Turn humble villages into a thriving network of trade and prosperity. Inspired by Euro board games, Prophet Margin is a cozy city-builder, a thinky strategy puzzler where every road, resource, and connection creates new opportunities. Can you maximize the profits and please the gods?

title: Boardlike
description: Classic tabletop games meet roguelite elements and card-based combat. Dice rolls, fate cards, deadly encounters, minigames, and countless unknowns await you in this strange adventure.

title: Harvest Dice: Abundia’s Blessing
description: Harvest Dice: Abundia's Blessing is a dice and card-driven roguelike settlement-building game, where you must allocate dice, trigger cards, and generate resources to develop your settlement. Will your expedition endure the relentless trials and survive the biting blizzards?

title: Sweep Strike
description: Face off against explosive critters in this cartoony roguelike where every battle unfolds on Minesweeper grids! Reveal tiles to strike and avoid enemy traps, build your inventory to evolve your strategy, and push your luck through intense runs packed with chaotic surprises.

title: Dire Echo
description:
In the near future, humanity is steadily expanding into the depths of space. You are an astronaut on a routine but important mission: follow a designated route to a remote station and deliver technical data.

Along the way, command contacts you with an additional request — retrieve documents from the research vessel "Echo-7", which recently went silent. The silence is attributed to a recent geomagnetic storm disrupting communications.

As you approach Echo-7, you attempt to contact the crew — but there’s no response. The ship appears functional from the outside. Inside — nothing.

No welcoming party, no signs of life. Just empty corridors, scattered personal belongings, and the unsettling feeling that you're not alone.

Key Features

Realistic graphics — visual fidelity enhances the feeling of unease

️ Haunting atmosphere — silence, isolation, and growing tension follow your every step

Immersive sound — rich audio design pulls you deep into the experience

title: Tabula
description: A mind-bending, level-based puzzler about overlapping computer windows to create traversable, top-down landscapes. Delve into the heart of an unusual operating system, one folder at a time!

title: Motoscafo
description: Choose the loadout for your speedboat, and get ready to to save the day in this topdown 2D action shooter! Make your way to save the people of Hostia Bay from the threats of weird gangs, cartoony villains and big monsters — be the hero that injustice fears, be Motoscafo!

title: Augmented Fear
description:
Augmented Fear is a horror puzzle game set in a dark and oppressive cyberpunk universe.
Trapped in a mysterious district, you must find a way out and survive against aggressive creatures.
Use augmented reality to uncover the secrets hidden within.

title: Little Old One and the Witch
description: A Lovecraft roguelite about an orphan and her interdimensional cats. Travel through strange worlds, collect relics, build weird combos, and face confusing moral agendas in every realm. People are just too complicated… I’d rather stay home and make games.

title: Elestrals Awakened
description:
In a world shaped by Gods and Titans, the elemental forces that once held balance have begun to unravel. As darkness stirs and conflict brews among the realms, the Gods call upon new Champions to rise.

Elestrals Awakened is 2.5D single-player action-adventure, monster tamer RPG video game that puts you at the center of the Elestrals Universe. Step into the role of a Caster, forge a bond with a Spirit companion, and explore the elemental lands as tensions rise and ancient powers awaken!

title: The Biorift
description: 2.5D action shooter with metroidvania elements and episodic presentation. Each level is a new chapter, new style, new enemies and challenges. The game combines dynamic battles, transitions between dimensions and saving survivors.

title: Derelict Star
description: A precise momentum-based platformer that emphasizes exploration and navigation puzzles. Run and jump your way through a wide variety of obstacles and challenges as you explore an abandoned derelict freighter.

title: Bella-Anna's Head
description: 2008, Spring. Bella-Anna's body was found near the railroad tracks. The body was headless. No one can find the girl's killer, and her head. But no one knows... That that head has been with me for a long time.

title: Sir Noggin
description: Sir Noggin is a platformer inspired by the glorious 8-bit days and in the style of the Master System. Relive the days where the controllers only had a couple of buttons and you'd have to re-tune in your television sets.

title: Animal Tilt-A-Show
description: Animal Tilt-a-Show is a delightful casual logic game where your task is to stack a variety of adorable circus animals on a wobbly see-saw to maintain perfect balance! Test your skill and strategy as you carefully place elephants, lions, donkeys and more.

title: Darkzan Adventure
description: Darkzan Adventure is a Medieval Arcade RPG full of humor, fast-paced action, and unusual characters. Explore mysterious lands, face the cult of Darkzan, and uncover bizarre events while playing solo, in co-op, or even in idle mode

title: Burg Schreckenstein: Der Dieb von Burg Schreckenstein
The Saint Wife’s Newlywed Trials
description: Play as both Dirk and Marianne. As Dirk, head to the Adventurers' Guild and complete requests to rank up. Fend off monsters in turn-based RPG combat and explore dungeons to obtain items and earn the money you need to get by. As Marianne, grow crops and help out the other villagers. Develop the village by interacting with your new neighbors and assisting them with their problems.

title: Jump To Stratos
description: Jump To Stratos is a Rage Physics Platformer that takes place in a cyberpunk city, your goal is to jump your way through the city and past obstacles to reach the top.

title: Dark City: London
description:
Dark City: London is the first installment of Dark City Series by 4Friends Games.

The Bonus Game has Charles Dickens as the protagonist as he unveils the true story of "A Christmas Carol".

title: Goethe's Last Laugh
description: Take control of Jack Faust, a heinously corrupt police lieutenant in service of Gondolas City, the capital of some deranged monster island.

title: Open Your Eyes
description: Fix your gaze on this grid-based puzzle game as you progress through levels by opening every eye. Discover eyes of different styles and properties and earn top ranks by focusing your vision and clearing stages with the least possible moves.

title: Jewel Quest: Match 3 Adventure
description: Set sail with Emma on a daring expedition across exotic islands in Jewel Quest: Match 3 Adventure. With hundreds of dazzling Match-3 levels, you'll dive into a world of mystery, romance, and danger as you chase the legend of Whitebeard's lost treasure.

title: Dark City: Munich - Collector's Edition
description:
Dark City: Munich is the second installment of Dark City series by 4Friends Games.

- Rescue Hansel and Gretel in the bonus game!
- Replay your favorite HOPs and mini-games!
- Find all the morphs, collectibles, and gain achievements!
- Enjoy exclusive wallpapers, screensavers, music, videos, and more!
- Never get lost with the strategy guide!

title: Truck Simulator US Driver
description:
Step into the shoes of a true TRUCK SIMULATOR US DRIVER, a captivating game that takes you across the endless highways of the United States. Whether you're passionate about trucks or simply looking for a realistic driving experience, this simulator offers the chance to explore major cities, deliver various cargo, and live the life on the open road.

TRUCK SIMULATOR US DRIVER is more than just a game – it’s a virtual journey through the heart of America, filled with challenges, strategic decisions, and relaxing moments on the road. Whether you're a simulation fan or just seeking a unique adventure, this title offers an authentic and engaging experience. Start your engine and conquer the roads of the United States!

title: The Lord of the Rings Online: Legacy of Morgoth
description: The Lord of the Rings Online: Legacy of Morgoth is the twelfth expansion for the MMORPG, The Lord of the Rings Online (LOTRO). In this new expansion, players must venture to the deserts and marshlands of Near Harad. The expansion continues the epic questline, Song of Waves and Wind, and features 350+ new quests.

title: Castlevania: Symphony of Horrors
description:
This game is a fan project and is not intended for profit. All rights and ownership belong to Konami.

A love letter to the early series, Castlevania - Symphony Of Horrors is a fan made, non-profit, free to play PC game made by First Serve Gaming where you take control of Simon Belmont. The game is a recreation of Castlevania 2: Simon's Quest made by Konami in 1987. Symphony Of Horrors features an expanded world from the original, with new locations, larger areas, more enemies, more bosses, more items to collect and a larger journey then ever before!

title: Hallowed Legends: Templar - Collector's Edition
description:
Hallowed Legends: Templar is the second title of the Hallowed Legends series. This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won’t find in the standard version.

The Collector’s Edition includes:
- Bonus gameplay
- Integrated Strategy Guide
- Wonderful Wallpapers

title: Renai Karichaimashita: Koikari - Love For Hire - After Hours
description: Contains both fandiscs for Koikari: Love for Hire.

title: Chill Planet
description: On this planet destined to perish, let's embark on the ultimate chill journey. This deck-building adventure game depicts girls traveling leisurely toward Hokkaido in a world doomed to destruction by an impending meteor strike.

title: Janitron
description:
JANITRON is a fast-paced 2D arcade-style game.

Navigate each building and CLEAN UP.

title: Tansaikigou: Sec Life, Monochrome Cube
description: Main character's parents get killed on the Christmas night by some red shadow. Eleven years later a wave of mysterious murders occurs at the town. All the witnesses can only say that killer just disappears in the air. Main character already knows by his past memory that the murders are caused by a vampire. He takes a sword and stands on the path of revenge. Mysterious girls join him in this quest.

title: Late Night Mop: Minimum Wage
description: The demon returns in this unofficial sequel to Late Night Mop (a game by Lixian)!

title: Lu Dreams
description: A compilation of dreams that you can explore.

title: Molly n' D.O.G.'s Records
description:
You are Molly, a dog accompanied by her D.O.G. (Digging operational guide) who is exploring a ruined world to find everything that remains under its rubbles.

Your goal is to find relics hidden behind rocks, so you must select one of 3 tool to dig and hope to find it before it's too much broken and the whole structure collapse.

After you've found them, you can check the artefact inside Molly and D.O.G.'s Records to learn more info about it.

title: Embryogenesis
description: A multiplayer twin-stick metroidvania. Stay together or split up. Explore and achieve your goals, whatever they may end up being.

title: Tsuyu ga Akeru Made
description:
"Oh, if only I could befriend the rain."

The one who appears before the protagonist is a non-human being in form a young man claiming himself as the rain.

title: Ijimerarekko ni Happy End ha Odozureru no ka
description:
Choose whether to save or not Mitsuki, a bullied girl.
This visual novel has 3 endings, however all of them will leave a bad aftertaste.

title: Saihate no Zangeshitsu
description: Saihate no Zangeshitsu is a short, atmospheric visual novel about a lone protagonist drawn to a rundown confessional room at the edge of the world.

title: Retrospect
description: "retrospect" is a novel game consisting of five chapters. Trace the memories of the ghosts and learn about them. That is the only mourning you can do.

title: Open or Die
description: In front of you are boxes. Some contain diamonds, while others contain death. How many times are you willing to take a risk to win in this deadly gambling show? Manipulate the odds and use items to emerge victorious. What will prove stronger, your greed or your instinct for self-preservation?

title: Magical Princess Lily
description: Go on a journey with Ritsu and Lily to uncover the secrets behind the Kuzono Group, a shady pharmaceutical corporation with nefarious plans. Join Ritsu as she uses Lily's power to transform into a magical girl to take on supernatural enemies in this thrilling adventure!

title: Tad-Bubble!
description: The pond is a tyrannical place hardly fit for little Tad-Bubble. Luckily, Tad has the power of the Miracle Bubble on his side! Help Tad fight off waves of dangerous boss bugs, boss fish, and boss more in this GameBoy homebrew.

title: We Can Smell It (maybe)
description: An attempt at making one of those old/weird Mac games.

title: 0 de Waru Kinou
description: 0 de Waru Kinou is a short school-set visual novel about a class of students carrying hidden darkness; you, as the protagonist, navigate relationships and choices that reveal each classmate’s troubled past. The game emphasizes interpersonal drama, moral ambiguity, and multiple routes.

title: Summertime Sadness
description: This interactive experience is based on some Supr's other games and their friends' games (Disco/Discomfort, for example). Also, it is inspired by Lovecraft books and the True Detective show.

title: Cursifix
description:
A letter arrived at the grand cathedral from a small village in the western lands, pleading for aid. They wrote that the villagers had fallen under a terrible curse. It's turned people into lumps of flesh.

Father had warned me that it might be something dreadful... Yet what kind of servant would I be, if I turned my back on those in need?

title: Ninja Game
description: Immersive stealth action ninja simulation! Act like a ninja. Sneak up on a ninja. Strangle a ninja. Dropkick a ninja off a cliff. Throw a ninja out the window. Kidnap a ninja. Make friends with a ninja in real life and play splitscreen coop together!

title: Hallowed Legends: Ship of Bones
description: You’ve just crash-landed near the village of Erlenbourg, where a ghostly figure has been stealing souls. Follow the trail of the mysterious woman in white and discover the secret behind her terrible task! Once you find the Book of Fire, you’ll have fun matching its relics to the game world, in a special added feature of Hallowed Legends: Ship of Bones.

title: The Apothecary of Trubiz
description: The Apothecary of Trubiz puts players in the role of a medieval pharmacist who must decode cryptic manuals and create potions for their patients. Players solve puzzles by translating fictional language texts, mixing ingredients, and determining the correct prescriptions for those seeking remedies in this compact puzzle-focused experience.

title: Music Game
description: A deeply customizable rhythm game that generates playable charts and colours from any audio file. Play solo or locally with up to 6 lanes, modify gameplay, and compete on global leaderboards with reactive visuals and controller support.

title: Knightwatch
description: By day - Build defenses and towers. By night - grab weapon of your choice and fight off relentless waves of zombies, undead, werewolves and other monsters. In a FPS x Tower Defense game where you defend a winter town overshadowed by the King’s castle.

title: Tomodachi 8in1
description: Tomodachi 8in1 is an experimental PICO-8 arcade of eight 00's nostalgia themed experimental games. It is a mix of narrative, musical, and interactive games and loosely based on the characters of Terranova.

title: The Girl In White
description: What seems like a miracle at first quickly reveals itself to be more of a nightmare, as Long realizes that restless Ghosts have always Surrounded Us—unseen, until now...

title: DateBoy
description: DateBoy involves playing on a Ga retro handheld video game console while you're on a DATE! Hence, DateBoy. DATE. BOY. Get it? DateBoy.

title: Demon Positive
description: Demon Positive is a blast 'em up shooter where you run from the Devil and his demons. Gain crazy powerups that make you feel like a demon! Collect all three items, awaken the Sleeping Imps, and complete the Ritual.

title: Shadereap
description: An ordinary farmer loses his family when monstrous creatures overrun the world. Now he must fight, solve puzzles, and search for a way to save his daughter.

title: The Midnighters
description: The Midnighters is a survival horror game for 1-4 players where you hunt for cursed treasures. Find and seize the treasures claimed by terrifying creatures. But as you do, heed the devil's whispers and never trust your eyes.

title: Heroes of Magic and Steel
description: Build a team of 3 heroes, prepare your deck and dominate tactical battles on a hex grid. Every run demands a different strategy and each card played matters, only going back to your deck on the next run.

title: Grayton the Detective
description: Grayton the Detective is a narrative adventure game about a homeless man who once lived in wealth and comfort, now showers with a kettle, and solves petty mysteries on the streets of Cleveland. However, with the disappearance of mysterious Golden Spoon, everything may change.

title: Eternity Breaker
description: Build your class, break the cycle. A 2.5D turn-based roguelike where the skills you gain become your class.

title: Spirit Magician
description: Embark on a challenging adventure to obtain the magic book. Overcome challenging trials with the various choices provided during your adventure. It may be a difficult adventure, but you will feel the joy of taking on the challenge!

title: Thousand N' Thousand: Mimico
description: Short story driven RPG-esque top-down adventure with simple puzzles. Escape the Igneferia mini-mall before it's too late. May fortune be on your side!

title: Neoditronix
description: The dreamcore rhythm experience.

title: ...Vincent: Mansion of The Dead
description: A twin stick shooter survivors-like with low-poly pixel art graphics and simple controls. Protect the ghost Winry from the Dark Lord's army. Let the soul harvest, Begin!

title: Children of Kronos
description: In this fast-paced retro FPS, you awaken in a Daedalus Industries mining facility near the moon Titan with nothing but the gun in your hand and a barcode on your wrist. Manipulate gravity while exploring mind-bending levels as you fight to escape with the help of a mysterious ally known only as 'Z'.

title: Last Watchtower
description: A short tower defense game where you gather resources and survive waves of monsters. Spend your resources on a variety of upgrades to incrementally grow stronger. Experiment with different builds and discover powerful synergies.

title: Bias Quartet
description:
Is this stalking? Harassment? Or...
A violence x messed up relationship between women.

Third year university student Sayaka and her best friend lives next to each other. One day after a drinking night, she found out 20 photos of her own home in her best friend's mailbox.

title: Donare
description: Human dies twice. The first time is when their life ended. The second time is when their existence become forgotten.

title: Hoozuki no Yakusai
description: Hoozuki no Yakusai is a compact horror-leaning visual novel set in a rural town haunted by an old superstition linked to the hoozuki (Chinese lantern plant). You follow a protagonist drawn into a string of strange incidents and escalating misfortunes as local secrets, folklore, and interpersonal tensions unravel.

title: Haishin
description: Haishin is a tense, broadcast-style visual novel in which the protagonist, urged on by a friend, tries a notorious streaming site called "Haishin"—a platform with a grim reputation tied to its creator's suicide. As the player you watch tutorial streams and then pay virtual tips to unlock increasingly extreme, provocative live broadcasts.

title: Chitei Chousasen ni Hibiku Kodoku
description: Chitei Chousasen ni Hibiku Kodoku is a short, atmospheric sci‑fi mystery set aboard an abandoned subterranean research vessel 10 km underground. You wake with no memory and must explore the empty ship to piece together what happened; the story centers on isolation, lost memories, and a tragic incident that unfolds as you investigate

title: Cinco Noches en Casa Rosada 3
description: The final entry of the trilogy is the most ambitious one. Every night you visit a different section of the Casa Rosada (pink house) where you have to resolve an issue and face against the politicians who will try to stop you. This game leaves behind the Five Nights at Freddy's clone style and Google Images in favor of new mechanics and 3D modeled original scenarios.

title: Kawaii Ano Ko ha Yousha toka Zenzen Shinai: Jiai no Youkou-hen
description: Kawaii Ano Ko ha Yousha toka Zenzen Shinai: Jiai no Youkou-hen is a ~2-hour SF‑romance/drama where you play a special investigator tasked with contacting and either befriending or eliminating dangerous individuals to prevent humanity's extinction. Your current contact is a deceptively cute humanoid cyborg who runs odd jobs but may hide a lethal military-origin virus.

title: Dakkan Stiletto
description: Dakkan Stiletto is a mini RPG‑style novel about a maid who fights to rescue her kidnapped young mistress. Playtime is ~30 minutes with a single route;

title: #Leo-kun White Day Kikaku
description: #Leo-kun White Day Kikaku is a brief, light-hearted short ADV (~5 minutes per route, four endings) where the protagonist Misaki is invited by Leo to spend time at a shopping mall while Leo looks for ideas for a White Day.

title: Omawari-san: Koitsu Desu. - Kai
description: is a brief, single-route after-school ADV (≈10 minutes) where the protagonist searches their school for a missing younger brother and encounters increasingly strange acquaintances. It's a remake of a 2017 free release with updated visuals and one added character.

title: Lady Blue
description: A seemingly sweet Valentine’s date with your cute, younger girlfriend takes an unsettling turn. What begins as a cozy, heartwarming outing slowly reveals that today she’s not her usual self. This is a single‑route, linear short novel (no choices) intended as a quick, Valentine‑flavored playthrough.

title: Static Dread: The Submarine
description: Descend into Lovecraftian horror aboard a claustrophobic military submarine. Assign tasks as a captain’s right hand, analyze sonar signals, make hard decisions, and keep the crew from madness. Dark horrors lurk both within… and beyond the hull.

title: The Solace of Flowers
description: The Solace of Flowers is a roguelike deckbuilder where flowers are used to restore life in a dying world. Build and improve your deck and use it to cover the corrupted areas of the world with vegetation before the damage to the environment becomes irreversible.

title: Ogu and the Secret Forest: Winter Festival Blast
description: Embark on an adventure to Winter Festival Island with Baby Ogu! Find the missing village chief and uncover the secrets hidden on the island. Includes a 1v1 local tennis battle game.

title: Etrange Overlord
description: Join Étrange on this musical odyssey as she seeks to conquer hell in the pursuit of living her best afterlife.

title: Friends vs. Friends: El Pelicano
description:
El Pelicano motel is now open on Buddy's Boulevard!
Enjoy a coffee along with a new skin for each character and for some weapons.

title: Company of Heroes 3: Endure & Defy
description: Company of Heroes 3: Endure & Defy is a Battlegroup DLC pack consisting of four Battlegroups for Multiplayer and Co-Op/ skirmish vs AI.

title: The Last Faith: Awakened Ancients
description: Awakened Ancients delivers long-awaited content, answers, deeper challenges and the most polished version of The Last Faith to date.

title: Slime Saga
description: Train slimes, make friends, and get set for adventure! It's time to pick up your slime catcher and become the latest and greatest tamer!

title: Shirotsume Souwa Bangai-hen: Tsunakawa-sanchi no Christmas
description: Short, stand-alone side-story available for free from Littlewitch's website. It was directly included in the Dreamcast version of Shirotsume Souwa

title: Recipe of Love
description: A lunch break hidden from the world—our story alone.

title: Groove In The Grove
description:
Groove in the Grove is a charming little musical adventure where you recruit a band of adorable little woodland animals to have a big jam session.

Created for the HexCode Game Jam in Groove in the Grove you control a little girl with a bongo drum who sets out to get a groove on with some forest friends. You can bang your little bongo drum in time to the music and as you wander around a small woodland area you come across animals that have their own instrumental beats. Match those beats and the animals will follow you to join in your groovy jam session.

title: The Corpse
description:
Over the course of a year, Big Bag handed the corpse from one to another, leaving nothing but a folder of assets for the next person to use. We had little to no knowledge of what came before or what would come after.

Our one rule was that we could only use the Mouse to control our corpse. The seams are there, and blood runs everywhere...

the corpse is meant to be played more than once, but only as many times as it takes to reach the white light at the end.

title: Meet My Stepmoms
description: Today is your day to take care of your dad's ex-girlfriends! Which one is your favorite? Don't pick, they are all here. The hotest milfs of the city are for you.

title: Last Command: B-Side
description:
A story about another side of the world of Last Command.
Explore with Honest, the prisoned girl, and redeem the unfortunate end!

title: Protean Fox
description: "Protean Fox" is a bullet shooting game that combines elements of creature capture and light roguelike gameplay. Players will take on the role of a girl who gains the power of the Protean Fox. In her quest to reclaim the Foxfire, she wields weapons and magical artifacts from different worlds.

title: Catnigma
description: Steal fish in the most magical and sneaky way possible! Catnigma is a magical puzzle game where you control a flying cat on a quest to satisfy its endless hunger for fish.

title: Bad Boy Brother
description: Japan's Triple B title hittin' the shelves! fighting and flaunting their 'tudes, add in three entirely new game systems, and you get a sick beat 'em up!

title: Nagareochiru Shirabe ni Nosete
description: Nagareochiru Shirabe ni Nosete is a visual novel set in an alternate version of Japan during the late modernization era. The game follows interconnected protagonists whose overlapping storylines gradually reveal supernatural mysteries and hidden conflicts through multiple perspectives.

title: SpongeBob SquarePants: Titans of the Tide - Ghostly Digital Edition
description:
How do you stop the two biggest egos of the Seven Seas from fighting? A clash between the Flying Dutchman and King Neptune has unleashed ghostly mayhem all over Bikini Bottom. SpongeBob and Patrick will need all their skills, bravery and - dare I say - wit, to return life to what passes for normal in their undersea home. Join Bikini Bottom's most notorious duo on their ghostliest adventure yet!

Includes the Tidal Season Pass
Switch seamlessly between SpongeBob and Patrick
Combine SpongeBob and Patrick's unique platforming skills
Master Patrick's brand-new skills like grappling and burrowing
Experience a new ghostly story
Fully voiced by the original cast of the show
Visit iconic locations like Neptune's Palace and Mount Bikini
Battle epic bosses like the Flying Dutchman, King Neptune and Hibernation Sandy

title: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection - Layered Armor for Kora: Attendant's Attire
description: Contains the following: Layered Armor for Kora: Attendant's Attire Change the Rangers' appearance with layered armor!

title: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection - Layered Armor for Gaul: Fur-tive Five Leader
description: Contains the following: Layered Armor for Gaul: Fur-tive Five Leader Change the Rangers' appearance with layered armor!

title: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection - Layered Armor for Eleanor: Foreign Dancer
description: Contains the following: Layered Armor for Eleanor: Foreign Dancer Change the Rangers' appearance with layered armor!

title: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection - Layered Armor for Ogden: Summertime Ogden
description: Contains the following: Layered Armor for Ogden: Summertime Ogden Change the Rangers' appearance with layered armor!

title: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection - Monster Hair: Octolocks Princess
description: Contains the following: Monster Hair: Octolocks Princess A special hairstyle for the protagonist!

title: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection - Monster Hair: Espinas Spikes

description: Bazar Simulator takes you to Boquerón City, where you will help Wan manage her uncle Wang Long's bazaar with your friends in a cooperative game. Customize your store in a game full of humor and action in this unique simulator.

title: Phase
description: Use the arrow keys to move and press the spacebar to teleport. By holding the spacebar, the world inverts from black to white, revealing hidden enemies and keys that are invisible in the normal state. Find all the keys and destroy the core to make your escape!

title: Soverain: An Eternal Legend
description: Eternal Legend is a turn-based tactical RPG that blends political drama and family destiny. Build your army, forge bonds, and wage epic pixel art battles in a world torn apart.

title: Nuclear Day
description: Nuclear Day is a story-based role-playing game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Explore the secrets of this world. Fight monsters. Pass tests and solve puzzles. Become your own in this tragic world.

title: Purrfect Catch
description: Purrfect Catch is a cozy yet action-packed indie game where fishing isn’t just relaxing – it’s your ultimate weapon!

title: Luminas: Parasite Reign
description: A single-player, party-based roguelite where you control up to 3 heroes at once. Face relentless enemies and unique bosses, unlock powerful treasures, and forge new builds through multiple skill paths. Each run offers fresh upgrades, combos, and strategic choices in your fight to survive.

title: Metal Gear Solid V: The Definitive Subsistence Update
description: A mod that aims to change MGSV: TPP's gameplay by forcing the player to start missions without equipment, but allowing them to get more from guards. Also changes the revenge system to change guards equipment within the same mission.

title: In Silence Waits
description: In Silence Waits is a modern take on classic graphical adventures. Solve puzzles and avoid dangers as you explore the desolate wastes of a cruel world in search of a new home. In this world, not all monsters must be feared... and not all friendly faces should be trusted.

title: Touhou Kourokuen: Glorious and Huge Singer
description: Glorious and Huge Singer is a Touhou fangame made to celebrate enka singer Sachiko Kobayashi's birthday.

title: Escape from Mental Hospital
description: Embrace this 100 doors challenge, seek and find hidden objects and solve escape puzzles, in order to help her piece together fragments of her past. But with sinister forces determined to keep her trapped within the asylum’s walls, she must use her newfound knowledge in this adventure escape game and employ special abilities to escape 100 mental hospital doors before it’s too late. “Escape the mental hospital,” she repeats to herself, determined to break free.

title: The Diamond Adventures
description: The Diamond Adventures is a multi-genre, single-player adventure game packed with minigames and exploration. DanTDM is taken back through the old eras of his YouTube journey, allying with old friends and facing old foes as he makes his way through the memories into the present day.

title: Hop & Seek
description: Hop & Seek is a multiplayer egg hunt game set in a game show for Easter bunnies. You can hide eggs, seek eggs and trick your friends.

title: Highway 11
description: Inspired by liminal horror, Highway 11 is a psychological horror anomaly detection game, an evolution of hidden-object titles. You awaken at an intersection. All roads lead back to the start. Observe your surroundings carefully to escape the endless loop and uncover the mystery of why you’re here…

title: Dynasty Warriors: Origins - Visions of Four Heroes
description: This DLC adds new stories featuring the Four Heroes, new allies, weapons, and more. The immersive battlefields and exhilarating 1 vs. 1,000 action return!

title: BrokenLore: Ascend
description: BrokenLore: Ascend is a first-person psychological horror with climbing and stealth mechanics. Follow Ren and Yui, two rooftop climbers facing a cursed tower and the terrifying Rokurokubi. The higher they climb, the closer they get to madness—and to the truth about themselves.

title: BlazBlue: Entropy Effect X
description: In BlazBlue Entropy Effect X, you’ll face off against surging hordes across ever-shifting dimensions in an action-focused roguelike platform adventure. The Sea of Possibility is envisioned as a descent through multiple levels, each filled with threats you’ll need to suppress while harvesting Shards of Possibility. Along the way, you’ll uncover a completely new, original story that expands the BlazBlue Entropy Effect X universe in unexpected ways. Read the swarm, weave through danger, and strike back with combos and strings that never let up.

title: Elden Ring Nightreign - The Forsaken Hollows
description:
The DLC will feature two new nightfaring warriors as playable characters:

- Scholar: An academic who walks the Lands Between. Boasting impressive arcane levels, he gains incredible advantages through battlefield observation.

- Undertaker: An abbess who was mandated to slay the Nightlord. Boasting impressive strength and faith, she sends enemies to the afterlife with ruthless efficiency.

It also features the new Limveld enemy type, and a new area: Shifting Earth: The Great Hollow, a great cavity in the depths of Limveld. The hollow is strewn with exotic ruins and temples; sacred towers denoting the remains of an ancient people; and crystals that exude a cursed, life-draining miasma.

title: Rescue the Hostages: Cryptic Countdown
description: Rescue the Hostages: Cryptic Countdown is a dark horror FMV game centered on a high-tension hostage crisis. The narrative centers around a bomber who has trapped several hostages in a deadly scenario. The player must solve a series of word scramble puzzles connected to a timed explosive device. Gameplay emphasizes psychological tension and problem-solving under pressure, as players attempt to decipher clues and prevent the bomb from detonating before time runs out.

title: Sushi Cat Legacy Collection
description: He’s round. He’s hungry. He’s back! Help your feline friend eat all the sushi (and find love) in this bundle of squishy puzzle classics! This collection includes the original Sushi Cat, Sushi Cat The Honeymoon, Sushi Cat 2, The Great Purrade, Sushi Cat-a-Pult, and more...

title: Wandfall
description: Master tactical combat and collect powerful Sigils in this challenging roguelike. Navigate procedural maps through three acts of escalating difficulty, where every encounter shapes your build and every decision determines your survival.

title: Heavenly Martyr
description:
On a fateful day a girl walking home gets the opportunity to change the world for the better. Against all odds and better judgement she takes upon the role of a Martyr, a magical girl bent on purging evil alongside her little friend.

Venture to the streets of England and hunt down those who mean harm to the well being of manking in this black and white world.

title: Low Tide
description: Set in 1999, Low Tide puts you alone on a foggy, abandoned beach called Old Quay with only a metal detector. What you dig up isn't treasure—it's a story. Piece together the strange past of this place, and decide if you're ready to learn why no one comes here anymore.

title: Shop it Up!
description: It's the grand opening of the new mall, and the customers are already inside, but the mall isn't ready yet! Your skills are needed to open and decorate new shops. Boost profits with dazzling inventory displays and fancy advertisements. Once the mall gets busy, hire assistants and cashiers to help with all the customers. As the new boss, you'll need to take advice and meet challenges from the local business leaders. Fun is in the bag when you play Shop it Up!

title: Romb
description: Romb is a short psychological horror game set in a mysterious confined room. Follow the voice's instructions each day if you want to make it out alive; no matter how wrong it feels.

title: Artdink Game Log: Tail of the Sun
description: The protagonist of this game is a primitive human. Their daily life was driven purely by instinct. They slept when tired, gathered fallen nuts, hunted animals to satisfy their hunger. This game recreates that wild, simple existence. Wagashi-shaped nuts, an open-world field, scattered objects resembling human body parts, avant-garde techno music, and a caveman who suddenly falls asleep while head-sliding... Experience a wild, pure, and simple life that appeals to your primal instincts.

title: Pyramidion
description: Pyramidion is a physics-based co-op action-puzzler for 2 players. Choose a unique role and coordinate with your partner to move a massive stone block to the pyramid's summit in a true test of teamwork and communication.

title: Once Upon a Katamari: Katamari Damacy Series Dance Dance Remixes
description:
Includes:
- 5 dazzling remixes featuring songs from the collaborative EP "Denonbu Katamarespect" by DENONBU
- 10 costume pieces from previous Katamari series titles

title: Once Upon a Katamari: Katamari Damacy Series Neo Remixes
description:
- 5 additional BGM tracks celebrating the legacy of Katamari with remixes from previous Katamari titles
- 10 costume pieces from previous Katamari series titles

Track List:
Baby Universe - Hiroshi Okubo Remix
Guru Guru Gravity - Sho Okada Remix
Alien - Kanaya Oki Remix
Walking on a Star! - Junichi Nakatsuru Remix
Family Damacy - Yoshihito Yano Remix

title: Berserk Heroes Online
description:
Berserk Heroes Online is a fast-paced tactical card dueler where every decision counts. Summon powerful creatures, cast game-changing spells, and equip legendary gear to outmaneuver your opponent. Victory is achieved by being the first to reduce the enemy Hero's health to zero.

At the heart of the game is deep strategic diversity. With a wide array of unique Heroes and a vast library of faction-based cards, the possibilities for deckbuilding are nearly endless. This design empowers you to experiment, innovate, and ultimately define your own unique style of combat.

title: Greenhouse: Schism
description: Greenhouse: Schism is a sidescrolling platformer focusing on Gameplay, Magic based combat and Boss Battles. Explore and fight through the Acri forest and discover the secret to it's high concentration of magic! Learn new spells and find secrets while adventuring deeper towards the truth.

title: Chivalry is Not Dead
description: Chivalry Is Not Dead is a video game published in 2007 on Windows by Squinky. It's an adventure game, set in a fantasy and comedy themes.

title: Veinrider
description: Veinrider is a scifi incremental game about traversing alien caves and escaping a strange planet. Fly, collect and upgrade your gravity-flipping craft to break deeper, faster and stronger!

title: PMC: Net Zero
description: PMC: Net Zero places you in the shoes of an elite soldier in charge of a private military company. Manage which missions to take on in this first person, millitary, retro inspired, action shooter. All in the name of profit.

title: Insecta Vindicta
description: Revenge Survival game where insects fight back against human kind

title: Walker
description: An online co-op horror game where you and your crew hunt monsters inside a massive Walker. Use your environment, items, or anything at your disposal to protect your Walker.

title: Dawn of Irkalla
description: Dawn of Irkalla is a 4 player co-op horror stealth dungeon-crawler where you have no weapons and no way to fight back. Build your deck, unlock skills, scavenge vital items, and race against the clock to retrieve artifacts for a shadowy government agency. Your survival depends on it.

title: UZG
description: No it is in no way related to Nex's UZG. We know about one another tho. UZG is a fast paced wave based zombie shooter game. There isn't much more to say about it. Similar in movement to Quake/Half-Life.

title: Chiaroscuro Imago
description: A short piece of horror fiction about honey and lies; entomology and etymology; murky secrets and stark realities. Find out what happened to the moths.

title: Inconvenience Store
description: Take on the role of a spirit condemned to forced labor in a store in The Afterlife​​ Your salvation is to buy a ticket to Paradise and escape by any means necessary. ​If you fail to manage the store, Hell will be waiting for you.

title: Solaria
description: Collect various androids known as "Pvas" on the futuristic colony planet named "Solaria", deploy them for battles, construction, farming, crafting; pilot your own mobile base to explore the vast world. This is a brand-new, single player open-world survival and crafting game.

title: Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter
description: A remake of the second installment in the main Trails series, serving as a direct sequel of Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter. The game follows Estelle as she sets out on a new adventure following the events of the previous game, where she will be joined by comrades both old and new.

title: The Drop
description: RIP your way through a party of BLOOD THIRSTY cultists, to uncover the true intent and source of its CHAOS in this roguelike, cinematic, action fest!

title: The Runner
description: mmerse yourself in the breathtaking realism of Venice's labyrinthine waterways. Dash past ancient architecture, navigate bustling squares, and embrace the challenge of an authentic Venetian endless runner. Can you master the art of swift navigation in this stunning, true-to-life cityscape?"

title: Haze
description: Haze is a 2D gothic dress-up platformer where you replace your body parts to survive.
