Hunt through a decaying forest and royal palace, collect limbs, gain new powers, and reshape yourself to overthrow a corrupt King — all for the one you love. How much of yourself will you sacrifice for vengeance?

title: A todas las palomas de Madrid les faltan dedos
description: Blood and concrete.

title: The Last Hero
description: Play this first person medieval game and jump, run, fight, collect, and stop the threat that is coming with the well known and last hero of Corli.Hugh Ashdown.

title: Golden Voyage
description: To save your island from a dragon, you must sail the island sea. Buy low, sell high! You were given a year to amass enough wealth for the dragon, will you be able to make it? Or will you have enough to bargain for more time? This is the beginning of your GOLDEN VOYAGE...

title: Meow Cafe
description: Embark on a cosmic culinary adventure! As a cat chef, travel from Whiskerton to Purrgatory aboard the Starlight Haven. Craft desserts, explore new worlds for rare ingredients, and manage an intergalactic cafe filled with charming characters and heartwarming stories.

title: The Adventures of Astel and the Dark Curse
description: Join Astel, the boldest (and funniest) bunny in Cenourolândia, on a magical adventure! Face bizarre enemies, collect epic powers, and save your village from a dark curse. What are you waiting for? Jump in and explore this incredible journey!

title: Let Me Go
description: This is a casual mini-game, a casual mini-game to relax your mind。 This is a maze game, a casual game where players only need to run and jump.

title: Slime Time
description: Eat your friends and become the last one standing in this 8 player slimey physics battler! Bounce around, eat to grow, fight with abilities and rescue your friends. A gooey, glorious free-for-all where you'll have to team up to avoid becoming a snack. There's always a bigger slime...

title: Corporation Inc.
description: Newly hired for a revitalization program, work against a ticking clock and navigate a skeptical boss, a lousy friend, and discrimination while making hiring decisions. Interactive narrative with timed decisions Critical thinking Prosocial Empathy

title: Element Cattos
description: Welcome to the Cattopia National Laboratory's Big Box Of Catto Research, where you can play around with all sorts of elements in the form of little creatures known as Element Cattos and see how they interact in different conditions and environments.

title: Kirisame Escape
description: Kirisame Escape is a Touhou fangame by the circle GEN. It is a horizontally-scrolling shoot 'em up, though in this game the player character scrolls away from enemies instead of towards them.

title: Touhou Koumadan
description: Touhou Koumadan is a Touhou doujin fangame. It's a shoot 'em up game with 2D platforming elements.

title: Kouma no Kagi
description: Kouma no Kagi is a Touhou Project doujin fangame with gameplay similar to Solomon's Key.

title: 1111-Strike
description: Tactical FPS where precision shooting meets role-based teamwork — pick Grand, Tank, Engineer, or Medic to combine aim, abilities, and proximity voice to outplay opponents in ranked, casual, or custom matches for up to 16 players.

title: 3on3 FreeStyle: Character Access Pass
description: You can unlock all current characters and upcoming 2025 update characters!

title: 3on3 FreeStyle: Beginner's Starter Kit
description: Jumpstart your 3on3 Rebound journey with a special Starter Pack, packed with essential items to boost your game from day one!

title: 4Story: Archer Armor Package
description: The Archer Equipment Package for 4Story: The Original delivers a well-balanced arsenal for tactical sharpshooters. Whether you specialize in long-range suppression or nimble battlefield adaptability, this gear set ensures you have the tools to outpace and outmaneuver your enemies.

title: 4Story: Assassin Armor Package
description: The Assassin Equipment Package for 4Story: The Original equips silent killers and master tacticians with the ultimate tools of death.

title: 4Story: Mage Armor Package
description: Step into the role of a true spellcaster with the Wizard Equipment Package for 4Story: The Original.

title: 4Story: Permanent Dragon Mount Package
description: Become the Master of the Black and Blue Dragon! This exclusive DLC package grants you ownership of the powerful Black and Blue Dragon mounts. First, launch the game 4Story : The Original and head to the Premium Shop.️ Then, click on the DLC Package banner to claim your rewards in-game.

title: 4Story: Permanent Nine-tailed Fox Mount Package
description: Own your mystical elegance with the legendary Nine-Tailed Fox mounts! This package includes three different colors of the permanent Nine-Tailed Fox mounts.

title: 4Story: Priest Armor Package
description: The Priest Equipment Package for 4Story: The Original equips faithful protectors and spiritual warriors with powerful tools to heal allies, banish darkness, and uphold the will of the divine.

title: 4Story: Summoner Armor Package
description: The Summoner Equipment Package for 4Story: The Original is crafted for those who bend otherworldly forces to their will.

title: 4Story: Warrior Armor Package
description: Power. Honor. Endurance. Equip yourself like a true champion of Iveria. Step into the battlefield fully armed with the Warrior Equipment Package, a powerful gear collection crafted for battle-hardened heroes in 4Story: The Original.

title: 5 Golden Skulls
description: Can you escape the cursed temple of Quetzalcoatl? In solo or coop, look out for any anomalies. Observe carefully, as any mistake would be fatal!

title: 50 Years Classic
description: 50 Years Classic is a minimalist turn-based strategy game where you can choose from a variety of nations, each with its own unique feature. The game offers fast, engaging gameplay with high replayability. This is a free version of the game "50 years".

title: 50 Doors
description: Your task is to go through a series of 50 rooms.

title: 5 Minutes: DLC Final
description: A collection of new tracks designed not to comfort but to intensify the void.

title: 5 Minutes: DLC 2
description: Welcome back to the cycle. It hasn't become easier. It has only become deeper. 5 Minutes: Echo of Persistence Continue. Suffer. Record your fall. And try, once again, to reach the unreachable.

title: 5 Minutes: DLC 1
description: 5 Minutes grants no comfort. Grants no rest. Grants no forgiveness. It is a game for those unafraid to fall a thousand times, for those who see defeat not as failure, but as an invitation. For those who seek the glory of challenging the impossible, even if they never reach it.

title: 8AM: The Swimming Pool
description: "8AM: The Swimming Pool" is a suspense game set in a public pool after closing hours. Observe the last swimmers through security cameras and decide whether their strange actions come from exhaustion or something far more disturbing, as you try to endure until 8:00 a.m.

title: 8AM: The Subway
description: "8AM: The Subway" is a suspense game set in the subway after midnight. Watch the security cameras as eerie events unfold and decide if it’s fatigue, malfunction, or something far darker until 8:00 a.m.

title: 8AM: The Shopping Mall
description: "8AM: The Shopping Mall" is a suspense game set in an empty mall after closing. Watch through security cameras as strange movements unfold and decide if it’s a glitch, exhaustion, or something sinister until 8:00 a.m.

title: 88 at an Exhibition
description: ★ → ●. (The star whispers.)

title: 7 Nights with Vroombi
description: Play as Vroombi, a brave little robo-vacuum who needs to keep Lily's house nice and clean! Clean away dust, dirt and debris in this satisfying twist on an interactive cleaning simulator. What awaits little Vroombi at night? What is Lily scared of?

title: 77p Egg: Cubicle 77
description: You are trapped in the endless toilet dimension or something. Observe your surroundings carefully to get back to your wife and finish your lunch.

title: 6 Ways To 7
description: 6 ways to 7 is a high-stakes roguelike twist on the classic dice game Craps! It combines the hard choices of a roguelike, with the push your luck gameplay of craps!

title: 6 Rooms
description: 6 Rooms - Find a way to get out of the endless Soviet communal apartment, look for clues, watch out for anomalies.

title: 9 To Ashes
description: Survive an intense horror inspired by Indonesian folklore. Evade the cunning Tuyul and other astral beings, explore eerie, haunted environments, and uncover sinister secrets hidden within the supernatural darkness.

title: 9mm Roulette
description: Step into a chaotic bar where every turn is a deadly gamble. Spin the revolver, smash tables, dodge bullets, and turn bar items into weapons. With destructible environments, ragdoll physics, and dark humor, it’s all about luck, strategy, and surviving the madness.

title: 9 Lives To Escape
description: A hardcore pixel-art platformer where you control a cat with 9 lives per level. Dodge deadly traps, survive precision jumps, and restart from scratch if you fail. Master fast-paced challenges and escape — or lose all your lives trying.

title: 9 Hallways: The Anomaly Agent
description: "9 Hallways: The Anomaly Agent" is a first-person horror game where you explore cosmic passageways connecting all realities. Investigate eerie disturbances, report anomalies, and survive encounters with malevolent entities in a constantly shifting, otherworldly environment.

title: Birdwatching Notebook
description: Build cozy birdwatching spots on balconies, docks, cliffs, rainforests, or deserts, and wait for lovely birds to visit. A gentle desktop idle game—like tiny postcards on your screen, where beautiful scenes and cute birds accompany your quiet moments.

title: AAA
description: It does not require complicated operations. You can click anywhere and anytime. The gameplay is very simple - just click and go!

title: Aakihiko Aruberutasu Adisony Apurinsu Azumeragi
description: In the Reset Era, the world forgot music. Only Prince Akihiko remembers the lost melodies. To restore them, he must collect the scattered Arias of Rebirth with his princess allies, and play it on his birthday to awaken music once more.

title: Aam Aadmi
description: A short first-person-shooter game. Kill the corrupt baddies, blow shit up, save your hot wife, drink tea.

title: Abandoned Continent
description: In this unfamiliar world full of danger, you will embark on a journey of location and engage in battles of wits and courage against various dangerous monsters.

title: Abdicate
description: This game captivates players with its distinctive pixel art style, crafting a fantastical realm where yellow earth meets a blue sky.

title: Abigail
description: In this narrative-focused game, Abigail must navigate her splintered friend group and explore vibrant handcrafted neighborhoods, each with their unique way of playing the ubiquitous folk game Azulejo.

title: Aberrate Inc.
description: Aberrate inc. is an upcoming 3D box-and-button puzzle game where the fabric of reality bends—and breaks—at your command. Harness the power to ABERRATE, splitting batteries into two coloured copies. Manipulate phased objects to solve puzzles, unlock new areas, and discover the world of Aberrate inc.!

title: Abeline Rush
description: A scream at night and you'll take flight on this Single-player Fantasy Action Adventure through a mystical castle filled with monsters, mystery, and giant bosses. Can you force your way to the top and foil the villain's plot?

title: Abelina
description: Explore a surreal wilderness by platforming and use timing based hits to gather resources. Break open branching paths to get to the other side of a giant world, talk to it's strange inhabitants, and try to understand the nature of this world.

title: A Blade for the Emperor
description: An interactive fiction epic fantasy.

title: AboJam
description: Manage your own farm in a turn-based defense game, and fend off swarming gangs with avocado towers you've grown yourself.

title: Above The Horizon
description: Above The Horizon is terraformation survival crafting game where you crash landed above the planet "Lunaris". The rest of your colonization team landed safely on the planet... so it's up to you to get back to the planet and terraform it along the way!

title: CriminalZ
description: Steal, survive, and pay your boss—or die trying. CriminalZ is a rogue-lite co-op heist game full of chaos, cops, and high-stakes loot.

title: Deep in the Dread
description: A First-person horror, mystery genre. A group of librarians is working in the old Hoverfield Mansion decide to hang out at a nearby pub, but one of them refuses and wants to stay inside. as the story unfolds, she begins to notice paranormal activities inside the library.

title: Dreadful Delivery
description: In the dead of night, when the streets are quiet and the neighborhood sleeps, you're on the clock, delivering packages no one else dares to touch. Each delivery is a race against time—and against the dangers lurking in the shadows. But the job pays well… if you can survive the night.

title: Dreadveil
description: Dreadveil is an atmospheric horror shooter where you desperately scavenge for resources while avoiding terrible monsters. Balance scarce resources to solve one of many issues. Make short-term decisions to solve a more pressing problem which will then come back and bite you in the future.

title: Dread of Night
description: Face the Dread, Survive the Night. An island has seemingly appeared just overnight in the middle of the ocean. Lost and stranded, the player searches for a way out but finds the island inhabited by a violent locals who stop at nothing to kill all outsiders.

title: Dreadline Express
description:
Investigative odyssey into the minds of fading passengers facing the end of the world aboard the last human train.

An adventure game that doesn't set specific goals. It naturally encourages you to make your own decisions and draw your own conclusions, providing a highly immersive experience with a fair amount of story branching.

title: Dreadmarrow
description: Enter the dark, thrilling world of DR3ADMARROW! Recruit a powerful party and plunge into deadly dungeons, intense arenas, and epic raids. Battle fearsome foes, claim legendary loot, and carve your legend in a realm of danger and glory!

title: Solomon's Keep: Dreadful Retro Edition
description: Ascend the dark tower and destroy the blackest necromancer the land has ever seen in your epic quest to graduate college.

title: Million Card Game
description: Compete with 1-5 players in this interactive cozy indie card game! Strategize table layouts and hand placement in order to be the first top win!

title: One Million Buttons
description: There are one million buttons. Only one button is correct. The correct button is chosen randomly, and there are no hints. Good luck!

title: Absolute Canasta for Windows 11
description: Canasta is an entertaining and strategic card game that requires both tactics and a bit of luck. Whether you are an advanced player or a beginner, "Absolute Canasta for Windows 11" offers you everything you need to consolidate your knowledge of Canasta or to learn it from scratch.

title: Abstract Wars
description: Abstract Wars is a straight shot of adrenaline to the brain! Abstract Wars is an arcade 2D bullet-hell roguelike where you are just a tiny, but incredibly nimble ship in a universe-sized meat grinder.

title: The Portsmoor Abysm
description: Explore the Catacombs of Portsmoor, push boulders, avoid deadly traps, face otherworldly monsters, and solve mind-bending puzzles. The Portsmoor Abysm is an atmospheric puzzle game with Sokoban-like mechanics, inspired by classics such as Boulder Dash, Supaplex, or Emerald Mine.

title: Abyss Rebirth
description: ●Game overview "The Labyrinth of the Abyss" has a depth of over 4000 layers. There is only one adventurer who challenges the labyrinth. Visit the central city of Midgard.

title: Abyss Dungeon
description: Hack and Slash, Mystery Dungeon The dungeon is randomly generated and changes shape every time you enter. You may encounter monsters in the dungeon. Battles with monsters are turn-based, and monsters don't move until you move. Pick up treasure chests scattered throughout the dungeon.

title: Action Clicker
description: Prove yourself in an exciting new clicker game, beat your highest score in the ever-faster action and try to keep track of things. Meet 20+ different types of enemies and unlock new items! Can you unlock all items in the store?

title: Add Cross
description: This pencil puzzle involves filling in the blanks with numbers 1 - 9 to match the numbers in the problem squares. Enjoy the light-hearted effects and have fun!

title: A Date With Yuika
description: A short story about you and Yuika, in a date, to talk about relationships and a possible future.

title: Addled Clicker
description: Addled Clicker is an idle-clicker game that takes place in the dark and twisted facility of "Chamber 49" -- ran by a mysterious figure called "The Director". Appease the Director's wishes by increasing the button count while surviving what creeps out from the darkness.

title: Addy
description: It's hard to focus on schoolwork when she's missing.

title: A Deep World
description: Guide a little green creature as it goes deep into a dark, dangerous underwater world once sealed off. You'll need to explore, hide, and outmaneuver different predators to find your lost friend and make it back home in one piece. Whatever you do, avoid the nests!

title: A Devastated City
description: A Devastated City is a 3D point and click adventure game! You are one of the few survivors lost in a devastated city. Explore devastated houses in search of food and water, fight zombies and do everything possible to survive in this nightmare world.

title: A Difficult Game About Letters
description: Transform into letters to overcome platforming challenges and save your friend from evil King in this crayon-style adventure!

title: Aenoic Abyss
description: Swap between two heroines (Paladin/Mage/Assassin/Centaur Archer) instantly in this 2D pixel-art roguelite platformer, forge permanent Diablo-inspired builds with 200+ affix combinations to conquer cycle-reborn abyssal labyrinths and rend the holy veil of the Purification Ritual.

title: Aegers Borg
description: You are in charge of the village called "Aegers Borg" manage the village her resources through assigning villagers, resolving events or by completing special rituals, develop and prepare the village because "winter is coming".

title: Adventure Time
description: This is a jacked-up Rogue-like game where you explore a dark and twisting dungeon. You are seeking ever-more powerful loot to fight the ever more terrifying monsters of the deep. Because the game is turn-based, you can take your time and think about your actions.

title: Aero
description: Challenge your friends in an exciting multiplayer ball parkour game. Customize your ball with skins, unlock unique abilities, and master dynamic obstacle courses. Compete for the top spot, show off your skills, and enjoy endless fast-paced parkour action together.

title: Asteroid Miner
description: An idle space mining simulator that lets you scan, extract, and refine asteroids while upgrading ships and managing resources.

title: Imperializer
description: Imperializer is a tactical simulation RPG set in a war-torn fantasy world where the player takes part in imperial military campaigns and political struggles. Gameplay focuses on turn-based, grid-based battles and strategic unit management across a story-driven campaign.

title: The Riese Project
description: Those who went underground never came back. But something still breathes beneath the ruins. The Riese Project is a narrative FPP/VR thriller about a place that hasn’t forgotten anyone.

title: Echoes of the Rest
description: A first-person psychological horror game where you explore Joe's house and psyche after his accident, solve clues while trying to escape the house, and attempt to uncover the underlying issue behind Joe's mental state.

title: SoulUp
description: If you can climb, you can fight. Every step is survival, every fall a lesson a hardcore action adventure.

title: Fcorvus
description: Solve puzzles, uncover riddles, and hunt crows and ravens through layered scenes of mystery. Assemble, search, and compete to reveal the hidden truth in a world where every shadow tells a story. Play solo, with or versus a friend. Learn about the fabulous corvus.

title: Soul Reflex
description: Master 50 fast-paced levels and train your Soul Reflex in a high-speed, Rhythm-Action 3D Runner centered on a journey toward Spiritual Awakening. Speed up or speed down, let your Soul Reflex decide.

title: Clicker Ore
description: Dig deeper! Break rocks, hire miners, and uncover endless treasures beneath the earth.

title: Prichal
description: Prichal is a 1-4 player cooperative survival horror game. Team up to solve the ominous puzzles of each unique map and uncover its dark history.

title: Gearbound: Odyssey
description: Gearbound: Odyssey is a vibrant 3D action-platformer where you blast, bash, and zip through alien worlds as rookie space cadet Ember, wielding over-the-top gadgets and gear on a galaxy-spanning journey to find her missing sister.

title: Waterflow
description: Waterflow is a Doom poem about the failure of language and why that is a beautiful thing. Originally created for RAMP 2025, Waterflow is a continuation of my explorations of expressing poetry through Doom.

title: Toward From
description:
Made for Game Poems Magazine Issue 1, whose theme was "First Moves".

Search fruitlessly and endlessly for meaning and beauty, unaware of the things you walk away from.

title: Rhythm Doggo
description: You wanted to play a video game and just got transformed into a dog! Rhythm Doggo is a classic platform adventure where you play as a dog and make music on the way. Can you go back to your human form?

title: Fourleaf Fields
description: Welcome to the tiny world of Fourleaf Fields, a cozy farming life sim where you're no bigger than a carrot. Grow towering crops, care for tiny farm bugs, and uncover a web of secrets fueled by gossip - solo or online with friends!

title: The Music Box: Arc
description: A sequel to (Mario) The Music Box -ARC-, continuing off of the 'Missing' ending. Make choices to go down either a 'sane' or 'insane' path.

title: Of Crowns & Chains
description: Of Crowns & Chains is a solo-developed, grand-strategy sandbox video game where players lead a nation in a dynamic, historically-inspired world, currently in early alpha.

title: Wilder World: Super Early Access
description: Interdimensional refugees known as the Wilders flee Our Base Reality, which has become an AI-controlled dystopia to Wiami, a digital sanctuary in Wilder World. When the authoritarian FORUM attempts to conquer Wiami, the Wilders strategize a defence.

title: Femboy Fury
description: Femboy Fury is a demolition derby of high-octane proportions! Choose between 10 femboy characters and compete in an arcade like drive-and-shoot in semi-destructible environments! Franticly search for weapon pick-ups as you dodge enemies chasing you! Be the last femboy driving in 8 levels!

title: Friday Night Funkin': V.S Cat Mangle YT
Horizon Steel Frontiers
description: The first MMORPG in the Horizon universe. A desperate adventure for survival in a world full of numerous threats.

title: Midnight Yammy 8-Bit Trickster Show
description: The elusive bunny thief, Midnight Yammy, is here to steal the show on a stage full of magic tricks! Erase blocks, slip through ceilings, switch platforms — and let your wits guide you through this simple yet deep action puzzle. Includes a .nes ROM that runs on real NES-compatible hardware!

title: Heart.Marrow.Blood.
description: A short, surreal visual novel about two people journeying to find the Heart of the City.

title: Sun Halo
description: Sun Halo is a real-time combat game blending roguelike progression with strategic deck-building. Recruit and develop a roster of distinctive characters, build your own unique deck, and adapt your tactics on the battlefield. Uncover the world’s unfolding story, all the way to its final chapter.

title: RoboLeague
description: A competitive 5v5 football game where skill, strategy, and teamwork decide every match. Plan precise plays, master unique abilities, and outsmart opponents in fast-paced, skill-driven matches.

title: Crossroads
description: With nothing but a revolver by your side, traverse the deepening chasms and acrobatically dispatch a range of enemies from bats to bandits in this western themed tale of letting go.

title: Best Hero
description: Dash into a stylish game featuring six unique characters, local co-op, achievements, leaderboards, bonus content, and Photo Mode. How far can you go?

title: Floor 13
description: In Floor13, reality doesn’t change all at once — it shifts quietly, waiting for you to notice.You walk the same office corridor over and over, but something always feels… slightly off.Your task is simple: observe, detect, report. If you fail to see the difference, the corridor will keep you forever.

title: Galactic Gardener
description: A fast, wave-based roguelite where you grow weapon upgrades instead of wielding them. Plant, link, and defend your drone garden against alien infestations.

title: Rotato
description: Spin. Shoot. Survive.

title: Dwoemer of the Drill Faced Goddess
description:
"You received a dream of an artifact of great power, and have felt compelled to journey forth and find it. Your search has taken you to a mysterious cave, which will be the beginning of a strange journey into the depths of the world. Maybe other beings exist there, and few of them are friendly. Can you survive the trials ahead of you? And, will what you find be what you were looking for?"

This game was made for RETROMANIA, RMN's 10 Year Birthday Celebration.

title: Rune Legacy Idle
description: Rune Legacy Idle is a multiplayer fantasy game featuring idle mechanics. Battle mythical monsters, train various skills, and team up or challenge your friends to duels. Enjoy a never ending idle RPG experience.

title: Magic Gear
description: When a mysterious mechanical base begins to emerge in the Silent Forest, it falls to the focused and pacifist Agent Pax to infiltrate it. On a mission to deactivate the "Magic Gear," the factory's heart, and rescue her captured comrades, Pax will face any challenge to get the job done. After all, the future of peace... and her General's lasagna, depend on it.

title: Promotion
description: Promotion is a short VR escape room set in the far future. The player is trapped on a spaceship and must unlock the escape pod before time runs out.

title: Republic at War
description: Republic at War is a total conversion modification for Star Wars: Empire at War - Forces of Corruption. The mod replaces the Empire with the Galactic Republic and the Rebel Alliance with the Confederacy. Republic at War focuses heavily on the theatrical films but also contains content from the Clone Wars cartoon series as well as the expanded universe. Players can re-enact various Clone War campaigns such as the Outer Rim Sieges. Players will have the choice to fight as either the CIS or the Republic and wage war for control of the galaxy. Realism is key and players will have unprecedented control over how and where they fight. Push forward with an entire clone legion such as the 501st or 212th or overwhelm your opponent with a seemingly endless number of B1 battledroids. The choice is yours.

title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. H.A.C.R.
description: H.A.C.R stands for Hayzee's Anomaly Community Remaster.

title: Space Salvage: Ship Happens
description: Sci-fi dark comedy action adventure including space flight, combat and refuse collection.

title: Delivery to Graveyard Manor
description: Gather the disguises and collect all the deliveries!

title: Mini Shopkeeper
description: Run your cozy little shop from the bottom of your screen, decorate to attract unique customers, hire assistants, and send adventurers for rare treasures - all in a lively, charming management sim!

title: Witchy Tower
description: A witchy arcade platformer about climbing an infinite tower and avoiding the consequences of your actions.

title: Island of Challenge
description: Are you ready for the challenge? Face monsters in a 2D pixel art bullet hell to prove your worth and join Captain Valdo's pirate crew! Step into Geraldo's shoes, choose your weapon, buy upgrades, and grow stronger on this journey. What are you waiting for? The crew is waiting for you!

title: Lucky Lord: The Coin Pusher of Fate
description: Lucky Lord: The Coin Pusher of Fate combines slot-machine-style random strategy with roguelike card enhancement mechanics, creating a unique gameplay experience centered around a coin pusher.

title: Guild Encounters
description: Guild Encounters is a minimalist arcade JRPG. Recruit heroes, battle through dangerous zones, and conquer challenging turn-based encounters. Earn Guild Points to unlock new allies, powerful gear, and game-changing items. Face a gauntlet of battles as you journey to the final boss!

title: Vaporwave Hardest Game
description: Enter a digital dream where every mistake echoes forever. Control your little computer soul through an endless neon labyrinth filled with moving obstacles, shimmering tiles and vaporwave vibes.

title: Akayaisdead
description: My dearest friend has passed away.But lately, I’ve been feeling her presence nearby—even though she’s supposed to be dead.A shadow moving in the dark, something lurking in the silence, nightmares…"Akayaisdead" is an adventure game set in the modern day.

title: Rat Run
description: Jump your way through endless obstacles and smash incoming enemies as a cheese-thirsty rat! Accelerate to the maximum speed and unlock all biomes and playable rodents!

title: Conquer the Tower
description: 17s high schooler's game dream !See the world in my eye and the mechanism I've built!A tale of liberty and liberation,also a tale of oppression and enslavement..It is a platformer. Call on your friends! You are wield the power of electricity. then CONQUER the tower.

title: FTL Team
description: This is a turn-based strategy adventure game. Assemble a five-hero squad, each with unique strengths. Collect mysterious artifacts, build potent hero abilities, defeat powerful monsters, and eliminate galactic threats.​

title: Sad Virus Deathland
description: Sad virus is back in this third person platformer and now he needs find beer bottles and avoid traps

title: Rapid Eye Madness
description: Rapid Eye Madness is a short grim & cute collection of mini-games that are as cryptic as they are engaging. Venture into the eldritch nightmare, and stream for your life as you solve the challenges the screens throw at you. Will you survive this eerie gamescape, or become another one of its victims?

title: Bots N-Bloom
description: Delve through a mysterious ruin alongside your adorable robot friend, and discover ancient secrets that could help rebuild your town in Bots N-Bloom, a unique solarcore turn-based dungeon crawler.

title: When It Falls
description: An apocalyptic Ice Age approaches the automatic doors of your convenience store. Scrape together what you need to survive through bartering or outright scamming in this short narrative game. In the end, only you can judge yourself.

title: The Box is Alive
description: A physics-based comedy platformer where you tumble, roll, and flap your way through chaotic warehouse challenges as a living cardboard box.

title: Rewoven Self
description: Rewoven Self is a narrative puzzle game where fantasy and reality intertwine. Through folding, cutting, and stitching, you rebuild yourself in a cycle of brokenness and renewal— a gentle yet profound journey of emotional healing.

title: Shoot Up Basketball Pro
description: Climb to impossible heights using skill, precision, and a basketball. Prove you’re still the GOAT in this punishing platformer where one mistake can send you falling back to the bottom.

title: Battlefield: Galactic Conquest
description: Battlefield: Galactic Conquest is a full conversion Star Wars themed modification for Battlefield 1942, which puts you in the role of an average soldier in the Star Wars universe.

title: Kola Аbyss
description: Kola Abyss is a short atmospheric horror about descending into a superdeep borehole—and what awaits in the depths.

title: Songboy
description: songboy is an instrument you play with a controller. tap, hold, move the sticks to make tracks. real music, made fast.

title: Konata yori Kanata made
description: Konata yori Kanata made is a visual novel about a terminally ill young man whose remaining time is shaped by his relationships with childhood friends and the arrival of a mysterious immortal girl. The story unfolds through branching choices in a mix of romance, drama, and light fantasy.

title: Rizz Dungeon: Skeleton Key to My Heart
description: Fighting is hard, right? Let your party do it for you! Romance Monster Girls and traverse the Dungeon! Hopefully they'll all get along... right?

title: I Am Very Good At Walking
description: A competitive walking third person jumping platformer. Indie. Maybe kind of frustrating.

title: Sanabi: A Haunted Day
description: The first spin-off DLC of Sanabi, packed with thrilling action expanding on the main story.

title: You See a Monster Smoking in the Parking Lot
description: A horror-dramedy text adventure that ends in just one or two actions, but has 33 unique endings to discover. Some conclusions are dreadful and uncomfortable. Others somber. A few are just plain absurd. You set the tone. Investigate the smoking monster or kill it, think about your life, buy food, laugh or cry, drive away - and many options in between.

title: Triarchy
description: Sail your ship, explore islands, fight monsters, choose your abilities, and craft legendary gear to hunt for deadly bosses. Play Triarchy your way! Activate Boss Challenge Modes or enable Assists to suit your playstyle. Open-world, Co-op, Action Adventure (1-3 Players)

title: Not My War
description: Explore, survive, and escape a deadly island as a clever ferret. Not My War is a 3D isometric stealth and exploration game with a day-night cycle that turns time against you. Gather resources, help survivors, and repair your boat, but remember... the robots never rest.

title: Commandos: Origins - Shadows over Crete
description: The skies have darkened over the sun-drenched island of Crete! Step into a new chapter of Commandos: Origins with the “Shadows over Crete” DLC, a gripping 4-mission campaign unfolding in the aftermath of one of WWII's most infamous invasions: The Battle of Crete.

title: Motorhome: Traveling North America 2 - Collector's Edition
description: New adventure in a motorhome! Explore the vast expanses of North America, find hidden objects and solve tricky puzzles. An unforgettable trip to the most scenic spots begins now!

title: Motorhome: Traveling North America 3 - Collector's Edition
description: A journey across America in a cozy motorhome. Relaxing mini-games, hidden object scenes, collectible baseball caps, and a Polaroid travel album make every stop unique and memorable.

title: I Commissioned Some Pigeons 3
description: I paid more artists to hide pigeons and bread in 15 more pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: I Commissioned Some Pigeons 4
description: I paid more artists to hide pigeons and bread in 15 more pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: Tomorrowness
description: Take flight as Juno, a small bird guided by the sound of her guitar through a hand-drawn world of music and memory. Play melodies to solve puzzles, fly through unique platforming challenges and piece together a story of grief and love.

title: Scraps of the Machine
description: FPS Mech Action! Pilot a mass of steel through a single player campaign set in a desolate landscape. Target enemy armor or weapons to wear them down piece by piece, find upgrades to improve your mech or change its loadout, and survive in a world of rust and decay. Discover, Destroy, Scavenge.

title: Cloudsong
description: Explore a world shaped like a four-leaf clover, each leaf a unique biome, in a journey to reconnect the lost fifth leaf that ascended to the clouds. With your cloud spirit companion, solve puzzles, fight bosses, and restore balance to the land and the sky.

title: The Murder of Ava Monroe
description: A gripping detective noir mystery that blends investigation and deduction with a rich, character-driven story. The Murder of Ava Monroe is cozy, twisty, and oozing with atmosphere.

title: Cyber-ART
description: Cyber-ART is a clicker game. In the game, you need to click on the artworks! You will get a random artwork every three hours, allowing you to continuously expand your art collection!

title: Ride 6
description: Live the thrill of asphalt and dirt with RIDE 6: affirm your biker identity by joining RIDE Fest, race with 250+ bikes from different categories and prove you're the best by challenging real motorcycling legends.

title: Modern Mud
description:
Forge your destiny in a no-mercy text RPG. Explore a brutal world filled with challenging quests, hidden secrets, and ruthless PvP. Every choice shapes your path in a realm of chaos and betrayal, where gods walk among mortals and witness your fall or your glory

A modern-era adaptation of classic MUDs, designed for today’s players and systems

title: Lostade
description: Lostade is a mysterious and unique Arcade-Stylised dungeon crawler with endless possibilities, combining Character building, Crafting, and Exploration with Endless endgame and Replayability !

title: Pangs: You Are Hungry
description: PANGS (you are hungry.) is a horror visual novel game with 5+ endings and roughly 15-20 minutes of playtime.

title: Smack Talk
description: Smack Talk is a 1-4 player online pvp platform fighting game where you must say your moves out loud. Beat your opponents with one liners and finish them off with ultimate moves in this chaotic new fighter!

title: Guwange Ruga Daioujou XII Kizuna Down
description: Guwange Ruga Daioujou XII Kizuna Down is a mashup of various famous shoot 'em ups.

title: Verdge
description: Verdge is a dynamic speedrun plaformer, where the player can decide which content is generated.

title: Superpanel
description: Superpanel is a hardcore tactical shooter with high lethality for solo players or groups of friends. Customize your gear and squads, take on dangerous missions through urban labyrinths, and fight your way to the heart of Megaslavia. Enemies are both humans and monsters.

title: 2001 A Space Oddysey
description: What happens when a for-hire studio is tasked with making an adaptation of the 1968 Stanley Kubrick masterpiece. An action packed, fast paced arcade story game.

title: Tavern Master: Pirates Retreat
description: Embark on the ultimate pirate adventure and transform your tavern into a pirate's paradise. Serve pirate themed drinks, unlock new food recipes and decorate your pirate tavern with completely new decorations! You also get to own your very own pirate ship and manage the crew!

title: Ramen-ten: Heart Abyss
description: Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of a cozy Asian noodle shop right from your desk. Discover new recipes, decorate your counter, and treat peasants, samurai, and yokai to delicious, hot food while you work or relax.

title: Balatro: Lost Edition
description:
A massive, fan-made content expansion for Balatro.

Lost Edition is built with love by members of the Balatro modding community. It aims to feel like a natural extension of the base game, with lots of new content to discover and fresh synergies to explore.

Features
75+ new Jokers spread across multiple pages
10+ challenging new Boss Blinds
New Decks, Stakes, Tags, Vouchers, Editions, Enhancements, and Consumables
New Challenges to test your builds
Optional themes and color presets
Original music (toggle between Lost Edition OST and Balatro OST)

title: Zomb Zerro - 999
description: Explore a hidden corporate mountain base in immersive VR. Face twisted creatures, solve challenging puzzles, and survive a dark, unfolding mystery. Uncover a forbidden ritual that threatens to unleash hell on Earth.

title: Limbus Company: Season 7 - Kumo no Ito / Aka no Ito
description: It consists of the game's ninth Story Chapter (Canto IX: The Unsevering), the seventh Mirror Dungeon and Line 6 of Refraction Railway, as well as the release of Identities based on story content and E.G.O exclusive to the Season's Pass.

title: Kitten Space Agency
description: Kitten Space Agency is a mission to create the spaceflight game that inspires the next generation of space explorers.

title: Starbump
description: Starbump combines fast-paced action, Third Person platforming and competitive modes in vibrants worlds. It’s designed for party nights where you and your friends battle it out for hours, packed into colorful arenas and quick-fire game modes. It's a pure cozy brawl !

title: Bully Breaker
description: Years of relentless humiliation have pushed you to the brink. Now, empowered by an ancient, vengeful spirit, you'll shatter their pride and watch them submit to your will, and experience every ounce of pleasure their delicious bodies can give you.

title: Flong: Directors Cut
description: Make sure those birds don't go past the pipes in this arcade-style game!

title: Vivid Twinkler!
description: Vivid Twinkler is a free shoot 'em up inspired by the Touhou Project series.

title: Poly Plaza 2
description: Buy properties for passive income, explore a thriving city for rare resources, and hustle through jobs to build your empire in this open-world business RPG with idle game progression.

title: Agerasia
description: Eight time periods from across human history collide in a competitive bid to stop the end of the world. Go from fighting monsters to solving a murder, dating sim to escape game. Experience seven vastly different routes in a bid to solve the mystery as to why you've all been brought together.

title: No, I'm not a Voenkom
description: You're an ordinary factory worker, whiling away your dreary life in a nondescript small town. You had a stable job, your own apartment, mortgaged at just 89% interest, and everything was going well, until one gloomy evening, an uninvited guest knocked on your door...

title: Orrin's Chessboard
description: A unique tower defense game where you build defenses on a dynamic board to repel enemies. Experience the thrill of strategy with an extraordinary degree of freedom.

title: The Sims 4: Modern Retreat Kit
description: Bring a modern vision of nature's spirit into your Sims' living room with The Sims 4 Modern Retreat†.

title: The Sims 4: Garden to Table Kit
description: Transform your outdoor dining area into a rustic retreat where homegrown harvests are the cornerstone of meal time with The Sims 4 Garden to Table Kit†.

title: Hotel Melancolie
description:
A short, first-person psychological horror experience set inside a forgotten hotel where time, guilt, and memory all bleed together.

You wake up in Room 9.
The corridor outside loops back on itself.
Every time you step through the door, something has changed; the walls, the lights, the voice on the radio.

title: Cicadamata"
description: + follow the white rabbit + hop, skip, and jump to become one with joyeuse, until you are no longer you +

title: Intrigue At Oakhaven
description: Oakhaven is a story-driven point-and-click adventure game. Cousins Daphne and Dominic are summoned by their Grand-mère to the family's historic southern manor house. Play as both characters as you explore the house and grounds, solve puzzles, complete tasks, and uncover long-buried family secrets.

title: Houkago Cinderella Mini Fandisk: Anata to Kaeru Saigo no Gekoudou
description: After-stories with each heroine after graduation.

title: Houkago Cinderella 2 Mini Fandisk: Kimi to Odoru Hajimete no Happy Halloween
Ship Explorer: Bismarck
description: Step aboard the German battleship Bismarck - history's most legendary warship. Explore the ship to learn about how she worked and bring her guns to life once more!

title: Anno 117: Pax Romana - Gold Edition
description:
In the Gold Edition, gain access to the Anno 117: Pax Romana base adventure and expand your reach to new provinces with the Year 1 Pass – containing 3 DLCs and 5 cosmetic bonuses!
Shape the Roman Empire in this genre-defining strategic builder game.
Build cities while expanding your influence through Roman provinces.
Govern using your economic prowess, diplomatic skills, or military might.

title: Capybara Against Humanity
description: Have you ever played a Tower Defence? Well. On this one, you don't place towers; you place obstacles in which waves of silly human invaders keep crashing into! You can also get dirty and personal by pushing the invaders away yourself!. Or throw a rock at them. That could also work!

title: Peasant Dream: Ascension
description: Forge your destiny and become a legend! Help villagers, explore a deadly dungeon, build passionate romances, and prove your worth to reach the rank of Gold Adventurer. Your journey to glory begins now!

title: God of Yoga
description: In a world of sensuality and grace, guide your yoga students through the power of movement, breath... and intimate connection. Feel the divine energy of pleasure! Abhyasa and Vairagya!

title: Red Out Block
description:
RedOutBlock has returned more fun than ever!

Actions like crouching and rotating.

title: Villa Nocturne
description: In a mansion shrouded in mist, face the ghosts of the past. With puzzles, exploration, and moments of sheer terror, Villa Nocturne awaits.

title: Movie Theater Simulator
description: This is a movie theater simulator where you can watch fair use documentaries and other video on various subjects. Want to go to the movies without leaving your house? now you can get the movie theater experience from your bedroom with virtual reality simulator

title: Human Construction Site
description: Human Construction Site is a survival horror game that follows the tradition of Japanese horror titles like Ao Oni and Ib. Players navigate through a dark narrative with body horror elements, discovering multiple story paths that lead to five different endings during its 2-3 hour runtime.

title: Ashes of Paradise
description: Ashes of Paradise is a cinematic visual novel set between a neon city and its underworld, following Ash as she uncovers hidden truths and shapes her path through key choices and emotional moments.

title: Cocoboy
description: Rediscover the lost ‘80s platformer COCOBOY in an alternate 2005! Hack a forgotten game with bizarre mods, decorate your bedroom with rare collectibles, and scour the forums of a budding fandom for clues to deeply puzzling secrets.

title: Dungeon Concierge
description:
Dungeon Concierge is a fast-paced Dungeon Crawler where you play as a wizard hired by a low budget company to maintain dungeons while the heroes are away.

Clean up the aftermath of epic battles in a chaotic medieval fantasy world, while trying to stay alive. Wield powerful spells to sweep through grime, dispose of hazards, and manipulate the environment to your advantage. Complete odd jobs, fulfill contracts, and make just enough gold to put bread on the table.

title: Phantasmal Exosteel
description: Build your team, master the board, and forge powerful shard decks in this 2D fantasy JRPG roguelike. Match tiles, chain elements, and explore ever-changing Sectors where no two runs are the same. Strategy, fate, and chaos collides.

title: Backyard Hockey ‘02
description: Lace up your skates, strap on your helmet, and grab your hockey stick because the Backyard athletes are teaming up with kid versions of legendary hockey stars in Backyard Hockey ‘02! Customize your uniform, set your lineups, and get ready for three periods of non-stop hockey action! Play quick games, single games, or a whole season. Track stats in Season play and create custom players to watch their skills improve over time!

title: Backyard Basketball ‘01
description: The Backyard athletes are teaming up with the kid version of hoops legend Lisa Leslie in Backyard Basketball ‘01! Customize your uniform, pick your fab five, and get ready for four quarters of hoops! Play single games or a whole season. Track stats in Season play and create custom players to watch their skills improve over time!

title: Feed The Scorchpot
description: A dice roguelike about feeding a dragon for twenty years. Roll ingredients, build your island, and fuse absurd recipes into combos that break the score wide open. Miss a meal and you're next on the menu.

title: Dune Raider
description: Surf the forgotten sands as a pirate of the dunes. Wreck ships with your trusty spear and use your loot to buy upgrades and explore dangerous biomes as you rise to fame in this open-world sand surfing roguelike.

title: Snake-A-Roid
description:
Snake-A-Roid is an Arcade style game that’s been lost down the back of the sofa.

Featuring a clean vector-like style, and crunchy chip tune sound track, it evokes an era where games taunted you to spend your money, as you climbed to the top of that high score table.

title: Five Nights at Flow's
description: Welcome to your new summer job at the beloved (or hated) Flow Podcast!

title: Five Nights at Flow's 2
description:
Well, let's forget the past and enjoy the present! Introducing... THE NEWEST AND GREATEST PODCAST STUDIO FROM THE mAgNiFicEnT "Newcast Productions"! With both loved and hated shows: Podpah, Master Podcast, À Deriva and that other one...

Enjoy the start of a NEW AGE of podcasts!

title: Dumpling
description: DUMPLing is a fast-paced top-down survival shooter with a metroidvania twist. Pulled into the strange land of DUMPL, you’ll explore tunnels in platformer perspective, fight dumpling-like enemies in top down perspective, and uncover a bizarre story about food, friendship, and survival.

title: Violent Horror Stories 2
description:
Violent Horror Stories 2 delivers a fresh lineup of horror games from different developers. Each title puts its own spin on the theme of confinement, complete with distinctive visuals, gameplay, and story. Expect roughly 30 minutes of playtime per game.

A brand‑new bundle from the creators of the short‑form horror hit Violent Horror Stories. This time the collection revolves around one chilling theme: confinement.

title: Parking Garage Rally Circuit: European Tour
description: 8 all-new courses across Europe!

title: Movies Tycoon: Thrills & Spectacles
description: Add explosive stunts and dazzling effects to your movies! Hire stuntmen and FX supervisors, film on thrilling new sets, and push your studio to new heights — or risk it all when your stuntmen go up in smoke!

title: A World of Keflings: Sugar, Spice and Not So Nice
description: The chocolate volcano, caramel lake, cotton candy forest and gingerbread Keflings are in danger of being devoured! Harvest candy, bake building pieces, and assemble edible buildings to help save the Gingerlings and drive a sinister wizard from their kingdom!

title: Escape from Tarkov: PVE Zone
description: Unlock co-op PvE mode for Escape from Tarkov — play with friends, progress without wipes, and develop your character at your own pace.

title: Escape From Ruin: Greymart Simulator
description: A post-apocalyptic loot-fight-extract survival game with escape-style raids by day and black-market shop management by night. Fans of Tarkov-like gameplay — and players who love running management sims — will feel right at home.

title: 201 Street
description:
Malsivus is throwing their first annual Halloween festival! Leticia's over the moon, but Billie's less than enthused. Join them on the Halloween of a lifetime.

Face your fears.

title: Drillbound
description: Drillbound is a short incremental game about mining your way to the planet’s core. Crush layers of rock, gather resources, upgrade your drill, and unlock powerful technologies as you descend into the depths.

title: Scratching Shadows
description:
This is an unfinished project that was originally meant to be part of a Critical Reflex game collab (CRBroadcast), but it ended up not moving forward.
A hungry cat wearing a small body camera, exploring an abandoned motel in search of food.

title: Scarlet Hollow: Episode 2
description: The second episode of the game Scarlet Hollow. Last night you encountered something beyond your understanding - start to investigate the matter with Stella and Kaneeka or forget about that and spend the day with your cousin Tabitha. Either way soon enough you will get in another supernatural event.

title: Lorenzo PC Adventure DX Director's Cut Ultimate New Funky Mode Edition
description: The Galactic Poultry Army has taken over a small town of Emerel and Amongst the captives are 8 orphans and a young woman named Sarah, who is the Mayor's daughter. It's up to Lorenzo and his friend Ivan to put a stop to it.

title: Renegade Hero: Termination of Salvation
description: You are Arnold and your goal is to terminate a machine by the name of: SALVATION and rescue professor Linda.

title: Void Grapplers
description: Void Grapplers is a super fast platforming roguelike with the crazy movement of games like Sonic Mania, Pizza Tower, and Grapple Dog, along with the funky style of Antonblast, Sonic Rush, and Garbanzo Quest. Join Jac, Giromo, and their friends as they dash, swing, and zip through several procedurally generated levels.

title: Scarlet Hollow: Episode 3
description: Yesterday you promised that today you'll participate in ghost hunting at Oscar's house but before that you can spend some quality time with Tabitha and visit Stella's and Kaneeka's friend Reese.

title: The Last Poem
description:
5 years have passed since then.
The sequel to "Christmas Tina" by the original team.
Here and now. A "Chinese" and a "Japanese" meet once more in a non-romantic encounter. At the end of the century, a journey begins—from the first (her) to the last (her)...

title: The Holiday Story
description: The Holiday Story is an indie horror game about Christmas and New Year, set in the 80s.

title: Scarlet Hollow: Episode 4
description: Stella is missing after she run off last night. Kaneeka suggests go looking for her. Her mom Sybil wants to meet you in the afternoon to discuss something about the mistery and the clinic is still supernaturally attracting you.

title: rotten angel
description:
You, your boyfriend, and his twin brother were having a great halloween dinner. Who knew that a corpse would be found just a day afterwards?

Some say that death is a beginning. This situation was no exception. In this case, death became a key to opening a pandora’s box. Suspicions and revelations of long kept secrets emerge as an exchange.

title: The Cat: Tales of Istanbul
description: Live, explore, and survive as three cats on the streets of Istanbul. A cozy yet emotional adventure full of discovery, freedom, and belonging — blending cat life simulation, narrative storytelling, and atmospheric exploration

title: It Takes a Tribe
description: ITAT is a single-player strategy set in a harsh and mythical world before cities and civilization. Lead a tribe of hunter-gatherers to fulfil their destiny. Survive, explore, craft, perform rituals, design art and forge a cultural identity. What stories will your tribe tell?

title: Protocol: Terminate
description: A co-op survival horror shooter against an AI that learns from your actions. It grows more dangerous, relentlessly hunts you, and turns mistakes into deadly traps. Hide, hack security systems, and work together to survive.

title: The Planetarian
description: Join the Planetarian, guardian of the World Tree, on an epic journey to protect various planets. Experience intense third-person shooter gameplay with bullet hell elements. Battle diverse enemies across seven visually stunning planets and collect equipment infused with planetary energy.

title: Mechwarrior 5: Clans - Wolves of Tukayyid
description: Join Natasha Kerensky's Wolf Spiders in a 20-mission campaign as ComStar faces the Clan threat. Field six powerful Mechs, call in Arrow IV Artillery and Tactical Strikes, and fight through the Battle of Tukayyid to claim honor for Clan Wolf.

title: Tomba! 2: The Evil Swine Return Special Edition
description: Tomba! 2: The Evil Swine Return Special Edition is an action-platformer following the pink-haired hero Tomba as he confronts the return of his porcine adversaries. This updated version of the 1999 PlayStation classic combines side-scrolling platforming with RPG elements, featuring quests and item collection across a colorful world where players must defeat evil pigs and restore peace to the land.

title: Session: Skate Sim - El Lay
description: Welcome to El Lay - where the sun and the sand meet the grit of the big city. Come shred our homage to some of the most iconic skateparks on the West Coast.

title: KinForge
description: KinForge is a co-op, creature-collector action RPG where every fusion of powers creates new experiences, wild combos, and the strength to fight against spreading Corruption. Forge bonds with Ancient Elementals, beings of the Mystic Realm, and restore a world on the brink of collapse.

title: Caribbean Legend: Age of Pirates
description: You are the captain and owner of your own ship—the finest fate one could hope for in the 17th century Caribbean. Unlimited sandbox experience. A unique genre blending naval combat, land exploration, and global map. Think Sid Meier's Pirates! meets Bannerlord.

title: Ark: Valguero Ascended
description: Explore Valguero, a land where medieval legend and ancient memory entwine. Journey across ten deadly biomes, from tundra to shadowed trenches, and face predators like the swift Deinonychus and the terrifying Megaraptor. Both beautiful and brutal, Valguero will test your survival like never before.

title: Phobophobia 1.0: The Experiment
description: A story-driven psychological horror experience where you must survive 10 phobia-inspired rooms, each filled with atmospheric puzzles, relentless dread, and unsettling truths waiting to be uncovered.

title: Phantom Lamb
description: Phantom Lamb casts you as an amnesiac inmate navigating a nightmarish, isolated asylum. Surrounded by unspeakable horrors and enigmatic characters, you must piece together your fragmented memories to escape or succumb to madness. This game blends psychological terror with stealth, and survival.

title: Lone Stars
description: You're a renowned doctor specializing in biomechatronics, dedicated to assisting cyborgs with cutting-edge body enhancements. When Boothill, freshly transformed into a cyborg, loses crucial body parts during his transition, he turns to you for help. As you navigate the intricate procedures, the lines between professional duties and personal feelings start to blur. Will you maintain your professionalism, or will an unexpected connection blossom?

title: Oh, You Touch My Balls
description: Oh, You Touch My Balls is a physics puzzle game. Solve the puzzle and guide the ball into the cup.

title: Lyset Core
description: A horror visual novel set in a steampunk universe. Young Lyset finds herself wandering through a mysterious world of sentient machines. In her desperate search for her long-lost brother, she must choose between death and immortality.

title: Guilty Pleasures
description: You are Marcus Holmes, a young private detective and nephew of the legendary detective Arthur Holmes, known among the elite as the “Detective of Passion” — a man who uncovered the intimate secrets of the rich and famous: affairs, love triangles, model disappearances, scandals in high society.

title: Get Colossal
description: Giant robot arena brawler/party game with huge unit size differences and inertia/physics based combat. Slug it out as tiny humans and giant robots in fully destructible environments! Team up with friends and prove your ultimate badassery. Get smacked! Get EVEN! Get EVEN BIGGER! GET COLOSSAL!

title: King's Courier
description: King’s Courier is a free roam, party-based RPG. Carry out perilous quests for the King while exploring dungeons, enchanted forests, deadly swamps, and monster-filled caves. Build your party, learn magic, battle in real-time or turn-based, solve puzzles, and uncover the kingdom’s secrets.

title: Iron Nest: Heavy Turret Simulator
description: Iron Nest is a brutal dieselpunk heavy-artillery game where you dominate the battlefield through a colossal war machine. Take map measurements based on the received coordinates, strain the hydraulics, and gunlay the cannons to unleash devastating blows ⟹ Will you obey High Command, Operator?

title: Status Entropos
description: Getting shooters back on the right track—just as gamers want. Immerse yourself in tactical team combat with a vast arsenal of weapons, customization, gadgets, and destruction!

title: Inkaro
description: Inkaro is a brutal Parkour FPS that crosses flow-state platforming and push forward combat against anomalous enemies - doling out punishment with a toybox of weapons. Roam megastructures of plastic and concrete in a desolate journey of revenge and violence, clad in armor of ink and bone.

title: Bang Bang Tank
description: Bang Bang Tank is a physics-based roguelike. Lead your tank battalion into explosive battles against the Evil Onioner’s invading army. Choose skilled drivers, craft unexpected winning strategies, upgrade your sciences, and deploy troops tactically to crush your enemies!

title: 17 MPH
description: Make your way through unusual off-road challenges with advanced suspension physics and weirdly shaped wheels, but don't go below 17 miles per hour or you will regret it.

title: Faro
description: Faro is an immersive visual novel set on a sunless planet. Everyone tries their best to survive in these barren lands. Make your choices as you set forth into this unforgiving world.

title: Gothic Scythe
description: An high-difficulty action game where you must slip past your enemies attacks and crush them. Take back the city controlled by homunculus with your scythe.

title: SCP: ReEnter
description: SCP: ReEnter is a free, asymmetrical multiplayer FPS set during a massive containment breach. Players are randomly assigned to Humans or SCPs. Fight to secure the facility, escape, or slaughter everyone with seven playable anomalies.

title: Little Squirrel Cabin
description:
Little Squirrel Cabin is a 2D pixel-art survival horror game with psychological elements and dynamic storytelling.
Every new dawn can change your situation.
Nights are harsh, your sanity is fragile, and local traders have their own interests.

title: Trium
description: Simple yet authentic 3-button action. Take control of the humanoid antivirus 'TRIUM', in this on-rails virus-killing action game. Eliminate viruses, speed up, and catch up to the 'Intruder' virus that started this mess!

title: Savior Syndrome: The Crimson Sun
description: Savior Syndrome: The Crimson Sun is a psychological dialogue-based RPG set in a world where genetic experiments coexist with occult practices.

title: REday -1
description: A time loop. Soviet Siberia. Build the protagonist’s character, unravel the mystery, and finally escape this cursed place.

title: PWK Trivia Collection
description: The 'PWK Trivia Collection' is a compilation of questions on various topics such as Anime, Gaming, and more! Click through diverse question types and become the Trivia Champion!

title: Cats and Cows
description: Plant, craft, farm, and build as a Cat in Cats And Cows. Paint and design your island landscape, build farms and expand your island to build your farming empire!

title: Marvel Rivals: Season 5 - Love is a Battlefield
description: Before the Timestream Entanglement tore their world apart, Gambit and Rogue were ready to say "I do" on Krakoa. But destiny intervened. Now, Gambit sets out on a daring cosmic heist to steal the universe's rarest ring - and win back the moment time itself stole from them.

title: Good Morning My Darling
description: Mailey wakes up and goes to make her morning tea. However, something strange is going on inside her house, and her housemate Derthan is nowhere to be seen. Perhaps, the answer lies somewhere in her memories?

title: Astra Industria
description: Astra Industria is a sci-fi factory builder set on colossal player-constructed space megastructures with the addictive growth of incremental games. Extract resources, craft advanced components, and automate deep-space production through a vast tech tree.

title: Seize The Elixir
description: A martial arts and immortal style action adventure single player game with thrilling battles. You need to constantly defeat strong enemies, gain strength, and forge ahead. Along the way, you can learn a variety of skills and spells to enhance your strength and deal with stronger enemies.

title: Soulflame
description: Fight, explore, and uncover the secrets of a world bound by nature and spirit — all to save the one person you have left.

title: Anomaly Evolution
description: Are you ready to uncover SCP-682’s ultimate form? In Anomaly Evolution, evolve SCP-682, SCP-1471, and SCP-999 from mere anomalies into godlike Lovecraftian beings. Click, evolve, and witness the rise of horrors beyond comprehension!

title: Heavy Spoilers RPG 2: Your Best Friend Is Actually the Great Demon King
description: Demons are in the forest and King Beek Eld fears for his life. His allies Kil Yu and Cleer Leeahspy are with him as rumors spread. The Demon King may be hiding as a human. Elsewhere, a man awakens with amnesia. He manages to make a best friend but doesn't yet know the shocking truth of his identity.

title: FiresOut!
description: FiresOut! is a chaotic couch co-op firefighting game for up to four players. You and your friends dive right into the burning neighborhood to extinguish fire, rescue trapped victims and overcome unpredictable environmental hazards all while dodging fiery projectiles from the fire monsters.

title: TownsFolk
description: Guide your people through ruin—build, survive, and let every choice shape their fate. Rekindle the light of a forgotten world.

title: Spectral Report
description: Enter abandoned locations as Spectral Reporters to prove the existence of ghosts. But beware: sanity is fragile, and not everything you see is real. Cooperate with your team, investigate the place, take evidences, and finally prove that ghosts are real.

title: Abyssal Anarchy
description: A fast-paced co-op spell-hell where each map pulls you deeper into the Abyss. Choose from 5 heroes and 14 spells, unlock upgrades, and survive alone or with friends as the magic grows wilder with every descent.

title: Fate Machine
description: A little slot machine-based roguelite dungeon crawler. Good for killing time.

title: Classroom 0
description: Trapped in endless corridors of an eeire Indian school, spot anomalies and reach the 0th floor to escape the loop.

title: Leaf Blower Something
description: Put those leaves on the street where they belong in this arcade-style game. Get as many leaves as you can into the pile before time runs out. Keep your performance level up or you'll be out of a job.

title: Imperial Bureaucracy Hero
description: IBH is a rich role playing game at the end of time. You're a mid-level official in a dying sci-fi regime, given the impossible task of fixing a faltering machine; explore a vast world, define your mind, flex your authority, and become a sinner or a savior in countless other stories.

title: The Doodle Palette
description: A cozy sandbox for building and painting miniature worlds. Place, paint, and decorate while tiny people and birds bring your dioramas to life.

title: Pieces of the Kingdom
description: What if Chess…was a roguelite? Assemble your party and battle your way across a broken kingdom in a fantastical, tactical take on Chess. Loot epic gear, recruit powerful pieces with unique abilities, and strategize your way to victory.

title: Bedtime Nightmare
description: In Bedtime Nightmare, you play as a kid who must finish all your tasks before going to sleep. But something is lurking in the dark areas of your house, so remember to always stay in the light.

title: Teaching Simulator: Elite Class
description: Jump into the world of teaching with Teaching Simulator: Elite Class. Help your students learn, improve, and graduate from primary school. Decorate your classroom to make learning more fun and exciting. Bring in new students, support your team, and keep your principal happy. Every choice you make affects your classroom, your school, and everyone around you.

title: Wuthering Waves: To the City Set in Amber
description:
Version 2.8 of Wuthering Waves, including:
• New characters: Chisa and Buling
• New story quests
• New area: Chronorift Metropolis
• New echoes, events and more!

title: Zenless Zone Zero: Update 2.4 - On the Precipice of the Abyss
description:
Version 2.4 of Zenless Zone Zero, which includes:
• New Characters: Dialyn and Banyue
• New Main Story Quest
• New events
• ...and more!

title: Taguan
description: David Lagani is just an ordinary Filipino worker trying to get by. But when news spreads of a figure breaking into homes and making people disappear, his routine turns to dread.

title: Outpacked
description:
A scientist needs your help to pack for a conference trip, but be sure not to pack any hot items next to any meltable items, nor any liquid containers next to any electronics!

A family needs your help to pack their rucksacks for a camping trip, but the childrens' plushies are very picky about who and what they're packed near!

A rock musician needs your :-- well, you get the idea.

Outpacked is a logic puzzle game about efficiently packing items into grid-based inventories while satisfying their various constraints. Think "Tetris meets Sudoku".

title: Corinne
description: Navigate Corinne through a realm of pixel horrors, surrounded by neighbors that are turning into bloodthirsty monsters. Discover the secrets of this twisted dimension before it's too late for Corinne and her friends.

title: Athelan Battlegrounds
description: Athelan Battlegrounds is a free-to-play, turn-based tactics game with no meta progression and no pay-to-win. It's a game made for players who thrive in a skill-based competitive environment. A game that promises to be easy to learn but incredibly difficult to master! Build your team of champions and engage in unique matches against players or AI!

title: Ravenous Hand
description:
The Onyx Mirage keeps the lights on, the drinks flowing, and the debts endless.

Night after night, you spin the wheel, deal the hands, and tell yourself if you work hard enough, you'll make it out. But in a city where luck runs dry and organized crime rules the streets, all it takes is catching the wrong person's eye to turn your life into the next wager...

This demo was created for the Yandere Game Jam 2025 and features one yandere Love Interest.

title: Devoted Vampire
description:
Rarely do residents go out at night because they fear for their lives. Police often leave this area alone due to its connections to unknown people of power. It is the perfect hunting ground for a vampire such as yourself.

However, after seeing blood in your apartment's hallway and a cop showing sudden interest in your turf you will need to put extra effort into finding your prey.

Keep yourself from accusations and find out who is behind all the murders within the limited daylight hours your vampire body can handle.

title: Half-Life: Insecure
description: Relive the events of the Black Mesa incident as security officer Andrew Cooper. Trapped in the facility after the resonance cascade, your priority is to escape alive before the situation gets any worse.

title: Granite Noir
description:
Granite Noir: The Social Experiment is a first-person experimental game where YOU literally create the game for others.

Enter a dark room. Wait 2 hours as a timer counts down to 00:00:00. Before you stands a black granite monolith inscribed with the wishes of previous players.

When the timer reaches zero, make ONE wish. ONE permanent addition to the game. Your wish will be implemented by the developers and engraved on the monolith forever.

THE RULES:
- One wish per player, for life
- Every wish is implemented - no refusals, no exceptions
- Implementation time: hours to months depending on complexity
- Your wish shapes the experience for thousands who follow

At launch, the game is nearly empty: a dark room, a monolith, a timer, echoing footsteps. The game builds itself through players' cumulative wishes.

This isn't Early Access. This is a finished social experiment that evolves indefinitely.

Will you collaborate with the community? Subvert expectations? Create chaos? The choice (and its permanent consequences) are yours.

"You're not buying a complete game. You're buying the power to CREATE the game for others."

title: Nature Flight Module
description: Find freedom by soaring to the skies, where safety and abundance await those gifted with wings.

title: Nature Jurassic Module
description: Return to an age of giants, where ferocious predators and colossal dinosaurs roam the land.

title: Janky Golf with Stream
description: A chaotic Twitch integrated mini golf game where your viewers control the shots. Design maps while Twitch chat aims, rotates, and swings using commands or the interactive extension.

title: Dispatch: Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
Dispatch is a superhero workplace comedy where choices matter. Manage a dysfunctional team of misfit heroes and strategize who to send to emergencies around the city, all while balancing office politics, personal relationships, and your own quest to become a hero.

Dispatch: Digital Deluxe Edition includes:
- Dispatch - Full Game
- Digital Art Book: The Art of Dispatch
- Digital Comic: Splash/The Last Bender
- Digital Comic: Pas De Deux/Shellshock
- Digital Comic: Get Up
- Digital Comic: The Death of Mecha Man

title: Peace Finder
description: "Shoot to find peace." Vertical shoot'em up made in pico-8.

title: Nocturnal Watch
description: In this short anomaly horror game your job is to patrol the forest at the northern border. Spot anomalies and purge the rot being spread by the witch.

title: Memology: Absurd Racing
description: Hold on to the steering wheel and hold your head tight — "Absurd racing" can drive you crazy. Good luck!

title: Bakery Magnate: Online
description: Bakery Magnate is an economic game that takes place in the 90s, during the collapse of the USSR, when everyone survives as best they can. You play as Juhud, a shoemaker trying to raise his illegal business in defiance of the state and the mafia.

title: Communist Clicker
description: Fun clicker game with everything from nukes to stonks!

title: Coin Chase
description: "Coin Chase" is a thrilling, action-packed racing game where players evade the police or compete with friends in high-speed chases. Collect coins, outmaneuver opponents, and leave a trail of smoke in this captivating and addictive racing adventure!

title: Memology: Italian Meme War
description: Tralalero Tralala vs. Frigo Camelo — who to choose? Who will be stronger and will smash the enemies to smithereens?

title: Poker Battle
description: Origin & Inspiration‌: Derived from the Chinese fable "‌The Race of Tian Ji's Horses‌". Light strategy 3D card game. Top-down perspective. Turn-based gameplay. Compares poker card numbers. Players control all actions through ‌mouse clicks‌. Offers a joyful gaming experience.

title: A Drop of Color
description: A story-driven RPG puzzle game where you solve color-based puzzles and engage in side-scrolling shooter action in an arcade.

title: NFL Math
description: NFL Math is an educational game which aims to teach children about math. Each play is resolved by solving a math question which is always set as text problem. The goal is of course to answer as many questions as possible so the own team wins the match. The questions are divided into four categories (Number Sense, Geometry, Algebra and Statistics & Probability) and have four difficulty levels. The matches itself are either single or playoffs (a series of six matches).

title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 - Season 1
Enchantex
description: Enchantex is an urban fantasy queer dating chat-sim with visual novel elements. Play as a Wizard, Witch or Wix, pick your name, icon and hobbies, help customers in need and, of course, find love... Either on the AO4 webpage or near the lava cooler.

title: I Commissioned Some Snails 5
description: I paid artists to hide snails and lettuce in 15 more artworks. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: Fatty Space
description: Strongly recommended to play with friends! You are astronaut stucked in space after an alien object almost destroyed your space station and you have no equipment to come back to Earth. What are you going to do in open space until boredom kills you? Your crew knows the answer!

title: Lord of Darkness: Celebration
description: This is the final game in the "Lord of Darkness" trilogy in the genre of old JRPGs with a turn-based combat system. As in the previous installments, the dramatic story is skillfully combined with parody and satirical notes. These are difficult times.

title: Invoker Tactics
description: A fantasy grid-based strategy game with deckbuilding and unit merging! Collect and battle with different units, craft strategies and challenge difficult opponents on the gridded battlefield!

title: Robot-Mail Rush
description: Welcome to a world where even robots can care! You are an automated postman whose task is to deliver important letters to every corner of the city.

title: FlowCity Builder
description: FlowCity Builder is a cozy and relaxing low-poly fantasy city builder. Create big cities from small villages. Manage your resources and fulfill the demands of your citizens!

title: Spacenap
description: A chill clicker-idle stars hunting and constellations creation game that sits in the corner of your screen. Feel free to daydream while you are working or doing something else.

title: Handmade Carprogram
description: Develop software with fun, game-like programming. You’ll set up things like houses and tools, without using hardly any words, just like a simulation game. This becomes an act of programming, and as a result, you’ll be able to develop software. “Programs are toys.”

title: Testimony: Metal Graveyard
description: Mario, a college student in his early 20s, gets a call from a distant uncle asking him to take care of a junkyard in the middle of nowhere. As the days unfold, he’ll wish he had never gone there. Mario survived by making the right choices

title: Zangyou: Overtime
description: Backrooms style thriller set in a deserted Shibuya skyscraper. Awaken on the 32nd floor at midnight, collect shards, unlock secrets, and escape before you disappear forever.

title: Mayday
description: Take to space in this action-packed shmup, where every wave of enemies is rewarded with a buff and debuff. Play through the intense story and arcade modes to become an ace pilot. What stats will you increase? Which ones are worth the sacrifice? The battle begins!

title: Destroyed Base
