description: Destroyed Base is a 2D platformer adventure where your main task is to survive, find resources to strengthen your shelter and defeat the enemies inhabiting these gloomy corners of the forest. Various bandits have escaped into this forest, who, like you, are hunting for various resources.

title: RedCloak
description: The story of Little Red Riding Hood begins in the forest with her companion Light in an unfamiliar place with no memory. Enjoy a full-scale side-scrolling action RPG with tough boss battles where even a moment of inattention can kill you, and uncover the truth about the lost world.

title: Gridvania
description: In this 2D Puzzle Metroidvania, explore the world collecting items to help you solve puzzles on your way to reach the flag! Will you remember where you came from, and will you be able to collect all the hidden gems?

title: Shadows Of Lir'Ah
description: A battle ensues and the fauna of the depths has awaken. Those who seek fortune, those who seek power gathered. You find yourself amidst it all, with no memory on how you reached the Island in the first place. What will you do?

title: Warhammer 40,000: Darktide - Hive Scum Class
description: The Hive Scum comes screaming from the depths of the hive, sowing destruction and mayhem in their wake. These dangerous cartel fixers represent the criminal powers that some say truly run Tertium.

title: Havendock: Wizard Island DLC
description: Bring magic to your Havendock with the Wizard Island DLC! Explore Asteria, befriend wizards, harvest Mana, grow Mana Shrooms, forge Mana Essence, and build arcane structures. Cast 20+ spells, level your mages, and let Wisps zip items across the island.

title: It's Inside Me
description: A short horror game experience made in 2 weeks for Pizza Doggy's Horror Jam #3.

title: Dadish 4
description: Dadish 4 keeps the series' signature platforming style but introduces new twists. Players will navigate through 3D environments, making the most of Dadish's upgraded abilities like double jumps, dash attacks, and wall running. Each level contains multiple paths, rewarding exploration and offering a fresh experience every time. The game features traditional platforming mechanics alongside puzzle elements that require players to think strategically about their next move.

title: Time Crack
description: A thriller and mystery visual novel about broken trust and the search for truth, when a high-school student is accused of his parents’ brutal murder. Every choice might bring you closer to the truth... or end in tragedy.

title: Bio-Breaker
description: A top-down 2D pixel art zombie shooter. Featuring 20+ enemies, 7 upgradeable weapons, 6 active abilities and passive perks, unlockable player skins and more!

title: An Eggstremely Hard Game
description: Two geese. One fragile egg. Infinite chaos. Work together to carry it through unpredictable challenges without breaking it, every crack makes it harder, every mistake more hilarious. A co-op physics game about teamwork, clumsiness, and the unstoppable power of honking.

title: Heroes of Megatoweropolis: Operation Bluelight
description:
This game is a direct continuation to the end of Heroes of Megatoweropolis Season 1.

Think of this game as a cross between Mega Man X, Dan the Man, and Pizza Tower. You run to the end, punch anything that moves, trigger transformations that drain your stamina, fight bosses at the end (or start) of each chapter, unlock Wyatt's Bluelight Level 2 transformation after beating the game, and unlock a fifth character after you M-Rank every level in the main campaign. There are also bonus levels, costumes, and 2-player co-op.

title: Tia: Weird Hunter
description: Welcome to Tia: Weird Hunter, a hand-drawn 2D action RPG. Unleash fast, fluid combos, and take on fierce boss battles that will test your reflexes and skills. Play as the mysterious Scythe Maiden as you explore the vivid, fantastical city known as the Faceless City.

title: Bikepacking Simulator
description: Bikepacking and cycle touring simulation game. Survive with the resources you carry on your bike as you travel through different environments and routes. Camp in your tent, buy food, manage your energy and inventory, and embark on the adventure of freely traveling by bike.

title: Oedipus / Antigone
description: Three Theban tragedies of Sophocles as a visual novel with parallel text in Ancient Greek for reference.

title: Stone Eternal
description:
"Every map marked this town as empty, forgotten, erased. And yet, the statues remain.

Nearby villagers still speak of this town in hushed tones. They warn travellers never to step through its streets once darkness falls.

Some claim those who lived here made a pact during the war, trading their souls for eternal life.

You travel here in search of truth…"

Explore this horrifying first person experience from ROBOTBOY.

title: Hollow Mire: Shadow of Breken House
description: A war hero returns to a shattered England, searching for his missing family while confronting nightmares that defy reality. A choice-driven, narrative thriller with 8 unique endings.

title: Tom Clancy's The Division 2: Year 5 Season 3 - Vanguard
description:
Year 5 Season 3: Vanguard takes Division Agents back to the streets of New York to investigate the disappearance of Agent Kelso. In addition to the new gear and continuation of the story, players will get their hands on the comprehensive health updates done as the result of Project Resolve.

CONTENTS
Season 3: Vanguard Manhunt
Season 3: Vanguard Calendar
Gear, Weapons & Talents
Descent
Project Resolve
Balancing
Improvements
Fixes
Apparel Event
Season Pass

title: BlueBirdRP
description:
BlueBirdRP is a multiplayer role-playing experience built for Grand Theft Auto V using the FiveM framework. Set in a fictionalised version of Melbourne, Australia, it focuses on long-term character stories, community-driven roleplay and a persistent online world.

Players can take on civilian, emergency services or criminal roles, including careers such as police, ambulance, fire and transport, or running player-owned businesses like cafés, mechanics, nightclubs and retail stores. A custom economy, progression systems and server-wide events support both everyday life roleplay and larger story arcs.

BlueBirdRP requires a PC copy of Grand Theft Auto V and the FiveM client to play. It is an online-only experience hosted on community-run dedicated servers and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.

title: Spookular Game
description: Egg lad from the adventures in Eggular Game returns for another adventure! This time he's traveled to the strange part of town, across the train tracks to trick or treat!

title: Syncblade
description: A rhythm game where you can play any song thanks to our advanced music analysis system, or create and share custom levels with players around the world. Play as Akemi, a unique samurai girl, and slash through waves of Zombeats to the beat of the music you love.

title: The Quiet After
description: The Quiet After is a narrative visual novel where players guide Ava, a survivor navigating a quiet but dangerous world shaped by memory, trauma, and choice. Every decision branches the story, influences Ava’s inner voice, and determines how you survive in the aftermath. The game blends choice-driven storytelling, psychological horror, and atmospheric art to create an emotional narrative experience focused on healing, survival, and the consequences of the past.

title: RandomRoll Challenge
description:
The game is about getting and beating highscores for different Levels.
Your goal is to collect enough random dice rolls to upgrade the speed for the next diceroll.
So try out your luck and get the best possible highscore, but be careful not to get angry if you dont get the needed roll. ;)

title: Go! Sloth
description: Leisurely? Not at all—it's a frantic dash. Control a physics-simulated sloth shuffling along, and cross the road before its HP runs out. A laughably nerve-wracking time-killer.

title: Float Your Goat
description: A wacky physics puzzler where you (sometimes haphazardly) engineer rafts that float a goat and his "friends" across the seas. Use various materials to keep them dry and sane.

title: Farming Simulator 25: JCB - WFT
description: JCB - WFT, the world's fastest and Guinness World Record-winning tractor (top speed: 247 km/h), is now drivable in Farming Simulator 25!

title: Tavernia
description: In Tavernia, a single-player fantasy tavern simulator, you’ll pour drinks for rowdy adventurers, calm drunken brawls, and manage magical mishaps while keeping your business alive. Chaos is guaranteed, profit is optional.

title: Micron Survivor
description: Micron Survivor is a survival game with rogue-lite elements where you command alien microorganisms under the microscope. Evolve, unlock research objectives, find symbiotic weapons, upgrade your builds, and fight hordes of terrestrial organisms to rule the microcosm.

title: Bashnya
description: Big Khrushchyovka. Eight neighbors. One escape pod. Bashnya is a sovietpunk multiplayer roguelike where players seek a way out, but find their doom.

title: Deep Extraction Inc.
description: You are part of a three-person recovery crew sent to retrieve black boxes from the ocean floor using an old submarine. Teamwork and communication are essential to navigate tight caves, survive system failures, and uncover the dark truth behind the mission.

title: Falling Face Fragments
description: Falling Face Fragments is a falling block puzzle game where you must assemble faces correctly and clear them on a button press. The more faces you have on screen when you choose to clear them, the higher you will score! Three fun modes of play; arcade mode, mission mode, and local 2-player!

title: Cozy Potions
description: Find comfort in bubbling cauldrons and blooming gardens. Craft potions, nurture plants, unlock new recipes, upgrade your tools, and sip your own brews for cozy buffs as your tiny alchemist’s shop becomes the town’s favourite haven.

title: Doomed Crew
description: Co-op Horror for 1-4 players. Dive into a brutal corporate environment, complete deadly objectives for your promised freedom. Trust nothing.

title: Imaginary Friend Institution
description: Experience the not-so-ordinary life of a young institutionalized woman in the 1950's. Amidst the daily struggles and overbearing loneliness, she often sees things that others do not. However, as the imaginary begins to seep into reality, she realizes she may not be as crazy as she once thought.

title: Imagine Future
description: "Imagine Future" is a Visual Novel with a campus theme. You will follow the perspective of the protagonist Ji Wang, experience the life of a high school student. The final examination seemed so far away. one day, it was close at hand. Standing at the crossroads of life, what choice will you make?

title: Detective Malinowski The Truth Will Be Revealed
description: A body discovered. Two people missing. You – a detective who hears more than others want to see.  Narrative noir game – sound guides you, sketches tell the story.

title: Galatico
description: Fight your way through the mega-corporation Galatico, the gatekeepers of the universe’s most powerful transportation devices. Destroy their infrastructure and blast your way to the top in this boomer shooter inspired FPS.

title: Mishaka Ubivaka
description: Mishaka is an ordinary mouse with extraordinary courage. Upon learning of the cheese theft, he decides to take gun into his own paws and reclaim the lost delicacies. Throughout his adventure, Mishaka will encounter dangers, traps, and a multitude of enemies — from cunning rats to giant predators.

title: Soldier Adventure
description: This is a 2D platform adventure game that supports both single player and online multiplayer gameplay. ASDW for move, space bar for jumping, left Shift for sprinting, left mouse buton for attacking, right mouse button for striking.

title: Little Stone Journey
description: "Little Stone Journey" is a single-player action-adventure game. In a mysterious place shrouded in mist, one day, Little Stone was born here and began its journey.

title: Pure Instinct Katana
description: A fast paced, open world, third person, slasher action. Experience real time combat that adapts to your instinct and strategy. Explore a world of vivid fantasy and artful slaughter. Earn coins and buy a blade, outfit, or a fairy healer. Find and slay bosses to gain their fighting style and element.

title: Ye Guild Clerk!
description: In Ye Guild Clerk!, you manage an Adventurer's Guild branch where anthropomorphic heroes seek quests and rewards. As a clerk, you distribute missions, dispense payment, and provide equipment to animal adventurers, with your decisions directly influencing their success or failure in their journeys. The game puts you behind the counter to experience fantasy adventures from a different perspective - that of the quest-giver rather than the traditional hero.

title: Tales of Berseria Remastered
description:
Tales of Berseria returns with enhanced graphics and optimized gameplay!

Engage in the ultimate quest for self-discovery, remastered for the first time. The sacred kingdom awaits the arrival of its savior, and a lone woman named Velvet is marked by traumatic deceit. Join Velvet on her journey for vengeance, along with her cast of eccentric companions, as they sail through the archipelago which comprises the kingdom of Midgand

title: Shardpunk 2
description: The Empire may have fallen, but humanity continues the fight. Shardpunk 2 puts you in command of a human outpost in this potent mix of turn-based tactical strategy, RPG, survival and resource management as you gather your team, scavenge for resources and prepare for a new, evolving threat.

title: Revenge of the Savage Planet: Bingo Brawl
description: Bingo Brawl adds a fun, frantic, and FREE new competitive mode where you and your best pal race to see who can score the most points before the timer expires!

title: North Hunt
description: An online social deduction game that will ruin your friendships. Thieves hide as Viking villagers, fake NPC behavior, and use chaotic abilities while Chiefs try to expose them. Trust no one.

title: Present Heist
description: It's Christmas time! But instead of spreading Christmas cheer, you made your way to Santa's Workshop wanting to steal some presents. Though, upon getting there, you realize something is wrong.

title: Wee Boats
description: A chill multiplayer boaty honk game!

title: Dismayed
description: Attempt to make sense of your twisted and macabre surroundings as the story unfolds. Will you figure out what's going on or will you succumb to the madness?

title: VacuuBot: Home Cleaning Simulator
description: Take control of a dust bustin' robot cleaning machine in this laid-back home cleaning simulation game. Put your bristles to the ground and try your best to make every inch of the house shine before time runs out!

title: Station 58
description: Howdy! I’m Starla, Junior Ranger on a mission to fix up Barcadero National Park — with a little help from my 25-foot-tall robot buddy, Shorty. We’re climbin’, explorin’, and teamin’ up to bring this place back to life… and maybe help him find his way home, too.

title: Ship Shape Slam!!!
description:
Out-dodge, out-dash, and outlast your friends in chaotic 1–4 player bullet hell arenas. Side effects may include shouting, betrayal, and broken couches.

Enter arenas with up to 4 players where you can only move and dash. Bullets fly in from every direction with wild properties, forcing you to dodge, weave, and time your dash just right. Dashing isn’t just for escaping—it builds temporary invincibility and can even send friends flying. Land a charged dash to earn a full second of invulnerability against all bullets!

title: Stranger's Mark
description: On your way home, you encounter a stranger.... Who is particuliarly interested in your tattoo?

title: Tails of Iron: Bloody Whiskers
description: Tails of Iron: Bloody Whiskers is a free expansion pack to Tails of Iron that is set after the events of the main game. Redgi would have to fight off 5 more bosses in this expansion.

title: Tomo Jam!
description: TomoJam is a musical sandbox where up to 4 players can perform real MIDI songs using only their gamepads. Play, learn, and laugh as you hit (and miss) every note solo or together. Add your own MIDI files and explore a surprisingly deep, endlessly customizable way to make music and Jam with friends!

title: Vholume
description: Vholume is a melancholic first-person parkour adventure set in a dystopian brutalist city where bureaucracy turns a simple task into an odyssey.

title: Escape from the XX
description: There is a girl in a dim room...

title: Memories of a Forgotten Home
description: Scott returns home after receiving news from his sister that his childhood home is soon to be demolished. Scott visits the house for one last time, upon which he realizes his memories of the house have faded. Scott must explore the house to regain lost memories of his childhood and remember why he left in the first place.

title: The Broken Lolipop
description: Lala is a sad clown that is widely considered a misfit. While your meeting with her is a chance encounter, it will be a large deciding factor in her fate. With you be the helping hand she needs? Or will you be the final straw that gives her the drive to end her suffering once and for all? It all depends on how you treat her and what you learn about her.

title: Uncanny Desire
description: You're unfortunately dared to venture into nearby woods at night, a ploy set by your friend to try and scare you. Will you be able to survive this dare? Or will you end up as someone's dinner?

title: One Hell of a Coffee Shop
description:
Good morning! May I take your order?

One Hell of a Coffee Shop is a short, kinetic Visual Novel where you get to order some surely overpriced coffee at your friendly neighborhood coffee shop and have a chat with its barista!

title: The Undead
description: The Undead is a first-person shooter that takes place in a cemetery. You must fight waves of zombies and skeletons. When you reach 30 kills, you'll be confronted with a fearsome foe.

title: Warhound
description: Warhound is a fast-paced, wave-based top-down shooter where survival means keeping your guns loaded and your reflexes sharp. You’ll face relentless packs of feral werewolves that grow faster and stronger with every passing wave.

title: Threshold of Judgement
description: A mysterious gate judges your soul between Heaven and Hell. Answer wisely — fifteen truths lead to salvation, one mistake to eternal damnation.

title: Fate Dealer
description: Bet your freedom in a deadly quiz where a single answer can save you… or kill you. Will you take the Dealer’s offer or walk away alive?

title: Shellie's Secret
description: An experimental text-based police interrogation game, in which the player questions a suspect and witness following a car accident. The game is designed to resemble the terminal of a computer from 1985.

title: How to Fish
description: A 1-4 player physics based fishing simulator. While drinking and boating you suddenly crash into a small island. To work your way back home you have to learn How to Fish.

title: Final Odyssey
description: Final Odyssey is a real-time strategy game with RPG elements set in a sci‑fi world, combining squad-based tactical combat, unit customization, and free-roaming camera exploration across varied missions and environments

title: An Imp and an Impostor
description: You've spent years undercover, disguised as a human, infiltrating the city’s magical law-enforcement organization. They stole your magic from you. Can you steal it back? (A text-based interactive historical urban fantasy novel.)

title: House of the Golden Mask
description: Awaken your magic and break an ancient curse at a secret school of sorcery! What mysteries will you uncover at this crossroads between realms? A text-based fantasy novel, 280,000 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects.

title: The Cute Whale
description: Get ready for an ocean full of puzzles and charm. Guide a lovable whale through 30 handcrafted stages where strategy meets relaxation. Push the turtles onto the buoys and help restore harmony to the sea in this adorable adventure of logic and calm.

title: Quick Whiskers
description: Get ready to jump, dash, and glide with Quick Whiskers, a pixel-art platformer where every move counts! Take control of a nimble cat and venture through 30 challenging levels across two unique biomes: the peaceful park and the bustling city. Your mission is simple but full of action: collect food cans and reach a cozy bed to rest.

title: Operation Dartness
description: Operation Dartness is a dart-based roguelike set in a strange, shadowy USSR-inspired world. Trapped in this curious and unsettling environment, you must rack up absurd amounts of points to pursue a goal that lies far beyond your understanding.

title: Utopia no Soubou
description: Mom, the world is so beautiful.

title: Gabriel’s Worlds: The Sokoban Adventure
description:
Gabriel finally took a vacation, but his adventure is just beginning!
During his travels, he discovered that mysterious villains have trapped helpless kittens inside boxes! Now, it's up to him to solve challenging puzzles to set them free.

Get ready for a journey full of color, charm, and fun!
Take on 40 Sokoban-style puzzles and help Gabriel rescue all the kittens in this relaxing and delightful adventure.

title: NodalBastion
description: Defend the last AI core in an abstract minimalist game of incremental progression, powerful skills, and evolving networks.

title: Mother: Invasion from the Unknown
description: Visual novel adaptation/remake of the 1989 choose-your-own-adventure gamebook, based on the 1989 Famicom game "MOTHER."

title: Red Wolf
description:
Once upon a time, there was a family consisted of a father, a mother and a daughter named Chara. They moved here from the village to look after their grandmother who lived in the house in the forest.

Chara got a lot of love and care from everyone.

She and her parents always visited their grandmother every month. They lived very happily together.

But one day, Chara's parents had gotten into a fight.
After that, they decided to split up. The father had moved away, so clueless Chara had to stay with her mother in a forest.

Three months since Chara's parents' separation, her mother, who had been in depression and unable to make the trip, finally entrusted Chara to go visit her grandmother by herself.

title: Christmas Story
description: Christmas Story is a horror game filled with Christmas warmth and coziness, where every festive light hides darkness, and the sense of comfort fades with every step you take.

title: Hikari no Valusia
description: In a big city in the desert called Valcia, only young people called 'adept' are allowed to go out. The city used to be covered with a canopy, but people can see the sky and a lot of people visit the city through the canopy now. But this inflow of people gradually changes the city...

title: Sekien no Inganock ~What a Beautiful People~ Fullvoice ReBORN
description: Ten years ago, the "resurrection" completely isolated the "perfect environment city" of Inganok. Terrifying fantastical creatures began to appear, and the once-prosperous steam-powered mechanical civilization mutated, occasionally transforming into alien beings to attack humanity. The nobles, dormant in the upper echelons, escaped unscathed, while millions of refugees in the lower classes were ravaged by a strange disease. An endless fog rose from the distorted gray sky, and instead of a single sun, two suns hung in the sky. This was an isolated city, and also an alien city.

title: This Is Where I Want To Die
description: A very short kinetic novel about a dying person trying to remember what happened. This Is Where I Want To Die is a depressing story with an important message I want to put across. The game is free to play and I would recommend it for players 16+. TIWIWTD was created in less than a month for NaNoRenO 2013.

title: Kid Mystic: Enchanted Edition
description:
Originally released in 1999, and massively updated in 2004, come celebrate the 25th (ish) anniversary of this action-RPG silliness with all-new features for 2025.

You can play the game in 1999 Mode, Classic Mode, or Modern Mode, and we tried to keep each mode true to its source. Except for that crunchy low-bitrate soundtrack. We remastered that.

title: Hollow Treats
description:
You're out alone this Halloween, which would be fine under normal circumstances. But recently there has been increasing cases of people being infected by an unknown parasitic entity causing people to becoming increasingly more aggressive.

There are signs of course, but unfortunately for your, you're face blind. You can't rely on normal human body language to guess who's who. That's why you need to carefully peek into people's homes to find out the truth. Do you have what it takes to get the most candy this Halloween?

title: Ashley's Adventure: Get a Job or Die Trying
description: Ashley's Adventure: Get a Job or Die Trying is an interactive visual novel based in a multiple-choice style of gameplay where you meet colourful characters and crazy events which you must resolve with the power of being a NEET.

title: Two Point Museum: Zooseum
description: Now hiring for Wildlife Experts to heal, raise and re-wild some wonderful wildlife in our brand new museum location!

title: Food From a Stranger
description: A short VN about a creepy stranger that tries to give this innocent girl some candy..

title: To Swat A Fly
description: For four years, the Red Valley County in Arizona was haunted by a shadowy serial killer with mysterious methods of murder. Even three years after her arrest, the "Red Valley Reaper" Mel Atkinson has refused to speak a word to the press-- until today. You've managed to get yourself an exclusive interview with the high-profile prisoner. The question is-- can you ask the right questions and make it out with the truth?

title: Gilt
description: Embark on a quest of redemption across the planet of Gilt to restore a disillusioned priest's faith, a dying God's power, and the waning hope of a people who have forgotten how to believe. A sci-fi fantasy adventure from celebrated indie game artist Ben Chandler.

title: Brightfall
description: Lived through the Plague, did you? Now try surviving till morning on an island erased from the maps. Gather, build, and fight to keep your light alive in Brightfall - a co-op open world survival-craft roguelite where the darkness wants to swallow you whole.

title: Femboy Futa House: Dirty Election
description: The academic year at the College of Magical Arts is in full swing, so the residents of 9 3/4 Dursley Way aren't just dealing with problems, they're dealing with HUGE PROBLEMS! Who could be a more terrifying enemy than the Principal at a place like this? The STUDENT COUNCIL, of course!

title: Trailmakers: Frozen Tracks
description: You're arriving at Hoff, a frozen and mountainous planet with a peculiar population. A species known as Waddles take residence in the desolate tundra and are inviting you, the Trailmaker, into their cold but hospitable settlements. They need something from you. But what?

title: Strigoi Town
description: Combine your potions and refine your deck to withstand waves of vampires in a Compact Deck-Refiner where every card matters. Draft your starting deck, discover powerful effects by mixing flasks and recruit allies to uncover the dark mystery threatening your home.

title: Warhammer: Vermintide 2 - Return to the Reik
description: Markus Kruber sets forth on a quest to recover his father's sword, plundered during the fall of Ubersreik… and naturally, the rest of the Ubersreik Five offer their aid.

title: FTB Stoneblock 4
description: StoneBlock 4 is the next chapter in one of modded Minecraft's most iconic series, rebuilt from the ground up to deliver the underground survival experience you know and love, now with deeper progression, narrative-driven gameplay, and of-course, randomized rewards!

title: Hidden Magical Creatures
description: Hidden Magical Creatures is a hidden object game where you need to find all the magical creatures from other worlds and return them home!

title: Magical Blush
description: Magical Blush is a top-down action-adventure where fast-paced elemental combat meets Metroidvania-style exploration. Chain spell combos, exploit elemental weaknesses, rescue survivors, and team up in local co-op as you battle the powerful Elemental Lords and explore the wondrous world of Wyn.

title: N.R.V
description: NRV is a frenetic and violent top-down shooter set in a grim cyberpunk universe that feels like a boomer shooter from top down view. Fueled by rage and by a thirst for revenge, you will slain waves of enemies and liberate the city to save the citizens from a cynical elite that seeks to enslave them.

title: Flock Around
description: Flock Around is a multiplayer bird watching game. Explore a nature sanctuary with friends, snap pictures of birds, and fill out the guide book!

title: Armatus
description: ARMATUS is a third-person roguelite shooter set in the demon-infested ruins of Paris. As the last supernatural warrior of an ancient order, armed with powerful firearms and incredible celestial powers, scour the city in search of a lost gateway to heaven - the Sunless Gate.

title: Last Patrol
description: You are an Orderlord — a mutating meatball cop battling cultists in a surreal post-human dystopia. Evolve your form, investigate an intergalactic conspiracy, and prevent cosmic annihilation in this top-down horror shooter.

title: Echo Generation 2
description: Embark on a sci-fi deckbuilding RPG odyssey. Gather your crew, craft powerful decks, and battle across the stars to find your way home. Deal the cards. Defy the cosmos. Embrace the adventure.

title: Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors
description: Deal world-ending combos and blitz through infested dungeons! Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors is a casual, turnbased deckbuilder with roguelite elements. Master the Turboturn with your own hand of cards!

title: Erosion
description: Your daughter's been kidnapped. Every death costs you a decade. Explore a roguelike open world where your actions reshape the timeline. Join a cult, steal a ride, gamble Cheddar. Collect 100+ weapons and abilities, demolish destructible voxel dungeons. Can you save her before time steals her away?

title: Zoopunk
description: Zoopunk is a team-based co-op PVE game that blends diesel-punk with Eastern aesthetic.

title: Cloverpit: Unholy Fusion
description: Unholy Fusion introduces the Surgery Machine to CloverPit! The grotesque new device lets you fuse charms together into a single, more powerful trinket. Combine effects, discover new synergies, and break the machine all over again.

title: Raji: Kaliyuga
description: Six years after the great war, destiny bleeds into prophecy as gods and mortals blur. Raji, the warrior of faith, and Darsh, the dreamwalker, face Mahabalasuras wrath as he tears open heavens gates, unleashing Kaliyuga-an age where every choice can unmake the universe.

title: SM64EX OMM: Super Mario Star Road
Dungeon of Departure
description: an independently developed, pixel art, visual novel set in an original universe which follows the silent, player protagonist and three companion characters as they struggle to find a way out of an increasingly puzzling, underground world.

title: SM64EX OMM: Super Mario 64 - The Green Stars
Olyen
description: Explore a forgotten valley filled with ancient mechanisms and mysteries. Solve intricate 3D puzzles and uncover the story of the four sages who once lived there.

title: JK Girl Samurai: Aoi No Mon
description: This is a side scrolling pixel game, players take on the role of a JK girl use various sword drawing techniques to deal with the enemy. On the way to find family, passing through Japanese style streets and Mount Fuji, what mysteries will be uncovered afterwards?

title: Super Shootin Star
description: Shoot up the leaderboards in a high scoring throwback to simpler times when stars were stars, and if we needed to jump, we shot at the ground. Use pure skill to launch yourself ever upward in Classic Mode, or earn experience and unlock powerful upgrades in Rogue Mode.

title: Daughter of the Rift
description: Daughter of the Rift is story-rich card-battling adventure with a unique deck-building progression system.

title: Where the Heart Rests
description: A sweetly domestic boys' love visual novel about a couple of young men who find themselves raising a child.

title: Moldling
description: Evolve your body further to survive this vast, yet dense, system of caves. You must use your wits to outsmart predators lurking in the dark and to solve puzzling challenges in order to further advance in this strange world.

title: Ryn: And the Thread of Life
description: A 3D metroidvania hack-and-slash with low-poly and pixel art aesthetics. As Ryn, a rag doll born from the last light, explore a fading realm torn by the dark witch Stella. Defeat the five wicked dolls, claim their powers, and restore the broken Thread of Life.

title: Astray: Zero
description: A 2D side-scrolling action-adventure game. You constantly defeat monsters and advance to the next level. In the hand-drawn game world, you will fight alongside a girl named Zero, uncovering the truth of this game world during a fantastical journey!

title: Orkastle
description: Orkastle: The JRPG where forgiving monsters means losing your friends.

title: Aro: Tales in the Dome
description: Aro: Tales in the Dome is a 2D hand-drawn action-adventure game. Play as Aro and explore an elemental world sealed beneath the dome. As the journey unfolds, uncover the hidden conspiracy and face the truth about the world, the dome, and yourself.

title: Miner to Die
description: Miner to Die is a survival mining game where you mine for money to regenerate your constantly decreasing health.

title: Paccarat
description: The 10-rats-in-a-trenchcoat roguelike deckbuilder. Recruit a rag-tag team of rats, craft a curated deck for each, and discover devastating multi-deck combos. Build your team & masterfully pilot multiple unique decks to take down increasingly difficult enemies.

title: Dream:scape Remastered
description: Explore a surreal dream world built from one man’s memories in this remastered story-rich first-person mystery/adventure.

title: Chronostasis
description: Play as Shion, a mysterious battle-hardened android, in this high-intensity character action game to defeat waves of enemies with stylish scythe attacks and time-stopping abilities!

title: Waxy: The Wick and The Witch
description:
Welcome to Waxy: The Wick and the Witch, a magical adventure where you play as a candle exploring the attic of a witch’s house.
This is a third-person 3D puzzle platformer that challenges you to master the power of fire while managing your wax before it melts away.

title: Cryptobiosis
description: Cryptobiosis is an experimental narrative game set in China’s Hengshui model. As a god’s-eye playtester in a high school simulation, you step into the running exercise scene, trace and remember ignored lives under hyper-regulated campus management, complete your exam, and rank worldwide.

title: SM64 Coop Deluxe: Mario in the Multiverse
Teko
description: Enter the casino in TEKO, an addictive Roguelike Deckbuilder! Hit the score goal by playing 3 poker hands simultaneously. Modify your Chips, collect Cards, and take risks to maximize your profits. An indie progressive scoring game inspired by Balatro.

title: SM64EX Coop: Star Revenge 4 - The Kedama Takeover 64
Star Revenge 6.5: Wrath of The Dim. Flower PC Port
Ten Deadly Games
description: Ten Deadly Games is a collection of games from different developers based around the same theme - "Death is an Opportunity." These ten deadly games were all created in a week for the Jamsepticeye game jam.

title: Path of Exile 2: The Last of the Druids
Femboy Futa House: Kinky Field Trip
description: They say there’s no place like home… but sometimes, you have to leave your dorm and take on an adventure. Pack your things and join the class trip to the one and only town of Kinksmouth. Forbidden secrets, lustful cultists, and ancient, indecent gods await you in the crooked streets of this little town.

title: Mortal Trap Dungeon
description: Mortal Trap Dungeon is a precision platformer with exploration elements, featuring stages filled with a wide variety of enemies and deadly traps!

title: Girls, I Just Want to Get Paid!
description: Girls, I just want to get Paid - is a visual novel with a meme-inspired mini-game where you’ll face the difficult task of sorting items in a factory and satisfying your horny coworkers. Do your job well and get your paycheck!

title: Isles of Wrath
description:
A single-player, medieval fantasy themed pixel-art strategic auto-battler with roguelike elements.

Defend your outpost against continuous waves of monsters. Between waves, recruit new units, upgrade your army, and optimize synergies to counter increasingly large and varied enemy forces.

title: Farlands: Tiny Harvest
description: Tiny Harvest is a relaxing desktop game that runs while you work, study, or browse the internet. Grow space plants, upgrade your crops, ship, home, and tools, and enjoy a cozy, minimalist experience designed to keep you company throughout your day.

title: Star Revenge 2: Night of Doom PC
Katze Stuck in the Toilet 64 PC
Star Revenge 2.5: Remnant of Doom PC
SM64EX Coop: Star Revenge 2 - Night of Doom
SM64EX Coop: Odyssey Mario's Moveset - Rebirth
Before Exit: Gas Station - Midnight DLC
description: In the Midnight DLC, you return to the gas station as an over-time employee now trapped in a deeper, darker scenario. You navigate nine new scenarios that unfold beyond the regular workweek, facing escalating darkness each night. New weather conditions add challenges, and your boss may appear unexpectedly. As you work, the station’s secret nature and its owner’s motives come to light in a tension-filled horror environment.

title: Before Exit: Gas Station - Daylight DLC
description: In the Daylight DLC, the perspective shifts to the gas station employee’s wife as she searches for her missing husband. Across seven days of investigation, you explore the station in daylight, documenting supernatural anomalies through photography to progress the new investigation-focused mode. Missing any key detail forces you to restart the inquiry. The DLC presents unexplained events that challenge logic, revealing the story from a new viewpoint and uncovering what truly happened to your husband.

title: Toilet 8
description: You’re trapped in endless toilets. Watch these stalls carefully—every detail counts. If something’s wrong, turn back. If not… don’t you dare look behind. Or face the fart from hell.

title: Carmageddon: Rogue Shift
description: Carmageddon smashes back with brutal roguelite vehicular‑combat mayhem. Adapt, upgrade, and unleash destruction on post‑apocalyptic zombie hordes. The legacy lives on, reinvented and unforgiving.

title: Verse Project
description: In this multiplayer game you have to explore the Solar System in real scale. Control spaceships of the near future, explore planets, moons and asteroids, mine resources, fight for space domination and build the future of the universe.

title: Escape From Cluckov
description: Escape from Cluckov is a PVE cooperative looter shooter—in a chicken's world! Loot your foes, build your arsenal, and upgrade your character in the world of Cluckov. End the fowl Duck regime and show them you don't give a cluck.

title: Kill Me If You Can: Multiplayer Edition
description: Kill Me If You Can: Multiplayer Edition is an RPG and construction-based zombie survival defense game. Explore by day to gather resources and grow, then build defenses at night to hold back zombie hordes. Each character has unique skills, and you can control multiple characters during gameplay.

title: Apocalypter
description: Apocalypter is a post-apocalyptic, driving, survival, fps, open-world game. Fight, help, trade with different factions. Find different cars and customize them. Scavenge, loot and survive the procedurally generated, open world of Apocalypter.

title: Genshin Impact: A Nocturne of the Far North
description:
Version "Luna III" of Genshin Impact, also known as "Song of the Welkin Moon: Interlude". This update includes:
• New characters: Durin and Jahoda
• New main story quests: "A Nocturne of the Far North" and "Melting Moonlight in the Morning Mist"
• New story quest for Durin
• New main event: Soulblazers' Snowbound Journey
• New system: Witch's Homework
• New updates for Miliastra Wonderland
• New QoL, and more!

title: SM64EX Coop: Super Mario and the Marvel Adventure
SM64EX Coop: King Boo's Revenge X
SM64EX Coop: The Gate of the Good
SM64EX Coop: Super Mario 64 - Twisted Adventures
SM64 Coop DX: Waluigi's Taco Stand
SM64 Coop DX: Organ of Matrias
SM64 Coop DX: Star Revenge 4.5 - The Kedama Takeover Rewritten
SM64 Coop DX: SM64 - The Green Comet
SM64 Coop DX: Goomba's Easter Egg Hunt
SM64 Coop DX: Mario on Indigo Island
TR-49
description: Narrative deduction meets audio drama, from the creators of Heaven’s Vault, Overboard! and A Highland Song.

title: Revenge of the Firstborn
description: A story-rich, party-based tactical turn-based RPG built on the classic 3.5 SRD ruleset. You lead a band of heroes to uncover the origin of the immortal “Firstborn”. Their power could either redeem the world or unleash its destruction.

title: G-Mode Archives+: Stella Deus - The Age of Alchemy
description:
Also know as - Stella Deus: Alchemy Time is a spinoff of the Atlus tactics style game "Stella Deus: the Gate of Eternity" released on PS2. It is one of 2 Spinoff games, the other being: "Stella Deus: The Spirit of Darkness/The Black Spirit."
The Spirit of Darkness serving as the first game, and The Age of Alchemy serving as the second game.

The game was released on Japanese mobile phones on January 22nd, 2007 and recently on Steam & Nintendo Switch 1&2 thanks to G-Mode+ Archives. Releasing on the Switch Platforms on November 20th, 2025 & Steam on December 4th, 2025.

The game has Japanese text only.

title: Adventure Mosaics: Land of the Rising Sun
Heroes of Artadis
description: Immerse yourself in a dark fantasy world. Build a squad of unique heroes, combine abilities, think tactically, and win PvP battles!

title: Wielders of the Essence
description: Single-player horde survival with a touch of incremental base building. Eight-minute runs. Eight hours to complete.

title: Reanimal: Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
Get the Digital Deluxe Edition of Reanimal to get the Season Pass for all three chapters of DLC that expand the world of Reanimal. Uncover long dead secrets, and cast new light on old friends. The roots of violence go deep.

Disguise yourselves with the exclusive Foxhead and Muttonhead masks DLC. Friendship can be hell and sometimes a mask is the only protection!

Includes:
Reanimal - Foxhead and Muttonhead masks
Season Pass

title: Godscale
description: Godscale is a 2D pixel art action roguelike set in an ancient Egyptian tomb. Face monsters, deadly traps, and powerful curses while managing blades, spells, and artifacts. Upgrade abilities in the Book of the Dead, collect Ankh tokens, and master the crypt to claim the gods' power.

title: Baroque Shooting: Reversed
description:
A shoot ’em up set in the world of the RPG “BAROQUE” returns as “REVERSED”, now available on Nintendo Switch.
The story takes place in the Neuro Tower, a mysterious structure overrun by countless enemies. You must fight through them using the items you acquire along the way to reach the final boss that awaits in the deepest depths.

title: Baroque: Become a Meta-Being Revive
description: Become a Meta-Being and head for the Neuro Tower… The protagonist is a Meta-Being! A jumping action game set in the world of BAROQUE.

title: Lost Artifacts: The Ghost of Florence - Collector's Edition
Crazy Manager
description: Crazy Manager is a chaotic video game in which you try to organize a supermarket while dealing with all kinds of crazy situations, annoying children, trash on the floor, or too many customers in line.

title: Welehola
description: Step into the shoes of a wizard student to learn the arcane arts in a magical academy! What sort of witching student life would you live?

title: Writhing
description: Explore the depths of Heaven's Gate Space Station and the solar system it orbits in Writhing: A new Sci-Fi Fantasy FPS that explores space in another universe that parallels ours. Hunt down an evil alternative resource baron, Moloch's avatar, and their army of evil spawn in this backwards universe.

title: Work Girl
description: In the game, players can experience a unique plot in a city with high degree of freedom. Players can manipulate the hostess and many men to produce various stories. The game has exquisite drawings, a variety of clothes, players can trigger a variety of different events in a specific place and time.

title: Tutankhamun: Builders of the Eternal
description: A 3D city-builder where you farm the Nile, worship powerful gods, train armies, trade with distant regions, and construct monumental works worthy of ancient Egypt.

title: Blue Swift Wind
description: A vibrant arcade plane racer! Battle with power-ups across 12 stylized tracks, from serene to chaotic scenic routes. Use power-ups and master drifting in dynamic weather to become the swiftest pilot in this stylized, anime-inspired world, With more free tracks arriving in future updates.

title: Animal Survival
description: Survive waves of animal foes, collect materials, and craft your way to victory in this survival RPG.

title: Raveren: The Legend Of Etheria
description:
Raveren: The Legend of Etheria

A dark fantasy RPG where memory is your greatest weapon—and your deepest curse.

title: The Ramen Shop
description: A horror game where you manage a ramen shop. Take orders from your customers, serve hot delicious ramens and sweet cold drinks to hungry customers.

title: Card Collection Simulator
description: Card Collection Simulator brings a deeper slice of the convention booth and personal collection aspects that surround real life card collecting. You'll open card packs on a virtual stream with your chat celebrating (or feeling your pain), sell or trade those cards at the convention, send in your rarest cards to be graded, design and build your personal collection room, and fill your collection the way you want!

title: People In The Dark
description: People In The Dark is a short horror game that can immerse you in its atmosphere and give you a lot of emotions. The game is not based on real events!

title: Ourobolos
description:
Ourobolos is a game where you control the infamous Ourobolos, a creature terrifying the city.

To grow and survives, he needs to loop around citizens.

title: Ormod: Directive
description: Shape your own survival experience in an infinite open-world sandbox. Customize world difficulty, rules, and playstyle. Play solo, co-op, or on 24/7 MMO-style servers across PvP, PvE, Hardcore, or Creative modes as you build, automate, fight, and survive. The choice is yours.

title: Dysthanasia
description: You awaken in a cold unfamiliar building crawling with grotesque creatures. Stave off terror using your wits and anything you can find, then try to make it out alive in this highly atmospheric environmental horror game.

title: The Dungeon Of Horror
description: A dark medieval-fantasy turn-based dungeon crawler where you try to escape the dungeon of your own creation! Place tiles, fight monster and cooperate with friends to find and destroy the pagan shaman Meir to escape this horror!

title: Don't Stop in Red Wood
description: A legend returns: the cold pines of Red Wood whisper of a hunter reborn… Is he alive, stalking us again?

title: Cultivation
description: CULTivation is a chill farming-sim about summoning souls, managing your willpower, and gathering resources to reach Ascension. Sleep to reset the world's resources, wake to progress, and repeat, until you transcend and Ascend into a new dimension.

title: Grippy
description: You are Grippy, a tiny golem born from a flowerpot.Try to reach a single poppy in the distance with only the power of your arms.You can't take your hand off the mouse even for a moment until you reach the goal in this arduous climbing action game.

title: Super Destroyer
description: Drive the world's strongest destroyer, command the world's most advanced missile force and engineering team, use system coordination and roguelite warfare tactics to completely smash the imperialist forces that are causing chaos in the world.

title: Infamous 18
description: A golf simulation game where all of the courses are based off the paintings of artist Loyal H. Chapman.

title: Chess & Chapter
description: Chess & Chapter is a 2D turn-based tactical strategy game.In a fictional sci-fi world, players take on the role of Pan, a commander of the Courier Foundation.The game allows players to navigate through levels in turn-based battles while gradually uncovering the full story.

title: DrunKing
description: A 3D action-comedy game where you control a drunken old man through chaotic challenges. Drink to score points, use crazy power-ups, discover relics, and customize your character with ridiculous outfits and mustaches. Test your reflexes and balance as the world spins out of control!

title: Crimson Seer
description: Crimson Seer is a fantasy detective puzzle game. Investigate murder scenes frozen in time, gather clues, and deduce motive, method, and location. Use your prophetic visions to uncover sinister elven plots, ancient mysteries, and dark rituals in an underground world.

title: Whispers of Elenrod
description: Deck-building meets strategy map exploration. Craft powerful decks. Discover mysterious artifacts on procedurally generated maps. Defeat enemies in turn-based combat and gain experience to evolve your hero. Create your best build…and find all the Whispers of Elenrod!

title: Small Mouse Big House
description: You play as Millie, a small mouse on a mission to find food for her kids in a house that's far too big—and far too dangerous. As Millie ventures through the enormous rooms, she’ll face towering obstacles and enemies that dwarf her in size. Can she outsmart these dangers and make it back to her family, or will the horrors of the house overwhelm her?

title: Critterville Goes Bankrupt
description: Inherit a royal title, preside over a cast woodland critters, and survive an industrial revolution together in Critterville goes Bankrupt, a town life RPG that combines farming, village management, home building, and high-society intrigue into an unforgettable adventure!

title: Vision Quench
description: An online co-op dark fantasy looter shooter set in the underbelly of a consumer goods conglomerate mega dungeon. Within its halls you will fight ancient foes and modern horrors. Can you survive long enough to make it to the top?

title: Bourbon Risky
description: Bourbon Risky is a simple but deep boss rush action game with retro style graphics. Smash all enemies in your way with your eternal companion that blasting bullets and lasers!

title: Voidnomaly
description: You finally got a good job, with an incredible payment for just 4 days of work. Get into the mansion, find the anomalies, complete your daily quota, and leave. The company said there isn't any life or death risk, but you may face "weird" things. It doesn't sound too dangerous. Easy peasy.... right?

title: Ellsydia
description: Welcome to Ellsydia! Escape to a small cozy medieval fantasy haven where you can build, customize, and manage your dream village. Make it thrive and ensure the well-being of its villagers so they feel truly happy and fulfilled.

title: BunnyOps
description: BunnyOps is a tactical PvP shooter where bunnies are the apex herbivore, carrots are scarce, and everything can be destroyed.

title: Mayak
description: Hard-sci-fi side-scrolling VN about first contact, love, and a prime-number countdown. You are a young astronomer researching a newly received signal from a distant star. Unravel an alien mystery — and fight to save the one you love.

title: Quantum Quartz
description: Steampunk pixel-art precision platformer where you toggle platforms on and off using colored crystals. With only one active at a time, each grants a different movement ability, changing how you move and how the level works, blending high-skill platforming with spatial puzzles!

title: I Won’t Let You Level up in My Goblin Town
description: Interfere in a turn based fight! When adventurers come to your goblin town to level up, your strongest warrior goblin meets them in Active Time Battle. Run around town gathering the equipment and potions he needs to defeat any adventurer party.

title: Night Plane
description: Night Plane is a job-sim horror game where you work as a flight attendant on a doomed plane. Check tickets, serve passengers, and decide who stays onboard as demons hide among innocent souls. Naturally, management says it’s your problem.

title: Card Conquest
description: Card Conquest is a Tower Defense game with Deckbuilding and Roguelite elements. Combine spells, towers and units to create a deck and defeat your enemies. Spend your resources wisely and find balance between offense and defense. Gather powerful relics that will enhance your cards.

title: Under His Eyes
description: Under His Eyes is a gritty, story-driven strategy game where you play a crime boss. Make game-changing decisions, manage your crew and income, send operatives on missions, seize districts, and eliminate rivals. Will you rise through subtlety, rule with fear, or fall to a small-time gang?

title: Bladefall
description: BladeFall is a fast-paced hack-and-slash game featuring fluid melee combat, 2.5D movement, and challenging battles against varied enemies and powerful bosses. Master timing and skill-based attacks as you fight through an evolving system built to test your abilities.

title: Ergenekon
description: Ergenekon is a story-based, cinematic-heavy, linear, third person single player game about the Turkish epic Ergenekon. You will witness the resurrection of the Turks with Ergenekon.

title: A Dogs Dream
description: Test your sixth sense. Will you eat a wild rabbit, or tie someone to the train tracks? Every choice is yours to make. May you find a reason to laugh inside your nightmares.

title: Chamberlore
description: Join the learning process of an artificial intelligence. A mysterious experiment awaits, where two people are sent to help it evolve.

title: Peach Territory
description: This is an avg game with a fantasy story. It tells the story of Xiao Xuan who jumped off a cliff and entered the peach blossom realm, a place isolated from the world for thousands of years, and then fell in love with a girl, cultivated, and finally defeated the devil.

title: Cardaire: Eternal Aces
description: Get ready to crack packs and throw cards in Cardaire: Eternal Aces, a single-player collectible card RPG! Explore a unique world, hunt down powerful cards, and build the deck that'll make you a Cardaire legend.

title: Zoo Tycoon 2: Arabian Nights
description: Zoo Tycoon 2: Arabian Nights is a user-made expansion pack (mod) for the 2004 video game Zoo Tycoon 2 designed by the Artifex team.

title: Masefeh
description: Recover an inter-generational story of migration told through real audio recordings of a Lebanese family coming to America in the early 1990's. Maneuver a forgotten strip of audio tape through puzzling landscapes to piece together the voices of the past.

title: Imp
description: Fight hordes of aliens and visit desolate moons in this arcade-inspired third-person shooter.

title: They Looked Like Us
description: An emergency broadcast urges people to stay inside and follow careful instructions to survive. Turn the lights off and close the curtains, do not let them find you.

title: The McMilian Tree Lot
description:
Near the outskirts of town exists a sleepy, solitary tree lot.
Some say that the firewood purchased from this place burns extra hot.
Many a customer has gotten lost traveling it's narrow, creepy rows...
For the thing which lurks in the lot's heart grows.

title: Eon of Life
description: Eon of Life is a game in which you guide the evolution of a creature for as many million years as you can survive! Find food, avoid predators, watch for a mate, and evolve selecting new parts and mutations for your creature, gaining new skills and becoming stronger.

title: Dead World Tales
description: A narrative roguelite puzzle game inspired by tic‑tac‑toe, where you explore self‑contained stories and make decisions that uncover the mystery of the world's end.

title: Vyjazd
description: From the developers of ZdvihniTo - You are part of an unofficial emergency response team sent to contain bizarre incidents across four locations, each haunted by twisted versions of popular Slovak YouTubers. Complete your objectives and survive the chaos.

title: Rogue Descent
description: A challenging Auto Battler, Roguelite, crawl through an ever changing pixel art dungeon. Plan your path. Make tough choices. Maybe even survive the descent...

title: Estella
description: A 3D rhythm game for mouse & keyboard. Ride a golden comet through the cosmos and compose your own adventure with every song and every note.

title: Rise of the Reds
description: Rise of the Reds – or ROTR for short – improves upon the C&C Generals formula while also adding its own distinct elements to it. Most notably, the mod adds two completely new factions, the tank-heavy Russian Federation and the defence-oriented European Continental Alliance. In addition, the three original factions China, USA and GLA have been greatly expanded and redesigned in a variety of ways, with several new units, buildings, powers and abilities to explore and combine in your in-game tactics. ROTR also changes some of the game mechanics in order to create a unique and fresh experience. Examples include a technology progression system based around three tiers, a more fleshed out counter system between air and anti-air units as well as an additional emphasis on specialised scouting and detection units which serve to make stealth tactics a more viable option than they were in the original game. Beyond the gameplay aspect, the mod also brings many cosmetical updates, spectacular special effects and custom sounds and voice overs to the table.

title: Anomaly Recovery
description: Explore an ever changing building affected by a strange anomaly. Recover packages from its barren halls.

title: Randel's Quest
description: Guide Randel and a tongue-tied thesaurus on an epic quest in a slot-driven, Wordle-style roguelike battler. Roll the slots for effects, read the color hints and strike with the right word at the right moment! Every word counts. Even the wrong ones!

title: Defcon Zero: Frontlines of Tomorrow
description: Defcon Zero is a classic real-time strategy game set on planet Eros, where you dive into the story of ERA, the last beacon of civilization. Build your base, gather resources, engage your enemies and make strategic choices to prevail in combat. Are you ready to command the frontlines of tomorrow?

title: Miami Paradise
description: Step into the vibrant, sun-soaked streets of Miami in Miami Paradise, an immersive 3D open-world RPG where adventure, romance, and drama await at every turn.

title: Perpetuo
description: Perpetuo is a first-person psychological horror game where you explore a mysterious apartment trapped in an endless time loop. Solve challenging puzzles, uncover a haunting story, and survive as a lurking presence grows stronger with each cycle.

title: Rabbit's All-corners Mapping Project 2024
description:
RAMP 2024 is the fourth yearly run of the Rabbit's All-comers Mapping Project.

The 2024 edition of RAMP attracted an astounding three hundred and eleven maps from 239 authors of all experience levels - from people's first attempts at Doom maps up to those who had been around in the community for many years.

title: Super Mario Bros.: The Lost Levels Remastered
All Night Nippon Super Mario Bros. Remastered
Model Debut 4
description:
Trendy items for full styling and production fun!
Step into the world of modeling, try out different jobs, and chase your dreams — and maybe even love.

title: Ultima I
description: A 1986 assembly-language remake of the original 1981 Ultima, featuring improved graphics and minor content additions. Players explore the open world of Sosaria in a top-down view, descend into first-person dungeons, complete quests for the realm's lords, and engage in space combat, all in pursuit of the immortal wizard Mondain and his Gem of Immortality.

title: Gravity House Duology
description: A collection of two short stories by the art collective Gravity House.

title: Letters to Rosa
description: An epistolary visual novel by Ophelia Cassandra Green.

title: The Romance of the Moth and the Flame
description: A visual novel by the indie group Crying Rules Actually.

title: Colorami
description: Repaint platforms on the map to solve asymmetric puzzles for two players. Use the unique function of each platform type to open up new paths. Cooperate, plan, solve, experiment with colors, and restart freely if need be. A vibrant pixel art world and its spirits need your help.

title: Rika Furude Simulator '25
description:
Return once again to the neverending June of 1983!

The world Rika Furude seeks still lies beyond a roll of six sixes on the die she must cast to determine her fate.

The highly-acclaimed fate defying simulator returns with this hotly anticipated incremental update that will have you clicking to roll the dice again and again, perhaps even for an eternity!

The future she seeks is just as far away as it's ever been, but with you at her side, Rika is sure to find the miracle she's been hoping for.

title: Total Tank Simulator 2
description:
A physics-driven, derpy battle simulator of total destruction. Build cross-era lineups, command your army in RTS mode, or jump into any unit directly. Play unique campaigns or just relax and watch the chaos unfold. Make a mess — then drive through it. The continuation of Total Tank Simulator returns with even more mayhem.

Total Tank Simulator 2 is an advanced physics-based battle sandbox where every structure, terrain element, and unit breaks into hundreds of pieces. Cities crumble, tanks shred, forests splinter — everything is destroyable. History, sci-fi, and fantasy collide as you build dream (or nightmare) matchups: WW2 armor vs aliens, cyclops vs cyborgs, laser dinos vs anything you dare throw at them.

title: Carrot Smash
description: Take control of a brave carrot on a mission to protect its territory in this exciting pixel art platformer. Face challenging enemies and obstacles, using powerful punches, double jumps, and the Dash to overcome action-packed, precise levels.

title: Midnight Scenes: Among Graves
description: When the graves stop whispering in your ear, it’s time for you to surrender to eternal silence. So says the Agreement, and so it must be fulfilled. Welcome to a new dimension of horror. Welcome to Midnight Scenes.

title: Vasilisa
description: Co-op horror game about surviving in old Russian village that is haunted by Slavic folk monsters.

title: The House Always Wins
description:
The House Always Wins is a roguelike deckbuilder set in a bizarre multiverse casino where every run is built on clever choices, powerful synergies, and calculated chaos.

Build your deck, battle through strange worlds, and collect relics in the form of playing cards. Each relic has its own unique effect, but the real power lies in the combinations you create. Form classic poker hands like pairs, three of a kind, or full houses to unlock massive bonuses, then experiment to uncover secret combos hidden throughout the game. You are not just building a deck — you are building a winning hand.

title: AI Limit: Eirene's Furnace of War
description: Continue the story beyond the ending of AI LIMIT. After the fall of the Church, embark on a new journey into the Northern Parish. Step into the domain of Eirene, the Warfare Bishop, and face a new trial within the Furnace Arena, where long-forgotten myths of Havenswell rise once again.

title: I Commissioned Some Pigeons 2
description: I paid more artists to hide pigeons and bread in 15 more pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: Anime Dream Match: Horses
description: A charming and relaxing memory game where you match pairs of adorable anime horses.

title: The Invisible Us
description: “The invisible us” is a FMV game where you play as Song Wufei, a timid high school student targeted by bullies. When a brave classmate intervenes, a series of mysterious events unfold. Investigate and piece together the hidden truth through deduction.

title: Stickman: Waves Of Doom
description: Stickman: Waves of Doom is a horde survivor game with minimalistic graphics where endless enemies crash down upon you in waves of pure chaos and destruction while maintaining steady FPS.

title: The Man You See
description: You're Dorian Vale. Heartbreak leads you to moving towns. Your eyes may or may not deceive you along the way.

title: Holding It
description:
An exercise in patience.

Design, programming, and sound by Toby Alden

Art by Taylor Dow & Sam Alden

Writing by all three

title: In Search of the Ice Pop
description: A story of modern melancholy, a short, nostalgic visual novel about a forgotten ice pop — and the girl who once felt like a big sister to you.

title: JumpStart Spanish
description: JumpStart Spanish is a JumpStart game developed by Funnybone Interactive and released by Knowledge Adventure in 1997. It is intended to help kids between the ages of three and six learn Spanish.

title: UnderPoint
description: A fangame of Undertale made entirely in Powerpoint. Enjoy your favorite friendly RPG in a brand new way by discovering the secrets of what lays beyond time and space.

title: Paddle Legends
description: A chaotic roguelite twist on classic retro arcade-style gameplay. Unlock paddles, grab upgrades, and new ball powers as you battle through dynamic levels, obstacles, and bosses across three campaigns and an endless mode.

title: Dream Dazia
description: Dream Dazia is a retro inspired 2D RPG where you explore open-world areas in Dazia's own nightmare. As Dazia - you solve puzzles, explore ways to level up, conquer any of the elemental temples in any order. Experience the turn-based combat, hidden secrets, custom bosses, exciting music and more!

title: Woman Simulator
description: Experience life as a woman - cleaning, cooking, laundry, and no time to rest. Full immersion into the world of everyday chaos!

title: Last Call: RE
description:
Wylan's grandfather had always had a peculiar obsession with the strange. Throughout his life, his grandfather would regale him and his siblings with tales of the odd and unusual. As he grew older, he brushed these stories off as just that — stories. Heavily exaggerated at best, pure fiction at worst, crafted by his grandfather solely to entertain his beloved grandchildren.

However, after a disastrous year in his life, Wylan made the impulsive decision to move to his grandfather's old haunt, a house in Pale Moon City.

Now, in the cursed city of Pale Moon, it doesn't take long for him to realize that perhaps his grandfather was telling the truth after all...

title: Undead Air
description:
Your radio show has gotten quite popular. By reporting on strange urban legends, conspiracies and scary stories, it has developed a cult following of fans, who regularly call on air to tell their delusions and stories.

On Devil's Night, a shady character calls: "I will commit murder. One in each time zone. You will be the last victim."

Is it yet another pathological liar, or is there something more to their words?

title: My Devil's Voice
description: The infernal authorities entrusted the Ambitious Demon with a new business - to look after a small town. He is already ready to lead the inhabitants to the most terrible manifestations of the Fall in their lives, but, unfortunately, the heavenly administration also does not sleep and directs her to counterbalance the equally ambitious angel in order to maintain the balance of power. You have to help the demon in the confrontation with the angel and persuade the inhabitants of the city to fall into sin.

title: Prerolled
description:
Pack boxes of pre-rolled dice and sell them to silly clients with funky requests in this roguelike-puzzle mix up.
Each die has unique effects based on the positioning of other dice around them, so combo dice together, overcharge shamelessly and maybe you'll be able to cover the rent this week!

title: Vena
description: Roguelike deckbuilder meets hex-tile city builder! Build a resource engine to survive the center’s rising demands. Place producers, converters, and combo-rich tiles. Roll dice to shop, pick perks, and chase wildly different builds every run.

title: Momolitos
description: Explore vibrant zones, collect ingredients, and feed adorable Momolitos to help them evolve into hundreds of unique forms. A cozy creature-collecting adventure that blends exploration, discovery, and the joy of caring for your own lab full of curious life.

title: I Dreamed about static again
description:
Do you want to be a prisoner of your dreams? Who are you pretending to be? Everything you do is just a farce. A puppet.

Escape reality with this visual novel, go beyond the limits of the self and wake up from your dream.

This is a visual novel about a character who pretends to be someone, even to herself. She wants to wake up from this dream and she needs you to do it.

The game lasts around 15 to 30 minutes, featuring 3 different endings.

title: Get Mazed
description: GET MAZED is a 3D asymmetrical multiplayer game pitting survivors against opponents in procedurally generated mazes. Work together, obstruct your adversaries, and solve puzzles to escape before time runs out.

title: Last Year's Snow Was Falling 2
description: Last Year's Snow Was Falling 2 is an Adventure game, developed by Aleksandr Efremov and published by 1C-Softclub, which was released in Europe in 2005.

title: Pop Pop Potato
description:
Pop Pop Potato is a rage game + 2D platformer where you blast yourself up the level with explosive corn kernels instead of jumping.

You lose control in the air, so wherever you land, that's it, even if it's the bottom of the level.

title: Halloween Waifu
description: Halloween Waifu is an exciting puzzle game with anime girls in a Halloween theme! Collect 30 unique levels, enjoy the gallery of collected images and achieve goals with the achievement system. Mystical atmosphere and bright images will make your time unforgettable!

title: Mount Hua
description: Click on 'Start Game', the image will be grayed out, and the colored parts will be randomly scrambled into 16 small fragments, scattered randomly on the screen.Players click on the small image, drag it to its original position to restore it, until all the small fragments move to the correct position

title: Killer Chat!: Original Edition
description: Killer Chat! is a satirical serial killer dating chatsim. Play as a (customisable!) writer as you pretend to be a serial killer, get inspiration for your book, fall in love and try not to call the cops through a whirlwind six months with your murderous beau of choice. What could possibly go wrong?

title: TwoBrains OneShip
description: Two players. One ship. Infinite chaos. Deliver cargo across the galaxy, upgrade your ship, and try not to explode — or each other.

title: Paradise Beach 2: Around the World
description: Paradise Beach 2: Around the World is an improved sequel of the reknown tycoon-style click management game where you build and manage of the world's leading beach resorts. This game allows total freedom of action, so let your imagination run wild! Exciting undeveloped beaches are all around the world just waiting for you to get start. It’s up to you to travel globe, encounter strange animals and meet amazing people, witness unbelievable love stories, complete daring business projects, and save endangered species on eight wonderful and diverse islands.

title: Beercrush
description: BEERCRUSH is a first-person action-roguelike where John Beer must fight his way through various environments to quench his thirst for beer.

title: Tiny Kitchen: Burger Edition
description: Stack, flip, and drop your way to burger glory in this cozy physics-based cooking game. Whether you’re actively grilling or letting orders wait, Tiny Kitchen is perfect for focused breaks and relaxed chaos.

title: Bottom Squad
description: An idle defense game at the bottom of your screen. Build your squad, upgrade your base, and hold the line against relentless alien waves while you work or browse.

title: Dark Front
description: Dark Front is a story-driven first-person shooter that takes players to the fiercest fronts of World War II. Fight on different battlefields with various armies. Experience the darkest era of history brought to life with the power of Unreal Engine 5's stunning graphics.

title: Escape the Script
description: They say you’re a monster who destroyed five star systems. Now you’re trapped in a futuristic prison, facing warped puzzles, absurd therapy, and ethical trials — all to prove you’re still human. Good luck surviving your psychological evaluation!

title: Void Rush
description: Void Rush is a fast-paced action roguelike boss rush game in a magical, fantastic setting. Trapped within a dark void, you face relentless bosses with unearthly powers. Escape may seem possible, but why seek freedom when you can conquer the souls of your enemies time and time again?

title: Backrooms Interception
description: Immerse yourself in a rich Backrooms experience filled with crafting, combat, exploration, and interactions with otherworldly entities. As you progress, a gripping narrative unfolds, revealing secrets hidden within the endless corridors. But be warned danger lurks around every corner.

title: Assassinvisible
description: A cute bite-sized puzzle and stealth game that takes place in the margins of a bored pupil' notebook. You're an invisible assassin, sneak your way past the guards to reach your target and erase it!

title: No Entry
description:
This is a club bouncer simulator meant for the types with a dark sense of humor but deep empathy of the feeling of exclusion, social isolation, and desensitization of the pleasures of life. Decide who is worthy and unworthy, while factoring in the club's status and the bouncer's health. Dealing with losers and drunks can be a very stressful job, and there is a support system of a bartender(shop), DJ(information), bottle girl(opportunities), and a loveable, taller, older dominating boss(raison d'etre).

There is downtime to talk to these fellow employees, but occasionally the club can have a VIP who can also add lore to the experience of night life debauchery. But really, it's just scanning, and making decisions. Occasionally, there will be an attendant who will protest their refusal of entry. They can be denied again, or force can be used. Sometimes they are willing to bribe, which there are no negative consequences in the short run, but may devalue the club's atmosphere in the long run. Survive 10 nights without dying or the club closing down due to an incompetent bouncer.

title: A-Train 9 V5.0 : Japan Train Simulator Ultimate Edition
description: The genre-defining fusion of transport simulator and city builder is back in its ultimate form!

title: A-Train9 Train Construction
description: "A-Train 9 Train Construction" is a 3D railway vehicle customization software that allows you to craft your very own unique train. Let your imagination soar as you design every detail from the shape and paint to the smallest parts of your dream train and set it in motion!

title: Frontline: Panzers & Generals Vol. I
description: Experience the thrill of commanding your army to victory in this exciting Table-top World War II Hex-strategy game. Strategize your way to success by conquering objectives and outsmarting your opponents!

title: Jinagan
description: A short, story-driven 2D platformer.

title: Nora the girl
description: Nora wakes up in a strange forest with no memory of how she got there. Guided by silent creatures and mysterious events, she explores an unfamiliar world and slowly uncovers a hidden truth. The journey is driven by choices, atmosphere, and subtle storytelling.

title: I'm Making a Monster
description: Piece by piece, you pour your soul into the monster. This is your burden and you bear it willingly. Your friends think that this is unhealthy.

title: DazOS_
description: An idle clicker where you manage emails, grow your team, and upgrade to handle even more messages.

title: Burakku Jakku Samurai
description: A fast-paced, turn-based card battler where you duel as a samurai using blackjack-inspired mechanics. Draw, strike, and outsmart rivals in tense one-on-one fights with tactical depth and stylish pixel art.

title: Rleotha: Trial of Gods
description: Help the young one complete the trial, set by the council of gods, on the planet Rleotha.

title: A Lucky Hunt With Lyra
description: Embark on a sensual ladybug-hunting adventure with Lyra, an attractive young woman. In this hidden object game, explore each location to discover what lies beneath Lyra's enticing layers.

title: Stack Prootocol
description: A puzzle-platformer with gravity-defying, block-stacking action. Play as Meep, a RAM-loving USB-mouse, on a quest in cyberspace to repair a broken toaster. Create new paths and jump to your goal—but watch out for the digital void!

title: Train Sim World 6: Transport for Wales BR Class 142 Pacer DMU
description: Bounce back to the Trafnidiaeth Cymru days of yesteryear with Just Trains' detailed BR Class 142. Shuttle around the Cardiff City Network in teal-toned Pacers, as they were in the last years of passenger operation in Wales.

title: Intueri
description: Intueri is an adventure game that explores self-understanding and acceptance through a surreal dream experience.

title: Infinity Nikki: Terra's Call
description:
The snail shell holds the earliest traces of civilization,
while the Titans sealed away the secrets of the gods.
Until a girl's footsteps softly fall,
uncovering long-buried truths that resonate through earth and wind.
A whispered prayer is heard as a decree long delayed unfolds in its final chapter…

title: Deviation Game
description: A co-op party game where you draw things humans can understand, but an image recognition AI can't! Play with 2-6 players using your mobile browser as your controller.

title: Shroomwood
description: Top-down bullet hell with challenging roguelike progression. Unlock and upgrade your town as you fight through procedural levels.

title: Uktena 64: Ultimate
description: A dark comedy horror game with a N64 aesthetic.
