title: Minecraft: Shared Inventory
description: Share the same inventory with other players on your server, including hotbar, armour and offhand slot.

title: Marble Odyssey: Sandbox
description: On a wooden table drifting through space, build little contraptions just to see what happens. Release the marbles and enjoy the calm rhythm of their flow. A warm, curious, and delightful sandbox experience.

title: Spot's Busy Day
description: Spot's Busy Day is a CD-ROM game designed for children 2 years or older. The game features four interactive stories based on the Spot books.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine II - Reclamation Update
description: The Imperium has begun to slowly, painstakingly push the Tyranids off Avarax, but the battle continues in the void and at the moment of their triumph, the great ship Wrath of Espandor has fallen silent. It is up to you and your battle brothers to make your way aboard and expunge the Tyranids once and for all in the new Reclamation Update for Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2

title: One More 6ix
description: A short-session clicker where you roll dice, chase streaks, and fight the cruelty of RNG in a minimalist, dopamine-driven challenge. Are you lucky enough though?

title: The Underpass
description:
Inspired by Exit 8, The Underpass is an anomaly hunting game in which you must remember your surroundings and spot any differences in order to escape the loop.

At release the game has 30+ anomalies, with an average gameplay length of 30-60 minutes.

title: Hall of Mirrors
description: Five people on one computer, really? Yes, this fast-action arcade-style multiplayer game is for the whole family! Shoot balloons with your lasers to score points – but the beams will often bounce off mirrors, creating interesting and complex shots. The more complex, the greater the score!

title: EQ gunkatas
description: EQ gunkatasv3.0 is the last version from the talented animator Lazer. This time with the help of Wiktorus Pro they built something which is known as a TC. The EQG team is proud to present finally their work. The modification is based and inspired by the movie Equilibrium. The coolest thing in this TC are the gunkatas. You can kill multiple enemies with gunkatas being more effective than by normal shooting. The mod contains swordfighting aswell meele beretta where you use your guns as a weapons without shooting. (everything is made from scratch)

title: Nephila
description: For as long as memory serves, a tower reaching all the way to heaven has served as the center of human civilization, its upper floors shrouded in mystery. But recently, legions of monsters have been unleashed upon the world, sent by Aeus, the lord of Pandemonium. Now you must arm yourself, and find a way to reach him. Explore the world, battle monsters, find upgrades, and learn the ancient secrets.

title: From The Void
description: Command a fleet of customizable spaceships, go through intense battles and create builds with unique synergies. Think your placements and upgrades as they will shape the fleet's fate and determines victory or defeat. Test your strategic skills in this rogue-like autobattler game.

title: Vespadian
description: Vespadian is a fantasy role-playing game with a highly customizable party-building system.

title: Young Suns
description:
Young Suns is a narrative-driven life sim for one to four players set in the Jovian System, where the people of Jupiter have just broken free from corporate control. Entrusted with your own spaceship, you fly to fantastical moonlets, derelict ruins, and converted space stations, alone or with up to three friends, salvaging broken furniture, clothing, and tools to repair and keep, gift, or donate to the common good. Along the way, you build relationships with a cast of 30 characters and help the different Jovian factions rebuild society, in a story with a radically optimistic outlook that focuses on the work that comes after liberation.

Your ship doubles as your home, and it can be painted, furnished, and rearranged solo or with friends using the recipes, souvenirs, and items collected on your travels. Your character’s appearance can be changed at any time, tools can be upgraded to take on harder jobs, and the ship itself can be expanded. The story continues to evolve over time, with the world changing in response to the actions of the player base.

title: Orbital Survivor
description: Defy the laws of space and master every trajectory in Orbital Survivor, a 2D survivor-like game where you optimise your movements and shots thanks to gravity. Play as smuggler Cassidy and unleash your arsenal in a ruthless retro-synthwave universe.

title: ServiceIT: Phone Service DLC
description: ServiceIT: Phone Service DLC adds full smartphone repairs: diagnose issues, replace screens, speakers, batteries, and rebuild phones. Fix software, reset PINs, remove unwanted apps, and unlock new missions and tools through a step-by-step training course.

title: Tiny Frontier
description: Crash-land on a forgotten frontier. Build your shelter, power your machines, unlock new tiles, and ignite towering beacons as the storm closes in.

title: Razorlocks
description: Blaze the trails, race your heart out, and let your bladed hair down to explore. Razorlocks is on a journey of speeding to the top and realizing her potential with strands of both style and substance.

title: Mothiary
description: Collect and raise hundreds of delicate moths in your cozy nighttime terrarium. Discover rare species, grow your collection, and unwind in a relaxing idle sanctuary.

title: Foggy Golf
description: Daily Chess + Golf Based Hybrid Puzzle Game.

title: Aeon Directive: The Interview
description: 50 binary questions. Infinite consequences. Observe every detail... the environment could change. Fail to notice an anomaly, and you fail the test. The further you progress, the more rooms you have to remember. Permadeath.

title: Super Drag Race 2
description: Drag racing game with 3 different tracks, ai opponents and earn money by racing and tune your car better and faster

title: Sprite's City Scramble
description: A 3D puzzle-platformer where you play as Sprite, an alien parasite who can possess creatures with unique abilities. Explore, solve puzzles, and collect everyday artifacts to understand our world and find your way home.

title: Plane Crazy Championship Edition
description: Get ready to experience high speed arcade-style racing action! Easy to learn…impossible to master! Your Goal: Earn the title of the quickest airborne Speed Freak! It will take a lot more than fancy flying, quick reactions, sheer nerve, and skill to win here…you gotta be Plane Crazy!

title: Fracta Regna
description: Fracta Regna is a short tactical-strategy experience where you must conquer territories by fight enemy points of interest.

title: Timberflow: Sawmill Simulator
description: From a single tree to an entire industry! Manage and automate your lumber business in this relaxing, yet challenging Sawmill Simulator. Start small, grow rich, dominate the market.

title: CxC
description: CxC is a platformer where each level is generated from a 100x100 .png image. Navigate through a pixel art collection that came to life, and also import and play on your own pictures!

title: City Bus Simulator 2026
description: Experience the Ultimate Bus Driving Adventure! Step into the driver's seat in City Bus Simulator 2026, the most immersive and realistic bus simulation game. Navigate a sprawling 40 square kilometer city, mastering a variety of bus models with unique features and dynamics.

title: Dystopika: B-Sides
description: New districts, props, and holograms for Dystopika

title: Völund
description: The forge remembers every strike. In VÖLUND, a blacksmithing roguelike, you shape raw ore into weapons of legend. Unearth cursed metals, master the ancient craft, and forge your path to immortality.

title: Trustfall
description: TRUSTFALL into the mysterious and quirky inner world of Cherry to 'battle' her inner parts. Master Emotional Alchemy in unique turn-based encounters: choose LOVE to integrate, FEAR to resist, or AWARENESS to transmute. Every choice will uncover a different path back home.

title: Bonegrinder
description: Bonegrinder is an action-packed ARPG. Looting legendary equipment and finding the perfect item combination is key to surviving the ever-growing hordes of zombies, wild animals and other foes. It can be played either solo or in online-coop with up to 4 players.

title: Kolyma
description: Kolyma is a story-rich, unforgiving survival deckbuilder. Face off against GULAG convicts and try to collect enough resources to survive and hopefully escape the prison camp. Build winning decks, complete quests, and don't make too many enemies. Welcome to the North. May the Numbers dance for you.

title: Casino Los Pixels
description: A casino gambling game with no microtransactions or in-game purchases.

title: Garbage Classification Simulator
description: Garbage Classification Simulator, is a simulation game that contains RPG elements. In this game, you can experience Garbage Classification differently.The game has a rich character skill system, realistic physical simulation.

title: The Melty Way
description: You move, you melt. Play as a brave size-shifting slime in this colorful precision puzzle-platformer, dashing through handcrafted puzzles and perilous traps on your journey in The Melty Way.

title: The Garry Story
description: This mod puts you in the shoes of a character named Garry G. An employee that accidentally went to work on Sunday, he's tasked with leaving the office building while a silly narrator keeps talking.

title: Shaman Steps
description: A short Sokoban-like puzzle game where you guide your tribe to collect food.

title: The Purple Peacock
description: The Purple Peacock is a 2D point-and-click adventure game where players guide Virgil Russ, in a mysterious quest to find a rare and elusive stamp, the “Purple Peacock”.

title: Neko Commando
description: Neko Commando is an Anime MMOFPS that features the ability to switch between Ranged and Melee. In ranged form you have a vast assortment of weapons at your disposal, giving you an advantage at a distance. Melee form has no ranged attacks but is faster, stronger, and more robust.

title: Raptor Evolution
description: Smash through environments, gather resources, and hunt grotesque human-mutants to evolve and grow stronger. Use what you collect to rebuild bridges, restore paths and push deeper into a world filled with danger and mystery.

title: Raptor Evolution: Celestosaurus
description: Radiate strength and grace with the Celestosaurus skin - a majestic raptor glowing with cosmic energy.

title: Raptor Evolution: Vectoraptor
description: Transform your raptor into a futuristic predator with the Vectoraptor skin - a neon-coated beast powered by pure energy and precision.

title: Raptor Evolution: Infermadon
description: Set the world ablaze with the Infermadon skin - a raging raptor born from fire.

title: Night People
description: Short horror game where you must escape from an evil family.

title: The Fairview Files: Episode Zero
description:
"There's something rotten going on here in Fairview
And you and I are going to get to the bottom of it."

Fairview is a place shrouded in both mystery and the paranormal.

Newly moved into town is Detective Dalia, a private investigator dead-set on deciphering the town's complexities.

Episode Zero recounts the night that her nephew, Ted, decided to take an ill-advised shortcut...

title: Rumours of a Roman Empire
description: In this alternate-universe visual novel and dating sim, play as Julia or Julius Caesar and navigate the intrigue of the Late Roman Republic. Flirt, scheme, and outwit Rome’s elite to shape history—and forge an empire of your own.

title: Breaking Deck
description: Welcome to BREAKING DECK — a 3D skateboarding PvP race party game where every map is a new kind of madness. Race, perform tricks, sabotage your friends, and survive the chaos long enough to cross the finish line! If you win with style, you’re a legend. If you crash at least you looked cool!

title: Those Who Dwell
description: Those Who Dwell is a story-first psychological horror focused on isolation, atmosphere, and folklore. Light is your only hope as you explore deeper into a cursed cave system disturbed by those who dug too deep. Restore shrines, survive the dark, and uncover what became of Those Who Dwell.

title: Sokofox
description: A short sokoban game where you play as a fox. There are a variety of outfits and customizations.

title: Cozy Jigsaw Puzzles
description: Step into the jigsaw puzzle world with a cozy twist.

title: Frogging Up
description: Frogging Up is a punishing yet rewarding physics platformer about a small frog in a yellow raincoat who dreams of escaping his muddy village life. Guided only by determination (and a very questionable sense of balance), he begins an impossible climb through a surreal world of floating pipes, platforms, and mechanical ruins. Each jump is a step closer to the top and a better life.

title: Hypercar Racing
description: In Hypercar Racing you'll enjoy the dirtiest, fastest, and most spectacular races at speeds over 200 Mp/h, avoiding multiple collisions against 20 adversaries. The game has different modes, such as Championship, Arcade, and 4-player multiplayer.

title: Hero Seekers
description: Restore the lost history in a summoning fantasy RPG!

title: Malachite: Temple of the Sun - Collector's Edition
description: Embark on a journey through the depths of a lost ancient jungle temple.

title: Solid Void Art Nonograms
description: A great collection of nonograms! Uncover art hidden within puzzles! Have fun and exercise your brain!

title: Speed Factor
description: Become a championship legend

title: Bake it! Pizza Master
description: Roll the dough and add toppings to order! Serve your customers delicious, fresh-baked pizza!

title: Restarting Systems: Smoke's Bizarre Adventure
description:
6 months ago, Smoke, Chocolate Spread, Paper Clip, Portable Charger, Milk Cap, and Battery were all assembled as a team, each spouting their own unique ability and prowess, by a desperate Red Button, who sought to defeat the corrupted being that had taken her brother, White Button, and hid out on Lucky Island. With a mission in mind, they set off...

In the present day, the aftermath of those events still lingers in the back of Smoke's mind, mainly due to what had happened to Spread, his once closest friend, and Paper Clip-- both struck by an Alteromalie that has robbed them of their memories. Through a series of events, the trio finds themselves in the mystical dimension between dimensions, the Other Realm. With a powerful threat looming on the horizon, Smoke and co set out on a journey and learn the true meaning of comradery and teamwork.

title: Icebound Secrets: The Frostwood Bane
description: Frostwood hides more than just the cold. Strange figures roam the streets, and one wrong step can change everything. Can you survive the night?

title: Melon Parker: We are Whatever Club!
description: The super-popular singing group “Melon Parker” is now in a visual novel game!

title: Boxville Collection
description: Two adventures. One whimsical world.

title: Family Roadshow: Hidden Adventures - Collector's Edition
description: An incredible and amazing adventure is now in the format of a TV show!

title: Markiplier Montage
description: Markiplier Montage is a mod for Friday Night Funkin' based around the Five Nights at Freddy's as well as of course, Markiplier! We intend to give a unique experience with the mod, with a unique Youtube based UI as well as (hopefully) balanced quirky mechanics. The mod can be a bit difficult, but not too difficult (there won't be any insta death mechanics or anything). Every mainline song also is a recreation of the respective FNAF game the song is based in, so you won't just be playing a rhythm game here!

title: Bad Time Bug in Apartment 309
description: A short, comedic visual novel created by Crying Rules Actually.

title: Funimal: Fusion Animal
description: Funimal is a turn-based sliding puzzle that you can always clear in 5 moves or fewer! The purpose is to move the ground and lead the unknown creature “Funimal” to the goal. Set on a mild planet drawn in pixel art, go to various fields and catch Funimal at your own pace!

title: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection - Premium Deluxe Edition
description:
The third entry in the Monster Hunter Stories RPG series is here!
Twin Rathalos, born in a twist of fate.

Set Contents:
- Base Game
- Deluxe Kit
Additional Side Story: Rudy
Special Outfits Set:
Layered Armor for Eleanor: Royal Flair
Layered Armor for Gaul: Protective Wings
Layered Armor for Kora: Armored Beauty
Layered Armor for Ogden: Eager Explorer
Layered Armor for Thea: Sky Blue Coat
Monster Hair: Arkveld Mane, Lunagaron Fade, Mizutsune Braid
Rudy Outfits: Regal Aspect, Smooth Sailing, Velvety Fur, Aristocratic Air
- DLC Pack
Layered Armor for Eleanor: Foreign Dancer
Layered Armor for Gaul: Fur-tive Five Leader
Layered Armor for Kora: Attendant's Attire
Layered Armor for Ogden: Summertime Ogden
Layered Armor for Thea: Canyne Ward
Monster Hair: Malzeno Bob, Hellfire Tail, Espinas Spikes, Garangolm Nest, Octolocks Princess, Goss Hairagy
Rudy Outfits: Rudy's Arkbelt, Scintillating Armor, Relaxed-acabra, Shogun Rudy, Rudyzeno

title: Tales of Berseria Remastered: Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition includes:
• Tales of Berseria Remastered
• Battle BGM Pack
• Digital Artbook & Soundtrack
• Super Growth Support Herb Set

title: Tales of Berseria Remastered: Super Growth Support Herb Set
description: A set of red herbs that permanently boosts a character’s stats in Tales of Berseria Remastered.

title: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection - Goss Hairagy
description: Contains the following: Monster Hair: Goss Hairagy A special hairstyle for the protagonist!

title: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection - Hellfire Tail
description: Contains the following: Monster Hair: Hellfire Tail A special hairstyle for the protagonist!

title: Resident Evil Requiem: Deluxe Kit
description:
A set of additional content for Resident Evil Requiem.

The Deluxe Kit contains the following content:
- Grace's Costume: Dimitrescu & Film Noir
- Leon's Costume: RE4, Apocalypse & Film Noir
- Screen Filter: Apocalypse & Film Noir
- Four weapon skins including S&S M232 Weapon Skin: Apocalypse
- Charms: Mr. Raccoon & DSO Emblem
- Audio Pack: Raccoon City Classic
- Files: Letters from 1998

title: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection - Layered Armor for Thea: Canyne Ward
description: Contains the following: Layered Armor for Thea: Canyne Ward Change the Rangers' appearance with layered armor!

title: Beyblade x Evobattle: Digital Beybooster Vol. 3
description: Includes 3 additional Beys! Contents: METEOROID DRAGOON 3-70J CURSE MUMMY 7-55W GILL SHARK 5-60FB

title: Beware of Dog
description: Beware Of Dog is a fast paced Action Adventure game with RPG elements set in eclectic insane world where our heroes grandpa Domkrat and his faithful Dog embark on their journey to buy some meat.

title: The Most Annoying Game Ever
description:
Welcome to The Most Annoying Game Ever, a puzzle game designed to test your patience.

This isn't your average brain-teaser. It’s the equivalent of an IQ test, but for your patience. Every interaction, every setting, every mechanic is carefully engineered to waste your time, push your buttons, and make you question why you even clicked "New Game".

title: Rubbish Island
description: In Rubish Island, pilot the Ferrum-1 robot to restore a polluted archipelago. Clean debris to revive wildlife and vegetation, recycle waste into upgrades, and equip special tools for faster cleanup.

title: Chesscape Room
description: Chess variant where you have to escape custom boards through a door with your king while your opponent hunts you! Play through a campaign, create custom boards or challenge others locally or online.

title: Lost Host
description:
Lost Host is a story-driven adventure puzzle game about a small toy car searching for its missing owner.
When the boy mysteriously disappears, the toy car begins a journey through the house and beyond, exploring dark rooms, hallways, foggy streets, and abandoned places while following clues to uncover what happened.

Players control the toy car as it navigates dangerous environments, solves physics-based puzzles, and interacts with objects to progress. The world is full of hazards for a tiny toy car - heights, fire, water - as well as enemies such as dogs, robotic vacuums, and hostile toy creatures.

The game combines atmospheric exploration, light horror elements, and emotional storytelling, creating a family-friendly adventure centered on mystery, discovery, and survival in a large, human-sized world.

title: Sweet Starlight Sisters
description: “Sweet Starlight Sisters” is a character-raising romance adventure where you share a sweet life under one roof with the bunny-girl sisters Anya and Sanya. Train the duo with your own hands to become top performers, and—while occasionally fielding their heart-pounding advances—lead them to victory.

title: Cheesy Chaser
description: Play as Bobo, a cute mouse that pops bubbles to fill his mouth in this arcade-y game.

title: Smashometry
description: Smashometry is a neon-soaked, three-button reflex score-attack game. Hit matching shapes, survive escalating speed, stack insane combos, and climb global leaderboards as the screen erupts with colour and an electrifying original soundtrack.

title: Across the Obelisk: Necropolis Of The Damned
description: Enter a terror-soaked alternate Act 4 and reach a new ending in a kingdom cursed by darkness. Face witches, vampires, and twisted spirits across three new maps. Unlock two new heroes, discover new mechanics, and storm the haunted Necropolis of the Damned.

title: The Aperture Dilemma
description: Step into the life of Aperture Lab's employee Mike, as he faces an extreme dilemma while at his place of work...

title: Nodwar
description: Nodwar is a Real Time Strategy game based in the browser.

title: Go Hell Go Gou: Tsukiotoshitego
description: An expanded version of goHELLgo with a new facility and corresponding characters, new events for the main heroines and 3 new story characters.

title: Night Seeker
description: Night Seeker is an immersive 3D hidden object game where you will explore a dark office shrouded in mystery. Your main goal is to find hidden objects that will help you uncover the story behind the mysterious events occurring in this place.

title: Owl Bounce
description: Owl Bounce is an exciting 2D platformer arcade game where you control an amazing owl-shaped ball capable of incredible jumps! Immerse yourself in a world of colorful levels, where your goal is to collect juicy apples and avoid obstacles on your path to victory.

title: Kissrim
description: “Please give your vital energy to Lily.”

title: Entropy graze
description: Fast-paced, skill-based, chaotic & hardcore "survivors" game, with huge array of builds, enemy variety and tons of mechanics.

title: Nion Forge
description: Nion Forge is a blend of roguelite gameplay and modular shipbuilding, set in a stylish cyberpunk world. By carefully selecting the right modules, you'll have a chance to conquer all 9 districts of the city, defeat their district bosses, and attain your freedom.

title: Euro Truck Simulator 2: Forest Machinery
description: Expand your haulable cargoes with the Forest Machinery DLC! If you're craving a breath of fresh forest air while supporting the forestry industry, this expansion has you covered.

title: Shared Visions
description: Protopia Island has become a hotspot for paranormal activity, with its residents reporting numerous unexplainable events, leading many to believe that the island is haunted. A reporter is sent to the island to document the experiences of the locals to create an audio documentary for the radio.

title: Ninja Infiltration
description: Newly married ninja Ayame is assigned her most dangerous mission yet: To infiltrate Lord Amakusa's castle for an undercover investigation. Acting as a mercenary for hire, it will take all of Ayame's skill and willpower to uncover the truth and return home to her husband.

title: MoriyaRhythm
description:
This game is a Touhou Project derivative work.
It is a rhythm-action game in which the player controls a character who keeps bouncing to the background music while avoiding enemy bullet patterns and attacking.

title: Flap de Clap
description:
Take on Mount Snoepje by flapping your way up with up to three friends. Be careful not to bonk too much or you might end up at the very bottom again.
Hunt for highscores in the endless runner mode, dodging and defeating various enemies and bosses.

title: Hole io: Japan DLC
description: Wear traditional skins and visit the new Japan map with your friends!

title: Cheese Dreams
description: A highly non-linear, "experiMENTAL" game with over 600 screens, made by the creator of Revenge of the Sunfish.

title: Paravalence: With My Angel
description: Get implicated in Saint Ambrose. A linear visual novel experience told in three parts: The shadow of my mother is my mother, too. My little cellmate casts a spell. The world is like a dancer: the ritual of everyday. We're all doing magic, of course.

title: MasterQuest Fantasy
description: MasterQuest Fantasy is a love letter to the classic 70s and 80s tabletop RPGs. Enter a procedurally generated world where no playthrough will ever be the same!

title: Henry Stickmin: Defending the Mall
description:
Defending the Mall is a Henry Stickmin fangame by Steve "THEPARAKEET101" Chrome. It was developed in Scratch and was released in both vector and bitmap mode. releasing on Game Jolt the same day. It released November 8th, 2025.

In an alternate timeline where Henry decides he doesn't want to Break the Bank, Henry becomes a Night Guard for the West Orange Pavilion Mall. On the night of Black Friday, infamous criminal Carl `"Nutcracker" Ghrimes breaks into the Mall, it's up to you to decide what Henry does.

title: Pact with a Demon EP01
description: You must survive on an island after a card accident and find a way out, while several demonic creature trying to attack you!

title: Stormlander
description: Stormlander is a new online action game that allows up to 100 players to enjoy thrilling siege battles. Customize characters with unique personalities to create your ideal hero that suits your play style, and aim for the top with your friends.

title: Midnight Cat Heist
description: Midnight Cat Heist is a 2D pixel-art platformer where players control a sneaky cat stealing shiny treasures to bring home to its human. Across 25 compact urban levels, players must avoid hazards, grab a specific item in each stage, and then reach the exit—leaving without the item results in failure. The game focuses on simple mechanics, light stealth, and playful feline charm.

title: Luppy
description: Luppy is a 2D platformer featuring 32 handcrafted levels filled with traps, enemies, and platforming challenges. Players collect coins to unlock a hidden trophy in each stage in order to progress, while making use of special abilities such as umbrella gliding and winged flight. The game emphasizes precise controls, varied mechanics, and a lighthearted, character-driven presentation.

title: The Last Survivors Harem
description: This is a simple survivor game, and also a loot-collecting game. While fighting hordes of monsters, you can collect equipment of various qualities. Combining these equipment allows your character to gradually grow stronger.

title: Bombastar
description: Bombastar is an explosive grid-based puzzle game with a variety of game modes that you can enjoy. This game contains a variety of endless game modes and 50 handcrafted puzzles that you can play to your heart content. Build up combo and reach new height in this affordable Single-Z quality game!

title: Crayation: The First Sketch
description: The crayons aren’t friendly anymore. Survive until 6 AM, evade five deadly mascots, and uncover the terrifying secrets hidden inside Crayation Plaza.

title: IdleDragon
description: This is an adventure AFK game based on text and images, where you can recruit heroes and collect equipment to defeat the demon king. Cultivate unique custom heroes in the game, create exclusive equipment as the main gameplay, easily place to complete the main storyline, and there is also an endless.

title: Dice In You
description: A roguelike deck builder with dice. Fuse dice to create your own powerful custom dice, and aim for even higher scores!

title: Floating Isle Days
description: You have traveled to a magical world in your dreams, and there is now a cute little sprite by your side. You will spend many wonderful moments with it on this land.

title: The Angel's Devil Tail: One More Question 2
description: A Single-Player Lateral Thinking Puzzle game. This title features a Bishoujo ADV story where you deduce the truth behind bizarre mysteries. With Steam Workshop support for infinite puzzles, it's the perfect solo detective experience!

title: Clim Snail
description: A single-player jump-action platformer where you guide Slow, a timid little snail, growing stronger with mushrooms and items as you climb toward the top of the world.

title: The Cradle
description: You are Alex, a curious journalist who has decided to investigate the mysterious disappearance of the entire staff of Synergy Soft. Six months ago, all the employees went mad at once, staging a bloody massacre. The official version is mass psychosis. But the truth is much more terrifying.

title: Flying Universe
description: Doomsday sci-fi, open world, barrage, multiple endings. With eight levels, players will have more than 30 fighters with different shapes and attack experiences, including upgrades to enhance their combat effectiveness.

title: Meow and the Diamond Jump
description: Meow and the Diamond Jump is a casual platformer featuring 40 levels, progressive difficulty, and infinite lives.

title: Puppy Link: Tile Connect
description: Relax with Puppy Link, a cute tile-connect puzzle game! Match adorable dogs across 300+ levels featuring Small, Medium, and Large boards. Enjoy soothing music, customize your wallpaper, and interact with the puppies by clicking them. Fill your Hall of Honor with achievements in this cozy adventure!

title: Dillingham
description: Dillingham is a fast-paced fish-processing and logistics simulator where chaos meets precision. Run an Alaskan seafood plant, unload boats, sort and process fish, manage conveyor systems, operate forklifts, and keep every station flowing before the whole line backs up.

title: Cat Girl Survivor: Extra Episodes and Additional Chapters
description: Premium Voice DLC Experience heroes' daily lives in 5 new chapters with full Japanese voice acting! S-grade equipment and Salamander drop rates are significantly increased. New character Mio can instantly freeze enemy movements. Enjoy deeper stories and powerful rewards!

title: Mine Puzzle Pieces of Flower Garden World
description: A puzzle game with the feature of randomly generating puzzle shapes for each round.

title: The Interval Bureau: Extension 0
description: A short psychological audio horror call where every number routes you deeper into a faceless bureau that measures and files you.

title: Cyber Lab
description:
Cyber Lab is a challenging 2D platformer with 30 levels set in a futuristic laboratory full of traps and deadly hazards.
The player controls a small robot through a series of precision experiments where every wrong move could be the last.

title: Corporation Liberty
description: Welcome, Worker. Up to four employees share a single shift to complete randomized tasks under severe time limits. Cooperate or face correction. Each shift reshapes the next. Work without rest for only through labor do we preserve Democracy and protect Freedom.

title: Unguided Order
description: In a world where ancient barriers are crumbling, Darkness approaches Master Leo's home. Using a powerful artifact, Leo attempts to repel the threat. Your key tasks are strategy, creature selection, and tactical deployment, while your troops and the Master handle the battles and application of magic.

title: Sneaky All-Nighter 2
description: It's time for another sneaky all-nighter! Play to your heart's content in all-new situations—just don't get caught!

title: Achilles-Sword-ll
description: In Achilles-Sword-ll, explore the dungeons by choosing one of the characters where you will have to fight to survive in a world full of challenges and fantasy.

title: The Counter Gambit
description: A revenge-themed visual novel. After a decade of study, I entered a top university, only to be framed in the library and unjustly imprisoned. Now at rock bottom, how can I break free? Is there any chance left to flip this ruined life of mine?

title: Snowball Fight 2025
description: In this game you start on one team during a snow storm. You can pick up snowballs and throw it at the opponents. Watch as each gets more challenging and the opponents throw snowballs faster. If you survive you win the snowball fight

title: Noble Steed
description: A fast, funny 2D platformer where every level throws you into chaotic combat and questionable heroics, all to rescue your runaway horse… again.

title: Sweetie Candy Maze: Purple Grape
description: Dive into a vibrant candy world! Collect delicious sweets and find your way through playful purple grape mazes in this sweet and colorful adventure.

title: Butcher of the North
description: You never received any New Year's gifts. This year, you decided to take what is yours. After tracking Santa down by his IP address, you head to his lair to take what is rightfully yours.

title: Mafia Infiltration
description: Here's some advice for you, pal: If you can't beat them, join them. Befriend them, learn their flaws, sabotage their operations, pit them against each other, climb the ranks. And then—burn it all down from the inside. Turn-based strategy meets choice-based narrative. Welcome to Mafia Infiltration.

title: Mahjong Girl Kshity-Gurpa
description: Genre: Table game + Visual Novel. This is a homage to the style of mahjong games that were hugely popular in Japan during the 90s. Numerous charming characters appear, delivering full voice reactions during matches and scenarios!

title: Extinct Forest
description: Fight for your life in a mysterious, abandoned open world. In Extinct Forest, there are no crosshairs and no HUD — just you and your weapon against intelligent dinosaurs. Explore the desolate wilderness, solve environmental puzzles, and master realistic combat mechanics in this immersive shooter.

title: DUD Detective Ulysses Day
description: When trouble strikes, they hire DUD & when they hire DUD, things get nuts! Do you have what it takes to be in DUD's shoes? Sure, you do. So get down & dirty & play this point&click adventure game today. Sneak your your way in and out of trouble of recovering the stolen will.

title: Pogui
description: Pogui is a short and charming platformer about a dreamy pug trapped in a nightmare. Travel through 5 worlds filled with creative levels, dozens of different enemies and unique mechanics to help Pogui wake up, if he can escape the entity that imprisoned him in his own dream!

title: Sip Or Die
description: A psychological party horror where every sip could kill you. Take a Gamble, and Choose a vial, drink, and pray it’s not poison.

title: Cropacalypse
description: A cozy themed farm where the crops are alive! Harvest your crop with a Harvester AKA W.H.E.A.T. (Weaponized Harvest Extraction Assault Tool). Challenge progressively difficult levels while changing the harvest to reduce Crop stats, buy and upgrade weapons, and level up to make the ultimate farmer.

title: Skullgirls 2nd Encore: Upgrade
description:
Hear Skullgirls' story as never before, try your hand at all new trials and challenges, and see how long you can last in Survival! Also unlocks all five additional characters: sing zombie opera with Squigly, and make beautiful music with Big Band! Unleash Eliza's skeletal Parasite, and howl at the moon with Beowulf! And, finally, learn why humans cry with Robo-Fortune. All while taking advantage of the full range of color options so you'll look spiffy in your next match! It's everything you want, in one convenient package!

This upgrade adds the following to the base Skullgirls game:

- All DLC characters: Squigly, Big Band, Eliza, Beowulf and Robo-Fortune!
- All DLC character colors, plus extra colors from Skullgirls Mobile and Skullgirls Switch: Brings all 14 characters up to 27 total colors, with many having even more!
- Fully-voiced Story Mode: Skullgirls' excellent cast of voice actors bring the story to life like never before!
- Unlocks the No Man's Land stage from Skullgirls Mobile!
- Challenges: Win a variety of challenging battles with unique conditions, and even play as Marie!
- Trials: Learn actually-useful combos, from basic bread n' butter to more advanced ones!
- Survival Mode: Endless waves of enemies await - how long can you survive?

title: Town Diggers
description: Dig up items from the earth and trade them in your shop. To grow your business in a ruthless capitalist world: sell items, smuggle, forge items, expand your shop, hire workers. With strong financial power be the town’s mafia boss. Take down the rival mafia.

title: Jiuzhaigou Valley Scenic and Historic Interest Area
description: Click on 'Start Game', the image will be grayed out, and the colored parts will be randomly scrambled into 16 small fragments, scattered randomly on the screen.Players click on the small image, drag it to its original position to restore it, until all the small fragments move to the correct position

title: Vytal Tactics
description: A real-time top down tactics game that rewards spacing, clever item use and team building. Vytal needs help, so form a strong team, level up your heroes and choose powerful artifacts to take out rounds of enemies.

title: 100Friends
description: The Loneliness Epidemic is coming, and only you and your hundred closest friends can stop it. Rally your party, fight back the Legions of Sadness, and bring the world back together once and for all...

title: Service Area Simulator
description: Your adventure begins: from a humble roadside pit stop to a massive Route 66 rest area! Clean, stock market shelves, and keep toilets spotless to avoid bankruptcy. Restaurant, market, restrooms, and classic American diner await you!

title: Pronoun Palace
description: Pronoun Palace is a word-spelling roguelike set in a dystopian future where the government has taken your pronouns. Use spells to manipulate letter tiles, catch fish, and abuse amphetamines to defeat the Party and get your pronouns back!

title: Hollowgrace
description:
In a land once blessed by divine light, grace has hollowed into silence. The world of Elyndra was once watched over by radiant gods whose touch gave life to all things. But their gifts turned to rot. What was meant to heal began to consume — transforming faith into obsession, worship into madness.

Only those with royal blood can mend this broken world, yet Princess Lysandra Veilborne, last heir to the throne, lies trapped within the fallen citadel — a ruin swallowed by ash, haunted by the undead and demons born from the dying light.

title: Pets Hidden In The Office
description:
The office is in chaos. The employees are gone. And the pets? Completely out of control!

Welcome to Pets Hidden In The Office, a fun 3D hidden object game where your mission is to track down wild animals causing panic in offices all across the city.

title: 100 StarPaws Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️‍Can you find them all? ️

title: 101 Dogs Hidden in Brazil
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in Brazil in the hand-crafted landscape. Earn tons of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: 101 Dogs Hidden in Mexico
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in Mexico in the hand-crafted landscape. Earn tons of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: 12 Labours of Hercules XIX: Pandora’s Gift Box
description: Help Hercules stop Pandora’s icy curse in snowy, festive Hellas!

title: 8 Floor, Only Me?
description: A horror game where you must identify anomalies in the environment. You’re trying to leave the building, but the 1st floor never comes.

title: 8-Second Records
description: In the horror puzzle game '8-SECOND RECORDS,' you become an observer investigating commissioned mysterious incidents by analyzing seven days of CCTV footage.

title: A Bad Christmas Story
description: Christmas lights, winter snow, and a serial killer on the loose. Follow a gifted detective through a twisted holiday night in this story-driven, interactive horror game. Your choices determine who lives, and who dies. Can you outsmart the killer?

title: A Bad Space Game
description: This is a Game about maneuvering a Spaceship through Rings all while trying to avoid some Rocks. Think you can manage? Test your patience in 8 increasingly challenging LvL´s consisting of flying through Rings Dodging Rocks and getting Boosted in between.

title: A Brown Rabbit's Story
description: A Brown Rabbit's Story is an interactive storybook, a text-driven adventure where your choices lead to branching paths and multiple endings. In a quiet orphanage, a boy wishes his toy rabbit to life… and together, you must face the world’s cruelties and find hope.

title: Absolute Tennis Manager 2
description: Immerse yourself in the world of tennis with ATM 2! Create or take on the role of a player and manage every aspect of their career: schedule, training, staff, personal life... Build your legend, tournament after tournament, and aim for the ultimate place in the Hall of Fame.

title: Apples in the Abyss
description: A puzzle platformer passion project where you manipulate the fabric of space to collect some apples. Tear holes, rotate chunks, and mirror entire columns of space across each other. Collect all the apples with a given set of abilities in each stage.

title: Nia and The Abyss
description: Join Nia on her journey to breathe new life into the ocean depths. Clean the seafloor, plant seeds, and attract unique marine life. Cultivate a thriving ecosystem as you uncover the remnants of humanity lost beneath the waves.

title: Diving Into Abyss
description: You are a new recruit in a professional civilian diving rescue team. Your first mission is to rescue the missing cave diver.

title: Death Forest Abyss
description: Escape from the Forest of Fear by searching for the broken bike parts while running away from the creatures that are the remains of the massacre victims!

title: The Abyssal Maze
description: Trapped in a nightmarish labyrinth, you have only two goals, find the ancient book and escape. But the walls are alive with echoes, and the monsters that stalk the corridors never sleep.

title: The Abyss Book
description: The Abyss Book a groundbreaking text-based adventure game that blends AI-powered dynamic story generation with stunning 3D visuals. Every choice you make shapes a unique adventure, with AI responding in real-time, delivering a new generation of personalized experiences.

title: The Abyss Break
description: Hardcore first-person co-op horror extraction game. Explore the parallel worlds of the Abyss alone or with a team, gather resources, and make life-or-death decisions that will determine your survival.

title: Star Station Frontier
description: Star Station Frontier, a company specialized in exploring and investigating possible planets for colonization, was studying a new planet when suddenly the base was attacked by aggresive aliens! The crew is locked behind the security system and only the Rescue Bot F580-T can open a safe path for the crew to escape safely!

title: Late Ming Dynasty
description: "Late Ming Dynasty" is a single-player horror exploration game. Traverse eerie backroom levels while searching for an exit to attempt escape.

title: Sticky Twig Dash!
description: Sticky Twig DASH! is a 2D platformer where you play as a kind forest creature who uses a twig spear to stick to walls and then launch himself with a high jump! Use your movement abillities to delve into an unknown place to save your lost little sister.

title: World In The Abyss
description: The aliens have caused the oceans to rise, plunging the world into the abyss. Survive, craft, and explore this mysterious underwater world. Build your base, defend it against relentless waves of enemies, and dive deep to uncover the secret that could stop the alien invasion once and for all!

title: StarAbyss Heroes
description: Torn by an ancient cataclysm, the world lies in ruins. In this ARPG, play a hero exploring relics, looting treasures, forging weapons, and mastering skills on a decaying yet fantastical journey.

title: Goblin Gold Hunt
description: Play as a greedy little goblin with an oversized sack and an even bigger hunger for loot! Dash, jump, and snatch every coin, chest, and shiny treasure in sight as you chase your dream of becoming the richest goblin in the world. Fortune favors the bold—and the gold-hungry! But watch out! Taking damage or dying will make you lose coins! Try your best to reach the end with the maximum amount of coins and show to the world the your greediness know no bounds!

title: Bonk 'N Bash
description: A small and hard-headed dinosaur sets off on an adventure to break obstacles, defeat enemies and gather all the lost dinossaur eggs lost after the eruption started. Help our little friend continue the mighty dino lineage by saving all the eggs and avoiding total extinction!

title: Planet Gallery
description: Discover strange planets using an experimental space telescope. Take photos and defend your ship from dangerous debris!

title: Distant Shore: Bretagne
description: Explore the ruins of a former research site, devastated by climate collapse. Wield magnetic gauntlets to move, bend, or break metal as you recover lost BIO2 data and uncover your brother’s trail — all while evading the Cloud, a sentient weather entity that watches your every move.

title: Amelorn
description: Recruit unique units, cast powerful spells, and conquer your enemies in a 2D fantasy strategy adventure. Tackle a challenging campaign or dive into Skirmish Mode to create and customize your own battles.

title: Elemency Island
description: Elemency island is a cozy farm coop game. Plant, raise animals, sell your ressources to unlock technologies and automate your entire farm. Alone, or with your friends, come discover this island full of surprises and unknown creatures.

title: The Fruits of the Literature Club
Frobbutt 3D
description: Frobbut 3D is a 3D platformer about a goofy frog finally departing from his home to explore the land! Run, jump, flip and bounce across 5 big open levels searching every nook and cranny for valuable gems! Be creative with your movement abilities to reach the highest mountains and traverse the most dangerous paths to collect every treasure you can find.

title: Sublustrum
description: Step into the space between subconscious and reality. Explore strange liminal worlds, solve sound-driven puzzles, and unravel the secrets behind the enigmatic device left by a vanished scientist.

title: My Doki Doki SNAFU
description: This mod is a blend between comedy and seriousness (without the memes or obvious references seen in Relapse). The story follows a redesigned protagonist and his experience joining the club. By redesign, I mean he was given a personality different to the base game, as well as a past that will play into his general outlook and interactions with the dokis. He's sort of a blend between the personalities of the protagonists from these stories: "My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU," "Bunny-Girl Senpai," and "The Fruit of Grisaia." I've never played the mod "Fruits of the Literature Club", so there may be a slight overlap due to our similar inspirations, but if there is it will likely be negligible. With that explained, what about the game-play?There will be 10~11 'routes' available, though that doesn't mean you'll have to play through the mod that many times. Each girl has two routes, a lover route and a friend route. You can only do one lover route at a time (so no harem), but you could technically clear multiple friend routes in a single playthrough. To give an idea, it's a similar system to what you would see in a Persona game.Two new characters are also introduced (hence the 10~11 routes), but one of them is totally optional if new characters aren't your thing.The potential of a stat system exists. Again, this is a similar system to what you'd see in a Persona game, with there being four "stats" that can be raised to unlock new scenes and interactions. It's currently incorporated into the code and present in the demo, but it may be removed or altered in the future if I run out of ways to use it meaningfully.But why don't you see all these for yourself? Click below to download the demo!

title: Odyssey: Starship Pinball
description: A zany pinball platformer, inspired by classic arcade tables with a procedural twist. Bounce, fling, and bump through a roguelite pinball world in endless singleplayer or idle modes.

title: Crystal Veins
description: Crystal Veins is a charming 2D platformer adventure that blends lighthearted cartoon visuals with intense subterranean challenge. Players take control of Toby, a rookie miner who wakes up trapped deep underground after a mysterious cave-in. With only his pickaxe, helmet, and a flickering lantern, he must dig, dodge, and dash his way through a forgotten mine full of secrets and dangers. Each ancient gate blocking Toby’s path requires a precise number of rare crystals to open. To survive, players must mine the glowing crystal veins hidden throughout the level, evade deadly threats like lava pits, bats, and lurking cave beasts, and race to the exit before the darkness closes in. Packed with satisfying mining mechanics, smooth movement, and puzzle-like level design, Crystal Veins offers a layered, fast-paced experience where every swing and every step matters. Will you dig deep enough to escape... or be lost in the shadows forever?

title: Space Adventure: Mercury
description: Space Adventures is a thrilling platformer series that takes players on an interplanetary journey across the solar system. Each instalment is set on a different planet, introducing unique environments and innovative gameplay mechanics that evolve with every game. With 30 challenging levels per title, players must adapt to new obstacles, physics, and surprises as they sharpen their platforming skills and uncover the mysteries of the cosmos. Prepare for an ever-changing adventure where no two planets — or levels — are the same.

title: Reunion Online
description: Reunion Online is a massively multiplayer online role-playing game (MMORPG) where you can fight monsters with your friends in an open world.

title: Fear Dog The Bolota Escape
description: Fear Dog: The Bolota Escape is a 2D adventure game that blends action, humor, and challenges in a backyard full of traps! You control Bolota, a cowardly and clumsy dog — but for a good bone, he becomes a true hero.Bolota's bones have been scattered all over the yard, and he needs to recover each one of them to be able to escape.

title: Tiny Arctic Hero
description: Tiny Arctic Hero is a cozy sokoban puzzle game about a clever little penguin who was taken by mysterious aliens to participate in their logic experiments. Solve puzzles, outsmart the alien tech, and guide this brave Arctic Hero back home!

title: The End of the Age
description:
The End of the Age is a challenging 2D pixel-art platformer that throws players into a prehistoric world on the brink of extinction. As Dino, a young but determined dinosaur, you must outrun the chaos triggered by a cataclysmic meteor impact, navigating collapsing forests, facing hostile creatures, and surviving an unforgiving environment where one wrong move means death. With a stamina-based movement system, every jump, dash, and decision matters. Meat scattered across the world becomes your only lifeline, restoring precious energy to help you push forward. Precision, timing, and adaptability are the keys to survival in this fast-paced, one-hit-kill journey. Blending classic platformer sensibilities with tense survival mechanics. The End of the Age is a intense adventure that rewards mastery and perseverance.

Can you outlast extinction or will you become a fossil of the forgotten past?

title: Air Defender
description:
TAKE COMMAND OF THE NATION'S AIR DEFENSE

The sky is your battlefield. A hostile contact appears on radar. Is it a civilian airliner off course, or the prelude to a full-scale attack? Your job is to find out.

Air Defender is a high-stakes, real-time strategy simulation that puts you in the command chair of a national Air Defence network. From a top-down strategic view, you are the unseen hand responsible for detecting, identifying, and intercepting airborne threats. This is not a dogfighting game; you are not a pilot. You are the commander with access to the capabilities of multiple roles in the bunker, and the fate of the nation rests on your split-second decisions.

Analyse radar returns, scramble your Quick Reaction Alert (QRA) fighters, and manage your assets to protect your airspace. Every choice matters, and the consequences of failure are devastating.

title: Hunter Survive Zero
description: Save the world, kill enemies, joke about mice in the new game from Red Grad.

title: The Shadow Ritual
description: Inspired by 'Ritual' creepypastas. Complete the ritual and enter the Shadow Realm.

title: Who is Johnny Sixgun?
description: Who is Johnny Sixgun? is the surreal and cinematic first chapter to the story of the world's biggest Hooters fan: a shitpost epic adventure through the depths of a fractured psyche.

title: The Red Hood: Hunting the Wolf
description: In "Red Hood's Hunt for the Wolf," you play as Red Riding Hood on a perilous journey through forests and caves to defeat the evil wolf. Battle enemies like skeletons and elves with your sword, collect coins, and overcome obstacles in this classic platformer to save the forest.

title: The Da Vinci Cryptex 4
description: Unravel 50 codes, unlock the Cryptex, and escape the room!

title: Careening
description: Careening is a bullet-heaven CarPG with a focus on exploration and movement. Drive across a small open world, defend yourself from the robot horde, then do it all again.

title: Backflip Madness 2
description: Backflip Madness 2 is a fast-paced, parkour-flavored extreme sports game. Your goal is simple - make tons of spectacular tricks and stunts. Take it to the extreme, again!

title: Back From Earth
description: This is the story of a fragile alien climbing through strange worlds in search of home. A journey of symbols and emotions, where every step forward carries the weight of healing.

title: Bunny Space Odyssey: FlopHop
description: Embark on a pixel adventure with Ponchee the bunny in "Bunny Space Odyssey: FlopHop". Solve puzzles, protect plants, and uncover deep mysteries with Usagi-01 on an uninhabited planet.

title: Sorcerer's Fortitude
description: Sorcerer's Fortitude is a dynamic 3D TPS game where you take on the role of a powerful wizard defending your fortress from relentless waves of enemies. Explore a magical world, learn new spells, and gather resources to unlock unique characters and enhance your abilities.

title: Echo of the Walls
description: Enter a world where the lines between reality are blurred. Like Daniel, you came here in search of the truth, but found yourself trapped in a terrifying mind game. Your only key to freedom and understanding is an ancient Polaroid camera, capable of capturing the invisible.

title: Knight of the Keep
description: Knight of the Keep is a retro-style 2D action platformer where you play as Sir Peter, the last knight defending Castle Keep from waves of corrupted foes. With only his skill, timing, and courage, he must clear each room to unlock the gates and move forward. Dodge traps, fight monsters, and survive a collapsing world. With crisp pixel art and tight controls, it's a brutal, no-shortcuts challenge. Can one knight protect the last gate to the light?

title: Cards, the Universe and Everything
description: Cards, the Universe and Everything is a unique trading card game with almost limitless possibilities: Dinosaurs, Norse gods, blue-footed boobies, Samurai, volcanoes, even the god particle. With the universe’s thingamabobs and endless strategies, are you ready for this gloriously bonkers game?

title: Reverse 1999: The Midnight Whistle
description:
Version 3.1 of Reverse: 1999, which includes:
• New characters: Rubuska and Corvus
• New Garments for A Knight, Cristallo, Aleph, Windsong, and Mercuria
• New main event: The Midnight Whistle
• New Anecdote for Necrologist
• …and more!

title: Bienvenue au club Tom-Tom et Nana
description: Join Tom-Tom and Nana's club! Like them, be resourceful, inventive, and full of humor to complete your missions: manage restaurant service, wash Poussin the dog and prepare the ghost party. You can also make membership cards for your own club, invitation cards... and more thanks to the creative workshop!

title: House of Saturn
description: Exorcize the demonic in this psychological horror game set in 1920s England. Navigate a haunted university by solving puzzles and hiding from a demon that can phase through walls. The gates of hell shall not prevail.

title: All Adrift
description: Whether its end is dark or bright, create a religion for a fabricated god and perform surgery on the history of the universe. Strive to understand all things in the universe that mere humans cannot know. For now, survive like that.

title: Mutation Overload
description: Fight your way through rooms full of monsters. You decide what mutations they get, but be careful, because it can quickly chain into deadly combination.

title: Resequence: The Orchard
description: Resequence: The Orchard is an occult-horror adventure game in which school counselor Saito approaches an inexplicable phenomena through his counseling sessions with students.

title: Accursed: Emma's Path
description: Accursed: Emma's Path is an adult story-rich dark-fantasy JRPG featuring a unique twist on the traditional turn-based combat system. Guide Emma through a corrupting plot of intrigue and survive in an unknown country. Do whatever it takes to break the curse!

title: Fatenames
description:
Fatenames is a team-based word deduction party game played online. Two teams, Red and Blue, race to find their own words on a shared board of cards. Each team has a Fateweaver, who sees the board's key and gives one-word clues with a number, and Seekers, who talk each clue over, point at cards and reveal the ones they believe belong to their team. Every board also hides a disaster card, the eclipse, and the team that reveals it loses on the spot.

Lobbies are joined with a code and hold up to 30 players, with 4x4, 5x5 or 6x6 boards, several word packs or a custom word list, and adjustable turn timers. Matches earn XP toward 100 levels that unlock cosmetics such as name colors, avatar auras and frames, animated profile cards and card backs. Every finished match is saved with a step-by-step replay, players are ranked on a global leaderboard, and the interface is available in English, Spanish, French, Chinese and Hindi.

title: Alicia and the Curse of Climax
Ariel Academy's Secret School Festival
description: Ariel Academy, a relatively unassuming girls school with an annual event so outlandish that attendance might be a bucket list item for every man in the country. The Ariel Academy Culture Festival is a 2 week affair held annually in October. The general public is invited to participate not only in the traditional festivities during the day, but they're also welcome to join the students behind the curtain during the evening for the real attraction, the Backstage Culture Festival. The clubs and classes of Ariel Academy have set up all sorts of obscene versions of traditional festival staples, and some unique activities only a truly perverse group of girls could have come up with, all to help their customers make every night one to remember.​

title: Battle Demon Kirsten
description:
Our protagonist "Kirsten" is a soldier troubled by her current way of life.
During her adventure, she'll encounter a wide variety of people,
and those warm exchanges will shape her in one direction or another...
Formerly known as "War Demon Kirstin"​

title: Betra Endemic
description:
Overview:
A mysterious disease that only couples develop is rampant in a small town far from the royal capital.
It requires special treatment, and if left untreated, it can be life-threatening.
The protagonist Edgar travels to the town with his partner Clarice to investigate this rare disease, and while interacting with the townspeople, they pursue the truth of the disease.
Enjoy this strange and lustful ensemble drama.​

title: Transit Station
description: Deep in the crater lies a Transit Station. Processing packages becomes a nightmare when something alive slips through the transit channel.

title: Island of Lost Things
description: Play as Eric, a spirit medium, who is navigating the space between life and death. Help trapped souls by recovering items from their past, reconnecting them with their lives, and guiding them to make the ultimate decision: return to life or pass on to whatever comes next.

title: Gaionin War Don't Combine
description: This game is a new online FPS with a unique rule called “Shop And War.” The objective is to compete for points. There are shops on the battlefield, and players can also participate as merchants of death. Players who become merchants earn more points than those who kill on the battlefield.

title: Duck Block
description: A new type of puzzle 2D platformer! Make the blocks materialize and guide the duck to the goal!

title: Wave Leads You...
description: A simple 2D action puzzle game that conveys waves to lead you to the goal. Make full use of scaffolding blocks that can be shaken like waves to reach the goal.

title: Skate Style
description: Skate Style is the next-generation skateboarding game! Create and share your style with your friends using the built-in animation editor. The game blends high-fidelity graphics and cutting edge animation techniques with an advanced character creator giving you full creative freedom. Whether you're hitting iconic street spots in Barcelona or flowing lines at Stalin Skate Plaza in Prague, every trick, every replay, and every style is yours to define.

title: Zoo Wars
description: Battle with cute animals and fruits! Build a deck of 6 cards and battle in this simple yet deep, real-time online PvP tower defense for two players!

title: Fri: The Unforgettable City
description: An adventure game where your choices change the world. Fri, a girl working at a coffee workshop, lives in a town that feels strangely mysterious. What will she encounter in this town while suffering from amnesia, and how will the world changing?

title: Z-Gyubaan!
description: Destroy the floor panel with the blast that defeated the enemy and rescue the captive girl! After destroying 75% of the panels, move on to the next stage.

title: Nightpark Journal
description: A dreamcore roguelike deck builder. Explore the mysterious Nightpark as three youths, each with distinct abilities. Build unique decks for each of them, defeat enemy adults and fiends, and uncover hidden secrets.

title: Deck of Harvest
description: Within a seasonal journey of harvest, plan limited fields, plant diverse seeds, reap bountiful crops, and amass wealth. Don't forget to manage your warehouse, select powerful treasures to build your deck, and become the ultimate farmer. Are you ready for this strategic challenge?

title: Back in the Swamp
description: An immersive first-person point-and-click exploration game set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland overrun by giant insects and abandoned robots. Embark on a journey to uncover hidden mysteries, guided solely by hand-drawn sketches—no text or dialogue.

title: The Escape to the Afterlife
description: The Escape to the Afterlife is a horror game where the protagonist, who has passed away, searches for a path to the afterlife.

title: XX Fulfillment Center
description: You've been hired as a Part-Time Contract Packaging Worker at the fulfillment center. Can you find your own happiness amid the speeding conveyor belts and ever-growing list of rules?

title: Lucky Coin Pusher
description: Lucky Coin Pusher is a coin pusher simulator focused on deck-building. Combine characters, coins (or bowling balls), stickers, items and other elements to build unique synergies and hit the jackpot.

title: AutoMaker
description: AutoMaker is an automotive business simulator. Start at the dawn of the automotive history, build your factory, research technologies and design cars as you progress through the ages to the current era and beyond.

title: Wiped Clean PC
description: Wiped Clean PC is a psychological horror game where you are an undercover agent tasked with cleaning crime scenes while secretly gathering evidence to expose a ruthless hitman.

title: Kindling Hour
description: A brief, atmospheric text adventure of flickering candlelight, forgotten memories, and a quiet search through the dark.

title: Robot Recycler Ryn
description: Build your own custom combat robots, piece by piece! Weld, saw, and shape metal to perfection. Lead your creations into battle as you follow Ryn in Story Mode, or craft freely in Construction Mode.

title: SpotCat vs. The Cheddar Mafia In Space
description:
SpotCat vs The Cheddar Mafia In Space is a thrilling "Find-the-Difference" game with a hidden object twist.

Cheese on Earth wasn’t enough... now The Cheddar Mafia is after the MOON! Can SpotCat foil their most ridiculous plan yet? Explore vibrant, hand-drawn scenes from distant galaxies, spot the subtle differences, and stay sharp—mafia rats can appear when you least expect it.

Your mission? Find all 25 mafia rats, solve every scene, and bring justice to the universe!

title: Aly The Alligator in Space Trouble
description:
Aly is an alligator with the ability to perform "Dashes" in the air, and loves to wander through the magical green forest.
But one day, he came across a flying saucer and ended up being abducted, taken to an inhospitable planet. Now he needs to find a way to return home.
Upon arriving on the alien planet, Aly finds a space laser gun and a helmet to protect himself from the hostile environment.
Now armed and protected, Aly is ready to face his adventure and the challenges that await him!
Help Aly the alligator overcome the traps and find his way out of the unknown planet before it’s too late.

title: DeckWrecking Pirates
description: A tactical roguelike deckbuilder where you roll dice, command your pirate crew, and even control your enemies. Build your deck… and wreck theirs!

title: Jarnathan's Cleaning Service
description: Jarnathan teaches you about cleaning and dealing with life's messes in this feel-good physics-based game. Life is overwhelming and messy sometimes. This is a little feel-good cleaning game where you herd your soapy bubbles to clean a grimy kitchen. Flap your wings to blow the bubbles around.

title: Saga & Seeker
description: From a consumer of stories to a creator of them. Saga & Seeker is a "storycrafting game" where you can generate endless tales with your favorite characters. The words you write become a part of the story itself in this immersive entertainment experience powered by your imagination.

title: The Streamer's Alt Account Labyrinth
description: A new collaboration by Acacia, the developers of Mahou Shoujo no Majo Saiban, and G-MODE. Explore dungeons and face a story of sickly sweetness, alt accounts, and a girl band with issues in The Streamer's Alt Account Labyrinth.

title: Avemary Rocket: Captain Patchwork
description: Join our brave captain on this action adventure in space! You'll be riding The Patchwork, a less than ideal spaceship, but enough to get away from pursuers. However, you'll be facing malfunctions, fires, enemies attacking... When it rains, it pours.

title: HoloVillage: Our Cozy Days
description: Farm, fish, mine, craft, and decorate your home in this cozy multiplayer life sim. Venture into dungeons and take on bosses outside the village for some added excitement. Share relaxing and thrilling moments alike with hololive talents as you shape your countryside life.

title: Keep Digging: Version 2.0
description: The update introduces completely new stages, a full overhaul of the game system—including crafting, refining, and enchanting tools —as well as new costumes, trophies, and other additional content.

title: Soup Rooms
description: A SOUP-like room tourism experience directly inspired by SOUP, an obscure Japanese minimalist art-game from 2007 where you walk around a series of small abstract rooms and generally soak in the atmosphere. Think of it as a sort of digital art gallery.

title: Wabisabi SushiDerby
description: Adorable sushi race at full speed in a training × racing game! Become a sushi chef, craft unique toppings, and enter your trained sushi into races. Don't forget to cheer on your sushi during the race. Win the prestigious S1 Cup championship, and become a top-tier sushi chef!

title: 1999 Tokoyo Building
description: 1999. The protagonist, a boy named Akira, finds himself lost in the TOKOYO Building—an indoor amusement park filled with secrets and eerie rumors. There, he begins living and working alongside its peculiar staff, but... Did you know? People disappear in the TOKOYO Building.

title: Hydrofoil Surfing
description: THPS style wingfoil surfing game with intuitive controls and realistic ocean physics. Pump to generate speed, ride waves and boost airs, land spins, flips, grabs, while maintaining speed or you will sink. Unlocking all locations & boards requires exploration and strategy to complete all 54 goals and achievements throughout 6 unique levels.

title: Hovercrafts x Nihilism
description: A 3D open-world vehicular boss-hunting game set in the ruins of a dead civilization. Inspired by Shadow of the Colossus, explore dusty low-poly landscapes and engage colossal foes in high-speed, cinematic combat.

title: Core Keeper: Void & Voltage
description: Awaken as an explorer in a long-forgotten cavern teeming with treasures and secrets. Harvest relics and resources, craft advanced tools, build your base, and explore over 10 unique biomes in a dynamically evolving world just waiting to be unearthed. Cultivate crops, fish in mysterious waters, master recipes, hatch pets, raise cattle, drive vehicles, fight enemies, level up your skills, automate your bases, and defeat legendary Titans to unveil the power of the Core.

title: S0lavita
description: s0lavita is an RPG Maker surreal horror game, focused on a philosophical theory explained by the view of a slightly mentally deranged woman.

title: Horos: Web of Shadows
description: Embark on an epic adventure game fused with a visual novel and a dash of RPG elements. Immerse yourself in a captivating storyline featuring intriguing characters, engaging gameplay, and unique erotic encounters that will leave you breathless.

title: Half-Life Arena
description: Welcome to Half-Life Arena, a mod that revamps Deathmatch of the original game into a small-scale, high intensity madness with new maps, weapons, bot support and quality of life features inspired by the Head-to-Head mode of the PS2 version of Valve's timeless classic.

title: Blast Racer
description: "BLAST RACER" is an arcade-style bullet hell game. You’re humanity’s last hope. Drive an upgradable, transformable battle race car. Blaze through deadly tracks, dodge waves of bullets, and save the world in flames!

title: Psyvariar 3
description: Play as one of 7 pilots in this thrilling sequel to a SHMUP classic. The time has come for a new generation of Psyvariars to rise… and save humanity.

title: Cross Quest
description: A retro-styled, turn-based RPG that takes place at a lone nation recognized as the 'Summer Island'. The young half-human-half-dragon, Steve Cross is chosen by the Summer King to slay an ancient, evil beast known as the 'Chandelier Serpent'.

title: FunnyPizzaLand: Unplugged
description:
Originally planned as part of FunnyPizzaLand in 2001, this brand new content was recently realised after 24 years for the first time. Dive in again with Pedro in the middle of nowhere and explore together with him some of the most mysterious angles of PIZZALAND!

With this side story you will get with more strange creatures and beauties a compass for the world, exactly like it was intended to be back in the days! Are you ready to meet and old avversario again?
first DLC for a 2001 game!
surreal, hand crafted art world with dark atmosphere
full HD (1920 X 1080)
with possible Happy End ;)

title: Libra: There Are Two
description: Story-driven RPG where you explore and upgrade a mysterious world, to escape.

title: Wrath of Mynah
description: Wrath of Mynah is a turn-based RPG adventure game that follows the gripping story of The Great Hanyem War. Hundreds of years after Mynah Smith arrived on Hanyem, you play as Pike Gilder, a petty thief who wants to make a difference in the everlasting fight against the tyrannical Indigallo Federation as they lose their grip over their territories. Join forces with a plethora of unique party members, such as Tusk, Liz Fureon, Deven Proditor, Rosie, Nova Acri, and Val Fortis! Collect items, armor and weapons! Uncover the deep history and lore of Hanyem and the human, felibrawno, and gisharen people. Eventually you will be prepared for the ultimate battle against the mysterious General Zed Aurum and King Mynah Smith IX!

title: How I Flex With AI
description: Guys, who gets it?! This is basically a mashup of The AI Show-Off Counterattack Guide for Socially Anxious Otakus and a Goofy Campus Sweet Romance Drama — I laughed so hard my abs cramped up!

title: Knights College 2
description: KnightsCollege 2 is a kemono visual novel set in the Knight College, where elite knight candidates live. In this game, every choice is presented as a card, and the protagonist lives in the dormitory while collecting cards.

title: NEH
description: noEndHOUSE is a cooperative horror game where players explore dark, monster-filled environments, solve deadly puzzles, and face moral choices. Trust your team — unless one of them is infected.

title: Chicky Blocks
description: A fresh twist on block puzzle games. Quick rounds, smart moves, instant fun! This is not your grandma tetris!

title: Legends of Hiro
description: Defend the code in this action-adventure open world immersive sim taking place in the dystopian city of Crocosmia. Switch characters mid fight for the ultimate advantage, defeat bosses to gain new weapons and attack combos, and explore the city to uncover the deep lore of the War for Evolution.

title: Mana Battle
description: Build your ultimate hero guild, master positioning, triggers, and try to get a Gold Victory in this turn-based strategy game. Choose a powerful core crystal, unlock devastating synergies, and climb to the top with each match. Every decision matters!

title: Manekin: The Lost Island
description: Single-player action-adventure. As an agent of the Manekin Order, land on a fog-shrouded island veiled by an electromagnetic storm; wield modern weapons to track the missing agent and uncover the island's dark story.

title: Bonk the Boykisser
description: Survive endless waves of Boykissers! Fend off the Boykissers, gain XP, and choose upgrades to survive as long as possible!

title: Path of Exile 2: Fate of the Vaal
Gears Of Glory
description:
Gears of Glory is a movement-based Tower Defense where you drive a van across the map to collect Gears, build powerful towers, and stop the robots from destroying your bases.

Developed for PC, Gears of Glory combines classic Tower Defense strategy with a unique twist: driving a stylish van through the chaos of a post-apocalyptic world.

Featuring a top-down pixel art look and fast-paced gameplay, the player takes on the role of a resistance pilot tasked with protecting the last human bases from hordes of robots that have taken over the planet and isolated humanity. To succeed, you’ll need skill behind the wheel, dodging obstacles or running enemies over. All while building towers with strategic synergies capable of turning the tide of battle.

Speed, strategy and survival collide in this game where every turn can mean the difference between extinction and the salvation of humanity.

The game’s inspiration comes from the desire to complement the Tower Defense genre and eliminate those idle moments where players would simply speed up the game after placing towers and wait. In Gears of Glory you are in constant motion driving the van to upgrade towers, collect Gears, and run enemies over.

The gameplay and art are influenced by titles such as Gemcraft, Kingdom Rush, Thronefall, Rock and Roll Racing, Biker Mice from Mars, GTA2.

title: Incidente em Varginha Remastered
description: First-person action adventure inspired by the Varginha incident. Explore real-world locations, manage resources, use stealth when needed, and recover an alien spacecraft seized by military forces.

title: Vermination
description: Vermination is a story about a man who wakes up in a mansion in old England 1902. He can't remember anything that has happened to him. He soon knows there is a horrific secret buried. Explore the mansion and village to find the answer to your questions. Find out what is going on and where you are in this mystery horror game.

title: A Turd in The Dark
description: You're playing as a cute small turd who has been flushed down the drain into the dark and cold sewers below. And what do turds need to survive? That's right, toilet paper! Collect as much toilet paper as you can, but avoid the mean water and rat!

title: Deadly Steps 4: The Showdown
description: You're playing a special agent called Jack. You're fighting the E.C.S. (Evil Clone Society) who are trying to take over the planet by cloning the best fighters. But if clones weren't bad enough, Jack soon discovers a much deeper secret.

title: Jack Cain: The Demon Killing Dude
description: Meet Jack Cain, a demon killing dude. You may wonder what his profession might be. Well, he is a demon killer.The Devil made a mistake. He brought the apocalypse by summoning a legion of demons. But even he has regrets. Although he is an evil monster, he does love craft beer, which is about to become extinct by his demon army. Only the infamous Jack Cain can stop them now. Assisted by his pistols Gabriel and Chris, he must perish every demon on the planet.

title: Glonk
