description: A short incremental game about feeding Glonk! Make Glonk bigger, get more money, and explore the skill tree to upgrade your abilities, and get more Glonks!

title: Escape 9 to 5
description: A hardcore climbing parkour game that challenges you to break free from the monotony of office life. Start in the office cubicles and ascend toward the limitless skies above. As you climb higher the final heights will test not just your skill, but your patience too.

title: The Forgotten Past
description: While investigating a forgotten factory, you uncover dark secrets, haunted machines, and a past that was never meant to be found. Strange visions, buried truths… and something watching from the shadows. Be careful, this place isn't abandoned.

title: Wiz Quest: Crystal Power
description: Wiz Quest: Crystal Power is a retro-style action survival game where you control a young wizard facing relentless waves of monsters. Defeat enemies, collect magic crystals, and unlock new powers to enhance your attacks. Each run is a new challenge — test your reflexes, master your magic, and see how long you can survive!

title: Spot The Pup
description: Get ready to put your eyes to the test and your heart on full display in Spot The Pup, the ultimate hidden object adventure for dog lovers! Each scene bursts with charm, color, and chaos as you hunt for ten mischievous pups tucked into unexpected places. Whether you’re racing the clock in Challenge Mode or taking a relaxed stroll through Casual Mode, every level promises a delightful mix of discovery, relaxation, and pure puppy joy. Gamers will care because Spot The Pup isn’t just about finding dogs, it’s about finding moments of happiness. With its cozy visuals, easy to learn mechanics, and addictive “just one more level” feeling, it’s the perfect escape for anyone who loves puzzles, pets, or simply a feel good gaming experience.

title: Emerald Huntress
description:
Precision. Speed. Survival.

Dive into a deadly forest in this fast-paced action platformer. Battle fierce enemies, dodge traps, and uncover hidden emeralds across 10 challenging stages. Master melee, ranged, and aerial attacks to survive escalating threats and unlock powerful upgrades. Only the sharpest reflexes will reveal every secret.

title: Fortnite: Chapter 7 - Season 1: Pacific Break
description: Surf into a new sun-soaked island, brand-new ways to play, and a star-studded Battle Pass in Chapter Seven: Pacific Break! This season kicks off a new era for Fortnite Battle Royale’s story, where the greatest stories are told — and the cameras are always rolling.

title: Tiny Archer
description: Embark on an epic adventure in Tiny Archer, a breathtaking 2D platformer set in a dangerous, slime-infested dungeon! As a nimble archer, fight through 20 treacherous levels filled with cunning slimes, each requiring clever tactics to defeat. Master wall-jumping to navigate deadly traps, collect crystals, and grab powerful quivers that unleash triple-shot barrages of devastating power. With precise controls and diverse enemies, Tiny Archer offers thrilling combat and exploration.

title: Poko's Artic Quest
description:
Join Poko on a frosty and challenging adventure!

Winter is coming, and the little penguin Poko needs to gather enough fish to survive the cold! Use your logic and planning to push blocks, open paths, and collect all the fish across 30 carefully designed levels inspired by classic puzzle games.

Travel through two charming environments the icy Iceberg and the snowy Forest each bringing new challenges that will test your reasoning and warm your heart.

title: Bear Squire Honey Journey
description: The Bear Squire dreams of becoming a knight! Wielding your hammer, jump and smash across 10 colorful levels full of tricky trials! Can you collect every honeycomb piece?

title: For Humanity
description: For Humanity is a cooperative extraction FPS. Explore a post-apocalyptic world invaded by zombies alone or up to 4 players. Raid and escape to your camp, craft and upgrade your equipment in order to help other survivors discover the origin of the pandemic.

title: Trigwa
description: Statue pushing game with a narrative. Each puzzle tells part of a larger story.

title: Super Thanksgiving
description: A family's Thanksgiving gathering goes horribly wrong...

title: Nightmarish Paranoia
description: Find out how to get out of torment.

title: La Bola Negra
description:
On a ordinary night, Carlos receives an unexpected letter inviting him to the mysterious and exclusive Casino of Granada to acquire the coveted status of member.

Rumor has it that whoever becomes a member of the Casino will have access to unprecedented riches, incredible parties, and a privileged social position.

The four pages of Federico García Lorca's unfinished novel "La bola negra" inspire this visual thriller in which the player embodies the character of Carlos, a young man in 1930s Spain who must make crucial decisions and uncover the secrets hidden within the Casino.
Meet the eccentric characters who will accompany you on a tense night, unravel their tragic personal histories, and discover the different endings that your choices determine.

They are all hiding something… Will you be able to claim victory, or will you die trying?

title: Space Drone
description: Space drone is a open world puzzle game with grid movement where you remotely control a drone to find and rescue your lost mates in space. Each move costs energy, so be careful not to go offline!

title: Carrot Crusade: Mimika's Reckoning
description: In a world where nature’s magic is fading, Mimika—a fierce half-human, half-rabbit warrior—embarks on a legendary journey to recover the lost 7 Rainbow Carrots, mystical relics said to hold the power to restore life and balance to her dying homeland. Armed with her trusty Carrot Blade and enchanted Carrot Arrows, Mimika must leap, slash, and shoot her way through treacherous lands teeming with corrupted beasts, ancient traps, and dark guardians. The reckoning has begun—and only she can dig up the truth beneath the soil.

title: Subject 33
description: SUBJECT 33 is a story-driven psychological horror game set in an abandoned asylum. You are Ephraim, sent on a mission to uncover what happened before its sudden closure in 1984. As you explore, the line between reality and memory begins to blur — and the truth you uncover might destroy you.

title: Tippy's Quest
description: A top-down action RPG where players battle monsters, collect loot, and grow stronger through varying forms of progression in both solo and multiplayer adventures.

title: Cubey: Hexfall
description: Jump. Smash. Escape. In Cubey: Hexfall, every move counts. Smash through hexagonal blocks beneath your feet, collect every last shimmering coin, and unlock the mysterious gate to freedom. Think fast and move faster—each level is a puzzle of precision and timing. But be careful: leave something behind, and you may not get another chance. Can you clear the path and make your escape?

title: Oakbound Quest
description: Embark on a mystical journey through an ancient forest in this thrilling 2D platformer. Play as a fearless warrior on a sacred mission to recover the lost oaks and restore life to your village.

title: SpotCat vs. The Cheddar Mafia In Asia
description:
SpotCat vs The Cheddar Mafia In Asia is a thrilling "Find-the-Difference" game with a hidden object twist.

The notorious Cheddar Mafia is spreading chaos across Asia, and only SpotCat can stop them. Explore vibrant, hand-drawn scenes from different countries, spot the subtle differences, and stay sharp—mafia rats can appear when you least expect it.

Your mission? Find all 25 mafia rats, solve every scene, and bring justice to the continent!

title: Run, Elric!
description: Run, Elric! is a 2D pixel-art platformer set in a mysterious forest filled with danger. You play as Elric, a quick-witted courier whose wagon was ambushed, scattering his coins. Unarmed, he must dash, jump, and outsmart monsters while avoiding traps and reclaiming his treasure. From eerie clearings to caverns with slimes, skeletons, and zombies, each step is a challenge. With tight controls and retro spirit, can Elric survive and recover his fortune?

title: Glad Tidings
description:
You are Ulder Ravengard. Your son is completely besotted with his fiancé, but you can’t figure out the appeal.
Surely the only solution is to declare an insane secret war on him before he can ruin the Midwinter's eve ball.

title: Engine Driver: Drive a Steam Train
Your Takeout
description: Due to financial difficulties, you’ve taken a part-time job delivering takeout. Some orders seem unusual. Stay alert, distinguish between what’s normal and what’s not, and deliver the orders on time — or just escape.

title: Winds of Valen
description: Winds of Valen is a free-to-play MMORPG that embraces traditional progression mechanics in a fantasy open world. Players develop their characters through skill-based advancement in areas like combat, mining, and smithing, while exploring a seamless environment filled with rare loot and resource gathering opportunities. The game focuses on earned achievements rather than microtransactions, following the design philosophy of classic MMORPGs.

title: Monster Ops 8
description: NSFW Gay Visual Novel Dating Sim! Black Ops soldiers Wraith and Tide know they must count on each other to survive. Will their bond as battle-brothers evolve into something more? Monster Ops: Military Special Forces Hunting Rogue Monsters!

title: Ikeelya
description: You play Barry, a disillusioned hitman who has grown tired of his day job, and dreams of becoming an interior decorator.

title: Sex and Morning
description: This is a novel game with no choices. Click to continue story. All characters in this story are over 18.

title: Ultimate JOI
description: An extremely customizable J O I game that displays provided images and videos in combination with custom instructions! Set it up to do whatever you want, even 'Do a handstand when an image of a blonde appears' if you want. The only limit is your imagination!

title: NTR
description: Enter the world of Block Blast, where you have to use your brain with every step, and you can also watch the magic cube explode, which is super rewarding!

title: One Pump Chump
description: One Pump Chump is a lewd parody Visual Novel with RPG elements, set in a world of powerful heroines, horny monster girls, and hero rankings. Train, flirt, survive... and try not to blow it too early.​

title: Monster Ops 10
description: NSFW Gay Visual Novel Dating Sim! Black Ops soldiers Wraith and Tide know they must count on each other to survive. Will their bond as battle-brothers evolve into something more? Monster Ops: Military Special Forces Hunting Rogue Monsters!

title: Quiet Dan
description: His name is Dan. He is an ordinary guy who works as a floor washer. However, soon in his life there are events that forever change his fate and push him on the path of crime... A chilling thriller in visual novel format.

title: Hentai Ariya
description: Hentai Ariya is a hot hentai puzzle game that invites you into the world of the unstoppable knight Ariya!

title: MindEscape
description: Step into immersive 3D escape rooms and reveal your true self. MindEscape uses cutting-edge AI and scientifically-backed gameplay to assess your personality, problem-solving style, and behavioral patterns—all while having fun

title: Skinwalkers Valley
description: In Skinwalkers Valley, a routine hunting expedition with Ethan and his dog Ranger transforms into a survival horror experience when supernatural forces emerge from the forest depths. The game follows their journey as they encounter unexplained phenomena in the woods, shifting from a standard hunting trip to a fight for survival against mysterious entities drawn from Native American folklore.

title: The Banker Tycoon
description: Start a management experience where you grow your own bank step by step. Handle customer operations yourself, control risk and fees, unlock new systems through a wide research tree, upgrade your bank and rise from a small branch to a respected financial center.

title: Space Is Red
description: Space is Red is an alt-history sci-fi horror visual novel set aboard a Soviet starship in an alternate future. The game features multiple endings, detective elements, mysterious deaths, and, of course, an alien presence.

title: Samurai Stratagem
description: Samurai Stratagem is a fast-paced, twitch-reflex action game where every input is a strike, every mistake a wound. Face five deadly samurai in one-on-one battles, each more brutal than the last. React to directional prompts, dodge feints, master holds and double taps, and unleash flawless combos.

title: Bouncy Butt Castle
description: Its all about Butts and Bouncy Castles. Launch in with your friends or foes. Collect star power-ups and squash your opponents with your rear! Make yourself stand out against the competition in style!

title: SeaQuest Dungeon
description: SeaQuest Dungeon is a fast-paced, twin-stick shooter roguelite. With limited resources, choose different props to create powerful combinations to challenge higher difficulties and unlock new skills and weapons.

title: Steel Skirmish: Reloaded
description: Experience the thrill of rapid-action combat in Steel Skirmish: Reloaded. Fight in exhilarating 10-on-10 PvP matches either alone or against others as each player fights for battlefield dominance. A variety of vehicles and maps await - join the action in this exciting vehicle shooter!

title: Blind Box
description: Collect blind boxes and unbox them to get cute figurines! Display them in your home and passively earn fame to unlock new decorations! Show off your collection to your friends and unwind!

title: Infernal Eclipse of Ragnarok
description:
Infernal Eclipse of Ragnarok is an ultra-modded Infernum Mode addon which currently includes major support for these content mods included in the associated mod pack:

Calamity Mod & many of its addons
Thorium Mod
Secrets of the Shadows
Consolaria

title: Clappy Cheeks: Lust and Magic
description: Clappy Cheeks: Lust and Magic is an erotic game where you jump to fly and xxx. You will hear the clap clap voices of them cheeks as you play. Let's fly deep into myserious castle of vampire queen!

title: Three Foreign Sisters!!
description:
This visual novel follows Kiro Nishikawa, whose quiet daily life is suddenly disrupted when three young women from different countries unexpectedly move into his home. Claiming to be his half-sisters, the trio quickly turns his routine into a lively and chaotic household filled with misunderstandings, comedy, and personal interactions.

The game focuses on character-driven storytelling and slice-of-life scenarios, featuring multiple endings and full voice acting throughout the story.

title: Eclipse: Fall - Kami no Danzai
description:
This visual novel follows Haruto Wanigura, a God Assistant who travels across parallel worlds to correct distorted destinies.

The first part of a two-part reboot of "Hello, Kami-sama Worker".

title: Hello, Kami-sama Worker
description: This visual novel follows a self-serving man driven by alcohol, gambling, and money who unexpectedly sets out on a journey to save another world. The story combines comedy, drama, and emotional moments through a fast-paced fantasy adventure. The game focuses on narrative-driven progression and character interactions within an isekai setting.

title: Campground Simulator
description: Build, manage, and grow your very own campground store! Stock shelves, serve campers, and expand your site as you transform a quiet forest outpost into a thriving outdoor destination. Run the ultimate campground supply shop and keep campers happy as they explore the great outdoors.

title: Project P.I.T.T.
description: Feed rubber ducks to a corporate void. Build physics contraptions. Chain combos for profit as the Maw grows hungrier... and larger. Brutalist PSX satire meets first-person sandbox chaos.

title: Residual Christmas
description: A Christmas game about Mortimer J. Maggot and his search for wisdom as to what Residual Christmas really means. Risen from the HTML grave of the 2000s.

title: Geckos & Deckos
description: There are four lizards at this table, but only one pirate can leave victorious. Play your cards strategically and blow up your rivals. Don't forget to sling your tail at your friends' heads (because it's funny). Can you manage to take the helm?

title: Sugoroku New Year's Party
description: Try your luck and test your wits in this adventure of fortune! Good luck abounds in Sugoroku New Year's Party!

title: The Rusted
description: The world belongs to machines now. Join a loyal robot dog on a journey through a haunting post-apocalyptic world in search of its lost human family. The Rusted is a hand-drawn 2D action-puzzle platformer.

title: Bouncemasters: Aiming Assist
description: Unlock a visual aiming aid - the Aiming Assist, a small comfort feature for players who want extra precision while launching Pengu!

title: The Eternal Mines
description: Upgrade your minions as you journey deeper into the mines. Discover new areas with unique effects. Upgrade and equip masks to change the behaviors of the your miners

title: Find Kittens 8: Happy New Year

description: Get him to the company. A huge, dark, and powerful conspiracy will engulf you. It's like a solo player race where you spray fire extinguishers to reach the goal from the starting position.

title: End of Eden
description: End of Eden is an open world RPG where you arrive unwanted on a cursed island and must earn every inch. Master tight melee, archery and magic. Join a faction, grow deep talents, craft gear, and explore a living world with real routines, tough bosses and meaningful quests.

title: Merry Crisis
description: Three loves. One week. Zero chill. Merry Crisis is an intimate, character-driven romance visual novel about love, loss, and belonging—is home what you left behind, or where you’re headed?

title: Soul Descent: Invade of Ether
description: Command the Time Authority and rewrite destiny in Soul Descent! You must recruit and lead a team of beautiful spirit-vessel maidens, while uncovering forbidden truths, and fighting in dazzling 3D battles. Your decisions stir old wars, ignite romance, and shape the world’s future.

title: Hivefront TD
description: Collect your insect army and defend the hive as either Ants or Bees in this awesome tower defense adventure, brought to life with a hand-drawn art style!

title: Aircrafter
description: Become a master plane designer and soar through the skies with your genius aircraft. The levels are relaxing, beautiful and challenging. Some levels will test your piloting skills while others your engineering. Learn to optimize aerodynamics as you play and unlock new parts and perks as you progress

title: Project Raze: Fall of Terra
description: Project RAZE is a fast-paced sci-fi FPS where you play as humanity’s greatest creation, RZ-01 (RAZE) Feel every shot and every impact as you obliterate anyone bold enough to threaten the human homeworld, Terra Supremis.

title: Mining Wizards
description: Mining Wizards is an incremental mining game. Mine minerals, gather materials, upgrade a massive skill tree, level up, unlock talents, discover artifacts, and attract artifact visitors!

title: Maelslime
description: Maelslime is an actiony, arcadey, rouge likey, twin stick shooter sort of dealio. Squelch a bunch of slimes, survive a couple storms, and maybe enjoy some bonus game modes I threw in as a treat.

title: Incinera: Pandemonium
description: This is a romance game that combines narrative puzzles with visual novels. Five love stories, five eras, a journey of soul. In endless reincarnation, you will witness the transformation of the world as the god of marriage, and when the story reaches its end, you will be forced to be part of it...

title: Which hand?
description: Solve the titan’s riddle, uncovering more hidden rules and connections each time you try

title: Ser Jorryn
description: Ser Jorryn is a retro platformer inspired by the classic arcade games of my childhood, updated with modern responsive controls. A love letter to a time when forced simplicity and pure gameplay came together to create hours of pure magic.

title: Within His View
description: An observation horror where cameras keep you alive—until they kill you. Hunt anomalies, guard your sanity, and survive a night with the Wendigo stalking behind you.

title: SALT: Super Awesome Laser Tag
description: Fast-paced single player and online laser tag arena where you parkour and battle with bots or other players across different maps in Elimination, Domination, and Capture the Flag game-modes.

title: Dream Wave'84
description: Leap, Collect, and Conquer in a Sci-Fi Rock Adventure! DreamWave'84 is a short and sweet 3D platforming adventure where exploration takes center stage. Players jump, run, and punch their way through visually distinct levels filled with strategically placed collectibles and exciting challenges.

title: Bit Buddy
description: Bit Buddy reacts in real-time to your keyboard and mouse activity. Every click and movement brings an adorable response from your little companion. Even better, each interaction gives you a chance to unlock new decorations, with no extra effort required!

title: Shiro Enkai
description: Shiro Enkai is a high-intensity top-down action experience where you become Mr. Katanas — a cyberpunk-era dark samurai. His world blends ancient Japanese aesthetics with the neon glow of the future. Face five distinct monster types, each demanding a unique combat approach.

title: Infinite Veil
description: Infinite Veil is an atmospheric forest survival experience focused on realism and immersion. Explore the wilderness, collect materials, and construct your shelter to shield yourself from wind and rain. The dynamic cycle of day, night, and weather brings the world to life.

title: Orbifall
description: ORBIFALL is an immersive third-person view fighting game. You take on the role of a cybernetic girl trapped on an abandoned space station filled with creatures. They don't get stronger — their numbers increase, and each new wave turns the station into a deadly maze.

title: Emberhold
description: Emberhold is an atmospheric survival game with building mechanics set in a massive cave once used for excavations. Now, it stands as a realm of stone, darkness, and a solitary survivor. It combines exploration, crafting, and construction that immerse players in the mood of underground survival.

title: Leviaclaw
description: Leviaclaw is a dark 3D action fighter where you step into the boots of a legendary pirate battling monsters from the ocean's depths. A cliffside town becomes a merciless battleground as waves of foes grow deadlier, testing your precision, reflexes, and skillful use of abilities.

title: Speed Liner
description: Speed Liner is an arcade Formula-inspired racer made for those who love pure speed and excitement. No need for simulation skills — the controls are smooth, responsive, and every track encourages fun experimentation with each turn. Choose from three distinct cars and race across three circuits.

title: Zenith Trace
description: Zenith Trace is a dark and intense offroad racing game set on an infernal island where the elements have gone wild. Ash-filled air, molten lakes, scorched terrain, and punishing trails become your battleground.

title: Dungeon Peplum
description: Dungeon Peplum is a grim horror FPS where each step through the catacombs might be your last. Your single objective: survive and find your way out. Over eight types of weapons — from a trusty double-barreled shotgun to fast pistols and grenades — will help you cut through the darkness

title: Eggrolls Shoot
description: Eggrolls Shoot is a retro inspired arcade shoot ‘em up game. Our game is all about the adventure of saving the animal world.

title: The Gas Station: Graveyard Shift
description: Congratulations, You've been hired as the new nightshift employee at silver lake gas station. Can you survive the night?

title: Samurai's Path
description: Idle gacha collection game set in a dojo. Train through skill-based minigames, collect and fuse hundreds of unique blades tradeable on the market. Follow your own path and become a Samurai.

title: Bruce Quest: The Secrets of the Outback
My Neighbor's Lonely Wife 2
description: After moving to a new house, you quickly meet the beautiful young wife next door, Haruka Aoi. Chat with her, befriend her, and make her lonely heart slowly succumb to your charms.

title: Crossover Collab
description: A collaborative mod project for Celeste, with every map based on a different video game.

title: Shop Mistress NTR
description: Shop Mistress NTR is a casual adult simulation game where players develop a relationship with a shopkeeper to unlock various intimate scenes — ultimately helping her fulfill a long-held desire.

title: Stargate Bullet
description: Level game combined with shooting and adventure in horizontal version. This game contains nearly 200 levels of common challenges with different degrees of difficulty and styles, and it will also randomly touch off the copy of challenges according to different conditions. In this game, the player will play the role of one guard of the earth empire, and through his (or her) own efforts, he (or she) can summon dozens of heroes fighting for the earth. During the challenge task, the players can collect a variety of training materials to strengthen their heroes in different ways, and then get ready to beat the knotty BOSS.

title: 3 Days to Live
description:
Looking for an escape?

Swift is just your average gay cartoon animal that's trying his best to get some time away from the drudgery and repression of the real world. Join him as he ventures into a queer space and takes a swing at love, in what might be the first visual novel to be written about an actual furry convention.

"3 Days to Live" is a short furry kinetic novel with about 15k words and no branching story routes. It is written to be conclusive, so there will be no additional chapters.

title: Witchy Woo
description: This short fantasy adventure game follows Woo, an inexperienced witch-in-training who sets out to find a familiar after being forbidden from having one due to her poor magical skills. The story blends lighthearted comedy with point-and-click puzzle solving as players help Woo navigate the witching world and overcome her shortcomings.

title: Coin Collection Challenge
description: Coin Collecting Challenge is a level-breaking platforming game. Players need to make full use of their jumping ability in different levels, and open the gate to pass the level by collecting enough gold coins. Brave the platform-jumping levels, collect all the coins, and open all the gates.

title: Blade & Sword 2: Ancient Legend
description: This game is an action-adventure RPG game that unfolds around an ancient Chinese mythology. 40 years after the defeat of the Emperor Jo, Chiyou's spirit, which had been suppressed for 3000 years was once causing trouble again.

title: Epic Transport
description: A casual transport sim where you play as 1 of 4 transport heroes and progress through different vehicle types.

title: Studio Scream: Verse One
description: You play as a talented rapper on a mission to record his best song while being tormented by an entity that haunts the abandoned studio that your friend Keith bought. Will you be able to face the darkness and free the studio from its cursed grip, or will the entity silence your voice forever?

title: Pool Friday
description: Play as an unnamed character as they go through their first day of work after graduating. Explore colorful worlds, walk through many hospitable and inhospitable territories and try to control other people's lives so that they have the best possible outcome. This is Pool Friday.

title: VROVPilot: Titanic
description: Experience the bow of the Titanic wreck as captured by Magellan at the bottom of the North Atlantic Ocean. Immerse yourself as an ROV pilot to explore the wreck and complete missions to scan key features of this sleeping spectacle.

title: Fxxkable Kim
description: In this 2D fighter you must rescue humanity from a cruel, merciless, bloodthirsty dictator aspiring to world hegemony.

title: Aphantasia
description: Aphantasia is a choice-driven adventure game following Roudert, the Son of Drop, as he ventures across the island of Mollagit to rescue his friend known as The Mouse. Players journey alongside three companions - Largo, Mustaeyed, and Caleidoface - making decisions that shape the narrative outcome while encountering various inhabitants of this peculiar world marked by unconventional characters and dark humor.

title: Deep Strike
description: You’re operating a drill machine beneath an abandoned chemical lab. You’ll feel the ground tremble, hear faint whispers in the dark, and glimpse shadows just beyond your lights. Stay focused—ignore what you see and hear—and keep drilling until your tasks are done.

title: Kid Icarus: Infinite Underworld
description: Kid Icarus: Infinite Underworld is an infinitely generating, arcade style, 2D platformer based on Nintendo's Kid Icarus.

title: Everhome
description: Become a sky architect in this relaxing, cozy, building and management sim. Meet charming characters and design unique houses just for them! Go shopping for new decorations, renovate their homes and discover the keys to their hearts.

title: Tom Clancy's The Division 2: The Pact
description:
This season sets the stage for a new power struggle. Factions are no longer content to hold ground, they're pressing harder, forcing you to fight for every block and every zone. That tension fuels Retaliation, a new open world activity that expands Control Point mechanics and opens new ways to earn Exotic loot.

Driving the focus on territory is Divide and Conquer, the global modifier that makes zone control a defining force throughout the season.

Together, these systems set the tone for the battles to come. Now let's dive into The Pact.

CONTENTS
Retaliation
Modifiers
Gear, Weapons and Talents
Master Climax Mission
Fixes and Improvements
Season Pass
One Time Offer

title: Dark Craft
description: Dark Craft is the first MMORPG in the Souls-like genre! Explore an open world filled with ruined castles, forgotten temples, and enemies waiting for their prey. Play solo or with friends, hunt bosses, join guilds, fight other players, and prove your right to reign supreme.

title: Monolith: Rogue TD
description: You are the Monolith - an unbreakable force crashing from the sky, spreading corruption across countless worlds in this roguelike tower defense game with deckbuilding mechanics. Defend your core against those who resist and meet each world’s unique challenges.

title: Canvas City
description: Canvas City is a turn-based tactics RPG of rebellion on rollerblades. Lead a crew of skaters and street artists rising up against an oppressive regime. Each map is a battleground and a canvas, where your actions shift control, leave your mark, and shape the city’s future.

title: Farnia Village
description:
“A game shaped by a fantasy world you’d love to live in…”

You remember nothing but your own name, and begin a new life in a peaceful village. Till the soil, go fishing, cook, forge, fall in love, care for your pets, explore the world, and teach a mysterious girl what it means to "enjoy" a meal.

Ever wish the world kept going after the story ends, so you could live your daily life there? No worries, this is a game where you can continue your days in the world you’ve completed!

title: Barty's Adventure
description: Discover the world of Barty's Adventure: a cozy, time-loop metroidvania set in the world of children's toys. Make new friends, explore unique biomes, and master the three-day cycle to stop the Colic from returning once and for all!

title: Zerowake Gates
description: Enter a battlefield where madness and desire collide. Pair Espers and Guides for powerful synergy, and join Han Gaon as he uncovers the meteor’s secret and fights to survive a world under alien invasion.

title: Cozy Littlequarium
description: Cozy Littlequarium is a relaxing aquarium simulator that sits at the bottom of your screen! Take care, breed them, collect and decorate!

title: Paper Castle
description: Paper Castle is a minimalist strategy game where you build, paint, and defend your kingdom of paper. Harness the power of water to protect it from relentless flames and enemy hordes. Will your Paper Castle survive the next wave?

title: Loutra
description: A loitering simulator and dreamcore powerhouse, Loutra opens its inaugural group show. Thirteen artists display their work within a world of crude, deteriorating pixels.

title: Pizza Agent
description: Pizza Agent is a co-op simulator combining pizza shop management with undercover alien investigation. Craft delicious pizzas, manage your stock, keep customers happy. And secretly scan customers to catch shape-shifting aliens. Cook, serve and scan !

title: Underdrown
description:
1928, Estonia, Arumere, near Pärnu.

A small, northern village, on the shore of the Baltic Sea. A small rural school, overlooking the beach. The main character, instead of studying, prefers to look at the northern sea.

But one day, he saw something strange... Something that should not be there...

title: Pixplorer
description: Pixplorer is a top-down sandbox action-RPG. Explore biomes, conquer dungeons, craft, build, fight, mine, farm, catch fish and insects! Enjoy the game's atmosphere and complete freedom to shape your own adventure.

title: Djoof's UCN 2
description: A fangame of Ultimate Custom Night, aiming to have the biggest roster out there. Featuring whatever characters Djoof decides to add, along with customizable options, an endless mode, and cosmetic skins.

title: Fallosophy
description: Use just two buttons to climb a colossal pinball table spanning the history of western philosophy. Fallosophy is a minimalist game that turns pinball into a quiet struggle against gravity. No score. No tilts. No savers. Falling down means climbing back up again. Why climb? What does it all mean?

title: A Night with Laverne
description: A visual novel made by Sssonic2 and Acgats. On a rainy night when a flat tire impedes the protagonist's trip home, he seeks shelter at a church and encounters Laverne, whose intentions are unexpectedly sinful for a nun.

title: Umbra Survivors
description:
Umbra Survivors is a roguelite action survival game set in a dark fantasy world. Players fight through multiple progressively challenging stages while facing ever-growing waves of enemies.

The game combines fast-paced combat with random upgrades, card-based level-ups and dynamic scaling. Players collect weapons, passive enhancements and rare artifacts as they advance through different environments.

Each run offers new enemy compositions and risk–reward scenarios. Progression is driven by random weapon and stat rolls, supported by a variety of starting weapons and passive abilities.

Umbra Survivors draws inspiration from classic bullet-hell and roguelite mechanics, focusing on clarity, stage variety and long-term survival gameplay.

title: Barp Online
description:
BARP Online is a retro fantasy RPG built on classic web-based MUD and early-MMO roots, revived and expanded for modern players. Featuring fast turn-based combat, skill progression, crafting, guilds, and a massive world to explore, BARP blends nostalgia with constant new content and community-driven updates.

Create a hero, train dozens of skills, battle monsters, gather resources, fish, mine, forge powerful gear, and join guilds that unlock unique abilities. Explore cities, caves, forests, islands, and dangerous high-level zones. Team up with friends, challenge world events, or adventure solo at your own pace.

BARP Online retains its original retro charm, complete with pixel art, classic sound effects, and browser-based gameplay, while adding modern improvements like weather systems, time-of-day cycles, new quests, expanded skill trees, and quality-of-life updates.

Whether you're chasing leaderboards, building your perfect character, or just relaxing with fishing and crafting, BARP Online offers a nostalgic yet constantly evolving RPG experience.

title: It's Not You, It's M.E
description: A short narrative point-and-click about living with limited energy — and how even the smallest tasks can feel impossible.

title: Labor Rights Funeral in Ukraine
description: Labor Rights Funeral in Ukraine is a short game about the deterioration of labor rights in Ukraine after the Russian invasion.

title: Pingbert's Snow Ride
description: Slide, soar, and deliver! Join Pingbert, the upbeat penguin mail carrier, in Pingbert’s Snow Ride—a fast-paced, platformer where you'll slide down snowy slopes to deliver mail at high speed!

title: Tokyo Hotel
description: A young man’s erotic journey through Tokyo’s hidden pleasures.

title: The Apple Girl
description: Apple-loving girl delivers potatoes and makes people happy... ?

title: Find Kittens 7: Cookie Town
description: Explore the sweet gingerbread town while finding cute cats and paint black - white locations with colored paints.

title: Pizzapocalypse 2
description: A 3D platformer with a pizza moveset that's accessible & engaging to all skill levels! Explore different countries, and put a stop to the evil corporation ruining Pizza!

title: MTF: Moth To a Flame
description: 18+ adult visual novel. Rosemary and Co go on a roadtrip to visit the Mothman statue, while sharing thoughts about love, found family, trans anxiety, and queer safety

title: Ustje
description: this game is not focused on traditional gameplay but on creating a unique atmosphere. it emphasizes visual style and sound design, combining them into a single artistic experience. the player is immersed in a space where feeling and perception matter more than action

title: Attack of The Dead
description: In a world overrun by the undead, can you endure the relentless onslaught of zombies and emerge as humanity's last hope? Dive into the heart-pounding action of Attack of the Dead, where your survival instincts and strategic prowess are your greatest assets.

title: Bird Game 3
description: Bird Game 3 is an immersive Multiplayer BvB (Bird vs. Bird) game, now finally coming to Steam! Select your favorite bird and fight other birds for domination over the bird realm!

title: Battle For Embolia
description: Battle For Embolia is a fast-paced indie MMORPG with responsive combat, meaningful progression, and constant updates. Explore a growing world, face challenging bosses, and help shape the game’s development through community feedback. Free to play with no pay-to-win.

title: Drone Fire
description: Drive the drone on the keyboard and destroy the target. Targets also attack the drone in many ways. Weapons of the drone include machine guns and missiles. Each time you destroy the target with a machine gun, another missile is created.

title: Red Cell
description: A first-person shooter rogue-like game blending fluid movement, fast-paced combat, and strategic weapon mastery. Dive into chaotic, neon-lit arenas, unleash combos, and uncover a gripping sci-fi story in Red Cell.

title: Bounceback
description: Bounceback is a short but challenging climb to the top. You play as a bouncing ball with limited movement and any mistake could potentially be your downfall. Only by mastering the movement will you succeed.

title: Save My Scrap
description: "They mean everything to me. Please, make them whole again." An interactive visual novel puzzle game. By fixing the broken android, you may uncover the truth about your client's past.

title: Capacity
description: This game immerses you in a magical town, where your character searches for hidden treasure chests amidst a maze-like environment.

title: Casual Fishing
description: Casual Fishing is a relaxing desktop idle game combining fishing simulation, codex collection, random item drops, and gear enhancement. You can enable "Easy Mode" to shrink the game and place it in a corner of the screen—perfect for fishing while working or studying.

title: Catacomb
description: Catacomb is a hardcore, melee-focused FPS roguelike inspired by the greats of the early 2000's. Using only your wits, your blade, and over 40 unique artifacts, hack and slash your way back to the surface and earn your freedom.

title: Chicken Defense War
description: Chicken Defense War - Tower Defense is a left-to-right tower defense roguelike game， where you play as a chicken commander. Use up to 15 skills and equipment to fend off waves of enemies. Create strategies and survive until rescue arrives in each randomly generated battle!

title: Among Shadows
description: Among Shadows is an intense blend of fast-paced combat and identity-based deduction. You are sent to stop a deadly infection from spreading across a corrupted land, but traitors have infiltrated your team. With the Blood Moon rising, can you escape from this place under the conspiracy?

title: Tome of the Damned
description: Tome of the Damned is a dark top-down roguelike where a cursed mage fights for freedom. Defeat castle guards, enhance weapons and spells. Enchanted weapons, elemental grimoires, ruthless bosses. Die, adapt, try again.

title: Constellar
description: A reinterpretation of retro games like Space Invaders and Galaga with a modern twist. Battle through planetary sectors using elemental abilities that combine for powerful effects and make bosses vanish. If you’re looking for a short, modernized retro-style game, this is perfect for you.

title: Cosmic Castaway
description: Cosmic Castaway is a colony building survival game. Gather scarce resources, rescue and assign your crew, build and defend your outpost from hostile forces, and turn wreckage into refuge to repair your ship and escape back to your home planet.

title: Courier Life Simulator
description: Connect to your driver account on the warehouse desktop , get on shift and load the packages in the van. Deliver the packages , choosing the packages to deliver based on your own preferences. After the shift ends , leave the van at the warehouse and get your personal car and drive to your home.

title: Cosmic Swarm
description: A modern space shooter where you guard the galaxy from collapsing into astropolitical war. Traverse the stars, hold the line between empires, and prevent cosmic conflict — one swarm at a time.

title: Crash Course
description: Crash Course is a fun little Lokal-Multiplayer Indie-Game about crashing into your friends and family in cars, and sabotaging them in a few epic mini games. Play Hexagon Heat, Hot Potato, The Floor is Lava and Soccer.

title: Curse of Yggdrasil
description: Rebuild the world tree Yggdrasil as the last surviving viking in this tower-defence and simulator game!

title: Oprost
description: Use the souls of fallen animals to jump, fly, and dash through a decaying forest, chasing the monster that is tearing it apart

title: Tiny Kitchen: Sandwich Edition
description: Click to drop ingredients and build your own chaotic deli-style sandwich in this cozy physics cooking game. Stack it tall, stack it wrong — just don’t forget the bread!

title: Close to Light
description: Follow the music and stay close to the lights in this rhythm game! Avoid hazards and do not let the darkness absorb you.

title: Gunship Global Operations
description: Take command of the Gunship and rain fire from above! Use powerful weapons, real thermal vision, defend against enemies and support allied forces to dominate missions and change the course of battle.

title: Harder Parkour
description:
Jump like you mean it. Fall hard, learn fast. Break into twisted inner worlds, bend physics, outrun your fear.
Fall. Rise. Repeat

title: Shield of Breaker
description: Shield of Breaker is a single-player Action-RPG set in a fantasy world. Protect your castle from endless waves of enemies and turn the tide of battle by deflecting their own blazing fireballs. Choose your hero, upgrade your powers,. Each victory unlocks your path to defend new lands in your realm.

title: The Basment
description: Descend into the basement and confront three escalating stages of psychological horror. Each phase offers subtle environmental clues and cryptic hints, pushing you to observe, interpret, and survive. This demo delivers an atmospheric preview of the full experience — the complete release will expand the story, puzzles, and intensity of the terror to come.

title: BugLab Simulator
description: Manage terrariums, breed insects, produce resources, and expand your lab into a thriving ecosystem. BugLab blends automation, strategy, and simulation with ever-growing systems.

title: Battle of Goldfish Scooping
description: "Battle of Goldfish Scooping" is an asymmetrical multiplayer action game. Players take on the roles of scoops and goldfish to aim for high scores. Based on your previous play results, you can acquire skills and enhance parameters to aim for even higher scores!

title: Stellar Mess: Operation Kush
description: Stellar Mess is a point&click 2D graphic adventure game with retro style, where the least likely hero must rescue the princess and save the galaxy from a tyrannical Stellar Armada. All this while walking through a small town located somewhere in the Argentinian Patagonia.

title: Hotel Hideaway
description: An immersive 3D social simulation MMO where you customize your avatar, build and decorate rooms, collect rare items, and join live community events in a nostalgic yet ever-evolving virtual world.

title: Vietnam Warrior: Against the US Invasion
description: Vietnam Warrior: Against the US Invasion is a 2D pixel-art action game that recreates the resistance war against the US. Players take on the role of guerrilla fighters, fighting through jungles, tunnels and historical campaigns.

title: Debugger 3.16: Recoded - Despair of the Developer Edition
description: The developer messed it up, his games are full of errors and bugs and he lost all hope that somebody will buy it! Take control of Debugger 3.16 and try to delete all the bugs the developer produced in this 2D-Platformer for up to four players.

title: Schattenjäger
description:
This is an 8bit retro platformer that's happening all in once screen. Every pixel is exactly one pixel in full-hd resolution.

You play as Gabriel Knight - The Schattenjäger - to save the kidnapped Diana from the castle of the evil Count.

title: Sudoku Champions
description:
Sudoku is a simple and clear number-puzzle game.
The goal is easy to understand: fill the grid so each row, column, and 3×3 box contains the numbers 1 to 9 with no repeats. No math required, just logic.

Playing Sudoku helps improve focus, memory, and problem-solving skills in a calm and enjoyable way. It’s a quick mental exercise that keeps the brain active and sharp.

This version includes a wide variety of color themes, allowing you to play in the style that feels most comfortable for your eyes.

Easy to learn, relaxing to play, and beneficial for your cognitive health.

title: Grave Regrets
description: Explore a misty 90's small town where every choice you make unravels a dark, haunting mystery. Investigate clues, manage tense relationships, and face the consequences of your actions in this psychological horror visual novel that may leave you questioning your own sanity.

title: Postal: Bullet Paradise
description: Postal: Bullet Paradise is a cooperative bullet-hell shooter set in the Postal universe where players select characters from throughout the series. Players collect makeshift weapons, enhance their arsenal, and face waves of enemies either solo or with others online in fast-paced, chaos-driven combat.

title: Apocryphoid
description:
In the afterlife you realize you are trapped in a cyber space as a digital spirit. Now you have to fight the digital Angel Virus to free your new dimension.

The game is a Boss Rush Bullet Hell shooter with upgrades. Fight 10 different bosses and try to defeat a secret boss for better ending!

title: Serpent's Gaze
description: Serpent’s Gaze is a punishing 1-4 player co-op third-person action game where you fight tough enemies and relentless bosses, all while uncovering the secrets of an ancient desert.

title: Wise Guys
description: Wise Guys is a ruthless, high-stakes social deduction game where trust is a weapon and betrayal is just survival. Up to 8 players race against time to clean up their criminal operation and get out before the raid hits. Meanwhile, a Rat is quietly sabotaging the crew at every turn.

title: Marrowbound
description: First-person hack-and-slasher with a heavy emphasis on exploration and player expression. You are an instrument of divine retribution.

title: A Simple Twist of Fae
description:
When the anxious pixie, Kalaira breaks the orb of fate at the last matchmaking event of the year, she finds herself caught between two very competitive lovers, learning divination from a demon, with only six moons to figure it out!

A romantic comedy manga come to life! Behind the shenanigans and lessons of desire, there just might be a story unfolding about learning to open one's heart!

title: Scrap Daddies
description: Scrap Daddies is a slapstick co-op extraction-style looter for 1–6 players. The world has sunk beneath the waves, and survivors live on scattered platforms. Dive into deep-sea bases as a scrapper to recover power cells and gather scrap to upgrade your gear.

title: Night Bici
description:
Your best friend Ethan had to go out of town, so you're looking after his shop for a few days.
Your job is simple: prepare shaved ice throughout the night, serve customers, and keep the shop running smoothly.
Shave the ice, pour the syrup on top, and serve it to the customer.

title: The Alters: Deluxe Edition
description:
Dive into an emotional sci-fi story and alter your experience even further, with the Deluxe Edition of the game. This inspiring collection includes:
The Alters
The Alters: Original Soundtrack
The Alters: Deluxe Outfits
1 DLC released after the game’s premiere

title: Repose: Deluxe Edition
description:
REPOSE - Deluxe Edition includes:
REPOSE
REPOSE - Soundtrack
REPOSE - Artbook

title: Venba: Deluxe Edition
description:
Venba Deluxe Edition includes:
Venba
Venba Soundtrack

title: Coridden: Deluxe Edition
description:
Coridden - Deluxe Edition includes:

Coridden
Coridden - Original Soundtrack
Coridden - Digital Bestiary
Coridden - Supporter Pack

title: Skald: Against the Black Priory - Deluxe Edition
description: Skald: Against the Black Priory Deluxe Edition contains the base game as well as the full, official soundtrack composed by Romanus Surt and the Reinforcement Pack.

title: Extract Game
description: A crossplay (Web and/or Unreal) system‑heavy multiplayer progression sandbox blending deep itemization, skill grinding, idle automation, and player‑driven economy. Playable actively or passively across shared worlds.

title: Golden Gate 2: Goddess Heart
description: Golden Gate 2: Goddess Heart is a modification for Gothic II: Gold Edition. The mod offers a deep, multi-threaded story with numerous choices that influence gameplay, enhanced systems and mechanics, full Polish voice acting, a completely new original soundtrack, and a beautifully original open world.

title: Thief Simulator 3
description: The Thief is back! Play solo or team up in CO-OP as a duo of thieves, plan the perfect hits, or improvise when things go wrong. From pickpocket to crime boss – only the best gangs will make it to the top.

title: Slice Overdrive
description: Slice Overdrive is a precision platformer built on speed, control, and flawless execution. Carve through deadly player-built levels, claim leaderboard glory, and ride the retro-synth soundtrack as you chase that perfect run.

title: Mom Life Simulator
description: Manage the busy daily life of a caring mother in Mom Life Simulator. Take care of your children, cook meals, clean the house, look after your dog, and find time for your own hobbies while balancing family responsibilities and time management.

title: Crosak
description: Do you like platforming, exploration, and plumbing...? Uh, I mean... play-dough?! Well, we may not have pipes, but we can give you 64 reasons to join Crosak’s daring adventures.

title: Cast Outs
description: Urban fantasy collides with true co-op as you and your crew unleash visceral, physical magic, amplifying each other’s powers, and pushing back invaders in the fight to save your city. Cast Outs mixes the weight of a brawler with the speed of a shooter, built for quick-fix fun, high-intensity co-op, and memorable sessions with friends.

title: Intervoid
description: INTERVOID is a tense co-op horror game with resource management elements. Delve into the dark depths of an abandoned subway, avoid dangerous anomalies, out-of-control trains, and manage your oxygen supply. Reach the heart of this oppressive place.

title: Naked Adventure
description: An erotic comedy adventure game by the female-only studio EraHunterTeam. The game follows the protagonist Nika as she completes exhibtionism-themed quests.

title: Path of Exile 2: The Third Edict
description:
The Beast is growing and the world is truly at stake. After finding Doryani in Act Three, you learn you must travel to a Karui archipelago called Ngamakanui to search for pieces of a great weapon, the instrument of the Third Edict. This weapon is the only hope against the Beast.

Journey to Kingsmach, hire a ship, and set sail!

title: PPD
description: PPD (meaning "Project Project Dxxx") is a free rhythm game inspired by the Hatsune Miku: Project Diva series. Users are able to make and share their own fanmade charts on the game's website.

title: Tune in to the Show
description: Tune in to the show is an adult visual novel with a focus on the story and characters. As a participant in a new TV show in which you'll be living with 7 strangers for a month, spend time with a cast of diverse and fun characters, investigate mysteries, and let the romance blossom!

title: Worldend Dominator Rosa
description: A first person shooter based on the iconic scene from the "Umineko no Naku Koro ni" series playable, where Rosa and Maria trying to escape from rokkenjima after all the family is slaughtered by the Golden Witch.

title: The Last Bee
description: Apis and Lili are two of the last bees in the world. They are trapped in some hideous caves among ants and other creatures.Help Apis find the key and free Lili.

title: Peasants War
description: Peasants War is the first competitive medieval shooter, created by one-person development studio New Companion.

title: KickNSlap
description: Come Kick And Slap Your Way To The Top!

title: Cardaver
description: Cardaver is a tower defense, deckbuilder, with roguelike looping gameplay. Using a wide variety of monsters and spells to defend each lane, help the Dragon Queen protect her Castle Kingdom against an army of fantasy do-gooders and tyrannical princesses.

title: Mystical Herbalists
description: A tactical alchemy board-game. Gather herbs, master recipes, finish missions, and compete in local hot-seat multiplayer.

title: GumPop!
description: GumPop! is a 3D Puzzle Platformer. Solve Puzzles to find a way to the next room and clear out the sweet factory from mutated sweets with your Bubble Gum Gun.

title: Luenna: School of the Magi
description: Luenna: School of the Magi is a fantasy student life RPG. From mellow life sim tasks to in-depth turn-based combat, there are as many ways to spend your time at Luenna as there are stars in the sky!

title: Home Cooked Spaghetti Western
description: Duel a gallery of nefarious rogues using pasta ingredients in this tongue-in-cheek western turn-based battler.

title: Recyclamation
description: Recyclamation is a gritty sci-fi job simulator. The victim of a mind-wiping process, you sort trash as you regain your lost memories and uncover the truth of who you are and the world around you. Will you learn who you were and how you came here, or will you continue your life as a mindless drone?

title: Argonauts Agency: Patterns of Morpheus
description: Jason, Medea, and Asclepius fight nightmares to restore the balance between sleep and waking life.

title: Detective Inna Duke
description: A noir story-driven visual novel where you team up with lieutenant Inna Duke and her partner corporal Fernal to investigate the mysterious abduction of the popular streamer Oleh Hamston. But will you manage to track down the poor hamster in rainy city?

title: Vanity: Unlock All Characters
description: With this DLC you unlock all current and future characters (apart from the skins obtainable in game rewards)

title: Burning Skies Arcade: Extra Content
description: Extra content for Burning Skies Arcade, for people who enjoyed the game.

title: Dark Flowers: Tiny Starlight
description: Dark Flowers: Tiny Starlight is a story-driven puzzle game where players embody the protagonist on a post-apocalyptic journey of self-reconciliation, enduring solitary struggles within a time loop. A millennium after the meteor catastrophe, magic has gradually become an instrument of control for the powerful. You awaken amidst ruins teeming with zombies, stripped of all past memories—remembering only that instinct-driven fireball spell.

title: Flower Dungeon
description: Choose a beautiful hero and grow stronger as you battle through unpredictable dungeons in this pixel art roguelite adventure RPG! Begin your journey into a dungeon filled with hundreds of events, enemies, and hidden secrets...!

title: Flower Dungeon: Gold Nib & Dragon Fists
description: Heroes Resia and Ranju are now available as playable characters.

title: Flower Dungeon: Mercenary & Berserker
description: Heroes Galen and Nerun are added as playable heroes.

title: Flower of Anarchy
description: You are the leader of a gang of slave raiders in post-apocalyptic America

title: Princess of Frozen Flowers
description: Princess of Frozen Flowers is a boss-heavy dungeon RPG where you transform the legendary weapon Icebreaker, manage frostblood, and reposition across a six-zone battlefield in combat. Conquer one deadly dungeon each day as the world grows more vicious.

title: Twilight Moonflower
description: A Japanese-style horror game for 1 to 4 players set in randomly generated residential neighborhoods. Explore a dangerous otherworld haunted by yokai, seal the supernatural phenomena that occur, and aim for escape. Experience replayable terror and tension with your friends.

title: Solitaire Flowerscapes
description: Unleash your inner gardener and embark on a captivating solitaire adventure!

title: Frostbite Frenzy: Flower Hat
description: Add flair to your penguin with the Flower Hat DLC! Whether you’re sliding, smashing, or splashing, this iconic Flower Hat ensures you stand out in every icy brawl. Elevate your penguin’s style and let the battlefield know who’s the most fashionable waddler on the ice!

title: Incoherence: Dark Rooms
description: Dark Rooms is a survival horror room-drafting game set in a looping nightmare. Expand the map by placing rooms at the cost of stability. Fight monsters, solve puzzles, manage limited resources, and unlock new rooms and upgrades. Every run is a new descent into darkness.

title: Asylium
description: Trapped in an abandoned mental hospital, you are hunted by a deranged doctor. Hide, fight, and outsmart your enemy as you uncover the dark secrets of the asylum. One wrong move, and you won't survive the night.

title: The Remains
description: The Remains is a multiplayer co-op survival horror game (4 players) where players must make use of stealth to complete objectives and escape enemies and progress through levels to advance their story.

title: Disc Golf
description: Disc Golf is a casual local multiplayer game for 1 to 4 players that brings the fun of the popular outdoor sport to your screen. Choose from a variety of characters and scenic courses and compete with friends for the lowest score!

title: Dinosaur
description: Create your own island without limits. Populate your island with dinosaurs, choose from over 50 species. Ensure the mutual symbiosis and prosperity of all species on the island.

title: The Celestial Seeker
description: Irata, a space bounty hunter is caught in a galactic conflict. A rogue federation seeks the fragments of the Eternium Core, an advanced chip that commands all defense systems in the solar system. In this sci-fi Metroidvania, explore, fight, and upgrade your way to stop the enemy and save the galaxy.

title: Baroque Syndrome
description: This ported edition of Baroque Syndrome presents the visual novel depicting the events before the main Baroque story. Play as Kitsune, owner of the Baroque Shop, and experience a branching narrative shaped by your choices. Fonts, stills, animations, and UI have been remastered for smoother play.

title: Don't Crash
description: Don't Crash is a fast-paced space survival dodging game. Pilot the Argo explorer through shifting cosmic hazards, using speed, sharp turns to escape meteors and storms. Survival depends solely on skill as threats escalate. Push farther, chase higher scores, and seek the hidden Haven Sector.

title: Doomsday Warrior
description: This is a relaxing single-player puzzle adventure game designed for players who love challenges and logical thinking.In this colorful post-apocalyptic world, you will take on the role of a warrior, using your brain to unlock all the levels in order to survive.

title: Dragon Gate: Tournament
description: Compete in short, deadly sprints full of power-ups, dangers and fierce rivalries where only speed and skill mean survival. Are you ready to take the crown?

title: Dungeon Battles
description: Struggling to survive in the dungeon!

title: Duskfall
description: Defend your village at dusk! Shoot the attacking crows, keep your population safe, and find all 5 keys before time runs out.

title: Dungeon Story
description: This is a card-based adventure game where you command three adventurers to explore dungeons, acquire skills and abilities, defeat monsters, collect rewards, and strengthen your party. Lead your trio to conquer the final boss!

title: Eggscape
description: Crack into chaos! Eggscape is a chaotic online party brawler where egg warriors battle and steal the piggy across wild arenas. 3 game modes, 15 ridiculous weapons, 119+ cosmetics, up to 6 players. Grab your friends - eggs are funnier when they scream together.

title: Elsewhere
description: The story of Anne, a 14-year-old who dives into the world of adults to find her brother. Strange, unwelcoming, and sometimes absurd — a black comedy adventure.

title: Ephemeral
description: This game crafts a medieval

title: Cozy Holiday
description: Cozy Holiday is a cooperation game for two players, where you can relax and enjoy winter adventures together. Explore charming places, deliver gifts and complete small tasks in a cozy Christmas world. Create memories with your friend, partner, child or a grandparent.

title: 20 Days to Find Amy
description:
20 Days To Find Amy is a short, single player, hidden object puzzle.

The story has the player returning home after being away for many years, she arranges to meet her friend but on arrival her friend, referred to as Anna throughout the game, is nowhere to be found. The twenty days referred to are the twenty levels within the game, each level contains one to three hidden object puzzles and for each level the player is given five hints. In levels with multiple puzzles it is possible to partially complete one puzzle, exit, start another puzzle and thus manage the use of the limited hints between them.

title: Shrouded Suns
description: In the midst of a seemingly hopeless war among the stars, take control of highly customizable spacefighters to experience classic space combat action throughout a story-driven campaign.

title: Plague Doctor: Life in Pestilence
description: From an unknown quack to a reputable Plague Doctor, watch the plague unfold before your eyes. Gather ingredients, brew remedies, expand your clinic, and perform surgeries alone or up to 4 player co-op. Will you uphold the Hippocratic Oath... or watch the world rot and darken with every death.

title: Eki: The Station
description: Eki - The Station is a retro-styled japanese inspired game about a person trying to get back home late in the night.

title: Shores of Vaelithar
description: Cast forsaken upon the Shores of Vaeilthar, a hapless villager in a haunting world torn asunder. Learn the veil-borne arts, hunt demi-gods with blade and magic, and rise a legend in this classic sword and sorcery come to life.

title: Riftaway
description: Riftaway is an NDS/N64-inspired 3D platformer in which you help a young witch recover her lost memories in an outter-space-like world known as... the Riftaway! Collect memory-refreshing crystals and meet unique personalities in a world where even gravity is broken.

title: Avoid Game
description: Avoid Game is a simple yet addictive dodge action game! Control the black cat to dodge raindrops. Experience easy controls, infinite survival, and randomly spaced obstacles as you challenge your best high score!

title: Furry Sniper
description: Your mission is tough: eliminate 30 furries scattered across a vast woodland. As an elite sniper, you’ll need precision, patience, and perseverance to track them down and complete your task.

title: Gripper's 3D/VR Adventure
description: Tackle over 40 clever VR puzzles in this immersive adventure. Can you reach the treasure at the end?

title: Sime Is Back 18+
description: Explore a mysterious world hub temple and travel to different worlds, collect shiny diamonds and keys, and unlock new levels packed with that nostalgic charm you’ve come to love. It’s everything you’d expect from a fun, lighthearted 3D platformer… Until it isn’t.

title: OuPaiWar2 Hua's lake hut
description: is a simulation management game developed by Laoyin with more than 20 collectible cards waiting for you to explore

title: Defense Legend 5: Survivor TD
description: Build a defense strategy to protect the peace.

title: Default Unreal Physics and Assets AKA DUPA Project
description: Physics based FPP puzzler (with a short lesson of Polish).

title: Tetris-Retro
description: Use the arrow keys to move the shapes left, right, rotate, or drop. The more lines you clear at one time, the more you score. Can you take the top score? Play and find out.

title: Carmagist
description: Civilization vs. the Demon Lord?! Carmagist is a deck-building strategy game set in a ruined world where the Demon Lord has shattered civilization. Lead a nation on the brink of extinction and build up Tech, Funds, and Population to reclaim the future — every choice shapes your nation’s fate.

title: Dreamcore: Rabbit Hole
description: Explore liminal spaces that feel eerily familiar and fire the imagination, like a dream you’ve already visited.

title: King's Haven
description: Build your deck, expand your kingdom, and defend your Haven! Recruit citizens, construct landmarks, and build powerful combos in this roguelike deckbuilder where each card is a citizen and each season brings new rewards, new threats, and new choices.

title: My Eyes Inside Out Chapter Two
description: After the accident and the traumatic event, Angela suffered a depression for several months, her ex-boyfriend Ned, meanwhile, went to look for Angela's car, explored the dangerous area, the containers of the desert, which contained chemical fluids, find one albaran, from where they transported all that dangerous material, Angela, aware of that, called some friends and traveled there, to find out where that radioactive material came from.

title: My Eyes Inside Out Chapter Three
description: The chaotic chemical disease that Angela tried to eradicate, spread by accident in Pozhas, a fishing town, the fluid spread through the ocean and a kind of fish that inhabited the shores and ports of Pozhas, confined and infected, now Pozhas death zone, Angela with many other infected were confined in one of the 3 Hotels of 3 and 5 stars for the government to plan what to do with all those people and with Pozhas.

title: Ad Iterum
description: Ad Iterum is a turn-based top-down 2D roguelike set in a decaying, ever-shifting world. Flesh is fragile, but you can hack it. Enhance your body, embrace mutations, or form ancient blood pacts. Descend into the depths, scavenge what’s left of humanity, and crawl back...if you can. Kill. Die. Repeat.

title: Total War: Warhammer III - Lords of the End Times
Total War: Medieval III
description:
We’ve been waiting a long time to say this: Total War is going back to the medieval era ⚔️ Total War: MEDIEVAL III is now in early development!

This isn’t just a sequel; it’s the rebirth of historical Total War. And we're bringing you on the journey with us.

title: Bisounours Party: Adventure
description: Bisounours Party is meant to be a fun mod settled in a colorful universe with various fast paced gamemodes such as Singleplayer Campaign, Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, Capture The Flag and more fun gamemodes such as Coop, Sourceforts-like...

title: Viaje al Centro de la Tierra: Versión Extendida
description: Relive Jules Verne's great adventure with this game originally conceived for Amstrad CPC.

title: Scila e il Drago Diamante
description: Scila and the Diamond Dragon is a third-person exploration adventure designed for young children. Help Scila recover the lost scales of the Diamond Dragon by overcoming challenges and minigames with lots of little dragon friends!

title: Abismo
description: Abismo is a deep-sea co-op horror game set on the abyssal floor of an alien planet. Descend alone or with up to three friends into shifting trenches, recover classified research, and survive the crushing dark while uncovering an analog-horror mystery buried in corrupted VHS tapes.

title: Hole io: Construction DLC
description: Wear heavy-duty skins and visit the new Construction map with your friends!

title: Magic Sheep
description: Get ready to fluff your brain and relax your heart, because this little sheep in a top hat is about to turn puzzle-solving into the cutest ritual of calm you’ve ever seen. Magic Sheep is a charming, slow-paced puzzle adventure where you push wooden barrels across peaceful gardens until each one rests perfectly on a marble pedestal. No pressure, no timer, only soft music, gentle thinking, and plenty of “oh, that was clever” moments.

title: Delivery of Us
description:
In Delivery of Us, you guide a clever carrier pigeon on a mission to deliver every letter across the city’s rooftops. Plan each route carefully, because every move counts. Once the counter hits zero, the delivery fails.

This relaxing logic and movement-based puzzle game combines smooth mechanics, strategic planning, and calm visuals. Each level challenges you to find the most efficient path to every mailbox while avoiding walls, hazards, and obstacles along the way.

Discover different rooftop settings, from cozy neighborhoods to corporate towers, and enjoy the peaceful yet clever atmosphere as you test your reasoning skills.

title: BioMech Vendetta
description: A forgotten world awakens — where nature and machine have become one. Step into the boots of an elite soldier sent to reclaim a planet consumed by biomechanical life.

title: Lil Guy Resort
description: Choose your lil guy and learn more about each other while exploring what the resort has to offer!

title: Sol: Shogunate
description: Paint the stars with the blood of your enemies in this Space-Samurai Action RPG set in an alt-future solar system ruled by the sword. A pulse-pounding soundtrack drives your gravity-defying, blood-soaked path of revenge as Yuzuki the “Shattered Heir” to a massacred clan who becomes an outlaw ronin.

title: Substructure
description: Harness the power of automation in this factory game set on a rogue planet in the far reaches of the solar system. Dig down and explore the depths of an alien world, exploit its resources across complex production chains, and travel towards the core to uncover its deepest secrets.

title: Neath
description: Manipulate the turns of friend and foe alike in this Eldritch roguelike tactical RPG by the makers of Rogue Legacy. Ascend the inverted tower. Kill an indolent god. Control every "moment".

title: About Fishing
description: Cast your line into calm waters and feel the quiet pull beneath the surface. Each cast brings rewards, but some things you reel in were never meant to be found.

title: Killing Floor III: Operation Breakout
description: Welcome to Season 2 Operation: Breakout. This massive seasonal update expands gameplay with new content, features, and balance improvements. Players can wield the KV Recluse, a new Medic SMG, face the return of the new stealthy Stalker Zed, and explore the new Prison survival map deep in the Costa Rican jungle. The update reintroduces DJ Scully as a new Specialist alongside a new ten-mission narrative campaign, fresh weekly modes, wave mutators, and Zed execution animations. A new Collections store taband100-tier Supply Pass overhaul progression and customization. Extensive balance tuning, optimizations, and hundreds bug fixes round out the most ambitious update yet within Killing Floor 3's Year 1 Roadmap.

title: Do Crimes!
description: Hey, how'd you find this game?? Do Crimes is an upcoming chaotic competitive co-op extraction game where you and your friends drop onto randomized islands and cause criminal mayhem - then try to escape before you're squashed by the law...or just give each other the finger. Do Crimes! Or Don’t!

title: Epoch Reset
description: Unravel a narrative-driven 2.5D anime adventure as Hector, a dirt-poor genius and creator of the world’s first time machine. Travel between timelines, meet intriguing characters, and explore futuristic cityscapes as you seek to save reality from time-bending forces beyond imagination.

title: Starship Troopers: Ultimate Bug War!
description: Lock and load into the Starship Troopers universe and join the Mobile Infantry in the most realistic depiction of war ever made ! Experience an original story in this action-packed, first-person retro shooter. Would you like to know more?

title: Rivage
description: Rivage is an immersive sci-fi puzzle adventure set aboard the A.R.E.S. space station trapped in a space phenomenon. Wake up as Miranda, forced to explore, solve intricate puzzles to unravel the fate of your missing crew.

title: When Sirens Fall Silent
description: When Sirens Fall Silent is a dark psychological thriller set in 1990s Italy. Players play as Mila, a troubled policewoman drawn into a high-profile case of kidnappings and murders. As the case unravels, players must not only save her from herself but from being swallowed by a vortex of violence and confusion.

title: Wardrum
description: Lead a tribal warband and time your attacks to the beat of the Wardrum in this tactical turn-based roguelite! Forge a path across a harsh fantasy world full of rhythm magic, face death and strengthen your warriors until you have the power to destroy the dark sorcery infecting the lands.

title: Guild Wars: Reforged
description: Step into Guild Wars Reforged, the award-winning online roleplaying game enjoyed by millions, now re-energized with system enhancements. Experience the complete saga—from the fall of Ascalon to the desperate stand against Nightfall. Your adventure is just getting started!

title: Rift Fishing
description: Rift Fishing is a multiplayer chatroom-focused fishing game. Fish through rifts into other worlds to catch mysterious creatures and artifacts. Make friends worldwide, paint together, and jam by the cozy campfire.

title: Cave Oasis at Shylake
description: In this eco-futuristic farm life sim, you arrive at a moon town as the new hydroponic greenhouse farmer. Then dust storms start to appear, threatening to block the town's precious sunlight. Grow and craft supplies, build renewable energy tech, protect the wild biomes, and help your community thrive.

title: Touhou Witch's Night Market
description: Marisa has lost all her fortune in 'Kappachinko', now she must fight other residents in Gensokyo to repay the debt she owes Reimu! Collect various items and skills, build your construct strategically, then head towards powerful opponents! She may even encounter a mysterious being in the end…

title: Dungeons of Dusk
description: Dungeons of DUSK is a classic turn based dungeon crawling RPG that takes place canonically between the episodes of the cult classic FPS. Are you... WORTHY?

title: The House of Hikmah
description: The House of Hikmah is a narrative-driven 3D adventure game exploring grief, legacy and the search for answers after profound loss. Solve puzzles, encounter historical scholars of the Islamic Golden Age, and uncover timeless lessons in a beautifully imagined House of Wisdom.

title: Shuffle! Episode 2: Kami ni mo Akuma ni mo Nerawareteiru Otoko
.Decluster & .Decluster Zero
description: The vertical scrolling shooter game '.Decluster' and its sequel '.Decluster Zero' are now available in one package.

title: DEX : Speed Run - Level Maker - World Records
description: Play together with the leader, take the first places, create levels in this action platformer! New levels every day

title: Space Warlord Baby Trading Simulator
description: Buy low, sell high, and short an entire universe of babies in this arcade stock market sim set in the world of Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator.

title: Project: Station
description: A 4-player co-op sci-fi horror game where you stealth through unstable research stations, scavenge vital resources, complete high-risk contracts, and extract before the facility overwhelms your team.

title: Springs, Eternal
description: Explore a mysterious hot springs in the dead of night and meet the other lost souls who are drawn to this place.

title: Limbot
description: Limbot is a super silly, physics-driven game about controlling the limbs of a person dressed as a giant cardboard robot! Master all four limbs in solo or embrace the chaos (and camaraderie) of couch co-op play, in this fully destructible cardboard world!

title: Samson
description: Samson returns to Tyndalston, a city that shaped him hard, where every fight is close and every escape is earned. He owes dangerous people more than he can pay, and they’re using his sister to force his hand. The clock is running. The only way out is through anyone who stands in his way.

title: The Enigma Lounge
description: The Enigma Lounge is a hand-pixeled, point and click escape room puzzle game. It features a cozy yet mysterious vibe, and a small but tricky set of interconnected puzzles that must be solved in order to escape.

title: Inkblood
description: You're an Inquisitor following a trail of death. A cult is at work, your predecessor has vanished, and the region teeters on the edge of chaos. Find the truth. Uphold the Inquisition. Do not fail.

title: Windrose
description: Embark on a PvE survival adventure in the Age of Piracy. Fight on land and sea, solo or with friends. Build, craft and explore vast open world filled with dark secrets. Master soulslite combat and take on challenging bosses, command your ship and plunder unspoken treasures!

title: Santa's Big Sack
