description: Seduce iconic holiday heroes and battle Krampus in an outrageous Christmas adventure like no other. Naughty or nice, the choice is yours!

title: How Many Bugs in a Box
description: A children's game featuring a collection of mini games mainly focusing on counting.

title: Unusual Tales: Deep Below
description:
Unusual Tales is an episodic psychological horror game that follows a main character through what seems like a never ending nightmare. Will they make it to the end in one piece?

The city you once knew and grew up in isn't safe at all anymore after recent events. You, a regular working Joe, decide to take things into your own hands after a spontaneous decision. Will you regret or accept your new destiny?

This game features many things that might peak your attention such as:
An hour long scary experience depending on pace
A horror experience filled with scares
Complete voice acting for each character
Lighthearted writing and amusing moments
A dark city full of secrets to explore
Environments to keep you on edge
And much more!

Maybe today was a day that you should've stayed in bed.
But who am I to decide on your decisions in the end...
You want to save her don't you?

title: Unknown Fluffy Object
description: Play as Buddy the sheepdog in this 3rd-person puzzle game. Herd sheep across rivers, cliffs, and rolling hills of Scotland while fending off mischievous UFOs with your mighty super bark.

title: Deadbus
description: DEADBUS is a first-person post-apocalyptic shooter where you’re part of a cleanup unit sent to clear infected zones and rescue survivors. Manage limited ammo, hit your kill quota, and make it back to the bus before time runs out. Efficiency is survival, and the DEADBUS waits for no one.

title: Supreme Experiment
description: In a world abandoned by humans, machines have evolved into a new species—and found their own gods. Survive, explore, and fight to uncover the truth and realize that... nothing is what it seems. Perhaps, you can still save what remains of humanity.

title: Space Trench
description: A survival horror roguelite where you salvage scrap, upgrade your equipment, and fight against countless hordes in the tight corridors of the derelicts of space.

title: Brainwashing Academy: The Cursed Person's Pot
description: One day, you awaken with no memories, guided only by a mysterious girl your age named Masamitsu Kanae. It turns out you've struck a deal with her uncle, granting you a powerful curse of brainwashing.

title: Microlandia
description: Brutally honest city builder. Become the mayor of a thriving new town and manage construction, policies, taxes, incident response and more, through an elaborate socioeconomic simulation that draws on real-world data.

title: Busty Detective! The Case Files of Aine Tamagushi
description: Busty detective Aine Tamagushi sat idly in her cluttered office, reclining in her chair as piles of documents and magazines lay scattered across the room, creating an air of disarray and indolence. The lazy quiet was interrupted when the door creaked open, revealing a middle-aged man in a suit. His face was tense as he stepped forward and placed a photograph on her desk—a rare cat with striking black-and-white fur, resembling a panda.

title: Caliross, the Shapeshifter's Legacy
description: Caliross, The Shapeshifter's Legacy, is a fantasy-themed game, which will follow a young up-and-coming historian, as she takes her first steps outside her hometown and into the real world, to learn more about the elusive nature of her own kind, the shapeshifters. Will she become a member of the Mage guild, or of the Adventurer's guild? Will she find out more about her heritage, or will she be too busy working extra time in sleazy bars to make a living?

title: Countdown to NTR
description: Five days. That’s all the time Bell has to confess his true feelings to Lumia, beautiful singer and love of his life. She left their hometown in pursuit of her dreams – can Bell become a part of her dreams, or will someone else charm Lumia's heart? Let the countdown begin!

title: Cosplayer's Quest
description: She is shy and has a somewhat negative mindset. For her, cosplay is like a ray of hope that can change herself. It is one of her transformation desires, but she has never participated in events and has not shown her cosplay on social media, so in reality, she has never shown anyone her cosplay appearance.

title: Aerosurfer
description: Glide and surf through handcrafted tracks at breakneck speed. The closer you fly to the ground, the faster you go! Chase your best times, race against your ghost, and climb the leaderboards in a high speed journey of control and flow.

title: Retail Therapy
description: Clock in. Freak out. Fight back. You’re stuck in the world’s worst shift - facing down entitled customers, absurd demands, and a mountain of workplace rage. Survive escalating chaos across restaurants, shops, and festivals, using whatever tools you can grab to keep the madness at bay.

title: Robot Space Frenzy
description: All the robots on Space Station 451 have gone berserk! Only one human is left alive! Can she survive the onslaught and escape? Blast your way through homicidal robots in this groovy throwback retro FPS!

title: Road to Jukai
description: Drive through Japan’s suicide ring in your night-shift taxi. Pick up strange passengers, fulfill their unsettling requests and follow the silent road as their stories make each ride darker than the last.

title: Kaidogaku
description: Kaidogaku is a symbolic deduction puzzle game. Decipher the positions for all symbols by make use of a list of placement rules. No progression no grinding just straight and simple fun to immerse in thought and lose the sense of time passing.

title: Pitchforks and Daggers
description: How far will you go to keep your crown? A branching court politics drama, where every choice matters. Navigate treacherous lords, scheming family members, and angry peasants- all while trying to secure your kingdom’s future.

title: Captain Sharkbait: Voyage for Treasure
description: Ahoy, matey! Join the famously unlucky Captain Sharkbait known far and wide for his name... and his two peg legs! Could his fortunes finally be changing when a mysterious bottle washes ashore?

title: Get'Trump'ed Trivia
description: Get'Trump'ed, the ultimate trivia showdown where Donald Trump's larger-than-life persona takes center stage!

title: Made VR
description: One day, JURI gets kidnapped and wakes up in dark basement. Desperately seeking her way to escape, JURI runs into a random guy who is indeed another hostage. And someone is chasing them! Who kidnapped them and why? Would they be able to survive?

title: Operation Empty Quiver
description: Nuclear train assault in arcade shooter-platformer mechanics. Your main objective: infiltrate a military convoy, locate and destroy nuclear weapons.

title: Burning Rainbow
description: A group of girls are in danger at Rainbow Island. Can they successfully beat the bad girl to leave?

title: King's Justice
description: Embark on a thrilling platforming quest across 10 handcrafted levels filled with deadly traps, diverse enemies, and escalating challenges. With an estimated playtime of 30–60 minutes, casual players will enjoy fast-paced action and precision gameplay.

title: Meowgic Mix
description:
Welcome to Meowgic Mix, an adorable pixel art puzzle where a floating cat on a living book must mix potions and deliver them to the correct cauldrons. There are 30 stages inside a magical academy, with challenges that require strategy, logic, and a good dose of feline cleverness.

Observe the classroom where each cauldron awaits its perfect potion. Push bottles, plan your route, and avoid getting stuck while solving each enchanted mini-puzzle. And if something goes wrong, no worries — undo or restart is always just a paw away.

Meowgic Mix combines charming pixel visuals, relaxing music, and mechanics made for players who love calm puzzles, cute animals, and a touch of fantasy. Get ready for a cozy, clever, purr-magical experience where every completed level is a tiny victory in feline alchemy.

title: Insurance Worker Game
description: A fast paced clicking and paperwork simulation game where you race against time to process insurance claims, earn money, and beat your best score!

title: World Sprint
description: Run, jump, and slide through colorful worlds in this fast-paced 3D endless runner! Unlock unique characters, helpful pets, and powerful upgrades using in-game coins. Chase achievements, climb local leaderboards, and see how far you can sprint in World Sprint!

title: Touhou: Blossom Blade
description: Konpaku Youmu sets out to prove herself to Saigyouji Yuyuko, mistress of Hakugyokurou. Make use of her three skills and challenge the veteran incident resolver and shrine maiden, Hakurei Reimu. An exhilarating 3D bullet hell action game set in Gensokyo, the world of Touhou Project!

title: Ultrapool
description: The pool bar is always open! Ultrapool is a colorful roguelike about playing pool with a bunch of wacky balls with crazy effects. Carefully craft a perfect build and get the craziest trickshots!

title: Memorel Restoration Project
description: 「MEMOREL RESTORATION PROJECT」is a digital archive by "Is It Reversible With Cream" and "Sorrowful Mother" for DOMINO CLUB X

title: Grundlewhack
description: In the world of Grundlewhack, the genres of comedy and fantasy come together for a steamy one-night stand. This erotic tale follows three wizarding school dropouts on their quest to take this magical world for their own.

title: Blackjack Roulette
description: Blackjack meets roulette in a deadly duel. Lose a hand, pull the trigger. Use powerful cards to outsmart opponents in 1v1 battles, or defeat the Clown to escape. Win or die.

title: Honkai: Star Rail - Memories are the Prelude to Dreams
description:
Version 3.8 of Honkai: Star Rail, which includes:
• New character: The Dahlia
• New Trailblaze Mission: "Memories are the Prelude to Dreams"
• New areas: Great Tomb of the Nameless Titan and Ruins of Time
• New area: Dream of Gnawing Oak
• New events
• ...and more!

title: Grand Theft Auto Online: A Safehouse in the Hills
description:
For those who have reached the highest rungs of the criminal ladder, celebrate your triumph with a painstakingly crafted palace in one of Los Santos’ most exclusive neighborhoods, complete with breathtaking views, the finest amenities, and countless ways to customize and make it your own.

Plus, stop the development of a mass surveillance network in an all-new action packed adventure — along with exquisite new vehicles to collect, the return of a familiar face, and much more.

title: The Lord of the Rings Online: Kingdoms of Harad
description: The Lord of the Rings Online: Kingdoms of Harad is the thirteenth expansion for the MMORPG, The Lord of the Rings Online (LOTRO). This expansion increases the level cap to 160 and concludes the epic, The Song of Waves and Wind. In this expansion, players travel into Harad to fight Morgoth's forces and features over 400 new quests.

title: Qualatro
description: A SiIvaGunner themed mod for Balatro.

title: Nuclecard
description:
Nuclecard is a post-apocalyptic survival card game where every decision matters. Build your base across 30+ unique locations, craft 50+ items, cook 35+ foods, and master essential survival skills like farming, hunting, and water purification.
The real challenge comes from the world itself. Radiation zones demand careful navigation, brutal winters punish the unprepared, and 30+ random events trigger 9 action-packed mini-games: flee from wolves, defend against raiders, escape collapsing ruins, stop tank assaults, extinguish forest fires, and more. These aren't optional—event cards force you into real-time survival challenges that disrupt your plans.
With 200+ collectible cards and unpredictable encounters, no two runs play the same. The hand-drawn art style makes the apocalypse surprisingly approachable while keeping the tension high.

title: Game Over!
description: "Game Over!" is the world's first (and hopefully only) universally inaccessible game. This practically means that it is a game that can be played by no one. But why was such a game created? Well, the goal of Game Over! is to be used as an educational tool for disseminating, understanding and consolidating game accessibility guidelines.

title: EXD: Extra Dimensional
description: A delivery guy. A dimensional rift. A quest across another world. Master telekinesis and elemental magic in Erath, where everyday objects become legendary weapons. Battle mythical creatures. Solve ancient puzzles. Uncover dark truths. Advanced VR physics meet epic fantasy adventure.

title: Diablo IV: Season of Divine Intervention
description:
Azmodan arises from the burning Hells, and he’s not alone.

Sanctuary trembles as Azmodan and the Lesser Evils rise from the Burning Hells, spreading corruption through shadow and deceit. Hadriel, a vengeful angel, grants humanity Divine Gifts to aid their stand against the darkness. This season also brings sweeping updates to Monster Combat and Item Journeys, redefining every encounter and how heroes forge their power.

title: Tatvalok
description:
Tatvalok is a third-person action-adventure game set on a mystical alien planet filled with ancient temples, powerful monsters, and forgotten civilizations.
You play as a lone survivor who crash-lands on a corrupted world once ruled by an advanced race. Explore enchanted forests, divine shrines, and cursed lands as you uncover the truth behind a portal that unleashed darkness.

Face mythical creatures, unlock magical abilities, complete story-driven quests, and restore balance to a world on the edge of collapse.
Every region hides secrets, challenges, and lore waiting to be discovered.

Explore. Fight. Discover your destiny. Restore Tatvalok.

title: How to create a witch
description: Claudia, a young girl who once saved the Demon Continent as a powerful mage, now sets out on a new journey. She infiltrates a mysterious cult in search of her long-lost younger sister, from whom she was separated in childhood. Will Claudia be able to find her sister safely?

title: Undercity of Sin
description: Experience a story of crime and gang warfare as you fight your way through eight procedurally generated dungeons full of machine soldiers and superpowered weaponry, and explore a skill tree with numerous ways to power up your character as you overcome this traditional turn-based RPG.

title: Satan II
description: The daughter of Satan has seized control of Hell and destroyed Heaven itself. You are hiding among the last survivors on Earth.—but not for long. An insane journey awaits you: a journey into Hell itself, to slaughter every demon, undead and cultist you encounter.

title: Blood Mall: Part II
description: Blood Mall: Part II is a retro-style dinosaur horror game that picks up exactly where Blood Mall left off. Are you prepared to put an end to the Hastovenator Crisis, or have you bitten off more than you can chew?

title: Reverend: Surf 'n Sin
description: Reverend: Surf 'n Sin is the follow-up you didn't expect. A spin-off to the cult game Reverend, this first-person shooter builds upon the gameplay and mechanics of the original, whilst throwing the story off the deep end. Have we jumped the shark? Water puns.

title: Dead Trash: Operation - Yellow Snow
description: Operation Yellow Snow is a short, grindhouse-style holiday mini-campaign set in the Dead Trash universe. This standalone DLC brings the retro horror shooter to the season of gibbing.

title: Frogshot Adventure
description: A skill-based platformer where you control a frog with nothing but its tongue. Swing like a grappling hook, launch like a slingshot, and overcome deadly obstacles across a variety of handcrafted worlds — each with its own unique twist.

title: Daycare Of Happy Children
description: A character named "James" goes to a strange daycare center to find a mysterious artifact that could perform scientific miracles. But James won't be alone in this daycare; he'll encounter creatures ready to do anything to kill him.

title: The Daughter
description: The Daughter is a first-person narrative horror game where the line between reality, dream, and memory slowly fades. You search for your missing daughter in a forest, only to find a house and a silent child who offers to help you… on one condition.

title: Spider Tanks: Cores of Chaos
description: Spider Tanks: Cores of Chaos is a Multiplayer PvP Brawler in which Players customize their Tank from a wide variety of Parts in the garage, then battle it out in high octane 3v3 mayhem. Assemble your tanks, defeat your opponents, climb the ranks and get components!

title: Zero Orders Tactics: Under
description: The entire new 7th faction, +31 units, + 3 heroes, + 3 boss fights

title: Spirit & Steel
description:
The spirits of a remote volcanic island have lived in balance for generations, until William Von Pingleton III arrives with a mining army and a plan to turn them into fuel for his machines. When his first attack knocks the island’s shaman, Ila, off her feet, the spirits answer with a gift: the power to command the elements themselves.

In Spirit & Steel, you play as Ila, a short but stubborn 70-year-old shaman who hits harder than she looks. Swap between elemental fists, chain melee combos, and weave in dashes and air movement to outplay swarms of mechanical enemies in tight, focused combat encounters. Every arena asks you to use your full toolkit; knock foes back with wind, pull them in with crashing waves, and burn through armored threats with searing fire.

As you fight deeper into the island, lush beaches and sacred temples slowly clash with scaffolding, smokestacks, and churning machinery.

Your journey builds toward a final showdown with Pingleton in his volcanic stronghold, where you’ll put all of your unlocked elements to the test. Defeat him, free the captured spirits, and restore the island’s balance, or watch it disappear under steel.

title: Memories With You
description: Memories with You is a fun visual novel, the final one of "to You" game series. Reunite once again with familiar characters Arlequina and Alicia in their new roles, experience a series of humorous stories, and help the protagonist, Mitch, find love among three captivating girls!

title: Save the Shapes
description:
Welcome to a place where geometry meets dread.

In Save The Shapes, you’ll wander through a bizarre little house, uncovering its secrets room by room.

The shapes that live here are vanishing one by one… and Diamond is up to no good.

title: Jumping Man: Mine
description: Help Charles mine enough gold to satisfy his endless greed.

title: Hidden Cats vs. Zombies 3
description: Hidden Cats VS Zombies is a hidden object game – the player's task is to find cats hidden on the map and eliminate the zombies. The game is designed in a zombie apocalypse style, but with a touch of humor.

title: Hidden Cats vs Zombies
description: Hidden Cats VS Zombies is a hidden object game – the player's task is to find cats hidden on the map and eliminate the zombies. The game is designed in a zombie apocalypse style, but with a touch of humor.

title: Recruit & Adventure
description: A deck-building card battler you never played before. Cards, relics, units, flipping and folding. Build powerful deck. Defeat powerful enemies!

title: Fill All
description: Is an exciting puzzle game in which the player paints the corridors of the maze with their movements

title: Dain Squares
description: Clear a line, hear a line!

title: It Was Beautiful
description: It Was Beautiful is a heartfelt story about a little fish who decides to witness the mysterious sunset despite facing a terminal illness. With the help of her father, she strives to find meaning and beauty, despite limited time and uncertain paths.

title: Little Bunny
description: Ready to test your reaction?

title: Cyberemo 2007
description: Cyberemo 2007: “Wake up damn you, Emo, we have a lot of veins for cuts!” Old-school platformer breathtaking game.

title: The Curse We Made
description: A short ride into a cursed town — a hand-drawn puzzle adventure where ghouls and monsters haunt every corner, and solving puzzles slowly brings life back to the world and uncovers the truth.

title: Knife Man
description:
Its 90's, and your dad bought you VHS camcorder.

Bunch of your friends got so excited, so they came up with wonderful slasher movie script, and you are gonna record it.

title: Draw in the Tray
description: "Draw in the Tray" is a casual game.

title: Find Differences
description: This is a casual game, improve your observation skills. Players must find four differences between the two similar pictures

title: Cursflip
description: Change your real Windows cursor, make it huge, collect hundreds of rare cursors, trade them on the Market and dominate clicker leaderboards!

title: Crossing Chains
description: An original line-drawing puzzle game with mind-bending crossing mechanics.

title: Aftermath Z: Red Pine Lake
description: Aftermath Z: Red Pine Lake is survival horror game with a chilling 80s slasher vibe. Experience a gripping single-player story and thrilling multiplayer modes. Unravel the virus mystery, battle zombies in Horde Mode, or outwit the infected slasher in the unique asymmetrical Infected Mode.

title: The Adventures of Emilie in Paris
description: The Adventures of Emilie in Paris is an independent 2D platform game with a unique Parisian atmosphere, inspired by 90s classics with an original twist.

title: Lose Control
description: Your controllers have had enough of your button mashing and are packing up and leaving. Put them back in their place.

title: Flopfish
description: Battle your mates with a randomly generated fish.

title: Splink
description: Can you master four screens at the same time? Challenge your multitasking skills against your friends in this local multiplayer.

title: Blades or Bets
description:
Blades or Bets is a unique dark fantasy RPG blending strategic first-person turn-based combat with HnS-style loot and a gambling system that can make or break the game!

You play as a squire thrust into a dark conspiracy after your caravan is ambushed. It's up to you to rebuild the broken village of Corvarg and face the challenges ahead.

title: Neodarlo
description:
Race a hover car around 2 tracks with 3 modes: normal race where you have to come first in 2 laps, royale where you win when you reach first place against a large number of cars and bomb where you race around 1 lap dodging balls which are dropped by a large hovercar which stays in the lead at all times.
4 people can play all the above modes against each other in local split screen multiplayer.

title: Must Be Feng Shui
description: Must be Feng Shui is a relaxing puzzle game where you arrange furniture to follow Feng Shui rules. Recreate your own home in sandbox mode, or decorate existing cozy apartments to restore their balance.

title: Line Up!
description: Line Up! is a chaotic, couch multiplayer game where you take on the role of a caring Mama trying to guide your adorable, easily confused little babies lined up through the bustling world. Other critters are doing the same, and they won’t hesitate to defend their little ones with everything they’ve got!

title: Frostpoint Toll
description: A machine of war, repurposed for labor. Frostpoint Toll is an action roguelike about mining, collecting, and letting go. Because here, moving forward means learning to forgive.

title: Fourteen Years of Flames
description: Fourteen Years of Flames is a story-driven FPS that replays China’s struggle in the Second Sino-Japanese War (1931–1945). Players embody 7 key characters and battle through 16 real historical events, experiencing the hardships and sacrifices over 14 years of struggle. Land weeps in 14 years of war.

title: Cactus Clicker
description: Cactus Clicker is a clicker game in which you click a cactus.

title: Skuf na dachie
description: A cottage is not just about garden beds! Dacha is primarily a solitude with oneself. Flood the sauna, go mushroom picking, and ride an old bucket over the village potholes in an immersive country simulator.

title: Starlet Disorder
description:
A psychological horror visual novel/RPG hybrid set inside a neon-noir reality television competition about fame, romance, surveillance, and public collapse. Players take the role of Adam, a rising entertainer with an uncertain past, as he enters the second season of Starlet Disorder alongside seven other contestants.

Each week combines life simulation, investigation, relationship-building, broadcast manipulation, and timed social combat in the Live Chamber. Through the PRISM system, player stats shape perception, access, and pressure choices as relationships turn into comfort, rivalry, scandal, evidence, or weapons in the show’s official narrative.

title: Forks & Daggers
description: A Chaotic Medieval Social Deduction Party Game for 3–10 Players. Find the traitor or become a traitor. Use Manor as a weapon itself; throw, hit, arm trap. Convert to a Dagger to hide and eliminate.

title: No Means Nothing
description: Psychological horror/ anti-dating sim about learning to say no.

title: Manor of Shadows
description: Manor of Shadows is a top-down 2D RPG/JRPG with puzzle and psychological horror elements. The story follows a girl named Melialor who becomes trapped inside a mysterious mansion and must explore its rooms trying to escape, uncovering evidence of a bigger secret hidden within the house as the investigation progresses.

title: Everyday Sororicide
description: Everyday Sororicide is a tragic attempt at conveying the feeling of interacting with another girl on any level beyond superficiality. You take up the sword against an NPC (one fight each day) or another girl-esque thing irl and fight until one of you is holding the lifeless, bloodstained hand of the other.

title: Of Me and My Mirror
description: A surreal, emotionally charged visual novel that explores identity, trauma, learning to let go of the past, and moving on.

title: Nature Minds
description:
Nature Minds is an action-adventure RPG where you play as Tareq, a young warrior chosen by the ancient Bracelet of Dilmun. As nature falters and forgotten realms awaken, Tareq discovers that the force behind the world’s disturbance is Gilgamesh—the immortal king who gained endless life through the Plant of Immortality and now seeks to reshape creation according to his vision.

Travel across vast deserts, sunken kingdoms, radiant jungles, and sky cities as you uncover the truth behind the Bracelet of Dilmun and Gilgamesh’s transformation. Along your journey, you will ride the legendary Phoenix, born from the Three Impossible Legends of Arabic culture, and unlock ancient powers that guide you toward your final confrontation with the immortal king.

title: Sword Art Online: Fractured Daydream - Character Pass Vol. 2
description: The second characters pass for Sword Art Online: Fractured Daydream.

title: Demiurge Sacrifice
description: You got unchained. Between the Apostolorum Country and the Shapeless Dimension, your goal will be to travel between worlds and interrupt the Festival of Abundance. For this you should improve in combat and agriculture including managing a farm and exploring a religious medieval world.

title: Lenrual
description: Dive into a small, dense open world with cryptic puzzles, weird interactions and interesting characters. Will you fit in? Join in divine communion? Or become something of your own!

title: Fight For America
description: Gear up, soldier - it’s time to reclaim freedom!

title: Heavy Front
description: "Heavy front" is a Japanese eschatological painting style, classic chess and card game with two core playing methods. Free skills, as well as arms restraint and matching, start your eschatological journey.

title: Fight For America: Fire Guns DLC
description: Ignite the battlefield and watch your enemies burn!

title: Fight For America: Golden Gun DLC
description: Go for gold with the ultimate all-around weapon!

title: Fight For America: Ice Guns DLC
description: Freeze the battlefield and shatter your enemies!

title: Fight For America: Iron Patriot DLC
description: Suit up and dominate the battlefield!

title: Fight For America: Zap Gun DLC
description: Shock the battlefield with electrifying power!

title: Bult: Hunting Simulator
description: BULT: Hunting Simulator is a hunting simulation game focused on waterfowl hunting. The game features a realistic shooting model based on ballistic calculations, dynamic bird behavior driven by an AI ecosystem, and tools such as decoys, calls, and a hunting boat. Players explore natural wetland environments influenced by weather, time of day, and seasonal activity

title: Skyblock Infinite
description: A datapack for Minecraft based on the original Skyblock map, which creates full world generation in the style of the original map.

title: This Winter of Ours
description: Alone as two, together as one - A fantasy/yuri visual novel telling the story of two girls traversing a snow covered forest and growing closer.

title: Scare Girl
description: A Scary game In The Forest And Your Trying To Collect 10 Treasure Chest To Open A Door

title: Beach Runner
description: Beach Runner is a casual runner game. Move the block/player so you dont fall into the water. If you touch the water will you start from the begining/start point. Complete the level and start the next level.

title: TCM Racing 2
description: A car sandbox game with no true goals laid out. It's up for you to decide what you want to do!

title: Birds and Nuts
description: "Birds and Nuts" is a game where you move the bird left and right to drop nuts. If you match 3 or more nuts of the same type, they will disappear. Will you be able to keep collecting nuts in various situations, such as rolling nuts and birds that get in your way?

title: My Sexy Neighbour 2
description: Run a spicy blog, take crazy dares from your fans, and sneak around your neighborhood to deliver the wildest content online. From naughty pranks to full-on adult missions — it's all about cash, chaos, and keeping it sexy. Don't get caught.

title: Civics Scribble
description: Test your knowledge of U.S. Civics while drawing lines for the inquisitive Mr. Apple to roll on or bounce off of to navigate challenges such as spikes, bouncy blocks and teleporters. Make your way through 96 levels across nine scenic locations based on real-life state and National Parks.

title: Console War Giant
description: Console War Giant is a turn-based management game that puts you in charge of a young company producing video game consoles! The gaming industry is still in its infancy. A place under the sun is yours to claim!

title: Pizza Knight: Out To Deliver
description: Ride through explosive medieval streets on your pizza-powered scooter! Smash knights, dodge fire-breathing bats, and deliver piping-hot pizzas to wizards, goblins, and bizarre royalty! Loot crazy weapons, upgrade your scooter with absurd gadgets, and become an unstoppable delivery legend!

title: Otar Island
description: Farm on Otar Island, mine, raise animals, fish, build, and progress through crafting; uncover the island’s secrets as you solve puzzles, raise magical Otars, and challenge the dungeons. Build your island from the ground up and grow it solo or with friends.

title: Surviving Purge
description:
Surviving Purge is a gay (bara) Tower Defence in which you play as an inferior human fighting to survive amongst other races from different galaxies!

Meet a host of various gay characters, all as sexy as they are horny!

Fight enemy armies by making them jerk and spend your hard-earned battlefield credits to upgrade your soldiers!

Experience a rich story in a post-apocalyptic world!

Manage a secret base and unlock new soldiers and new skills for your army!
Unlock numerous animated sex scenes, and jerk off to your heart's content!

title: Pripyat 0
description: Chernobyl has broken down. As radiation rains down upon you, the world starts rapidly mutating. You've gotten stuck in a nightmarish loop. Can you correctly spot the anomalies on time and get to safety? Or will you become one with the zone?

title: A Taste of Home
description:
Horror Game Movie in this time is いえのあじ A taste of home (Horror Game)

A taste of home is a short exploration-based horror game set in the Japanese countryside.
Keita must keep the promise with his mother. He must not make friends. He must not go outside. He must not speak to anyone. But Keita breaks his promise with his mother and goes to play at his friend's house.

That was the beginning of everything.

title: Yondel
description: Yondel is an endless survival RPG set in a limitless world you can shape and conquer. Craft, build, and brave the depths of underground dungeons in search of power and secrets.

title: Egg Maiden
description: Your dream- to become a traveling merchant. The problem? You've noone to manage your hotel your parents left you five years ago. In this world, those who tread the line of poverty become slaves for the wealthy. You've finally saved up enough for your own to manage your hotel, but life had different plans. A slave fell into your lap. She's a little odd though, just a little. She lays eggs that hatch into monster girls?

title: Hellish Fright & Burgers
description: A 2D sit n' survive game inspired by the likes of FNAF with a focus on cooking mechanics akin to Papa's Pizzeria. This game was originally made for the Toxic Terror Gamejam.

title: My Wife Wants to Be a Professional Cosplayer?!
description: Your wife's almost thirty, and she loves cosplay more than anything. So this year, she made a vow: to try her hand at becoming a professional cosplayer and take the internet by storm! And you... Well, as her husband, it's your duty to help your hot wife fulfill her dreams!

title: Arcane Merchant
description: Open your own shop in the heart of a Medieval Fantasy realm! Stock your shelves with everything from potions and swords to mysterious crystals and legendary artifacts. Set your prices, earn your customers' trust and become the richest merchant in the town!

title: Pleasure Cruise
description: You will meet various female characters on a luxury cruise ship. Most of them have character flaws and you need to use super powers to make them admit their mistakes.

title: Onna Sennyuu Sousakan no Hentai Chiiku: Shoufu no You ni Midareru Yakumo
description: Undercover agent Yakumo’s mission takes a dark turn when the organization she’s infiltrating already knows who she is. Captured and subjected to brutal “training,” she must endure, adapt, and survive — or risk losing herself completely as they twist her into their perfect double agent.

title: ELbab
description: ELbab is a pixel-art roguelite set in an endless library. Choose tiles to progress through dungeon-like paths and enjoy a build-crafting experience similar to ARPG planning tools. All battles are automated, letting you relax with coffee, videos, or even other games while refining your build.

title: Seina: a Tale Of Spirits
description: Seina: A Tale of Spirits is a cozy fantasy adventure about Mika, a young girl searching for her lost cat, Seina. Her journey leads her into a peaceful, hand-painted world filled with cute animal spirits, ancient shrines, and quiet magic.

title: Rebel Infernal Path
description: Rebel Infernal Path is a turn-based, command-driven 3D hack-and-slash RPG. Choose from 10 classes to form a party of 4 heroes and 4 summoned monsters. Battle through dazzling dungeons and vast open fields to overthrow a tyrant. Defeat his minions, craft powerful gear, and conquer all 6 stages.

title: Forgot
description: You are trapped at home in an endless loop. Remember your surroundings and watch out for anomalies, if you ever want to leave.

title: Hands of Victory
description: Use every trick up your sleeve to outwit, outplay and outscore everyone in the most cut-throat poker-based showdown ever. Play and face a gallery of gusty bluffers, ruthless card skarks and cunning cheaters.

title: Lost Ember: Legendary Souls
description:
Legendary Souls is an expansion of Lost Ember’s world into a new and open map that you can explore freely.

It features all the playable animals from the main game and you’ll need them all in order to get around the different biomes, climb massive mountain ridges, search for forgotten memories deep in the lake and see the world from high above.

Help more lost embers make their way to the legendary City of Light by helping them understand their past through the new Soul Quest side missions.

title: Color Splash: Butterflies
description: Color Splash: Butterflies is a charming and relaxing puzzle game that will lift your spirits and take You into the world of adorable butterflies and art. Venture into the gallery, where you will find many extraordinary and colorful butterflies paintings.

title: Kaidou ni Kisu
description:
A story constantly demands to choose between two choices.

Four men and women who had known each other via the internet had met and gone through several offline meetings. At the inn they are staying, they meet a mysterious girl, Hiro.

As they gradually deepen their relationship with her, the protagonist fell in love with such a girl.

During the limited days of the offline meeting,
A pleasant and elated time slowly passes.

...Nevertheless, no matter how leisurely it is,
The day of parting will definitely come.

"...I won't let that happen."

There is only one choice entrusted to you.

A story with only one turning point.

Is it white...? Or is it black...?

As those colors are placed upon, you will see what lies within those "gray eyes'' for the first time.

title: The Vanishing Train
description: The Vanishing Train is a psychological horror game where you work as a train driver on a rural Japanese railway line.

title: Quintillion Quest
description: A fantasy-themed run-based active incremental game

title: Bob To The Top
description: Bob to the Top is sound like Hop to the top. This is a Rage PhysicBase Platformer where you use mouse to control everything. Swing, Jump, and Stick your tongue to reach the top.

title: Whispers Beyond
description:
Whispers Beyond is a semi-cooperative deduction game set in a dark fantasy world where a restless Spirit guides a circle of Inquisitors to solve a murder. Uncover the suspect, location, and object of fate by interpreting the Spirit’s visions and whispers; surreal visual and audio clues that reveal fragments of the truth.

Work together… but only those who read the signs best will truly see beyond the veil.

Choose your role:
- The Spirit: Communicate without words. Send abstract visions, offer whispers as audio clues, or bestow extra signs to guide the living.

- The Inquisitor: Interpret the Spirit’s clues to uncover the truth. Use your perceptions to evaluate and wager on others’ choices for an advantage.

Features:
- Online multiplayer for up to 8 players
- Solo play with AI companions
- Adjustable difficulty, customize: inspirations, perceptions, hand size, timers, and more

title: Walking With Dinosaurs
description: This is a BBC developed educational game about dinosaurs for Windows 95

title: Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon - Sanctuary of Sarras
description: Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon - Sanctuary of Sarras is a major expansion for the dark fantasy open-world RPG, adding a new underwater-themed region, storyline, and quests. It focuses on the lore of Nimue and rebels defying King Arthur, featuring new creatures and gear scaled for high-level characters.

title: RTS Hero
description: I want to make RTS (real time strategy) both approachable and deep. Taking direct control of a hero feels natural, and swapping is instant! Pick different heroes with unique abilities, playstyles, and buildings! This RTS has simple design with deep strategy, SinglePlayer, Online: Co-Op and Versus!

title: Opona
description: The reality TV show Popworld is a one-way ticket to pop stardom, and Mia and Noah came here to win! Fight your way through turn-based dance battles (and a whole lot of drama) in this hand-drawn idol adventure game.

title: Business Simulator
description: Business simulator is a simple economic simulator. Making their way forward, the player builds the future of their character, earning money and respect, buying real estate, cars, and climbing the career ladder.

title: VA-11 HALL-A Prototype
description:
The original prototype of VA-11 HALL-A: Cyberpunk Bartender Action, featuring unique content not in the main game and its demos.

In this world, corporations reign supreme, all human life is infected with nanomachines designed to oppress them, and terrifying White Knights ensure that everyone obeys the laws.

But, this is not about those people.

You are a bartender at VA-11 HALL-A, affectionately nicknamed "Valhalla." Although it is just a small bar downtown, it attracts the most fascinating people this side of dystopia. Keep your clients lubricated and you will be made privy to the most interesting stories.

title: King of Spies
description: “King of Spies” is a political spy-thriller visual novel and yuri dating sim. You play as Kelly Bond, a former USAF Intelligence Officer turned political espionage specialist.

title: Dverghold
description: When the Dwarves of Dverghold awakened something ancient beneath the isle of Rekestt, King Sterren sent word across the Shattered Sea: brave the haunted depths, or let the darkness rise. Oldschool dungeon crawler with turn-based combat and atmospheric soundtrack by Dungeon Synth artist Splendorius.

title: Boars in Rome
description: Boars in Rome is a parkour adventure game set in dystopian Rome. Master momentum based traversal and make your own path through ruined districts, decaying megastructures, and historical preserves.

title: Better Than Us
description: Better Than Us is a sci-fi narrative game about secrets, deception, and what happens when a few people hoard most of the world's wealth. By maintaining a complex web of lies, you'll convince the freakishly ultra-rich you belong among them long enough to take what they treasure most: their stuff.

title: Catgirl Bloodhunt
description: Catgirl is dying and needs blood fast ʕ!!≧ᴥ≦ʔ Hunt down cute critters + steal their life-force. In this puzzle/shooter game, the only puzzle is the slippery floor ʕ ᵔ⩊ᵔ ʔ

title: Petunia's Purgatory
description: Petunia’s Purgatory is a creepy-cute, idle-farming game that lives at the bottom of your screen. Plant seeds that grow into horrifying crops, sacrifice animals for blood, and summon assistants to help you run your farm. Manage your sanity while you try to appease the Elder God!

title: Everyday Devil
description:
A short, linear story game revolving around fragments of a random demon guy's life.

The scattered pieces of memory are short, and somewhat disjointed... it's mostly a lot of walking and talking. The style of it may be a little different between each vignette, depending on Cecil's feelings at the time.

It's a strange world, full of darkness. But it's just everyday life for him. I hope you understand.

title: There's No Differences: Santa
description: Can you find the differences between the two festive images?

title: Teleportal
description: This is a side-scrolling puzzle action game with a swapping theme. The selling points of this game are the fast-paced action that comes from swapping, the exhilaration of using swaps to think one or two moves ahead to solve puzzles, and the new fighting style that utilizes the environment, such as the protagonist being unable to attack enemies, but switching places with them when they fire bullets and defeating them with their own bullets.

title: Turn It Around
description: Solve puzzles by turning the maze around. "Turn It Around" is a gravity-based puzzle game where you'll need to rotate the scene left or right to slide the balls to the goal. Navigate through increasingly challenging levels with a variety of evolving mechanics.

title: Treasure Hunter
description: While searching for treasure in an ancient castle, an explorer is chased by shadow knights and skeletons and tries to survive.

title: Tower Defense
description: Protect the castle towers from dark forces. Use a battle mage and bonuses. Upgrade weapons and bonuses.

title: The Alley
description: A first-person psychological horror game where you explore a maze-like Korean alley, photograph and identify supernatural 'Demon Traces' from realistic illusions, and escape while evading a relentless ghost.

title: Love Limit
description:
In an effort to support her sister's future career as a matchmaker, Eiren Reeves agrees to a blind date her sister sets up. Several hours later, when her date's a no show...

The planet is invaded!?

But wait... the invader looks rather familiar? No, it couldn't be. There's no way Eiren's date is an alien invader that just put the fate of the world in her hands, right? Unless...?

title: Torii: Beyond the Gates
description: The spirit realm has broken. Your brother has gone missing. Forge the path you were destined for. Explore the gates and find out why there has been broken links inside the spirit realm. Battle, discover and find the secrets, and make new connections in a beautiful hand-drawn 2D style.

title: Tiger Simulator
description: Tiger Simulator is a casual high-score game. You're a tiger that has been set loose in a big city! How many humans can you send flying before time runs out? Run and jump around a sprawling city and attack all sorts of people to get points; attack one right after the other to get bonus points!

title: The Sweet Spot
description: The Sweet Spot is a cozy horror game where you work the last shift at an 80s ice cream shop. Make ice cream, serve customers and watch out for strange things.

title: Maze Creep!!
description: A satire co-op horror game where players aim to reach the end of an infinite series of mazes, evading the all-hearing Maze Creep and various other threats.

title: The Outlast Trials: Project Messiah
description: Season 5: Project Messiah will include a new Prime Asset villain, a new map: Resort, Winter Kills and more!

title: Motoracing
description: Motoracing is a racing game. Pick a motorbike, enter Quick Race or start a new career, and aim to finish first. Use tight cornering and bold moves to push rivals aside. Tweak resolution and visual effects for smooth play. Grab a bike and hit the track today.

title: Sbeve
description: A game of immense adventure and fun excavation potential.

title: Rainforest Solitaire
description: Enjoy the addictive beautiful matching solitaire in the tropical forest and show your card skills!

title: Preserve: Ice Age
description: Expand Preserve into the Ice Age! Shape frozen landscapes, guide glaciers, and nurture prehistoric megafauna in harmony with your evolving ecosystem.

title: Indian Legends Solitaire
description: Discover the treasure of the lost city playing new awesome solitaire card game.

title: Tableau Vivant
description: Multiple spot the difference scenes, with unusual gameplay mechanics.

title: Puzzle Art: Reptiles
description: Minimalist, relaxing, picture logic, art - puzzle game with reptiles.

title: HoloSeeker
description: A deckbuilding roguelite RPG featuring hololive members.

title: Saylor Anime Puzzle Boys & Girls
description: Saylor Anime puzzle Boys & is simplictic jigsaw puzzle game with anime girls and boy images to solve

title: La Lellenda de la Cerda DX
That's Not Your Neighbor
description: Spot the Doppelgangers! Take on the role of a doorman in your building. Year 1955, stay sharp, stay alert. Remember, kindness is key—treat your true neighbors with care while keeping the doppelgangers at bay. Can you keep your building safe? The challenge awaits!

title: Zoboomafoo: Animal Kids
description: Zoboomafoo Animal Kids is an educational children’s game based on the Zoboomafoo television series, where players help care for young animals alongside Zoboo, Chris, and Martin at Animal Junction. Through interactive activities, the game introduces animal facts while encouraging skills such as sorting, color recognition, critical thinking, logic, and creativity.

title: Codex Mortis
description: In Codex Mortis, Death is your weapon. Mix five schools of dark magic, unleash devastating spell synergies, and raise undead armies in this necromantic bullet hell. Infinite builds, solo or co-op – embrace the forbidden and dominate. 100% AI-driven development.

title: Gate Guard Simulator
description: Step into the boots of the castle guard. Inspect seals, expose smugglers and reveal witches. You decide who enters and who’s turned away. Will you uphold the law, or break it for your own gain?

title: The Darkside Detective: Backside of the Moon
description: You'd think that after 20+ cases, there'd be no crime left in Twin Lakes - but that's not how crime works, rookie. Six new mind-melting mysteries await Detective McQueen and Officer Dooley - just as soon as they get the mustard out of Dooley's gun.

title: Tackle Box: The First Catch
description: Tackle Box: The First Catch is a fishing-action hybrid where you have to fight every catch with your bare hands.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector - Black Legion
description: The Black Legion are the latest faction to invade Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector. Fifteen new units bring the Warmaster’s wrath to the galaxy and devastation to all who stand in their way.

title: Tiny Kitchen: Pizza Edition
description: Sauce it, top it, drop it! Build pizzas with flying ingredients and bouncy physics in this charming, low-pressure cooking sim. Tiny Kitchen: Pizza Edition is part chaos, part calm — all cozy.

title: Idle Tycoon Manufacturing
description: Idle Tycoon Manufacturing is an industrial management game where your workers are literal monsters. Build, upgrade and automate your factory to transform a rusty heap of scrap into a thriving empire. Handle unexpected events, unlock new technologies and make the Monstercoins rain.

title: Thrifty Business
description: Run your very own thrift shop in this laid-back management sim! Sort through boxes to find hidden treasures and arrange nostalgic displays of clothes, antiques, toys & more. Befriend the regulars, help with their requests and expand your store into a hub for the local community!

title: Verdant
description: Accompany Sprout on his journey through the green post-apocalyptic world of Verdant. Survive the beautiful yet harsh environment by building camps and upgrading your gear. Balance life and death literally in your hand with your powers and uncover their connection to the downfall of humanity.

title: Find Your Words
description: Find your community at summer camp, one friendship at a time. Take a beat, enjoy a breath of fresh air - all while playing at the beach, strolling in the woods, and dancing with friends. This short cozy game was created by two dads, celebrating their kids’ journeys to find their voices.

title: CatchMaker
description: Embark on a cozy, 3D adventure where you catch bugs... and match them for perfect romance! Explore a world abuzz with cute critters and help them find their perfect date through playful minigames. Befriend the locals, uncover your past and embrace your destiny as steward of a magical island.

title: Pandemonium: Merge!
description: Cozy up by the campfire and merge ingredients in a sizzling pan to cook tastier creations! This silly physics-based merge game is easy to play, difficult to beat - Can you merge your way to the ultimate campfire feast?

title: ReStory: Chill Electronics Repairs
description: Run a quaint electronics repair shop in mid-2000s Tokyo. Grow your business by carefully restoring iconic video game consoles, cell phones, music players, and other nostalgic devices. Talk to customers, hear their stories, and see how your decisions impact both their lives and your shop.

title: Echoes Untold
description: Echoes Untold is a wordless, space-brutalist adventure where a lone female traveler explores a realm shaped by time distortion, hidden timelines, and ancient philosophical atmosphere. Players unlock unique movement abilities, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover the truth behind the Void.

title: Bloodspill
description: Bloodspill is a fast-paced, pvp retro fps with one hit combat, featuring classic gamemodes like deathmatch, capture the flag and conquest!

title: Wyrmspace Tactics
description: Join a crew of traumatised space pirates in this tile tactics card game as you commit faster-than-light heists! Push your luck and play your cards right to break in and out of freighter ships with the bag! The more you learn about your crew's past, the more memories you unlock as new cards to play.

title: Signs of Danger
description: Drop onto dangerously reactive alien planets where every pixel is physically simulated. Craft wild guns and abilities that melt, burn, freeze and blow up hostile creatures or destroy entire levels - solo or with up to three friends in chaotic 4-player online and couch co-op.

title: Enfant
description: A 3D action-adventure/metroidvania about an elephant looking for his herd. Explore a vibrant, decaying world, uncover remnants of humanity, and interact with a quirky cast of evolved intelligent animals.

title: Bad Badger
description: You're a bad Honey Badger. Smash out of your enclosure and wreak havoc across an Open-Zoo sandbox. Break, escape, sneak, smash, steal, ride, trick & taunt. BE BAD!

title: Odd Jobs: On The Lot
description: A physics-powered, 1-4 player co-op set in a vibrant Australian carpark. Teammates race to complete a rotating roster of odd jobs avoiding hazards and losing wages. Manage chaos collecting stray trolleys, unloading delivery trucks, cleaning up trash, or delivering groceries directly to car boots.

title: Factory 95
description: Factory 95 is a retro Windows inspired puzzle-automation game about making a slide show factory… in a slide show! Manage your space, make increasingly complex slides and worry about Y2K in this minimalistic factory builder.

title: Go Phish
description: Go Fish or go homeless. In this rogue-ish debt-builder, pay your rent by phishing a target in a supercharged version of the classic card game. Crack your victims password in a dynamic dialogue system, then use your loadout of unlockable suits and items to hack their PC and drain their savings.

title: Bento Blocks
description: Craft delicious lunch boxes in this cozy-yet-challenging ingredient-cutting puzzle game.

title: A Date with Death 2: Remnants
description: Train, chat, and flirt your way through the Underworld in this romantic story-driven chat simulator. Create your own Grim Reaper, connect with your team through text and video calls, and decide who you are when the past no longer defines you in a sequel to A Date with Death!

title: Hidden Around the World
description: Travel the world in this cozy hidden-object adventure with decoration and discover the charm of cities like Tokyo, Paris, New York, and many more!

title: Treetopians
description: Treetopians is a cozy colony simulator where players build vertical villages in the treetops and care for a growing community of villagers with unique needs and personalities.

title: Mirror of Heaven
description: The Qi has awakened demons, they wreak havoc on our world. You traverse ancient realms with the aid of the "Kunlun Mirror," embarking on a journey of cultivation and acension to gods.

title: Scramble Knights Online
description: Welcome to Scramble Knights Online! Embark together with friends on bite-sized, Zelda-inspired quests in the shared online kingdom of Terracotta! Venture across an archipelago filled with dangerous enemies, quaint towns, puzzling dungeons, and challenges suited for a knight-in-training.

title: Mutter
description: In the midst of war, a far more personal horror takes root at home. Your mother is becoming a monster. Survive, uncover the truth, and navigate a heartbreaking bond in this unique stop-motion narrative horror adventure.

title: Arm Around!
description: You are an arm. Yes, seriously, just an arm. And to be it you have to use your mouse. Oh, and everything is physics based. If it sounds hard it's because it is. Drag, jump, punch and arm around to... wait, what kind of a mission could a disembodied arm possibly have?

title: Retail Hell
description: A horror job simulator set in a convenience store in purgatory. Serve non human customers, fight collapsing inventory, survive curses, and uncover why your shift never ends.

title: Broken Arrow: Baltic Battalion
description: The first specialization DLC for Broken Arrow introduces the Baltic Battalion, a brand-new army specialization accessible to the U.S. faction.

title: Height
description: Height is a minimalist mech fighting game where the only way to damage your opponent is to jump on their head.

title: Headquarters: Cold War
description: Headquarters: Cold War is a fast-paced turn-based strategy game set in a hypothetical 1984 conflict between NATO and the USSR. Play as both sides and command helicopters, tanks, and infantry across 20 campaign missions and rewrite the outcome of modern history.

title: Dragooner
description: In the future the earth became an annoying place to live, because of the censors and the brain implants. Because of this, all your homies left the planet. It is up to you to go and find your homies and chill like the good days.

title: Built to Scale Solitaire
description: Take a load off your mind with Built to Scale Solitaire, a uniquely designed card game about building a musical scale, inspired by Zachtronics' solitaire games.

title: Panzer Corps 2: Allied Operations - Italy: Vol.1
description: Lead the Allied invasion of Sicily in the opening chapter of a grand trilogy. Command British and American forces across two converging campaigns, carry your veteran core army forward, and relive the historic push that broke open Fortress Europe.

title: Starship Troopers: Terran Command - The Eradicators
description: The Eradicators is the first Battle Group DLC for Starship Troopers: Terran Command, focusing exclusively on new Territory Mode content.

title: Terminator: Dark Fate - Defiance: Evolution
description: Evolution is the next major story expansion for Terminator: Dark Fate – Defiance, the gritty real-time strategy experience set in the dark future of Dark Fate.

title: Lucky Rabbit Club
description:
"How could you lose that? Don't you know how important it is?"

The Lucky Rabbit—a nightclub as famous as it is infamous, and named after its very owner. Drinking, drugs, dancing, all the stuff that makes the night life enticing and fills you with regret in the morning. Nina has regrets—but not over having a fun night. Rather, she regrets being so careless with one of her belongings. On her search to find it again, she returns to The Lucky Rabbit and the charmed owner himself. Another night of fun awaits her—but not for her.

Lucky Rabbit Club is a murdersim-styled visual novel with many point-and-click puzzle/adventure sections.
The game takes about 2 hours to complete. There are 11 endings, including a True Ending, and an unlockable Bonus Scene that will follow the True Ending. The game features an endings menu to help you keep track.

title: Red Bow: Strange Dream
description: Embark on an immersive adventure alongside Roh as she tries to break free from her strange dream. Red Bow: Strange Dream offers a nice 1 to 2 hours of engaging gameplay. Dive into a semi-open world filled with puzzles and navigate between different realms, uncover secrets, and encounter enigmatic entities. Unlock the path to awakening by diving deeper and unraveling the mysteries of this strange spirit world.

title: The Dark Curiosity
description: First-person sci-fi psychological horror set on a secret corporate station. Left alone to secure it, you navigate oppressive corridors where every sound, shadow and choice punishes. "Curiosity always leads you further than fear ever could."

title: Amairo Chocolate 3
description: It's been about one year since a young man came to Yunagicho. And in this town, he's met quite a few people. This is the story of his loving relationships with the wonderful women he has met. Let's do our best today, with both our familiar friends, and our new ones, too! ♪

title: Don't wake up
description: Play as Eli, a boy trapped in collapsing dreams. Explore surreal nightmares, solve eerie puzzles, and stay silent—every sound resets the dream.

title: Farm Life
description: "Farm Life" is an 3D arcade puzzle game that will transport you to the incredible world of farming! Simply click on the objects that match the required shapes, and you’ll progress through the levels!

title: FeedBack
description: This game offers a classic pixel art style, taking players on a nostalgic and charming adventure.

title: Flashbound
description: Sam agrees to help his friends by staying the night in their house while they leave for urgent business. Outside, a heavy rainstorm rages, with loud thunderclaps shaking the walls and creating an oppressive atmosphere.

title: Fluffy's Adventure
description: Fluffy's Adventure is a whimsical platformer where players guide Fluffy, a furry creature, through a magical land by walking, jumping, and using physics-based mechanics to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles.

title: Fuse
description: A cozy, 3D, puzzle platformer with a underlying story. Play as cute origami characters exploring a vast world through puzzles, combat and platforming. Fight your way past enemies and rid the world of the black tar.

title: Forest Survival
description: A 2D survival action game in which the player aims to survive by using a flashlight to illuminate the enemy.

title: Forever With You
description: Finding love isn't always easy. Within a limited time, manage your life and find someone you truly love.

title: Getting Over It with Your Body
description: You must learn to control your body, embrace the pain, endure the agony, reach the goal by any means necessary, and overcome the challenges together with your very own flesh!!!

title: Galaxy
description: An arcade game where the player controls a spaceship and defends against waves of enemy invaders. The goal is to survive as long as possible, achieve the highest score, and progress through increasingly difficult levels.

title: Geon
description: Geon is a turn-based JRPG set in a not so distant future where the past is seemingly forgotten; ruled by the supreme overlord only known as "George". Discover ancient history and uncover mysteries as you are forced to face George and fight to save the world from strange things from beyond the stars.

title: Ghost Shooter
description: Ghost Shooter is a shooting range type microgame where you shoot ghosts that randomly appear on screen. You have 3 lives which you lose if any ghost stays too long on screen. The goal is to score as high as possible.

title: Golf Island
description: Golf Island is a casual arcade golf game with randomly generated levels. Tee off in vibrant, ever-changing courses for endless fun and fresh challenges. Perfect your swing and enjoy the ultimate pick-up-and-play golf experience!

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Showtime
description:
After years of silence, Freddy's finally reopens to the public and they need a new night guard.

Welcome to Freddy Fazbear's Showtime Pizzeria! A place for kids and grownups alike, where fantasy and fun come to life. When you're not getting food poisoned from our half-prepared pizza or losing an entire paycheck from the arcade games, you're probably watching our state-of-the-art animatronic band perform on stage. Although watching them during the day is a treat, you won't be watching them during the day...

During the night, the animatronics become a bit erratic (you could even say quirky) and we need someone to watch over them. Our shoestring budget can't afford them breaking anything (or themselves even), so your job is to reset them anytime you see them active. Just be sure they don't get into your office. Our last night guard didn't exactly quit after all...

title: Humanity Echo: Cyberpunk Tactical RPG
description:
Humanity Echo is a tactical turn-based RPG set in the rusted harbour slums of Odesa, 2044.

You play as an Engineer - not a soldier - using sabotage, environmental manipulation, and raw intellect to outsmart a corporate machine. In this high-tech, low-life world, every explosion carries physical weight and every shot leaves a unique acoustic imprint.

title: Feather Land
description: Feather Land is an idle game that blends productivity tools with a study/work companion. Enjoy calming music, hatch eggs, collect cute birds, and watch a quiet space into a landscape full of life, bringing peace and focus to your study or work sessions.

title: Machick 2: Journey to the East
description: A new journey to the east begins with 4 new chickens, 30 new accessories, 4 new stages in this upcoming free update to Machick 2.

title: Unknown Faces
description: Unknown Faces is a 6-15 player multiplayer social deduction game inspired by the Mafia party game, reimagined with darker themes and deeper strategy. Lies, manipulation, and betrayal fuel every round as players deceive, outsmart, and expose one another in a fight for survival.

title: Gnomophobia
description: Gnomophobia is an unsettling escape-horror game where gnomes stalk you through a themed forest, staying frozen only while you’re watching them. Follow the chain of visual clues hidden in notes, outsmart the gnomes’ relentless pursuit, and find the way out of the forest!

title: Holiday Harry
description: He’s evil on a shelf… Holiday horror creeps into your home, and he’s waiting right above your fireplace.

title: Overrust
description: Overrust is a 2D narrative survival game set in a cyberpunk universe with a horror atmosphere. The player must use stealth, reasoning, and exploration to overcome environmental puzzles.

title: Fortnite OG: Chapter 1 Season 6
description: Relive Battle Royale from its beginnings in Chapter 1 Season 6. Drop back in and explore the OG map, collect OG loot, and relive OG seasons!

title: Silicium
description: Silicium is a multiplayer sandbox survival game where you are a robot stranded on a mining planet. Explore, extract, craft, and kill. Mine your quota for corporate, or die trying. There are no rules, death is permanent and the company doesn't care who lives. Team up or eliminate the competition.

title: Lucid Falls
description: Manipulate gravity, space and time, and survive terrifying nightmares in a deeply atmospheric lucid dream. Facing terrifying creatures, and solving challenges that bend reality, every moment reveals more of the dark truth behind Lucid Falls.

title: Grafted
description: In this dark and twisted, top-down action roguelike your body is your inventory. Fight and grow stronger by grafting weapons and items with unique shapes onto you. Your space must be managed carefully to create a build strong enough to face even the most gruesome of enemies.

title: Virtue and a Sledgehammer
description: Go back to your hometown and tear it down with a sledgehammer in this narrative exploration game. Confront your past in a devastating story about feeling like you no longer belong in the place you grew up.

title: Astromine
description: Astromine is a co-op survival game about scavenging fully destructible voxel planets. Land on planets and gather enough materials to fight off alien creatures, build structures and spaceships, and conquer the solar system

title: Soundgrass
description: You find yourself on a planet where plants emit sound. Sound and music are also your main gameplay mechanic. Experience the world of sound as never done before.

title: UN:Me
description: UN:Me is an adventure game where you guide a girl harboring multiple souls within her body through an unsettling mental labyrinth, engaging in dialogue with each soul while making the harrowing choice of which to keep and which to erase in your escape attempt.

title: Mirria
description: An atmospheric casual puzzle game where players navigate a strange cryptic world that blurs the line between dream and reality. Using inspection and memory, uncover hidden anomalies between mirrored worlds.

title: Iron Colony
description: After crash-landing on a mysterious island, confront hostile robotic creatures in intense combat and strategic duels. Explore forgotten ruins, uncover secrets, and fight for survival in a world where corrupted technology dominates every corner.

title: TIE Fighter: Total Conversion
description: A total conversion mod for Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance that ports the original TIE Fighter game into the engine, and offers some new bonus content as well.

title: CorgiSpace
description: CorgiSpace is a collection of 8-bit games that have short legs on purpose. This anthology includes more than a dozen action, adventure, arcade, and puzzle games, and each can be thoroughly explored in under an hour.

title: Guns and Nuns: Storming Hell
description: Demons are not the danger, you are the danger!!! play as Angelica Amadeus, a nun with the power of faith and guns. Slay demons at your heart's content on bizarre stages with strange gravity fields. Get highscores to unlock more stages and weapons and teach those filthy demons their place.

title: Pesky Orcs!
description: In "Pesky Orcs!" you take part in medieval fantasy battles between ancient foes: Orcs and humans. Dive into a unique mix of Autobattler, RTS and Roguelike in real retro pixelart fashion!

title: Frog Sqwad
description: Storm The Sewers for the glory of the Swamp King! Swing, jump, catapult your friends, and eat eat EAT until you grow into a humongous Megafrog. A co-op extraction puzzle-platformer for up to 8 players. Squad up with your frog friends for a friendslop party in this slapstick physics adventure!

title: The Plant Shop
description: A cozy horror game where you craft plants for late-night customers while you manage a small plant shop. Expand your plant collection, upgrade your shop & grow your business.

title: Hierosaga Overture
description: Enter the tomb of the Pharaess and tactically maneuver through a plethora of challenges and monster-filled gauntlets in this homage to strategy roguelikes of the 90s.

title: Express No. 6
description: Thirty minutes to New Year. You're a train passenger. Something awful is unfolding- stop the train and survive. Look through the camera- it reveals the truth.

title: Forgotten Faiths
description: The story of a merchant house in a world on the mend. Their leader sifts through the ashes of history for lost secrets. Embark on expeditions to support the house and search for lost artifacts. A mix of visual novel and RPG mechanics.

title: Three Feet From Death
description: Enter into what might be the most insane gaming challenge created - Three Feet from Death. A precision platformer with bullet-hell elements, responsive, fast paced gameplay, and a skill ceiling that even masters of the genre may spend their lives reaching for. Good luck.

title: Balloon Bros
description: A chaotic co-op airship adventure! Team up with 2–4 players, each controlling a different part of the ship at the same time. Navigate a wild, procedural world full of obstacles, surprises, and skyborne chaos. Hold together… or crash spectacularly!

title: Derealization
description: A visual novel about a girl who escaped from a psychiatric hospital. She is pursued by a strange being from another world — and it seems she’s not the only one who can see visitors from beyond.

title: Obey the Insect God
description: Step foot into the lair of the Insect God...if you dare. Face brutal enemies in pulse-pounding combat with digitized sprites that harken back to your favorite controversial fighting game from the ’90s that your mom’s hairdresser’s kid let you play that one time. The castle awaits…

title: Blurry Shopping
description: Did you think going to the supermarket was easy? Ha! Welcome to Blurry Shopping, the ultimate simulator of getting lost between endless aisles, fluorescent lights, and products that all look the same… because they literally are, at least for you.

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Winter Ball
description: The 20th free update for Disney Dreamlight Valley brings new content inspired by Disney's Cinderella - including the titular princess herself as a villager, new Winter and Christmas-themed events, the new community feature DreamTeams and starts the Winter Warmth Star Path.

title: Aldradah: Tome of Mist Realm
description: Aldradah: Tome of Mist Realm​​ is a fantasy-themed, turn-based tactical dungeon crawler. By harnessing ancient ritual magic, summon Phantoms from beyond to form your expedition party. Venture into the Alda Mists—where no mortal has ever tread—and unravel ancient mysteries concealed within.

title: The Last Gift
description: A Christmas horror story about a thief who encounters a ghost in an “empty” house.

title: Felicity's Door
description: As Tom and Felicity fall asleep and slip into dreamland, they find themselves in a strange, unfamiliar bedroom filled to the brim with toys and gadgets… Join them and Mi-chan on adventures where you will have to show off your musical prowess to help souls in need!

title: Safo and The Moon Warriors
description: In a world where the sun no longer rises, Prince Safo must rescue his sister from Argus, a mysterious one-eyed monster. Joined by diverse companions, this adventure RPG features beautiful illustrations and a novel-like story as players uncover secrets in this sunless world.

title: Sheol no Mori: Tasogare no Majuuzukai
description: Inspired by “Kodoku Poison,” an ancient Chinese sorcery, this game combines “Kodoku Poison, Beast Alchemy, and Match-3 Puzzles.” Select a few beasts from the herd to turn into familiars, pit your familiars against the beasts, and fuse familiars together to create giant beasts.

title: R-Type Dimensions III
description: Building on the legacy of R-Type Dimensions and R-Type Dimensions EX, Dimensions III has been completely re-envisioned with cutting-edge visuals and sounds, expanded gameplay modes, and a range of new features designed to deliver the most definitive modern edition of R-Type’s classic era.

title: Kingdom's Return: Time-Eating Fruit and the Ancient Monster
description: A kingdom-rebuilding adventure filled with action and strategy! Kingdom's Return is an action RPG where you'll adventure to restore your fallen kingdom. Collect materials in 2D side-scrolling adventure stages, then use them in the strategy part to rebuild your kingdom and power up your characters!

title: Yuletide Regicide
description: A dead Santa Claus right before Christmas is never a good sign. Interrogate the North Pole suspects to solve the murder and figure out how to save the festive season in this short dark comedy visual novel whodunnit.

title: RevolverRouge
description: RevolverRouge is a game that combines overlooking shooter roguelike action with deck-building roguelike. Use ammunition and ampules that are randomly loaded into your chamber to shoot down the oncoming enemies.

title: Synchronity
description:
This game is a puzzle game with three axes in mind.

It has a rigid specification of merging blocks from a small number to a larger number.

The game was created with a focus on the world view including BGM of my own composition, and level design incorporating various interesting aspects.

Furthermore, the development engine is a self-made engine and was adjusted from scratch.

title: Let's Fight!! Nokachan
description: Let's fight. Nokachan is a action game heavily focused on boss battles, with an emphasis on score attack.Let's Enjoy character animation & boss battle.all in a classic, hand-drawn 2D style.

title: Make Friends
description: This is a friend-making experience game that you play by swinging a mannequin's head.

title: Cthuloop
description:
Loathsomeness waits and dreams in the deep.

Madness. Frenzy. Loopiness. Succumb to them in the depths of a looping nightmare.

title: Jaws: Retro Edition
description:
This can’t be! There has never been a Great White in these warm tropical waters before, NEVER! This is more than a coincidence…this shark appears to be possessed…as if it’s hunting you down… like it’s personal. You’d better prepare yourself and strike back before it’s too late.

Will you use the mini-sub, sea plane, sailboat, or just scuba gear? Perhaps it won’t even matter. Remember, this is some kind of unbelievably powerful eating machine you’re dealing with.

Quick, grab your weapons, pack your explosives, and check your maps. It’s out there…you know it…and it’s coming for you. This is serious! This is the ultimate Jaws challenge, because this time it’s not over until only one of you is left alive.

title: Amphis Game
description:
A colorful snake puzzle game.

You can move the colorful double-headed snake (Amphisbaena).

And goal is to connect all the same colors on the stage.

title: Tri-bo
description:
One-button action with SPACE to jump!

Defeat the boss by ricocheting bullets fired from the boss!

title: Sonic X Shadow Generations: Day One Edition
description:
The day one edition includes:
- Base game
- Physical printed copy of Gerald Robotnik's journal
- Code for Sonic Adventure skin

title: Life of an NPC
description: An AI-directed town where anything can happen. Let your NPCs thrive, or turn them against each other. Each character has their own goals and desires and responds to events in real time.

title: Good Dreams
description: You are on vacation in a country house, but at night you live a real nightmare. Discover several endings that can help you get out of this bizarre dream.

title: Ratocalypse
description: A strategy RPG where you design the AI of your characters! The prince of a fallen kingdom, ruined by a zombie plague, investigates the capital overrun with the undead in search of hope to resolve the crisis.

title: StratDots RTS
description: StratDots is a fun strategy game about expanding your control and outsmarting opponents on a map of your choice.

title: Elpis
description:
A robot wakes up in the dark.
He moves forward by the light of scattered "stars".
He picks up "stars" and throws them to illuminate its surroundings, activate gimmicks, and defeat enemies.
As the robot progresses, he unravels the history of a lost civilization.

title: Suncraft
description: Another sun-filled day begins in this cozy pixel-art adventure. Gather resources, craft items, and upgrade tools to expand the land. Can you rebuild the grand Lighthouse and bring the village back to its golden days?

title: Click Cluck
description: A curious desktop chicken that wanders your screen, pecks around, naps peacefully, and brings cozy charm to your workspace.

title: King's Devotion
description: Experience a world broken by war with one hope of redemption. Follow the tale of a general whose loyalty is put to the test when his kingdom is thrown into shambles. Friends may become enemies, and enemies may turn to friends.

title: Car Parkour Together
description: A skill-based car parkour game where speed, reflexes, and chaos collide! Play solo or with a friend, use your special abilities to overcome challenging obstacles, provoke your partner, or team up for victory.

title: Butterfly Æffect: Papillons à Quatre Mains
