description: Butterfly Æffect is a multi-route visual novel inspired by bishoujo games and early 2000s American anime culture about love, lust, spite, violence, and nipping your problems in the bud.

title: Army of Darkness Doom 2 Total Conversion
description: Always dreamed of being Ash? Well buddy, here's your chance. Gun down skeletons in the graveyard. Hack apart Deadites in the Pit. Blow away Bad Ash at the windmill. To put it in the words of the help screen: "Be Ash and protect the town of Arthur and make your way home to S-Mart. Armed with a torch, shotgun, chainsaw, and Winchester, you'll have the best Doom add-on experience ever made." 'Nuff said.

title: Aliens Doom 3: Aliens vs Predator
description: Players play as Ripley, Hudson, Hicks, Vasquez, or the Doom marine as they battle Xenomorphs, Corporates (company soldiers), and Predators in a facility with the help of allied marines.

title: The Finals: Season 9 - Dragon Rising
description:
The Season 9 of The Finals includes:
- New Map: Fangwai City
- New Mode: Point Break
- New Progression: World Tour 2.0
- Reward System: Reward Coin

title: Gear.Club Unlimited 3
description: The Gear.Club series is back! Customize and set up your favourite cars to race at top speed along the roads of the French Mediterranean coast and Japan. Don't just win – show off your style!

title: City States: Medieval
description: You are the leader of a city-state in high medieval Europe. Expand your city through deep city-building systems, build a trade empire across the known world, and lead men to war to defend trade routes in a high-stakes struggle of global strategy and brutal tower defense warfare.

title: Love & Fool's Gold
description:
Love & Fool’s Gold is a choice-driven Wild West romance-mystery visual novel with an Eldritch horror twist.

You play as a nomadic bounty hunter, arriving in the town of Cortez Creek to chase a bounty, only to quickly discover that not everything is as it seems.

After meeting a cast of enigmatic characters, you're given a choice of who to partner up with to uncover the dark Eldritchian mystery that plagues this ill-fated town. But who do you choose? The Cowboy, the Bounty Hunter, or the Mysterious Outlaw? What does this mean for the desperate citizens of Cortez Creek? And is romance - or death - in the cards?

title: Climb Rusher
description:
​This game is an rage, hard platformer.

Good luck.

title: Heart Flipper: A House Flipper Dating Sim
description: Heart Flipper: A House Flipper Dating Sim is a visual novel that lets you date characters from the beloved renovation simulator. Mend their hearts with your choices, help through relaxing minigames, and find love… or stay single forever!

title: Winx Club: The Magic Is Back
description: Winx Club: The Magic is Back captures the essence of the Winx universe, delivering an enchanting experience with a mix of magical combat and puzzle-solving. Play as all six members of the Winx Club, each with their own magical abilities.

title: Without A Hitch
description: Without A Hitch is a co-op delivery game where you transport cargo across an apocalyptic landscape. Whether driving solo or in a convoy of 2 to 4 players, you must navigate chaotic hazards, scavenge vital parts, and escape from THEM. Can you survive Without A Hitch?

title: Edxn
description: Embark on a journey with Eva as she navigates the labyrinth of her mind, solving puzzles, battling inner demons, and exploring eerie landscapes in the haunting world of edxn. Uncover forgotten memories and navigate the delicate balance between sanity and despair in this immersive adventure.

title: Black Sailors
description: Command a fleet of formerly enslaved people who became pirates in Brazil’s Bay of All Saints. Challenge colonial oppression, fight for freedom, and rewrite Atlantic history in turn-based tactical naval battles.

title: Space Memory: Rodents
description: Cute, relaxing memory game where you match pairs of adorable rodents in space

title: Fortnite OG: Chapter 1 Season 7
description: OG takes it back to Chapter 1 Season 7! The Ice King has frozen the map, zoom around the frigid terrain on new ziplines, and take to the skies on the X-4 Stormwing.

title: Frog Knight
description:
Frog Knight is a precision platformer where every jump counts and every fall hurts.

You play as a cunning frog armed with a sentient sword. Together, you must escape an ancient, vertical pit by mastering the power of Bounce: hitting floating objects in the environment to launch yourself upward with speed and precision.

There are no checkpoints. One mistake can cost you minutes of progress, but also teach you to master the physics-based movement system. Along the way, you’ll unlock new mobility abilities that completely reshape how you navigate the world and recover from falls.

Combining dark fantasy pixel art with a light touch of humor, Frog Knight offers a gameplay experience that’s both punishing and satisfying, made for speedrunners, skilled players, and anyone who loves a good climb.

title: Furry Defenders​​
description: In Furry Defenders, where the Demon Clan covets the Dragon Veins and incites war among all races, you will play as Cynton, the Dragon Bloodline Warrior. Rally your allies and set masterful traps at crucial passes to outsmart the looming threat of the Demon Army.

title: From Ruins
description: A new-gen detective adventure combining deduction gameplay with a gripping story full of twists and turns. Gather clues, establish connections, and solve a series of increasingly challenging cases. Will you uncover the feud that began at the end of the world?

title: PinKeep
description: PinKeep is a pinball deckbuilding roguelite – use the ball and flippers to collect resources and defeat your enemies! Place buildings from your deck on the playfield to defend your Keep. Create powerful synergies to eradicate the hordes of attacking Knights!

title: Bonetox
description: A fast-paced arena shooter where you grind demons into piles of bones and meat. Choose your favorite weapon and unleash uncompromising carnage. Survive as long as you can, break your limits, and drown the arena in blood.

title: Rosaluna: Moonlit Vengeance
description: Four years have passed since a perpetual winter shrouded this reimagined, mystical North Vietnam. As Rosie, experience a deeply personal journey of emotional escalation and high-stakes battles in this visceral blend of real-time action and turn-based strategy.

title: Deified
description: Forge your strategy around powerful relics in this turn-based tactical roguelite. Choose your slots, manage their constraints, and face formidable bosses.

title: FPS Quest
description: An FPS where FPS is your health. If you play poorly, performance drops. Tweak settings on the fly, lower graphics, break the rules, and create glitches to survive.

title: Fortunato
description: Draw a pair of aces, use them as poker hands or to eliminate your opponents? A poker roguelike battle card game. Build a deck of jokers, defeat bosses, modify cards, and conquer challenges across the ever-changing islands. At the table of four, win by chips or remaining health, your call...

title: Potions, Please!
description: A cosy alchemy shop sim with a hint of RPG, a spoonful of sentient mushrooms, a dash of naughty llamas and a generous helping of morbid humour thanks to your late Aunty, who is patiently awaiting her resurrection from six feet under.

title: Mermaids Are Seafood
description: Gamble your blood and Credits in this incremental horror. Bet against suspected Mermaids and upgrade your luck with insider info. If you catch the wrong suspect, you'll cannibalise an innocent human.

title: Resonant Q
description: Resonant Q is a cosmic horror survival action game for 1–3 players, set on a dilapidated Orbital Ring. Ascend to the Orbital Ring, hunt anomalies, take loot back to an evolving base to craft new items to reach the stars.

title: Hero's Hour 2
description: Build grand cities, raise mighty armies, and fight massive battles to vanquish your foes in this turn-based strategy RPG auto battler. Powerful heroes at the head of unique factions bring endless possibilities as they lead armies of the dead, the living, and everything in between.

title: Crimson Freedom
description: A classic RTS with modern look - Crimson Freedom is a gripping real-time strategy game featuring a thrilling campaign experience. Set on 22nd-century Mars, the game follows the epic struggle of ideologies battling for supremacy over the red planet.

title: Pelikeeper
description: Pelikeeper is a cozy tower defense & base building strategy game where you play as the last pelican in a world swallowed by a shadowy fog. Build up and defend the settlement around your lighthouse, rescue lost animal neighbors, and return constellations to the cosmos.

title: Time Travel Train
description: Time Travel Train is a roguelite incremental game about commanding a weaponized locomotive through history. Battle enemies, and upgrade your train to become an unstoppable force. Your train never stops moving. Keep it fueled, destroy everything in your path, and collect scrap from the wreckage.

title: Signal Zone
description: Defend your base against increasingly dangerous enemy waves each night in this minimalist survival strategy. Mine resources, build and repair defenses, and upgrade your structures, tools, and abilities to survive in this harsh world.

title: FamCram
description: FamCram is a 3D grid-based puzzle game about two dads putting their kids to bed. Guide the children through increasingly challenging and multicultural settings, each with unique items, mechanics, and humor.

title: Cannon Keep
description: Build your city block by block and defeat waves of mechs in this tower defense roguelike! Combine powerful cannons with unique effects to survive the unforgiving wasteland and explore the underground to gather resources and find powerful relics.

title: Tri6: Infinite 2
description: Tri6: Infinite 2 is futuristic arcade racing without brakes: race across procedurally generated cyber tracks, dodge traps, use power-ups, and experience thrilling high-speed action. Every run is unique — how long can you last?

title: Night Errand
description: Night Errand is a 2D detective adventure where you play as Sage & Nur, an unlikely detective duo solving murder and mixing coffee in the quiet town Morrowpines. Collect clues, piece together contrasting perspectives, uncover the truth — and don't forget to mix a cup of coffee while you're at it.

title: The Free Shepherd
description: Run fast and free as a sheepdog in a beautiful but troubled world. Herd masses of lost sheep to a secret refuge. Discover a mysterious calamity that only you can stop.

title: No Law
description: Welcome to Port Desire, a city that doesn't belong to anyone, but where everyone wants a piece. You’re Grey Harker, an ex-military attempting to live a quiet life after near fatal injuries in the field. All you want now is peace - but in a city of no laws, what you want isn’t always what you get.

title: Monarchs at Play
description: Turn-based 4x strategy with a board game soul. Build your empire, combine buildings for powerful adjacency effects and fight or trade with rival monarchs – solo or multiplayer. Simple rules, deep tactics – all in just one hour.

title: TankRat
description: A dying world, flesh given way to steel. Swarms of corrupted mech-monsters roam a desolated land. Search and destroy, scavenge and dismantle, rebuild yourself from the wreckage. What you take becomes what you are. Survive the wasteland. Make it to Highpoint.

title: Solstride
description: Solstride is a casual story-rich roguelike where you journey through seasonal biomes with your animal companions. Together, rebuild a cozy sanctuary, uncover hidden truths, and find humanity in shared connections. Every bond tells a story; what will yours say?

title: Bradley the Badger
description: Bradley, the beloved platforming icon, finds himself lost in strange new lands... and decides to fight back! Shape unfinished worlds with your game developer powers, explore a genre-bending story, and save your home in this unique action-adventure. Wishlist now and join Bradleys journey!

title: Stupid Never Dies
description: Turn weak zombie Davy stupid strong, stupid fast in this Blazing Fast Growth action RPG! Devour enemies, steal powers, transform, and brave a deadly dungeon to revive frozen Julia.

title: Waning Crescent
description: Visual novel game based on Vampire: the Masquerade V5, created for the VtM game jam 2021 and part of the Dark Pack agreement.

title: Star Wars: Fate of the Old Republic
description: The fate of the galaxy is in your hands in a narrative-driven action RPG where you step into the role of a Force user on a journey through a galaxy on the edge of rebirth. Blending innovative storytelling, memorable characters, and heart-pounding combat, Star Wars: Fate of the Old Republic immerses you in an unforgettable experience where every decision deepens your journey toward light or darkness.

title: 4:Loop
description: Created by Mike Booth and the interactive storytellers at Bad Robot Games, 4:LOOP is a tactical, four-player co-op shooter crafted for endless replayability and infinite ways to build the ultimate team. Together, if you can learn from your mistakes, you might just fail to save the world.

title: Coven of the Chicken Foot
description: After the dungeons have been plundered and the monsters all killed, an elderly witch quietly gets to work. In this emotionally-rich, stylized, single-player adventure - Gert will need to build a bond with a peculiar creature if she’s to fulfill a coven’s oath.

title: Ontos
description: A sci-fi mystery set on the repurposed moon hotel Samsara. Uncover cryptic experiments, face unsettling encounters, and piece together a mind-bending narrative. The deeper you go, the more the truth unravels as you confront the ultimate question: What is reality?

title: Zenless Zone Zero: Update 2.5 - To Be Fuel for the Night
description:
Version 2.5 of Zenless Zone Zero, which includes:
• New Characters: Ye Shunguang and Zhao
• New Main Story Quest
• New events
• New skins for Jane and Ye Shunguang
• ...and more!

title: Odile: Black Duckling Tale
description: Romance fantasy style action adventure 'Odile: Black Duckling Tale' is a game of adventure, love, and various endings of a lovely black duck eventhough a villain.

title: Order of the Sinking Star
description: From director Jonathan Blow (Braid, The Witness), Order of the Sinking Star is a narrative adventure set in a realm of magic and enigma. Solve over 1000 interconnected, hand-crafted puzzles, discover unique playable heroes, master evolving gameplay mechanics, and decipher a grand mystery.

title: Gang of Dragon
description: A new action-adventure game from game creator Toshihiro Nagoshi, set in the streets of Shinjuku, Tokyo. Starring Ma Dong-seok as Shin Ji-seong, the story unfolds with heated and intense human drama across Shinjuku, including Kabukicho — one of Japan’s largest entertainment districts.

title: Tomb Raider: Catalyst
description: Set in the wake of a mythical cataclysm that has unleashed ancient secrets and awakened mysterious guardian forces, Tomb Raider: Catalyst follows Lara Croft on a new adventure across Northern India.

title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
description: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis is a reimagining of Lara Croft’s 1996 genre-defining game with visuals powered by Unreal Engine 5, modern gameplay, and new surprises that honor the spirit of the original.

title: Forest 3
description: Forest 3 is a first-person survival horror game developed by Endnight Games and the third entry in The Forest series. Set on a hostile alien planet, players explore unfamiliar environments, gather resources, hunt, and fight grotesque creatures.

title: Wuthering Waves: We Who See the Stars
description:
Version 3.0 of Wuthering Waves is the game's second major post-release update, and it includes:
• New characters: Lynae and Mornye
• New region: Lahai-Roi, with several new areas
• New story quests
• New exploration systems
• New echoes, events and more!

title: Diablo IV: Lord of Hatred
description: Sanctuary reaches its breaking point. In Diablo IV: Lord of Hatred, Mephisto’s dark crusade threatens the heart of Sanctuary. Rise as new heroes, uncover the fate of old allies, and forge your legend in the next chapter of the critically acclaimed action-RPG.

title: Marvel Rivals: Season 6 - Night at Museum
Where Winds Meet: The Imperial Palace
Hitman 3: Patient Zero Requiem
description: In this new mission, Agent 47 is tasked with the elimination of Lilith Devereux, the ambitious prospective CEO of Ether Corporation. A relative newcomer in the world of the high and mighty, Devereux’s rapid ascent has followed the mysterious deaths of her predecessor Neleis De Waal and chief scientists Silvio Caruso and Francesca De Santis. Her meteoric rise has been generously supported by Gregory Carlisle. For this mission, Agent 47 will visit the Carlisle Estate, based in the Dartmoor location, where tensions will reach a breaking point.

title: Total War: Warhammer 40,000
description: Experience the brutal fusion of galactic strategy and grimdark warfare in Total War: WARHAMMER 40,000. Take command of iconic factions, customise your war machine, and engage in devastating battles as you carve a bloody warpath across the stars.

title: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve
description: Soar through the skies and rise above every challenge to earn your place among the elite. Engage in intense aerial combat to dominate the battlefield with powerful weapons. Experience a breathtaking campaign filled with high-stakes missions, hard choices, and deep squad connections.

title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer
description: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer is a runs-based, high-stakes reinvention of racing born in the lawless Outer Rim. With the Empire gone and the galaxy rebuilding, The Galactic League is created: an underground, unsanctioned circuit where syndicates bankroll chaos and champions are forged.

title: Mega Man: Dual Override
description: Mega Man returns in 2027 with a brand-new entry in the classic action platforming series! Override challenges and blast down legions of robots while springboarding across a new array of futuristic frontiers!

title: Highguard
description: From the creators of Apex Legends and Titanfall, comes Highguard: a PvP raid shooter where players will ride, fight, and raid as Wardens, arcane gunslingers sent to fight for control of a mythical continent.

title: Beastfall
description: A pure Boss Rush roguelike - no trash mobs, only epic boss battles. Find your sister's body in a journey of redemption and revenge. Encounter eight unique deities and uncover the truth buried 200 years ago.

title: Avalon Jewels 3: Collector's Edition
description: Restore the magic of Avalon in a fantasy Match-3 adventure! Battle the Shadow King's minions across 250 handcrafted levels, explore enchanted realms, master magical powers, and choose between Relaxed or Puzzle Mode as you save the kingdom from darkness.

title: Five Nights In Saransk
description: You wake up in the middle of the night in your cozy one-room apartment and notice something wandering around your five-story panel building. Your only task is to prevent these strange creatures from getting inside.

title: Interim Apex
description:
Interim Apex is a standalone multiplayer mod for Command & Conquer: Renegade.

The mod expands upon the original game's C&C mode, adding new gameplay elements such as capturable tech buildings, upgrades, and naval warfare. The mod also features weapons and vehicles from both the Red Alert series and real life (World War II to modern era).

title: Autocard: Your RPG Adventure
description: Autocard is a card game, it's an Autobattler with Deckbuilder, Roguelike and RPG elements. Build a powerful board, unleash insane combos, and climb from zero to hero in under an hour!

title: DCS World: F4U-1D Corsair
description:
This module includes an F4U-1D Corsair aircraft, Essex class aircraft carrier and 8 WWII Imperial Japanese ground units.

The Vought F4U Corsair is an American fighter aircraft that saw prominent service primarily in World War II and the Korean War. Originally designed and manufactured by Chance Vought, the Corsair's exceptional performance led to substantial demand; consequently, additional production contracts were awarded to Goodyear (whose Corsairs were designated FG) and Brewster (designated F3A).

title: Void's Rage
description: Void's Rage is a fast-paced, ultra-responsive hack'n slash game inspired by arcade games. With each match, improve your combat reflexes, achieve the highest scores on the leaderboard, and defeat the evil creatures of the void once and for all.

title: Limb.Inc
description:
Limb.Inc is an investigative, narrative-focused game that addresses the theme of the afterlife with a bureaucratic twist. The main character is an employee of Limb.Inc whose job is to help souls trapped in purgatory make their passage to the afterlife.

You do this by reading descriptive files found in your drawer, containing personal data and a brief summary of what each spirit did in life. With this information, you must associate the corresponding item with the file so that the spirit can be released from its attachment to that earthly item that was part of its life.

title: Firefighter Gaiden
description: Firefighter Gaiden is a thrilling game set in a University that is being consumed by flames, where the fire gives life to the furniture. As a brave firefighter, your mission is to defeat the flaming objects with your powerful hose and sharp axe to save the university.

title: Bloons TD 6: Frontier Legends
description: Become the new Sheriff, explore the new world, and deal with the notorious Bloon Gangs in Frontier Legends.

title: S.M.P.C.U.: Special Monster Pest Control Unit
description: S.M.P.C.U. is an online co-op horror game for up to 4 players. As a member of the "Special Monster Pest Control Unit" your job is to remove extraterrestrial Monsters that have infested the pantries of fast-food restaurants. Work together to find them, trap them and get out. Don't wake the Monster!

title: Memoware
description: Memoware! A small adventure, exploration and puzzle videogame.

title: Meatballs Farm
description: Meatballs Farm is a first-person surrealistic shooter and farming game where you have to plant living flesh-based organisms, when night falls, you must defend your farm from creatures that want to eat your plants.

title: Brew & Dash
description: Jump, duck, accelerate, and run to test your reflexes by dodging obstacles and enemies, collecting ingredients along the way to brew potions, gaining new powers, and going even further. Face challenges on randomly selected maps.

title: Crisálida
description: A short emotional journey through memory, grief, and healing. Help Íris piece together her fragmented memories and uncover hidden truths about herself and those she loves. Your choices shape the story — only by revisiting the past you will unlock new layers and reveal the true ending (and music).

title: Waldo: In the Heart of the City
description: Join Waldo in a fast-paced 2D adventure! Fly across Mosquitópolis, battle enemies, and uncover the source of a mysterious virus in this fun and educational shoot ’em up.

title: South Star River
description:
Build a community and develop ecological agroforestry techniques in this cozy game set in the Amazon! Animals and local people are all part of an ecosystem where each has a role!

Join Lu as she returns from the big city, seeking a peaceful life in the place where she was born and raised!

title: Lendas da Amazônia
description: Lendas da Amazônia is a game that depicts the enchanted creatures of the Brazilian Amazon. It's a 2.5D platform game in the style of Little Nightmares, carrying a bit of Pará culture in a brief story and 8 levels. To pass each level, you must find the muiraquitã. Compatible with XBOX controllers.

title: The Lightseeker
description: The Lightseeker is a 2D pixel-art platformer in which you guide Analú, a young girl seeking her inner light in a world of darkness. Explore mysterious caves, shape paths with your lantern, and face trials in a deeply moving journey of self-discovery.

title: Cage: Along With Us
description: Cage: Alone With You is a psychological horror game with an isometric view and retro pixel art style that combines strategic exploration, escape, and constant tension.

title: Eleanor
description: A game telling the story of the brave warrior Eleanor.

title: Bag of Dreams
description: Bag of dreams is the cozy card-based Roguelike Dreambuilder you didn't know you needed. Can you piece together the perfect sleep, one fragment at a time?

title: Val'ty
description:
An retro first-person shooter about an "evil" alien mother and her daughter.
Inspired by Turok, MDK, Chasm: The Rift and ARG elements, Val'ty crosses the galaxy unlocking new powers, doing silly alien activities and asserting her dominance.
Nothing will stand between her and her kin.

title: Myths & Rites
description:
Take on the role of a legendary guardian and face mythical creatures in strategic turn-based battles. Build your deck, combine attack, defense, and ritual skill cards to purify the corrupted forces and restore balance between man and nature.

Each card is a fragment of ancient power.
Each battle, a rite of redemption.

title: UnoDos
description: Take control of Uno and Dos using just one controller to solve puzzles with minimalist graphics. The characters have unique abilities: one can jump, while the other can dash forward. The characters must use these abilities to solve the stages and progress through the levels.

title: Acre: Last Stand
description: In a world consumed by a deadly virus, you are one of the last survivors. As night falls, waves of increasingly stronger and faster zombies close in. Your only goal: survive as long as possible. Gather resources, upgrade your weapons, and fortify your defenses — each round is tougher than the last. There’s no happy ending, only one question: how long can you last before you’re torn apart?

title: Trouble Witches Episode 1 Daughters of Amalgam
description: Doujin Bullet Hell game of the Cute'Em Up sub-genre by Studio SiestA. Trouble Witches Episode 1 Daughters of Amalgam (2007) is the first game of the series and was released for Windows PC as doujin game.

title: Project.Tasker
description: In a world where physical death is no longer possible, artificial intelligence is created to free people from mental death. However, would it be right to do such a thing? Wouldn't erasing someone's memories to replace them be the same as erasing them?

title: Mind Defender
description: A fast-paced, futuristic tower defense game in which Anderson, a hacker, is trapped inside a digitized mind. With the Codex collapsing, he must defend the mental core against waves of corrupted and buggy memories to restore his consciousness and return to the real world.

title: Folia Felina
description:
Gatosa is a distracted cat, raised in an apartment and easily lost on the street. When trouble arises, she always asks her best friend for help.

Her best friend, Miranja, is a more laid-back cat who likes to talk nonsense and was raised on the streets. She is fierce, there's no way around it!

This Carnival, the friends agreed to go to a street party together, but Miranja needs to send directions and routes via cell phone, since Gatosa has a long history of getting lost when she leaves home and, besides that, doesn't have a good internet plan.

title: Eco City Planner
description: Eco City Planner is a card-based city-building and strategy game focusing on sustainability, urban planning, and resource management.

title: Cosmic Maid Café
description:
Welcome, dear customer, to Cosmic Maid Café! My name is Clara, and I will be accompanying you on this incredible journey, and... well... the truth is, I'm afraid I can't get more coffee by myself, so could you help me?

My boss is such a powerful cosmic being that his mere presence is enough to distort the space in the kitchen, and to avoid the risk of being thrown who knows where, my only movement is pressing space.
But fear not! As a high-tech artificial intelligence maid, I am equipped with the best central light in this galaxy, which recharges slightly as I perform my tasks! Just don't waste my time, because I'd rather not know what happens if that light goes out...

title: Mulheres na taverna
description: An interactive game based on the book A Noite na Taverna by Álvares de Azevedo, where the main objective was to create a horror game in which most of the characters were women, either as villains or protagonists. Throughout the game, the player will encounter the stories of five characters, with the narrative being constructed based on the choices made by the player.

title: Fallen Echoes
description: Fallen Echoes is a hand-drawn 2D platform game in which Kael, a warrior frog, travels through ruins, forests, and frozen mountains in search of a hidden valley. With an introspective atmosphere, the game offers a challenging and emotional experience, guiding the player through a journey of overcoming adversity in a world fragmented by grief.

title: Meatbound
description: Two unlikely adventurers — a brute-force Dwarven Barbarian and an explosively creative Elf Artificer — must work together in co-op to survive a living dungeon made entirely of pulsating flesh. Grotesque creatures lurk around every corner, and the only way to make it out alive is by trusting your partner… and the Grumpy Merchant, of course. He’s got everything you need — weapons, gear, and even a way to bring fallen heroes back from the dead.

title: Guará Guaraná
description: An incremental tower defense game with farm mechanics, where you grow crops, defend your village, and make it prosper!

title: Kundara: Art of Cards
description: Kundara: Arts of Cards is a roguelite deck-building card game featuring strategic and dynamic battles inspired by the aesthetics of traditional Japanese Kabuki theater. By combining numbered cards with elemental suits, you create increasingly powerful combos to face your opponents. With every defeat comes a new lesson, as you explore an adventure filled with encounters with new enemies, spirits, and bosses.

title: Ba Bị
description: The Ba Bị's game is a time limit challenge in the style of a haunted early 2000s educational software. Play as one of the unlucky kids trapped in this twisted game and help them make it out alive!

title: Space Digger Red Beard
description: Go down the mine, gather enough resources, and return back to the surface. Make sure that you don't run out of oxygen on your way! Plan every move on the grid carefully, only by returning safely can you progress and uncover even greater rewards.

title: Kung Fu Addiction
description: An auto-battler RPG where anticipation is everything. Predict your enemies' moves, shape your hero's progression, and channel the souls of ancient warriors to resurrect with a new fighting style as you overcome escalating challenges across multiple combat modes.

title: Death On Holly Ridge
description: Christmas Eve, a delivery driver turns onto Holly Ridge & becomes trapped inside a decaying house of death. Reality fractures as something hunts her through rooms that shouldn’t exist. Survive the night, uncover the truth behind the house, & escape the snowy nightmare, if escape is even possible.

title: Angel Clicker
description: It's Heaven vs. Hell in the annual Soul-Catching Contest! An incremental clicker with optional rhythm elements. Help Heavenly Architect Legion defeat her eternal archrival Lucifer once and for all! (Or not...?)

title: Elevator: Source
description: Elevator: Source is a single or co-op elevator experience that is different each time you play. What floor will you stop on next? What will happen? Who knows! We don't even know! And we made the game. It's THAT EXCITING.

title: Venturaka
description: The past comes alive in Venturaka, a classic 3D adventure with a focus on atmospheric exploration, challenging puzzles and manual platforming. Journey through fastuous natural locales, forgotten temples and much more in this thrilling path to unravel the mysteries of ancient legends.

title: The Fiancée Has Never Known First Love: Motto Iinazuke
description:
"Next time for sure, you'll make ME your fiancée, right?!"
This new release add Ayaka's route that wasn't present in the original game.

title: ¿ Y ? A Short Memoir Told in Bits
description: Join Cubert in his quest to roll down, over and over and over again, the same track — a riveting journey and experience unlike any other.

title: The Maze: L'ultimo soldato
description: You have been chosen to descend into the abyss. No one told you why those before you never returned. Do not turn back. Do not listen to the noises in the corridors. You have one task: restore power to your nation before the Maze takes you. The mission is clear. Your fate is not.

title: Everlast: Undying Tale
description: On Everlast: Undying Tale’s magical world of Sarkis, the undead have risen. Gather, explore, skill, and craft in this MMO-Lite action RPG adventure. Only by bridging the gap between the living and the dead can you break Death’s curse.

title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - Thank You Update
description: The "Thank You" update is a free major content update, including a brand-new level, “Verso’s Drafts”, featuring new environments to explore, battles to fight, and plenty of surprises to discover. The biome has a very childlike, wonderland-style aesthetic, inspired by Verso’s childhood, but you’ll see more cutscenes that elaborate on this in the update.

title: Half-Life Legacy
description: Relive Half-Life 1 with bug fixes, enhanced controller support, Steam Achievements, bunny-hopping, enhanced visuals, and more, in the ultimate restoration.

title: Sung in Flame
description: This is a dystopian Gothic story featuring morally grey characters with unethical beliefs/actions

title: Dyadem
description: Become the greatest tactician in this love letter to classic handheld SRPGs. It falls to you to forge the bonds of your Prince's followers, develop their skills, and shape their strategies as you fight to reclaim your homeland and save the world.

title: Tiny Train Tycoon
description: Build a toy railway from limited pieces, launch trains, and solve logistical challenges. Tackle economic puzzles or relax in sandbox mode — the choice is yours.

title: Desert Revenant 2: The Reawakening
description: A tactical roguelike deckbuilder built for massive combos. Cast spells, summon minions, and stack effects that cascade into devastating turns as you face brutal enemies with diverse abilities across escalating, curse-driven runs.

title: Pawbay
description: Take part in the most coziest cat adventure! Explore a lively open-world town through the eyes of a mischievous cat. Create chaos, discover secrets, and turn everyday life in Pawbay upside down.

title: Poubelle City
description: Poubelle City: Dive into a vibrant and offbeat metropolis where the raw energy of the streets meets authenticity! Explore iconic locations and feel the rhythm of the legendary night with DJ Aye-Aye!

title: Tracebound
description: Tracebound is an atmospheric, fast paced, ice skating game. Slide and leap across the giant’s colossal body, shattering its shackles to restore nature’s movement.

title: Police Detective: Tokyo Beat
description: Gather evidence, interview suspects and send your case to trial. Have you got what it takes to be Tokyo's top detective?

title: Spring Me Up
description: A challenging physics-based 2.5D platformer. Use your spring to bounce and land with precision, navigating tricky platforms and obstacles. Every miscalculation can send you back, testing your skill, patience, and self-control.

title: Into the Cannon, Soldier!
description: You are the commander on the last line of defense. Hold your base, recruit soldiers, and launch them via cannon to another collapsing front. A cooperative (1-2 players) tactical defense game where your decisions decide the fate of two battles.

title: Dodge Everything
description: Dodge Everything is a fast-paced dodge arcade game where you control a tiny block and try to survive as long as possible while dodging endless projectiles. Collect power-ups, climb the highscore and unlock new levels and skins.

title: Evil Plays Dice
description:
A classic RPG adventure where a group of outcasts unite as a team and face ancient mysteries and awakening evil.

You are a wandering outlaw whose past is unknown. You come to Whiteland to earn some silver coins by fighting wild animals. However, your curiosity and boldness will take you to the very heart of events that will decide the future of this land and the entire kingdom of Feuria.

title: Bonfire Stories: Faceless Gravedigger - Collector's Edition
Lakehopper
description: Take flight in a seaplane flight simulator through a rugged world where you are responsible for the care and maintenance of your plane. Deliver cargo between far-flung communities in a flooded landscape that challenges your piloting skills! Fix your plane and keep flying!

title: Paddlenoid
description: Paddlenoid is a fun brick breaker you can play solo or with a friend. There’s nothing out of the ordinary and absolutely no reason to suspect a deeper purpose. Just have a good time and remember to ignore the crystals!

title: Ghosts of the Past: Bones of Meadows Town - Collector's Edition
Legends of the East: The Cobra's Eye - Collector's Edition
Mystery Trackers: Raincliff's Phantoms - Collector's Edition
Skybound
description: Skybound is a 3D exploration platformer focused on fun, fluid movement mechanics, parkour and environmental puzzle solving.

title: WriteNor
description: WriteNor is a first-person psychological horror game that simulates a coding environment. The player assumes the role of a developer tasked with debugging a corrupted simulation, only to be confronted by a rogue AI entity named Nori. The game features a diegetic interface where all UI elements exist within the game world, including a functional console terminal used to alter the environment and delete objects. WriteNor explores themes of artificial intelligence, fourth-wall breaking mechanics, and the blurring line between software and reality.

title: Developer Daily
description: You can start a studio with your friends and manage your dream game company together, or compete against each other. You can take over companies honestly or deceitfully, or dominate the market with your own game distribution platform.

title: Shibuya Sushi Master
description: Cyberpunk sushi master adventure

title: Cygnus Leapt
description:
Three years ago Erin started dating his best friend, a ballet dancer named Cygnus. Between Cygnus' mental illness, their desire to move forward as partners, and increased demands and stress from his job, an overwhelmed Erin has recently pulled away from his relationship. His struggles with avoidance have left him and Cygnus in a limbo.

However, when Cygnus passes away suddenly, Erin's decisions are rendered irrelevant. After getting a posthumous email from Cygnus, Erin uses his position at the Department of Last Thoughts and Unspoken Words to review Cygnus' last week and things they left unsaid.

Erin now has to figure out where he stands in relation to his partner, their passing, and the where the two of them belonged. Accepting death is never easy, especially when you still have yet to accept the life you led together. One last kiss for my lover, because it's time to say goodbye.

title: Nightmare: Reimagined Beginning
description: Nightmare: Reimagined Beginning is a remake of game Nightmare in which Anton has nightmares and finds out what causes them. Of course, in his dreams Anton will encounter many obstacles that he must overcome

title: I Broke My Legs and Got Left Behind in a Burning Hospital
description:
After the incident both of your legs have been rendered useless. Luckily, you should be able to recover in no time, right doc? doc? Where are you going!? Oh geez why is there smoke- uh- oh no- A FIRE! AHHH EVERYTHING IS ON FIRE ARGHHHHHHH!!!
This game was originally made for the Toxic Terror Gamejam.

title: Red Booth
description:
Trying to hide from the rain, you take shelter in an old phone booth. Suddenly, the door locks shut. The phone starts ringing. Learn. Adapt. Repeat.
This game was originally made for the Toxic Terror Gamejam.

title: 14 Nights With Beatrice
description:
14 Nights With Beatrice is an upcoming 3D survival horror game with a strong focus on narrative, player choice, and multiple endings.

Players must survive a zombie outbreak by defending a house using light-based mechanics, managing limited resources, and making decisions that influence relationships and story outcomes.

The game emphasizes atmosphere, mystery, and branching storylines where choices directly affect the ending.

title: Qubica
description: A next-generation sandbox game heavily inspired by The Blockheads. All about exploring, building, and playing together. Mine resources, craft tools, build a cozy cabin or an entire city.

title: Mythic Wonders: The Philosopher's Stone - Collector's Edition
Piczle World of Puzzles: Old Masters
description: 200 challenging Piczle Cross nonograms over 12 collage puzzles based on the works of the Old Masters.

title: Piczle World of Puzzles: Into the Puzzleverse
description: More than 200 Piczle Lines puzzles that formed the story mode in "Into the Puzzleverse" (only released on console)

title: Ratsukade
description: Drag heavy gems, slay giant bugs, find mystical items and craft overpowered builds in this action packed physics based roguelike!

title: Ratmouse
description: it's rat vs roach in this arcade style romp... RATMOUSE is a fast-paced, challenging, arcade style romp where you play as a RAT, with your MOUSE (get it yet?)

title: Resurrection Gate
description: Resurrection Gate is an interactive novella about loss, liches, and what lingers at the edge of existence.

title: The Glitch Prison Together
description: Find bugs with your friends, exploit them, and escape!

title: Clickertale
description: Do you like Undertale? Here is my project "Clickertale"! In this game you need click and collect LV, to buy bosses and endings from Undertale! In final you need... Oh, this is spoilers. So, if you like clickers and like Undertale this game is for you!

title: Enchantia: Wrath of the Phoenix Queen - Collector's Edition
Death Upon an Austrian Sonata: A Dana Knightstone Novel - Collector's Edition
Craterville
description: A base-building, simulation and inventory management game where you build and defend your base in the crater formed when blasting into a new dimension. Hire and equip combat units then send them into battle. Organise loot in your inventory. Complete objectives to advance your reputation.

title: Ruadine
description: Ruadine' is a single player dungeon-crawling adventure with a unique combat system. The game features a branching world to explore, mysterious monsters to defeat, and an atmospheric soundtrack.

title: Simsala Grimm: Het Dappere Snijdertje
description: An educative game based on the fairytale.

title: Midnight Billiards
description: Midnight Billiards is a turn-based roguelite game inspired by Peglin and billiards. Choose from a variety of characters and collect items to build your unique strategy. Aim carefully and make the perfect shot to defeat your opponents!

title: Midnight Hoops
description: The court is peaceful after dark. Just you, a ball, and a whole lot of crickets. You put in the hours every evening. While your friends are out partying, you're on the grind. But tonight... you don't feel quite so alone.

title: Alice's Current Draft
description: Fly around and explore floating islands, interact with townsfolk and cryptids, and discover secrets.

title: Mass of Consumption
description: The church is impatient. The church is hungry. The church is willing to do anything to get you back.

title: Together Again
description: An erotic game involving a girl in need of sexual healing.

title: Donkey Kong Country 4: The Kongs Return
description: Donkey Kong Country 4 fangame is a nonprofit dedicated to the greatest games of the 90s. It is a faithful continuation DKC series with all the characters, animals, new stages and new songs.

title: Sengodai
description: Collect and create your Gokai monsters team in this tactical roguelike deckbuilder! Build, expand and evolve your deck to explore an ever-changing world.

title: Nidos
description: A strategic nature-themed card battler where animals fight for territory, survival, and dominance. Create habitats, control resources, and outsmart your opponents in the wild!

title: DCS World: MiG-29A Fulcrum
description: The MiG-29A remains one of the most famous fighters in the world due to its outstanding performance characteristics, reliability, and simplicity of the weapons systems. It is capable of performing high-alpha maneuvers that make it deadly in close air combat. In addition to the R-73 and HMS, the MiG-29A is also armed with medium-range radar-guided missiles, a 30mm cannon, and unguided bombs and rockets.

title: Murky
description: Murky is a zany artistic narrative adventure where you solve microgames, cast spells, and alter time to create new timelines as you attempt to rediscover your past in order to escape a world trapped in a three day cycle.

title: Hypernet Explorer
description: Roguelike immersive sim set in esoteric post Y2K Europe.

title: Zombie Diner Simulator
description: Zombie Diner — In a post-apocalyptic world, you run the only diner for the undead. Cook grotesque meals, serve hungry zombie patrons, and blast those who lose patience. Survival, management, and dark humor all on the menu!

title: Dark Souls 2: Mad Warrior Edition
description:
Restores cut content, adds new spells, rings and attacks.
Increases player prowess while also increasing the difficulty in thoughtful ways.

title: Once Glorious Artahk
description: Explore the ruins of an ancient city. Solve puzzles to unlock new paths, abilities, and forgotten lore. Read the lost stories you uncover to gain insight into a tangled web of mysteries. Using only your wits and your trusty torch to guide you, you must find a way to return light to a starless sky.

title: Star Spark
description: Master combos, unleash powerful attacks, and survive dangerous encounters to win the Star Spark Tournament! Plan your moves and outwit your opponents in this roguelite, turn-based fighting game.

title: You’re Here Again
description: You’re Here Again is a weirdcore fast-paced movement shooter, exploring the liminal space between the end of life and whatever comes after. Experience the slow deconstruction of your existence as you utilise a wide range of weapons to kill the strange creatures inhabiting this strange new realm.

title: Champion of Lore
description: The Guardians have failed. Myths crumble into chaos. Become the Champion of Lore the world needs. Battle through corrupted myths and lost worlds in this turn-based, card-driven tactical adventure forged on hexes and ancient lore.

title: Dragon Dinner
description: Cute but chaotic restaurant simulator where you play as a dragon waiter in a fast-paced dining rush. Set tables, serve hungry dragons, deliver the right dishes, and keep the place clean! After each day, customize the layout of the restaurant and learn new abilities to improve.

title: In Silent Walls Sujet:13
description: Explore the decayed corridors of a haunted sanatorium, uncover disturbing documents, and face the paranormal horrors and restless spirits that linger within its walls

title: Balla Machina
description: A pinball roguelike where you build your retro machine by buying and placing items like targets, flippers, rollovers and stickers. Make game-breaking combos and beat the target score!

title: Goldstained
description: Explore a dangerous, fantastical world and slay the divine being that corrupted it. Goldstained is a top-down 2D action-adventure where unlocking new weapons with new movesets is your way forward through boss fights, puzzles, and combat!

title: Zombies Hate to Die
description: A roguelite wasteland escape. Experience the satisfying knockback of physics-based combat, manage your scarce resources, and wield an array of absurd items found along the way. Every run is a unique journey through a darkly humorous apocalypse.

title: Echoes of the Cove
description: Uncover your father's fate in a 2D story-rich action adventure RPG set in a forgotten coastal town. Follow his diary, explore the Cove, battle strange creatures and rebuild a community on the edge of the sea.

title: Ephemeral Frame
description: Step inside picture frames, films, and other imagery that connect a variety of dreamscapes in this surreal first-person exploration game.

title: Twisted Grove
description: A non-violent Roguelike Deckbuilder about befriending critters in a magical forest. Assemble unique decks, pet/compliment/smooch your way into the heart of corrupted flora and fauna, and dismantle the capitalist systems tearing down the Grove.

title: Harmony Havoc
description: A roguelike shooter where you create music to power up your battles and experience what it's like to be part of a heavy metal band.

title: Woodworm
description: Woodworm is a grid-based puzzle game about carving bite-sized wooden sculptures. Chomp your way through blocks of wood to create new shapes, while managing gravity and tricky geometry!

title: Beneath the Quiet: Where It Ends
description: Beneath The Quiet: Where It Ends is a first-person psychological horror game. After a bank ultimatum forces you back to your childhood home in Miskolc, Hungary, you return to pack up the past, only to uncover buried trauma, unsettling memories, and a mind you can no longer trust.

title: Shroomveil
description: Shroomveil is a real-time combat, Action RPG, with character progression, skills, and gear upgrades. Set in a magical, mushroom-filled world full of danger and discovery, you'll explore a beautiful fantasy land, find and defend villages, equip warriors, clear dungeons, defeat bosses, and bring peace to the land.

title: WuKung: A Legendary Adventure
description:
WuKung: A Legendary Adventure is a point-and-click adventure game based on the popular Monkey God mythos of ancient China. The Emperor is seeking The Book of Governance, an artifact containing all the wisdom necessary to rule a kingdom in a just fashion. He dispatches the monk SamChang on a quest to find it. Along the way, SamChang meets WuKung, an extraordinary and magical monkey. When SamChang disappears, it's up to WuKung to track him down with the help of his friends Eddy (a pig demon) and Seamoure (a river demon), then together find the Book sought by the Emperor.

The typical adventure gameplay involves solving puzzles to progress the story. Eventually three characters become available and it is possible to switch between them. Four actions are available as part of the HUD. There is also an inventory system where items are stored.

title: Monster World RPG
description: Monster World RPG is a new free rpg videogame developed by MAX TEAM & MOTA with RpgMaker2003. MWRPG is based on the Wonder Boy/Monster World games series by SEGA/Westone. It's not a sequel, prequel or remake, but a brand new game in rpg style instead of platform.

title: Gaussian Mansion
description: Explore a cursed hotel in this FREE rail shooter. Face off against hordes of ghosts, uncover hidden secrets, and fight for the best time in this 10-15 minute experience.

title: Scary Shadow Spot: All In
description: Escape the nightmare by observing what shouldn’t exist. Lisa is trapped in ten floors that shift each loop: find the anomaly, survive, and uncover the truth behind the endless office.

title: Torment Hexus
description: Technofascist cyberpunk CEOs must die! Charge spells with the match-3 grid, then cast them on your enemies in turn-based tactical roguelike combat. Climb the tower, kill the boss, and maybe make the world a better place.

title: Occult Office: Lofi Rituals
description: Welcome to Occult Office, a cozy and mysterious productivity game! Decorate your workspace, conquer to-do lists, and explore dungeons on your coffee breaks. Master daily rituals, collect strange pets, and climb the corporate ladder - all in cozy pixel art with a Lovecraftian twist.

title: Five Biggest Accomplishments
description: Five Biggest Accomplishments is a short Visual Novel where you play as someone who has held the same job for 30 years: push a button every 8 hours or the world will end. Suddenly, you get an email asking you to list your five biggest accomplishments for the week, or risk being fired.

title: Sporbs
description: A relaxing, short incremental game where you harvest Orbs from newly discovered alien organisms. Upgrade your extraction technology, manage resources, and unlock new areas to maximise your yield.

title: Orbital Chaos
description: A physics-based bullet hell that's all about gravity - with you as the center of it!

title: Journey to Shambhala
description: Embark on an epic quest in "Journey to Shambhala," a 3D Action-Adventure Hindi game that takes you deep beneath ancient temples in search of the mystical city of Shambhala. You must navigate through 5 challenging stages, each filled with obstacles to unveil the hidden pathway to the legendary city.

title: Love is a Demon
description: Love is a Demon is an adventure game packed with romance, chaos, and supernatural surprises. Confess your crush, dodge demons, and embrace the mess; love has never been this complicated. Your choices shape Ash’s love life in this heartfelt, hilarious story-driven experience.

title: Beandejo
description: BEANDEJO is an action-packed spin-gun roguelite. Enter the Old West, where the cattle roam, and drunken vegetables terrorize the local saloons. Spin your gun, time your draws, and gun them down to become the toughest sheriff in town!

title: Puzzles in Otter Space
description: Don your spacesuit to teleport and super-jump your way through 90 brain-teasing platform puzzles.

title: SwitchTrack
description: SwitchTrack is a coordination puzzle game about switches, levers and minecarts. Time your inputs correctly to guide as many minecarts through each level as possible.

title: Don Pepe & His Balloons
description: Welcome to Don Pepe's hit game show! Grab your water balloons and outsmart your rivals in this explosive, fast-paced party brawler for up to 4 players.

title: Stunted Gravity
description: Stunted Gravity is a hovercraft stunt-driving game set in a neon-dystopian future. Race, jump, and improvise lines across arenas where gravity pulls in any and every direction. Execute stunts, evade hazards, and battle enemy drones as you pilot though the interplanetary Stunted Gravity Circuit.

title: Pussy
description: What could be more beautiful than hentai?

title: Parman: Haunted School Guard
description: Players take the role of a trapped night guard, searching for five hidden keys while avoiding terrifying ghosts like the red kuntilanak, pocong, and ghost children. With a chilling atmosphere, randomized levels after every death, and hidden notes that unravel a deeper mystery, Parman offers an intense, culturally rich horror experience.

title: That Damn Fox
description: That Damn Fox is a Quake engine based third person platformer with some high-octane gunplay action! Join Cam the Fox on her adventure to save her city from the evil Dr. Henney Penny and his plan to 'Taxerminate' the world with his reanimated-cybernetic animal army!

title: Pussy 2
description: What could be more beautiful than hentai?

title: Morbid Mailroom
description: In a claymation prison for occult offenders, you are the package inspector. Search packages for hidden contraband, coded letters, and cursed objects. Balance duty, compassion, and survival as you decide what reaches the inmates and what burns in the incinerator. Your choices cannot be undone.

title: Pussy 3
description: What could be more beautiful than hentai?

title: Snatch
description: Snatch is a wild twist on classic Pong—faster, flashier, and loaded with abilities. Deflect, dash, and unleash chaotic powers in fast paced matches. Battle relentless enemies in 1v1 duels or survive 1v3 chaos—dash, deflect, and dominate in fast-paced, single-player arcade mayhem.

title: Inaka no Koukou de Atta Kowai Hanashi
description:
Y, a member of the newspaper club, was forced by his senior to write an article on scary stories.
It took place in a dusty, abandoned room far away from the usual classrooms and clubrooms.
While waiting for the remaining person to arrive, fearful scenes begin to unfold...

title: AIRevolution
description: AIRevolution is a Visual Novel Game, sci-fi bathed with a shiny layer of fantasy. The world is crowded with Artificial intelligence, most of them looking like humans, they even managed to have the same rights as humans do in the 'near' future. Will you accept them as equals or.. choose another path? You better decide fast, an AIRevolution is incomming..

title: AFAR: An Interactive Horror Film
description: A survival horror experience inspired by 90s FMV games and VHS nightmares. Choose your path as a paranormal investigator in a haunting interactive film and uncover the secrets of Barlang Valley. Every choice you make shapes the story—leading to new scenes, multiple endings, and many ways to die.

title: Dungeon Gambler: All In, No Out
description: Hit the jackpot in this gambling-infused dungeon crawler. Pay what you owe. Survive the dungeon. Play your cards close to your chest and defeat Skelly.

title: Dig to China Simulator
description: Dig to China Simulator, is a game about digging a hole in your back yard, until you get to China. Find ores in the holes you dig, sell them, upgrade your equipment to dig faster.

title: Demon Castle Story
description: Demon Castle Building Dungeon Management Simulation

title: The Division 2: Mutiny
description: Agents, The Division 2: Mutiny brings a shift in the conflict. True Sons defectors are breaking ranks, and we can recruit them as field ready Companions. With the Command Link system at the center of this season, your coordination with these recruits becomes a powerful tool in every fight. New threats, new equipment and a demanding Master Climax Mission will test how well you can adapt and work together.

title: D.A.D.S.
description: Use your special ops units to construct base facilities and towers to protect them from the ever-increasing threat of alien invaders in this Tower Defense game with a city-building element! Research their weaknesses and develop defenses before mankind runs out of time.

title: Project Timbre
description: Control the squishy hero, Timbre, as you jump, dash, and dive onto enemies and gather power gems in this bite-sized 3D platformer!

title: Thirsty Princess
description: Thirsty Princess is a fast-paced, top-down party game for 2–4 local players where you and your friends compete to drink beer with an impatient and unreasonable princess. Get drunk and slowly lose control while you brawl, steal from and sabotage your friends to win the favour of your princess.

title: Anxiety Arcade
description: Anxiety Arcade is a short, surreal narrative game about living with anxiety — and how it feels when your own thoughts turn into puzzles.

title: May and the Amazing Bouquet
description: Help May to obtain the Eight Prized Flowers in this cozy pixelated top-down action adventure! Explore her island home, meet new people, avoid shadowy creatures, solve puzzles, and collect whatever useful objects you can find!

title: Berry Bury Berry
description: A juicy first-person incremental game about growing berries and tossing them down an ominous hole. Earn money and upgrades. Make new friends with sentient berry pals. Grow and control the hole as you unearth why nobody leaves this accursed garden. Bury it all, Berry everything.

title: Mythic Kart Maker
description: Mythic Kart Maker is fantasy kart racing level editor, with vehicular combat, whimsical characters, & a vibrant 3D prerendered art-style, with gameplay akin to classic "kart racers".

title: When the Embers Wake
description: When the Embers Wake is a third person narrative adventure with a cause to create awareness about the very current and real threats on wildlife. You play as a red panda that needs to survive amidst environmental challenges, threats and also grief.

title: Superbug
description: A blindingly-fast arcade shooter. Become the deadliest virus, and destroy everything in your path.

title: Crunch Time! Beat the Clock
description: Crunch Time! Beat The Clock is a fantasy third-person action platformer. Jump, Fight and Blast your way through a variety of levels in order to beat the clock once and for all!

title: Joint Force
description: Solve challenging puzzles to reunite Belcho and Nim.

title: NYXverse.AI
description: Explore a platform with thousands of AI-generated 3D characters. Customize personalities, appearances, voices, and stories, all synced with real-world time. Unleash your creativity, crafting unique virtual worlds. Join a community of creators and share your imagination.

title: Neverending AI Storybook
description: Personalized AI-powered storytelling, built for you. Runs entirely on your machine with no online servers and no data collection, for the ultimate privacy.

title: Absolutely Nothing
description: Absolutely Nothing is a (game?) about absolutely nothing, and it is the pinnacle of minimalistic puzzle non-game design rivaling modern AAA titles.

title: BeachHead: Gold Edition
description: Defend the beach in three legendary arcade strategy games! Battle enemy forces across land, sea, and air in BeachHead 2000, 2002, and 2003 (Desert War). Create custom battles with the Level Editor, share with the community, and dominate global leaderboards. The classics are back!

title: Dave's Word Game
description: Dave's Word Game (known as DWG by fans) is an important new daily word game, where you must strategically use your best words to maximise your score every day.

title: Konbini's World
description: Become a slime named Konbini ( ᵔ ◡ ᵔ ) Collect gachapon capsule toys, manage vending machines and run a conveyor belt sushi restaurant. Keep your slime happy by unlocking new buildings, playing mini-games and collecting unique items!

title: Pirate Sagas: The Golden Age
description: Yarrrgh! Embark on adventure in three narrative-driven campaigns set in the Golden Age of Piracy. Engage and battle enemy ships in a mix of turn-based and real time combat. Battle enemy ships, defeat crews in combat, raid ports, loot, pillage and lead your ships to victory!

title: Mazewar
description: The game that pioneered the FPS genre brought back to life.

title: The Gurgling
description: A 3D Psychological Horror game where you navigate through tense levels filled with dread, fear, isolation and suffering as an unknown presence lurks beyond, leaving a trail of haunting sounds that are both oppressive and foreboding. Containing approximately 4-8 hours of disturbing gameplay.

title: Kaya The Dog
description: You experience the life of an abused dog, forced to stay in one place and only watch as the world moves on around him. This game tries to show you how lonely our pets can be and how Important it is to treat them right.

title: Jewel Match Atlantis Solitaire 5: Collector's Edition
description: Set sail for a Solitaire adventure beneath the waves! Explore hundreds of beautifully crafted levels and restore the underwater kingdom of Atlantis to its shimmering glory. Enjoy stunning visuals, a soothing soundtrack, and dive into the splendor and secrets of Atlantis once more.

title: Mything
description: Gather your monsters and fight against the Gods of Greek mythology in this idle battler. Collect and upgrade your units.

title: Keep The Beat
description: The party is on, don't let the neighbors stop it!

title: Errasaga
description:
This is an RPG game made with RPG Maker VX .

It is the 3rd work of the 'Age of Myth Series', an RPG for all ages produced by the Circle, and with this work as a starting point, the basic framework of the Age of Mythology work was established. It is also the first work in which a character from the previous work appears in the lead role.

The work directly related to this work is SEQUEL kludge. They are set in the same world and are closely related.

title: Totally Reliable Delivery Service: Atari Attire
description:
Did anyone else see a one-button joystick running around? In Atari Attire, it’s all about celebrating the world of Atari, while still staying as Totally Reliable as always. Don one of 15 outrageous, new Atari skins, including the iconic joystick, Centipede, and even a surprise character from Nightdive Studios.

Take on chaotic new challenges in 5 new multiplayer events that feature a swan boat race, an obstacle course, and plenty of wacky competition. And 10 new delivery missions will keep your skills sharp with new launcher deliveries and ice block challenges.

title: Little Shadow
description: Go and try free your friends scattered across the city of lights, up to the ultimate beacon. But careful, stay hidden in the shadows, our dark little creature doesn't do well under the light...

title: A Magical Tale: Revoke DX
description: Venture to a new island and find locals in horror, it's your task to return their sacred gems that have been scattered by evils bestowed upon the land. Step into caverns, defeat enemies, and solve puzzles as Hero...

title: Dohyo Dreams: Rise to Yokozuna
description: Dohyo Dreams: Rise to Yokozuna is a narrative sumo RPG that blends first person combat, life simulation, and story rich exploration. Train, cook, bond with stablemates, and fight to rise to the pinnacle of sumo.

title: Highway Noir
description: You are an underground driver for hire, fired from the Major Crimes Agency. Rush through a busy city at night as you take on high speed getaways, dangerous street races, white knuckle pursuits and more. Don't stop until you reveal the truth about who wanted you gone

title: SeeYou
description: A dark, medieval horror experience filled with lore, focused on exploration and puzzle-solving. There is no combat — only survival. Single player gameplay with challenging mechanics. Try to unravel the mystery behind the cursed world and maybe find a way to return it.

title: Maddmadd
description: Maddmadd is a third-person run-and-gun boomer shooter with fast-paced movement, beautiful giblets and a comedic tone. Blow stuff up in your tank and then get up-close-and-personal with your boomstick!

title: RadCity: a post-apocalyptic adventure
description: Scavenge for food and escape a dead city in a broken, post apocalyptic world. Gather enough food for 40 days and prepare for a train journey to a place of refuge. Featuring a top-down perspective and a finely crafted 3D world.

title: Little Retreat
description: Little Retreat is your personal cozy productivity game. Set timers for real-life tasks and unlock items to decorate wholesome rooms inspired by places and legends from Southern Germany. Little Retreat blends entertainment with self-motivation, rewarding you for making the most of your time!

title: Clown House: Lunacy
description: Unravel the mystery of an abandoned mansion and a commune of lunatic clowns. Clown House: Lunacy is a horror game with focus on the uncanniness and unpredictability of clowns. Observe the clowns, solve puzzles and survive. Never forget: Every clown you kill brings you closer to becoming one.

title: Mancy
description: An old-school card game where every deck is a kitchen table deck. No card limit. No net decks. Just duelists and their shoebox collection.

title: Biolune
description: An artificial life simulation about a robot cultivating ecosystems on the moons of a ruined planet. Grow fantastical plants and animals, facilitate their evolution, and gather resources while discovering the secrets of this strange world.

title: Something Meaningful
description: An open-world RPG where you decide how to live after your death. Work, study, train, explore the city, customize your appearance, meet cartoonish characters and unlock interesting locations as you try to do something meaningful with this new opportunity.

title: Red Season
description: Red Season is a brutal third-person stealth-action game set in the storm-soaked countryside of 1998. Hunt the cult that kidnapped your daughter with violent takedowns, savage melee and intense gunfights. Face the horrors as you walk the fine line between justice and becoming a monster.

title: Pollinate or Die
description: Pollinate or Die is a fast-paced action roguelite set in the hazardous wastelands left behind by humanity. As one of the last surviving bumblebees, you alone can revive Earth's flora. Fight through swarms of enemies as you search for flowers to pollinate and bring life back to the planet.

title: Radiant Sky
description: You and a group of adventurers must travel the world and unite the factions of weather spirits to stop constant natural disasters and stop an inevitable world ending catastrophe once the sky turns "radiant".

title: Bad Delivery: Pizza Your Heart
description: You're the new girl at your local pizza place. Make pizzas, go on delivery runs, and collect tips to save enough money to pay your rent (and maybe find love along the way)!

title: Match Morphosis
description: Match Morphosis is a Roguelike Match-3 Deckbuilder. Match tiles to defeat enemies, gain artifacts, build synergies and unleash powerful combos. Master your way in this unique turn-based RPG. Kill, death, unlock, repeat. No two runs are the same, no timers, no grinding, no mercy.

title: The Boo Croo
description: 4-player cooperative and competitive party game with various minigames where everyone can win... and everyone can lose!

title: Stranded Survivors
description: Survive swarms of monsters, rescue stranded animals, and build a base where they can be safe in this unique bullet heaven. Turn your rescues into upgrades and build a safe town to create new weapons and recruit powerful heroes that unlock new ways to survive til dawn.

title: Towers of Scale
description: A resource management optimization puzzle game with metaprogression under a guise of an RPG. Explore the towers, get high scores, obtain gems and push the scores even further beyond!

title: Little Tree Kingdom
description: Build a gnome kingdom among the branches of a giant tree in this relaxing mix of city-building and roguelike deckbuilding. Grow the tree, build structures, earn cards and blessings, and survive monsters and disasters. Each run spans seasons and unfolds differently. Can your tree kingdom thrive?

title: Crimson Furnace
description: Manage a clandestine tavern where gangs, poachers, and Council spies cross paths. In this cozy horror simulator, cook cursed dishes, manipulate your patrons, and build your reputation to expand your cult's influence.

title: Elite Beasts
description: From out of the shadows comes a new breed of beast! Put these cute characters through their paces to discover which ones have what it takes to become a true ELITE BEAST. Reach the goal without dying. Kill enemies or collect fruit if that's your jam.

title: Family Reunion
description: Family Reunion is a game about speedrunning a childhood family dinner. Use imagination, conversation, and exploration to make time go faster and finally escape the table.

title: SimuLadron
description:
In SimuLadron, your mission is simple: fire up the money printer and keep the country “running.”
Use the glorious machinery of the State to print bills, promise impossible subsidies, and watch inflation skyrocket faster than your approval ratings.

title: Stop the Press!
description: You run a newspaper in a nation on the brink of revolution. Twist headlines to suit your agenda, upgrade your printing press, mastermind a distribution strategy to grow your readership and evade being censored—or worse—by the Secret Police. With enough influence you can change the course of history.

title: Loco: Rails & Tails
description: Chaotic co-op for 1-4 players! Build rails, protect the train and deliver cargo on time. Pick your favourite animal hero and embark with your friends on wild west adventure!

title: Amaneku Tenshi ni Yakusoku wo
description: A free visual novel about Hololive member Amane Kanata

title: Echo Punk
description: Echo Punk is a roguelite top-down looter shooter with fast-paced combat, tactical upgrades, and endless replayability. Blast through waves of enemies, collect resources, and upgrade your build -- or die trying.

title: Rushcremental
description: Rushcremental is an active incremental journey about searching the wasteland for scrap resources and building a racecar to rule over all the territories.

title: Maid Cafe Coop
description: Become a cute maid in a maid cafe! Prepare to harness your inner moe energy by preparing and serving customers many different drinks and foods with proper Moe Moe Kyun hospitality, and unlock new ways to make them happier. Play singleplayer or with your friends!

title: Asthenia
description: Trapped in a decaying world ruled by cosmic entities, wield the primordial gauntlet to fight distorted foes. Explore, uncover secrets, and use tainted artifacts. Survive or be consumed by Asthenia.

title: Seven Nexus
description: Seven Nexus is an Adult BL/Gay Visual Novel about Grey, a man who dies but can’t go to Heaven or Hell. He must complete the Seven Trials on Earth, accompanied by two Guardians: an angel and a devil. Each choice draws Grey toward virtue or sin… and into deeper intimacy with his Guardians.

title: Mutate! Fight! Purr!
description: A roguelike deck-builder set in a twisted biblical world, where a lone cat mutates to survive the trials of heaven and the pit.

title: Sub-Species
description: At first the alien outbreak spreading throughout the oceans was confined. We delayed our extinction rather than avert it. As part of a salvage crew, you search the hellish containment zones, where a treasure trove of lost tech can help you and your crew eke out a living in a slowly dying world.

title: Fortnite OG: Chapter 1 Season 1
description: Relive the origins of Fortnite Battle Royale, complete with OG loot, OG locations, and OG gameplay in Fortnite OG Chapter 1 - Season 1!

title: Whatta Frogs?
description: Persuade your friends by lying or telling the truth in this social deduction game, all in the pursuit of scoring as many points as possible! Does your box have a fruit? Yes or no, it doesn’t matter—just convince them to pick you!

title: Sinner's Verdict
description: In Sinners Verdict you play as an Inquisitor who must hunt down and banish sinners and perform Justice. Acquire new movement tools on your quest to find the biggest sinner deep within the castle.

title: Persona 5 Royal: Kasumi as Protagonist
description: A cosmetic mod that replaces the protagonist with Kasumi wherever possible, including edited animations and custom artwork.

title: Uh Oh!
description: Play through three VHS tapes, uncovering the mystery of a decrepit facility, eluding tormented beasts, and discovering the truth of the chosen one.

title: Dreadmyst
description: Dreadmyst is an online fantasy RPG running on its own engine. Customize your stats and abilities as you slaughter the aberrations plaguing a cursed land. Choose from four playable classes, level up, farm gear, run dungeons (PvE), and fight other players (PvP). Tab target combat.

title: Barfender
description: Barfender is a chaotic 1–4 player co-op bar sim where you pour drinks, clean disasters, stop fights, and try to keep the bar alive while everything falls apart. Build the place, serve the crowd, survive the night.

title: Phantom Void
description: Possess enemies, steal their powers, and shape your evolution in a cinematic sci-fi horror set in a collapsing dystopian world. Build your strength through a deep skill tree and physics-based combat.

title: Basilisk's Isles
description: Basilisk's Isles is a point and click investigation game. Explore the beautiful painterly islands, talk with their colourful inhabitants, and use the different windows and tools at your disposal to unravel their strange mysteries.

title: Wordy Weapon
description: A word-crafting roguelite! As the Wordsmith, fill in the blanks with Adjectives & Nouns to forge ridiculous weapons with RPG-style names and defeat your enemies.

title: The Frog That Leapt Too Far
description: Frog was kidnapped by a crow, only to be trashed far away from home. He'll have to croak around to find his way back.

title: Loreen's Purgatory
description: Get ready to be hunted by monsters, surprised by jump scares, and tested by the rage-inducing obstacles! Get ready to conquer Loreen's Purgatory! if you can...

title: True Galactic Mission
description: There are 5 pilots in training, each with unique characteristics. It is the day of the final level and everyone wil l face a test to see who will be able to accept the next challenge, a true galactic mission. Be you one of the selecteds!

title: HorrorMon Photography
description: Photograph hallucinations of monsters to make them disappear. When the monsters become real, defend yourself and take more photos to complete your monster dex!

title: Angry Chef World Tour
description: A fast paced mix of solitaire, mahjong, and match puzzles where explosive chefs challenge you to survive chaotic global kitchens.

title: Open The Gate: Just A Little
description: Defense your medieval castle from unfriendly legions approaching in this Tower Defense Rogue-lite PvE. Combine your unique team of Human, Goblin, Undead... to defeat your enemies by slaying the Dragon in shortest amount of time!

title: Shadows Show
description: Are you ready to face the mysteries of the past? The player will explore the gloomy environment of the hospital, encountering creepy phenomena and supernatural creatures. Uncover the story of the disappearance of all the inhabitants of the "Red Forest" sanatorium.

title: Xenogen
description: A distant planet, a buried reactor, an atom of consciousness lost in darkness. Uncover the secret of Xenogen in a journey of precision and tension, where every jump reveals a fragment of truth—and every fall sends you deeper into the depths.

title: Giantfall
description: A minimalist medieval kingdom builder, tower defence real time strategy game where you build defences, research weapons, raise armies to defend the realm. Lead your people, build and defend the kingdom against an invasion of Giants.

title: Inferno Protocol
description: Trapped in a deadly labyrinth, you and 5 friends must scavenge, craft, and survive. Harvest monster parts for gear, inject experimental syringes to gain unique skills, and navigate trap-filled corridors. In this 6-player horror survival, you must evolve to escape.

title: Elden Ring Seamless Co-op
description: Elden Ring is a huge game, and testing every possible route/combination a party might take through the game is impossible. The purpose of the beta is to pool resources, get as much information as possible, and fix bugs as they arise. Updates to address bugs will be frequent.

title: Hollow Knight: Silksong - Sea of Sorrow
