description: Voyage across and beneath the salt-stricken seas in this thrilling nautically-themed expansion of Hollow Knight: Silksong, free for all players in 2026!

title: Biotomata
description: BIOTOMATA is a semi-active, sci-fi themed incremental with elements of strategy and story. Play as a shapeshifting being in constant evolution to explore the insides of an abandoned research facility.

title: Voxel Delvers
description: Descend into procedurally generated dungeons with up to 4 players. Master 4 unique classes, slay bosses, claim legendary loot, and push deeper into the darkness. A voxel co-op dungeon crawler where every run is different.

title: Mia's Reading Adventure: The Search for Grandma's Remedy
description: In Mia: The Search for Grandma's Remedy, players accompany a young mouse on a quest to find a cure for her sick grandmother. Acting as Mia's guide, children ages five to nine navigate through a series of nine language-based puzzles, each unlocking vital clues that propel the journey forward.

title: Mia's Science Adventure: Romaine's New Hat
description: Mia lost her mother's hat to the rat Romaine. The player helps her on a quest to find it, buy it back and return home safely.

title: Tenshoku Maou
description:
A SFW version of "Tenshoku Maou 18+".

Command your demon squad in this epic RPG and master every battle! Smash enemies through slick battles, boost your maidens with gear, and forge their loyalty. Dive into a dark fantasy saga of betrayal and power, where stunning visuals and voiced characters bring the story to life.

title: Dungeon ni Seisoku Da!
description: "Inhabit the Dungeon!" is a 2D dungeon management game where you use a mouse and keyboard to build the ecosystem of a dungeon to your liking and repel adventurers who are trying to destroy the crystal. You are a nature god summoned by the earth spirit Rasta. Use your "power to maintain the dungeon" to rearrange the terrain of the dungeon.

title: Scars of Summer: After
description:
Live out your last two summers with your childhood friend and attempt to save her from the many fates that await her in the backwards village where she grew up. Explore a rural Japanese town, enjoying various activities either alone or with Ryoka. Through fun minigames, try bug-catching, watermelon-splitting, martial arts, part-time jobs, and collecting all the prizes from an old-timey gacha machine.

Keita doesn't have much influence, but he can call Ryoka while she's on her own to chat about what she's doing, or seek her out to talk in person. It's up to you to decide how to stay connected!

title: Feast of the Beast: Unleashed
description: "Top-down action and survival shooter, playable solo or cooperatively. Explore Valachia with your brother and face off against humans, lycanthropes, and rival vampire clans as you advance towards the origin of TOX-Z, the toxin that consumes the world."

title: Not For You
description: Not For You is an album of short, narrative experiences, which you can play through in any order you would like. Each one delves further into the thoughts and feelings of the games developer, Thomas Hunt, and the struggle that is the video game industry.

title: Whoowasit?
description: Reveal the secrets of the speaking animals and find the thief!

title: Halo Infinite: Operation Haloween II
description: Fog gathers. Fear stalks the land. Operation: Haloween II has risen from its dark slumber. To mark the frightful occasion, we’re trick-or-treating Halo Infinite players to a reanimated Survive the Undead playlist, scary-good Squad Battle updates, haunted helmets, and a creature-feature of Haloween costumes and accessories in The Exchange.

title: Halo Infinite: Operation Infinite
description: To celebrate all the Spartans in our Halo Infinite Fireteam, Operation: Infinite introduces a 100-tier free Operation Pass featuring three full armor sets and a 100-tier Premium Pass offering five more sets, six weapon models, and over 30 exclusive Spartan customizations. Upgrade to the Premium Pass at any time to transfer your tier progress from the free Operation Pass and earn your way to eight full sets. Halo Infinite’s last planned multiplayer update also welcomes permanent progression boosts, new maps, refreshed Ranked Seasons, over 200 never-before-seen customizations arriving in The Exchange, and more!

title: The Alters: Signature Edition
description:
Explore an emotional sci-fi game with a unique blend of survival, adventure, and base-building elements. Help Jan Dolski, the sole survivor of an ill-fated space expedition, create alternative versions of himself to escape a hostile planet and tackle personal turmoils with this unconventional crew.

The Signature Edition contains:
Signature Edition Box
Digital download code in game box
Set of 4 pins
Metal keychain
Pierogi Press
Lenticular Card
Sticker Sheet

title: Bogwater
description: Fish and Survive. Your dream home is just on the horizon, and your only method of profit is...fish?! Fish your way to a better life in this "sit and survive" game, BOGWATER! Beware of the leech infestation though. This game was originally made for the Toxic Terror Gamejam.

title: Luigi and the Quest for Nothing Revisited
WonderLang Spanish
description: Learn Spanish through immersive quests, interactive dialogues, and spaced repetition combats. Help a young hero lift a magical curse by mastering Spanish. Customize your learning experience and explore a vibrant world filled with unique characters. Start your journey to Spanish fluency today!

title: Ferret Frenzy
description: Ferret Frenzy is a compilation of four minigames with variants made for Pirate Software's 2024 Game Jam. Starring Ferrets and made for fun by Team Suspiciously Inconspicuous. It's FREE, what are you waiting for?!

title: Defend the Castle
description: Defend the Castle is a day-by-day tower defense roguelike where you face 5 enemy waves per day, upgrade between battles, and struggle to survive as enemies grow stronger. Make the right choices or fall. Some days bring... something else.

title: Jurassic Wrap
description: Rescue baby dino eggs in a family-friendly adventure made by a father & son duo. In Jurassic Wrap, your goal is simple: save the baby dino eggs and make it safely to the exit portal. Along the way you'll leap, dodge, and use clever screen-wrapping mechanics to outsmart threats through each level.

title: Ocean Fishooter
description: Try the best fish-shooting game and experience the most thrilling shooting action and the most immersive adventure! Start your hunting journey now — challenge sea creatures, zombie hordes, fantasy monsters, and ancient dinosaurs to hone your shooting skills!

title: Death in a Party
description: You begin in a theme park forgotten to the world for over a decade. What you uncover will take you further down, below the surface, to man-made horrors you can comprehend. Point and click horror game about nostalgia.

title: ClickShot
description: Lock, Load, Click. A slick clicker game where every click pulls the trigger. Earn shells, unlock wild gun cosmetics, and stack permanent multipliers. Simple to play, hard to quit. Lock, load, and click your way to glory.

title: Maou's Crucible
description: Maou's Crucible is a community-driven horde survivor roguelite featuring original characters from various creators. Enter the Crucible, survive against hordes of enemies, and claim the title of Demon Lord!

title: Mario and Yoshi
description: A faithful fan recreation of Yoshi for the Game Boy.

title: The Christmas Cackler
description: The Christmas Cackler is a first-person Christmas-themed Comedic Horror game where you play as little Jimmy, lying in bed on the night before Christmas, trying to finish drawing his mother's present and avoid getting grabbed by the Christmas Cackler!

title: Super Mario Adventure
description: Super Mario Adventure is a platformer game developed and published by SkahottSan and EdweirdoDaRabid in 2003.

title: Yoshi Invasion
description: Defend Yoshi's Island from the evil robots! Help Yoshi bump them back into the sky, but don't let them break the ground and destroy the island!

title: Valkyrie Tune: Synthesis of Souls
description:
A visual novel that brings the "Valkyrie Tune" plastic model series by Good Smile Company to life.
Experience the resonant story of an amnesiac protagonist and six stunning heroines, whose intertwining serenade of love, sorrow, and fateful encounters calls forth a reboot for the future.

title: Porters
description: Porters is a hilarious 2-4 player co-op platformer! As porters, carry crates, furniture, and quirky items through obstacle-filled levels. Work in sync, don’t lose your arms, and try to deliver everything intact. Can you handle the chaos?

title: An Introvert's Nightmare
description:
The visual novel where you DON'T want to talk to anyone...but everyone wants to talk to you! Sit and survive all alone at a party where you know nobody else. Manage your social battery, maybe scroll on your phone to calm yourself down…and hope you can keep it together as unfamiliar faces try to make small talk with you.
This game is effectively a proof of concept demo, that was originally made for the Toxic Terror Gamejam. A full game release is planned for the future.

title: The Purple Coin: Club Saturn Edition
I Wanna Go for a Walk
Fake Azure Arcology
description: The Earth was hit by 5 meteors 500 years, sending humans underground, underwater or in buildings called “arcology”. However, humans soon forgot how things were like outside of the utopia they lived in. Chihiro lives in Amahara, an arcology built on the land previously known as Japan. He had a passion for ‘flight’ motorsports and trained hard to be like his idol. But his idol died in an accident, and he lost his goal in life. Then one day, a ‘flight’ broke the walls surrounding Amahara, crashed to the ground in front of him and out stepped a golden-haired girl.

title: KimiMuzi: The Merciless Queen of the Pigs
description: Fight off the approaching army of orcs who become female knights. If you lose to an orc, you will receive a humiliating training session. However, if the female knight endures this special training, she will become stronger and stronger. Can you survive the harsh training and defeat all the orcs?

title: Dungeon Divas
description: Dungeon Divas is a block-pushing puzzle game where you solve levels to save a bunch of princesses. Add the rescued maidens to your roster and see their interactions as you proceed through the narrative.

title: PokemonGoGo
description: Added pokemons adventure to Minecraft 1.21.1. Play with friends and have fun!

title: Orium
description: Aboard your ship, exterminate the enemies of profit, exploit planets and expand the corporation’s commercial empire across the stars. Orium is a roguelite infused with streamlined 4X elements.

title: Contraband Police - Crimson Fall
description: It is the year 1983, a month has passed since the end of the Great War. The situation in the territories of the former Republic of Kagastam remains tense. The remnants of General Morin's army are engaged in bloody battles with representatives of the new regime. As an experienced war veteran, you are appointed as the commander of an outpost located at the very heart of the ongoing conflict.

title: Xicon Exedra: Minor Advancement
description:
An RPG game that was first released on June 13th, 2017. The game features creatures from the galaxy known as Formation within the Xicon Exedra Universe. The creatures have transformed into copies of characters outside of the universe as a representation of respect and recognition. A friendly war begins between the galaxy and the Sincrons. Four planets get a representative from each of their worlds to go on a journey to end the war. But what awaits them was unexpected.

This is XiconExertoroyah's first completed RPG game using RPG Maker 2003. A simple game with a simple story.

title: Twilight's Flavors & Delight
description: Twilight's Flavors & Delights is a crossover add-on between Twilight Forest, Farmer's Delight, and Neapolitan. As you battle your way through the Twilight Forest's many foes, you may just discover how tasty an Ur-Ghast's brain can be.

title: Chrono CCG
description: A digital collectible card game involving a war between rival time-traveling syndicates over the fate of history. Built by CCG veterans, incorporating favorite mechanics from a variety of beloved games as well as some new twists like Divers, Timeline Shifting, and Immortalization. Crowdfunded in 2024. Built for the CCG community, by the CCG community.

title: Mechanical Relations
description: Girlfriends Fritter and Marmalade find themselves stranded on a landfill moon in the middle of space! Marmalade seems to think of it as an impromptu vacation, while Fritter is a bit more hesitant to blow off steam. Maybe some alone time is just what they need?

title: Meli
description: Dive into the void with Meli

title: Agromatic
description: Automated farming sim where specialized workers handle all tasks while you focus on strategic decisions. Design efficient layouts, manage supply chains across zones, and optimize your growing operation.

title: Mario's Slightly Unusual Boss Rush: v2.0 Release
Five Nights at Friedrich's
description:
Willkommen to Friedrich's Pizza! A mystical, magical, fantastical restaurant where anything is possible. Our headlining act is, of course, the great Friedrich and his band of lifelike, near-sentient animatronic friends! We are thrilled to have you on board on this life-changing...
You know what? Cut the crap. These things are going to straight up f@cking kill you. Not even exaggerating. I have no idea what their problem is. They almost seem to be having fun with it. But they wanna rip off your arms and gouge out your eyeballs. Are you gonna let them?
Cook pizzas! Read manuals! Fire deadly lasers! Do whatever it takes to keep Friedrich, Bernard, Clara, and any other creeps out of your strange, purple office!
Can you survive Five Nights at Friedrich's?

title: Isolated Hours
description: A 3D horror game where your only goal is to finish your work… and survive the night. Unnatural anomalies creep into the office as you complete your tasks. Can you make it to the end of your shift alive.

title: Wild Cosmos
description: You crashed into an unknown asteroid belt. Explore this alien world, leap between asteroids and find a way to repair your spaceship.

title: Fate Architect
description: Fate Architect is a roguelike deckbuilder where you build and modify symbols on a slot machine to earn points and shape your strategy. Each run offers new combinations, synergies, and challenges as you design the ultimate slot machine of fate.

title: Schlangen-Schmaus
description: Schlangen-Schmaus is a multiplayer arcade game developed with Unity 6 that reimagines the classic Snake mechanics in a competitive battle royale format. Players navigate an arena to consume items and grow in length, utilizing strategy to cut off and trap opponents without hitting walls or themselves. The game distinguishes itself through its tournament structure, where players compete in intense skill-based matches for physical real-world prizes rather than just in-game high scores.

title: The Void: An Incremental Roguelite
description: Roll the reels to determine the outcome of your attacks! An unique mix of luck, strategy and incremental elements comes together in this colorful roguelite; battle out against other lost souls in turn-based combat while traversing through the void, trying to find answers to what you are.

title: Off The Grid: Bad Dream
description:
Off the Grid: Bad Dream (working title: Project Escher) is a first- and third-person psychological thriller and mystery adventure developed by Rare Castle. The game follows a man who survives a fatal car crash and begins experiencing surreal dreams connected to a plane of existence beyond space and time.

Gameplay alternates between the protagonist’s grounded real-world life and an otherworldly dream realm, where consciousness exists as light or energy within mechanical vessels. Players explore non-Euclidean environments, solve puzzles, engage in limited combat, and make narrative choices emphasizing introspection, moral decision-making, and emotional healing over traditional horror.

Featuring cinematic storytelling, dialogue-driven encounters, and visually distinct worlds inspired by impossible geometry and classical art, Off the Grid: Bad Dream blends mystery, philosophy, and emotional depth into a story-driven experience focused on self-discovery and healing rather than fear.

title: Peacemaker: Protect, Search & Destroy

The mod features a new story told over sixteen levels, custom spritework and an optional new soundtrack.

title: Retromine

Spend ore to buy new cards, upgrade your deck, and discover powerful synergies on your way to the bottom of the world.

title: BlitzRift
description: BlitzRift is a PvPvE space extraction shooter for small groups of friends. You are a Blitzer: a hired hand flying a spacecraft through a dense asteroid belt for a corporate syndicate. Break rocks, siphon gems into your hold and bank them at your home port. Everything you carry spills out when you die, and loaded ships trail dust that anyone can read from across the belt. Rifts open on a schedule with the richest gems inside and pull hard on anyone who lingers. The alien Hive mines the same belt, and a loaded Forager is worth more than any rock. Rival syndicates compete for the same claims. Pick a syndicate, drop into a hosted sector with your Steam friends and fly home with the lead. Cockpit first, gamepad first, keyboard and mouse welcome. Online play uses hosted cloud sectors; offline practice is included.

title: The Rooster Files
description: Panic strikes the heart of Miami as horrific massacres take place during the night. We've all seen this story a hundred times, however The Rooster Files takes a twist on your typical Hotline Miami story, as you can now play as both Jacket and the police who are trying to find him. After each level, return to the scene of the crime as the police and hunt for clues to track down the Rooster Man! Featuring Custom Music, Modded Sprites and 9 levels from easy to very hard!

title: SteelGuard
description: Pilot customizable mechs in an epic battle against hordes of enemiesor dive into intense PvP battles where precision aiming can turn the tide, or let your mech's auto-firing system handle the heat of combat. With rogue-lite elements, each run offers a unique challenge and opportunity for growth.

title: Silent Hill Demake

title: Bruisers 2D Boxing
description:
Step into the ring and fight your way to the top in Bruisers 2D Boxing — a gritty, retro-styled boxing RPG where every punch counts and every decision shapes your career.

Welcome to the unforgiving world of professional boxing. Build your legacy from the ground up — train hard, fight smart, and manage the life of an up-and-coming fighter chasing glory. With in-depth 2D boxing action and a rich career mode, Bruisers 2D Boxing captures the raw intensity of the sport like never before.

title: Dino Party
description: Fight your friends through a stadium full of chaotic minigames! Dino Party is a 2–4 player party brawler where you score goals, steal stars, dodge hazards, and settle every round with punches.

title: Treasure Rush Cave Climb
description:
Once upon a time, the quiet town of Chairwood, Florida was greeted by the arrival of Phantom Corporation. For 7 years they dug a massive hole in the town square… until one night they vanished without a trace.

Thirteen years later, Joey receives a strange letter: “DIAMOND SPOTTED IN THE CAVE IN THE CENTER SQUARE OF CHAIRWOOD!!! CLAIM IT IF YOU CAN.”

When Joey’s friends Peter, Michael, and Victoria enter the cave without him, they vanish just like the stories. Now Joey must climb the Tower Cave, rescue his friends, and uncover the truth behind Phantom Corp — before he disappears too.

title: Pratfall
description: A co-op game where you fall, dig, and explode your way down a dangerous cave system to find your lost dog. Catch your friends and watch your step on this journey full of traps, hazards, and the most deadly force of all: gravity. Will you jump into the unknown to rescue your dog?

title: Tetrad
description: Tetrad is a custom made turn-based RPG stylized after games like old school Final Fantasy, Dragon Quest, and The Legend of Zelda. Dungeons are filled with puzzles and difficult monster encounters. The level design is often simple, functional, and little more than a path to the next battle.

title: Cho Noi
description: A Monopoly-like RPG where you fight inanimate objects and sell its remains to unsuspecting shoppers – on boats. Inspired by Vietnam's floating markets, players move around the board via dice to gather collectable stamps, fight enemies for goods, and build storefronts to sell gained goods.

title: Red Means Evil
description: You came to the forest of Yomori to slay a mysterious unicorn. Face the consequences.

title: The Last of Us Part II Remastered: Patch 2.0.0
description:
Two new characters are being introduced for the 'No Return' mode – The Last of Us Part I’s Bill and Marlene. Like with each No Return combatant, these characters offer their own unique playstyles, and should offer both new and returning fans an exciting new opportunity to test their mettle. Bill is a “Smuggler” playstyle who can access a custom pump shotgun from dead drops, and receives double rewards from drops as well. He’s stronger against melee attacks but can’t dodge. Marlene, meanwhile, features a “Risk Taker” playstyle that includes a Custom Assault Rifle, “All or Nothing” gambits, can reroute her No Return path once per run, and more.

Four new maps have also been added to No Return. Overlook, which is set high above the city of Seattle and features plenty of verticality, is the memorable site of a Seraphites encounter in the campaign. School is, during the campaign, the abandoned elementary school in which Ellie and Dina face off against the W.L.F. Streets is set in the overgrown Seattle neighborhood of Hillcrest, while Nest will be familiar to players who have played as Abby through an Infected-infested building.

Other than bugfixes, a new cosmetic from Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet has been added for Ellie.

title: The Last of Us Part II Remastered: Chronological Experience
description:
In this "Chronological Experience" update, new trophies, character skins, and a "Chronological" mode has been added.

We believe players will gain even deeper insight into Part II’s narrative. Players will be able to see how Ellie being gifted a guitar flows so neatly into her learning to play, for example, while the journey through Seattle will showcase the fascinating parallels between Ellie and Abby’s crisscrossing journeys. You’ll see just how close they come into running into each other, how their actions impact each other, and more.

The new trophies are tied to completing the narrative experience in chronological order, doing so will also unlock two new, perhaps surprisingly familiar skins…

title: Valhalla Path

title: As A Vampire
description: A vampire life simulator constructed as an "action-optional" open-world sandbox RPG. Experience both the freedom and the challenges of being a vampire. Enable societal and technological advances by defeating the forces preventing them, or just relax and live a peaceful life. The art is placeholder.

title: Breaching Harkon
description: Breach, upgrade, and unleash chaos in this roguelike shooter where every run builds new gunplay possibilities. Stack wild attachments, forge broken weapon combos, and dive into explosive firefights against a ruthless criminal empire.

Three ruthless demons escaped their ancient prisons and stole the orbs that gave the Sun Wukong his legendary power. If they unlock their secrets, the entire kingdom could fall into chaos.

Good thing the Alliance knows a thing or two about world-ending threats! Together, they must chase the demons across perilous islands and restore balance before it’s too late.

description: NIGHTMARE ON MAPLE ROAD is a survival horror game about juggling two characters at once, where failure for one means death for both. Solve puzzles, explore an abandoned house, and endure quick-time events while keeping them both alive.

title: Human Spirit Agency: A Salvageable Tragedy
description: Human Spirit Agency ~ A Salvageable Tragedy is a free Chinese fangame developed in RPGMaker XP by Bawu Team, heavily inspired by the Ace Attorney Investigations games. Players take on the role of Youmu Konpaku as she solves a series of grisly murders throughout Gensokyo and unwraps the tragedy connecting it all.

title: Trombone Champ: Undertale + Deltarune
description: This DLC song pack brings 14 songs from the UNDERTALE and DELTARUNE Soundtracks to Trombone Champ!

title: Ravenswatch: Merlin
description: The greatest wizard in Avalon awakens from his prison of slumber, stripped of his clairvoyance but not his power. With nature, arcane and sacred magic, Merlin the sorcerer has an extraordinary arsenal. Unlock a new playable hero with this DLC.

title: Dune: Awakening - Raiders of the Broken Lands
description: Raiders of the Broken Lands DLC features a cosmetic pack inspired by the Smugglers of the Imperium. Customize your base with 74 building pieces and 17 decorations, and take the smuggler style into the desert with new armor, weapon, and vehicle variants, a cosmetic swatch, and emotes.

title: Volleyhalla
description: A frantic fantasy ping-pong battler! Also sheep!

title: You Belong Here
description: Family man Philip Oakes wakes up with a piercing headache, unable to remember his past. Dazed, he explores an old home, receiving guidance from a caller on the phone. As Philip walks through the familiar rooms, he uncovers a reality better left forgotten.

title: Slop Fest
description: An incremental horroresque game about feeding a gluttonous beast! Feed it slop, upgrade, repeat!

title: The Night Cleaner
description: Night shift office cleaning. All that greets you, a new hire, is a dirty floor… and a formless sense of unease. In the silent floors above, something is unmistakably moving.

title: Streaming Race
description: Streaming Race is a single-player management game about building and running the career of a music artist. Plan releases, choose singles, manage marketing campaigns, negotiate contracts and follow your results daily and week by week on detailed global charts.

title: The Bomb Split
description: Two mysterious, challenging platformers where you launch yourself with an infinite supply of bombs.

title: Spirit Trigger
description: Play as a bio-organic superweapon in this stylized third-person shooter. Combine guns and swords, adapt to limb regeneration, and unleash over-the-top combos with intense, cartoonish violence.

title: Flip Hammy
description: Flip Hammy is a 2D puzzle game with unique stages that you can flip its face. Let's clear simple rules puzzles with Hammy!

title: Chronosmith's Saga
description: Travel across the time-bending world of Tempora, master and plan routes through a branching static map, manage energy, grind and hunt exclusive drops as you face Vexar in a rougelike RPG designed for strategy and replayability.

title: A Frog in a Small Pond
description: It is a game in which a frog that has heard about the sea from another frog goes on an adventure. Help the frog go through the forest and into the sea.

title: Sukima: The Creeping Gap
description: A gap somewhere in your room begins to open on its own, little by little. If you can’t find it and close it before it opens completely. A first-person escape game centered around the fear of gaps.

title: I Shouldn’t Have Drawn That!
description: Decks are dungeons. Each turn reveals four cards and you must face three: fight monsters, swap weapons, or manage your health in this single player rougelike dungeon crawler. Build custom dungeons and share runs with your friends using the same shuffled decks, so everyone faces the same challenges!

title: Where Are We Floating?
description: A 1–4 player co-op adventure where you sail across a wild sea in search of a legendary treasure.

title: Clans of Four Color: Impossible Promise
description: Third person action adventure chess indie game, you explore colorful maps and fight the Red Clan to save your family.

title: Nocturn
description: Nocturn is a strategy rogue-like game where you have to survive eternal darkness. Rebuild your outpost, manage villagers, survive random events and assaults to bring back the light to the world!

title: Veil: Project Conductor
description: The train derails in an abandoned tunnel.No signal, no exits — only darkness and the broken remains of the carriage.You are an undercover journalist, and you had a reason to be on this train.

title: Find All: Christmas 2025 - Extra Level
description: Explore the shops in the shopping center in the run-up to Christmas, find 270 different items and paint the black and white picture with colored paints.

title: Twisted Fate
description: A turn-based roguelike with a deep ability-modification system. Lead a party of three heroes, adapt their skills using modifiers, collect artifacts, and craft unique builds to destroy the source of corruption… or die trying.

title: Kumasama
description: A large brown shadow lurks in the abandoned factory; the night hides her form.Something terrifyingly massive is concealed within this town.I think of her, and of the days I can never go back to.“KUMASAMA” is a horror adventure set in the present day.

title: William's Wideblock
description: A simple and sharp puzzle game. With a wide array of shapes. Stack the blocks neatly to fill the play space and clear blocks horizontally, or choose when to utilize an ability to clear blocks vertically. Any form of block clearing progresses the game and further accelerates the pace!

title: Intergalactic Cleaning Squad
description: Meet Zephyra, Robuddy and Niles in this tactical arcade space action clicker game! Can you defeat all 25 levels of interplanetary evil and restore peace in the universe?

title: Archer of Den
description: The evil in the air has it's grip on everything. So it's up to you and your trusty bow to put a stop to it. You will travel a diverse set of lands to accomplish your goal. in this Action Adventure you have to do what it takes, run, shoot, slide, bomb , and even fly to bring back peace.

title: A Philosophical Discussion of Worms
description: A Philosophical Discussion of worms is a Kinetic Visual Novel that explores two characters, Vynder and Ophiel, as they navigate cohabitation in a strange, unfamiliar house when they don't speak the same language.

title: Static Voice
description: Artyom, a resident of an old Soviet apartment block, finds himself trapped after a factory explosion releases a deadly gas. He plans to explore the toxic entrance to build an SOS transmitter with his friend Viktor. But the building is no longer safe, and his neighbors are hunting in the silence.

title: Emu Empire
description: Build your empire, manage resources, and ascend to greatness in Emu Empire—a quirky strategy game where every decision shapes your legacy!

title: Diluted
description: Diluted is a 3/4ths puzzle adventure-action game where nightmares seep into reality. Play as Archie, an orphan bound to a living nightmare, and uncover the truth behind his matron's orphanage as you explore twisted forests and corrupted memories.

title: Duolty
description: Duolty is a mystery, exploration and puzzle game developed by a single person. Dive into a strange world and befriend its curious inhabitants. Will you discover who you really are before it’s too late?

title: Run Giraffe Run
description: Run Giraffe Run is a multiplayer fast-paced giraffe racing 2D platformer. Poop bombs. Spit banana peels. Slip on banana peels. Race against friends through chaotic and colorful levels. Have you tried farting?

title: The Seven Bad Apples
description: Ranko and her friend Astrid must investigate the case of some missing scores just before the big Christmas concert of the academy. Help them question the seven daunting suspects before it's too late!

title: Cochonnet
description: Play Pétanque online with your friends, the traditional french ball-throwing sport where 2 teams compete to land their metal balls closest to the target.

title: Tubby's Wonderful Town
description: Tubby's Wonderful Town is an indie first-person horror game featuring quests, exploration, item collection and a day-night transition that starts as a friendly colorful to a robotic nightmare full of corrupted visuals and distortions

title: Deadrock Salvation
description: The frontier of Deadrock Salvation is an immersive Open World RPG on the edge of a gun barrel and temptation hides behind every saloon door. In DR2, you step into the boots of Colt Dawson, a weary gunslinger searching for a second chance in a land that's forgotten the meaning of mercy.

title: Trickshot Tactics
description: Billiards will never be the same again! Trickshot Tactics is where sharp minds meet sharper shots, a wild mix of deck building, strategy, and pure skill. Play your cards, bend the rules, and show who really knows how to handle a cue!

title: Rewindead
description: Rewindead is a single-player, third-person shooter about contract killing in time loops. Assassinate your target, rewind time, then eliminate your past selves before they complete the hit.

title: The Champions of Lootheim
description: The Champions of Lootheim is an action roguelike where you face hordes of creatures to survive. Have fun defeating enemies to evolve your attributes throughout the game and buy permanent upgrades in the shop, as well as equipment dropped in chests by powerful enemies.

title: Dunk Cookies
description: Break cookies. Dunk them in milk. Repeat. A satisfying incremental game where you crush cookies into a swirling vortex of milk. Upgrade your breaking power, unlock new stats via an expansive skill tree, and discover the ultimate satisfaction of the perfect dunk.

title: Liar’s Line
description: A monster is hunting you from the phone line. A tense detective mystery. Listen to each caller, compare their stories, and expose the liar before you give away your location. One wrong judgment, and it comes to your door.

title: Monstro Maestro
description: Play as a conductor trapped in a haunted and crazy mansion! As a concert begins, a jealous ghost appears and takes possession of your orchestra. To free them, you must explore every corner of the mansion, complete musical challenges, and rebuild your troupe.

title: Carrot Catcher
description: Squish, dash, jump, survive, repeat. Carrot Catcher is a fast-paced arcade game where you grab floating carrots, dodge hazards, and chase high scores. Simple to play, hard to master—how long can you keep up before it all gets out of hand?

title: Rogueblock
description: Classic puzzle mechanics meet roguelite chaos. Stack blocks, draft powerful upgrades, and survive the ever-changing challenges in this adventure.

title: Arrow Bingo
description: "Touch the arrow to slide the balls together, leading to One Away, then Bingo!" Touch the arrow to slide an entire line in its direction. You guide the balls to the matching color and pattern sheets and make them reach the goal, line them up to get Bingo, and sink them.

title: End of Garbage
description: A darkened sky. A blazing fire. A wretched tombstone. And you, here at the end of everything. End of Garbage is a short, first-person puzzle game exploring the dark surreality of endings.

title: Monster Tavern
description: A Roguelite Deckbuilder where drinks are your weapons and monsters are your guests. Serve smart, upgrade your drinks and hold the bar together for another night.

title: Casenology
description: A top-down tactical shooter where you'll fight enemies, rescue hostages, and complete various missions. But it's not that simple — you'll face shortages of ammo, medkits, and all kinds of resources. So, is it worth engaging in a firefight? Think before you act!

title: Private Lesson with My Lover Teacher 2
Candy Girl
description: Main character is a normal office worker, brother or trainer - depending on the choice. But in every path your opponent is a doll with a soul. Can dolls really pursue the same way of life as people?

title: Kotowari: Kimi no Kokoro no Koboreta Kakera
description: When Mishiro was small, half of his soul was eaten by a toothed deity. Since then he has had to deal with spirits called kotowari that reside in the darkness of the souls of people who are related to him, no matter how distant. Kotowari are soul fragments created from a person’s suffering and they can normally only be seen, heard and touched by that individual. Even if the kotowari is destroyed, it will keep respawning unless the cause of the suffering is resolved. Shortly after transferring to a school in a history-laden sightseeing town, Mishiro encounters a kotowari and decides to search for its owner. However, there isn’t just one kotowari as many other girls harbour their own suffering.

title: Ken Griffey Jr.'s Horrible Tower
description: Torture platformer from hell. Move with arrow keys, jump with Z.

title: Aruma Ketera
description:
AruMa KeteRa is a 2D shooter game developed by a personal developer "lol_rust" that introduces an RPG-like growth system.

Manipulate a character called "身身身", use strategic systems such as absorption of barrage, stop of time, etc., and collect energy called "krm", Let's challenge the stage while growing your character.

title: The Not-Deer Stew
description: A Christmas folk-horror cooking adventure where you hunt the Not-Deer to finish the recipe.

title: Kirugakuen
description:
A faded memory, hidden piece of an unfinished puzzle.

Remember. Remember that person who is key to your story, and remember why they are. Dive into the depths of your mind before it’s too late...

Before everything turns into a lost dream.

title: Paperback
description:
Logic-oriented puzzles and mechanics make up most of this game with a fully integrated physics and object-grabbing system, drawing inspiration from horror games of the past and present.

The game takes roughly 30-60 minutes to finish depending on your own individual pace. It features multiple paths the player can take, and even has a secret easter egg. Think you can be the first to find it?

title: Eggtastic
description: Eggtastic - A retro puzzle game where you paint, mask, and design eggs to match the target. Simple to learn, fun for all ages.

title: Creaworm
description: In this short indie puzzle game you play as a little bookworm with a big dream. Find morsels of lost knowledge across the maze, craft spells to pass doors, and find the way to the land of dreams.

title: Paklyx
description: PAKLYX is a turn-based puzzle game about finding the correct sequence of moves. Use special buttons to manipulate timers, delay them, and collect all keys in the level.

title: Starvester
description: A short incremental game about expanding a star-system wide factory to build giant megastructures in space. Deploy swarms of drones, mine resources, unlock upgrades and harvest the power of the stars!

title: Amidar
description:
Pico-8 version of the 1981 Konami arcade game.

Most "enemies" (the Amidar) follow a set movement pattern. The blue enemies are tracers and circuit the outside. On later levels, after a set number of circuits, they start to chase you!

title: Ballet of Steel
description:
Play as a ballet dancer with incredible reflex, who can see bullets coming and swiftly swat them back, using the enemies weapons against them. With an unknown motive, she dives deep into the ruins of what was once a bustling metropolis, to find answers...

This is an atmospheric turn-based bullet hell game prototype inspired by games such as Enter The Chronosphere, Ultrakill, Radio the Universe and TWWWR. Fight your way through 9 floors full of mechanical foes in a dying world.

title: North Sentinel Island
description: A young man and woman, a rising YouTube couple, travel to the forbidden North Sentinel Island and vanish. Their last upload shows their approach to the island. Five days later, the Indian Coast Guard finds their empty boat drifting offshore. No bodies. No clues. No contact.

title: Rosa + Juliet
description:
Rosa ✞ Juliet is an upcoming dark and grotesque RPGMaker horror game about exploring both the abandoned and twisted “Sohenwicht University,” and the relationship with your often malicious co-conspirator Juliet.

Inspired by classic RPGMaker horror games like ‘Ib,’ ‘Wadanohara and the Great Blue Sea,’ ‘Mad Father,’ and the more recent ‘Fear&Hunger,’ danger lurks everywhere throughout Sohenwicht University. Escape from monsters, traps and other hazards - with gruesome consequences if you fail.

Traverse parallel universes, turn back time and set up stable time-loops to solve puzzles and duplicate items. Different choices lead to different outcomes across different timelines.

title: Cybersoul: Undercity Rot
description: System Breach: Undercity Rot is spreading. Contaminate the grid with 3 new Factions: The illicit Black Market, the mutating Helix Vats, and the deceptive Media Moguls. Total System Access: 9 Factions & 300+ Cards. Mutate the flesh, spin the truth, or steal the win.

title: NFSCO
description:
The definitive Need for Speed: Carbon experience.

NFSCO is a C++ modification for the PC version of Electronic Arts' Need for Speed: Carbon.
The project patches numerous problems with the original game, improves graphics and performance, extends modification capabilities, and much more.

title: Silicon Scars
description: Running. Gunning. Reading.

title: Behold the Horde
description: An endless horde advances without rest. Survive infinite waves, dodge the chaos, and fight for the top spot on the online leaderboard.

title: Antique Dealer Simulator
description: Run your own cozy antique shop where every item has a story. Buy and sell furniture and collectibles, manage customer needs and smart pricing, expand and upgrade your store, and grow your reputation from a small-town trader to a respected antique dealer.

title: Cataclysmic Bite
description: Cataclysmic Bite is a dark fantasy horror, turn based RPG where survival means hiding, listening, and holding onto your sanity. You follow a small group of travelers Lila, Malcolm, Elias, Rowan, and Alice. They uncover the truth behind, the demon cat curse spread across the village.

title: Reap & Repay
description: Reap and collect the crops to repay the debt of villagers in this short, non-idle incremental game. Start weak, invest in the skill tree to unlock various new abilities and become strong enough to harvest every field.

title: Mining Shift
description: Mining Shift is an incremental game about mining minerals and upgrading your skills to conquer your shift.

title: Santaquest
description: Embark on Santaquest, a festive grind through the frozen North Pole! Play as Santa himself, battling holiday foes, collecting loot, and upgrading your gear to save Christmas. Snow, steel, and sleigh bells collide in this wintery RPG adventure from NecroCatic Games.

title: Asylum Denied
description: Asylum Denied is a survival horror game about escaping an abandoned mansion once used as an asylum for WWI veterans.

title: Butler! Summon the Imps!
description:
Tonight is the lord of the manor's summoning soirée, but the manor has been infested with imps!

As the butler(-in-training), you have to banish the imps by fighting back with your own summoned imps, so that you can combine them and banish them all at once in this imp-matching arcade puzzle game!

title: Pingorile
description: An indie retro-style 2D platformer where you play as a penguin collecting yellow budgies to fulfill his dream of flying, featuring both traditional jump'n'run as well as JRPG inspired elements.

title: Wibbly's Treasure Hunt
description: Wibbly requires you to embark on a brand new 3D platforming adventure filled with excitement and terror! Collect the required objects needed for Wibbly's own resurrection! Nothing could possibly go wrong!

title: Faster Bunnies
description: Raise, race and breed bunnies in a roguelike management sim like you've never experienced! Synergize your stable managers' abilities with your bunnies' natures and breed your best racers together to get faster and faster with every generation before time runs out and you face the championship race!

title: Sacred: Last Pixel of Ancaria
description: Sacred returns as a party-based RPG set in a ruptured and battle-worn post-war Ancaria. Featuring hybrid real-time and turn-based combat, handcrafted 16-bit pixel art, and an open world from the original creators of Sacred. Build your party! Loot everything! Laugh at the rest!

title: Red Howl
description: Social deduction game for 4 to 15 players, inspired by Little Red Riding Hood. 3 factions clash: use your unique powers and unmask them before the Blood Moon turns against you, or be devoured.

title: Devoris
description: You become a bird living in the sewers, killing and eating other inhabitants to fill your stomach. Of course, as an adventurer, you can choose to explore the underground world to obtain new weapons, new delicacies, discover the stories here, and even the secrets of the gods.

title: Spirited Line
description: Spirited Line is a boss rush hack ‘n’ slash action game where every hit you take is fatal. Master precise, skill-based combat against unique spirits in a surreal, minimalist subway world. Fast-paced duels demand focus, timing, and patience to survive.

title: Wood Clicker
description: Hold to chop wood, earn resources, and grow your idle lumber empire in this relaxing 2D idle clicker game!

title: Valkyrie Heart
description:
From your birth, you were tasked with preventing Ragnarök.

Under the guidance of goddess freyja, you will embark on a time-spanning journey using Ymir's chest,

Encountering Einherjar of all kinds and forming contracts with them. Complete missions to alter the predetermined course of fate and write ultimate destiny of the Nine Realms...

title: Dead Dog
description: Dead Dog is a stealth puzzle-platformer where you control an undead assassin. Master teleportation, invisibility, and shadow clones to infiltrate enemy bases, outsmart patrols, and uncover a hidden past.

title: Fate/Empire of Dirt: Made in Heaven
description: An append to Fate/Empire of Dirt which adds new routes for Nightingale, Kiara and a new original character. Also introduces Anastasia, Murasaki Shikibu and Consort Yu as sub-heroines.

title: Xmas Survivors
description: A brutal pixel-art holiday survival shooter where Santa slaughters endless waves of enemies.

title: Klaws
description: Embark on a chilling adventure through a mysterious forest on a cold Christmas Eve night, searching for ornaments to decorate a Christmas tree. But bewaresomething lurks in the snowy darkness

title: Santa With Gun
description: This is a top-down shooter. You are Santa Claus and you save Christmas!, find the Christmas presents, so that the children can celebrate a happy Christmas. Find paths, solve puzzles, jump, run, and shoot.

title: President of Steel
description: President of Steel is a choice-driven political strategy game where every decision shapes the fate of your nation. Balance power, stability, and economy while navigating political intrigue, war threats, organized crime, and personal relationships.

title: Pixelance
description: Pixelance is a turn based roguelike adventure RPG with permadeath and multiple quests within dungeons and a vast overworld.

title: Restoring the Past: The Beauty of Porcelain 3
description: Unlock 12 brand-new levels and repair these damaged porcelain wares.

title: Sub Terra Draconis: Hidden Glade
description: Join a young dragon on his search for hoard! A level pack for Sub Terra Draconis with 30 additional challenges!

title: Pepper Rush
description: Half duck. Half dog. Total chaos. Rosan got separated from Grandpa Spike in Pepper City and needs to get to the airport ASAP! Dodge insane traffic, eat peppers to turn into an unstoppable beast, and avoid sweets so you don't get too fat to run. It's crunch time in Pepper Rush!

title: Moving with the Moon: Mastering Universal Gravitation!
description: This is a new action game where you steer the earth. Steer the Earth, when both the Earth and the Moon are in the goal zone, the stage is cleared. Stars are constantly pulling on each other with universal gravitation. You can experience a simulated universal gravitation.

title: Chart Weaver
description: Break the board with powerful synergies, discover game-defining relics and alter your deck in this market-inspired roguelike! Chart Weaver is a mesmerizingly simple but deep score-attack deckbuilder where you create magnificent combos and weave intricate patterns.

title: 3876 AD: Corruption
description: A hardcore military sci-fi survival roguelike set in the post-apocalyptic world of 3876 AD. Engage in tense tactical combat, scavenge for resources, complete dangerous quests, and explore an immersive lore full of dark themes and meaningful decisions.

title: Echidna Wars DX
description:
Echidna Wars DX (Japanese: ミリア戦記DX, Milia Senki DX)is a 2D side-scrolling beat-'em-up action video game developed by ASIMOFU and D-Gate, released on December 31, 2016, exclusively for PC.

Echidna Wars DX is a pixel-art, side-scrolling action game with beat-'em-up mechanics. Players control one of four heroines (Mirea, Sachiho, Usaco and TGO-07), battling through three main stages, each divided into smaller areas with a boss at the end.

title: DreadBound
description: DreadBound is an atmospheric action roguelike with immersive sim elements. Steal your soul back from a cursed city, hide on roofs, eat bugs, make deals with demons, throw vases at your enemies.

title: Last Second Save
description: A story set in Cavemanon's Snoot Game by snoot_talk. Anon gets his act together and stops himself at the very brink of Ending 1. Now that he's at the edge of the abyss, he has to make his way back up. Alas, he can't undo the damage that's already been done, but that doesn't mean he won't try.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 - 1-Year Anniversary Edition
description:
Embody the superhuman skill and brutality of a Space Marine. Unleash deadly abilities and devastating weaponry to obliterate the relentless Tyranid swarms. Defend the Imperium in spectacular third-person action in solo or multiplayer modes.

1-Year Anniversary Edition includes the Season Pass 1.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 - 2-Year Anniversary Edition
description:
Embody the superhuman skill and brutality of a Space Marine. Unleash deadly abilities and devastating weaponry to obliterate the relentless Tyranid swarms. Defend the Imperium in spectacular third-person action in solo or multiplayer modes.

2-Year Anniversary Edition includes the Season Pass 1 and Season Pass 2.

title: Octodad Shorts
description:
It’s finally time… time for two brand spakin’ new levels of Octodad: Dadliest Catch; the Shorts! After the great response Octodad received from y’all, we wanted to give back a little in thanks for your support. Everyone who currently owns Octodad: Dadliest Catch as well as anyone who grabs a copy in the future will get these levels FREE through the new v1.2.x patch.
In addition to the new levels, there will be an assortment of bug fixes and smaller features, such as multiple mouse support for co-op, persistent checkpoint on last played freeplay/shorts level, and a global story timer.

title: 20,000 Leagues Under the Sea: Extended Edition
description: Help Captain Nemo's three captives escape from the Nautilus.

title: A Tale for Anna: Collector's Edition
Roll or Die
description: The roguelike dicebuilder. Build your dice bag and go as far as you can in this underground casino! Earn chips, place your bets, combine unique dice, and create absurd synergies as you advance through increasingly exclusive rooms. Bet it all, challenge your luck, and reach the top — or die trying.

title: Only Faces Remain
description:
You play as Marlene, a backpacker traveling alone, who finds a cheap room to spend the night.

Only Faces Remain is a short psychological horror experience.

title: Armor Attack
description: Armor Attack invites you to assemble your squad of sci-fi machines for intense PvP action! Lead robots, tanks, and hovers, each equipped with powerful weapons and unique abilities. Strategically combine these units to dominate the battlefield in a dynamic, evolving environment where every move matters.

title: Teh Scrunglybois: Working Title
description: Teh Scrunglybois: Working Title is a 3d platformer set in the printed world of Teh Scrunglybois, Pick between an average Scrungle or a taller Lunar Scrungle and prepare yourself for a strange adventure between the slide lines of those who are more important than you.

title: Foillower
description: Welcome to Davenburg. On a snowy night downtown, Mitch makes a simple stop on his way to his girlfriend Claire's house. Food. A gift. Then home.

title: Spibee
description: A cooperative puzzle-platformer! Join a cute spider and bee on a thrilling adventure! Solve puzzles together, enjoy fun PvP minigames, and face epic boss battles!

title: Moonchrome.
description: "Moonchrome." is a monochrome JRPG in which you travel to various locations to raise the moon and save a colorless world.

title: Relative Frame
description: Explore space in a hand crafted, physics based universe, with immersive sound and atmosphere. Fight and board ships, collect rare cargo, and upgrade your ship.

title: The Shaman Diary
description: A turn-based RPG with strategic combat, character progression, and a strong narrative in a vast heroic-fantasy world... Level up, gear up, learn skills, and meet allies in an original story!

title: Westlanders
description: Forge your legacy in the Westlands. Survive and thrive in a Wild West open world. Alone or with friends, explore, fight, and build from your customizable wagon. Expand into bustling settlements, recruit allies, and forge a network to tame the wilderness and build your legacy.

title: Rogue Cave
description: Descend into a crystal filled cave in this roguelike rail shooter. Smash ammo gems to mine more ammo, destroy traps, gather EXP, and adapt your strategy with game changing perks, but run out of ammo, and it’s all over…

title: Clockwork Cleanup
description: Clockwork cleanup is a auto-battler game where your actions are dictated by tiles of various shapes placed in a grid. Defeat waves of enemies to save the factory!

title: The Mushroom Journal
description: The Mushroom Journal is a Single-Player RPG, that takes you on an adventure to Mush Meadows. Mush Meadows is a mushroom-centered village, where you will have to help your neighbours by identifying and collecting them to uncover the mysteries that may lie under trading table.

title: The Remains of Dahlia
description: In the early 2010s, a housewife known as “Dahlia” was reported missing after running away from home. Her husband, Bowo, filed a report with the police, but the investigation yielded no results. With no clear answers, Bowo decided to investigate the case on his own.

title: Obsessed: Trace
description: Haunted by loss and guilt, Arya is lost between reality and delusion as he tries to uncover the truth behind the disappearance of Valeria. The daughter of his late friend that worked at his shop

title: Backrooms Santa
description: Backrooms Santa is a singleplayer horror game. Bring back the kids gifts and escape a massive Backrooms maze — while holiday horrors hunt you every step of the way. How fast can you save the kids christmas?

title: Endless Asphalt
description: Dive into a fast-paced endless runner designed with a clean and simplistic style that puts the focus on pure gameplay. Easy to pick up but hard to put down, Endless Asphalt delivers that addictive, “just one more run” feeling!

title: Room Rules
description: Room Rules is an experimental simulator focused on the study of anomalous rooms. Follow the protocols, complete test sessions, and analyze the behavior of anomalous “Rooms.”

title: Christmas Incident
description: Christmas Incident is a short horror game inspired by SCP-4666. The Yule Man and created for the Christmas Miracle Horror Jam.

title: Metanet Hunter G4
description:
Metanet Hunter G4 is called that thanks to it being a huge leap in quality from the past games. It is about a lone Cyberspace Samurai, the METANET HUNTER, and his adventures through Cyberspace to tackle the CHAOS ORBS.

You'll get a short-but-sweet action-packed adventure, featuring six intense stages, incredible boss fights, and endless fun with the new Time Attack Mode. Clear the game once, and see how well you play!

There are over 50 different gameplay palettes you unlock by playing Metanet Hunter G4, found throughout the levels, or tons of the game's secrets. We even have some alternate forms of gameplay with the Jetpack Upgrades that the player can unlock!

We also have the Bosses out once again, and this time, it is serious. Featuring multiple phases, and rockin' old-school-style music, you'll be OBLITERATING THE ORBS in no time.

title: Ouchi de Amaeru Shakaijin Kanojo no Renai Moyou
description: A heartwarming visual novel about a romance with a younger female colleague. Enjoy an authentic office love story between two working adults navigating their careers and their feelings for each other.

title: Five New-Fangled Nights
description: You've found yourself a brand new job; workin' as night watchman for a kiddy restaurant downtown. Should be a piece of cake! The pay's...average, but hey, at least the work's easy! Right?

title: Cybersoul: Digital Sorcery
description: System Patch: Digital Sorcery is active. Hack the reality engine with 3 new Factions: The time-warping Chrono Drifters, the occult Circuit Mystics, and the glitching Transhacks. Total System Access: 12 Factions & 400+ Cards. Rewind the clock, curse the code, or ghost the machine.

title: Hoop Dungeon
description: Hoop Dungeon is a basketball turn-based tactical roguelike game. Use the powers of friendship and rivalry to become a better basketball player and conquer the Hoop Dungeon.

title: Faz-Karts
description: Rev up your engines in BoxSoft's newest game, Faz-Karts! Hop into a server with up to 7 of your friends, and race against them with a variety of FNaF's most iconic characters!

title: Dust to Dust
description: Fight for your afterlife in DUST TO DUST! As a ghost on the run in a specter research facility, dash through interconnected levels, befriend the psychic Matthias, and take control of his body and powers to break down hostile coalesced creatures and wipe them out once and for all.

title: The Light Of Our Yearning
description: I marched to the shine like moth to death, yearning for salvation

title: Soli-tair-ror
description:
A game where you play Solitaire before your sanity runs out, and avoid the demon that lurks.

This game takes a spin on the classic single player card game Solitaire, and turns it into a horror experience for the player.

The game features multiple ways to die within the solitaire match, as well as other challenges to distract you from completing your decks. Keep the creature at bay, and skillfully complete the game of solitaire.

title: Convenience Store Simulator
description: A game about running and managing your own convenience store. Actively work the register, master stock and inventory, make and sell coffee, hire unique staff, and fully decorate your space. Strategically expand your business and play special mini-games for prizes.

title: Super Star Battle Royale
description:
It's a peaceful galactic year on the Solar System... Until Sol is abducted by a Black Hole to take part in the Super Star Battle Royale!

Now Sol must survive an entire boxing tournament against her fellow stars if she wants to win and return home, since the losers... Will be devoured by the Black Hole!

title: Bridgelands
description: Explore the mysterious islands of Bridgelands, fight dangerous creatures, gather resources, and craft powerful gear. Discover hidden secrets, upgrade your tools, and dive into fast-paced battles across ever-changing islands. An action-packed adventure full of exploration and combat awaits.

title: Mountain Taxi Challenge
description: Take on the ultimate driving challenge in Mountain Taxi Challenge! Navigate treacherous mountain roads, pick up diverse passengers, and complete 30 unique missions—from emergency rescues to time-sensitive drop-offs. Can you master the winding paths and become the best taxi driver in the mountains?

title: Full Stride
description:
Full Stride is a jockey racing game focused on first-person riding and skill-based race control.
Players manage speed, stamina, positioning, and timing while adapting to each horse’s characteristics and the layout of 3D racecourses.

title: Go Go Burunyanman Ecstasy!!!
description:
Soreyuke! Burunyan-man Ecstasy!!! was based on the Hardcore edition, but added elements from Portable version and added H-scenes.

In the new "Ecstasy" mode, combo system, breaking effect, new enemies and stages were added. Some enemies attack patterns were refreshed.

title: The Legend of Sword and Fairy 4: Remake
Assassin's Creed III: Freedom Edition
description:
The Freedom Edition contains:

- Assassin's Creed III (base game)
- a steel book case with cover art drawn by comic artist Alex Ross
- George Washington's notebook
- a 24 cm figurine of the protagonist Connor
- two exclusive lithographs
- In-game content: two exclusive single player missions (Ghost of War and Lost Mayan Ruins) and an additional multiplayer character (Sharpshooter).

title: Bby don't hurt me
description: BBY DONT HURT ME is an anti-dating furry Desktop Companion. Get insulted and intimately interrogated by furries with no safeword. Laugh, cry, either way, mascara cleanup’s part of the welcome package.

title: Project Killdance
description: Project KILLDANCE is a Noir tactical action featuring a one-army strategy and instant-death combat. Slowly observe surroundings, choreograph each killing move, leave no survivor, and become the spectral death.

title: Party Party Anxiety!
description: A dating card game for anxious people. Use conversation cue cards up your sleeves to make connections. But beware—the more anxious you get, the scarier they become.

title: Way of the Hunter 2
description: Feel the thrill of the hunt and keep an eye out for the wild and wonderous species that are roaming the North American wilderness and the African Savanna. Hunt and display big game like Moose, and Cape Buffalo as well as, smaller animals and birds.

title: Songs of Silence: Celestial Church Expansion
description: Decades after the Crusade's defeat, rumors of a Witch leading a new order spark an age of Inquisition... Wield the full powers of the Celestial Church in both Campaign and Skirmish, with this Songs of Silence expansion!

title: Allrams Höjdarspel
description:
Allrams Höjdarspel is a Swedish video game based on SVT's christmas calendar of 2004; Allrams Höjdarpaket. It was made by Upside Studios and published by PAN Vision.

Allrams Höjdarspel consists of 25 minigames that could be unlocked by inputting codes shown in the TV christmas calendar it was based on. Each minigame was based on the episode of the calendar in which the code was shown.

title: Follow Us
description: A co-op horror game for 2 players, where you risk your life outside to entertain a world that never leaves home. On Follow Us, contestants work in pairs: one explores, the other guides. Trust is your lifeline.

title: Warhead Circus
description: Dodge! Evade! Slip past! A rogue-like specialized in avoidance. Survive the twisting and turning missile circus!

title: Occupied
description: a funi little game made in two weeks during the GDKO Gamejam

title: Gretel & Hansel
description: Gretel & Hansel is a delightfully twisted exploration-adventure crafted entirely by hand in watercolor. Abandoned in a cursed forest, you play as Gretel, guiding her brother home while outwitting deadly traps, unraveling sinister puzzles, and escaping the clutches of a ravenous witch.

title: Satellite Odyssey: Jupiter
description:
Rogue machines, mutant insects, and jazz echoing through deep space
A stylish blend of survival horror and noir detective mystery wrapped in a decopunk aesthetic. Beautifully unsettling.

title: Buried Spirits
description: A minesweeper game where you can use your magical abilities to deal with pesky odds. Save your concentration resource to speed up the process or get rid of tiebreakers. Mine your way through without disturbing the spirits.

title: Nebula Veil
description: Only tiny, fragile shuttle between you and open space. Beyond it, wreckages drift in blood-red fog. The longer you’re alone, the less dead the cosmos around feel. Survival isn’t enough. Seek answers, analyze data, examine anomalies. To unveil fog’s secret, every detail matters.

title: League of Piss
description: "John Fogle, Aini, and the Purple Hat Man are back and ready for a sublime bullet experience. and also driving a bus and this time there are no police but there are stink bugs" Surreal indie game!

title: Gnomes Garden: Mask of the Rat King - Collector's Edition
Byouki na Generation: Crane Catcher no Bourei
Dark Farts: Parody Smell Edition
description: The most absurd Souls-like parody ever! You’re a blacksmith with bean-powered dragon abilities, taking on evil corporations with maximum gasitude! Fart-dash, demolish bosses, and break the fourth wall in this hilarious action RPG. Smell the legend!

title: The Tickle People
description: a 3D graphics FPS game by ChiselBrain Software and uses Pie in the Sky (3D Game Creation System) engine.

title: Rivalia Online
description: Rivalia Online is a classic-style fantasy MMORPG inspired by early Tibia gameplay, focused on slow progression, meaningful PvE and PvP, and a player-driven world. Explore dangerous lands, face challenging monsters and bosses, master professions, and forge your legacy in a harsh but rewarding online realm built for long-term adventure.

title: FNAF: Killer in Purple 2
description:
After over half a million people killed kids, William Afton thinks it's enough to finish is project called Malhare. He saves the data and stored it on a hard drive in case something in his plan goes wrong.
When he goes to the surface, William is again thirsty for blood.
He starts his own pizzeria, where he lures kids and kill them for fun.

title: Abracademia
description: Become a wizard, and a thumping good one! Abracademia is a cozy mage idle life-sim that lives on your screen and keeps you company while you work or play. Pick a coven, manage your daily routine, learn spells, make friends, embark on adventures, and pass exams on your way to graduation.

title: Hexa Merge
description: Hexa Merge is a captivating puzzle game that combines strategic thinking with satisfying merge mechanics on a unique hexagonal grid. Match and merge tiles to unlock beautiful new tile designs and reach higher levels!

title: Spearrowblade
description: A dark 2D action-adventure in Metroidvania style. Choose sword, spear, or bow, explore a connected world full of secrets, meet strange NPCs, battle powerful foes – and face your rival. Your path, your weapon, your destiny.

title: 101 Cats in Kyoto
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Kyoto landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: The Honest Little Fisher
description: A cozy fishing game made with care, full of discovery, gentle progression, and hundreds of things to catch. Set out to explore the sea, upgrade your boat, and uncover stories, fun facts, and legendary finds along the way.

title: Meowstery Wisp
description: A multiplayer social deduction and investigation game where players gather clues, debate, and manipulate trust to resolve a mystery; with no elimination until the big finale.

title: Micro Overdrive: Home Tour
description: Micro Overdrive: Home Tour is a fast-paced arcade racer where tiny cars turn everyday rooms into chaotic tracks. Race solo or with friends, master tight controls, dodge oversized obstacles, and fight for every corner in loud, playful races.

title: Unsolved Case: Whispers of Elderwick - Collector’s Edition
description: A killer hides behind familiar faces. Solve puzzles, uncover hidden clues, and expose the conspiracy tearing the village apart before fear consumes it whole.

title: Just Pong
description: A game of pong between friends, what could go wrong?

title: No Nap November
description: No Nap November is a short psychological horror game set in a kindergarten during an endless nap time. Observe each loop carefully, spot anomalies, and survive an entire month without sleep to save yourself and the children from a strange presence.

title: Twins of the Sun: Arena of Heroes
description: Enter the ancient arena of your ancestors and prove your worth.

title: Synthetic Orders
description: A quick, hypercasual pattern-memory game. Watch the left-right yellow signals, memorize the sequence, and repeat it using two simple buttons - no grinding, no complex mechanics.

title: Notebook Battlegrounds
description: A multiplayer game where your voice is the weapon. Play as a random letter and use proximity voice chat to hear nearby players. Say the funny words on your screen to shoot opponents, find secret words for special powers, and battle in Timed Deathmatch or Battle Royale!

title: Mitnal
description: Play as Emily, drawn to a remote Mayan ruin after her brother insists it’s safe, amazing and beautiful. Explore an ancient Mayan site spanning jungle, temple, and catacombs as it becomes clear that he didn’t understand what he uncovered.

title: Insanity Path
description: A plague spreads alongside a spree of sudden disappearances... You don't need more to get on with your adventure. Step into the world of an Auto-battler Roguelite, where each of your mistakes will send you further down the path of Insanity. Will you be able to free the forest from this tragic curse?

title: White Memories
description: Take the mantle of a postman who refuses to give up his job, even after death. Clinging to your last memory, take off into the world of the forgotten to deliver your letters to the ghosts that are stuck there, allowing them to reach the afterlife. Protect your mail from those who are pursuing you.

title: Exoterra: A Space Journey
description: EXOTERRA: A Space Journey is a first-person science fiction puzzle game set aboard a stranded ship in the vast, dark expanse of outer space. Explore the HOPE-03 and uncover the mysteries it holds as you solve fully interactive escape-room-style chambers powered by a physics-based system.

title: Drop and Grow
description: A short incremental clicker about dropping water to grow plants. Sit back and relax while you grow more and more plants.

title: Might & Magic: Duel of Champions - Void Rising
Might & Magic: Duel of Champions - Herald of the Void
Might & Magic: Duel of Champions - Forgotten Wars
Might & Magic: Duel of Champions - Five Towers
Orbital Overdrive
description: Orbital Overdrive is a high-octane roguelite twin-stick arena shooter where you are pitted against hordes of relentless enemies on an orbit of a planet. Choose from hundreds of different abilities and weapons to create the deadliest build and smash the resistance!

title: Might & Magic: Duel of Champions - Heart of Nightmares
Might & Magic: Duel of Champions - Griffin Bane
Might & Magic: Duel of Champions - Sins of Betrayal
Might & Magic: Duel of Champions - Time of Renewal
Slappingrot
description: SLAP, SLAP, and keep SLAPPING. Use your SLAPPING powers to SLAP rotten bosses; each with their unique combat abilities. Reach the end and be the GOAT of the Rotten Ring.

title: Take Care of It.
description: take care of it. is a psychological game about guilt and toxic patterns depicted through the experience of daily life after a traumatic event. The narrative is driven by player choices, allowing them to explore the different sides of Riley and his relationship with Austin.

title: As:9-nine- Arteisia
description: A spinoff to the 9-nine- series written by Yukihito. The story is about a girl whose powers are too strong for her to handle, and a young researcher who treats her condition

title: Minecraft: Mounts of Mayhem
description: The Mounts of Mayhem drop is an update to Minecraft: Java Edition which adds new modes of transportation such as the nautilus and the camel husk, as well as a new weapon: the spear.

title: Cyberslav: Eclipse
description: Cyberslav: Eclipse is a dark action-RPG slasher set in a unique "Slavic-cyberpunk" universe. The game tells the story of a fallen warrior whose defeat in the arena has put the entire principality at risk. Driven by a desire to restore his honor and punish traitors, the hero must tear enemies apart in a world where the line between good and evil is blurred.

title: Sister Other Paranoia
description: A dark visual novel created by the team behind NEEDY GIRL OVERDOSE. Overly sensitive to other people's emotions, the protagonist—a light novel writer—develops the ability to read minds, only to be driven even deeper into isolation. His sole remaining comfort is his younger sister, gifted yet lonely.

title: The Forever Winter: Holiday Hangover
description: The Forever Winter Holiday Hangover Skin Pack includes: The U-PAC Skin for Gunhead The Dedwak Skin for Shaman The Kevlar Cake Skin for Scav Girl

title: Steak Simulator: Medium Rare
description: As a steak, you must rediscover and navigate this bizarre world, overcome daunting challenges, and cook yourself to perfection to become a delectable delicacy. You can also team up with your friends and dash into thrilling, high-speed steak races!

title: Trine Classic Collection
description: Experience the magic of the puzzle-platforming Trine series with Trine Classic Collection. Includes four titles: Trine Enchanted Edition, Trine 2: Complete Story, Trine 3: Artifacts of Power and Trine 4: Definitive Edition.

title: Farming Camp
description: Every summer, Evertree Farming Camp searches for the next best Evertree Farmer, someone ready to raise the bar in agriculture. In hopes of a better future, young Alessandra enters the contest to claim the title, but she will have to face her peers and discover what it means to be an Evertree Farmer.

title: Mytosis
description: Mytosis is a short, experimental incremental game about evolving life forms from simple cells to complex procedural organisms.

title: Imprinted
description: Retro-style Turn-Based JRPG. In this world, certain humans possess "brands" on their bodies. These are usually hereditary, passed from parent to child. Humans who possess the brands usually have special powers that resemble magic....

title: Lost in the Fire
description: Lost in the Fire is an atmospheric first-person exploration game. Its diverse locations draw you into an unknown world where every shadow hides a story and every step deepens the mystery. Uncover the truth behind the mystery that started it all. Are you ready to get lost in different realities?

title: Bob's Beaker Blobs
description: Bob’s Beaker Blobs is a physics-based Suika-like merge puzzle. Use reagents to manipulate the blobs in your beaker, but be careful of Bob. He's trying to sabotage your experiment with his own reagents.

title: The Artisan of Glimmith
description: The Artisan of Glimmith is a cozy, relaxing puzzle game about coloring stained glass and restoring the artworks of a kingdom above the clouds. Explore a world of handcrafted puzzles designed with intent, where simple rules lead to delightful surprises.

title: Yomifuda: Kanji Survivors
description: Your path to survival is written in ink! Survive the endless Yokai onslaught with the power of language. Yomifuda combines rogue-lite action with a Japanese learning system featuring over 1,000 essential Kanji. Build your vocabulary, and unlock powers to devastate the evils of the underworld.

title: Tankegeddon!
description: Prepare to turn the battlefield into your playground in TANKEGEDDON!, a toy-inspired tank shooter bursting with explosive action and charm.

title: Princess Miner
description: Princess Miner is a Gold Miner-style Roguelike game. You play as a Princess who loves money more than tiaras. Equip your gear, and drag up every nugget in sight. This game shatters the traditional "single hook" mechanic—why fire one hook when you can fire them all?

title: Once Upon a Shell
description: Once Upon a Shell is a roguelike racing game of ridiculous speed and wild upgrades. As a tortoise, use your shell to your advantage and slide downhill to generate speed. Build movement combos between races and prove that even a tortoise can lift The Hare Cup.

title: Amatsuko
description: A knowledge-based progression game. Explore and solve the strange misteries of the interconnected fantasy worlds trapped inside an esoteric book and discover the roots of a terrible evil. No stats, no log, no savefiles. Only pure knowledge is your progress.

title: We Want Your Head
description: Hit… or die. Welcome to the twisted version of a classic arcade experience. In We Want Your Head, you enter a world of pixelated nightmares where disembodied heads burst out from the darkness. With every swing of your hammer, you fight for a few more seconds of peace — and for your own head.

title: Puzzle Gallery: Jigsaw Art Collection
description: Handcrafted jigsaw puzzles made by top-notch artists. Never AI, never generic stock images. Relax and discover unique collections piece by piece.

title: Professor Galaktionov Dawn of the Robopocalypse
description: Embark on an incredible adventure with the eccentric genius Professor Galaktionov and his voice assistant Sara! You’ll unravel the mysteries of the universe and experience mind-blowing escapades.

title: Kino
description: Odesa, 1929. A woman wakes up. This will be her last morning. An all-powerful film camera forces her to watch her life again. Can she find what was missing? A very short choose-your-own-adventure based on Dziga Vertov's Man with a Movie Camera.

title: Truck Rally Hyper Hardcore
description: The challenging races that you only know are just the beginning level of this game. Absolutely realistic behavior of the machine. No arcade controls. Using the laws of the real physical world. Only for hardcore players.

title: The Coin
description: The Coin is a thrilling clicker game where a simple coin flip becomes a high-stakes gamble. Heads or tails—pure luck decides. But beware: the longer your streak, the bigger the rewards… and the risk. Can you quit while you're ahead?

title: Poobo
description: A fast-paced action roguelike where you play as a tiny and adorable poop fighting off bacteria. Upgrade your weapons and items to escape the toilet and claim victory!

title: Seoul Bridge
description: You are trapped on the Seoul Bridge. Whether you move toward the exit or return to the entrance, you remain trapped on the Seoul Bridge. Observe your surroundings carefully and find a way to escape.

title: The Fox's Dream
description: Solve puzzles and unravel mysteries with the little fox. Look for clues scattered around the level, find patterns in them and become a hero with the cute fox
