title: Paws Per Minute
description: A cozy desktop typing game where your furry friend hammers away on a keyboard as you type. Boost your WPM with colorful effects, and unlock speed achievements!

title: Color Splash: Mushrooms
description: Color Splash: Mushrooms is a charming and relaxing puzzle game that will lift your spirits and take You into the world of adorable mushrooms and art. Venture into the gallery, where you will find many extraordinary and colorful mushrooms paintings.

title: Puzzle Vault
description: A dynamic puzzle where attention, logic, and speed work as a team. Each level is a new challenge: find your way out of tangled mazes, collect the necessary elements, search for hidden details, move objects, and match the right colors.

title: RoboCop: Rogue City - Collection
description:
The Rogue City Collection brings together RoboCop: Rogue City and RoboCop: Rogue City - Unfinished Business, with all the bonus content from both titles: Vanguard Pack and Alex Murphy Pack for the base game and Prime Directives Pack for the expansion.

The physical edition comes with updated discs that contain the add-ons and a metal case.

title: Market Moe
description: Work the night shift on a Japanese street… where something shouldn’t be there.

title: Paper Bride 7: Lethal Bond
description: Paper Bride 7: Lethal Bond is a Chinese horror puzzle game, and the 7th title of the Paper Bride series.

title: Alternian Turnabout: Aradia Megido
description: Homestuck themed Ace Attorney made in Ren'py, with an emphasis on imitation and paying homage to the endearing elements of both series.

title: Smash Hit Museum
description: Smash stones. Collect artifacts. Build the world’s most profitable museum. A short clicker game set in the archeology room of a museum. Build up your collection and Upgrade until you break it.

title: A Date With Chester 2
description: A Date With Chester 2 is a short, standalone story about remembering the good times. You've been with Chester for a long time. If there's one thing you're sure of, it's that things don't always go as you expect.

title: Passerines in End Times
description:
Canary lives alone in the remnants of an abandoned city, years after the collapse of civilization. One stormy winter night, a nameless traveler stumbles into her humble home, looking for a place to shelter from the rain.

Passerines in End Times is a short visual novel that tells the story of their blossoming friendship amidst the desolation that surrounds them.

title: The Aurora Chronicles
description: A crew of four. Mysteries at the edge of known space. A utopia that might be more fragile than it appears. The Aurora Chronicles is an episodic sci-fi visual novel where your choices shape relationships, uncover buried secrets, and test whether hope can survive what you discover.

title: Kitty Witchy
description: A little lost witch, a magical cat, and a world full of secrets. Kitty Witchy is a 3D narrative puzzle adventure game. Join the witch and solve puzzles with the help of her cat, uncover the secrets of this universe, and find the way back home.

title: Witchlight Woods
description: Blending fairy tale fright with psychological horror, this narrative game challenges you to survive a weird journey through the woods while being hunted by the witch you were tasked with imprisoning. Sometimes charming, sometimes frightening, she’ll force you to make hard choices.

title: Tiles of Grimmwoods
description: Every tile you place in this strategic roguelike deck-builder shapes the story of lost kids trying to escape the twisted depths of the Grimmwoods. Outsmart lurking creatures, lay down paths with powerful items, and upgrade your deck to survive a forest that shifts with every step.

title: Mirrorandum
description: Mirrorandum is not just a visual novel...it's a journey through a world of mirrors, where every reflection challenges your perception and every choice reveals the depths of your true self.

title: Summer’s Heartbeat
description: Village romance hotter than summer's heat! Drowning in debt, you escape to the countryside only to meet the loan shark noona, your first love, and the tsundere village princess! This summer, your heart’s melting faster than ice cream. Who’s going to set your world on fire?

title: Hepatomancy
description: Hepatomancy is a FPS roguelike. Delve deep in an ever shifting temple complex. Learn the esoteric secrets of the ruins and their inhabitants, and do your best to reach the inner-most chamber.

title: Unicycle Sheep
description: Can a sheep on a unicycle reach its goal? Start on a small island, learn to balance, and ride your way toward the tallest mountain on a physics-driven unicycle. Navigate chaotic islands, overcome tricky obstacles, and try not to fall

title: Carnal Coup: Overseer's Edition
description: Carnal Coup is a very NSFW text-based game in a sci-fi setting, in which you play a member of a species of perverted alien shapeshifters who have just had your world invaded by a puritanical space federation. By infiltrating the invasion at the top, it's time to turn it to your own ends!

title: Being Food
description: Being Food is a third-person, Bird Game. In this puzzle-platformer, you play as a cute bird named Oolahla in what starts seemingly like a normal bird day. Something is different about today, though... Do you know what it takes to be a bird? Will you survive the bird day?

title: Battle Food Mania
description: Food fights hit the streets! Battle Food Mania is a fast-paced, action game packed with humor and chaos. Play as pizza, cupcakes, bottles and more as you battle to deliver the box - or stop the delivery! Run, shoot and blast your rivals in wild food wars, play solo or with friends.

title: Shaolin Mystery: Tale of the Jade Dragon Staff
Night Watch at Freddie's: The July 5th Archive
St. Elmo's Fire
description: When Hina doesn't return home from school late at night, Sayo decides to go pick her up herself. And she encounters surreal phenomena inside the school alongside Hina.

title: Fruit Casket
description: Survive and thrive in Fruit Casket! Match fruits and use power ups to make your Hi-Score soar, and unlock more colorful bugs. The longer you survive, the harder it gets. Don't get smooshed or starve to avoid it becoming your Fruit Casket.

title: Tiny Pasture: Azure Waters
description:
Your pasture will now transform into a desktop aquarium, where adorable fish will keep you company through work and study. Unlock new fish species, build a lively aquarium, and create your very own mini ocean paradise!

Watch your fish swim freely, interact with them, collect their dropped coins, and expand your aquarium step by step—bringing life and tranquility to your screen!

title: Whisker Wanderlust: The Mosaic of Souls
description: Welcome to "Stray of Lost Cat", a story centered around a peculiar little feline. Follow the kitten's journey as it escapes the pursuit of "Meowdes" while collecting soul fragments, striving to reunite with its beloved owner.

title: Breaking Armor
description: Operate a super-heavy tank alone on a post-apocalyptic Earth. Face enemy tanks and alien beasts across deadly missions, and upgrade your tank to survive the escalating threats.

title: Futa Fucks Femboys
description: Futa Fucks Femboys is an explosive mix of 2D Visual Novel and Collectible Card Game, where an alien symbiote turns the main hero into a FUTANARI and drags her into an adventure full of passion, absurdity, and FEMBOYS. Saving Earth has never felt so spicy

title: My Little Sister Is an Angel
description: "Hey, wanna try becoming a god?" After saving an angel, introvert Yuki gets pulled into divine training, and the Archangel moves in as his “little sister” to guide him. A warm supernatural romance VN where your choices lead to 4 endings.

title: Donare: Winter Days
description: A newly written append for Donare

title: War of Dots
description: Easy to learn, hard to master. A simple & free RTS game.

title: Spooky Monkey
description: A cozy top-down Zelda-like ARPG with satisfying riddles, relaxing exploration, and a spooky undead theme.

title: Devins Play
description: Devins Play is a survival first person shooter horror game created by BlueEnhanced it is a game with Sci FI horror and base building. The game allows you to grind resources to survive.

title: Rat Lines
description: In an alternate 1945, the Axis powers never fell. Explore ruined cities and secret facilities, uncover what’s left of humanity, and strike back against those who rewrote history. Will you survive long enough to tell the truth?

title: Grim Pulse: The First Blood
description: Grim Pulse: The First Blood is an ARPG that follows Aelthar, an ancient vampire who awakens 9,743 years after being sent to his Eternal Slumber within a modern city locked in a dreamlike state of blood, control, and forgotten history. As he dismantles vampire Covens embedded within towering skyscrapers, Aelthar uncovers a hidden hierarchy known as the Vampire Council, and the truth that his resurrection was never accidental. Through combat, exploration/eavesdropping, and fractured memories, he must confront his past, a tragic love named Lisette, and the burden of the First Blood itself.

title: Xenosensory
description: Xenosensory is a short incremental casual game with horror themes. Use your cursor to bust Xenos and save convicts then spend your research points on skill tree upgrades, actions, gadgets, and uncover the true horrifying nature of this space station nightmare.

title: WonderLang German
description: Learn German through immersive quests, interactive dialogues, and spaced repetition combat challenges. Help a young hero lift a magical curse by mastering German. Customize your learning experience and explore a vibrant world filled with unique characters. Start your journey to German fluency today!

title: WonderLang Italian
description: Learn Italian through immersive quests, interactive dialogues, and spaced repetition combats. Help a young hero lift a magical curse by mastering Italian. Start your journey to Italian fluency today!

title: Ruins of Araethia
description: An open-world game set in a post-apocalyptic medieval fantasy world. Learn to survive, fight off threats, and thrive in a harsh world.

title: Christmas Across America: Collector's Edition
description: Immerse yourself in the holiday spirit! Journey into the heart of winter America to create traditions, find hidden treasures, and experience the magic of the coziest time of year.

title: In The Gym
description: Emotional horror about survival in a gym.

title: Wicked West
description: Survive the unforgiving frontier in Wicked West, a top-down shoot 'em up where every kill earns upgrades and new abilities. Face relentless enemies, epic bosses, and one-shot death in this brutal Wild West survival challenge. Can you outlast the chaos?

title: Wreckborn
description: Cleanse the system of pirates, destroy their bases and free the captives. On the asteroids, build a base, mining colonies, explore asteroids and extract resources needed for survival. Develop buildings, build defenses and turn the asteroid into a fortress.

title: Muffles' Life Sentence: Episode 5
description: EPISODE 5 of Muffles' journey. A darkly quirky RPG set in a prison where inmates are remade to match their crimes.

title: Jumpy Tiger
description: Jumpy Tiger is a family-friendly collect-a-thon 2D platformer inspired by the classics of the 90s. Journey through seven unique levels and complete 35 missions, defeating enemies and avoiding hazards along the way.

title: Moonshot Billiards
description: Moonshot Billiards is a relaxing puzzle game blending billiards and mini-golf. Plan angles and power to sink every ball in as few shots as possible. Easy to learn, inspired by the classic NES game.

title: Waddle Words
description: Waddle, spell, and honk your way to victory in this chaotic word game for 1–4 players!

title: Sunken Sky
description: Welcome to the world of Sunken Sky and get ready for an epic action adventure through a vast open world. No place is beyond your reach - from the tallest mountains to the very minds of others. Battle bizarre creatures and befriend even stranger people. All in a detailed, hand-drawn 2D style.

title: Musynx Return
description: The beloved indie rhythm game “MUSYNX” returns! Back to classic gameplay roots—bringing you a pure rhythm gaming experience!

title: Return to Rezpulka
description: After months on the battlefield, Sergey awakes back in his homeland of Rezpulka. With only a vague memory of what he believes were his final moments on the battlefield, he must now put the pieces together to really understand what happened on that fateful day.

title: Celeste Blue Wizard Luna
description: Help Luna form a resistance to take down Princess Lucia the Black Witch and free the skyborne land of Jupiterno from her tyranny!

title: Deepest Blue
description: A futuristic space combat simulation set in deep space featuring 1st person combat, exploration of new warp paths and sectors, prospecting resource, shipping freight, base building or munitions deployment. Up to 9 player ships can be flown or assigned to co-pilots and grouped into squads.

title: Let It Consume
description: Let It Consume is a short, active incremental game about leading a dark cult. Raise loyal imps, harvest their emotions, and feed your all-consuming idol before it hungers for you. Expand your rituals, unlock dark upgrades, and watch devotion turn into divine power.

title: LevelFighters
description: LevelFighters is a competitive and creative platform game where two players design levels and then challenge each other to complete them faster than the other. Each game combines skill and creativity, with a built-in level editor that allows you to build unique challenges for your opponent.

title: Mapped by Our Ancestors
description: A game about crawling in the dark, one death after another. Nothing you do will be saved, everything will eventually be forgotten. Go as far as you can until you feel you've reached a correct ending.

title: Hitogata
description: Hitogata is a story driven adventure game about dolls, electricity, and ending the world with your friends.

title: AI Attorney: Neuro-sama
description:
In 2032, Vedal succeeded in creating two functional bodies for his twin AIs. In his expansion of VedalAI, he created a legal division to get him and his employees out of trouble. Without a lawyer to lead the department, he tasked Neuro-sama to become the first AI defence lawyer. Understanding the popularity he can gain from owning both the first defence and prosecution lawyers, he sent Evil to become the first AI prosecutor. After a streamed arduous journey, they pass the bar exam and became real lawyers.

After a few days of becoming an official lawyer, Neuro is called up by Vedal not to congratulate her but for a pressing issue. He’s been accused of Filian’s murder and needs Neuro to defend him. With Neuro-sama’s first case decided, she embarks on a journey of chaos and mayhem through the legal system.

title: Dungeon Devotion
description: Short idle clicker game about gathering a harem of woman ready to worship you. Change into many forms to please your worshippers while restoring your dungeon.

title: No Backup
description: Escape together or die alone. In this intense co-op bodycam horror game, you and your team are hunted by a relentless creature. Communicate, stay quiet, and fight to survive. Every move counts. Every sound could be your last.

title: Fireworks Factory
description: Fireworks Factory is a single MBF21 map, set in a sprawling industrial facility baked into a magma canyon.

title: PlushiePet
description: Feeling overwhelmed? Tired of waking up to dystopian and/or exhausting news stories? Wish the world would slow down? Here at PlushiePet Corporation, we've got your back. PlushiePet is a wellness and utility companion with 100+ features, and dozens of adorable designs randomly distributed via blind boxes! Your PlushiePet is uniquely yours! And you are theirs. It's an alarm clock. It's a wellness app. It's a 3D printer. It's a geiger counter. And it's the only friend you'll ever need.

title: Malleable Girl Simulator
description: A game where you can flatten and stretch a custom character of your choice (supporting MMD and Vroid models,) using the many machines provided on the map.

title: Isolated Inhale
description: You are a spaceship pilot in an abandoned sector. Your job is to complete tasks and service stations. To reach your destination, you need to monitor your ship and its systems during the flight. Also, don't forget about the strange things that can happen to you, so be on your guard.

title: Zaya: Rise to the Gods
description: A gore action and adventure game where you'll learn about the Mayan culture while you explore, obtain new abilities and defeat enemies to save Zaya's lands from the curse that ravages humankind and deities.

title: Keepers of Vyrellia
description: A retro 8-bit deck builder roguelike with '80s vibes, where you can not only customize your deck and weapons, but you can also choose to use your cards in attack mode or defense mode!

title: Traction Point
description: Traction Point is a vehicular, physics-driven, puzzle/exploration game. Embark on a sci-fi road trip together with your crew in the campaign, or experiment and play around in the sandbox mode.

title: Card Colony
description: It’s a card game where you build a deck, draw cards, and strategically place towers on a tile grid to earn gold. And you must defend your empire from the enemies closing in. They won’t let you build in peace.

title: Sheriff Looper
description:
Sheriff Looper is a short horror-themed action adventure game with looping mechanics (similar to games like Pokémon Ranger).
The game takes about 30 minutes to complete in one sitting.

title: Mystics Ablaze
description: Magi, spirits and occultists clash with colorful crystal orbs and explosive teleportation! Mystics Ablaze is a deep and spectacular couch fighting game for 2-4 players unlike anything you’ve ever played.

title: Luna de Selene
description: Luna and her partners are about to arrive to the end lair of the Dark Lord. But the day before disembarking and facing their destiny, Luna and her girlfriend Alejandra have an argument, and something weird happens... The day starts repeating from the start! Luna must find the why of the temporal loop, and fix it, if she wants to save the world and her relationship!

title: Follower
description: On a snowy night downtown, Mitch makes a simple stop on his way to his girlfriend Claire's house. Food. A gift. Then home.

title: Spirit Catcher 93'
description: Spirit Catcher 93', a first-person descent into psychological horror. A journey of evasion, discovery, and surviving the relentless Shepherd. A chilling return to the roots of classic horror that will leave you breathless.

title: Schola Spiritus
description: Schola Spiritus is an old-school style RPG inspired by the PS2/GBA classics that explores the troubles of growing up in Florida while demons from the past seek to take over. Play as Simmone as she leads her group of unlikely friends and rejects to uncovering the real evil lurking in their small town

title: Spirit-Capture Net
description: In "Spirit-Capture Net," guide a small spirit through a world of light and obstacles. Every move creates new barriers, making each puzzle more challenging. Experience unique self-blocking mechanics, clever level design, and a clean visual style. Outsmart yourself and find the way out!

title: Westland Survival: Albino Alligator
description: On the frontier, no pet is mightier or harder to tame than an alligator. This snow-white albino is yours to claim, and its unique look will live on in its offspring, letting you build a bloodline of these fierce-looking beasts. Ride into town—no one’s gonna out-cool you now!

title: Westland Survival: Wind Spirit
description: Ride like the legends of the frontier with the Wind Spirit DLC! This unique horse, painted in vibrant American Indigenous motifs, will pass its striking look to its offspring—carrying the spirit of the open plains for generations

title: Westland Survival: Uncle Gab’s Signet
description: From the dusty trails to the wild frontier, Uncle Gabe’s Signet keeps you standing in the toughest fights. This unique one-of-a-kind ring shields you from poison, bleeding, and burning—turning the tide against both ruthless outlaws and wild beasts.

title: Silent Spirits
description: Operate a secret speakeasy in 1920s America during Prohibition. Craft illicit alcohol, serve demanding customers, avoid police raids, smuggle shipments to the mob, and expand your empire across 15 years of escalating danger, pressure, and underground opportunity.

title: Spirits of Lunara
description: Spirits of Lunara is a soulslike metroidvania where you must face enemies, unlock new areas, and evolve your combat with spiritual powers to restore the balance of Lunara, challenging the corruption threatening the ancient forest.

title: Flesh & Spirit
description: Giants crush the land. Monsters stalk the shadows. Take up your weapon—and become their worst nightmare.

title: Spirits' Forest
description: Armed with a sacred sword, protect the sacred forest of a kingdom against the invasion of fiery demons in this shoot'em up taking place in a universe that mixes medieval and fantasy.

title: Flux Empyrean
description: The ocean hides countless forgotten secrets. Echoes of calamity and loss scar the waves. Sail a vast planet under a blanket of stars and use your tools and wit to solve the grand puzzle of the past. Rediscover truth in this expansive open world mystery.

title: All The Colors That You Paint
description: A short visual novel. Words from my heart struggling to voice adoration in adequacy. Dissonant guitar strumming and noise from my living room

title: Kuentame
description: A bizarre, top-down, bullet hell platformer about someone who doesn't desire connection, in a world in which everything is connected.

title: Giant Snake Girl Wants the Burger!
description: One silly Tsuchinoko's epic journey to feed The Burger to her Giant Snake friend.

title: Zory
description: You will have to play as fighters against evil and monsters in the world of Slavic mythology, as well as craft and build some buildings of your camp to improve weapons, armor and cooking.

title: Day of Light
description: Day of Light is a hand-drawn platformer about facing inner struggles. Use powerful masks to unlock temporary abilities and bring light back into a dark world!

title: Fun Times at Homer´s
description: A new diner has open it doors in Springfield going by “Simpsons Happy Donuts”. And it’s owner made partnership with Professor Frink to create the best robots A.I.s, outstanding other diners in town. But as a favor, Frink wanted to test his new subject "Security Couch" so every moonrise 12am to 6am the robots would turn aggressive towards Security Couch as a Artificial Intelligence test. The company accepted the favor, and You are the couch, will You make it far?

title: Organ Failure
description:
When boredom and an epidemic mix together, having some fun is never a bad idea. Well... maybe the Plague Doctors shouldn't have turned their job into a game.
But its fun nevertheless!

title: Apoptosis
description: You are born into a cold, rusty facility covered in gore. Use your wits to navigate illogical environments while narrowly avoiding traps and entities that solely wish to rend you apart. Will you discover your true purpose or succumb to hopelessness like the other miserable creatures trapped within its walls?

title: Lorerim
description:
LoreRim is a vision to turn Skyrim into both a modern action game as well as re-introduce roleplaying mechanics through the integration of many of EnaiSiaion's (EnaiRim) Mods, Requiem - The Roleplaying Overhaul as well as HUNDREDS of custom addons, patches & more. This modlist will automatically install for you through the use of Wabbajack. Most importantly, EVERY single aspect of the game has been overhauled and modernized. This is Skyrim in 2025. Cities are bigger. Forests are lush. Enemies and areas from previous games are re-introduced.

LoreRim is complete overhaul of Skyrim Anniversary Edition, designed to modernize the visuals and combat of the game while also staying true to lore and bringing back gameplay mechanics from previous games. This modlist is heavily focused on immersion, role-playing and progression.

title: Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty - Master Collection Version
description:
This is the fourth release in the Metal Gear series. Metal Gear Solid 2 is a story a told in two parts:
In the Tanker chapters, Solid Snake sneaks into a secret tanker in pursuit of a new top-secret nuclear weapon, called Metal Gear.
In the Plant chapters, Raiden of the new Foxhound unit infiltrates an offshore plant occupied by terrorists.

New gameplay actions such as handling weapons from a first person viewpoint, holding up enemies at gunpoint, and grabbing and dragging fallen opponents were also incorporated into this title.

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: The Banquet Operative
description:
Version 8.6 of Honkai Impact 3rd, which includes
• New Part 2 Story Chapter XI: A Mass for Atheists
• New S Rank Valkyrie: Miss Espionage (Rita)
• New Featured Event: Agent Rosette: Banquet of Intrigue
• ...and more!

title: Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater - Master Collection Version
description:
Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater is the origin story of Naked Snake and his mentor The Boss and the fifth title in the METAL GEAR series.

The game is set in a deep jungle environment.
Snake must find his equipment and use various camouflage which allows the player to deceive the enemy's eyes and face paint that matches the surrounding environment, providing a unique stealth gameplay experience.

The game is also packed with new action elements which allow players to capture jungle animals for food and to regain stamina, and Close Quarters Combat (CQC), a combat system based on martial arts for fighting enemies at close range.

title: Full Moon Fishing
description: Full Moon Fishing is a casual immersive spear fishing game. You catch fish and upgrade your gear while you explore the strange and beautiful world.

title: Kevin's Playing In Berlin
description: Release the author, who is nothing but the player. Release the player, and restore the freedom once taken away. A three-game experiment in what it means to play.

title: Jigrift
description: Leap and swing around the lost tropical paradise of Jigrift as you assemble the island like a massive jigsaw puzzle.

title: Aster Pebble and the Case of Bad Bureaucracy
description: A short and cozy point and click time loop mystery. Join Aster Pebble as she solves mysteries and helps those in need as she takes on her first adventure in a modern fantasy world. Overcome bureaucracy via direct action in this funny little adventure filled with intriguing oddball characters.

title: Half-Life: Game of the Year Edition
description: GOTY Winner from over 40 publications; Half-Life re-releases with new multiplayer content, including new player models, deathmatch maps, as well as comign bundled with Team Fortress Classic.

title: Sightings of Beyond
description:
After a recent encounter with something undeniably non-human, you are forcibly reassigned to a long-abandoned government SETI program—Project SILO—revived solely to keep you contained and quiet.

You play as Dr Kai Mercer, an untrained, non-certified civilian whom the government labels “Doctor” for convenience and credibility. With no real preparation, you're dropped into a valley near the coast in Washington State. You are stationed in a facility that was used to detect ocean UFO and UAP anomalies back in the 90s, when its previous technician mysteriously vanished without a trace.

Your task is simple on paper:
Monitor strange phenomena, use your radio to relay your own audio to space with accurate responses back, and document potential other-planetary activity with your camera.
In practice, nothing about the valley, ocean, or Project SILO feels safe, stable, or truthful.

title: Orpheus: To Hell and Back
description: Orpheus: To Hell and Back is a adventure game for the gameboy, where the player plays as Orpheus descending into the Underworld to rescue Eurydice. You have your magical lute that allows you to play songs that pull or push enemies toward you, or put them to sleep momentarily.

title: Daddy's Christmas
description: Coming home for the holidays is always eventful. This year more than most. It is the family's first Christmas since Daddy's accident. Your mother hasn't seen him so excited in ages. Apparently, he has planned a BIG surprise for the WHOLE family...

title: UnAligned: 21 Days, 27 Maps, Zero Texture Alignment
description: Three episodes of classic, vanilla Doom created in exactly 21 days, that attempt to capture some of the essence of 1990s mapping. Bite-sized, unconventional, and intentionally under-detailed.

title: Argonauts Agency: The Bronze Plague - Collector's Edition
Oloo
description: Oloo is a 2D physics-based platformer where you play as a little creature that is too squishy to be dangerous and too cute to be scary. Find out why you are in this falling-apart world and where you are going.

title: I Gooned at My Grandmas Crib at 2 AM While My Mom Wasnt Watching
description: The game consists of gooning at your grandmas crib at 2 am while your mom isnt watching, you have to goon at your grandmas crib (at 2 am) while avoiding your mother and other cribmates. It's a short game, a successful run would take about 20 minutes. In-game guide goes further in depth.

title: Mahiru no Ankoku
description:
Tama New Town, 2028.
Those were happy, peaceful days... I think.
But once my older sister disappeared... Everything started breaking down.
Mom and dad left too. Everyone dear to me was no more.

But Sensei appeared instead. He's very kind and gentle.
Will he protect me from the killer?
Can we be friends?

Will he not abandon me?

title: Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector - Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition gives you the entire Citizen Sleeper experience - the dice-driven RPG game where you must get a ship, find a crew, and take on contracts while you navigate across the Starward Belt, the Sleeper's Sketchbook, and the Original Soundtrack by composer Amos Roddy.

It contains:
Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector
Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector Soundtrack
The Sleeper's Sketchbook

title: Darkest Dungeon II: Resolute Edition
description: Get Darkest Dungeon II, all DLC, and the superlative original soundtrack by Stuart Chatwood (over 2 hours of music!) together for a tidy discount.

title: The Coma 2B: Catacomb - Deluxe Edition
description:
The Coma 2B: Catacomb Deluxe Edition contains:
The Coma 2B: Catacomb
The Coma 2B: Catacomb - The Child of Destiny Skin
The Coma 2B: Catacomb - The Gamer Skin
The Coma 2B: Catacomb - The Survivalist Skin
The Coma 2B: Catacomb Artbook
The Coma 2B: Catacomb Original Soundtrack

title: Forgive Me Father 2: Deluxe Edition
description: The Deluxe Edition of Forgive Me Father 2 gives you access not only to the game, but lets you also feast your eyes on its Digital Artbook containing more than fifty pages of mind-bending artworks, as well as listen for hours to the 30 tracks of its original Soundtrack composed by Tim Fialka.

title: Book of Hours: Anthology Edition
description:
The complete, definitive edition of BOOK OF HOURS! This bundle includes:

BOOK OF HOURS, a narrative crafting RPG
HOUSE OF LIGHT, a story-focused expansion
The BOOK OF HOURS soundtrack

title: Spider-Man Ultimate Avenger
description:
A fun new game from Big Trash Games.

Join Spider-Man on his quest to become a real Avenger.

title: Donald and Xi at the 2021 Olympics
description: Olympic game jam entry

title: Mario Teaches Typing 3
description: Unofficial fan parody sequel

title: Mellings
description: Mellings are striking back! Control an excavator and grab resources to bring them back to the burrow, defend yourself with various cannons while harvesting, and destroy huge buildings and bosses!

title: Wireworks
description: Wireworks is a base-defense roguelike auto-battler where your defenses are built and controlled using a module board.

title: Librum SE
description:
Librum for Skyrim Special Edition (SE) is a comprehensive gameplay, graphics, and content overhaul that reimagines the Skyrim experience as a hardcore survival-adventure game in a darker, more unforgiving world.
It combines some of the best and most popular mods for Skyrim SE, featuring a suite of new quests and adventures that outnumber the original game’s content.
The modlist completely overhauls mechanics, graphics, and atmosphere, integrating thousands of hours of new, fully voiced content into a cohesive vision.

title: The Promise Tree of Alden
description: The Promise Tree of Alden is a short, atmospheric narrative experience about remorse, memory, and the silence of a forest once alive.

title: The Town of Nowhere: End Of The Line
description: This is the first downloadable entry in the Town of Nowhere series. This game was made with the intention of being playable and enjoyable regardless of if you know the back story of the larger surrealist horror series. Largely inspired by CGA DOS adventure games TTON:EotL is in full first person 3D.

title: The Dagby Files
description: Assemble beautiful hand-illustrated jigsaw puzzles to unveil the clues as intrepid Inspector Dagby investigates dastardly crimes. Listen in as Dagby questions the suspects. Then solve the case yourself! Seven perplexing mysteries await. Features 28 brand-new illustrations from artist Dave Montes.

title: Rise of State
description: Rise of State is a state management game focused on leadership and strategy. Every decision you make affects public happiness, military strength, the economy, and political stability. Manage crises, define your ideology, and try to keep your state standing.

title: Clownfield 6
description: It's 2028. After years of foreign conflicts, economic strain, and prolonged emergency measures, public trust in the U.S. government collapses. What begins as nationwide protests quickly escalates into armed resistance.

title: What’s in the Box?
description: A first-person incremental game where you buy and open containers filled with random items, repair and upgrade the things you find, and sell them for profit. In a dark industrial environment, upgrade your character, tools, and machines, earn money, and step by step work your way toward freedom.

title: Captcha The Flag
description: A chaotic PvP first person shooter with fully destructible terrain where you need to solve quick Captchas to reload your guns. Build bridges, dig tunnels, and blow everything up while competing in teams with fellow humans in games of capture the flag for the amusement of your AI overlords.

title: Rela
description: This program simulates astrophysics, allowing the creation of stellar systems in the void and the experience of being one of the celestial bodies.

title: The Big Hollow: 1982
description: A serial killer’s dumping ground is exposed. Find details in the evidence, interpret their behaviors, and prove your worth to the FBI’s new Behavioral Science Unit. A dark, atmospheric 2D animated murder mystery.

title: Hunter From Hell
description: With your friends, form a team of paranormal experts to unravel the mysteries of the most terrifying places. Armed with sophisticated gadgets like EMF detectors, infrared cameras, and incantation books, your mission is simple: gather evidence of the beyond and survive chilling encounters.

title: On Tape << Rewind
description: On Tape << Rewind is a psychological horror story told through cassette tapes. Play recordings, search for clues, discover hidden cassettes, and manipulate audio. Unravel the mystery of a scientist’s disappearance and the obsession that consumed him — tape by tape.

title: Buddy City Inc.
description: Raise a Buddy for a strange and mysterious company. Rise through the ranks as you learn and grow with your Buddy!

title: Amen 11 11
description: AMEN 11 11 is a hidden object adventure game set in an atmosphere of apocalypse and psychological horror. The player's task is to find objects hidden on the maps.

title: Neighbor Master
description: Your neighbor just bought a SPORTS CAR. You? You're broke. But you have a shovel and a backyard full of... opportunity. Dig, melt, and bottle snow to build a "Premium Glacier Water" empire. Send in the drones, upgrade your gear, and save up for a ride that will make his car look like a cheap toy.

title: Absolute Cinema
description: Build your movie empire! Create blockbusters by combining 44 topics and 22 genres, hire star actors through auditions, develop your studio and technologies. Crazy random events, references to real stars, and tons of humor. Prove you're the best director!

title: Some of You May Die
description: Create an overpowered squad of heroes to fight for you. Each run is different. Heroes are granted random boosted abilities making each unique. Go head to head against other players online or overcome the challenging singleplayer campaign in this one-of-a-kind roguelike autobattler!

title: Stuck in Fears: North-east
description:
A PSX-style horror game that tells fictional stories. But they could be real.
North-east tells the story of a maniac in northeastern Brazil.

title: Rune Gunner
description: Rune Gunner is a 1-4 player co-op roguelite shooter where you fuse guns and magic, mix classes mid-run, and break your build in the best way possible.

title: Baba Is You: Jam Build
description:
Baba Is Win!

Jam Is Nordic Game Jam 2017

title: MediAevi
description: A medieval fantasy colony sim based on Dwarf Fortress and Rimworld, MediAevi features multiple playable races in a procedurally generated world. Make a sustainable colony and keep your colonists alive through raids and attacks. Research and Advance, to make better weapons, armors, spells, and more.

title: Dreadnought Tartarus
description: Dreadnought Tartarus is a semi-automated strategic simulation game centered around a single, colossal battleship. Take control of the massive warship Tartarus and destroy everything in your path as the battlefield continuously advances！

title: Digging a Hole... with a Spoon... Escape from Alcatraz
description: A darkly comedic escape game where you dig your way out of a decaying Alcatraz-style prison using nothing but a plastic spoon. Scavenge junk, barter with your toilet-dwelling cellmate, and bolt bizarre upgrades onto your spoon.

title: Dragon Khan
description: Dragon Khan is a third-person action RPG set in Ithannar, a world ruled by dragons, where the player controls Botu, a unique green draconate born with wings and elemental power, drawn into a conflict triggered by the disappearance of a dragon Khan and the invasion of the forest domain.

title: How To Build A Snowman
description: Build a snowman following the instructions your grandpa told you once, and watch how a Christmas miracle does it´s magic this winter! Surely nothing wrong could happen so close to holidays...

title: The Approaching Quiet
description:
The Fog is enveloping the Earth

The last hope for Humanity is reaching the spaceship bound to the stars before the Earth is swallowed whole. You're a bus driver, driving what few survivors are left to the launch pad.

The Approaching Quiet is a turn-based tactical RPG about hard choices.

Manage your food and fuel to reach your destination

Decide who you can bring with you, and who will be left behind for the Fog

The story and gameplay are different each run!

title: Waves of Chess
description: A roguelike chess game where players see how far one set of pieces will take them. A short, run based game that respects the classic, but with a few fun twists. Compete against friends and the world on the leaderboards, how far will you go?

title: Sheep Monologue
description: A happy sheep talks about what it's like on the field (there's even a bit of poetry).

title: Asteroid Odyssey
description: Gather and refine resources, shoot your way through countless asteroids and other celestial bodies to gather and refine useful resources from them to build the biggest and the most powerful spaceship-base.

title: SleepingPills
description: A short game about a girl named Pill.

title: Buzz Off, Buddy
description: The broad-handed carpenter bee (Xylocopa latipes) is one of the biggest bees in the world and can be found across Southeast Asia. They are solitary bees and unlike honeybees, they do not live in hives. Instead, female bees construct nest tunnels and chambers in dead wood.

title: Bubba Yuga
description: Bubba Yuga is a 2-player couch co-op puzzle game based on the Slavic folktales of the Baba Yaga. Playing as a pair of tied together witches, you and a friend must work together with your walking house to capture all the woodland children and break the curse that's been placed upon your family.

title: Love with Kadyrov
description: Spend an unforgettable evening with the cutest, smartest, handsome, strong, courageous, gentle, sensitive man in Russia and the World. Use gems to melt Ramzan’s heart.

title: MorTown
description: MorTown is a survival game where players must explore, gather resources, craft equipment, build defenses, and survive in a hostile town. Featuring a day and night cycle, base-building systems, challenging enemies and boss battles.

title: Tamaweb
description:
Your Virtual Pet Adventure Awaits!

Raise, Care, and Adventure with Your Virtual Pet! Enter a vibrant world where your digital pet relies on you for everything!

Whether it’s feeding, cleaning, or playing fun games, every choice you make shapes their life and happiness.

From heartfelt interactions to exciting new features, there’s always something to discover.

title: Olive Raiders
description: A narrative-driven Spaghetti Western adventure set in post-unification Southern Italy. Play as outlaws, nobles, and bounty hunters in a world of shifting allegiances, dramatic shootouts, and folkloric chaos.

title: Sideswipe
description: Sideswipe is a fast-paced side scrolling arcade game. It's a sequel to Natomic Studios' 2001 release, Project 053.

title: Retro Gamer Adventure
description: Retro Gamers are under so much hate on youtube, so this friends must travel to video-game world and deal with all haters punching they face, on this world each char can use a cosplay from your favorite character.

title: WYRM Plus
description: High-speed action game where you cross a wire floating 10km above the ground using only one anchor to reach the goal.

title: FloraLumina
description: FloraLumina is a peaceful, magical gardening game where sunlight, moonlight, and shifting weather impact your garden's growth. Nurture your garden of beautiful hand-drawn flowers, enjoy soft ambience, and play at your own pace.

title: Detektiv
description: A short horror experience centered on a strange murder, in which you play Detective Fyodor Mikhailovich, investigating the crime and looking for clues to unravel the mystery.

title: Moonlit Blessed
description:
Your best friend is the chosen one.
Soon, they will have to depart on a quest to save the Moon.

But it’s alright. You are not the Hero. No one expects anything from you.

Will you still take the journey?

title: Waifu Beach Bar
description: Be a bartender and run your own bar. Take orders, mix beverages and serve drinks to beautiful girls in bikinis. Attend them enough times to build trust and have sex with them!

title: Arktis SCP-RP
description: Dive into the mysterious and dangerous universe of the SCP Foundation with ARKTIS SCP. Explore secret facilities, survive anomalies, and experience an intense, narrative-driven roleplay adventure.

title: Love and Sex: First Base
description: Become roommates with two gorgeous girls and explore the largest free hand-drawn 18+ dating sim ever. Level up your stats, sharpen your game, and roam the city to seduce 5 unique waifus & find your soulmate(s). Play your cards right, and your days will be filled with nothing but love… and sex!

title: A Christmas Journey With: Noelle
description: Embark on a titillating journey through mystical winter realms with Noelle, your alluring festive guide. This adults-only "spot the differences" game challenges your keen eye, rewarding your success with seductive reveals steeped in the magic of the season.

title: Reflections of Life: Gone but not Forgotten - Collector's Edition
description: Can you save the city of Harmoris from the undead?

title: Late Hours
description: Your job sucks. Your relationships collapsing. And someones watching you from the shadows of Greasezs. Welcome to the night shift.

title: Appetite of the Abyss
description: Appetite of the Abyss is a survival cooking roguelite where your tribe’s fate depends on feeding an abyssal creature, learning its tastes through cooking, building with cards, and choosing forecasted paths to prepare for growing threats.

title: In Search of Freedom
description: In Search of Freedom combines close-quarters and ranged combat with environmental puzzle solving. The game rewards creativity: using the environment, combining different Blaster chargers, and coordinating enemy waves are the keys to survival. This isn’t just about shooting — it’s about thinking, improvising, and adapting your arsenal to every threat.

title: Of the Devil: Episode 3
description: Morgan finds herself centerstage as the State conducts a witch trial to exorcise itself of one of its most outspoken critics, but she refuses to play the fool in the oncoming torrent of political theater.

title: Legion Saga Remastered
description:
Legion Saga Remastered is an updated version of the 2001 game.

Originaly created by Kamau (Matt Glanville), this new version provides bug fixes, new/updated game mechanics and an adjusted soundtrack.

title: Of the Devil: Episode 0
description: When Morgan finds herself assigned as Public Defender for the man the police say has shot six people through the heart, she'll need to leverage all her wits and the full force of her "unique insight" into the case to come out unscathed and on-top.

title: Billie's Wheelie
description: Billie's Wheelie is an adventure racing platformer game, You can play it with up to 8 players Co-op/PvP, Playing as a hamster in his ball trying to beat all challenges, Collecting all cheese pieces for rewards, And beating your friend's time records.

title: Drop Duchy: The North
description: In The North, the second DLC for Drop Duchy, you will fight in battles inspired by warring Vikings. Build new tactics for all game modes, with aggressive new combat and looting mechanics.

title: Rise of the Cones: Planetary Defense
description: Rise of the Cones is a 3D sci-fi tower defense game set on alien worlds. Build and upgrade towers to stop relentless cone-shaped machines before they reach your base.

title: Jiaozi & Shopkeeper
description: "Jiaozi & Shopkeeper" is a simulation game themed around cooking dumplings. You will become a dumpling shop owner, making dumplings, managing the shop, and improving your skills; you'll encounter friendly fellow shop owners and comfortably grow your business from a novice to a thriving business.

title: Exofinity Clicker
description: Discover new worlds and earn credits by mining the legendary Infinity Crystal in Exofinity Clicker! Tap to extract rare cosmic minerals, upgrade your buildings and expand your reach as you evolve from a small outpost into a multi-planetary powerhouse.

title: Abyss Prowler
description:
Abyss Prowler is a fast-paced precision movement combat shooter built around movement, positioning, and battlefield control.

Dash through enemy attacks, exploit openings, and turn overwhelming situations into controlled victories through skillful movement and rapid decision-making. When pressure peaks, Focus Mode slows time, giving you a brief window to reposition, assess threats, and unleash devastating missile strikes.

Set within a neon digital realm under siege, Abyss Prowler challenges players to master movement, control space, and survive relentless enemy swarms through precision and skill.

title: Alastrius
description: In this explosive on-the-rails shooter pilot powerful Star-Fighters and wage a vast interstellar war. Chart your own course across a galaxy of exotic sci-fi worlds as you carve a path to the Capital. Lay waste to hordes of enemy ships and bring down ruthless bosses. You are the Republics last hope!

title: Cult of Lily
description:
Cult of Lily, an open-world/dating sim adult game.

In this game you're a futa girl, a very popular singer known as "Lily" who, after a traumatizing event, decide to lay low and decide to enter an academy to try to have a normal life.

Spend your time as you want, you can raise your stat to meet new people, or spend some time together with your friend to deepen your bond and eventually become more than friend, or you can just explore the city, who know what'll you find.

title: YouTD 2
description: YouTD 2 is a remake of the tower defense custom map "YouTD" from Warcraft III (original mod created by geX and the YouTD community).

title: Favij: The Game
description: A fan-made game based on the famous Italian YouTuber Favij

title: She Tells Her Story
description:
She Tells Her Story is an indie, narrative-driven visual novel that explores mental health through a deeply personal and emotionally honest story. The game follows a young protagonist navigating her teenage years while dealing with bullying, burnout, depression, trauma, and fear of failure — alongside moments of friendship, love, growth, and healing.
This is not a “high-action” game. It’s a story-first experience designed to resonate emotionally and spark reflection, discussion, and connection.

title: The Second Reproduction: Reunion
description: A remake/alternative version of the otome visual novel "The Second Reproduction."

title: Lirai: Heir Of Darkness
description:
Lirai: Heir of Darkness is a fast-paced action RPG set in a dark fantasy world consumed by an ancient curse. Players take on the role of Brian, a warrior who must uncover the truth behind their corrupted heritage before losing their humanity entirely.

The game features intense real-time combat with a fluid combo system that rewards precision and timing. Each enemy presents unique attack patterns and weaknesses that require both strategy and quick reflexes to overcome. Boss encounters push combat mastery to the limit with multi-phase battles against legendary demons trapped between worlds.

Lirai: Heir of Darkness combines challenging skill-based combat, atmospheric world design, and narrative-driven gameplay, exploring themes of sacrifice, identity, and the corrupting nature of power.

title: Bengan Box
description: Fight endless waves of enemies and purchase defenses to survive the next onslaught. Permanently unlock new items and build a custom arsenal tailored to your playstyle in this chaotic co-op survival action game.

title: The Moon Looks Beautiful Tonight: Definitive Edition
description: The Moon Looks Beautiful Tonight: Definitive Edition is a Yuri Visual Novel about fear of the unknown. The re-release is a complete edit of the original story, including new graphics, an original OST, and an updated story.

title: The Farming One
description: The Farming One is a fast paced farming simulation game, with barely any farming or simulation at all. While starting with an eternally growing patch of radishes that you can harvest over and over again, you’ll get enough money to buy more crops, hire assistants, acquire tools and investing in the maintenance of the town, making it flourish with people again.

title: Sunless Empire
description: Sunless Empire is a set of 10 Aztec themed maps (+1 Credits Map) by the Waffle House Team for Doom 2 in MBF21 format. The set features new textures by Ludi and muumi along with a fully bespoke soundtrack by Korp, LVENdead, and LPad. The monsters have also received cosmetic changes that do not affect gameplay, and a weaker green cyber has been added to the roster. This set starts out with smaller, easier maps but makes a pretty big leap in both scale and difficulty in the last third.

title: Bergabash
description:
A mod about a guy. Named Bergatron. I think.

Lots of Bergatron. Oh and that green guy too I guess he's there.

title: Yumemiru Sepia
description:
Pia adores Wither and Wither adores Pia. The two cherish their time together alone, spent on playdates at the park.

It's simple, easygoing - a pleasurable time that they indulge in for as long as the day allows. Pia is allowed to let loose and howl to their heart's content. Yume enjoys Pia's song immersed within nature's own orchestra. Life is lovely... But Pia notices that Yume is troubled.

Can these gentle moments last?

title: Man, I Love Terraria Fishing
description: Man, I Love Terraria Fishing is a short Terraria-themed fishing game.

title: Dead Trust
description: Dead Trust is a short PSX-style horror game where a mysterious explosion in your neighbourhood turns a cozy night into something terrifying.

title: Chaturanga
description: Chess-variant mixed with roguelite elements

title: Quake Brutalist Jam III
description: Quake Brutalist Jam III is a megalithic community project more than a year in the making. It features an entirely new arsenal, a set of new monsters, new powerups, and a complete visual overhaul of Quake's existing roster. The community came out in force, producing an unprecedented 77 maps, pushing the limits of the Quake engine to bring the oppressive, gritty, and beautiful aesthetic of brutalism to life.

title: Densou Tenshi Valforce
description: A 3D Arena Fighting-Shooter inspired by titles such as Virtual On and Armored Core.

title: Tiny Pasture: Baabaa and Moomoo
description: This DLC introduces two adorable new animals—a sheep and a cow. Both are gentle herbivores, with the cow being chubby and charming, and the sheep sweet and cuddly! Don’t wait—welcome these new friends to your Pasture today!

title: Tiny Pasture: Ribbitribbit and Quackquack
description: This DLC brings in two brand-new little buddies – a frog and a duck. With summer upon us, why not invite these lively water-edge chatterboxes over to cool down your desktop pasture?

title: Cross The World
description: Explore, gather, craft, fight, and survive the fantasy world with persistent world simulation as an adventurer party. Every part of the world is persistently calculated, environment interacts and changes over time with season and progress. Play alone or play with your friends in multiplayer!

title: Faster Than Death
description: Faster Than Death is a fast-paced, violent first person action game with platformer elements and one-hit kill mechanics. Enter its vast environments with unique visual style and slice your way to victory.

title: Endhop
description:
ENDHOP is a precision platformer game, where if you hold the space bar, the higher you will jump, and your goal is to reach the top.

At the start of ENDHOP, you also get a gun! Collect trash to use as bullets to launch yourself and get to the top as fast as possible.

title: Runeveil
description:
Runeveil is a roguelike deckbuilder where your strategy isn't just about what you play, but how you sequence it. Step into the shoes of powerful 7 Elemental Mages and travel through various Arenas. Your goal: Complete the 7 Kings' Trials of the 7 Unique Arena, and survive the escalating chaos.

Unlike traditional card games, where you play one card at a time, in Runeveil, you are the architect of your own turn.

title: Dark Watching: Chapter 1
description: Dark Watching: Chapter 1 – The Bunker is a gripping first-person horror adventure. You play as Jacob, searching for your missing sister. Your path leads through an abandoned bunker full of secrets, puzzles, and deadly dangers. Explore rooms, collect clues and items.

title: Boar Farm
description: Boar Farm is a 3D semi-horror game inspired by creepypastas and it's predecessor, skebalious.exe. It has multiple endings, which you access by obtaining clues and putting the pieces together.

title: Aliencity
description: AlienCity is a fast-paced, wave-based FPS where you fight through a dark, stylized city overrun by alien creatures. Survive, score high, and push your limits against relentless enemy swarms.

title: Cosy Cafe
description:
Your rough childhood is over, and you stand on the precipice of adulthood with only one goal in mind: To become an exceptional restaurateur like your grandfather. But for now, you'll settle for building a modest cafe.

Unfortunately, nothing in life is ever so straightforward. Money is tight, and your simple dream must be balanced with your sudden inclusion in an unseen world of high society and nobility, but with hard work and determination, you know that you can build a life for yourself and the girls you meet along the way.

title: Cubettiny
description: Cubettiny is a fast-paced 2.5D arcade game where you guide a sad blue cube through low-poly levels filled with obstacles, traps, and power-ups. Collect cubes, complete chains, unlock hidden paths, use power-ups, and push through each stage to bring order back to Numeria!

title: Outworld Defence
description: Outworld Defense is a 2D tower defense game where you recruit defenders, fortify your mansion, purchase upgrades, and use bonuses to protect it from hordes of demonic creatures.

title: Guerilla Cubes
description: Guerilla Cubes is an action-packed couch co-op hero shooter where a special ops squad battles through living jungles, scorching deserts, and bone-freezing tundra's to reclaim Cube City from the ruthless BOX BOSS.

title: Your Painting, Sir
description: Recreate paintings using newspaper cutouts — Analyze the painting, search the newspaper for similar elements, carefully cut them out, and place them on their correct position. Will you fool your boss with your arts and crafts?

title: RogueDiceR
description: RogueDiceR is a Roguelite Dice-builder. Buy randomly generated dice and modify their values. Attach stickers to grant special effects or strengthen your dice deck with powerful artifacts. Fight your way through randomly generated dungeons filled with monsters, events and bosses.

title: Void81
description: VOID81 is a 3D platform game with survival horror elements, where you explore ever-changing levels, solve puzzles, avoid dangers, and traverse surreal worlds inspired by the retro atmosphere of the 1980s.

title: Kepler 186F
description: In Kepler 186F, survival is just the beginning—you must investigate. Your choices shape the story, unfolding a thrilling adventure from the planet's dark side to its space station.

title: Exone Rift
description: Take direct control of your hero on a hostile planet. Build your base, gather resources, expand your territory your way, and survive against the planet’s deadly wildlife.

title: Backroom Cleaners
description: Purge the unknown Backrooms in this 4-player co-op TPS roguelike. Experience endless combat with fresh build combinations every run.

title: Func Key
description: Deck out your keyboard with powerful upgrades in this roguelike word-builder. Snap on keycaps to buff entire rows or columns, install "broken" function keys, and pick your projects as you rise from a lowly intern to a corporate legend.

title: A Game About Shooting Bullets At Bullets
description: A 3D incremental FPS game where you don’t move, only your bullets do. You’re stuck in space with nothing to do but shoot bullets...at bullets. Watch bullets bounce out of control, numbers explode, and a quiet room turn into pure chaos.

title: King's Downfall
description: Defy the tyrant. Build your settlement, defend it from invasions, and gain enough power to overthrow the king.

title: Tiny House Finds
description: Search inside and around cozy 3D houses, floor by floor, in a relaxing 3D hidden object game full of tiny details.

title: RageByte
description: A minimalist precision platformer designed to lie to you. Dodge spikes, survive portal shifts, and trust nothing.

title: Wasteland Outpost
description: Wasteland Outpost is an explosive online cocktail of tactical shooter, base building, and survival. Scavenge for resources, build an impregnable fortress, and fight off hordes of mutants and the enemy team. Fortify your base or watch it burn in the flames of the apocalypse!

title: Soul Hunter
description: A team of young paranormal researchers ventures into the cursed corners of Japan to prove the existence of the spirit world. Ghosts feed on fear and the sanity of the living, luring you into traps of illusion. Your only defense is a special camera, capable of banishing spirits and unveiling secrets.

title: Blackjack Descent
description: You're locked in a room where your only chance of survival is to play blackjack against a sinister dealer. Every hand isn't just a gamble, it's a deal with fate. Fail to repay your debt on time, and you'll fall into darkness... or something far worse.

title: Twin Shot Deluxe
description: The Angel Cats are back! Twin Shot Deluxe is a platform arcade shooter where players defend their homeland using bow and arrows. Take aim at 200+ brand new levels set across four worlds. Play solo or with a friends in local co-op (1-4 players) or competitively to see who will be crowned champion.

title: Power Rangers Online
description: Power Rangers Online was a South Korean side-scrolling action MMORPG game based on Mahou Sentai Magiranger which aired in South Korea as Power Rangers Magic Force in 2006. The game was developed by IRONNOS and published by Ntreev Soft and Daewon Media, and went into closed beta in November 2011.

title: Radio Farm
description: relax and take an afternoon stroll in gravel county.

title: Cube Game Server Boss
description: Feel the thrill of running you own cube game server! Experience the journey of building your server from the ground up by upgrading gamemodes, hiring staff, and more!

title: La Yaga
description: Walk through the Slavic forests with Baba Yaga in search of the origin of a blight affecting the natural balance. Collect ingredients and combine them in your hut to create potions that will aid you on your journey.

title: Portal Hopper
description: A story-driven 2D precision platformer for PC about a lost squid navigating an unfamiliar world, guided by a kind ferret lady determined to get him home, and reminding the broken what it means to love.

title: Terrors to Unveil: Last Trace
description: Ethan Reid, a 33 year old man craving a break from his demanding routine, decides to take a much needed trip with his girlfriend. What was meant to be a peaceful getaway quickly takes an unexpected turn, setting events in motion that Ethan could have never anticipated.

title: Wandersky
description: Wandersky is a skybound top-down adventure with a single arrow and a flying house. Kuu and her companion Tama are on a mission to restore the land of Hyndara. Explore a huge world filled with puzzles, enemies and quests: the sky always carries those who dare to wander…

title: Terra Request
description: Take the reins as a planet manager. Build up the planet's surface and orbit, appease the three factions, and take advantage of special abilities. But watch out, if you're not careful, you might just lose control.

title: Shoyu Ramen Forever
description: Overworked office worker Tsutomu, his ramen blog dying, stops at a station-side stall and orders six toppings. A kids' rumor says six makes you vanish. His heart sinks into history's dark.

title: A Shadow in Space
description: A Shadow in Space is a narrative-driven third-person immersive sim that combines futuristic sci-fi with Lovecraftian cosmic horror. Discover the ancient secrets of a desolate space station and face the sanity-bending terrors that lurk within the deep void of space.

title: Steal Santa's Pills
description: Do you hate Christmas? Of course you do, everybody does. Well then, it's time to bring this all to an end. In this game, you break into Santa's house and steal his medications, so we'll never have to experience this stupid holiday ever again.

title: Time Twins Mosaics: Tales of Avalon
Zeldarius
description: A mix of The Legend of Zelda and Darius.

title: Cole Hunter: Payback
description:
You're Captain Cole Hunter - broke, hunted, and heavily armed.

In this retro-fueled space roguelite, blast through bullet hell gauntlets, collect enemy cores to upgrade your ship, and repay a galaxy-sized debt to a syndicate that wants your hide more than your money.

The longer you fly, the hotter the chase gets. Make every shot count... or default in flames.

title: Mimetic
description: Hunt or be hunted is this new generation hide & seek game style with advanced physics and interactions. Hunt your friends with the drone or be hunted and morph yourself into any object in the game ! Turn on special abilities mode for more fun !

title: Low Effort Romance
description: Low Effort Romance is an otome visual novel about two tired adults who accidentally fall for each other between quarterly reports. Can you juggle deadlines, nosy coworkers, group projects, and a romance that keeps almost happening on company property?

title: Defend The Cubes
description: Defend The Cubes is a strategic tower defense game where you deploy units instead of towers to protect your cube from challenging waves of enemies.

title: Down We Go
description: Down We Go is a little roguelite horror game about taking an elevator way deeper than anyone should.

title: Weed Supermarket Simulator
description: Grow weed and grow your business! Run your own weed supermarket, manage stock, set prices, and help customers. Try new strains, choose the best products, upgrade your shop, and keep your store running smoothly so people always come back.

title: Paper Soldiers
description: Paper Soldiers is a deck-building card game with a game board consisting of different tile types. You are leading an uprising against tyranny. To win the game you need to complete multiple encounters and build your ideal deck.

title: Synchronite_Drive1
description: The player finds itself without memory in a deserted place. Its sole guide and companion is Nem, a robot girl with the city as her ward.

title: Crossroads: Fatal Truths - Collector's Edition
description: Make your choices. Find your path.

title: Parking Lot Simulator
description: Start as a valet parking cars and work your way up to becoming a legendary car collector! Park customer's vehicles quickly and safely, earn tips, and expand your parking lot to build the most prestigious business in town.

title: Soglia
description: "Like all psychic life, creativity also comes from the unconscious. If you identify with the creative process, you end up believing that you are the creator." Soglia is a game based entirely on sound. A dreamlike journey into our unconscious to discover where ideas are born.

title: Flip or Fade: The Bottle Flip
description: "Flip or Fade: The Bottle Flip" is a physics-based, 4-player online survival game. Flip, stand, and perform tricks to gain viewers and fame! Can you survive 10 days while paying a hefty streaming contract fee? Succeed or perish—a battle for your destiny awaits!

title: Four Bombs
description:
Entry for Ludum Dare 27: "10 Seconds"

Disarm 4 bombs in 10 seconds each. You only get one shot at it.

title: Lady Mabel Mysteries: Death on Board - Collector’s Edition
description:
In the tradition of classic murder mysteries, Elephant Games proudly presents Lady Mabel Mysteries: Death on Board, the first entry in a brand-new series!

Mystery author Lady Mabel Porter sets off on a comfort cruise seeking inspiration for her latest detective story, only to find herself tangled up in a real-life mystery of rivalry, passion, and murder! With suspects stacking up and a mysterious figure watching her every move, it’s only a matter of time before Lady Mabel either solves the case or becomes the killer’s next victim! Can you help her solve the case, catch the criminal, and finish her story? There’s just one way to find out! Come aboard and set a course for mayhem in the first exciting entry in a brand new Hidden-Object Puzzle Adventure game series!

This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won’t find in the standard version.

The Collector’s Edition includes:
Dive into a secret organization in the bonus chapter!
Stay afloat with the strategy guide!
Earn achievements for your creative gameplay! Complete the collectibles search in the Expedition mode.
Find puzzle pieces, morphing items, and mystery book collectibles! Your reward is a charming bonus puzzle!
Enjoy and save exclusive wallpapers, screensavers, and music!

title: Loveless General Hospital
description:
Welcome to Loveless, a hospital known for it's clinical efficiency above anything else.

Tonight you will choose a doctor to fix you up, be careful.

title: Only Down: Not Up!
description: After finishing his shift, a crane operator finds himself stuck at the top of a massive crane tower. There’s no climbing up, only down! Jump from platform to platform, avoid falling, and reach the ground to get home. Only Down: Not Up!

title: LibreQuake
description: LibreQuake is an on-going project to create free content game data for the Quake engine, which alongside being a game in its own right, allows the play of various mods and total conversions without requiring the original proprietary commercial assets. It is the second attempt at this, having been preceded by Open Quartz in the 2000s. LibreQuake was founded in 2019 and aims for a Lovecraftian theme. The game is released under a three clause BSD license similar to Freedoom.

title: VirtualBus
description: VirtualBus is a free racing simulation program designed for Windows users, providing an immersive experience in bus driving. The application allows players to navigate realistic environments while managing various aspects of bus operation, from route planning to passenger management. With its focus on realism and detailed graphics, users can enjoy a unique racing experience that emphasizes strategy and precision over speed.

title: Seed
description: A brutal physics-based climbing game, where a robot tries to escape a cave using nothing but his awkward arms.

title: Twilight Ferry
description: Tytti is tasked with ferrying lost souls to the afterlife. Existing between the two realms, her own soul is set adrift. Discover secrets, unlock emotions to navigate puzzles, and experience a moving journey in an intriguing landscape inspired by Finnic mythology.

title: Sorekara: End of a Journey
description:
Threading through the universe are railways that deliver the dead to the Great Beyond, and traveling those rails is a cursed individual with no place to go. Caught between life and death, the man resigns himself to the tendrils of dark that wrap around his body like cocoon. Days and night are all the same. One day, it'll all disappear.

At the edge of a shore-- in a place that that time forgot-- with the illusionary sunrise painting the rubble gold-- A wayward soul watches the sky, and the journey begins with a gift.

title: Trials of Luna
description: A 2D 16-bit styled action MMORPG.

title: Party Box
description: PartyBox is a free party game inspired by the Jackbox format, designed for players who enjoy bold humor and awkward situations. Thousands of professionally narrated prompts across dozens of game categories easily turn any gathering into lively discussions and heated debates. Create and add your own questions with custom voice lines, and discover unexpected sides of your friends. Download the game for free, gather around a big screen, and get ready for an unforgettable night of laughter.

title: Dreamshift
description:
Entry for Ludum Dare 30: "Connected Worlds"

In Dreamshift, you must guide our exhausted hero to the doorway across the level. His energy drops quickly and he is unable to jump when his energy is low. His stress also builds, but very slowly.

When his energy runs out, he falls asleep. In the dream world, he can fly and recover his stress and energy. If his energy completely refills, he wakes up again. Taking damage in the dream world, however, wakes him up immediately and causes extra stress.

You can force him to fall asleep (or force him to wake up, if he's near his 'body')

The higher your stress gets, the more miasma will appear in the dream world and the more shades they will spawn. If your stress level gets too high, they will manifest in the real world, and are deadly to you!

title: Lure Of Passion
description: "Lure of Passion" is an adult game about a simple fisherman living in a old hut… who somehow keeps catching more than just fish.

title: Finish Your Project
description:
Entry for Ludum Dare 31: "Entire Game on One Screen"

A lonely mouse must finish his project while taking care of other needs in order to keep his inspiration up.

title: Shooterhouse
description: Fangame of Splatterhouse that re-envisions it as a horizontal score shooter instead.

title: Beast Of The Woods
description:
Entry for Ludum Dare 33: "You are the Monster"

You are a terrifying beast, stalking humans that venture into your woods. They have a flashlight and a gun, while all you have is your claws... but that's all you need. Sneak up on them and kill them before they can kill you.

Killing all 18 wins the game. How many can YOU get?

title: Saphi
description: Race. Learn. Improve. The home of CTR custom track time trials. Challenge yourself, learn from others, and be part of a passionate community.

title: Little Fishing Trip
description: It's a short, psx style horror game about fishing.

title: Christmas with Father Ben
description:
Hidden beneath the rotting floorboards of an abandoned house in a forgotten village in the dead of winter. A videotape that simply reads “Christmas with Father Ben.” Let curiosity take hold and experience what might be the darkest Christmas Special ever made.

"Christmas with Father Ben" is a short interactive experience that draws inspiration from Rankin/Bass stop-motion Christmas specials and real-life disturbing events.

title: Once a Porn a Time 3
description: The ultimate NSFW fairytale trainer game – Corrupt all the princesses! Use Persuasion, Magic, and Corruption to break them. Unlock animated porn scenes, voice acting, and multiple endings in the galaxy’s most sinful park!

title: Dream of Corpse Lady
description: Cards, battle! Someone woke up the sleeping Corpse Lady... Perhaps, the world needs to pay a price for the awakening... In this game, you will play the role of the awakened Corpse Lady, try various strange construction combinations, discover powerful opponents, and then knock them all down!

title: Stardew Aquarium
description: Help restore the Stardew Aquarium to its former glory by donating fish for its exhibitions! See the collection come to life in full animation as you contribute to the collection. And in the meantime, why not explore the beach outside and buy a snack from the beach shop, or stock up on fishing supplies from the submarine shop if you want to try catching the rumored rare fish in these waters?

title: Robot Rampage
description: *Robot Rampage* is a thrilling multiplayer robot shoot 'em up that immerses players in fast-paced, high-stakes combat. Set in a futuristic world where advanced robotic warriors clash in fierce battles.

title: Defentrix
description: Defentrix is ​​a tower defense game with 31 handcrafted levels. Capture the towers and defend our solar system.

title: Dance Dance Detective
description: Grab your dance shoes, and Dance, Dance, Detective! Go undercover as a dance teacher on a cruise ship full of wacky suspects. Create choreographies to uncover their dark secrets, follow the leads, and connect clues to find who killed the chief science officer of Bolero Chocolate Company.

title: Neon City
description: Build your empire in the futuristic city where light and shadow intertwine - "Neon City" will bring you an unprecedented strategic management experience. As an independent game that combines cyberpunk style with gorgeous pixels, the realistic light and shadow effects will immerse you in it.

title: Office Inspector
description: Identify anomalies and dangers in a mysterious office complex and make the right decisions to escape using the elevator.

title: Trapped on the FlipSide
description: In this Puzzle Platformer, follow the narrative of three explorers, kidnapped by a mechanical megastructure. Play as their assistant spherical robot in an effort to save them from this brutal place. By powering up the system, area by area, the secretive past and dark truth may make itself known.

title: Summer Days in the Joyful Countryside
description: Welcome your nieces to your rural home to help them enjoy a summer vacation of relaxation, farming, and gaming!

title: I'm a Human
description: Forget defense. This is Reverse Tower Defense where you are the threat. Lead the AI, build robots and destroy human bases.Your goal is invasion. Your weapon is the swarm.

title: Occult Hand of the Blood Lily
description: A Gothic-Punk yuri visual novel about a magician on the run and her mysterious vampiric guardian. Journey by airship across a war-torn Europe and search for a legendary flower with the power to destroy nations.

title: Blitz Strasse
description: Japan-exclusive Mideval warfare strategy/simulation game for Windows 95, developed by Artdink. Released in 1996.

title: The Granny Detective Society
description: A cozy and quirky detective game where Madeline, a retired little mouse, watches her street and dives into thrilling investigations… until the Granny Detective Society contacts her and she discovers that the whole neighborhood is living a double life… especially the grannies.

title: With Walker
description: With Walker is a game made using RPG Maker 2000 created by FLARE. The fan-translation into English by rm2Kfanboy in called "Romancing Walker". The story is a combination of a traditional roleplaying game and a dating sim, and draws heavily on the harem genre.

title: Riddle Of Revenge
description:
Riddle of Revenge is a conceptual gameplay mod for Doom, forged under the inspiration of other renowned mods, but with a thematic difference: it is heavily based on the "pseudo-conceptual horror story" of the album Three Cheers for Sweet Revenge.

It's art direction features pre-rendered animations created from scratch, running at 35 frames per second, giving the gameplay a deliberately unique aesthetic. To execute their sweet revenge, the player will have a vast arsenal of 11 weapons and other moves to be ready for battle.

title: Symblyx
description:
Entry for Ludum Dare 35: "Shapeshift"

Shift rows and columns of different shapes together in order to match and clear them. The faster you clear the board, the more points you earn! Take too long, and it's game over!

title: Blacked Out
description:
Where the world of living people comes into contact with the world of ghosts, reality no longer lends itself to logic and the usual course of things. Our thoughts, strong desires, true impulses can sometimes become uncontrollable. If, in order to realize his intentions, a person is ready to make a deal with the witchcraft world, he will not be the only one responsible for this mistake, but also all those who meet him on his life’s path.
