All these people will end up in the world of the damned, the world of the outcast and the desperate.

This story will tell you about prisoners of enchanted paintings, painted by a crazy artist and doomed them to eternal wandering between the real world and the ghostly world. When these worlds come into contact, you can talk to spirits. Each painting is unique and dangerous, since to free its spirit you need to go into the other world yourself and find the answer. Damned souls are treacherous, and the artist will protect his creations.

title: Stickman Beach Volleyball Deluxe
description: Become a stick beach volleyball champion! Multiple varied beach locations!

title: Exodus II
description: A high-velocity movement-shooter following CPL CHAI on his vengeful assault against the Zephari homeworld after their failed invasion of Earth.

title: Differences Online
description: Differences Online - a game of attention and speed! Find the differences between two pictures faster than your opponent in exciting duels. Unlock new levels and locations, improve your attention, and compete for the top spot in the rankings. Play stress-free and enhance your skills.

title: Wrong Way
description: "Escape the psychological nightmare by solving ingenious puzzles. Every object you touch hides secrets. Every code you crack brings you closer to freedom… or to final destruction."

title: Long 15: NCR Expansion
description: Massive lore-friendly quest & land expansion with 30+ quests, 200+ fully voiced characters, new minor factions, player homes, and multiple main questlines. Allows the player to visit the Long 15 before nuking it in Lonesome Road, and expands upon NCR lands in California. ~20 hours of total content, with expansive player choice and consequences.

title: Sectoris Sky
description: Sectoris Sky is constantly evolving. New content, features, and optimizations will be added regularly.

title: Gemini Rush
description: Gemini Rush is a LAN racing game where each player controls a single-wheel vehicle on a circuit made up of two constantly parallel roads. The player has the ability to switch between the two using a skill. The vehicle is highly amenable and very fast.

title: P0: Byte-Sized Brilliance
description:
P0 is a speedrunning anomaly hunting game within the horror genre.

In P0, 10 seconds is all you’ll get to decide whether your memorised office environment has an anomaly or not before smashing a button to progress to the next floor. Look fast, decide quickly, and crash through all 30 floors to earn the highest grade possible and ace a rather unusual interview to land your dream job. Red or green. Make your choice.

You won’t be thrown in at the deep end for your interview. Every candidate starts on the Junior level exam, and once completed, tougher difficulties and sub difficulties will unlock. You’ll be up against a global roster of talent, so to really impress and earn your spot on the board, pick ANY exam and complete it as quickly as possible.

Your office bestie, Buddy, is there to offer you emotional support during your interview. Through every run, you’ll earn credits to spend on kitting them out in the finest or wackiest wares. If you’re more sensible with your credits, you might want to spend them on collectibles. These can help spot tougher anomalies or provide glimpses into the lore.

title: Battle Tokens
description: Battle Tokens is a free-to-play, turn-based tactics RPG where up to 9 players push 2D tokens across a living grid, crush escalating monster waves, and complete dynamic quests for gold, upgrades, and items!

title: Disturbulence
description: Aboard Skyway Airlines above the Bermuda Triangle, the cabin is caught in an endless loop. Each time you walk the aisle, reality changes—small details twisting into something deeply wrong. Spot the difference just got more....DISTURBING!

title: Vivariums
description: Immerse yourself in the first-ever blend of classic Sudoku and first-person horror as you descend deeper into the unknown.

title: Frontier: Path of Shadows
description: Fight enemies, upgrade your squad, and explore new planets! Make tough choices and shape the fate of an entire sector in Frontier: Path of Shadows. Experience a richly crafted 25th-century world and tactical combat where X-COM meets Final Fantasy.

title: ShapeCycle
description: ShapeCycle is a peaceful open-world adventure built on recycling. Collect resources, solve shape-based puzzles, and restore balance to the world. Every copy also includes ShapeRecipe, a free expansion that lets you craft 3D shapes from 2D forms, blending creativity with critical thinking.

title: Locum Tenens
description: Originally made for PSP in 2025. Full PC Steam port to modern systems. Variety of enemies, weapons, bosses and levels.

title: Konbini Simulator
description: Konbini Simulator lets you manage your own convenience store! Handle inventory, serve customers, and expand your business. Customize your shop, complete daily challenges, and manage a wide range of products to create the ultimate shopping experience. Perfect for casual players and simulation fans.

title: Blindfold Chess
description: Blindfold Chess is a minimalist strategy game where you play chess entirely from memory. Practice with blindfold exercises, improve your visualization, and battle Stockfish AI or online players without ever seeing the board.

title: Anime Dream Match: Reptiles
description: A charming and relaxing memory game where you match pairs of cool anime reptiles.

title: Money Theft 3: Last Mission
description: Gangster Terlander is back again. His mission is again to find money bags in different areas in this third person shooter game

title: Normis Simulator
description: Playing as Normis, you are a typical representative of the mainstream with a traditional stable life, ironically referring to youth subcultures, avoiding conflicts and extreme actions, preferring routine and social adaptation.

title: VHS Romance
description: Be kind, rewind… and fall in love. Summer ’86 in a small U.S. town: save a cozy VHS shop from a corporate chain, choose your girl, and help a secret dropout shoot his first film. Six heroines, 14 endings, one last take.

title: Tower Crusher
description: Crush the tower, click as quickly as you can to save the 5 princesses in the castle. Start as a poor knight with a wooden helmet, collect coins and upgrade your outfit to golden armor and a golden axe.

title: Nightmare Train
description: A survival horror set on a haunted train where you must manage your sanity and dwindling light, collect mysterious artifacts, and evade the monster to reach the driver’s seat and stop the nightmare.

title: Furni-Chore
description:
Entry for Ludum Dare 37: "One Room"

It's time to re-decorate the house, and someone else is in charge of it (which frankly is the way you like it). They still want you to decorate ONE of the rooms yourself, and it needs to meet their approval. Oh well, let's get this over with...

Each level gives you one room to place all of the furniture given to you. Hold the left mouse button to drag the furniture to the room, and click the right mouse button while dragging to rotate it. Hover over it to see the rules for its placement. There must also be a clear path at the end to walk from one door to the other (rugs will not block the path, of course).

title: Chaos Below
description: Chaos Below is a one-map MBF21 project centered around a small techbase, overtaken by nature.

title: V tylu vraga: Diversanty 2
description: Second add-on to the first V tily vraga (Soldiers: Heroes of World War II) and the second game in the Diversanty spin-off series, folowing "Silent Heroes: Elite Troups of WWII".

title: Burglin' Gnomes
description: An online Co-op game about breaking into houses and causing havoc as a tiny gnome. Avoid danger, repurpose stolen household items, and complete tasks to meet the High-Gnome’s demands. Craft equipment and upgrade your home to make your missions easier and more successful.

title: Zeroad
description: ZEROAD is an endless pixel-art roguelike shooter. Fight through shifting roads and zombie hordes, growing stronger every run. Find unique weapons with modifiers, level up your character, and push further each time – solo or in two-player co-op!

title: Heroes Battle Awakening
description: Fight monsters with monsters as you command legions against waves of invaders in tower defense style!

title: The Dream of Jacob
description: Travel as Jacob through the most transcendent astral dream ever told. Discover heaven and hell, overcoming unexpected challenges and fighting your inner demons. Will you reach the top of the ladder?

title: The Dinner Table
description: A blend of visual novel elements with platforming levels. An ode to the challenging levels of the 16-bit era. No checkpoints.

title: Game Company Simulator
description: A weary ex‑developer, tired of pay‑to‑win and toxic workplaces, creates a simulation where you play as a game company boss. Recruit staff, push their potential, battle rivals, and aim to dominate the market with blockbuster hits to reach the pinnacle of success.

title: Spellcaster: Origins - Duel
description:
Spellcaster: Origins is a fast-paced, competitive typing RPG where your keyboard is your most powerful weapon. Step into the astral arena, channel your inner mage, and prove that your fingers are faster than any enchantment.

In Spellcaster, every word you type is a spell. Accuracy and speed are the keys to victory. Cast powerful incantations to damage your foes, but be careful—hesitation leads to failure. If you're too slow, the enemy strikes back!

title: Rogue Signal Protocol
description:
Rogue Signal Protocol is a traditional turn-based coffee break stealth roguelike where you play as an escaped digital consciousness navigating hostile corporate networks. Quick 10-15 minute runs with permadeath - each death teaches lessons, each run reveals more truth.

Navigate procedurally-generated corporate networks using strategic stealth and cunning. Hide in blind spots to avoid detection, manage your heat levels to prevent overheating, and carefully choose when to use your limited exploits. Every move counts in this purely skill-based tactical challenge.

title: Reaper of Souls
description:
Compo entry for Ludum Dare 52: "Harvest"

You have been sent to claim the soul of a human that is fated to die. This must be done in order to maintain the Balance, which slowly degrades the longer you take to finish your task.

The Fated's soul is red, making them easy to spot. They can see your approach and will attempt to flee, so you may need to trap them somewhere they can't run. When collecting other souls, they will briefly indicate the direction of the Fated.

Regular humans' souls are blue, meaning they are not meant yet to die. You can claim their souls if you wish, but it will hurt the Balance greatly. As they are not near death, they cannot see you.

The fates of those who are injured are indeterminate, as shown by their yellow souls. Claim them as you wish; doing so will restore a small amount of the Balance. They will be able to see you nearby, but are injured and cannot flee very well.

If a human is dying, their soul is orange. Claim these to restore a good amount of the balance, as their death is expected. THey are unconscious and will not flee from your approach, making this task easier.

title: Hotseat Wagons 2
description: Local Multiplayer. Up to 8 players. Up to 8 gamepads and 3 keyboard players. Sadness, fun, suffering (nowhere without it) and the exultation of victory

title: Hotseat Wagons 2: Space World
description:
New models.
9 game mods (4 new).
37 new levels.
New world!

title: Deda
description: Old crazy grandfather trapped you in his house... You have 3 difficulties to choose. Try to escape DEDA's house...

title: Brekekekex
description: Hunt frogs, clash with cultists, and survive close-range arena combat in this short, skill-driven swamp adventure.

title: Chaos in the Harem
description: You play a beautiful girl with magic. Defeat all kinds of enemies, enemies are beautiful but also very powerful. Don't be attracted by their beauty. Pick up your weapon and don't let it crush them.

title: Chaos Beach: A Virgin Boy’s Pheromone-Fueled Summer of Lust!
description: A pheromone-soaked summer where girls swarm a desperate virgin! No choices, just fast-paced storytelling packed with intense, fully voiced H-scenes—uncensored and bleep-free. A visual novel made for one thing: pure, practical pleasure.

title: Catapult Girls
description: This is a slow-paced casual game. Meet five beautiful girls from another world with distinct personalities. Control them, fire off weapons, and deepen your bonds as you battle your way through levels. Enjoy a moment of peace and quiet.

title: Cardnal Desires
description: Monster girls have invaded the local card shop...? It's up to you to collect and play your cards to satisfy their desires... Collect currency, unlock card packs, apply status effects, and see how long you(r run) can last...

title: Captain Fly and Sexy Girls at the Night Club
description: In this game you control the captain who flies through the night club.

title: Cambion
description: Cambion is an adult visual novel about a young man who discovers he's a half-demon. He is tasked with the mission to save the city from the forces of darkness. Embark on this adventure and you will gain power and influence and win the hearts of the sexiest women in the city.

title: Breeding City Welcomes you
description: The government has created new laws supporting a system of "breeding officials" in order to deal with the declining birthrate. Breeding officials are free to impregnate those who request to be inseminated! Do your best to solve the issue of the declining birthrate!!

title: Breed Laboratory
description: Navigate your way through an abandoned lab and uncover its mysteries. Search for useful items such as clothing and important potions. Most importantly, try to resist any temptation that comes your way!

title: Bouncing Agency
description: Become the most influential agent of bouncing models ! Have you always dreamed of creating the most prestigious modelling agency in the world specialized in buxom women? Now's your chance!

title: Crazy Puzzle: Cosplay
description: Swap, slide, and reveal sensual 3D girls in this erotic tile puzzle game. With 12 steamy images, 3 difficulty levels, and an unlockable gallery, it’s the perfect way to tease your brain and your senses.

title: Coloring Pixels: Zoom Out
description: This Zoom Out book unlocks 20 additional levels for Coloring Pixels. Each image is zoomed out from the previous image, revealing more and more of the scene! Grab your magnifying glasses and look really close at the fine details!

title: Levelup With 100 Cyber Girlfriend
description: This is a post-apocalyptic cyber-themed, sci-fi, immortal cultivation and treasure-hunting game.

title: Coloring Pixels: Advent 7
description: This Advent-themed book unlocks 24 additional levels for Coloring Pixels! It's Christmassssss! Celebrate again with Coloring Pixels. Play during the month of December to get the full Advent experience! 1 image will unlock every day between the 1st and the 24th, like a true Advent calendar!

title: Dread Fields
description: You bought an isolated farm to start a new life. Your peaceful routine is shattered when the former owner's terrible secrets rise from beneath the ground. A slow-burn rural horror.

title: Coloring Pixels: Folklore
description: This Folklore book unlocks 20 additional levels for Coloring Pixels. Each image depicts a mysterious, magical folklore tale from around the world! Unlock the secret stories of various cultures in this book.

title: Erma: The Game
description: Erma's here and she has a.....science fair project to finish? As your project goes explosively awry, look through your hometown in this point-and-click adventure game to gather all the pieces. Figure out how to find the remains of your project to get them back in time to finish for the science fair!

title: Eternal Degrade
description: Our communications have COLLAPSED. Something went TERRIBLY WRONG and you just, you just LET IT HAPPEN. You watched our precious INSTALL turn to BAD DATA. You IGNORED all the signs.

title: Subpoena Magus
description:
As the court bailiff, your job is to summon witnesses that are called, and evidence that is presented. Hold the right mouse button to view the Court Record to study what the summoning symbols for each are, and hold the left mouse button to start drawing a symbol (release button to cast).

You will also be asked to unsummon witnesses or evidence after they are no longer needed; use the unsummoning symbols on the left side of the court record for this.

title: Nobu Jump
description: A game where you keep aiming upward, no matter how many times you fall. It's a high-difficulty action game — skilled players might clear it easily, but for those who aren't good at games, it will be a real challenge.

title: Glitch Racer
description:
Cancelled game from creator of Toribash, Nabi Studios.

build, race and crash.

title: Innadreem
description: Raven is a young girl who has found herself far from home. To make things worse, some evil entity wants her captured. Can you help Raven get back home?

title: Tsunami Rider
description:
A little surfing game.
Escape a massive tsunami while avoiding debris, rescue a few swimmers for bonus points.

title: Shuwa Shuwa Guin!
description: Shuwa Shuwa Guin is a time management game set in a charming world of penguins, where you must wash, dry, and iron clothes to keep your grandfather's laundry business open! Use the money you earn to buy items that will make your job easier!

title: V tylu vraga: Diversanty 3
description: The third game in the Diversanty series of add-ons to V tily vraga (Soldiers: Heroes of World War II) started with Silent Heroes: Elite Troups of WWII. Despite coming out years after V tily vraga 2 (Faces of War) was released, it still uses the old engine of the first game.

title: V tylu vraga 2: Bratya po oruzhiyu
description: A standalone World War II real-time action/strategy expansion built on the Faces of War engine, offering a focused single-player campaign that follows intense tactical combat with squad and vehicle control across varied battle scenarios on the Eastern Front. The game blends squad-level decision-making, destructible environments, and strategic positioning in historically inspired missions, while also featuring new multiplayer maps and modes for competitive and cooperative play.

title: Fortnite Festival: Season 1
description: It’s “opening night” for Fortnite Festival, and what better way to celebrate the launch weekend than with… The Weeknd! The award-winning artist is the featured Icon of Fortnite Festival Season 1: Opening Night. Season 1 runs from now until February 22, 2024, at 12 AM ET. During this time, keep the beat going in the Opening Night Festival Pass to unlock new Instruments, Jam Tracks, and more! The Opening Night Festival Pass has a free reward track and a Premium Reward Track upgrade. With the Premium Reward Track, you’ll unlock an extra layer of rewards as you progress, including The Weeknd Outfit!

title: Infinity Nikki: Life as a Poem
description:
Deep in the secluded Forest of Slumber, lost poems drift upon the wind.
Tree rings, engraved with life's whispers, gather shade in the forest's depths.
Rest now, rest—
As the long summer drifts away, so too shall your name and these verses...
carried to the very edge of time, to a farther, more distant plane...

title: Texplore
description:
Texplore is a roguelite digging-and-combat game where every run challenges you to go deeper. Drill through a collapsing Earth, fight what lives below, haul valuables back to the surface, and spend your winnings to push farther next attempt—until you can build the rocket and escape to a harsher world.
Each run is a fast loop of descend → mine & fight → cash out → upgrade → dive again, with risky choices that can supercharge you or end the run early.

title: The Forest Watches
description: You are the newest member of a forest cult. Complete assigned rituals, obey their rules, and uncover the forest’s unsettling secrets. Every step is watched.

title: Cururu: Whispers of the Forest
description: In a fantastical Brazil where nature has reclaimed the world, an ancient corruption threatens both mortals and spirits. Take on the role of Cururu, a young cane toad chosen by the gods, as he seeks to master the power of the Lunar Waters and discover new ways to explore reimagined biomes filled with mysteries, enchanted creatures, and secrets from the past. Face the Miasma, free guardians from Brazilian folklore, and restore nature’s balance before all of Zootania is consumed.

title: Idle Breakanoid
description: Idle Breakanoid combines the satisfying block-breaking action of classic Breakout/Arkanoid with the addictive progression of idle games. Watch as your balls bounce, blocks shatter, and your power grows!

title: BreakLoop
description: The first brickbreaker deckbuilder! Start off with just a puny ball and build yourself an arsenal of weapons to mow down the endless waves of bricks barreling towards you. Discover powerful items and synergies as you evolve into the ultimate brick-killing machine.

title: Surface Breaker
description: Sci-fi rogue-like mining/tower defense game. Mine through a procedurally generated world to discover artifacts. Defend your spaceship from waves of enemies. Discover and spend resources to improve your mining and spaceships combat ability.

title: Cellbreak
description: In 2062, twenty years after a treaty legalized human cloning for organ harvesting, in Vitacorp's mega factory an incubator malfunctions and a boy pops out. Opening his eyes for the first time he is Overwhelmed by the sight and pure size of the mega factory. The boy succumbs to his instincts: ESCAPE!

title: Fish Tank Simulator
description: Manage your own digital aquarium in various relaxing environments. Raise fish with unique behaviors, decorate tanks, and unlock rare species. Whether you enjoy min-maxing your income, unwinding with a cozy game, or you're a fish lover looking for a digital tank, you'll find it in Fish Tank Simulator

title: Legend of the Wonderfish
description: Legend of the Wonderfish is a pixel art exploration fishing game across multiple fishing environments. Search for and reel in the three King fish - the River King, the Lake King, and the Ocean King - to earn the right to challenge the mightiest of all fish, the Wonderfish!

title: Monkey Wave
description: The Ape-pocalypse is here! Survive devastating waves, sharpen your reflexes, and defeat epic bosses in this fast-paced clicker full of PvP, co-op, and non-stop chaos.

title: Caparace
description: Humanity has been underground for centuries. When a lone miner discovers a long-hidden root system, they embark on a journey that might change their civilization.

title: Frozen Forward
description:
In Frozen Forward, you play as both Clara and Addie, two childhood friends that are noticeably absent from each other's lives in the current day.

Clara's side of the story follows her experiences in a patented GoFar Expedition Vehicle. This is a wonderful new invention that allows even the most inexperienced of adventurers to experience the rush of traveling along one of the global poles without any of the danger that usually comes with such a trek!

Addie's side of the story shows how her relationship with Clara begins, how it develops over time, and the deep importance it will forever hold to both of them.

title: Steeplejack
description: A traditional point and click adventure game made by GOC Games in one month for MAGS April 2024.

title: Sick Generation: The Ghost of the Crane Catcher
description: A simulation where realistic crane grabber mechanics, recreated with lifelike physics, intersect with a gloomy story reminiscent of 1990s games. The more you play, the better your skills become, the deeper the story gets, and even your desire to "escape from here" is put to the test—a slightly twisted game that somehow hits close to home.

title: 1000000 shrimp
description: Incremental shrimp boating. Catch 1,000,000 shrimp. hover with your mouse.

title: Tiny Tree Talk
description: Find a new sense of belonging on TinyTreeTalk – a wholesome old-school bonsai forum. Decorate miniature scenes, grow & shape bonsai trees, and bring people's diorama requests to life as you grow your reputation, unlock new props, and embark on a chill and vibey journey across mid-2000s Japan.

title: HyperCycle League
description: Cut the line. Own the neon. Hypercycle League is a high-octane evolution of light-trail combat where milliseconds are the difference between glory and a data-crash. No RNG, no gimmicks—just pure, frame-perfect digital athleticism. Are you fast enough to leave a mark?"

title: Heroic
description: Control the hero to defeat enemies with devastating blows. Become a hero with your unique fighting style in this beat 'em up action game. HEROIC.The true peace, brought by the hero, awaits at the end of victory! Grasp peace!

title: Dawg Game
description: DAWG GAME is a comedy adventure that will tell you what Maxim is doing outside of streams and why there are so few streams. Get into the shoes of your favorite streamer: do your chores, take care of your body, and do whatever it takes to get a stream going!

title: Assassin of Demon
description: Demon monster have captured magic skulls and your player warrior mission is kill Demon and find skulls in different areas. So you need collect weapons and kill demon and his army

title: Nighthold: Number 1
description: Investigate a starship crash, explore a hostile world, build shelters and survive nightly attacks of the Rot. Tear down any structure and experience total freedom of action.

title: The Cursed Moon: The Girl Trapped in the Haunted House
description: After hearing a young girl's cry for help, Yukine as a kami went in to the unknowned dimension to help. While helping the ghosts on the way to fulfill their wishes, she also has to solve riddles and traps. Will Yukine be able to save the girl from this cursed dimension ...?

title: Zamok
description: 5 stories of students in a dying dorm

title: Vegas Nights
description: Build, manage, and design your own casino empire from the ground up. Turn the city's junk into profit in this detailed management simulation, rising from rags to riches. Set up Blackjack tables and slots, hire staff, and furnish your venue with luxurious decor to become the ultimate boss.

title: Wobbler
description: Accelerate while turning, and decelerate while going forward. These unique physics are simple & forgiving, yet hard to master. Wobble your way to first place as you find the optimal routes through a series of unique levels, and challenge other players for the best times!

title: Roguelyte
description: A fast 2D roguelite where you move, dodge, and auto-attack through endless waves, stacking upgrades and scary bosses!

title: Sheep in Dreams
description: One day, mysterious sheep began to appear in Hitsuji-chan's house! And strange things happen around everyone in the city... When you dream, you can enter the dream dungeon. Let's capture the dream dungeon and solve the mysterious phenomenon!

title: RBM Studio's Waterloo
description: A historical hexagonal turn-based strategy wargame using markers to represent units designed by the legendary Mark Herman. Throwback to the great hex-based wargames of the 70's and 80's. Solo and online multiplayer modes are supported.

title: Havok Balloons Tech Showcase
description: Havok usually works behind the scenes helping to power your favourite AAA games, but this tech showcase proved too popular to keep to industry only meetings.

title: MetroCross
description:
Haruka is on her way to work!

A fangame inspired by the 1985 Namco arcade classic Metro-Cross but with THE iDOLM@STER theming (a fellow Namco franchise), featuring the character Haruka Amami.

title: Boldly Forward
description: Join a roguelike battle immediately, where you need to recruit human warriors, activate bonds, purchase divine equipment, and form a powerful combat team. Facing waves of growing undead, elf, and orc teams, lead your warriors to charge happily and enjoy the fun of electronic cricket fighting!

title: Deer
description: This is a casual puzzle game, where the position of each game image is random and can be repeated.At first, it may be very chaotic,Then gradually place the image in the corresponding position,The image gradually becomes complete,Come and give it a try!

title: Inotia 4
description: The grand adventure of Kiyan, assassin of the Dark Clan, and Yusha, saint of light, begins across the vast continent of Inotia. Experience an emotional story and thrilling, action-packed combat!

title: Ubai: To Take Another Man's Property
description: Take your pick between following Asami or Tsubaki in this exciting visual novel. Skip text you've already read with a handy skip button or enjoy the story with the auto button. Choose your story with differing endings and unveil how their story concludes.

title: Easy Puzzle: Animals
description: This is a logical game in which the goal of the game is to rearrange the tiles to get the final picture. In the pictures that need to be collected, different animals are depicted

title: Perciflette
description: Welcome, future hero! Perciflette is a narrative adventure with a simple goal : Find the way out. Explore, move forward with caution, and make the right choices…or start over!

title: TopDownFarter
description: Don't believe the hype. You can't stop zombies with bullets or with fire. You need farts. TopDownFarter is a silly take on traditional "Top Down Shooter" games in which you destroy zombies with clouds of disgusting green fart gas.

title: UsadaMaze
description: Kidnapped and awakening in a strange room… a small creature that looks like a rabbit—but isn’t—greets you."UsadaMAZE" is an adventure game with puzzle elements.

title: Campoca
description: Enter Campoca, where feel-good activities and delightful interactions are yours to enjoy completely for free! Collect joyful memories and turn your campsite into a charming, heartwarming retreat!

title: From Red to Green
description: Change all red objects to green, systematically clicking on them with the objective of solving the puzzle in the lowest number of moves possible. If you click on a green object, it becomes red, and the opposite is also true. Some levels have inverted controls, and others have moving objects.

title: Anime Girls Jigsaw Puzzles
description: Anime Girls Jigsaw Puzzles - Do puzzle in a new puzzle way! Advanced puzzle layout and involving game play will help you to relax after a hard-working day. Anime Girls Jigsaw Puzzles is designed for anime fans.

title: The Trolling Adventure
description: Troll Adventures is a hilarious and unconventional puzzle game created by the trolls for the trolls. Get ready to embark on a wacky journey around the world filled with mind-bending challenges.

title: Cipheur: Trivia - Geography
description: Test your knowledge with 100 encrypted geography questions.

title: Popscene: Track 2
description: The intro is over, so turn the volume up for "Track 2" of MDickie's landmark music industry sim! This re-mixed version of Popscene brings you the same great concept in its most polished form. Construct your own act from hundreds of uniquely gifted artists and bring their work to life with the most impressive 3D visuals the series has ever enjoyed. The range of venues has exploded to a staggering 20 different locations - each of which has been carefully refurbished for this instalment. All you have to worry about is filling them with adoring fans! Doing so is more challenging than ever thanks to sophisticated new game mechanics that more accurately link your talent to your progress. And along the way you'll have to tip-toe your way through TWICE as many backstage meetings that make your chosen career a political minefield. A lot can change over the years in the music business. Have you still got what it takes to top the charts?

title: Infinifrag
description:
Infinifrag is a networked, multiplayer first person shooter game developed by Zachtronics Industries and is the predecessor of Infiniminer, which went on to become the main inspiration behind Minecraft.

Infinifrag brings some of the trademark aspects of Infinitron and Infinarena to another level, with the features including:

Deathmatch, Team-Deathmatch, and Capture the Flag style gameplay
Customizable “sprite-models”, sort of like a 3D Infinarena
Customizable weapons, with tons of variables to change
Customizable terrain, allowing you to build massive bases

title: Two Tired to Mountain
description: A cyclical jaunt. Pilot a bicycle vertically to the peak of a frozen mountain tower! Platform with the power of momentum and rage to reach the summit!

title: Go! Go! Mister Chickums
description: GO! GO! MISTER CHICKUMS is a fun, classic single-screen platformer, inspired by arcade hits of the 80s. The game can be played either in single player mode, or in local couch co-op with 2 players simultaneously.

title: KharkivVision 2035
description: KharkivVision-2035 is an atmospheric narrative-driven game that tells the story of Mark, a young man who moved from a poor small town to Kharkiv in 2019. He seeks to find his place in the big city, but life presents him with unexpected challenges.

title: Ether Void
description: New York, the 90s. Detective Frank Miller investigates a murder in a grim metropolis. Your window to the truth is an old terminal. Analyze data, crack codes, uncover digital trails. Remember: not everyone here wants you to succeed.

title: Voidnomicon
description: 2d platformer, action, adventure - "Metroidvania" set in fantasy world filled with ancient magic and monsters. Pixel art graphic with anime style.

title: Sloop
description: A fast-paced, sea-faring, adventure where you’ll have to learn to turn. Brave the waters!

title: Void Guard Outpost
description: In Void Guard Outpost you build powerful towers to defend your gate against endless hordes of enemies! This action-packed tower defence game offers tactical depth, epic maps and challenging battles. So, are you ready to stop the invasion?

title: Voidzone
description: Voidzone is a first-person horror game. As a cleaner, your job is to cleanse these "anomalies" in the city's dark sectors, also known as Voidzones. But the choice is yours, escape this fate or follow your duty? This is your story; trust your instincts and make the right decision.

title: Voidstepper
description: Experience the elegance of pure black and white in this unique platformer. Navigate through puzzle- and action-packed levels, manipulate gravity, and destroy terrain to overcome obstacles. Dodge mines, lasers, and turrets as you defy gravity and outsmart challenges.

title: Five
description: FIVE is a card game in which luck is the most important factor. It is not an easy game; you need patience to reach the end. It consists of choosing cards that can cause you to lose fingers on your hand. To reach the end, you must survive all 5 rounds. It won't be easy, so GOOD LUCK!

title: Infinifrag 2
description:
Infinifrag 2 or Infinifrag II: Revenge of the Blocks was an unfinished multiplayer sandbox game developed by Zach Barth and Dan Hathaway. Conceived as a sequel to Barth’s earlier prototype Infinifrag, they intended to build on the idea of block based 3D worlds and combine it with mining gameplay inspired by the flash game Motherload.

The developers envisioned opposing teams gathering resources, constructing structures, and engaging in combat, with influences from contemporary multiplayer shooters such as Team Fortress 2.

The project grew in scope over approximately a year of development. Ultimately, Barth stepped away due to the increasing complexity of the design. Hathaway continued experimenting with the codebase after the collaboration ended, reworking many of its ideas into a first-person shooter project titled Block Arena, which would eventually get reworked again into Fractal Block World.

Barth later released Infiniminer, whose more focused design would go on to directly influence Minecraft, making Infiniminer 2 an important but largely unseen precursor in the history of voxel-based games.

title: Voidwell
description: Voidwell is a simple sandbox, spell slinging, roguelike. Fight enemies, find tools, spells, and secret items, and grapple with a dark truth about your rightful place in the void.

title: Strikevoid
description: Strikevoid is a fast-paced 2D bullet hell where the magical world descends into pure chaos. You take on the role of a mysterious mage, battling waves of mythical creatures and colossal bosses. Combine skills to adapt for new enemies. More than 10 distinct enemies and over 5 unique bosses await.

title: Biovoid
description: Biovoid is a creature-building roguelike game that tests your creativity. As a fragile hatchling alone in the abyss, your only objective is to consume and adapt. Will you survive the perils that await and evolve to the top of this alien foodchain?

title: Void Raid
description: A cooperative space horror about raiding derelict ships: breach compartments, grab the loot, and make it back to your own vessel before the oxygen runs out — or before something lurking in the dark gets to you.

title: Void Harvest
description: Condemned to work in an endless void, you must mine ore from asteroids, search wrecks and upgrade your ship to survive. Explore vast spaces, unlock upgrades, manage your crew and avoid constantly changing threats. Can you survive your sentence?

title: Void Vanguards
description: Void Vanguards is a sci-fi action shooter with rogue-like elements and intense planetary exploration. Each planet offers a unique environment - defeat every enemy wave, gather their resources, and unlock/upgrade your weapons to advance further into the void.

title: Paravoid
description: Paravoid is a sci-fi survival horror game where you confront shapeshifting monsters, navigate a non-Euclidean space station, and battle both external threats and your own self. Manage your health and sanity as you uncover the dark secrets aboard a derelict ship.

title: Void Point
description: Explore mysterious caves in a secluded village, solving puzzles and uncovering secrets of otherworldly technology to find your missing uncle. Are you ready to take on the journey?

title: Void Frontiers
description: Void Frontiers is a survival roguelike set on randomly generated floating islands. Gather resources, craft tools, build your base, and defend against nightly enemy waves. Play solo or team up with up to 4 other players, customizing your playstyle with over 40 unique enhancements.

title: Seeing Double
description: In this puzzle platformer, your screen is split down the middle. Control Pitter and Patter simultaneously as you jump, dash, and climb through two parallel realities in this atmospheric adventure on your quest to reunite them.

title: Feed The Reactor
description: An incremental unfolding game about feeding fuel into a reactor. Combine elements to produce energy, unlock exotic technologies and explore a strange galaxy.

title: Where is 2009?
description: Help Santa find new year.

title: MMX
description: Explore the mysterious dimension of MMX, spinning the whole world. Your mission is simple, send Mr. X to teleport.

title: From Basement with Love
description: Conduct a high-stakes espionage operation at the peak of the Cold War. Intercept and decipher encrypted communications to uncover a hidden threat. Break codes, manipulate targets through social engineering, connect the dots, and escape before it's too late.

title: Uncle's Basement: The Winter House
description: Finding yourself in an old winter house, you are faced with harsh conditions: icy cold, strong winds and lack of resources. This house will become your shelter, but to survive you will have to use all available means. Will you be able to survive this winter?

title: Primal Frost
description: A singleplayer hardcore prehistoric arctic experience. Collect all the nests and wait for extraction. 15 - 45 minutes of gameplay. NOTE: This game is challenging! Defend yourself from feathered raptors, hide in tall brush, and keep your shotgun loaded.

title: Senior Sunset
description: 35 dead students, dozens of silenced parents, and one police coverup later you decide it's time to take matters into your own hands. You descend into the depths of your high school to figure out what really happened to your classmates.

title: The Bubonicz
description: Outsmart zombies and deadly traps using the environment as your weapon in BubonicZ, a third-person horror puzzle of survival in a plague-ravaged prison.

title: Christmas With My Family: Jigsaw Puzzle
description: In Cristmas With My Family you'll find jigsaw puzzle challenges that show you incredible moments I spent with my family.

title: Poly Memory: Furries 2
description: Cute, relaxing, polygonal memory game with furries.

title: Where is 2011?
description: Uh, oh! Did another year just pass by unexpectedly?? I'm afraid it just did. And what a year that was! But what's past is past and let's look forward in search for the new one.

title: Anime Fantasy Jigsaw Puzzle 3D
description: Puzzle game in 3D Epic naughty puzzles full of charm! With colorful characters with careful design in a world of medieval fantasy that will not leave you unscathed ...

title: Lawnmower Game: Pinball
description: New part for lawnmower themed game series. Pinball which has lawnmower game series style

title: Puzzle Pleasant
description: Puzzle Pleasant - a cozy evening to relax.

title: Enchanted Broom
description: Enchanted Broom is a 3D platformer full of magic and exploration! Play as a cute little witch and embark on a wonderful journey to find magical crystals. Hop on your broom and start your magical adventure!

title: Where is 2012?
description: Help santa find the new year, because that kid got lost somewhere.

title: Perfect Hue Arena
description: A casual action platformer with 7 game modes including Capture the Flag, Boss, Puck, and Orb. There are a variety of unique items to collect and atmospheric arenas to explore.

title: Snapshots
description: A short game about organizing messy spaces. Place every object back where it belongs, discovering and deciphering secrets hidden amongst the clutter.

title: Where is 2014?
description: Find the new year!

title: Lore of Luvarith: The Hollow Crown
description: A story-rich 2Deco RPG where exiles, scavengers, and traitors are drawn together by fate. Explore crumbling ruins, haunted forests, and cursed castles as you uncover the empire’s forgotten truth. The past isn’t dead; it’s waiting.

title: Bowlers
description: Bowlers is THE bowling simulation. Create your character, live an adventure, and progress from amateur games to the most prestigious professional tournaments!

title: Pixel Puzzles Traditional Jigsaws: Forests
description: Pixel Puzzles Traditional, setting the standards for online jigsaw puzzling.

title: Duck Duck Hotel
description: A 3D cute management sim where you're a duck building and operating a treetop hotel for a variety of bird species. Strategically expand your tree, cater to each species' unique needs, and keep your feathery guests happy through all four seasons. Just don't ruffle any feathers, or it's game over!

title: Core Miners
description: A pixel-style mining game with easy AFK gameplay and continuous progression!

title: Caterpillar King
description: Return the Caterpillar King's lost child for a life-changing reward! Ant pushes for change, Beetle clings to comfort, and their hungry Caterpillar keeps pulling them into trouble in this narrative-driven light tactics-puzzle game.

title: Retro Arcade Shop Simulator
description: Build and manage your ultimate retro arcade! Buy classic Arcade Machines, Galaxy Pinball, and Gift Claw games, or invest in Cinema 8D, Go-Karts, and Racing Simulators. Manage the economy, hire staff, and repair your machines to keep the tokens rolling in!

title: The Beginner Investor
description: Start from scratch, learn the market, and build your fortune in this accessible stock market tycoon game. Buy, sell, and diversify your way to wealth!

title: Witchling Grove
description: Witchling Grove is an action-rpg, arena-shooting roguelike.

title: 3D Minesweeper
description: A 3D version of Minesweeper developed by Dan Hathaway.

title: Streamer Party
description:
It's a collection of games you can play live with your chat, designed to make viewers active participants instead of passive spectators. Right now, the game features a coffee shop where your chatters can place orders directly from your menu while you're live.

What makes Streamer Party different is that viewers can also download the game and join you directly. Even then, everything still runs through Twitch chat. The game only reads and sends chat messages. No external connections, no security concerns.

Just you, your stream, and your community playing together.

title: All That is Left
description: After the tragic death of her ex-girlfriend Yves, Sera finds herself haunted. As Yves’ presence grows stronger, she begins to manipulate Sera’s thoughts—dragging her deeper into a cycle of guilt and longing, and isolating her from those who still care, including her current girlfriend, Irina.

title: Fortnite Festival: Season 11
description:
Special Season of Fortnite Festival, the first to not include a real-life artist as a headliner.

Adds the biggest, most varied collection of Jam Tracks so far. Perform your best show yet on the Main Stage, make new mixes on the Jam Stage and in Battle Royale, and choose your background music when you get a Victory Royale or drop out of the Battle Bus.

title: Fortnite Festival: Season 12
description: Singer, actress, global star, and now Festival Season 12 Icon, LISA comes to Fortnite with her music and Outfits! Use the mic to sing absolute bangers. The Music Pass includes Jam Tracks like LISA’s “FUTW (Vixi Solo Version)” and kinetic tracks from other artists.

title: I Have an Item
description: "I Have an Item" is a quick, chaotic multiplayer game for 2-4 players about risks, rewards, and item manipulations. Each turn, players blindly draw items from a shared dynamic pool, facing a constant dilemma. End the turn and keep resources or risk and draw more which can lead to triggering dangerous items sabotaging their turn or damaging them. This creates a tense, push-your-luck dynamic where greed is rewarded or punished instantly.

title: Where is 2016?
description: Point and click your way through finding the new year!

title: Runtalis
description: Runtalis is a 1–5 player turn-based tactical RPG. Coordinate your party, socket powerful Runes, and push your Magic Key against enemies with dangerous affixes. Higher risks unlock greater power in this grid-based, tabletop-inspired challenge. Master your skills or lose your Runes.

title: I'll Invaligate Your Aid: Foreaver
description: An adventure game where the antagonist is a girl who doesn't want you to play. Puzzly QTEs, rogue cursors... Not even your controller is safe from her! Help the protagonist retrieve his item while she tries to stop you, the player! ♥♥♥

title: 101 Cats in Denmark
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Denmark landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: Senara: The Sacrament
description: "SENARA: The Sacrament" is a first-person survival horror aboard a ship. Uncover the truth while escaping fanatics and unspeakable horrors. In a place where blind faith and salvation intertwine, you’ll be forced to make choices that go far beyond survival.

title: Where We Went
description: Where We Went is a narrative driven puzzle game. Step into the role of a mysterious character that can control ancient guardians to solve puzzles. Uncover the story behind your visit to the tomb and the reason for it's existence!

title: Skyward Bastion
description: Skyward Bastion is a tower defense roguelite set on floating islands. Build and upgrade your defenses, survive endless waves of enemies, and explore procedurally expanding maps under a living day-night cycle.

title: Dig, Dig, Die
description: Online co-op horror for 1–6 players. Board a cursed flying ship, raid haunted graveyards for loot, and survive monsters that hear every sound. Beware of UFO abductions, grab boosters from vending machines, gamble in the onboard casino, and embrace pure chaos with friends in voice chat.

title: Tales Of Glory 3 : Fists of Legend
description:
In the shadows of forgotten temples, when neon lights fade and fists decide destiny…

Step into Tales Of Glory 3 : Fists of Legend, a VR kung fu experience inspired by the legendary 80’s beat’em all.

Ten schools. Ten battlegrounds of legend. Only one path: fight, endure, ascend.

Immersive combat: unleash fists, kicks, and combos against multiples enemies.

Arcade spirit reborn: a tribute to the golden age of beat’em alls, reimagined in VR.

10 beautifully crafted maps: from back‑alley brawls to mystical arenas, each stage is a cinematic battleground.

13 unique combat styles: every opponent fights differently, forcing you to adapt and master your technique.

Mystical powers: channel ancient energy to unleash devastating abilities and turn the tide of battle.

VR intensity: sweat, move, and fight like you’re truly inside the game.

Sho Ren’s fists are the key. His spirit is the weapon.

The battle begins now — will you rise as the ultimate kung fu legend?

title: Gun.Dog.Revenge
description: GUN·DOG·REVENGE is a high-speed arcade platform shooter, drawing inspiration from NES classics "Rolling Thunder" and "Code Name: Viper", the indie hit "RollingBird" on Steam, and the film "John Wick". Reload! Shoot! Kill the boss! Revenge for your dog.

title: PokAidle: The Everfall Chronicles
description:
The Kanto Region... Reimagined as an Infinite Dungeon.

Dive into a nostalgic yet fresh experience where Generation 1 meets Idle RPG.
The "Everfall" phenomenon has twisted the world, turning familiar routes into endless gauntlets. Can you build the perfect team to conquer infinity?

title: Anarchy Racer
description: Survive an apocalyptic wasteland in this open-world apocalyptic car combat game inspired by Mad Max.

title: A Game About a King Saving a Dragon
description: Help a mighty dragon break a terrible curse in this incremental game. Hire workers, collect resources, construct buildings, unlock upgrades, and become a powerful king.

title: Scission
description: Scission is a dark and gruesome action game where you control two characters at once. Fight grotesque representations of the subconscious, master new skills and explore the depth of the human mind in this singleplayer game.

title: Penniless Chef
description: "Penniless Chef" is a game where you run and grow your own restaurant. Run and grow your restaurant, and get to know the villagers!

title: Don’t Stop Smiling
description: Smile—and survive. A first-person “forced-smile” horror game that tracks your facial expression in real time. PC camera required.

title: Mainframe Men
description: Learn about the ancestors of the very computer that you're looking at this now with in this interactive visual novel. ENIAC, UNIVAC... Wait, are these machines talking to you?

title: Martyr
description: Rise as a martyr in a plague-scarred, heretical Europe. Surrounded by disease, paganism, and relentless foes, you will fall, return as a Shade, and forge power from sacrifice. Death is not the end. Every fall strengthens you, every relic will help you, but enemies will hunt you for your faith.

title: Star Striker
description: Dominate your enemies with modernized familiar arial combat controls. Craft the perfect build to become the most deadly star fighter in the galaxy!

title: Silent Snow
description: Seth and May have moved out of the city and into a big old house that uncle John decided he didnt want anymore. Although the holiday spirit brings color and joy to an otherwise barren house, something lurks outside hidden in the snow. Watching. Waiting.

title: Gun X Gunner
description: Gun X Gunner is a free-to-play, round-based first-person-shooter where up to eight players face off in fast-paced free-for-alls. Choose new equipment, weapons, and powerful, game-altering augments between rounds in an ever-evolving competition. It’s time to get good, get lucky, and GUN X GUNNER.

title: Terrafactory: Idle Planet
description: A planet building idle game that sits anywhere on your desktop while you do other things.

title: Taking Today Off
description: Taking Today Off is a light-hearted roguelike deck-builder about managing modern life states. Draw cards, place them on the board, add stickers and tools, and build playful combos. Easy to learn, with fresh choices and strategies every run.

title: Hi-Fi Roller
description: Roll, jump, and race through a tinkerer’s workshop turned obstacle course. Master a vast miniature world of circuit boards, wires, and contraptions in this photo-realistic marble platformer built for skill and precision.

title: Moon Crashers
description: Moon Crashers is a 4-player online co-op game. Crash-land on the lunar surface with your squad, drift across craters, scavenge junk & rare minerals, uncover ancient ruins, build your ride, and rocket back home. Think you can make it home?

title: Project R4T
description: Take control of a test subject tasked with testing out a new device capable of shrinking and enlarging the user. Take on a few tests by changing your size and weight in this short single-player experience.

title: Emerald Gallery: 2-Score
description: A retro-inspired puzzle game reminiscent of the beloved classic handheld era. Featuring challenging gameplay across standard and speedrun modes, with dynamic music and in-depth stat tracking.

title: Space Extra
description: Space Extra is a 2D vertical shoot em up game. Save Earth from alien invaders and help your allies!

title: Tank Commander: Battlefield
description: Get ready to blow up the tanks, shoot for the enemy tanks and claim victory. Accept your commander missions, firing to kill enemy tanks . You need be a tanks hero to win WW2 Battles.

title: Intelligent Destruction
description:
Intelligent Destruction was coded in 48 hours by Zach Barth for the RPI GameJam competition which ended on April 11, 2008 and is a two player hot-seat game played locally on one computer.

It is based on a board game that he was working on called Infinitron.

Research units and then* build them* to capture cities to gain points (gained at the beginning of your turn) and increase your unit cap. Researching and building units costs points. When you capture a city, you can create and shape the terrain around the city, but only once. Begin your turn with one of your units on the enemy capital to win the game.

title: Fridge
description: How many fridges can you stack before it all comes crashing down? Test your balance and nerves in this quirky highscore chaser where the only way is up... one fridge at a time.

title: Sprint City
description: Sprint City is a shared-world competitive 2D platformer from the original creators of SpeedRunners, where tight controls, explosive speed, and hidden shortcuts fuel high-intensity racing.

title: Rise of the Successor
description: You wake up as North Korea’s Supreme Leader. Manage diplomacy, internal power struggles, and national survival. Balance nuclear ambition, public needs, and elite loyalty. One wrong move could cost you everything — will you rule or fall?

title: Claustromania
description: Claustromania is a simple game where the player must find the best way out of a vast maze that seems to have no end.

title: Astonishing
description: This game features a retro cartoon style with bright and magical elements, creating a strong fairy tale atmosphere at first glance.

title: Gop Stop Auto
description: GOP STOP AUTO – This is a dynamic first-person shooter in which you will exterminate hordes of evil memes. They are everywhere. Don’t let them get close to you!

title: Ella's Nightmare
description: Linear single-player game with puzzles and alternate endings. Control Ella and explore the rooms of the house, solving puzzles to progress and escape before becoming a victim of the lurking creature.

title: A Whittle Tale
description: A Whittle Tale is a whimsical 3D platformer where you jump, glide, and swap ability-granting prosthetic tails to overcome handcrafted wooden worlds and collect Obal coins to travel between realms.

title: Campus Confidential
description: An LGBTQ slice of life/supernatural dating sim

title: Cheeseland Mistery
description: Cheeseland Mystery is a retro-style puzzle adventure where a sneaky rat steals cheese under cover of night. Solve clever, room-based challenges across 30 levels, inspired by classic Lolo gameplay, with pixel art visuals, dynamic sound, and Xbox controller support.

title: Dontcrush
description: Let's embark on an exciting jumping adventure! In each level, you'll need to jump nimbly over various obstacles, skillfully dodge blocking monsters, and collect sweet fruits along the way. Once you successfully complete each level, you'll unlock more exciting challenges!

title: House Tidy
description: House Tidy is a meditative and calming game that will help you relax and unwind from the hustle and bustle of everyday life.

title: Sweep Squad
description: Sweep Squad is a 1-4 player arcade sweep-em-up where you and your ambiguous rodent friends team up to sweep away the bad guys and hit your quotas. Crank up the earnings with overtime and use various sub-weapons at your disposal to sweep away the competition.

title: Poolside Vigil
description: Based on a true story. Navigate through ever-changing pools where the path can never be memorized. Solve puzzles with physics-based interactions and survive the entity on your trail. Experience the grim consequences of phone addiction. Can you solve the mystery of that fateful day?

title: The Sims 4: EA Play Edition
description: The Sims 4: EA Play Edition is a life simulation game where you create custom Sims, build homes, and control their daily lives. The EA Play Edition includes the Get to Work expansion, which lets you follow Sims through careers like Doctor, Detective, or Scientist, or start and manage retail businesses such as bakeries or boutiques. You can also teach your Sims photography and baking skills to create items for personal use or profit.

title: Richard Scarry's Best Reading Program Ever
description: Mr. Fixit has built a brand new storymobile, but he's forgotten the stories. Huckle and Lowly help him find more stories by playing mini-games at the Busytown Schoolhouse, the supermarket, the beach, a campsite, and Farmer Soybeans' farm.

title: Laser Hell
description: A fast-paced and minimalist game where you aim to live as long as you can, to climb higher on the leaderboard.

title: 4PGP
description: Race around the world! 4PGP is a 90’s arcade-style racing game with a timeless charm and simple controls that makes it easy to pick up and play.

title: Steam & Steel Railway Tycoon
description: Steam & Steel — Railway Tycoon puts you at the helm of a dieselpunk railway empire. Manage stations, locomotives, and resources, then dive into real-time simulation with dynamic maps, evolving fleets, and strategic decisions that shape your network’s rise.

title: Twinkle Stardust's Catnap Chaos
description: Protect your cute sleeping cat in this action-arcade resource management game with single stick controls. Test your aim by bouncing pesky mice off walls. The more mice you kick away, the more money you earn to buy power-ups. With clever bouncing, combine these power-ups for powerful effects!

title: Dungeon Antiqua 2
description: Relive the golden age of dungeon RPGs with Dungeon Antiqua 2! A retro 2D dungeon crawler bursting with SNES nostalgia. Hack, slash, and survive relentless side-view encounters! With 10 jobs and endless skill combos, forge the ultimate party and conquer the depths—if you dare!

title: Woodswalker
description: Woodswalker is a strategy-based survival horror game in which quick thinking is key. Listen closely to your surroundings, defend yourself with your searchlight, budget your limited power, and solve environmental puzzles to discover the truth of the forest.

title: Fruit Fusion!
description: Help Aira, Rinka and Yuri merge fruit and unlock new cards in this sweet and charming Suika x Deckbuilder!

title: Last State
description:
Last State is a hardcore wilderness survival simulation where every decision shapes your fate. You're alone in the post-collapse wilderness with nothing but your skills and determination.

Scavenge abandoned settlements. Craft tools from raw materials. Hunt for food. Build shelter against the elements. Trade with strangers or fight them. Every action drains your resources. Every mistake can be fatal.

The wilderness doesn't care about your plans. Storms will destroy your shelter. Wildlife will compete for resources. Injuries will slow you down. Starvation, dehydration and freezing temperatures are constant threats.

title: Laments of a Platinum Rose
description: A mixed-media visual novel about a robot and God. A story-focused visual novel game where the player can explore Nexus and interact with the world in whatever order they like, with a story emphasizing the player's agency.

title: Marble's Marbles
description: A love letter to the classic marble games. Help Marble find his lost marbles and roll through physics-powered worlds packed with wild challenges and quirky contraptions.

title: Tower Defense: Goblin Wars
description: Defend your kingdom from relentless goblin hordes in Tower Defense: Goblin Wars! Strategize with unique archers, battle epic goblin bosses, and outsmart your enemies.

title: Hololive Dreams
description:
The first official hololive mobile game is here, featuring a rhythm & RPG gameplay!
Centered around rhythm games, the game includes a variety of content such as theme park development and mini-games!
Over 50 hololive members make an appearance, and the initial tracklist will include 150+ songs!
A game that both hololive fans and newcomers can enjoy. The way you play is entirely up to you!

title: Multiplayer Citizens
description: Multiplayer Citizens - This is a fun and challenging life simulation game. (Multiplayer or Single Player)

title: Tape Art
description: Tape Art is a Tap to play Game, inspired by the infamous Italian Banana art "Comedian". In Tape Art, you tap anywhere on the screen to tape the Banana! There are more artifacts to tape to the wall and create more art like taping the Banana. You get every 3 chances to tap and tape at the exact point of time to stick, you fail when the banana won't get taped properly and you lose.

title: Significant
description: This game invites players into a charming adventure story featuring a cute little bee flying freely through the streets of a small town.

title: Rembrunir
description: Rembrunir is a game made to be played with one hand, the triggers on the back of the controller are the attack and super attack buttons, you move with the directional buttons and the Y, X, A, B. the buttons to play on the keyboard are: A,W,S,D,R,T and for the second player they are U,H,J,K,O,P

title: HexaMerge 2048
description: HexaMerge 2048 is an exciting puzzle game that combines the satisfying “merge” mechanics with the strategic depth of 2048. Set on a visually captivating hexagonal grid, players slide and merge number tiles to create higher-value combinations.

title: TapPlus
description: A simple clicker game where you press a button to increase the number, with Steam leaderboard support.

title: Void Pachinko
description: Build your own pachinko! Upgrade pins and balls, unleash powerful synergies, and help a shattered village rise again in this incremental adventure.

title: Sim Sports Raid
description: *NOTE: A CONTROLLER OR STEERING WHEEL IS REQUIRED TO PLAY THIS GAME* SIM SPORTS RAID offers you the excitement of off-road and navigation competition with maximum realism. You can also compete in duels in Challenge mode and participate in events that we will make available to our users

title: Anigma Byte
description: ANIGMA Byte is a tense and dynamic game that challenges your reaction and coordination. You are the last byte on whose digital shoulders rests the fate of the entire operating system. A critical error has caused chaos in the simulation, turning everything upside down.

title: Lemonia The Last Castle
description: Lemonia The Last Castle takes you on a journey filled with mystery and survival. As an ordinary civilian, you must navigate a dangerous planet overrun by zombies while uncovering the truth behind your arrival. Interact with the townspeople, follow the clues, and find your place in this unknown world

title: Rebels: Under the Spell of Magic - Chapter 5
description: A Visual Novel game about adventure, fantasy, magic and friendship. This is a continuation of Chapter 4, and the conclusion of Book 1. There are only a few choices that can be made, and some paths to choose from. But they do not have an impact on the ending.

title: Jiří Kára Simulátor
description: Jiří Kára Simulator is a Czech independent action FPS inspired by the cult video The Wedding of Jiří Kára. Playing as Jirka, you dive into Prague at the turn of the millennium and experience what happened the day after his legendary wedding

title: Curious George Early Learning Adventure
description: The first volume in the Curious George PC game series.

title: Exovore
description: EXOVORE is a dual-stick space horror shoot’em-up inspired by the legendary Sinistar. Mine asteroids for energy, forge powerful weapons and battle through swarms of biomechanical nightmares as a colossal alien intelligence awakens to destroy you. It starts out nice and slow, giving you a chance to learn the controls and upgrade your ship. But the action and complexity builds with each level.

title: Medieval Life Simulator
description: Rise from nothing to wealth! Mine ore, harvest crops, cut trees, gather livestock products, sell resources, hire workers, buy rentable houses, gamble with card games, bet on fights, and expand into an empire.

title: Sex Therapy
description: Sex Therapy is a candid visual novel for adults. A routine consultation with a sex therapist turns into a story of forbidden passion and awakened desires, where professional boundaries collapse under the pressure of long-suppressed hunger.

title: Watch Grass Grow Simulator
description: A real-time experience built entirely around watching grass grow, where patience turns into payoff and leaving too early means missing it.

title: RAM Downloader
description: Do you need more RAM? Of course you do. Everybody does. Get RAM Downloader and improve your quality of life. It's easy. You click Download. RAM increases. You live a happier life.

title: Glyph Chess
description: Glyph Chess is a strategic board game infused with magical fantasy elements, derived from the Tales of Tarsylia. You will command mages with distinct abilities to escort your Scepter to the central "Source of Magic", or to destroy the enemy's Scepter.

title: The Board is Yours
description: The Board is Yours is a strategic chess-based incremental game: buy squares, unlock upgrades, and chain synergies through defended pieces. It plays as a demanding idle game where you’ll constantly reposition pieces and optimize your production until the board belongs to you.

title: The Beautiful World
description: You are a cube. A mysterious voice wakes you up and promises a beautiful world above. The only way to see it is by climbing. Jump between platforms, press un-labeled buttons and discover what this world has to offer.

title: My Beautiful Misinterpretation of Words
description: "My Beautiful Misinterpretation of Words" is a collection of experimental art games I vomited over the span of a year. The gameplay and visuals dramatically varies every moment. One may say it is less of a "game" but more of an "experience". Now, I welcome you into my mind.

title: Dear Lighthouse
description: You are hired to restore a silent lighthouse. What starts as routine maintenance turns into unraveling a dark history. Bring the machinery back to life and discover that these malfunctions were no accident, and that the light doesn't just guide ships.

title: Song of Twilight
description: A horror adventure where you control two sisters trapped in a twisted otherworld, fleeing from the insane ruler known as "Father". Explore the realm of madness and find your escape. Your choices shape the story in this multi-ending experience.

title: Shadow of the Moonlight
description: A dark fantasy visual novel set in a medieval world. You are the privileged son of a wealthy family, seeking revenge, even if it means becoming an outlaw. Will you dare to face your weakness and strength? How far will you go to find your true enemy? Uncover your roots' secrets. Survive… if you can.

title: Neko-Nin exHeart Spin! Love+Plus
description: Kikumaru and his ninja compatriots are back in this fan disc to NEKO-NIN exHeart SPIN! Enjoy a relaxing episode with each of the heroines of this series. Nin nin!

title: Wagamama High Spec Oc
description: Kouki Narumi and the girls are back in this fan disc release with side stories featuring each of the heroines from WAGAMAMA HIGH SPEC including new stories focusing on the minor heroines as well. Enjoy the hijinks and romantic encounters in WAGAMAMA HIGH SPEC OC!

title: Market Street Tycoon Simulator
description: Start from scratch, build your own market, set the prices and become the ultimate retail tycoon. Manage, expand and dominate the street. This is your business, your rules, your empire.

title: Cocaine Diesel
description: Frantic bomb mode first-person shooter based on Warsow.

title: GraviChess
description: Use the classic chess pieces to work your way through this complex puzzle platformer. Capture all enemy pieces before they get you to beat the 102 intricately designed levels.

title: Ace Attorney Investigations: Miles Edgeworth
description:
Ace Attorney Investigations: Miles Edgeworth is the first of the prosecutorial prodigy's solo adventures.
Leaving his rival Phoenix Wright and the courtroom behind, Edgeworth is determined to uncover the truth at the crime scene.
Luckily for him, the story begins in his very own office...
where a gunshot in the dead of night has turned it into an active crime scene!
But why? What does his office have to do with anything?

title: Pneuma
description: Take the role of Zoe, Deaths apprentice, and fight back against the 7 Deadly sins who stole the fragments of your soul, engage in fast paced top-down hack and slash action, fending off hoards of Hell's spawn. Gain buffs throughout the different levels to increase your power to take on the bosses....

title: Where Winds Meet: Live to Game
description:
Version 1.2 of Where Winds Meet, also known as "Live to Game."

This update includes new maps (Nine Mortal Ways Base & Mistveil Prison), an encounter (Bellman's Oath), lost chapters (The Gilded Chase & Whispers Beneath the Moon), sect (Velvet Shade), and a gameplay (Boss Dummy), along with other events, optimizations, and fixes.

title: Carnival Roulette
description: Carnival Roulette is a horror game built around a deadly game of chance, similar in spirit to Buckshot Roulette, but expanded with new mechanics and strategic layers.

title: Rasen
description: Strike with precision, time your deflects and fight flawlessly to your own rhythm. Step into atmospheric PvP or PvE arena duels and fast-paced clashes with a variety of lethal characters.

title: Codename: Lovania
description: Lovania is a simulation–adventure game with a distinctive art style and immersive social gameplay. It centers on character growth, building relationships, and shaping your lifestyle, while offering extensive customization, decoration, and multiplayer options. Designed to be calm and meaningful, Lovania invites players to connect, explore, and express themselves within a colorful, shared world.

title: Shinshou Sange: Chiru Hana
description:
A place that is here and not here.

Once the water surface looks blue, there's no going back.

An older sister who can see the future and a girl called the Grim Reaper.

Is what we see really the truth?

Or is what we cannot see the truth?

Produced by our circle,

Scattering flowers ~Chiruhana~

Reconstructing the second chapter of Renge ~Renka~Sange,

This work includes a final chapter.

title: RentPoly
description: RentPoly is a roguelike city-builder board game. Build your own real estate empire, squeeze rent from tenants, and become a billionaire!

title: Swapwood Quest R
description: SwA unique block puzzle game with an RPG twist. Combo your enemies and match enough tiles to protect against opposing blows, but make haste, You only have 10 seconds to prepare before your turn ends!

title: Where is 2017?
description: Deal with the grown up 2016 and try to find 2017.

title: Where is 2019?
description: The new year got lost again!

title: Fickle Card Legend
description: A side-scrolling, non-turn-based card battle game. Level up, collect gear, and challenge stages and bosses with a unique card-clash combat system.

title: Ezmeralda
description: Ezmeralda is an action-packed top-down RPG where you explore dangerous dungeons, battle powerful bosses, and collect legendary loot. Master fast-paced combat, uncover hidden secrets, and forge your path through a world of adventure.

title: Pearls of Wisdom
description: A rogue-like mindfulness deck builder with real-world side quests. The game involves matching quotes, using power-ups ('emblems'), and undertaking mindfulness tasks to increase the score.

title: Funny Volleyball
description: "Funny Volleyball" is a modern remake of the classic arcade volleyball game from the 90s, giving new emotions and nostalgia. Immerse yourself in bright and picturesque landscapes, enjoying the game, but do not forget about the main goal - victory!

title: Tanks Online
description: This is a simple and very addictive multiplayer game where you can fight tank battles with your friends, acquaintances and strangers.

title: Town Market Simulator 2025
description: Step into the world of Town Market Simulator 2025 and become the ultimate market manager! Stock shelves, serve customers, set prices, and grow your business.

title: Break the Block
description: Break the Block is a block-breaking game that challenges your reaction. You must use your skills and various power-ups to break through endless waves of blocks. Claim the leaderboard ranks and show how far you can go!

title: Godwreath: Chapter 1
description: Godwreath: Chapter 1 is a top-down nonlinear survival horror game set in a prison in the fictional Balkan nation of Tetrania. Discover what lurks within the shadows of this unique world, filled with unsettling locations and characters.

title: Tatar Altan vs. Shaitan
description: An epic slasher about the Tatar warrior Altan and his battle with Shaitan on earth and underground.

title: Car Parking Adventure
description: Car Parking Adventure – The Ultimate 2D Parking Challenge! Test your skills in this addictive game with vibrant graphics and fun puzzles! Navigate tight spots, dodge obstacles, and enjoy intuitive controls. Perfect for all ages. Download now and become the parking master!

title: Hero Hellspawn: Learn Arithmetic
description: Hero Hellspawn is a roguelite arithmetic learning game.

title: Winter Quackdown
description: A 3D shooter roguelike where you lead a flock of magical ducks, casting dazzling spells to conquer snow monsters. You’ll gather unique ducks, strategize by swapping and upgrading them between levels, and build the ultimate magical team.

title: Hayden's Odyssey
description: Hayden's Odyssey is a roguelike dungeon crawler where you explore procedurally generated levels, battle a variety of challenging enemies, and collect powerful upgrades. Each run brings new obstacles, ensuring that every journey through the portals is a fresh and intense experience.

title: Fantasy Soul Revenge
description: Fantasy Soul Revenge is an exhilarating action RPG game that thrusts players into a vibrant, mythical world where dark forces threaten the realm. Players assume the role of a vengeful hero, harnessing the power of ancient souls to vanquish enemies and uncover hidden truths.

title: Involve
description: This game invites players into a magical winter night adventure, where they play as a brave beetle making its way through the snow.

title: Satan 3D
description: Satan 3D is retro fps shooter in pixel art style

title: Green Pond Town
description: You've received a strange letter, and inside, a chilling black and white photograph - the people in the picture are eerily faceless! A powerful intuition compels you to journey to the location in the photo: Greenwater Town. However, this town, named after a "green pond," is far more sinister than its name suggests.

title: Ladies, Don't Tempt My Immortality
description:
They say the path to immortality is paved with hardship. But in your case, this hardship happened to take the form of seven dangerously beautiful women.

You are Lin Fan, the chosen one of the Crane Illusion Sect. Born with a Pure Yang Lineage, you are destined to ascend to the heavens. However, no matter how hard you train, fate sends yet another challenge in your way...temptations in the shape of an unreliable master, a strict senior sister, or a saintess who seems far more interested in testing your heart rather than your skills.

Can you survive the thousand tribulations of love, jealousy, and thunder? Or will your heart fall just before your heavenly ascension?

title: Gold Miner: Return to Glory
description: Gold Miner: Return to Glory brings back the classic digging fun with modern twists. Play through challenging levels, chase high scores in endless mode, or face off in nostalgic local multiplayer for competitive excitement.

title: Fury's Path: To The Stars
description: A colorful 2D platformer adventure to the stars! Navigate vibrant levels filled with tricky enemies and collect shiny diamonds. Each stage offers fun challenges that test your skills and patience. Jump, defeat enemies, and reach the finish line in this exciting journey!

title: Fierce Kingdoms
description: A medieval RTS where you're the king. Command peasants to expand your base and grow your economy. Research powerful technologies. Then, mass an army to crush your enemies! Conquer other kingdoms in Campaign mode to unlock new perks.

title: Curse of the Ethereal Dragon
description: Adventure to the strange and remote town of Cliffside to investigate a mysterious curse. Meet eccentric characters, face unusual foes, and collect unique items as you climb the snowy mountains to discover the cause.

title: Dragon Cat
description: A fast-paced 3D side-scrolling arcade game where you glide, dodge, and weave through tight gaps using precise tap-to-fly controls.

title: Jet Fighters with Friends 2
description: Jet Fighters with Friends 2 - UFOs are attacking Paris, Go get 'em! Single Player OR Multiplayer Jet Fighter Game with A.I. UFO Bots. PvP or COOP.

title: Ghost Dragon III
