description: Hack'n'Slash in forgotten world.

title: Attack of the Astrals
description: Cosmic warriors invade! Command a champion trio in tight grid battles where every turn is a movement puzzle and every skill and spell is positionally targeted. Adapt your team to each realm's challenges and rewards to thwart the Attack of the Astrals!

title: The Last Joy
description: The play center was once a vibrant and happy place filled with children's laughter and the latest interactive toys. However, a mysterious accident caused its sudden closure. Nobody knows exactly what happened

title: Catrun
description: Join Philip the cat in CATRUN, an exhilarating runner game set in a bustling city. Help Philip avoid wolves, navigate tricky obstacles, and use fall acceleration to speed through challenges. Explore dynamic environments, collect power-ups, and uncover a heartfelt story of adventure and friendship.

title: Blood Red Rebirth
description: Drive, shoot, and blow up your way through an East Bloc hellhole with a beaten-up sedan, an AKM and a post-punk soundtrack. Your mission is to steal three nuclear missiles – and so is everyone else's.

title: The Clockwork Requiem
description: When a band of survivors unearths a rare ore said to power Aetherforge's miraculous machines, they see it as their final hope for salvation. But as they journey to trade it, the party is drawn into secrets, whispers of vanished ages, and a truth that could unmake what remains of their world.

title: Zombie Survivors: Eternal Nightfall
description: Zombie Survivors: Eternal Nightfall is an action-packed roguelike survival game. Battle through relentless waves of zombies while collecting powerful upgrades to stay alive. Will you outlast the eternal nightfall, or will you join the ranks of the undead? Your legacy begins now.

title: Retro Runner
description: Embark on a high-speed adventure in my passion project! Choose from 39 cars and race down vibrant streets while dodging traffic and collecting coins.With a killer synthwave by DavidKBD and an addictive, intuitive gameplay, this game promises a unique atmosphere.Get ready to rev your engines

title: My Rose
description: "My Rose" is a pixel-style precision platform jumping game. A boy sets out to find the soul fruit to save a girl. Will he be able to collect the soul fruit smoothly? And in the end, can he save the girl?

title: From Beyond
description: From Beyond is a game about a man being transported into a different world after being stabbed. Will he find happiness and hope in a world filled with despair? Will he piece the puzzle pieces together and uncover the mystery of his newfound colorblindness? That's up to you... Or is it?

title: Taming Yore Dragon
description: Embark on your own epic fantasy quest to restore colour and life to an abandoned world. Solve puzzles and learn about real strategies for managing anxiety taught in a fun and engaging way. Developed alongside a psychologist, Taming Yore Dragon innovates and expands on what videogames can achieve!

title: Snake Classic 3D Reborn
description: Dive into Snake Classic 3D Reborn! This exciting snake simulator features vibrant 3D graphics and three unique maps filled with challenges. Collect blocks to grow your snake, unlock various skins, and compete for the highest score.

title: Letters of Art
description: You're a starving artist out on the streets, trying to survive the harsh reality of the art business. With a high decline and misappreciation for art, you need to make enough money to escape this hellhole.

title: Antivirus Survivors 2003 Professional
description: The family computer is infected again and it’s your job to fend off waves of viruses and adware foes with an arsenal of nostalgic Y2K-inspired weapons. Antivirus Survivors 2003 Professional is a survivor-like auto-shooter filled with nods to the days when computers were actually fun.

title: Flaak TD
description: Each day the US air force send wave after wave of bomber to crush our War machine. You are one anti-aircraft Brigade commander equiped with flakwierling 38 and the awesome Flak 88mm gun. Install them wisely and shoot all the bombers! Protect our factories and the fatherland!

title: Masters of the Air
description: This is a flying barrage shooting game, the background is the Pacific theater of World War II, the player controls a fighter plane in the game, in order to experience the exhilarating barrage shooting.

title: Sword Snap
description: Test your reflexes in this fast-paced duel between Tanuki, the nimble raccoon, and Toad, the samurai toad. Strike first when the exclamation mark appears to earn a point. With simple yet exciting gameplay, focus on speed and timing to outsmart your opponent and rack up points in each duel!

title: Little Buddy
description: Little Buddy is a casual pet simulation where you care for a virtual companion. Feed, play, and interact with Buddy while they wander around your screen. Designed to be played alongside other activities, it’s the perfect idle game to keep your little friend happy and healthy.

title: MazeTD
description: [MazeTD] is a tower defense game where the attack power of the arrow tower is slightly insufficient. You need to build a maze around the waypoints, allowing the animals to slowly navigate through the maze to give the arrow tower more attack time and eliminate them in the maze.

title: sleep_mode
description: sleep_mode - is an analog horror game that we play as a guy who lives in the near future and orders AR glasses to overcome insomnia, but everything turns out to be not so simple...

title: Molest
description: This game unfolds against a soft pink backdrop, offering players a light and enjoyable gaming experience.

title: Interpret
description: This game is a light and fun casual game where players use the AD keys to control a trophy moving left and right at the bottom of the screen.

title: Investigate
description: This game is a classic puzzle game where players can select their preferred difficulty level at the beginning.

title: RealDol
description: One day, the protagonist was reincarnated into the world of a magical girl anime that his niece loved to watch. However, disappointed by the strange situation where everyone around him looked like stones, the protagonist tries to live a normal life but constantly gets caught up in events.

title: Ultimate Candy Hunt
description: It's time for "Ultimate Candy Hunt," the annual candy scavenger hunt on your family farm. For seven days, you'll scramble to find every candy on the list before bedtime. But something seems off this year. You just have a strange feeling that something isn't quite right.

title: Flatinside Simulator
description: Flatinside offers a realistic simulation experience set in a vast city waiting to be explored. Work for more money, create your style, buy luxury houses and cars, flirt with women, and dive into the fun at nightclubs. In this city where everyone writes their own story, take your place!

title: Shoes Store Simulator
description: Are you ready to outshine competitors? Order shoes, stock them on shelves, assist customers in finding the perfect shoes, and handle payments. Hire staff, design your store, and expand it step by step. Build the best shoe store, and enjoy the exciting journey. There’s so much waiting for you!

title: Knight's Path
description: Step into a story-driven action RPG set in a grounded low-fantasy world inspired by the Holy Roman Empire. Rise from a nobody to a respected knight through hard-earned, immersive progression. Master HEMA-inspired combat and explore forests, villages, castles, and the living town of Eranthold!

title: Imminent
description: This game is a highly challenging shooting game that features unique geometric effects, providing players with an unprecedented visual experience.

title: Juxtapose
description: This game captivates players with its stunning palace settings, meticulously crafted visuals that transport you to the splendor of ancient times.

title: Mitigate
description: This game captivates every player with its warm animated style, featuring soft yet vivid colors that create a world both dreamy and lifelike.

title: Marks of Ki
description: Marks of Ki is an adventure-RPG game featuring intense, souls-like combat, developed single-handedly by one passionate guy. Players can choose from six unique customizable characters, each offering distinct abilities and fighting styles.

title: Mirrorplume Frostfate
description: In early 1945 WWII, British pilot Daniel crash-landed in Norway’s snowfields and was rescued by German pilot Elena. Opposing sides, they survived together, fell for each other, yet struggled with identity, war and inner turmoil. Can they outlive the war and embrace peace?

title: The Isolated
description: You are an ordinary man who found himself in the wrong place at the wrong time. Your plane crashes off the coast of a sinister island, hidden from civilization by a shroud of fog and rumor.

title: Virtual Campus
description: This is a first-person VR campus simulator where you can roam around the campus at night and cause some chaos.

title: Forest Hustle
description: You are dropped into a forest with one goal - making money and paying off your 100k debt. Collect resources, make deals, upgrade, build and hire workers to do the job for you.

title: Titanium Court
description: A surreal strategy game for clowns and criminals.

title: Catch The Beaukes
description: In Catch The Beaukes, Beaukes (spheres) fall from the sky, and you need to collect them to earn money. Then you can upgrade things so you earn even more!

title: Consequently
description: This game invites players into a charming town adventure, where they take on the role of a cute little chick navigating through the town.

title: Cooperate
description: This game transports players to a mysterious Ghostly Path, where they take on the role of a green witch advancing along this path full of the unknown.

title: Sustain
description: This game transports players into a dreamlike setting, where they use the AD keys to control a geometric block sliding down a sunset boulevard.

title: Deco Online Origins
description: Deco Online Origins is a free-to-play 3D MMORPG that put players deep into the fantastic story of two warring nations, "Millena" and "Rain". As a legendary swordsman, a fierce archer, or a master of wizardry, players were constantly challenged by the opposing nation and by monsters that lurked around every corner. Notable features included a combo system with hundreds of potential skills, and guardian pets that buffed entire guilds.

title: Ubiquitous
description: This is a classic puzzle game.

title: Specter: The Battle of the Mind
description: Engage in strategic, memory-based combat, overcome exciting challenges, and dive into a story full of mysteries and twists!

title: Celestial Front
description: Watch as stars battle for control of a simple simulated galaxy. Each star belongs to a faction, indicated by its color, and combat happens automatically between neighboring stars. Your role is to observe the dynamic battlefield as stars change ownership.

title: Maker Arena: Path of Vaiolet
description: Join the competition at Vaiolet Arena! Choose your Maker, train their heroes, and climb the divisions by defeating challenging rivals. Show off your strategies, win battles, and become the ultimate Vaiolet Champion!

title: Slay the Abyss
description: Slay The Abyss is a deck-building roguelike game where you choose the events you will encounter, step by step, to regain lost power. Time waits for no one — Try your best in the Action Time Battles. Seize every opportunity, make quick decisions, and slaughter hordes of enemies in the abyss.

title: Dark Angel
description: An amazing RPG game with adventure and general knowledge.

title: PolyGunner
description: PolyGunner is a simple single player FPS game. You have 2 weapons, but a limited amount of ammo. Battle with incoming enemies, collect ammo from enemies, prepare for the next battle to come.

title: King of Swords
description: Fight to the death.

title: Screws Loose
description: Be the best battle bot in this fun multiplayer shooter. Challenge others to this deathmatch style game across various maps and battlegrounds. Get more kills than your foe and win the match.

title: Road To Place
description: Road To Place is a dice rolling roguelike based on chance. The number you roll on the dice can affect everything in the game. Manage resources bullets, food, medicine, and money. Your goal is to survive, there are things that will make that difficult But your main objective is Get to "the place"

title: Bubble Sweeper
description: Pop bubbles on various field sizes and layouts. The perfect game for short sessions!

title: Puzzle Playing Cards
description: Join the captivating world of Puzzle Playing Cards, a strategic tabletop card game! Prove your card-matching prowess and challenge opponents to be the first to call Puzzle Playing Cards. Embrace variety by tweaking lobby settings and enjoy endless hours of entertaining gameplay!

title: Cartoon Cagematch
description: A top-down RogueLike shooter game. Attack cute cartoonish enemies with 6 different weapons! Many tough choices await!! Play now :)

title: SwordSpire
description: Command a rebellion against an oppressive kingdom in this medieval tower-defense strategy game. Manage resources, upgrade units, and battle through 21 intense matches. Protect your tower, crush the enemy's, and lead the people to justice in a fight for freedom and equality.

title: Alpha Trashman Antoine
description: A simple, straightforward swarm survival game with emphasis on fast pace action. Survive and grow stronger!

title: Hockey Pong
description: Have you ever wondered what it would be like to play pong on ice? Welcome to Hockey Pong ladies and gentleman. Hockey Pong is a fun mix between the game "Pong" and the game of hockey. If you love Pong and hockey this game was made for you eh!

title: Shmandala
description: Shmandala is a delirious arcade-style shoot'em up choreographed to a banging soundtrack!

title: City Defence Artillery
description: City defence artillery, the war has begun. Defend cities, upgrade artillery and call in air defense systems.

title: Chasing Rabbits in Snow
description: Aliens will release rabbits with plague in the North Pole in order to conquer the earth. As the guardian of the North Pole, you need to catch the rabbits in the shortest time to protect the North Pole.

title: SSR
description: Throw with the tank the black sheep out. Now with the Neuschwanstein meadow!

title: Dunjinn
description: Turn-based dungeon crawl, every step advances foes; stealth, noise, and light matter. Procedural rooms mix traps, mimics, locks, loot; combat is gear-driven with augments, consumables, and breakable durability. Between runs use town to shop, craft/repair, vault gear; death drops your pack.

title: Not Enough Space
description: Shoot to move. Move to survive. A space action roguelike about momentum, chaotic battles, loot, builds, and bosses.

title: Exorush
description: A 2D vertical shoot 'em up that lets you upgrade your ship with an insane amount of options. From missiles and pods to specials and shields, you can upgrade every bit of your ship from guns to thrusters.

title: Dawnrazor
description: Step into the decaying world of Kagenovia in Dawnrazor, a story-driven 8-bit action adventure! Take control of Zedekiah, a betrayed knight reborn through parasitic vampirism, as he fights through blood-soaked ruins and biomechanical horrors.

title: Medieval Lord Tycoon
description: A pixel art medieval lord simulator! Farm, chop wood, hunt yourself—or delegate to townsfolk. No meddling in daily lives; govern via taxes & laws. When enemies attack, higher prestige means more peasants rally to fight. Balance survival & strategic rule—build your medieval realm, forge your legacy!

title: All Hail the Orb
description:
All Hail The Orb is a quirky and short active incremental game in which you devote yourself to The Orb!
Explore the once lost dungeon as you build your gathering of cultists and bring the dungeon back to its former glory!
Explore and enjoy the light-hearted progression and story!

title: Sea Sweeper
description: Sea Sweeper is a relaxing incremental game where you clean the ocean with your ship. Collect garbage, manage fuel, earn money, and upgrade your ship to clean faster and sweep larger sea areas each run.

title: Help Santa In Christmas Xmas Game
description: Navigate through beautifully crafted levels with challenging obstacles. Gather presents to unlock new stages and surprises. Enjoy the holiday spirit with charming graphics and delightful music. Experience increasing difficulty. Family-Friendly Fun: Perfect for players of all ages.

title: Neon Mind
description: A single-player turn-based puzzle game that will thoroughly tease your brain

title: Phantom of Time
description: Phantom of Time is an endless runner where you've got to grab the key and get to the next gate in 10 seconds or it's game over! How long can you delay the inevitable?

title: Currents of War
description: A turn-based strategy merchant tycoon.

title: Hen Frontiers
description: Embark on epic challenges as you guide our brave chicken through bustling streets, overcoming thrilling obstacles in diverse landscapes. Your mission? Find the lost eggs! Accept the challenge and help our chicken complete this egg-straordinary mission!

title: Halberta
description: In Halberta, you must jump and rotate your way to the exits. Will you be able to escape?

title: Finger Flex
description: Step into the past with your LCD handheld! Test your reflexes and coordination as you navigate challenging obstacles to defeat the alien invasion. With two unique game modes, master the sequences and climb the leaderboards. Can you rise to the challenge?

title: Medieval Marathon: A Quest for Gold
description: Fun little endless runner. Great for killing time.

title: Intern Fox
description: Intern Fox is an exciting game in which you as intern Anna Fox go on a search for stolen jewelry in an ice bunker in Antarctica. Help Anna find all the treasures to prove her professional skills and earn a spot in the police department.

title: Pink Devil
description: Join the fight against alien invaders in Pink Devil. Pilot an upgradable fighter jet through diverse environments, from oceans to deserts. Face unique bosses with distinct tactics and use weapons like machine guns, lasers, and rockets. Become the unstoppable Pink Devil and save the planet.

title: Tiny Elf
description: You can interact, feed and play with your pet sprite and your actions will affect its attributes and personality. After two stages, the Sprite will evolve into different forms depending on your actions.

title: College Dept: The Game
description: You have graduated, but you won't get your degree until you pay off your debt. Study and work to make money.

title: Arthur and His Companions
description: A traditional pixel style role-playing game...

title: Prop Hunt Planet
description: Prop Hunt Planet is a fun party game in which certain players have to hide from Hunters by disguising themselves as props all over the earth.

title: The Key Riddle
description: Exciting riddles and more are ahead of you. Try not to lose yourself in the maze walls. The key riddle is not for those with weak hearts, you enter the village at your own risk. Doors are not doors, the walls are high.

title: Angles of Death
description: "Angles of Death" is an action RPG and roguelike game. It blends the intensity of real-time combat and the unpredictability of roguelike mechanics. The pixel art aesthetic adds a nostalgic yet modern visual appeal, while the atmospheric soundtrack immerses players in a dark and captivating world.

title: Click Frenzy
description: In this game, you need to click quickly and accurately. Every click matters, and you must act fast to avoid missing any target! Improve your mass click accuracy!!!

title: Play a Match?: Play a Catch 2
description: Somewhere online, on a riverbank, a shootout with someone you don't know. A 1vs1 side-scrolling gun shooting. One shot to win or strategies intersect. Use random weapons, obstacles, to defeat someone you don't know. In Friend matches, you can play with someone you know, but please get along well.

title: Emerald Geography
description: Learn the countries and capitals of the world in style.

title: Clash of the Kings
description: Take part in building the best team of knights the kingdom has ever seen! Or lose them all in a glorious fight, the choice is yours!

title: Veil Play
description: Find the killer hiding among the people!

title: The Short Story Of A Riftkeeper
description: The Short Story of A Riftkeeper is a first-person story-based game about a particular Riftkeeper, one who is tasked to close doors in the Rifts to prevent any unwanted things from entering the universe.

title: Street Grabbing of Territory
description: A group of bored female students broke into an Eastern village to take selfies, and a bizarre event occurred where there were things that the real world didn't have! The female student is no longer able to seek help from the outside world, and a mysterious person has appeared

title: Nerd Space
description: Welcome to NerdSpace, an action-shooting game that can be enjoyed with up to four people! Each round will feature a fierce battle, with random rewards for each round. With this reward, you can upgrade your character even more powerfully, so you can fight the battle of overwhelming your enemies in...

title: Konekomi Castle
description: Fifty years in the future, a plucky investigator named Pandora is caught in a snowstorm. Seeking shelter, she unknowingly steps into Konekomi Castle, finding mysterious, one-eyed aliens. You'll need to earn trust, tell lies, and befriend strangers to unearth the castle's extraordinary secrets.

title: In The Middle
description: You work in a haunted laundry. In the morning, you run your business, at night you survive through the scary night.

title: Essence Hunters

Will Servitor be able to form a team and achieve the dreams that wont stop flowing unendingly in Ouiki's mind?

title: Zaria
description: A young family finds itself at the heart of an unprecedented family drama. Manipulate the all-powerful white and black dices in this turn-based narrative roguelike, and help them get out of this mess.

title: Sebi 16
description: Sebi 16 packs sixteen curated singleplayer games into one charming collection: metroidvanias, puzzle games, platformers, a roguelike, and even a deck builder. Built with love in PICO-8!

title: Sudoku Online With Friends
description: Sudoku online with friends is a competitive multiplayer puzzle game.

title: Chilling Devotion
description:
A peaceful winter retreat becomes an unexpected adventure when a snowstorm leads you to the wrong cabin in the mountains.

Originally a submission for the Winter Visual Novel Jam 2024!

title: Bullet Heaven 3
description: Bullet Heaven 3 is a spin-off of the Epic Battle Fantasy series and the sequel to Bullet Heaven 2.

title: Number Way
description: Number Way is a fun math puzzle adventure. Navigate the board to arrive to the final cell by connecting paths—no backtracking or diagonal moves allowed! With over 130 exciting levels, special cells, and quirky boss battles, it's a fresh challenge for casual gamers ready to test their skills.

title: Defense of Wancotte
description: Build-a-Tower Defense. Combine modular units to forge custom towers, experiment with thousands of synergies, and save Wancotte from the encroaching shadow!

title: Codeyssey
description: Write real Python code to repair Codey's spaceship and get him home! Automate and optimize tasks as you explore the planet Codey has landed on. Improve your problem solving and coding skills step by step.

title: Vile Halicarnassus
description: A mystery visual novel with a little bit of puzzle-solving mixed in. Made for a personal 48-hour game jam.

title: Siren's Call: Second Wind
description: A wedding where one of the guests arrives dead. A strange black hole eclipsing the Florida sun. And your best friend? Gone. Is all this a butterfly dream or is reality breaking? Is their story romance or mystery? Your choices will determine the genre of his soul. Welcome to the town of Siren's Call.

title: Prison Breaker
description: As a Prison Breaker, you are a polygon trapped in the prison and destined to smash your way out. Find the right time to attack the prison. Memorize and dodge the dangerous obstacles. Watch how the prison's defense patterns evolve as you progress.

title: Droid Must Deliver
description: Droid Must Deliver is a classical logistics puzzle game where a low-rank delivery droid proves its worth by pushing supply crates through increasingly challenging levels of an empire at war.

title: Angry Birds: Play & Learn
description: A colorful educational game for children that blends story-driven play with creative activities to help kids explore emotions and develop social skills. Set across two themed islands, Mood Nest Island focuses on kindness, friendship, and self-awareness through gentle narrative encounters, while Color Blast Island turns emotions into art with scene‑coloring and expressive activities that reinforce emotional literacy.

title: Last Shift Standing
description: A fast, tactical roguelite: missions explode across the city with ticking timers. Assign heroes, build wild power combos, manage injuries, and keep the city alive through the whole shift.

title: Slick Tricks: Potion Persuasion!
description: Sell your dubious potions to unsuspecting customers by repeating exactly what they want to hear back to them.

title: Bomboban
description: Bomboban is a classic Sokoban-style puzzle game with an explosive twist: instead of pushing crates, you push enemy robots into bombs to defeat them and clear each stag

title: Wishing Well Hotel
description: Wishing Well Hotel is a visual novel comedy game centered around a hotel full of mysterious suspects with some light minigames intertwined within it. Your objective is to discover the true mastermind behind this mystery and this hotel's weird collection of guests.

title: We Are Counting
description:
We are counting.
I open my eyes.
Suction cups.
On my chest. On my arms. Everywhere.
Seventeen.
Eighteen.
Voices whisper.
Mom is waiting.
A short psychological horror visual novel about compulsive counting. A fragmented narrative where the ordinary melts into absurdity.

title: Blitz Society
description: In Blitz Society you have direct control of a Command Tank, battling another player. Each Command Tank has a unique weapon, special ability, and overall stats. Your objective is to destroy your Opponent’s HQ. Build a base, collect resources, defend your territory, raise an army, conquer the enemy!

title: Torshtra Minkan Setsuwashuu yori: Kokuou no Musume
Arx: End of Sun
description: A free fan game successor to Arx Fatalis, built on the idtech 4 engine used in Doom 3.

title: CDL for a UFO
description: Play as a starship captain who is woefully unqualified for the job. With an unfamiliar control panel in front of you, all 45 keys of your keyboard are randomized at the start of every attempt. Guide your ship through a variety of obstacles in an attempt to make it to your destination in one piece.

title: Agrivore
description: Agrivore is an incremental farming roguelike where you equip magical farming gear, harvest crops, unlock new equipment, and create hyper combos in your skill tree.

title: Touhou Rock Maiden FC 3: Little Native Goddess's Revival
description:
The third installment in the Famicom-style Rock Maiden series!
A Rockman-inspired action game faithfully recreating screen size (double display), colors, and more!
Plus, powerful Famicom arrangements for the BGM by ARA from Hobby Workshop Ninjin Wine!
Use charge shots, slides, and special weapons to take down enemies!
Play with restrictions like owata mode and charge shot on/off!
Even greater fidelity than the previous title!

title: The Lost Painter
description: Welcome to The Lost Painter, A single player, first person, atmospheric walking simulator exploring liminal spaces. Enter your Paintings and explore a world full of mystery and Horror. Storm the beaches of Normandy, Get lost in the Backroooms and Survive the Devils Labyrinth.

title: Vedal's Secret
description: Vedal's Secret is a romantic visual Novel based on the characters within the story.

title: Dark Solitaire: Search for a Cure
Solitaire Crime Stories
description: Put your detective skills to the test in a thrilling solitaire mystery!

title: Ashes of Kardoria
description: A dark choice-driven RPG where moral decisions shape your path. Face a brutal island torn by plague, hunger, and a growing orc threat. Pick a faction, hone your skills, battle unique bosses, and fight for a future worth paying for.

title: Moonlit Nights
description: Moonlit Nights is a base management game set in a zombie apocalypse world. Form raiding parties and send them out to gather supplies, deal with mysterious visitors, and make difficult choices. How many days can you survive, or can you be freed and return to your normal life? Make your choice wisely.

title: Tied By Numbers
description: A short Visual Novel that uses horror as a narrative device to touch on topics such as bullying, troublesome family relations and the importance of friendship.

title: The Round-about Orchard
description: The Round-about Orchard is a super tiny fan project (about 15 minutes of play time!) that reunites some Over the Garden Wall folks (creator Patrick McHale, background artist Levon Jihanian, musicians The Blasting Company, and Elijah Wood is back as Wirt!) to create this nugget of point-and-click adventure gaming!

title: Canteen's Islander
description: A game about managing a pirate canteen and exploring a charming island to supply it.

title: Paracesium
description: PARACESIUM is a body horror time management game where you collect, analyze, dismember and reassemble body parts in order to create a pure cadaver for your experimentation. Every action takes time, so make your next decision carefully. Manage time, bodies and monsters and stay alive. Who is Delilah?

title: Caramel Action Micro
description: A very small, difficult & heavily randomized arcade run-n-gun game inspired by Elevator Action, Rolling Bird & Tank Force.

title: A Chef's Oncoming Breakdown
description: What does it take to become the best girlfriend you can be? How far do you have to go? How much of yourself do you have to sacrifice? How much sleep do you lose? The meals you skip? The medicine you stop taking? The things you leave unsaid?

title: Umbranomicon
description: Umbranomicon is a full immersive experience! Because you get two in one: a VN and a fully animated dating simulator. You will have to dive into a mystical world of dangerous adventures to fight the Queen of Darkness and meet a lot of lonely girls, because men are extinct.

title: Observa
description: Alone on a floating island in deep space, you use your telescope to study the universe, capture what you find, and confront the growing sense that something out there is aware of you.

title: GladiMaker
description: Optimal stat allocation, creative equipment combos, and tactics that exploit your enemy's weaknesses—your choices define the battlefield! GladiMaker is a whimsical Auto-battler RPG that packs a punch with deep strategy and the thrill of infinite growth.

title: Stardust: Wish of Witch
description: STARDUST: Wish of Witch is a single-player SRPG beautifully crafted in pixel art. Follow the secret of the wish-granting star and join the adventure of the girl “Star” and the mage “Yu”.

title: Make it! Kushikatsu
description: Get ready for a delicious kushikatsu-making challenge! Make tons of kushikatsu and watch your food cart prosper!

title: Amazing Weekend 4: Search and Relax - Collector's Edition
description: Picturesque locations are waiting for you, filled with an atmosphere of relaxation.

title: Around the World 4: Family Tour - Collector's Edition
description: An incredible and amazing journey!

title: Our Burial Dolls Remastered
description:
They buried the dolls for us that night. But the story didn’t end with the soil.

The beloved classic returns in a remastered edition, featuring improved visuals and enhanced atmospheric presentation.

title: Neopets: Mega Mini Games Collection - The Neopian Arcade Odyssey
description:
Neopets: The Mega Mini Games Collection is a lovingly remastered collection of 26 fan-favourite mini-games from the golden age of Neopets! From collecting Doughnutfruits in Hasee Bounce, launching Kass in Kass Basher, or chasing Neggs in Meerca Chase, the magic of Neopets is back!

And introducing an all-new adventure: Starlight Symphony, starring Nyx in a dazzling musical quest through the stars!

title: Bottle of Sickness
description:
You play as a protagonist trapped in the final moments of a tragedy. As the drugs wear off and reality starts to distort, you must confront what lies before you.

Is it just a pile of scrap metal, a biocomponent... or is it something else?

title: Heartbeat House: Hong Kong
description: Heartbeat House: Hong Kong is a dating reality visual novel. Live with eight participants in a shared villa and make romantic choices. Your decisions are remembered, and relationships will change. If the screen flickers or something feels off—please relax and keep dating. The show is still ongoing.

title: Cantarella: Dominion of Qualia
description: A dark turn-based RPG where you kill, devour, and command aberrations. In a mad tower where life itself is consumed as a resource, rewrite fate through choice and sacrifice in endless looping battles.

title: Jump King: Ghost of the Babe
description:
As well as the new mode, this update includes new garments to wear, new music, and 15 new Achievements for the dedicated to master!

Travel to a new land where the Babe is missing, and the world has died. In this third and ultimate test of stamina you will encounter the remaining souls... This challenge is unlike anything before in Jump King, and when all that remains is a faint ghostly presence, what is left to jump for? Well... You didn't do it for her, did you?

title: Jump King: New Babe+
description: This update will include extra achievements, a new soundtrack, and the New Babe+ mode. Featuring an entirely new level both greater in length and skill-requirement than the original! In this definitive conclusion to Jump King you will get to prove yourself truly worthy of the title Jump King!

title: Security 51
description: You're a security officer deep within Area 51. Scan the staff, verify clearances, and decide who can enter the elevator and who absolutely mustn't leave. The deeper you go, the less certain you are that anyone standing before you is still human.

title: Sonic Mania Randomizer
description: A full game randomizer for Sonic Mania which randomizes the level order, game modes, characters, item boxes, and enemy locations.

title: Little Boo and the Spectral Orbs
description: A challenging single-screen platformer inspired by 80s arcade classics. Help Little Boo rescue his lost friends across 40 deadly levels. Dodge traps, outrun enemies, and race against time. Easy to learn. Brutal to master.

title: Love Love Mystery Club
description: In Love Love Mystery Club, you’re the newest member of the Detective Club at a seemingly ordinary high school. Through Full Motion Video (FMV) storytelling, your choices steer the narrative—will your heart find tenderness… or will hidden horrors emerge from the darkness?

title: Menacetide
description: Menacetide is a top-down sci-fi shooter where every second counts and every upgrade could mean the difference between extinction and survival. Dodge, destroy, and dominate as you unravel the mysterious forces behind a tide of chaos.

title: Fun Zone Omega
description: Explore, survive, and vibe in this post-apocalyptic RPG set in a vacation resort gone wrong. Choose your squad from 12 eccentric misfits, and scavenge the ruins of a hypercapitalist dystopia.

title: Bobble Shop Simulator
description: Take control of your very own bobble head shop. Sell, buy, trade, and repair a large variety of bobble heads and related merchandise. Stock shelves, hire employees, and grow your business. Pay attention though, as these bobble heads sometimes have a mind of their own.

title: Tetro Runner
description: Tetro Runner is an arcade platformer about a sentient block trying to escape a collapsed and corrupt arcade cabinet. You must juggle fast paced platforming and precise block placement to stay alive and get the highest score you can.

title: Make The Dead Dead Again
description: Lux is a DNA-enhanced heroine purging a paranormal outbreak, one loot drop at a time. But loot doesn't just mean bigger guns - it means clothes, makeup, and more. Clear the streets, then spend your spoils making her look drop-dead gorgeous. Because the apocalypse is no excuse for a bad outfit.

title: A Study in Blue
description: Play as Kenneth, a private detective, and Blue, a runaway searching for answers. Explore the megacity of Republica in a semi-open world, solve criminal cases, make decisive moral choices, and uncover the truth behind Blue’s past.

title: Devil's Academy DxD
description: You're brought back from the dead after a tragic first date. Your saviour, however, is a devil, and now you must serve her and her entire family.

title: Wittengrad Is No More
description: Wittengrad Is No More is a surreal, narrative walking sim with horror elements. The city's foggy streets will lead you through the story of a single evening in Barnaba’s life. You will encounter the peculiar inhabitants of Wittengrad, though… does it even matter? After all, Wittengrad is gone.

title: Koioto Se Piace
description: Shin'ya heard the sound of someone playing the guitar poorly while returning home and followed them to Hana, who was happily giving an amateurish performance in the park. After initially mistaking that he was hitting on her, she told him that she started playing the guitar because she attended his band’s show. She implored him to teach her how to play the guitar, but actually he was the drummer in the band. So their musical drama begins on the wrong note.

title: Upbeat Melody Project
description: Tap to the rhythm of Japanse songs! Play the official music and all songs made by the community on a level that suits you!

title: Nagai
description: Puzzle platformer made for the Tu juego a juicio Jam 2021.

title: Hessian Landing
description: A hand-crafted open-world Adventure RPG set in a sci-fi colony. Explore, take on quests, fight hostile creatures in real time, and shape a branching mystery through dialogue choices. The Maroon heroine signals the Frog People with a vital tongue gesture — bridging worlds on the edge of the unknown.

title: Flufftopia: Fluffmazing Edition
description: Flufftopia is a cute little clicker game with a story. Help your town to grow and eventually become Flufftopia! But wait… could there be even more?

title: Clock Tower Madness
description:
Welcome to the Dream Emulation Disc-program.
The clock tower is always stand still.

climb this tower of dreams & get your life in vision again....

title: Kube Kreatures: Bleached White
description: Kube kreatures is a pokemon style game drenched in childhood trauma from being scared by spooky Pokémon Creepypastas and urban legends

title: Obey the Voice
description: You are here to listen to The Voice, do what he says. But don't listen to other voices...

title: FoxHaunt
description: FoxHaunt is a choice-based RPG with turn-based battles. You are the Forgotten Fox. Find and fight the other fox spirits so that you will be remembered.

title: Feline Realms: The Ancients' Legacy
description: Feline Realms: The Ancients' Legacy is a quirky turn-based RPG where ancient feline heroes rediscover their forgotten heritage to defend Earth from an invading force. Unlock your Guardian powers, and navigate a modern world filled with danger. Can you reclaim your legacy and save Earth?

title: Split Tactics
description: A turn-based LAN multiplayer card game where players share the same hand. Each player must make their own decisions on how to split the cards so that they leave less options to opponent and get closer to victory!

title: Draft Day Sports: College Football 2025
description: Draft Day Sports: College Football 2025 puts you in the role of head coach for your favorite college football team. Recruit, gameplan, hire a successful staff and make the right calls on the field to lead your team to the top of the ranks and the college football championship.

title: Select Quiz
description: Select Quiz is the most fun and original quiz game! The game contains more than 3,500 questions, in 8 categories and 18 different characters to choose from.

title: FPS Hero
description: There are many robots in FPS Hero that you need to defeat! Come and relax and unwind in this game!!!

title: EmuDevz
description: A game about building emulators! Implement your own NEEES core in JavaScript, get instant feedback with unit/video tests, build the graphics unit in real time, learn 6502 assembly, debug test ROMs, and have fun with the included homebrew games!

title: The Scaling
description: The Scaling is a platformer with special mechanics. Increase and decrease to overcome obstacles.

title: Wizard Pool
description: Pool, but each ball is enchanted! Master the 7 different magical effects, but don't forget your fundamentals!

title: Mythic Love: Iberian Legends
description: Think you can handle a little romance with creatures from Spanish folklore? Careful: your love life isn’t the only thing at stake at Mythic Love: Iberian Legends.

title: Sushi on Wheels
description: Run your dream sushi truck in Sushi on Wheels! Prep ingredients, customize your truck, and serve handmade sushi to hungry locals. Upgrade your gear, discover new recipes, and build your reputation in this cozy management game set in a charming Japanese town.

title: Treasure Rush: Phantom Infiltration
description:
After you save your friends from the Tower Cave, things in Chairwood don’t calm down at all. People start going missing, whole houses turning quiet overnight, and nobody knows what’s going on. Every clue you follow keeps pointing back to Phantom Corp. They’re acting like nothing’s happening, but everyone knows they’re involved.

So now it’s up to you and your friends to go inside their facility, figure out what they’re doing, and stop it before the whole town ends up gone.

title: The Land of Stuff
description: The Land of Stuff is an online multiplayer role-playing game. You can explore a vast world solo or with friends, battling monsters, gaining loot and completing story quests.

title: EchoEvade
description: EchoEvade is a fast-paced rhythm-action hybrid. Dodge, catch, and tap to the beat, precision and movement are key!

title: Nightwater
description: Forage, craft and automate to grow your factory, unlock new technologies and expand your island to discover new biomes. Progress through the ages from sticks and stones to the Bronze Age, the Industrial Era and into the future to uncover the secret of the Lighthouse and escape this reality.

title: Beyond Up
description: Beyond Up is an exhilarating adventure that will push your platforming skills to their limits! Your goal is simple: ascend through a world filled with obstacles, platforms, and unexpected twists, all while defying gravity and conquering your fear of falling.

title: Veyora
description: Veyora is a medieval open-world RPG with elements of farming, survival, and adventure. In a vast, stylized world, you decide where to live and what to create – whether near a bustling town, in the lonely mountains, or by a peaceful lake. Each location offers its own resources, challenges, and opportunities.

title: Beyond Zero Line
description: A nation is on the brink of collapse and you have been given a special order: rescue the trapped president. Run, jump, and gun your way across its interconnected districts full of enemies and secrets. Uncover the truth behind your mission.

title: Night Rampage
description: A neo-film noir 2D side-scrolling action game that delivers an adrenaline-pumping gunfight and violently aesthetic combat experience reminiscent of John Wick

title: Cinco Noches Con Mi Tío Raúl
description:
Well, you got a new summer job in "Uncle Raul's Pizzeria" because you need some money. This new job consist in check cameras to ensure the local during the night. But in your first day, you start to notice weird things around you...

You must be intelligent and use your limited resources to survive five nights to Uncle Raul and his friends.

title: Echo's Inc
description: You work the late shift at Echo's Inc reviewing bodycam footage of employees that vanished. Tonight it's Melvin's tape. You press play and suddenly you're not watching anymore. You're him. Living his last shift.

title: The Anomaly Manor
description: There's a mansion with a dark legend: Whoever enters disappears forever. Equipped with your spectral camera, you decide to delve inside to investigate. Locate and photograph the anomalies to escape before the wandering souls catch you!

title: Zorlac's Revenge
description: After 4 long decades Zorlac is back with a reconstructed fortress armed with 6 indestructible guns, 2 types of deadly missiles and a self-repairing forcefield.

title: Super Cat the Builder
description: "Super Cat The Builder" is a 2D platform puzzle game. It features a unique blueprint game mechanism, where players can solve obstacles by changing the position of enemies. With multiple levels and a storyline full of humor, players are in for a gaming experience filled with surprises and fun!

title: Return of the Demons
description: A side-scrolling story-driven game woven from Taiwanese folklore, demons, and ghosts. In the story, players will join Haoxuan, who has just lost his mother in a car accident, to learn the truth about his mother's accident and the cause and effect behind it while encountering demons and ghosts.

title: Not Lonely Up!
description: Set in a stylized anime version of Japan, a charming heroine climbs toward the sky in search of a lost heart-shaped balloon. With checkpoints, auto-saves, and unlockable outfits, you can progress at your own pace. Explore a mysterious world full of branching paths and breathtaking views.

title: Send In The Vampires
description: Maniacs have taken over the asylum. Restore order with your fists in the ultimate gothic arcade beat em up. Supports up to 4 players in couch coop/remote play.

title: Guǐyāchuáng
description: Is a first-person perspective horror game, adapted from the producer's personal experiences and real-life events, with the story set in Tainan in 2005. Through the gaming experience, it aims to help players who have never experienced ghost pressing bed understand the fear associated with it.

title: Fusil
description: An action-adventure set in a weird fantasy world. Face levels where every shot counts: move silently to backstab enemies, use spells to unlock paths, and explore non-linear environments with multiple solutions. Choose your path, manage your ammo, and survive.

title: Vow of the Wordlocks
description: Vow of the Wordlocks is a Roguelike where you cast spells with a Scrabble board-the higher the score, the stronger the sorcery. The player controls one of the witchers who swore a vow to become a Worldock, engaging enemies with bizzare fates and bosses with tragic histories.

title: Tap Tap Loot
description: The world is under attack, and every tap fights back. Each keystroke unleashes your cute cat hero, smashing enemies and showering you with loot. Dive into a never-ending desktop expedition with friends or solo. Tap. Tap. Loot.

title: Snailshell
description: a short visual novel about a girl and her snail

title: Elven Rivers VII: The Crimson Tide - Collector's Edition
description: Battle an ancient icy plague and stop the undead before the world freezes. The collector's edition features 15 bonus levels and other goodies.

title: Deadly Project
description: You wake up in a dark room, the first thing you see is a bomb in front of you and your only way out is to answer a Quiz of questions and thus save your life. Can you come out alive and prove that you were the smartest?

title: Holo vs. Robo
description: Build a strong defense of hololive dolls to defeat a robot army in this exciting hololive-themed tower defense game!!

title: Hack.bak
description: HACK.BAK is a terminal-based hacking game where the user searches a procedurally generated network for commands in order to decrypt their data which was sealed by hackers.

title: Guts 'n Grunts Jr.
description: Play a missing classic from the genesis of the 16-bit era. Roll like a hedgehog! Shoot like a soldier!

title: Plighters
description: Fight. Loot. Die. Repeat. Begin your plight into this 2D rogue-lite, and try to survive. Battle enemies, bosses, charge orbs, enter portals, and try to make it farther than last time, uncovering new items, challenges, and secrets. Adventure alone or with up to 3 other friends in co-op.

title: Reel Horror
description: A haunted projectionist's room. A shelf of cursed films. Each reel plays a terrifying short story you must live through. Explore twisted worlds from the safety of the projection booth, or so you think...

title: Spin to Survive
description: Rougelite + Russian Roulette, but using a more powerful cannon. Survive and take all the prizes!
A quick reaction game inspired by the 67 meme. React at the exact right moment, or it’s over. Simple, fast, and all about pure reflex.

title: The Letter That Came Over Time
description: A remake of Casablanca ni Ai o: Satsujinsha wa Jikū o Koete which changed from being a text adventure with graphics to using menus instead.

title: Pintorino
description: Ready to challenge your brain? Pintorino is a grid-based puzzle game where you guide a player across the board, aiming to pass through all the required blocks - each with its own unique purpose.

title: Shinjuku Anomaly
description: You have a part-time job taking photos of anomalies in the night in Shinjuku.

title: Grexovka Village
description: You've come to the village to "recharge." An hour later, you're looking for something you've lost, sniffing incense in a barn, and arguing with people who smile when it suits them. Here, a glance, a pause, and what's under the rug decide everything.

title: RX Racing 2022 Pro
description: RX Racing 2022 Pro is an arcade rallycross game where you can drive the drivers of the year 2022 in different categories. The goal is very simple, you take a driver and try to win the race . More than 40 pilots, +20 teams, +25 tracks 3 Modes : Time Attack , Race and Season

title: Band Mates
description: Band Mates is a chill music-making game that provides a quick and intuitive sonic playground to jam out solo or with friends. A plethora of groovy sounds, funky beats, and vibrant fx allow for all styles of music. Let your creativity guide you and discover the joy of making music!

title: Who I Am
description: The fictional nation of Danna's turbulent history of independence and foreign intervention serves only as a backdrop. This is simply a cliché love story about its third generation, who grew up in peace.

title: Nocturnal Quest
description: Nocturnal Quest is a Semi-Idle Adventure RPG with 100s of spells & effects, 6 classes, 12 specializations, and countless builds. Have your teams grind gear and progress through an infinity of levels!

title: VHSMan
description: "Alice decides to watch a VHS she found in the dumpster 6 months ago and crazy stuff happens!" A Visual Novel about a magical VHS tape

title: Eclipse of Eldergaard
description: A dark action-adventure where you race against time to seal the hell gates, gather crystal shards, and stop Umbra’s return on the Bloody Day. Estimated playtime: ~1 hour.

title: Buttons Up!
description: Buttons Up! is a incremental button collecting game where you hoard Buttons and keep them safe from stealing intruders. Get those Buttons Up by buying buildings, using skills and by automating your income.

title: Keyclash
description: Keyclash is a simple tower defense roguelike about building on keyboard keys and surviving as long as possible.

title: PostApo
description: It’s a post-apocalyptic game set in the year 2067. The game will feature full voice acting and all in-game texts and descriptions will be localized. It will be released in 9 languages. Unreal Engine 5.4.4 Unreal Engine 5.2.1

title: TreasureTails
description: A cozy, relaxing and casual adventure game where you play as a curious cat searching for treasures. Explore peaceful landscapes, follow treasure maps and solve clues to find and unearth many hidden wonders and mysteries.

title: Wild Terrain
description: You're a wild pig on a quest to find all of your missing piglets. Smash obstacles, forage through trash for food, discover special mushrooms, and poop flowers to restore balance as you grow closer to your piglet family and the wild around you.

title: BetterVR
description: BetterVR is a full VR conversion mod for The Legend Of Zelda: Breath of the Wild. It supports hand and arms tracking, gestures to equip and throw weapons, and motion controls to interact with the world.

title: The Found Magic
description: The Found Magic is a 34 map MBF21 mapset for Doom 2, created by a large group of mappers, and is the sequel to 2023's The Quinary Conundrum.

title: Time Breaking: Dino Breach
description: Time Breaking: Dino Breach is an isometric survival horror inspired by the unforgettable Dino Crisis. With gameplay that echoes the intense survival dynamics and tension of the classic Dino Crisis, Time Breaking: Dino Breach offers a mix of action, puzzle-solving and moments of pure suspense as you explore claustrophobic research centers and prehistoric jungles populated by deadly dinosaurs.

title: Mantle Crater
description: A 5 map UZDoom only wad for Doom 2 themed around the animated series RWBY.

title: Frog Adventure
description: Frog Adventure is a cozy puzzle arcade game about a frog trying to get home. Jump between cells, avoid cars, cross rivers on logs, collect crowns for perfect completion, and compete against a friend in a local race.

title: Life is Strange: Reunion
description: Life is Strange: Reunion is the thrilling finale to the Max and Chloe saga, a chapter that brings their book to a close. This is a full circle moment for both developers and fans—one that builds on everything that has come before. And even as the game delivers a reunion long-thought impossible, it also caps off our time at Caledon University in a literal blaze of glory.

title: Fister
description: Fist your friends in the physics-based multiplayer game where you fist or be fisted!

title: Keine's Expanding Class!
description: Solve and guess words one letter at a time in a brain-teasing, customizable Hangman-style challenge with Keine Kamishirasawa! Test your knowledge of English words or Touhou characters, locations and music to expand your mind! Wait... something else is expanding too!?

title: Foxy Dumplings
description: In Foxy Dumplings, you’ll run your own food truck and make friends along the way. Cook dumplings from all over the world, take good care of your clients, and discover how a meal can mend more than just hunger in this cozy cooking sim. Rise to the top of Foxtagram, one heartfelt dish at a time.

title: Guardian of the Sacred Seal
description: In another world, the protagonist works alongside a mysterious young man, handling requests that appear ordinary but conceal subtle changes beneath the surface. Through repeated choices, relationships between the characters gradually evolve, and the hidden truths of this world slowly come to light.

title: Captain Whiskers: Incremental Seas
description: This is a relaxing fishing-themed incremental game. You will join the Cat Captains to explore global fishing grounds, catch fish, and collect resources. Unlock permanent upgrades in a vast talent tree with your gold. Every rewarding voyage will have you shouting, "One more round!"

title: Pilot 6174: Orbital Survival
description: Navigate star systems using real orbital mechanics. Pilot a cockpit with controls inspired by the Apollo command module. Manage heat, energy, and trajectory.

title: Magic Hero Incremental
description: Magic Hero Incremental is a click-based incremental game focused on growth and progression. Players create their own unique hero through character creation, then defeat enemies to gather resources and grow stronger.

title: Dicevaders
description: Build an army of alien invaders to invade the Earth in DiceVaders, the roguelike dice game set in the same universe as StarVaders!

title: Darkrite: The Blight of Love
description: Old school, rich with lore, and made with love. Experience a linear gothic story with carefully handwritten prose. Play either as an action RPG or visual novel. Your Weaver journey starts here.

title: Shin Megami Tensei: Devil Summoner - Raidou Kuzunoha vs. the Fiefdom of Death
description:
Shin Megami Tensei: Devil Summoner: Raidou Kuzunoha vs. the Fiefdom of Death is a free fanmade game.

As a result of a ritual of delayed demise, Raidou Kuzunoha XIV finds himself in the body of his descendant against his will. Raidou must complete the investigation into the missing boy Koichi and return to his own time. A gruesome dark story inspired by traditional Japanese folklore.

title: Paprika x Persona False God Reincarnation
description: Dream researcher Paprika - whose real identity is Dr. Atsuko Chiba, a psychotherapist - begins experiencing vivid, unsettling nightmares. These visions include a ruined Tokyo, her former colleague transformed into the demon Amon, the enigmatic entity Philemon, and the mysterious Velvet Room. As these dreams intensify, Tokyo itself is gripped by widespread phenomena of mass hallucinations, blurring the line between dream and reality as patients’ subconscious fears leak into the waking world. To uncover the source of this phenomenon, Paprika and her intern students turn to the retro game Megami Ibunroku Persona as both a tool and a guide.

title: Opus Torrentia
description: Opus Torrentia is a surreal exploration RPG with inspiration from the classics such as Earthbound and Yume Nikki. (it’s a quirky RPGmaker game, what do you want from me?) It has strange environments, curious characters, fun abilities, puzzles, minigames and secretssss!

title: Bloksie (For Now)
description: Enforce the Internal Revenue Code. Turn Hundreds into Decillions. Praise BirdJesus. The Rouge-Litest Arithmetic 'Em Up.

title: Infinite Minefield
description: Infinite Minefield is a variation of classic minesweeper where the playing field expands as you explore it. The game is score-based, and bonuses help you win extra time.

title: Infinite Dungeon
description: Infinite Dungeon is a pixel-art roguelike deck-building game. Play as a despised "villain," delve into a mysterious dungeon, recruit allies, collect gear, and build your deck. The unpredictable "flow of time" mechanic shapes each battle. Uncover secrets and conquer powerful foes!

title: The Curator
description: The Curator is a gallery-management roguelite about managing your own traveling exhibition. Upgrade your van and constantly re-organize artworks to unleash synergies while satisfying picky visitors. Prepare for special events and curate a collection that pleases everyone, including the Baron Family.

title: Liv
description: You are accused of the disappearance of a young woman. To prove your innocence, you must solve the case. Use the computer, the victim's diary, and her videos from the last months. You can use specialized software and the police datas. Make deductions, solve puzzles and find out what happened to Liv.

title: The Carcass
description: A deep roguelike colony RPG inside a dead god's corpse. Procedurally generated events, branching narratives, species with unique traits, and meaningful choices that shape your colony's fate. Every playthrough tells a different story of survival and evolution.

title: I Can Offer You Flowers
description: 'To propose to my boyfriend... what flowers would you recommend?’ Arrange bouquets in this cozy puzzly game! Discover flowers, meet new people, and become the Atrium Botanique community center florist!

title: What We Carry
description: What We Carry is a dark romance visual novel where you wake inside a locked compound and must build trust, survive deadly trials, and uncover the truth behind the experiment before love becomes your greatest weakness.

title: Travellin Cats Advent Calendar
description: Sweeten the countdown to Christmas with this fabulous advents calendar full of hidden cats for you to find in this cute HOG by Travellin Cats - the original viral hidden cats game creator!

title: Ball Busters
description: An over-the-top 3D arena roguelike about juggling balls. Rip insane combos, unlock bodacious-to-unhinged characters, and craft high-hit builds—until you drop it.

title: Tea for the Soul
description: A relaxing game about walking through nature and brewing a cup of tea with a friend while listening to their problems.

title: Whiskers' Wish
description: Discover the life of an abandoned kitten in this cute and heartwarming adventure. Explore the city park with other strays, solve puzzles, make friends, and face dangers—all while dreaming of finding a forever home.

title: Faehnor Online
description: A handcrafted MMORPG developed by a solo creator, where exploration relies on real paper maps. Get lost, find your way, and set out to conquer a world that will never take you by the hand.

title: From Rust To Ash
description: "From Rust To Ash" is roguelike auto battler where your items are your build. Fight, Loot, Scavenge. Arrange your items to benefit from each other, store items in your backpack for future synergies, scrap what you don't need to increase your health. Do all that you need to survive the encounters before you.

title: Get Goating
description: You’re a goat. You work at a post office. A storm scatters the mail across the PNW woods. Recover lost packages solo or with friends, navigate treacherous terrain, and avoid a roaming Sasquatch. Deliver fast, hide when needed, and don’t get caught.

title: Bump Guardian
description: Bump Guardian is a casual deck-building defense game about protecting a growing life. Build your deck, repel incoming threats, and progress through the stages of pregnancy.

title: Another Hero's Adventure
description: A pixel-art RPG rooted in modern wuxia novels. This spin-off continues the spirit of the original, letting you embark on an untold tale of the jianghu where your choices shape the chaos and forge a new heroic saga.

title: Chained Wheels
description: Embark on a chaotic co-op drive in Chained Wheels, where two vehicles are chained together and every move turns into a shared adventure or a DISASTER.

title: Stiff Neck
description: A story about the self—and about others. A toy factory, several cursed dolls, and a horror novel… This quiet seaside town throws Noele's love life into chaos and dredges up the old wounds she has tried for years to forget.

title: Cat President: 3rd-Rate Candidate
description:
In a world where pets run the government, President DJ Nibbles has spent most of his time lying in sunbeams and using his desk as a scratching post. But now his days of zoomies in the Oval Office are coming to a close, as the U.S. prepares to elect its next Cat President!

Six wildly incompetent candidates are throwing their yarn balls into the ring, each more dysfunctional than the last. You’re the human campaign manager tasked with keeping these adorable candidates out of trouble. Wrangle egos, dodge scandals, fall in love, and maybe even save the country...or make it much, much worse.

With a script that’s nearly 100,000 words long, Cat President: 3rd-Rate Candidate is a visual novel packed full of romance, humor and cute pictures of real cats. Whether you’re a campaign veteran or just here for the musical numbers and fur-flying debates, it’s the most paws-itively absurd political simulator you’ll ever play.

title: Toey Weedz Smoke Dead Mirror
description: Toey Weedz is humanity's last hope... Or maybe not!? Because in Toey Weedz Smoke Dead Mirror, nothing is as it seems. Get ready for a comedic solo adventure in retro military shooter style that you won't soon forget!

title: The Cemetery Shift
description:
The Cemetery Shift is a short, first-person horror story that takes place over a single night. You play as a college student working an overnight security job at a remote cemetery in the Arkansas woods.
You’ll spend most of your shift monitoring CCTV feeds from the security booth, then stepping out to investigate when the cameras catch something suspicious. Search the grounds, interact with the environment, and follow the trail of events to keep the night moving forward.

title: Sniper Camouflage Orange Spy Warrior I Buried Two Bodies in the Garden and the Police Haven't Figured Out Yet That They're Missing Because They Were a Lonely Old Couple Who Had No Relatives Simulator 2026
description: Sniper simulator game with sponge bob graphics

title: Rise of Mutant Swarms
description: Rise of Mutant Swarms is a strategy survival tower-defense game where you defend the base against waves of evolving mutant enemies. Place and upgrade turrets, adapt to enemy abilities, and make critical decisions as the pressure rises with every wave.

title: Critical Descent
description: Master the high-stakes catch of the SpaceX Starship! Execute precise maneuvers to stick the landing in the tower’s arms, complete missions, compete on global leaderboards, and race your own ghost for the best time in Critical Descent.

title: Shin Fangame Tensei
description:
build a team of demons and summon the right party to defeat your enemies

each demon has an unique set of skills that determine their behavior in battle, so carefully consider their positioning as to not waste their talents, or worse.....

if your team sucks you can fuse your demons to make stronger ones, but even weak demons will shine with proper tactics

enemies grow stronger as the FULL MOON approaches, and something awaits beyond that.....

title: Boomerang Survivor 3
description: The action of controlling the boomerang has been powered up! Defeat the evil "Dark Acero" and aim to escape from the spaceship "Magenta Jolokia". It's even more fun with two-player mode, new items, gimmicks, a challenge battle mode, and more! There is also a "Easy Mode" for beginners.

title: Mortal Mythos: Island of Fairies
description: Dodge waves of bullets in cover shooter + shmup-inspired combat, as you strike back with powerful attacks of your own! Use clever cover spots to gain an advantage over your enemies, find treasures to make yourself stronger, and avoid taking damage to raise your score!

title: Cityscapes
description: You're an urban planner, and it's time to build a new city! Your new residents all dream of something different, but there's only one design that is perfect for everyone! Take your time and use your brain in this cozy puzzle game.

title: Pigmarines
description: Pigmarines is a 2–10 player online social deduction game where players blend in among the passengers aboard the same submarine, sabotage, hunt down traitors, and decide who to trust or betray before the ship sinks.

title: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown: Deluxe DLC
description: The DLC contains 5 additional missions, 2 new recruitable heroes and 3 new technologies.

title: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown: Deluxe Edition
description: The Deluxe Edition contains 5 additional missions, 2 new recruitable heroes and 3 new technologies.

title: Special Order
description: 'Special Order' is a short visual novel, where you make an order in a femboy themed fast-food chain. The one boy in particular is your favourite. Do you think you will meet him today?

title: Nightfall Berlin
description: Nightfall Berlin is an occult detective RPG with a focus on exploration, case-solving and our relationship to the places where we live and die, set in the dynamic, seductive and violent history of 90s Berlin.

title: World of Tanks Blitz: Reforged
description: World of Tanks Blitz: Reforged is a massive technical overhaul of Wargaming’s hit MMO action game. Rebuilt from the ground up on Unreal Engine 5, it introduces next-gen graphics, dynamic lighting, and advanced physics. Experience intense 7v7 tank combat with stunning PBR textures and enhanced environments, while maintaining full cross-platform progression in the most visually advanced version of Blitz to date.

title: Worship Demon
description: Worship Demon is a 2D survivor game blending anime art and immortal cultivation. Choose one of the Four Great Demonic Sects, cultivate powers, hunt lost treasures and spells, defeat foes, and forge your unique immortal journey with hundreds of skill-item combinations.

title: Fantastic Journey
description: Simulation: Hot air balloon ride in dreamlike landscape in Arctic then, floating around worlds in cosmos with captivating music

title: Day and Night
description:
In this fast, fun and frantic puzzle game, match and collect blocks and stay alive long enough to change time, flipping both the game and the rules!

An epic battle between Day and Night sees two opponents - a friend or CPU - race to collect their own time-themed blocks while managing the blocks of their opponent. But when time changes, Day becomes Night, Night become Day and suddenly what's collectible and what's not is turned upside down!

title: Dune Rancher
description: Dune Rancher is a first-person incremental Moondust collecting game where you hoard materials and keep them safe from stealing Desert Spirits. Use Moondust to buy weapons, tools and robots to boost and automate your income.

title: Path of Glory
description: Path of Glory is a deck-building, roguelite game, set in a post-apocalyptic world. Offering endless replayability, unlockable characters with unique tree skills and card deck's. Fight all beast on your path to become a Hero.

title: Firestarters
description: As a convicted criminal in the brutal future of this lightning-paced arcade movement FPS, a government-sanctioned bloodsport is your only hope of redemption. Strategize, skate, shoot, and slay against a gauntlet of genocidal androids for the chance to win your freedom.

title: Core of War
description: The Core of War features a highly free battlefield, offering units including but not limited to infantry, Titan robots, tanks, mech, aircraft, warships, etc. Build your own battlefield! Whether you want future or modern or earlier era warfare , you can experience it all here!

title: Drop Duchy: Complete Edition
description: Drop Duchy: Complete Edition includes all additional content released so far (“The Tribe” and “The North” DLCs) bringing the full strategic experience to console players! In a charming, maquette-inspired medieval world, Drop Duchy blends deckbuilding, puzzle mechanics, and roguelite progression into one seamless, strategic experience.

title: Bobble and the Tri-Crystal
description: Swim, shoot, and save the ocean! Play as a detective fish in this fast-paced 2D Game Boy-style shoot 'em up! Unlock multiple weapons, defeat enemy hordes, and defeat bosses before it's too late!

title: Ranchbound
description: Ranchbound is a western-themed real-time strategy and management game focused on running and expanding a ranch. Players manage cowboys and livestock, assign workers to tasks, transport cattle between locations, and make economic decisions to keep the ranch profitable and alive. The game combines strategic planning, light survival elements, and a stylized depiction of life in the Wild West.

title: Beastfolk Barber
description: You're a barber in a city full of beastfolk. Chat with your customers, style their look, help them see something new in the mirror... and in themselves.

title: Diablo IV: Age of Hatred Collection
description:
The Diablo IV: Age of Hatred Collection includes:

- Diablo IV Base Game
- Diablo IV: Vessel of Hatred
- Diablo IV: Lord of Hatred Standard Edition

The Age of Hatred Collection is the best way to begin your journey in Diablo IV. This bundle instantly unlocks the Diablo IV base game and Vessel of Hatred expansion, and includes the Lord of Hatred expansion.

title: Dicegeon Whispers
description: A tactical roguelike with cards and dice, inspired by tabletop RPGs. Use cards to influence the roll, throw the dice, and create powerful abilities. Choose between three classes and delve into a dungeon where something ancient begins to awaken.

title: Muppet Kids: Letters - Capital & Small
description: Letters: Capital & Small is a Muppet Kids CD-Rom game produced by Brighter Child in 1997. This game is volume 1 in the Muppet Kids Reading and Thinking Series.

title: Warhead Destined
description: Warhead Destined is a dungeon delving action roleplaying game. It features custom made 2d art never before seen in another game. The game is about grinding loot to be strong enough to beat bosses and advance to the next dungeon theme.

title: MoneyFalls: Coin Pusher Simulator
description: MoneyFalls is a coin pusher simulator with accurate physics and stunning graphics with many added items and gadgets that makes the game more challenging. Added in version 1.2 new machines and modes. Discover it yourself.

title: A Game About Making A Planet
description: A Game About Making A Planet is a short incremental auto clicker game. Make a planet by merging particles together.

title: Little Woody
description: Little Woody is a 2D point-and-click puzzle adventure where you guide a small wooden soul through a mysterious world of shifting environments. Meet unusual companions along the way, solve handcrafted logic puzzles, explore atmospheric locations and uncover a forgotten past.

title: Color Splash: Parrots
description: Color Splash: Parrots is a charming and relaxing puzzle game that will lift your spirits and take You into the world of adorable parrots and art. Venture into the gallery, where you will find many extraordinary and colorful birds paintings.

title: Lovely Anime Puzzle: Halloween
description: Lovely Anime Puzzle: Halloween is a fun and rewarding puzzle game. Assemble charming Halloween-themed pictures, sharpen your attention, and immerse yourself in a festive holiday world.

title: Pallet Jack Racing
description: Welcome to the "Pallet Jack Racing" — crazy races through endless labyrinths of warehouses! Get comfortable on your trusty pallet truck and hit the gas hard!

title: Enchanted Vampire Defense
description: A tower defense game that we play against vampires in ancient times.

title: Enchanted Desert
description: A tower defense game where we try to kill skeletons and wizards in the desert.

title: Social Caterpillar
description: The only hands-on puzzle adventure guaranteed to accurately and humanely teach Socialization to Introverts, heh heh!

title: Key Your Debt
description: You have two things, debt and a number keypad. Use the number keys on your keyboard to pay your debt in this capitalistic clicker debt paying simulator.

title: Duckiost
description: An exciting game in which you will find yourself in the role of a duck with a machine gun and will fight for your life.

title: G-Mode Archives+: Armored Core Mobile 3
description: Fight on—just to survive. A world of rival powers, with tomorrow unknown.

title: Futurika Online
description: Futurika Online is a free-to-play, pixel art cyberpunk MMORPG with real-time combat and story-driven progression. Play for free!

title: Puzzle: Lines and Knots 3
description: Logical puzzle game for meditation and relaxation. The goal of the game is to assemble a puzzle consisting of knots.

title: Epitome
description:
Welcome to the system of Epitome. Explore a world woven from the threads of reality.
Here, us, the Archons, my creations, rule over their unique realms, shaping and disorting them according to their desires.This is no mere adventure - enter Epitome and strive to become an Archon.

title: Last Gasp
description:
Whatever you do, do not give up.

Create a party on the fly and engage in Turn-Based JRPG Combat. Awakening in the world of Limbo, the Wanderer must take hold of their inspirations to escape. Limbo constantly changes and ideas will flow. You will have to work with what you're given and improvise your strategy.

title: Adamant Heart
description: A Megaman Legends inspired, lighthearted shooting adventure! Force your way into mysterious ruins filled with ancient robots, find valuable treasure to upgrade your gear, and discover their true origin and purpose.

title: Mongolian Death Worm Capture Department Activity Record
description: I arrived in the land of Mongolia to capture the Mongolian Death Worm. To capture my beloved Mongolian Death Worm and save our Mongolian Death Worm Capture Department from extinction.

title: Wesley Moons
description: Wesley's Moons is a collection of 34 moons with a roguelike system built in made by MagicWesley for the indie title Lethal Company. All the moons have unique ideas and concepts behind them; with each moon you explore having varying challenges to face, and areas to explore!

title: Edgar Allan Poe's Interactive Horror: 1995 Edition
description: Originally released as The Dark Eye, this 1995 cult classic adapts Edgar Allan Poe's most macabre tales. Navigate a nightmarish world of uncanny stop-motion puppetry narrated by William S. Burroughs. Solve twisted puzzles and experience madness through the eyes of both murderer and victim.

title: The Run
description: An FMV horror-thriller. A famous fitness influencer must fight for survival when she's hunted by killers. Your decisions determine whether she lives or dies.

title: Chapolin X Drácula 2
description: A fan-made game imagining a sequel to Chapolin X Dracula for Master System, but inspired by Castlevania.

title: Never Safe in Delaware
description:
Never Safe in Delaware is built on a kinetic combat system inspired by games such as Max Payne, Hotline Miami, and Brutal Doom. We've taken notes from the best games in the action genre to achieve precise gunplay and satisfying melee combat.

Take control of three of America’s most dangerous fugitives in a breakneck, intense battle against the scum and criminals infesting the city.

title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II - Royal Edition
description: The Royal Edition includes the base game, all the exciting story DLC and additional expansion sets to make your Middle Ages journey truly unforgettable.

title: Armored Vehicle Designer
description: Sandbox game about designing armored vehicles.

title: Swim Meet
description: There's nothing better than swimming with a variety of women. Work hard and play hard with these beautiful swimmers to ensure the best of endings together as you compete for a place on the team.

title: Dodori
description: DODORI is a rhythm adventure game where you perform music along the lines of a rotating square. You play as Sara, the vocalist of the Soun High School band, working with your friends to create the ultimate performance. Enjoy DODORI, a high school girl band story with a unique emotional twist!

title: PaceBreak
