description: PaceBreak is a first-person parkour speedrunning game. Compete against yourself, your friends or the top of the leaderboard. Play official levels, community maps, or create and share your own courses using the in-game level editor.

title: Applecalypse
description: Apples are not what they seem. Feed the neighbors until they are full and uncover a conspiracy in this unique point and click adventure that blends exploration of real photos with physics based challenges.

title: Void Roots
description: Void Roots is an autobattler Roguelite, widely influenced by the randomness. You'll find a range of upgradable tools , allowing you to manipulate your chances, and the choices you'll make will directly influence your progression.

title: Husk of Axiom
description: Husk of Axiom is a 2.5D turn-based psychological RPG, where human belief gives life to magic and monsters. As a secretive organization tries to erase pain from the world, a small party of unlikely heroes has to save reality by preserving not perfection, but the imperfect humanity that gives it life.

title: Ignoble
description: Destroy enemies and harvest blood, bones, and marrow to grow stronger, unlock forbidden skills, and wipe out the Ignoble tyrants who dare threaten your master.

title: Senatus
description: Strategic card battles in the heart of the Roman Senate. Debate, persuade, and rise through the ranks to become Consul of Rome. Influence is power — and power decides everything.

title: Boykisser Collection
description: A bundle on Steam featuring akhsotoen's Boykisser games.

title: Food Truck Chef: Full Course Edition
description: In Food Truck Chef: Full Course Edition, you explore vibrant locations and unlock fresh levels, each introducing a brand-new lineup of special dishes to perfect. Packed with delicious recipes from around the world, this is a true culinary journey. From the lively sights of Oriental Street and the smoky goodness of BBQ Street to the sugary treats of Donut and Waffle Street, tackle every challenge and complete each cooking mission. Simple to pick up but tough to perfect, this high-speed cooking game features some mechanics that keep you on your toes.

title: Gacha Capsule Shop Simulator: Akihabara
description: Stock and manage your Gacha Capsule Machines in this shop simulator. Help your collectors chase rare pulls, welcome anime lovers, and turn Akihabara into a true gacha paradise. Build your own capsule figure collection aswell, from giant mecha robots and kawaii cat maids to iconic meme figures.

title: Endless Forest
description: You find yourself in an unending forest, trees as far as the imagination can reach. How did you get here? Where even are you? At this point you are really only left with one option, chop trees and hone your senses as you venture through the mysterious forest.

title: Obscure Horrors
description:
8 obscure horror games, based on surrealism, psychology, depression, fantasy, existentialism, analog horror and fear of all kinds.

Ossa:
A surreal psychological horror game about the mind escaping from a dying body.

Mosquito Face:
A psychological horror game about John and the invasion of mosquitoes.

Timore Solum:
Short horror game about sadness.
Stay. Cry.

Queen Of Cards:
The game that tells you your future.
Play at your own risk.

Dia:
There is nothing scary ahead.
No sudden noises.
No flashing images.
No one will follow you.
Welcome to Dia.

Garrison Broadcast:
An existential horror game about a post-apocalyptic technology driven world.

From Me, To You:
'Death is an opportunity'

Analog Sammelot:
Analog horror in a dark dungeon, answer the questions on the TV screen and maybe you'll be set free.

The collection comes with a launcher game, featuring each game as an in-game physical box, bringing the retro atmosphere and visuals.

title: Trick x Trick
description: Supernatural × Mystery × Death Game: Twelve high school students awaken trapped in a mysterious building. To escape, they must identify the mastermind by vote—choose wrong, and someone is executed. Each student has a unique supernatural power. Uncover the truth and reveal the mastermind.

title: Find Kittens 9: Aliens
description: Explore a mysterious alien world, find cute cats, and paint black-and-white locations with bright cosmic colors.

title: Rogum: A Cat Match Puzzle
description: Rogum A Cat Match Puzzle is a puzzle adventure where you help a clever cat escape a mysterious dream world. Match blocks, race against the rising water, and face obstacles across mysterious islands. With 50 levels, it challenges your memory, focus, and quick reactions. Can you save the cat?

title: Puzzle Cozy
description: Puzzle Cozy - pleasant atmosphere, relaxing music, complete tranquility.

title: Sunken Seeker
description: Sunken Seeker is a short, first-person underwater horror experience. Forced to pilot a decaying submersible, you have 7 days to pay off a massive debt. Navigate pitch-black waters, scan for salvage beyond your headlights, and survive the shift before the Director cuts your life support.

title: Spider Roulette
description: Spider Roulette is a tense online party game where 2-4 friends take turns flipping cups, trying to avoid finding each other's spiders..

title: Hungrities
description: In Hungrities, you will take care of small and adorable creatures while attracting new visitors who will explore your farm! Play and interact with your cute creatures: drag them, squeeze them, or stop them if they start fighting each other. Have fun while expanding your collection!

title: Stick Out!
description: Stick Out! is a precision platformer where you must use a spear to overcome obstacles by sticking yourself to walls and surfaces. Collect coins, buy skins, earn stars, and break time records! Can you complete every level?

title: Robotic Arm Simulator
description: Control real-time physical simulation control and transform into a robotic arm operator. Challenging millimeter level grasping tasks in multiple precision industrial scenarios, any operational jitter could trigger a chain of disasters!

title: The Joy of Putting
description: Relive the era of Flash mini-golf games on more than 54 holes based on real courses! And do it... for The Joy of Putting!

title: Fast Food Rage
description: Welcome to a universe where cheese is deadlier than lasers and extra bacon counts as heavy armor. Evil mutant pizzas have invaded your home planet, melting cities, clogging arteries and plotting to steal every spice in existence.

title: Colorful Tower of Hanoi
description: Tower of Hanoi: ancient mathematical puzzle/intellectual casual game, legend says it can end the world. Retains classic gameplay with innovations—offers 1-64 difficulty levels, random openings, and auto mode. Stars light up as you play,finally transformed into unknown elfs.

title: Loot Scoot
description: LootScoot is a fast, team-based cops-and-robbers game. Thieves break into shops and deliver cash; Cops patrol, chase, and arrest. Beat the clock with chaotic plays or go stealth and slip past patrols. Pick a side, outsmart the other, and sprint for the win.

title: Retr0Mine
description: A modern take on Minesweeper with quality-of-life features. Save your progress, use hints, and customize gameplay settings to your liking. Whether you're a veteran or newcomer, enjoy a polished experience that honors the classic.

title: Avalon Crew
description: A cooperative sci-fi horror adventure where players must work together to find a rescue capsule on a space station under alien invasion. Players team up online to navigate the darkness of the space station. Players can find and carry only one item at a time to fend off invaders, clear paths, and open gates. Success hinges on effective communication and collective problem-solving.

title: Geobeast
description: Test your geography skills with Geobeast! Find as many countries as you can in 12 minutes, master two unique game modes, and climb the global Steam leaderboard.

title: Voice of Nature
description: Welcome to Moonspring Vale! your new life in another world after you got summoned by a little witch girl. Join Adventure Guild, buy abandoned farm, take care of animals, plants flower fruits and veggie, meet new friends, find love and explore unknown area. New Journey is waiting for you.

title: Akairu: A Day Adventure!
description: In a small Japanese open world, Akairu confronts Kaivee spirits that spreading mud sickens elders, including his mother. With a water gun, tools, and help from experts, he cleanses the land and restores life to the village.

title: Grems
description: Explore a cozy hand-drawn world where you use your camera to connect with quirky aliens called Grems. Each Grem has something unique to say about what you've captured, so gift your photos to build relationships and make new friends!

title: Ropuka
description: What does the grass hide? Ropuka is a nostalgic adventure into the unknown. Cut grass, explore meadows and forests, and get a chance to befriend wild creatures.

title: Hollow Bequest
description: As a legendary detective, the disappearance of a former mentor provokes a return to your humble beginnings. Every clue reveals the dark secrets that haunt the town. What should have been a quick investigation gradually became a struggle for your life and freedom. Who or what is responsible?

title: Tumor Necrosis Factor: Amen
description: Tear through the decaying Earth as a mutant half-worm in this arcade-inspired rail shooter! Branching paths, fast-paced gameplay, and lots of gore: a blood-smeared love letter to the classics of old.

title: Pinball M: Bethesda Pinball
description: Bethesda Pinball combines three stunning tables based on the most iconic Bethesda franchises: Fallout Pinball, DOOM Pinball, The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Pinball.

title: Kiln
description: An online, multiplayer, pottery party brawler from Double Fine Productions. Grab your friends to assemble a team of colorful spirits, then sculpt ceramic battle armor on a pottery wheel. The size and shape of your pots determine their play-style and abilities—work together to douse the enemy's kiln!

title: Juniper: A Scrapbooking Adventure
description: A cozy adventure-platformer featuring several small but dense "open-world" islands. Jet around, photographing oddities, befriending eccentric locals, and personalising your scrapbook. Use your camera to uncover hidden secrets, and place objects in your scrapbook to influence the world.

title: Saraab
description: In this atmospheric visual novel, every decision shapes Elham’s destiny. Will you help Elham find lost sibling and reclaim her own power? or will she be consumed by the darkness

title: Léo
description: Wander the rooftops, alleys, and parks of Montréal on a laid-back quest to finish your growing to-do list. Léo is a squirrel on a mission to help local animals, uncover hidden spots, and explore the city in this curiosity-driven exploration game.

title: Fossil Quest
description: Fossil Quest is a cozy fossil‑digging life sim where you travel to dig sites, excavate bones, and assemble exhibits to build your own dinosaur museum. Upgrade tools, decorate your home, and curate displays before opening the museum to visitors in a relaxed, collectible‑focused experience.

title: Oh No! UFO!
description: Join Cosmo and P.E.A. as they write the first intergalactic planetary guidebook about the Earth. Explore the planet, meet interesting life forms, lend a tentacle when you find trouble, and get up to a lot of shenanigans along the way.

title: Chop Chains
description: Chop Chains is a relaxing incremental game where you chop, gather, and upgrade to become the ultimate lumberjack through trees, axes, and skills.

title: The Donut Gallery
description: The showcase of student donuts and other 3d models from their stemmersion class.

title: Nahi's Winter Holidate
description: Nahi's Winter Holidate is a short yuri romance visual novel with multiple endings and a slice-of-life setting. Step into the shoes of a sleepy vampire doing her best to win a date to a local festival in a story revolving around real VTubers!

title: No Reason To Climb
description:
A simple yet challenging 2D platformer about climbing for absolutely no reason.

Jump, dodge, and keep climbing in a world where the only goal is to reach as high as possible. There is no reason, no epic story… the characters simply do it. Why? Nobody knows.

Explore 5 different worlds, each more difficult than the last. As you progress, new enemies, deadlier obstacles, and tougher challenges will appear, putting your precision and skill to the test. One small mistake can make you fall… and lose all your progress.

This game is perfect for casual players looking for a challenge, as well as speedrunners trying to complete the game as fast as possible.

title: Monopoly: World Cup France 98 Edition
description:
This release of Monopoly celebrates the national teams that participated in the 1998 World Cup (soccer). The usual tokens are replaced with little soccer players ; the coloured properties are no more streets but national football grounds ; the four stations are now the top four French venues for the 1998 World Cup. Also, green houses and red hotels are replaced by red terraces and blue stadiums. Up to six human players can play at once on one computer, their names can be edited.

Most of the game is still the same but there are some extra features in this version. When you pass go you are allowed to take penalties, which when successful allow you to throw an extra dice. And teams can degrade in value which cause them to shift around on the board.

title: Hourfall
description: Hourfall is a fast-paced character-action RPG where you wield three unique clock hand blades, fight fantastic servants of Time, and race against a ticking timer while in combat.

title: 101 Dogs Hidden in Madrid
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in Madrid in the hand-crafted landscape. Earn tons of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: 101 Cats in Vancouver
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Vancouver landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: 101 Cats in Naples
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Naples landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: 101 Dogs Hidden in Tokyo
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in Tokyo in the hand-crafted landscape. Earn tons of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: Increbraintal
description: Increbraintal is an incremental game based on protecting your brain from hordes of viruses that defeat you every round.

title: Pairvo
description: Pairvo is a satisfying roguelike card game where you memorize cards revealed at the start of each phase, discover rule cards that change the game's mechanics, and chase high scores with fluid combos, making every round and run feel unique.

title: Silliards
description: A 3D physics-based game where you must explore a variety of absurd levels through the mind’s eye of a budding billiards monk. Do you have what it takes to reach Billiards Nirvana?

title: Project: Doors
description: What if every door opened into a world that shouldn’t exist? Project: Doors throws your squad into a shifting maze packed with traps, anomalies, and creatures you’d rather not meet. Stick together, solve strange puzzles - and try to escape in one piece

title: MCSR Ranked
description: MCSR Ranked is the best place to learn and play Minecraft speedrunning. Practice with friends, compete for elo, and climb the ranks – First to beat the game wins.

title: Growing Things Up: Season 1
description: An adult visual novel about desire, trust and the secrets we try to hide even from ourselves. In South Lake, every choice reveals scars, silent manipulations and paths that bring you closer to or further from who you truly are.

title: Xiongguan Mandao, Yi Meng Wan Li
description: Find a way out, for a dream that never fade away.

title: Monolithus
description: Play a slow paced puzzle. A charm and onirical ambience will help you focus to find your way trough various levels and discover all the cubes that offers new mechanics overtime.

title: Escape from the Black Monolith
description: ESCAPE FROM THE BLACK MONOLITH is a short but tough fast-paced shooter that lets you GUN your way down the face of a SKYSCRAPER. Unlock several weapons, dodge enemies peeking through windows, and shoot down flying threats! Initially made by a solo developer for a game jam, then enhanced for Steam.

title: Plush Rangers
description: Survive waves of wacky mutated constructs and defeat powerful bosses with your team of Plushie friends in this quirky chaotic Survivors-like. Collect loot! Acquire merit badges! Dodge and dash your way to victory!

title: Koromeke
description: Koromeke is a game of simple rules and rich tactics which forces you to think on your feet. Collect enough jewels to survive your laps around the looping board, choosing from over 50 different upgrades to make every run unique. With limitless mind-bending synergies to discover, can you find the combos that tip the odds back in your favor?

title: Bad Eye Deer
description: Bad Eye Deer is a point and click survival horror game where you survive 3 nights, manage your 'energy' and 'temperature' levels, and keep your own eye out for any incoming threats.

title: Babulya
description: Babulya – that’s what grandchildren affectionately call their beloved grandmother. But what if your Babulya is no longer human, but a bloodthirsty monster? You came to taste her pies… and she wants to taste you instead…

title: Astro Party EX
description: Shoot first, then run 'em over

title: Dragon Spira
description: Master the board game with Spirit Beasts in a pixel-art fantasy RPG!

title: The Empty Halls
description: The Empty Halls is a VHS analog horror exploration game inspired by the idea of liminal spaces. Explore eerie Backrooms-style environments, record strange anomalies with your VHS camera, and complete missions assigned by the anonymous higher ups.

title: Ancient Maze
description: A 3D survival exploration game set in a mysterious ancient labyrinth. Unravel the truth in Story Mode, or descend endlessly through procedurally generated mazes. Dynamic fear and environment systems create a tense, ever-changing experience.

title: Level 37: The Ritewood Anomaly
description: Level 37: The Ritewood Anomaly is a first-person found-footage horror game set in a distorted imitation of the Backrooms' poolrooms. As David, a Fluxora Dynamics intern, you follow the lost log tapes of Paul Ritewood through shifting halls, flooded corridors, and the surreal poolrooms.

title: Running Horror
description: A first-person horror game where you must explore a vast labyrinth, evade a relentless demonic Beast, and find trapped survivors to reverse a miscast spell and escape.

title: Dead Zombie
description: Dead Zombie is a top-down survival shooter set in a dark city at night. Fight zombies and mutated monsters using a pistol, SMG, and flamethrower, explore the environment with a flashlight, rescue survivors, collect ammo, destroy obstacles with bombs, and escape by reaching the evacuation helicopter.

title: Forza Horizon 6: Deluxe Edition
description: Forza Horizon 6 Deluxe Edition includes the full game, Welcome Pack and Car Pass (30 cars delivered to your game, one per week).

title: Forza Horizon 6: Premium Edition
description: Forza Horizon 6 Premium Edition includes the full game with Early Access - Play 4 days early starting May 15, and VIP Membership, Welcome Pack, Time Attack Car Pack, and Car Pass (30 cars delivered to your game, one per week), as well as the Italian Passion Car Pack and two Premium Expansions coming post-launch.

title: Andy Runner
description: An endless runner made by NoelleW and AidenV, based off Andyland. It has unique abilities, bosses, characters, etc.

title: Galactic Overthrow
description: Conquer the galaxy in this streamlined space conquest and empire management game. With the heart of a classic 4x experience, but with campaigns that can be finished in one short sitting. Play any way you want: Open ended sandbox, race against bots, multiplayer vs friends, and more.

title: Ashentia Hauntings
description: Ashentia Hauntings is a 2D top-down survival horror game based on the story of a paranormal enthusiast called Noah, who decided to investigate the various haunted locations of Ashentia, a place that is surrounded by hills and forests.

title: Moved In
description: A short horror game where you unpack in a new house and experience paranormal occurrences.

title: The Lucky Stray Cat
description: “The Lucky Stray Cat” is a hybrid Dungeon Crawler and Visual Novel, told through an urban horror narrative reminiscent of Junji Ito's storytelling style.

title: Samuel Prince Attorney at Law: Chapter 3
description: The third of seven chapters of a courtroom battle style visual novel, in which the story follows brand new lawyer Samuel Prince as he solves a strange variety of different crimes. Acquire evidence by investigating the crime scene, then use it in court when cross examining witnesses to cleave through all the lies and find your way to the truth. In this chapter, Samuel Prince becomes newly acquainted with a senior college student, but a new case ends up enveloping the both of them.

title: Beast's Bane
description: In the shadowed depths of the cursed forest, a brave warrior bound to face the lurking monsters takes your place. Will you break the curse and restore peace, or succumb to the darkness? The fate of the realm lies in your hands!

title: Bit//Cycle
description: bit//Cycle is a fast-paced top-down rogue-lite where you cleanse a corrupted computer system. Move fast as the heroic bit, or risk shrinking away to nothing. Procedural levels, grid-based movement, and permadeath make every choice matter.

title: Unstrange
description: You are an 11-year-old child. Every month, your mother leaves you at your grandmother’s isolated house, far from the city and surrounded by silence. It has always felt like a routine—quiet, lonely, but safe.

title: Codex Arcana: Grimoire of Monsters
description: Summon an army of Monster Girls to face your enemies in strategic battles! Defeat the Dark Lord's minions and expand your collection with cool, fierce and cute Monster Girls of all variety in this "Capsule Monsters" inspired game!

title: Dadum The Dice
description: Plan, roll and outsmart your enemies in this turn-based tactical puzzle adventure. Show a higher number to defeat foes, discover new mechanics in every world, and face challenging bosses that twist the rules. Think ahead, take your time… and master the Great Die.

title: Cartapli: Fold Quest
description: Cartapli is a turn-based battle game that combines a strategic roguelike with unique paper-folding puzzles. Fold the paper to shift positions and defeat all enemies!

title: Heavy Metal Death Can
description: Heavy Metal Death Can is a Retro-Inspired Survival-Horror game set on a submarine in an alternate late-70s Swedish setting. Trapped beneath the ocean, you must fight against the terrifying Sludge which has turned your crew into Zombies. Look for survivors and uncover the truth behind the madness.

title: Boxed Up!
description: The Box Company is excited to hire you as our new Box Sorter! Act as our champion of quality, destroying discrepant packages, and keeping our service faultless and troll free!* *The Box Company denies any and all claims of trolls infiltrating our packaging. Such claims are without evidence.

title: Champions Stable: Equestrian Dynasty
description: Champions Stable: Equestrian Dynasty is the ultimate horse racing management experience. Train, breed, and race your champions across world-famous tracks, or ride freely in a breathtaking open world with stunning visuals.

title: Cyber Sprinters
description: Ready to get a new highscore? This endless runner is all about avoiding obstacles by jumping, sliding, and dodging for as long as you can while the running speed steadily increases.

title: Deceptiive Love Ballad The Blasphemer
description: Faced with aggressive detectives, I—"Zilin·SAI"—seemed unable to clear my suspicions. At the critical moment, a mysterious caller contacted me: "I can help you, but the price is to go to the mansion where 'demons' reside." A dark fantasy tale of mind games and romance begins now...

title: Myth of Valderit
description:
Myth of Valderit is a psychological horror experience set in the cursed village of Valderit, inspired by the abandoned Catalan village of La Mussara. You wake up as Nil, separated from your friends Julia and Enric, and soon uncover the dark secrets lurking within the village…

This single-player, first-person experience combines exploration, survival, and puzzle-solving. Nil must endure and remain alive, evading the fanatical devotees of an unimaginable entity.

title: Idle Monkey Theorem
description: **Idle Monkey Theorem** is a charming idle/clicker game that brings the famous *Infinite Monkey Theorem* to life. Watch as your adorable team of monkeys frantically type away on their typewriters, randomly producing words that against all odds slowly but surely recreate the complete works of William Shakespeare.

title: Underchoice
description: Underchoice is a survival simulator set in a sealed bunker. Become the overseer and shape the fate of those who come knocking at the door. Each decision you make, whether it is to let in a stranger, to use your resources on something, or to risk the safety of the bunker.

title: The Rot Below
description: Discover the secrets of a mad lich who thought themselves a god. Explore an ancient palace, a subterranean city of the undead, and an insane warlock's research hall. Includes three boss battles, a voice acted story, new weapons, and a host of new enemies. Foil Namira's plans and stop the coming rot.

title: Final Splash
description:
Final Splash is a chaotic multiplayer party game where the goal is simple: be the first to die!

The ocean has become so polluted that sharks refuse to live in it any longer.
So they figured if it’s the end, might as well make it spectacular!

Gather up to 4 friends and take part in a completely insane race to the death.
Charge into mines, blow yourself up, and do whatever it takes to be the first shark to bite the dust!

Final Splash: because saving the ocean is overrated better sink in style.

title: SM64 Coop DX: Bananza Kong
description: A mod which adds Donkey Kong, with his moveset from Donkey Kong Bananza, to SM64 Coop DX.

title: Goblin Company
description: Dig, build rail, and survive underground as a goblin miner for WHAAG MINING INC. Light your path or the darkness will drain your life. Explore fully destructible biomes, fight hostile creatures, and hunt the legendary Giant Nugget, solo or online co-op

title: Coin Slots Live
description: Interactive slots gameplay built for live streaming. Connect your Twitch channel and let your chat spin, earn, and participate in real time. Currently supports Twitch, with YouTube and Kick on the way. Participate in the game outcome during Early Access!

title: Adventurers Shop
description: Forge your legacy as both merchant and hero. Explore Zoldar, battle monsters for rare materials, and craft epic gear. Team up with friends to build a thriving shop in the village markets or arm yourselves to conquer the dangerous depths of the wild.

title: Palace of Poetry
description: A visual novel based on The Tale of Genji. The protagonist is a young woman who is thrust into a noble palace. She must make aquantince with the girls that live there and decide her future.

title: The First Spine - Arena
description: The First Spine Arena is an exhilarating online competitive board and card game. In this game, players place their unique cards on a board with the goal of reaching their opponent's side. Each card is generated according to the player's level, ensuring a balanced and challenging experience for all.

title: Flirting With Girls in Fantasy World
description: Your choices shape the story, deepening relationships and unlocking romantic paths. Experience a vibrant fantasy world brought to life with stunning hand-drawn monochrome art and a blend of adventure and dating sim mechanics.

title: Edelweiss Knights
description: Edelweiss Knights is a bite-sized tactical RPG, where players lead a trio of heroes against almighty creatures.

title: 101 Dogs Hidden in Los Angeles
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in Los Angeles in the hand-crafted landscape. Earn tons of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: Festival Journey: Highland Dreams - Collector's Edition
description: Join the Brooks on a vibrant puzzle journey through Edinburgh’s festivals—solve, explore, and capture the magic of Scotland!

title: Clicker Astro Planet
description: Clicker Astro Planet: collect energy, XP, eggs! Buy planets, level up, track stats!

title: The December Job
description: The December Job is a short first-person horror stealth game built with that classic feel. Navigate a maze like workshop filled with dimly lit hallways and storage rooms as you attempt to collect a target number of deserved gifts.

title: Rogue Slots
description: A deckbuilding roguelike, with a slot machine as your Dungeon Master. Spin to strike in a roguelike where every action comes from your custom slot machine. Load the reels with weapons, coins, and cursed relics, then let fate take the reel. Collect Knobs and trade them with your friends.

title: Madness Starts Young
description: You have stumbled upon a museum you might have not intended to find. But it called to you. And you realized you ended up someplace…roiling…alive. If you interact with the art, some speak while others hold bygone echoes. You’ve heeded the call. It’s up to you now to explore.

title: Seize the Cheese
description: Harness the power of explosions to propel yourself skyward and claim the biggest cheese, the Moon. Seize the Cheese, because you can never have enough cheddar!

title: Cozy Home
description: Cozy Home is a calm and relaxing organizer game where you can forget your daily stress and find peace by sorting, stacking, and organizing your items.

title: Mosaica: Arboreal
description: If "Diablo" and "Cookie Clicker" had a cute goblincore baby. An enchanting RPG mosaic puzzle where every mouse click evokes the mysterious power of nature.

title: Tornblade
description: Tornblade is a dark action game combining top-down exploration with direct side-scroll combat, inspired by the uncompromising spirit of classic games from the 80s and 90s, and shaped by Slavic and Celtic atmosphere.

title: Gemblades
description: A roguelite deckbuilder where you draft a deck of heroes called Gemblades and create satisfying synergies between them to save the world from the forces of Onyxion.

title: Gargoyle Garden
description: Sit back, relax, and grow many magical and mystical plants in your very own greenhouse! Collect rare plants, upgrade your tools, and earn enough money to unlock new greenhouses.

title: Gripless: Drift Valley
description: Indie drifting game with smooth arcade drift physics, multiple game modes and winding natural roads. Choose your tires wisely, adapt to changing weather and master every slide!

title: Umbra Flora
description: In a world where green has vanished, plant, grow, and fuse plants into fearsome creatures. Lead your farm-grown warriors in a turn-based strategy fight against the forces of nature.

title: Umpteenth Photo
description: Villagers are everywhere, and they need their photos taken. In Umpteenth Photo, you step into the worn shoes of a roaming retro photographer, snapping portraits for curious townsfolk and getting paid for every shot.

title: Sky Mates
description: Sky Mates is a turn-based, multiplayer-only 1v1 tactics game in which you assemble a team of deadly steampunk pirates to gain control over a crumbling airship.

title: The Another World
description: The Another World is a fantasy-themed adventure game where you have to defeat the monster king, but before that, you have to find a key to open each door to reach the monster king, and every time you look for the key, there will be monsters in your way! Be careful

title: Day Trader Tycoon
description: Play as a day trader gambling on people's pension money and try to beat the stock market. Engage in a comedic story with multiple endings. Meet different characters and get insider info to use for your own advantage. Gamble on cryptocurrency and quickly react to market events.

title: Little Fishing Idle
description: Cozy up with an idle fishing and sushi-making adventure on a peaceful raft. Relax, catch fish, and enjoy the game's company as you go about your day.

title: Driving Rogue
description: Arcade driving meets roguelike chaos - fast, intense, and ridiculously addictive. In Driving Rogue, every run is a new story: the city keeps changing, and you’ll need pure focus to push your score to the limit. After each race, hit the shop and craft your build for the longest streak possible.

title: Shadows of Delusion
description: A first-person survival horror game inspired by the classics. Fight to survive against grotesque horrors and disturbing delusions. Manage your resources carefully in order to survive this retro style psychological nightmare.

title: Imperial Command
description: Imperial Command is a turn-based strategy board game inspired by classics like Risk. Conquer a hex-based map, build your economy, and battle friends or AI in multiplayer—fully playable on Steam Deck.

title: Pepper the Giant Purple Dog
description: In this twist on a harmless pet simulator, take care of Pepper, who happens to be a giant purple dog. But when things go awry, you will have to decide: how many lives is one good boy worth?

title: Parkour Paws
description: An action-packed parkour game

title: Next Patient
description: During a pandemic, you are a medical distribution officer at a controlled checkpoint. Review IDs, medical reports, and blood tests; approve or deny requests. Supplies are limited. Procedures are strict. The decision is yours.

title: Mice Crisis
description: Mice Crisis is a cute and chaotic action game where you play as a heroic cat on a mission to save the town! Hunt down swarms of mischievous mice, smacking corrupted predators, and saving the town in fast paced, adorable action!

title: CaraVanguard
description: A rogue-lite action RPG with co-op for up to 7 players. Choose from 7 classes, master 70+ weapons and 100+ skills, and battle through a world where elemental interactions can weaken—or empower—your enemies. Inspired by traditional action RPG's and classic titles.

title: Penguin Ascension
description: A cozy pixel-art idle clicker where you click for Fish, buy upgrades, trigger random events, and Rebirth for Golden Krill to unlock permanent prestige boosts and absurd arctic progression.

title: Panline
description: Welcome to post-scarcity! But you’re not on the list. Deliver to make a living off-grid while Panline, the abundance engine that keeps the city endlessly supplied, begins to change. Earn currency, favors, kit upgrades and work the runner scene to unlock new contacts and fixers.

title: Elzypon
description: Elzypon is metaphysical pedagogy disguised as a turn-based JRPG.

title: Doomtrain
description: Hell has gone CORPORATE! DemonCorp's evil executives force demons into eternal overtime. Armed with the powerful DOOMTRAIN, unionize Hell and free the demon workers. Build a medieval steampunk town, upgrade your train and turrets, unionize demon workers, and defeat DemonCorp's corporate overlords!

title: A Spiritual Adventure
description: A choice-driven adventure delivered primarily via text but also with graphics, focusing on a large breadth of possibilities as opposed to focusing on a core narrative. It contains many minigames with alternate gameplay.

title: Coney's
description: Coney's is a 1 or 2 player online co-op game where you work at an ice cream parlor that specializes in cones! Bake cones! Scoop ice cream! Serve with a smile! And at the end of your shift, don’t forget to clean up the store before you head home! Nothing bad will happen!

title: AonTheVoid Nevaeh
description: Aonaran Nevaeh is a first-person psychological horror puzzle experience focused on exploration, observation, and environmental problem-solving. Investigate a quiet suburban block, interpret cryptic signals, and complete a session-based run where mistakes trigger escalating manifestations.

title: Antpocalypse
description: Many ants have become infected by the cordyceps fungus and are attacking their queens! Place ants (towers) along the paths of zombie ants and hopefully save every queen! Features: - Bespoke 2D art and animation - Multiple biomes - Original music - Satisfying ant deaths - Charming environments

title: Bloodsaint 2
description: BLOODSAINT 2 is the most recent, barely playable, fast-paced, retro-hardcore, top-down arena-shooter minigame from Walter Machado.

title: Move Dash Rush
description: Move, dash and move again. Identify the most efficient route to complete the race more quickly. Will you be able to make it into the top 10?

title: Gun Swinger
description: Blaze away with blistering fast weapons! Never stop! Swing your self through a world without floors! No Fear! No Brakes! Gain upgrades to increase your ferocious velocity! Unlock new weapons! Solve puzzles! Or relax in the in-game level creator with endless fun and possibilities!

title: CM-SS13
description: The year is 2182, but the engine is from 2003. Join the Falling Falcons in a massive tactical deathmatch RP fest held together by spaghetti code and duct tape. Build bases, perform surgery, or evolve as the Hive. It's laggy, it's complex, and it is the most fun you will have dying in space.

title: Lucky Season: King of Fools - Collector's Edition
Bluegrass
description:
A spatial audio ASMR-narrative rhythm life-sim. Laid off, Linda is seeking peace on the Appalachian Trail. Guide her pulse as she unveils her Granny’s old hand-drawn illustrations and makes new memories in this relaxing spatial audio journey to Mt. Katahdin.

Bluegrass is an experiential episodic interactive audio narrative through the soundscape of Appalachia. In a linear adventure to Mt. Katahdin, tune your ears into the relaxing audio cues. Allow yourself to be guided by Linda's inner Conscience as you keep the heart pace steady by regulating her breathwork. Influence Linda's behavior via feedback at critical moments in this interactive theatrical.

title: C.A.R.S: Creating A Ridiculous Shitshow
description: A rebellious chaos sandbox where you weaponize junk, disrupt highway traffic, and engineer outrageous physics disasters to turn the morning commute into pure, glorious mayhem.

title: Worming from Home
description: Be the Worm of Wall Street in this silly simulation game about working a remote finance job. Throw your spineless body around the keyboard to invest in the stock market and earn obscene amounts of money. Buy upgrades, train skills, and worm your way up to the promotion you've always dreamed of!

title: Akai Hana
description: An interactive manga featuring art and story written by Yoshiharu Tsuge. It was released as part of a series of interactive manga called MangaRom.

title: The Hero of Destiny Was Killed by the Final Boss
description: How many NPCs equal 1 Hero? In the land of Alta, The Hero of Destiny was fated to defeat a terrible Dark Wizard... but the Hero of Destiny was killed by the final boss. What now? Next to the final dungeon, in a sleepy village, 50 NPCs decide to take matters into their own hands.

title: Xenus Bug Eater
description: Survive and evolve your carnivorous alien plant, defending and hunting bug swatter style. Adapt as you see fit. Be careful though, you can attract more prey than you can handle, and they will be just as happy to eat you.

title: Gravity's Edge
description: Begin an epic space journey filled with strange worlds, engaging puzzles, and a dense Afro-punk theme. Another challenge also awaits you in 'Survival'. There you will face off against oncoming hordes while searching for the Ability Anvils. Are you ready to become a Kassler?

title: Crown Siege
description: A short incremental siege game centered around growing and strengthening an army to defend your kingdom. Seize the crown from an endless wave of enemies for your best chance at survival!

title: Killer Escape 4
description: Killer Escape 4 continues the series but also starts something new.

title: Need for Speed: Most Wanted - Pepega Edition
description: The Pepega Edition is a mod for Need for Speed Most Wanted that adds a bunch of memes and funny elements into the game, along with countless additions in regard to customization, cars and playable content. It changes everything including cars, textures, text, music, sounds, cutscenes and many other things. You will be able to play through a completely different career and challenge series as well as find a lot of changes within the game world along with completely new content!

title: Spirit Talk
description: Cozy visual novel about a lovely witch who’s able to talk to spirits in a fantasy setting. Using her powers, Julia helps her neighbors in their daily whereabouts. Craft potions, find the right time to use them and get to know both spirits and clients to find their peace.

title: MusicHell
description: MusicHell is an intense, level-based bullet hell where each projectile is synced to the music!

title: Tenshin Ranman: Happy Go Lucky!!
description: Censored Port of "Tenshin Ranman: Lucky or Unlucky!?"

title: War Drone
description: Tactical drone combat against infantry, armor, and air defenses. Control advanced drones, strike high-value targets, and dominate the battlefield from anywhere, your call. War is no longer fought on the ground. Operate combat drones, destroy high-value targets, and survive hostile airspace.

title: Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot - Daima Edition
description:
The DAIMA EDITION includes:
• DRAGON BALL Z: KAKAROT
• DAIMA: Adventure Through the Demon Realm Pack
- DAIMA: Adventure Through the Demon Realm Part 1
- DAIMA: Adventure Through the Demon Realm Part 2
• Pack Bonus: Ultimate Meat Feast, Mega Sacred Water, Purple Dino Horn, and Awakening Water

title: Multispy
description: Multispy promotional video game about the Fiat Multipla car.

title: Physio
description: Play as a bouncer determined to climb the social ladder of this world. Face the dangers of the nightlife, get work contracts increasingly risky, build a reputation with clubs, develop your skills and buy equipment to give yourself a brighter future.

title: Scary Stickmen
description: my first game made with godot, it kind of sucks. its a first-person horror game, dont expect much

title: Triple Pairing
description: HOOKSOFT's 27th project. The gimmick in this title is about navigating a love triangle.

title: Detective Dunkadoo
description: "Detective Dunkadoo" is a serious detective game. A blackmail has thrust the Well-Done supermarket into the spotlight. This crisis shatters the store and forces the employee Dunkadoo out of his passive routine. Can this bird see through the case and avert disaster before the impending doom strikes?

title: Cirno! Lifts a Boulder
description: Help Cirno get back into her home! A chill, bite-sized 3D platformer in which you explore a frozen Misty Lake and gain boulder-lifting strength.

title: Perceptum
description: A psychological horror game where you play as a medium investigating the disappearance of a family. Explore a house with an oppressive atmosphere, close your eyes to hear the beyond, use your mirror to see what should not exist and uncover the truth hidden within its walls.

title: Van Stalker
description: Van Stalker is a short PSX-style horror game where you are followed by a mysterious van.

title: Bagarre
description: Bagarre is a competitive top-down PvP MOBA. The main gameplay is a Deathmatch, with RPG and gacha elements. Everyone starts with the same base character and theorycrafting is a core feature of the game.

title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - The Last Chieftains
description: Venture into medieval South America to command the Mapuche, Muisca, and Tupi through dense jungles and vivid landscapes in three epic campaigns where folklore, warfare, and endless intrigue collide.

title: Avenging Angel Hikari Akeldama
description:
Since the dawn of mankind, Heaven has been waging a war against the demonic forces of Hell through the use of child soldiers-turned-bioweapons known as "Angels".

The year is 201X. In the city of Bethel, when the leader of the St. Abraham's High School Angel Brigade, Hikari Akeldama, begins to unravel the dark truth of the war she's been fighting for years, what she discovers will drive a wedge between her and the rest of the platoon as she tries to find the answer to an age-old question:

Is it better to reign in Hell than to serve in Heaven?

title: Captain Contraption's Safari Park
description: Manage a safari park with a fully simulated ecosystem in a nostalgic tycoon sandbox with rewarding roguelite elements. Clone bizarre species, unlock new toys and design clever paths to guide guests through the attractions. Don't worry, there's only a small chance they'll become dinner.

title: Retrowave Barro Crazy Drift
description: Retrowave Barro Crazy Drift is a racing game with small cars and challenging tracks.

title: Floracide
description:
Take revenge for a terrible betrayal from a corrupt god who promised so much, yet took everything instead. "I have no body. I can't shed a tear for my lost sisters"

Floracide can be seen as a sequel to Floral Disaffect, but can also be understood alone.

title: Terraria: Bigger and Boulder
description: Terraria 1.4.5 is launching on January 27th, Bigger and Boulder than ever before!

title: Train Goes Right
description: A cozy physics based railroad simulator where you chop trees, drive trains, transport materials, and build track one rail at a time in the early steam age. The goal is simple: go right.

title: Hain
description: H.A.I.N: Heir of the Ancient Immortal Necromancer is an asymmetrical co-op horror/thriller game for 1–4 players. Explore hostile regions, collect ancient artifacts, and begin the final ritual. But one of you will become H.A.I.N, the betrayer, and trust will collapse.

title: Oily Tower
description: A tower nobody wants. Climb it anyways.

title: Cardoom
description: Cardoom is a roguelite deckbuilder where you start with a basic deck. You collect new cards and items that affect your gameplay as you go.

title: Nick's Text Adventure
description: Nick’s Text Adventure is a cruel text-based RPG where everything unfolds one line at a time. Spells lie, gear gets worse, fishing can hurt you, and enemies mock your choices. Nothing is fair, nothing is explained, and the game remembers.

title: Dot Art Logic
description: This game is for players who simply want to enjoy nonograms. There are no flashy effects at all, and it feels like solving paper puzzles from magazines using a mouse on your computer. It includes 1600 B&W puzzles sized 20x20 and 300 color puzzles up to 15x15, for a total of 1900 puzzles.

title: Jambredrek: Two Guns
description: A first-person action-adventure set in the 1990s. Play as a corrupt police officer as you move through story-driven locations, investigate crime scenes, and make morally questionable choices.

title: Zombie God
description: Zombie God is a roguelite strategy game where players take control of zombie hordes and use unholy powers to defeat increasingly difficult cities and their defences. Gather DNA research and mutate your zombies, enhancing them with special abilities to help you in your pursuit of world domination.

title: Reflector Sector
description: Your ball bounces off active blocks only. Switch the blocks, smash monster eggs. Watch out for momma monster!

title: Vector Sector
description:
Switch the walls to save your balls.

Inspired by the light-switching mini-game of pinball machines when the ball is about to pass through one of multiple paths.

title: Yoko no Hanashi
description: Yoko no Hanashi is a first-person survival horror game where you need to survive in an abandoned college with one of your chosen yandere: Yoto (male version) and Yoko (female version)

title: Crystal Garden
description: A classic-style match-3 puzzle experience with a soothing garden theme. Easy to play, rewarding to master, and perfect for short sessions or long, relaxing play.

title: LEGO Fortnite: Expeditions
description: LEGO Fortnite: Expeditions is a 4-player cooperative PvE action-adventure game within the LEGO Fortnite universe. Players enroll in the Supernova Academy, choose from distinct hero classes with unique abilities, and team up to complete structured missions against enemy forces led by the villain Mask Maker Daigo. The mode emphasizes squad-based combat, character progression, and mission objectives. It was launched on June 18, 2025, before shutting down on November 1, 2025, and having many of its core mechanics ported to LEGO Fortnite Odyssey

title: Every Morning My Alarm Clock Kills Me
description: Have you set your alarm for 07:00 yet? He was waiting for you too.

title: Serendipity Morning Mist: Dawn, Tobacco, Your Scent
description: Your girlfriend, Chisa Tsukiyama, suddenly decides to go study abroad. Every prolonged touch, every held breath, every slight burning sensation becomes silent proof that you still exist for each other, leaving marks in the room until the countdown ends.

title: ToWhere?
description: A 2D sandbox focused on exploration and automation. Construct production chains, optimize resource flow, and discover hidden mechanics shaping a self evolving world. Please don't fall that would be bad for your bones actually.

title: The Game Has Started
description: The Game Has Started is a horror indie murder mystery visual novel game. Investigate the murders, prepare for trials and build up different realtionships with characters! Game perfectly matches the aesthetics of old-retro visual novels. Face the trials, as *they* remember who you truly are.

title: Dirt Bike Motocross Stunts
description:
Go ahead and live out your bike stunt racing dreams with Dirt Bike MotoCross Stunts.

Ride your dirt bike on unusually challenging obstacle courses and try to complete all the levels, in this adrenaline action-packed , heart-thumping Dirt bike game.

title: Ravelle: Last Draw
description: What starts as casual matches in a humble café becomes a shared effort to protect a place that matters. Ravelle is a free-to-play turn-based strategy card game with visual novel elements, blending tactical card battles and personal character stories.

title: Sinyaya Boroda
description: Instead of sunny days, carefree relaxation, and dates, he has a “responsible” task ahead of him — to look after the sinister but seemingly empty mansion of the mysterious, absent owner whom everyone calls Bluebeard. Denis thought it would be easy, watering flowers and bored in silence...

title: Reverse Horizons
description: Navigate a monochromatic world of forgotten ruins as Pluma, a wanderer with the power to bend gravity. Reclaim lost colors and mend the fabric of reality in this contemplative puzzle-platformer where up is down, and the only path forward is through the impossible.

title: Dragon Ball: Xenoverse 3
description:
Step into a brand-new future Dragon ball universe filled with unique, original characters brought to life by Akira Toriyama, the original author of Dragon Ball. In Age 1000, journey through developed and vibrant West City. Explore the bustling city, encounter characters, and uncover exciting new stories.
Take your place in the story and experience what awaits in West City.
Guided into the ranks of the Great Saiyan Squad, you’ll fight alongside allies as events there begin to take shape.

title: Yesterday's Meat
description:
Finally, it happens: the girl you like, Kaori, confesses her feelings for you. Without hesitation, you accept, and together you begin a relationship so perfect it seems like a dream. Each date is filled with laughter, furtive glances, and a warmth you never thought you'd find.
But one day, Kaori invites you to her home. You hope for another step in your blossoming love story; however, as soon as you cross the threshold, everything changes. The atmosphere thickens, the shadows thicken, and the silences linger. What was once painted in bright pink slowly begins to decompose into something dark and disgusting.
Behind Kaori's perfect smile lies a secret. A secret so powerful it would destroy not only their relationship... but also their sanity.
Will you discover the truth about Kaori... or will you lose yourself in it?

title: Steamwrecked
description: Ascend the skies and escape the hot desert caused by humanities over usage of fossil fuels. Find blueprints, scavenge and craft items to build your airship to soar the skies up to society once more. Can you survive this tragedy or fall prey to the harsh nature of this decaying world?

title: 86'd
description: Order Up, Chef! Grow a ragtag goblin kitchen crew and cook disgusting dishes for detestable diners, where mistakes don't just cost time, they cost a goblin's life! Can you keep your crew from getting 86'd?

title: Machine Gun Knight
description: Machine Gun Knight is a fast-paced vertical roguelike shooter where reflexes, positioning, and a bit luck decide your run.

title: Dwarf Guild Mania
description: Lead your capitalist dwarves across new lands in search of gems and gold. Each game brings a unique experience in this procedural turn-based strategy. You must vanquish your enemies, prospect for gems, construct mines, dispatch spies, and risk it all. For the Guild!

title: Resident Evil: Code - Madman
description: "CODE: Madman" refers to the fan-made tech demo, a project aiming to recreate a playable duplicate of the 2002/2003 trailer versions of beta Resident Evil 4.

title: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight - Deluxe Edition
description:
Includes:
• Full Base Game
• Legacy Collection:
- Over 30 launch-day items included across 3 Themed Packs: Arkham Trilogy Pack, Batman Beyond Pack, Party Music Pack
- Each Themed Pack includes 7 suits (1 for each playable character), 1 Batmobile, and a set of 5 Batcave customization props
- 3-day Advanced Access

• Mayhem Collection*:
- Includes new Story Mission and Mayhem Mode featuring The Joker and Harley Quinn, along with a villain-themed Sinister Pack
- Break out of Arkham Asylum as playable characters The Joker and Harley Quinn in an all-new Story Mission
- Cause chaos on the streets of Gotham City in the all-new Mayhem Mode
- Sinister Pack includes 7 suits (1 for each of the original playable characters), 1 Batmobile, and 1 Batcave prop set

title: Did You Visit CommutatorApply
description: You will go blind in 291 days. Decide who gets a "Commutator" to survive in the new world. Four endings. Three are pure hell.

title: Banjo: Recompiled
description: Banjo: Recompiled is a project that uses N64: Recompiled to statically recompile Banjo-Kazooie into a native port with many new features, enhancements, and extensive mod support. This project uses RT64 as the rendering engine to provide graphical enhancements.

title: Banjo: Recompiled - Jiggies of Time
description: A port of Banjo-Kazooie: Jiggies of Time as a mod of Banjo: Recompiled.

title: Gods of Nowhere
description:
"You can't say no to Death. It's hard to when he's renting the room right above you."

Christmas Eve, 1998.

Ichabod, meek as any young man can be, stumbles upon a bed and breakfast in the middle of nowhere. The "Heilbronner Hof". Four strangers meet there and are changed for better or for worse.

In short: a visual novel with player choices leading to branching dialogues, scenes, and friendships to build on.

title: Dark Descent
description: Dark Descent is a 4 player multiplayer cooperative horror game where you and your friends venture into an old elevator, aiming to reach the deepest levels. However, the journey won't be without it's challenges.

title: Rise of the White Flower
description: Follow the adventures of Catherine Belrose in a world full of magic inspired by D&D. Will she be able to repay her debts and become a respected wizard? Or will she fail and become a slave? It is up to you.

title: Infinideer: Deerfinity
description: Infinideer: Deerfinity is the spiritual sibling to shameless frogger ripoff INFINIDEER. It's a whole lot like the first game, procedural levels, wacky vehicle AI and a loose understanding of how physics works.

title: Realms at War
description: Realms at War is a turn-based strategy game inspired by chess, where fantasy factions clash in PvP and PvE battles. Equip your forces, adapt to rogue-like challenges, and conquer diverse realms filled with ever-changing foes and environments.

title: Inganock of the Raging Flame: What a Beautiful People
description: A remaster of Inganock ReBORN with upgraded resolution and new features.

title: Residual Wilds
description:
Residual Wilds is an indie 2D action and exploration game with a pixel art style, set in a hostile and mysterious post-apocalyptic world.

You play as FV8, a robot who awakens alone in a land where civilization has long since vanished. As you journey through dangerous biomes, you will face strange creatures, manage limited resources, and uncover fragments of the story behind a broken world.

The game blends platforming, combat, and survival. It is not just about moving forward. You must choose when to fight, when to flee, and how to use what you find to increase your chances of survival. Exploration is essential, with hidden areas, environmental storytelling, and secrets scattered throughout the world.

Residual Wilds is developed by a single creator and focuses on delivering an atmospheric, challenging, and honest experience, where every step forward feels earned and every discovery matters. A lonely, harsh, and melancholic journey through a world that no longer waits for anyone.

title: Koikata: How Our Love Grows
description: An all-ages remaster of Koi Suru Kimochi no Kasanekata, with upgraded resolution, new features and Ichika route, which was not present in the original game.

title: Jukai Maze
description: Jukai Maze is a sci-fi suspense visual novel where every choice sends the story down a completely different path. Branching routes twist and diverge with each decision you make. Explore multiple endings, piece together scattered clues, and uncover the deeper truth that lies beneath them all.

title: Kotyxa
description: Kotiha is a visual novel parody. This is laughter, this is falsehood, this is pain, this is life.

title: Midnight Files: Missing in Forest Lake
description: Two teenagers go missing in the Forest Lake area after an incident at a roadside arcade. With local police focused on the suspect, you must find the victims by investigating the scene, gathering clues in the fog-covered area, and verifying leads in the database.

title: Odinochestvo Skufa
description: A real journey into the depths of yourself, an atmospheric immersion in the night city, soaked with rain, melancholy and the mysterious whispering of destinies. You are not just a reader, but the creator of your own story, a composer whose decisions are the chords that form the unique melody of fate

title: Versus One
description: Chaotic Party Action with Dark Witch Characters! Jump into a party game for up to 4 players, starring characters from The Legend of Dark Witch Episode 4! Play locally or online and compete in 6 fast-paced mini-games, where magic isn’t just for winning — it’s for messing with your friends.

title: Find My Mom
description: Find Your MOM

title: Pokémon Ranger Star
description: On this game you will embark on an adventure as a Pokémon Ranger, rescuing Pokémon, helping people, protecting the environment, exploring the world and solving mysteries! This game plays a little different when compared to the traditional Pokémon games. Here, each battle is in real time! You can command your Pokémon and your trainer to unleash powerful moves and dodge your enemy attacks! The game offers a beautiful region with amazing vistas, and biomes filled with unique Pokémon and secrets to find.

title: Ocean and Fish
description: Hanhai wakes up in an unfamiliar room, his calf inexplicably cut by a sharp object. As he investigates his surroundings, he discovers an unidentified male corpse in the bathroom, a mysterious room with an evil magic circle drawn on the floor... What exactly happened here?

title: Mystic Shroom
description: A tower defense game where we try to kill evil mushrooms in the forest.

title: Super Battle Golf
description: An online 1-8 player golf game where everyone plays at the same time. Swing, shoot, sabotage, and finish first by any means necessary in a free-for-all rush to the hole.

title: Rummix
description: Rummix is a fast, minimalist puzzle game inspired by Rummy. Slide rows and columns to create matches of equal numbers or consecutive sequences. Every move counts—fail to make a match in time and the run ends. Plan smart, chase high scores, and master the pressure.

title: Arc Aquarium
description:
Collect, place and merge living creature cards in this cozy 2D idle aquarium. Open card packs to discover freshwater and saltwater fish, shrimp, crabs, seahorses, jellyfish, plants and corals, then bring them to life in your tank.
Feed your creatures, collect the gold they earn, merge duplicate cards to raise their stars up to 10, and complete your collection book. Decorate multiple tanks with sand, backgrounds and lights, switch on night mode and relax with calm music.

title: Alarial's Blessing
description: Experience the tragic tale of three wandering mercenaries and the lonely goddess who wouldn't let them die. Fight challenging, turn-based battles and explore a continent of forgotten mysteries in this fresh twist on the JRPG genre.

title: Miko no Kanata: Curious Tales from Oguni Shrine - Zero
description: A prequel to Miko no Kanata featuring Koharu! Here is the origin story of the miko of Oguni Shrine.

title: Deathlust
description: Demon sisters Lyra and Lorelei are out for vengeance with a lust for death. Harvest the souls of the Angels and ascend the Overworld before your time runs out. Slay your way to ending the Deathlust curse in this Third-person Movement Shooter / Bullet Hell Hybrid.

title: Get Clucked
description: Run through chaotic roads! Dodge cars with up to 5 friends. Explore 12 levels, collect eggs, gems, and unlock over 20 hats to show off your style.

title: People Farm
description: People Farm is a God-sim game for the PC where you are an advanced alien that is in charge of a human conservation program. The people move about on all fours like animals, and you have genetically engineered animal-people that act as advisers.

title: Towerlings
description: Watch autonomous adventurers climb a 100-floor tower while you guide their fate through strategic intervention. No direct control — only decisions. Choose when to summon, strengthen, or protect, and decide whether to build an army or raise a few elite heroes.

title: Total Shift: Wheeled Rebellion
description: TOTAL SHIFT: Wheeled Rebellion is a PSX inspired arcade racer where you play as a unique cast of anthropomorphic characters. In this game it is not all about the speed of your cars. Instead it is about your skills! Select a character and listen to your engine sing as you race through small town USA. Carve through long forgotten backroads. Run from the law as your race through the streets of Annabelle. And maybe even uncover something sinister just beneath the town's picture perfect appearance...

title: Master of Monsters: Mado-ou no Shiren
Master of Monsters 4: Hikari to Yami no Souha
Asteroid 69
description: Rogue asteroids have been detected heading toward earth. You are the pilot of experimental spacecrafts to destroy the impending danger. Fight solo or up to 4 players. Outerspace is full of lethal rocks and strange creatures out to stop you. Don't let your planet down!

title: AstroDiner Manager
description: It is a fast-paced diner sim set on an asteroid where you serve alien customers, upgrade your restaurant, and uncover the mystery hidden beneath.

title: Manifest Anything
description:
Manifest Anything is a playable sandbox game where players create, explore, and play fully interactive games within the experience itself. Players control a character inside generated 3D environments, navigate worlds, test mechanics, and immediately play the games they build in real time.

Using an in-game project creator and an AI companion, players generate interactive worlds, gameplay systems, and scenarios directly inside the game. Creation and play are tightly connected: players can explore environments, trigger mechanics, and iterate on their ideas by playing them instantly rather than exporting to an external editor.

Gameplay includes designing core game systems such as menus, objectives, user interfaces, and win or loss conditions. Players define gameplay rules and outcomes, then playtest those systems inside the same session. Each project functions as a complete, playable game experience rather than a static builder.

The current version includes a project creator, playable demo environments, and AI-assisted systems for assembling maps, assets, gameplay mechanics, and basic progression. As development continues, additional environments, assets, driving mechanics, and gameplay systems are planned to expand the variety and depth of games that players can create and play

title: Sweet Home: Look and Find 5 - Collector's Edition
description: Step into a cozy world of hidden object fun, heartwarming stories, and the joy of creating your perfect home.

title: Barely Alive
description: A co-op survival party game - hunt your friends or survive until sunrise. Use the in game proximity VOIP and radios to form alliances...or betray.

title: Hanabira Ep1: When the Petals Fade Away
description: People say that somewhere far away there is a separate world where there is no place for suffering, but not a single living soul has yet confirmed this. A little girl named Sharlett faced unpleasant events and ran away from her family's house in despair, but she could not have guessed that she would fall into that separate reality about which so much is being said. The child will have to find out if this world is really so pure. Isn't she afraid to face the bitter truth? Is she ready to face the Rulers of this world? How scary is the darkness hiding behind the light of this universe?

title: Behind the Light: The Extraordinary Life of Luca Comerio
description: Behind the Light: The Extraordinary Life of Luca Comerio is an exploration game narrating the story of Lidia, an undergraduate trainee researching on films restoration. Following her old family house clearance, she finds some of her grandfather’s personal belongings, who actually was the assistant of Comerio. The player will have the chance to get passionate about Lidia’s adventures, learning film restauration techniques through different mini-games, also discovering the historical personality of Luca Comerio.

title: Feed The Queen
description:
FEED THE QUEEN is an active incremental game with a focus on strategic play and synergy-building.

Gather food to grow and evolve your colony. Hatch and upgrade different worker types. Discover new synergies. Optimize your production, customize your build, and feed the Queen ever-increasing amounts of food.

title: Ashbane
description: Ashbane is a turn-based tactical RPG where you lead a mercenary guild in a world that rewards power and punishes mistakes. Recruit and customize your warband, take on dangerous jobs or strike at rival guilds, and lead expeditions where every encounter has lasting consequences.

title: Chasing the Dawn
description: Chasing the Dawn is a joyous pixel-art strategy game, designed for families. In this vibrant, ever-shifting fantasy world, every playthrough is a unique new journey.

title: Migblock
description: An infinite Voxel Universe; A Solar Sandbox - at your fingertips.

title: ReBlade: The Death Spiral
description: You are a condemned Synthetic, marked for destruction and trapped in endless resets. In a cyberpunk world inspired by Chinese mythology, harness weapons, chips, and augments to cut through mechanical creatures. Each run brings you closer to breaking the cycle and unravelling the truth.

title: Alonitaire
description: Break the rules of solitaire in this atmospheric roguelike deckbuilder. Unleash forbidden sigils while the Jack of Spades begs for your help in secret. Forge game-breaking combos under the Joker’s watchful eye and uncover the truth behind the deck. Don’t investigate… just play.

title: Primal Reign: The Age of New Kings
description: A story-driven VR action adventure where you uncover lost tombs, battle dinosaurs, and clash with Nazi soldiers in a fight to rewrite history.

title: End of Everything
description:
End of Everything is a first-person open-world survival game set in a collapsing post-apocalyptic wasteland overrun by the infected. Players must scavenge for supplies, craft weapons and tools, build shelters, and manage survival needs while navigating a hostile and unforgiving environment.

The game focuses on grounded survival systems, atmospheric exploration, and emergent gameplay, with an emphasis on long-term progression rather than scripted experiences. Currently in Early Access, End of Everything is actively evolving, with ongoing updates aimed at expanding content, improving performance, and refining core systems.

title: Secret Love (Or Not?)
description: Secret Love (Or Not?) is a romance visual novel about a student whose ordinary school life changes after receiving an anonymous love letter. As several girls begin secretly expressing their feelings, the player navigates relationships and personal choices to find the person they care about most.

title: Directory Dungeon
description: A tiny dungeon crawler played right in the Windows File Explorer. Explore a monster and loot-filled dungeon by dragging and dropping your player folder into new rooms, equip powerful files, defeat terrible monsters, and banish evil once and for all.

title: Workhorse Desktop
description: A group of people who love goofing off at work created this desktop idle game. Characters continuously shuttle back and forth across the desktop to earn coins. With the coins you earn, you can move into a mansion, drive a sports car, or decorate your desktop taskbar.

title: Emoji Marble Dash
description:
emoji Marble Dash represents a new generation of Web3 gaming, where blockchain enhances rather than complicates the player experience. Officially licensed by the emoji company and built on Immutable zkEVM, the game demonstrates how true digital ownership can seamlessly integrate into competitive arcade racing.

The game features physics-driven marble racing, where players control emoji characters riding on top of rolling marbles. Unlike traditional racers, this momentum-based system creates skill-based gameplay where physics mastery determines victory across 6-player multiplayer competitions.

All Web3 features are completely optional. Traditional players enjoy the full racing experience without ever touching crypto, while Web3 enthusiasts unlock ownership features through simple Immutable Passport integration (email, Google, Apple ID login – no wallet setup required).

Items earned through gameplay can be minted as NFTs or SFTs and traded on the dedicated emoji marketplace. Immutable zkEVM's gasless transaction technology means players never pay blockchain fees.

Quick Race: Barrier-free entertainment with no blockchain requirements Ranked Mode: Competitive play with $EMJ token entry fees and cryptocurrency prize pools distributed to top performers.

emoji Marble Dash follows full MiCA (Markets in Crypto-Assets) compliance, ensuring regulatory adherence for the European market. The $EMJ token (ERC-20, 10 billion fixed supply) powers the ecosystem with a Token Generation Event scheduled for Q1 2026.

Developed by El Dorado Studio and published by Euronext-listed Crypto Blockchain Industries (ALCBI), emoji Marble Dash launches in early 2026, demonstrating that accessible Web3 gaming is achievable when player experience comes first.

title: Deceived of Joy
description: Step into a Psychological Horror Experience where you live in an apartment complex where the walls between reality and nightmares are crumbling. Run for your life, solve small puzzles and use items to help you survive.

title: Ghost Scout
description: Identify invisible ghosts using mundane and strange objects. Find the Anchor without getting killed, reveal the ghosts true form and attempt to get out alive.

title: Solar.Cross
description:
Expose political corruption in this narrative Solarpunk Picross Game where you complete nonogram puzzles in order to facilitate restoration projects undertaken by the Environmental Renewal Agency (ERA).

Play as Mateo, a naive 25 year old new hire at ERA who quickly finds himself in the midst of a secret ploy to uncover records of political corruption within ERA.

(Developed in 10 days for the Day Zero Games: Solarpunk Jam)

title: Zone 1-70
description: Lead a research team to explore and study a strange dimension while fending off the entities that inhabit the Zone. Manage your base and construct experiments and unique machines by harnessing the properties of multiple anomalies.

title: O.D.T: Escape Again... Or Die Trying
description: The Nautiflyus is on a mission to save Cali from a deadly epidemic using the mystical Green Pearl’s power. Disaster strikes, you crash atop a dark tower within the Forbidden Zone. It is up to you to restore the ship, survive and complete the mission. Can you escape the tower, or will you die trying?

title: 2 Cooks 1 Mess
description: 2 Cooks 1 Mess is a chaotic online cooking game where you manage a team of chefs, servers and cleaners with unique skills. Cook, clean, serve and survive wild kitchen events as you climb from rookie to restaurant master.

title: Dinosaur Planet: Recompiled - Dinomod Enhanced
description: A port of Dinomod Enhanced for Dinosaur Planet: Recompiled.

title: Secret Love (Kari): Junai After Story
description: A fandisc for Secret Love (Kari).

title: Headsrest
description: As the time abrased universe approaches heat death, agent Off-White is sent among an elect to fruit a rebirth of the cosmos with their soul as fertilizer.

title: SM64 Coop DX: Extra Characters Plus
Drug Farmer Simulator
description: Drug Farmer Simulator plunges you into a gritty, atmospheric world where a small shop and hidden grow room can grow into a thriving underground business. Start with a few seedlings and slowly build your operation, experimenting with production, managing customers, and shaping your reputation. Every jar, every seedling, every bill is in your hands, making every choice matter.

title: Doom but its Half-Life 2
description: Play as Gordon Freeman going through Ravenholm in a DOOM art style

title: Call to Arms: Gates of Hell - Finest Hour
description:
From the early war “Blitzkrieg” in France to the final fights in Germany, this DLC offers the Commonwealth faction on the Western front. Re- live the British Empire’s Finest Hour in spectacular historical detail, in both multiplayer and singleplayer!
It features English, Scottish, Canadian and Polish forces, all with their own specific uniforms, equipment, voice acting and special perks.
A massive amount of multiplayer and singleplayer content makes this our largest DLC to date.

title: Necrotic Nightmare
description: Nightmare has descended on the starship Starfarer ETOS-1. Battle the hoards, defend the crew, resist the infection and uncover the truth in this first-person Sci-Fi horror shooter, harnessing powers, upgrading weapons, and battling to survive. The voices are calling you. Will you listen?

title: Simulation
description: Try and make as much money as you are able to or grow the biggest community you can, there is so much possibility in here to have fun. Manage them, give them tasks or put them to rest as the community grows bigger in this retro-styled management/simulation game.

title: Iseki
description: Embark on an ancient adventure, uncovering secrets in a 3D dungeon. Automatic combat based on Memory Threads, each with unique abilities. Manage fuel for exploration; depletion means retreat. Expand fuel, collect Threads, follow commands, and discover ancient mysteries.

title: Video Battle Arena
description: Which YouTube video is more popular or engaging? Pick a topic and guess which of two YouTube videos has more views or more comments. Test your social media skills: How many can you get right?

title: Stellar Dawn: Survivor
description: "Star Dawn: Survivors" is a survivor-like game. You will transform into a brave warrior and use high-tech weapons to fight against endless enemies. Explore the mysterious interstellar wilderness, and constantly unlock powerful upgrades to enhance your combat effectiveness.

title: Hentai Shinobi
description: Sexy shinobi puzzle game. Solve 15-puzzle, swipe and rotate modes to reveal spicy art. Two difficulties and soothing music.
